Note on Kedāra

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
ekadā tu tadā tena yajñaḥ prāraṃbhito mahān..
tatrāhūtāstadā sarve dīkṣitena tapasvinā.. 2.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
एकदा तु तदा तेन यज्ञः प्रारंभितो महान्..
तत्राहूतास्तदा सर्वे दीक्षितेन तपस्विना.. 2.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Once, at that time, a great sacrifice was undertaken by him; / all were then summoned by that initiated ascetic. (2.1)

1.3.s:
ṛṣayo vividhāstatra vaśiṣṭhādyāḥ samāgatāḥ..
agastyaḥ kaśyapo'triśca vāmadevastathā bhṛguḥ.. 2.2 ..
1.3.d:
ऋषयो विविधास्तत्र वशिष्ठाद्याः समागताः..
अगस्त्यः कश्यपोऽत्रिश्च वामदेवस्तथा भृगुः.. 2.2 ..
1.3.m: Various seers assembled there, headed by Vasiṣṭha: / Agastya, Kaśyapa, Atri, Vāmadeva, and Bhṛgu; (2.2)

1.3.s:
dadhīco bhagavānvyāso bharadvājo'tha gautamaḥ..
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ samājagmurmaharṣayaḥ.. 2.3 ..
1.3.d:
दधीचो भगवान्व्यासो भरद्वाजोऽथ गौतमः..
एते चान्ये च बहवः समाजग्मुर्महर्षयः.. 2.3 ..
1.3.m: Dadhīca, the venerable Vyāsa, Bharadvāja, and Gautama; / these and many other great seers arrived. (2.3)

1.3.s: tathā sarve suragaṇā lokapālastathā'pare vidyādharāśca gaṃdharvāḥ kiṃnarāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ.. 2.4 ..
1.3.d: तथा सर्वे सुरगणा लोकपालस्तथाऽपरे विद्याधराश्च गंधर्वाः किंनराप्सरसां गणाः.. 2.4 ..
1.3.m: Likewise all the hosts of gods, the guardians of the worlds, and others— / vidyādharas, gandharvas, and troops of kinnaras and apsarases. (2.4)

1.3.s:
saptalokātsamānīto brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ..
vaikuṃṭhācca tathā viṣṇuḥ samānīto maravaṃ prati.. 2.5 ..
1.3.d:
सप्तलोकात्समानीतो ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः..
वैकुंठाच्च तथा विष्णुः समानीतो मरवं प्रति.. 2.5 ..
1.3.m: Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, was brought from the seven realms, / and Viṣṇu was brought from Vaikuṇṭha to the assembly. (2.5)

1.3.s:
devendro hi samānīta iṃdrāṇyā saha suprabhaḥ..
tathā caṃdro hi rohiṇyā varuṇaḥ priyayayā saha.. 2.6 ..
1.3.d:
देवेन्द्रो हि समानीत इंद्राण्या सह सुप्रभः..
तथा चंद्रो हि रोहिण्या वरुणः प्रिययया सह.. 2.6 ..
1.3.m: The resplendent Devendra was brought along with Indrāṇī, / and likewise the Moon with Rohiṇī, and Varuṇa with his beloved wife; (2.6)

1.3.s:
kuberaḥ puṣpakārūḍho mṛgā''rūḍho'tha mārutaḥ..
bastā''rūḍhaḥ pāvakaśca pretā''rūḍho'tha nirṛti.. 2.7 ..
1.3.d:
कुबेरः पुष्पकारूढो मृगा'ऽरूढोऽथ मारुतः..
बस्ता'ऽरूढः पावकश्च प्रेता'ऽरूढोऽथ निरृति.. 2.7 ..
1.3.m: Kubera mounted on the Puṣpaka, the Wind mounted on a deer, / Fire mounted on a he-goat, and Nirṛti mounted on a corpse. (2.7)

1.3.s:
ete sarve samāyātā yajñavāṭe dvijanmanaḥ..
te sarve satkṛtāstena dakṣeṇa ca durātmanā.. 2.8 ..
1.3.d:
एते सर्वे समायाता यज्ञवाटे द्विजन्मनः..
ते सर्वे सत्कृतास्तेन दक्षेण च दुरात्मना.. 2.8 ..
1.3.m: All these arrived at the sacrificial enclosure of the twice-born one; / they were all honored by him, the wicked-minded Dakṣa. (2.8)

1.3.s:
bhavanāni mahārhāṇi suprabhāṇi mahāṃti ca..
tvaṣṭrā kṛtāni divyāni kauśalyena mahātmanā.. 2.9 ..
1.3.d:
भवनानि महार्हाणि सुप्रभाणि महांति च..
त्वष्ट्रा कृतानि दिव्यानि कौशल्येन महात्मना.. 2.9 ..
1.3.m: Splendid, vast, and highly precious celestial dwellings / were fashioned with skill by the great-souled Tvaṣṭṛ. (2.9)

1.3.s: teṣu sarveṣu dhiṣṇyeṣu yathājoṣaṃ samāsthitāḥ.. 2.10 ..
1.3.d: तेषु सर्वेषु धिष्ण्येषु यथाजोषं समास्थिताः.. 2.10 ..
1.3.m: They took their seats at ease in all those mansions. (2.10)

1.3.s:
varttamāne mahāyajñe tīrthe kanakhale tathā..
ṛtvijaśca kṛtāstena bhṛgvādyāśca tapodhanāḥ.. 2.11 ..
1.3.d:
वर्त्तमाने महायज्ञे तीर्थे कनखले तथा..
ऋत्विजश्च कृतास्तेन भृग्वाद्याश्च तपोधनाः.. 2.11 ..
1.3.m: As the great sacrifice proceeded at the sacred ford Kanakhala, / the ascetic priests, headed by Bhṛgu, were appointed by him as officiants. (2.11)

1.3.s:
dīkṣāyuktastadā dakṣaḥ kṛtakautukamaṃgalaḥ..
bhāryayā sahito vipraiḥ kṛtasvatyayano bhṛśam.. 2.12 ..
1.3.d:
दीक्षायुक्तस्तदा दक्षः कृतकौतुकमंगलः..
भार्यया सहितो विप्रैः कृतस्वत्ययनो भृशम्.. 2.12 ..
1.3.m: Invested with initiation, performing auspicious rites, / Dakṣa, accompanied by his wife, had benedictory mantras chanted extensively by the brahmins. (2.12)

1.3.s:
reje mahattvena tadā suhṛdbhiḥ paritaḥ sadā..
etasminnaṃtare tatra dadhīcirvākyamabravīt.. 2.13 ..
1.3.d:
रेजे महत्त्वेन तदा सुहृद्भिः परितः सदा..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र दधीचिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 2.13 ..
1.3.m: He shone then in greatness, surrounded constantly by friends. / At that moment, Dadhīci spoke these words: (2.13)

1.3.s:
..dadhīciruvāca..
ete sureśā ṛṣayo mahattarāḥ salokapālāśca samāgatāstava..
tathā'pi yajñastu na śobhate bhṛśaṃpinākinā tena mahātmanā vinā.. 2.14 ..
1.3.d:
..दधीचिरुवाच..
एते सुरेशा ऋषयो महत्तराः सलोकपालाश्च समागतास्तव..
तथाऽपि यज्ञस्तु न शोभते भृशंपिनाकिना तेन महात्मना विना.. 2.14 ..
1.3.m: Dadhīci said: / All these lords of gods, exalted seers, and guardians of the worlds have arrived at your [sacrifice]; / even so, the sacrifice does not shine brightly without the wielder of Pināka, that great soul. (2.14)

1.3.s:
yenaiva sarvāṇyapi maṃgalāni jātāni śaṃsaṃti mahāvipaścitaḥ..
so'sau na dṛṣṭo'tra pumānpurāṇo vṛṣadhvajo nīlakaṇṭhaḥ kapardī.. 2.15 ..
1.3.d:
येनैव सर्वाण्यपि मंगलानि जातानि शंसंति महाविपश्चितः..
सोऽसौ न दृष्टोऽत्र पुमान्पुराणो वृषध्वजो नीलकण्ठः कपर्दी.. 2.15 ..
1.3.m: He through whom alone all auspicious things arise, as the great sages declare— / that ancient Person, bull-bannered, blue-throated, matted-haired, is not seen here. (2.15)

1.3.s:
amaṃgalānyeva ca maṃgalāni bhavaṃti yenādhikṛtāni dakṣa..
triyaṃbakenātha sumaṃgalāni bhavaṃti sadyohyapamaṃgalāni.. 2.16 ..
1.3.d:
अमंगलान्येव च मंगलानि भवंति येनाधिकृतानि दक्ष..
त्रियंबकेनाथ सुमंगलानि भवंति सद्योह्यपमंगलानि.. 2.16 ..
1.3.m: Even inauspicious things become auspicious when governed by him, O Dakṣa; / through the Three-eyed One, highly auspicious things become instantly [conferred], averting misfortune. (2.16)

1.3.s:
tasmāttvayaiva kartavyamāhvānaṃ parameṣṭhinā..
tvaritaṃ caiva śakreṇa viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā.. 2.17 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्त्वयैव कर्तव्यमाह्वानं परमेष्ठिना..
त्वरितं चैव शक्रेण विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना.. 2.17 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, an invitation must be sent by you, by the Supreme Lord [Brahmā], / and quickly by Śakra, and by the all-powerful Viṣṇu. (2.17)

1.3.s: sarvaireva hi gaṃtavyaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ.. 2.18 ..
1.3.d: सर्वैरेव हि गंतव्यं यत्र देवो महेश्वरः.. 2.18 ..
1.3.m: Indeed, all should go to where the god Maheśvara resides. (2.18)

1.3.s:
dākṣāyaṇyā sametaṃ tamānayadhvaṃ tvarānvitāḥ..
tena sarvaṃ pavitraṃ syācchaṃbhunā yoginā bhṛśam.. 2.19 ..
1.3.d:
दाक्षायण्या समेतं तमानयध्वं त्वरान्विताः..
तेन सर्वं पवित्रं स्याच्छंभुना योगिना भृशम्.. 2.19 ..
1.3.m: Bring him along with the daughter of Dakṣa with all haste; / by that Śambhu, the yogin, everything will become exceedingly pure. (2.19)

1.3.s:
yasya smṛtyā ca nāmoktyā samagraṃ sukṛtaṃ bhavet..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena samāneyo vṛṣadhvajaḥ.. 2.20 ..
1.3.d:
यस्य स्मृत्या च नामोक्त्या समग्रं सुकृतं भवेत्..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन समानेयो वृषध्वजः.. 2.20 ..
1.3.m: By remembering him and uttering his name, all merit becomes complete; / therefore, with every effort, the bull-bannered one should be fetched. (2.20)

1.3.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasannāha duṣṭadhīḥ..
mūlaṃ viṣṇurhi devānāṃ yatra dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ.. 2.21 ..
1.3.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहसन्नाह दुष्टधीः..
मूलं विष्णुर्हि देवानां यत्र धर्मः सनातनः.. 2.21 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that speech of his, the wicked-minded one laughed and said: / 'Viṣṇu indeed is the root of the gods, in whom the eternal dharma abides; (2.21)

1.3.s:
yasminvedāśca yajñāśca karmāṇivividhāni ca..
pratiṣṭhitāni sarvāṇi so'sau viṣṇurihāgataḥ.. 2.22 ..
1.3.d:
यस्मिन्वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च कर्माणिविविधानि च..
प्रतिष्ठितानि सर्वाणि सोऽसौ विष्णुरिहागतः.. 2.22 ..
1.3.m: in whom the Vedas, sacrifices, and various ritual acts / are all established—that very Viṣṇu has come here. (2.22)

1.3.s:
satyalokātsamāyāto brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ..
vedaiścopaniṣadbhiśca āgamairvividhaiḥ saha.. 2.23 ..
1.3.d:
सत्यलोकात्समायातो ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः..
वेदैश्चोपनिषद्भिश्च आगमैर्विविधैः सह.. 2.23 ..
1.3.m: Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, has arrived from Satyaloka, / along with the Vedas, the Upaniṣads, and the various Āgamas. (2.23)

1.3.s:
tathā suragaṇaiḥ sākamāgataḥ surarāṭ‌ svayam..
tathā yūyaṃ samāyātā ṛṣayo vītakalmaṣāḥ.. 2.24 ..
1.3.d:
तथा सुरगणैः साकमागतः सुरराट्‌ स्वयम्..
तथा यूयं समायाता ऋषयो वीतकल्मषाः.. 2.24 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, the king of gods has come himself, accompanied by the heavenly hosts; / and you, seers freed from stain, have assembled. (2.24)

1.3.s:
yeye yajñocitāḥ śāṃtāstete sarve samāgatāḥ..
vedavedārthatattvajñāḥ sarve yūyaṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ.. 2.25 ..
1.3.d:
येये यज्ञोचिताः शांतास्तेते सर्वे समागताः..
वेदवेदार्थतत्त्वज्ञाः सर्वे यूयं दृढव्रताः.. 2.25 ..
1.3.m: All those who are suitable for sacrifice and tranquil have arrived— / all of you firm in your vows, knowing the truth of the Vedas and the Vedic meaning. (2.25)

1.3.s:
atraiva ca kimasmākaṃ rudreṇāpi prayojanam...
kanyā dattā mayā viprā brahmaṇā noditena hi.. 2.26 ..
1.3.d:
अत्रैव च किमस्माकं रुद्रेणापि प्रयोजनम्...
कन्या दत्ता मया विप्रा ब्रह्मणा नोदितेन हि.. 2.26 ..
1.3.m: What need do we have for Rudra in this matter? / My daughter was given to him, O brahmins, only because I was urged by Brahmā. (2.26)

1.3.s:
akulīno hyasau viprā naṣṭo naṣṭapriyaḥ sadā..
bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ patireko duratyayaḥ.. 2.27 ..
1.3.d:
अकुलीनो ह्यसौ विप्रा नष्टो नष्टप्रियः सदा..
भूतप्रेतपिशाचानां पतिरेको दुरत्ययः.. 2.27 ..
1.3.m: For he is of no noble lineage, O brahmins, ruined and ever fond of the ruined; / he is the solitary master of ghosts, spirits, and flesh-eaters, uncontrollable. (2.27)

1.3.s:
ātmasaṃbhāvito mūḍhaḥstabdho maunī samatsaraḥ..
karmaṇyasminnayogyo'sau nānīto hi mayā'dhunā.. 2.28 ..
1.3.d:
आत्मसंभावितो मूढःस्तब्धो मौनी समत्सरः..
कर्मण्यस्मिन्नयोग्योऽसौ नानीतो हि मयाऽधुना.. 2.28 ..
1.3.m: Conceited, foolish, obstinate, taciturn, and full of malice, / he is unfit for this rite, and therefore has not been brought by me now. (2.28)

1.3.s:
tasmāttvayā na vaktavyaṃ punarevaṃ vacodvija..
sarvairbhavadbhiḥ kartavyo yajño me saphalo mahān.. 2.29 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्त्वया न वक्तव्यं पुनरेवं वचोद्विज..
सर्वैर्भवद्भिः कर्तव्यो यज्ञो मे सफलो महान्.. 2.29 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, such words must not be spoken again by you, O twice-born one; / you all should make my great sacrifice fruitful.' (2.29)

1.3.s: etacchrutvā vacastasya dadhīcirvākyamabravīt.. 2.30 ..
1.3.d: एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य दधीचिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 2.30 ..
1.3.m: Hearing these words of his, Dadhīci spoke: (2.30)

1.3.s:
..dadhīciruvāca..
sarveṣāmṛṣivaryāṇāṃ surāṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām..
anayo'yaṃ mahāñjāto vinā tena mahātmanā.. 2.31 ..
1.3.d:
..दधीचिरुवाच..
सर्वेषामृषिवर्याणां सुराणां भावितात्मनाम्..
अनयोऽयं महाञ्जातो विना तेन महात्मना.. 2.31 ..
1.3.m: Dadhīci said: / 'A great injustice has been committed against all the foremost seers and the purified deities / without that great soul. (2.31)

1.3.s:
vināśo'pi mahānsadyohyatratyānāṃ bhaviṣyati..
evamuktvā dadhīco'sāveka eva vinirgataḥ.. 2.32 ..
1.3.d:
विनाशोऽपि महान्सद्योह्यत्रत्यानां भविष्यति..
एवमुक्त्वा दधीचोऽसावेक एव विनिर्गतः.. 2.32 ..
1.3.m: A great destruction will instantly befall those present here!' / Having spoken thus, that Dadhīca departed alone. (2.32)

1.3.s:
yajñavāṭācca dakṣasya tvaritaḥ svāśramaṃ yayau..
munau vinirgate dakṣaḥ prahasannidamabravīt.. 2.33 ..
1.3.d:
यज्ञवाटाच्च दक्षस्य त्वरितः स्वाश्रमं ययौ..
मुनौ विनिर्गते दक्षः प्रहसन्निदमब्रवीत्.. 2.33 ..
1.3.m: And from Dakṣa’s sacrifice-enclosure, he went swiftly to his own hermitage. / When the sage had departed, Dakṣa laughed and said this:

1.3.s:
gataḥ śivapriyo vīro dadhīcirnāma nāmataḥ..
āviṣṭacittā maṃdāśca mithyāvādaratāḥ khalāḥ.. 2.34 ..
1.3.d:
गतः शिवप्रियो वीरो दधीचिर्नाम नामतः..
आविष्टचित्ता मंदाश्च मिथ्यावादरताः खलाः.. 2.34 ..
1.3.m: "He who is dear to Śiva, that hero named Dadhīci by name, has gone. / Possessed in mind, dull-witted, devoted to falsehood, wicked,

1.3.s:
vedabāhya durācārāstyājyāste hyatra karmaṇi..
vedavādaratā yūyaṃ sarve viṣṇupurogamāḥ.. 2.35 ..
1.3.d:
वेदबाह्य दुराचारास्त्याज्यास्ते ह्यत्र कर्मणि..
वेदवादरता यूयं सर्वे विष्णुपुरोगमाः.. 2.35 ..
1.3.m: outside the Vedas, of evil conduct—they are to be abandoned in this rite. / You who are devoted to Vedic doctrine, all headed by Viṣṇu,

1.3.s:
yajñaṃ me saphalaṃ viprāḥ kurvaṃtu hyacirādiva..
tadā te devayajanaṃ cakruḥ sarve saharṣayaḥ.. 2.36 ..
1.3.d:
यज्ञं मे सफलं विप्राः कुर्वंतु ह्यचिरादिव..
तदा ते देवयजनं चक्रुः सर्वे सहर्षयः.. 2.36 ..
1.3.m: make my sacrifice fruitful, O brahmins, without delay!" / Then all those [gods] along with the ṛṣis performed the worship of the gods.

1.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare tatra parvate gaṃdhamādane..
dhārāgṛhe vimānena sakhībhiḥ parivāritā.. 2.37 ..
1.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र पर्वते गंधमादने..
धारागृहे विमानेन सखीभिः परिवारिता.. 2.37 ..
1.3.m: In the meantime, there on Mount Gandhamādana, / in a water-pavilion, in an aerial chariot, surrounded by her companions,

1.3.s:
dākṣāyaṇī mahādevī cakāra vividhāstadā..
krīḍā vimānamadhyastā kandukādyāḥ sahasraśaḥ.. 2.38 ..
1.3.d:
दाक्षायणी महादेवी चकार विविधास्तदा..
क्रीडा विमानमध्यस्ता कन्दुकाद्याः सहस्रशः.. 2.38 ..
1.3.m: Dakṣa’s daughter, the great goddess, then engaged in diverse / sports by the thousands, such as ball-games, seated inside the aerial chariot.

1.3.s:
krīḍāsaktā tadā devī dadarśātha mahāsatī..
yajñaṃ prayāṃtaṃ somaṃ ca rohiṇyā sahitaṃ prabhum.. 2.39 ..
1.3.d:
क्रीडासक्ता तदा देवी ददर्शाथ महासती..
यज्ञं प्रयांतं सोमं च रोहिण्या सहितं प्रभुम्.. 2.39 ..
1.3.m: Engaged in sports, the goddess, the great Satī, then saw / the lord Soma going to the sacrifice along with Rohiṇī.

1.3.s:
kva gamiṣyati caṃdro'yaṃ vijaye pṛccha satvaram..
tayoktā vijayā devī taṃ papraccha yathocitam.. 2.40 ..
1.3.d:
क्व गमिष्यति चंद्रोऽयं विजये पृच्छ सत्वरम्..
तयोक्ता विजया देवी तं पप्रच्छ यथोचितम्.. 2.40 ..
1.3.m: "Where is this moon going? Ask quickly, Vijayā!" / Commanded by her, the goddess Vijayā asked him as was fitting.

1.3.s:
kathitaṃ tena tatsarvaṃ dakṣasyaiva makhādikam..
tacchrutvā tvaritā devī vijayā jātasaṃbhramā..
kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ yaduktaṃ śaśinā bhṛśam.. 2.41 ..
1.3.d:
कथितं तेन तत्सर्वं दक्षस्यैव मखादिकम्..
तच्छ्रुत्वा त्वरिता देवी विजया जातसंभ्रमा..
कथयामास तत्सर्वं यदुक्तं शशिना भृशम्.. 2.41 ..
1.3.m: He related all that, namely Dakṣa’s sacrifice and the rest. / Hearing that, the swift goddess Vijayā, filled with excitement, / related fully all that had been spoken by the moon.

1.3.s:
vimṛśya kāraṇaṃ devī kimāhvānaṃ karoti na..
dakṣaḥ pitā me mātā ca vismṛtā māṃ kuto'dhunā.. 2.42 ..
1.3.d:
विमृश्य कारणं देवी किमाह्वानं करोति न..
दक्षः पिता मे माता च विस्मृता मां कुतोऽधुना.. 2.42 ..
1.3.m: Considering the cause, the goddess [thought]: "Why does he not invite [me]? / My father Dakṣa and my mother—why have they forgotten me now?

1.3.s:
pṛcchāmi śaṃkaraṃ cādya kāraṇaṃ kṛtaniścayā..
sthāpayitvā sakhīstatra āgatā śaṃkaraṃ prati.. 2.43 ..
1.3.d:
पृच्छामि शंकरं चाद्य कारणं कृतनिश्चया..
स्थापयित्वा सखीस्तत्र आगता शंकरं प्रति.. 2.43 ..
1.3.m: Having made up my mind, I will ask Śaṃkara today about the reason." / Leaving her companions there, she went to Śaṃkara.

1.3.s:
dadarśataṃ sabhāmadhye trilocanamavasthitam..
gaṇaiḥ parivṛtaṃ sarvaiścaṃḍamuṃḍādibhistadā.. 2.44 ..
1.3.d:
ददर्शतं सभामध्ये त्रिलोचनमवस्थितम्..
गणैः परिवृतं सर्वैश्चंडमुंडादिभिस्तदा.. 2.44 ..
1.3.m: She saw him, the three-eyed, seated in the midst of the assembly, / surrounded then by all the gaṇas, Caṇḍa, Muṇḍa, and the others:

1.3.s:
bāṇo bhṛṃgistathā naṃdī śailādo hi mahātapāḥ..
mahākālo mahācaṃḍo mahāmuṃḍo mahāśirāḥ.. 2.45 ..
1.3.d:
बाणो भृंगिस्तथा नंदी शैलादो हि महातपाः..
महाकालो महाचंडो महामुंडो महाशिराः.. 2.45 ..
1.3.m: Bāṇa, Bhṛṅgin, and Nandī the son of Śalāda of great austerity, / Mahākāla, Mahācaṇḍa, Mahāmuṇḍa, Mahāśiras,

1.3.s:
dhūmrākṣo dhūmraketuśca dhūmrapādastathaiva ca..
ete cānye ca bahavo gaṇā rudrānuvartinaḥ.. 2.46 ..
1.3.d:
धूम्राक्षो धूम्रकेतुश्च धूम्रपादस्तथैव च..
एते चान्ये च बहवो गणा रुद्रानुवर्तिनः.. 2.46 ..
1.3.m: Dhūmrākṣa, Dhūmraketu, and likewise Dhūmrapāda. / These and many other gaṇas following Rudra,

1.3.s:
kecidbhayānakā raudrāḥ kabaṃdhāśca tathā pare..
vilocanāśca kecicca vakṣohīnāstathā pare.. 2.47 ..
1.3.d:
केचिद्भयानका रौद्राः कबंधाश्च तथा परे..
विलोचनाश्च केचिच्च वक्षोहीनास्तथा परे.. 2.47 ..
1.3.m: some terrifying, dreadful, and others headless trunks, / some with strange eyes, and others without chests,

1.3.s:
evaṃbhūtāśca śataśaḥ sarve te kṛttivāsasaḥ..
jaṭākalāpasaṃbhūṣāḥ sarve rudrākṣabhūṣaṇāḥ.. 2.48 ..
1.3.d:
एवंभूताश्च शतशः सर्वे ते कृत्तिवाससः..
जटाकलापसंभूषाः सर्वे रुद्राक्षभूषणाः.. 2.48 ..
1.3.m: hundreds of such beings, all clad in skins, / adorned with braids of matted hair, all decorated with rudrākṣa seeds,

1.3.s:
jiteṃdriyā vītarāgāḥ sarve viṣayavairiṇaḥ..
ebhiḥ sarvaiḥ parivṛtaḥ śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ..
dṛṣṭastayā upāviṣṭa āsane parāmādbhute.. 2.49 ..
1.3.d:
जितेंद्रिया वीतरागाः सर्वे विषयवैरिणः..
एभिः सर्वैः परिवृतः शंकरो लोकशंकरः..
दृष्टस्तया उपाविष्ट आसने परामाद्भुते.. 2.49 ..
1.3.m: their senses conquered, free from passion, all enemies of sense-objects— / surrounded by all these, Śaṃkara, who brings peace to the world, / was seen by her seated on a most wondrous seat.

1.3.s:
ākṣiptacittā sahasā jagāma śivasaṃnidhim..
śivena sthāpitā svāṃke prītiyuktena vallabhā.. 2.50 ..
1.3.d:
आक्षिप्तचित्ता सहसा जगाम शिवसंनिधिम्..
शिवेन स्थापिता स्वांके प्रीतियुक्तेन वल्लभा.. 2.50 ..
1.3.m: Agitated in mind, she swiftly approached Śiva’s presence. / She, his beloved, was placed on his lap by Śiva, full of love.

1.3.s:
premṇoditā vacobhiḥ sā bahumānapuraḥsaram..
kimāgamanakāryaṃme vada śīghraṃ sumadhyame.. 2.51 ..
1.3.d:
प्रेम्णोदिता वचोभिः सा बहुमानपुरःसरम्..
किमागमनकार्यंमे वद शीघ्रं सुमध्यमे.. 2.51 ..
1.3.m: She was addressed with loving words accompanied by high respect: / "Tell me quickly, O slender-waisted lady, what is the purpose of your coming?"

1.3.s: evamuktā tadā tena uvācāsitalocanā.. 2.52 ..
1.3.d: एवमुक्ता तदा तेन उवाचासितलोचना.. 2.52 ..
1.3.m: Addressed thus then by him, the dark-eyed lady spoke.

1.3.s:
..satyuvāca..
piturmama mahāyajñe kasmāttava na rocate..
gamanaṃ devadevaśa tatsarvaṃ kathaya prabho.. 2.53 ..
1.3.d:
..सत्युवाच..
पितुर्मम महायज्ञे कस्मात्तव न रोचते..
गमनं देवदेवश तत्सर्वं कथय प्रभो.. 2.53 ..
1.3.m: Satī said: / "Why does going to my father’s great sacrifice not please you, / O god of gods? Tell all that, O Lord!

1.3.s:
suhṛdāmeṣa vai dharmaḥ suhṛdbhiḥ saha saṃgatim..
kurvaṃti yanmahādeva suhṛdāṃ prītivardhinīm.. 2.54 ..
1.3.d:
सुहृदामेष वै धर्मः सुहृद्भिः सह संगतिम्..
कुर्वंति यन्महादेव सुहृदां प्रीतिवर्धिनीम्.. 2.54 ..
1.3.m: This is indeed the duty of friends: that they associate with friends, / which increases the affection of friends, O Mahādeva.

1.3.s:
tasamātsarvaprayatnena anāhūto'pi gaccha bhoḥ..
yajñavāṭaṃ piturme'dya vacanānme sadāśiva.. 2.55 ..
1.3.d:
तसमात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन अनाहूतोऽपि गच्छ भोः..
यज्ञवाटं पितुर्मेऽद्य वचनान्मे सदाशिव.. 2.55 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, by every effort, even though uninvited, go / today to my father’s sacrifice-enclosure at my request, O Sadāśiva!"

1.3.s:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā ba bhāṣe sūnṛtaṃ vacaḥ..
tvayā bhadre na gaṃtavyaṃ dakṣasya yajanaṃ prati.. 2.56 ..
1.3.d:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब भाषे सूनृतं वचः..
त्वया भद्रे न गंतव्यं दक्षस्य यजनं प्रति.. 2.56 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that speech of hers, he spoke words of truth: / "You should not go, O gentle lady, to Dakṣa’s sacrifice.

1.3.s:
tasya ye māninaḥ sarve sasurāsukiṃnarāḥ..
te sreva yajanaṃ prāptāḥ pitustava na saṃśayaḥ.. 2.57 ..
1.3.d:
तस्य ये मानिनः सर्वे ससुरासुकिंनराः..
ते स्रेव यजनं प्राप्ताः पितुस्तव न संशयः.. 2.57 ..
1.3.m: All those proud people belonging to him, along with gods and kinnaras, / they have all reached the sacrifice of your father, without doubt.

1.3.s:
anāhūtāśca ye subhru gacchaṃti paramandiram..
apamānaṃ prāpnuvanti maraṇādadhikaṃ tataḥ.. 2.58 ..
1.3.d:
अनाहूताश्च ये सुभ्रु गच्छंति परमन्दिरम्..
अपमानं प्राप्नुवन्ति मरणादधिकं ततः.. 2.58 ..
1.3.m: And those who go uninvited to another’s house, O fair-browed lady, / meet with dishonour, which is worse than death.

1.3.s:
pareṣāṃ maṃdiraṃ prāpta iṃdropi laghutāṃ vrajet..
tasmāttvāyā na gaṃtavyaṃ dakṣasya yajanaṃ śubhe.. 2.59 ..
1.3.d:
परेषां मंदिरं प्राप्त इंद्रोपि लघुतां व्रजेत्..
तस्मात्त्वाया न गंतव्यं दक्षस्य यजनं शुभे.. 2.59 ..
1.3.m: Even Indra, having reached the house of others, would suffer humiliation. / Therefore you must not go, O auspicious lady, to Dakṣa’s sacrifice."

1.3.s:
evamuktā satī tena maheśena mahātmanā..
uvāca roṣasaṃyuktaṃ vākyaṃ vākyavidāṃ varā.. 2.60 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्ता सती तेन महेशेन महात्मना..
उवाच रोषसंयुक्तं वाक्यं वाक्यविदां वरा.. 2.60 ..
1.3.m: Addressed thus by that great-souled Maheśa, Satī, / best among those who know speech, uttered words full of anger:

1.3.s:
yajño hi satyaṃ loke tvaṃ sa tvaṃ devavareśvara..
anāhūto'si tenādya pitrā me dṛṣṭacāriṇā..
tatsarvaṃ jñātumicchāmi tasya bhāvaṃ durātmanaḥ.. 2.61 ..
1.3.d:
यज्ञो हि सत्यं लोके त्वं स त्वं देववरेश्वर..
अनाहूतोऽसि तेनाद्य पित्रा मे दृष्टचारिणा..
तत्सर्वं ज्ञातुमिच्छामि तस्य भावं दुरात्मनः.. 2.61 ..
1.3.m: "You are indeed the sacrifice itself in the world, you the supreme lord of the gods! / You have not been invited today by him, my father of perverted conduct. / I wish to know all of that: the intention of that wicked one.

1.3.s:
tasmāccādyaiva gacchāmi yajñavāḍaṃ piturmmama..
anujñāṃ dehi me nātha devadeva jagatpate.. 2.62 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माच्चाद्यैव गच्छामि यज्ञवाडं पितुर्म्मम..
अनुज्ञां देहि मे नाथ देवदेव जगत्पते.. 2.62 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, I am going this very day to my father’s sacrifice-enclosure. / Grant me permission, my lord, god of gods, ruler of the universe!"

1.3.s:
ityukto bhagavānrudrastayā devyā śivaḥ svayam..
vijñātākhiladṛgdraṣṭā bhagavānbhūtabhāvanaḥ.. 2.63 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युक्तो भगवान्रुद्रस्तया देव्या शिवः स्वयम्..
विज्ञाताखिलदृग्द्रष्टा भगवान्भूतभावनः.. 2.63 ..
1.3.m: Having been spoken to thus by that goddess, the blessed Rudra, Śiva himself, / the knower, the all-seeing seer, the blessed source of all beings,

1.3.s:
sa tāmuvāca deveśo maheśaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ..
gaccha devi tvarāyuktā vacanānmama suvrate.. 2.64 ..
1.3.d:
स तामुवाच देवेशो महेशः सर्वसिद्धिदः..
गच्छ देवि त्वरायुक्ता वचनान्मम सुव्रते.. 2.64 ..
1.3.m: he, the lord of the gods, Maheśa, giver of all perfections, said to her: / "Go, O goddess, with haste, at my word, O lady of good vows!

1.3.s:
etaṃ naṃdinamāruhya nānāvidhagaṇānvitā..
gaṇāḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi jagmūraudrāḥ śivajñayā.. 2.65 ..
1.3.d:
एतं नंदिनमारुह्य नानाविधगणान्विता..
गणाः षष्टिसहस्राणि जग्मूरौद्राः शिवज्ञया.. 2.65 ..
1.3.m: Mounting this Nandī, accompanied by various gaṇas." / Sixty thousand Rudra-gaṇas went by Śiva’s command.

1.3.s:
tairgaṇaiḥ saṃvṛtā devī jagāma pitṛmaṃdiram..
nirīkṣya tadbalaṃ sarvaṃ mahādevotivismitaḥ.. 2.66 ..
1.3.d:
तैर्गणैः संवृता देवी जगाम पितृमंदिरम्..
निरीक्ष्य तद्बलं सर्वं महादेवोतिविस्मितः.. 2.66 ..
1.3.m: Surrounded by those gaṇas, the goddess went to her father’s abode. / Looking at that entire host, Mahādeva was greatly astonished.

1.3.s:
bhūṣaṇāni mahārhāṇi tebhyo devyai paraṃtapaḥ..
preṣayāmāsa cāvyagro mahādevo'nu pṛṣṭhataḥ.. 2.67 ..
1.3.d:
भूषणानि महार्हाणि तेभ्यो देव्यै परंतपः..
प्रेषयामास चाव्यग्रो महादेवोऽनु पृष्ठतः.. 2.67 ..
1.3.m: Costly ornaments for them and for the goddess, that scorcher of foes, / Mahādeva, composed in mind, sent behind them.

1.3.s:
devyā gataṃ vai svapiturgṛhaṃ tadā vimṛśya sarvaṃ bhagavānmaheśaḥ..
dākṣāyaṇī pitravamānitā satī na yāsyatīti svapuraṃ punarjagau.. 2.68 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe dakṣayajñaṃ prati satīdevyāgamanavarṇanaṃnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ.. 2 ..
1.3.d:
देव्या गतं वै स्वपितुर्गृहं तदा विमृश्य सर्वं भगवान्महेशः..
दाक्षायणी पित्रवमानिता सती न यास्यतीति स्वपुरं पुनर्जगौ.. 2.68 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखंडे दक्षयज्ञं प्रति सतीदेव्यागमनवर्णनंनाम द्वितीयोऽध्यायः.. 2 ..
1.3.m:
Reflecting entirely on the goddess’s departure to her father’s house, the blessed Maheśa / then declared to his own city: "Satī, Dakṣa’s daughter, insulted by her father, will not return."
Thus ends the second chapter, named 'Description of the Goddess Satī’s Departure to Dakṣa’s Sacrifice', in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first [part], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
viṣṇunoktaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā dakṣo vacanamabravīt..
vedānāmapramāṇaṃ ca kṛtaṃ te madhusūdana.. 4.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
विष्णुनोक्तं वचः श्रुत्वा दक्षो वचनमब्रवीत्..
वेदानामप्रमाणं च कृतं ते मधुसूदन.. 4.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Hearing the words spoken by Viṣṇu, Dakṣa said these words: / "You have rendered the Vedas invalid, O Madhusūdana!

1.3.s:
vaidikaṃ karma cotsṛjya kathaṃ seśvaratāṃ vrajet..
taducyatāṃ mahāviṣṇo yena dharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ.. 4.2 ..
1.3.d:
वैदिकं कर्म चोत्सृज्य कथं सेश्वरतां व्रजेत्..
तदुच्यतां महाविष्णो येन धर्मः प्रतिष्ठितः.. 4.2 ..
1.3.m: And abandoning Vedic action, how could one attain the state of being with the Lord? / Let that be spoken, O Mahāviṣṇu, by which dharma is established!"

1.3.s:
dakṣeṇokto mahāviṣṇuruvāca parisāṃtvayan..
traigaṇyaviṣayā vedāḥ saṃbhavaṃti na cānyathā.. 4.3 ..
1.3.d:
दक्षेणोक्तो महाविष्णुरुवाच परिसांत्वयन्..
त्रैगण्यविषया वेदाः संभवंति न चान्यथा.. 4.3 ..
1.3.m: Addressed by Dakṣa, Mahāviṣṇu spoke, pacifying him: / "The Vedas have the three guṇas as their domain; they cannot be otherwise.

1.3.s:
vedoditāni karmāṇi īśvareṇa vinā katham..
saphalāni bhaviṣyaṃti viphalānyeva tāni ca.. 4.4 ..
1.3.d:
वेदोदितानि कर्माणि ईश्वरेण विना कथम्..
सफलानि भविष्यंति विफलान्येव तानि च.. 4.4 ..
1.3.m: How can rites proclaimed in the Vedas bear fruit without Īśvara? / They will indeed be entirely fruitless.

1.3.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena īśvaraṃ śaraṇaṃ vraaijā..
evaṃ bruvati govinda āgataḥ sainyasāgaraḥ..
vīrabhadreṇa sadṛśo dadṛśustaṃ tadā surāḥ.. 4.5 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन ईश्वरं शरणं व्रऐजा..
एवं ब्रुवति गोविन्द आगतः सैन्यसागरः..
वीरभद्रेण सदृशो ददृशुस्तं तदा सुराः.. 4.5 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, by every effort, take refuge in Īśvara!" / While Govinda was speaking thus, an ocean of an army arrived, / resembling Vīrabhadra; then the gods saw it.

1.3.s:
iṃdropi prahasanviṣṇumātmavādarataṃ tadā..
vajrapāṇiḥ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ yoddhukāmo'bhavattadā.. 4.6 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्रोपि प्रहसन्विष्णुमात्मवादरतं तदा..
वज्रपाणिः सुरैः सार्द्धं योद्धुकामोऽभवत्तदा.. 4.6 ..
1.3.m: Laughing at Viṣṇu, who was then engaged in asserting his own doctrine, / Indra, thunderbolt in hand, together with the gods, desired to fight.

1.3.s:
bhṛguṇācāritaḥ śīghramuccāṭanapareṇa hi..
tadā gaṇāḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ yuyudhuste gaṇānvitāḥ.. 4.7 ..
1.3.d:
भृगुणाचारितः शीघ्रमुच्चाटनपरेण हि..
तदा गणाः सुरैः सार्धं युयुधुस्ते गणान्विताः.. 4.7 ..
1.3.m: Driven on quickly by Bhṛgu, intent on expulsion, / the attendants then fought against the gods, surrounded by their retinues.

1.3.s:
śaratomaranāgacairjaghnuste ca parasparam..
neduḥśaṃkhāśca bahuśastasminraṇamahotsave.. 4.8 ..
1.3.d:
शरतोमरनागचैर्जघ्नुस्ते च परस्परम्..
नेदुःशंखाश्च बहुशस्तस्मिन्रणमहोत्सवे.. 4.8 ..
1.3.m: They struck one another with arrows, javelins, and iron darts; / conches sounded repeatedly in that great festival of battle.

1.3.s:
tathā dundubhayo neduḥ paṭahā ḍiṃḍimādayaḥ..
tena śabdena mahatāślāghyamānāstadā surāḥ..
lokapālaiśca sahitā jaghnustāñchivakiṃkarān.. 4.9 ..
1.3.d:
तथा दुन्दुभयो नेदुः पटहा डिंडिमादयः..
तेन शब्देन महताश्लाघ्यमानास्तदा सुराः..
लोकपालैश्च सहिता जघ्नुस्ताञ्छिवकिंकरान्.. 4.9 ..
1.3.m: Likewise kettle-drums, wardrums, and small drums resounded. / Praised by that mighty noise, the gods then, / joined with the world-guardians, struck down those servants of Śiva.

1.3.s:
khaḍgaiścāpi hatāḥ kecidgadābhiśca vipothitāḥ..
devaiḥ parājitāḥ sarve gaṇāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ.. 4.10 ..
1.3.d:
खड्गैश्चापि हताः केचिद्गदाभिश्च विपोथिताः..
देवैः पराजिताः सर्वे गणाः शतसहस्रशः.. 4.10 ..
1.3.m: Some were slain with swords and others crushed with maces; / all the attendants, by hundreds and thousands, were defeated by the gods.

1.3.s:
iṃdrādyaurlokapālaiśca gaṇāste ca parāṅgamukhāḥ..
kṛtāśca tatkṣaṇādeva bhṛgormaṃtrabalena hi.. 4.11 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्राद्यौर्लोकपालैश्च गणास्ते च पराङ्गमुखाः..
कृताश्च तत्क्षणादेव भृगोर्मंत्रबलेन हि.. 4.11 ..
1.3.m: Those attendants were turned back by the world-guardians headed by Indra, / and routed instantly by the power of Bhṛgu's mantra.

1.3.s:
uccāṭanaṃ kṛtaṃ teṣāṃ bhṛguṇā yajvinā tadā..
yajanārthaṃ ca devānāṃ tuṣṭyarthaṃ dīkṣitasya ca.. 4.12 ..
1.3.d:
उच्चाटनं कृतं तेषां भृगुणा यज्विना तदा..
यजनार्थं च देवानां तुष्ट्यर्थं दीक्षितस्य च.. 4.12 ..
1.3.m: Their expulsion was then performed by the sacrificer Bhṛgu / for the sake of the sacrifice and for the satisfaction of the consecrated Dakṣa.

1.3.s:
tenaiva devā jayino jātāstatkṣaṇameva hi..
svānāṃ parājayaṃ dṛṣṭvā vīrabhadro rupānvitaḥ.. 4.13 ..
1.3.d:
तेनैव देवा जयिनो जातास्तत्क्षणमेव हि..
स्वानां पराजयं दृष्ट्वा वीरभद्रो रुपान्वितः.. 4.13 ..
1.3.m: By that alone, the gods became victorious at that very moment. / Seeing the defeat of his own forces, Vīrabhadra, filled with wrath,

1.3.s:
bhūtānpretānpiśācāṃśca kṛtvā tāneva pṛṣṭhataḥ..
vṛṣabhasthānpuraskṛtya svayaṃ caiva mahābalaḥ..
tīkṣṇaṃ triśūlamādāya pātayāmāsa tānraṇe.. 4.14 ..
1.3.d:
भूतान्प्रेतान्पिशाचांश्च कृत्वा तानेव पृष्ठतः..
वृषभस्थान्पुरस्कृत्य स्वयं चैव महाबलः..
तीक्ष्णं त्रिशूलमादाय पातयामास तान्रणे.. 4.14 ..
1.3.m: placing behind him the spirits, ghosts, and fiends, / placing before him those mounted on bulls, the mighty one himself / took up a sharp trident and threw them down in battle.

1.3.s:
devānyakṣānpiśācāṃśca guhyakānrākṣasāṃ stathā..
śūlaghātaiśca te sarve gaṇā devānprajaghnire.. 4.15 ..
1.3.d:
देवान्यक्षान्पिशाचांश्च गुह्यकान्राक्षसां स्तथा..
शूलघातैश्च ते सर्वे गणा देवान्प्रजघ्निरे.. 4.15 ..
1.3.m: Against the gods, yakṣas, fiends, guhyakas, and rākṣasas, / with blows of tridents, all those attendants struck down the gods.

1.3.s:
keciddvidhākṛtāḥ khaṅgairmudgaraiścāpi pothitāḥ..
paraśvadhaiḥ khaṃḍaśaśca kṛtāḥ kecidraṇājire.. 4.16 ..
1.3.d:
केचिद्द्विधाकृताः खङ्गैर्मुद्गरैश्चापि पोथिताः..
परश्वधैः खंडशश्च कृताः केचिद्रणाजिरे.. 4.16 ..
1.3.m: Some were cut in two with swords and others beaten with clubs; / some were chopped into pieces with battle-axes on the battleground.

1.3.s:
śūlairbhinnāśca śataśaḥ kecicca śakalīkṛtāḥ..
evaṃ parājitāḥ sarve palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ.. 4.17 ..
1.3.d:
शूलैर्भिन्नाश्च शतशः केचिच्च शकलीकृताः..
एवं पराजिताः सर्वे पलायनपरायणाः.. 4.17 ..
1.3.m: Hundreds were pierced with pikes, and some were smashed to bits. / Thus defeated, they all became intent on flight.

1.3.s:
parasparaṃ pariṣvajya gatāstepi triviṣṭapam..
kevalaṃ lokapālāśca iṃdrādyāstasthurutsukāḥ..
bṛhaspatiṃ pṛcchamānāḥ kutosmākaṃ jayo bhavet.. 4.18 ..
1.3.d:
परस्परं परिष्वज्य गतास्तेपि त्रिविष्टपम्..
केवलं लोकपालाश्च इंद्राद्यास्तस्थुरुत्सुकाः..
बृहस्पतिं पृच्छमानाः कुतोस्माकं जयो भवेत्.. 4.18 ..
1.3.m: Embracing one another, they fled even to heaven. / Only the world-guardians headed by Indra remained, anxious, / asking Bṛhaspati: “Whence may victory be ours?”

1.3.s:
bṛhaspatiruvācedaṃ sureṃdraṃ tvaritastadā..
..bṛhaspatiruvāca..
yaduktaṃ viṣṇunā pūrvaṃ tatsatyaṃ jātamadya vai.. 4.19 ..
1.3.d:
बृहस्पतिरुवाचेदं सुरेंद्रं त्वरितस्तदा..
..बृहस्पतिरुवाच..
यदुक्तं विष्णुना पूर्वं तत्सत्यं जातमद्य वै.. 4.19 ..
1.3.m: Bṛhaspati then spoke quickly to the king of the gods: / Bṛhaspati said: / “What Viṣṇu spoke previously has indeed come true today.

1.3.s:
asti cedīśvaraḥ kaścitphalarūpyasya karmmaṇaḥ..
kartāraṃ bhajate sopi na hyakartuḥ prabhurhisaḥ.. 4.20 ..
1.3.d:
अस्ति चेदीश्वरः कश्चित्फलरूप्यस्य कर्म्मणः..
कर्तारं भजते सोपि न ह्यकर्तुः प्रभुर्हिसः.. 4.20 ..
1.3.m: If there is any lord who bestows the fruit of action, / he attends to the agent; he is surely not a master over one who does nothing.

1.3.s:
na maṃtrauṣadhayaḥ sarve nābhicārā na laukikāḥ..
na karmāṇi na vedāśca na mīmāṃsādvayaṃ tathā.. 4.21 ..
1.3.d:
न मंत्रौषधयः सर्वे नाभिचारा न लौकिकाः..
न कर्माणि न वेदाश्च न मीमांसाद्वयं तथा.. 4.21 ..
1.3.m: Neither all mantras and herbs, nor sorceries, nor worldly means, / nor rituals, nor the Vedas, nor the two Mīmāṃsās,

1.3.s:
jñātumīśāḥ saṃbhavaṃti bhaktyājñeyastvananyayā..
śāṃtyā ca parayā tṛṣṭyā jñātavyo hi sadāśivaḥ.. 4.22 ..
1.3.d:
ज्ञातुमीशाः संभवंति भक्त्याज्ञेयस्त्वनन्यया..
शांत्या च परया तृष्ट्या ज्ञातव्यो हि सदाशिवः.. 4.22 ..
1.3.m: are capable of knowing [him]. But he can be known through single-minded devotion; / Sadāśiva is to be known through supreme peace and satisfaction.

1.3.s:
tena sarvaṃ saṃbhavaṃti sukhaduḥjhakhātmakaṃ jagat..
paraṃtu saṃvadiṣyāmi kāryākāryavivakṣayā.. 4.23 ..
1.3.d:
तेन सर्वं संभवंति सुखदुःझखात्मकं जगत्..
परंतु संवदिष्यामि कार्याकार्यविवक्षया.. 4.23 ..
1.3.m: Through him the entire world, consisting of pleasure and pain, comes into being. / Nevertheless, I shall speak out of a desire to distinguish what should and should not be done.

1.3.s:
tvamiṃdra bāliśo bhūtvā lokapālaiḥ sahādya vai..
āgato bāliśo bhūtvā idānīṃ kiṃ kariṣyasi.. 4.24 ..
1.3.d:
त्वमिंद्र बालिशो भूत्वा लोकपालैः सहाद्य वै..
आगतो बालिशो भूत्वा इदानीं किं करिष्यसि.. 4.24 ..
1.3.m: You, Indra, acting like a fool together with the world-guardians, / have arrived here today as a fool. What will you do now?

1.3.s:
ete rudrasahāyāśca gaṇāḥ paramaśobhanāḥ..
kupitāśca mahābhāgā na tu śeṣaṃ prakurvate.. 4.25 ..
1.3.d:
एते रुद्रसहायाश्च गणाः परमशोभनाः..
कुपिताश्च महाभागा न तु शेषं प्रकुर्वते.. 4.25 ..
1.3.m: These highly glorious attendants are the helpers of Rudra; / when enraged, these illustrious ones leave no remainder.”

1.3.s:
evaṃ bṛhaspatervākyaṃ śrutvā te'pi divaukasaḥ..
ciṃtāmāpedire sarve lokapālā maheśvarāḥ.. 4.26 ..
1.3.d:
एवं बृहस्पतेर्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा तेऽपि दिवौकसः..
चिंतामापेदिरे सर्वे लोकपाला महेश्वराः.. 4.26 ..
1.3.m: Hearing this speech of Bṛhaspati, those dwellers of heaven, / all the great world-guardians, fell into anxiety.

1.3.s:
tato'bravīdvīrabhadro gaṇaiḥ parivṛto bhṛśam..
sarve yūyaṃ bāliśatvādavadānārthamāgatāḥ.. 4.27 ..
1.3.d:
ततोऽब्रवीद्वीरभद्रो गणैः परिवृतो भृशम्..
सर्वे यूयं बालिशत्वादवदानार्थमागताः.. 4.27 ..
1.3.m: Then Vīrabhadra, closely surrounded by the attendants, said: / “All of you have come out of foolishness for your sacrificial portions.

1.3.s:
avadānāni dāsyāmi tṛptyarthaṃ bhavatāṃ tvaran..
evamuktvā śitairbāṇairjaghānātha ruṣānvitaḥ.. 4.28 ..
1.3.d:
अवदानानि दास्यामि तृप्त्यर्थं भवतां त्वरन्..
एवमुक्त्वा शितैर्बाणैर्जघानाथ रुषान्वितः.. 4.28 ..
1.3.m: I shall give you your portions swiftly for your satisfaction.” / Having spoken thus, filled with rage, he then struck with sharp arrows.

1.3.s: tairbāṇairnihatāḥ sarve jagmuste ca diśo daśa.. 4.29 ..
1.3.d: तैर्बाणैर्निहताः सर्वे जग्मुस्ते च दिशो दश.. 4.29 ..
1.3.m: Struck down by those arrows, they all fled to the ten directions.

1.3.s:
gateṣu lokapāleṣu vidruteṣu sureṣu ca..
yajñavāṭe samāyāto vīrabhadro gaṇānvataḥ.. 4.30 ..
1.3.d:
गतेषु लोकपालेषु विद्रुतेषु सुरेषु च..
यज्ञवाटे समायातो वीरभद्रो गणान्वतः.. 4.30 ..
1.3.m: When the world-guardians had departed and the gods were dispersed, / Vīrabhadra, accompanied by the attendants, arrived at the sacrificial enclosure.

1.3.s:
tadā ta ṛṣayaḥ sarve sarvameveśvareśvaram..
vijñaptukāmāḥ sahasā ūcurevaṃ janārdanam.. 4.31 ..
1.3.d:
तदा त ऋषयः सर्वे सर्वमेवेश्वरेश्वरम्..
विज्ञप्तुकामाः सहसा ऊचुरेवं जनार्दनम्.. 4.31 ..
1.3.m: Then all those seers, desiring to entreat the supreme Lord of all, / quickly spoke thus to Janārdana:

1.3.s:
rakṣa yajñaṃ hi dakṣasya yajñosi tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ..
etacchrutvā tu vacanamṛṣīṇāṃ vai janārdanaḥ.. 4.32 ..
1.3.d:
रक्ष यज्ञं हि दक्षस्य यज्ञोसि त्वं न संशयः..
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनमृषीणां वै जनार्दनः.. 4.32 ..
1.3.m: “Protect Dakṣa’s sacrifice, for you are the sacrifice without doubt.” / Hearing this word of the seers, Janārdana,

1.3.s:
yoddhukāmaḥ sthito yuddhe viṣṇuradhyātmadīpakaḥ..
vīrabhadro mahābāhuḥ keśavaṃ vākyamabravīt.. 4.33 ..
1.3.d:
योद्धुकामः स्थितो युद्धे विष्णुरध्यात्मदीपकः..
वीरभद्रो महाबाहुः केशवं वाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 4.33 ..
1.3.m: Viṣṇu, who illuminates inner truth, stood in battle wishing to fight. / The mighty-armed Vīrabhadra addressed a speech to Keśava:

1.3.s:
atra tvayāgataṃ kasmādviṣṇo vettrā mahābalam..
dakṣasya pakṣamāśritya kathaṃ jeṣyasi tadvada.. 4.34 ..
1.3.d:
अत्र त्वयागतं कस्माद्विष्णो वेत्त्रा महाबलम्..
दक्षस्य पक्षमाश्रित्य कथं जेष्यसि तद्वद.. 4.34 ..
1.3.m: “Why have you come here, Viṣṇu, who know my great power? / Taking Dakṣa's side, how will you conquer? Tell me that!

1.3.s:
dākṣāyaṇyā kṛtaṃ yacca na dṛṣṭaṃ kiṃ tvayānagha..
tvaṃ cāpi yajñe dakṣasya avadānārthamāgataḥ..
avadānaṃ prayacchāmi tava cāpi mahābhūja.. 4.35 ..
1.3.d:
दाक्षायण्या कृतं यच्च न दृष्टं किं त्वयानघ..
त्वं चापि यज्ञे दक्षस्य अवदानार्थमागतः..
अवदानं प्रयच्छामि तव चापि महाभूज.. 4.35 ..
1.3.m: Have you not seen what was done by Satī, O sinless one? / And you too have come to Dakṣa's sacrifice for a portion; / I will give a portion to you as well, O mighty-armed one!”

1.3.s:
evamuktvā praṇamyādau viṣṇuṃ sadṛśarūpiṇam..
vīrabhadro'grato bhūtvā viṣṇuṃ vākyamathābravīt.. 4.36 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा प्रणम्यादौ विष्णुं सदृशरूपिणम्..
वीरभद्रोऽग्रतो भूत्वा विष्णुं वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्.. 4.36 ..
1.3.m: Having spoken thus, first bowing to Viṣṇu whose form is equal, / Vīrabhadra stepped forward and then addressed words to Viṣṇu:

1.3.s:
yathā śaṃbhustathā tvaṃ hi mama nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ..
tathāpi tvaṃ mahābāho yoddhukāmo'grataḥ stitaḥ..
neṣyāmyapunarāvṛttiṃ yadi tiṣṭhestvamātmanā.. 4.37 ..
1.3.d:
यथा शंभुस्तथा त्वं हि मम नास्त्यत्र संशयः..
तथापि त्वं महाबाहो योद्धुकामोऽग्रतः स्तितः..
नेष्याम्यपुनरावृत्तिं यदि तिष्ठेस्त्वमात्मना.. 4.37 ..
1.3.m: “Just as Śambhu is, so indeed are you; there is no doubt of this in my mind. / Nevertheless, O mighty-armed one, you stand before me wishing to fight. / I will dispatch you to non-return if you stand your ground.”

1.3.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vīrabhadrasya dhīmataḥ..
uvāca prahasandevo viṣṇuḥ sarveśvareśvaraḥ.. 4.38 ..
1.3.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वीरभद्रस्य धीमतः..
उवाच प्रहसन्देवो विष्णुः सर्वेश्वरेश्वरः.. 4.38 ..
1.3.m: Hearing those words of the wise Vīrabhadra, / the god Viṣṇu, supreme Lord of all, laughed and spoke:

1.3.s:
..viṣṇuruvāca..
rudratejaḥprasūtosi pavitro'si mahāmate..
anena prārthitaḥ pūrvaṃ yajñārthaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ.. 4.39 ..
1.3.d:
..विष्णुरुवाच..
रुद्रतेजःप्रसूतोसि पवित्रोऽसि महामते..
अनेन प्रार्थितः पूर्वं यज्ञार्थं च पुनः पुनः.. 4.39 ..
1.3.m: Viṣṇu said: / “You are born from the fiery energy of Rudra; you are pure, O noble-minded one! / I was requested previously and repeatedly by Dakṣa for the sake of the sacrifice.

1.3.s:
ahaṃ bhaktaparādhīnastathā so'pi maheśvaraḥ..
tenaiva kāraṇenātra dakṣasya yajanaṃ prati.. 4.40 ..
1.3.d:
अहं भक्तपराधीनस्तथा सोऽपि महेश्वरः..
तेनैव कारणेनात्र दक्षस्य यजनं प्रति.. 4.40 ..
1.3.m: I am dependent on devotees, and so is Maheśvara; / for that very reason, I have come here to Dakṣa's sacrifice,

1.3.s:
āgato'haṃ vīrabhadra rudrakopasamudbhava..
ahaṃ nivārayāmi tvāṃ tvaṃ vā māṃ vinivāraya.. 4.41 ..
1.3.d:
आगतोऽहं वीरभद्र रुद्रकोपसमुद्भव..
अहं निवारयामि त्वां त्वं वा मां विनिवारय.. 4.41 ..
1.3.m: O Vīrabhadra, who arose from the wrath of Rudra! / I will ward you off, or you ward me off.”

1.3.s:
ityuktavati goviṃde prahasya sa mahābhujaḥ..
praśrayāvanato bhūtvā idamāha janārdanam.. 4.42 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युक्तवति गोविंदे प्रहस्य स महाभुजः..
प्रश्रयावनतो भूत्वा इदमाह जनार्दनम्.. 4.42 ..
1.3.m: When Govinda had spoken thus, the mighty-armed one laughed, / bowed with modesty, and spoke this to Janārdana:

1.3.s:
yathā śivastathā tvaṃ hi yathā tvaṃ ca tathā śivaḥ..
sevakāśca vayaṃ sarve tava vā śaṃkarasya ca.. 4.43 ..
1.3.d:
यथा शिवस्तथा त्वं हि यथा त्वं च तथा शिवः..
सेवकाश्च वयं सर्वे तव वा शंकरस्य च.. 4.43 ..
1.3.m: “Just as Śiva is, so indeed are you; and just as you are, so is Śiva. / We are all the servants of you or of Śaṃkara.”

1.3.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya so'cyutaḥ saṃprahasya ca..
idaṃ viṣṇurmahāvākyaṃ jagāda parameśvaraḥ.. 4.44 ..
1.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य सोऽच्युतः संप्रहस्य च..
इदं विष्णुर्महावाक्यं जगाद परमेश्वरः.. 4.44 ..
1.3.m: Hearing those words of his, the imperishable Acyuta laughed, / and the supreme lord Viṣṇu spoke this momentous word:

1.3.s:
yodhayasva mahābāho mayā sārdhamaśaṃkitaḥ..
tavāstraiḥ pūryamāṇo'haṃ gacchāmi bhavanaṃ svakam.. 4.45 ..
1.3.d:
योधयस्व महाबाहो मया सार्धमशंकितः..
तवास्त्रैः पूर्यमाणोऽहं गच्छामि भवनं स्वकम्.. 4.45 ..
1.3.m: “Fight with me without fear, O mighty-armed one! / Being covered by your weapons, I shall go to my own abode.”

1.3.s:
tathetyuktvā tu vīro'sau vīrabhadro mahābalaḥ..
gṛhītvā paramāstrāṇi siṃhanādairjagarja ha.. 4.46 ..
1.3.d:
तथेत्युक्त्वा तु वीरोऽसौ वीरभद्रो महाबलः..
गृहीत्वा परमास्त्राणि सिंहनादैर्जगर्ज ह.. 4.46 ..
1.3.m: Saying “So be it,” that hero, the mighty Vīrabhadra, / took up supreme weapons and roared with lion-roars.

1.3.s:
viṣṇuścāpi mahāghoṣaṃ śaṃkhanādaṃ cakāra saḥ..
tacchrutvā ye gatā devā raṇaṃ hitvā''yayuḥ punaḥ.. 4.47 ..
1.3.d:
विष्णुश्चापि महाघोषं शंखनादं चकार सः..
तच्छ्रुत्वा ये गता देवा रणं हित्वा'ऽययुः पुनः.. 4.47 ..
1.3.m: Viṣṇu too made a loud sound with the blast of his conch; / hearing that, the gods who had fled, having left the battle, returned once again.

1.3.s:
vyūhaṃ cakrustadā sarve lokapālāḥ savāsavāḥ..
tadendreṇa hato naṃdīvajreṇa śataparvaṇā.. 4.48 ..
1.3.d:
व्यूहं चक्रुस्तदा सर्वे लोकपालाः सवासवाः..
तदेन्द्रेण हतो नंदीवज्रेण शतपर्वणा.. 4.48 ..
1.3.m: Then all the world-protectors, led by Indra, formed a battle array. / At that, Nandin was struck by Indra with his hundred-jointed thunderbolt.

1.3.s:
naṃdīnā ca hataḥ śakrastriśūlena stanāṃtare..
vāyunā ca hato bhṛṃgī bhṛṃgiṇā vāyurāhataḥ.. 4.49 ..
1.3.d:
नंदीना च हतः शक्रस्त्रिशूलेन स्तनांतरे..
वायुना च हतो भृंगी भृंगिणा वायुराहतः.. 4.49 ..
1.3.m: And Indra was struck by Nandin with a trident between the breasts. / And Bhṛṅgin was struck by Vāyu, and Vāyu was struck down by Bhṛṅgin.

1.3.s:
śūlena sitadhāreṇa saṃnaddho daṇḍadhāriṇā..
yamena saha saṃgrāmaṃ mahākālo balānvitaḥ.. 4.50 ..
1.3.d:
शूलेन सितधारेण संनद्धो दण्डधारिणा..
यमेन सह संग्रामं महाकालो बलान्वितः.. 4.50 ..
1.3.m: Equipped with a sharp-edged spear, the powerful Mahākāla / [fought] in battle with Yama, who carried a staff.

1.3.s:
kubereṇa ca saṃgamya kūṣmāṃḍānāṃ patiḥ svayam..
varuṇena samaṃ yuddhaṃ muṃḍaścaiva mahābalaḥ.. 4.51 ..
1.3.d:
कुबेरेण च संगम्य कूष्मांडानां पतिः स्वयम्..
वरुणेन समं युद्धं मुंडश्चैव महाबलः.. 4.51 ..
1.3.m: And meeting Kubera, the lord of the kūṣmāṇḍas himself [fought him]. / And the exceedingly strong Muṇḍa fought a duel with Varuṇa,

1.3.s:
yuyudhe parayāśaktyā trailokyaṃ vismayanniva..
nairṛtena samāgamya caṃḍaścabalavattaraḥ.. 4.52 ..
1.3.d:
युयुधे परयाशक्त्या त्रैलोक्यं विस्मयन्निव..
नैरृतेन समागम्य चंडश्चबलवत्तरः.. 4.52 ..
1.3.m: Fighting with supreme power, as if astonishing the three worlds. / Encountering Nairṛta, the exceedingly powerful Caṇḍa,

1.3.s:
yuyudhe paramāstreṇa nairṛtyaṃ ca viḍaṃbayan..
yoginīcakrasaṃyukto bhairavo nāyako mahān.. 4.53 ..
1.3.d:
युयुधे परमास्त्रेण नैरृत्यं च विडंबयन्..
योगिनीचक्रसंयुक्तो भैरवो नायको महान्.. 4.53 ..
1.3.m: Fought with a supreme weapon, deriding Nairṛta. / Accompanied by a circle of yoginīs, the great leader Bhairava,

1.3.s:
vidārya devānakhilānpapau śoṇitamadbutam..
kṣetrapālāstathā cānye bhūtapramathaguhyakāḥ.. 4.54 ..
1.3.d:
विदार्य देवानखिलान्पपौ शोणितमद्बुतम्..
क्षेत्रपालास्तथा चान्ये भूतप्रमथगुह्यकाः.. 4.54 ..
1.3.m: Tearing apart all the gods, drank the extraordinary blood. / Likewise, other kṣetrapālas, bhūtas, pramathas, and guhyakas,

1.3.s:
sākinī ḍākinī raudrā navadurgāstathaiva ca..
yoginyo yātudānyaśca tathā kūṣmāṃḍakādayaḥ..
neduḥ papuḥ śoṇitaṃ ca bubhujuḥ piśitaṃ bahu.. 4.55 ..
1.3.d:
साकिनी डाकिनी रौद्रा नवदुर्गास्तथैव च..
योगिन्यो यातुदान्यश्च तथा कूष्मांडकादयः..
नेदुः पपुः शोणितं च बुभुजुः पिशितं बहु.. 4.55 ..
1.3.m: Fierce śākinīs, ḍākinīs, the nine Durgās as well, / yoginīs and yātudhānīs, and likewise kūṣmāṇḍas and the rest / roared, drank blood, and ate much flesh.

1.3.s:
bhakṣyamāṇaṃ tadā sainyaṃ vilokya surarāṭsvayam..
vihāya naṃdinaṃ paścādvīrabhadraṃ samākṣipat.. 4.56 ..
1.3.d:
भक्ष्यमाणं तदा सैन्यं विलोक्य सुरराट्स्वयम्..
विहाय नंदिनं पश्चाद्वीरभद्रं समाक्षिपत्.. 4.56 ..
1.3.m: Seeing his army being devoured then, the king of the gods himself / left Nandin behind and rushed toward Vīrabhadra.

1.3.s:
vīrabhadro vihāyaiva viṣṇuṃ devendramāsthitaḥ..
tayoryuddhamabhūddhoraṃ budhāṃgārakayoriva.. 4.57 ..
1.3.d:
वीरभद्रो विहायैव विष्णुं देवेन्द्रमास्थितः..
तयोर्युद्धमभूद्धोरं बुधांगारकयोरिव.. 4.57 ..
1.3.m: Leaving Viṣṇu aside, Vīrabhadra set upon the lord of the gods. / A terrible battle ensued between the two, like that between Mercury and Mars.

1.3.s:
vīrabhadraṃ yadā śakro haṃtukāmastvarānvitaḥ..
tāvacchaṃkraṃ gajasthaṃ hi purayāmāsa mārgaṇaiḥ.. 4.58 ..
1.3.d:
वीरभद्रं यदा शक्रो हंतुकामस्त्वरान्वितः..
तावच्छंक्रं गजस्थं हि पुरयामास मार्गणैः.. 4.58 ..
1.3.m: When Indra, filled with haste, desired to kill Vīrabhadra, / [Vīrabhadra] immediately covered Indra, seated on his elephant, with arrows.

1.3.s:
vīrabhadro ruṣāviṣṭo durnivāryo mahābalaḥ..
tadedreṃṇāhataḥ śīghraṃ vajreṇa śataparvaṇā.. 4.59 ..
1.3.d:
वीरभद्रो रुषाविष्टो दुर्निवार्यो महाबलः..
तदेद्रेंणाहतः शीघ्रं वज्रेण शतपर्वणा.. 4.59 ..
1.3.m: Filled with rage, Vīrabhadra was irresistible and of great might. / Then he was swiftly struck by Indra with his hundred-jointed thunderbolt.

1.3.s:
sagajaṃ ca savajraṃ ca vāsavaṃ grastumudyutaḥ..
hāhākāro mahā nāsīdbhūtānāṃ tatra paśyatām.. 4.60 ..
1.3.d:
सगजं च सवज्रं च वासवं ग्रस्तुमुद्युतः..
हाहाकारो महा नासीद्भूतानां तत्र पश्यताम्.. 4.60 ..
1.3.m: He prepared to swallow Indra along with his elephant and his thunderbolt. / A great cry of woe arose among the beings watching there.

1.3.s:
vīrabhadraṃ tatābhūtaṃ tathābhūtaṃ haṃtukāmaṃ puraṃdaram..
tavramāṇastadā viṣṇurvīrabhadrāgrataḥ sthitaḥ.. 4.61 ..
1.3.d:
वीरभद्रं तताभूतं तथाभूतं हंतुकामं पुरंदरम्..
तव्रमाणस्तदा विष्णुर्वीरभद्राग्रतः स्थितः.. 4.61 ..
1.3.m: Seeing Vīrabhadra acting in such a way, desiring to slay Purandara, / Viṣṇu, hurrying at that moment, stood in front of Vīrabhadra.

1.3.s:
śakraṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā yodhayāmāsa vai tadā..
vīrabhadrasya viṣṇośca yuddhaṃ paramabhūttadā.. 4.62 ..
1.3.d:
शक्रं च पृष्ठतः कृत्वा योधयामास वै तदा..
वीरभद्रस्य विष्णोश्च युद्धं परमभूत्तदा.. 4.62 ..
1.3.m: Placing Indra behind him, he then fought [with him]. / Then a supreme battle took place between Vīrabhadra and Viṣṇu.

1.3.s:
śastrāstrairvividhākārairyodhayāmāsatustadā..
punarnaṃdinamālokya śakro yuddha viśāradaḥ.. 4.63 ..
1.3.d:
शस्त्रास्त्रैर्विविधाकारैर्योधयामासतुस्तदा..
पुनर्नंदिनमालोक्य शक्रो युद्ध विशारदः.. 4.63 ..
1.3.m: The two then fought with weapons and missiles of various forms. / Seeing Nandin again, Indra, skilled in combat, [resumed fighting].

1.3.s:
dvaṃdvayuddhaṃ sutumulaṃ devānāṃ pramathaiḥ saha..
pramathā mathitā devaiḥ sarve te prādravanraṇāt.. 4.64 ..
1.3.d:
द्वंद्वयुद्धं सुतुमुलं देवानां प्रमथैः सह..
प्रमथा मथिता देवैः सर्वे ते प्राद्रवन्रणात्.. 4.64 ..
1.3.m: A tumultuous duel took place between the gods and the pramathas. / Crushed by the gods, all those pramathas fled from the battle.

1.3.s:
gaṇānparāṅmukhāndṛṣṭvā sarve te vyādhayo bhṛśam..
rudrakopātsamudbhūtā devāścāpi pradudruvuḥ.. 4.65 ..
1.3.d:
गणान्पराङ्मुखान्दृष्ट्वा सर्वे ते व्याधयो भृशम्..
रुद्रकोपात्समुद्भूता देवाश्चापि प्रदुद्रुवुः.. 4.65 ..
1.3.m: Seeing the gaṇas turn their backs, all the diseases / born of Rudra's anger also fled from the gods.

1.3.s:
jvaraistu pīḍitāndevāndṛṣṭvā viṣṇurhasanniva..
jīvagrāheṇa jagrāha devāṃstāṃśca pṛthakpṛthak.. 4.66 ..
1.3.d:
ज्वरैस्तु पीडितान्देवान्दृष्ट्वा विष्णुर्हसन्निव..
जीवग्राहेण जग्राह देवांस्तांश्च पृथक्पृथक्.. 4.66 ..
1.3.m: Seeing the gods afflicted by fevers, Viṣṇu, as if laughing, / captured those gods alive, one by one.

1.3.s:
devāścinau tadāhūya vyādhīnhaṃtuṃ tadā bhṛtim..
dadau tābhyāṃ prayatnena gaṇayitvā subuddhimān.. 4.67 ..
1.3.d:
देवाश्चिनौ तदाहूय व्याधीन्हंतुं तदा भृतिम्..
ददौ ताभ्यां प्रयत्नेन गणयित्वा सुबुद्धिमान्.. 4.67 ..
1.3.m: Then, having summoned the divine Aśvins to destroy the diseases, / the highly intelligent [Viṣṇu] attentively paid wages to both of them, counting it out.

1.3.s:
jvarāṃśca sannipātāṃśca anye bhūtadruhastadā..
tānsarvānnigṛhītvātha aśvinau tau mudānvitau..
vijvarānatha devāṃśca kṛtvā mumudatuściram.. 4.68 ..
1.3.d:
ज्वरांश्च सन्निपातांश्च अन्ये भूतद्रुहस्तदा..
तान्सर्वान्निगृहीत्वाथ अश्विनौ तौ मुदान्वितौ..
विज्वरानथ देवांश्च कृत्वा मुमुदतुश्चिरम्.. 4.68 ..
1.3.m: Then, seizing all the fevers, deliria, and other afflictors of creatures, / those two Aśvins, filled with joy, / freed the gods from fever and rejoiced for a long time.

1.3.s:
tairjitaṃ yoginīcakraṃ bhairavaṃ vyākulīkṛtam..
tīkṣṇāgraiḥ pātayāmāsuḥ śarairbhūtagaṇānapi.. 4.69 ..
1.3.d:
तैर्जितं योगिनीचक्रं भैरवं व्याकुलीकृतम्..
तीक्ष्णाग्रैः पातयामासुः शरैर्भूतगणानपि.. 4.69 ..
1.3.m: They conquered the circle of yoginīs and threw Bhairava into disarray. / With sharp-pointed arrows, they also struck down the troops of bhūtas.

1.3.s:
surairvidrāvitaṃ sainyaṃ vilokya patitaṃ bhuvi..
vīrabhadro rupāviṣṭo viṣṇuṃ vacanamabravīt.. 4.70 ..
1.3.d:
सुरैर्विद्रावितं सैन्यं विलोक्य पतितं भुवि..
वीरभद्रो रुपाविष्टो विष्णुं वचनमब्रवीत्.. 4.70 ..
1.3.m: Seeing the army routed by the gods and fallen upon the earth, / Vīrabhadra, filled with wrath, addressed Viṣṇu with these words:

1.3.s:
tvaṃ śūrosi mahābāho devānāṃ pālako hyasi..
yudhyasva māṃ prayatnena yadi te matirīdṛśī.. 4.71 ..
1.3.d:
त्वं शूरोसि महाबाहो देवानां पालको ह्यसि..
युध्यस्व मां प्रयत्नेन यदि ते मतिरीदृशी.. 4.71 ..
1.3.m: "You are a hero, O mighty-armed one; you are indeed the protector of the gods! / Fight with me diligently, if such is your desire!"

1.3.s:
ityuktvā taṃ samāsādya viṣṇuṃ sarveśvareśvaram..
vavarṣa niśitairbāṇairvīrabhadro mahābalaḥ.. 4.72 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तं समासाद्य विष्णुं सर्वेश्वरेश्वरम्..
ववर्ष निशितैर्बाणैर्वीरभद्रो महाबलः.. 4.72 ..
1.3.m: Having said this, approaching Viṣṇu, the lord of all lords, / the mighty Vīrabhadra showered him with sharpened arrows.

1.3.s:
tadā cakreṇa bhagavānvīrabhadraṃ jaghāna saḥ..
āyāṃtaṃ cakramālokya grasitaṃ tatkṣaṇācca tat.. 4.73 ..
1.3.d:
तदा चक्रेण भगवान्वीरभद्रं जघान सः..
आयांतं चक्रमालोक्य ग्रसितं तत्क्षणाच्च तत्.. 4.73 ..
1.3.m: Then the Blessed One struck Vīrabhadra with his discus. / Seeing the discus approaching, he swallowed it that very moment.

1.3.s:
grasitaṃ cakramālokya viṣṇuḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ..
mukhaṃ tasya parāmṛjya viṣṇunodgilitaṃ punaḥ.. 4.74 ..
1.3.d:
ग्रसितं चक्रमालोक्य विष्णुः परपुरंजयः..
मुखं तस्य परामृज्य विष्णुनोद्गिलितं पुनः.. 4.74 ..
1.3.m: Seeing the discus swallowed, Viṣṇu, the conqueror of enemy citadels, / stroked his face, and Viṣṇu caused it to be vomited forth again.

1.3.s:
svacakramādāya mahānubhāvo divaṃ gato'tho bhuvanaikabhartā..
jñātvā ca tatsarvamidaṃ ca viṣṇuḥ kṛtī kṛtaṃ duṣprasahaṃ pareṣām.. 4.75 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe vīrabhadrādīnāṃ viṣṇvādibhiḥ saha yuddhavarṇanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ.. 4 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
स्वचक्रमादाय महानुभावो दिवं गतोऽथो भुवनैकभर्ता..
ज्ञात्वा च तत्सर्वमिदं च विष्णुः कृती कृतं दुष्प्रसहं परेषाम्.. 4.75 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखंडे वीरभद्रादीनां विष्ण्वादिभिः सह युद्धवर्णनंनाम चतुर्थोऽध्यायः.. 4 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
Taking his discus, the glorious sole master of the worlds then departed to heaven, / and knowing all this, the capable Viṣṇu [knew] that an unbearable deed had been done by the enemies.
Thus ends the fourth chapter, named 'Description of the Battle of Vīrabhadra and Others with Viṣṇu and Others', in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first [section], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
viṣṇau gate tadā sarve devāśca ṛṣibhiḥ saha..
vinirjitā gaṇaiḥ sarve ye ca yajñopajīvinaḥ.. 5.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
विष्णौ गते तदा सर्वे देवाश्च ऋषिभिः सह..
विनिर्जिता गणैः सर्वे ये च यज्ञोपजीविनः.. 5.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / When Viṣṇu had departed, then all the gods, along with the ṛṣis, / and all those who subsist on sacrifices, were utterly conquered by the gaṇas.

1.3.s:
bhṛguṃ ca pātayāmāsa smaśrūṇāṃ luṃcanaṃ kṛtam..
dvijāṃścotpāṭayāmāsa pūṣṇo vikṛtavikriyān.. 5.2 ..
1.3.d:
भृगुं च पातयामास स्मश्रूणां लुंचनं कृतम्..
द्विजांश्चोत्पाटयामास पूष्णो विकृतविक्रियान्.. 5.2 ..
1.3.m: And he struck down Bhṛgu; the plucking of his beard was done. / And he pulled out the teeth of Pūṣan, causing monstrous deformities.

1.3.s:
viḍaṃbitā svadhā tatra ṛṣayaśca viḍaṃbitāḥ..
vavṛṣuste purīṣeṇa vitānāgnau rupānvitāḥ.. 5.3 ..
1.3.d:
विडंबिता स्वधा तत्र ऋषयश्च विडंबिताः..
ववृषुस्ते पुरीषेण वितानाग्नौ रुपान्विताः.. 5.3 ..
1.3.m: Svadhā was desecrated there, and the ṛṣis were mocked. / Filled with anger, they rained feces upon the sacrificial fire of the canopy.

1.3.s:
anirvācyaṃ tadā cakrurgaṇāḥ krodhasamanvitāḥ..
aṃtarvedyaṃtaragato dakṣo vai mahato bhayāt.. 5.4 ..
1.3.d:
अनिर्वाच्यं तदा चक्रुर्गणाः क्रोधसमन्विताः..
अंतर्वेद्यंतरगतो दक्षो वै महतो भयात्.. 5.4 ..
1.3.m: Then the gaṇas, filled with wrath, performed unspeakable acts. / Dakṣa went inside the sacrificial enclosure out of immense fear.

1.3.s:
taṃ nilīnaṃ samājñāya ānināyaruṣānvitaḥ..
kapoleṣu gṛhītvā taṃ khaḍgenopahataṃ śiraḥ.. 5.5 ..
1.3.d:
तं निलीनं समाज्ञाय आनिनायरुषान्वितः..
कपोलेषु गृहीत्वा तं खड्गेनोपहतं शिरः.. 5.5 ..
1.3.m: Knowing that he was hiding, [Vīrabhadra], filled with anger, brought him out. / Grasping him by the cheeks, he struck his head with a sword.

1.3.s:
abhedyaṃ tacchiro matvā vīrabhadraḥ pratāpavān..
skaṃdhaṃ padbhyāṃ samākramya kadhare'pīḍayattadā.. 5.6 ..
1.3.d:
अभेद्यं तच्छिरो मत्वा वीरभद्रः प्रतापवान्..
स्कंधं पद्भ्यां समाक्रम्य कधरेऽपीडयत्तदा.. 5.6 ..
1.3.m: Thinking that head to be impenetrable, the glorious Vīrabhadra / pressed down on his shoulder with his feet and squeezed his neck then.

1.3.s:
gaṃdharātpāṭyamānācca śiraśchinnaṃ durātmanaḥ..
dakṣasya ca tadā tena vīrabhadreṇa dhīmatā..
tacchiraḥ suhutaṃ kuṃḍe jvalixxxxxxx.. 5.7 ..
1.3.d:
गंधरात्पाट्यमानाच्च शिरश्छिन्नं दुरात्मनः..
दक्षस्य च तदा तेन वीरभद्रेण धीमता..
तच्छिरः सुहुतं कुंडे ज्वलिxxxxxxx.. 5.7 ..
1.3.m: And as the neck was being torn open, the head of the evil-minded / Dakṣa was then severed by the wise Vīrabhadra. / That head was well-offered into the blazing sacrificial pit […]

1.3.s:
ye cānya ṛṣayo devāḥ pitaro yakṣarākṣasāḥ..
gaṇairupadrutāḥ sarve palāyanaparā yayuḥ.. 5.8 ..
1.3.d:
ये चान्य ऋषयो देवाः पितरो यक्षराक्षसाः..
गणैरुपद्रुताः सर्वे पलायनपरा ययुः.. 5.8 ..
1.3.m: And the other ṛṣis, gods, ancestors, yakṣas, and rākṣasas, / all harassed by the gaṇas, fled intent on running away.

1.3.s:
caṃdrādityagaṇāḥ sarve grahanakṣatratārakāḥ..
sarve vicalitā hyāsangaṇaistepi hyupadrutāḥ.. 5.9 ..
1.3.d:
चंद्रादित्यगणाः सर्वे ग्रहनक्षत्रतारकाः..
सर्वे विचलिता ह्यासन्गणैस्तेपि ह्युपद्रुताः.. 5.9 ..
1.3.m: All the hosts of the moon and sun, the planets, constellations, and stars— / all of them were indeed displaced, harassed by the gaṇas as well.

1.3.s:
satyalokaṃ gato brahmā putraśokena pīḍitaḥ..
ciṃtayāmāsa cāvyagraḥ kiṃ kāryaṃ kāryamadya vai.. 5.10 ..
1.3.d:
सत्यलोकं गतो ब्रह्मा पुत्रशोकेन पीडितः..
चिंतयामास चाव्यग्रः किं कार्यं कार्यमद्य वै.. 5.10 ..
1.3.m: Afflicted by grief for his son, Brahmā went to Satyaloka. / Undisturbed, he reflected: "What duty must be done today?"

1.3.s:
manasā dūyamānena śaṃna lebhe pitāmahaḥ..
jñātvā sarvaṃ prayatnena duṣkṛtaṃ tasya pāpinaḥ.. 5.11 ..
1.3.d:
मनसा दूयमानेन शंन लेभे पितामहः..
ज्ञात्वा सर्वं प्रयत्नेन दुष्कृतं तस्य पापिनः.. 5.11 ..
1.3.m: With an anguished mind, the Grandfather found no peace, / knowing with great effort all the misdeeds of that sinner [Dakṣa].

1.3.s:
gamanāya matiṃ cakre kailāsaṃ parvataṃ prati..
haṃsārūḍho mahātejāḥ sarvadevaiḥ samanvitaḥ.. 5.12 ..
1.3.d:
गमनाय मतिं चक्रे कैलासं पर्वतं प्रति..
हंसारूढो महातेजाः सर्वदेवैः समन्वितः.. 5.12 ..
1.3.m: He made up his mind to go toward Mount Kailāsa. / Mounted on a swan, possessing great splendor, accompanied by all the gods,

1.3.s:
praviṣṭaḥ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ sa dadarśa sadāśivam..
ekāṃtavāsinaṃ rudraṃ śailādena samanvitam.. 5.13 ..
1.3.d:
प्रविष्टः पर्वतश्रेष्ठं स ददर्श सदाशिवम्..
एकांतवासिनं रुद्रं शैलादेन समन्वितम्.. 5.13 ..
1.3.m: Having entered that best of mountains, he beheld Sadāśiva, / Rudra dwelling in solitude, accompanied by Śailāda.

1.3.s:
kaparddinaṃ śriyā yuktaṃ vedāṃgānāṃ ca durgamam..
tathāvidhaṃ samālokya brahma kṣobhaparo'bhavat.. 5.14 ..
1.3.d:
कपर्द्दिनं श्रिया युक्तं वेदांगानां च दुर्गमम्..
तथाविधं समालोक्य ब्रह्म क्षोभपरोऽभवत्.. 5.14 ..
1.3.m: wearing matted locks, endowed with glory, and unapproachable even by the limbs of the Veda. / Seeing him in such a state, Brahmā became overwhelmed with distress.

1.3.s:
daṃḍavatpatito bhūmaukṣamāpayitumudyataḥ..
saṃspṛśaṃ statpadābjaṃ ca caturmukuṭakoṭibhiḥ..
stutiṃ kartuṃ samārebhe śivasya paramātmanaḥ.. 5.15 ..
1.3.d:
दंडवत्पतितो भूमौक्षमापयितुमुद्यतः..
संस्पृशं स्तत्पदाब्जं च चतुर्मुकुटकोटिभिः..
स्तुतिं कर्तुं समारेभे शिवस्य परमात्मनः.. 5.15 ..
1.3.m: He fell to the ground like a staff, resolved to beg forgiveness. / Touching his lotus feet with the tips of his four crowns, / he began to sing the praises of Śiva, the Supreme Self.

1.3.s:
..brahmovāca..
namo rudrāya śāṃtāya brahmaṇe paramātmane..
tvaṃ hi viśvasṛjāṃ sraṣṭā dhātā tvaṃ prapitāmahaḥ.. 5.16 ..
1.3.d:
..ब्रह्मोवाच..
नमो रुद्राय शांताय ब्रह्मणे परमात्मने..
त्वं हि विश्वसृजां स्रष्टा धाता त्वं प्रपितामहः.. 5.16 ..
1.3.m: Brahmā said: / Homage to Rudra, the peaceful one, the Brahman, the Supreme Self! / For you are the creator of the creators of the universe, the supporter, the great-grandfather.

1.3.s:
namo rudrāya mahate nīlakaṃṭhāya vedhase..
viśvāya viśvabījāya jagadānaṃdahetave.. 5.17 ..
1.3.d:
नमो रुद्राय महते नीलकंठाय वेधसे..
विश्वाय विश्वबीजाय जगदानंदहेतवे.. 5.17 ..
1.3.m: Homage to Rudra, the great one, the blue-throated one, the ordainer, / the universe itself, the seed of the universe, the cause of joy to the world.

1.3.s:
oṃkārastvaṃ vaṣaṭkāraḥ sarvāraṃbhapravartakaḥ..
yajñosi yajñakarmāsi yajñānāṃ ca pravartakaḥ.. 5.18 ..
1.3.d:
ओंकारस्त्वं वषट्कारः सर्वारंभप्रवर्तकः..
यज्ञोसि यज्ञकर्मासि यज्ञानां च प्रवर्तकः.. 5.18 ..
1.3.m: You are the syllable Oṃ, you are the vaṣaṭ-call, the instigator of all undertakings. / You are the sacrifice, you are the sacrificial act, and the promoter of sacrifices.

1.3.s:
sarveṣāṃ yajñakartṝṇāṃ tvameva pratipālakaḥ..
śaraṇyosi mahādeva sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ prabho..
rakṣa rakṣa mahādeva putraśokena pīḍitam.. 5.19 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वेषां यज्ञकर्तॄणां त्वमेव प्रतिपालकः..
शरण्योसि महादेव सर्वेषां प्राणिनां प्रभो..
रक्ष रक्ष महादेव पुत्रशोकेन पीडितम्.. 5.19 ..
1.3.m: You alone are the protector of all performers of sacrifice. / You are the refuge, O Mahādeva, of all living beings, O Lord! / Protect, protect [me], O Mahādeva, afflicted by grief for my son!

1.3.s:
..mahādeva uvāca..
śrṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā mama vākyaṃ pitāmaha..
dakṣasya yajñabhaṃgoyaṃ na kṛtaśca mayā kvacit.. 5.20 ..
1.3.d:
..महादेव उवाच..
श्रृणुष्वावहितो भूत्वा मम वाक्यं पितामह..
दक्षस्य यज्ञभंगोयं न कृतश्च मया क्वचित्.. 5.20 ..
1.3.m: Mahādeva said: / Listen attentively to my words, O Grandfather! / This disruption of Dakṣa’s sacrifice was never caused by me.

1.3.s: svīyena karmaṇā dakṣo hato brahmanna saṃśayaḥ.. 5.21 ..
1.3.d: स्वीयेन कर्मणा दक्षो हतो ब्रह्मन्न संशयः.. 5.21 ..
1.3.m: By his own action Dakṣa was slain, O Brahmā, there is no doubt.

1.3.s:
pareṣāṃ kleśadaṃ karma na kāryaṃ tatkadācana..
parameṣṭhinpareṣāṃ yadātmanastadbhaviṣyati.. 5.22 ..
1.3.d:
परेषां क्लेशदं कर्म न कार्यं तत्कदाचन..
परमेष्ठिन्परेषां यदात्मनस्तद्भविष्यति.. 5.22 ..
1.3.m: An action causing distress to others should never be done. / O highest Lord, whatever is done to others will happen to oneself.

1.3.s:
evamuktvā tadā rudro brahmaṇā sahitaḥ suraiḥ..
yayau kanakhalaṃ tīrthaṃ yajñavāṭaṃ prajāpateḥ.. 5.23 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तदा रुद्रो ब्रह्मणा सहितः सुरैः..
ययौ कनखलं तीर्थं यज्ञवाटं प्रजापतेः.. 5.23 ..
1.3.m: Having spoken thus, Rudra, accompanied by Brahmā and the gods, / went to the sacred ford Kanakhala, to the sacrificial enclosure of Prajāpati [Dakṣa].

1.3.s:
rudrastadā dadarśāya vīrabhadreṇa yatkṛtam..
svāhā svadhā tathā pūṣā bhṛgurmatimatāṃ varaḥ.. 5.24 ..
1.3.d:
रुद्रस्तदा ददर्शाय वीरभद्रेण यत्कृतम्..
स्वाहा स्वधा तथा पूषा भृगुर्मतिमतां वरः.. 5.24 ..
1.3.m: Then Rudra saw what had been done by Vīrabhadra: / Svāhā, Svadhā, and likewise Pūṣan, and Bhṛgu, the best of the wise,

1.3.s:
tadānya ṛṣayaḥ sarve pitaraśca tathāvidhāḥ..
ye'nye ca bahavastatra yakṣagaṃdharvakinnarāḥ.. 5.25 ..
1.3.d:
तदान्य ऋषयः सर्वे पितरश्च तथाविधाः..
येऽन्ये च बहवस्तत्र यक्षगंधर्वकिन्नराः.. 5.25 ..
1.3.m: and all the other seers, and the ancestors likewise, / and the many other yakṣas, gandharvas, and kinnaras there,

1.3.s: troṭitā luṃcitāścaiva mṛtāḥ kecidraṇājire.. 5.26 ..
1.3.d: त्रोटिता लुंचिताश्चैव मृताः केचिद्रणाजिरे.. 5.26 ..
1.3.m: were torn apart, stripped of hair, and some were dead on the field of battle.

1.3.s:
śaṃbhuṃ samāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā vīrabhadro gaṇaiḥ saha..
daṃḍapraṇāmasaṃyuktastasthāvagre sadāśivam.. 5.27 ..
1.3.d:
शंभुं समागतं दृष्ट्वा वीरभद्रो गणैः सह..
दंडप्रणामसंयुक्तस्तस्थावग्रे सदाशिवम्.. 5.27 ..
1.3.m: Seeing that Śambhu had arrived, Vīrabhadra, together with the gaṇas, / prostrated himself like a staff and stood before Sadāśiva.

1.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā puraḥ sthitaṃ rudro vīrabhadraṃ mahābalam..
upāca prahasanvākyaṃ kiṃ kṛtaṃ vīra nanvidam.. 5.28 ..
1.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा पुरः स्थितं रुद्रो वीरभद्रं महाबलम्..
उपाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं किं कृतं वीर नन्विदम्.. 5.28 ..
1.3.m: Seeing Vīrabhadra of great might standing before him, / Rudra laughed and spoke these words: “What is this that has been done, O hero?

1.3.s:
dakṣamānaya śīghraṃ bho yenedaṃ kṛtamīdṛśam..
yajñe vilakṣaṇaṃ tāta yasyedaṃ phalamīdṛśam.. 5.29 ..
1.3.d:
दक्षमानय शीघ्रं भो येनेदं कृतमीदृशम्..
यज्ञे विलक्षणं तात यस्येदं फलमीदृशम्.. 5.29 ..
1.3.m: Bring Dakṣa quickly, by whom such a deed was done / in an extraordinary sacrifice, my dear, and whose fruit is of such a kind!”

1.3.s:
evamuktaḥ śaṃkareṇa vīrabhadrastvarānvitaḥ..
kabaṃdhamānayitvātha śaṃbhoragre tadākṣipat.. 5.30 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्तः शंकरेण वीरभद्रस्त्वरान्वितः..
कबंधमानयित्वाथ शंभोरग्रे तदाक्षिपत्.. 5.30 ..
1.3.m: Thus addressed by Śaṃkara, Vīrabhadra, with haste, / brought the headless trunk and cast it down before Śambhu.

1.3.s:
tadoktaḥ śaṃkareṇaiva vīrabhadro mahāmanāḥ..
śiraḥ kenā panītaṃ ca dakṣasyāsya durātmanaḥ.. 5.31 ..
1.3.d:
तदोक्तः शंकरेणैव वीरभद्रो महामनाः..
शिरः केना पनीतं च दक्षस्यास्य दुरात्मनः.. 5.31 ..
1.3.m: Then high-minded Vīrabhadra was asked by Śaṃkara himself: / “By whom was the head of this wicked Dakṣa taken away?

1.3.s:
dāsyāmi jīvanaṃ vīra kuṭilasyāpi cādhunā..
evamuktaḥ śaṃkareṇa vīrabhadro'bravītpunaḥ.. 5.32 ..
1.3.d:
दास्यामि जीवनं वीर कुटिलस्यापि चाधुना..
एवमुक्तः शंकरेण वीरभद्रोऽब्रवीत्पुनः.. 5.32 ..
1.3.m: Even though he was deceitful, O hero, I shall now give him life.” / Thus addressed by Śaṃkara, Vīrabhadra spoke again:

1.3.s:
mayā śiro hutaṃ cāgnau tadānīmeva śaṃkara..
avaśiṣṭaṃ śiraḥśaṃbho paśośca vikṛtānanam.. 5.33 ..
1.3.d:
मया शिरो हुतं चाग्नौ तदानीमेव शंकर..
अवशिष्टं शिरःशंभो पशोश्च विकृताननम्.. 5.33 ..
1.3.m: “The head was offered by me into the fire at that very time, O Śaṃkara! / What remains, O Śambhu, is the head of the sacrificial animal with a deformed face.”

1.3.s:
iti jñātvā tato rudraḥ kabaṃdhopari cākṣipat..
śiraḥ paśośca vikṛtaṃ kūrcayuktaṃ bhayāvaham.. 5.34 ..
1.3.d:
इति ज्ञात्वा ततो रुद्रः कबंधोपरि चाक्षिपत्..
शिरः पशोश्च विकृतं कूर्चयुक्तं भयावहम्.. 5.34 ..
1.3.m: Knowing this, Rudra then placed upon the headless trunk / the deformed, bearded, and terrifying head of the sacrificial animal.

1.3.s:
sa dakṣo jīvitaṃ lebhe prasādācchaṃkarasya ca..
sa dṛṣṭvāgre tadā rudraṃ dakṣo lajjāsamanvitaḥ..
tuṣṭāva praṇato bhūtvā śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram.. 5.35 ..
1.3.d:
स दक्षो जीवितं लेभे प्रसादाच्छंकरस्य च..
स दृष्ट्वाग्रे तदा रुद्रं दक्षो लज्जासमन्वितः..
तुष्टाव प्रणतो भूत्वा शंकरं लोकशंकरम्.. 5.35 ..
1.3.m: Dakṣa obtained life by the grace of Śaṃkara. / Then, seeing Rudra before him, Dakṣa, filled with shame, / bowed down and praised Śaṃkara, the benefactor of the world.

1.3.s:
..dakṣa uvāca..
namāmi devaṃ varadaṃ vareṇyaṃ namāmi deveśvaraṃ sanātanam..
namāmi devādhipamīśvaraṃ haraṃ namāmi śaṃbhuṃ jagadekabaṃdhum.. 5.36 ..
1.3.d:
..दक्ष उवाच..
नमामि देवं वरदं वरेण्यं नमामि देवेश्वरं सनातनम्..
नमामि देवाधिपमीश्वरं हरं नमामि शंभुं जगदेकबंधुम्.. 5.36 ..
1.3.m: Dakṣa said: / I bow to the boon-giving God, the most choice; I bow to the eternal Lord of the gods. / I bow to Hara, the supreme master and Lord of the gods; I bow to Śambhu, the sole friend of the universe.

1.3.s:
namāmi viśveśvaraviśvarūpaṃ sanātanaṃ brahma nijātmarūpam..
namāmi sarvaṃ nijabhāvabhāvaṃ varaṃ vareṇyaṃ nato'smi.. 5.37 ..
1.3.d:
नमामि विश्वेश्वरविश्वरूपं सनातनं ब्रह्म निजात्मरूपम्..
नमामि सर्वं निजभावभावं वरं वरेण्यं नतोऽस्मि.. 5.37 ..
1.3.m: I bow to the Lord of the universe whose form is the universe, the eternal Brahman whose form is one’s own Self. / I bow to the All, the source of one's own being; to the highest, the most choice, I am bowed down.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
dakṣeṇa saṃstuto rudro babhāṣe prahasanrahaḥ.. 5.38 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
दक्षेण संस्तुतो रुद्रो बभाषे प्रहसन्रहः.. 5.38 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Praised by Dakṣa, Rudra laughed and spoke in secret:

1.3.s:
..hara uvāca..
caturvidhā bhajaṃte māṃ janāḥ sukṛtinaḥ sadā..
ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī ca dvijasattama.. 5.39 ..
1.3.d:
..हर उवाच..
चतुर्विधा भजंते मां जनाः सुकृतिनः सदा..
आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च द्विजसत्तम.. 5.39 ..
1.3.m: Hara said: / Four kinds of virtuous men constantly worship me: / the afflicted, the seeker of knowledge, the seeker of wealth, and the man of knowledge, O best of the twice-born.

1.3.s:
tasmānme jñāninaḥ sarve priyāḥ syurnātra saṃśayaḥ..
vinā jñānena māṃ prāptuṃ yataṃte te hi bāliśaḥ.. 5.40 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मान्मे ज्ञानिनः सर्वे प्रियाः स्युर्नात्र संशयः..
विना ज्ञानेन मां प्राप्तुं यतंते ते हि बालिशः.. 5.40 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, all who possess knowledge are dear to me; there is no doubt in this. / For those who strive to attain me without knowledge are childish fools.

1.3.s: kevalaṃ karmaṇā tvaṃ hi saṃsārāttartumicchasi.. 5.41 ..
1.3.d: केवलं कर्मणा त्वं हि संसारात्तर्तुमिच्छसि.. 5.41 ..
1.3.m: You indeed wish to cross over cyclic existence merely by action.

1.3.s:
na vedaiśca na dānaiśca na yajñaistapasā kvacit..
na śaknuvaṃti māṃ prāptuṃ mūḍhāḥ karmmavaśānarāḥ.. 5.42 ..
1.3.d:
न वेदैश्च न दानैश्च न यज्ञैस्तपसा क्वचित्..
न शक्नुवंति मां प्राप्तुं मूढाः कर्म्मवशानराः.. 5.42 ..
1.3.m: Neither by the Vedas, nor by gifts, nor by sacrifices, nor ever by austerity / can foolish men enslaved by actions reach me.

1.3.s:
tasmājjñānaparo bhūtvā kuru karmma samāhitaḥ..
sukhaduḥkhasamo bhūtvā sukhī bhava niraṃtaram.. 5.43 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माज्ज्ञानपरो भूत्वा कुरु कर्म्म समाहितः..
सुखदुःखसमो भूत्वा सुखी भव निरंतरम्.. 5.43 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, devoted to knowledge, perform action with composure. / Becoming equal in pleasure and pain, be constantly happy.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
upadiṣṭastadā tena śaṃbhunā parameṣṭhinā..
dakṣaṃ tatraiva saṃsthāpāya yayo rudraḥ svaparvatam.. 5.44 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
उपदिष्टस्तदा तेन शंभुना परमेष्ठिना..
दक्षं तत्रैव संस्थापाय ययो रुद्रः स्वपर्वतम्.. 5.44 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Having thus instructed Dakṣa and established him there, / that Śambhu, the supreme lord, Rudra, departed for his own mountain.

1.3.s:
brahmaṇāpi tathā sarve bhṛgvādyāśca maharṣayaḥ..
āśvāsitā bodhitāśca jñāninaścābhavankṣaṇāt.. 5.45 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मणापि तथा सर्वे भृग्वाद्याश्च महर्षयः..
आश्वासिता बोधिताश्च ज्ञानिनश्चाभवन्क्षणात्.. 5.45 ..
1.3.m: All the great seers as well, Bhṛgu and the others, were comforted and enlightened / by Brahmā, and in an instant they became possessors of knowledge.

1.3.s: gataḥ pitāmaho brahmā tataśca sadanaṃ svakam.. 5.46 ..
1.3.d: गतः पितामहो ब्रह्मा ततश्च सदनं स्वकम्.. 5.46 ..
1.3.m: The grandfather Brahmā then went to his own abode.

1.3.s:
dakṣopi ca svayaṃ vākyātparaṃ bodhamupāgataḥ.
śivadhyānaparo bhūtvā tapastepe mahāmanāḥ.. 5.47 ..
1.3.d:
दक्षोपि च स्वयं वाक्यात्परं बोधमुपागतः.
शिवध्यानपरो भूत्वा तपस्तेपे महामनाः.. 5.47 ..
1.3.m: Dakṣa too, by his word alone, attained supreme enlightenment. / Intent on meditating upon Śiva, the high-minded one performed austerity.

1.3.s: tasmātsarvaprayatnena saṃkṣevyo bhagavāñchivaḥ.. 5.48 ..
1.3.d: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन संक्षेव्यो भगवाञ्छिवः.. 5.48 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, the blessed Lord Śiva should be served with every effort.

1.3.s:
saṃmārjanaṃ ca kurvaṃti narā ye ca śivāṃgaṇe..
te vai śivapuraṃ prāpya jagadvaṃdyā bhagsi ca.. 5.49 ..
1.3.d:
संमार्जनं च कुर्वंति नरा ये च शिवांगणे..
ते वै शिवपुरं प्राप्य जगद्वंद्या भग्सि च.. 5.49 ..
1.3.m: Those men who sweep the courtyard of Śiva / indeed attain the city of Śiva and become praised by the world.

1.3.s:
ye śivasya prayacchati darppaṇaṃ sumahāprabham..
bhaviṣyaṃti śivasyāgre pārṣadatvena te narāḥ.. 5.50 ..
1.3.d:
ये शिवस्य प्रयच्छति दर्प्पणं सुमहाप्रभम्..
भविष्यंति शिवस्याग्रे पार्षदत्वेन ते नराः.. 5.50 ..
1.3.m: Those who offer a mirror of great brilliance to Śiva, / those men shall become attendants before Śiva.

1.3.s:
cāmarāṇi prayacchaṃti devadevasya śūlinaḥ..
cāmarairvījyapānāste bhaviṣyaṃti jagattraya.. 5.51 ..
1.3.d:
चामराणि प्रयच्छंति देवदेवस्य शूलिनः..
चामरैर्वीज्यपानास्ते भविष्यंति जगत्त्रय.. 5.51 ..
1.3.m: Those who offer flywhisks to the God of gods, the wielder of the trident, / will be fanned with flywhisks in the three worlds.

1.3.s:
dīpadānaṃ prayacchaṃti mahādevālaye narāḥ..
tejasvino bhaviṣyaṃti te trailokyapradīpakā.. 5.52 ..
1.3.d:
दीपदानं प्रयच्छंति महादेवालये नराः..
तेजस्विनो भविष्यंति ते त्रैलोक्यप्रदीपका.. 5.52 ..
1.3.m: The men who offer the gift of a lamp in the temple of Mahādeva / will become full of splendor, illuminating the three worlds.

1.3.s:
dhūpaṃ ye vai prayacchanti śivāya paramātmane..
yaśasvino bhaviṣyaṃti uddharanti kuladvayam.. 5.53 ..
1.3.d:
धूपं ये वै प्रयच्छन्ति शिवाय परमात्मने..
यशस्विनो भविष्यंति उद्धरन्ति कुलद्वयम्.. 5.53 ..
1.3.m: Those who indeed offer incense to Śiva, the Supreme Self, / will become renowned and deliver both their maternal and paternal families.

1.3.s:
naivedyaṃ ye prayacchaṃti bhakayā hariharāgrataḥ..
sikthesikthe kratuphalaṃ prāpnuvaṃti hi te narāḥ.. 5.54 ..
1.3.d:
नैवेद्यं ये प्रयच्छंति भकया हरिहराग्रतः..
सिक्थेसिक्थे क्रतुफलं प्राप्नुवंति हि ते नराः.. 5.54 ..
1.3.m: Those men who offer food offerings with devotion before Hari-Hara / obtain the fruit of a sacrifice with every grain of rice.

1.3.s:
bhagnaṃ śivālayaṃ ye ca prakurvaṃti narottamāḥ..
prāpnuvati phala te vai dviguṇaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 5.55 ..
1.3.d:
भग्नं शिवालयं ये च प्रकुर्वंति नरोत्तमाः..
प्राप्नुवति फल ते वै द्विगुणं नात्र संशयः.. 5.55 ..
1.3.m: And the best of men who repair a broken temple of Śiva / obtain double the fruit; there is no doubt in this.

1.3.s:
nūtanaṃ ye prakṛrvaṃti iṣṭakairaśmanāpi vā..
svarge hi te pramodaṃte yāvattiṣṭhati nirmalam..
yaśo bhūmau dvijaśreṣṭhā kāryā vicāraṇā.. 5.56 ..
1.3.d:
नूतनं ये प्रकृर्वंति इष्टकैरश्मनापि वा..
स्वर्गे हि ते प्रमोदंते यावत्तिष्ठति निर्मलम्..
यशो भूमौ द्विजश्रेष्ठा कार्या विचारणा.. 5.56 ..
1.3.m: Those who construct a new one, either with bricks or with stone, / rejoice in heaven as long as their spotless / fame remains on earth, O best of the twice-born; [no] doubt should be entertained.

1.3.s:
kārayaṃti ca ye viprāḥ prāsādaṃ bahubhūmikam..
śivasyātha mahāprājñāḥ prāpnuvaṃti parāṃ gatim.. 5.57 ..
1.3.d:
कारयंति च ये विप्राः प्रासादं बहुभूमिकम्..
शिवस्याथ महाप्राज्ञाः प्राप्नुवंति परां गतिम्.. 5.57 ..
1.3.m: And those brahmins, great in wisdom, who cause a multi-storied temple / of Śiva to be built, attain the supreme goal.

1.3.s:
śuddhaṃ dhavalitaṃ ye ca kurvanti haramaṃdiram..
svīyaṃ parakṛtaṃ cāpi te'pi yāṃti parāṃ gatim.. 5.58 ..
1.3.d:
शुद्धं धवलितं ये च कुर्वन्ति हरमंदिरम्..
स्वीयं परकृतं चापि तेऽपि यांति परां गतिम्.. 5.58 ..
1.3.m: And those who clean and whitewash Hara's temple, / whether their own or made by another, they too attain the supreme state. 5.58

1.3.s:
vitānaṃ ye prayacchati narāḥ sukṛtinopi hi..
tārayati kulaṃ kṛtsnaṃ śivalokaṃ gatāḥ punaḥ.. 5.59 ..
1.3.d:
वितानं ये प्रयच्छति नराः सुकृतिनोपि हि..
तारयति कुलं कृत्स्नं शिवलोकं गताः पुनः.. 5.59 ..
1.3.m: Indeed, those meritorious men who offer a canopy / deliver their entire lineage and go, moreover, to Śiva's realm. 5.59

1.3.s:
ye ca nādamayīṃ ghaṃṭāṃ nibadhnaṃti śivālaye..
tejasvinaḥ kīrtimaṃto bhaviṣyaṃti jagattraye.. 5.60 ..
1.3.d:
ये च नादमयीं घंटां निबध्नंति शिवालये..
तेजस्विनः कीर्तिमंतो भविष्यंति जगत्त्रये.. 5.60 ..
1.3.m: And those who hang a resonant bell in Śiva's temple / will become radiant and renowned in the three worlds. 5.60

1.3.s:
ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ cānupaśyati..
āḍhyo vāpi daridro vā sukhaṃ duḥkhātpracucyate.. 5.61 ..
1.3.d:
एककालं द्विकालं वा त्रिकालं चानुपश्यति..
आढ्यो वापि दरिद्रो वा सुखं दुःखात्प्रचुच्यते.. 5.61 ..
1.3.m: Whether rich or poor, one who beholds [him] / once, twice, or thrice a day, is happily freed from suffering. 5.61

1.3.s:
śraddhāvānbhajate yo vā śivāya paramātmane..
kulakoṭiṃ samuddhṛtya śivena saha modate.. 5.62 ..
1.3.d:
श्रद्धावान्भजते यो वा शिवाय परमात्मने..
कुलकोटिं समुद्धृत्य शिवेन सह मोदते.. 5.62 ..
1.3.m: Or the faithful person who worships Śiva, the Supreme Self, / delivers ten million ancestors and rejoices with Śiva. 5.62

1.3.s:
atraivodāharaṃtīma mitihāsaṃ purātanam..
aiṃdradyumneśca saṃvādaṃ yamasya ca mahātmanaḥ.. 5.63 ..
1.3.d:
अत्रैवोदाहरंतीम मितिहासं पुरातनम्..
ऐंद्रद्युम्नेश्च संवादं यमस्य च महात्मनः.. 5.63 ..
1.3.m: In this very connection they cite this ancient history, / the conversation between Indradyumna's son and the great-souled Yama. 5.63

1.3.s:
purā kṛtayuge hyasīdindraseno narādhipaḥ..
pratiṣṭhānādhipo vīro mṛgayārasikaḥ sadā.. 5.64 ..
1.3.d:
पुरा कृतयुगे ह्यसीदिन्द्रसेनो नराधिपः..
प्रतिष्ठानाधिपो वीरो मृगयारसिकः सदा.. 5.64 ..
1.3.m: Long ago, in the Kṛta age, there was a king named Indrasena, / the ruler of Pratiṣṭhāna, a warrior who was ever fond of hunting. 5.64

1.3.s:
abrahmaṇyaḥ sadā krūraḥ kevalāsutṛpaḥ sadā..
paraprāṇaurnijaprāṇānpuṣṇāti sa khalaḥ sadā.. 5.65 ..
1.3.d:
अब्रह्मण्यः सदा क्रूरः केवलासुतृपः सदा..
परप्राणौर्निजप्राणान्पुष्णाति स खलः सदा.. 5.65 ..
1.3.m: Hostile to brahmins, always cruel, always gratifying only his own belly, / that villain constantly sustained his own life through the lives of others. 5.65

1.3.s:
parastrīlaṃ paṭo'tyaṃtaṃ paradravyeṣu lolupaḥ..
brāhmaṇā ghātitāstena surāpaśca niraṃtaram.. 5.66 ..
1.3.d:
परस्त्रीलं पटोऽत्यंतं परद्रव्येषु लोलुपः..
ब्राह्मणा घातितास्तेन सुरापश्च निरंतरम्.. 5.66 ..
1.3.m: Excessively addicted to other men's wives, covetous of others' wealth, / brahmins were killed by him, and he incessantly drank liquor. 5.66

1.3.s:
gurulatpagatotyarthaṃ sadā sauvarṇataskaraḥ..
tathābhūtānugāḥ sarve rājñastasya durātmanaḥ.. 5.67 ..
1.3.d:
गुरुलत्पगतोत्यर्थं सदा सौवर्णतस्करः..
तथाभूतानुगाः सर्वे राज्ञस्तस्य दुरात्मनः.. 5.67 ..
1.3.m: He frequently violated his guru's bed and was ever a thief of gold; / all the followers of that evil-minded king were just like him. 5.67

1.3.s:
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ rājyaṃ cakāra sa durātmavān..
tataḥ kālena mahatā paṃcatvaṃ prāpa durmatiḥ.. 5.68 ..
1.3.d:
एवं बहुविधं राज्यं चकार स दुरात्मवान्..
ततः कालेन महता पंचत्वं प्राप दुर्मतिः.. 5.68 ..
1.3.m: In this manner that evil-natured man ruled his kingdom in various ways. / Then, in the course of long time, the wicked-minded man met his death. 5.68

1.3.s:
tadā yāmyaiśca nīto'sāviṃdraseno durātmavān..
yamāntikamanuprāptastadā rājā sakalmaṣaḥ.. 5.69 ..
1.3.d:
तदा याम्यैश्च नीतोऽसाविंद्रसेनो दुरात्मवान्..
यमान्तिकमनुप्राप्तस्तदा राजा सकल्मषः.. 5.69 ..
1.3.m: Then, that evil-natured Indrasena was carried off by Yama's attendants; / the stained king then arrived before Yama. 5.69

1.3.s:
yamena dṛṣṭastatrāsāviṃdrasenogrataḥ sthitaḥ..
abhyutthānaparo bhūtvā nanāma śirasā śivam.. 5.70 ..
1.3.d:
यमेन दृष्टस्तत्रासाविंद्रसेनोग्रतः स्थितः..
अभ्युत्थानपरो भूत्वा ननाम शिरसा शिवम्.. 5.70 ..
1.3.m: There he was seen by Yama, standing in front—that Indrasena; / standing up [in reverence], Yama bowed his head to Śiva. 5.70

1.3.s:
dūtānsaṃbhartsayāmāsa yamo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ..
pāśairbaddhaṃ caṃdrasenaṃ muktvā provāca dharmarāṭ.. 5.71 ..
1.3.d:
दूतान्संभर्त्सयामास यमो धर्मभृतां वरः..
पाशैर्बद्धं चंद्रसेनं मुक्त्वा प्रोवाच धर्मराट्.. 5.71 ..
1.3.m: Yama, the best among upholders of dharma, rebuked his messengers; / having freed Candrasena who was bound with nooses, the King of Dharma said: 5.71

1.3.s:
gaccha puṇyatamām̐llokānbhuṃkṣva rājanyasattama..
yāvadiṃdraśca nāke'sti yāvatsūryo nabhastale.. 5.72 ..
1.3.d:
गच्छ पुण्यतमाम्̐ल्लोकान्भुंक्ष्व राजन्यसत्तम..
यावदिंद्रश्च नाकेऽस्ति यावत्सूर्यो नभस्तले.. 5.72 ..
1.3.m: “Go to the most sacred realms, and enjoy them, O best of kings, / as long as Indra remains in heaven and the sun in the vault of the sky, 5.72

1.3.s:
paṃcabhūtāni yāvacca tāvattvaṃ ca sukhī bhava..
sukṛtī tvaṃ mahārāja śivabhakto'si nityadā.. 5.73 ..
1.3.d:
पंचभूतानि यावच्च तावत्त्वं च सुखी भव..
सुकृती त्वं महाराज शिवभक्तोऽसि नित्यदा.. 5.73 ..
1.3.m: and as long as the five elements endure, so long be happy! / You are a doer of good deeds, O great king, and ever a devotee of Śiva.” 5.73

1.3.s:
yamasya vacanaṃ śrutvā iṃdrasenobhyabhāṣata..
ahaṃ śivaṃ na jānāmi mṛgayārasiko hyaham.. 5.74 ..
1.3.d:
यमस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा इंद्रसेनोभ्यभाषत..
अहं शिवं न जानामि मृगयारसिको ह्यहम्.. 5.74 ..
1.3.m: Hearing Yama's words, Indrasena replied: / “I do not know Śiva, for I was only fond of the hunt.” 5.74

1.3.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya yamo bhāṣyamabhāṣata..
āhara praharasveti uktaṃ cedaṃ sadā tvayā.. 5.75 ..
1.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य यमो भाष्यमभाषत..
आहर प्रहरस्वेति उक्तं चेदं सदा त्वया.. 5.75 ..
1.3.m: Hearing those words of his, Yama spoke [this] reply: / “'Bring [it]!' (āhara), 'Strike!' (prahara)—this was constantly spoken by you. 5.75

1.3.s:
tena karmavipākena sadā pūtosi mānada..
tasmāttvaṃ gaccha kailāsaṃ parvataṃ śaṃkaraṃ prati.. 5.76 ..
1.3.d:
तेन कर्मविपाकेन सदा पूतोसि मानद..
तस्मात्त्वं गच्छ कैलासं पर्वतं शंकरं प्रति.. 5.76 ..
1.3.m: By the fruition of that deed you are forever purified, O courteous one; / therefore, go to Mount Kailāsa, to Śaṃkara.” 5.76

1.3.s:
evaṃ saṃbhāṣamāṇasya yamasya ca mahātmanaḥ..
āgatāḥ śivadvatāste vṛṣārūḍhā mahāprabhāḥ.. 5.77 ..
1.3.d:
एवं संभाषमाणस्य यमस्य च महात्मनः..
आगताः शिवद्वतास्ते वृषारूढा महाप्रभाः.. 5.77 ..
1.3.m: While the great-souled Yama was speaking thus, / those messengers of Śiva arrived, mounted on bulls and of great splendor. 5.77

1.3.s:
nīlakaṃṭhā daśabhujāḥ paṃcavaktrāstrilocanāḥ..
kaparddinaḥ kuṃḍalinaḥ śaśaṃkāṃkitamaulayaḥ.. 5.78 ..
1.3.d:
नीलकंठा दशभुजाः पंचवक्त्रास्त्रिलोचनाः..
कपर्द्दिनः कुंडलिनः शशंकांकितमौलयः.. 5.78 ..
1.3.m: Blue-throated, ten-armed, five-faced, three-eyed, / wearing matted hair and earrings, their crests marked by the moon. 5.78

1.3.s:
tāndṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya yamo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ..
pūjayāmāsa tānsarvānmaheṃdrapratimāṃstadā.. 5.79 ..
1.3.d:
तान्दृष्ट्वा सहसोत्थाय यमो धर्मभृतां वरः..
पूजयामास तान्सर्वान्महेंद्रप्रतिमांस्तदा.. 5.79 ..
1.3.m: Seeing them, Yama, the best among upholders of dharma, rose up at once, / and then honored them all, who resembled Mahendra. 5.79

1.3.s:
tvarīrenaiva te sarve ūcurvaivasvataṃ yamam..
atrāgato mahābhāga iṃdraseno'mitadyutiḥ..
nāmnāḥ pravarttako nityaṃ rudrasya ca mahātmanaḥ.. 5.80 ..
1.3.d:
त्वरीरेनैव ते सर्वे ऊचुर्वैवस्वतं यमम्..
अत्रागतो महाभाग इंद्रसेनोऽमितद्युतिः..
नाम्नाः प्रवर्त्तको नित्यं रुद्रस्य च महात्मनः.. 5.80 ..
1.3.m: Immediately they all said to Yama, son of Vivasvat: / “Indrasena of boundless splendor has arrived here, O fortunate one, / who constantly uttered the name of the great-souled Rudra.” 5.80

1.3.s:
śrutvā ca vacanaṃ teṣāṃ yamena ca puraskṛtaḥ..
iṃdraseno vimānasthaḥ preṣito hi śivālayam.. 5.81 ..
1.3.d:
श्रुत्वा च वचनं तेषां यमेन च पुरस्कृतः..
