इंद्रसेनो विमानस्थः प्रेषितो हि शिवालयम्.. 5.81 ..
1.3.m: Having heard their words and being honored by Yama, / Indrasena, seated in an aerial chariot, was sent to the abode of Śiva. 5.81

1.3.s:
ānītoyaṃ tadā taiśca pārṣadapravarottamaiḥ..
śaṃbhunā hi tadā dṛṣṭa iṃdraseno'mitadyutiḥ.. 5.82 ..
1.3.d:
आनीतोयं तदा तैश्च पार्षदप्रवरोत्तमैः..
शंभुना हि तदा दृष्ट इंद्रसेनोऽमितद्युतिः.. 5.82 ..
1.3.m: Brought then by those supreme, best attendants, / Indrasena of boundless splendor was beheld by Śambhu. 5.82

1.3.s:
abhyutthāyāgato rudraḥ pariṣvajya tadā nṛpam..
arddhāsanagataṃ kṛtvā iṃdrasenaṃ tato'bravīt.. 5.83 ..
1.3.d:
अभ्युत्थायागतो रुद्रः परिष्वज्य तदा नृपम्..
अर्द्धासनगतं कृत्वा इंद्रसेनं ततोऽब्रवीत्.. 5.83 ..
1.3.m: Rising, Rudra approached and embraced the king; / seating Indrasena on half of his throne, he then said to him: 5.83

1.3.s:
kiṃ dātavyaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha prayacchāmi tavepsitam..
iti śrutvā vacastasya maheśasya tadā nṛpaḥ..
ānaṃdāśrukaṇānmuṃcanpremṇā novāca kiṃcana.. 5.84 ..
1.3.d:
किं दातव्यं नृपश्रेष्ठ प्रयच्छामि तवेप्सितम्..
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य महेशस्य तदा नृपः..
आनंदाश्रुकणान्मुंचन्प्रेम्णा नोवाच किंचन.. 5.84 ..
1.3.m: “What shall be given, O best of kings? I grant what you desire.” / Hearing those words of the Great Lord, the king then, / shedding tears of joy, could say nothing out of love. 5.84

1.3.s:
tadā kṛto maheśena pārṣado hi mahātmanā..
caṃḍo nāmnāca vikhyātomuṇḍasya ca sakhā priyaḥ.. 5.85 ..
1.3.d:
तदा कृतो महेशेन पार्षदो हि महात्मना..
चंडो नाम्नाच विख्यातोमुण्डस्य च सखा प्रियः.. 5.85 ..
1.3.m: Then he was made an attendant by the great-souled Great Lord, / known by the name Caṇḍa, and the dear friend of Muṇḍa. 5.85

1.3.s:
nāmoccāraṇamātreṇa rudrasya paramātmanaḥ..
siddhiṃ prāpto hi pāpiṣṭha idraseno narādhipaḥ.. 5.86 ..
1.3.d:
नामोच्चारणमात्रेण रुद्रस्य परमात्मनः..
सिद्धिं प्राप्तो हि पापिष्ठ इद्रसेनो नराधिपः.. 5.86 ..
1.3.m: By merely uttering the name of Rudra, the Supreme Self, / even that most sinful king Indrasena attained perfection. 5.86

1.3.s:
rahehareti vai nāmnā śaṃbhoścakradharasya ca..
rakṣitā bahavo martyāḥ śivena paramātmanā.. 5.87 ..
1.3.d:
रहेहरेति वै नाम्ना शंभोश्चक्रधरस्य च..
रक्षिता बहवो मर्त्याः शिवेन परमात्मना.. 5.87 ..
1.3.m: Indeed, by the syllables “ra” and “ha”, the names of Śambhu and the Discus-wielder, / many mortals have been protected by Śiva, the Supreme Self. 5.87

1.3.s:
maheśānnāparo devo dṛśyatebhuvanatraye..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjanīyaḥ sadāśivaḥ.. 5.88 ..
1.3.d:
महेशान्नापरो देवो दृश्यतेभुवनत्रये..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन पूजनीयः सदाशिवः.. 5.88 ..
1.3.m: No god higher than the Great Lord is seen in the three worlds; / therefore, Sadāśiva must be worshipped with every effort. 5.88

1.3.s:
patraiḥpuṣpaiḥ phalairvāpi jalairvā vimalaiḥ sadā..
karavīraiḥ pūjyamānaḥ śaṃkaro varado bhavet.. 5.89 ..
1.3.d:
पत्रैःपुष्पैः फलैर्वापि जलैर्वा विमलैः सदा..
करवीरैः पूज्यमानः शंकरो वरदो भवेत्.. 5.89 ..
1.3.m: Worshipped with leaves, flowers, or fruits, or ever with pure water, / [or] with oleanders, Śaṃkara becomes the granter of boons. 5.89

1.3.s:
karavīrāddaśaguṇamarkapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate..
vibhūtyādikṛtaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram.. 5.90 ..
1.3.d:
करवीराद्दशगुणमर्कपुष्पं विशिष्यते..
विभूत्यादिकृतं सर्वं जगदेतच्चराचरम्.. 5.90 ..
1.3.m: Ten times superior to oleander is the arka flower. / This whole universe of mobile and immobile beings is brought forth by holy ash and the rest; 5.90

1.3.s:
śivasyāṃgaṇalagnā yā tasmāttāṃ dhārayetsadā..
tatastripuṃḍre yatpumyaṃ tacchṛṇudhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ.. 5.91 ..
1.3.d:
शिवस्यांगणलग्ना या तस्मात्तां धारयेत्सदा..
ततस्त्रिपुंड्रे यत्पुम्यं तच्छृणुध्वं द्विजोत्तमाः.. 5.91 ..
1.3.m: therefore one should always wear that which belongs to Śiva's courtyard. / Next, hear the merit of the tripuṇḍra, O best of brahmins! 5.91

1.3.s:
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ tacchṛṇudhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ..
stenaḥ ko'pi mahāpāpo ghātito rājadūtakaiḥ.. 5.92 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं तच्छृणुध्वं द्विजोत्तमाः..
स्तेनः कोऽपि महापापो घातितो राजदूतकैः.. 5.92 ..
1.3.m: It takes away all sin; hear of that merit, O best of brahmins! / A certain thief, a great sinner, was slain by the king's emissaries. 5.92

1.3.s:
taṃ khādituṃ samāyātaḥ śvāśirasyuparisthitaḥ..
nakhāṃtarālasaṃlagnā rakṣā tasyaiva pāpinaḥ.. 5.93 ..
1.3.d:
तं खादितुं समायातः श्वाशिरस्युपरिस्थितः..
नखांतरालसंलग्ना रक्षा तस्यैव पापिनः.. 5.93 ..
1.3.m: A dog came to eat him and stood upon his head; / ash clinging between its claws [fell] upon that very sinner, 5.93

1.3.s:
lalāṭe patitā tasya tripuṃḍrāṃkiṃtamudrayā..
caitanyena vinā tasya dehamātraikalagnayā.. 5.94 ..
1.3.d:
ललाटे पतिता तस्य त्रिपुंड्रांकिंतमुद्रया..
चैतन्येन विना तस्य देहमात्रैकलग्नया.. 5.94 ..
1.3.m: and dropped onto his forehead in the imprint of a tripuṇḍra mark, / clinging merely to his body devoid of consciousness. 5.94

1.3.s:
kailāsaṃ taskaro nīto rudradūtaistatastadā..
vibhūtermahimānaṃ tu ko viśeṣiturmahati.. 5.95 ..
1.3.d:
कैलासं तस्करो नीतो रुद्रदूतैस्ततस्तदा..
विभूतेर्महिमानं तु को विशेषितुर्महति.. 5.95 ..
1.3.m: Then that thief was immediately taken to Kailāsa by Rudra's emissaries. / Who indeed is able to describe the excellence of the greatness of holy ash? 5.95

1.3.s:
vibhūtvā maṃḍitāṃgānāṃ narāṇāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām..
mukhe paṃcākṣaro yeṣāṃ rudrāste nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 5.96 ..
1.3.d:
विभूत्वा मंडितांगानां नराणां पुण्यकर्मणाम्..
मुखे पंचाक्षरो येषां रुद्रास्ते नात्र संशयः.. 5.96 ..
1.3.m: Men of meritorious deeds whose bodies are adorned with holy ash, / on whose mouth is the five-syllable mantra—they are Rudras; of this there is no doubt. 5.96

1.3.s:
jaṭākalāpino ye ca ye rudrākṣavibhūṣaṇāḥ..
te vai manuṣyarūpeṇa rudrā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ.. 5.97 ..
1.3.d:
जटाकलापिनो ये च ये रुद्राक्षविभूषणाः..
ते वै मनुष्यरूपेण रुद्रा नास्त्यत्र संशयः.. 5.97 ..
1.3.m: Those who have masses of matted hair, and those adorned with rudrākṣas, / they are indeed Rudras in human form; of this there is no doubt. 5.97

1.3.s:
tasmātsadāśivaḥ puṃbhiḥ pūjanīyo hi nityaśaḥ..
prātarmadhyāhnakāle ca sāyaṃ saṃdhyā viśiṣyate.. 5.98 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्सदाशिवः पुंभिः पूजनीयो हि नित्यशः..
प्रातर्मध्याह्नकाले च सायं संध्या विशिष्यते.. 5.98 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, Sadāśiva should be worshipped constantly by men / in the morning, at noon, and especially at the evening twilight. 5.98

1.3.s:
prātastu darśanācchaṃbhornaiśameno vyapohati..
madhyāhne darśanācchaṃbhoḥ saptajanmārjitaṃ nṛṇām..
pāpaṃ praṇāśamāyāti niśāyāṃ naiva gaṇyate.. 5.99 ..
1.3.d:
प्रातस्तु दर्शनाच्छंभोर्नैशमेनो व्यपोहति..
मध्याह्ने दर्शनाच्छंभोः सप्तजन्मार्जितं नृणाम्..
पापं प्रणाशमायाति निशायां नैव गण्यते.. 5.99 ..
1.3.m: By the darśana of Śambhu in the morning, the sin of the night is removed; / by the darśana of Śambhu at noon, the sin accumulated by mortals over seven lifetimes / is destroyed; [the darśana] at night is beyond reckoning. 5.99

1.3.s:
śiveti dvyakṣaraṃ nāma mahā pāpapraṇāśanam..
yeṣāṃ mukhodgataṃ nṝṇāṃ tairidaṃ dhāryate jagat.. 5.100 ..
1.3.d:
शिवेति द्व्यक्षरं नाम महा पापप्रणाशनम्..
येषां मुखोद्गतं नॄणां तैरिदं धार्यते जगत्.. 5.100 ..
1.3.m: The two-syllabled name “Śiva” destroys great sins; / by those men from whose mouth it issues, this universe is sustained. 5.100

1.3.s:
śivāṃgaṇe tu yā bherī sthāpitā puṇyakarmabhiḥ..
tasyā nādena pūtā vai ye ca pāparatā janāḥ..
pāṣaṃḍino'pyasadvādāste'pi yāṃti parāṃ gatim.. 5.101 ..
1.3.d:
शिवांगणे तु या भेरी स्थापिता पुण्यकर्मभिः..
तस्या नादेन पूता वै ये च पापरता जनाः..
पाषंडिनोऽप्यसद्वादास्तेऽपि यांति परां गतिम्.. 5.101 ..
1.3.m: The kettle-drum set up in the courtyard of Śiva's temple by men of meritorious deeds— / by its sound indeed people devoted to sin are purified; / even heretics of false doctrine go to the highest state. 5.101

1.3.s:
paśoryasya ca saṃbaddhā carmaṇā ca śivālaye..
nṛbhiryā sthāpitā bherī mṛdaṃgamurajādi ca..
sa paśuḥ śivasānnidhyamāpnotyatra na saṃśayaḥ.. 5.102 ..
1.3.d:
पशोर्यस्य च संबद्धा चर्मणा च शिवालये..
नृभिर्या स्थापिता भेरी मृदंगमुरजादि च..
स पशुः शिवसान्निध्यमाप्नोत्यत्र न संशयः.. 5.102 ..
1.3.m: And with the hide of whatever animal the drum, mṛdaṅga, muraja, and the like / are bound and set up by men in Śiva's temple, / that animal attains Śiva's presence; of this there is no doubt. 5.102

1.3.s:
tasmāttataṃ ca vitataṃ ghanaṃ suṣirameva ca..
cāmarāṇi mahārhāṇi maṃcakāḥ śayanāni ca.. 5.103 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्ततं च विततं घनं सुषिरमेव च..
चामराणि महार्हाणि मंचकाः शयनानि च.. 5.103 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, stringed, percussion, solid, and wind instruments, / precious chowries, couches, and beds, 5.103

1.3.s:
gāthāśca itihāsāśca gāyanaṃ ca yathāvidhi..
bahurūpādikaṃ śaṃbhoḥ priyānyetāni kalpayet.. 5.104 ..
1.3.d:
गाथाश्च इतिहासाश्च गायनं च यथाविधि..
बहुरूपादिकं शंभोः प्रियान्येतानि कल्पयेत्.. 5.104 ..
1.3.m: and ballads, histories, singing according to rule, / theatrical disguises, and the like, which are dear to Śambhu, one should arrange. 5.104

1.3.s:
kalpayitvā ca gacchaṃti śivalokaṃ hi pāpinaḥ..
sudharmāṇo mahātmānaḥ śivapūjāviśāradāḥ.. 5.105 ..
1.3.d:
कल्पयित्वा च गच्छंति शिवलोकं हि पापिनः..
सुधर्माणो महात्मानः शिवपूजाविशारदाः.. 5.105 ..
1.3.m: Having arranged these, even sinners go to the world of Śiva— / to say nothing of the righteous, great-souled men skilled in the worship of Śiva. 5.105

1.3.s:
gurormukhācca saṃprāptaśivapūjāratāśca ye..
śivarūpeṇa ye viśvaṃ paśyaṃti kṛtaniścayāḥ.. 5.106 ..
1.3.d:
गुरोर्मुखाच्च संप्राप्तशिवपूजारताश्च ये..
शिवरूपेण ये विश्वं पश्यंति कृतनिश्चयाः.. 5.106 ..
1.3.m: And those who, devoted to the worship of Śiva received from the mouth of a guru, / view the universe with resolute mind as the form of Śiva, 5.106

1.3.s:
samyagbuddhyā samācārā varṇāśramayutā narāḥ..
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśvayāḥ śūdrāścānye tathā narāḥ.. 5.107 ..
1.3.d:
सम्यग्बुद्ध्या समाचारा वर्णाश्रमयुता नराः..
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्वयाः शूद्राश्चान्ये तथा नराः.. 5.107 ..
1.3.m: men of proper conduct with a right intellect, adhering to the classes and stages of life— / brahmins, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, śūdras, and other men— 5.107

1.3.s:
śvapaco'pi variṣṭhaḥ sa śaṃbhoḥ priyataro bhavet..
śaṃbhunādhiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram.. 5.108 ..
1.3.d:
श्वपचोऽपि वरिष्ठः स शंभोः प्रियतरो भवेत्..
शंभुनाधिष्ठितं सर्वं जगदेतच्चराचरम्.. 5.108 ..
1.3.m: even an outcaste becomes most distinguished and dearer to Śambhu. / All this universe, moving and unmoving, is presided over by Śambhu. 5.108

1.3.s:
tasmātsarvaṃ śivamayaṃ jñātavyaṃ suviśeṣataḥ..
vedaiḥ purāṇaiḥ śāstraiśca tathaupanipadairapi.. 5.109 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्सर्वं शिवमयं ज्ञातव्यं सुविशेषतः..
वेदैः पुराणैः शास्त्रैश्च तथौपनिपदैरपि.. 5.109 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, everything is to be known as especially filled with Śiva / through the Vedas, Purāṇas, treatises, and also the Upaniṣads. 5.109

1.3.s:
āgamairvividhaiḥ śaṃbhurjñātavyo nātra saṃśayaḥ..
niṣkāmaiśca sakāmaiśca pūjanīyaḥ sadā śivaḥ.. 5.110 ..
1.3.d:
आगमैर्विविधैः शंभुर्ज्ञातव्यो नात्र संशयः..
निष्कामैश्च सकामैश्च पूजनीयः सदा शिवः.. 5.110 ..
1.3.m: Śambhu is to be known through various Āgamas; of this there is no doubt. / Śiva is always to be worshipped by those without desires and those with desires. 5.110

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
kathayāmi purāvṛttamitihāsaṃ purātanam..
naṃdī nāma purā vaiśyo hyavaṃtīpuramāvasat.. 5.111 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
कथयामि पुरावृत्तमितिहासं पुरातनम्..
नंदी नाम पुरा वैश्यो ह्यवंतीपुरमावसत्.. 5.111 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / I shall relate an ancient narrative, an ancient history: / Formerly a vaiśya named Nandī lived in the city of Avantī. 5.111

1.3.s:
śivadhyānaparo bhūtvā śivapūjāṃ cakāra saḥ..
nityaṃ tapovanasthaṃ hi liṃgamekaṃ samarcayat.. 5.112 ..
1.3.d:
शिवध्यानपरो भूत्वा शिवपूजां चकार सः..
नित्यं तपोवनस्थं हि लिंगमेकं समर्चयत्.. 5.112 ..
1.3.m: Devoted to meditation on Śiva, he performed the worship of Śiva; / he worshipped daily a single liṅga located in a forest of austerity. 5.112

1.3.s:
uṣasyuṣasi cotthāya pratyahaṃ śivavallabhaḥ..
naṃdīliṃgārccanarato babhūvātiśayena hi.. 5.113 ..
1.3.d:
उषस्युषसि चोत्थाय प्रत्यहं शिववल्लभः..
नंदीलिंगार्च्चनरतो बभूवातिशयेन हि.. 5.113 ..
1.3.m: Rising at dawn every day, dear to Śiva, / Nandī was exceedingly devoted to the worship of the liṅga. 5.113

1.3.s:
liṃgaṃ paṃcāmṛtenaiva yathoktenābhyaṣecayat..
vipraiḥ samāvṛto nityaṃ vedavedāṃgapāragaiḥ.. 5.114 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगं पंचामृतेनैव यथोक्तेनाभ्यषेचयत्..
विप्रैः समावृतो नित्यं वेदवेदांगपारगैः.. 5.114 ..
1.3.m: He bathed the liṅga with the five nectars strictly as prescribed, / always surrounded by brahmins who had crossed to the end of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas. 5.114

1.3.s:
yathāśāstreṇa vidhinā liṃgārcanaparo'bhavat..
snāpayitvā tataḥ puṣpairnānaścaryasamanvitaiḥ.. 5.115 ..
1.3.d:
यथाशास्त्रेण विधिना लिंगार्चनपरोऽभवत्..
स्नापयित्वा ततः पुष्पैर्नानश्चर्यसमन्वितैः.. 5.115 ..
1.3.m: He engaged in the worship of the liṅga in accordance with the scriptural injunctions. / Then, having bathed it, with flowers possessing various wonders, 5.115

1.3.s:
muktāphalairiṃdranīlairgomedaiśca niraṃtaram..
vaiḍūryaiścaiva nīlaiśca māṇikyaiśca tathārcayat.. 5.116 ..
1.3.d:
मुक्ताफलैरिंद्रनीलैर्गोमेदैश्च निरंतरम्..
वैडूर्यैश्चैव नीलैश्च माणिक्यैश्च तथार्चयत्.. 5.116 ..
1.3.m: and constantly with pearls, sapphires, hessonites, / cat's-eyes, blue gems, and rubies, he worshipped it. 5.116

1.3.s:
evaṃ naṃdī mahābhāgo bahūnyabdāni cārccayat..
vijanasthaṃ tadā liṃgaṃ nānābhogasamanvitam.. 5.117 ..
1.3.d:
एवं नंदी महाभागो बहून्यब्दानि चार्च्चयत्..
विजनस्थं तदा लिंगं नानाभोगसमन्वितम्.. 5.117 ..
1.3.m: Thus the fortunate Nandī worshipped for many years / that liṅga standing in a secluded place, with various offerings. 5.117

1.3.s:
ekadā mṛgayāsaktaḥ kirāto bhūtahiṃsakaḥ..
avivekaparo bhūtvā mṛgayārasikaḥ sadā.. 5.118 ..
1.3.d:
एकदा मृगयासक्तः किरातो भूतहिंसकः..
अविवेकपरो भूत्वा मृगयारसिकः सदा.. 5.118 ..
1.3.m: One day, a hunter addicted to the chase, a slayer of living beings, / devoid of discrimination, always delighting in hunting, 5.118

1.3.s:
pāpī pāpasamācāro vicarangirikaṃdare..
anekaśvāpadākīrṇe hanyamāna itastataḥ.. 5.119 ..
1.3.d:
पापी पापसमाचारो विचरन्गिरिकंदरे..
अनेकश्वापदाकीर्णे हन्यमान इतस्ततः.. 5.119 ..
1.3.m: a sinner of sinful conduct, was wandering in a mountain cave / crowded with many wild beasts, killing here and there. 5.119

1.3.s:
evaṃ vicaramāṇo'sau kirāto bhūtahiṃsakaḥ..
yadṛcchayāgatastatra yatra liṃgaṃ supūjitam.. 5.120 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विचरमाणोऽसौ किरातो भूतहिंसकः..
यदृच्छयागतस्तत्र यत्र लिंगं सुपूजितम्.. 5.120 ..
1.3.m: While wandering thus, this hunter, a slayer of living beings, / arrived by chance at the place where the liṅga was well worshipped. 5.120

1.3.s:
udakaṃ vīkṣamāṇo'sau tṛṣayā pīḍito bhṛśam..
tato vane saraḥ śīghraṃ dṛṣṭvā toye samāviśat.. 5.121 ..
1.3.d:
उदकं वीक्षमाणोऽसौ तृषया पीडितो भृशम्..
ततो वने सरः शीघ्रं दृष्ट्वा तोये समाविशत्.. 5.121 ..
1.3.m: Looking for water, severely tormented by thirst, / he quickly saw a lake in the forest and entered the water. 5.121

1.3.s:
tīre saṃsthāpya duṣṭātmā tatsarvaṃ mṛgayādikam..
gaṃḍūṣotsarjanaṃ kṛtvā pītvā toyaṃ ca nirgataḥ.. 5.122 ..
1.3.d:
तीरे संस्थाप्य दुष्टात्मा तत्सर्वं मृगयादिकम्..
गंडूषोत्सर्जनं कृत्वा पीत्वा तोयं च निर्गतः.. 5.122 ..
1.3.m: Having placed all his game and gear on the bank, the wicked-minded one, / having rinsed and spat from his mouth, drank water, and came out. 5.122

1.3.s:
śivālayaṃ dadarśāgre anekāścaryamaṃḍitam..
dṛṣṭaṃ supūjitaṃ liṃgaṃ nānāratnaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak.. 5.123 ..
1.3.d:
शिवालयं ददर्शाग्रे अनेकाश्चर्यमंडितम्..
दृष्टं सुपूजितं लिंगं नानारत्नैः पृथक्पृथक्.. 5.123 ..
1.3.m: He saw before him a temple of Śiva adorned with many wonders; / the liṅga was seen well-worshipped with various gems separately. 5.123

1.3.s:
tathā liṃgaṃ samālakṣya yadā pūjāṃ samāharat..
ratnāni sarvabhūtāni vidhūtāni itastataḥ.. 5.124 ..
1.3.d:
तथा लिंगं समालक्ष्य यदा पूजां समाहरत्..
रत्नानि सर्वभूतानि विधूतानि इतस्ततः.. 5.124 ..
1.3.m: Observing the liṅga in that manner, when he took hold of the worship, / all the gems were scattered here and there. 5.124

1.3.s:
snapanaṃ tasya liṃgasya kṛtaṃ gaṃḍūṣavāriṇā..
kareṇaikena pūjārthaṃ bilvapatrāṇi so'rpayat.. 5.125 ..
1.3.d:
स्नपनं तस्य लिंगस्य कृतं गंडूषवारिणा..
करेणैकेन पूजार्थं बिल्वपत्राणि सोऽर्पयत्.. 5.125 ..
1.3.m: The ceremonial bath of that liṅga was performed with a mouthful of water; / with one hand he offered bilva leaves for the sake of worship, 5.125

1.3.s:
dvitīyena karem̐ṇaiva mṛgamāṃsaṃ samarpayat..
daṇḍapraṇāmasaṃyuktaḥ saṃkalpaṃ manasā'karot.. 5.126 ..
1.3.d:
द्वितीयेन करेम्̐णैव मृगमांसं समर्पयत्..
दण्डप्रणामसंयुक्तः संकल्पं मनसाऽकरोत्.. 5.126 ..
1.3.m: and with his second hand he offered venison. / Prostrating like a staff, he made a resolve in his mind: 5.126

1.3.s:
adyaprabhṛti pūjāṃ vai kariṣyāmi prayatnataḥ..
tvaṃ me svāmī ca bhaktohamadyaprabhṛti śaṃkara.. 5.127 ..
1.3.d:
अद्यप्रभृति पूजां वै करिष्यामि प्रयत्नतः..
त्वं मे स्वामी च भक्तोहमद्यप्रभृति शंकर.. 5.127 ..
1.3.m: "From this day onward I shall indeed perform worship with effort. / You are my master, and from this day onward I am your devotee, O Śaṅkara!" 5.127

1.3.s:
evaṃ naiyamiko bhūtvā kirāto gṛhamāgataḥ..
nandī dadarśa tatsarvaṃ kirātena itastataḥ.. 5.128 ..
1.3.d:
एवं नैयमिको भूत्वा किरातो गृहमागतः..
नन्दी ददर्श तत्सर्वं किरातेन इतस्ततः.. 5.128 ..
1.3.m: Having thus bound himself to this rule, the hunter went home. / Nandī saw all that [done] here and there by the hunter. 5.128

1.3.s:
ciṃtāyukto'bhavannaṃdī jātaṃ kiṃ chidramadya me..
kathitāni ca vighnāni śivapūjāratasya ca..
upasthitāni tānyeva mama bhāgyaviparyayāt.. 5.129 ..
1.3.d:
चिंतायुक्तोऽभवन्नंदी जातं किं छिद्रमद्य मे..
कथितानि च विघ्नानि शिवपूजारतस्य च..
उपस्थितानि तान्येव मम भाग्यविपर्ययात्.. 5.129 ..
1.3.m: Nandī became filled with anxiety: "What fault has occurred in me today? / The obstacles that are spoken of for one devoted to Śiva's worship— / those very obstacles have arrived through the reversal of my fortune!" 5.129

1.3.s:
evaṃ vimṛśya suciraṃ prakṣālya śivamaṃdiram..
yathāgatena mārgeṇa naṃdī svagṛhamāgataḥ.. 5.130 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विमृश्य सुचिरं प्रक्षाल्य शिवमंदिरम्..
यथागतेन मार्गेण नंदी स्वगृहमागतः.. 5.130 ..
1.3.m: Reflecting thus for a long time, having washed the temple of Śiva, / Nandī went to his own home by the way he had come. 5.130

1.3.s:
tato naṃdinamāgatya purodhā gatamānasam..
abravodvacanaṃ taṃ tu kasmāttvaṃ gatamānasaḥ.. 5.131 ..
1.3.d:
ततो नंदिनमागत्य पुरोधा गतमानसम्..
अब्रवोद्वचनं तं तु कस्मात्त्वं गतमानसः.. 5.131 ..
1.3.m: Then, having approached the disheartened Nandī, the family priest / addressed words to him: "Why are you disheartened?" 5.131

1.3.s: purohitaṃ prati tadā nandī vacanamabravīt.. 5.132 ..
1.3.d: पुरोहितं प्रति तदा नन्दी वचनमब्रवीत्.. 5.132 ..
1.3.m: Then Nandī spoke these words to the family priest: 5.132

1.3.s:
adya dṛṣṭaṃ mayā vipra amedhyaṃ śivasaṃnidhau..
kenedaṃ kāritaṃ tatra na jānāmi kathaṃcana.. 5.133 ..
1.3.d:
अद्य दृष्टं मया विप्र अमेध्यं शिवसंनिधौ..
केनेदं कारितं तत्र न जानामि कथंचन.. 5.133 ..
1.3.m: "Today, O brahmin, impure matter was seen by me in the presence of Śiva; / by whom this was caused to be done there, I do not know at all." 5.133

1.3.s:
tataḥ purodhā vacanaṃ nandinaṃ cābravīttadā..
yena viskhalitaṃ tatra ratnādīnāṃ prapūjanam..
so'pi mūḍho na saṃdehaḥ kāryākāryeṣu maṃdadhīḥ.. 5.134 ..
1.3.d:
ततः पुरोधा वचनं नन्दिनं चाब्रवीत्तदा..
येन विस्खलितं तत्र रत्नादीनां प्रपूजनम्..
सोऽपि मूढो न संदेहः कार्याकार्येषु मंदधीः.. 5.134 ..
1.3.m: Then the priest spoke these words to Nandī at that time: / "He by whom the rich worship with gems and the like was disturbed there— / he is surely a fool, dull-witted regarding what should and should not be done. 5.134

1.3.s:
tasmācciṃtā na kartavyā tvayā aṇurapi prabho..
prabhāte ca mayā sārddhaṃ gamyatāṃ tacchivālayam.. 5.135 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माच्चिंता न कर्तव्या त्वया अणुरपि प्रभो..
प्रभाते च मया सार्द्धं गम्यतां तच्छिवालयम्.. 5.135 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, no anxiety should be had by you, not even a particle, O master! / In the morning, go to that temple of Śiva along with me. 5.135

1.3.s:
nirīkṣaṇārthaṃ duṣṭasya tatkāryaṃ vidadhāmyaham..
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ nandī tasya purodhasaḥ.. 5.136 ..
1.3.d:
निरीक्षणार्थं दुष्टस्य तत्कार्यं विदधाम्यहम्..
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं नन्दी तस्य पुरोधसः.. 5.136 ..
1.3.m: For the sake of watching for the villain, I shall arrange that matter." / Having heard this statement of his priest, 5.136

1.3.s:
āsthitaḥ svagṛhe naktaṃ dūyamānena cetasā..
tasyāṃ rātryāṃ vyatītāyāmāhūya ca purodhasam.. 5.137 ..
1.3.d:
आस्थितः स्वगृहे नक्तं दूयमानेन चेतसा..
तस्यां रात्र्यां व्यतीतायामाहूय च पुरोधसम्.. 5.137 ..
1.3.m: Nandī stayed in his own house during the night with an aching heart. / When that night had passed, having summoned the priest, 5.137

1.3.s:
gataḥ śivālayaṃ nandī samaṃ tena mahātmanā..
tato dṛṣṭaṃ pūrvadine kṛtaṃtena durātmanā.. 5.138 ..
1.3.d:
गतः शिवालयं नन्दी समं तेन महात्मना..
ततो दृष्टं पूर्वदिने कृतंतेन दुरात्मना.. 5.138 ..
1.3.m: Nandī went to the temple of Śiva together with that great-souled man. / Then was seen what had been done on the previous day by that wicked one. 5.138

1.3.s:
samyakprapūjanaṃ kṛtvā nānāratnaparicchadam..
pañcopacārasaṃyuktaṃ caikādasyanvitaṃ tathā.. 5.139 ..
1.3.d:
सम्यक्प्रपूजनं कृत्वा नानारत्नपरिच्छदम्..
पञ्चोपचारसंयुक्तं चैकादस्यन्वितं तथा.. 5.139 ..
1.3.m: Having performed proper worship with equipment of various gems, / consisting of the five articles of worship and likewise elevenfold, 5.139

1.3.s:
anekastutibhiḥ stutvā girīśaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha..
tadā yāmadvayaṃ jātaṃ stūyamānasya naṃdinaḥ.. 5.140 ..
1.3.d:
अनेकस्तुतिभिः स्तुत्वा गिरीशं ब्राह्मणैः सह..
तदा यामद्वयं जातं स्तूयमानस्य नंदिनः.. 5.140 ..
1.3.m: having praised the Lord of the Mountain with many hymns along with the brahmins, / two watches of the day had passed as Nandī was praising [him]. 5.140

1.3.s:
āyāto hi mahākālastathārūpo mahābalaḥ..
kālarūpo mahāraudro dhanuṣpāṇiḥ pratāpavān.. 5.141 ..
1.3.d:
आयातो हि महाकालस्तथारूपो महाबलः..
कालरूपो महारौद्रो धनुष्पाणिः प्रतापवान्.. 5.141 ..
1.3.m: Then indeed came one like Mahākāla in form, possessing great strength, / resembling Death, exceedingly fierce, bow in hand, full of prowess. 5.141

1.3.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayavitrasto nandī sa vilalāpa ha..
purodhāścaiva sahasā bhayabhītastadābhavat.. 5.142 ..
1.3.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा भयवित्रस्तो नन्दी स विललाप ह..
पुरोधाश्चैव सहसा भयभीतस्तदाभवत्.. 5.142 ..
1.3.m: Seeing him, terrified with fear, Nandī wept; / and the priest also immediately became terrified with fear. 5.142

1.3.s:
kirātena kṛtaṃ tatra yathāpūrvamaviskhalam..
tāṃ pūjāṃ prapadāhatya bilvapatraṃ samarpayat.. 5.143 ..
1.3.d:
किरातेन कृतं तत्र यथापूर्वमविस्खलम्..
तां पूजां प्रपदाहत्य बिल्वपत्रं समर्पयत्.. 5.143 ..
1.3.m: By the hunter, [the worship] was performed there without hesitation, just as before: / kicking away that worship with the forepart of his foot, he offered a bilva leaf. 5.143

1.3.s:
snapanaṃ tasya kṛtvā ca tato gaṃḍūṣavāriṇā..
naivedyaṃ tatpalaṃ caiva kirātaḥ śivamarpayat.. 5.144 ..
1.3.d:
स्नपनं तस्य कृत्वा च ततो गंडूषवारिणा..
नैवेद्यं तत्पलं चैव किरातः शिवमर्पयत्.. 5.144 ..
1.3.m: And having given him a ceremonial bath with water from his mouthful, / the Kirāta offered that flesh as a food offering to Śiva.

1.3.s:
daṇḍavatpatito bhūmāvutthāya svagṛhaṃ gataḥ..
taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ ciṃtayāmāsa vai ciram.. 5.145 ..
1.3.d:
दण्डवत्पतितो भूमावुत्थाय स्वगृहं गतः..
तद्दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्यं चिंतयामास वै चिरम्.. 5.145 ..
1.3.m: Falling flat on the ground like a staff, he got up and went to his own house. / Having seen that great wonder, [Nandī] indeed reflected for a long time.

1.3.s:
purodhasā saha tadā naṃdīvyākulacetasā..
tena cākāritā viprā bahavo vedavādinaḥ.. 5.146 ..
1.3.d:
पुरोधसा सह तदा नंदीव्याकुलचेतसा..
तेन चाकारिता विप्रा बहवो वेदवादिनः.. 5.146 ..
1.3.m: Then, together with his priest, Nandī, his mind agitated, / had many brahmins who were expounders of the Vedas summoned.

1.3.s:
nivedya teṣu tatsarvaṃ kirātena ca yatkṛtam..
kiṃ kāryamatha bho viprāḥ kathyatāṃ ca yathātatham.. 5.147 ..
1.3.d:
निवेद्य तेषु तत्सर्वं किरातेन च यत्कृतम्..
किं कार्यमथ भो विप्राः कथ्यतां च यथातथम्.. 5.147 ..
1.3.m: Having reported to them all that was done by the Kirāta, [he said:] / “What should be done now, O brahmins? Tell me the truth!”

1.3.s:
saṃpradhārya tataḥ sarve militvā dharmaśāstrataḥ..
ūcuḥ sarve tadā viprā naṃdinaṃ cātiśaṃkinam.. 5.148 ..
1.3.d:
संप्रधार्य ततः सर्वे मिलित्वा धर्मशास्त्रतः..
ऊचुः सर्वे तदा विप्रा नंदिनं चातिशंकिनम्.. 5.148 ..
1.3.m: Then, having deliberated all together in accordance with the Dharmaśāstras, / all the brahmins then spoke to Nandī, who was extremely anxious:

1.3.s:
idaṃ vighnaṃ samutpannaṃ durnivāryaṃ surairapi..
tasmādānaya liṃgaṃ tvaṃ svagṛhaṃ vaiśyasattama.. 5.149 ..
1.3.d:
इदं विघ्नं समुत्पन्नं दुर्निवार्यं सुरैरपि..
तस्मादानय लिंगं त्वं स्वगृहं वैश्यसत्तम.. 5.149 ..
1.3.m: “This obstacle has arisen, difficult to avert even by the gods; / therefore, bring the liṅga to your own house, O best of Vaiśyas!”

1.3.s:
tatheti matvāsau naṃdī śivasyotpāṭanaṃ tadā..
kṛtvā svagṛhamānīya pratiṣṭhāpya yatāvidhi.. 5.150 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति मत्वासौ नंदी शिवस्योत्पाटनं तदा..
कृत्वा स्वगृहमानीय प्रतिष्ठाप्य यताविधि.. 5.150 ..
1.3.m: Agreeing, Nandī then uprooted the Śiva[-liṅga], / brought it to his own house, and installed it according to the rules.

1.3.s:
suvarṇapīṭhikāṃ kṛtvā navaratnasuśobhitām..
upacārairanekaiśca pūjayāmāsa vai tadā.. 5.151 ..
1.3.d:
सुवर्णपीठिकां कृत्वा नवरत्नसुशोभिताम्..
उपचारैरनेकैश्च पूजयामास वै तदा.. 5.151 ..
1.3.m: Having made a golden pedestal adorned with the nine jewels, / he then worshipped [it] with many services.

1.3.s:
athāpare dyurāyātaḥ kirātaḥ śivamaṃdiram..
yāvadvilokyāmāsa liṃgamaiśaṃ na dṛṣṭavān.. 5.152 ..
1.3.d:
अथापरे द्युरायातः किरातः शिवमंदिरम्..
यावद्विलोक्यामास लिंगमैशं न दृष्टवान्.. 5.152 ..
1.3.m: Then, on the next day, the Kirāta came to the temple of Śiva; / when he looked, he did not see the liṅga of Īśa.

1.3.s:
maunaṃ vihāya sahasā hyākrośannidamabravīt..
he śaṃbho kva gatosi tvaṃ darśayātmānamadya vai.. 5.153 ..
1.3.d:
मौनं विहाय सहसा ह्याक्रोशन्निदमब्रवीत्..
हे शंभो क्व गतोसि त्वं दर्शयात्मानमद्य वै.. 5.153 ..
1.3.m: Abandoning silence, he immediately cried out, saying this: / “O Śambhu, where have you gone? Reveal yourself today!

1.3.s:
na dṛṣṭosi mayā tvaṃ hi tyajāmyadya kalevaram..
he śaṃbho he jagannātha tripurāṃtakara prabho.. 5.154 ..
1.3.d:
न दृष्टोसि मया त्वं हि त्यजाम्यद्य कलेवरम्..
हे शंभो हे जगन्नाथ त्रिपुरांतकर प्रभो.. 5.154 ..
1.3.m: If you are not seen by me, I will give up my body today! / O Śambhu, O Lord of the universe, O destroyer of Tripura, O Lord!

1.3.s: he rudra he mahādeva darśayātmānamātmanā.. 5.155 ..
1.3.d: हे रुद्र हे महादेव दर्शयात्मानमात्मना.. 5.155 ..
1.3.m: O Rudra, O Mahādeva, show yourself by your own will!”

1.3.s:
evaṃ sākṣepamadhurairvākyaiḥ kṣiptaḥ sadāśivaḥ..
kirātena tato raṃgairvīrosau jaṭharaṃ svakam.. 5.156 ..
1.3.d:
एवं साक्षेपमधुरैर्वाक्यैः क्षिप्तः सदाशिवः..
किरातेन ततो रंगैर्वीरोसौ जठरं स्वकम्.. 5.156 ..
1.3.m: Thus rebuked with words reproachful yet sweet, Sadāśiva [remained hidden]; / then that heroic Kirāta with [violent] outbursts tore open his own belly,

1.3.s:
vibhedāśu tato bāhūnāsphoṭyaiva ruṣābravīt..
he śaṃbho darśayātmānaṃ kuto māṃ tyajya yāsyasi.. 5.157 ..
1.3.d:
विभेदाशु ततो बाहूनास्फोट्यैव रुषाब्रवीत्..
हे शंभो दर्शयात्मानं कुतो मां त्यज्य यास्यसि.. 5.157 ..
1.3.m: and having quickly pierced his arms, he struck [his chest] and spoke with rage: / “O Śambhu, show yourself! Where will you go, abandoning me?”

1.3.s:
iti kṣiptvā tatoṃtrāṇi māṃsamutkṛtya sarvataḥ..
tasmingarte kareṇaiva kirātaḥ sahasākṣipat.. 5.158 ..
1.3.d:
इति क्षिप्त्वा ततोंत्राणि मांसमुत्कृत्य सर्वतः..
तस्मिन्गर्ते करेणैव किरातः सहसाक्षिपत्.. 5.158 ..
1.3.m: So saying, having pulled out his entrails and cut away his flesh from all sides, / the Kirāta suddenly hurled [them] into that pit with his own hand.

1.3.s:
svasthaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ kṛtvā sasnau tatsarasi dhruvam..
tathaiva jalamānīya bilvapattraṃ tvarānvitaḥ.. 5.159 ..
1.3.d:
स्वस्थं च हृदयं कृत्वा सस्नौ तत्सरसि ध्रुवम्..
तथैव जलमानीय बिल्वपत्त्रं त्वरान्वितः.. 5.159 ..
1.3.m: Having composed his heart, he indeed bathed in that lake; / bringing water and a bilva leaf in the same way, in great haste,

1.3.s: pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ daṃḍavatpatito bhuvi.. 5.160 ..
1.3.d: पूजयित्वा यथान्यायं दंडवत्पतितो भुवि.. 5.160 ..
1.3.m: he worshipped [the pit] in the proper manner and fell flat like a staff on the earth.

1.3.s:
dhyānasthitastatastatra kirātaḥ śivasaṃnidhau..
prādurbhūtastadā rudraḥ pramathaiḥ parivāritaḥ.. 5.161 ..
1.3.d:
ध्यानस्थितस्ततस्तत्र किरातः शिवसंनिधौ..
प्रादुर्भूतस्तदा रुद्रः प्रमथैः परिवारितः.. 5.161 ..
1.3.m: Then, while the Kirāta stood absorbed in meditation in the presence of Śiva, / Rudra appeared, surrounded by his pramathas,

1.3.s:
karpūragauro dyutimānkapardī caṃdraśekharaḥ..
taṃ gṛhītvā kare rudra uvāca parisāṃtvayan.. 5.162 ..
1.3.d:
कर्पूरगौरो द्युतिमान्कपर्दी चंद्रशेखरः..
तं गृहीत्वा करे रुद्र उवाच परिसांत्वयन्.. 5.162 ..
1.3.m: fair as camphor, radiant, with matted hair and the crescent moon on his crest. / Taking him by the hand, Rudra spoke, comforting him:

1.3.s:
bhobho vīra mahāprājña madbhaktosi mahāmate..
varaṃ vṛṇīṣvātmahitaṃ yatte'bhilaṣitaṃ mahat.. 5.163 ..
1.3.d:
भोभो वीर महाप्राज्ञ मद्भक्तोसि महामते..
वरं वृणीष्वात्महितं यत्तेऽभिलषितं महत्.. 5.163 ..
1.3.m: “O hero, O very wise one, you are my devotee, O noble-minded one! / Choose a boon conducive to your welfare, whatever great thing you desire!”

1.3.s:
evamuktaḥ sa rudreṇa mahākālo mudānvitaḥ..
papāta daṃḍavadbhūmau bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ.. 5.164 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्तः स रुद्रेण महाकालो मुदान्वितः..
पपात दंडवद्भूमौ भक्त्या परमया युतः.. 5.164 ..
1.3.m: Thus addressed by Rudra, Mahākāla, filled with joy, / fell flat like a staff upon the ground, endowed with supreme devotion.

1.3.s:
tato rudraṃ babhāṣe sa varaṃ samprārthayāmyaham..
ahaṃ dāsosmi te rudra tvaṃ me svāmī na saṃśayaḥ.. 5.165 ..
1.3.d:
ततो रुद्रं बभाषे स वरं सम्प्रार्थयाम्यहम्..
अहं दासोस्मि ते रुद्र त्वं मे स्वामी न संशयः.. 5.165 ..
1.3.m: Then he spoke to Rudra: “I pray for a boon: / I am your servant, O Rudra, and you are my master, without doubt.

1.3.s:
etadbuddhātmano bhaktiṃ dehi janmanijanmani..
tvaṃ mātā ca pitā tvaṃ ca tvaṃ baṃdhuśca sakhā hi me.. 5.166 ..
1.3.d:
एतद्बुद्धात्मनो भक्तिं देहि जन्मनिजन्मनि..
त्वं माता च पिता त्वं च त्वं बंधुश्च सखा हि मे.. 5.166 ..
1.3.m: Grant devotion to one whose mind understands this, in birth after birth! / You are my mother, and you are my father, and you are indeed my kinsman and my friend.

1.3.s:
tvaṃ gurustvaṃ mahāmaṃtro maṃtravedyo'si sarvadā..
tasmāttvadaparaṃ nānyattriṣu lokeṣu kiṃcana.. 5.167 ..
1.3.d:
त्वं गुरुस्त्वं महामंत्रो मंत्रवेद्योऽसि सर्वदा..
तस्मात्त्वदपरं नान्यत्त्रिषु लोकेषु किंचन.. 5.167 ..
1.3.m: You are the guru, you are the great mantra, you are always to be known through mantra; / therefore, there is nothing else other than you in the three worlds.”

1.3.s:
niṣkāmaṃ vākyamākarṇya kirātasya tadā bhavaḥ..
dadau pārṣadamukhyatvaṃ dvārapālatvameva ca.. 5.168 ..
1.3.d:
निष्कामं वाक्यमाकर्ण्य किरातस्य तदा भवः..
ददौ पार्षदमुख्यत्वं द्वारपालत्वमेव च.. 5.168 ..
1.3.m: Hearing the desireless words of the Kirāta, Bhava then / granted him leadership among his attendants and the status of doorkeeper.

1.3.s:
tadā ḍamarunādena nāditaṃ bhuvanatrayam..
bherībhāṃkāraśabdena śaṃkhānāṃ ninadena ca.. 5.169 ..
1.3.d:
तदा डमरुनादेन नादितं भुवनत्रयम्..
भेरीभांकारशब्देन शंखानां निनदेन च.. 5.169 ..
1.3.m: Then the three worlds were made to resound with the sound of the ḍamaru, / with the booming resonance of the kettle-drum, and with the blare of conches.

1.3.s:
tadā duṃdubhayo neduḥ paṭahāśca sahasraśaḥ..
naṃdī taṃ nādamākarṇya vismayāttvarito yayau.. 5.170 ..
1.3.d:
तदा दुंदुभयो नेदुः पटहाश्च सहस्रशः..
नंदी तं नादमाकर्ण्य विस्मयात्त्वरितो ययौ.. 5.170 ..
1.3.m: Then kettledrums sounded, and drums by the thousands. / Hearing that sound, Nandī went swiftly in astonishment

1.3.s:
tapovanaṃ yatra śivaḥ sthitaḥ pramathasaṃvṛtaḥ..
kirāto hi tathā dṛṣṭo naṃdinā ca tadā bhṛśam.. 5.171 ..
1.3.d:
तपोवनं यत्र शिवः स्थितः प्रमथसंवृतः..
किरातो हि तथा दृष्टो नंदिना च तदा भृशम्.. 5.171 ..
1.3.m: to the penance-grove where Śiva was present, surrounded by the pramathas. / And there the Kirāta was seen by Nandī with great [wonder].

1.3.s:
uvāca praśrito vākyaṃ sa naṃdī vismayānvitaḥ..
kirātaṃ stotukāma'sau parameṇa samādhinā.. 5.172 ..
1.3.d:
उवाच प्रश्रितो वाक्यं स नंदी विस्मयान्वितः..
किरातं स्तोतुकामऽसौ परमेण समाधिना.. 5.172 ..
1.3.m: Filled with wonder, Nandī spoke a humble word, / wishing to praise the Kirāta with supreme concentration:

1.3.s:
ihānītastvayā śaṃbhustvaṃ bhaktosi paraṃtapa..
tvaṃ bhakto'hamiha prāpto māṃ nivedaya śaṃkare.. 5.173 ..
1.3.d:
इहानीतस्त्वया शंभुस्त्वं भक्तोसि परंतप..
त्वं भक्तोऽहमिह प्राप्तो मां निवेदय शंकरे.. 5.173 ..
1.3.m: “Śambhu has been brought here by you; you are a devotee, O scorcher of foes! / You are a devotee, and I have arrived here; introduce me to Śaṃkara!”

1.3.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya kirātastvarayānvitaḥ..
naṃdinaṃ ca kare gṛhya śaṃkaraṃ samupāgataḥ.. 5.174 ..
1.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य किरातस्त्वरयान्वितः..
नंदिनं च करे गृह्य शंकरं समुपागतः.. 5.174 ..
1.3.m: Hearing his word, the Kirāta, acting swiftly, / took Nandī by the hand and approached Śaṃkara.

1.3.s:
prahasya bhagavānrudraḥ kirātaṃ vākyamabravīt..
ko'yaṃ tvayā samānīto gaṇānāmiha sannidhau.. 5.175 ..
1.3.d:
प्रहस्य भगवान्रुद्रः किरातं वाक्यमब्रवीत्..
कोऽयं त्वया समानीतो गणानामिह सन्निधौ.. 5.175 ..
1.3.m: Laughing, the blessed Lord Rudra said these words to the Kirāta: / “Who is this that has been brought by you here into the presence of the gaṇas?”

1.3.s:
..kirāta uvāca..
vijñapto'sau kirātena śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ..
tava bhaktaḥ sadā deva tava pūjārato hyasau.. 5.176 ..
1.3.d:
..किरात उवाच..
विज्ञप्तोऽसौ किरातेन शंकरो लोकशंकरः..
तव भक्तः सदा देव तव पूजारतो ह्यसौ.. 5.176 ..
1.3.m: The Kirāta said: / Śaṃkara, the source of auspiciousness to the world, was addressed by the Kirāta: / “O God, he is your devotee always, indeed devoted to your worship.

1.3.s:
pratyahaṃ ratnamāṇikyaiḥ puṣpaiścoccāvacairapi..
jīvitena dhanenāpi pūjito'si na saṃśayaḥ.. 5.177 ..
1.3.d:
प्रत्यहं रत्नमाणिक्यैः पुष्पैश्चोच्चावचैरपि..
जीवितेन धनेनापि पूजितोऽसि न संशयः.. 5.177 ..
1.3.m: Every day, with gems and rubies, and with various kinds of flowers, / and even with his life and wealth, you have been worshipped [by him], there is no doubt.

1.3.s: tasmājjānīhi manmitraṃ naṃdinaṃ bhaktavatsala.. 5.178 ..
1.3.d: तस्माज्जानीहि मन्मित्रं नंदिनं भक्तवत्सल.. 5.178 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, recognize my friend Nandī, O you who are affectionate to your devotees!”

1.3.s:
..mahādeva uvāca..
na jānāmi mahābhāga naṃdinaṃ vaiśyacarcitam..
tvaṃ me bhaktaḥ sakhā ceti mahākāla mahāmate.. 5.179 ..
1.3.d:
..महादेव उवाच..
न जानामि महाभाग नंदिनं वैश्यचर्चितम्..
त्वं मे भक्तः सखा चेति महाकाल महामते.. 5.179 ..
1.3.m: Mahādeva said: / “I do not know Nandī, attended by the Vaiśyas, O fortunate one! / You are my devotee and my friend, O Mahākāla, O high-minded one!

1.3.s:
upādhirahitā ye ca ye'pi caiva manasvinaḥ..
te'tīva me priyā bhaktāste viśiṣṭā narottamāḥ.. 5.180 ..
1.3.d:
उपाधिरहिता ये च येऽपि चैव मनस्विनः..
तेऽतीव मे प्रिया भक्तास्ते विशिष्टा नरोत्तमाः.. 5.180 ..
1.3.m: Those who are free from limiting conditions, and who are also resolute— / they are my very dear devotees; they are distinguished, the best of men.

1.3.s:
tava bhakto hyahaṃ tāta sa ca me priyakṛttaraḥ..
tāvubhau svīkṛtau tena pārṣadatvena śaṃbhunā.. 5.181 ..
1.3.d:
तव भक्तो ह्यहं तात स च मे प्रियकृत्तरः..
तावुभौ स्वीकृतौ तेन पार्षदत्वेन शंभुना.. 5.181 ..
1.3.m: For I am a devotee of yours, dear child, and he is a doer of what is pleasing to me.” / Both of them were accepted by Śambhu into the status of his attendants.

1.3.s:
tato vimānāni bahūni tatra samāgatānyeva mahāprabhāṇi..
kirātavaryeṇa sa vaiśyavarya uddhāritastena mahāprabheṇa.. 5.182 ..
1.3.d:
ततो विमानानि बहूनि तत्र समागतान्येव महाप्रभाणि..
किरातवर्येण स वैश्यवर्य उद्धारितस्तेन महाप्रभेण.. 5.182 ..
1.3.m: Then many aerial chariots of great radiance arrived there; / that best of Vaiśyas was redeemed by that best of Kirātas, who possessed great brilliance.

1.3.s:
kailāsaṃ parvataṃ prāptau vimānairvegavattaraiḥ..
sārūpyameva saṃprāptāvīśvareṇa mahātmanā.. 5.183 ..
1.3.d:
कैलासं पर्वतं प्राप्तौ विमानैर्वेगवत्तरैः..
सारूप्यमेव संप्राप्तावीश्वरेण महात्मना.. 5.183 ..
1.3.m: They reached Mount Kailāsa by means of very swift aerial chariots; / they attained conformity of form with Īśvara, the Great Soul.

1.3.s:
nīrājitau girijayā śivena sahitau tadā..
uvācedaṃ tato devī prahasya gajagāminī.. 5.184 ..
1.3.d:
नीराजितौ गिरिजया शिवेन सहितौ तदा..
उवाचेदं ततो देवी प्रहस्य गजगामिनी.. 5.184 ..
1.3.m: Then, being accompanied by Śiva, they were greeted with the waving of lights by Girijā. / Then the goddess, who walks like an elephant, spoke this, laughing:

1.3.s:
yathā tvaṃ hi mahādeva tathā caitau na saṃśayaḥ..
svarūpeṇa ca gatyā ca hāsyabhāvaiḥ supūjitau.. 5.185 ..
1.3.d:
यथा त्वं हि महादेव तथा चैतौ न संशयः..
स्वरूपेण च गत्या च हास्यभावैः सुपूजितौ.. 5.185 ..
1.3.m: “Just as you are, Mahādeva, so are these two, there is no doubt; / in appearance, in gait, and in cheerful disposition, they are well worshipped.

1.3.s:
mayā tvameka evāsīḥ sevito vai na saṃśayaḥ..
devyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā kirāto vaiśya eva ca.. 5.186 ..
1.3.d:
मया त्वमेक एवासीः सेवितो वै न संशयः..
देव्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा किरातो वैश्य एव च.. 5.186 ..
1.3.m: By me you alone were served, without a doubt.” / Hearing that word of the Goddess, both the Kirāta and the Vaiśya,

1.3.s:
sadyaḥ parāṅmukhau bhūtvā śaṃkarasya ca paśyataḥ..
bhavāvastvanukaṃpyau ca bhavatā hi trilocana.. 5.187 ..
1.3.d:
सद्यः पराङ्मुखौ भूत्वा शंकरस्य च पश्यतः..
भवावस्त्वनुकंप्यौ च भवता हि त्रिलोचन.. 5.187 ..
1.3.m: immediately turning their faces away as Śaṃkara was looking on, [said:] / “May we two be pitied by you, O three-eyed Lord!

1.3.s: tava dvāri sthitau nityaṃ bhāvavaste namonamaḥ.. 5.188 ..
1.3.d: तव द्वारि स्थितौ नित्यं भाववस्ते नमोनमः.. 5.188 ..
1.3.m: Standing constantly at your door, may we remain [your servants]! Homage, homage to you!”

1.3.s:
tayorbhāvaṃ sa bhagavānviditvā prahasanbhavaḥ..
uvāca parayā bhaktyā bhavatorastu vāṃchitam.. 5.189 ..
1.3.d:
तयोर्भावं स भगवान्विदित्वा प्रहसन्भवः..
उवाच परया भक्त्या भवतोरस्तु वांछितम्.. 5.189 ..
1.3.m: Understanding the disposition of both, the lord Bhava smiled and said: / 'Through your supreme devotion, let your desire be fulfilled.' 5.189

1.3.s:
tadā prabhṛti tāvetau dvārapālau babhūvatuḥ..
śivadvāri sthitau viprā madhyāhne śivadarśinau.. 5.190 ..
1.3.d:
तदा प्रभृति तावेतौ द्वारपालौ बभूवतुः..
शिवद्वारि स्थितौ विप्रा मध्याह्ने शिवदर्शिनौ.. 5.190 ..
1.3.m: From that time forward, O brahmins, those two became doorkeepers, / stationed at the door of Śiva, beholding Śiva at midday. 5.190

1.3.s:
eko naṃdī mahākālo dvāvetau śivavallabhau..
ūcatustau mudāyuktāveka eva sadāśivaḥ.. 5.191 ..
1.3.d:
एको नंदी महाकालो द्वावेतौ शिववल्लभौ..
ऊचतुस्तौ मुदायुक्तावेक एव सदाशिवः.. 5.191 ..
1.3.m: One was Nandī, and [the other] Mahākāla—these two were dear to Śiva. / Filled with joy, they said: 'Sadāśiva is one alone.' 5.191

1.3.s:
ekāṃguliṃ samuddhṛtya mahādevobhyabhāṣata..
tathā naṃdī uvācedamuddhṛtya svāṃgulidvayam.. 5.192 ..
1.3.d:
एकांगुलिं समुद्धृत्य महादेवोभ्यभाषत..
तथा नंदी उवाचेदमुद्धृत्य स्वांगुलिद्वयम्.. 5.192 ..
1.3.m: Raising one finger, Mahādeva spoke; / likewise Nandī spoke this, raising two of his fingers. 5.192

1.3.s:
evaṃ saṃjñānvitau dvāri tiṣṭhatastau mahātmanaḥ..
śaṃkarasya mahābhāgāḥ śrṛṇvaṃtu ṛṣayo hyamī.. 5.193 ..
1.3.d:
एवं संज्ञान्वितौ द्वारि तिष्ठतस्तौ महात्मनः..
शंकरस्य महाभागाः श्रृण्वंतु ऋषयो ह्यमी.. 5.193 ..
1.3.m: Endowed with such gestures, the two stand at the door of the great-souled Śaṃkara. / O fortunate ones, let these seers indeed hear! 5.193

1.3.s:
śailādena purā proktaṃ śivadharmamanaṃtakam..
prāṇināṃ kṛpayā viprāḥ sarveṣāṃ duṣkṛtātmanām.. 5.194 ..
1.3.d:
शैलादेन पुरा प्रोक्तं शिवधर्ममनंतकम्..
प्राणिनां कृपया विप्राः सर्वेषां दुष्कृतात्मनाम्.. 5.194 ..
1.3.m: In ancient times, the eternal dharma of Śiva was proclaimed by Śailāda / out of compassion for all living beings whose souls have committed evil deeds, O brahmins. 5.194

1.3.s:
ye pāpino'pyadharmiṣṭhā aṃdhā mūkāśca paṃgavaḥ..
kulahīnā durātmānaḥ śvapacā api mānavāḥ.. 5.195 ..
1.3.d:
ये पापिनोऽप्यधर्मिष्ठा अंधा मूकाश्च पंगवः..
कुलहीना दुरात्मानः श्वपचा अपि मानवाः.. 5.195 ..
1.3.m: Even those who are sinners, most unrighteous, blind, mute, and lame, / base-born, wicked-souled, and even dog-cookers among men— 5.195

1.3.s:
yādṛśāstādṛśāścānye śivabhaktipuraskṛtāḥ..
te'pi gacchaṃti sāṃnidhyaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ.. 5.196 ..
1.3.d:
यादृशास्तादृशाश्चान्ये शिवभक्तिपुरस्कृताः..
तेऽपि गच्छंति सांनिध्यं देवदेवस्य शूलिनः.. 5.196 ..
1.3.m: whatever sorts they may be, if they are guided by devotion to Śiva, / they too attain the presence of the god of gods, the bearer of the trident. 5.196

1.3.s:
liṃgaṃ sikatāmayaṃ ye pūjayaṃti vipaścitaḥ..
te rudralokaṃ gacchaṃti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 5.197 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe śivaśāstre śivabhaktimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 5 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
लिंगं सिकतामयं ये पूजयंति विपश्चितः..
ते रुद्रलोकं गच्छंति नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 5.197 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखंडे शिवशास्त्रे शिवभक्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पंचमोऽध्यायः.. 5 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
Those wise ones who worship a liṅga made of sand / go to the realm of Rudra; no doubt should be entertained in this matter. 5.197
Thus ends the fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Devotion to Śiva', in the Śivaśāstra of the Kedārakhaṇḍa in the first [part], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 5.

1.3.s:
..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
liṃge pratiṣṭhā ca kathaṃ śivaṃ hitvā pravartitā..
tatkathyatāṃ mahābhāga paraṃ śuśruṣatāṃ hi naḥ.. 6.1 ..
1.3.d:
..ऋषय ऊचुः..
लिंगे प्रतिष्ठा च कथं शिवं हित्वा प्रवर्तिता..
तत्कथ्यतां महाभाग परं शुश्रुषतां हि नः.. 6.1 ..
1.3.m: The seers said: / 'How was consecration established in the liṅga, leaving aside Śiva [himself]? / Let that be told, O fortunate one, for we are eager to hear.' 6.1

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
yadā dāruvane śaṃbhurbhikṣārthaṃ prācaratprabhuḥ.. 6.2 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
यदा दारुवने शंभुर्भिक्षार्थं प्राचरत्प्रभुः.. 6.2 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / 'When the lord Śambhu wandered in the Dāruvana for the sake of alms, 6.2

1.3.s:
digaṃbaro muktajaṭākalāpo vedāṃtavedyo bhuvanaikabhartā..
sa īśvaro brahmakalāpadhāro yogīśvarāṇāṃ paramaḥ paraśca.. 6.3 ..
1.3.d:
दिगंबरो मुक्तजटाकलापो वेदांतवेद्यो भुवनैकभर्ता..
स ईश्वरो ब्रह्मकलापधारो योगीश्वराणां परमः परश्च.. 6.3 ..
1.3.m: sky-clad, his mass of matted hair unbound, knowable through the Vedānta, the sole protector of the world, / that Īśvara, wearing the crescent of Brahmā, the supreme and beyond the lords of yogins, 6.3

1.3.s:
aṇoraṇīyānmahato mahī yānmahānubhāvo bhuvanādhipo mahān..
sa īśvaro bhikṣurūpī mahātmā bhikṣāṭanaṃ dāruvane cakāra.. 6.4 ..
1.3.d:
अणोरणीयान्महतो मही यान्महानुभावो भुवनाधिपो महान्..
स ईश्वरो भिक्षुरूपी महात्मा भिक्षाटनं दारुवने चकार.. 6.4 ..
1.3.m: subtler than the subtle, greater than the great, of great majesty, the great sovereign of the world, / that Īśvara, the great soul in the form of a mendicant, wandered for alms in the Dāruvana. 6.4

1.3.s:
madhyāhna ṛṣayo viprāstīrthaṃ jagmuḥ svakāśramāt..
tadānīmeva sarvāstā ṛṣībhāryāḥ samāgatāḥ.. 6.5 ..
1.3.d:
मध्याह्न ऋषयो विप्रास्तीर्थं जग्मुः स्वकाश्रमात्..
तदानीमेव सर्वास्ता ऋषीभार्याः समागताः.. 6.5 ..
1.3.m: At midday, the seers, the brahmins, went to the sacred ford from their hermitage. / At that very time, all those wives of the seers gathered together. 6.5

1.3.s:
vilokayaṃtyaḥ śaṃbhuṃ tamācakhyuśca parasparam..
ko'sau bhikṣukarūpoyamāgato'pūrvadarśanaḥ.. 6.6 ..
1.3.d:
विलोकयंत्यः शंभुं तमाचख्युश्च परस्परम्..
कोऽसौ भिक्षुकरूपोयमागतोऽपूर्वदर्शनः.. 6.6 ..
1.3.m: Beholding that Śambhu, they said to one another: / 'Who is this one in the form of a mendicant who has arrived, never seen before? 6.6

1.3.s:
asmai bhikṣāṃ prayacchāmo vayaṃ ca sakhibhiḥ saha..
tatheti gatvā sarvāstā gṛhebhya ānayanmudā.. 6.7 ..
1.3.d:
अस्मै भिक्षां प्रयच्छामो वयं च सखिभिः सह..
तथेति गत्वा सर्वास्ता गृहेभ्य आनयन्मुदा.. 6.7 ..
1.3.m: Let us give alms to him together with our companions.' / Saying 'So be it', all of them joyfully brought [food] from their homes. 6.7

1.3.s:
bhikṣānnaṃ vividhaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ sopacāraṃ ca śaktitaḥ..
pradattaṃ bhikṣitaṃ tena devadevena śūlinā.. 6.8 ..
1.3.d:
भिक्षान्नं विविधं श्लक्ष्णं सोपचारं च शक्तितः..
प्रदत्तं भिक्षितं तेन देवदेवेन शूलिना.. 6.8 ..
1.3.m: Alms-food of various kinds, delicate, and accompanied with respectful service according to their ability, / was offered and accepted as alms by that god of gods, the bearer of the trident. 6.8

1.3.s:
kācitpriyatamaṃ śaṃbhuṃ babhāṣe vismayānvitā..
kosi tvaṃ bhikṣuko bhūtvā āgatotra mahāmate.. 6.9 ..
1.3.d:
काचित्प्रियतमं शंभुं बभाषे विस्मयान्विता..
कोसि त्वं भिक्षुको भूत्वा आगतोत्र महामते.. 6.9 ..
1.3.m: Filled with wonder, a certain woman spoke to the beloved Śambhu: / 'Who are you, having become a mendicant, who have come here, O wise one? 6.9

1.3.s:
ṛṣīṇāmāśramaṃ śuddhaṃ kimarthaṃ no niṣīdasi..
tayokto'pi tadā śaṃbhurbabhāṣe prahasanniva.. 6.10 ..
1.3.d:
ऋषीणामाश्रमं शुद्धं किमर्थं नो निषीदसि..
तयोक्तोऽपि तदा शंभुर्बभाषे प्रहसन्निव.. 6.10 ..
1.3.m: Why do you not sit in the pure hermitage of the seers?' / Though addressed by her then, Śambhu spoke as if smiling: 6.10

1.3.s:
īśvarohaṃ sukeśāṃte pāvanaṃ prāptavānimam..
īśvarasya vacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣibhāryā uvāca tam.. 6.11 ..
1.3.d:
ईश्वरोहं सुकेशांते पावनं प्राप्तवानिमम्..
ईश्वरस्य वचः श्रुत्वा ऋषिभार्या उवाच तम्.. 6.11 ..
1.3.m: 'I am Īśvara, O fair-haired one, and I have arrived at this purifying [place].' / Hearing the words of Īśvara, the seer's wife said to him: 6.11

1.3.s:
īśvaro'si mahābhāga kailāsapatireva ca..
ekākinaḥ kathaṃ deva bhikṣārthamaṭanaṃ tava.. 6.12 ..
1.3.d:
ईश्वरोऽसि महाभाग कैलासपतिरेव च..
एकाकिनः कथं देव भिक्षार्थमटनं तव.. 6.12 ..
1.3.m: 'You are Īśvara, O fortunate one, the very lord of Kailāsa. / Why do you wander alone for alms, O god?' 6.12

1.3.s:
evamuktastayā śaṃbhuḥ punastāmabravīdvacaḥ..
dākṣāyaṇyā virahito vicarāmi digaṃbaraḥ.. 6.13 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तया शंभुः पुनस्तामब्रवीद्वचः..
दाक्षायण्या विरहितो विचरामि दिगंबरः.. 6.13 ..
1.3.m: Thus addressed by her, Śambhu spoke words to her again: / 'Separated from Dākṣāyaṇī, I wander sky-clad 6.13

1.3.s:
bhikṣāṭanārthaṃ suśroṇi saṃkalparahitaḥ sadā..
tayā satyā vinā kiṃcitstrīmātraṃ mama bhāmini..
na rocate viśālākṣi satyaṃ prativadāmi te.. 6.14 ..
1.3.d:
भिक्षाटनार्थं सुश्रोणि संकल्परहितः सदा..
तया सत्या विना किंचित्स्त्रीमात्रं मम भामिनि..
न रोचते विशालाक्षि सत्यं प्रतिवदामि ते.. 6.14 ..
1.3.m: for the sake of begging alms, O fair-hipped one, always free from desire. / Without that Satī, no woman whatsoever pleases me, O lady; / I tell you the truth, O wide-eyed one.' 6.14

1.3.s:
tasyoktaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā uvāca kamalekṣaṇā..
striyo hi sukhasaṃsparśāḥ puruṣasya na saṃśayaḥ.. 6.15 ..
1.3.d:
तस्योक्तं वचनं श्रुत्वा उवाच कमलेक्षणा..
स्त्रियो हि सुखसंस्पर्शाः पुरुषस्य न संशयः.. 6.15 ..
1.3.m: Hearing the words spoken by him, the lotus-eyed woman said: / 'Women are indeed of delightful touch for a man, without doubt. 6.15

1.3.s: tāsstriyo varjitāḥ śaṃbho tvādṛśena vipaścitā.. 6.16 ..
1.3.d: तास्स्त्रियो वर्जिताः शंभो त्वादृशेन विपश्चिता.. 6.16 ..
1.3.m: Those women are avoided, O Śambhu, by a wise person like you.' 6.16

1.3.s:
iti ca pramadāḥ sarvā militā yatra śaṃkaraḥ..
bhikṣāpātraṃ ca tacchaṃbhoḥ pūritaṃ ca mahāguṇaiḥ.. 6.17 ..
1.3.d:
इति च प्रमदाः सर्वा मिलिता यत्र शंकरः..
भिक्षापात्रं च तच्छंभोः पूरितं च महागुणैः.. 6.17 ..
1.3.m: Thus all the women gathered where Śaṃkara was, / and that begging bowl of Śambhu was filled with excellent things, 6.17

1.3.s:
annaiścaturvidhaiḥ ṣaḍbhī rasaiśca paripūritam..
yadā saṃbhurgaṃtukāmaḥ kailāsaṃ parvataṃ prati..
tadā sarvā viprapatnyo hyangacchanmudānvitāḥ.. 6.18 ..
1.3.d:
अन्नैश्चतुर्विधैः षड्भी रसैश्च परिपूरितम्..
यदा संभुर्गंतुकामः कैलासं पर्वतं प्रति..
तदा सर्वा विप्रपत्न्यो ह्यन्गच्छन्मुदान्विताः.. 6.18 ..
1.3.m: completely filled with the four kinds of food and the six flavors. / When Śambhu wished to go toward Mount Kailāsa, / then all the wives of the brahmins followed, filled with joy. 6.18

1.3.s:
gṛhakāryaṃ parityajya cerustadgatamānasāḥ..
gatāsu tāsu sarvāsu patnīṣu ṛṣisattamāḥ.. 6.19 ..
1.3.d:
गृहकार्यं परित्यज्य चेरुस्तद्गतमानसाः..
गतासु तासु सर्वासु पत्नीषु ऋषिसत्तमाः.. 6.19 ..
1.3.m: Abandoning their household duties, they walked along with their minds fixed on him. / When all those wives had gone, the best of seers, 6.19

1.3.s:
yāvadāśramamabhyetya tāvacchūnyaṃ vyalokayan..
parasparamathocuste patnyaḥ sarvāḥ kuto gatāḥ.. 6.20 ..
1.3.d:
यावदाश्रममभ्येत्य तावच्छून्यं व्यलोकयन्..
परस्परमथोचुस्ते पत्न्यः सर्वाः कुतो गताः.. 6.20 ..
1.3.m: as soon as they returned to the hermitage, saw it completely empty. / Then they said to one another: 'Where have all the wives gone? 6.20

1.3.s:
na vidāmo'tha vai sarvāḥ kena naṣṭena cāhṛtāḥ..
evaṃ vimṛśyamānāste vicinvaṃtastatastataḥ.. 6.21 ..
1.3.d:
न विदामोऽथ वै सर्वाः केन नष्टेन चाहृताः..
एवं विमृश्यमानास्ते विचिन्वंतस्ततस्ततः.. 6.21 ..
1.3.m: We do not know by what vile creature they have all been taken away.' / Deliberating thus, searching here and there, 6.21

1.3.s:
samapaśyaṃstataḥ sarve śivasyānugatāśca tāḥ..
śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu saṃprāptā ṛṣayaste ruṣānvitāḥ.. 6.22 ..
1.3.d:
समपश्यंस्ततः सर्वे शिवस्यानुगताश्च ताः..
शिवं दृष्ट्वा तु संप्राप्ता ऋषयस्ते रुषान्विताः.. 6.22 ..
1.3.m: they all then saw them following after Śiva. / Seeing Śiva, those seers approached, filled with rage. 6.22

1.3.s:
śivasyāthāgrato bhūtvā ūcuḥ sarve tvarānvitāḥ..
kiṃ kṛtaṃ hi tvayā śaṃbho viraktena mahātmanā..
paradārāpaharttāsi tvamṛṣīṇāṃ na saṃśayaḥ.. 6.23 ..
1.3.d:
शिवस्याथाग्रतो भूत्वा ऊचुः सर्वे त्वरान्विताः..
किं कृतं हि त्वया शंभो विरक्तेन महात्मना..
परदारापहर्त्तासि त्वमृषीणां न संशयः.. 6.23 ..
1.3.m: Then stepping in front of Śiva, they all spoke in haste: / 'What has been done by you, O Śambhu, a great soul who is supposedly detached? / You are an abductor of others' wives, the wives of seers, without doubt!' 6.23

1.3.s:
evaṃ kṣiptaḥ śivo maunī gacchamāno'pi parvatam..
tadā sa ṛṣibhiḥ prāpto mahādevo'vyayastathā..
yasmātkalatrahartā tvaṃ tasmātṣaṃḍho bhava tvaram.. 6.24 ..
1.3.d:
एवं क्षिप्तः शिवो मौनी गच्छमानोऽपि पर्वतम्..
तदा स ऋषिभिः प्राप्तो महादेवोऽव्ययस्तथा..
यस्मात्कलत्रहर्ता त्वं तस्मात्षंढो भव त्वरम्.. 6.24 ..
1.3.m: Though thus reproached, Śiva remained silent while continuing toward the mountain. / Then Mahādeva, the imperishable, was approached by the seers [who said]: / 'Because you are an abductor of wives, therefore become an eunuch at once!' 6.24

1.3.s:
evaṃ śaptaḥ sa munibhirliṃgaṃ tasyāpatadbhuvi..
bhūmiprāptaṃ ca talliṃgaṃ vavṛdhe tarasā mahat.. 6.25 ..
1.3.d:
एवं शप्तः स मुनिभिर्लिंगं तस्यापतद्भुवि..
भूमिप्राप्तं च तल्लिंगं ववृधे तरसा महत्.. 6.25 ..
1.3.m: Thus cursed by the sages, his liṅga fell upon the earth; / and that liṅga, having reached the ground, grew rapidly and exceedingly vast. 6.25

1.3.s:
āvṛtya sapta pātālānkṣaṇālliṃgamadordhvataḥ..
vyāpya pṛthvīṃ samagrāṃ ca aṃtarikṣaṃ samāvṛṇot.. 6.26 ..
1.3.d:
आवृत्य सप्त पातालान्क्षणाल्लिंगमदोर्ध्वतः..
व्याप्य पृथ्वीं समग्रां च अंतरिक्षं समावृणोत्.. 6.26 ..
1.3.m: Enveloping the seven netherworlds in an instant, the liṅga [extended] downwards and upwards; / pervading the entire earth, it covered the atmosphere. 6.26

1.3.s:
svargāḥ samāvṛtāḥ sarve svargātītamathābhavat..
na mahī na ca dikcakraṃ na toyaṃ na ca pāvakaḥ.. 6.27 ..
1.3.d:
स्वर्गाः समावृताः सर्वे स्वर्गातीतमथाभवत्..
न मही न च दिक्चक्रं न तोयं न च पावकः.. 6.27 ..
1.3.m: All the heavens were covered, and then it surpassed heaven. / There was neither earth, nor the circle of directions, nor water, nor fire, 6.27

1.3.s:
na ca vāyurna vākāśaṃ nāhaṃkāro na vā mahat..
na cāvyaktaṃ na kālaśca na mahāprakṛtistathā.. 6.28 ..
1.3.d:
न च वायुर्न वाकाशं नाहंकारो न वा महत्..
न चाव्यक्तं न कालश्च न महाप्रकृतिस्तथा.. 6.28 ..
1.3.m: nor wind, nor space, nor ego, nor the cosmic intellect, / nor the unmanifest, nor time, nor primordial nature. 6.28

1.3.s:
nāsīddvavaitavibhāgaṃ ca sarvaṃ līnaṃ ca tatkṣaṇāt..
yasmāllīnaṃ jagatsarvaṃ tasmim̐llige mahātmanaḥ.. 6.29 ..
1.3.d:
नासीद्द्ववैतविभागं च सर्वं लीनं च तत्क्षणात्..
यस्माल्लीनं जगत्सर्वं तस्मिम्̐ल्लिगे महात्मनः.. 6.29 ..
1.3.m: There was no division of duality, and everything dissolved in that instant. / Because the entire universe dissolved in that liṅga of the great soul, 6.29

1.3.s:
layanālliṃgamityevaṃ pravadaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ..
tathābhūtaṃ varddhamānaṃ dṛṣṭvā te'pi surarṣayaḥ.. 6.30 ..
1.3.d:
लयनाल्लिंगमित्येवं प्रवदंति मनीषिणः..
तथाभूतं वर्द्धमानं दृष्ट्वा तेऽपि सुरर्षयः.. 6.30 ..
1.3.m: the wise call it 'liṅga' on account of dissolution. / Seeing it growing in such a manner, the divine seers as well, 6.30

1.3.s:
brahmeṃdraviṣṇuvāyyagnilokapālāḥ sapannagāḥ..
vismayāviṣṭamanasaḥ parasparamathābruvan.. 6.31 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मेंद्रविष्णुवाय्यग्निलोकपालाः सपन्नगाः..
विस्मयाविष्टमनसः परस्परमथाब्रुवन्.. 6.31 ..
1.3.m: along with Brahmā, Indra, Viṣṇu, Vāyu, Agni, the world guardians, and the serpents, / their minds overcome with wonder, then said to one another: 6.31

1.3.s:
kimāyāmaṃ ca vistāraṃ kva cāṃtaḥ kva ca pīṭhikā..
iti ciṃtānvitā viṣṇumūcuḥ sarve surāstadā.. 6.32 ..
1.3.d:
किमायामं च विस्तारं क्व चांतः क्व च पीठिका..
इति चिंतान्विता विष्णुमूचुः सर्वे सुरास्तदा.. 6.32 ..
1.3.m: 'What is its length and its breadth? Where is its end, and where is its pedestal?' / Thus filled with anxiety, all the gods then spoke to Viṣṇu. 6.32

1.3.s:
..devā ūcuḥ..
asya mūlaṃ tvayā viṣṇo padmodbhava ca mastakam..
yuvābhyāṃ ca vilokyaṃ syātsthāne syātparipālakau.. 6.33 ..
1.3.d:
..देवा ऊचुः..
अस्य मूलं त्वया विष्णो पद्मोद्भव च मस्तकम्..
युवाभ्यां च विलोक्यं स्यात्स्थाने स्यात्परिपालकौ.. 6.33 ..
1.3.m:
The gods said:
“Its base [should be seen] by you, O Viṣṇu, and its head by you, O lotus-born [Brahmā]! / It should be looked for by you two; in this position, be its protectors!”

1.3.s:
śrutvā tu tau mahābhāgau vaikuṃṭhakamalodbhavau..
viṣṇurgato hi pātālaṃ brahmā sarvargaṃ jagāma ha.. 6.34 ..
1.3.d:
श्रुत्वा तु तौ महाभागौ वैकुंठकमलोद्भवौ..
विष्णुर्गतो हि पातालं ब्रह्मा सर्वर्गं जगाम ह.. 6.34 ..
1.3.m: Hearing this, those two illustrious ones, the dweller of Vaikuṇṭha and the lotus-born, [departed]; / Viṣṇu indeed went to Pātāla, and Brahmā went to heaven.

1.3.s:
svargaṃ gatastadā brahmā avalokanatatparaḥ..
nāpasyattatra liṃgasya mastakaṃ ca vicakṣamaḥ.. 6.35 ..
1.3.d:
स्वर्गं गतस्तदा ब्रह्मा अवलोकनतत्परः..
नापस्यत्तत्र लिंगस्य मस्तकं च विचक्षमः.. 6.35 ..
1.3.m: Having gone to heaven then, Brahmā, intent upon searching, / could not see the head of the liṅga there, [though] wise.

1.3.s:
tathā gatena mārgeṇa pratyāvṛttyābjasaṃbhavaḥ..
merupṛṣṭhamanuprāptaḥ surabhyā lakṣitastataḥ.. 6.36 ..
1.3.d:
तथा गतेन मार्गेण प्रत्यावृत्त्याब्जसंभवः..
मेरुपृष्ठमनुप्राप्तः सुरभ्या लक्षितस्ततः.. 6.36 ..
1.3.m: Returning by the path he had taken, the lotus-born / reached the ridge of Meru, and was then noticed by Surabhi,

1.3.s:
sthitā yā ketakīcchāyāmuvāca madhuraṃ vacaḥ..
tasyā vacanamākarṇya sarvalokapitāmahaḥ..
uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ chaloktyā surabhiṃ prati.. 6.37 ..
1.3.d:
स्थिता या केतकीच्छायामुवाच मधुरं वचः..
तस्या वचनमाकर्ण्य सर्वलोकपितामहः..
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं छलोक्त्या सुरभिं प्रति.. 6.37 ..
1.3.m: who, standing in the shade of a ketakī [tree], spoke sweet words. / Hearing her speech, the grandfather of all the worlds / spoke these words, smiling, with a deceptive speech to Surabhi:

1.3.s:
liṃgaṃ mahādbhutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yenavyāptaṃ jagattrayam..
darśanārthaṃ ca tasyāṃtaṃ devaiḥ saṃpreṣitosmayaham.. 6.38 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगं महाद्भुतं दृष्टं येनव्याप्तं जगत्त्रयम्..
दर्शनार्थं च तस्यांतं देवैः संप्रेषितोस्मयहम्.. 6.38 ..
1.3.m: “A greatly wondrous liṅga has been seen, by which the three worlds are pervaded. / I have been sent by the gods in order to see its end.

1.3.s:
na dṛṣṭaṃ mastakaṃ tasya vyāpakasya mahātmanaḥ..
kiṃ vakṣye'haṃ ca devāgre ciṃtā me cāti vartate.. 6.39 ..
1.3.d:
न दृष्टं मस्तकं तस्य व्यापकस्य महात्मनः..
किं वक्ष्येऽहं च देवाग्रे चिंता मे चाति वर्तते.. 6.39 ..
1.3.m: The head of that all-pervading, great-souled one was not seen. / What shall I say before the gods? A great anxiety indeed possesses me.

1.3.s:
liṃgasya mastakaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ devānāṃ ca mṛṣā vadeḥ..
te sarve yadi vakṣyaṃti iṃdrādyā devatāgaṇāḥ.. 6.40 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगस्य मस्तकं दृष्टं देवानां च मृषा वदेः..
ते सर्वे यदि वक्ष्यंति इंद्राद्या देवतागणाः.. 6.40 ..
1.3.m: You should falsely tell the gods: ‘The head of the liṅga has been seen.’ / If all those hosts of deities headed by Indra should say:

1.3.s:
te saṃti sākṣimo devā asminnarthe vadatvaram..
arthe'sminbhava sākṣī tvaṃ ketakyā saha suvrate.. 6.41 ..
1.3.d:
ते संति साक्षिमो देवा अस्मिन्नर्थे वदत्वरम्..
अर्थेऽस्मिन्भव साक्षी त्वं केतक्या सह सुव्रते.. 6.41 ..
1.3.m: ‘Who are the witnesses to this matter? Speak quickly, O gods!’ / In this matter, be a witness together with the ketakī, O lady of good vows!”

1.3.s:
tadvacaḥ śirasā gṛhya brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ..
ketakīsahitā tatra surabhī tadamānayat.. 6.42 ..
1.3.d:
तद्वचः शिरसा गृह्य ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः..
केतकीसहिता तत्र सुरभी तदमानयत्.. 6.42 ..
1.3.m: Taking that command of Brahmā Parameṣṭhin on her head, / Surabhi, together with the ketakī, agreed to that.

1.3.s: evaṃ samāgato brahma devāgre samuvāca ha.. 6.43 ..
1.3.d: एवं समागतो ब्रह्म देवाग्रे समुवाच ह.. 6.43 ..
1.3.m: Having arrived thus, Brahmā spoke before the gods:

1.3.s:
..brahmovāca..
liṃgasya mastakaṃ devā dṛṣṭavānahamadbhutam..
samīcīnaṃ cārtitaṃ ca ketakīdala saṃyutam.. 6.44 ..
1.3.d:
..ब्रह्मोवाच..
लिंगस्य मस्तकं देवा दृष्टवानहमद्भुतम्..
समीचीनं चार्तितं च केतकीदल संयुतम्.. 6.44 ..
1.3.m:
Brahmā said:
“O gods, I have seen the wondrous head of the liṅga, / auspicious, worshipped, and adorned with ketakī petals,

1.3.s:
viśālaṃ vimalaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ prasannataramadbhutam..
ramyaṃ ca ramaṇīyaṃ ca darśanīyaṃ mahāprabham.. 6.45 ..
1.3.d:
विशालं विमलं श्लक्ष्णं प्रसन्नतरमद्भुतम्..
रम्यं च रमणीयं च दर्शनीयं महाप्रभम्.. 6.45 ..
1.3.m: vast, stainless, smooth, exceedingly serene, wondrous, / delightful, charming, splendid to behold, and of great splendor.

1.3.s:
etādṛśaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ tadvinākvacit..
brahmaṇo hi vacaḥ śrutvā surā vismayamāyayuḥ.. 6.46 ..
1.3.d:
एतादृशं मया दृष्टं न दृष्टं तद्विनाक्वचित्..
ब्रह्मणो हि वचः श्रुत्वा सुरा विस्मयमाययुः.. 6.46 ..
1.3.m: Such a thing has been seen by me; nowhere else has anything like it been seen.” / Hearing the words of Brahmā, the gods were filled with wonder.

1.3.s:
evaṃ vismayapūrṇāste iṃdrādyā devatāgaṇāḥ..
tiṣṭhaṃti tāvatsarveśo viṣṇuradhyātmadīpakaḥ.. 6.47 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विस्मयपूर्णास्ते इंद्राद्या देवतागणाः..
तिष्ठंति तावत्सर्वेशो विष्णुरध्यात्मदीपकः.. 6.47 ..
1.3.m: While those hosts of deities headed by Indra were thus standing full of wonder, / Viṣṇu, the lord of all, the illuminator of the inner self,

1.3.s:
pātālādāgataḥ sadyaḥ sarveṣāmavadattvaram..
tasyāpyaṃto na dṛṣṭo me hyavalokanatatparaḥ.. 6.48 ..
1.3.d:
पातालादागतः सद्यः सर्वेषामवदत्त्वरम्..
तस्याप्यंतो न दृष्टो मे ह्यवलोकनतत्परः.. 6.48 ..
1.3.m: having just arrived from Pātāla, quickly spoke to all of them: / “Though intent upon searching, its end was not seen by me either.

1.3.s:
vismayo me mahāñjātaḥ pātālātparataścaran..
atalaṃ sutalaṃ cāpi nitalaṃ ca rasātalam.. 6.49 ..
1.3.d:
विस्मयो मे महाञ्जातः पातालात्परतश्चरन्..
अतलं सुतलं चापि नितलं च रसातलम्.. 6.49 ..
1.3.m: Great wonder arose in me as I wandered beyond Pātāla: / Atala, Sutala, and also Nitala, Rasātala,

1.3.s:
tathā gatastalaṃ caiva pātālaṃ ca tathātalam..
talātalāni tānyenaṃ śūnyavadyadvibhāvyate.. 6.50 ..
1.3.d:
तथा गतस्तलं चैव पातालं च तथातलम्..
तलातलानि तान्येनं शून्यवद्यद्विभाव्यते.. 6.50 ..
1.3.m: and likewise I went to Tala, and Pātāla, and so to Atala; / those various netherworlds appear to be like a void.

1.3.s:
śūnyādapi ca śūnyaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ sunirīkṣitam..
na mūlaṃ ca na madhyaṃ ca na cāṃto hyasya vidyate.. 6.51 ..
1.3.d:
शून्यादपि च शून्यं च तत्सर्वं सुनिरीक्षितम्..
न मूलं च न मध्यं च न चांतो ह्यस्य विद्यते.. 6.51 ..
1.3.m: All that was thoroughly inspected by me, emptier even than an empty void: / no base, no middle, and no end exists for it.

1.3.s:
liṃgarūpī mahādevo yenedaṃ dhāryate jagat..
yasya prasādādutpannā yūyaṃ ca ṛṣayastathā.. 6.52 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगरूपी महादेवो येनेदं धार्यते जगत्..
यस्य प्रसादादुत्पन्ना यूयं च ऋषयस्तथा.. 6.52 ..
1.3.m: This is Mahādeva in the form of a liṅga, by whom this universe is upheld, / and by whose grace you and the seers were brought forth.”

1.3.s:
śrutvā surāśca ṛṣayastasya vākyamapūjayan..
tadā viṣṇuruvācedaṃ brahmāṇaṃ prahasanniva.. 6.53 ..
1.3.d:
श्रुत्वा सुराश्च ऋषयस्तस्य वाक्यमपूजयन्..
तदा विष्णुरुवाचेदं ब्रह्माणं प्रहसन्निव.. 6.53 ..
1.3.m: Hearing this, the gods and the seers honored his words. / Then Viṣṇu said this to Brahmā, as if laughing:

1.3.s:
dṛṣṭaṃ hi cettvayā brahmanmastakaṃ paramārthataḥ..
sākṣiṇaḥ ke tvayā tatra asminnarthe prakalpitāḥ.. 6.54 ..
1.3.d:
दृष्टं हि चेत्त्वया ब्रह्मन्मस्तकं परमार्थतः..
साक्षिणः के त्वया तत्र अस्मिन्नर्थे प्रकल्पिताः.. 6.54 ..
1.3.m: “If indeed the head was truly seen by you, O Brahmā, / what witnesses have you prepared for this matter?”

1.3.s:
ākarṇya vacanaṃ viṣṇorbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ..
uvāca tvaritenaiva ketakī surabhīti ca.. 6.55 ..
1.3.d:
आकर्ण्य वचनं विष्णोर्ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः..
उवाच त्वरितेनैव केतकी सुरभीति च.. 6.55 ..
1.3.m: Hearing Viṣṇu's words, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / quickly said: “Ketakī and Surabhi.

1.3.s:
te devā mama sākṣitve jānīhi paramārthataḥ..
brahmaṇo hi vacaḥ śrutvā sarve devāstvarānvitāḥ.. 6.56 ..
1.3.d:
ते देवा मम साक्षित्वे जानीहि परमार्थतः..
ब्रह्मणो हि वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वे देवास्त्वरान्विताः.. 6.56 ..
1.3.m: Know them, O gods, as my witnesses in truth.” / Hearing Brahmā's words, all the gods in haste

1.3.s:
āhvānaṃ cakrire tasyāḥ surabhyāśca tayā saha..
āgate tatkṣamādeva kāryārthaṃ brahmaṇastadā.. 6.57 ..
1.3.d:
आह्वानं चक्रिरे तस्याः सुरभ्याश्च तया सह..
आगते तत्क्षमादेव कार्यार्थं ब्रह्मणस्तदा.. 6.57 ..
1.3.m: summoned her, Surabhi, along with that [ketakī]. / Then, at that very moment, both arrived for the purpose of Brahmā.

1.3.s:
iṃdrādyaiśca tadā devairuktā ca surabhī tataḥ..
uvāca ketakīsārddhaṃ dṛṣṭo vai brahmaṇā surāḥ.. 6.58 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्राद्यैश्च तदा देवैरुक्ता च सुरभी ततः..
उवाच केतकीसार्द्धं दृष्टो वै ब्रह्मणा सुराः.. 6.58 ..
1.3.m: Addressed then by the gods headed by Indra, Surabhi thereupon / spoke together with the ketakī: “Indeed, O gods, it was seen by Brahmā!

1.3.s:
liṃgasya mastako devāḥ ketakīdalapūjitaḥ..
tadā nabhogatā vāṇī sarveṣāṃ śrṛṇvatāmabhūt.. 6.59 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगस्य मस्तको देवाः केतकीदलपूजितः..
तदा नभोगता वाणी सर्वेषां श्रृण्वतामभूत्.. 6.59 ..
1.3.m: The head of the liṅga, O gods, was worshipped with ketakī petals.” / Then a voice from the sky arose while everyone listened:

1.3.s:
surabhyā caiva yatproktaṃ ketakyā ca tathā surāḥ..
tanmṛṣoktaṃ ca jānīdhvaṃ na dṛṣṭo hyasya mastakaḥ.. 6.60 ..
1.3.d:
सुरभ्या चैव यत्प्रोक्तं केतक्या च तथा सुराः..
तन्मृषोक्तं च जानीध्वं न दृष्टो ह्यस्य मस्तकः.. 6.60 ..
1.3.m: “Whatever has been spoken by Surabhi and likewise by the ketakī, O gods, / know that to be spoken falsely; its head has not been seen.”

1.3.s:
tadā sarve'tha vibudhāḥ seṃdrā vai viṣṇunā saha..
śepuśca surabhīṃ roṣānmṛṣāvādanatatparām.. 6.61 ..
1.3.d:
तदा सर्वेऽथ विबुधाः सेंद्रा वै विष्णुना सह..
शेपुश्च सुरभीं रोषान्मृषावादनतत्पराम्.. 6.61 ..
1.3.m: Then all the gods, along with Indra and Viṣṇu, / cursed Surabhi in anger, because she had engaged in lying speech:

1.3.s:
mukhenoktaṃ tvayādyaivamanṛtaṃ ca tathā śubhe..
apavitraṃ mukhaṃ te'stu sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtam.. 6.62 ..
1.3.d:
मुखेनोक्तं त्वयाद्यैवमनृतं च तथा शुभे..
अपवित्रं मुखं तेऽस्तु सर्वधर्मबहिष्कृतम्.. 6.62 ..
1.3.m: “Since an untruth was spoken by your mouth today, O auspicious one, / let your mouth be unholy, excluded from all religious duties!

1.3.s:
sugaṃdhaketakī cāpi ayogyā tvaṃ śivārcane..
bhaviṣyasi na saṃdeho anṛtā caiva bhāmini.. 6.63 ..
1.3.d:
सुगंधकेतकी चापि अयोग्या त्वं शिवार्चने..
भविष्यसि न संदेहो अनृता चैव भामिनि.. 6.63 ..
1.3.m: And you, fragrant ketakī, will also be unfit for the worship of Śiva; / there is no doubt of this, because you lied, O splendid lady!”

1.3.s:
tadā nabho gatā vāṇī brahmaṇaṃ ca śaśāpa vai..
mṛṣoktaṃ ca tvayā maṃda kimarthaṃ bāliśena hi.. 6.64 ..
1.3.d:
तदा नभो गता वाणी ब्रह्मणं च शशाप वै..
मृषोक्तं च त्वया मंद किमर्थं बालिशेन हि.. 6.64 ..
1.3.m: Then the voice from the sky cursed Brahmā indeed: / “Falsehood was spoken by you, O dull-witted one! Why [did you do so], like a child?

1.3.s:
bhṛguṇā ṛṣibhiḥ sākaṃ tathaiva ca purodhasā..
tasmādyuyaṃ na pūjyāśca bhaveyuḥ kleśabhāginaḥ.. 6.65 ..
1.3.d:
भृगुणा ऋषिभिः साकं तथैव च पुरोधसा..
तस्माद्युयं न पूज्याश्च भवेयुः क्लेशभागिनः.. 6.65 ..
1.3.m: Together with Bhṛgu, the seers, and likewise the family priest, / therefore you all shall not be worshipped, and shall be sharers in misery!

1.3.s:
ṛṣayo'pi ca dharmiṣṭhāstattvavākyabahiṣkṛtāḥ..
vivādaniratā mūḍhā atattvajñāḥ samatsarāḥ.. 6.66 ..
1.3.d:
ऋषयोऽपि च धर्मिष्ठास्तत्त्ववाक्यबहिष्कृताः..
विवादनिरता मूढा अतत्त्वज्ञाः समत्सराः.. 6.66 ..
1.3.m: Even the seers, though very righteous, shall be excluded from statements of truth, / devoted to disputation, deluded, ignorant of truth, and full of envy,

1.3.s:
yācakāścāvadānyāśca nityaṃ svajñānaghātakāḥ..
ātmasaṃbhāvitāḥ stabdhāḥ parasparaviniṃdakāḥ.. 6.67 ..
1.3.d:
याचकाश्चावदान्याश्च नित्यं स्वज्ञानघातकाः..
आत्मसंभाविताः स्तब्धाः परस्परविनिंदकाः.. 6.67 ..
1.3.m: beggars, ungenerous, constantly destroying their own knowledge, / self-conceited, obstinate, and revilers of one another!”

1.3.s:
evaṃ śaptāśca munayo brahmādyā devatāstathā..
śivena śaptāste sarve liṃgaṃ śaraṇamāyayuḥ.. 6.68 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṇḍe śrīśivaliṅgamāhātmye brahmādiśāpavṛttāntavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ.. 6 ..cha ..
1.3.d:
एवं शप्ताश्च मुनयो ब्रह्माद्या देवतास्तथा..
शिवेन शप्तास्ते सर्वे लिंगं शरणमाययुः.. 6.68 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखण्डे श्रीशिवलिङ्गमाहात्म्ये ब्रह्मादिशापवृत्तान्तवर्णनं नाम षष्ठोऽध्यायः.. 6 ..छ ..
1.3.m:
Having been thus cursed, the sages and the deities headed by Brahmā, / cursed by Śiva, all went to the liṅga for refuge.
Thus ends the sixth chapter, named ‘The Description of the Cursing of Brahmā and Others’ in the māhātmya of the glorious Śivaliṅga, in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first [book], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
tadā ca te surāḥ sarva ṛṣayopi bhayānvitāḥ..
īḍire liṃgamaiśaṃ ca brahmādyā jñānavihvalāḥ.. 7.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
तदा च ते सुराः सर्व ऋषयोपि भयान्विताः..
ईडिरे लिंगमैशं च ब्रह्माद्या ज्ञानविह्वलाः.. 7.1 ..
1.3.m:
Lomaśa said:
Then all those gods and seers, overcome with fear, / bewildered in mind, praised the liṅga belonging to Īśa, beginning with Brahmā.

1.3.s:
..brahmovāca..
tvaṃ liṃgarūpī tu mahāprabhāvo vedāṃtavedyosi mahātmarūpi..
yenaiva sarve jagadātmamūlaṃ kṛtaṃ sadānaṃdapareṇa nityam.. 7.2 ..
1.3.d:
..ब्रह्मोवाच..
त्वं लिंगरूपी तु महाप्रभावो वेदांतवेद्योसि महात्मरूपि..
येनैव सर्वे जगदात्ममूलं कृतं सदानंदपरेण नित्यम्.. 7.2 ..
1.3.m:
Brahmā said:
“You have the form of the liṅga, possess great power, are to be known through Vedānta, and have the nature of the Supreme Self, / by whom, supreme in eternal bliss, the whole world has ever been made from your own self as its root.

1.3.s:
tvaṃ sākṣī sarvalokānāṃ hartā tvaṃ ca vicakṣaṇaḥ..
rakṣaṇosi mahādeva bhairavosi jagatpate.. 7.3 ..
1.3.d:
त्वं साक्षी सर्वलोकानां हर्ता त्वं च विचक्षणः..
रक्षणोसि महादेव भैरवोसि जगत्पते.. 7.3 ..
1.3.m: You are the witness of all the worlds, you are the destroyer, the discerning one; / you are the protector, O Mahādeva, you are Bhairava, O Lord of the universe!

1.3.s:
tvayā liṃgasvarūpeṇa vyāptametajjagattrayam..
kṣudrāścaiva vayaṃ nātha māyāmohitacetasaḥ.. 7.4 ..
1.3.d:
त्वया लिंगस्वरूपेण व्याप्तमेतज्जगत्त्रयम्..
क्षुद्राश्चैव वयं नाथ मायामोहितचेतसः.. 7.4 ..
1.3.m: By you, in the form of the liṅga, these three worlds are pervaded. / And we are insignificant, O Lord, our minds deluded by māyā:

1.3.s:
ahaṃ surā'surāḥ sarve yakṣagaṃdharvarākṣasāḥ..
pannagāśca piśācāśca tathā vidyādharā hyamī.. 7.5 ..
1.3.d:
अहं सुराऽसुराः सर्वे यक्षगंधर्वराक्षसाः..
पन्नगाश्च पिशाचाश्च तथा विद्याधरा ह्यमी.. 7.5 ..
1.3.m: I, all the gods and asuras, yakṣas, gandharvas, rākṣasas, / pannagas, piśācas, and likewise these vidyādharas.

1.3.s:
tvaṃhi viśvasṛjāṃ sraṣṭā tvaṃ hi devo jagatpatiḥ..
kartā tvaṃ bhuvanasyāsya tvaṃ hartā puruṣaḥ paraḥ.. 7.6 ..
1.3.d:
त्वंहि विश्वसृजां स्रष्टा त्वं हि देवो जगत्पतिः..
कर्ता त्वं भुवनस्यास्य त्वं हर्ता पुरुषः परः.. 7.6 ..
1.3.m: For you are the creator of the creators of the universe; you indeed are the god, the lord of the universe; / you are the maker of this world, you are the destroyer, the supreme Puruṣa.”

1.3.s:
trāhyasmākaṃ mahādeva devadeva namo'stu te..
evaṃ stuto hi vai dhātrā liṃgarūpī maheśvaraḥ.. 7.7 ..
1.3.d:
त्राह्यस्माकं महादेव देवदेव नमोऽस्तु ते..
एवं स्तुतो हि वै धात्रा लिंगरूपी महेश्वरः.. 7.7 ..
1.3.m: "Protect us, O Mahādeva, God of gods, homage be to you!" / Thus praised indeed by the Creator, Maheśvara in the form of the liṅga,

1.3.s:
ṛṣayaḥ stotukāmāste maheśvaramakalmaṣam..
astuvangīrbhiragryābhiḥ śrutigītābhirādṛtāḥ.. 7.8 ..
1.3.d:
ऋषयः स्तोतुकामास्ते महेश्वरमकल्मषम्..
अस्तुवन्गीर्भिरग्र्याभिः श्रुतिगीताभिरादृताः.. 7.8 ..
1.3.m: The seers, desiring to praise spotless Maheśvara, / Praised him respectfully with supreme words sung in the Vedas.

1.3.s:
..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
ajñānino vayaṃ kāmānna viṃdāmo'sya saṃsthitim..
tvaṃ hyātmā paramātmā ca prakṛtistvaṃ vibhāvinī.. 7.9 ..
1.3.d:
..ऋषय ऊचुः..
अज्ञानिनो वयं कामान्न विंदामोऽस्य संस्थितिम्..
त्वं ह्यात्मा परमात्मा च प्रकृतिस्त्वं विभाविनी.. 7.9 ..
1.3.m: The seers said: / "Ignorant through desire, we do not comprehend his abiding nature; / You are indeed the self and the supreme self, you are Prakṛti bringing forth illumination.

1.3.s:
tvameva mātā ca pitā tvameva tvameva baṃdhuśca sakhā tvame..
tvamīśvaro vedavidekarūpo mahānubhāvaiḥ pariciṃtyamānaḥ.. 7.10 ..
1.3.d:
त्वमेव माता च पिता त्वमेव त्वमेव बंधुश्च सखा त्वमे..
त्वमीश्वरो वेदविदेकरूपो महानुभावैः परिचिंत्यमानः.. 7.10 ..
1.3.m: You alone are mother and father; you alone are kin and friend; / You are Īśvara, of one form with the knower of the Vedas, contemplated by the magnanimous.

1.3.s:
tvamātmā sarvabhūtānāmeko jyotirivaidhasām..
sarvaṃ bhavati yasmāttvattasmātsarvo'si nityadā.. 7.11 ..
1.3.d:
त्वमात्मा सर्वभूतानामेको ज्योतिरिवैधसाम्..
सर्वं भवति यस्मात्त्वत्तस्मात्सर्वोऽसि नित्यदा.. 7.11 ..
1.3.m: You are the one inner self of all beings, like fire among kinds of firewood; / Because everything arises from you, therefore you are Sarva eternally.

1.3.s: yasmācca saṃbhavatyetattasmācchaṃbhuriti prabhuḥ.. 7.12 ..
1.3.d: यस्माच्च संभवत्येतत्तस्माच्छंभुरिति प्रभुः.. 7.12 ..
1.3.m: And because this universe comes into being [from you], therefore the Lord is called Śambhu.

1.3.s:
tvatpādapaṃkajaṃ prāptā vayaṃ sarve surādayaḥ..
ṛṣayo devagaṃdharvā vidyādharamahoragāḥ.. 7.13 ..
1.3.d:
त्वत्पादपंकजं प्राप्ता वयं सर्वे सुरादयः..
ऋषयो देवगंधर्वा विद्याधरमहोरगाः.. 7.13 ..
1.3.m: All of us—the gods and others, / The seers, devagandharvas, vidyādharas, and great serpents—have approached your lotus feet.

1.3.s: tasmācca kṛpayā śaṃbho pāhyasmāñjagataḥ pate.. 7.14 ..
1.3.d: तस्माच्च कृपया शंभो पाह्यस्माञ्जगतः पते.. 7.14 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, through compassion, O Śambhu, protect us, O Lord of the world!"

1.3.s:
..mahādeva uvāca..
śrṛṇudhvaṃ tu vaco me'dya kriyatāṃ ca tvarānvitaiḥ..
viṣṇuṃ sarve prārthayaṃtu tvaritena tapodhanāḥ.. 7.15 ..
1.3.d:
..महादेव उवाच..
श्रृणुध्वं तु वचो मेऽद्य क्रियतां च त्वरान्वितैः..
विष्णुं सर्वे प्रार्थयंतु त्वरितेन तपोधनाः.. 7.15 ..
1.3.m: Mahādeva said: / "Hear my word today and act with haste: / Let all of you rich in austerity quickly pray to Viṣṇu."

1.3.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ..
viṣṇuṃ sarve namaskṛtya īḍire ca tadā surāḥ.. 7.16 ..
1.3.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शंकरस्य महात्मनः..
विष्णुं सर्वे नमस्कृत्य ईडिरे च तदा सुराः.. 7.16 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that word of his, of the magnanimous Śaṃkara, / All the gods bowed down to Viṣṇu and praised him then.

1.3.s:
..deva ūcuḥ..
vidyādharāḥ suragaṇā ṛṣayaśca sarve trātāstvayādya sakalājagadekabaṃdho..
tadvatkṛpākarajanānparipālayādya trailokyanātha jagadīśa jagannivāsa.. 7.17 ..
1.3.d:
..देव ऊचुः..
विद्याधराः सुरगणा ऋषयश्च सर्वे त्रातास्त्वयाद्य सकलाजगदेकबंधो..
तद्वत्कृपाकरजनान्परिपालयाद्य त्रैलोक्यनाथ जगदीश जगन्निवास.. 7.17 ..
1.3.m: The gods said: / "Vidyādharas, hosts of gods, and all the seers have been saved by you today, O sole kin of the whole universe; / Likewise, protect these people who seek mercy today, O Lord of the three worlds, Sovereign of the world, Abode of the universe!"

1.3.s:
prahasya bhagavanviṣṇuruvācedaṃ vacastadā..
daityaiḥ prapīḍitā yūyaṃ rakṣitāśca purā mayā.. 7.18 ..
1.3.d:
प्रहस्य भगवन्विष्णुरुवाचेदं वचस्तदा..
दैत्यैः प्रपीडिता यूयं रक्षिताश्च पुरा मया.. 7.18 ..
1.3.m: Smiling, the blessed Viṣṇu then spoke this word: / "Formerly, when afflicted by Daityas, you were protected by me.

1.3.s:
adyaiva bhayamutpannaṃ liṃgādasmācciraṃtanam..
na śakyate mayā trātumasmālliṃgabhayātsurāḥ.. 7.19 ..
1.3.d:
अद्यैव भयमुत्पन्नं लिंगादस्माच्चिरंतनम्..
न शक्यते मया त्रातुमस्माल्लिंगभयात्सुराः.. 7.19 ..
1.3.m: Only today has fear arisen from this ancient liṅga; / It is not possible for me to protect you from this fear of the liṅga, O gods."

1.3.s:
acyutenaivamuktāste devā ściṃtānvitābhavan..
tadā nabhogatā vāṇī uvācāśvāsya vai surān.. 7.20 ..
1.3.d:
अच्युतेनैवमुक्तास्ते देवा श्चिंतान्विताभवन्..
तदा नभोगता वाणी उवाचाश्वास्य वै सुरान्.. 7.20 ..
1.3.m: Thus addressed by Acyuta, those gods became filled with anxiety; / Then an incorporeal voice in the sky spoke, reassuring the gods:

1.3.s:
etalliṃgaṃ saṃvṛṇuṣva pūjanāya janārdana..
piṃḍibhūtvā mahābāho rakṣasva sacarācaram..
tatheti matvā bagavānvīrabhadro'bhyapūjayat.. 7.21 ..
1.3.d:
एतल्लिंगं संवृणुष्व पूजनाय जनार्दन..
पिंडिभूत्वा महाबाहो रक्षस्व सचराचरम्..
तथेति मत्वा बगवान्वीरभद्रोऽभ्यपूजयत्.. 7.21 ..
1.3.m: "Enclose this liṅga for worship, O Janārdana; / Becoming a mass, O mighty-armed one, protect the moving and unmoving!" / Thinking 'So be it,' the blessed Vīrabhadra worshipped it.

1.3.s:
brahmādibhaḥ suragaṇaiḥ sahitaistadānīṃ saṃpūjitaḥ śivavidhānarato mahātmā..
sravīrabhadraḥ śaśiśekharo'sau śivapriyo rudrasamastrilokyām.. 7.22 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मादिभः सुरगणैः सहितैस्तदानीं संपूजितः शिवविधानरतो महात्मा..
स्रवीरभद्रः शशिशेखरोऽसौ शिवप्रियो रुद्रसमस्त्रिलोक्याम्.. 7.22 ..
1.3.m: Worshipped then by the hosts of gods accompanied by Brahmā and others, devoted to Śiva's rites, that magnanimous one, / He was Vīrabhadra, bearing the crescent moon, dear to Śiva, equal to Rudra in the three worlds.

1.3.s:
liṃgasyārcanayukto'sau vīrabhadro'bhavattadā..
tadrūpasyaiva liṃgasya yena sarvamidaṃ jagat.. 7.23 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगस्यार्चनयुक्तोऽसौ वीरभद्रोऽभवत्तदा..
तद्रूपस्यैव लिंगस्य येन सर्वमिदं जगत्.. 7.23 ..
1.3.m: Vīrabhadra then engaged in the worship of the liṅga, / Of the liṅga of that very form by which all this universe

1.3.s:
udbhāti sthitimāpnoti tathā vilayameti ca..
talliṃgaṃ liṃgamityāhurlayanāttattvavittamāḥ.. 7.24 ..
1.3.d:
उद्भाति स्थितिमाप्नोति तथा विलयमेति च..
तल्लिंगं लिंगमित्याहुर्लयनात्तत्त्ववित्तमाः.. 7.24 ..
1.3.m: Shines forth, attains maintenance, and also dissolves. / The best knowers of truth call that liṅga 'liṅga' because of its dissolving (layana).

1.3.s:
brahmāṇḍāgolakairvyāptaṃ tathā rudrākṣabhūṣitam..
tathā liṃgaṃ mahajjātaṃ sarveṣāṃ duratikramam.. 7.25 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्माण्डागोलकैर्व्याप्तं तथा रुद्राक्षभूषितम्..
तथा लिंगं महज्जातं सर्वेषां दुरतिक्रमम्.. 7.25 ..
1.3.m: Pervaded by globes of cosmic eggs and adorned with rudrākṣas, / Thus the great liṅga became impossible for all to surpass.

1.3.s:
tadā sarve'tha vibudhā ṛṣo vai mahāprabhāḥ..
tuṣṭuvuśca mahāliṃgaṃ vedāvādaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak.. 7.26 ..
1.3.d:
तदा सर्वेऽथ विबुधा ऋषो वै महाप्रभाः..
तुष्टुवुश्च महालिंगं वेदावादैः पृथक्पृथक्.. 7.26 ..
1.3.m: Then all the gods and the seers of great splendor / Praised the great liṅga individually with Vedic assertions:

1.3.s:
aṇoraṇīyāṃstvaṃ deva tathā tvaṃ mahato mahān..
tasmāttvayā vidhātavyaṃ sarvaiṣāṃ liṃgapūjanam.. 7.27 ..
1.3.d:
अणोरणीयांस्त्वं देव तथा त्वं महतो महान्..
तस्मात्त्वया विधातव्यं सर्वैषां लिंगपूजनम्.. 7.27 ..
1.3.m: "O God, you are subtler than the subtle, and likewise you are greater than the great; / Therefore, the worship of the liṅga should be performed by all on your account."

1.3.s:
tadānīmeva sarveṇa liṃgaṃ ca bahuśaḥ kṛtam..
satye brahmeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ vaikuṇṭhe ca sadāśivaḥ.. 7.28 ..
1.3.d:
तदानीमेव सर्वेण लिंगं च बहुशः कृतम्..
सत्ये ब्रह्मेश्वरं लिंगं वैकुण्ठे च सदाशिवः.. 7.28 ..
1.3.m: At that very time, the liṅga was established in many ways by Śarva: / The liṅga Brahmeśvara in Satya[loka], and Sadāśiva in Vaikuṇṭha;

1.3.s:
amarāvatyāṃ supratiṣṭhamamareśvarasaṃjñakam..
varuṇeśvaraṃ ca vāruṇyāṃ yāmyāṃ kāleśvaraṃ prabhum.. 7.29 ..
1.3.d:
अमरावत्यां सुप्रतिष्ठममरेश्वरसंज्ञकम्..
वरुणेश्वरं च वारुण्यां याम्यां कालेश्वरं प्रभुम्.. 7.29 ..
1.3.m: In Amarāvatī the well-established one named Amareśvara; / Varuṇeśvara in the western quarter, and Lord Kāleśvara in the southern;

1.3.s:
nairṛteśvaraṃ ca nairṛtyāṃ vāyavyāṃ pāvaneśvaram..
kedāraṃ mṛtyuloke ca tathaiva amareśvaram.. 7.30 ..
1.3.d:
नैरृतेश्वरं च नैरृत्यां वायव्यां पावनेश्वरम्..
केदारं मृत्युलोके च तथैव अमरेश्वरम्.. 7.30 ..
1.3.m: Nairṛteśvara in the south-western quarter, and Pāvaneśvara in the north-western; / Kedāra in the world of mortals, and likewise Amareśvara;

1.3.s:
oṃkāraṃ narmadāyāṃ ca mahākālaṃ tathaiva ca..
kāśyāṃ viśveśvaraṃ devaṃ prayāge laliteśvaram.. 7.31 ..
1.3.d:
ओंकारं नर्मदायां च महाकालं तथैव च..
काश्यां विश्वेश्वरं देवं प्रयागे ललितेश्वरम्.. 7.31 ..
1.3.m: Oṃkāra on the Narmadā, and likewise Mahākāla; / The god Viśveśvara in Kāśī, and Laliteśvara in Prayāga;

1.3.s:
triyambakaṃ brahmagirau kalau bhadreśvaraṃ tathā..
drākṣārāmeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame.. 7.32 ..
1.3.d:
त्रियम्बकं ब्रह्मगिरौ कलौ भद्रेश्वरं तथा..
द्राक्षारामेश्वरं लिंगं गंगासागरसंगमे.. 7.32 ..
1.3.m: Triyambaka on Brahmagiri, and likewise Bhadreśvara in the Kali [age]; / The liṅga Drākṣārāmeśvara at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and the ocean;

1.3.s:
saurāṣṭre ca tathā liṃgaṃ someśvaramiti smṛtam..
tathā sarveśvaraṃ vindhye śrīśaile śikhareśvaram..
kāntyāmallālanāthaṃ ca siṃhanāthaṃ ca siṃgale.. 7.33 ..
1.3.d:
सौराष्ट्रे च तथा लिंगं सोमेश्वरमिति स्मृतम्..
तथा सर्वेश्वरं विन्ध्ये श्रीशैले शिखरेश्वरम्..
कान्त्यामल्लालनाथं च सिंहनाथं च सिंगले.. 7.33 ..
1.3.m: And in Saurāṣṭra the liṅga remembered as Someśvara; / Likewise Sarveśvara in the Vindhya, Śikhareśvara at Śrīśaila; / Allālanātha in Kāñcī, and Siṃhanātha in Siṃhala;

1.3.s:
virūpākṣaṃ tathā liṃgaṃ koṭiśaṅkarameva ca..
tripurāntakaṃ bhīmeśamamareśvarameva ca.. 7.34 ..
1.3.d:
विरूपाक्षं तथा लिंगं कोटिशङ्करमेव च..
त्रिपुरान्तकं भीमेशममरेश्वरमेव च.. 7.34 ..
1.3.m: Likewise the liṅga Virūpākṣa, and Koṭiśaṅkara; / Tripurāntaka, Bhīmeśa, and Amareśvara;

1.3.s:
bhogeśvaraṃ ca pātāle hāṭakeśvarameva ca..
evamādīnyanekāni liṃgāni bhuvanatraye..
sthāpitāni tadā devairviśvopakṛtihetave.. 7.35 ..
1.3.d:
भोगेश्वरं च पाताले हाटकेश्वरमेव च..
एवमादीन्यनेकानि लिंगानि भुवनत्रये..
स्थापितानि तदा देवैर्विश्वोपकृतिहेतवे.. 7.35 ..
1.3.m: Bhogeśvara in Pātāla, and Hāṭakeśvara; / Such many liṅgas were established in the three worlds / Then by the gods for the sake of benefiting the universe.

1.3.s:
liṃgeśaiśca tathā sarvaiḥ pūrṇamāsījjagattrayam..
tathā ca vīrabhadrāṃśāḥ pūjārthamamaraiḥ kṛtāḥ.. 7.36
tatra viṃśatisaṃskārāsteṣāmaṣṭādhikābhavan..
kathitāḥ śaṃkareṇaiva liṃgasyācanasūcakāḥ.. 7.37 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगेशैश्च तथा सर्वैः पूर्णमासीज्जगत्त्रयम्..
