तथा च वीरभद्रांशाः पूजार्थममरैः कृताः.. 7.36
तत्र विंशतिसंस्कारास्तेषामष्टाधिकाभवन्..
कथिताः शंकरेणैव लिंगस्याचनसूचकाः.. 7.37 ..
1.3.m: And with all these lords of liṅgas, the three worlds became full. / And partial incarnations of Vīrabhadra were made by the immortals for the sake of worship. / There twenty-eight consecrations were proclaimed by Śaṃkara himself, / Indicating the worship of the liṅga.

1.3.s:
saṃti rudreṇa kathitāḥ śivadharmā sanātanāḥ..
vīrabhadro yathā rudrastathānye guravaḥ smṛtāḥ.. 7.38 ..
1.3.d:
संति रुद्रेण कथिताः शिवधर्मा सनातनाः..
वीरभद्रो यथा रुद्रस्तथान्ये गुरवः स्मृताः.. 7.38 ..
1.3.m: The eternal dharmas of Śiva have been spoken by Rudra. / Just as Vīrabhadra is Rudra, so are the other teachers remembered.

1.3.s:
gurorjātāśca guravo vikhyātā bhuvanatraye..
liṃgasya mahimāna tu nandī jānāti tattvataḥ.. 7.39 ..
1.3.d:
गुरोर्जाताश्च गुरवो विख्याता भुवनत्रये..
लिंगस्य महिमान तु नन्दी जानाति तत्त्वतः.. 7.39 ..
1.3.m: Born from the teacher, the teachers became renowned in the three worlds. / But Nandī knows in truth the majesty of the liṅga,

1.3.s:
tathā skando hi bhagavānnye te nāmadhārakāḥ..
yathoktāḥ śivadharamā hi nandinā parikīrttitāḥ.. 7.40 ..
1.3.d:
तथा स्कन्दो हि भगवान्न्ये ते नामधारकाः..
यथोक्ताः शिवधरमा हि नन्दिना परिकीर्त्तिताः.. 7.40 ..
1.3.m: As does the blessed Skanda, and those who bear their names; / The dharmas of Śiva were proclaimed by Nandī exactly as spoken.

1.3.s:
śailādena mahābhāgā vicitrā liṃgadhārakāḥ..
śavasyopari liṃgaṃ ca dhriyate ca purātanaiḥ.. 7.41 ..
1.3.d:
शैलादेन महाभागा विचित्रा लिंगधारकाः..
शवस्योपरि लिंगं च ध्रियते च पुरातनैः.. 7.41 ..
1.3.m: By the son of Śilāda, O fortunate ones, the diverse bearers of the liṅga [were ordained]; / A liṅga is worn upon the body by the ancients.

1.3.s:
liṃgena saha pañcatvaṃ liṃgena saha jīvitam..
ete dharmāḥ supratiṣṭhāḥ śailādena pratiṣṭhitāḥ.. 7.42 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगेन सह पञ्चत्वं लिंगेन सह जीवितम्..
एते धर्माः सुप्रतिष्ठाः शैलादेन प्रतिष्ठिताः.. 7.42 ..
1.3.m: Dissolution into the five elements along with the liṅga, living along with the liṅga— / These well-established practices were established by the son of Śilāda.

1.3.s: dharmaḥ pāśupataḥ śreṣṭhaḥ skandena pratipālitaḥ.. 7.43 ..
1.3.d: धर्मः पाशुपतः श्रेष्ठः स्कन्देन प्रतिपालितः.. 7.43 ..
1.3.m: The supreme Pāśupata dharma was maintained by Skanda.

1.3.s:
śuddhāpañcākṣarīvidyāprāsādī tadanantaram..
ṣaḍakṣarī tathā vidyā prāsādasya ca dīpikā.. 7.44 ..
1.3.d:
शुद्धापञ्चाक्षरीविद्याप्रासादी तदनन्तरम्..
षडक्षरी तथा विद्या प्रासादस्य च दीपिका.. 7.44 ..
1.3.m: The pure five-syllable mantra (pañcākṣarī vidyā) followed by the prāsāda mantra, / Likewise the six-syllable mantra (ṣaḍakṣarī vidyā), the lamp of the prāsāda—

1.3.s:
skandāttatsamanuprāptamagastyena mahātmanā..
paścādācāryabhedena hyāgamā bahavo'bhavan.. 7.45 ..
1.3.d:
स्कन्दात्तत्समनुप्राप्तमगस्त्येन महात्मना..
पश्चादाचार्यभेदेन ह्यागमा बहवोऽभवन्.. 7.45 ..
1.3.m: That was obtained from Skanda by the magnanimous Agastya. / Thereafter, through variations of teachers, there arose many Āgamas.

1.3.s:
kiṃ tu vai bahunoktena śvi ityakṣaradvayam..
uccārayaṃti sa nityaṃ te rudrā nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 7.46 ..
1.3.d:
किं तु वै बहुनोक्तेन श्वि इत्यक्षरद्वयम्..
उच्चारयंति स नित्यं ते रुद्रा नात्र संशयः.. 7.46 ..
1.3.m: Yet what is the use of much talk? Those who continually utter / The two syllables 'Śi-va' are Rudras, there is no doubt about this.

1.3.s:
satāṃ mārgaṃ puraskṛtya ye sarve te purāṃtakāḥ..
vīrā māheśvarājñeyāḥ pāpakṣayakarā nṛṇām.. 7.47 ..
1.3.d:
सतां मार्गं पुरस्कृत्य ये सर्वे ते पुरांतकाः..
वीरा माहेश्वराज्ञेयाः पापक्षयकरा नृणाम्.. 7.47 ..
1.3.m: All those who, placing first the path of the virtuous, are destroyers of the cities [of passion], / Are to be known as heroic Māheśvaras, destroyers of human sins.

1.3.s:
prasaṃgenānupaṃkṣeṇa śradvayā ca yadṛcchayā..
śivabhaktiṃ prakurvanti ye vai te yāṃti sadgatim.. 7.48 ..
1.3.d:
प्रसंगेनानुपंक्षेण श्रद्वया च यदृच्छया..
शिवभक्तिं प्रकुर्वन्ति ये वै ते यांति सद्गतिम्.. 7.48 ..
1.3.m: Those who practice devotion to Śiva incidentally, unintentionally, / With faith, or even by chance, go to the good destination.

1.3.s:
śrṛṇudhvaṃ kathayāmīha itihāsaṃ purātanam..
kṛtaṃ śivālayaṃ yacca pataṃgyā mārjanaṃ purā.. 7.49 ..
1.3.d:
श्रृणुध्वं कथयामीह इतिहासं पुरातनम्..
कृतं शिवालयं यच्च पतंग्या मार्जनं पुरा.. 7.49 ..
1.3.m: Listen, I shall narrate here an ancient narrative: / How formerly a sweeping of the temple of Śiva was done by a moth.

1.3.s:
āgatā bhakṣaṇārthaṃ hi naivedyaṃ kena cārpitam..
mārjanaṃ rajastasyāḥ pakṣābhyāmabhavatpurā.. 7.50 ..
1.3.d:
आगता भक्षणार्थं हि नैवेद्यं केन चार्पितम्..
मार्जनं रजस्तस्याः पक्षाभ्यामभवत्पुरा.. 7.50 ..
1.3.m: For she had come to eat the food offering presented by someone; / anciently, a sweeping of the dust was made by her wings.

1.3.s:
tena karmavipākena uttamaṃ svargamāgatā..
bhuktvā svargasukhaṃ cograṃ punaḥ saṃsāramāgatā.. 7.51 ..
1.3.d:
तेन कर्मविपाकेन उत्तमं स्वर्गमागता..
भुक्त्वा स्वर्गसुखं चोग्रं पुनः संसारमागता.. 7.51 ..
1.3.m: Through that ripening of actions, she went to highest heaven; / having enjoyed intense heavenly pleasure, she came back to the world of rebirth.

1.3.s:
kāśirājasutā jātā sundarīnāma viśrutā..
pūrvābhyāsācca kalyāṇī babhūva paramā satī.. 7.52 ..
1.3.d:
काशिराजसुता जाता सुन्दरीनाम विश्रुता..
पूर्वाभ्यासाच्च कल्याणी बभूव परमा सती.. 7.52 ..
1.3.m: She was born as the daughter of the king of Kāśī, famed by the name Sundarī; / and from previous practice, the auspicious lady became supremely virtuous.

1.3.s:
uṣasyuṣasi tanvaṃgī śivadvāraratā sadā..
saṃmārjanaṃ ca kurute bhaktyā paramayā yutā.. 7.53 ..
1.3.d:
उषस्युषसि तन्वंगी शिवद्वाररता सदा..
संमार्जनं च कुरुते भक्त्या परमया युता.. 7.53 ..
1.3.m: Dawn after dawn, the slender-limbed lady, ever devoted to Śiva's doorway, / swept [it] clean, endowed with supreme devotion.

1.3.s:
svayameva tadā devī sundarī rājakanyakā..
tathābhūtāṃ ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṣiruddālako'bravīt.. 7.54 ..
1.3.d:
स्वयमेव तदा देवी सुन्दरी राजकन्यका..
तथाभूतां च तां दृष्ट्वा ऋषिरुद्दालकोऽब्रवीत्.. 7.54 ..
1.3.m: At that time the noble lady, Sundarī, the king's daughter, [did so] herself. / And seeing her in such a state, the seer Uddālaka said:

1.3.s:
sukumārī satī bāle svayameva kathaṃ śubhe..
saṃmārjanaṃ ca kuruṣe kanyake tvaṃ śucismite.. 7.55 ..
1.3.d:
सुकुमारी सती बाले स्वयमेव कथं शुभे..
संमार्जनं च कुरुषे कन्यके त्वं शुचिस्मिते.. 7.55 ..
1.3.m: “Delicate, virtuous maiden, why do you yourself, auspicious one, / sweep, O maiden with a bright smile?

1.3.s:
dāsī dāsyaśca bahavaḥ saṃti devi tavāgrataḥ..
tavājñayā kariṣyaṃti sarvaṃ saṃmārjanādikam.. 7.56 ..
1.3.d:
दासी दास्यश्च बहवः संति देवि तवाग्रतः..
तवाज्ञया करिष्यंति सर्वं संमार्जनादिकम्.. 7.56 ..
1.3.m: O noble lady, there are many male and female servants before you; / at your command they will do all the sweeping and the rest.”

1.3.s: ṛṣestadvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasyedamuvāca ha.. 7.57 ..
1.3.d: ऋषेस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्येदमुवाच ह.. 7.57 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that speech of the seer, she smiled and said:

1.3.s:
śivasevāṃ prakurvāṇāḥ śivabhaktipuraskṛtāḥ..
ye narāścaiva nāryyaśca śivalokaṃ vrajaṃti vai.. 7.58 ..
1.3.d:
शिवसेवां प्रकुर्वाणाः शिवभक्तिपुरस्कृताः..
ये नराश्चैव नार्य्यश्च शिवलोकं व्रजंति वै.. 7.58 ..
1.3.m: “Those men and women who perform service to Śiva, / placing devotion to Śiva first, indeed go to Śiva's world.

1.3.s:
saṃmārjanaṃ ca pāṇibhyāṃ padbhyāṃ yānaṃ śivālaye..
tasmānmayā ca kriyate saṃmārjanamataṃdritam.. 7.59 ..
1.3.d:
संमार्जनं च पाणिभ्यां पद्भ्यां यानं शिवालये..
तस्मान्मया च क्रियते संमार्जनमतंद्रितम्.. 7.59 ..
1.3.m: Sweeping with both hands, going on foot in Śiva's temple— / therefore sweeping is unweariedly done by me.

1.3.s:
anyatkiñcinna jānāmi ekaṃ saṃmārjanaṃ vinā..
ṛṣistadvacanaṃ śrutvā manasā ca vimṛśya hi.. 7.60 ..
1.3.d:
अन्यत्किञ्चिन्न जानामि एकं संमार्जनं विना..
ऋषिस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मनसा च विमृश्य हि.. 7.60 ..
1.3.m: I know nothing else, except for sweeping.” / The seer, having heard her speech and pondering it in his mind:

1.3.s:
anayā kiṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ keyaṃ kasya prasādataḥ..
tadā jñānaṃ ca ṛṣiṇā tatsarvaṃ jñānacakṣuṣā..
vismayena samāviṣṭastūṣṇīṃbhūto'bhavattadā.. 7.61 ..
1.3.d:
अनया किं कृतं पूर्वं केयं कस्य प्रसादतः..
तदा ज्ञानं च ऋषिणा तत्सर्वं ज्ञानचक्षुषा..
विस्मयेन समाविष्टस्तूष्णींभूतोऽभवत्तदा.. 7.61 ..
1.3.m: “What was done by her previously? Who is she, and by whose grace?” / Then with the eye of knowledge, all that became known by the seer. / Overcome with astonishment, he then fell silent.

1.3.s:
savismayo'bhūdatha tadviditvā uddālako jñānavatāṃ variṣṭhaḥ..
śivaprabhāvaṃ manasā viciṃtya jñānātparaṃ bodhamavāpa śāṃtaḥ.. 7.62 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe saptamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 7 .. cha ..
1.7.44
1. prāsādaḥ praṇavaḥ iti mantraśāstre praṇavasya prāsādabījasaṃjñā)
1.3.d:
सविस्मयोऽभूदथ तद्विदित्वा उद्दालको ज्ञानवतां वरिष्ठः..
शिवप्रभावं मनसा विचिंत्य ज्ञानात्परं बोधमवाप शांतः.. 7.62 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे सप्तमोऽध्यायः.. 7 .. छ ..
1.7.44
1. प्रासादः प्रणवः इति मन्त्रशास्त्रे प्रणवस्य प्रासादबीजसंज्ञा)
1.3.m:
Then, having realized that, Uddālaka, the best of the wise, was astonished; / reflecting in his mind on Śiva's majesty, the tranquil one attained understanding beyond knowledge.
Thus ends the seventh chapter in the first [part], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
1.7.44
1. [Note: The temple is the praṇava, as in the mantra scriptures the praṇava has the designation of the prāsāda-seed-syllable.]

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
taskaro'pi purā brahmansarvadharmabāhiṣkṛtaḥ..
brahmaghno'sau surāpaśca suvarṇasya ca taskaraḥ.. 8.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
तस्करोऽपि पुरा ब्रह्मन्सर्वधर्मबाहिष्कृतः..
ब्रह्मघ्नोऽसौ सुरापश्च सुवर्णस्य च तस्करः.. 8.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / “Formerly there was also a thief, O brahmin, excluded from all duties; / he was a killer of a brahmin, a drinker of liquor, and a thief of gold,

1.3.s:
laṃpaṭohi mahāpāpa uttamastrīṣu sarvadā..
dyūtakārī sadā maṃdaḥ kitavaiḥ saha saṃgataḥ.. 8.2 ..
1.3.d:
लंपटोहि महापाप उत्तमस्त्रीषु सर्वदा..
द्यूतकारी सदा मंदः कितवैः सह संगतः.. 8.2 ..
1.3.m: lecherous, of great sin, ever [lusting] after noble women, / always a gambler, foolish, keeping company with rogues.

1.3.s:
ekadā krīḍatā tena hāritaṃ dyūtamadbhutam..
kitavairmardyamāno hi tadā novāca kiñcana.. 8.3 ..
1.3.d:
एकदा क्रीडता तेन हारितं द्यूतमद्भुतम्..
कितवैर्मर्द्यमानो हि तदा नोवाच किञ्चन.. 8.3 ..
1.3.m: Once, as he was gambling, an astonishing game of dice was lost [by him]. / Oppressed by the gamblers, he said nothing at that time.

1.3.s:
pīḍito'pyabhavattūṣṇīṃ tairuktaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ..
dyūte tvayā ca taddravyaṃ hāritaṃ kiṃ prayacchasi.. 8.4 ..
1.3.d:
पीडितोऽप्यभवत्तूष्णीं तैरुक्तः पापकृत्तमः..
द्यूते त्वया च तद्द्रव्यं हारितं किं प्रयच्छसि.. 8.4 ..
1.3.m: Although tormented, he fell silent. That foremost sinner was told by them: / ‘That money was lost by you in the gamble; will you pay it?

1.3.s:
no vā tatkathyatāṃ śīghraṃ yāthātathyena durmate..
yaddhāritaṃ prayacchāmi rātrāvityabravīcca saḥ.. 8.5 ..
1.3.d:
नो वा तत्कथ्यतां शीघ्रं याथातथ्येन दुर्मते..
यद्धारितं प्रयच्छामि रात्रावित्यब्रवीच्च सः.. 8.5 ..
1.3.m: Or not? Say that quickly, in truth, O evil-minded one!’ / And he said: ‘What was lost, I will pay tonight.’

1.3.s:
tairmuktastena vākyena gatāste kitavādayaḥ..
tadā niśīthasamaye gato'sau śivamaṃdiram.. 8.6 ..
1.3.d:
तैर्मुक्तस्तेन वाक्येन गतास्ते कितवादयः..
तदा निशीथसमये गतोऽसौ शिवमंदिरम्.. 8.6 ..
1.3.m: Released by them at that word, those gamblers and the rest departed. / Then at midnight he went to a temple of Śiva.

1.3.s:
śirodhiruhya śambhośca ghaṇṭāmādātumudyataḥ..
tāvatkailāsaśikhare śaṃbhuḥ provāca kiṃkarān.. 8.7 ..
1.3.d:
शिरोधिरुह्य शम्भोश्च घण्टामादातुमुद्यतः..
तावत्कैलासशिखरे शंभुः प्रोवाच किंकरान्.. 8.7 ..
1.3.m: Having climbed onto the head of Śambhu, he was prepared to take the bell. / Just then, upon the peak of Kailāsa, Śambhu spoke to his attendants:

1.3.s:
anena yatkṛtaṃ cādya sarveṣāmadhikaṃ bhuvi..
sarveṣāmeva bhaktānāṃ variṣṭho'yaṃ ca matpriyaḥ.. 8.8 ..
1.3.d:
अनेन यत्कृतं चाद्य सर्वेषामधिकं भुवि..
सर्वेषामेव भक्तानां वरिष्ठोऽयं च मत्प्रियः.. 8.8 ..
1.3.m: ‘What has been done by this man today is greater than all on earth! / He is the foremost of all devotees and dear to me.’

1.3.s:
iti proktvāna yāmāsa vīrabhadrādibhirgaṇaiḥ..
te sarve tvaritā jagmuḥ kailāsācchivavallabhāt.. 8.9 ..
1.3.d:
इति प्रोक्त्वान यामास वीरभद्रादिभिर्गणैः..
ते सर्वे त्वरिता जग्मुः कैलासाच्छिववल्लभात्.. 8.9 ..
1.3.m: Having spoken thus, he sent for him with the gaṇas headed by Vīrabhadra; / they all went swiftly from Kailāsa, beloved of Śiva.

1.3.s:
sarvairḍamarunādena nāditaṃ bhuvanatrayam..
tāndṛṣṭvā sahasottīrya taskarosau durātmavān..
liṃgasya mastakātsadyaḥ palāyanaparo'bhavat.. 8.10 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वैर्डमरुनादेन नादितं भुवनत्रयम्..
तान्दृष्ट्वा सहसोत्तीर्य तस्करोसौ दुरात्मवान्..
लिंगस्य मस्तकात्सद्यः पलायनपरोऽभवत्.. 8.10 ..
1.3.m: The three worlds were made to resound by all with the sound of the ḍamaru. / Seeing them, quickly descending from the top of the liṅga, / that evil-minded thief immediately took to flight.

1.3.s: palāyamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā vīrabhadraḥ samāhvayat.. 8.11 ..
1.3.d: पलायमानं तं दृष्ट्वा वीरभद्रः समाह्वयत्.. 8.11 ..
1.3.m: Seeing him fleeing, Vīrabhadra called out to him:

1.3.s:
kasmādvibhepi re manda devadevo mahesvaraḥ..
prasannastava jātodya udāracarito hyasau.. 8.12 ..
1.3.d:
कस्माद्विभेपि रे मन्द देवदेवो महेस्वरः..
प्रसन्नस्तव जातोद्य उदारचरितो ह्यसौ.. 8.12 ..
1.3.m: ‘Why do you fear, O fool? The God of gods, Maheśvara, / has become pleased with you today, for he is of noble conduct!’

1.3.s:
ityuktvā taṃ vimāne ca kṛtvā kailāsamāyayau..
pārṣado hi kṛtastena taskaro hi mahātmanā.. 8.13 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तं विमाने च कृत्वा कैलासमाययौ..
पार्षदो हि कृतस्तेन तस्करो हि महात्मना.. 8.13 ..
1.3.m: Having spoken thus and placing him in an aerial chariot, he came to Kailāsa. / Indeed, that thief was made an attendant by the Great-souled One.

1.3.s:
tasmādbhāvyā śive bhaktiḥ sarveṣāmapi dehinām..
paśavo'pi hi pūjyāḥ syuḥ kiṃ punarmānavābhuvi.. 8.14 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्भाव्या शिवे भक्तिः सर्वेषामपि देहिनाम्..
पशवोऽपि हि पूज्याः स्युः किं पुनर्मानवाभुवि.. 8.14 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, devotion to Śiva should be cultivated by all embodied beings; / even beasts would be worthy of worship, how much more so humans on earth?

1.3.s:
ye tārkikāstarkaparāstatha mīmāṃsakāśca ye..
anyonyavādinaścānye cānye vātmavitarkakāḥ.. 8.15 ..
1.3.d:
ये तार्किकास्तर्कपरास्तथ मीमांसकाश्च ये..
अन्योन्यवादिनश्चान्ये चान्ये वात्मवितर्ककाः.. 8.15 ..
1.3.m: Those logicians devoted to logic, and those who are Mīmāṃsakas, / others who debate with one another, and others who engage in idle speculation about the self—

1.3.s:
ekavākyaṃ na kurvaṃti śivārcanabahiṣkṛtāḥ..
tarko hi kriyate yaiśca tesarve kiṃ śivaṃ vinā.. 8.16 ..
1.3.d:
एकवाक्यं न कुर्वंति शिवार्चनबहिष्कृताः..
तर्को हि क्रियते यैश्च तेसर्वे किं शिवं विना.. 8.16 ..
1.3.m: they do not reach agreement, excluded from the worship of Śiva. / And those by whom logic is practiced, what are they all without Śiva?

1.3.s:
tathā kiṃ bahunoktena sarve'pi sthirajaṃgamāḥ..
prāṇino'pi hi jāyaṃte kevalaṃ liṃgadhāriṇaḥ.. 8.17 ..
1.3.d:
तथा किं बहुनोक्तेन सर्वेऽपि स्थिरजंगमाः..
प्राणिनोऽपि हि जायंते केवलं लिंगधारिणः.. 8.17 ..
1.3.m: So what is the use of speaking much? All moving and unmoving / living beings are born simply bearing the liṅga.

1.3.s:
piṇḍīyuktaṃ yathā liṃgaṃ sthāpitaṃ ca yathā'bhavat..
tathā narā liṃgayuktāḥ piṇḍībhūtāstathā striyaḥ.. 8.18 ..
1.3.d:
पिण्डीयुक्तं यथा लिंगं स्थापितं च यथाऽभवत्..
तथा नरा लिंगयुक्ताः पिण्डीभूतास्तथा स्त्रियः.. 8.18 ..
1.3.m: Just as a liṅga joined with a pedestal is established, / so men are joined with the liṅga, and likewise women constitute the pedestal.

1.3.s:
śivaśaktiyutaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram..
taṃ śivaṃ mauḍhyatastyaktvā mūḍhāścānyaṃ bhajaṃti ye.. 8.19 ..
1.3.d:
शिवशक्तियुतं सर्वं जगदेतच्चराचरम्..
तं शिवं मौढ्यतस्त्यक्त्वा मूढाश्चान्यं भजंति ये.. 8.19 ..
1.3.m: This entire universe, moving and unmoving, is endowed with Śiva and Śakti. / The foolish who, having abandoned that Śiva out of stupidity, worship another,

1.3.s:
dharmamātyaṃtikaṃ tucchaṃ naśvaraṃ kṣaṇabhaṃguram..
yo viṣṇuḥ sa śivo jñeyo yaḥ śivo viṣṇureva saḥ.. 8.20 ..
1.3.d:
धर्ममात्यंतिकं तुच्छं नश्वरं क्षणभंगुरम्..
यो विष्णुः स शिवो ज्ञेयो यः शिवो विष्णुरेव सः.. 8.20 ..
1.3.m: seek a trivial, perishable duty, transient in a moment. / He who is Viṣṇu should be known as Śiva; he who is Śiva is Viṣṇu alone.

1.3.s:
pīṭhikā viṣṇurūpaṃ syālliṃgarūpī maheśvaraḥ..
tasmālliṃgārcanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarveṣāmapi vai dvijāḥ.. 8.21 ..
1.3.d:
पीठिका विष्णुरूपं स्याल्लिंगरूपी महेश्वरः..
तस्माल्लिंगार्चनं श्रेष्ठं सर्वेषामपि वै द्विजाः.. 8.21 ..
1.3.m: The pedestal is the form of Viṣṇu, [and] Maheśvara is in the form of the liṅga; / therefore the worship of the liṅga is the best for all, O twice-born!

1.3.s:
brahmā maṇimayaṃ liṃgaṃ pūjayatyaniśaṃ śubham..
indro ratnamayaṃ liṃgaṃ candro muktāmayaṃ tathā.. 8.22 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मा मणिमयं लिंगं पूजयत्यनिशं शुभम्..
इन्द्रो रत्नमयं लिंगं चन्द्रो मुक्तामयं तथा.. 8.22 ..
1.3.m: Brahmā constantly worships an auspicious liṅga made of gems; / Indra, a liṅga made of jewels, and likewise Candra, one made of pearls.

1.3.s:
bhānustāmramayaṃ liṃgaṃ pūjayatyaniśaṃ śubham..
raukmaṃ liṃgaṃ kuberaśca pāśī cāraktameva ca.. 8.23 ..
1.3.d:
भानुस्ताम्रमयं लिंगं पूजयत्यनिशं शुभम्..
रौक्मं लिंगं कुबेरश्च पाशी चारक्तमेव च.. 8.23 ..
1.3.m: The Sun constantly worships an auspicious liṅga made of copper; / Kubera, a golden liṅga; and the bearer of the noose, one of red [gem].

1.3.s:
yamo nīlamayaṃ liṃgaṃ rājataṃ nairṛtastathā..
kāśmīraṃ pavano liṃgamarcayatyaniśaṃ vibhoḥ.. 8.24 ..
1.3.d:
यमो नीलमयं लिंगं राजतं नैरृतस्तथा..
काश्मीरं पवनो लिंगमर्चयत्यनिशं विभोः.. 8.24 ..
1.3.m: Yama [worships] a liṅga made of sapphire, and Nairṛta likewise one of silver; / Pavana constantly worships a liṅga of saffron for the Lord.

1.3.s:
evaṃ te liṃgitāḥ sarve lokapālāḥ savāsavāḥ..
tathā sarve'pi pātāle gaṃdharvāḥ kiṃnaraiḥ saha.. 8.25 ..
1.3.d:
एवं ते लिंगिताः सर्वे लोकपालाः सवासवाः..
तथा सर्वेऽपि पाताले गंधर्वाः किंनरैः सह.. 8.25 ..
1.3.m: In this way all those world-protectors, together with Indra, are devoted to the liṅga; / likewise all those in Pātāla, the gandharvas together with kinnaras.

1.3.s:
daityānāṃ vaiṣṇavāḥ kecitprahlādapramukhā dvijāḥ..
tathāhi rākṣasānāṃ ca vibhīṣaṇapurogamāḥ.. 8.26 ..
1.3.d:
दैत्यानां वैष्णवाः केचित्प्रह्लादप्रमुखा द्विजाः..
तथाहि राक्षसानां च विभीषणपुरोगमाः.. 8.26 ..
1.3.m: Among the daityas, some were Vaiṣṇavas, headed by Prahlāda, O twice-born; / and likewise among the rākṣasas, led by Vibhīṣaṇa.

1.3.s:
baliśca namuciścaiva hiraṇyakaśipustathā..
vṛṣaparvā vṛṣaścaiva saṃhrādo bāṇa eva ca.. 8.27 ..
1.3.d:
बलिश्च नमुचिश्चैव हिरण्यकशिपुस्तथा..
वृषपर्वा वृषश्चैव संह्रादो बाण एव च.. 8.27 ..
1.3.m: Bali, Namuci, Hiraṇyakaśipu, / Vṛṣaparvan, Vṛṣa, Saṃhrāda, and Bāṇa—

1.3.s:
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ śiṣyāḥ śukrasya dhīmataḥ..
evaṃ śivārcanaratāḥ sarve te daityadānavāḥ.. 8.28 ..
1.3.d:
एते चान्ये च बहवः शिष्याः शुक्रस्य धीमतः..
एवं शिवार्चनरताः सर्वे ते दैत्यदानवाः.. 8.28 ..
1.3.m: these and many other disciples of the wise Śukra, / all those daityas and dānavas were thus devoted to the worship of Śiva.

1.3.s:
rākṣasā eva te sarve śivapūjānvitāḥ sadā..
hetiḥ prahetiḥ saṃyātirvighasaḥ praghasastathā.. 8.29 ..
1.3.d:
राक्षसा एव ते सर्वे शिवपूजान्विताः सदा..
हेतिः प्रहेतिः संयातिर्विघसः प्रघसस्तथा.. 8.29 ..
1.3.m: All those rākṣasas were ever engaged in Śiva's worship: / Heti, Praheti, Saṃyāti, Vighasa, and Praghasa.

1.3.s:
vidyujjihvastīkṣṇadaṃṣṭro dhūmrākṣo bhīmavikramaḥ..
mālī caiva sumālī ca mālyavānatibhīṣamaḥ.. 8.30 ..
1.3.d:
विद्युज्जिह्वस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रो धूम्राक्षो भीमविक्रमः..
माली चैव सुमाली च माल्यवानतिभीषमः.. 8.30 ..
1.3.m: Vidyujjihva, Tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭra, Dhūmrākṣa of dreadful prowess, / and Mālī, Sumālī, and the very terrifying Mālyavān; 8.30

1.3.s:
vidyutkaiśastaḍijjihvo rāvaṇaśca mahābalaḥ..
kuṃbhakarṇo durādharṣo vegadarśī pratāpavān.. 8.31 ..
1.3.d:
विद्युत्कैशस्तडिज्जिह्वो रावणश्च महाबलः..
कुंभकर्णो दुराधर्षो वेगदर्शी प्रतापवान्.. 8.31 ..
1.3.m: Vidyutkeśa, Taḍijjihva, and the mighty Rāvaṇa, / Kumbhakarṇa, difficult to overcome, Vegadarśin, and Pratāpavān— 8.31

1.3.s:
ete hi rākṣasāḥ śreṣṭhā śivārcanaratāḥ sadā..
liṃgamabhyarcya ca sadā siddhiṃ prāptāḥ purā tu te.. 8.32 ..
1.3.d:
एते हि राक्षसाः श्रेष्ठा शिवार्चनरताः सदा..
लिंगमभ्यर्च्य च सदा सिद्धिं प्राप्ताः पुरा तु ते.. 8.32 ..
1.3.m: these foremost rākṣasas were ever devoted to worshipping Śiva. / By continually worshipping the liṅga in ancient times, they attained perfection. 8.32

1.3.s:
rāvaṇena tapastaptaṃ sarveṣāmapi duḥkhaham..
tapodhipo mahādevastutoṣa ca tadā bhṛśam.. 8.33 ..
1.3.d:
रावणेन तपस्तप्तं सर्वेषामपि दुःखहम्..
तपोधिपो महादेवस्तुतोष च तदा भृशम्.. 8.33 ..
1.3.m: Rāvaṇa performed austerity that brought sorrow even to all. / Then Mahādeva, the lord of austerities, was exceedingly pleased. 8.33

1.3.s:
varānprāyacchata tadā sarveṣāmapi durlabhān..
jñānaṃ vijñānasahitaṃ labdhaṃ tena sadāśivāt.. 8.34 ..
1.3.d:
वरान्प्रायच्छत तदा सर्वेषामपि दुर्लभान्..
ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं लब्धं तेन सदाशिवात्.. 8.34 ..
1.3.m: He then granted boons that were difficult for anyone to obtain. / Knowledge accompanied by realization was received by him from Sadāśiva, 8.34

1.3.s:
ajeyatvaṃ ca saṃgrāme dvaiguṇyaṃ śirasāmapi..
paṃcavaktro mahā devo daśavaktro'tha rāvaṇaḥ.. 8.35 ..
1.3.d:
अजेयत्वं च संग्रामे द्वैगुण्यं शिरसामपि..
पंचवक्त्रो महा देवो दशवक्त्रोऽथ रावणः.. 8.35 ..
1.3.m: as well as invincibility in battle and a doubling of his heads: / Mahādeva having five faces, Rāvaṇa then had ten faces. 8.35

1.3.s:
devānṛṣīnpitṝṃścaiva nirjitya tapasā vibhuḥ..
maheśasya prasādācca sarveṣāmadhiko'bhavat.. 8.36 ..
1.3.d:
देवानृषीन्पितॄंश्चैव निर्जित्य तपसा विभुः..
महेशस्य प्रसादाच्च सर्वेषामधिकोऽभवत्.. 8.36 ..
1.3.m: Having vanquished the gods, seers, and ancestors through his austerity, the powerful one, / by the grace of Maheśa, surpassed all beings. 8.36

1.3.s:
rājā trikūṭādhipatirmaheśena kṛto mahān..
sarveṣāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca paramāsanamāstitaḥ.. 8.37 ..
1.3.d:
राजा त्रिकूटाधिपतिर्महेशेन कृतो महान्..
सर्वेषां राक्षसानां च परमासनमास्तितः.. 8.37 ..
1.3.m: The great king, lord of Trikūṭa, was made [such] by Maheśa, / and he took the supreme throne over all the rākṣasas. 8.37

1.3.s:
tapasvināṃ parīkṣāyai yadṛṣīṇāṃ vihiṃsanam..
kṛtaṃ tena tadā viprā rāvaṇena tapasvinā.. 8.38 ..
1.3.d:
तपस्विनां परीक्षायै यदृषीणां विहिंसनम्..
कृतं तेन तदा विप्रा रावणेन तपस्विना.. 8.38 ..
1.3.m: The tormenting of seers that was done by that ascetic Rāvaṇa / was done to test the ascetics, O brahmins! 8.38

1.3.s:
ajeyo hi mahāñjāto rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ..
sṛṣṭyaṃtaraṃ kṛtaṃ yena prasādācchaṃkarasya ca.. 8.39 ..
1.3.d:
अजेयो हि महाञ्जातो रावणो लोकरावणः..
सृष्ट्यंतरं कृतं येन प्रसादाच्छंकरस्य च.. 8.39 ..
1.3.m: For Rāvaṇa, who made the world weep, became invincible and great; / a different creation was made by him through the grace of Śaṃkara. 8.39

1.3.s:
lokapālā jitāstena pratāpena tapasvinā..
brahmāpi vijito yena tapasā parameṇa hi.. 8.40 ..
1.3.d:
लोकपाला जितास्तेन प्रतापेन तपस्विना..
ब्रह्मापि विजितो येन तपसा परमेण हि.. 8.40 ..
1.3.m: The guardians of the worlds were conquered by that ascetic through his splendor; / even Brahmā was conquered by his supreme austerity. 8.40

1.3.s:
amṛtāṃśukaro bhūtvā jito yena śaśī dvijāḥ..
dāhakatvājjito vahnirīśaḥ kailāsatolanāt.. 8.41 ..
1.3.d:
अमृतांशुकरो भूत्वा जितो येन शशी द्विजाः..
दाहकत्वाज्जितो वह्निरीशः कैलासतोलनात्.. 8.41 ..
1.3.m: Having become one whose rays hold nectar, the moon was conquered by him, O twice-born; / fire was conquered in burning power, and Īśa by lifting Kailāsa. 8.41

1.3.s:
aiśvaryeṇa jitaścendro viṣṇuḥ sarvagatastathā..
liṃgārcanaprasādena trailokyaṃ ca vaśīkṛtam.. 8.42 ..
1.3.d:
ऐश्वर्येण जितश्चेन्द्रो विष्णुः सर्वगतस्तथा..
लिंगार्चनप्रसादेन त्रैलोक्यं च वशीकृतम्.. 8.42 ..
1.3.m: Indra was conquered in sovereignty, and likewise the all-pervading Viṣṇu; / and through the grace born of worshipping the liṅga, the three worlds were brought under his control. 8.42

1.3.s:
tadā sarve suragaṇā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ..
merupṛṣṭhaṃ samāsādya sumaṃtraṃ cakrire tadā.. 8.43 ..
1.3.d:
तदा सर्वे सुरगणा ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरोगमाः..
मेरुपृष्ठं समासाद्य सुमंत्रं चक्रिरे तदा.. 8.43 ..
1.3.m: Then all the hosts of gods, led by Brahmā and Viṣṇu, / gathered upon the ridge of Meru and held good counsel: 8.43

1.3.s:
pīḍitāḥ smo rāvaṇena tapasā duṣkareṇa vai..
gokarṇākhye girau devāḥ śrūyatāṃ paramādbhutam.. 8.44 ..
1.3.d:
पीडिताः स्मो रावणेन तपसा दुष्करेण वै..
गोकर्णाख्ये गिरौ देवाः श्रूयतां परमाद्भुतम्.. 8.44 ..
1.3.m: "We are afflicted by Rāvaṇa through his austerity that is hard to perform. / On the mountain called Gokarṇa, O gods, hear of the supreme wonder! 8.44

1.3.s:
sākṣālliṃgārcanaṃ yena kṛtamasti mahātmanā..
jñānajñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ yadyatparamamadbhutam..
tatkṛtaṃ rāvaṇenaiva sarveṣāṃ duratikramam.. 8.45 ..
1.3.d:
साक्षाल्लिंगार्चनं येन कृतमस्ति महात्मना..
ज्ञानज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं यद्यत्परममद्भुतम्..
तत्कृतं रावणेनैव सर्वेषां दुरतिक्रमम्.. 8.45 ..
1.3.m: Direct worship of the liṅga has been performed by that great-souled one. / Whatever supreme marvel is to be known by knowledge and attained by knowledge, / that was done by Rāvaṇa alone, unsurpassable by all. 8.45

1.3.s:
vairāgyaṃ paramāsthāya audāryaṃ ca tato'dhikam..
tenaiva mamatā tyaktā rāvaṇena mahātmanā.. 8.46 ..
1.3.d:
वैराग्यं परमास्थाय औदार्यं च ततोऽधिकम्..
तेनैव ममता त्यक्ता रावणेन महात्मना.. 8.46 ..
1.3.m: Resorting to supreme detachment, and beyond that to generosity, / by that great-souled Rāvaṇa alone was possessiveness abandoned. 8.46

1.3.s:
saṃvatsarasahasrācca svaśiro hi mahābhujaḥ..
kṛttvā kareṇa liṃgasya pūjanārthaṃ samarpayat.. 8.47 ..
1.3.d:
संवत्सरसहस्राच्च स्वशिरो हि महाभुजः..
कृत्त्वा करेण लिंगस्य पूजनार्थं समर्पयत्.. 8.47 ..
1.3.m: After a thousand years, the mighty-armed one severed his own head / with his hand and offered it for the worship of the liṅga. 8.47

1.3.s:
rāvaṇasya kabaṃdhaṃ ca tadagre ca samīpataḥ..
yogadhāraṇayā yuktaṃ parameṇa samādhinā.. 8.48 ..
1.3.d:
रावणस्य कबंधं च तदग्रे च समीपतः..
योगधारणया युक्तं परमेण समाधिना.. 8.48 ..
1.3.m: And the headless trunk of Rāvaṇa, standing near it before it, / was engaged in yogic concentration through supreme meditation. 8.48

1.3.s:
liṃge layaṃ samādhāya kayāpi kalayā sthitam..
anyacchirovivṛścyaivaṃ tenāpi śivapūjanam..
kṛtaṃ naivānyamuninā tathā caivāpareṇahi.. 8.49 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगे लयं समाधाय कयापि कलया स्थितम्..
अन्यच्छिरोविवृश्च्यैवं तेनापि शिवपूजनम्..
कृतं नैवान्यमुनिना तथा चैवापरेणहि.. 8.49 ..
1.3.m: Having fixed absorption in the liṅga, it remained through some subtle part. / Cutting off another head in this manner, he performed the worship of Śiva— / not done by any other sage or anyone else. 8.49

1.3.s:
evaṃ śirāṃsyeva bahūni tena samarpitānyeva śivārcanārthe..
bhūtvā kabaṃdho hi punaḥ punaśca śivo'sau varado babhūva.. 8.50 ..
1.3.d:
एवं शिरांस्येव बहूनि तेन समर्पितान्येव शिवार्चनार्थे..
भूत्वा कबंधो हि पुनः पुनश्च शिवोऽसौ वरदो बभूव.. 8.50 ..
1.3.m: Thus many heads were offered by him for the sake of worshipping Śiva; / he became a headless trunk again and again, and that Śiva became the granter of boons: 8.50

1.3.s:
mayā vināsurastatra piṃḍībhūtena vai purā..
varānvaraya paulastya yatheṣṭaṃ tāndadāmyaham.. 8.51 ..
1.3.d:
मया विनासुरस्तत्र पिंडीभूतेन वै पुरा..
वरान्वरय पौलस्त्य यथेष्टं तान्ददाम्यहम्.. 8.51 ..
1.3.m: 'Without me, the demon there became a solidified mass in the past. / Choose boons, O descendant of Pulastya; I shall grant whatever you desire.' 8.51

1.3.s:
rāvaṇena tadā coktaḥ śivaḥ paramamaṃgalaḥ..
yadi prasanno bhagavandeyo me vara uttamaḥ.. 8.52 ..
1.3.d:
रावणेन तदा चोक्तः शिवः परममंगलः..
यदि प्रसन्नो भगवन्देयो मे वर उत्तमः.. 8.52 ..
1.3.m: Then Rāvaṇa spoke to Śiva, the supreme auspiciousness: / 'If you are pleased, O Blessed One, an excellent boon must be given to me. 8.52

1.3.s:
na kāmaye'nyaṃ ca varamāśraye tvatpadāṃbujam..
yathā tathā pradātavyaṃ yadyasti ca kṛpā mayi.. 8.53 ..
1.3.d:
न कामयेऽन्यं च वरमाश्रये त्वत्पदांबुजम्..
यथा तथा प्रदातव्यं यद्यस्ति च कृपा मयि.. 8.53 ..
1.3.m: I desire no other boon; I take refuge in your lotus feet. / Let it be granted in any way, if there is compassion toward me.' 8.53

1.3.s:
tadā sadāśivenokto rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ..
matprasādācca sarvaṃ tvaṃ prāpsyase manasepsitam.. 8.54 ..
1.3.d:
तदा सदाशिवेनोक्तो रावणो लोकरावणः..
मत्प्रसादाच्च सर्वं त्वं प्राप्स्यसे मनसेप्सितम्.. 8.54 ..
1.3.m: Then Sadāśiva said to Rāvaṇa, who made the world weep: / 'By my grace you shall attain everything desired by your mind.' 8.54

1.3.s:
evaṃ prāptaṃ śivātsarvaṃ rāvaṇena sureśvarāḥ..
tasmātsarvairbhavadbhiśca tapasā parameṇa hi.. 8.55 ..
1.3.d:
एवं प्राप्तं शिवात्सर्वं रावणेन सुरेश्वराः..
तस्मात्सर्वैर्भवद्भिश्च तपसा परमेण हि.. 8.55 ..
1.3.m: Thus everything was obtained from Śiva by Rāvaṇa, O lords of gods! / Therefore, by all of you, through supreme austerity, 8.55

1.3.s:
vijetavyo rāvaṇoyamiti me manasi sthitam..
cyutasya vacaḥ śrutvā brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ.. 8.56 ..
1.3.d:
विजेतव्यो रावणोयमिति मे मनसि स्थितम्..
च्युतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा ब्रह्माद्या देवतागणाः.. 8.56 ..
1.3.m: this Rāvaṇa must be conquered; this is what is in my mind." / Having heard the words of Cyuta, the hosts of deities led by Brahmā 8.56

1.3.s:
ciṃtāmāpedire sarve ciraṃ te viṣayānvitāḥ..
brahmāpi ceṃdriyagrastaḥ sutā ramitumudyataḥ.. 8.57 ..
1.3.d:
चिंतामापेदिरे सर्वे चिरं ते विषयान्विताः..
ब्रह्मापि चेंद्रियग्रस्तः सुता रमितुमुद्यतः.. 8.57 ..
1.3.m: all fell into anxiety for a long time, being attached to sense objects. / Even Brahmā, seized by the senses, was intent on enjoying his daughter. 8.57

1.3.s:
iṃdro hi jārabhāvācca caṃdro hi gurutalpagaḥ..
yamaḥ kadaryabhāvācca caṃcalatvātsadāgatiḥ.. 8.58 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्रो हि जारभावाच्च चंद्रो हि गुरुतल्पगः..
यमः कदर्यभावाच्च चंचलत्वात्सदागतिः.. 8.58 ..
1.3.m: Indra was disqualified by his adultery, and the moon by defiling his guru's bed; / Yama because of his miserliness, and the wind because of his fickleness; 8.58

1.3.s:
pāvakaḥ sarvabhakṣitvāttathānye devatāgaṇāḥ..
aśaktā rāvaṇaṃ jetuṃ tapasā ca vijṛṃbhitam.. 8.59 ..
1.3.d:
पावकः सर्वभक्षित्वात्तथान्ये देवतागणाः..
अशक्ता रावणं जेतुं तपसा च विजृंभितम्.. 8.59 ..
1.3.m: the fire-god because of consuming everything; and likewise the other hosts of deities / were powerless to conquer Rāvaṇa, who had grown formidable through austerity. 8.59

1.3.s:
śailādo hi mahātejā gaṇaśreṣṭhaḥ purātanaḥ..
buddhi mānnītinipuṇo mahābalaparākramī.. 8.60 ..
1.3.d:
शैलादो हि महातेजा गणश्रेष्ठः पुरातनः..
बुद्धि मान्नीतिनिपुणो महाबलपराक्रमी.. 8.60 ..
1.3.m: Then Śailāda of great splendor, the foremost and ancient of the gaṇas, / wise, skilled in conduct, endowed with great strength and valor, 8.60

1.3.s:
śivapriyo rudrarūpī mahātmā hyuvāca sarvānatha ceṃdramukhyān..
kasmādyūyaṃ saṃbhramādāgatāśca etatsarvaṃ kathyatāṃ vistareṇa.. 8.61 ..
1.3.d:
शिवप्रियो रुद्ररूपी महात्मा ह्युवाच सर्वानथ चेंद्रमुख्यान्..
कस्माद्यूयं संभ्रमादागताश्च एतत्सर्वं कथ्यतां विस्तरेण.. 8.61 ..
1.3.m: dear to Śiva, having the form of Rudra, the great soul, spoke to all of them, headed by Indra: / "Why have you come in confusion? Let all this be told at length." 8.61

1.3.s: naṃdinā ca tadā sarve pṛṣṭāḥ procustvarānvitāḥ.. 8.62 ..
1.3.d: नंदिना च तदा सर्वे पृष्टाः प्रोचुस्त्वरान्विताः.. 8.62 ..
1.3.m: Then, being questioned by Nandin, all of them spoke in haste. 8.62

1.3.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ..
rāvaṇena vayaṃ sarve nirjitā munibhiḥ saha..
prasādayitumāyātāḥ śivaṃ lokeśvareśvaram.. 8.63 ..
1.3.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः..
रावणेन वयं सर्वे निर्जिता मुनिभिः सह..
प्रसादयितुमायाताः शिवं लोकेश्वरेश्वरम्.. 8.63 ..
1.3.m: The gods said: / "We, along with the sages, have all been conquered by Rāvaṇa. / We have come to propitiate Śiva, the lord of the lords of the world." 8.63

1.3.s:
prahasya bhagavānnaṃdī brahmāṇaṃ vai hyuvāca ha..
kva yūyaṃ kva śivaḥ śaṃbhustapasā parameṇa hi..
draṣṭavyo hṛdi madhyasthaḥ so'dya draṣṭuṃ na pāryate.. 8.64 ..
1.3.d:
प्रहस्य भगवान्नंदी ब्रह्माणं वै ह्युवाच ह..
क्व यूयं क्व शिवः शंभुस्तपसा परमेण हि..
द्रष्टव्यो हृदि मध्यस्थः सोऽद्य द्रष्टुं न पार्यते.. 8.64 ..
1.3.m: Laughing, the blessed Nandin indeed said to Brahmā: / "Where are you, and where is Śiva Śambhu? Through supreme austerity / he is to be seen residing in the middle of the heart; he cannot be seen today. 8.64

1.3.s:
yāvadbhāvā hyanekāśca iṃdriyārthāstathaiva ca..
yāvacca mamatābhāvastāvadīśo hi durlabhaḥ.. 8.65 ..
1.3.d:
यावद्भावा ह्यनेकाश्च इंद्रियार्थास्तथैव च..
यावच्च ममताभावस्तावदीशो हि दुर्लभः.. 8.65 ..
1.3.m: As long as there are various feelings and likewise objects of the senses, / and as long as there is the feeling of 'mine', so long is the Lord hard to attain. 8.65

1.3.s:
jiteṃdriyāṇāṃ śāṃtānāṃ tanniṣṭhānāṃ mahātmanām..
sulabho liṃgarūpī syādbhavatāṃ hi sudurlabhaḥ.. 8.66 ..
1.3.d:
जितेंद्रियाणां शांतानां तन्निष्ठानां महात्मनाम्..
सुलभो लिंगरूपी स्याद्भवतां हि सुदुर्लभः.. 8.66 ..
1.3.m: For great souls who have conquered their senses, are calm, and are devoted to Him, / He whose form is the liṅga is easily attained, but for you He is exceedingly hard to attain." 8.66

1.3.s:
tadā brahmādayo devā ṛṣayaśca vipaścitaḥ..
praṇamya naṃdinaṃ prāhuḥ kasmāttvaṃ vānarānanaḥ..
tatsarvaṃ kathayānyaṃ ca rāvaṇasya tapobalam.. 8.67 ..
1.3.d:
तदा ब्रह्मादयो देवा ऋषयश्च विपश्चितः..
प्रणम्य नंदिनं प्राहुः कस्मात्त्वं वानराननः..
तत्सर्वं कथयान्यं च रावणस्य तपोबलम्.. 8.67 ..
1.3.m: Then the gods led by Brahmā and the wise seers, / having bowed to Nandin, said: "Why do you have the face of a monkey? / Tell all that, and also of the power of Rāvaṇa's austerity." 8.67

1.3.s:
..naṃdīśvara uvāca..
kubero'dhikṛtastena śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā..
dhanānāmādipatye ca taṃ draṣṭuṃ rāvaṇo'tra vai.. 8.68 ..
1.3.d:
..नंदीश्वर उवाच..
कुबेरोऽधिकृतस्तेन शंकरेण महात्मना..
धनानामादिपत्ये च तं द्रष्टुं रावणोऽत्र वै.. 8.68 ..
1.3.m: Nandīśvara said: / "Kubera was appointed by that great-souled Śaṃkara / to the sovereignty over riches. In order to see him here, Rāvaṇa 8.68

1.3.s:
āgacchattvarayā yuktaḥ samāruhya svavāhanam..
māṃ dṛṣṭvā cābravītkruddhaḥ kubero hyatra āgataḥ.. 8.69 ..
1.3.d:
आगच्छत्त्वरया युक्तः समारुह्य स्ववाहनम्..
मां दृष्ट्वा चाब्रवीत्क्रुद्धः कुबेरो ह्यत्र आगतः.. 8.69 ..
1.3.m: came in haste, having mounted his vehicle. / Seeing me, he angrily said: 'Has Kubera come here? 8.69

1.3.s:
tvayā dṛṣṭo'tha vātrāsau kathyatāmavilaṃbitam..
kiṃ kāryaṃ dhanadenādya iti pṛṣṭo mayā hi saḥ.. 8.70 ..
1.3.d:
त्वया दृष्टोऽथ वात्रासौ कथ्यतामविलंबितम्..
किं कार्यं धनदेनाद्य इति पृष्टो मया हि सः.. 8.70 ..
1.3.m: Has he been seen by you here or not? Let it be told without delay.' / When he was questioned by me: 'What business is there with the giver of wealth today?' 8.70

1.3.s:
tadovāca mahātejā rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ..
mayyaśraddhānvito bhūtvā viṣayātmā sudurmadaḥ.. 8.71 ..
1.3.d:
तदोवाच महातेजा रावणो लोकरावणः..
मय्यश्रद्धान्वितो भूत्वा विषयात्मा सुदुर्मदः.. 8.71 ..
1.3.m: then Rāvaṇa of great splendor, who made the world weep, / having become devoid of faith in me, sensual, and exceedingly arrogant, spoke: 8.71

1.3.s:
śikṣāpayitumārabdho maivaṃ kāryamiti prabho..
yathāhaṃ ca śriyā yukta āḍhyo'haṃ balavānaham..
tathā tvaṃ bhava re mūḍha mā mūḍhatvamupārjaya.. 8.72 ..
1.3.d:
शिक्षापयितुमारब्धो मैवं कार्यमिति प्रभो..
यथाहं च श्रिया युक्त आढ्योऽहं बलवानहम्..
तथा त्वं भव रे मूढ मा मूढत्वमुपार्जय.. 8.72 ..
1.3.m:
"He began to instruct [me], O lord: 'This must not be done!
As I am endowed with fortune, wealthy, and strong,
so should you become, you fool; do not foster foolishness!'

1.3.s:
ahaṃ mūḍhaḥ kṛtastena kubereṇa mahātmanā..
mayā nirākṛto roṣāttapastepe sa guhyakaḥ.. 8.73 ..
1.3.d:
अहं मूढः कृतस्तेन कुबेरेण महात्मना..
मया निराकृतो रोषात्तपस्तेपे स गुह्यकः.. 8.73 ..
1.3.m:
I was called a fool by that great-souled Kubera.
Spurned by me in anger, that Guhyaka performed tapas.

1.3.s:
kuberaḥ sa hi naṃdinkimāgatastava maṃdiram..
dīyatāṃ ca kuberodya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 8.74 ..
1.3.d:
कुबेरः स हि नंदिन्किमागतस्तव मंदिरम्..
दीयतां च कुबेरोद्य नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 8.74 ..
1.3.m:
Did that Kubera come to your abode, Nandikā?
Let Kubera be handed over today; no hesitation should be made here!'

1.3.s:
rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā hyavocaṃ tvarito'pyaham..
liṃgakosi mahābhāga tvamahaṃ ca tathāvidhaḥ.. 8.75 ..
1.3.d:
रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा ह्यवोचं त्वरितोऽप्यहम्..
लिंगकोसि महाभाग त्वमहं च तथाविधः.. 8.75 ..
1.3.m:
Hearing the words of Rāvaṇa, I too replied swiftly:
'O fortunate one, you are a devotee of the liṅga, and so am I.

1.3.s:
ubhayoḥ samanāṃ jñātvā vṛthā jalpasi durmate..
yathoktaḥ sa tvavādīnmāṃ vadanārthe baloddhataḥ.. 8.76 ..
1.3.d:
उभयोः समनां ज्ञात्वा वृथा जल्पसि दुर्मते..
यथोक्तः स त्ववादीन्मां वदनार्थे बलोद्धतः.. 8.76 ..
1.3.m:
Knowing our equality, you prattle in vain, you wicked-minded one!'
Thus spoken to, he, arrogant with strength, spoke to me regarding [my] face:

1.3.s:
yathā bhavadbhiḥ pṛṣṭo'haṃ vadanārthe mahātmabhiḥ..
purāvṛttaṃ mayā proktaṃ śivārcanavidheḥ phalam..
śivena dattaṃ sālūpyaṃ na gṛhītaṃ mayā tadā.. 8.77 ..
1.3.d:
यथा भवद्भिः पृष्टोऽहं वदनार्थे महात्मभिः..
पुरावृत्तं मया प्रोक्तं शिवार्चनविधेः फलम्..
शिवेन दत्तं सालूप्यं न गृहीतं मया तदा.. 8.77 ..
1.3.m:
'Just as I was questioned by you great-souled ones regarding [my] face,
so the ancient occurrence was spoken by me, the fruit of the rite of worshipping Śiva.
Conformity of form [with himself] was given by Śiva, [but] was not accepted by me then.

1.3.s:
yācitaṃ ca mayā śaṃbhorvadanaṃ vānarasya ca..
śivena kṛpayā dattaṃ mama kāruṇyaśālinā.. 8.78 ..
1.3.d:
याचितं च मया शंभोर्वदनं वानरस्य च..
शिवेन कृपया दत्तं मम कारुण्यशालिना.. 8.78 ..
1.3.m:
And the face of a monkey was requested by me from Śambhu;
out of grace it was given to me by Śiva, who is full of compassion.

1.3.s:
nirābhimānino ye ca nirdabhā niṣparigrahāḥ..
śaṃbhoḥ priyāste vijñeyā hyanye śivavabahiṣkṛtāḥ.. 8.79 ..
1.3.d:
निराभिमानिनो ये च निर्दभा निष्परिग्रहाः..
शंभोः प्रियास्ते विज्ञेया ह्यन्ये शिववबहिष्कृताः.. 8.79 ..
1.3.m:
Those who are devoid of pride, devoid of hypocrisy, and free from possessions,
they should be known as dear to Śambhu; others are cast out from Śiva.'

1.3.s:
tathāvadanmayā sārddhaṃ rāvaṇastapaso balāt..
mayā ca yācitānyeva daśa vaktrāṇi dhīmatā.. 8.80 ..
1.3.d:
तथावदन्मया सार्द्धं रावणस्तपसो बलात्..
मया च याचितान्येव दश वक्त्राणि धीमता.. 8.80 ..
1.3.m:
So spoke Rāvaṇa with me through the power of his tapas:
'And ten faces were requested by me, the wise one!'

1.3.s:
upahāsakaraṃ vākyaṃ paulastyasya tadā surāḥ..
mayā tadā hi śapto'sau rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ.. 8.81 ..
1.3.d:
उपहासकरं वाक्यं पौलस्त्यस्य तदा सुराः..
मया तदा हि शप्तोऽसौ रावणो लोकरावणः.. 8.81 ..
1.3.m:
Hearing that mocking speech of the son of Pulastya, O gods,
then indeed that Rāvaṇa, who makes the worlds weep, was cursed by me:

1.3.s:
īdṛśānyeva vaktrāṇi yeṣāṃ vai saṃbhavaṃti hi..
taiḥ sameto yadā ko'pi naravaryo mahātapāḥ..
māṃ puraskṛtya sahasā haniṣyati na saṃśayaḥ.. 8.82 ..
1.3.d:
ईदृशान्येव वक्त्राणि येषां वै संभवंति हि..
तैः समेतो यदा कोऽपि नरवर्यो महातपाः..
मां पुरस्कृत्य सहसा हनिष्यति न संशयः.. 8.82 ..
1.3.m:
'When a certain foremost of men of great tapas,
united with those who indeed have faces just like this,
advances with me at the front, he will kill [you] swiftly—there is no doubt!'

1.3.s:
evaṃ śapto mayā brahmanrāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ..
arcitaṃ kevalaṃ liṃgaṃ vinā tena mahātmanā.. 8.83 ..
1.3.d:
एवं शप्तो मया ब्रह्मन्रावणो लोकरावणः..
अर्चितं केवलं लिंगं विना तेन महात्मना.. 8.83 ..
1.3.m:
Thus, O brahmin, was Rāvaṇa, who makes the worlds weep, cursed by me.
Only the bare liṅga without [the pedestal] was worshipped by that great-souled one;

1.3.s:
pīṭhikārūpasaṃsthena vinā tena surottamāḥ..
viṣṇunā hi mahābhāgāstasmātsarvaṃ vidhāsyati.. 8.84 ..
1.3.d:
पीठिकारूपसंस्थेन विना तेन सुरोत्तमाः..
विष्णुना हि महाभागास्तस्मात्सर्वं विधास्यति.. 8.84 ..
1.3.m:
without that [pedestal] which stands in the form of the pedestal, O best of gods,
for it is Viṣṇu, O fortunate ones; therefore he will accomplish everything.

1.3.s:
devadevo mahādevo viṣṇurūpī maheśvaraḥ..
sarve yūyaṃ prārthayaṃtu viṣṇuṃ sarvaguhāśayam.. 8.85 ..
1.3.d:
देवदेवो महादेवो विष्णुरूपी महेश्वरः..
सर्वे यूयं प्रार्थयंतु विष्णुं सर्वगुहाशयम्.. 8.85 ..
1.3.m:
Maheśvara, the god of gods, Mahādeva, has the form of Viṣṇu.
All of you should pray to Viṣṇu, who dwells in the cave of every [heart].

1.3.s:
ahaṃ hi sarvadevānāṃ purovartī bhavāmyataḥ..
te sarve naṃdino vākyaṃ śrutvā muditamānasāḥ..
vaikuṃṭhamāgatā gīrbhirviṣṇuṃ stotuṃ pracakrire.. 8.86 ..
1.3.d:
अहं हि सर्वदेवानां पुरोवर्ती भवाम्यतः..
ते सर्वे नंदिनो वाक्यं श्रुत्वा मुदितमानसाः..
वैकुंठमागता गीर्भिर्विष्णुं स्तोतुं प्रचक्रिरे.. 8.86 ..
1.3.m:
For I shall march at the head of all the gods.'
Hearing the words of Nandin, all of them, their minds gladdened,
went to Vaikuṇṭha and began to praise Viṣṇu with hymns:

1.3.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ..
namo bhagavate tubhyaṃ devadeva jagatpate..
tvadādhāramidaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram.. 8.87 ..
1.3.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः..
नमो भगवते तुभ्यं देवदेव जगत्पते..
त्वदाधारमिदं सर्वं जगदेतच्चराचरम्.. 8.87 ..
1.3.m:
The gods said:
'Homage to you, the Blessed One, O god of gods, lord of the world!
Supported by you is this entire world, both moving and unmoving.

1.3.s:
etalliṃgaṃ tvayā viṣṇo dhṛtaṃ vai piṇḍirūpiṇā..
mahāviṣṇusvarūpeṇa ghātitau madhukaiṭabhau.. 8.88 ..
1.3.d:
एतल्लिंगं त्वया विष्णो धृतं वै पिण्डिरूपिणा..
महाविष्णुस्वरूपेण घातितौ मधुकैटभौ.. 8.88 ..
1.3.m:
This liṅga was borne by you, O Viṣṇu, in the form of the pedestal.
In the form of Mahāviṣṇu, Madhu and Kaiṭabha were slain [by you].

1.3.s:
tathā kamaṭharūpeṇa dhṛto vai maṃdarācalaḥ..
varāharūpamāsthāya hiraṇyākṣo hatastvayā.. 8.89 ..
1.3.d:
तथा कमठरूपेण धृतो वै मंदराचलः..
वराहरूपमास्थाय हिरण्याक्षो हतस्त्वया.. 8.89 ..
1.3.m:
Likewise, in the form of a tortoise, Mount Mandara was supported.
Assuming the form of a boar, Hiraṇyākṣa was slain by you.

1.3.s:
hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo hato nṛharirūpiṇā..
tvayā caiva balirbaddho daityo vāmanarūpiṇā.. 8.90 ..
1.3.d:
हिरण्यकशिपुर्दैत्यो हतो नृहरिरूपिणा..
त्वया चैव बलिर्बद्धो दैत्यो वामनरूपिणा.. 8.90 ..
1.3.m:
The Daitya Hiraṇyakaśipu was slain in the form of the man-lion,
and the Daitya Bali was bound by you in the form of the dwarf.

1.3.s:
bhṛgūṇāmanvaye bhūtvā kṛtavīryātmajo hataḥ..
itopyasmānmahāviṣṇo tathaiva paripālaya.. 8.91 ..
1.3.d:
भृगूणामन्वये भूत्वा कृतवीर्यात्मजो हतः..
इतोप्यस्मान्महाविष्णो तथैव परिपालय.. 8.91 ..
1.3.m:
Born in the lineage of the Bhṛgus, the son of Kṛtavīrya was slain.
Now also protect us likewise from this, O Mahāviṣṇu!

1.3.s: rāvamasya bhayādasmāttrātuṃ bhūyorhasi tvaram.. 8.92 ..
1.3.d: रावमस्य भयादस्मात्त्रातुं भूयोर्हसि त्वरम्.. 8.92 ..
1.3.m: You ought to swiftly save [us] again from this fear of Rāvaṇa!'

1.3.s:
evaṃ saṃprārthito devairbhagavānbhūtabhāvanaḥ..
uvāca ca surānsarvānvāsudevo jaganmayaḥ.. 8.93 ..
1.3.d:
एवं संप्रार्थितो देवैर्भगवान्भूतभावनः..
उवाच च सुरान्सर्वान्वासुदेवो जगन्मयः.. 8.93 ..
1.3.m:
Thus implored by the gods, the Blessed One, the creator of beings,
Vāsudeva, who comprises the universe, spoke to all the gods:

1.3.s:
he devāḥ śrūyatāṃ vākyaṃ prastāvasadṛśaṃ mahat..
śailādiṃ ca puraskṛtya sarve yūyaṃ tvarānvitāḥ..
avatārānprakurvantu vānarīṃ tanumāśritāḥ.. 8.94 ..
1.3.d:
हे देवाः श्रूयतां वाक्यं प्रस्तावसदृशं महत्..
शैलादिं च पुरस्कृत्य सर्वे यूयं त्वरान्विताः..
अवतारान्प्रकुर्वन्तु वानरीं तनुमाश्रिताः.. 8.94 ..
1.3.m:
'O gods, hear [my] great speech, suited to this occasion:
Placing the son of Śilāda at the front, all of you, endowed with haste,
should make descents, resorting to monkey bodies.

1.3.s:
ahaṃ hi mānuṣo bhūtvā hyajñānena samāvṛtaḥ..
saṃbhaviṣyāmyayodhyāyaṃ gṛhe daśarathasya ca..
brahmavidyāsahāyosmi bhavatāṃ kāryasiddhaye.. 8.95 ..
1.3.d:
अहं हि मानुषो भूत्वा ह्यज्ञानेन समावृतः..
संभविष्याम्ययोध्यायं गृहे दशरथस्य च..
ब्रह्मविद्यासहायोस्मि भवतां कार्यसिद्धये.. 8.95 ..
1.3.m:
Having become a mortal, covered by ignorance,
I shall be born in Ayodhyā, in the house of Daśaratha.
I have Brahmavidyā as my companion for the accomplishment of your purpose.

1.3.s:
janakasya gṛhe sākṣādbrahmavidyā janiṣyati..
bhakto hi rāvaṇaḥ sākṣācchivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ.. 8.96 ..
1.3.d:
जनकस्य गृहे साक्षाद्ब्रह्मविद्या जनिष्यति..
भक्तो हि रावणः साक्षाच्छिवध्यानपरायणः.. 8.96 ..
1.3.m:
Directly in the house of Janaka, Brahmavidyā will be born.
Rāvaṇa is indeed a devotee, wholly intent on meditating upon Śiva.

1.3.s:
tapasā mahatā yukto brahmavidyāṃ yadecchati..
tadā susādhyo bhavati puruṣo dharmanirjitaḥ.. 8.97 ..
1.3.d:
तपसा महता युक्तो ब्रह्मविद्यां यदेच्छति..
तदा सुसाध्यो भवति पुरुषो धर्मनिर्जितः.. 8.97 ..
1.3.m:
Endowed with great tapas, when he desires Brahmavidyā,
then that man, overcome by righteousness, becomes easily subdued.'

1.3.s:
evaṃ saṃbhāṣya bhagavānviṣṇuḥ paramamaṅgalaḥ..
vālī cendrāṃśasaṃbhūtaḥ sugrīvoṃ śumataḥ sutaḥ.. 8.98 ..
1.3.d:
एवं संभाष्य भगवान्विष्णुः परममङ्गलः..
वाली चेन्द्रांशसंभूतः सुग्रीवों शुमतः सुतः.. 8.98 ..
1.3.m:
Having spoken thus, the Blessed One, Viṣṇu, supremely auspicious—
Vālin was born from a portion of Indra; Sugrīva was the son of the Sun.

1.3.s:
tathā brahmāṃśasaṃbhūto jāmbavānnṛkṣakuñjaraḥ..
śilādatanayo naṃdī śivasyānucaraḥ priyaḥ.. 8.99 ..
1.3.d:
तथा ब्रह्मांशसंभूतो जाम्बवान्नृक्षकुञ्जरः..
शिलादतनयो नंदी शिवस्यानुचरः प्रियः.. 8.99 ..
1.3.m:
Likewise, Jāmbavat, the best of bears, was born from a portion of Brahmā.
Nandin, the son of Śilāda, is the beloved attendant of Śiva;

1.3.s:
yo vai caikādaśo rudro hanūmānsa mahākapiḥ..
avatīrṇaḥ sahāyārthaṃ viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ.. 8.100 ..
1.3.d:
यो वै चैकादशो रुद्रो हनूमान्स महाकपिः..
अवतीर्णः सहायार्थं विष्णोरमिततेजसः.. 8.100 ..
1.3.m:
and the great monkey Hanūmat is indeed the eleventh Rudra,
who descended to assist Viṣṇu of boundless splendor.

1.3.s:
maiṃdādayo'tha kapayaste sarve surasattamāḥ..
evaṃ sarve suragaṇā avateruryathā tatham.. 8.101 ..
1.3.d:
मैंदादयोऽथ कपयस्ते सर्वे सुरसत्तमाः..
एवं सर्वे सुरगणा अवतेरुर्यथा तथम्.. 8.101 ..
1.3.m:
Mainda and other monkeys were all the foremost of the gods.
Thus all the hosts of gods descended in their respective forms.

1.3.s:
tathaiva viṣṇurutpannaḥ kauśalyānaṃdavarddhanaḥ..
viśvasya ramaṇāccaiva rāma ityucyate budhaiḥ.. 8.102 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव विष्णुरुत्पन्नः कौशल्यानंदवर्द्धनः..
विश्वस्य रमणाच्चैव राम इत्युच्यते बुधैः.. 8.102 ..
1.3.m:
Likewise Viṣṇu was born, increasing the joy of Kauśalyā;
and because he brings delight to the universe, he is called Rāma by the wise.

1.3.s: śeṣopi bhaktyā viṣṇośca tapasā'vātaradbhuvi.. 8.103 ..
1.3.d: शेषोपि भक्त्या विष्णोश्च तपसाऽवातरद्भुवि.. 8.103 ..
1.3.m: Śeṣa also descended to earth through devotion to Viṣṇu and through tapas.

1.3.s:
dordaṇḍāvapi viṣṇośca avatīrṇau pratāpinau..
śatrughnabharatākhyau ca vikhyātau bhuvanatraye.. 8.104 ..
1.3.d:
दोर्दण्डावपि विष्णोश्च अवतीर्णौ प्रतापिनौ..
शत्रुघ्नभरताख्यौ च विख्यातौ भुवनत्रये.. 8.104 ..
1.3.m:
The two mighty arms of Viṣṇu also descended,
named Śatrughna and Bharata, renowned throughout the three worlds.

1.3.s:
mithilādhipateḥ kanyā yā uktā brahmavādibhiḥ..
sā brahmavidyāvataratsurāṇāṃ kāryyasiddhaye..
sītā jātā lāṃgalasya iyaṃ bhūmivikarṣaṇāt.. 8.105 ..
1.3.d:
मिथिलाधिपतेः कन्या या उक्ता ब्रह्मवादिभिः..
सा ब्रह्मविद्यावतरत्सुराणां कार्य्यसिद्धये..
सीता जाता लांगलस्य इयं भूमिविकर्षणात्.. 8.105 ..
1.3.m:
The daughter of the ruler of Mithilā, who is spoken of by the knowers of Brahman,
she, Brahmavidyā, descended for the accomplishment of the gods' purpose.
She was born as Sītā from the furrows made by a plow dragging the earth.

1.3.s:
tasmātsīteti vikhyātā vidyā sānvīkṣikī tadā..
mithilāyāṃ samutpannā maithitītyabhidhīyate.. 8.106 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्सीतेति विख्याता विद्या सान्वीक्षिकी तदा..
मिथिलायां समुत्पन्ना मैथितीत्यभिधीयते.. 8.106 ..
1.3.m:
Therefore, renowned as Sītā, she was then the science of inquiry;
born in Mithilā, she is called Maithilī.

1.3.s:
janakasya kule jātā viśrutā janakātmajā..
khyātā vedavatī pūrvaṃ brahmavidyāghanāśinī.. 8.107 ..
1.3.d:
जनकस्य कुले जाता विश्रुता जनकात्मजा..
ख्याता वेदवती पूर्वं ब्रह्मविद्याघनाशिनी.. 8.107 ..
1.3.m:
Born in the family of Janaka, celebrated as the daughter of Janaka,
formerly known as Vedavatī, Brahmavidyā that destroys sins.

1.3.s: sā dattā janakenaiva viṣṇave paramātmane.. 8.108 ..
1.3.d: सा दत्ता जनकेनैव विष्णवे परमात्मने.. 8.108 ..
1.3.m: She was given by Janaka himself to Viṣṇu, the Supreme Self.

1.3.s:
tayātha vidyayā sārddhaṃ devadevo jagatpatiḥ..
ugre tapasi līno'sau viṣṇuḥ paramaduṣkaram.. 8.109 ..
1.3.d:
तयाथ विद्यया सार्द्धं देवदेवो जगत्पतिः..
उग्रे तपसि लीनोऽसौ विष्णुः परमदुष्करम्.. 8.109 ..
1.3.m:
Together with that Vidyā, the god of gods, the lord of the world,
that Viṣṇu, engaged in fierce and exceedingly difficult tapas.

1.3.s:
rāvaṇaṃ jetukāmo vai rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ..
araṇyavāsamakaroddevānāṃ kāryasiddhaye.. 8.110 ..
1.3.d:
रावणं जेतुकामो वै रामो राजीवलोचनः..
अरण्यवासमकरोद्देवानां कार्यसिद्धये.. 8.110 ..
1.3.m:
Desiring to conquer Rāvaṇa, the lotus-eyed Rāma
dwelt in the forest for the accomplishment of the purpose of the gods.

1.3.s:
śeṣāvatāro'pi mahāṃstapaḥ paramaduṣkaram..
tatāpa parayā śaktyā devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye.. 8.111 ..
1.3.d:
शेषावतारोऽपि महांस्तपः परमदुष्करम्..
तताप परया शक्त्या देवानां कार्यसिद्धये.. 8.111 ..
1.3.m:
The great incarnation of Śeṣa also, for the accomplishment of the gods' purpose,
performed exceedingly difficult tapas with supreme power.

1.3.s: śatrughno bharataścaiva tepatuḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ.. 8.112 ..
1.3.d: शत्रुघ्नो भरतश्चैव तेपतुः परमं तपः.. 8.112 ..
1.3.m: Śatrughna and Bharata also performed supreme tapas.

1.3.s:
tato'sau tapasā yuktaḥ sārddhaṃ tairdevatāgaṇaiḥ..
sagaṇaṃ rāvaṇaṃ rāmaḥ ṣaḍbhirmāsairajīhanat..
viṣṇunā ghātitaḥ śastraiḥ śivasārūpyamāptavān.. 8.113 ..
1.3.d:
ततोऽसौ तपसा युक्तः सार्द्धं तैर्देवतागणैः..
सगणं रावणं रामः षड्भिर्मासैरजीहनत्..
विष्णुना घातितः शस्त्रैः शिवसारूप्यमाप्तवान्.. 8.113 ..
1.3.m:
Then, endowed with tapas, together with those hosts of deities,
Rāma killed Rāvaṇa along with his host within six months.
Slain by Viṣṇu with weapons, he attained conformity of form with Śiva.

1.3.s: sagamaḥ sa punaḥ sadyo baṃdhubhiḥ saha suvratāḥ.. 8.114 ..
1.3.d: सगमः स पुनः सद्यो बंधुभिः सह सुव्रताः.. 8.114 ..
1.3.m: He departed at once together with his kinsmen, O you of noble vows!

1.3.s:
śivaprasādātsakalaṃ dvaitādvaitamavāpa ha..
dvaitādvaitavivekārthamṛpayopyatra mohitāḥ..
tatsarvaṃ prāpnuvaṃtīha śivārcanaratā narāḥ.. 8.115 ..
1.3.d:
शिवप्रसादात्सकलं द्वैताद्वैतमवाप ह..
द्वैताद्वैतविवेकार्थमृपयोप्यत्र मोहिताः..
तत्सर्वं प्राप्नुवंतीह शिवार्चनरता नराः.. 8.115 ..
1.3.m: By the grace of Śiva, he attained all duality and non-duality. / Even seers are bewildered concerning the discernment between duality and non-duality; / men devoted to the worship of Śiva attain all that here.

1.3.s:
ye'rcayaṃti śivaṃ nityaṃ liṃgarūpiṇameva ca..
striyo vāpyatha vā śūdrāḥ śvapacā hyaṃtyavāsinaḥ..
taṃ śivaṃ prāpnuvaṃtyeva sarvaduḥkhopanāśanam.. 8.116 ..
1.3.d:
येऽर्चयंति शिवं नित्यं लिंगरूपिणमेव च..
स्त्रियो वाप्यथ वा शूद्राः श्वपचा ह्यंत्यवासिनः..
तं शिवं प्राप्नुवंत्येव सर्वदुःखोपनाशनम्.. 8.116 ..
1.3.m: Those who constantly worship Śiva specifically in the form of a liṅga, / whether women, Śūdras, or outcastes dwelling on the fringes, / attain that very Śiva who destroys all suffering.

1.3.s: paśavo'pi paraṃ yātāḥ kiṃ punarmānuṣādayaḥ.. 8.117 ..
1.3.d: पशवोऽपि परं याताः किं पुनर्मानुषादयः.. 8.117 ..
1.3.m: Even beasts have attained the supreme, what then of human beings and others?

1.3.s:
ye dvijā brahmacaryeṇa tapaḥ paramamāsthitāḥ..
varṣairanekairyajñānāṃ te'pi svargaparā bhavan.. 8.118 ..
1.3.d:
ये द्विजा ब्रह्मचर्येण तपः परममास्थिताः..
वर्षैरनेकैर्यज्ञानां तेऽपि स्वर्गपरा भवन्.. 8.118 ..
1.3.m: Those twice-born who, through celibacy, engaged in supreme austerity, / even they, through sacrifices over many years, became intent on heaven.

1.3.s:
jyotiṣṭomo vājapeyo hyatirātrādayo hyamī..
yajñāḥ svargaṃ prayacchaṃti sattrīṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 8.119 ..
1.3.d:
ज्योतिष्टोमो वाजपेयो ह्यतिरात्रादयो ह्यमी..
यज्ञाः स्वर्गं प्रयच्छंति सत्त्रीणां नात्र संशयः.. 8.119 ..
1.3.m: The Jyotiṣṭoma, Vājapeya, and Atirātra sacrifices— / these rituals bestow heaven upon the sacrificers; of this there is no doubt.

1.3.s:
tatra svargasukhaṃ bhuktvā puṇyakṣayakaraṃ mahat..
puṇyakṣaye'pi yajvāno martyalokaṃ pataṃti vai.. 8.120 ..
1.3.d:
तत्र स्वर्गसुखं भुक्त्वा पुण्यक्षयकरं महत्..
पुण्यक्षयेऽपि यज्वानो मर्त्यलोकं पतंति वै.. 8.120 ..
1.3.m: Having enjoyed the great bliss of heaven there, which causes the exhaustion of merit, / upon the exhaustion of their merit, the sacrificers indeed fall back to the mortal world.

1.3.s:
patitānāṃ ca saṃsāre daivādbuddhiḥ prajāyate..
guṇatrayamayī viprāstāsutāstviha yoniṣu.. 8.121 ..
1.3.d:
पतितानां च संसारे दैवाद्बुद्धिः प्रजायते..
गुणत्रयमयी विप्रास्तासुतास्त्विह योनिषु.. 8.121 ..
1.3.m: And when they have fallen into the cycle of worldly existence, an intellect arises by fate / composed of the three qualities, O brahmins, in those diverse wombs here.

1.3.s:
yathā sattvaṃ saṃbhavati sattvayuktabhavaṃ narāḥ..
rājasāśca tathā jñeyāstā masāścaiva te dvijāḥ.. 8.122 ..
1.3.d:
यथा सत्त्वं संभवति सत्त्वयुक्तभवं नराः..
राजसाश्च तथा ज्ञेयास्ता मसाश्चैव ते द्विजाः.. 8.122 ..
1.3.m: According as goodness arises, men are born endowed with goodness; / those characterized by passion and those characterized by darkness are to be known likewise, O twice-born.

1.3.s:
evaṃ saṃsāracakre'sminbhramitā bahavo janāḥ..
yadṛcchayā daivagatyā śivaṃ saṃsevate naraḥ.. 8.123 ..
1.3.d:
एवं संसारचक्रेऽस्मिन्भ्रमिता बहवो जनाः..
यदृच्छया दैवगत्या शिवं संसेवते नरः.. 8.123 ..
1.3.m: Thus, many people wander in this wheel of worldly existence; / by chance, through the course of fate, a man serves Śiva.

1.3.s:
śivadhyānaparāṇāṃ ca narāṇāṃ yatacetasām..
māyānirasanaṃ sadyo bhaviṣyati na cānyathā.. 8.124 ..
1.3.d:
शिवध्यानपराणां च नराणां यतचेतसाम्..
मायानिरसनं सद्यो भविष्यति न चान्यथा.. 8.124 ..
1.3.m: And for men intent on meditating upon Śiva, whose minds are restrained, / the dispelling of illusion will occur immediately; it cannot be otherwise.

1.3.s:
māyānirasanātsadyo naśyatyeva guṇatrayam..
yadā guṇatrayātīto bhavatīti sa muktibhāk.. 8.125 ..
1.3.d:
मायानिरसनात्सद्यो नश्यत्येव गुणत्रयम्..
यदा गुणत्रयातीतो भवतीति स मुक्तिभाक्.. 8.125 ..
1.3.m: From the dispelling of illusion, the three qualities are destroyed at once; / when one transcends the three qualities, he becomes a possessor of liberation.

1.3.s:
tasmālliṅgārcanaṃ bhāvyaṃ sarveṣāmapi dehinām..
liṅgarūpī śivo bhūtvā trāyate saṃcarācaram.. 8.126 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माल्लिङ्गार्चनं भाव्यं सर्वेषामपि देहिनाम्..
लिङ्गरूपी शिवो भूत्वा त्रायते संचराचरम्.. 8.126 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, worship of the liṅga should be performed by all embodied beings; / having assumed the form of a liṅga, Śiva protects the moving and the unmoving.

1.3.s:
purā bhavadbhiḥ pṛṣṭo'haṃ liṅgarūpī kathaṃ śivaḥ..
tatsarvaṃ kathitaṃ viprā yāthātathyena saṃprati.. 8.127 ..
1.3.d:
पुरा भवद्भिः पृष्टोऽहं लिङ्गरूपी कथं शिवः..
तत्सर्वं कथितं विप्रा याथातथ्येन संप्रति.. 8.127 ..
1.3.m: Formerly you asked me how Śiva came to have the form of a liṅga; / all that has now been related faithfully, O brahmins.

1.3.s:
kathaṃ garaṃ bhakṣitavāñchivo lokamaheśvaraḥ..
tatsarvaṃ śrūyatāṃ viprā yatāvatkathayāmi vaḥ.. 8.128 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhāsryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe śivaśāstre śivaliṅgārcanamāhātmyakathane śrīrāmāvatārakathāvarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 8 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
कथं गरं भक्षितवाञ्छिवो लोकमहेश्वरः..
तत्सर्वं श्रूयतां विप्रा यतावत्कथयामि वः.. 8.128 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहास्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखंडे शिवशास्त्रे शिवलिङ्गार्चनमाहात्म्यकथने श्रीरामावतारकथावर्णनंनामाष्टमोऽध्यायः.. 8 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
How Śiva, the Great Lord of the world, consumed the poison— / hear all that, O brahmins; I will relate it to you as it truly happened.
Thus ends the eighth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Story of the Incarnation of Śrī Rāma' in the recounting of the greatness of worshipping the Śivaliṅga, in the Śiva treatise of the Kedārakhaṇḍa, in the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, of the venerable Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
ekadā tu sabhāmadhya āsthito devarāṭ svayam..
lokapālaiḥ parivṛto devaiśca ṛṣibhistathā.. 9.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
एकदा तु सभामध्य आस्थितो देवराट् स्वयम्..
लोकपालैः परिवृतो देवैश्च ऋषिभिस्तथा.. 9.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Once, the king of the gods himself was seated in the midst of his assembly, / surrounded by the guardians of the quarters, gods, and seers,

1.3.s:
apsarogaṇasaṃvīto gaṃdharvaiśca puraskṛtaḥ..
upagīyamānavijayaḥ siddhavidyādharairapi.. 9.2 ..
1.3.d:
अप्सरोगणसंवीतो गंधर्वैश्च पुरस्कृतः..
उपगीयमानविजयः सिद्धविद्याधरैरपि.. 9.2 ..
1.3.m: surrounded by hosts of apsarases and honored by gandharvas, / his victory being sung by siddhas and vidyādharas.

1.3.s:
tadā śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto devarājaguruḥ sudhīḥ..
āgato'sau mahābhāgo bṛhaspati rudāradhīḥ.. 9.3 ..
1.3.d:
तदा शिष्यैः परिवृतो देवराजगुरुः सुधीः..
आगतोऽसौ महाभागो बृहस्पति रुदारधीः.. 9.3 ..
1.3.m: Then, surrounded by his disciples, the preceptor of the king of gods, the wise, / fortunate, and noble-minded Bṛhaspati arrived.

1.3.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā devāḥ praṇemuḥ samupasthitāḥ..
iṃdropi dadṛśe tatra prāptaṃ vācaspatiṃ tadā.. 9.4 ..
1.3.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा सहसा देवाः प्रणेमुः समुपस्थिताः..
इंद्रोपि ददृशे तत्र प्राप्तं वाचस्पतिं तदा.. 9.4 ..
1.3.m: Seeing him, the gods present rose at once and bowed down. / Indra too saw Vācaspati arrived there at that time.

1.3.s:
novāca kiṃciddurmedhāvaco mānupuraḥsaram..
nāhvānaṃ nāsanaṃ tasya na visarjanameva ca.. 9.5 ..
1.3.d:
नोवाच किंचिद्दुर्मेधावचो मानुपुरःसरम्..
नाह्वानं नासनं तस्य न विसर्जनमेव च.. 9.5 ..
1.3.m: The foolish-minded [Indra] spoke not a single word preceded by honor; / there was neither an invitation to sit nor a seat for him, nor even a formal dismissal.

1.3.s:
śakraṃ pramattaṃ jñātvātha madādrājyasya durmatim..
tirodhānamanuprāpto bṛhaspatī ruṣānvitaḥ.. 9.6 ..
1.3.d:
शक्रं प्रमत्तं ज्ञात्वाथ मदाद्राज्यस्य दुर्मतिम्..
तिरोधानमनुप्राप्तो बृहस्पती रुषान्वितः.. 9.6 ..
1.3.m: Knowing that Śakra was infatuated and foolish with the intoxication of kingship, / Bṛhaspati, filled with anger, vanished from sight.

1.3.s:
gate devagurau tasminvimanaskā'bhavansurāḥ..
yakṣā nāgāḥ sagaṃdharvā ṛṣayo'pi tathā dvijāḥ.. 9.7 ..
1.3.d:
गते देवगुरौ तस्मिन्विमनस्काऽभवन्सुराः..
यक्षा नागाः सगंधर्वा ऋषयोऽपि तथा द्विजाः.. 9.7 ..
1.3.m: When that preceptor of the gods had departed, the gods became despondent, / as did the yakṣas, nāgas, gandharvas, seers, and twice-born.

1.3.s:
gāṃdharvasyā vasāne tu labdhasaṃjño hariḥ surān..
papraccha tvaritenavai kva gato hi mahātapāḥ.. 9.8 ..
1.3.d:
गांधर्वस्या वसाने तु लब्धसंज्ञो हरिः सुरान्..
पप्रच्छ त्वरितेनवै क्व गतो हि महातपाः.. 9.8 ..
1.3.m: At the conclusion of the gandharva music, Hari, having regained his awareness, / quickly asked the gods: 'Where indeed has that [sage] of great austerities gone?'

1.3.s:
tadaiva nāradenoktaḥ śakro devādhipastathā..
tvayā kṛtā hyavajñā ca gurornastyatra saṃśayaḥ.. 9.9 ..
1.3.d:
तदैव नारदेनोक्तः शक्रो देवाधिपस्तथा..
त्वया कृता ह्यवज्ञा च गुरोर्नस्त्यत्र संशयः.. 9.9 ..
1.3.m: Then Nārada said to Śakra, the ruler of the gods: / 'Disrespect was shown by you to your preceptor; of this there is no doubt.

1.3.s:
guroravajñayā rājyaṃ gataṃ te balasūdana..
tasmātkṣamāpanīyo'sau sarvabhāvena hi tvayā.. 9.10 ..
1.3.d:
गुरोरवज्ञया राज्यं गतं ते बलसूदन..
तस्मात्क्षमापनीयोऽसौ सर्वभावेन हि त्वया.. 9.10 ..
1.3.m: Through disrespect of the preceptor, your sovereignty is lost, O slayer of Bala; / therefore, you must appease him with every devotion.'

1.3.s:
etacchrutvā vacastasya nāradasya mahātmanaḥ..
āsanātsahasotthāya taiḥ sarvaiḥ parivāritaḥ..
āgacchattvarayā śakro gurorgehamataṃdritaḥ.. 9.11 ..
1.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य नारदस्य महात्मनः..
आसनात्सहसोत्थाय तैः सर्वैः परिवारितः..
आगच्छत्त्वरया शक्रो गुरोर्गेहमतंद्रितः.. 9.11 ..
1.3.m: Hearing this speech of the noble Nārada, / Śakra rose quickly from his seat and, surrounded by all of them, / went with haste and vigilance to the house of his preceptor.

1.3.s:
pṛṣṭvā tārāṃ praṇamyādau kva gato hi mahātapāḥ..
na jānāmītyuvācedaṃ tārā śakraṃ nirīkṣatī.. 9.12 ..
1.3.d:
पृष्ट्वा तारां प्रणम्यादौ क्व गतो हि महातपाः..
न जानामीत्युवाचेदं तारा शक्रं निरीक्षती.. 9.12 ..
1.3.m: Having first bowed and asked Tārā, 'Where indeed has the [sage] of great austerities gone?', / Tārā, looking at Śakra, said this: 'I do not know.'

1.3.s:
tadā ciṃtānvito bhūtvā śakraḥ svagṛhamāvrajat..
etasminnaṃtare svarge hyaniṣṭāndbhutāni ca.. 9.13 ..
1.3.d:
तदा चिंतान्वितो भूत्वा शक्रः स्वगृहमाव्रजत्..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे स्वर्गे ह्यनिष्टान्द्भुतानि च.. 9.13 ..
1.3.m: Then, filled with anxiety, Śakra returned to his own home. / In the meantime, in heaven, unfavorable portents

1.3.s:
abhavansarvaduḥkhārthe śakrasya ca mahātmanaḥ..
pātālasthena balinā jñātaṃ śakrasya ceṣṭitam.. 9.14 ..
1.3.d:
अभवन्सर्वदुःखार्थे शक्रस्य च महात्मनः..
पातालस्थेन बलिना ज्ञातं शक्रस्य चेष्टितम्.. 9.14 ..
1.3.m: occurred to the total sorrow of the great-souled Śakra. / Bali, residing in Pātāla, came to know of Śakra's condition.

1.3.s:
yayau daityaiḥ parivṛtaḥ pātālādamarāvatīm..
tadā yuddhamatīvāsīddevānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha.. 9.15 ..
1.3.d:
ययौ दैत्यैः परिवृतः पातालादमरावतीम्..
तदा युद्धमतीवासीद्देवानां दानवैः सह.. 9.15 ..
1.3.m: Surrounded by Daityas, he set out from Pātāla to Amarāvatī. / Then a great battle took place between the gods and the Dānavas.

1.3.s:
devāḥ parājitā daityai rājyaṃ śakrasya tatkṣaṇāt..
saṃprāptaṃ sakalaṃ tasya mūḍhasya ca durātmanaḥ.. 9.16 ..
1.3.d:
देवाः पराजिता दैत्यै राज्यं शक्रस्य तत्क्षणात्..
संप्राप्तं सकलं तस्य मूढस्य च दुरात्मनः.. 9.16 ..
1.3.m: The gods were defeated by the Daityas; the entire sovereignty of Śakra / fell in that moment to that foolish and evil-minded one.

1.3.s:
nītaṃ sarvaprayatnena pātālaṃ tvaritaṃ gatāḥ..
śukraprasādātte sarve tathā vijayino'bhavan.. 9.17 ..
1.3.d:
नीतं सर्वप्रयत्नेन पातालं त्वरितं गताः..
शुक्रप्रसादात्ते सर्वे तथा विजयिनोऽभवन्.. 9.17 ..
1.3.m: Carrying off [everything] with utmost effort, they quickly departed to Pātāla. / By the grace of Śukra, they all became victorious in this manner.

1.3.s:
śakro'pi niḥśriko jāto devaistyaktastato bhṛśam..
devī tirodhānagatā babhūva kamalekṣaṇā.. 9.18 ..
1.3.d:
शक्रोऽपि निःश्रिको जातो देवैस्त्यक्तस्ततो भृशम्..
देवी तिरोधानगता बभूव कमलेक्षणा.. 9.18 ..
1.3.m: Śakra, completely bereft of splendor, was then utterly abandoned by the gods; / the lotus-eyed goddess [Lakṣmī] vanished from sight.

1.3.s:
airāvato mahānāgastathaivoccaiḥśravā hayaḥ..
evamādīni ratnāni anekāni bahūnyapi..
nītāni sahasā daityairlobhādasādhuvṛttibhiḥ.. 9.19 ..
1.3.d:
ऐरावतो महानागस्तथैवोच्चैःश्रवा हयः..
एवमादीनि रत्नानि अनेकानि बहून्यपि..
नीतानि सहसा दैत्यैर्लोभादसाधुवृत्तिभिः.. 9.19 ..
1.3.m: Airāvata the great elephant, and likewise the horse Uccaiḥśravas, / and many other such diverse treasures / were carried away in haste by the Daityas, who were greedy and wicked in conduct.

1.3.s:
puṇyabhāṃji ca tānyeva patitāni ca sāgare..
tadā sa vismayāviṣṭo balirāha guruṃ prati.. 9.20 ..
1.3.d:
पुण्यभांजि च तान्येव पतितानि च सागरे..
तदा स विस्मयाविष्टो बलिराह गुरुं प्रति.. 9.20 ..
1.3.m: And those very things, possessing merit, fell into the ocean. / Then, overcome with wonder, Bali said to his preceptor:

1.3.s:
devānnirjitya cāsmābhirānītāni bahūni ca..
ratnāni tu samudre'tha patitāni tadadbhutam.. 9.21 ..
1.3.d:
देवान्निर्जित्य चास्माभिरानीतानि बहूनि च..
रत्नानि तु समुद्रेऽथ पतितानि तदद्भुतम्.. 9.21 ..
1.3.m: 'Having conquered the gods, many treasures were brought by us, / but they have fallen into the ocean; that is wondrous.'

1.3.s:
balestadvacanaṃ śrutvā uśanā pratyuvāca tam..
aśvamedhaśatenaiva surarājyaṃ bhaviṣyati..
dīkṣitasya na saṃdehastasmādbhokta sa eva ca.. 9.22 ..
1.3.d:
बलेस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा उशना प्रत्युवाच तम्..
अश्वमेधशतेनैव सुरराज्यं भविष्यति..
दीक्षितस्य न संदेहस्तस्माद्भोक्त स एव च.. 9.22 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that speech of Bali, Uśanas replied to him: / 'The kingship of the gods can only be attained through a hundred horse-sacrifices; / there is no doubt about one who is consecrated [for it], therefore only such a one can enjoy it.

1.3.s: aśvamedhaṃ vinā kiṃcitsvargaṃ bhoktaṃ na pāryate.. 9.23 ..
1.3.d: अश्वमेधं विना किंचित्स्वर्गं भोक्तं न पार्यते.. 9.23 ..
1.3.m: Without a horse-sacrifice, heaven cannot be enjoyed at all.'

1.3.s:
gurorvacanamājñāya tūṣṇīṃbhūto balistataḥ..
babhūva devaiḥ sārddhaṃ ca yathocitamakārayat.. 9.24 ..
1.3.d:
गुरोर्वचनमाज्ञाय तूष्णींभूतो बलिस्ततः..
बभूव देवैः सार्द्धं च यथोचितमकारयत्.. 9.24 ..
1.3.m: Understanding the words of his preceptor, Bali then fell silent, / and he acted toward the gods as was appropriate.

1.3.s:
indropi śocyatāṃ prāpto jagāma parameṣṭhinam...
vijñāpayāmāsa tathā sarvaṃ rājyabhayādikam.. 9.25 ..
1.3.d:
इन्द्रोपि शोच्यतां प्राप्तो जगाम परमेष्ठिनम्...
विज्ञापयामास तथा सर्वं राज्यभयादिकम्.. 9.25 ..
1.3.m: Indra too, having fallen into a pitiable state, went to Parameṣṭhin / and reported everything, including the fear concerning his kingdom.

1.3.s: śakrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā parameṣṭhī uvāca ha.. 9.26 ..
1.3.d: शक्रस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा परमेष्ठी उवाच ह.. 9.26 ..
1.3.m: Hearing Śakra's speech, Parameṣṭhin said:

1.3.s:
saṃmilitvā surānsarvāṃstvayā sākaṃ tvarānvitāḥ..
ārādhanārthaṃ gacchāmo viṣṇuṃ sarveśvareśvaram.. 9.27 ..
1.3.d:
संमिलित्वा सुरान्सर्वांस्त्वया साकं त्वरान्विताः..
आराधनार्थं गच्छामो विष्णुं सर्वेश्वरेश्वरम्.. 9.27 ..
1.3.m: 'Assembling all the gods along with you, with haste / let us go to worship Viṣṇu, the Lord of the lords of all.'

1.3.s:
tatheti gatvā te sarve śakrādyā lokapālakāḥ..
brahmāṇaṃ ca puraskṛtya taṭaṃ kṣīrārṇavasya ca..
prāpyopaviśya te sarve hariṃ stotuṃ pracakramuḥ.. 9.28 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति गत्वा ते सर्वे शक्राद्या लोकपालकाः..
ब्रह्माणं च पुरस्कृत्य तटं क्षीरार्णवस्य च..
प्राप्योपविश्य ते सर्वे हरिं स्तोतुं प्रचक्रमुः.. 9.28 ..
1.3.m: Saying “So be it,” all the world-protectors, headed by Śakra, / placing Brahmā at their head, went to the shore of the milk-ocean; / having arrived and sat down, they all began to praise Hari.

1.3.s:
..brahmovāca..
devadeva jagānnātha surāsuranamaskṛta..
puṇyaślokāvyayānaṃta paramātmannamo'stu te.. 9.29 ..
1.3.d:
..ब्रह्मोवाच..
देवदेव जगान्नाथ सुरासुरनमस्कृत..
पुण्यश्लोकाव्ययानंत परमात्मन्नमोऽस्तु ते.. 9.29 ..
1.3.m: Brahmā said: / “O God of gods, Lord of the universe, worshipped by gods and demons! / O of holy renown, imperishable, infinite one! O Supreme Self, homage unto you!

1.3.s:
yajño'si yajñarūpo'si yajñāṃgo'si ramāpate..
tato'dya kṛpayā viṣṇo devānāṃ varado bhava.. 9.30 ..
1.3.d:
यज्ञोऽसि यज्ञरूपोऽसि यज्ञांगोऽसि रमापते..
ततोऽद्य कृपया विष्णो देवानां वरदो भव.. 9.30 ..
1.3.m: You are sacrifice, you are the form of sacrifice, you are the limb of sacrifice, O Lord of Ramā! / Therefore today, through your grace, O Viṣṇu, be the granter of boons to the gods.

1.3.s:
guroravajñayā cādya bhraṣṭarājyaḥ śatakratuḥ..
jātaḥ surarṣibhiḥ sākaṃ tasmādenaṃ samuddhara.. 9.31 ..
1.3.d:
गुरोरवज्ञया चाद्य भ्रष्टराज्यः शतक्रतुः..
जातः सुरर्षिभिः साकं तस्मादेनं समुद्धर.. 9.31 ..
1.3.m: Because of disrespect toward his guru, Śatakratu, along with the celestial seers, / has now been deprived of his kingdom; therefore, deliver him!”

1.3.s:
..śrībhagavānuvāca..
dukokalajñayā sarvaṃ nasyatīti kimadbhutam..
ye pāpino hyadharmiṣṭhāḥ kevalaṃ viṣayātmakāḥ..
pitarau niṃditau yaiśca nirdaivātvena saṃśayaḥ.. 9.32 ..
1.3.d:
..श्रीभगवानुवाच..
दुकोकलज्ञया सर्वं नस्यतीति किमद्भुतम्..
ये पापिनो ह्यधर्मिष्ठाः केवलं विषयात्मकाः..
पितरौ निंदितौ यैश्च निर्दैवात्वेन संशयः.. 9.32 ..
1.3.m: The Blessed Lord said: / “By disregarding […] all is lost—what wonder is there in this? / Those who are sinners, utterly unrighteous, devoted solely to sensual objects, / and by whom their parents are reviled, are without doubt destitute of fortune.

1.3.s:
anena yatkṛtaṃ brahmansadyastatphalamāgatam..
karmaṇā cāsya śakrasya sarveṣāṃ saṃkaṭāgamaḥ.. 9.33 ..
1.3.d:
अनेन यत्कृतं ब्रह्मन्सद्यस्तत्फलमागतम्..
कर्मणा चास्य शक्रस्य सर्वेषां संकटागमः.. 9.33 ..
1.3.m: What was done by him, O Brahmā, its fruit has come immediately; / and by this deed of Śakra, adversity has befallen everyone.

1.3.s:
viparīto yadā kālaḥ puruṣasya bhavettadā..
bhūtamaitrīṃ prakurvaṃti sarvakāryārthasiddhaye.. 9.34 ..
1.3.d:
विपरीतो यदा कालः पुरुषस्य भवेत्तदा..
भूतमैत्रीं प्रकुर्वंति सर्वकार्यार्थसिद्धये.. 9.34 ..
1.3.m: When adverse times come upon a man, / then they make friendship even with creatures for the accomplishment of every purpose.

1.3.s:
tena vai kāraṇeneṃdra madīyaṃ vacanaṃ kuru..
kāryahetostvayā kāryo daityaiḥ saha samāgamaḥ.. 9.35 ..
1.3.d:
तेन वै कारणेनेंद्र मदीयं वचनं कुरु..
कार्यहेतोस्त्वया कार्यो दैत्यैः सह समागमः.. 9.35 ..
1.3.m: For that very reason, O Indra, follow my word: / for the sake of the objective, you must make an alliance with the Daityas.”

1.3.s:
evaṃ bhagavatādiṣṭaḥ śakraḥ paramabuddhimān..
amarāvatīṃ yayau hitvā sutalaṃ daivataiḥ saha.. 9.36 ..
1.3.d:
एवं भगवतादिष्टः शक्रः परमबुद्धिमान्..
अमरावतीं ययौ हित्वा सुतलं दैवतैः सह.. 9.36 ..
1.3.m: Thus commanded by the Lord, Śakra, highly intelligent, / leaving Amarāvatī, went to Sutala together with the gods.

1.3.s:
indraṃ samāgataṃ śrutvā iṃdraseno ruṣānvitaḥ..
babhūva saha sainyena haṃtukāmaḥ puraṃdaram.. 9.37 ..
1.3.d:
इन्द्रं समागतं श्रुत्वा इंद्रसेनो रुषान्वितः..
बभूव सह सैन्येन हंतुकामः पुरंदरम्.. 9.37 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that Indra had arrived, Indrasena became filled with wrath, / and with his army he wished to slay Purandara.

1.3.s:
nāradena tadā daityā baliśca balināṃ varaḥ..
nivāritastadvadhācca vākyairuccāvacaistathā.. 9.38 ..
1.3.d:
नारदेन तदा दैत्या बलिश्च बलिनां वरः..
निवारितस्तद्वधाच्च वाक्यैरुच्चावचैस्तथा.. 9.38 ..
1.3.m: Then the Daityas and Bali, best of the mighty, / were restrained from killing him by Nārada with various arguments.

1.3.s:
ṛṣestasyaiva vacanāttyaktamanyurbalistadā..
babhūva saha sainyena āgato hi śatakratuḥ.. 9.39 ..
1.3.d:
ऋषेस्तस्यैव वचनात्त्यक्तमन्युर्बलिस्तदा..
बभूव सह सैन्येन आगतो हि शतक्रतुः.. 9.39 ..
1.3.m: By the word of that seer alone, Bali abandoned his anger; / then, along with his army, he [approached] Śatakratu who had come.

1.3.s:
indrasenena dṛṣṭo'sau lokapālaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ..
uvāca tvarayā yuktaḥ prahasanniva daityarāṭ.. 9.40 ..
1.3.d:
इन्द्रसेनेन दृष्टोऽसौ लोकपालैः समावृतः..
उवाच त्वरया युक्तः प्रहसन्निव दैत्यराट्.. 9.40 ..
1.3.m: Seen by Indrasena surrounded by the world-protectors, / the king of Daityas, with haste and as if laughing, said:

1.3.s:
kasmādihāgataḥ śakra sutalaṃ prati kathyatām..
tasyaitadvacanaṃ śrutvā smayamāna uvācatam.. 9.41 ..
1.3.d:
कस्मादिहागतः शक्र सुतलं प्रति कथ्यताम्..
तस्यैतद्वचनं श्रुत्वा स्मयमान उवाचतम्.. 9.41 ..
1.3.m: “Why have you come here to Sutala, O Śakra? Tell me!” / Hearing this word of his, he smilingly said to him:

1.3.s:
vayaṃ kaśyapadāyādā yūyaṃ sarve tathaiva ca..
yathā vayaṃ tathā yūyaṃ vigraho hi nirarthakaḥ.. 9.42 ..
1.3.d:
वयं कश्यपदायादा यूयं सर्वे तथैव च..
यथा वयं तथा यूयं विग्रहो हि निरर्थकः.. 9.42 ..
1.3.m: “We are descendants of Kaśyapa, and all of you are likewise; / as we are, so are you; indeed, conflict is useless.

1.3.s:
mama rājyaṃ kṣaṇenaiva nītaṃ daivavaśāttavayā..
tathā hyetāni tānyena ratnāni subahūnyapi..
gatāni tatkṣaṇādeva yatnānītāni vai tvayā.. 9.43 ..
1.3.d:
मम राज्यं क्षणेनैव नीतं दैववशात्तवया..
तथा ह्येतानि तान्येन रत्नानि सुबहून्यपि..
गतानि तत्क्षणादेव यत्नानीतानि वै त्वया.. 9.43 ..
1.3.m: My kingdom was taken in an instant by you through the power of fate; / likewise, those very numerous jewels, / which were obtained by great effort, were immediately lost to you.

1.3.s:
tasmādvimarśaḥ kartavyaḥ puruṣeṇa vipaścitā..
vimarśajjāyate jñānaṃ jñānānmokṣo bhaviṣyati.. 9.44 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्विमर्शः कर्तव्यः पुरुषेण विपश्चिता..
विमर्शज्जायते ज्ञानं ज्ञानान्मोक्षो भविष्यति.. 9.44 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, deliberation must be made by a wise man; / from deliberation arises knowledge, and from knowledge will come liberation.

1.3.s:
kiṃ tu me bata uktena jāne na ca tavāgrataḥ..
śaraṇārthī hyahaṃ prāptaḥ suraiḥ saha tavāṃtikam.. 9.45 ..
1.3.d:
किं तु मे बत उक्तेन जाने न च तवाग्रतः..
शरणार्थी ह्यहं प्राप्तः सुरैः सह तवांतिकम्.. 9.45 ..
1.3.m: Yet, what is the use of my speaking in front of you? / Seeking refuge, I have come into your presence together with the gods.”

1.3.s:
etacchrutvā tu śakrasya vākyaṃ vākyavidāṃ varaḥ..
prahasyovāca matimāñchakraṃ prati vidāṃ varaḥ.. 9.46 ..
1.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु शक्रस्य वाक्यं वाक्यविदां वरः..
प्रहस्योवाच मतिमाञ्छक्रं प्रति विदां वरः.. 9.46 ..
1.3.m: Hearing this speech of Śakra, the wise [king of Daityas], the best of speakers, / laughed and spoke to Śakra, best of the discerning:

1.3.s: tvamāgatosi deveṃdra kimarthaṃ tanna vedmayaham.. 9.47 ..
1.3.d: त्वमागतोसि देवेंद्र किमर्थं तन्न वेद्मयहम्.. 9.47 ..
1.3.m: “You have come, O Lord of gods; for what purpose, that I do not know.”

1.3.s:
śakrastadvacanaṃ śrutvā hyaśrupūrṇākulekṣaṇaḥ..
kiṃcinnovāca tatrainaṃ nārado vākyamabravīt.. 9.48 ..
1.3.d:
शक्रस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ह्यश्रुपूर्णाकुलेक्षणः..
किंचिन्नोवाच तत्रैनं नारदो वाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 9.48 ..
1.3.m: Hearing his word, Śakra’s eyes filled with tears in agitation; / he said nothing there, [so] Nārada spoke [these] words to him:

1.3.s:
bale tvaṃ kiṃ na jānāsi kāryākāryavicāraṇām..
dharmo hi mahatāmeṣa śaraṇāgatapālanam.. 9.49 ..
1.3.d:
बले त्वं किं न जानासि कार्याकार्यविचारणाम्..
धर्मो हि महतामेष शरणागतपालनम्.. 9.49 ..
1.3.m: “O Bali, do you not know the deliberation of what is to be done and not done? / For the duty of the great is the protection of one who has sought refuge.

1.3.s:
śaraṇāgataṃ ca vipraṃ ca rogiṇaṃ vṛddhameva ca..
yaetānna ca rakṣaṃti te vai brahmahaṇo narāḥ.. 9.50 ..
1.3.d:
शरणागतं च विप्रं च रोगिणं वृद्धमेव च..
यएतान्न च रक्षंति ते वै ब्रह्महणो नराः.. 9.50 ..
1.3.m: A suppliant who has sought refuge, a brahmin, a sick man, and an old man— / those men who do not protect them are indeed slayers of brahmins.

1.3.s:
śaraṇāgataśabdena āgatastava sannidhau..
saṃrakṣaṇāya yogyaśca tvayā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ..
evamukto nāradena tadā daityapatiḥ svayam.. 9.51 ..
1.3.d:
शरणागतशब्देन आगतस्तव सन्निधौ..
संरक्षणाय योग्यश्च त्वया नास्त्यत्र संशयः..
एवमुक्तो नारदेन तदा दैत्यपतिः स्वयम्.. 9.51 ..
1.3.m: By the word ‘one who has sought refuge’, he has come into your presence; / he is worthy to be protected by you; of this there is no doubt.” / Being thus addressed by Nārada, the lord of the Daityas himself then,

1.3.s:
vimṛśya parayā buddhyā kāryākāryavicāraṇām..
śakraṃ prapūjayāmāsa bahumānapuraḥsaram..
lokapālaiḥ sametaṃ ca tathā suragaṇaiḥ saha.. 9.52 ..
1.3.d:
विमृश्य परया बुद्ध्या कार्याकार्यविचारणाम्..
शक्रं प्रपूजयामास बहुमानपुरःसरम्..
लोकपालैः समेतं च तथा सुरगणैः सह.. 9.52 ..
1.3.m: having deliberated with supreme intellect upon what should and should not be done, / honored Śakra with great respect, / together with the world-protectors and the hosts of gods.

1.3.s:
pratyayārthaṃ ca sattvāni hyanekāni vratāni vai..
balipratyayabhūtāni sa cakāraḥ puraṃdaraḥ.. 9.53 ..
1.3.d:
प्रत्ययार्थं च सत्त्वानि ह्यनेकानि व्रतानि वै..
बलिप्रत्ययभूतानि स चकारः पुरंदरः.. 9.53 ..
1.3.m: And for the sake of creating trust, Purandara performed / many vows and pledges that served to reassure Bali.

1.3.s:
evaṃ sa samayaṃ kṛtvā śakraḥ svārthaparāyaṇaḥ..
balinā saha cāvāsīdarthaśāstraparo mahān.. 9.54 ..
1.3.d:
एवं स समयं कृत्वा शक्रः स्वार्थपरायणः..
बलिना सह चावासीदर्थशास्त्रपरो महान्.. 9.54 ..
1.3.m: Having thus made an agreement, Śakra, intent on his own goal, / dwelt together with Bali, being greatly versed in the science of polity.

1.3.s:
evaṃ nivasatastasya sutale'pi śatakratoḥ..
vatsarā bahavo hyāsaṃstadā buddhimakalpayat..
saṃsmṛtya vacanaṃ viṣṇorvimṛśya ca punaḥpunaḥ.. 9.55 ..
1.3.d:
एवं निवसतस्तस्य सुतलेऽपि शतक्रतोः..
वत्सरा बहवो ह्यासंस्तदा बुद्धिमकल्पयत्..
संस्मृत्य वचनं विष्णोर्विमृश्य च पुनःपुनः.. 9.55 ..
1.3.m: As Śatakratu was thus dwelling in Sutala, / many years passed; then, remembering the word of Viṣṇu / and deliberating again and again, he formed a plan.

1.3.s:
ekadā tu sabhāmadhya āsīno devarāṭ‌svayam..
uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ balimuddiśya nītimān.. 9.56 ..
1.3.d:
एकदा तु सभामध्य आसीनो देवराट्‌स्वयम्..
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं बलिमुद्दिश्य नीतिमान्.. 9.56 ..
1.3.m: Once, seated in the assembly, the king of gods himself, / versed in policy, smilingly spoke words addressed to Bali:

1.3.s:
prāptavyāni tvayā vīra asmākaṃ ca tvayā bale..
gajādīni bahūnyeva ratnāni vividhāni ca.. 9.57 ..
1.3.d:
प्राप्तव्यानि त्वया वीर अस्माकं च त्वया बले..
गजादीनि बहून्येव रत्नानि विविधानि च.. 9.57 ..
1.3.m: “O hero, [all those things] should be regained by you, and by us through you, O Bali— / the many diverse jewels such as elephants and others,

1.3.s:
gatāni tatkṣaṇādeva sāgare patitāni vai..
prayatno hi prakartavyo hyasmābhistvayānvitaiḥ.. 9.58 ..
1.3.d:
गतानि तत्क्षणादेव सागरे पतितानि वै..
प्रयत्नो हि प्रकर्तव्यो ह्यस्माभिस्त्वयान्वितैः.. 9.58 ..
1.3.m: which were lost in an instant and indeed fell into the ocean; / an effort must indeed be made by us together with you.

1.3.s:
teṣāṃ coddharaṇe daitya ratnānāmiha sāgarāt..
tarhi nirmathanaṃ kāryaṃ bhavatā kāryasiddhaye.. 9.59 ..
1.3.d:
तेषां चोद्धरणे दैत्य रत्नानामिह सागरात्..
तर्हि निर्मथनं कार्यं भवता कार्यसिद्धये.. 9.59 ..
1.3.m: For the recovery of those jewels from the ocean here, O Daitya, / the churning must be carried out by you for the accomplishment of the purpose.”

1.3.s:
baliḥ pravartitastena śakreṇa surasūdanaḥ..
uvāca śakraṃ tvaritaḥ kenedaṃ mathanaṃ bhavet.. 9.60 ..
1.3.d:
बलिः प्रवर्तितस्तेन शक्रेण सुरसूदनः..
उवाच शक्रं त्वरितः केनेदं मथनं भवेत्.. 9.60 ..
1.3.m: Bali, the slayer of gods, being prompted by that Śakra, / promptly said to Śakra: “By what means can this churning take place?”

1.3.s:
tadā nabhogatā vāṇī meghagaṃbhīraniḥsvanā..
uvāca devā daityāśca maṃthadhvaṃ kṣīrasāgaram.. 9.61 ..
1.3.d:
तदा नभोगता वाणी मेघगंभीरनिःस्वना..
उवाच देवा दैत्याश्च मंथध्वं क्षीरसागरम्.. 9.61 ..
1.3.m: Then a voice residing in the sky, resounding deeply like a thundercloud, / spoke: “O gods and Daityas, churn the milk-ocean!

1.3.s: bhavatāṃ balavṛddhiśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ.. 9.62 ..
1.3.d: भवतां बलवृद्धिश्च भविष्यति न संशयः.. 9.62 ..
1.3.m: An increase of strength will come to you, there is no doubt.

1.3.s:
maṃdaraṃ caiva maṃthānaṃ rajjuṃ kuruta vāsukim..
paścāddevāśca daityāśca melayitvā vimathyatām.. 9.63 ..
1.3.d:
मंदरं चैव मंथानं रज्जुं कुरुत वासुकिम्..
पश्चाद्देवाश्च दैत्याश्च मेलयित्वा विमथ्यताम्.. 9.63 ..
1.3.m: Make Mandara the churning rod and Vāsuki the rope; / then, having united, let gods and Daityas churn!”

1.3.s:
nabhogatāṃ ca tāṃ vāṇīṃ niśamyātha tadāḥsurāḥ..
daityaiḥ sārddhaṃ tataḥ sarva udyamaṃ cakrurudyatāḥ.. 9.64 ..
1.3.d:
नभोगतां च तां वाणीं निशम्याथ तदाःसुराः..
दैत्यैः सार्द्धं ततः सर्व उद्यमं चक्रुरुद्यताः.. 9.64 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that voice residing in the sky, the gods / along with the Daityas, all becoming eager, made an effort.

1.3.s:
pātālānnirgatāḥ sarve tadā te'tha surāsurāḥ..
ājagmuratulaṃ sarve maṃdaraṃ parvatottamam.. 9.65 ..
1.3.d:
पातालान्निर्गताः सर्वे तदा तेऽथ सुरासुराः..
आजग्मुरतुलं सर्वे मंदरं पर्वतोत्तमम्.. 9.65 ..
1.3.m: Having emerged from Pātāla, all those gods and demons then / came to the incomparable Mandara, the excellent mountain.

1.3.s:
daityāśca koṭisaṃkhyākāstathā devā na saṃśayaḥ..
udyuktāḥ sahasā prā'yurmaṃdaraṃ kanakaprabham.. 9.66 ..
1.3.d:
दैत्याश्च कोटिसंख्याकास्तथा देवा न संशयः..
उद्युक्ताः सहसा प्राऽयुर्मंदरं कनकप्रभम्.. 9.66 ..
1.3.m: Daityas numbering in crores, and likewise gods, without doubt, / being prepared, quickly approached Mandara shining like gold,

1.3.s:
saratnaṃ vartulākāraṃ sthūlaṃ caiva mahāprabham..
anekaratnasaṃvītaṃ nānādrumaniṣevitam.. 9.67 ..
1.3.d:
सरत्नं वर्तुलाकारं स्थूलं चैव महाप्रभम्..
अनेकरत्नसंवीतं नानाद्रुमनिषेवितम्.. 9.67 ..
