1.3.m: rich in gems, rounded in form, massive and of great splendor, / covered with numerous jewels, frequented by various trees,

1.3.s:
caṃdanaiḥ pārijātaiśca nāgapunnāgacaṃpakaiḥ..
nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇaṃ siṃhaśārdūlasevitam.. 9.68 ..
1.3.d:
चंदनैः पारिजातैश्च नागपुन्नागचंपकैः..
नानामृगगणाकीर्णं सिंहशार्दूलसेवितम्.. 9.68 ..
1.3.m: with sandalwoods, pārijātas, nāgas, punnāgas, and campakas, / crowded with hosts of diverse animals, and frequented by lions and tigers.

1.3.s:
mahāśailaṃ dṛṣṭvā te surasattamāḥ..
ūcuḥ prāṃjalayaḥ sarve tadā te surasattamāḥ.. 9.69 ..
1.3.d:
महाशैलं दृष्ट्वा ते सुरसत्तमाः..
ऊचुः प्रांजलयः सर्वे तदा ते सुरसत्तमाः.. 9.69 ..
1.3.m: Having seen that great mountain, those foremost among the gods, / with folded hands, all those foremost among the gods then spoke:

1.3.s:
..devā ūcuḥ..
adre surā vayaṃ sarve vijñaptumiha cāgatāḥ..
tacchṛṇuṣva mahāśaila pareṣāmupakārakaḥ.. 9.70 ..
1.3.d:
..देवा ऊचुः..
अद्रे सुरा वयं सर्वे विज्ञप्तुमिह चागताः..
तच्छृणुष्व महाशैल परेषामुपकारकः.. 9.70 ..
1.3.m: The gods said: / “O mountain, all of us gods have come here to make a request; / listen to that, O great mountain, you who are a benefactor to others!”

1.3.s:
evamuktastadā śailo davairdaityaiḥ sa maṃdaraḥ..
uvāca niḥsṛto bhūtvā paraṃ vigrahavānvacaḥ.. 9.71 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तदा शैलो दवैर्दैत्यैः स मंदरः..
उवाच निःसृतो भूत्वा परं विग्रहवान्वचः.. 9.71 ..
1.3.m: Addressed thus by the gods and daityas, Mount Mandara, / stepping forth in bodily form, spoke this supreme word:

1.3.s:
tena rūpeṇa rūpī sa parvato maṃdarācalaḥ..
kimarthamāgatāḥ sarve matsamīpaṃ taducyatām.. 9.72 ..
1.3.d:
तेन रूपेण रूपी स पर्वतो मंदराचलः..
किमर्थमागताः सर्वे मत्समीपं तदुच्यताम्.. 9.72 ..
1.3.m: In that form, embodied, Mount Mandarācala [said]: / “For what purpose have you all come before me? Let it be told.”

1.3.s:
tadā baliruvācedaṃ prastāvasadṛśaṃ vacaḥ..
iṃdropi tvarayā yukto babhāṣe sūnṛtaṃ vacaḥ.. 9.73 ..
1.3.d:
तदा बलिरुवाचेदं प्रस्तावसदृशं वचः..
इंद्रोपि त्वरया युक्तो बभाषे सूनृतं वचः.. 9.73 ..
1.3.m: Then Bali spoke this word suitable to the occasion, / and Indra also, filled with haste, uttered truthful speech:

1.3.s:
asmābhiḥ saha kāryārthe bhava tvaṃ maṃdarācala..
amṛtotpādanārthe tvaṃ maṃthānaṃ bhava suvrata.. 9.74 ..
1.3.d:
अस्माभिः सह कार्यार्थे भव त्वं मंदराचल..
अमृतोत्पादनार्थे त्वं मंथानं भव सुव्रत.. 9.74 ..
1.3.m: “Be with us for the sake of an undertaking, O Mount Mandarācala! / For the churning of nectar, become the churning rod, O you of noble vows!”

1.3.s:
tatheti matvā tadvākyaṃ devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye..
ūce devāsurāṃścedamindraṃ prati viśeṣataḥ.. 9.75 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा तद्वाक्यं देवानां कार्यसिद्धये..
ऊचे देवासुरांश्चेदमिन्द्रं प्रति विशेषतः.. 9.75 ..
1.3.m: Accepting their words, saying “So be it,” for the success of the gods’ purpose, / he addressed the gods and asuras, especially toward Indra:

1.3.s:
cheditau ca tvayā pakṣau vajreṇa śataparvaṇā..
gaṃtuṃ kathaṃ samartho'haṃ bhavatāṃ kāryasiddhaye.. 9.76 ..
1.3.d:
छेदितौ च त्वया पक्षौ वज्रेण शतपर्वणा..
गंतुं कथं समर्थोऽहं भवतां कार्यसिद्धये.. 9.76 ..
1.3.m: “Both my wings were severed by you with your hundred-jointed thunderbolt. / How can I go for the accomplishment of your undertaking?”

1.3.s:
tadā devāsurāḥ sarve stūyamānā mahācalam..
utpāṭayeyuratulaṃ maṃdaraṃ ca tatodbhutam.. 9.77 ..
1.3.d:
तदा देवासुराः सर्वे स्तूयमाना महाचलम्..
उत्पाटयेयुरतुलं मंदरं च ततोद्भुतम्.. 9.77 ..
1.3.m: Then all the gods and asuras, singing praises to the great mountain, / uprooted the matchless and wonderful Mandara.

1.3.s:
kṣīrārṇavaṃ netukāmā hyaśaktāste tato'bhavan..
parvataḥ patitaḥ sadyo devadaityopari dhruvam.. 9.78 ..
1.3.d:
क्षीरार्णवं नेतुकामा ह्यशक्तास्ते ततोऽभवन्..
पर्वतः पतितः सद्यो देवदैत्योपरि ध्रुवम्.. 9.78 ..
1.3.m: Wishing to carry it to the ocean of milk, they were unable; / forthwith the mountain surely crashed down upon the gods and daityas.

1.3.s:
kecidbhagnā mṛtāḥ kecitkecinmūrchāparā bhavan..
parīvādaratāḥ kecitkecitkleśatvamāgatāḥ.. 9.79 ..
1.3.d:
केचिद्भग्ना मृताः केचित्केचिन्मूर्छापरा भवन्..
परीवादरताः केचित्केचित्क्लेशत्वमागताः.. 9.79 ..
1.3.m: Some were broken, some were dead, some fell into a faint, / some engaged in lamentation, and some fell into deep distress.

1.3.s:
evaṃ bhagnodyamā jātā asurāḥsuradānavāḥ..
cetanāṃ paramāṃ prāptāstuṣṭuvurjagadīśvaram.. 9.80 ..
1.3.d:
एवं भग्नोद्यमा जाता असुराःसुरदानवाः..
चेतनां परमां प्राप्तास्तुष्टुवुर्जगदीश्वरम्.. 9.80 ..
1.3.m: Thus thwarted in their effort, the asuras, gods, and dānavas, / regaining supreme consciousness, praised the Lord of the Universe:

1.3.s:
rakṣarakṣa mahāviṣṇo śaraṇāgatavatsala..
tvayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ jaṃgamājaṃgamaṃ ca yat.. 9.81 ..
1.3.d:
रक्षरक्ष महाविष्णो शरणागतवत्सल..
त्वया ततमिदं सर्वं जंगमाजंगमं च यत्.. 9.81 ..
1.3.m: “Protect, protect, O Mahāviṣṇu, affectionate to those who take refuge! / By you is all this pervaded, both moving and unmoving.”

1.3.s:
devānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ prādurbhūto haristadā..
tāndṛṣṭvā sahasā viṣṇurgaruḍopari saṃsthitaḥ.. 9.82 ..
1.3.d:
देवानां कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थं प्रादुर्भूतो हरिस्तदा..
तान्दृष्ट्वा सहसा विष्णुर्गरुडोपरि संस्थितः.. 9.82 ..
1.3.m: Then Hari manifested himself for the accomplishment of the gods' purpose. / Seeing them suddenly, Viṣṇu mounted upon Garuḍa,

1.3.s:
līlayā parvataśreṣṭhamuttabhyāropayatkṣaṇāt..
garutmati tadā devaḥ sarveṣāmabhayaṃ dadau.. 9.83 ..
1.3.d:
लीलया पर्वतश्रेष्ठमुत्तभ्यारोपयत्क्षणात्..
गरुत्मति तदा देवः सर्वेषामभयं ददौ.. 9.83 ..
1.3.m: playfully lifted that best of mountains and set it in an instant / upon Garutmat; then the god granted fearlessness to all.

1.3.s:
tata utthāya tāndevānkṣīrosyottaraṃ taṭam..
nītvā taṃ parvataṃ vṛddhaṃ nikṣipyāpsu tato yayau.. 9.84 ..
1.3.d:
तत उत्थाय तान्देवान्क्षीरोस्योत्तरं तटम्..
नीत्वा तं पर्वतं वृद्धं निक्षिप्याप्सु ततो ययौ.. 9.84 ..
1.3.m: Then, having raised up those gods, he carried that ancient mountain / to the northern shore of the milk ocean, placed it in the waters, and went away.

1.3.s:
tadā sarve suragaṇāḥ svāgatya asuraiḥ saha..
vāsukiṃ ca samādāya cakrire samayaṃca tam.. 9.85 ..
1.3.d:
तदा सर्वे सुरगणाः स्वागत्य असुरैः सह..
वासुकिं च समादाय चक्रिरे समयंच तम्.. 9.85 ..
1.3.m: Then all the hosts of gods, having arrived together with the asuras, / took hold of Vāsuki and made an agreement:

1.3.s:
maṃthānaṃ maṃdaraṃ caiva vāsukiṃ rajjumeva ca..
kṛtvā surā'surāḥ sarve mamaṃthuḥ śrīrasāgaram.. 9.86 ..
1.3.d:
मंथानं मंदरं चैव वासुकिं रज्जुमेव च..
कृत्वा सुराऽसुराः सर्वे ममंथुः श्रीरसागरम्.. 9.86 ..
1.3.m: Making Mandara the churning rod and Vāsuki the rope, / all the gods and asuras churned the ocean of milk.

1.3.s:
kṣīrābdhermathyamānasya parvato hi rasātalam..
gataḥ sa tatkṣaṇādeva kūrmo bhūtvā ramāpatiḥ..
uddhṛtastatkṣaṇādeva tadadbhutamivābhavat.. 9.87 ..
1.3.d:
क्षीराब्धेर्मथ्यमानस्य पर्वतो हि रसातलम्..
गतः स तत्क्षणादेव कूर्मो भूत्वा रमापतिः..
उद्धृतस्तत्क्षणादेव तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्.. 9.87 ..
1.3.m: As the ocean of milk was being churned, the mountain sank to Rasātala; / but becoming a tortoise at that very instant, the Lord of Ramā / lifted it immediately, which was like a wonder.

1.3.s:
bhrāmyamāṇastataḥ śailo noditaḥ suradānavaiḥ..
bhramamāṇo nirādhāro bodhaśceva guruṃ vinā.. 9.88 ..
1.3.d:
भ्राम्यमाणस्ततः शैलो नोदितः सुरदानवैः..
भ्रममाणो निराधारो बोधश्चेव गुरुं विना.. 9.88 ..
1.3.m: The mountain was then whirled, urged on by the gods and dānavas, / spinning without a support, like understanding without a guru.

1.3.s:
paramātmā tadā viṣṇurādhāro maṃdarasya ca..
dorbhiścaturbhiḥ saṃgṛhya mamaṃthābdhiṃ sukhāvaham.. 9.89 ..
1.3.d:
परमात्मा तदा विष्णुराधारो मंदरस्य च..
दोर्भिश्चतुर्भिः संगृह्य ममंथाब्धिं सुखावहम्.. 9.89 ..
1.3.m: The Supreme Self, Viṣṇu, then became the support of Mandara; / grasping it with his four arms, he churned the ocean, bringing delight.

1.3.s:
tadā surāsurāḥ sarve mamaṃthuḥ kṣīrasāgaram..
ekībhūtvā balenaivamatimātraṃ balotkaṭāḥ.. 9.90 ..
1.3.d:
तदा सुरासुराः सर्वे ममंथुः क्षीरसागरम्..
एकीभूत्वा बलेनैवमतिमात्रं बलोत्कटाः.. 9.90 ..
1.3.m: Then all the gods and asuras churned the ocean of milk, / united in force, exceedingly mighty in power.

1.3.s:
pṛṣṭhakaṃṭhorujānvaṃtaḥ kamaṭhasya mahātmanaḥ..
tathāsau parvataśreṣṭho vajrasāramayo dṛḍhaḥ..
ubhayorgharṣaṇādeva vaḍavāgniḥ samutthitaḥ.. 9.91 ..
1.3.d:
पृष्ठकंठोरुजान्वंतः कमठस्य महात्मनः..
तथासौ पर्वतश्रेष्ठो वज्रसारमयो दृढः..
उभयोर्घर्षणादेव वडवाग्निः समुत्थितः.. 9.91 ..
1.3.m: Between the back, neck, thighs, and knees of that great-souled tortoise, / that best of mountains, firm and made of the essence of diamond, [rubbed]; / and from the friction of both, the submarine fire arose.

1.3.s:
halāhalaṃ ca saṃjātaṃ tadṝṣṭvā nāradena hi..
tato devānuvācedaṃ devarṣiramitadyutiḥ.. 9.92 ..
1.3.d:
हलाहलं च संजातं तदॄष्ट्वा नारदेन हि..
ततो देवानुवाचेदं देवर्षिरमितद्युतिः.. 9.92 ..
1.3.m: And the halāhala poison was generated. Seeing that indeed, / Nārada, the divine seer of boundless brilliance, then spoke to the gods:

1.3.s:
na kāryaṃ mathanaṃ cābdherbhavadbhiradhunā'khilaiḥ..
prārthayadhvaṃ śivaṃ devāḥ sarve dakṣasya yājanam..
tadvismṛtiṃ ca voyātaṃ vīrabhadreṇa yatkṛtam.. 9.93 ..
1.3.d:
न कार्यं मथनं चाब्धेर्भवद्भिरधुनाऽखिलैः..
प्रार्थयध्वं शिवं देवाः सर्वे दक्षस्य याजनम्..
तद्विस्मृतिं च वोयातं वीरभद्रेण यत्कृतम्.. 9.93 ..
1.3.m: “The churning of the ocean should not be done by all of you right now. / Pray to Śiva, O gods! Dakṣa’s sacrifice— / has what was done by Vīrabhadra faded from your memory?

1.3.s:
tasmācchivaḥ smaryatāṃ cāśu devāḥ paraḥ parāṇāmapi vā paraśca..
parātparaḥ paramānaṃdarūpo yogidhyeyo niṣprapaṃco hyarūpaḥ.. 9.94 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माच्छिवः स्मर्यतां चाशु देवाः परः पराणामपि वा परश्च..
परात्परः परमानंदरूपो योगिध्येयो निष्प्रपंचो ह्यरूपः.. 9.94 ..
1.3.m: Therefore let Śiva be remembered quickly, O gods! He is higher even than the highest, / higher than the highest, the nature of supreme bliss, to be meditated on by yogins, free from phenomenal reality, formless.”

1.3.s:
te mathyamānāstvaritā devāḥ svātmārthasādhakāḥ..
abhilāṣaparāḥ sarve na śrṛṇvaṃti yato jaḍāḥ.. 9.95 ..
1.3.d:
ते मथ्यमानास्त्वरिता देवाः स्वात्मार्थसाधकाः..
अभिलाषपराः सर्वे न श्रृण्वंति यतो जडाः.. 9.95 ..
1.3.m: Those gods, churning in haste, bent on accomplishing their own aims, / all intent on desire, did not listen, since they were dull-witted.

1.3.s:
upadeśaiśca bahubhirnopadeśyāḥ kadācana..
te rāgadveṣasaṃghātāḥ sarve śivaparāṅ‌mukhāḥ.. 9.96 ..
1.3.d:
उपदेशैश्च बहुभिर्नोपदेश्याः कदाचन..
ते रागद्वेषसंघाताः सर्वे शिवपराङ्‌मुखाः.. 9.96 ..
1.3.m: Even with many instructions they could not be instructed; / possessed of aggregates of passion and hatred, they all turned their faces away from Śiva.

1.3.s:
kevalodyamasaṃvītā mamaṃthuḥ kṣīrasāgaram..
atinirmathanājjātaṃ kṣīrābdheścahalāhalam.. 9.97 ..
1.3.d:
केवलोद्यमसंवीता ममंथुः क्षीरसागरम्..
अतिनिर्मथनाज्जातं क्षीराब्धेश्चहलाहलम्.. 9.97 ..
1.3.m: Engrossed solely in their enterprise, they churned the ocean of milk; / from that excessive churning of the milk ocean, the halāhala arose.

1.3.s:
trailokyadahane prauḍhaṃ prāptaṃ haṃtuṃ divaukasaḥ..
ata ūrdhvaṃ diśaḥ sarvā vyāptaṃ kṛtsnaṃ nabhastalam..
grasituṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ kālakūṭaṃ samabhyayāt.. 9.98 ..
1.3.d:
त्रैलोक्यदहने प्रौढं प्राप्तं हंतुं दिवौकसः..
अत ऊर्ध्वं दिशः सर्वा व्याप्तं कृत्स्नं नभस्तलम्..
ग्रसितुं सर्वभूतानां कालकूटं समभ्ययात्.. 9.98 ..
1.3.m: Mighty enough to burn the three worlds, it approached to destroy the gods. / Rising upward, it pervaded all the directions and the entire vault of the sky; / the kālakūṭa poison rushed forward to devour all living beings.

1.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā bṛhaṃtaṃ svakarasthamojasā taṃ sarparājaṃ saha parvatena..
tatraiva hitvāpayayustadānīṃ palāyamānā hyasuraiḥ sametāḥ.. 9.99 ..
1.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा बृहंतं स्वकरस्थमोजसा तं सर्पराजं सह पर्वतेन..
तत्रैव हित्वापययुस्तदानीं पलायमाना ह्यसुरैः समेताः.. 9.99 ..
1.3.m: Seeing that mighty king of serpents together with the mountain in their hands by its force, / abandoning it right there, they fled at that moment, fleeing together with the asuras.

1.3.s:
tathaiva sarva ṛṣayo bhṛgvādyāḥ śataśāmyati..
dakṣasya yajanaṃ tena yathā jātaṃ tathābhavat.. 9.100 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव सर्व ऋषयो भृग्वाद्याः शतशाम्यति..
दक्षस्य यजनं तेन यथा जातं तथाभवत्.. 9.100 ..
1.3.m: Likewise all the seers, Bhṛgu and others, by the hundreds, had calmed down; / just as happened at Dakṣa’s sacrifice, so it happened then.

1.3.s:
satyalokaṃ gatāḥ sarve bhuguṇā noditā bhṛśam..
vedavākyaiśca vividhaiḥ kālakūṭaṃ śataśastataḥ..
devā nāstyatra saṃdehaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmi vaḥ.. 9.101 ..
1.3.d:
सत्यलोकं गताः सर्वे भुगुणा नोदिता भृशम्..
वेदवाक्यैश्च विविधैः कालकूटं शतशस्ततः..
देवा नास्त्यत्र संदेहः सत्यं सत्यं वदामि वः.. 9.101 ..
1.3.m: All went to Satyaloka, urged urgently by Bhṛgu / with various Vedic utterances: “From the kālakūṭa hundreds [of perils come], / O gods, there is no doubt here; truth, the truth I speak to you!”

1.3.s:
bhṛguṇoktaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā kālakūṭaviṣārdditāḥ..
satyalokaṃ samāsādya brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ.. 9.102 ..
1.3.d:
भृगुणोक्तं वचः श्रुत्वा कालकूटविषार्द्दिताः..
सत्यलोकं समासाद्य ब्रह्माणं शरणं ययुः.. 9.102 ..
1.3.m: Hearing the speech spoken by Bhṛgu, afflicted by the kālakūṭa poison, / reaching Satyaloka, they went to Brahmā for refuge.

1.3.s:
tadā jājvalyamānaṃ vai kālakūṭaṃ prabhojjavalam..
dṛṣṭvā brahmātha tāndṛṣṭvā hyakarmajñānasurāsurān..
teṣāṃ śapitumārebhe nāradena nivāritaḥ.. 9.103 ..
1.3.d:
तदा जाज्वल्यमानं वै कालकूटं प्रभोज्जवलम्..
दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्माथ तान्दृष्ट्वा ह्यकर्मज्ञानसुरासुरान्..
तेषां शपितुमारेभे नारदेन निवारितः.. 9.103 ..
1.3.m: Seeing that blazing kālakūṭa, shining with radiance, / and seeing those gods and asuras ignorant of proper rites and knowledge, / Brahmā began to curse them, but was restrained by Nārada.

1.3.s:
..brahmovāca..
akāryaṃ kiṃ kṛtaṃ devāḥ kasmātkṣobhoyamudyataḥ..
īśvarasya ca jāto'dya nānyathā mama bhāṣitam.. 9.104 ..
1.3.d:
..ब्रह्मोवाच..
अकार्यं किं कृतं देवाः कस्मात्क्षोभोयमुद्यतः..
ईश्वरस्य च जातोऽद्य नान्यथा मम भाषितम्.. 9.104 ..
1.3.m: Brahmā said: / “What improper deed has been done, O gods? Whence has this agitation arisen? / Today it belongs to Īśvara; my speech is not otherwise!”

1.3.s:
tato devaiḥ parivṛto vedopaniṣadaistathā..
nānāgamaiḥ parivṛtaḥ kālakūṭabhayādyayau.. 9.105 ..
1.3.d:
ततो देवैः परिवृतो वेदोपनिषदैस्तथा..
नानागमैः परिवृतः कालकूटभयाद्ययौ.. 9.105 ..
1.3.m: Then, surrounded by the gods, by the Vedas and the Upaniṣads, / and surrounded by various Āgamas, he departed out of fear of the kālakūṭa.

1.3.s:
tataściṃtānvitā devā idamūcuḥ parasparam..
avidyākāmasaṃvītāḥ kuryāmaḥ śaṃkaraṃ ca kam.. 9.106 ..
1.3.d:
ततश्चिंतान्विता देवा इदमूचुः परस्परम्..
अविद्याकामसंवीताः कुर्यामः शंकरं च कम्.. 9.106 ..
1.3.m: Then the gods, filled with worry, said this to one another: / “Enveloped in ignorance and desire, to what Śaṃkara shall we turn?”

1.3.s:
brahmāṇaṃ ca puraskṛtya tadā devāstvarānvitāḥ..
vaikuṇṭhamāvrajansarve kālakūṭa bhayārdditāḥ.. 9.107 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्माणं च पुरस्कृत्य तदा देवास्त्वरान्विताः..
वैकुण्ठमाव्रजन्सर्वे कालकूट भयार्द्दिताः.. 9.107 ..
1.3.m: Placing Brahmā at their head, the gods, filled with haste / and afflicted by fear of the kālakūṭa, all went to Vaikuṇṭha.

1.3.s:
brahmādayaścarṣigaṇāśca tadā pareśaṃ viṣṇuṃ purāṇapuruṣaṃ prabhaviṣṇumīśam..
vaikuṇṭhamāśritamadhokṣajamādhavaṃ te sarve surāsuragaṇāḥ śaraṇaṃ prayātāḥ.. 9.108 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मादयश्चर्षिगणाश्च तदा परेशं विष्णुं पुराणपुरुषं प्रभविष्णुमीशम्..
वैकुण्ठमाश्रितमधोक्षजमाधवं ते सर्वे सुरासुरगणाः शरणं प्रयाताः.. 9.108 ..
1.3.m: Then Brahmā and the hosts of seers, together with all the hosts of gods and asuras, / went for refuge to the Supreme Lord Viṣṇu, the ancient Person, the powerful Ruler, / Adhokṣaja, Mādhava, who abides in Vaikuṇṭha.

1.3.s:
tāvatpravṛddhaṃ sumahatkālakūṭaṃ samabhyayāt..
dagdhvādo brahmaṇo lokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca dadāha vai.. 9.109 ..
1.3.d:
तावत्प्रवृद्धं सुमहत्कालकूटं समभ्ययात्..
दग्ध्वादो ब्रह्मणो लोकं वैकुण्ठं च ददाह वै.. 9.109 ..
1.3.m: Meanwhile, the immense, swollen kālakūṭa came on; / having first burned the world of Brahmā, it burned Vaikuṇṭha as well.

1.3.s:
kālakūṭāgninā dagdho viṣṇuḥ sarvaguhāśayaḥ..
pārṣadaiḥ sahitaḥ sadyastamālasadṛśacchaviḥ.. 9.110 ..
1.3.d:
कालकूटाग्निना दग्धो विष्णुः सर्वगुहाशयः..
पार्षदैः सहितः सद्यस्तमालसदृशच्छविः.. 9.110 ..
1.3.m: Burned by the fire of the kālakūṭa, Viṣṇu, who dwells in the hearts of all, / along with his attendants, instantly assumed a dark complexion like a tamāla tree.

1.3.s:
vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca sunīlaṃ ca sarvalokaiḥ samāvṛtam..
jalakalmaṣasaṃvītāḥ sarve lokāstadābhavan.. 9.111 ..
1.3.d:
वैकुण्ठं च सुनीलं च सर्वलोकैः समावृतम्..
जलकल्मषसंवीताः सर्वे लोकास्तदाभवन्.. 9.111 ..
1.3.m: And Vaikuṇṭha, deep blue and filled with all worlds, / all those worlds then became enveloped in the poison of the water.

1.3.s:
aṣṭāvaraṇasaṃvītaṃ brahmāṃḍaṃ brahmaṇā saha..
bhasmībhūtaṃ cakārāśu jalakalmaṣamadbhutam.. 9.112 ..
1.3.d:
अष्टावरणसंवीतं ब्रह्मांडं ब्रह्मणा सह..
भस्मीभूतं चकाराशु जलकल्मषमद्भुतम्.. 9.112 ..
1.3.m: Encompassed by the eight coverings together with Brahmā, the cosmic egg / was swiftly reduced to ashes by that wondrous poison of the water.

1.3.s:
nobhūmirna jalaṃ cāgnirna vāyurna nabhastadā..
nāhaṃkāro na ca mahānmūlāvidyā tathaiva ca..
śivasya kopātsaṃjātaṃ tadā bhasmākulaṃ jagat.. 9.113 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇaṃ ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathamamāheśvarakhaṇḍāntargate kedārakhaṇḍe navamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 9 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
नोभूमिर्न जलं चाग्निर्न वायुर्न नभस्तदा..
नाहंकारो न च महान्मूलाविद्या तथैव च..
शिवस्य कोपात्संजातं तदा भस्माकुलं जगत्.. 9.113 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराणं एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथममाहेश्वरखण्डान्तर्गते केदारखण्डे नवमोऽध्यायः.. 9 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
There was no earth, no water, no fire, no wind, and no space then; / there was no ego-sense, no cosmic intellect, and likewise no primal ignorance. / From the wrath of Śiva, the universe then became a mass of ashes.
Thus ends the ninth chapter in the Kedārakhaṇḍa within the first Māheśvarakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

1.3.s:
..munaya ūcuḥ..
yattvayā kathitaṃ brahmanbrahmāṃḍaṃ sacarācaram..
bhasmībhūtaṃ rudrakopātkālakūṭāgninā'tha़khilam.. 10.1 ..
1.3.d:
..मुनय ऊचुः..
यत्त्वया कथितं ब्रह्मन्ब्रह्मांडं सचराचरम्..
भस्मीभूतं रुद्रकोपात्कालकूटाग्निनाऽथ़खिलम्.. 10.1 ..
1.3.m: The sages said: / O brahmin, as you have related that the entire cosmic egg with its moving and unmoving beings / was burned to ashes by the fire of the kālakūṭa poison through Rudra's wrath,

1.3.s:
brahmāṃḍāṃtarataḥ kiṃ tu rudraṃ manyāmahe vayam..
tadā carācaraṃ naṣṭaṃ brahmaviṣṇupurogamam.. 10.2 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मांडांतरतः किं तु रुद्रं मन्यामहे वयम्..
तदा चराचरं नष्टं ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरोगमम्.. 10.2 ..
1.3.m: yet we consider Rudra to be within the cosmic egg. / When everything moving and unmoving was destroyed, headed by Brahmā and Viṣṇu,

1.3.s:
bhasmībhūtaṃ rudrakopātkathaṃ sṛṣṭiḥ pravartitā..
kuto brahmā ca viṣṇuśca kutaścaṃdrapurogamāḥ.. 10.3 ..
1.3.d:
भस्मीभूतं रुद्रकोपात्कथं सृष्टिः प्रवर्तिता..
कुतो ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च कुतश्चंद्रपुरोगमाः.. 10.3 ..
1.3.m: and reduced to ashes through Rudra's wrath, how did creation proceed? / Whence came Brahmā and Viṣṇu, and whence came the moon and the others?

1.3.s:
anye surā surāḥ kutra bhasmībhūtā layaṃ gatāḥ..
ata ūrdhvaṃ kimabhavattatsarvaṃ vaktumarhasi.. 10.4 ..
1.3.d:
अन्ये सुरा सुराः कुत्र भस्मीभूता लयं गताः..
अत ऊर्ध्वं किमभवत्तत्सर्वं वक्तुमर्हसि.. 10.4 ..
1.3.m: Where were the other gods? Where were the demons when they were reduced to ashes and dissolved? / You ought to tell us all of what happened after that.

1.3.s:
vyāsaprasādātsakalaṃ vettha tvaṃ nāparo hi tat..
tasmājjñānamayaṃ śāstraṃ tajjānāsi na cāparaḥ.. 10.5 ..
1.3.d:
व्यासप्रसादात्सकलं वेत्थ त्वं नापरो हि तत्..
तस्माज्ज्ञानमयं शास्त्रं तज्जानासि न चापरः.. 10.5 ..
1.3.m: Through the grace of Vyāsa, you know everything, and no one else; / therefore you know that scripture filled with knowledge, and no one else does.

1.3.s:
iti pṛṣṭastadā sarvairmunibhirbhāvitātmabhiḥ..
sūto vyāsaṃ namaskṛtya vākyaṃ cedamathābravīt.. 10.6 ..
1.3.d:
इति पृष्टस्तदा सर्वैर्मुनिभिर्भावितात्मभिः..
सूतो व्यासं नमस्कृत्य वाक्यं चेदमथाब्रवीत्.. 10.6 ..
1.3.m: Thus questioned then by all the sages of cultivated minds, / Sūta, having bowed to Vyāsa, spoke these words:

1.3.s:
.. lomaśa uvāca..
yadā brahmāṃḍamadhyasthā vyāptā devā viṣāgninā..
haribrahmādayo hyete lokapālāḥ savāsavāḥ..
tadā vijñāpitaḥ śaṃbhurheraṃbena mahātmanā.. 10.7 ..
1.3.d:
.. लोमश उवाच..
यदा ब्रह्मांडमध्यस्था व्याप्ता देवा विषाग्निना..
हरिब्रह्मादयो ह्येते लोकपालाः सवासवाः..
तदा विज्ञापितः शंभुर्हेरंबेन महात्मना.. 10.7 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / When the gods dwelling within the cosmic egg were pervaded by the fiery poison— / these ones, Hari, Brahmā, and the others, the world-protectors along with Indra— / then Śambhu was petitioned by the great-souled Heramba.

1.3.s:
..heraṃba uvāca..
he rudra he mahādeva he sthāṇo ha jagatpate..
mayā vighnaṃ vinodena kṛtaṃ teṣāṃ sudurjayam.. 10.8 ..
1.3.d:
..हेरंब उवाच..
हे रुद्र हे महादेव हे स्थाणो ह जगत्पते..
मया विघ्नं विनोदेन कृतं तेषां सुदुर्जयम्.. 10.8 ..
1.3.m: Heramba said: / O Rudra! O Mahādeva! O Sthāṇu! O Lord of the universe! / In sport, I have created an insurmountable obstacle for them.

1.3.s:
bhayena mati mohāttvāṃ nārccayaṃti ca māmapi..
udyogaṃ ye prakurvanti teṣāṃ kleśo'dhiko bhavet.. 10.9 ..
1.3.d:
भयेन मति मोहात्त्वां नार्च्चयंति च मामपि..
उद्योगं ये प्रकुर्वन्ति तेषां क्लेशोऽधिको भवेत्.. 10.9 ..
1.3.m: Out of fear and delusion of intellect, they worship neither you nor me. / Those who exert effort shall only suffer greater distress.

1.3.s:
evamabhyarthitastena pinākī vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ..
vighnāṃdhakārasūryeṇa gaṇādhipatinā tadā.. 10.10 ..
1.3.d:
एवमभ्यर्थितस्तेन पिनाकी वृषभध्वजः..
विघ्नांधकारसूर्येण गणाधिपतिना तदा.. 10.10 ..
1.3.m: Thus petitioned then by him, the wielder of the Pināka, whose emblem is the bull, / by the lord of the gaṇas, the sun to the darkness of obstacles,

1.3.s:
liṃgarūpo'bravīcchaṃbhurnirākāro nirāmayaḥ..
niraṃjano vyomakeśaḥ kaparddī nīlalohitaḥ.. 10.11 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगरूपोऽब्रवीच्छंभुर्निराकारो निरामयः..
निरंजनो व्योमकेशः कपर्द्दी नीललोहितः.. 10.11 ..
1.3.m: Śambhu, who has the form of a liṅga, formless, free from disease, / taintless, having the sky for hair, matted-haired, blue and red, spoke:

1.3.s:
..maheśvara uvāca..
heraṃba śrṛṇu me vākyaṃ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ..
ahaṃkārātmakaṃ caiva jagadetaccarācaram.. 10.12 ..
1.3.d:
..महेश्वर उवाच..
हेरंब श्रृणु मे वाक्यं श्रद्धया परया युतः..
अहंकारात्मकं चैव जगदेतच्चराचरम्.. 10.12 ..
1.3.m: Maheśvara said: / O Heramba, listen to my words endowed with supreme faith: / this entire world of moving and unmoving beings consists of ego-sense.

1.3.s:
sthitiṃ karotyahaṃkāraḥ pralayotpattimeva ca..
jagadādaugaṇapate tadā vijñaptimātrataḥ.. 10.13 ..
1.3.d:
स्थितिं करोत्यहंकारः प्रलयोत्पत्तिमेव च..
जगदादौगणपते तदा विज्ञप्तिमात्रतः.. 10.13 ..
1.3.m: Ego-sense performs maintenance, dissolution, and origination. / At the beginning of the universe, O lord of the gaṇas, by mere consciousness,

1.3.s:
māyāvirahitaṃ śāṃtaṃ dvaitādvaitaparaṃ sadā..
jñaptimātrasvarūpaṃ tatsadānaṃdaikalakṣaṇam.. 10.14 ..
1.3.d:
मायाविरहितं शांतं द्वैताद्वैतपरं सदा..
ज्ञप्तिमात्रस्वरूपं तत्सदानंदैकलक्षणम्.. 10.14 ..
1.3.m: free from māyā, peaceful, beyond duality and non-duality, / that whose essential nature is pure consciousness alone, whose sole mark is eternal bliss [persists].

1.3.s:
..gaṇapatiruvāca..
yadi tvaṃ kevalo hyātmā paramānandalakṣaṇaḥ..
tasmāttvadaparaṃ kiṃcinnānyadasti paraṃtapa.. 10.15 ..
1.3.d:
..गणपतिरुवाच..
यदि त्वं केवलो ह्यात्मा परमानन्दलक्षणः..
तस्मात्त्वदपरं किंचिन्नान्यदस्ति परंतप.. 10.15 ..
1.3.m: Gaṇapati said: / If you alone are the Self, characterized by supreme bliss, / then there is nothing other than you, O scorcher of foes.

1.3.s:
nānārūpaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ surāsuravilakṣaṇam..
vicitraṃ mohajananaṃ tribhirddevaiśca lakṣitam.. 10.16 ..
1.3.d:
नानारूपं कथं जातं सुरासुरविलक्षणम्..
विचित्रं मोहजननं त्रिभिर्द्देवैश्च लक्षितम्.. 10.16 ..
1.3.m: How did multiform existence arise, distinct as gods and demons, / manifold, causing delusion, observed by the three gods,

1.3.s:
bhūtagrāmaiścaturbhiśca nānābhedaiḥ samanvitaiḥ..
jātaṃ saṃsāracakraṃ ca nityānityavilakṣaṇam.. 10.17 ..
1.3.d:
भूतग्रामैश्चतुर्भिश्च नानाभेदैः समन्वितैः..
जातं संसारचक्रं च नित्यानित्यविलक्षणम्.. 10.17 ..
1.3.m: along with the four classes of living beings endowed with diverse differences? / How did the wheel of worldly existence arise, distinct as eternal and non-eternal?

1.3.s:
parasparavirodhena jñānavādena mohitāḥ..
karmavādaratāḥ kecitkecitsvaguṇamāśritāḥ.. 10.18 ..
1.3.d:
परस्परविरोधेन ज्ञानवादेन मोहिताः..
कर्मवादरताः केचित्केचित्स्वगुणमाश्रिताः.. 10.18 ..
1.3.m: Deluded by mutually contradictory doctrines of knowledge, / some are devoted to doctrines of action, while others rely on their own qualities;

1.3.s:
jñānaniṣṭhāśca ye kecitparasparavirodhinaḥ..
evaṃ saṃśayamāpannaṃ trāhi māṃ vṛṣabhadhvaja.. 10.19 ..
1.3.d:
ज्ञाननिष्ठाश्च ये केचित्परस्परविरोधिनः..
एवं संशयमापन्नं त्राहि मां वृषभध्वज.. 10.19 ..
1.3.m: and those who are devoted to knowledge are mutually opposed. / Save me, who am thus fallen into doubt, O one whose emblem is the bull!

1.3.s:
ahaṃ gaṇaśca kutratyāḥ kva cāyaṃ vṛṣabhaḥ prabho..
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ kuto jātāśca kutra vai.. 10.20 ..
1.3.d:
अहं गणश्च कुत्रत्याः क्व चायं वृषभः प्रभो..
एते चान्ये च बहवः कुतो जाताश्च कुत्र वै.. 10.20 ..
1.3.m: Where do I and the gaṇas come from? And where did this bull come from, O Lord? / Whence were these and many others born, and where indeed

1.3.s:
kṛtāḥ sarve mahābhāgāḥ sāttvikā rājasāśca vai..
prahasya bhagavāñchaṃbhurgaṇeśaṃ vaktumudyataḥ.. 10.21 ..
1.3.d:
कृताः सर्वे महाभागाः सात्त्विका राजसाश्च वै..
प्रहस्य भगवाञ्छंभुर्गणेशं वक्तुमुद्यतः.. 10.21 ..
1.3.m: were all the fortunate ones made, both sāttvika and rājasa? / Laughing, the Lord Śambhu prepared to speak to Gaṇeśa.

1.3.s:
..maheśvara uvāca..
kālaśaktyā ca jātāni rajaḥsattvatamāṃsi ca..
tairāvṛtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsumānuṣam.. 10.22 ..
1.3.d:
..महेश्वर उवाच..
कालशक्त्या च जातानि रजःसत्त्वतमांसि च..
तैरावृतं जगत्सर्वं सदेवासुमानुषम्.. 10.22 ..
1.3.m: Maheśvara said: / Through the power of time were born rajas, sattva, and tamas; / by them the entire universe is pervaded, along with gods, demons, and humans.

1.3.s:
paridṛśyamānametaccānaśvaraṃ paramārthataḥ..
viddhyetatsarvasiddhyaiva kṛtakatvācca naśvaram.. 10.23 ..
1.3.d:
परिदृश्यमानमेतच्चानश्वरं परमार्थतः..
विद्ध्येतत्सर्वसिद्ध्यैव कृतकत्वाच्च नश्वरम्.. 10.23 ..
1.3.m: And this that is seen around is not imperishable in ultimate reality; / know that all this, through accomplishment and because it is made, is perishable.

1.3.s:
.. lomaśa uvāca..
yāvadgaṇeśasaṃyukto bhāṣamāṇaḥ sadāśivaḥ..
liṃgarūpī viśvarūpaḥ prādurbhūtā sadāśivāt.. 10.24 ..
1.3.d:
.. लोमश उवाच..
यावद्गणेशसंयुक्तो भाषमाणः सदाशिवः..
लिंगरूपी विश्वरूपः प्रादुर्भूता सदाशिवात्.. 10.24 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / While Sadāśiva was speaking together with Gaṇeśa, / having the form of a liṅga, universal in form, there appeared from Sadāśiva

1.3.s:
śivarūpā jagadyoniḥ kāryakāraṇarūpiṇī..
liṃgarūpī sa bhagavānnimagnastatkṣaṇādabhūt.. 10.25 ..
1.3.d:
शिवरूपा जगद्योनिः कार्यकारणरूपिणी..
लिंगरूपी स भगवान्निमग्नस्तत्क्षणादभूत्.. 10.25 ..
1.3.m: she who has the form of Śiva, the womb of the universe, having the form of effect and cause; / and that Lord, having the form of a liṅga, became submerged from that very moment.

1.3.s:
ekā sthitā parā śaktirbrahmavidyātmalakṣaṇā..
gaṇeśo vismayāviṣṭo hyavalokanatatparaḥ.. 10.26 ..
1.3.d:
एका स्थिता परा शक्तिर्ब्रह्मविद्यात्मलक्षणा..
गणेशो विस्मयाविष्टो ह्यवलोकनतत्परः.. 10.26 ..
1.3.m: The one supreme power remained, whose self-nature is the knowledge of Brahman. / Gaṇeśa, overcome with wonder, was intent on watching.

1.3.s:
..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
prakṛtyantargataṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram..
gaṇeśasya pṛthaktvaṃ ca kathaṃ jātaṃ taducyatām.. 10.27 ..
1.3.d:
..ऋषय ऊचुः..
प्रकृत्यन्तर्गतं सर्वं जगदेतच्चराचरम्..
गणेशस्य पृथक्त्वं च कथं जातं तदुच्यताम्.. 10.27 ..
1.3.m: The seers said: / All this universe of moving and unmoving beings is contained within nature; / let it be explained how the distinctness of Gaṇeśa arose.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
sākṣātprakṛtyāḥ saṃbhūto gaṇeśo bhagavānabhūt..
yathārūpaḥ śivaḥ sākṣāttadrūpo hi gaṇeśvaraḥ.. 10.28 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
साक्षात्प्रकृत्याः संभूतो गणेशो भगवानभूत्..
यथारूपः शिवः साक्षात्तद्रूपो हि गणेश्वरः.. 10.28 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Born directly from nature, Gaṇeśa became a lord; / just as the visible form of Śiva is, such indeed was the form of the lord of gaṇas.

1.3.s:
śivena saha saṃgrāmo hyabhūttasya mahātmanaḥ..
ajñānātprakṛto bhūtvā bahukālaṃ nirantaram.. 10.29 ..
1.3.d:
शिवेन सह संग्रामो ह्यभूत्तस्य महात्मनः..
अज्ञानात्प्रकृतो भूत्वा बहुकालं निरन्तरम्.. 10.29 ..
1.3.m: A battle took place between him, the great-souled one, and Śiva; / having become an ordinary being through ignorance, [he fought] continuously for a long time.

1.3.s:
tasya dṛṣṭvā hyajeyatvaṃ gajārūḍhasya tattadā..
triśūlenāhanacchaṃbhuḥ sagajaṃ tamapātayat.. 10.30 ..
1.3.d:
तस्य दृष्ट्वा ह्यजेयत्वं गजारूढस्य तत्तदा..
त्रिशूलेनाहनच्छंभुः सगजं तमपातयत्.. 10.30 ..
1.3.m: Seeing that he who was mounted on an elephant was then invincible, / Śambhu struck him with his trident and brought him down together with the elephant.

1.3.s:
tadā stuto mahādevaḥ paraśaktyā paraṃtapaḥ..
paraśaktimuvācedaṃ varaṃ varaya śobhane.. 10.31 ..
1.3.d:
तदा स्तुतो महादेवः परशक्त्या परंतपः..
परशक्तिमुवाचेदं वरं वरय शोभने.. 10.31 ..
1.3.m: Then Mahādeva, the scorcher of foes, was praised by the supreme power; / he said to the supreme power: 'Choose a boon, O fair one.'

1.3.s:
tadā vṛto mahādevo vareṇa parameṇa hi..
yo'yaṃ tvayā hato deva mama putro na saṃśayaḥ.. 10.32 ..
1.3.d:
तदा वृतो महादेवो वरेण परमेण हि..
योऽयं त्वया हतो देव मम पुत्रो न संशयः.. 10.32 ..
1.3.m: Then Mahādeva was chosen [by her] with a supreme boon: / 'This one who was slain by you, O Lord, is my son, without a doubt.

1.3.s:
tvāṃ na jānātyayaṃ mūḍhaḥ prakṛtyaṃśasamudbhavaḥ..
tasmātputraṃ jīvayemaṃ mama tṛṣṭyarthameva ca.. 10.33 ..
1.3.d:
त्वां न जानात्ययं मूढः प्रकृत्यंशसमुद्भवः..
तस्मात्पुत्रं जीवयेमं मम तृष्ट्यर्थमेव च.. 10.33 ..
1.3.m: This foolish one, born of a portion of nature, does not know you; / therefore revive this son, just for my satisfaction.'

1.3.s:
prahasya bhagavānrudro māyāputramajīvayat..
siṃdhuravadanenaiva mukhe sa samayojayat.. 10.34 ..
1.3.d:
प्रहस्य भगवान्रुद्रो मायापुत्रमजीवयत्..
सिंधुरवदनेनैव मुखे स समयोजयत्.. 10.34 ..
1.3.m: Laughing, the Lord Rudra revived the son of māyā; / he joined an elephant face to his head.

1.3.s:
tadā gajānano jātaḥ prasādācchaṃkarasya ca..
māyāputropi nirmāyo jñānavānsaṃbabhūva ha.. 10.35 ..
1.3.d:
तदा गजाननो जातः प्रसादाच्छंकरस्य च..
मायापुत्रोपि निर्मायो ज्ञानवान्संबभूव ह.. 10.35 ..
1.3.m: Then he became the elephant-faced one through the grace of Śaṃkara; / even though the son of māyā, he became free of māyā and full of knowledge.

1.3.s:
ātmajñānāmṛtenaiva nityatṛpto nirāmayaḥ..
samādhisaṃsthito raudraḥ kālakālāṃtako'bhavat.. 10.36 ..
1.3.d:
आत्मज्ञानामृतेनैव नित्यतृप्तो निरामयः..
समाधिसंस्थितो रौद्रः कालकालांतकोऽभवत्.. 10.36 ..
1.3.m: Eternally satisfied by the nectar of self-knowledge alone, free from affliction, / established in deep meditation, fierce, he became the ender of the ender of time.

1.3.s:
yogadaṃḍārthamutpāṭya svakīyaṃ daśanaṃ mahat..
kare gṛhya gaṇādhyakṣaḥ śabdhabrahmātivarttate..
ṛddhisiddhidvayenaiva ekatvena virājitaḥ.. 10.37 ..
1.3.d:
योगदंडार्थमुत्पाट्य स्वकीयं दशनं महत्..
करे गृह्य गणाध्यक्षः शब्धब्रह्मातिवर्त्तते..
ऋद्धिसिद्धिद्वयेनैव एकत्वेन विराजितः.. 10.37 ..
1.3.m: Pulling out his own large tusk to serve as a yogic staff / and holding it in his hand, the leader of the gaṇas transcends the sound-Brahman, / shining forth in unity with the pair of Ṛddhi and Siddhi.

1.3.s:
ye te gaṇāśca vighnāśca ye cānye'bhyadhikā bhuvi..
teṣāmapi patirjātaḥ kṛto'sau śaṃbhunā tadā.. 10.38 ..
1.3.d:
ये ते गणाश्च विघ्नाश्च ये चान्येऽभ्यधिका भुवि..
तेषामपि पतिर्जातः कृतोऽसौ शंभुना तदा.. 10.38 ..
1.3.m: Those who are gaṇas, and obstacles, and those others who are superior on earth — / of them too he became the lord, made so by Śambhu at that time.

1.3.s:
tasmādvi lokayāmāsa prakṛtiṃ viśvarūpiṇīm..
pṛthaksthitvāgrato jānālliṃgaṃ prakṛtimeva ca..
dadarśa vimalaṃ liṃgaṃ prakṛtisthaṃ svabhāvataḥ.. 10.39 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्वि लोकयामास प्रकृतिं विश्वरूपिणीम्..
पृथक्स्थित्वाग्रतो जानाल्लिंगं प्रकृतिमेव च..
ददर्श विमलं लिंगं प्रकृतिस्थं स्वभावतः.. 10.39 ..
1.3.m: Therefore he beheld primordial matter which embodies the universe. / Standing apart, in front, through knowledge he knew the liṅga and primordial matter; / by nature he saw the spotless liṅga abiding in primordial matter.

1.3.s:
ātmānaṃ ca gaṇaiḥ sāddhaṃ tathaiva ca jagattrayam..
līnaṃ liṃge samastaṃ taddherambo jñānavānapi.. 10.40 ..
1.3.d:
आत्मानं च गणैः साद्धं तथैव च जगत्त्रयम्..
लीनं लिंगे समस्तं तद्धेरम्बो ज्ञानवानपि.. 10.40 ..
1.3.m: Heramba, though possessed of knowledge, [saw] himself along with the gaṇas, / and likewise the three worlds, all dissolved in that liṅga.

1.3.s:
mumoha ca punaḥ saṃjñāṃ pratilabhya prayatnataḥ..
nanāma śirasā tābhyāmīśābhyāṃ sa gaṇeśvaraḥ.. 10.41 ..
1.3.d:
मुमोह च पुनः संज्ञां प्रतिलभ्य प्रयत्नतः..
ननाम शिरसा ताभ्यामीशाभ्यां स गणेश्वरः.. 10.41 ..
1.3.m: And he fell into a swoon; then regaining consciousness with effort, / that lord of gaṇas bowed his head to those two rulers.

1.3.s:
tadā dadarśa tatraiva lokasaṃhārakārakam..
brahmāṇaṃ caiva rudraṃ ca viṣṇuṃ caiva sadāśivam.. 10.42 ..
1.3.d:
तदा ददर्श तत्रैव लोकसंहारकारकम्..
ब्रह्माणं चैव रुद्रं च विष्णुं चैव सदाशिवम्.. 10.42 ..
1.3.m: Then right there he saw the cause of the dissolution of the worlds, / and Brahmā, and Rudra, and Viṣṇu, and Sadāśiva.

1.3.s:
dadarśa pretatulyāni liṃgaśaktyātmakāni ca..
brahmāṇḍagolakānyeva koṭiśaḥ paramāṇuvat.. 10.43 ..
1.3.d:
ददर्श प्रेततुल्यानि लिंगशक्त्यात्मकानि च..
ब्रह्माण्डगोलकान्येव कोटिशः परमाणुवत्.. 10.43 ..
1.3.m: He saw the globes of the cosmos, equal to corpses, / consisting of the liṅga and śakti, by the crores, like atoms.

1.3.s:
līyaṃte ca vilīyaṃte maheśe liṃgarūpiṇi..
prakṛtyaṃtargataṃ liṃgaṃ liṃgasyāṃtargatā ca sā.. 10.44 ..
1.3.d:
लीयंते च विलीयंते महेशे लिंगरूपिणि..
प्रकृत्यंतर्गतं लिंगं लिंगस्यांतर्गता च सा.. 10.44 ..
1.3.m: They dissolve and are completely dissolved in Maheśa who has the form of a liṅga; / the liṅga entered within primordial matter, and she entered within the liṅga.

1.3.s:
śaktyā liṃgaṃ ca saṃchannaṃ tadā sarvamadṛśyata..
liṃgena śaktiḥ saṃchannā parasparamavartata.. 10.45 ..
1.3.d:
शक्त्या लिंगं च संछन्नं तदा सर्वमदृश्यत..
लिंगेन शक्तिः संछन्ना परस्परमवर्तत.. 10.45 ..
1.3.m: The liṅga was covered by śakti, and then everything was seen [by him]; / śakti was covered by the liṅga; they were mutually engaged.

1.3.s:
śivābhyāṃ saṃśritaṃ lokaṃ jagadetaccarācaram..
gaṇeśo vāpi tajjñānaṃ na pare'pi tathāvidan.. 10.46 ..
1.3.d:
शिवाभ्यां संश्रितं लोकं जगदेतच्चराचरम्..
गणेशो वापि तज्ज्ञानं न परेऽपि तथाविदन्.. 10.46 ..
1.3.m: The world, this movable and immovable universe, took refuge in the two Śivas; / even Gaṇeśa possessed that knowledge, while others did not know it so.

1.3.s:
tadovāca mahātejā gaṇādhyakṣo gaṇaiḥ saha..
saśaktikaṃ stūyamānaḥ śaktyā ca parayā tadā.. 10.47 ..
1.3.d:
तदोवाच महातेजा गणाध्यक्षो गणैः सह..
सशक्तिकं स्तूयमानः शक्त्या च परया तदा.. 10.47 ..
1.3.m: Then the commander of the gaṇas, endowed with great splendor, together with the gaṇas, / being praised with his śakti, spoke to [Śiva] with the supreme Śakti:

1.3.s:
..gaṇeśa uvāca..
namāmi devaṃ śaktyānvitaṃ jñānarūpaṃ prasannaṃ jñānātparaṃ paramaṃjyotirūpam..
rūpātparaṃ paramaṃ tattvarūpaṃ tattvātparaṃ paramaṃ maṃgalaṃ ca ānaṃdākhyaṃ niṣkalaṃ nirviṣādam.. 10.48 ..
1.3.d:
..गणेश उवाच..
नमामि देवं शक्त्यान्वितं ज्ञानरूपं प्रसन्नं ज्ञानात्परं परमंज्योतिरूपम्..
रूपात्परं परमं तत्त्वरूपं तत्त्वात्परं परमं मंगलं च आनंदाख्यं निष्कलं निर्विषादम्.. 10.48 ..
1.3.m: Gaṇeśa said: / I bow to the God endowed with śakti, the form of knowledge, gracious, beyond knowledge, whose form is the supreme light, / beyond form, whose form is the supreme reality, beyond reality, supreme auspiciousness, called bliss, partless, devoid of sorrow.

1.3.s:
dhūmātparamayovahnirdhūmavatpratibhāsate..
prakṛtyaṃtargastvaṃ hi lakṣyase jñānisaṃbhavaḥ..
prakṛtyaṃtargatastvaṃ hi māyāvyaktiritīyase.. 10.49 ..
1.3.d:
धूमात्परमयोवह्निर्धूमवत्प्रतिभासते..
प्रकृत्यंतर्गस्त्वं हि लक्ष्यसे ज्ञानिसंभवः..
प्रकृत्यंतर्गतस्त्वं हि मायाव्यक्तिरितीयसे.. 10.49 ..
1.3.m: The fire beyond smoke appears like smoke. / Abiding within primordial matter, you are perceived as the origin of the knower; / abiding within primordial matter, you are known as the manifestation of māyā.

1.3.s:
evaṃvidhastvaṃ bhagavansvamāyayā sṛjasyatholuṃpasi pāsi viśvam..
asmādgarātsarvamidaṃ pranaṣṭaṃ sabrahmavipreṃdrayutaṃ carācaram.. 10.50 ..
1.3.d:
एवंविधस्त्वं भगवन्स्वमायया सृजस्यथोलुंपसि पासि विश्वम्..
अस्माद्गरात्सर्वमिदं प्रनष्टं सब्रह्मविप्रेंद्रयुतं चराचरम्.. 10.50 ..
1.3.m: Being of such a nature, O Blessed One, through your own māyā you create, then destroy, and protect the universe. / From this poison, all this has perished, the movable and immovable along with Brahmā, the brahmins, and Indra.

1.3.s:
yathā purāsīrbhagavānmaheśastrailokyanātho'si carācarātmā..
kuruṣya śīghraṃ sahajīvakośaṃ carācaraṃ tatsakalaṃ pradagdham.. 10.51 ..
1.3.d:
यथा पुरासीर्भगवान्महेशस्त्रैलोक्यनाथोऽसि चराचरात्मा..
कुरुष्य शीघ्रं सहजीवकोशं चराचरं तत्सकलं प्रदग्धम्.. 10.51 ..
1.3.m: As you were formerly, O Blessed Maheśa, you are the lord of the three worlds, the self of the movable and immovable. / Quickly restore, together with their sheaths of living beings, all those movable and immovable things that have been consumed by fire!

1.3.s:
.. lomaśa uvāca..
evaṃ stuto gaṇeśena bhagavānbhūtabhāvanaḥ..
yadutthitaṃ kālakūṭaṃ lokasaṃhārakārakam.. 10.52 ..
1.3.d:
.. लोमश उवाच..
एवं स्तुतो गणेशेन भगवान्भूतभावनः..
यदुत्थितं कालकूटं लोकसंहारकारकम्.. 10.52 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Praised thus by Gaṇeśa, the Blessed One, the source of beings, / [swallowed] the kālakūṭa that had arisen, the cause of the dissolution of the worlds.

1.3.s:
liṃgarūpeṇa tadgrastaṃ vimalaṃ cākarottadā..
sadevāsuramartyāśca sarvāṇi trijaganti ca..
tatkṣaṇādrakṣitānyeva kṛpayā parayā yutaḥ.. 10.53 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगरूपेण तद्ग्रस्तं विमलं चाकरोत्तदा..
सदेवासुरमर्त्याश्च सर्वाणि त्रिजगन्ति च..
तत्क्षणाद्रक्षितान्येव कृपया परया युतः.. 10.53 ..
1.3.m: In the form of the liṅga it was swallowed, and he made it pure then. / Together with the gods, asuras, and mortals, all the three worlds / were instantly protected by him, filled with supreme compassion.

1.3.s:
brahmā viṣṇuḥ sureṃdraśca lokapālāḥ saharṣayaḥ..
yakṣā vidyādharāḥ siddhā gaṃdharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ..
utthitāścaiva te sarve nidrāparigatā iva.. 10.54 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुः सुरेंद्रश्च लोकपालाः सहर्षयः..
यक्षा विद्याधराः सिद्धा गंधर्वाप्सरसां गणाः..
उत्थिताश्चैव ते सर्वे निद्रापरिगता इव.. 10.54 ..
1.3.m: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, the lord of gods, the guardians of the quarters along with the seers, / the yakṣas, vidyādharas, siddhas, gandharvas, and the hosts of apsarases, / all of them arose as if overcome by sleep.

1.3.s:
vismayena samāviṣṭā babhūvurjātasādhvasāḥ..
sarve devāsurāścaiva ūcurāścaryavattataḥ.. 10.55 ..
1.3.d:
विस्मयेन समाविष्टा बभूवुर्जातसाध्वसाः..
सर्वे देवासुराश्चैव ऊचुराश्चर्यवत्ततः.. 10.55 ..
1.3.m: Seized with astonishment, they became filled with fear. / All the gods and asuras then spoke with wonder:

1.3.s:
kva kālakūṭaṃ sumahadyena vidrāvitā vayam..
mṛtaprāyāḥ kṛtāḥ sadyaḥ salokapālakā hyamī.. 10.56 ..
1.3.d:
क्व कालकूटं सुमहद्येन विद्राविता वयम्..
मृतप्रायाः कृताः सद्यः सलोकपालका ह्यमी.. 10.56 ..
1.3.m: “Where is that immense kālakūṭa by which we were driven away, / and all these [beings], together with the guardians of the quarters, were instantly made almost dead?”

1.3.s:
ityabruvaṃstadā daityāstūṣṇīṃbhūtāstadā sthitāḥ..
śakrādayo lokapālā viṣṇuṃ sarveśvareśvaram..
brahmāṇaṃ ca puraskṛtya idamūcuḥ samedhitā.. 10.57 ..
1.3.d:
इत्यब्रुवंस्तदा दैत्यास्तूष्णींभूतास्तदा स्थिताः..
शक्रादयो लोकपाला विष्णुं सर्वेश्वरेश्वरम्..
ब्रह्माणं च पुरस्कृत्य इदमूचुः समेधिता.. 10.57 ..
1.3.m: Saying this, the daityas then stood silent. / Indra and the other guardians of the quarters, placing Viṣṇu, the lord of the lord of all, / and Brahmā at their head, having regained strength, spoke this:

1.3.s:
kenedaṃ kāritaṃ viṣṇo na vidāmo'lpamedhasaḥ..
tadā prahasya bhagavānbrahmaṇā saha taiḥ suraiḥ.. 10.58 ..
1.3.d:
केनेदं कारितं विष्णो न विदामोऽल्पमेधसः..
तदा प्रहस्य भगवान्ब्रह्मणा सह तैः सुरैः.. 10.58 ..
1.3.m: “By whom was this accomplished, O Viṣṇu? We of little intellect do not know.” / Then, laughing, the Blessed One along with Brahmā and those gods,

1.3.s:
samādhimagamansarve'pyekāgramanasastadā..
tattvajñānena nirhṛtya kāmakrodādikāndvijāḥ.. 10.59 ..
1.3.d:
समाधिमगमन्सर्वेऽप्येकाग्रमनसस्तदा..
तत्त्वज्ञानेन निर्हृत्य कामक्रोदादिकान्द्विजाः.. 10.59 ..
1.3.m: all entered into samādhi with one-pointed minds at that time, / having removed lust, anger, and the like by knowledge of the truth, O twice-born.

1.3.s:
tadātmani sthitaṃ liṃgamapaśyanvi budhādayaḥ..
viṣṇuṃ puraskṛtya tadā tuṣṭuvuḥ paramārthataḥ.. 10.60 ..
1.3.d:
तदात्मनि स्थितं लिंगमपश्यन्वि बुधादयः..
विष्णुं पुरस्कृत्य तदा तुष्टुवुः परमार्थतः.. 10.60 ..
1.3.m: Then the gods and others saw the liṅga abiding within the self. / Placing Viṣṇu at their head, they then praised in accordance with the ultimate truth.

1.3.s: ātmanā paramātmānaṃ yoginaḥ paryupāsate.. 10.61 ..
1.3.d: आत्मना परमात्मानं योगिनः पर्युपासते.. 10.61 ..
1.3.m: By the self, yogins worship the supreme Self:

1.3.s:
liṃgameva paraṃ jñānaṃ liṃgameva paraṃ tapaḥ..
liṃgameva paro dharmo liṃgameva parā gatiḥ..
tasmālliṃgātparataraṃ yacca kiṃcinna vidyate.. 10.62 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगमेव परं ज्ञानं लिंगमेव परं तपः..
लिंगमेव परो धर्मो लिंगमेव परा गतिः..
तस्माल्लिंगात्परतरं यच्च किंचिन्न विद्यते.. 10.62 ..
1.3.m: “The liṅga alone is the supreme knowledge; the liṅga alone is the supreme austerity; / the liṅga alone is the supreme dharma; the liṅga alone is the supreme goal. / There is nothing whatever higher than that liṅga.”

1.3.s:
evaṃ bruvaṃto hi tadā surāsurāḥ salokapālā ṛṣibhiśca sākam..
viṣṇuṃ puraskṛtya tamālavarṇaṃ śaṃbhuṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ.. 10.63 ..
1.3.d:
एवं ब्रुवंतो हि तदा सुरासुराः सलोकपाला ऋषिभिश्च साकम्..
विष्णुं पुरस्कृत्य तमालवर्णं शंभुं शरण्यं शरणं प्रपन्नाः.. 10.63 ..
1.3.m: Saying this at that time, the gods and asuras, together with the guardians of the quarters and the seers, / placing Viṣṇu, whose color is like the tamāla tree, at their head, sought refuge in Śambhu, the refuge.

1.3.s:
trāhitrāhi mahādeva kṛpālo parameśvara..
purā trātā yathā sarve tathātvaṃ trātumarhasi.. 10.64 ..
1.3.d:
त्राहित्राहि महादेव कृपालो परमेश्वर..
पुरा त्राता यथा सर्वे तथात्वं त्रातुमर्हसि.. 10.64 ..
1.3.m: “Save, save, O Mahādeva, compassionate Parameśvara! / Just as you were the savior of all in the past, so ought you to save [now].

1.3.s:
taddevadeva bhavataścaraṇāraviṃdaṃ sevānubaṃdhamahimānamanaṃtarūpam..
tvadāśritaṃ yatparamānukaṃpayā namo'stu te devavara prasīda.. 10.65 ..
1.3.d:
तद्देवदेव भवतश्चरणारविंदं सेवानुबंधमहिमानमनंतरूपम्..
त्वदाश्रितं यत्परमानुकंपया नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद.. 10.65 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, O God of gods, your lotus foot, the greatness of whose service is boundless, whose form is infinite, / has been resorted to by [us] through your supreme compassion. Salutation to you, O best of gods! Be gracious!”

1.3.s:
liṃgasvarūpamadhyastho bhagavānbhūtabhāvanaḥ..
sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ sākaṃ babhāṣedaṃ ramāpatiḥ.. 10.66 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगस्वरूपमध्यस्थो भगवान्भूतभावनः..
सर्वैः सुरगणैः साकं बभाषेदं रमापतिः.. 10.66 ..
1.3.m: The Blessed One, the source of beings, who is situated in the midst of the nature of the liṅga, / was spoken to by the lord of Ramā together with all the hosts of gods:

1.3.s:
tvaṃ liṃgarūpī bhagavāñjagatāmabhayapradaḥ..
viṣṇunā saṃstuto devo liṃgarūpī maheśvaraḥ.. 10.67 ..
1.3.d:
त्वं लिंगरूपी भगवाञ्जगतामभयप्रदः..
विष्णुना संस्तुतो देवो लिंगरूपी महेश्वरः.. 10.67 ..
1.3.m: “You are the Blessed One possessing the form of the liṅga, granting fearlessness to the worlds.” / The God possessing the form of the liṅga, Maheśvara, was praised by Viṣṇu:

1.3.s:
mṛtāstrātā garātsarve tasmānmṛtyuṃjaya prabho..
rakṣarakṣa mahākāla tripurāṃta namostu te.. 10.68 ..
1.3.d:
मृतास्त्राता गरात्सर्वे तस्मान्मृत्युंजय प्रभो..
रक्षरक्ष महाकाल त्रिपुरांत नमोस्तु ते.. 10.68 ..
1.3.m: “Those who were dead were all saved from the poison; therefore, O Conqueror of Death, O Lord, / protect, protect, O Mahākāla, O destroyer of Tripura! Salutation to you!”

1.3.s:
viṣṇunā saṃstuto devo liṃgarūpī maheśvaraḥ..
prādurbabhūva sāṃbo'tha bodhayanniva tānsurān.. 10.69 ..
1.3.d:
विष्णुना संस्तुतो देवो लिंगरूपी महेश्वरः..
प्रादुर्बभूव सांबोऽथ बोधयन्निव तान्सुरान्.. 10.69 ..
1.3.m: Praised by Viṣṇu, the God possessing the form of the liṅga, Maheśvara, / accompanied by Ambā, then manifested, as though awakening those gods:

1.3.s:
he viṣṇo he surāḥ sarva ṛṣayaḥ śrūyatāmidam..
manyate'pi hi saṃsāre anitye nityatākulam.. 10.70 ..
1.3.d:
हे विष्णो हे सुराः सर्व ऋषयः श्रूयतामिदम्..
मन्यतेऽपि हि संसारे अनित्ये नित्यताकुलम्.. 10.70 ..
1.3.m: “O Viṣṇu, O all gods and seers, let this be heard! / Even in the impermanent cycle of rebirth, one considers it full of permanence,

1.3.s:
avilokayatā''tmātmanā vibudhādayaḥ..
kiṃ yajñaiḥ kiṃ tapobhiśca kimudyogena karmaṇām.. 10.71 ..
1.3.d:
अविलोकयता'ऽत्मात्मना विबुधादयः..
किं यज्ञैः किं तपोभिश्च किमुद्योगेन कर्मणाम्.. 10.71 ..
1.3.m: not looking at the Self by the self, O gods and others! / What is the use of sacrifices, what of austerities, what of the effort of actions?

1.3.s:
ekatvena pṛthaktvena kiṃcinnaiva prayojanam..
yasmādbhavadbhirmilitaiḥ kṛtaṃ yatkarma duṣkaram.. 10.72 ..
1.3.d:
एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन किंचिन्नैव प्रयोजनम्..
यस्माद्भवद्भिर्मिलितैः कृतं यत्कर्म दुष्करम्.. 10.72 ..
1.3.m: In oneness or in separateness, there is no purpose at all. / For that difficult deed which was done by you all assembled together,

1.3.s:
kṣīrābdhermathanaṃ tattu amṛtārthaṃ kathaṃ kṛtam..
mṛtyuṃ jayaṃ nirākṛtya avajñāya ca māṃ sadā.. 10.73 ..
1.3.d:
क्षीराब्धेर्मथनं तत्तु अमृतार्थं कथं कृतम्..
मृत्युं जयं निराकृत्य अवज्ञाय च मां सदा.. 10.73 ..
1.3.m: that churning of the Ocean of Milk for the sake of nectar—how was it done? / Having rejected the conqueror of death, and always having disregarded me,

1.3.s:
tasmātsarve mṛtyumukhaṃ patitā vai na saṃśayaḥ..
asmābhirnirmito devo gaṇeśaḥ kāryasiddhaye.. 10.74 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्सर्वे मृत्युमुखं पतिता वै न संशयः..
अस्माभिर्निर्मितो देवो गणेशः कार्यसिद्धये.. 10.74 ..
1.3.m: therefore all of you have indeed fallen into the mouth of death; of this there is no doubt. / The god Gaṇeśa was created by us for the accomplishment of purposes.

1.3.s:
na namaṃti gaṇeśaṃ ca durgāṃ caiva tathāvidhām..
kleśabhājo bhaviṣyati nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 10.75 ..
1.3.d:
न नमंति गणेशं च दुर्गां चैव तथाविधाम्..
क्लेशभाजो भविष्यति नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 10.75 ..
1.3.m: Those who do not bow to Gaṇeśa, and likewise to Durgā, / will become partakers of suffering; there should be no deliberation about this.

1.3.s:
yūyaṃ sarve tvadharmiṣṭhāḥ stabdhāḥ paṃḍitamāninaḥ..
kāryākāryamavijñāya kevalaṃ mānamohitāḥ.. 10.76 ..
1.3.d:
यूयं सर्वे त्वधर्मिष्ठाः स्तब्धाः पंडितमानिनः..
कार्याकार्यमविज्ञाय केवलं मानमोहिताः.. 10.76 ..
1.3.m: You all are completely unrighteous, stubborn, thinking yourselves learned, / not knowing what should and should not be done, completely deluded by pride.

1.3.s:
tasmātkālamukhe sarve patitā nātra saṃśayaḥ..
sarve śrutiparā yūyamiṃdrādyā devatāgaṇāḥ.. 10.77 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्कालमुखे सर्वे पतिता नात्र संशयः..
सर्वे श्रुतिपरा यूयमिंद्राद्या देवतागणाः.. 10.77 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, all have fallen into the mouth of Death; of this there is no doubt. / All of you, the hosts of deities headed by Indra, are intent on the Vedic texts,

1.3.s:
prarocanaparāḥ sarve kṣudrāśceṃdrādayo vṛthā..
nātmānaṃ ca prapaṃcena vetsi tvaṃ hi śacīpate.. 10.78 ..
1.3.d:
प्ररोचनपराः सर्वे क्षुद्राश्चेंद्रादयो वृथा..
नात्मानं च प्रपंचेन वेत्सि त्वं हि शचीपते.. 10.78 ..
1.3.m: Yet, [being] petty, Indra and the rest are all vainly devoted to mere cajolery. / Indeed, O lord of Śacī, you do not know yourself in this phenomenal world.

1.3.s:
kṛtaḥ prayatno hi mahānamṛtārthaṃ tvayā śaṭha..
aśvamedhaśatenaiva yadrājyaṃ prāptavānasi..
api tacca parādhīna tanna jānāsi durmate.. 10.79 ..
1.3.d:
कृतः प्रयत्नो हि महानमृतार्थं त्वया शठ..
अश्वमेधशतेनैव यद्राज्यं प्राप्तवानसि..
अपि तच्च पराधीन तन्न जानासि दुर्मते.. 10.79 ..
1.3.m: A great effort was indeed made by you for the sake of nectar, you villain! / The kingdom that you attained solely through a hundred horse-sacrifices— / even that is dependent on others, yet you do not understand it, O evil-minded one!

1.3.s:
yairvadavākyaistvaṃ mūḍha saṃstuto'si tapasvibhiḥ..
te mūḍhāsto ṣayaṃti tvāṃ tattadrāgaparāyaṇāḥ.. 10.80 ..
1.3.d:
यैर्वदवाक्यैस्त्वं मूढ संस्तुतोऽसि तपस्विभिः..
ते मूढास्तो षयंति त्वां तत्तद्रागपरायणाः.. 10.80 ..
1.3.m: The Vedic words by which you have been praised by ascetics, O fool— / those fools, intent on their respective passions, merely flatter you.

1.3.s:
viṣṇo tvaṃ ca pakṣapātānna jānāsi hitāhitam..
kecidadhatāstvayā viṣṇo rakṣitāścaiva kecana.. 10.81 ..
1.3.d:
विष्णो त्वं च पक्षपातान्न जानासि हिताहितम्..
केचिदधतास्त्वया विष्णो रक्षिताश्चैव केचन.. 10.81 ..
1.3.m: And you, O Viṣṇu, because of partiality, do not distinguish between good and bad. / Some were struck down by you, O Viṣṇu, and some were protected.

1.3.s:
icchāyuktastvamatraiva sadā bālakaceṣṭitaḥ..
ye'nye ca lokapāḥ sarve teṣāṃ vārtā kutastviha.. 10.82 ..
1.3.d:
इच्छायुक्तस्त्वमत्रैव सदा बालकचेष्टितः..
येऽन्ये च लोकपाः सर्वे तेषां वार्ता कुतस्त्विह.. 10.82 ..
1.3.m: Possessed of desire here, your behavior is always like that of a child. / As for the others who are world-guardians, what need is there to speak of them here?

1.3.s:
anyathā hi kṛte hyarthe anyathātvaṃ bhaviṣyati..
kāryasiddhirbhavedyena bhavadbhirvismṛtaṃ ca tat.. 10.83 ..
1.3.d:
अन्यथा हि कृते ह्यर्थे अन्यथात्वं भविष्यति..
कार्यसिद्धिर्भवेद्येन भवद्भिर्विस्मृतं च तत्.. 10.83 ..
1.3.m: For if an action is performed incorrectly, contrary results will ensue. / That by which success in an undertaking would arise has been forgotten by you.

1.3.s:
yenādya rakṣitāḥ sarve kālakūṭamahābhayāt..
yena nīlīkṛto viṣṇuryena sarve parājitāḥ.. 10.84 ..
1.3.d:
येनाद्य रक्षिताः सर्वे कालकूटमहाभयात्..
येन नीलीकृतो विष्णुर्येन सर्वे पराजिताः.. 10.84 ..
1.3.m: The one by whom all were protected today from the great terror of the Kālakūṭa poison, / by whom Viṣṇu was turned blue, by whom all were subdued,

1.3.s:
lokā bhasmīkṛtā yena tasmādyenāpi rakṣitāḥ..
tasyārccanāvidhiḥ kāryo gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥ.. 10.85 ..
1.3.d:
लोका भस्मीकृता येन तस्माद्येनापि रक्षिताः..
तस्यार्च्चनाविधिः कार्यो गणेशस्य महात्मनः.. 10.85 ..
1.3.m: By whom the worlds were reduced to ashes, and yet by whom they were also preserved— / the rite of worshipping that great-souled Gaṇeśa must be performed.

1.3.s:
karmāraṃbhe tu vighneśaṃ ye nārcaṃti gaṇādhipam..
kāryasiddhirna teṣāṃ vai bhavettu bhavatāṃ yathā.. 10.86 ..
1.3.d:
कर्मारंभे तु विघ्नेशं ये नार्चंति गणाधिपम्..
कार्यसिद्धिर्न तेषां वै भवेत्तु भवतां यथा.. 10.86 ..
1.3.m: Those who do not worship the lord of obstacles, the commander of the gaṇas, at the beginning of an undertaking / will surely have no success in their enterprise, just like you."

1.3.s:
etanmaheśasya vaco niśamya surāsurāḥ kiṃnaracāraṇāśca..
pūjāvidhānaṃ paramārthato'pi papracchurenaṃ ca tadā girīśam.. 10.87 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṇḍe samudramaṃthanākhyāne śivakṛtaviṣabhakṣaṇavṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 10 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
एतन्महेशस्य वचो निशम्य सुरासुराः किंनरचारणाश्च..
पूजाविधानं परमार्थतोऽपि पप्रच्छुरेनं च तदा गिरीशम्.. 10.87 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखण्डे समुद्रमंथनाख्याने शिवकृतविषभक्षणवृत्तान्तवर्णनंनाम दशमोऽध्यायः.. 10 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
Hearing this speech of the great lord, the gods and demons, Kinnaras and Cāraṇas, / then asked that Lord of the Mountain about the ritual procedure of worship in its true reality. 10.87
Thus ends the tenth chapter, titled “The Description of the Eating of Poison by Śiva in the Account of the Churning of the Ocean,” in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first [part], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 10.

1.3.s:
..maheśvara uvāca..
pratipakṣe caturthyāṃ tu pūjanīyo gaṇādhipaḥ..
snātvā śuklatilaiḥ śuddhaiḥ śuklapakṣe sadā nṛbhiḥ.. 11.1 ..
1.3.d:
..महेश्वर उवाच..
प्रतिपक्षे चतुर्थ्यां तु पूजनीयो गणाधिपः..
स्नात्वा शुक्लतिलैः शुद्धैः शुक्लपक्षे सदा नृभिः.. 11.1 ..
1.3.m: Maheśvara said: / “The commander of the gaṇas is to be worshipped on the fourth day in each fortnight, / having bathed with pure white sesame seeds, always by men during the bright fortnight.

1.3.s:
kṛtvā cāvasyakaṃ sarvaṃ gaṇeśasyārcanakriyām..
prayatnenaiva kurvīta gaṃdhamālyākṣatādibhiḥ.. 11.2 ..
1.3.d:
कृत्वा चावस्यकं सर्वं गणेशस्यार्चनक्रियाम्..
प्रयत्नेनैव कुर्वीत गंधमाल्याक्षतादिभिः.. 11.2 ..
1.3.m: And having performed all obligatory duties, one should diligently carry out / the rite of worship to Gaṇeśa with perfumes, garlands, unbroken grains, and the like.

1.3.s:
dhyānamādau prakartavyaṃ gaṇeśasya yathāvidhi..
āgamā bahavo jātā gaṇeśasya yathā mama.. 11.3 ..
1.3.d:
ध्यानमादौ प्रकर्तव्यं गणेशस्य यथाविधि..
आगमा बहवो जाता गणेशस्य यथा मम.. 11.3 ..
1.3.m: First, the meditation on Gaṇeśa should be properly performed according to rule. / Many scriptures have arisen for Gaṇeśa, just as for me,

1.3.s:
bahudhopāsakā yasmāttamaḥ sattvarajonvitāḥ..
gaṇabhedena tānyeva nāmāni bahudhā'bhavat.. 11.4 ..
1.3.d:
बहुधोपासका यस्मात्तमः सत्त्वरजोन्विताः..
गणभेदेन तान्येव नामानि बहुधाऽभवत्.. 11.4 ..
1.3.m: Because his worshippers are manifold, endowed with darkness, purity, and passion. / According to the classification of gaṇas, those very names have become manifold.

1.3.s:
paṃcavaktro gaṇādhyakṣo daśabāhustrilocanaḥ..
kāṃtasphaṭikasaṃkāśo nīlakaṃṭho gajānanaḥ.. 11.5 ..
1.3.d:
पंचवक्त्रो गणाध्यक्षो दशबाहुस्त्रिलोचनः..
कांतस्फटिकसंकाशो नीलकंठो गजाननः.. 11.5 ..
1.3.m: The presiding lord of gaṇas has five faces, ten arms, and three eyes; / he resembles radiant crystal, has a blue neck, and an elephant face.

1.3.s: mukhāni tasya paṃcaiva kathayāmi yatātatham.. 11.6 ..
1.3.d: मुखानि तस्य पंचैव कथयामि यतातथम्.. 11.6 ..
1.3.m: I shall describe his five faces exactly as they are: 11.6

1.3.s:
madhyamaṃ tu mukhaṃ gauraṃ caturdantaṃ trilocanam..
śuṃḍādaṃḍamanojñaṃ ca puṣkare modakānvitam.. 11.7 ..
1.3.d:
मध्यमं तु मुखं गौरं चतुर्दन्तं त्रिलोचनम्..
शुंडादंडमनोज्ञं च पुष्करे मोदकान्वितम्.. 11.7 ..
1.3.m: The middle face is white, with four tusks and three eyes, / charming with the staff of his trunk, holding a sweetmeat in the tip of the trunk.

1.3.s:
tathānyatpītavarṇaṃ ca nīlaṃ ca śubhalakṣaṇam..
piṃgalaṃ ca tathā śubhraṃ gaṇeśasya śubhānanam.. 11.8 ..
1.3.d:
तथान्यत्पीतवर्णं च नीलं च शुभलक्षणम्..
पिंगलं च तथा शुभ्रं गणेशस्य शुभाननम्.. 11.8 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, another is yellow in color, one is blue with auspicious marks, / another is reddish-brown, and one is white—the auspicious faces of Gaṇeśa.

1.3.s:
tathā daśabhujeṣveva hyāyudhāni bravīmi vaḥ..
pāśaṃ pasśupadme ca aṃkuśaṃ daṃtameva ca.. 11.9 ..
1.3.d:
तथा दशभुजेष्वेव ह्यायुधानि ब्रवीमि वः..
पाशं पस्शुपद्मे च अंकुशं दंतमेव च.. 11.9 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, I shall declare to you the weapons held in his ten arms: / a noose, a battle-axe and a lotus, a goad, and a tusk,

1.3.s:
akṣamālāṃ lāṃgalaṃ ca musalaṃ varadaṃ tathā..
pūrṇaṃ ca modakaiḥ pātraṃ pāṇinā ca viciṃtayet.. 11.10 ..
1.3.d:
अक्षमालां लांगलं च मुसलं वरदं तथा..
पूर्णं च मोदकैः पात्रं पाणिना च विचिंतयेत्.. 11.10 ..
1.3.m: A rosary, a plow, a pestle, the boon-bestowing gesture, / and one should visualize a vessel filled with sweetmeats in his hand.

1.3.s:
laṃbodara virūpākṣaṃ nivītaṃ mekhalānvitam..
yogāsane copaviṣṭaṃ caṃdralekhāṃ kaśekharam.. 11.11 ..
1.3.d:
लंबोदर विरूपाक्षं निवीतं मेखलान्वितम्..
योगासने चोपविष्टं चंद्रलेखां कशेखरम्.. 11.11 ..
1.3.m: One should visualize him with a large belly, uneven eyes, wearing a sacred thread, endowed with a girdle, / seated upon a yogic posture, with the crescent moon on his crest.

1.3.s:
dhyānaṃ ca sāttvikaṃ jñeyaṃ rājasaṃ hi nṛṇāmiva..
śuddhacāmīkarābhāsaṃ gajānanamalaukikam.. 11.12 ..
1.3.d:
ध्यानं च सात्त्विकं ज्ञेयं राजसं हि नृणामिव..
शुद्धचामीकराभासं गजाननमलौकिकम्.. 11.12 ..
1.3.m: This is known as the pure meditation. The passionate one for men [is as follows]: / possessing the radiance of pure gold, with an extraordinary elephant face,

1.3.s:
caturbhujaṃ trinayanamekadaṃtaṃ mahodaram..
pāśāṃkuśadharaṃ devaṃ daṃtamodakapātrakam.. 11.13 ..
1.3.d:
चतुर्भुजं त्रिनयनमेकदंतं महोदरम्..
पाशांकुशधरं देवं दंतमोदकपात्रकम्.. 11.13 ..
1.3.m: Four-armed, three-eyed, with a single tusk, having a large belly, / the god holding a noose and a goad, with a tusk and a bowl of sweetmeats.

1.3.s:
nīlaṃ ca tāmasaṃ dhyānamevaṃ trividhamucyate..
tataḥ pūjā prakartavyā bhavadbhiḥ śīghrameva ca.. 11.14 ..
1.3.d:
नीलं च तामसं ध्यानमेवं त्रिविधमुच्यते..
ततः पूजा प्रकर्तव्या भवद्भिः शीघ्रमेव च.. 11.14 ..
1.3.m: And the dark meditation is [described as] blue. Thus meditation is said to be of three kinds. / Thereupon, worship must be performed by you without delay.

1.3.s:
ekaviṃśatidūrvābhirdvābhyāṃ nāmnā pṛthakpṛthak..
sarvanāmabhirekaiva dīyate gaṇanāyake.. 11.15 ..
1.3.d:
एकविंशतिदूर्वाभिर्द्वाभ्यां नाम्ना पृथक्पृथक्..
सर्वनामभिरेकैव दीयते गणनायके.. 11.15 ..
1.3.m: With twenty-one blades of dūrvā grass, two at a time, individually with each name, / only one [blade] is offered to the leader of the gaṇas with all names combined.

1.3.s:
tathaiva nāmabhirdeyā ekaviṃśatimodakāḥ..
daśanāmānyahaṃ vakṣye pūjanārthaṃ pṛthakpṛthak.. 11.16 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव नामभिर्देया एकविंशतिमोदकाः..
दशनामान्यहं वक्ष्ये पूजनार्थं पृथक्पृथक्.. 11.16 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, twenty-one sweetmeats are to be offered with the names. / I shall recite the ten names individually for the purpose of worship:

1.3.s:
gaṇādhipa namastestu umāputrāghanāśana..
vināyakeśaputroti sarvasiddhipradāyaka.. 11.17 ..
1.3.d:
गणाधिप नमस्तेस्तु उमापुत्राघनाशन..
विनायकेशपुत्रोति सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायक.. 11.17 ..
1.3.m: ‘Obeisance to you, Gaṇādhipa, Son of Umā, Destroyer of sins, / Vināyaka, Son of Īśa, Bestower of all perfections,

1.3.s:
ekadaṃtebhavaktreti tathā mūṣakavāhana..
kumāragurave tubhyaṃ pūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ.. 11.18 ..
1.3.d:
एकदंतेभवक्त्रेति तथा मूषकवाहन..
कुमारगुरवे तुभ्यं पूजनीयः प्रयत्नतः.. 11.18 ..
1.3.m: Single-tusked, Elephant-faced, having a rat as your mount, / Teacher of Kumāra!’ With these, he is to be diligently worshipped by you.

1.3.s:
evamuktvā surānsadyaḥ pariṣvajya ca sādaram..
viṣṇuṃ guhāśayaṃ sadyo brahmāṇaṃ ca sadāśivaḥ.. 11.19 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा सुरान्सद्यः परिष्वज्य च सादरम्..
विष्णुं गुहाशयं सद्यो ब्रह्माणं च सदाशिवः.. 11.19 ..
1.3.m: Having spoken thus to the gods, Sadāśiva immediately embraced with respect / Viṣṇu, who dwells in the secret heart, and Brahmā.

1.3.s:
tirodhāna gataḥ sadyaḥ śaṃbhuḥ paramaśobhanaḥ..
praṇamya śaṃbhuṃ te sarve gaṇādhyakṣārccane ratāḥ.. 11.20 ..
1.3.d:
तिरोधान गतः सद्यः शंभुः परमशोभनः..
प्रणम्य शंभुं ते सर्वे गणाध्यक्षार्च्चने रताः.. 11.20 ..
1.3.m: The exceedingly splendid Śambhu immediately vanished. / Having bowed to Śambhu, all of them engaged in the worship of the presiding lord of gaṇas.

1.3.s:
tataḥ saṃpūjya vidhivadgaṇādhyakṣārccane ratāḥ..
upacārairanekaiśca dūrvābhiśca pṛthakpṛthak.. 11.21 ..
1.3.d:
ततः संपूज्य विधिवद्गणाध्यक्षार्च्चने रताः..
उपचारैरनेकैश्च दूर्वाभिश्च पृथक्पृथक्.. 11.21 ..
1.3.m: Then, having worshipped according to rule, intent upon the worship of the presiding lord of gaṇas / with numerous offerings and dūrvā grasses, individually,

1.3.s:
saṃtuṣṭo hi gaṇādhyakṣo devānāṃ varado'bhavat..
pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskṛtya taiḥ sarvairabhitoṣitaḥ.. 11.22 ..
1.3.d:
संतुष्टो हि गणाध्यक्षो देवानां वरदोऽभवत्..
प्रदक्षिणं नमस्कृत्य तैः सर्वैरभितोषितः.. 11.22 ..
1.3.m: The presiding lord of gaṇas was satisfied and became the granter of boons to the gods. / Circumambulating and bowing, they were all delighted by him.

1.3.s:
tamoguṇānvitāḥ sarve hyasurā nābhyapūjayan..
upahāsaparāste vai devānpratyasurottamāḥ.. 11.23 ..
1.3.d:
तमोगुणान्विताः सर्वे ह्यसुरा नाभ्यपूजयन्..
उपहासपरास्ते वै देवान्प्रत्यसुरोत्तमाः.. 11.23 ..
1.3.m: Endowed with the quality of darkness, all the demons did not worship him. / Those chief demons were solely intent on deriding the gods.

1.3.s:
pūjayitvā śāṃkariṃ te punaḥ kṣīrārṇavaṃ yayuḥ..
brahmā viṣṇuśca ṛṣayo devadaityāḥ surottamāḥ.. 11.24 ..
1.3.d:
पूजयित्वा शांकरिं ते पुनः क्षीरार्णवं ययुः..
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च ऋषयो देवदैत्याः सुरोत्तमाः.. 11.24 ..
1.3.m: Having worshipped the daughter of Śaṅkara, they went back to the ocean of milk— / Brahmā, Viṣṇu, the seers, the gods, and the demons, the foremost of the gods.

1.3.s:
maṃthānaṃ maṃdaraṃ kṛtvā rajjuṃ kṛtvātha vāsukim..
mamaṃthuśca tadā devā viṣṇuṃ kṛtvātha sannidhau.. 11.25 ..
1.3.d:
मंथानं मंदरं कृत्वा रज्जुं कृत्वाथ वासुकिम्..
ममंथुश्च तदा देवा विष्णुं कृत्वाथ सन्निधौ.. 11.25 ..
1.3.m: Making Mandara the churning rod and making Vāsuki the rope, / the gods then churned, placing Viṣṇu in their presence.

1.3.s:
mathyamāne tadābdhau ca nirgataścaṃdra agrataḥ..
pīyūṣapūrṇaḥ sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye.. 11.26 ..
1.3.d:
मथ्यमाने तदाब्धौ च निर्गतश्चंद्र अग्रतः..
पीयूषपूर्णः सर्वेषां देवानां कार्यसिद्धये.. 11.26 ..
1.3.m: Then, as the ocean was being churned, the moon emerged first, / filled with nectar, for the accomplishment of the purpose of all the gods.

1.3.s:
.. śaunaka uvāca..
arṇave kiṃ purā caṃdro nikṣiptaḥ kena suvrata..
gajādikāni ratnāni kathitāni tvayā purā.. 11.27 ..
1.3.d:
.. शौनक उवाच..
अर्णवे किं पुरा चंद्रो निक्षिप्तः केन सुव्रत..
गजादिकानि रत्नानि कथितानि त्वया पुरा.. 11.27 ..
1.3.m: Śaunaka said: / “Why was the moon cast into the ocean in ancient times, and by whom, O you of noble vows? / Jewels such as the elephant were mentioned by you earlier.

1.3.s:
etatsarvaṃ samāsena ādau kathaya me prabho..
jñātvā sarve vayaṃ sūta paścādāvarṇayāmahe.. 11.28 ..
1.3.d:
एतत्सर्वं समासेन आदौ कथय मे प्रभो..
ज्ञात्वा सर्वे वयं सूत पश्चादावर्णयामहे.. 11.28 ..
1.3.m: Tell me all this in brief from the beginning, O lord! / Having understood it, O Sūta, all of us will describe it afterward.”

1.3.s: teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sūto vākyamupādade.. 11.29 ..
1.3.d: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सूतो वाक्यमुपाददे.. 11.29 ..
1.3.m: Hearing their words, Sūta began to speak: 11.29

1.3.s:
caṃdra āpomayo viprā atriputro guṇānvitaḥ..
utpanno hyanasūyāyāṃ brahmaṇoṃ'śātsamudbhavaḥ..
rudrasyāṃśāddhi durvāsā viṣṇoraṃśāttu dattakaḥ.. 11.30 ..
1.3.d:
चंद्र आपोमयो विप्रा अत्रिपुत्रो गुणान्वितः..
उत्पन्नो ह्यनसूयायां ब्रह्मणोंऽशात्समुद्भवः..
रुद्रस्यांशाद्धि दुर्वासा विष्णोरंशात्तु दत्तकः.. 11.30 ..
1.3.m: “The moon consists of water, O brahmins, is the virtuous son of Atri, / born from Anasūyā, arising from a portion of Brahmā. / Durvāsas arose from a portion of Rudra, and Dattātreya from a portion of Viṣṇu.

1.3.s:
kṣīrābdhiṃ mathyamānaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā caṃdro mudānvitaḥ..
kṣīrābdhirapi caṃdraṃ ca dṛṣṭvā so'pyutsuko'bhavat.. 11.31 ..
1.3.d:
क्षीराब्धिं मथ्यमानं तु दृष्ट्वा चंद्रो मुदान्वितः..
क्षीराब्धिरपि चंद्रं च दृष्ट्वा सोऽप्युत्सुकोऽभवत्.. 11.31 ..
1.3.m: Seeing the ocean of milk being churned, the moon was filled with joy; / and seeing the moon, the ocean of milk also became eager.

1.3.s:
praviṣṭaścobhayaprītyā śrṛṇvatāṃ bho dvijottamāḥ..
caṃdro hyamṛta pūrṇobhūdagrato devasannidhau.. 11.32 ..
1.3.d:
प्रविष्टश्चोभयप्रीत्या श्रृण्वतां भो द्विजोत्तमाः..
चंद्रो ह्यमृत पूर्णोभूदग्रतो देवसन्निधौ.. 11.32 ..
1.3.m: And entered out of mutual affection, listen, O best of twice-born [brahmins]! / Indeed, full of nectar, the Moon stood before them in the presence of the gods.

1.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā ca kāṃtiṃ tvarito'tha caṃdro nīrājito devagaṇaistadānīm..
vāditragoṣaistumulairanekairmṛdaṃgaśaṃkhaiḥ paṭahairanekaiḥ.. 11.33 ..
1.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा च कांतिं त्वरितोऽथ चंद्रो नीराजितो देवगणैस्तदानीम्..
वादित्रगोषैस्तुमुलैरनेकैर्मृदंगशंखैः पटहैरनेकैः.. 11.33 ..
1.3.m: And seeing his radiance, the Moon was then quickly honored with waving lights by the hosts of gods, / amidst tumultuous and diverse sounds of musical instruments, many mṛdaṅgas, conches, and paṭahas.

1.3.s:
namaścakruśca te sarve sasurāsuradānavāḥ..
tadā gargaṃ pṛcchamānā balaṃ caṃdrasya tattvataḥ.. 11.34 ..
1.3.d:
नमश्चक्रुश्च ते सर्वे ससुरासुरदानवाः..
तदा गर्गं पृच्छमाना बलं चंद्रस्य तत्त्वतः.. 11.34 ..
1.3.m: All of them, together with the gods, asuras, and dānavas, bowed down, / then asking Garga about the true strength of the Moon.

1.3.s:
gargeṇoktāstadā sarveṣāṃ balamadya vai..
keṃdrasthānagatāḥ sarve bhavatāmuttamā grahāḥ.. 11.35 ..
1.3.d:
गर्गेणोक्तास्तदा सर्वेषां बलमद्य वै..
केंद्रस्थानगताः सर्वे भवतामुत्तमा ग्रहाः.. 11.35 ..
1.3.m: They were then spoken to by Garga: “Today indeed is the strength of you all; / all the finest planets are situated in the center [kendras] for you.

1.3.s:
caṃdraṃ muruḥ samāyāto budhaścaiva samāgataḥ..
ādityaśca tathā śukraḥ śaniraṃgārako mahān.. 11.36 ..
1.3.d:
चंद्रं मुरुः समायातो बुधश्चैव समागतः..
आदित्यश्च तथा शुक्रः शनिरंगारको महान्.. 11.36 ..
1.3.m: Jupiter has approached the Moon, and Mercury too has arrived; / and likewise the Sun, Venus, Saturn, and mighty Mars.

1.3.s:
tasmāccaṃdrabalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhavatāṃ kāryasiddhaye..
gomaṃtasaṃjñakonāma muhūrto'yaṃ jayapradaḥ.. 11.37 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माच्चंद्रबलं श्रेष्ठं भवतां कार्यसिद्धये..
गोमंतसंज्ञकोनाम मुहूर्तोऽयं जयप्रदः.. 11.37 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, the strength of the Moon is supreme for the accomplishment of your purpose; / this muhūrta named Gomanta grants victory.”

1.3.s:
evamāśvāsitā devā gargeṇaiva mahātmanā..
mamaṃthurabdhiṃ tvaritā garjamānā mahābalāḥ.. 11.38 ..
1.3.d:
एवमाश्वासिता देवा गर्गेणैव महात्मना..
ममंथुरब्धिं त्वरिता गर्जमाना महाबलाः.. 11.38 ..
1.3.m: Thus reassured by the high-souled Garga himself, / the gods, exceedingly strong and roaring, quickly churned the ocean.

1.3.s:
dviguṇaṃ balamāpannā mahātmāno dṛḍhavratāḥ..
maheśaṃ smaramāṇāste gaṇeśaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ.. 11.39 ..
1.3.d:
द्विगुणं बलमापन्ना महात्मानो दृढव्रताः..
महेशं स्मरमाणास्ते गणेशं च पुनः पुनः.. 11.39 ..
1.3.m: Having attained double strength, the high-souled ones of firm resolve, / remembering Maheśa and Gaṇeśa again and again,

1.3.s:
nirmathyamānādudadhergarjamānācca sarvaśaḥ..
nirgatā surabhiḥ sākṣāddevānāṃ kāryasiddhaye.. 11.40 ..
1.3.d:
निर्मथ्यमानादुदधेर्गर्जमानाच्च सर्वशः..
निर्गता सुरभिः साक्षाद्देवानां कार्यसिद्धये.. 11.40 ..
1.3.m: from the ocean being thoroughly churned and roaring on every side, / Surabhi came forth in visible form for the accomplishment of the purpose of the gods.

1.3.s:
tuṣṭā kapilavarṇāṃ sā ūdhobhāreṇa bhūyasā..
taraṃgopari gacchaṃtī śanakaiḥ śanakaistataḥ.. 11.41 ..
1.3.d:
तुष्टा कपिलवर्णां सा ऊधोभारेण भूयसा..
तरंगोपरि गच्छंती शनकैः शनकैस्ततः.. 11.41 ..
1.3.m: Contented, of a tawny color, with a massive weight of udder, / moving over the waves very gently step by step,

1.3.s:
kāmadhenuṃ samāyāṃtīṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve surāsurāḥ..
puṣpavarṣeṇa mahatā vavarṣuramitaprabhām.. 11.42 ..
1.3.d:
कामधेनुं समायांतीं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे सुरासुराः..
पुष्पवर्षेण महता ववर्षुरमितप्रभाम्.. 11.42 ..
1.3.m: seeing the wish-fulfilling cow approaching, all the gods and asuras / rained down a great shower of flowers upon her of boundless splendor.

1.3.s:
tadā tūryāṇyanekāni nedurvādyānyanekaśaḥ..
ānītā jalamadhyācca saṃvṛtā gośatairapi.. 11.43 ..
1.3.d:
तदा तूर्याण्यनेकानि नेदुर्वाद्यान्यनेकशः..
आनीता जलमध्याच्च संवृता गोशतैरपि.. 11.43 ..
1.3.m: Then many musical horns sounded and diverse instruments repeatedly; / brought out from the midst of the waters, she was also surrounded by hundreds of cows.

1.3.s:
tāsu nīlāśca kṛṣṇaśca kapilāśca kapiṃjalāḥ..
babhravaḥ śyāmakā raktā jaṃbūvarṇāśca piṃgalāḥ..
ābhiryuktā tadā gobhiḥ surabhiḥ pratyadṛśyata.. 11.44 ..
1.3.d:
तासु नीलाश्च कृष्णश्च कपिलाश्च कपिंजलाः..
बभ्रवः श्यामका रक्ता जंबूवर्णाश्च पिंगलाः..
आभिर्युक्ता तदा गोभिः सुरभिः प्रत्यदृश्यत.. 11.44 ..
1.3.m: Among them were dark-blue, black, tawny, partridge-colored, / reddish-brown, dark, red, rose-apple colored, and yellowish-brown ones; / accompanied by these cows, Surabhi was then beheld.

1.3.s:
asurāsurasaṃvītāṃ kāmadhenuṃ yayācire..
ṛṣayo harṣasaṃyuktā devāndaityāṃśca tatkṣaṇāt.. 11.45 ..
1.3.d:
असुरासुरसंवीतां कामधेनुं ययाचिरे..
ऋषयो हर्षसंयुक्ता देवान्दैत्यांश्च तत्क्षणात्.. 11.45 ..
1.3.m: Filled with joy, the seers at once begged the gods and the daityas / for the wish-fulfilling cow who was surrounded by the gods and asuras:

1.3.s:
sarvebhyaścaiva viprebhyo nānāgotrebhya eva ca..
surabhīsahitā gāvo dātavyā nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 11.46 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वेभ्यश्चैव विप्रेभ्यो नानागोत्रेभ्य एव च..
सुरभीसहिता गावो दातव्या नात्र संशयः.. 11.46 ..
1.3.m: “To all the brahmins of diverse lineages / the cows, accompanied by Surabhi, must indeed be given; of this there is no doubt.”

1.3.s:
tairyācitāste'tra surāsurāśca daduśca tā gāḥ śivatoṣaṇāya..
taiḥ svīkṛtāstā ṛṣibhiḥ sumaṃgalairmahātmabhiḥ puṇyatamaiḥ surabhyaḥ.. 11.47 ..
1.3.d:
तैर्याचितास्तेऽत्र सुरासुराश्च ददुश्च ता गाः शिवतोषणाय..
तैः स्वीकृतास्ता ऋषिभिः सुमंगलैर्महात्मभिः पुण्यतमैः सुरभ्यः.. 11.47 ..
1.3.m: Begged by them, the gods and asuras then gave those cows for the pleasure of Śiva; / those cows were received by the auspicious, high-souled, most meritorious seers.

1.3.s:
puṇyāhaṃ munibhiḥ sarvaiḥ kāritāste tadā surāḥ..
devānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthamasurāṇāṃ kṣayāya ca.. 11.48 ..
1.3.d:
पुण्याहं मुनिभिः सर्वैः कारितास्ते तदा सुराः..
देवानां कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थमसुराणां क्षयाय च.. 11.48 ..
1.3.m: All the sages then caused the declaration of an auspicious day to be made by those gods, / for the accomplishment of the purpose of the gods and for the destruction of the asuras.

1.3.s:
punaḥ sarve susaṃrabdhā mamaṃthuḥ kṣīrasāgaram..
mathyamānāttadā tasmādudadheśca tathā'bhavat.. 11.49 ..
1.3.d:
पुनः सर्वे सुसंरब्धा ममंथुः क्षीरसागरम्..
मथ्यमानात्तदा तस्मादुदधेश्च तथाऽभवत्.. 11.49 ..
1.3.m: Again, with great fury, all of them churned the Ocean of Milk. / As that ocean was then being churned, there appeared

1.3.s:
kalpavṛkṣaḥ pārijātaścūtaḥ saṃtānakastathā..
tāndrumānekataḥ kṛtvā gandharvanagaropamān..
mamaṃthurugraṃ tvaritāḥ punaḥ kṣīrārṇavaṃ budhā.. 11.50 ..
1.3.d:
कल्पवृक्षः पारिजातश्चूतः संतानकस्तथा..
तान्द्रुमानेकतः कृत्वा गन्धर्वनगरोपमान्..
ममंथुरुग्रं त्वरिताः पुनः क्षीरार्णवं बुधा.. 11.50 ..
1.3.m: the wish-fulfilling tree, the Pārijāta, the mango, and the Saṃtānaka. / Setting aside those trees resembling the city of the Gandharvas, / the wise ones quickly and fiercely churned the Ocean of Milk once more.

1.3.s:
nirmathyamānādudadherabhavatsūryavarcasam..
ratnānāmuttamaṃ ratnaṃ kaustubhākhyaṃ mahāprabham.. 11.51 ..
1.3.d:
निर्मथ्यमानादुदधेरभवत्सूर्यवर्चसम्..
रत्नानामुत्तमं रत्नं कौस्तुभाख्यं महाप्रभम्.. 11.51 ..
1.3.m: From the ocean being churned, having the luster of the sun, / arose the best of jewels among all gems, named Kaustubha, possessing great splendor,

1.3.s:
svakīyena prakāśena bhāsayaṃtaṃ jagattrayam..
ciṃtāmaṇiṃ puraskṛtya kaustubhaṃ dadṛśurhi te.. 11.52 ..
1.3.d:
स्वकीयेन प्रकाशेन भासयंतं जगत्त्रयम्..
चिंतामणिं पुरस्कृत्य कौस्तुभं ददृशुर्हि ते.. 11.52 ..
1.3.m: illuminating the three worlds by its own radiance. / Placing the wish-fulfilling jewel [Cintāmaṇi] in front, they beheld the Kaustubha.

1.3.s:
sarve surā dadustaṃ vai kaustubhaṃ viṣṇave tadā..
ciṃtāmaṇi tataḥ kṛtvā madhye caiva surāsurāḥ..
mamaṃthuḥ punarevābdhiṃ garjaṃtaste balotkaṭāḥ.. 11.53 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वे सुरा ददुस्तं वै कौस्तुभं विष्णवे तदा..
चिंतामणि ततः कृत्वा मध्ये चैव सुरासुराः..
ममंथुः पुनरेवाब्धिं गर्जंतस्ते बलोत्कटाः.. 11.53 ..
1.3.m: All the gods then gave that Kaustubha to Viṣṇu. / Then, placing the wish-fulfilling jewel in the middle, the gods and asuras, / mighty in strength, roaring, again churned the ocean.

1.3.s:
mathyamānāttatastasmāduccaiḥśravāḥ samadbhutam..
babhūva aśvo ratnānāṃ punaścairāvato gajaḥ.. 11.54 ..
1.3.d:
मथ्यमानात्ततस्तस्मादुच्चैःश्रवाः समद्भुतम्..
बभूव अश्वो रत्नानां पुनश्चैरावतो गजः.. 11.54 ..
1.3.m: As it was being churned, from it then arose the wondrous / jewel of horses, Uccaiḥśravas, and again the elephant Airāvata,

1.3.s:
tathaiva gajaratnaṃ ca catuḥṣaṣṭyā samanvitam..
gajānāṃ pāṃḍurāṇāṃ ca caturddantaṃ madānvitam.. 11.55 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव गजरत्नं च चतुःषष्ट्या समन्वितम्..
गजानां पांडुराणां च चतुर्द्दन्तं मदान्वितम्.. 11.55 ..
1.3.m: and likewise the jewel among elephants, accompanied by sixty-four / white elephants, four-tusked and in rut.

1.3.s:
tānsarvānmadhyataḥ kṛtvā punaścaiva mamaṃthire..
nirmathyamānādudadhernirgatāni bahūnyatha.. 11.56 ..
1.3.d:
तान्सर्वान्मध्यतः कृत्वा पुनश्चैव ममंथिरे..
निर्मथ्यमानादुदधेर्निर्गतानि बहून्यथ.. 11.56 ..
1.3.m: Placing all those in the middle, they churned yet again. / From the ocean being churned, many things then came forth:

1.3.s:
madirā vijayā bhṛṃgī tathā laśunagṛṃjanāḥ..
atīva unmādakaro dhattūraḥ puṣkarastathā.. 11.57 ..
1.3.d:
मदिरा विजया भृंगी तथा लशुनगृंजनाः..
अतीव उन्मादकरो धत्तूरः पुष्करस्तथा.. 11.57 ..
1.3.m: liquor, hemp [vijayā], bhṛṅgī, as well as garlic and leeks, / the exceedingly intoxicating datura, and puṣkara.

1.3.s:
sthāpitā naikapadyena tīre nadanadīpateḥ..
punaśca te tatra mahāsurendrā mamaṃthurabdhiṃ surasattamaiḥ saha.. 11.58 ..
1.3.d:
स्थापिता नैकपद्येन तीरे नदनदीपतेः..
पुनश्च ते तत्र महासुरेन्द्रा ममंथुरब्धिं सुरसत्तमैः सह.. 11.58 ..
1.3.m: Placed in no single place on the shore of the lord of rivers and streams, / there once again those great lords of asuras churned the ocean together with the best of gods.

1.3.s:
nirmathyamānādudadhestadāsītsā divya lakṣmīrbhuvanaikanāthā..
ānvīkṣikīṃ brahmavido vadaṃti tathaā cānye mūlavidyāṃ gṛṇaṃti.. 11.59 ..
1.3.d:
निर्मथ्यमानादुदधेस्तदासीत्सा दिव्य लक्ष्मीर्भुवनैकनाथा..
आन्वीक्षिकीं ब्रह्मविदो वदंति तथआ चान्ये मूलविद्यां गृणंति.. 11.59 ..
1.3.m: From the ocean being churned, there then arose divine Lakṣmī, the sole sovereign of the universe, / whom the knowers of Brahman call Dialectics [Ānvīkṣikī], and whom others proclaim to be the Primal Lore [Mūlavidyā].

1.3.s:
brahmavidyāṃ kecidāhuḥ samarthāḥ kecitsiddhimṛddhimājñā mathāśām..
yāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ yoginaḥ kecidāhustathā ca māyāṃ māyino nityayuktāḥ.. 11.60 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मविद्यां केचिदाहुः समर्थाः केचित्सिद्धिमृद्धिमाज्ञा मथाशाम्..
यां वैष्णवीं योगिनः केचिदाहुस्तथा च मायां मायिनो नित्ययुक्ताः.. 11.60 ..
1.3.m: Some capable ones call her Knowledge of Brahman [Brahmavidyā], some perfection [siddhi], prosperity [ṛddhi], authority [ājñā], and hope [āśā]; / some yogins call her the power of Viṣṇu [Vaiṣṇavī], and the ever-focused sorcerers call her Māyā.

1.3.s: vadaṃti sarve kenasiddhāṃtayuktāṃ yāṃ yogamāyāṃ jñānaśaktyānvitā ye.. 11.61 ..
1.3.d: वदंति सर्वे केनसिद्धांतयुक्तां यां योगमायां ज्ञानशक्त्यान्विता ये.. 11.61 ..
1.3.m: All those endowed with the power of knowledge, following what doctrine, proclaim her as Yogamāyā.

1.3.s:
dadṛśustāṃ mahālakṣmīmāyāṃtī śanakaistadā..
gaurāṃ ca yuvatīṃ snigdhāṃ padmakiṃjalkabhūṣaṇām.. 11.62 ..
1.3.d:
ददृशुस्तां महालक्ष्मीमायांती शनकैस्तदा..
गौरां च युवतीं स्निग्धां पद्मकिंजल्कभूषणाम्.. 11.62 ..
1.3.m: They then saw Mahālakṣmī slowly approaching— / fair and youthful, charming, adorned with the filaments of lotuses,

1.3.s:
susmitāṃ sudvijāṃ śyāmāṃ navayauvanabhūṣaṇām..
vicitravastrābharaṇaratnānekodyataprabhām.. 11.63 ..
1.3.d:
सुस्मितां सुद्विजां श्यामां नवयौवनभूषणाम्..
विचित्रवस्त्राभरणरत्नानेकोद्यतप्रभाम्.. 11.63 ..
1.3.m: gently smiling, with beautiful teeth, of youthful bloom, adorned with fresh youth, / whose radiant splendor was heightened by various garments, ornaments, and jewels,

1.3.s:
biṃboṣṭhīṃ sunasāṃ tanvīṃ sugrīvāṃ cārulocanām..
sumadhyāṃ cārujaghanāṃ bṛhatkaṭitaṭāṃ tathā.. 11.64 ..
1.3.d:
बिंबोष्ठीं सुनसां तन्वीं सुग्रीवां चारुलोचनाम्..
सुमध्यां चारुजघनां बृहत्कटितटां तथा.. 11.64 ..
1.3.m: with lips like the bimba fruit, a fine nose, slender-waisted, with a beautiful neck and lovely eyes, / possessing a slender waist, attractive hips, and large thighs,

1.3.s:
nānāratnapradīpaiśca nīrājitamukhāṃbujām..
cāruprasannavadanāṃ hāranūpūraśobhitām.. 11.65 ..
1.3.d:
नानारत्नप्रदीपैश्च नीराजितमुखांबुजाम्..
चारुप्रसन्नवदनां हारनूपूरशोभिताम्.. 11.65 ..
1.3.m: whose lotus face was illuminated by lamps of various gems, / with a lovely and serene countenance, adorned with necklaces and anklets,

1.3.s:
mūrddhani dhriyamāṇena cchatreṇāpi virājitām..
cāmarairvījyamānāṃ tāṃ gaṃgākallolalohitaiḥ.. 11.66 ..
1.3.d:
मूर्द्धनि ध्रियमाणेन च्छत्रेणापि विराजिताम्..
चामरैर्वीज्यमानां तां गंगाकल्लोललोहितैः.. 11.66 ..
1.3.m: resplendent beneath a parasol held over her head, / being fanned with chowries as bright as the billows of the Gaṅgā,

1.3.s:
pāṃḍuraṃ gajamārūḍhāṃ stūyamānāṃ maharṣibhiḥ..
suradrumapuṣpamālāṃ bibhratīṃ mallikāyutām.. 11.67 ..
1.3.d:
पांडुरं गजमारूढां स्तूयमानां महर्षिभिः..
सुरद्रुमपुष्पमालां बिभ्रतीं मल्लिकायुताम्.. 11.67 ..
1.3.m: mounted upon a pale white elephant, praised by the great seers, / wearing a garland of divine flowers interwoven with jasmine blossoms.

1.3.s:
karāgre dhriyamāṇāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devāḥ samutsukāḥ..
ālokanaparā yāvattāvattāndadṛśe hyasau.. 11.68 ..
1.3.d:
कराग्रे ध्रियमाणां तां दृष्ट्वा देवाः समुत्सुकाः..
आलोकनपरा यावत्तावत्तान्ददृशे ह्यसौ.. 11.68 ..
1.3.m: Seeing that [garland] held at the tips of her hands, the gods were filled with longing; / as they were gazing at her, she then looked upon them—

1.3.s:
devāṃśca dānavāṃścaiva siddhacāraṇapannagān..
yathā mātā svaputrāṃśca mahālakṣmīstathā satī.. 11.69 ..
1.3.d:
देवांश्च दानवांश्चैव सिद्धचारणपन्नगान्..
यथा माता स्वपुत्रांश्च महालक्ष्मीस्तथा सती.. 11.69 ..
1.3.m: upon the gods and the dānavas, the siddhas, cāraṇas, and serpents— / just as a virtuous mother looks upon her own sons, so did Mahālakṣmī.

1.3.s:
ālokitāstathā devāstayā lakṣmyā śriyānvitāḥ..
sañjātāstatkṣaṇādeva rājya lakṣaṇalakṣitāḥ..
daityāste niḥśrikā jātā ye śriyā'navalokitāḥ.. 11.70 ..
1.3.d:
आलोकितास्तथा देवास्तया लक्ष्म्या श्रियान्विताः..
सञ्जातास्तत्क्षणादेव राज्य लक्षणलक्षिताः..
दैत्यास्ते निःश्रिका जाता ये श्रियाऽनवलोकिताः.. 11.70 ..
1.3.m: Gazed upon by that Lakṣmī, the gods were endowed with fortune, / and instantly became marked with the signs of sovereignty; / those daityas who were not looked upon by Lakṣmī became devoid of fortune.

1.3.s:
nirīkṣyamāṇā ca tadā mukundaṃ tamālanīlaṃ sukapolanāsam..
vibhrājamānaṃ vapuṣā pareṇa śrīvatsalakṣmaṃ sadayāvalokam.. 11.71 ..
1.3.d:
निरीक्ष्यमाणा च तदा मुकुन्दं तमालनीलं सुकपोलनासम्..
विभ्राजमानं वपुषा परेण श्रीवत्सलक्ष्मं सदयावलोकम्.. 11.71 ..
1.3.m: And then she looked upon Mukunda, dark as a tamāla tree, with lovely cheeks and nose, / resplendent with a supreme form, marked with the Śrīvatsa, casting a compassionate glance.

1.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tadaiva sahasā vanamālayānvitā lakṣmīrgajādavatatāra suvismayaṃtī..
kaṃṭhe sasarja puruṣasya parasya viṣṇormālāṃ śriyā viracitāṃ bhramarairupetām.. 11.72 ..
1.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तदैव सहसा वनमालयान्विता लक्ष्मीर्गजादवततार सुविस्मयंती..
कंठे ससर्ज पुरुषस्य परस्य विष्णोर्मालां श्रिया विरचितां भ्रमरैरुपेताम्.. 11.72 ..
1.3.m: Having seen [him], Lakṣmī, adorned with a garland of forest flowers, at once stepped down from the elephant, greatly astonishing [all]; / she placed around the neck of Viṣṇu, the Supreme Person, a garland fashioned by Śrī and surrounded by bees. 11.72

1.3.s:
vāmāṃgamāśritya tadā mahātmanaḥ sopāviśattatra samīkṣya tā ubhau..
surāḥ sadaityā mudamāpuradbhutāṃ siddhāpsaraḥ kiṃnaracāraṇāśca.. 11.73 ..
1.3.d:
वामांगमाश्रित्य तदा महात्मनः सोपाविशत्तत्र समीक्ष्य ता उभौ..
सुराः सदैत्या मुदमापुरद्भुतां सिद्धाप्सरः किंनरचारणाश्च.. 11.73 ..
1.3.m: Taking her place at the left side of that great soul, she sat there; seeing the two of them, / the gods and the daityas, along with the siddhas, apsarases, kinnaras, and cāraṇas, felt wondrous joy. 11.73

1.3.s:
