sarveṣāmeva lokānāmaikapadyena sarvaśaḥ..
harṣo mahānabhūttatra lakṣmīnārāyaṇāgame.. 11.74 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वेषामेव लोकानामैकपद्येन सर्वशः..
हर्षो महानभूत्तत्र लक्ष्मीनारायणागमे.. 11.74 ..
1.3.m: All the worlds together on every side / felt great delight at the union of Lakṣmī and Nārāyaṇa. 11.74

1.3.s:
lakṣmyā vṛto mahāviṣṇurlakṣmīstenaiva saṃvṛtā..
evaṃ parasparaṃ prītyā hyavalokanatatparau.. 11.75 ..
1.3.d:
लक्ष्म्या वृतो महाविष्णुर्लक्ष्मीस्तेनैव संवृता..
एवं परस्परं प्रीत्या ह्यवलोकनतत्परौ.. 11.75 ..
1.3.m: Mahāviṣṇu was chosen by Lakṣmī, and Lakṣmī was embraced by him; / thus, out of love, both were intent on gazing at one another. 11.75

1.3.s:
śaṃkhāśca paṭahāścaiva mṛdaṃgānakagomukhāḥ..
bheryaśca jharjharīṇāṃ ca sa śabdastumulo'bhavat.. 11.76 ..
1.3.d:
शंखाश्च पटहाश्चैव मृदंगानकगोमुखाः..
भेर्यश्च झर्झरीणां च स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत्.. 11.76 ..
1.3.m: Conches, kettle-drums, mṛdaṅgas, ānakas, gomukhas, / bherīs, and jharjharīs—tumultuous arose that sound. 11.76

1.3.s:
babhūva gāyakānāṃ ca gāyanaṃ sumahattadā..
tatāni vitatānyena ghānāni suṣirāṇi ca.. 11.77 ..
1.3.d:
बभूव गायकानां च गायनं सुमहत्तदा..
ततानि विततान्येन घानानि सुषिराणि च.. 11.77 ..
1.3.m: A magnificent singing of vocalists then took place, / along with [instruments] stringed, percussion, solid, and wind. 11.77

1.3.s:
evaṃ vādyaprabhedaiśca viṣṇuṃ sarvātmanā harim..
atoṣayansugītajñā gaṃdharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ.. 11.78 ..
1.3.d:
एवं वाद्यप्रभेदैश्च विष्णुं सर्वात्मना हरिम्..
अतोषयन्सुगीतज्ञा गंधर्वाप्सरसां गणाः.. 11.78 ..
1.3.m: Thus, with varieties of instruments, the gandharvas and hosts of apsarases, skilled in fine song, / pleased Viṣṇu, Hari, with all their soul. 11.78

1.3.s:
tathā jagurnāradatuṃburādayo gaṃdharvayakṣāḥ surasiddha saṃghāḥ..
saṃsevamānāḥ paramātmarūpaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devamagādhabodham.. 11.79 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṇḍe samudramanthanākhyāne lakṣmīprādurbhāvavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 11 ..
1.3.d:
तथा जगुर्नारदतुंबुरादयो गंधर्वयक्षाः सुरसिद्ध संघाः..
संसेवमानाः परमात्मरूपं नारायणं देवमगाधबोधम्.. 11.79 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखण्डे समुद्रमन्थनाख्याने लक्ष्मीप्रादुर्भाववर्णनंनामैकादशोऽध्यायः.. 11 ..
1.3.m:
Likewise sang Nārada, Tumburu, and others, the gandharvas, yakṣas, and hosts of gods and siddhas, / paying homage to Lord Nārāyaṇa, the embodiment of the Supreme Self, of unfathomable wisdom. 11.79
Thus ends the eleventh chapter, titled “Description of the Manifestation of Lakṣmī” in the account of the Churning of the Ocean, in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 11

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
praṇamya paramātmānaṃ ramāyuktaṃ janārddanam..
amṛtārthaṃ mamaṃthuste surāsuragaṇāḥ punaḥ.. 12.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
प्रणम्य परमात्मानं रमायुक्तं जनार्द्दनम्..
अमृतार्थं ममंथुस्ते सुरासुरगणाः पुनः.. 12.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Having bowed to the Supreme Self, Janārdana accompanied by Ramā, / those hosts of gods and asuras churned again for the sake of the nectar of immortality. 12.1

1.3.s:
udadhermathyamānācca nirgataḥ sumahāyaśāḥ..
dhanvaṃtaririti khyāto yuvā mṛtyuñjayaḥ paraḥ.. 12.2 ..
1.3.d:
उदधेर्मथ्यमानाच्च निर्गतः सुमहायशाः..
धन्वंतरिरिति ख्यातो युवा मृत्युञ्जयः परः.. 12.2 ..
1.3.m: From the ocean as it was being churned emerged one of very great fame, / known as Dhanvantari, youthful, the supreme conqueror of death. 12.2

1.3.s:
pāṇibhyāṃ pūrṇakalaśaṃ sudhāyāḥ parigṛhya vai..
yāvatsarve surāḥ sarve nirīkṣaṃte manoharam.. 12.3 ..
1.3.d:
पाणिभ्यां पूर्णकलशं सुधायाः परिगृह्य वै..
यावत्सर्वे सुराः सर्वे निरीक्षंते मनोहरम्.. 12.3 ..
1.3.m: Holding in both hands a full pitcher of nectar, / while all the gods looked upon him with enchantment, 12.3

1.3.s:
tadā daityāḥ samaṃ gatvā hartukāmā balādiva..
sudhayā pūrṇakalaśaṃ dhanvaṃtarikare sthitam.. 12.4 ..
1.3.d:
तदा दैत्याः समं गत्वा हर्तुकामा बलादिव..
सुधया पूर्णकलशं धन्वंतरिकरे स्थितम्.. 12.4 ..
1.3.m: the daityas rushed together, eager to seize by force, as it were, / the pitcher filled with nectar held in Dhanvantari's hand. 12.4

1.3.s:
yāvattaraṃgamālābhirāvṛto'bhūdbhiṣaktamaḥ..
śanaiḥ śanaiḥ samāyāto dṛṣṭo'sau vṛṣaparvaṇā.. 12.5 ..
1.3.d:
यावत्तरंगमालाभिरावृतोऽभूद्भिषक्तमः..
शनैः शनैः समायातो दृष्टोऽसौ वृषपर्वणा.. 12.5 ..
1.3.m: While that foremost of physicians was surrounded by rows of waves, / he came forth slowly, slowly, and was spotted by Vṛṣaparvan. 12.5

1.3.s:
karasthaḥ kalaśastasya hṛtastena balādiva..
asurāśca tataḥ sarve jagarjuratibhīṣaṇam.. 12.6 ..
1.3.d:
करस्थः कलशस्तस्य हृतस्तेन बलादिव..
असुराश्च ततः सर्वे जगर्जुरतिभीषणम्.. 12.6 ..
1.3.m: The pitcher in his hand was snatched by him, as if by force, / and then all the asuras roared most dreadfully. 12.6

1.3.s:
kalaśaṃ sudhayā pūrṇaṃ gṛhītvā te samutsukāḥ..
daityāḥ pātālamājagmustadā devā bhramānvitāḥ.. 12.7 ..
1.3.d:
कलशं सुधया पूर्णं गृहीत्वा ते समुत्सुकाः..
दैत्याः पातालमाजग्मुस्तदा देवा भ्रमान्विताः.. 12.7 ..
1.3.m: Taking the pitcher filled with nectar, eager, / the daityas went down to Pātāla; then the gods, bewildered, 12.7

1.3.s:
anujagmuḥ susaṃnaddhā yoddhukāmāśca taiḥ saha..
tadā devānsamālokya balirevamabhāṣata.. 12.8 ..
1.3.d:
अनुजग्मुः सुसंनद्धा योद्धुकामाश्च तैः सह..
तदा देवान्समालोक्य बलिरेवमभाषत.. 12.8 ..
1.3.m: followed them, fully armored and wishing to fight with them. / Then, seeing the gods, Bali spoke in this manner: 12.8

1.3.s:
.. baliruvāca..
vayaṃ tu kevalaṃ devāḥ sudhayā paritoṣitāḥ..
śīghrameva pragaṃtavyaṃ bhavadbhiśca surottamaiḥ.. 12.9 ..
1.3.d:
.. बलिरुवाच..
वयं तु केवलं देवाः सुधया परितोषिताः..
शीघ्रमेव प्रगंतव्यं भवद्भिश्च सुरोत्तमैः.. 12.9 ..
1.3.m: Bali said: / “O gods, we alone are satisfied with the nectar; / you best among the gods should depart at once! 12.9

1.3.s:
triviṣṭapaṃ mudā yuktaiḥ kimasmābhiḥ prayojanam..
purāsmābhiḥ kṛtaṃ maitraṃ bhavadbhiḥ svārthatatparaiḥ..
adhunā viditaṃ tattu nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 12.10 ..
1.3.d:
त्रिविष्टपं मुदा युक्तैः किमस्माभिः प्रयोजनम्..
पुरास्माभिः कृतं मैत्रं भवद्भिः स्वार्थतत्परैः..
अधुना विदितं तत्तु नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 12.10 ..
1.3.m: To heaven, full of joy! What business have you with us? / Formerly, friendship was made by us, but you were intent on your own interests; / now that is known, and no further deliberation is needed here.” 12.10

1.3.s:
evaṃ nirbhārtsitāstena balinā surasattamāḥ..
yathāgatena mārgeṇa jagmurnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum.. 12.11 ..
1.3.d:
एवं निर्भार्त्सितास्तेन बलिना सुरसत्तमाः..
यथागतेन मार्गेण जग्मुर्नारायणं प्रभुम्.. 12.11 ..
1.3.m: Thus reviled by that Bali, the best of the gods / went by the way they had come to Lord Nārāyaṇa. 12.11

1.3.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇunā sarve surā bhagnamanorathā..
āśvāsitā vacobhiśca nānānunayako vidaiḥ.. 12.12 ..
1.3.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा विष्णुना सर्वे सुरा भग्नमनोरथा..
आश्वासिता वचोभिश्च नानानुनयको विदैः.. 12.12 ..
1.3.m: Seeing them, all the gods whose hopes were dashed / were consoled by Viṣṇu with words skilled in various consolations: 12.12

1.3.s:
mā trāsaṃ kurutātrārtha ānayiṣyāmi tāṃ sudhām..
evamābhāṣya bhagavānmukundo'nāthasaṃśrayaḥ.. 12.13 ..
1.3.d:
मा त्रासं कुरुतात्रार्थ आनयिष्यामि तां सुधाम्..
एवमाभाष्य भगवान्मुकुन्दोऽनाथसंश्रयः.. 12.13 ..
1.3.m: “Do not fear on this account; I shall bring that nectar.” / Having spoken thus, the Lord Mukunda, the refuge of the helpless, 12.13

1.3.s:
sthāpayitvā surānsarvāṃstatraiva madhusūdanaḥ..
mohanīrūpamāsthāya daityanāmagrato'bhavat.. 12.14 ..
1.3.d:
स्थापयित्वा सुरान्सर्वांस्तत्रैव मधुसूदनः..
मोहनीरूपमास्थाय दैत्यनामग्रतोऽभवत्.. 12.14 ..
1.3.m: left all the gods right there, and Madhusūdana, / assuming the form of Mohinī, appeared before the daityas. 12.14

1.3.s:
tāvaddaityāḥ susaṃrabdhāḥ parasparamathābruvan..
vivādaḥ sarvadaityānāmamṛtārthe tadā'bhavat.. 12.15 ..
1.3.d:
तावद्दैत्याः सुसंरब्धाः परस्परमथाब्रुवन्..
विवादः सर्वदैत्यानाममृतार्थे तदाऽभवत्.. 12.15 ..
1.3.m: Meanwhile, the daityas, greatly agitated, spoke among themselves; / then a dispute arose among all the daityas over the nectar. 12.15

1.3.s:
evaṃ pravartamāne tu mohinīrūpamāśritām..
dṛṣṭvā yoṣāṃ tadā daivātsarvabhūtamanoramām.. 12.16 ..
1.3.d:
एवं प्रवर्तमाने तु मोहिनीरूपमाश्रिताम्..
दृष्ट्वा योषां तदा दैवात्सर्वभूतमनोरमाम्.. 12.16 ..
1.3.m: While this was going on, seeing by chance that woman who had taken the form of Mohinī, / captivating to the minds of all beings, 12.16

1.3.s:
vismayena samāviṣṭā babhūvustṛṣitekṣaṇāḥ..
tāṃ saṃmānya tadā daityarājo baliruvāca ha.. 12.17 ..
1.3.d:
विस्मयेन समाविष्टा बभूवुस्तृषितेक्षणाः..
तां संमान्य तदा दैत्यराजो बलिरुवाच ह.. 12.17 ..
1.3.m: they were filled with wonder, their eyes thirsty [with desire]; / showing respect to her, the daitya king Bali said: 12.17

1.3.s:
..baliruvāca..
sudhā tvayā vibhaktavyā sarveṣāṃ gatihetave..
śīghratvena mahābhāge kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama.. 12.18 ..
1.3.d:
..बलिरुवाच..
सुधा त्वया विभक्तव्या सर्वेषां गतिहेतवे..
शीघ्रत्वेन महाभागे कुरुष्व वचनं मम.. 12.18 ..
1.3.m: Bali said: / “The nectar must be distributed by you so that everyone receives their portion; / make haste, O fortunate lady, and fulfill my word.” 12.18

1.3.s:
evamuktā hyuvācedaṃ smayamānā baliṃ prati..
strīṇāṃ naiva ca viśvāsaḥ kartavyo hi vipaścitā.. 12.19 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्ता ह्युवाचेदं स्मयमाना बलिं प्रति..
स्त्रीणां नैव च विश्वासः कर्तव्यो हि विपश्चिता.. 12.19 ..
1.3.m: Addressed in this manner, smiling, she replied to Bali: / “No wise man should ever place trust in women. 12.19

1.3.s:
anṛtaṃ sāhasaṃ māyā mūrkhatvamati lobhatā..
aśaucaṃ nirghṛṇatvaṃ ca strīṇāṃ doṣāḥ svabhāvajāḥ.. 12.20 ..
1.3.d:
अनृतं साहसं माया मूर्खत्वमति लोभता..
अशौचं निर्घृणत्वं च स्त्रीणां दोषाः स्वभावजाः.. 12.20 ..
1.3.m: Falsehood, recklessness, deceit, foolishness, excessive greed, / impurity, and pitilessness are the innate flaws of women. 12.20

1.3.s:
niḥsnehatvaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ dhūrtatvaṃ caiva tattvataḥ..
svastrīṇāṃ caiva vijñeyā doṣā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ.. 12.21 ..
1.3.d:
निःस्नेहत्वं च विज्ञेयं धूर्तत्वं चैव तत्त्वतः..
स्वस्त्रीणां चैव विज्ञेया दोषा नास्त्यत्र संशयः.. 12.21 ..
1.3.m: Lack of affection is to be recognized, and roguishness indeed, in truth; / flaws are to be recognized even in one's own women; of this there is no doubt. 12.21

1.3.s:
yathaiva śvāpadānāṃ ca vṛkā hiṃsāparāyaṇāḥ..
kākā yatāṃḍajānāṃ ca śvāpadānāṃ ca jaṃbukāḥ..
dhūrtā tathā manuṣyāṇāṃ strījñeyā satataṃ budhaiḥ.. 12.22 ..
1.3.d:
यथैव श्वापदानां च वृका हिंसापरायणाः..
काका यतांडजानां च श्वापदानां च जंबुकाः..
धूर्ता तथा मनुष्याणां स्त्रीज्ञेया सततं बुधैः.. 12.22 ..
1.3.m: Just as among beasts of prey wolves are bent on violence, / just as among birds crows are sly, and jackals among wild beasts, / so women among humans are constantly to be known as cunning by the wise. 12.22

1.3.s:
mayā saha bhavadbhiśca kathaṃ sakhyaṃ pravartate..
sarvathātra na vijñeyāḥ ke yūyaṃ caiva ka hyaham.. 12.23 ..
1.3.d:
मया सह भवद्भिश्च कथं सख्यं प्रवर्तते..
सर्वथात्र न विज्ञेयाः के यूयं चैव क ह्यहम्.. 12.23 ..
1.3.m: How can friendship exist between you and me? / You are not known to me at all; who are you, and who am I? 12.23

1.3.s:
tasmādbhavadbhiḥ saṃciṃtyakāryākāryavicakṣaṇaiḥ..
kartavyaṃ parayā buddhyā prayātāsurasattamāḥ.. 12.24 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्भवद्भिः संचिंत्यकार्याकार्यविचक्षणैः..
कर्तव्यं परया बुद्ध्या प्रयातासुरसत्तमाः.. 12.24 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, having reflected with supreme intellect, you who are skilled in discerning what should and should not be done, / you should act accordingly; depart, O best among asuras!” 12.24

1.3.s:
..baliruvāca..
adyāmṛtaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vibhajasva yathātatham..
tvayā dattaṃ ca gṛhṇīmaḥ satyaṃsatyaṃ vadāmi te.. 12.28 ..
1.3.d:
..बलिरुवाच..
अद्यामृतं च सर्वेषां विभजस्व यथातथम्..
त्वया दत्तं च गृह्णीमः सत्यंसत्यं वदामि ते.. 12.28 ..
1.3.m: Bali said: / “Distribute the nectar to all today as is fitting; / we shall accept what is given by you; truly, truly do I tell you.” 12.28

1.3.s:
evamuktā tadā devī mohinī sarvamaṃgalā..
uvācāthāsurānsarvānrocayam̐llaukikīṃ sthitim.. 12.29 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्ता तदा देवी मोहिनी सर्वमंगला..
उवाचाथासुरान्सर्वान्रोचयम्̐ल्लौकिकीं स्थितिम्.. 12.29 ..
1.3.m: Spoken to thus, the goddess Mohinī, all-auspicious, / spoke to all the asuras, commending worldly custom: 12.29

1.3.s:
.. bhagavānuvāca..
yūyaṃ sarve kṛtārthāśca jātā daivena kenacit..
adyopāvāsasaṃyuktā amṛtasyādhivāsanam.. 12.30 ..
1.3.d:
.. भगवानुवाच..
यूयं सर्वे कृतार्थाश्च जाता दैवेन केनचित्..
अद्योपावाससंयुक्ता अमृतस्याधिवासनम्.. 12.30 ..
1.3.m: The Lord said: / “You all have achieved your goal through some stroke of destiny; / today, observing a fast, perform the preliminary consecration of the nectar, 12.30

1.3.s:
kriyatāmasurāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ śubhecchā kiṃcidasti vaḥ..
śvebhūte pāraṇaṃ kuryādvratārcanaratiśca vaḥ.. 12.31 ..
1.3.d:
क्रियतामसुराः श्रेष्ठाः शुभेच्छा किंचिदस्ति वः..
श्वेभूते पारणं कुर्याद्व्रतार्चनरतिश्च वः.. 12.31 ..
1.3.m: O best of asuras, if you have any desire for auspiciousness! / Tomorrow let the breaking of the fast be done by you who take pleasure in the worship of the vow. 12.31

1.3.s:
nyāyopārjitavittena daśamāṃśena dhīmatā..
kartavyo viniyogaśca īśaprītyarthahetave.. 12.32 ..
1.3.d:
न्यायोपार्जितवित्तेन दशमांशेन धीमता..
कर्तव्यो विनियोगश्च ईशप्रीत्यर्थहेतवे.. 12.32 ..
1.3.m: With wealth acquired by righteous means, a tenth part / should be distributed by the wise for the purpose of pleasing the Lord.” 12.32

1.3.s:
tatheti matvā te sarve yathoktaṃ devamāyayā..
cakrustathaiva daiteyā mohitā nātikovidāḥ.. 12.33 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा ते सर्वे यथोक्तं देवमायया..
चक्रुस्तथैव दैतेया मोहिता नातिकोविदाः.. 12.33 ..
1.3.m: Thinking ‘So be it,’ as spoken by the divine illusion, / those sons of Diti, deluded and not very clever, did just so. 12.33

1.3.s:
mayāsureṇa ca tadā bhavanāni kṛtāni vai..
manojñāni mahārhāṇi suprabhāṇi mahāṃti ca.. 12.34 ..
1.3.d:
मयासुरेण च तदा भवनानि कृतानि वै..
मनोज्ञानि महार्हाणि सुप्रभाणि महांति च.. 12.34 ..
1.3.m: Mansions were then built by Mayāsura, / charming, costly, magnificent, and vast. 12.34

1.3.s:
teṣupaviṣṭāste sarve susnātāḥ samalaṃkṛtāḥ..
sthāpayitvā susaṃrabdhāḥ pūrṇaṃ kalaśamagrataḥ.. 12.35 ..
1.3.d:
तेषुपविष्टास्ते सर्वे सुस्नाताः समलंकृताः..
स्थापयित्वा सुसंरब्धाः पूर्णं कलशमग्रतः.. 12.35 ..
1.3.m: Seated in them, all having bathed well and adorned themselves, / highly enthusiastic, they placed the full pitcher in front [of them]. 12.35

1.3.s:
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ sarvaiḥ kṛtaṃ paramayā mudā..
athoṣasi pravṛtte ca prātaḥsnānayutā bhavan.. 12.36 ..
1.3.d:
रात्रौ जागरणं सर्वैः कृतं परमया मुदा..
अथोषसि प्रवृत्ते च प्रातःस्नानयुता भवन्.. 12.36 ..
1.3.m: At night, a vigil was kept by all with supreme joy. / Then, when dawn broke, they performed their morning ablutions.

1.3.s:
asurā balimukhyāśca paṃktibhūtā yatākramam..
sarvamāvaśyakaṃ kṛtvā tadā pānaratā bhavan.. 12.37 ..
1.3.d:
असुरा बलिमुख्याश्च पंक्तिभूता यताक्रमम्..
सर्वमावश्यकं कृत्वा तदा पानरता भवन्.. 12.37 ..
1.3.m: The Asuras, led by Bali, sat in rows in proper order. / Having performed all necessary duties, they then devoted themselves to drinking.

1.3.s:
baliśca vṛṣaparvā ca namuciḥ śaṃkha eva ca..
sudaṃṣṭraścaiva saṃhlādī kālanemirvibhīṣaṇaḥ.. 12.38 ..
1.3.d:
बलिश्च वृषपर्वा च नमुचिः शंख एव च..
सुदंष्ट्रश्चैव संह्लादी कालनेमिर्विभीषणः.. 12.38 ..
1.3.m: Bali, Vṛṣaparvan, Namuci, and Śaṅkha, / Sudaṃṣṭra, Saṃhlādin, Kālanemi, and Vibhīṣaṇa,

1.3.s:
vātāpirilvalaḥ kumbho nikumbhaḥ pracchadastathā..
tathā sundopasundau ca niśumbhaḥ śumbha eva ca.. 12.39 ..
1.3.d:
वातापिरिल्वलः कुम्भो निकुम्भः प्रच्छदस्तथा..
तथा सुन्दोपसुन्दौ च निशुम्भः शुम्भ एव च.. 12.39 ..
1.3.m: Vātāpi, Ilvala, Kumbha, Nikumbha, and Pracchada, / and likewise Sunda and Upasunda, Niśumbha, and Śumbha,

1.3.s:
mahiṣo mahiṣākṣaśca biḍālākṣaḥ pratāpavān..
cikṣurākhyo mahābāhurjṛbhaṇo'tha vṛṣāsuraḥ.. 12.40 ..
1.3.d:
महिषो महिषाक्षश्च बिडालाक्षः प्रतापवान्..
चिक्षुराख्यो महाबाहुर्जृभणोऽथ वृषासुरः.. 12.40 ..
1.3.m: Mahiṣa, Mahiṣākṣa, the mighty Biḍālākṣa, / the one named Cikṣura of mighty arms, Jṛmbhaṇa, and Vṛṣāsura,

1.3.s:
vibāhurbāhuko ghorastathā vai ghoradarśanaḥ..
ete cānye ca bahavo daityadānavarākṣasāḥ..
yathākramaṃ copaviṣṭā rāhuḥ ketustathaiva ca.. 12.41 ..
1.3.d:
विबाहुर्बाहुको घोरस्तथा वै घोरदर्शनः..
एते चान्ये च बहवो दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः..
यथाक्रमं चोपविष्टा राहुः केतुस्तथैव च.. 12.41 ..
1.3.m: Vibāhu, Bāhuka, the terrible, and the terrible-looking one— / these and many other Daityas, Dānavas, and Rākṣasas / sat in proper order, as did Rāhu and Ketu.

1.3.s: teṣāṃ tu koṭisaṃkhyānāṃ daityānāṃ paṃktirāsthitā.. 12.42 ..
1.3.m: A row of those Daityas, numbering tens of millions, was formed.

1.3.s:
tatastayā tadā devyā amṛtārthaṃ hi vai dvijāḥ..
yajjātaṃ tacchṛṇaudhvaṃ hi tayā devyā kṛtaṃ mahat.. 12.43 ..
1.3.d:
ततस्तया तदा देव्या अमृतार्थं हि वै द्विजाः..
यज्जातं तच्छृणौध्वं हि तया देव्या कृतं महत्.. 12.43 ..
1.3.m: Then, O twice-born, for the sake of the nectar, / listen to the great deed done by that goddess:

1.3.s:
sarve vijñāpitāḥ sadyo gṛhītakalaśā tadā..
śobhayā parayā yuktā sākṣātsā viṣṇumohinī.. 12.44 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वे विज्ञापिताः सद्यो गृहीतकलशा तदा..
शोभया परया युक्ता साक्षात्सा विष्णुमोहिनी.. 12.44 ..
1.3.m: All were immediately informed by her who had taken up the jar, / endowed with supreme splendour, Mohinī, Viṣṇu manifest in person.

1.3.s:
karasthena tadā devī kalaśena virājitā..
śuśubhe parayā kāṃtyā jaganmaṃgalamaṃgalā.. 12.45 ..
1.3.d:
करस्थेन तदा देवी कलशेन विराजिता..
शुशुभे परया कांत्या जगन्मंगलमंगला.. 12.45 ..
1.3.m: Adorned with the jar in her hand, the goddess / shone with supreme radiance, the auspiciousness of the world's auspiciousness.

1.3.s:
pariveṣadharāḥ sarve surāste hyasurāṃtikam..
āgatāstatkṣaṇādeva yatra te hyasurottamāḥ.. 12.46 ..
1.3.d:
परिवेषधराः सर्वे सुरास्ते ह्यसुरांतिकम्..
आगतास्तत्क्षणादेव यत्र ते ह्यसुरोत्तमाः.. 12.46 ..
1.3.m: All the gods, acting as distributors, / came at that very moment near the Asuras, where those best of Asuras were.

1.3.s: tāndṛṣṭvā mohinī sadya uvāca pramadottamā.. 12.47 ..
1.3.d: तान्दृष्ट्वा मोहिनी सद्य उवाच प्रमदोत्तमा.. 12.47 ..
1.3.m: Seeing them, Mohinī, the best of women, immediately spoke:

1.3.s:
..mohinyuvāca..
ete hyatithayo jñeyā dharmmasarvasvasādhanāḥ..
ebhyo deyaṃ yatāśaktyā yadi satyaṃ vaco mama..
pramāṇaṃ bhavatāṃ cādya kurudhvaṃ mā vilaṃbatha.. 12.48 ..
1.3.d:
..मोहिन्युवाच..
एते ह्यतिथयो ज्ञेया धर्म्मसर्वस्वसाधनाः..
एभ्यो देयं यताशक्त्या यदि सत्यं वचो मम..
प्रमाणं भवतां चाद्य कुरुध्वं मा विलंबथ.. 12.48 ..
1.3.m: Mohinī said: / "These should be known as guests, the means for fulfilling all duties. / To them should be given according to one's capacity, if my word is truth / and authoritative to you today. Act accordingly; do not delay!

1.3.s:
pareṣāmupakāraṃ ca ye kurvaṃti svaśaktitaḥ..
dhanyāste caiva vijñeyāḥ pavitrāḥ lokapālakāḥ.. 12.49 ..
1.3.d:
परेषामुपकारं च ये कुर्वंति स्वशक्तितः..
धन्यास्ते चैव विज्ञेयाः पवित्राः लोकपालकाः.. 12.49 ..
1.3.m: Those who render service to others according to their own capacity / are to be recognized as blessed, pure guardians of the world.

1.3.s:
kevalātmodarārthāya udyogaṃ ye prakurvate..
te kleśabhāgino jñeyā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 12.50 ..
1.3.d:
केवलात्मोदरार्थाय उद्योगं ये प्रकुर्वते..
ते क्लेशभागिनो ज्ञेया नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 12.50 ..
1.3.m: Those who make effort solely for their own bellies / are to be known as sharers of affliction; there is no deliberation needed here.

1.3.s:
tasmādvibhajanaṃ kāryaṃ mayaitasya śubhavratāḥ..
devebhyaśca prayacchadhvaṃ yaddhi cātmapriyāpriyam.. 12.51 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्विभजनं कार्यं मयैतस्य शुभव्रताः..
देवेभ्यश्च प्रयच्छध्वं यद्धि चात्मप्रियाप्रियम्.. 12.51 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, O you of auspicious vows, a distribution of this must be made by me. / Give to the gods whatever is pleasing or unpleasing to yourselves!"

1.3.s:
ityukte vacane devyā tathā cakrurataṃ dritāḥ..
āhvayāmāsurasurāḥ sarvāndevānsavāsavān.. 12.52 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युक्ते वचने देव्या तथा चक्रुरतं द्रिताः..
आह्वयामासुरसुराः सर्वान्देवान्सवासवान्.. 12.52 ..
1.3.m: When this speech was uttered by the goddess, they acted without hesitation. / The Asuras summoned all the gods along with Indra.

1.3.s:
upaviṣṭāśca te sarve amṛtārthaṃ ca bho dvijāḥ..
teṣūpaviśyamāneṣu hyuvāca paramaṃ vacaḥ..
mohinī sarvadharmmajñā asurāṇāṃ smayanniva.. 12.53 ..
1.3.d:
उपविष्टाश्च ते सर्वे अमृतार्थं च भो द्विजाः..
तेषूपविश्यमानेषु ह्युवाच परमं वचः..
मोहिनी सर्वधर्म्मज्ञा असुराणां स्मयन्निव.. 12.53 ..
1.3.m: And they all sat down for the nectar, O twice-born. / As they were being seated, Mohinī, who knew all duties, / spoke supreme words, as if smiling at the Asuras:

1.3.s:
..mohinyuvāca..
ādau hyabhyāgatāḥ pūjyā iti vai vaidikī śrutiḥ.. 12.54 ..
1.3.d:
..मोहिन्युवाच..
आदौ ह्यभ्यागताः पूज्या इति वै वैदिकी श्रुतिः.. 12.54 ..
1.3.m: Mohinī said: / "First, indeed, guests must be honoured: such is the Vedic scripture.

1.3.s:
tasmādyūyaṃ vedaparāḥ sarve devaparāyaṇāḥ..
bruvaṃtu tvaritenaiva ādau keṣāṃ dadāmyaham..
amṛtaṃ hi mahābhāgā balimukhyā vadaṃtu bhoḥ.. 12.55 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्यूयं वेदपराः सर्वे देवपरायणाः..
ब्रुवंतु त्वरितेनैव आदौ केषां ददाम्यहम्..
अमृतं हि महाभागा बलिमुख्या वदंतु भोः.. 12.55 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, you who are devoted to the Vedas and intent on the gods, / speak quickly: to whom shall I give first / the nectar, O fortunate ones? Speak, O leaders of Bali's host!"

1.3.s:
balinoktā tadā devī yatte manasi rocate..
svāminī tvaṃ na saṃdeho hyasmākaṃ suṃdarānane.. 12.56 ..
1.3.d:
बलिनोक्ता तदा देवी यत्ते मनसि रोचते..
स्वामिनी त्वं न संदेहो ह्यस्माकं सुंदरानने.. 12.56 ..
1.3.m: The goddess was then addressed by Bali: "Whatever pleases your mind! / You are our mistress, without doubt, O fair-faced one."

1.3.s:
evaṃ saṃmānitā tena balinā bhāvitātmanā..
pariveṣaṇakāryārthaṃ kalaśaṃ gṛhya satvarā.. 12.57 ..
1.3.d:
एवं संमानिता तेन बलिना भावितात्मना..
परिवेषणकार्यार्थं कलशं गृह्य सत्वरा.. 12.57 ..
1.3.m: Thus honoured by Bali of cultivated soul, / taking the jar quickly for the task of distribution,

1.3.s:
tasmānnarendrakarabhorulasaddṛkūlā śroṇītaṭālasagatirmavihvalāṃgī..
sā kūjatī kanakanūpurasiṃjitena kuṃbhastanī kalaśapāṇirathāviveśa.. 12.58 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मान्नरेन्द्रकरभोरुलसद्दृकूला श्रोणीतटालसगतिर्मविह्वलांगी..
सा कूजती कनकनूपुरसिंजितेन कुंभस्तनी कलशपाणिरथाविवेश.. 12.58 ..
1.3.m: her thighs resembling elephant trunks, her fine garments glistening, her gait slow from the weight of her hips, her limbs languid, / tinkling with the chiming of golden anklets, her breasts like jars, with the pitcher in her hand, she then entered.

1.3.s:
tadā tu devī pariveṣayaṃtī sā mohinī devagaṇāya sākṣāt..
vavarṣa deveṣu sudhārasaṃ punaḥ punaḥ sudhāhārarasāmṛtaṃ yathā.. 12.59 ..
1.3.d:
तदा तु देवी परिवेषयंती सा मोहिनी देवगणाय साक्षात्..
ववर्ष देवेषु सुधारसं पुनः पुनः सुधाहाररसामृतं यथा.. 12.59 ..
1.3.m: Then, serving [it] in person to the host of gods, that goddess Mohinī / poured out the nectar essence upon the gods again and again, like a draft of divine immortal ambrosia.

1.3.s:
punaśca te devagaṇāḥ sudhārasaṃ dattaṃ tayā parayā viśvamūrtyā..
balimukhyāḥ saha lokapālā gaṃdharvayakṣāpsarasāṃ gaṇāśca.. 12.60 ..
1.3.d:
पुनश्च ते देवगणाः सुधारसं दत्तं तया परया विश्वमूर्त्या..
बलिमुख्याः सह लोकपाला गंधर्वयक्षाप्सरसां गणाश्च.. 12.60 ..
1.3.m: And again those hosts of gods [received] the nectar essence given by her of supreme, universal form; / and Bali's leaders, along with the guardians of the quarters, the hosts of Gandharvas, Yakṣas, and Apsarases,

1.3.s:
sarve daityā āsanasthā punaśca te devagaṇāḥ sudhārasaṃ dattaṃ pīḍitāśca..
tūṣṇīṃbhūtā balimukhyā dvijeṃdrā manasvino dhyānaparā babhūvuḥ.. 12.61 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वे दैत्या आसनस्था पुनश्च ते देवगणाः सुधारसं दत्तं पीडिताश्च..
तूष्णींभूता बलिमुख्या द्विजेंद्रा मनस्विनो ध्यानपरा बभूवुः.. 12.61 ..
1.3.m: all the Daityas remained seated, while the hosts of gods [were given] the nectar essence; and afflicted, / Bali's chiefs, silent, became thoughtful and intent on contemplation, O lords among the twice-born.

1.3.s:
tatastathāvidhāndṛṣṭvā daityāṃstānmohamāśritān..
tadā rāhuśca ketuśca dvāvetau daityapuṃgavau.. 12.62 ..
1.3.d:
ततस्तथाविधान्दृष्ट्वा दैत्यांस्तान्मोहमाश्रितान्..
तदा राहुश्च केतुश्च द्वावेतौ दैत्यपुंगवौ.. 12.62 ..
1.3.m: Then, seeing the Daityas in such a state, fallen into delusion, / both Rāhu and Ketu, those two foremost of Daityas,

1.3.s:
devānāṃ rūpamāsthāya amṛtārthaṃ tvarānvitau..
upaviṣṭau tadā paṅktyāṃ devānāmamṛtārthinau.. 12.63 ..
1.3.d:
देवानां रूपमास्थाय अमृतार्थं त्वरान्वितौ..
उपविष्टौ तदा पङ्क्त्यां देवानाममृतार्थिनौ.. 12.63 ..
1.3.m: assuming the form of gods, eager for nectar, / sat down then in the row of the gods, desiring the nectar.

1.3.s:
yadāmṛtaṃ pātukāmo rāhuḥ paramadurjayaḥ..
candrārkābhyāṃ prakathito viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ.. 12.64 ..
1.3.d:
यदामृतं पातुकामो राहुः परमदुर्जयः..
चन्द्रार्काभ्यां प्रकथितो विष्णोरमिततेजसः.. 12.64 ..
1.3.m: When Rāhu, exceedingly hard to conquer, wished to drink the nectar, / Viṣṇu of immeasurable splendour was told by the Sun and the Moon.

1.3.s:
tadā tasya śiraśchinnaṃ rāhordurvigrahasya ca..
śiro gaganamāpede kabaṃdhaṃ ca mahītale..
bhramamāṇaṃ tadā hyadrīṃścūrṇayāmāsa vai tadā.. 12.65 ..
1.3.d:
तदा तस्य शिरश्छिन्नं राहोर्दुर्विग्रहस्य च..
शिरो गगनमापेदे कबंधं च महीतले..
भ्रममाणं तदा ह्यद्रींश्चूर्णयामास वै तदा.. 12.65 ..
1.3.m: Then the head of Rāhu of monstrous body was severed; / his head reached the sky, while the torso fell upon the earth, / and rolling about then, it crushed the mountains.

1.3.s:
sādriśca sarvabhūlokaścūrṇitaśca tadā'bhavat..
tayā tena ca dehena cūrṇitaṃ sacarācaram.. 12.66 ..
1.3.d:
साद्रिश्च सर्वभूलोकश्चूर्णितश्च तदाऽभवत्..
तया तेन च देहेन चूर्णितं सचराचरम्.. 12.66 ..
1.3.m: The entire earth along with its mountains was crushed at that time; / by that body, all that moves and does not move was crushed.

1.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tadā mahādevastasyopari tu saṃsthitaḥ..
nivāsaḥ sarvadevānāṃ tasyāḥ pādatale'bhavat.. 12.67 ..
1.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तदा महादेवस्तस्योपरि तु संस्थितः..
निवासः सर्वदेवानां तस्याः पादतलेऽभवत्.. 12.67 ..
1.3.m: Seeing that, Mahādeva then stood upon it; / the dwelling of all the gods was beneath her foot.

1.3.s: pīḍanaṃ tatsamīpetha nivāsa iti nāma vai.. 12.68 ..
1.3.d: पीडनं तत्समीपेथ निवास इति नाम वै.. 12.68 ..
1.3.m: The pressing near it is indeed called 'dwelling' (Nivāsa).

1.3.s:
mahatāmālayaṃ yasmādyasyāstaccaraṇāṃbujam..
mahālayeti vikhyātā jagattrayavimohinī.. 12.69 ..
1.3.d:
महतामालयं यस्माद्यस्यास्तच्चरणांबुजम्..
महालयेति विख्याता जगत्त्रयविमोहिनी.. 12.69 ..
1.3.m: Because her lotus foot is the abode (ālaya) of the great (mahat), / she, the bewitcher of the three worlds, is renowned as Mahālayā.

1.3.s:
ketuśca dhūmarūpo'sāvākāśe vilayaṃ gataḥ..
sudhāṃ samarpya caṃdrāya tirodhānagato'bhavat.. 12.70 ..
1.3.d:
केतुश्च धूमरूपोऽसावाकाशे विलयं गतः..
सुधां समर्प्य चंद्राय तिरोधानगतोऽभवत्.. 12.70 ..
1.3.m: And Ketu, having the form of smoke, dissolved into the sky; / having offered the nectar to the Moon, he disappeared.

1.3.s:
vāsudevo jagadyonirjagatāṃ kāraṇaṃ param..
viṣṇoḥ prasādāttajjātaṃ surāṇāṃ kāryasiddhidam.. 12.71 ..
1.3.d:
वासुदेवो जगद्योनिर्जगतां कारणं परम्..
विष्णोः प्रसादात्तज्जातं सुराणां कार्यसिद्धिदम्.. 12.71 ..
1.3.m: Vāsudeva is the womb of the universe, the supreme cause of the worlds. / By the grace of Viṣṇu, that which accomplished the purpose of the gods came to pass.

1.3.s:
asurāṇāṃ vināśāya jātaṃ daivaviparyayāt..
vinā daivena jānīdhvamudyamo hi nirarthakaḥ.. 12.72 ..
1.3.d:
असुराणां विनाशाय जातं दैवविपर्ययात्..
विना दैवेन जानीध्वमुद्यमो हि निरर्थकः.. 12.72 ..
1.3.m: It resulted in the destruction of the Asuras through the reversal of destiny. / Know that without destiny, effort is indeed futile.

1.3.s:
yaugapadyena taiḥ sarvaiḥ kṣīrābdhermaṃthanaṃ kṛtam..
siddhirjātā hi devānāmasiddhirasurānprati.. 12.73 ..
1.3.d:
यौगपद्येन तैः सर्वैः क्षीराब्धेर्मंथनं कृतम्..
सिद्धिर्जाता हि देवानामसिद्धिरसुरान्प्रति.. 12.73 ..
1.3.m: The churning of the ocean of milk was done by all of them simultaneously; / success came to the gods, but failure to the Asuras.

1.3.s:
tataśca te devavarānprakopitā daityāśca māyāpravi mohitāḥ punaḥ..
anekaśastrāstrayutāstadā'bhavanviṣṇau gate garjamānāstadānīm.. 12.74 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe samudramaṃthanākhyāne devānāmamṛtaprāśanavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 12 .. .
cha ..
1.3.d:
ततश्च ते देववरान्प्रकोपिता दैत्याश्च मायाप्रवि मोहिताः पुनः..
अनेकशस्त्रास्त्रयुतास्तदाऽभवन्विष्णौ गते गर्जमानास्तदानीम्.. 12.74 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखंडे समुद्रमंथनाख्याने देवानाममृतप्राशनवर्णनंनाम द्वादशोऽध्यायः.. 12 .. .
छ ..
1.3.m:
And then, enraged against the foremost of gods, and once again deluded by illusion, / the Daityas became equipped with many weapons and missiles, roaring at that time as Viṣṇu departed.
Thus ends the twelfth chapter, named 'Description of the Gods Drinking the Nectar' in the narrative of the churning of the ocean, in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first [section], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
[End of section].

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
tataste garjjamānāśca ākṣipaṃtaḥ surānraṇe..
śatakratupramukhyāṃstanmahābalaparākramān.. 13.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
ततस्ते गर्ज्जमानाश्च आक्षिपंतः सुरान्रणे..
शतक्रतुप्रमुख्यांस्तन्महाबलपराक्रमान्.. 13.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Then, roaring and challenging the gods in battle, / those of great might and prowess [challenged] those headed by Indra (Śatakratu)—

1.3.s:
vimānamāruhya tadā mahātmā vairocaniḥ sarvabalena sārddham..
daityaiḥ sameto vividhairmahābalaiḥ surānpradudrāva mahābhayāvaham.. 13.2 ..
1.3.d:
विमानमारुह्य तदा महात्मा वैरोचनिः सर्वबलेन सार्द्धम्..
दैत्यैः समेतो विविधैर्महाबलैः सुरान्प्रदुद्राव महाभयावहम्.. 13.2 ..
1.3.m: Then the great-souled son of Virocana, mounting an aerial chariot with his entire army / and accompanied by diverse Daityas of great might, rushed upon the gods, inspiring great terror.

1.3.s:
svāni rūpāṇi bibhraṃtaḥ samāpetuḥ sa hasraśaḥ..
kecidvyāghrānsamārūḍhā mahiṣāṃśca tathā pare.. 13.3 ..
1.3.d:
स्वानि रूपाणि बिभ्रंतः समापेतुः स हस्रशः..
केचिद्व्याघ्रान्समारूढा महिषांश्च तथा परे.. 13.3 ..
1.3.m: Displaying their own forms, they swooped down by thousands: / some mounted upon tigers, and others upon buffaloes;

1.3.s:
aśvānkecitsamārūḍhā dvipānkecittathā pare..
siṃhāṃstathā pare rūḍhāḥ śārdūlāñcharabhāṃstathā.. 13.4 ..
1.3.d:
अश्वान्केचित्समारूढा द्विपान्केचित्तथा परे..
सिंहांस्तथा परे रूढाः शार्दूलाञ्छरभांस्तथा.. 13.4 ..
1.3.m: some mounted upon horses, and others upon elephants; / others mounted lions, tigers, and sarabhas;

1.3.s:
mayūrānrājahaṃsāṃśca kukkuṭāṃśca tathā pare..
keciddhayānsamārūḍhā uṣṭrānaśvatarānapi.. 13.5 ..
1.3.d:
मयूरान्राजहंसांश्च कुक्कुटांश्च तथा परे..
केचिद्धयान्समारूढा उष्ट्रानश्वतरानपि.. 13.5 ..
1.3.m: others upon peacocks, royal swans, and roosters; / some mounted upon steeds, camels, and even mules;

1.3.s:
gajānkharānpare caiva śakaṭāṃśca tathā pare..
pādātā bahavo daityāḥ khaṅgaśaktyṛṣṭipāṇayaḥ.. 13.6 ..
1.3.d:
गजान्खरान्परे चैव शकटांश्च तथा परे..
पादाता बहवो दैत्याः खङ्गशक्त्यृष्टिपाणयः.. 13.6 ..
1.3.m: and others upon elephants and donkeys, as well as carts. / Many Daityas went on foot, holding swords, spears, and javelins in their hands,

1.3.s:
parighāyudhinaḥ pāśaśūlamudgarapāṇayaḥ..
asilomānvitāḥ kecidbhuśuṃḍīparighāyudhāḥ.. 13.7 ..
1.3.d:
परिघायुधिनः पाशशूलमुद्गरपाणयः..
असिलोमान्विताः केचिद्भुशुंडीपरिघायुधाः.. 13.7 ..
1.3.m: armed with iron clubs, holding nooses, tridents, and maces in their hands, / some equipped with sword-edged arrows, armed with bhuśuṇḍis and iron clubs.

1.3.s:
hayanāgarathāścānye samārūḍhāḥ prahāriṇaḥ..
vimānāni samārūḍhā balimukhyāḥ sahasraśaḥ.. 13.8 ..
1.3.d:
हयनागरथाश्चान्ये समारूढाः प्रहारिणः..
विमानानि समारूढा बलिमुख्याः सहस्रशः.. 13.8 ..
1.3.m: Other warriors mounted horses, elephants, and chariots; / and the leaders of Bali's forces mounted aerial chariots by the thousands.

1.3.s:
sparddhamānāstatānyonyaṃ garjaṃtaśca muhurmuhuḥ..
vṛṣaparvā hyuvā cedaṃ balinaṃ daityapuṃgavam.. 13.9 ..
1.3.d:
स्पर्द्धमानास्ततान्योन्यं गर्जंतश्च मुहुर्मुहुः..
वृषपर्वा ह्युवा चेदं बलिनं दैत्यपुंगवम्.. 13.9 ..
1.3.m: Rivaling one another and roaring again and again, / Vṛṣaparvan then said this to Bali, the foremost of the Daityas:

1.3.s:
tvayā kṛtaṃ mahābāho iṃdreṇa saha saṃgamam..
viśvāso naiva kartavyo durhṛdā ca kathaṃcana.. 13.10 ..
1.3.d:
त्वया कृतं महाबाहो इंद्रेण सह संगमम्..
विश्वासो नैव कर्तव्यो दुर्हृदा च कथंचन.. 13.10 ..
1.3.m: “O mighty-armed one, you have made an alliance with Indra. / Yet no trust should ever be placed in an enemy.

1.3.s:
ūnenāpi hi tucchena vairiṇāpi kathaṃcana..
maitrī buddhimatā kāryā āpadyapi nivartate.. 13.11 ..
1.3.d:
ऊनेनापि हि तुच्छेन वैरिणापि कथंचन..
मैत्री बुद्धिमता कार्या आपद्यपि निवर्तते.. 13.11 ..
1.3.m: Never should friendship be formed by an intelligent man / even with an inferior, trivial foe, since he turns away even in calamity.

1.3.s:
na viśvasetpūrvavirodhinā kvacitparājitāḥ smo'tha bale tvayādhunā..
purāṇaduṣṭāḥ kathamadya vai punarmaṃtraṃ vikartuṃ na ca te yateran.. 13.12 ..
1.3.d:
न विश्वसेत्पूर्वविरोधिना क्वचित्पराजिताः स्मोऽथ बले त्वयाधुना..
पुराणदुष्टाः कथमद्य वै पुनर्मंत्रं विकर्तुं न च ते यतेरन्.. 13.12 ..
1.3.m: One should never trust a former adversary. ‘Now we are conquered by you in strength,’ [they say]; / being chronically wicked, why would they not strive again today to hatch a plot?”

1.3.s:
ityūcuste durādharṣā yoddhukāmā vyavasthitāḥ..
dhvajaiśchatraiḥ patākaiśca raṇabhūmimamaṃḍayan.. 13.13 ..
1.3.d:
इत्यूचुस्ते दुराधर्षा योद्धुकामा व्यवस्थिताः..
ध्वजैश्छत्रैः पताकैश्च रणभूमिममंडयन्.. 13.13 ..
1.3.m: Thus spoke those unassailable ones, standing eager to fight. / With banners, parasols, and pennants, they adorned the battlefield.

1.3.s:
cāmaraiśca diśaḥ sarvā lopitaṃ ca raṇasthalam..
tathā sarve surāstatra daityānprati samutsukāḥ.. 13.14 ..
1.3.d:
चामरैश्च दिशः सर्वा लोपितं च रणस्थलम्..
तथा सर्वे सुरास्तत्र दैत्यान्प्रति समुत्सुकाः.. 13.14 ..
1.3.m: With chowries the entire battlefield was overspread in all directions. / Likewise, all the gods there were eager to confront the Daityas.

1.3.s:
pītvāmṛtaṃ mahābhāgā vāhānyāruhya daṃśitāḥ..
gajārūḍho maheṃdropi vajrapāṇiḥ pratāpavān..
sūryaścoccaiḥ śravārūḍho mṛgā rūḍhaśca candramāḥ.. 13.15 ..
1.3.d:
पीत्वामृतं महाभागा वाहान्यारुह्य दंशिताः..
गजारूढो महेंद्रोपि वज्रपाणिः प्रतापवान्..
सूर्यश्चोच्चैः श्रवारूढो मृगा रूढश्च चन्द्रमाः.. 13.15 ..
1.3.m: Having drunk the nectar, the fortunate ones donned their armor and mounted their steeds. / The glorious Mahendra, thunderbolt in hand, was mounted on an elephant; / Sūrya mounted Uccaiḥśravas, and the moon mounted an antelope.

1.3.s:
chatracāmarasaṃvītāḥ śobhitā vijayaśriyā..
praṇamya viṣṇuṃ te sarva iṃdrādyā jayakāṃkṣiṇaḥ.. 13.16 ..
1.3.d:
छत्रचामरसंवीताः शोभिता विजयश्रिया..
प्रणम्य विष्णुं ते सर्व इंद्राद्या जयकांक्षिणः.. 13.16 ..
1.3.m: Surrounded by parasols and chowries, adorned with the splendor of victory, / all of them, led by Indra and desiring victory, bowed to Viṣṇu.

1.3.s:
te viṣṇunā hyanujñātā asurānprati vai ruṣā..
asurāśca mahākāyā bhīmākṣā bhīmavikramāḥ.. 13.17 ..
1.3.d:
ते विष्णुना ह्यनुज्ञाता असुरान्प्रति वै रुषा..
असुराश्च महाकाया भीमाक्षा भीमविक्रमाः.. 13.17 ..
1.3.m: Permitted by Viṣṇu, they [marched] in wrath against the Asuras; / and the Asuras were huge-bodied, with fierce eyes and terrible prowess.

1.3.s:
teṣāṃ boramabhūdyuddhaṃ devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha..
tumulaṃ ca mahāghoraṃ sarvabhūtabhayāvaham.. 13.18 ..
1.3.d:
तेषां बोरमभूद्युद्धं देवानां दानवैः सह..
तुमुलं च महाघोरं सर्वभूतभयावहम्.. 13.18 ..
1.3.m: Between those gods and the Dānavas there occurred a terrible battle, / tumultuous, exceedingly dreadful, and inspiring terror in all living beings.

1.3.s:
śaradhārānvitaṃ sarvaṃ babhūva paramādbhutam..
tataśca ṭacaṭāśabdā babhūvuśca diśodaśa.. 13.19 ..
1.3.d:
शरधारान्वितं सर्वं बभूव परमाद्भुतम्..
ततश्च टचटाशब्दा बभूवुश्च दिशोदश.. 13.19 ..
1.3.m: It was filled with showers of arrows and was utterly wondrous; / and then clashing sounds arose in all the ten directions.

1.3.s:
tato nimiṣamātreṇa śaraghātayutā bhavan..
śaratomaranārācairāhatāścāpatanbhuvi.. 13.20 ..
1.3.d:
ततो निमिषमात्रेण शरघातयुता भवन्..
शरतोमरनाराचैराहताश्चापतन्भुवि.. 13.20 ..
1.3.m: Then in a mere moment they were covered with arrow-wounds; / struck by arrows, javelins, and iron shafts, they fell upon the earth.

1.3.s:
vidhyamānāstathā kecidvividhuścāparānraṇe..
bhallairbhagnāśca patitā nārācaiḥ śakalīkṛtāḥ.. 13.21 ..
1.3.d:
विध्यमानास्तथा केचिद्विविधुश्चापरान्रणे..
भल्लैर्भग्नाश्च पतिता नाराचैः शकलीकृताः.. 13.21 ..
1.3.m: As some were being pierced, they pierced others in the battle; / shattered by broad-headed shafts, they fell, cut to pieces by iron arrows.

1.3.s:
kṣuraprahāritāḥ keciddaityā dānavarākṣasāḥ..
śilīmukhairmāritāśca bhagnāḥ kecicca dānavāḥ.. 13.22 ..
1.3.d:
क्षुरप्रहारिताः केचिद्दैत्या दानवराक्षसाः..
शिलीमुखैर्मारिताश्च भग्नाः केचिच्च दानवाः.. 13.22 ..
1.3.m: Some Daityas, Dānavas, and Rākṣasas were struck by razor-faced arrows; / and slain by arrows, some Dānavas were broken.

1.3.s:
evaṃ bhagnaṃ dānavānāṃ ca sainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā devā garjamānāḥ samaṃtāt..
hṛṣṭāḥ sarve saṃmilitvā tadānīṃ labdhvā yuddhe te jayaṃ ślāghayante.. 13.23 ..
1.3.d:
एवं भग्नं दानवानां च सैन्यं दृष्ट्वा देवा गर्जमानाः समंतात्..
हृष्टाः सर्वे संमिलित्वा तदानीं लब्ध्वा युद्धे ते जयं श्लाघयन्ते.. 13.23 ..
1.3.m: Seeing the army of the Dānavas thus broken, the gods roared all around; / then, having assembled together in joy and gained victory in battle, they praised [themselves].

1.3.s:
śaṃkhavāditraghoṣeṇa pūritaṃ ca jagattrayam..
devānprati kṛtāmarṣā dānavāste mahābalāḥ.. 13.24 ..
1.3.d:
शंखवादित्रघोषेण पूरितं च जगत्त्रयम्..
देवान्प्रति कृतामर्षा दानवास्ते महाबलाः.. 13.24 ..
1.3.m: The three worlds were filled with the sound of conches and musical instruments. / Full of wrath against the gods, those mighty Dānavas,

1.3.s:
baliprabhṛtayaḥ sarve saṃbhrameṇotthitāḥ punaḥ..
vimānaiḥ sūryasaṃkāsairanekaiśca samanvitāḥ.. 13.25 ..
1.3.d:
बलिप्रभृतयः सर्वे संभ्रमेणोत्थिताः पुनः..
विमानैः सूर्यसंकासैरनेकैश्च समन्विताः.. 13.25 ..
1.3.m: all headed by Bali, rose up again in agitation, / accompanied by numerous aerial chariots resembling the sun.

1.3.s:
dvaṃdvayuddhaṃ sutumulaṃ devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha..
saṃpravṛttaṃ punaścaiva parasparajigīṣayā.. 13.26 ..
1.3.d:
द्वंद्वयुद्धं सुतुमुलं देवानां दानवैः सह..
संप्रवृत्तं पुनश्चैव परस्परजिगीषया.. 13.26 ..
1.3.m: A tumultuous single combat between the gods and the Dānavas / began once more, out of a desire to conquer one another.

1.3.s:
balinā dānaveṃdreṇa maheṃdro yuyudhe tadā..
tathā yamo mahābāhurnamucyā saha saṃgataḥ.. 13.27 ..
1.3.d:
बलिना दानवेंद्रेण महेंद्रो युयुधे तदा..
तथा यमो महाबाहुर्नमुच्या सह संगतः.. 13.27 ..
1.3.m: Then Mahendra fought with Bali, the chief of the Dānavas; / likewise, the mighty-armed Yama clashed with Namuci.

1.3.s:
nairṛtaḥ praghasenaiva pāśī kuṃbhena saṃgataḥ..
nikuṃbhenaiva sumahadyuddhaṃ cakre sadārayaḥ.. 13.28 ..
1.3.d:
नैरृतः प्रघसेनैव पाशी कुंभेन संगतः..
निकुंभेनैव सुमहद्युद्धं चक्रे सदारयः.. 13.28 ..
1.3.m: Nirṛti [fought] with Praghasa, and the noose-bearer [Varuṇa] clashed with Kumbha; / the eternal enemy [Vāyu] waged a great battle with Nikuṃbha.

1.3.s:
somena saha rāhuśca yuddhaṃ cakre sudāruṇam..
rāhuṇā candradehotthamamṛtaṃ bhakṣitaṃ tadā..
saṃparkādamṛsyaiva yathā rāhustathā'bhavat.. 13.29 ..
1.3.d:
सोमेन सह राहुश्च युद्धं चक्रे सुदारुणम्..
राहुणा चन्द्रदेहोत्थममृतं भक्षितं तदा..
संपर्कादमृस्यैव यथा राहुस्तथाऽभवत्.. 13.29 ..
1.3.m: Rāhu waged a dreadful battle with Soma; / Rāhu then consumed the nectar arising from the body of the moon; / because of that contact with the nectar, Rāhu became as [immortal as] he was.

1.3.s:
tāni sarvāṇi dṛṣṭāni śaṃbhunā parameṣṭhinā..
āśrayo'haṃ ca sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ..
asurāṇāṃ surāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāmapi vallabhaḥ.. 13.30 ..
1.3.d:
तानि सर्वाणि दृष्टानि शंभुना परमेष्ठिना..
आश्रयोऽहं च सर्वेषां भूतानां नात्र संशयः..
असुराणां सुराणां च सर्वेषामपि वल्लभः.. 13.30 ..
1.3.m: All those things were seen by Śambhu, the supreme lord: / “I am the refuge of all beings, of this there is no doubt; / and I am dear to all, both Asuras and gods.”

1.3.s:
evamuktastadā rāhuḥ praṇamya śirasā śivam..
maulau sthitastadā caṃdro amṛtaṃ vyasṛjadbhayāt.. 13.31 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तदा राहुः प्रणम्य शिरसा शिवम्..
मौलौ स्थितस्तदा चंद्रो अमृतं व्यसृजद्भयात्.. 13.31 ..
1.3.m: Thus addressed, Rāhu then bowed with his head to Śiva; / standing upon [Śiva's] crown, the moon then released nectar out of fear.

1.3.s:
tena tasya hi jātāni śirāṃsi subahūnyapi..
ekapadyena teṣāṃ ca srajaṃ kṛtvā manoharām..
babaṃdha śaṃbhuḥ śirasi śirobhūṣaṇavatkṛtam.. 13.32 ..
1.3.d:
तेन तस्य हि जातानि शिरांसि सुबहून्यपि..
एकपद्येन तेषां च स्रजं कृत्वा मनोहराम्..
बबंध शंभुः शिरसि शिरोभूषणवत्कृतम्.. 13.32 ..
1.3.m: Because of that, numerous heads arose for him; / and making an attractive garland of them along a single cord, / Śambhu bound it upon his head as a crest-ornament.

1.3.s:
aśanātkālakūṭasya nīlakaṃṭho'bhavattadā..
devānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ muṃḍamālā tathā kṛtā.. 13.33 ..
1.3.d:
अशनात्कालकूटस्य नीलकंठोऽभवत्तदा..
देवानां कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थं मुंडमाला तथा कृता.. 13.33 ..
1.3.m: From consuming the kālakūṭa poison he had then become blue-throated; / for accomplishing the purpose of the gods, a garland of skulls was thus made.

1.3.s: dadhāra śirasā tāṃ ca muṇḍamālāṃ maheśvaraḥ.. 13.34 ..
1.3.d: दधार शिरसा तां च मुण्डमालां महेश्वरः.. 13.34 ..
1.3.m: Maheśvara bore that garland of skulls upon his head.

1.3.s:
tayā srajā'sau śuśubhe mahātmā devādidevastripurāṃtako haraḥ..
gajāsuro yena nipātito mahānathāṃdhako yena kṛtaśca cūrṇaḥ.. 13.35 ..
1.3.d:
तया स्रजाऽसौ शुशुभे महात्मा देवादिदेवस्त्रिपुरांतको हरः..
गजासुरो येन निपातितो महानथांधको येन कृतश्च चूर्णः.. 13.35 ..
1.3.m: With that garland shone the great-souled primordial God of gods, Hara, the destroyer of Tripura, / by whom the great Gajāsura was struck down, and by whom Andhaka was reduced to powder,

1.3.s:
gaṃgā dhṛtā yena śirassumadhye caṃdraṃ ca cūḍe kṛtavānbhayāpahaḥ..
vedāḥ purāṇāni tathāgamāśca tathaiva nānāśrutayo'tha śāstram.. 13.36 ..
1.3.d:
गंगा धृता येन शिरस्सुमध्ये चंद्रं च चूडे कृतवान्भयापहः..
वेदाः पुराणानि तथागमाश्च तथैव नानाश्रुतयोऽथ शास्त्रम्.. 13.36 ..
1.3.m: by whom the Gaṅgā was held in the midst of his head, and who, dispelling fear, placed the moon on his crest. / The Vedas, the Purāṇas, the Āgamas, the diverse revealed scriptures, and the treatises

1.3.s:
jalpaṃti nānāgamabhedairmīmāṃsamānāśca bhavaṃti mūkāḥ..
nānāgamārcāyamataprabhedairnirūpyamāṇo jagadekabaṃdhuḥ.. 13.37 ..
1.3.d:
जल्पंति नानागमभेदैर्मीमांसमानाश्च भवंति मूकाः..
नानागमार्चायमतप्रभेदैर्निरूप्यमाणो जगदेकबंधुः.. 13.37 ..
1.3.m: speak through diverse distinctions of scriptures, and reflecting deeply, they become silent. / He is the sole friend of the universe, ascertained through diverse scriptures, worships, and doctrines,

1.3.s:
śivaṃ hi nityaṃ paramātmadaivaṃ vedaikavedyaṃ paramātmadivyam..
vihāya taṃ mūḍhajanāḥ pramattāḥ śivaṃ na jānaṃti parātmarūpam.. 13.38 ..
1.3.d:
शिवं हि नित्यं परमात्मदैवं वेदैकवेद्यं परमात्मदिव्यम्..
विहाय तं मूढजनाः प्रमत्ताः शिवं न जानंति परात्मरूपम्.. 13.38 ..
1.3.m: Śiva, the eternal, the supreme soul and deity, known through the Vedas alone, the divine supreme self; / abandoning him, deluded and careless people do not know Śiva, whose form is the supreme self,

1.3.s:
yenaiva sṛṣṭaṃ vidhṛtaṃ ca yena yena śritaṃ yena kṛtaṃ samagram..
yasyāṃśabhūtaṃ hi jagatkadācidvedāṃtavedyaḥ paramātmā śivaśca.. 13.39 ..
1.3.d:
येनैव सृष्टं विधृतं च येन येन श्रितं येन कृतं समग्रम्..
यस्यांशभूतं हि जगत्कदाचिद्वेदांतवेद्यः परमात्मा शिवश्च.. 13.39 ..
1.3.m: by whom indeed all was created, by whom sustained, by whom sheltered, and by whom made, / of whom indeed the universe is a part, the supreme soul Śiva, who is to be known through the Vedānta.

1.3.s:
āḍhyo vāpi daridro vā uttamo hyadhamo'pi vā..
śivabhaktirato nityaṃ śiva eva na saṃśayaḥ.. 13.40 ..
1.3.d:
आढ्यो वापि दरिद्रो वा उत्तमो ह्यधमोऽपि वा..
शिवभक्तिरतो नित्यं शिव एव न संशयः.. 13.40 ..
1.3.m: Whether rich or poor, highest or lowest, / one who is ever devoted to Śiva is Śiva himself, without a doubt.

1.3.s:
yo vā parakṛtāṃ pūjāṃ śivasyopari śobhitām..
dṛṣṭvā saṃtoṣamāyāti dāyaṃ prāpnoti tatsamam.. 13.41 ..
1.3.d:
यो वा परकृतां पूजां शिवस्योपरि शोभिताम्..
दृष्ट्वा संतोषमायाति दायं प्राप्नोति तत्समम्.. 13.41 ..
1.3.m: Or whoever, seeing an exquisite worship performed by another unto Śiva, / experiences joy, attains a reward equal to that [worship].

1.3.s:
ye dīpamālāṃ kurvaṃti kārtikyāṃ śraddhayānvitāḥ..
yāvatkālaṃ prajvalaṃti dīpāste liṃgamagrataḥ..
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi dātā svarge mahīyate.. 13.42 ..
1.3.d:
ये दीपमालां कुर्वंति कार्तिक्यां श्रद्धयान्विताः..
यावत्कालं प्रज्वलंति दीपास्ते लिंगमग्रतः..
तावद्युगसहस्राणि दाता स्वर्गे महीयते.. 13.42 ..
1.3.m: Those who, endowed with faith, offer rows of lamps on the full moon of Kārttika, / for as long as those lamps burn before the liṅga, / for that many thousands of yugas the giver is honoured in heaven.

1.3.s:
kausuṃbhatailasaṃyuktā dīpā dattāḥ śivālaye..
dātāraste'pi kailāse modante śivasaṃnidhau.. 13.43 ..
1.3.d:
कौसुंभतैलसंयुक्ता दीपा दत्ताः शिवालये..
दातारस्तेऽपि कैलासे मोदन्ते शिवसंनिधौ.. 13.43 ..
1.3.m: Those who offer lamps filled with safflower oil in an abode of Śiva, / those givers also rejoice in Kailāsa in the presence of Śiva.

1.3.s:
atasītailasaṃyuktā dīpā dattāḥ śivālaye..
te śivaṃ yāṃti saṃyuktāḥ kulānāṃ ca śatena vai.. 13.44 ..
1.3.d:
अतसीतैलसंयुक्ता दीपा दत्ताः शिवालये..
ते शिवं यांति संयुक्ताः कुलानां च शतेन वै.. 13.44 ..
1.3.m: Those who offer lamps filled with linseed oil in an abode of Śiva, / they go to Śiva together with a hundred generations of their families.

1.3.s: jñānino'pi hi jāyaṃte dīpadānaphalena hi.. 13.45 ..
1.3.d: ज्ञानिनोऽपि हि जायंते दीपदानफलेन हि.. 13.45 ..
1.3.m: Indeed, they become possessors of knowledge by the fruit of offering lamps.

1.3.s:
tilatailena saṃyuktā dīpā dattāḥ śivālaye..
te śivaṃ yāṃti saṃyuktāḥ kulānāṃ ca śatena vai.. 13.46 ..
1.3.d:
तिलतैलेन संयुक्ता दीपा दत्ताः शिवालये..
ते शिवं यांति संयुक्ताः कुलानां च शतेन वै.. 13.46 ..
1.3.m: Those who offer lamps filled with sesame oil in an abode of Śiva, / they go to Śiva together with a hundred generations of their families.

1.3.s:
ghṛtāktā yaiḥ kṛtā dīpā dīpitāśca śivālaye..
te yāṃti paramaṃ sthānaṃ kulalakṣasamanvitāḥ.. 13.47 ..
1.3.d:
घृताक्ता यैः कृता दीपा दीपिताश्च शिवालये..
ते यांति परमं स्थानं कुललक्षसमन्विताः.. 13.47 ..
1.3.m: Those by whom lamps anointed with ghee are prepared and lit in an abode of Śiva, / they go to the supreme abode accompanied by a hundred thousand generations of their families.

1.3.s:
karpūrāgurudhūpaiśca ye yajaṃti sadā śivam..
ārārtikāṃ sakarppūrāṃ ye kurvaṃti dinedine..
te prāpnuvaṃti sāyujyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 13.48 ..
1.3.d:
कर्पूरागुरुधूपैश्च ये यजंति सदा शिवम्..
आरार्तिकां सकर्प्पूरां ये कुर्वंति दिनेदिने..
ते प्राप्नुवंति सायुज्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 13.48 ..
1.3.m: Those who constantly worship Śiva with incense of camphor and agallochum, / and those who day by day perform the wave-offering of lights with camphor, / they attain union with him; no doubt should be entertained here.

1.3.s:
ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ ye hyataṃdritāḥ..
liṃgārcanaṃ prakurvaṃti te rudrā nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 13.49 ..
1.3.d:
एककालं द्विकालं वा त्रिकालं ये ह्यतंद्रिताः..
लिंगार्चनं प्रकुर्वंति ते रुद्रा नात्र संशयः.. 13.49 ..
1.3.m: Those who unwearied perform the worship of the liṅga / once, twice, or thrice a day, they are Rudras; of this there is no doubt.

1.3.s:
rudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ ye ca kurvaṃti śivapūjane..
dāne tapasi tīrthe ca parvakāle hyataṃdritāḥ..
teṣāṃ yatsukṛtaṃ sarvamanaṃtaṃ bhavati dvijāḥ.. 13.50 ..
1.3.d:
रुद्राक्षधारणं ये च कुर्वंति शिवपूजने..
दाने तपसि तीर्थे च पर्वकाले ह्यतंद्रिताः..
तेषां यत्सुकृतं सर्वमनंतं भवति द्विजाः.. 13.50 ..
1.3.m: And those who unwearied wear rudrākṣa beads in the worship of Śiva, / during gift-giving, austerity, at a sacred ford, and on auspicious festive days, / whatever meritorious deed they perform becomes endless, O twice-born.

1.3.s:
rudrākṣā ye śivenoktāstācchṛṇudhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ..
ārambhaikamukhaṃ tāvadyābadvaktrāṇi ṣoḍaśa..
eteṣāṃ dvau ca vijñeyau śreṣṭhau tārayituṃ dvijāḥ.. 13.51 ..
1.3.d:
रुद्राक्षा ये शिवेनोक्तास्ताच्छृणुध्वं द्विजोत्तमाः..
आरम्भैकमुखं तावद्याबद्वक्त्राणि षोडश..
एतेषां द्वौ च विज्ञेयौ श्रेष्ठौ तारयितुं द्विजाः.. 13.51 ..
1.3.m: Hear, O best of the twice-born, of the rudrākṣas spoken of by Śiva, / beginning with the one-faced up to sixteen-faced ones. / Among these, two are to be known as the best for carrying one across [the ocean of existence], O twice-born:

1.3.s:
rudrākṣāṇāṃ paṃcamukhakhastathā caikamukhaḥ smṛtaḥ..
ye dhārayaṃtyekamukhaṃ rudrākṣamaniśaṃ narāḥ..
rudralokaṃ ca gacchaṃti modante rudrasaṃnidhau.. 13.52 ..
1.3.d:
रुद्राक्षाणां पंचमुखखस्तथा चैकमुखः स्मृतः..
ये धारयंत्येकमुखं रुद्राक्षमनिशं नराः..
रुद्रलोकं च गच्छंति मोदन्ते रुद्रसंनिधौ.. 13.52 ..
1.3.m: The five-faced among rudrākṣas, and the one-faced is likewise declared. / Those men who wear a one-faced rudrākṣa day and night, / they go to the world of Rudra and rejoice in the presence of Rudra.

1.3.s:
japastapaḥ kriyā yogaḥ snānaṃ dānārcanādikam..
kriyate yacchṛbhaṃ karmma hyanaṃtaṃ cākṣadhāraṇāt.. 13.53 ..
1.3.d:
जपस्तपः क्रिया योगः स्नानं दानार्चनादिकम्..
क्रियते यच्छृभं कर्म्म ह्यनंतं चाक्षधारणात्.. 13.53 ..
1.3.m: Recitation, austerity, ritual action, yoga, ritual ablution, gift-giving, worship, and the rest— / whatever auspicious rite is performed becomes indeed endless through the wearing of rudrākṣa beads.

1.3.s:
śunaḥ kaṃṭhanibaddho'pi rudrākṣo yadi vartate..
so'pi saṃtāritastena nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 13.54 ..
1.3.d:
शुनः कंठनिबद्धोऽपि रुद्राक्षो यदि वर्तते..
सोऽपि संतारितस्तेन नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 13.54 ..
1.3.m: Even if a rudrākṣa is tied around the neck of a dog, / even that [creature] is saved by it; no doubt should be entertained here.

1.3.s:
tathā rudrākṣasaṃbaṃdhātpāpamapikṣayaṃ vrajet..
evaṃ jñātvā śubhaṃ karma kāryaṃ rudrākṣabaṃdhanāt.. 13.55 ..
1.3.d:
तथा रुद्राक्षसंबंधात्पापमपिक्षयं व्रजेत्..
एवं ज्ञात्वा शुभं कर्म कार्यं रुद्राक्षबंधनात्.. 13.55 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, through connection with a rudrākṣa, even sin is destroyed. / Knowing this, one should perform auspicious action after binding on a rudrākṣa.

1.3.s:
tripuṇḍradhāraṇaṃ yeṣāṃ vibhūtvā mantrapūtayā..
te rudraloke rudrāśca bhaviṣyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ.. 13.56 ..
1.3.d:
त्रिपुण्ड्रधारणं येषां विभूत्वा मन्त्रपूतया..
ते रुद्रलोके रुद्राश्च भविष्यंति न संशयः.. 13.56 ..
1.3.m: Those who wear the three-line mark of ashes consecrated by mantras, / they will become Rudras in the world of Rudra; of this there is no doubt.

1.3.s:
kapilāyāśca saṃgṛhya gomayaṃ cāṃtarikṣagam..
śuṣkaṃ kṛtvātha saṃdāhyaṃ vibhūtyarthaṃ śivapriyaiḥ.. 13.57 ..
1.3.d:
कपिलायाश्च संगृह्य गोमयं चांतरिक्षगम्..
शुष्कं कृत्वाथ संदाह्यं विभूत्यर्थं शिवप्रियैः.. 13.57 ..
1.3.m: Having taken cow dung from a brown cow, caught as it falls through the air, / and dried it, it should be burnt for sacred ash by those dear to Śiva.

1.3.s:
vibhūtīti samākhyātā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī..
lalāṭeṃ'guṣṭharekhā ca ādau bhāvyā prayatnataḥ.. 13.58 ..
1.3.d:
विभूतीति समाख्याता सर्वपापप्रणाशिनी..
ललाटेंऽगुष्ठरेखा च आदौ भाव्या प्रयत्नतः.. 13.58 ..
1.3.m: The sacred ash is declared to be the destroyer of all sins. / First, a line with the thumb should be applied with effort on the forehead,

1.3.s:
madhyamāṃ varjayitvā tu aṃgulīkdvayena ca..
evaṃ trirekhāsaṃyukto lalāṭe yasya dṛśyate..
sa śaivaḥ śivavajjñeyo darśanātpāpanāśanaḥ.. 13.59 ..
1.3.d:
मध्यमां वर्जयित्वा तु अंगुलीक्द्वयेन च..
एवं त्रिरेखासंयुक्तो ललाटे यस्य दृश्यते..
स शैवः शिववज्ज्ञेयो दर्शनात्पापनाशनः.. 13.59 ..
1.3.m: leaving out the middle finger, and using two fingers [as well]. / One who is seen with three lines thus on his forehead / is to be known as a Śaiva, like Śiva himself, destroying sin merely by being seen.

1.3.s:
jaṭādharāśca ye śaivāḥ sapta paṃca tathā nava..
jaṭā ye sthāpiyiṣyaṃti śaivena vidhinā yutāḥ.. 13.60 ..
1.3.d:
जटाधराश्च ये शैवाः सप्त पंच तथा नव..
जटा ये स्थापियिष्यंति शैवेन विधिना युताः.. 13.60 ..
1.3.m: And those Śaivas who wear matted locks—seven, five, or nine— / who maintain matted locks according to the Śaiva rule,

1.3.s:
te śivaṃ prāpnuvaṃ tīha nātra kāryā vicāraṇā..
rudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ śivabhaktairviśeṣataḥ.. 13.61 ..
1.3.d:
ते शिवं प्राप्नुवं तीह नात्र कार्या विचारणा..
रुद्राक्षधारणं कार्यं शिवभक्तैर्विशेषतः.. 13.61 ..
1.3.m: they attain Śiva here; no doubt should be entertained here. / The wearing of rudrākṣas must especially be observed by the devotees of Śiva.

1.3.s:
alpena vā mahattvena pūjito vā sadāśivaḥ..
kulakoṭiṃ samuddhṛtya śivena saha modate.. 13.62 ..
1.3.d:
अल्पेन वा महत्त्वेन पूजितो वा सदाशिवः..
कुलकोटिं समुद्धृत्य शिवेन सह मोदते.. 13.62 ..
1.3.m: Whether worshipped poorly or richly, Sadāśiva / delivers ten million generations of one's family, and one rejoices with Śiva.

1.3.s:
tasmācchivātparataraṃ nāsti kiṃciddvijottamāḥ..
yadaivamucyate śāstre tatsarvaṃ śivakāraṇam.. 13.63 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माच्छिवात्परतरं नास्ति किंचिद्द्विजोत्तमाः..
यदैवमुच्यते शास्त्रे तत्सर्वं शिवकारणम्.. 13.63 ..
1.3.m: Therefore there is nothing higher than Śiva, O best of the twice-born. / Whatever is spoken in the sacred treatises has Śiva as its sole cause.

1.3.s:
śivo dātā hi lokānāṃ kartā caivānumoditā..
śivaśaktyātmakaṃ viśvaṃ jānīdhvaṃ hi dvijottamāḥ.. 13.64 ..
1.3.d:
शिवो दाता हि लोकानां कर्ता चैवानुमोदिता..
शिवशक्त्यात्मकं विश्वं जानीध्वं हि द्विजोत्तमाः.. 13.64 ..
1.3.m: Śiva alone is the giver to all the worlds, the creator, and the approver. / Know, O best of the twice-born, that the universe consists of Śiva and Śakti.

1.3.s:
śiveti dvyakṣaraṃ nāma trāyate mahato bhayāt..
tasmācchivaściṃtyatāṃ vai smaryatāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ.. 13.65 ..
1.3.d:
शिवेति द्व्यक्षरं नाम त्रायते महतो भयात्..
तस्माच्छिवश्चिंत्यतां वै स्मर्यतां च द्विजोत्तमाः.. 13.65 ..
1.3.m: The two-syllable name 'Śiva' delivers from great fear. / Therefore let Śiva be meditated upon and remembered, O best of the twice-born.

1.3.s:
..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
somanāthasya māhātmyaṃ jñātaṃ tasya prasādataḥ..
rāhoḥ śirobhayātsarve rakṣitāḥ parameṣṭhinā.. 13.66 ..
1.3.d:
..ऋषय ऊचुः..
सोमनाथस्य माहात्म्यं ज्ञातं तस्य प्रसादतः..
राहोः शिरोभयात्सर्वे रक्षिताः परमेष्ठिना.. 13.66 ..
1.3.m: The seers said: / The māhātmya of Somanātha has been understood through his grace, / [and how] all were protected by the Supreme Lord from the fear of Rāhu's head,

1.3.s:
surāśceṃdrādayaścānye tasminyuddhe sudāruṇe..
ata ūrdhvaṃ surāḥ sarve kimakurvata ucyatām.. 13.67 ..
1.3.d:
सुराश्चेंद्रादयश्चान्ये तस्मिन्युद्धे सुदारुणे..
अत ऊर्ध्वं सुराः सर्वे किमकुर्वत उच्यताम्.. 13.67 ..
1.3.m: and the gods, Indra and others, in that terrible battle. / What did all the gods do after this? Let it be told.

1.3.s:
śivasya mahimā sarvaḥ śrutastava mukhodgataḥ..
atha yuddhasya vṛttāntaḥ kathyatāṃ paramārthataḥ.. 13.68 ..
1.3.d:
शिवस्य महिमा सर्वः श्रुतस्तव मुखोद्गतः..
अथ युद्धस्य वृत्तान्तः कथ्यतां परमार्थतः.. 13.68 ..
1.3.m: The entire greatness of Śiva has been heard coming from your mouth. / Now let the account of the battle be related according to reality.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
yadā hi daityaiśca parājitāḥ surāḥ śambhuṃ ca sarve śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ..
śivaṃ praṇemuḥ sahasā surottamā yuddhāya sarve ca mano dadhustadā.. 13.69 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
यदा हि दैत्यैश्च पराजिताः सुराः शम्भुं च सर्वे शरणं प्रपन्नाः..
शिवं प्रणेमुः सहसा सुरोत्तमा युद्धाय सर्वे च मनो दधुस्तदा.. 13.69 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / When the gods were defeated by the Daityas, they all took refuge with Śambhu; / the best of the gods instantly bowed to Śiva and then set their minds upon battle.

1.3.s:
tathaiva daityā api yudhyamānā utsāhayuktātibalāśca sarve..
devaiḥ sametāśca punaḥ punaśca yuddhaṃ pracakruḥ paramāstrayuktāḥ.. 13.70 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव दैत्या अपि युध्यमाना उत्साहयुक्तातिबलाश्च सर्वे..
देवैः समेताश्च पुनः पुनश्च युद्धं प्रचक्रुः परमास्त्रयुक्ताः.. 13.70 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, the Daityas also, fighting with enthusiasm and exceedingly strong, / having gathered against the gods, waged battle again and again equipped with supreme missiles.

1.3.s:
evaṃ ca sarve hyasurāḥ surāśca śaktyṛṣṭiśūlaiḥ parighaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ..
jayārthinomarṣayutāḥ parasparaṃ siṃhā yathā haimavatīṃ durātyayāḥ..
nihanyamānā hyasurāḥ suraistadā nānāstrayogaiḥ paramairnipetuḥ.. 13.71 ..
1.3.d:
एवं च सर्वे ह्यसुराः सुराश्च शक्त्यृष्टिशूलैः परिघैः परश्वधैः..
जयार्थिनोमर्षयुताः परस्परं सिंहा यथा हैमवतीं दुरात्ययाः..
निहन्यमाना ह्यसुराः सुरैस्तदा नानास्त्रयोगैः परमैर्निपेतुः.. 13.71 ..
1.3.m: Thus all the Asuras and gods, striving for victory, filled with fury against one another / like lions facing a mountain lioness, unyielding, / with spears, javelins, tridents, clubs, and battle-axes, / the Asuras, struck down then by the gods with various supreme missile attacks, fell.

1.3.s:
cakruste sakalāmurvī māṃsaśoṇitakardamām..
mahīṃ vṛkṣādrisaṃyuktāṃ sasāgaravanākarām.. 13.72 ..
1.3.d:
चक्रुस्ते सकलामुर्वी मांसशोणितकर्दमाम्..
महीं वृक्षाद्रिसंयुक्तां ससागरवनाकराम्.. 13.72 ..
1.3.m: They made the entire earth muddy with flesh and blood— / the earth with its trees and mountains, together with its oceans, forests, and mines.

1.3.s:
śirāṃsi ca kabandhāni kavacāni mahāṃti ca..
dhvajārathāḥ patākāśca gajavājiśirāṃsi ca.. 13.73 ..
1.3.d:
शिरांसि च कबन्धानि कवचानि महांति च..
ध्वजारथाः पताकाश्च गजवाजिशिरांसि च.. 13.73 ..
1.3.m: [There lay] heads and headless trunks, and great coats of mail, / banners, chariots, flags, and the heads of elephants and horses.

1.3.s:
bahantyaścāpagā hyāsannadyo bhīrubhayāvahāḥ..
agādhāḥ śoṇitodāśca taraṃto brahmarākṣasāḥ..
tayaṃti parānbhūtapratapramatharākṣasān.. 13.74 ..
1.3.d:
बहन्त्यश्चापगा ह्यासन्नद्यो भीरुभयावहाः..
अगाधाः शोणितोदाश्च तरंतो ब्रह्मराक्षसाः..
तयंति परान्भूतप्रतप्रमथराक्षसान्.. 13.74 ..
1.3.m: Streams and rivers flowed, terrifying to the faint-hearted, / unfathomable with blood for their waters; crossing them, brahmarākṣasas / crossed over with other spirits, ghosts, pramathas, and rākṣasas.

1.3.s:
śākinīḍākinīsaṃghā yakṣiṇyo'tha sahasraśaḥ..
nānākeliṣu saṃyuktāḥ parasparamudānvitāḥ.. 13.75 ..
1.3.d:
शाकिनीडाकिनीसंघा यक्षिण्योऽथ सहस्रशः..
नानाकेलिषु संयुक्ताः परस्परमुदान्विताः.. 13.75 ..
1.3.m: Hosts of śākinīs and ḍākinīs, and yakṣiṇīs by the thousands, / engaged in various sports, filled with mutual delight.

1.3.s:
evaṃ saṃkrīḍamānāste bhūtapramatharākṣasāḥ..
raṇe tasminmahāraudre devāsurasamāgame.. 13.76 ..
1.3.d:
एवं संक्रीडमानास्ते भूतप्रमथराक्षसाः..
रणे तस्मिन्महारौद्रे देवासुरसमागमे.. 13.76 ..
1.3.m: As those spirits, pramathas, and rākṣasas were sporting thus / in that dreadfully fierce battle, in the clash of gods and Asuras,

1.3.s:
balinā saha devendro yuyudhe'dbhutavikramaḥ..
śaktyā jaghāna deveṃdraṃ vairocaniramarṣaṇaḥ.. 13.77 ..
1.3.d:
बलिना सह देवेन्द्रो युयुधेऽद्भुतविक्रमः..
शक्त्या जघान देवेंद्रं वैरोचनिरमर्षणः.. 13.77 ..
1.3.m: the king of the gods of wondrous prowess fought with Bali; / the wrathful son of Virocana struck the king of the gods with a javelin.

1.3.s:
tāṃ śaktiṃ vañcayāmāsa mahendro laghuvikramaḥ..
jaghāna sa baliṃ yatnāddaityeṃdraṃ parameṇa hi.. 13.78 ..
1.3.d:
तां शक्तिं वञ्चयामास महेन्द्रो लघुविक्रमः..
जघान स बलिं यत्नाद्दैत्येंद्रं परमेण हि.. 13.78 ..
1.3.m: The swift-striding Mahendra dodged that spear; / he then forcefully struck Bali, the king of the Daityas, with his supreme [weapon].

1.3.s:
vajreṇa śitadhāreṇa bāhuṃ ciccheda vikramī..
gātāsurapatadbhūmau vimānātsūryasaṃnnibhāt.. 13.79 ..
1.3.d:
वज्रेण शितधारेण बाहुं चिच्छेद विक्रमी..
गातासुरपतद्भूमौ विमानात्सूर्यसंन्निभात्.. 13.79 ..
1.3.m: With his sharp-edged vajra the valorous one severed his arm; / lifeless, [Bali] fell to the ground from his sun-like aerial chariot.

1.3.s:
patitaṃ ca baliṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛṣaparvā rūpānvitaḥ..
vavarṣa śaradhārābhiḥ payoda iva parvatam.. 13.80 ..
1.3.d:
पतितं च बलिं दृष्ट्वा वृषपर्वा रूपान्वितः..
ववर्ष शरधाराभिः पयोद इव पर्वतम्.. 13.80 ..
1.3.m: Seeing Bali fallen, Vṛṣaparvan, filled with anger, / rained showers of arrows [upon Indra], as a rain-cloud [showers] a mountain.

1.3.s:
maheṃdraṃ sagajaṃ caiva sahamānaṃ śitāñcharān..
tadā yuddhamabhūdvoraṃ mahendravṛṣaparvaṇoḥ.. 13.81 ..
1.3.d:
महेंद्रं सगजं चैव सहमानं शिताञ्छरान्..
तदा युद्धमभूद्वोरं महेन्द्रवृषपर्वणोः.. 13.81 ..
1.3.m: Mahendra along with his elephant, enduring the sharp arrows— / then a dreadful battle took place between Mahendra and Vṛṣaparvan.

1.3.s: nipātya vṛṣaparvāṇamiṃdraḥ parabalārdanaḥ.. 13.82 ..
1.3.d: निपात्य वृषपर्वाणमिंद्रः परबलार्दनः.. 13.82 ..
1.3.m: Having struck down Vṛṣaparvan, Indra, the crusher of enemy forces, [fought on].

1.3.s:
tato vajreṇa mahatā dānavānavadhīdraṇe..
śirasi ccheditāḥ kecitkecitkaṃdharato hatāḥ.. 13.83 ..
1.3.d:
ततो वज्रेण महता दानवानवधीद्रणे..
शिरसि च्छेदिताः केचित्केचित्कंधरतो हताः.. 13.83 ..
1.3.m: Then with his great thunderbolt he slew the Dānavas in battle; / some were decapitated at the head, and some were struck down by the neck.

1.3.s:
vihvalāśca kṛtāḥ kecidiṃdreṇa kupitena ca..
tathā yamena nihatā vāyunā varuṇena ca.. 13.84 ..
1.3.d:
विह्वलाश्च कृताः केचिदिंद्रेण कुपितेन च..
तथा यमेन निहता वायुना वरुणेन च.. 13.84 ..
1.3.m: Some were thrown into bewilderment by the enraged Indra; / likewise, [others] were slain by Yama, by Vāyu, and by Varuṇa.

1.3.s:
kubereṇa hatāścānye nairṛtena tathā pare..
agninā nihatāḥ kecidīśenaiva vidāritāḥ.. 13.85 ..
1.3.d:
कुबेरेण हताश्चान्ये नैरृतेन तथा परे..
अग्निना निहताः केचिदीशेनैव विदारिताः.. 13.85 ..
1.3.m: Others were killed by Kubera, and others likewise by Nairṛta; / some were slain by Agni, and [others] torn apart by Īśa himself.

1.3.s:
evaṃ tadā tairnihatā balīyaso mahāsurā vikramaśāninaśca..
suraistu sarvaiḥ saha lokapālaiḥ śivaprasādā bhihatāstadānīm.. 13.86 ..
1.3.d:
एवं तदा तैर्निहता बलीयसो महासुरा विक्रमशानिनश्च..
सुरैस्तु सर्वैः सह लोकपालैः शिवप्रसादा भिहतास्तदानीम्.. 13.86 ..
1.3.m: Thus the very mighty and valiant great Asuras were slain by them then; / struck down at that time by all the gods together with the world-protectors, by the grace of Śiva.

1.3.s:
tato mahādaityavaro durātmā sa kalānemiḥ paramāstrayuktaḥ..
yayau tadānīṃ surasattamāṃstānhaṃtuṃ sadā krūramatiḥ sa ekaḥ.. 13.87 ..
1.3.d:
ततो महादैत्यवरो दुरात्मा स कलानेमिः परमास्त्रयुक्तः..
ययौ तदानीं सुरसत्तमांस्तान्हंतुं सदा क्रूरमतिः स एकः.. 13.87 ..
1.3.m: Then that best of great Daityas, the evil-minded Kālanemi, equipped with supreme weapons, / that single one of ever-cruel mind, went forth at that time to slay those foremost of the gods.

1.3.s:
siṃhārūḍho daṃśitaśca triśulena hi saṃyutaḥ..
daityānāmarbudenaiva siṃhārūḍhena saṃvṛtaḥ.. 13.88 ..
1.3.d:
सिंहारूढो दंशितश्च त्रिशुलेन हि संयुतः..
दैत्यानामर्बुदेनैव सिंहारूढेन संवृतः.. 13.88 ..
1.3.m: Mounted on a lion, clad in armor, and equipped with a trident, / surrounded by a hundred million Daityas mounted on lions.

1.3.s:
te siṃhā daṃśitāḥ sarve mahābalaparākramāḥ..
teṣu siṃheṣu cārūḍhā mahādaityāśca tatsamāḥ.. 13.89 ..
1.3.d:
ते सिंहा दंशिताः सर्वे महाबलपराक्रमाः..
तेषु सिंहेषु चारूढा महादैत्याश्च तत्समाः.. 13.89 ..
1.3.m: All those lions were armored, possessing great strength and prowess; / and mounted upon those lions were great Daityas equal to them.

1.3.s:
āyāṃtīṃ daityasenāṃ tāṃ sarvāṃ siṃhavibhūṣitām..
kālanemiyutāṃ dṛṣṭvā devā iṃdrapurogamāḥ..
bhayamājagmuratulaṃ tadā dhyānaparā bhavan.. 13.90 ..
1.3.d:
आयांतीं दैत्यसेनां तां सर्वां सिंहविभूषिताम्..
कालनेमियुतां दृष्ट्वा देवा इंद्रपुरोगमाः..
भयमाजग्मुरतुलं तदा ध्यानपरा भवन्.. 13.90 ..
1.3.m: Seeing that entire army of Daityas approaching, adorned with lions / and joined with Kālanemi, the gods, led by Indra, / were overcome with incomparable fear, and then became absorbed in meditation:

1.3.s:
kiṃ kurmo'dya vayaṃ sarve kathaṃ jeṣyāma cādbhutam..
etādṛśamasaṃkhyākamanīkaṃ siṃhasaṃvṛtam.. 13.91 ..
1.3.d:
किं कुर्मोऽद्य वयं सर्वे कथं जेष्याम चाद्भुतम्..
एतादृशमसंख्याकमनीकं सिंहसंवृतम्.. 13.91 ..
1.3.m: "What shall all of us do today? How shall we conquer this wondrous, / innumerable army surrounded by lions?"

1.3.s:
evaṃ viciṃtyamānāste hyāgatastatra nāradaḥ..
nāradena ca tatsarvaṃ purāvṛttaṃ mahattaram.. 13.92 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विचिंत्यमानास्ते ह्यागतस्तत्र नारदः..
नारदेन च तत्सर्वं पुरावृत्तं महत्तरम्.. 13.92 ..
1.3.m: While they were thus pondering, Nārada arrived there; / and by Nārada the entire great past history was related.

1.3.s:
kathitaṃ ca maheṃdrāya kālanemestapobalam..
ajeyatvaṃ ca saṃgrāme varadānabalena tu.. 13.93 ..
1.3.d:
कथितं च महेंद्राय कालनेमेस्तपोबलम्..
अजेयत्वं च संग्रामे वरदानबलेन तु.. 13.93 ..
1.3.m: And the power of Kālanemi's austerity was told to Mahendra, / as well as his invincibility in battle through the power of a boon granted [to him]:

1.3.s:
viṣṇuṃ vinā vayaṃ devā aśaktā raṇamaṃḍale..
jetuṃ ca sa tato viṣṇuḥ smaryatāṃ parameśvaraḥ..
tamālanīlo varadaḥ sarvairvijayakāṃkṣibhiḥ.. 13.94 ..
1.3.d:
विष्णुं विना वयं देवा अशक्ता रणमंडले..
जेतुं च स ततो विष्णुः स्मर्यतां परमेश्वरः..
तमालनीलो वरदः सर्वैर्विजयकांक्षिभिः.. 13.94 ..
1.3.m: "Without Viṣṇu, O gods, we are unable to conquer him on the battlefield; / therefore let Viṣṇu, the supreme Lord, dark as a tamāla tree and the granter of boons, / be remembered by all who desire victory."

1.3.s:
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā tadā devāstvarānvitāḥ..
dhyānena ca mahāviṣṇuṃ tataḥ parabalārddanam..
smaraṃtaḥ paramātmānamidamūcuśca taṃ vibhum.. 13.95 ..
1.3.d:
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा तदा देवास्त्वरान्विताः..
ध्यानेन च महाविष्णुं ततः परबलार्द्दनम्..
स्मरंतः परमात्मानमिदमूचुश्च तं विभुम्.. 13.95 ..
1.3.m: Hearing Nārada's words, the gods, filled with haste, / remembering through meditation Mahāviṣṇu, the crusher of the enemy's army, / the supreme Self, spoke thus to that all-pervading Lord:

1.3.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ..
namastubhyaṃ bhagavate namaste viśvamaṃgalam..
śrīnivāsa namastubhyaṃ śrīpate te namonamaḥ.. 13.96 ..
1.3.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः..
नमस्तुभ्यं भगवते नमस्ते विश्वमंगलम्..
श्रीनिवास नमस्तुभ्यं श्रीपते ते नमोनमः.. 13.96 ..
1.3.m: The gods said: / "Obeisance to you, the Blessed One! Obeisance to you, the auspiciousness of the universe! / O Sriniketa, obeisance to you! O Lord of Śrī, obeisance, obeisance to you!

1.3.s:
adyāsmānbhayabhītāṃstvaṃ kālanemibhayārditān..
trātumarhasi daityācca devānāmabhayaprada.. 13.97 ..
1.3.d:
अद्यास्मान्भयभीतांस्त्वं कालनेमिभयार्दितान्..
त्रातुमर्हसि दैत्याच्च देवानामभयप्रद.. 13.97 ..
1.3.m: Today, you should protect us who are terrified of fear, tormented by fear of Kālanemi, / from the Daitya, O granter of fearlessness to the gods!"

1.3.s:
evaṃ dhyātaḥ saṃsmṛtaśca prādurbhūto haristadā..
nīlo garuḍamāruhya jagatāmabhayapradaḥ.. 13.98 ..
1.3.d:
एवं ध्यातः संस्मृतश्च प्रादुर्भूतो हरिस्तदा..
नीलो गरुडमारुह्य जगतामभयप्रदः.. 13.98 ..
1.3.m: Thus meditated upon and remembered, Hari then manifested, / dark-hued, mounted upon Garuḍa, the granter of fearlessness to the worlds.

1.3.s:
cakrapāṇistadāyāto devānāṃ vijayāya ca..
gaganasthaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ garuḍopari saṃsthitam..
śrīvāsamenaṃ durddharṣaṃ yoddhukāmaṃ dadarśire.. 13.99 ..
1.3.d:
चक्रपाणिस्तदायातो देवानां विजयाय च..
गगनस्थं महाविष्णुं गरुडोपरि संस्थितम्..
श्रीवासमेनं दुर्द्धर्षं योद्धुकामं ददर्शिरे.. 13.99 ..
1.3.m: Holding the discus in hand, he arrived then for the victory of the gods; / they beheld Mahāviṣṇu standing in the sky, seated upon Garuḍa, / the unassailable abode of Śrī, eager to fight.

1.3.s:
tathā dṛṣṭvā kālanemistadānīṃ prahasyamāno'tiruṣā balānvitaḥ..
kastvaṃ mahābhāga vareṇyarūpaḥ śyāmo yuvā vāraṇamattavikramaḥ..
kare gṛhītaṃ niśitaṃ mahāprabhaṃ cakraṃ ca kasmātkathayasva me prabho.. 13.100 ..
1.3.d:
तथा दृष्ट्वा कालनेमिस्तदानीं प्रहस्यमानोऽतिरुषा बलान्वितः..
कस्त्वं महाभाग वरेण्यरूपः श्यामो युवा वारणमत्तविक्रमः..
करे गृहीतं निशितं महाप्रभं चक्रं च कस्मात्कथयस्व मे प्रभो.. 13.100 ..
1.3.m: Seeing him thus, Kālanemi, laughing derisively with extreme wrath, endowed with strength, [said]: / "Who are you, O fortunate one of choice form, dark, youthful, with the prowess of a rutting elephant? / Why is a sharp discus of great splendor held in your hand? Tell me, O lord!"

1.3.s:
..śrībhagavānuvāca..
yuddhārthamiha cāyāto devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye..
tvaṃ sthiro bhava re maṃda dahāmyadya na saṃśayaḥ.. 13.101 ..
1.3.d:
..श्रीभगवानुवाच..
युद्धार्थमिह चायातो देवानां कार्यसिद्धये..
त्वं स्थिरो भव रे मंद दहाम्यद्य न संशयः.. 13.101 ..
1.3.m: The Blessed Lord said: / "I have come here for battle, to accomplish the purpose of the gods. / Stand firm, O dullard! I will burn you today without a doubt."

1.3.s:
śrutvā bhagavato vākyaṃ kālanemiḥ pratāpavān..
uvāca ruṣito bhūtvā bhagavaṃtamadhokṣajam.. 13.102 ..
1.3.d:
श्रुत्वा भगवतो वाक्यं कालनेमिः प्रतापवान्..
उवाच रुषितो भूत्वा भगवंतमधोक्षजम्.. 13.102 ..
1.3.m: Hearing the words of the Blessed Lord, the powerful Kālanemi, / becoming furious, spoke to the Blessed Lord Adhokṣaja:

1.3.s:
mūlabhūto hi devānāṃ bhagavānyuddhadurmadaḥ..
yuddhaṃ kuru mayā sārddhaṃ yadi śūro'si saṃprati.. 13.103 ..
1.3.d:
मूलभूतो हि देवानां भगवान्युद्धदुर्मदः..
युद्धं कुरु मया सार्द्धं यदि शूरोऽसि संप्रति.. 13.103 ..
1.3.m: "You are indeed the root of the gods, O Blessed One, arrogant in battle; / fight with me now if you are a hero!"

1.3.s:
prahasya bhagavānviṣṇuruvācedaṃ mahāprabhaḥ..
gaganastho bhava tvaṃ hi mahīstho'haṃ bhavāmi vai.. 13.104 ..
1.3.d:
प्रहस्य भगवान्विष्णुरुवाचेदं महाप्रभः..
गगनस्थो भव त्वं हि महीस्थोऽहं भवामि वै.. 13.104 ..
1.3.m: Laughing, the Blessed Lord Viṣṇu of great splendor said this: / "Be in the sky, for I shall indeed be on the earth.

1.3.s:
apraśastaṃ ca viṣamaṃ yuddhaṃ caiva yathā bhavet..
tathā kuru mahābāho gagano vā mahītale.. 13.105 ..
1.3.d:
अप्रशस्तं च विषमं युद्धं चैव यथा भवेत्..
तथा कुरु महाबाहो गगनो वा महीतले.. 13.105 ..
1.3.m: Act in such a way, O mighty-armed one, whether in the sky or on the earth's surface, / so that the battle does not become unpraiseworthy and unequal."

1.3.s:
tatheti matvā hi mahānubhāvo daityaiḥ sameto'rbudasaṃkhyakaiśca..
siṃhoparisthaiśca mahānubhāvairmahābalaiḥ krūrataraistadānīm.. 13.106 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा हि महानुभावो दैत्यैः समेतोऽर्बुदसंख्यकैश्च..
सिंहोपरिस्थैश्च महानुभावैर्महाबलैः क्रूरतरैस्तदानीम्.. 13.106 ..
1.3.m: Agreeing to this, that mighty one, accompanied by Daityas numbering a hundred million, / mounted on lions, noble, exceedingly powerful and fierce at that time,

1.3.s:
gaganamatha jagāhe maṃdamaṃdaṃ mahātmā hyasuragaṇasameto viśvarūpaṃ jighāṃsuḥ..
triśikhamaparamugraṃ gṛhya saṃdeśaceṣṭādaśanavikṛtavaktro yoddhukāmo hariṃ saḥ.. 13.107 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe samudramaṃthanākhyāne devāsurasaṃgrāmavarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 13 ..
1.3.d:
गगनमथ जगाहे मंदमंदं महात्मा ह्यसुरगणसमेतो विश्वरूपं जिघांसुः..
त्रिशिखमपरमुग्रं गृह्य संदेशचेष्टादशनविकृतवक्त्रो योद्धुकामो हरिं सः.. 13.107 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे समुद्रमंथनाख्याने देवासुरसंग्रामवर्णनंनाम त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः.. 13 ..
1.3.m:
the great-souled one, accompanied by the host of Asuras, slowly entered the sky, wishing to slay the Universal-Formed One; / holding an extremely fierce trident, his face deformed with teeth [bared] in menacing action, he desired to fight Hari.
Thus ends the thirteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Battle between the Gods and the Asuras', in the narrative of the Churning of the Ocean, in the first [part], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
tato yuddhamatīvāsīdasurairviṣṇunā saha..
tataḥ siṃhāḥ sapakṣāste daṃśitāḥ paramādbhutāḥ.. 14.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
ततो युद्धमतीवासीदसुरैर्विष्णुना सह..
ततः सिंहाः सपक्षास्ते दंशिताः परमाद्भुताः.. 14.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / "Then there was an intense battle between the Asuras and Viṣṇu. / Then those winged lions, armored and most wonderful,

1.3.s:
asurairuhyamānāste rahutmaṃtaṃ vyadārayan..
siṃhāste dāritāstena khaṃḍaśaśca vidāritāḥ.. 14.2 ..
1.3.d:
असुरैरुह्यमानास्ते रहुत्मंतं व्यदारयन्..
सिंहास्ते दारितास्तेन खंडशश्च विदारिताः.. 14.2 ..
1.3.m: carried by the Asuras, attacked Garuḍa. / Those lions were torn apart by him and ripped to pieces.

1.3.s:
viṣṇunā ca tadā daityāścakreṇa śakalīkṛtāḥ..
hatāṃstānasurāndṛṣṭvā kālanemiḥ pratāpavān.. 14.3 ..
1.3.d:
विष्णुना च तदा दैत्याश्चक्रेण शकलीकृताः..
हतांस्तानसुरान्दृष्ट्वा कालनेमिः प्रतापवान्.. 14.3 ..
1.3.m: And then the Daityas were cut into pieces by Viṣṇu with his discus. / Seeing those Asuras slain, the powerful Kālanemi,

1.3.s:
triśūlenāhanadviṣṇuṃ roṣaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ..
tamāyāṃtaṃ ca jagṛhe mukuṃdo'nāthasaṃśrayaḥ.. 14.4 ..
1.3.d:
त्रिशूलेनाहनद्विष्णुं रोषपर्याकुलेक्षणः..
तमायांतं च जगृहे मुकुंदोऽनाथसंश्रयः.. 14.4 ..
1.3.m: his eyes agitated with anger, struck Viṣṇu with his trident. / Mukunda, the refuge of the helpless, seized him as he approached.

1.3.s:
kareṇa vāmena jaghāna līlayā taṃ kālanemiṃ hyasuraṃ mahābalam..
tenaiva śūlena samāhato'sau mūrcchānvito'sau sahasā papāta.. 14.5 ..
1.3.d:
करेण वामेन जघान लीलया तं कालनेमिं ह्यसुरं महाबलम्..
तेनैव शूलेन समाहतोऽसौ मूर्च्छान्वितोऽसौ सहसा पपात.. 14.5 ..
1.3.m: With his left hand he effortlessly struck that exceedingly strong Asura Kālanemi; / severely struck with that very trident, he fainted and collapsed suddenly.

1.3.s:
patitaḥ punarutthāya śanairunmīlya locane..
purataḥ sthitamālokya viṣṇuṃ sarvaguhāśayam.. 14.6 ..
1.3.d:
पतितः पुनरुत्थाय शनैरुन्मील्य लोचने..
पुरतः स्थितमालोक्य विष्णुं सर्वगुहाशयम्.. 14.6 ..
1.3.m: Having fallen, he rose again, slowly opened his eyes, / and seeing Viṣṇu, who dwells in the secret heart of all, standing before him,

1.3.s:
labdhasaṃjño'bravīdvākyaṃ kālanemirmahābalaḥ..
tava yuddhaṃ na dāsyāmi nāsti loke spṛhā mama.. 14.7 ..
1.3.d:
लब्धसंज्ञोऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं कालनेमिर्महाबलः..
तव युद्धं न दास्यामि नास्ति लोके स्पृहा मम.. 14.7 ..
1.3.m: the exceedingly strong Kālanemi, having regained consciousness, spoke these words: / 'I will not give you battle; I have no desire for the world.

1.3.s:
ye ye'surā hatā yuddhe akṣayaṃ lokamāpnuyuḥ..
brahmaṇo vacanātsadya iṃdreṇa saha saṃgatāḥ.. 14.8 ..
1.3.d:
ये येऽसुरा हता युद्धे अक्षयं लोकमाप्नुयुः..
ब्रह्मणो वचनात्सद्य इंद्रेण सह संगताः.. 14.8 ..
1.3.m: Whichever Asuras are killed in battle attain an imperishable world; / by the word of Brahmā, they instantly unite with Indra.

1.3.s:
bhuṃjato vividhānbhogāndevavadvicaraṃti te..
iṃdreṇa sahitāḥ sarve saṃsāre ca pataṃtyatha.. 14.9 ..
1.3.d:
भुंजतो विविधान्भोगान्देववद्विचरंति ते..
इंद्रेण सहिताः सर्वे संसारे च पतंत्यथ.. 14.9 ..
1.3.m: Enjoying diverse pleasures, they wander about like gods; / but along with Indra, they all fall back into the cycle of worldly existence.

1.3.s:
tasmādyuddhena maraṇaṃ na kāṃkṣe kṣaṇabhaṃguram..
anyajanmani me vīra vairabhāvānna saṃśayaḥ..
dātumarhasi me nātha kaivalyaṃ kevalaṃ param.. 14.10 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्युद्धेन मरणं न कांक्षे क्षणभंगुरम्..
अन्यजन्मनि मे वीर वैरभावान्न संशयः..
दातुमर्हसि मे नाथ कैवल्यं केवलं परम्.. 14.10 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, I do not desire a momentary death through battle; / in another birth, O hero, through the attitude of enmity, without a doubt, / you should grant me, O Lord, only supreme, absolute liberation.'

1.3.s:
tatheti daityapravaro nipātitaḥ pareṇa puṃsā paramārthadena..
dattvā'bhayaṃ devatānāṃ tadānīṃ tathā sudhāṃ devatābhyaḥ pradattvā.. 14.11 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति दैत्यप्रवरो निपातितः परेण पुंसा परमार्थदेन..
दत्त्वाऽभयं देवतानां तदानीं तथा सुधां देवताभ्यः प्रदत्त्वा.. 14.11 ..
1.3.m: Saying “So be it,” the supreme Daitya was struck down by the Supreme Person, the bestower of the ultimate truth, / after giving fearlessness to the gods and then bestowing the nectar upon the gods.

1.3.s:
kālanemirhato daityo devā jātā hyakaṭakāḥ..
śalyarūpo mahānsadyo viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā.. 14.12 ..
1.3.d:
कालनेमिर्हतो दैत्यो देवा जाता ह्यकटकाः..
शल्यरूपो महान्सद्यो विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना.. 14.12 ..
1.3.m: When the Daitya Kālanemi was slain by the all-powerful Viṣṇu, / the gods were freed from their tormentor, who had been a great thorn [in their side].

1.3.s:
tirodhānaṃ gataḥ sadyo bhagavānkamalekṣaṇaḥ..
iṃdro'pi kadanaṃ kṛtvā daityānāṃ paramādbhutam.. 14.13 ..
1.3.d:
तिरोधानं गतः सद्यो भगवान्कमलेक्षणः..
इंद्रोऽपि कदनं कृत्वा दैत्यानां परमाद्भुतम्.. 14.13 ..
1.3.m: Instantly the lotus-eyed Lord vanished. / Indra, too, made a wondrous slaughter of the Daityas;

1.3.s:
patitānāṃ klībarūpāṇāṃ bhagnānāṃ bhītacetasām..
muktakacchaśikhānāṃ ca cakre sa kadanakriyām.. 14.14 ..
1.3.d:
पतितानां क्लीबरूपाणां भग्नानां भीतचेतसाम्..
मुक्तकच्छशिखानां च चक्रे स कदनक्रियाम्.. 14.14 ..
1.3.m: he carried out the slaughter of those who had fallen, turned into cowards, broken, terrified at heart, / and whose lower garments and topknots were disheveled.

1.3.s:
arthaśāstraparo bhūtvā maheṃdro durātikramaḥ..
daityānāṃ kālarūpo'sau śacīpatirudāradhīḥ.. 14.15 ..
1.3.d:
अर्थशास्त्रपरो भूत्वा महेंद्रो दुरातिक्रमः..
दैत्यानां कालरूपोऽसौ शचीपतिरुदारधीः.. 14.15 ..
1.3.m: Devoted to statecraft, unassailable Mahendra, / that noble-minded husband of Śacī, became like Death itself to the Daityas.

1.3.s:
evaṃ nihanymānānāmasurāṇāṃ śacīpateḥ..
nivāraṇārthaṃ bhagavānāgato nāradastadā.. 14.16 ..
1.3.d:
एवं निहन्य्मानानामसुराणां शचीपतेः..
निवारणार्थं भगवानागतो नारदस्तदा.. 14.16 ..
1.3.m: As the Asuras were being slain in this manner, / the lordly Nārada then arrived to stop the husband of Śacī.

1.3.s:
.. nārada uvāca..
yuddhahatāśca ye vīrā hyasurā raṇamaṇḍale..
teṣāmanu kathaṃ kartā bhītānāṃ ca vihiṃsanam.. 14.17 ..
1.3.d:
.. नारद उवाच..
युद्धहताश्च ये वीरा ह्यसुरा रणमण्डले..
तेषामनु कथं कर्ता भीतानां च विहिंसनम्.. 14.17 ..
1.3.m: Nārada said: / The heroic Asuras were slain in battle on the field of war; / why then do you cause the slaughter of those terrified survivors?

1.3.s:
ye bhītāṃśca prapannāṃścaghātayaṃti madoddhatāḥ..
brahmaghnāste'pi vijñeyā mahāpātakasaṃyutāḥ.. 14.18 ..
1.3.d:
ये भीतांश्च प्रपन्नांश्चघातयंति मदोद्धताः..
ब्रह्मघ्नास्तेऽपि विज्ञेया महापातकसंयुताः.. 14.18 ..
1.3.m: Those who, puffed up with arrogance, kill the terrified and the surrendered, / are to be known as slayers of brahmins, stained with the greatest sins.

1.3.s:
tasmāttvayā na karttavyaṃ manasāpi vihiṃsanam..
evamuktastadā śakro nāradena mahātmanā.. 14.19 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्त्वया न कर्त्तव्यं मनसापि विहिंसनम्..
एवमुक्तस्तदा शक्रो नारदेन महात्मना.. 14.19 ..
1.3.m: Therefore you must not commit slaughter, even in your mind! / Addressed thus by the high-souled Nārada,

1.3.s:
surasenānvitaḥ sadya āgato hi triviṣṭapam..
tadā sarve suragaṇāḥ suhṛdbhyaśca parasparam..
babhūvurmuditāḥ sarve yakṣagaṃdharvakiṃnarāḥ.. 14.20 ..
1.3.d:
सुरसेनान्वितः सद्य आगतो हि त्रिविष्टपम्..
तदा सर्वे सुरगणाः सुहृद्भ्यश्च परस्परम्..
बभूवुर्मुदिताः सर्वे यक्षगंधर्वकिंनराः.. 14.20 ..
1.3.m: Śakra, accompanied by the army of the gods, went at once to heaven. / Then all the hosts of gods, Yakṣas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras / rejoiced mutually with their friends.

1.3.s: tadā iṃdro'marāvatyāṃ hasa śacyā'bhiṣecitaḥ.. 14.21 ..
1.3.d: तदा इंद्रोऽमरावत्यां हस शच्याऽभिषेचितः.. 14.21 ..
1.3.m: Then Indra was joyfully anointed in Amarāvatī alongside Śacī

1.3.s:
devarṣipramukhaiścaiva brahmarṣipramukhaistathā..
śakro'pi vijayaṃ prāptaḥ prasādācchaṃkarasya ca.. 14.22 ..
1.3.d:
देवर्षिप्रमुखैश्चैव ब्रह्मर्षिप्रमुखैस्तथा..
शक्रोऽपि विजयं प्राप्तः प्रसादाच्छंकरस्य च.. 14.22 ..
1.3.m: by the foremost celestial seers and the foremost brāhmaṇa seers; / and Śakra attained victory through the grace of Śaṃkara.

1.3.s:
tadā mahotsavo viprā devaloke mahānabhūt..
śaṃkhāśca paṭahāścaiva mṛdaṃgā murajā api..
tathānakāśca bheryaśca nedurduṃdubhayaḥ samam.. 14.23 ..
1.3.d:
तदा महोत्सवो विप्रा देवलोके महानभूत्..
शंखाश्च पटहाश्चैव मृदंगा मुरजा अपि..
तथानकाश्च भेर्यश्च नेदुर्दुंदुभयः समम्.. 14.23 ..
1.3.m: Then, O brahmins, a great festival took place in the realm of the gods: / conches, paṭahas, mṛdaṅgas, and murajas, / as well as ānakas, bherīs, and kettledrums sounded together.

1.3.s:
gāyakāścaiva gaṃdharvāḥ kinnarāścāpsapogaṇāḥ..
nanṛturjagustuṣṭuvuśca siddhacāraṇaguhyakāḥ.. 14.24 ..
1.3.d:
गायकाश्चैव गंधर्वाः किन्नराश्चाप्सपोगणाः..
ननृतुर्जगुस्तुष्टुवुश्च सिद्धचारणगुह्यकाः.. 14.24 ..
