1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Then, seeing him gone to dissolution, all the hosts of gods / pondered: 'And how shall we proceed?' 17.1

1.3.s:
surabhiṃ cāhvayitvātha tadovāca śacīpatiḥ..
kalevaraṃ dadhīcasya lihyāstvaṃ vacanānmama.. 17.2 ..
1.3.d:
सुरभिं चाह्वयित्वाथ तदोवाच शचीपतिः..
कलेवरं दधीचस्य लिह्यास्त्वं वचनान्मम.. 17.2 ..
1.3.m: Then, having summoned Surabhi, Śacī's husband [Indra] said: / 'Lick the body of Dadhīci at my command.' 17.2

1.3.s:
tatheti ca vacomatvā tatkṣaṇādeva lihya tat..
nirmāṃsaṃ ca kṛtaṃ sadyastayā dhenvā kalevaram.. 17.3 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति च वचोमत्वा तत्क्षणादेव लिह्य तत्..
निर्मांसं च कृतं सद्यस्तया धेन्वा कलेवरम्.. 17.3 ..
1.3.m: And thinking, 'So be it,' at that very moment, that body / was immediately licked and made fleshless by that cow. 17.3

1.3.s:
jagṛhustāni cāsthīni cakruḥ śastrāṇi vai surāḥ..
tasya vaṃśodbhavaṃ vajraṃ śiro brahmaśirastathā.. 17.4 ..
1.3.d:
जगृहुस्तानि चास्थीनि चक्रुः शस्त्राणि वै सुराः..
तस्य वंशोद्भवं वज्रं शिरो ब्रह्मशिरस्तथा.. 17.4 ..
1.3.m: The gods took those bones and fashioned weapons: / the vajra arose from his backbone, and his skull [became] the Brahmaśiras weapon. 17.4

1.3.s:
anyāni cāsthīni bahūni tasya ṛṣestadānīṃ jagṛhuḥ surāśca..
tathā śirājālamayāṃśca pāśāṃścakruḥ surā vairayutāśca daityān.. 17.5 ..
1.3.d:
अन्यानि चास्थीनि बहूनि तस्य ऋषेस्तदानीं जगृहुः सुराश्च..
तथा शिराजालमयांश्च पाशांश्चक्रुः सुरा वैरयुताश्च दैत्यान्.. 17.5 ..
1.3.m: And the gods then took many other bones of that seer; / and the gods, filled with hostility towards the daityas, made nooses of his network of veins. 17.5

1.3.s:
śastrāṇi kṛtvā te sarve mahābalaparākramāḥ..
yayurdevātastvarāyuktā vṛtraghātanatatparāḥ.. 17.6 ..
1.3.d:
शस्त्राणि कृत्वा ते सर्वे महाबलपराक्रमाः..
ययुर्देवातस्त्वरायुक्ता वृत्रघातनतत्पराः.. 17.6 ..
1.3.m: Having fashioned the weapons, all those gods of great strength and valor / departed in haste, intent upon slaying Vṛtra. 17.6

1.3.s:
tataḥ suvarccāśca dadhīcipatnī yā preṣitā sā surakāryasiddhaye..
vyalokayattatra sametya sarvaṃ mṛtaṃ patiṃ dehamatho dadarśatam.. 17.7 ..
1.3.d:
ततः सुवर्च्चाश्च दधीचिपत्नी या प्रेषिता सा सुरकार्यसिद्धये..
व्यलोकयत्तत्र समेत्य सर्वं मृतं पतिं देहमथो ददर्शतम्.. 17.7 ..
1.3.m: Then Suvarcas, the wife of Dadhīci who had been sent away so the gods' work might succeed, / returned, beheld everything there, and then saw her dead husband's body. 17.7

1.3.s:
jñātvā ca tatsarvamidaṃ surāṇāṃ kṛtyaṃ tadānīṃ ca cukopa sādhvī..
dadau satī śāpamatīva ruṣṭā tadā suvarcā ṛṣivaryapatnī.. 17.8 ..
1.3.d:
ज्ञात्वा च तत्सर्वमिदं सुराणां कृत्यं तदानीं च चुकोप साध्वी..
ददौ सती शापमतीव रुष्टा तदा सुवर्चा ऋषिवर्यपत्नी.. 17.8 ..
1.3.m: And learning all this act of the gods, the virtuous woman then became enraged; / extremely wrathful, that chaste woman, the wife of the best of seers, Suvarcas, then uttered a curse: 17.8

1.3.s:
aho surā duṣṭatarāśca sarve sarve hyaśaktāśca tathaiva lubdhāḥ..
tasmācca sarve'prajaso bhavaṃtu divaukaso'dyaprabhṛtityuvāca sā.. 17.9 ..
1.3.d:
अहो सुरा दुष्टतराश्च सर्वे सर्वे ह्यशक्ताश्च तथैव लुब्धाः..
तस्माच्च सर्वेऽप्रजसो भवंतु दिवौकसोऽद्यप्रभृतित्युवाच सा.. 17.9 ..
1.3.m: 'Ah, all the gods are most wicked, and all are powerless and greedy; / therefore, let all the sky-dwellers be childless from this day forth!' she said. 17.9

1.3.s:
eva śāpaṃ dadau teṣāṃ surāṇāṃ sā tapasvinī..
pravīśyāśvatthamūle sā svodaraṃ dārayattadā.. 17.10 ..
1.3.d:
एव शापं ददौ तेषां सुराणां सा तपस्विनी..
प्रवीश्याश्वत्थमूले सा स्वोदरं दारयत्तदा.. 17.10 ..
1.3.m: Having thus given a curse to those gods, that ascetic woman / went to the base of a sacred fig tree and then tore open her own womb. 17.10

1.3.s:
nirgato jaṭharādgarbho dadhīcasya mahātmanaḥ..
sākṣādrudrāvatāro'sau piplādo mahāprabhaḥ.. 17.11 ..
1.3.d:
निर्गतो जठराद्गर्भो दधीचस्य महात्मनः..
साक्षाद्रुद्रावतारोऽसौ पिप्लादो महाप्रभः.. 17.11 ..
1.3.m: From her belly came forth the embryo of the noble Dadhīci, / Pippalāda of great splendor, a direct incarnation of Rudra. 17.11

1.3.s:
prahasya jananī garbhamuvāca ruṣitekṣaṇā..
suvarcā taṃ pippalādaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhāsya sannidhau.. 17.12 ..
1.3.d:
प्रहस्य जननी गर्भमुवाच रुषितेक्षणा..
सुवर्चा तं पिप्पलादं चिरं तिष्ठास्य सन्निधौ.. 17.12 ..
1.3.m: Smiling, the mother, with furious eyes, said to that embryo, / to Pippalāda: 'Suvarcas [says]: Stay long in the proximity of this 17.12

1.3.s:
aśvatthasya mahābhāga sarveṣāṃ saphalo bhaveḥ..
tathaiva bhāṣamāṇā sā suvarcā tanayaṃ prati..
patimanvagamatsādhvī parameṇa samādhinā.. 17.13 ..
1.3.d:
अश्वत्थस्य महाभाग सर्वेषां सफलो भवेः..
तथैव भाषमाणा सा सुवर्चा तनयं प्रति..
पतिमन्वगमत्साध्वी परमेण समाधिना.. 17.13 ..
1.3.m: sacred fig tree, O fortunate one! May you be fruitful for all!' / Speaking thus to her son, / that virtuous woman followed her husband through supreme samādhi. 17.13

1.3.s: evaṃ dadhīcapatnī sā patinā svargamāvrajat.. 17.14 ..
1.3.d: एवं दधीचपत्नी सा पतिना स्वर्गमाव्रजत्.. 17.14 ..
1.3.m: Thus that wife of Dadhīci went to heaven with her husband. 17.14

1.3.s:
te devāḥ kṛtaśastrāstrā daityānprati samutsukāḥ..
ājagmuśceṃdramukhyāste mahābalaparākramāḥ.. 17.15 ..
1.3.d:
ते देवाः कृतशस्त्रास्त्रा दैत्यान्प्रति समुत्सुकाः..
आजग्मुश्चेंद्रमुख्यास्ते महाबलपराक्रमाः.. 17.15 ..
1.3.m: Those gods, having fashioned their weapons and missiles, eager against the daityas, / came forth, headed by Indra, possessing great strength and valor. 17.15

1.3.s:
guruṃ puraskṛtya tadājñayā te gaṇāḥ surāṇāṃ bahavastadānīm..
bhuvaṃ samāgatya ca madhyadeśamūcuśca sarve paramāstrayuktāḥ.. 17.16 ..
1.3.d:
गुरुं पुरस्कृत्य तदाज्ञया ते गणाः सुराणां बहवस्तदानीम्..
भुवं समागत्य च मध्यदेशमूचुश्च सर्वे परमास्त्रयुक्ताः.. 17.16 ..
1.3.m: Placing their Guru at their head, by his order, those many hosts of gods / then came down to the earth, to the middle region, and, equipped with supreme weapons, all shouted. 17.16

1.3.s:
samāgatānupasṛtya devāṃśceṃdrapurogamān..
yayau vṛtro mahādaityo daityavṛndasamāvṛtaḥ.. 17.17 ..
1.3.d:
समागतानुपसृत्य देवांश्चेंद्रपुरोगमान्..
ययौ वृत्रो महादैत्यो दैत्यवृन्दसमावृतः.. 17.17 ..
1.3.m: Advancing toward the gods who had assembled with Indra at their head, / the great daitya Vṛtra marched out, surrounded by a multitude of daityas. 17.17

1.3.s:
yathā merośca śikharaṃ paripūrṇaṃ pradṛśyate..
tathā so'pi mahātejā viśvakarmmasuto mahān.. 17.18 ..
1.3.d:
यथा मेरोश्च शिखरं परिपूर्णं प्रदृश्यते..
तथा सोऽपि महातेजा विश्वकर्म्मसुतो महान्.. 17.18 ..
1.3.m: Just as the summit of Mount Meru is seen fully filled, / so appeared that great one of immense radiance, the son of Viśvakarman. 17.18

1.3.s:
tena dṛṣṭo mahendraśca maheṃdreṇa mahāsuraḥ..
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca darśanaṃ ca mahādbhutam.. 17.19 ..
1.3.d:
तेन दृष्टो महेन्द्रश्च महेंद्रेण महासुरः..
देवानां दानवानां च दर्शनं च महाद्भुतम्.. 17.19 ..
1.3.m: Great Indra saw him, and the great Asura saw great Indra; / and wondrous indeed was the confrontation of the gods and the Dānavas.

1.3.s:
tadā te baddhavairāśca devadaityāḥ parasparam..
anyonyamabhisaṃrabdhā jagarjuḥ paramādbhutam.. 17.20 ..
1.3.d:
तदा ते बद्धवैराश्च देवदैत्याः परस्परम्..
अन्योन्यमभिसंरब्धा जगर्जुः परमाद्भुतम्.. 17.20 ..
1.3.m: Then, harboring deep enmity toward each other, the gods and Daityas, / furiously enraged against one another, roared most wondrously.

1.3.s:
vāditrāṇi ca bhīmāni vādyamānāni sarvaśaḥ..
śrūyaṃte'tra gabhīrāṇi surā surasamāgame.. 17.21 ..
1.3.d:
वादित्राणि च भीमानि वाद्यमानानि सर्वशः..
श्रूयंतेऽत्र गभीराणि सुरा सुरसमागमे.. 17.21 ..
1.3.m: Frightful instruments of music were sounded on all sides; / deep notes were heard here at the clashing of gods and Asuras.

1.3.s:
vādyamāneṣu tūryeṣu te sarve tvarayānvitāḥ..
anekaiḥ śastrasaṃghātairjaghnuranyonyamojasā.. 17.22 ..
1.3.d:
वाद्यमानेषु तूर्येषु ते सर्वे त्वरयान्विताः..
अनेकैः शस्त्रसंघातैर्जघ्नुरन्योन्यमोजसा.. 17.22 ..
1.3.m: As the war drums were sounded, all of them, seized with haste, / struck one another with vigor using showers of various weapons.

1.3.s:
tadā devāsure yuddhe trailokyaṃ sacarācaram..
bhayena mahatā yuktaṃ babhūva gatacetanam.. 17.23 ..
1.3.d:
तदा देवासुरे युद्धे त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्..
भयेन महता युक्तं बभूव गतचेतनम्.. 17.23 ..
1.3.m: Then, in that battle between gods and Asuras, the three worlds with all that moves and is still / were seized with great terror and became lifeless.

1.3.s:
cheditāḥ sphoṭitāścaiva kecicchastrairdvidhā kṛtāḥ..
nārācaiśca tathā kecicchastrāstraiḥ śakalīkṛtāḥ.. 17.24 ..
1.3.d:
छेदिताः स्फोटिताश्चैव केचिच्छस्त्रैर्द्विधा कृताः..
नाराचैश्च तथा केचिच्छस्त्रास्त्रैः शकलीकृताः.. 17.24 ..
1.3.m: Some were cut down and split open, others cleft in two by weapons; / some were struck by iron arrows, and shattered to pieces by weapons and missiles.

1.3.s:
bhallaiścerurhatāḥ kecidvyaṃgabhūtā divaukasaḥ..
raśmayo meghasaṃbhūtāḥ prakāśaṃte nabhassviva.. 17.25 ..
1.3.d:
भल्लैश्चेरुर्हताः केचिद्व्यंगभूता दिवौकसः..
रश्मयो मेघसंभूताः प्रकाशंते नभस्स्विव.. 17.25 ..
1.3.m: Mutilated, some gods fell slain by spearheads; / weapons flashed in the sky like lightning rays born of clouds.

1.3.s:
śirāṃsi patitānyeva bahūnica nabhastalāt..
nakṣatrāṇīva ca yathā mahāpralayasaṃkulam.. 17.26 ..
1.3.d:
शिरांसि पतितान्येव बहूनिच नभस्तलात्..
नक्षत्राणीव च यथा महाप्रलयसंकुलम्.. 17.26 ..
1.3.m: Countless heads fell down from the expanse of the sky, / like stars tumbling down, turbulent as during the great dissolution.

1.3.s:
pravartitaṃ madhyadeśe sarvabūtakṣayāvaham..
śakreṇa saha saṃgrāmaṃ cakāra namucistadā.. 17.27 ..
1.3.d:
प्रवर्तितं मध्यदेशे सर्वबूतक्षयावहम्..
शक्रेण सह संग्रामं चकार नमुचिस्तदा.. 17.27 ..
1.3.m: In the midst [of the battle] was waged a conflict bringing destruction to all beings; / then Namuci fought a battle with Śakra.

1.3.s:
vajreṇa jaghne tarasā namuciṃ devarāṭ svayam..
na romaikaṃ ca trucitaṃ tamucerasurasya ca.. 17.28 ..
1.3.d:
वज्रेण जघ्ने तरसा नमुचिं देवराट् स्वयम्..
न रोमैकं च त्रुचितं तमुचेरसुरस्य च.. 17.28 ..
1.3.m: The king of the gods himself struck Namuci with his thunderbolt with great speed; / yet not a single hair of the Asura Namuci was broken.

1.3.s:
vajreṇāpi tadā sarve vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ..
asurāśca surāścaiva maheṃdro vrīḍitastadā.. 17.29 ..
1.3.d:
वज्रेणापि तदा सर्वे विस्मयं परमं गताः..
असुराश्च सुराश्चैव महेंद्रो व्रीडितस्तदा.. 17.29 ..
1.3.m: At [the failure of] the thunderbolt itself, all the Asuras and gods / were seized with utmost astonishment, and great Indra was put to shame.

1.3.s:
gadayā namuciṃ jaghne gadā sāpi vicūrṇitā..
namuceraṃgalagnāpi papāta vasudhātale.. 17.30 ..
1.3.d:
गदया नमुचिं जघ्ने गदा सापि विचूर्णिता..
नमुचेरंगलग्नापि पपात वसुधातले.. 17.30 ..
1.3.m: He struck Namuci with a mace, but that mace too was shattered into dust; / though it struck Namuci's body, it fell down upon the surface of the earth.

1.3.s:
tathā śūlena mahatā taṃ jaghāna puraṃdaraḥ..
tacchūlaṃ śatadhā cūrṇaṃ namuceraṃgamāśritam.. 17.31 ..
1.3.d:
तथा शूलेन महता तं जघान पुरंदरः..
तच्छूलं शतधा चूर्णं नमुचेरंगमाश्रितम्.. 17.31 ..
1.3.m: Then Puraṃdara struck him with a great trident; / hitting Namuci's body, that trident was smashed into a hundred pieces.

1.3.s:
evaṃ taṃ vavidhaiḥ śastrairājaghāna surārihā..
prahasya māno namucirna jaghāna puraṃdaram.. 17.32 ..
1.3.d:
एवं तं वविधैः शस्त्रैराजघान सुरारिहा..
प्रहस्य मानो नमुचिर्न जघान पुरंदरम्.. 17.32 ..
1.3.m: Thus the slayer of the foes of the gods struck him with diverse weapons; / laughing in mockery, Namuci did not [even] strike back at Puraṃdara.

1.3.s:
tūṣṇīṃbhūtastadā ceṃdraściṃtayā parayā yutaḥ..
kiṃ kāryaṃ kimakāryaṃ vā itīṃdro nāvidattadā.. 17.33 ..
1.3.d:
तूष्णींभूतस्तदा चेंद्रश्चिंतया परया युतः..
किं कार्यं किमकार्यं वा इतींद्रो नाविदत्तदा.. 17.33 ..
1.3.m: Then Indra fell silent, filled with deep anxiety; / Indra did not know what was to be done or what was not to be done.

1.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare tatra mahāyuddhe mahābhaye..
jātā nabhogatā vāṇī iṃdrasuddiśya satvaram.. 17.34 ..
1.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र महायुद्धे महाभये..
जाता नभोगता वाणी इंद्रसुद्दिश्य सत्वरम्.. 17.34 ..
1.3.m: At that moment, in that great, terrifying battle, / a voice from the sky arose, quickly addressing Indra:

1.3.s:
jahyenamadyāśu maheṃdra daityaṃ divaukasāṃ ghorataraṃ bhayāvaham..
phenena caivāśu mahāsurendramapāṃ samīpena durāsadena.. 17.35 ..
1.3.d:
जह्येनमद्याशु महेंद्र दैत्यं दिवौकसां घोरतरं भयावहम्..
फेनेन चैवाशु महासुरेन्द्रमपां समीपेन दुरासदेन.. 17.35 ..
1.3.m: "Slay this Daitya today, O great Indra, who brings terrifying dread to the gods; / quickly [slay] the great lord of Asuras using foam, by the waters, invincible though he be.

1.3.s:
anyena śastreṇa ca āhato'sau vadhyaḥ kadācinna bhavatyayaṃ tu..
tasmācca deveśa vadhārthamasya kuru prayatnaṃ namucerdurātmanaḥ.. 17.36 ..
1.3.d:
अन्येन शस्त्रेण च आहतोऽसौ वध्यः कदाचिन्न भवत्ययं तु..
तस्माच्च देवेश वधार्थमस्य कुरु प्रयत्नं नमुचेर्दुरात्मनः.. 17.36 ..
1.3.m: Even when struck by any other weapon, he can never be killed; / therefore, O lord of the gods, make an effort to slay this evil-minded Namuci."

1.3.s:
niśamya vācaṃ paramārthayuktāṃ daivīṃ sadānaṃdakarīṃ śubhāvahām..
cakre paraṃ yatnavatāṃ variṣṭho gatvodadheḥ pāramanaṃtavīryaḥ.. 17.37 ..
1.3.d:
निशम्य वाचं परमार्थयुक्तां दैवीं सदानंदकरीं शुभावहाम्..
चक्रे परं यत्नवतां वरिष्ठो गत्वोदधेः पारमनंतवीर्यः.. 17.37 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that divine voice fraught with supreme truth, ever joyful and auspicious, / the foremost among the resolute, endowed with infinite vigor, went to the shore of the ocean and made a supreme effort.

1.3.s:
tatrāgataṃ samīkṣyātha namuciḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ..
hatvā śūlena deveṃdraṃ prahasannidamabravīt.. 17.38 ..
1.3.d:
तत्रागतं समीक्ष्याथ नमुचिः क्रोधमूर्छितः..
हत्वा शूलेन देवेंद्रं प्रहसन्निदमब्रवीत्.. 17.38 ..
1.3.m: Seeing him arrive there, Namuci, faint with fury, / struck the lord of gods with a spear, and laughing, spoke these words:

1.3.s:
samudrasya taṭaḥ kasmātsevitaḥ surasattama..
vihāya raṇabhūmiṃ ca tyaktaśastro'bhavadbhavān.. 17.39 ..
1.3.d:
समुद्रस्य तटः कस्मात्सेवितः सुरसत्तम..
विहाय रणभूमिं च त्यक्तशस्त्रोऽभवद्भवान्.. 17.39 ..
1.3.m: "Why have you taken refuge on the ocean shore, O best of the gods, / abandoning the battlefield, and dropping your weapons?

1.3.s: tvadīyenaiva vajreṇa kiṃ kṛtaṃ mama durmate.. 17.40 ..
1.3.d: त्वदीयेनैव वज्रेण किं कृतं मम दुर्मते.. 17.40 ..
1.3.m: What did your own thunderbolt do [to me], O dull-witted one?

1.3.s:
tathānyāni ca śastrāṇi astrāṇi subahūni ca..
gṛhītāni purā maṃda haṃtuṃ māmeva cādhunā.. 17.41 ..
1.3.d:
तथान्यानि च शस्त्राणि अस्त्राणि सुबहूनि च..
गृहीतानि पुरा मंद हंतुं मामेव चाधुना.. 17.41 ..
1.3.m: So many other weapons and missiles were taken up by you before, O fool, / to slay me now!

1.3.s:
kiṃ kariṣyasi māṃ haṃtuṃ yuddhāya samupasthitaḥ..
kena śastreṇa re maṃda yoddhumicchasi saṃyuge.. 17.42 ..
1.3.d:
किं करिष्यसि मां हंतुं युद्धाय समुपस्थितः..
केन शस्त्रेण रे मंद योद्धुमिच्छसि संयुगे.. 17.42 ..
1.3.m: Standing ready for battle, what will you do to slay me? / With what weapon, O fool, do you wish to fight in combat?

1.3.s:
tvāṃ gātayāmi cādyaiva yadi tiṣṭhasi saṃyuge..
no cedgaccha mayā muktaściraṃ jīva sukhī bhava.. 17.43 ..
1.3.d:
त्वां गातयामि चाद्यैव यदि तिष्ठसि संयुगे..
नो चेद्गच्छ मया मुक्तश्चिरं जीव सुखी भव.. 17.43 ..
1.3.m: I will cause you to be slain this very day if you stand in battle; / if not, go! Released by me, live long and be happy."

1.3.s:
evaṃ sa garvitaṃ tasya vākyamāhavaśobhinaḥ..
śrutvā maheṃdro'pi ruṣā jagṛhe phenamadbhutam.. 17.44 ..
1.3.d:
एवं स गर्वितं तस्य वाक्यमाहवशोभिनः..
श्रुत्वा महेंद्रोऽपि रुषा जगृहे फेनमद्भुतम्.. 17.44 ..
1.3.m: Hearing this arrogant speech of the demon who shone in combat, / great Indra, provoked to wrath, took hold of the wondrous foam.

1.3.s: phenaṃ karasthaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu asurā jahasustadā.. 17.45 ..
1.3.d: फेनं करस्थं दृष्ट्वा तु असुरा जहसुस्तदा.. 17.45 ..
1.3.m: Seeing the foam in his hand, the Asuras then burst into laughter:

1.3.s:
kṣayaṃ gatāni cāstrāṇi penenaiva puraṃdaraḥ..
haṃtumicchati māmadya śatakraturudāradhīḥ.. 17.46 ..
1.3.d:
क्षयं गतानि चास्त्राणि पेनेनैव पुरंदरः..
हंतुमिच्छति मामद्य शतक्रतुरुदारधीः.. 17.46 ..
1.3.m: "His weapons have met their end, and Puraṃdara, / the noble-minded Śatakratu, wishes to kill me today with foam alone!"

1.3.s:
evaṃ prahasya namucirajñāya puraṃdaram..
sāvajñaṃ puratastasthau namucirdaityapuṃgavaḥ.. 17.47 ..
1.3.d:
एवं प्रहस्य नमुचिरज्ञाय पुरंदरम्..
सावज्ञं पुरतस्तस्थौ नमुचिर्दैत्यपुंगवः.. 17.47 ..
1.3.m: Laughing thus, not recognizing Puraṃdara's [intent], / Namuci, the bull among the Daityas, stood before him with contempt.

1.3.s: tadaiva taṃ sa phenena śīghramiṃdro jaghāna ha.. 17.48 ..
1.3.d: तदैव तं स फेनेन शीघ्रमिंद्रो जघान ह.. 17.48 ..
1.3.m: Right then, Indra swiftly struck him down with the foam.

1.3.s:
hate tu namucau devāḥ sarve caiva mudānvitāḥ..
sādhusādhviti śabdena ṛṣayaścābhyapūjayan.. 17.49 ..
1.3.d:
हते तु नमुचौ देवाः सर्वे चैव मुदान्विताः..
साधुसाध्विति शब्देन ऋषयश्चाभ्यपूजयन्.. 17.49 ..
1.3.m: When Namuci was slain, all the gods were filled with joy; / and the seers honored him with cries of 'Well done! Well done!'

1.3.s:
tadā sarve jayaṃ prāptā hatvā namucimāhave..
daityāste kopasaṃrabdhā yoddhukāmā mudānvitāḥ.. 17.50 ..
1.3.d:
तदा सर्वे जयं प्राप्ता हत्वा नमुचिमाहवे..
दैत्यास्ते कोपसंरब्धा योद्धुकामा मुदान्विताः.. 17.50 ..
1.3.m: Having slain Namuci in combat, they all attained victory; / but those Daityas, furious with anger and eager to fight, were [yet] resolute.

1.3.s:
punaḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha..
śastrāstrairbahudhā muktaiḥ parasparavadhaiṣibiḥ.. 17.51 ..
1.3.d:
पुनः प्रववृते युद्धं देवानां दानवैः सह..
शस्त्रास्त्रैर्बहुधा मुक्तैः परस्परवधैषिबिः.. 17.51 ..
1.3.m: The battle between the gods and the Dānavas commenced once more, / with various weapons and missiles released by those longing to kill each other.

1.3.s:
yadā te hyasurā devaiḥ pātitāśca punaḥpunaḥ..
tadā vṛtro mahātejāḥ śatakratumupāvrajat.. 17.52 ..
1.3.d:
यदा ते ह्यसुरा देवैः पातिताश्च पुनःपुनः..
तदा वृत्रो महातेजाः शतक्रतुमुपाव्रजत्.. 17.52 ..
1.3.m: When those Asuras were struck down repeatedly by the gods, / then Vṛtra of great splendor advanced toward Śatakratu.

1.3.s:
vṛtraṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā sarve sasurāsuramānavāḥ..
bhayena mahatāviṣṭāḥ patitā bhuvi śerate.. 17.53 ..
1.3.d:
वृत्रं दृष्ट्वा तदा सर्वे ससुरासुरमानवाः..
भयेन महताविष्टाः पतिता भुवि शेरते.. 17.53 ..
1.3.m: Upon seeing Vṛtra, all the gods, Asuras, and mortals / were seized by great terror and lay fallen upon the ground.

1.3.s:
evaṃ bhīteṣu sarveṣu surasiddheṣu vai tadā..
iṃdraścairāvaṇārūḍho vajrapāṇiḥ pratāpavān.. 17.54 ..
1.3.d:
एवं भीतेषु सर्वेषु सुरसिद्धेषु वै तदा..
इंद्रश्चैरावणारूढो वज्रपाणिः प्रतापवान्.. 17.54 ..
1.3.m: When all the gods and Siddhas were thus terrified, / Indra, mounted upon Airāvata, thunderbolt in hand, full of majesty,

1.3.s:
chatreṇa dhriyamāṇena cāmareṇa virājitaḥ..
tadā sarvaiḥ sameto hi lokapālaiḥ pratāpitaḥ.. 17.55 ..
1.3.d:
छत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन चामरेण विराजितः..
तदा सर्वैः समेतो हि लोकपालैः प्रतापितः.. 17.55 ..
1.3.m: splendid with an umbrella held over him and a chowrie, / united with all the world-protectors, was scorched with distress.

1.3.s:
vṛtraṃ vilokya te sarve lokapālā maheśvarāḥ..
bhayabhītāśca te sarve śivaṃ śaraṇamanvayuḥ.. 17.56 ..
1.3.d:
वृत्रं विलोक्य ते सर्वे लोकपाला महेश्वराः..
भयभीताश्च ते सर्वे शिवं शरणमन्वयुः.. 17.56 ..
1.3.m: Seeing Vṛtra, all those world-protectors and mighty lords, / terrified with fear, sought refuge in Śiva.

1.3.s:
manasāciṃtayansarve śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram..
liṃgaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivanmaheṃdro jayakāmukaḥ.. 17.57 ..
1.3.d:
मनसाचिंतयन्सर्वे शंकरं लोकशंकरम्..
लिंगं संपूज्य विधिवन्महेंद्रो जयकामुकः.. 17.57 ..
1.3.m: Mentally they all meditated on Śaṃkara, who brings welfare to the world; / and great Indra, desiring victory, duly worshipped the liṅga.

1.3.s:
guruṇā viditaḥ sadyo viśvāsena pareṇa hi..
uvāca ca tadā śakraṃ bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ.. 17.58 ..
1.3.d:
गुरुणा विदितः सद्यो विश्वासेन परेण हि..
उवाच च तदा शक्रं बृहस्पतिरुदारधीः.. 17.58 ..
1.3.m: Instructed then by his Guru with supreme faith, / the noble-minded Bṛhaspati spoke to Śakra:

1.3.s:
..bṛhaspatiruvāca..
kārtike śuklapakṣe tu maṃdavāre trayodaśī..
samagrā yadi labhyeta sarvaprāptayai na saṃśayaḥ.. 17.59 ..
1.3.d:
..बृहस्पतिरुवाच..
कार्तिके शुक्लपक्षे तु मंदवारे त्रयोदशी..
समग्रा यदि लभ्येत सर्वप्राप्तयै न संशयः.. 17.59 ..
1.3.m: Bṛhaspati said: / "If the thirteenth lunar day in the bright fortnight of the month of Kārtika falls upon a Saturday, / complete [in duration], it brings attainment of everything, no doubt.

1.3.s:
tasyāṃ pradoṣasamaye liṃgarūpī sadāśivaḥ..
pūjanīyo hi deveṃdra sarvakāmārthasiddhaye.. 17.60 ..
1.3.d:
तस्यां प्रदोषसमये लिंगरूपी सदाशिवः..
पूजनीयो हि देवेंद्र सर्वकामार्थसिद्धये.. 17.60 ..
1.3.m: On that day, at the time of dusk (pradoṣa), Sadāśiva in the form of the liṅga / should be worshipped, O lord of the gods, for the fulfillment of all desires and purposes.

1.3.s:
snātvā madhyāhnasamaye tilāmalakasaṃyutam..
śivasya kuryādgaṃdhapuṣpaphalādibhiḥ.. 17.61 ..
1.3.d:
स्नात्वा मध्याह्नसमये तिलामलकसंयुतम्..
शिवस्य कुर्याद्गंधपुष्पफलादिभिः.. 17.61 ..
1.3.m: Having bathed at noon with sesame and myrobalan, / one should perform [worship] of Śiva with fragrances, flowers, fruits, and the like.

1.3.s:
paścātpradoṣavelāyāṃ sthāvaraṃ liṃgamarccayet..
svayaṃbhu sthāpitaṃ cāpi pauruṣeyamapauruṣam.. 17.62 ..
1.3.d:
पश्चात्प्रदोषवेलायां स्थावरं लिंगमर्च्चयेत्..
स्वयंभु स्थापितं चापि पौरुषेयमपौरुषम्.. 17.62 ..
1.3.m: Afterward, at the hour of dusk (pradoṣa), one should worship an immovable liṅga, / whether self-manifest (svayambhu), installed, man-made, or unmade by man.

1.3.s:
jane vā vijane vāpi araṇye vā tapovane..
talliṃgamarccayedbhaktyā pradoṣe tu viśeṣataḥ.. 17.63 ..
1.3.d:
जने वा विजने वापि अरण्ये वा तपोवने..
तल्लिंगमर्च्चयेद्भक्त्या प्रदोषे तु विशेषतः.. 17.63 ..
1.3.m: Whether in an inhabited place or an uninhabited place, in a forest or in a hermitage, / one should worship that liṅga with devotion, especially at dusk (pradoṣa)."

1.3.s:
grāmadbahiḥ sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ grāmācchataguṇaṃ phalam..
brāhmacchataguṇaṃ puṇyamaraṇye liṃgamadbhutam.. 17.64 ..
1.3.d:
ग्रामद्बहिः स्थितं लिंगं ग्रामाच्छतगुणं फलम्..
ब्राह्मच्छतगुणं पुण्यमरण्ये लिंगमद्भुतम्.. 17.64 ..
1.3.m: A liṅga situated outside a village yields a hundredfold the fruit of [one in] a village; / a wondrous liṅga in a forest yields a hundredfold the merit of a brahmin's [liṅga].

1.3.s:
āraṇyācchataguṇaṃ puṇyamarcitaṃ pārvataṃ yathā..
pārvatāccaiva liṃgācca phalaṃ cāyutasaṃjñitam..
tapovanāśritaṃ liṃgaṃ pūjitaṃ vā mahāphalam.. 17.65 ..
1.3.d:
आरण्याच्छतगुणं पुण्यमर्चितं पार्वतं यथा..
पार्वताच्चैव लिंगाच्च फलं चायुतसंज्ञितम्..
तपोवनाश्रितं लिंगं पूजितं वा महाफलम्.. 17.65 ..
1.3.m: Worshipping [a liṅga] on a mountain yields a hundredfold the merit of a forest [liṅga]; / and from a mountain liṅga, the fruit is termed ten thousandfold; / or a liṅga worshipped in a hermitage yields great fruit.

1.3.s:
tasmādetadvibhāgena śivapūjanārcanaṃ budhaiḥ..
kartvayaṃ nipuṇatvena tīrthasnānādikaṃ tathā.. 17.66 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मादेतद्विभागेन शिवपूजनार्चनं बुधैः..
कर्त्वयं निपुणत्वेन तीर्थस्नानादिकं तथा.. 17.66 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, according to this division, the wise must skillfully / perform the worship and adoration of Śiva, and likewise ritual ablution in sacred fords.

1.3.s:
paṃcapiṃḍānsamuddhṛtya snānamātreṇa śobhanam..
kūpe snānaṃ prakurvīta uddhṛtena viseṣataḥ.. 17.67 ..
1.3.d:
पंचपिंडान्समुद्धृत्य स्नानमात्रेण शोभनम्..
कूपे स्नानं प्रकुर्वीत उद्धृतेन विसेषतः.. 17.67 ..
1.3.m: A ritual ablution in a well should be done especially with drawn water, / [which is] splendid merely by bathing after removing five lumps [of earth].

1.3.s:
taḍāge daśa piṃḍāṃśca uddhṛtya snānamācaret..
nadīsnānaṃ viśṣṭaṃ ca mahānadyāṃ viśeṣataḥ.. 17.68 ..
1.3.d:
तडागे दश पिंडांश्च उद्धृत्य स्नानमाचरेत्..
नदीस्नानं विश्ष्टं च महानद्यां विशेषतः.. 17.68 ..
1.3.m: In a pond, one should perform ritual ablution after removing ten lumps [of earth]; / ritual ablution in a river is superior, and especially so in a great river.

1.3.s:
sarveṣāmapi tīrthānāṃ gaṃgāsnānaṃ viśiṣyate..
devakhāte ca tattulyaṃ praśastaṃ snānamācaret.. 17.69 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वेषामपि तीर्थानां गंगास्नानं विशिष्यते..
देवखाते च तत्तुल्यं प्रशस्तं स्नानमाचरेत्.. 17.69 ..
1.3.m: Ritual ablution in the Gaṅgā is distinguished above all sacred fords; / and equal to it is [ablution] in a divine pool; one should perform this praised ritual ablution.

1.3.s:
pradīpānāṃ sahasreṇa dīpanīyaḥ sadāśivaḥ..
tathā dīpaśatenāpi dvātriṃśaddīpamālayā.. 17.70 ..
1.3.d:
प्रदीपानां सहस्रेण दीपनीयः सदाशिवः..
तथा दीपशतेनापि द्वात्रिंशद्दीपमालया.. 17.70 ..
1.3.m: Sadāśiva is to be illuminated with a thousand lamps, / or likewise with a hundred lamps, or with a row of thirty-two lamps.

1.3.s:
ghṛtena dīpayeddīpāñchivasya parituṣṭaye..
tathā phalaiśca dīpaiśca naivedyairgaṃdhadhūpakaiḥ.. 17.71 ..
1.3.d:
घृतेन दीपयेद्दीपाञ्छिवस्य परितुष्टये..
तथा फलैश्च दीपैश्च नैवेद्यैर्गंधधूपकैः.. 17.71 ..
1.3.m: One should light the lamps with ghee for the satisfaction of Śiva, / and likewise with fruits and lamps, food offerings, perfumes, and incenses.

1.3.s:
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirliṃgarūpī sadā śivaḥ..
pūjyaḥ pradoṣavelāyāṃ nṛbhiḥ sarvārthasiddhaye.. 17.72 ..
1.3.d:
उपचारैः षोडशभिर्लिंगरूपी सदा शिवः..
पूज्यः प्रदोषवेलायां नृभिः सर्वार्थसिद्धये.. 17.72 ..
1.3.m: Sadāśiva in the form of a liṅga should be worshipped / at the twilight hour by men with sixteen services to achieve all aims.

1.3.s:
pradakṣiṇaṃ prakurvīta śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tathā..
namaskārānprakurvīta tāvatsaṃkhyānprayatnataḥ.. 17.73 ..
1.3.d:
प्रदक्षिणं प्रकुर्वीत शतमष्टोत्तरं तथा..
नमस्कारान्प्रकुर्वीत तावत्संख्यान्प्रयत्नतः.. 17.73 ..
1.3.m: One should circumambulate one hundred and eight times, / and one should diligently make prostrations of the same number.

1.3.s:
pradakṣiṇanamaskāraiḥ pūjanīyaḥ sadāśivaḥ..
nāmnāṃ śatena rudro'sau stavanīyo yatāvidhi.. 17.74 ..
1.3.d:
प्रदक्षिणनमस्कारैः पूजनीयः सदाशिवः..
नाम्नां शतेन रुद्रोऽसौ स्तवनीयो यताविधि.. 17.74 ..
1.3.m: Sadāśiva should be worshipped with circumambulations and prostrations; / that Rudra is to be praised according to the rules with a hundred names:

1.3.s:
namo rudrāya bhīmāya nīlakaṇṭhāya vedhase..
kaparddhine sureśāya vyomakeśāya vai namaḥ.. 17.75 ..
1.3.d:
नमो रुद्राय भीमाय नीलकण्ठाय वेधसे..
कपर्द्धिने सुरेशाय व्योमकेशाय वै नमः.. 17.75 ..
1.3.m: "Homage to Rudra, to the terrible one, to the blue-throated one, to the creator, / to the matted-haired one, to the lord of gods, indeed homage to the sky-haired one!

1.3.s:
vṛṣadhvajāya somāya nīlakaṇṭhāya vai namaḥ..
digaṃbarāya bhargāya umākāṃtakaparddine.. 17.76 ..
1.3.d:
वृषध्वजाय सोमाय नीलकण्ठाय वै नमः..
दिगंबराय भर्गाय उमाकांतकपर्द्दिने.. 17.76 ..
1.3.m: Homage to the bull-bannered one, to Soma, indeed to the blue-throated one, / to the space-clad one, to the radiant one, to the matted-haired lover of Umā!

1.3.s:
tapomayāya vyāptāya śipiviṣṭāya vai namaḥ..
vyālapriyāya vyālāya vyālānāṃ pataye namaḥ.. 17.77 ..
1.3.d:
तपोमयाय व्याप्ताय शिपिविष्टाय वै नमः..
व्यालप्रियाय व्यालाय व्यालानां पतये नमः.. 17.77 ..
1.3.m: Homage indeed to the one composed of austerity, to the pervasive one, to the one clothed in rays, / homage to the lover of serpents, to the serpent, to the lord of serpents!

1.3.s:
mahīdharāya vyāghrāya paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ..
tripurāṃtakasiṃhāya śārdūlograravāya ca.. 17.78 ..
1.3.d:
महीधराय व्याघ्राय पशूनां पतये नमः..
त्रिपुरांतकसिंहाय शार्दूलोग्ररवाय च.. 17.78 ..
1.3.m: Homage to the supporter of the earth, to the tiger, to the lord of beasts, / to the lion who destroys the three cities, and to the one with the fierce roar of a tiger!

1.3.s:
mīnāya mīnanāthāya siddhāya parameṣṭhine..
kāmāṃtakāya buddhāya buddhīnāṃ pataye namaḥ.. 17.79 ..
1.3.d:
मीनाय मीननाथाय सिद्धाय परमेष्ठिने..
कामांतकाय बुद्धाय बुद्धीनां पतये नमः.. 17.79 ..
1.3.m: Homage to the fish, to the lord of fishes, to the perfected one, to the supreme ruler, / to the destroyer of desire, to the awakened one, to the lord of intellects!

1.3.s:
kapotāya viśiṣṭāya śiṣṭāya paramātmane..
vedāya vedabījāya devaguhyāya vai namaḥ.. 17.80 ..
1.3.d:
कपोताय विशिष्टाय शिष्टाय परमात्मने..
वेदाय वेदबीजाय देवगुह्याय वै नमः.. 17.80 ..
1.3.m: Homage indeed to the dove, to the distinguished one, to the virtuous one, to the supreme self, / to the Veda, to the seed of the Veda, to the secret of the gods!

1.3.s:
dīrghāya dīrghadīrghāya dīrghārghāya mahāya ca..
namo jagatpratiṣṭhāya vyomarūpāya vai namaḥ.. 17.81 ..
1.3.d:
दीर्घाय दीर्घदीर्घाय दीर्घार्घाय महाय च..
नमो जगत्प्रतिष्ठाय व्योमरूपाय वै नमः.. 17.81 ..
1.3.m: To the extensive one, to the vastly extensive one, to the worthy one of great reach, and to the feast, / homage to the foundation of the world, indeed homage to the one whose form is space!

1.3.s:
gajāsuravināśāya hyaṃdhakāsurabhedine..
nīlalohitaśuklāya caṇḍamuṇḍapriyāya ca.. 17.82 ..
1.3.d:
गजासुरविनाशाय ह्यंधकासुरभेदिने..
नीललोहितशुक्लाय चण्डमुण्डप्रियाय च.. 17.82 ..
1.3.m: To the destroyer of the elephant demon, and indeed to the piercer of the demon Andhaka, / to the dark-red and white one, and to the one beloved of Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa!

1.3.s:
bhaktipriyāya devāya jñānajñānāvyayāya ca..
maheśāya namastubhyaṃ mahādevaharāya ca.. 17.83 ..
1.3.d:
भक्तिप्रियाय देवाय ज्ञानज्ञानाव्ययाय च..
महेशाय नमस्तुभ्यं महादेवहराय च.. 17.83 ..
1.3.m: To the god dear to devotion, and to the imperishable knowledge of knowledge, / homage to you, the great lord, and to the destroyer, the Great God!

1.3.s:
trinetrāya trivedāya vedāṃgāya namonamaḥ..
arthāya artharūpāya paramārthāya vai namaḥ.. 17.84 ..
1.3.d:
त्रिनेत्राय त्रिवेदाय वेदांगाय नमोनमः..
अर्थाय अर्थरूपाय परमार्थाय वै नमः.. 17.84 ..
1.3.m: Homage, homage to the three-eyed one, to the three Vedas, to the limb of the Veda; / homage indeed to purpose, to the form of purpose, to the supreme purpose!

1.3.s:
viśvarūpāya viśvāya viśvanātāya vai namaḥ..
śaṃkarāya ca kālāya kālāvayavarūpiṇe.. 17.85 ..
1.3.d:
विश्वरूपाय विश्वाय विश्वनाताय वै नमः..
शंकराय च कालाय कालावयवरूपिणे.. 17.85 ..
1.3.m: Homage indeed to the universal form, to the universe, to the lord of the universe; / and to Śaṃkara, to time, and to the one having the form of parts of time!

1.3.s:
arūpāya ca sūkṣmāya sūkṣmasūkṣmāya vai namaḥ..
śmaśānavāsine tubhyaṃ namaste kṛttivāsase.. 17.86 ..
1.3.d:
अरूपाय च सूक्ष्माय सूक्ष्मसूक्ष्माय वै नमः..
श्मशानवासिने तुभ्यं नमस्ते कृत्तिवाससे.. 17.86 ..
1.3.m: Homage indeed to the formless one, and to the subtle one, to the subtlest of the subtle; / homage to you, the dweller in the cremation ground, homage to you, the skin-clad one!

1.3.s:
śaśāṃkaśekharāyaiva rudraviśvāśrayāya ca..
durgāya durgasārāya durgāvayavasākṣiṇe.. 17.87 ..
1.3.d:
शशांकशेखरायैव रुद्रविश्वाश्रयाय च..
दुर्गाय दुर्गसाराय दुर्गावयवसाक्षिणे.. 17.87 ..
1.3.m: To the one with the crescent moon on his crest, and to Rudra, the refuge of all; / to the fortress, to the essence of the fortress, to the witness of the fortress's limbs!

1.3.s:
liṃgarūpāya liṃgāya liṃgānāṃ pataye namaḥ..
praṇavarūpāya praṇavārthāya vai namaḥ.. 17.88 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगरूपाय लिंगाय लिंगानां पतये नमः..
प्रणवरूपाय प्रणवार्थाय वै नमः.. 17.88 ..
1.3.m: Homage to the one whose form is the liṅga, to the liṅga, to the lord of liṅgas; / homage indeed to the form of the praṇava, to the meaning of the praṇava!

1.3.s:
namonamaḥ kāraṇakāraṇāya te mṛtyuṃjayāyātmabhavasvarūpiṇe..
triyaṃbakāyāsitakaṃṭha bharga gauripate sakalamaṃgalahetave namaḥ.. 17.89 ..
1.3.d:
नमोनमः कारणकारणाय ते मृत्युंजयायात्मभवस्वरूपिणे..
त्रियंबकायासितकंठ भर्ग गौरिपते सकलमंगलहेतवे नमः.. 17.89 ..
1.3.m: Homage, homage to you, the cause of causes, the conqueror of death, whose nature is self-existence! / O three-eyed one, O dark-throated one, O radiant one, O lord of Gaurī, homage to the cause of all auspiciousness!"

1.3.s:
..bṛhaspatiruvāca..
nāmnāṃ śataṃ maheśasya uccāryaṃ vratinā tadā..
pradakṣiṇanamaskārairetatsaṃkhyaiḥ prayatnataḥ..
kāryaṃ pradoṣasamaye tuṣṭyarthaṃ saṃkarasya ca.. 17.90 ..
1.3.d:
..बृहस्पतिरुवाच..
नाम्नां शतं महेशस्य उच्चार्यं व्रतिना तदा..
प्रदक्षिणनमस्कारैरेतत्संख्यैः प्रयत्नतः..
कार्यं प्रदोषसमये तुष्ट्यर्थं संकरस्य च.. 17.90 ..
1.3.m: Bṛhaspati said: / "These hundred names of the great lord should then be recited by one observing the vow; / this should be performed diligently at twilight with the same number of circumambulations and prostrations / for the satisfaction of Śaṃkara.

1.3.s:
evaṃ vrataṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ tava śakra mahāmate..
śīghraṃ kuru mahābhāga paścādyuddhaṃ kuru prabho.. 17.91 ..
1.3.d:
एवं व्रतं समुद्दिष्टं तव शक्र महामते..
शीघ्रं कुरु महाभाग पश्चाद्युद्धं कुरु प्रभो.. 17.91 ..
1.3.m: Thus the vow has been declared to you, O wise Śakra; / perform it quickly, O fortunate one, and then wage war, O lord.

1.3.s: śaṃbhoḥ prasādātsarvaṃ te bhaviṣyati jayādikam.. 17.92 ..
1.3.d: शंभोः प्रसादात्सर्वं ते भविष्यति जयादिकम्.. 17.92 ..
1.3.m: By the grace of Śambhu, everything such as victory will belong to you.

1.3.s:
vṛtro hyayaṃ mahātejā daiteyastapasā purā..
śivaṃ prasādayāmāsa parvate gaṃdhamādane.. 17.93 ..
1.3.d:
वृत्रो ह्ययं महातेजा दैतेयस्तपसा पुरा..
शिवं प्रसादयामास पर्वते गंधमादने.. 17.93 ..
1.3.m: For formerly this Vṛtra, a Daiteya of great splendour, / pleased Śiva by austerity on Mount Gandhamādana.

1.3.s:
nāmnā citraratho rājā vanaṃ citrarathasya tat..
etajjānīhi bho indra śivapuryāḥ samīpataḥ.. 17.94 ..
1.3.d:
नाम्ना चित्ररथो राजा वनं चित्ररथस्य तत्..
एतज्जानीहि भो इन्द्र शिवपुर्याः समीपतः.. 17.94 ..
1.3.m: There was a king named Citraratha; know, O Indra, / that this forest belonging to Citraratha is near the city of Śiva.

1.3.s:
yasminvane mahābhāga na saṃti ca ṣaḍūrmayaḥ..
tasmāccaitrarathaṃ nāma vanaṃ paramamaṃgalam..
tasya rājñaḥ śivenaiva dattaṃ yānaṃ mahādbhutam.. 17.95 ..
1.3.d:
यस्मिन्वने महाभाग न संति च षडूर्मयः..
तस्माच्चैत्ररथं नाम वनं परममंगलम्..
तस्य राज्ञः शिवेनैव दत्तं यानं महाद्भुतम्.. 17.95 ..
1.3.m: In which forest, O fortunate one, the six waves [of existence] do not exist; / therefore it is named Caitraratha, a most auspicious forest. / To that king a wondrous vehicle was given by Śiva himself,

1.3.s:
kāmagaṃ kiṃkiṇīyuktaṃ siddhacāraṇasevitam..
gaṃdharvairapsaroyakṣaiḥ kiṃnarairupaśobhitam.. 17.96 ..
1.3.d:
कामगं किंकिणीयुक्तं सिद्धचारणसेवितम्..
गंधर्वैरप्सरोयक्षैः किंनरैरुपशोभितम्.. 17.96 ..
1.3.m: moving at will, fitted with tinkling bells, served by Siddhas and Cāraṇas, / adorned by Gandharvas, apsarases, Yakṣas, and Kinnaras.

1.3.s:
tatastenaiva yānena pṛthivīṃ paryaṭanpurā..
tathā girīśamukhyāṃśca dvīpāṃśca vividhāṃstathā.. 17.97 ..
1.3.d:
ततस्तेनैव यानेन पृथिवीं पर्यटन्पुरा..
तथा गिरीशमुख्यांश्च द्वीपांश्च विविधांस्तथा.. 17.97 ..
1.3.m: Then, roaming the earth formerly in that very vehicle, / and likewise the chief mountains and various continents,

1.3.s:
ekadā paryaṭanrājā nāmnā citraratho mahān..
kailāsamāgatastatra sa dadarśa parādbhutam.. 17.98 ..
1.3.d:
एकदा पर्यटन्राजा नाम्ना चित्ररथो महान्..
कैलासमागतस्तत्र स ददर्श पराद्भुतम्.. 17.98 ..
1.3.m: once that great king named Citraratha, while roaming, / came to Kailāsa, and there he saw a supreme marvel:

1.3.s:
sabhātalaṃ maheśasya gaṇaiścaiva virājitam..
arddhāgalagnayā devyā śobhitaṃ ca maheśvaram.. 17.99 ..
1.3.d:
सभातलं महेशस्य गणैश्चैव विराजितम्..
अर्द्धागलग्नया देव्या शोभितं च महेश्वरम्.. 17.99 ..
1.3.m: the assembly hall of the great lord, adorned with his attendants, / and the Great Lord embellished by the Goddess clinging to half his body.

1.3.s: nirīkṣya devyā sahitaṃ sadāśivaṃ devyānvitaṃ vākyamidaṃ babhāṣe.. 17.100 ..
1.3.d: निरीक्ष्य देव्या सहितं सदाशिवं देव्यान्वितं वाक्यमिदं बभाषे.. 17.100 ..
1.3.m: Seeing Sadāśiva accompanied by the Goddess, he spoke these words in her presence:

1.3.s:
vayaṃ ca śaṃbho viṣayānvitāśca maṃtryādayaḥ strījitāścāpi cānye..
na lokamadhye vayameva cājñāḥ strīsevanaṃ lajjayā naiva kurmaḥ.. 17.101 ..
1.3.d:
वयं च शंभो विषयान्विताश्च मंत्र्यादयः स्त्रीजिताश्चापि चान्ये..
न लोकमध्ये वयमेव चाज्ञाः स्त्रीसेवनं लज्जया नैव कुर्मः.. 17.101 ..
1.3.m: "We, O Śambhu, are attached to sense-objects, and our ministers and others are also conquered by women, / yet we ignorant ones do not indulge in women in the midst of people out of shame.

1.3.s:
etadvākyaṃ niśamyātha maheśaḥ prahasanniva..
uvāca nyāyasaṃyuktaṃ sarveṣāmapi śrṛṇvatām.. 17.102 ..
1.3.d:
एतद्वाक्यं निशम्याथ महेशः प्रहसन्निव..
उवाच न्यायसंयुक्तं सर्वेषामपि श्रृण्वताम्.. 17.102 ..
1.3.m: Having heard this statement, the great lord, as if smiling, / spoke with reason while all were listening:

1.3.s:
bhayaṃ lokāpavādācca sarveṣāmapi nānyathā..
grāsitaṃ kālakūṭaṃ ca sarveṣāmapi durjaram.. 17.103 ..
1.3.d:
भयं लोकापवादाच्च सर्वेषामपि नान्यथा..
ग्रासितं कालकूटं च सर्वेषामपि दुर्जरम्.. 17.103 ..
1.3.m: 'All have fear of public reproach, and not otherwise; / the kālakūṭa poison, indomitable to all, was swallowed [by me].

1.3.s:
tathāpi upahāso me kṛto rājñā hi durjaraḥ..
taṃ citrarathamāhūya girijā vākyamabravīt.. 17.104 ..
1.3.d:
तथापि उपहासो मे कृतो राज्ञा हि दुर्जरः..
तं चित्ररथमाहूय गिरिजा वाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 17.104 ..
1.3.m: Nevertheless, an insufferable mockery of me has been made by the king.' / Calling that Citraratha, the mountain-born Goddess spoke [these] words:

1.3.s:
..gīrijovāca..
re durātmankathaṃ tvajña śaṃkaraścopahāsitaḥ..
mayā sahaiva maṃdātmandrakṣyase karmaṇaḥ phalam.. 17.105 ..
1.3.d:
..गीरिजोवाच..
रे दुरात्मन्कथं त्वज्ञ शंकरश्चोपहासितः..
मया सहैव मंदात्मन्द्रक्ष्यसे कर्मणः फलम्.. 17.105 ..
1.3.m: Girijā said: / 'O evil-minded one, how have you, an ignorant fool, mocked Śaṃkara / together with me? O dull-witted one, you shall see the fruit of your deed!

1.3.s:
sādhūnāṃ samacittānāmupahāsaṃ karoti yaḥ..
devo vāpyatha vā martyaḥ sa vijñeyo'dhamādhamaḥ.. 17.106 ..
1.3.d:
साधूनां समचित्तानामुपहासं करोति यः..
देवो वाप्यथ वा मर्त्यः स विज्ञेयोऽधमाधमः.. 17.106 ..
1.3.m: Whoever makes a mockery of virtuous ones of equanimous mind, / whether a god or a mortal, is to be known as the lowest of the low.'

1.3.s:
ete munīṃdrāśca mahānubhāvāstathā hyamī ṛṣayo vedagarbhāḥ..
tathaiva sarve sanakādayo hyamī ajñāśca sarve śivamarcayaṃte?.. 17.107 ..
1.3.d:
एते मुनींद्राश्च महानुभावास्तथा ह्यमी ऋषयो वेदगर्भाः..
तथैव सर्वे सनकादयो ह्यमी अज्ञाश्च सर्वे शिवमर्चयंते?.. 17.107 ..
1.3.m: These lords of sages of great majesty, and these seers who bear the Vedas within them, / and likewise all those such as Sanaka—are all these ignorant because they worship Śiva?

1.3.s:
re mūḍha sarveṣu janeṣvabhijñastvameva evādya na cāpare janāḥ..
tasmādabhijñaṃ hi karomi daityaṃ devairdvijaiścāpi bahiṣkṛtaṃ tvām.. 17.108 ..
1.3.d:
रे मूढ सर्वेषु जनेष्वभिज्ञस्त्वमेव एवाद्य न चापरे जनाः..
तस्मादभिज्ञं हि करोमि दैत्यं देवैर्द्विजैश्चापि बहिष्कृतं त्वाम्.. 17.108 ..
1.3.m: Ah, fool! Among all people only you are knowledgeable today, and no others! / Therefore I shall make you a knowledgeable Daitya, cast out by the gods and by the twice-born!

1.3.s:
evaṃ śaptastayā devyā bhavānyā rājasattamaḥ..
rājā citrarathaḥ sadyaḥ papāta sahasā divaḥ.. 17.109 ..
1.3.d:
एवं शप्तस्तया देव्या भवान्या राजसत्तमः..
राजा चित्ररथः सद्यः पपात सहसा दिवः.. 17.109 ..
1.3.m: Having been thus cursed by the goddess Bhavānī, that best of kings, / King Citraratha, immediately fell headlong from heaven.

1.3.s:
āsurīṃ yonimāsādya vṛtronāmnā'bhavattadā..
tapasā parameṇaiva tvaṣṭrā saṃyojitaḥ kramāt.. 17.110 ..
1.3.d:
आसुरीं योनिमासाद्य वृत्रोनाम्नाऽभवत्तदा..
तपसा परमेणैव त्वष्ट्रा संयोजितः क्रमात्.. 17.110 ..
1.3.m: Entering a demonic womb, he then became [the demon] named Vṛtra. / By supreme austerity, he was gradually joined [in purpose] by Tvaṣṭṛ.

1.3.s:
tapasā tena mahatā ajeyo vṛtra ucyata..
tasmācchaṃbhuṃ samabhyarcya pradoṣe vidhinā'dhunā.. 17.111 ..
1.3.d:
तपसा तेन महता अजेयो वृत्र उच्यत..
तस्माच्छंभुं समभ्यर्च्य प्रदोषे विधिनाऽधुना.. 17.111 ..
1.3.m: Because of that great austerity, Vṛtra was called invincible. / Therefore, having properly worshipped Śambhu at dusk now,

1.3.s:
jahi vṛtraṃ mahādaityaṃ devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye..
gurostadvacanaṃ śrutvā uvācātha śatakratuḥ..
sodyāpanavidhiṃ brūhi pradoṣasya ca me'dhunā.. 17.112 ..
1.3.d:
जहि वृत्रं महादैत्यं देवानां कार्यसिद्धये..
गुरोस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा उवाचाथ शतक्रतुः..
सोद्यापनविधिं ब्रूहि प्रदोषस्य च मेऽधुना.. 17.112 ..
1.3.m: slay the great Daitya Vṛtra for the accomplishment of the purpose of the gods!' / Hearing that word of his teacher, Śatakratu said: / 'Tell me now the rule for the closing ceremony of the dusk [observance].'

1.3.s:
..bṛhaspatiruvāca..
kārtike māsi saṃprāpte maṃdavāre trayodaśī..
saṃpūrtistu bhavettatra saṃpūrṇavratasiddhaye.. 17.113 ..
1.3.d:
..बृहस्पतिरुवाच..
कार्तिके मासि संप्राप्ते मंदवारे त्रयोदशी..
संपूर्तिस्तु भवेत्तत्र संपूर्णव्रतसिद्धये.. 17.113 ..
1.3.m: Bṛhaspati said: / 'When the month of Kārtika arrives, on a thirteenth [lunar day] falling on a Saturday, / the completion should be performed there for the perfection of the complete observance.

1.3.s:
vṛṣabho rājataḥ kāryaḥ pṛṣṭhe tasya supīṭhakam..
tasyoparinyaseddevamumākāṃtaṃ trilocanam.. 17.114 ..
1.3.d:
वृषभो राजतः कार्यः पृष्ठे तस्य सुपीठकम्..
तस्योपरिन्यसेद्देवमुमाकांतं त्रिलोचनम्.. 17.114 ..
1.3.m: A bull should be made of silver, with a fine seat upon its back. / Upon it one should place the three-eyed god, beloved of Umā,

1.3.s:
paṃcavaktraṃ daśabhujamarddhāṃge girijāṃ satīm..
evaṃ comāmaheśaṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ.. 17.115 ..
1.3.d:
पंचवक्त्रं दशभुजमर्द्धांगे गिरिजां सतीम्..
एवं चोमामहेशं च सौवर्णं कारयेद्बुधः.. 17.115 ..
1.3.m: five-faced, ten-armed, with the virtuous daughter of the mountain on half his body. / In this way the wise person should cause Umā and Maheśa to be fashioned of gold.

1.3.s:
savṛṣaṃ tāmrapatre ca vastreṇa pariguṃṭhite..
sthāpayitvomayā sārddhaṃ nānābogasamanvitam.. 17.116 ..
1.3.d:
सवृषं ताम्रपत्रे च वस्त्रेण परिगुंठिते..
स्थापयित्वोमया सार्द्धं नानाबोगसमन्वितम्.. 17.116 ..
1.3.m: Having installed them with the bull upon a copper plate veiled with cloth, / together with Umā and accompanied by manifold offerings,

1.3.s:
vidhinā jāgaraṃ kuryādrātrau śraddhāsamanvitaḥ..
paṃcāmṛtena snapanaṃ kāryamādau prayatnataḥ.. 17.117 ..
1.3.d:
विधिना जागरं कुर्याद्रात्रौ श्रद्धासमन्वितः..
पंचामृतेन स्नपनं कार्यमादौ प्रयत्नतः.. 17.117 ..
1.3.m: one should properly keep vigil at night, endowed with faith. / In the beginning, a ceremonial bath should be carefully performed with the five nectars:

1.3.s:
gokṣīrasnānaṃ deveśa gokṣīreṇa mayā kṛtam..
snapanaṃ devadeveśa gṛhāṇa parameśvara.. 17.118 ..
1.3.d:
गोक्षीरस्नानं देवेश गोक्षीरेण मया कृतम्..
स्नपनं देवदेवेश गृहाण परमेश्वर.. 17.118 ..
1.3.m: 'O Lord of gods, a ritual ablution with cow's milk has been performed by me with cow's milk. / Accept the ceremonial bath, O Lord of the gods of gods, O Supreme Lord!

1.3.s:
dadhnā caiva mayā deva snapanaṃ kriyate'dhunā..
gṛhāma ca mayā dattaṃ suprasanno bhavādya vai.. 17.119 ..
1.3.d:
दध्ना चैव मया देव स्नपनं क्रियतेऽधुना..
गृहाम च मया दत्तं सुप्रसन्नो भवाद्य वै.. 17.119 ..
1.3.m: And now, O God, a ceremonial bath is performed by me with curd. / Accept what is given by me, and be very pleased today!

1.3.s:
sarpiṣā ca mayā deva snapanaṃ kriyate'dhunā..
gṛhāṇa śraddhayā dattaṃ tava prītyarthameva ca.. 17.120 ..
1.3.d:
सर्पिषा च मया देव स्नपनं क्रियतेऽधुना..
गृहाण श्रद्धया दत्तं तव प्रीत्यर्थमेव च.. 17.120 ..
1.3.m: And now, O God, a ceremonial bath is performed by me with ghee. / Accept what is given with faith, solely for your pleasure!

1.3.s:
idaṃ madhu mayā dattaṃ tava prītyarthameva ca..
gṛhāma tvaṃ hi deveśa mama śāṃtiprado bhava.. 17.121 ..
1.3.d:
इदं मधु मया दत्तं तव प्रीत्यर्थमेव च..
गृहाम त्वं हि देवेश मम शांतिप्रदो भव.. 17.121 ..
1.3.m: This honey is given by me solely for your pleasure. / Receive it, O Lord of gods, and be the bestower of peace upon me!

1.3.s:
sitayā devadeveśa snapanaṃ kriyate'dhunā..
gṛhāṇa śraddhayā dattāṃ suprasanno bhava prabho.. 17.122 ..
1.3.d:
सितया देवदेवेश स्नपनं क्रियतेऽधुना..
गृहाण श्रद्धया दत्तां सुप्रसन्नो भव प्रभो.. 17.122 ..
1.3.m: Now, O Lord of the gods of gods, a ceremonial bath is performed with white sugar. / Accept what is given with faith, and be very pleased, O Lord!'

1.3.s:
evaṃ paṃcāmṛtenaiva snapanīyo vṛṣadhvajaḥ..
paścādarghyaṃ pradātavyaṃ tāmrapātreṇa dhīmatā..
anenaiva ca maṃtreṇa umākāṃtasya tṛṣṭaye.. 17.123 ..
1.3.d:
एवं पंचामृतेनैव स्नपनीयो वृषध्वजः..
पश्चादर्घ्यं प्रदातव्यं ताम्रपात्रेण धीमता..
अनेनैव च मंत्रेण उमाकांतस्य तृष्टये.. 17.123 ..
1.3.m: Thus the bull-bannered god should be bathed with the five nectars. / Then water for honouring should be offered with a copper vessel by the wise person, / with this very mantra for the satisfaction of Umā's beloved:

1.3.s:
arghyo'si tvamumākāṃta argheṇānena vai prabho..
gṛhāṇa tvaṃ mayā dattaṃ prasanno bhava śaṃkara.. 17.124 ..
1.3.d:
अर्घ्योऽसि त्वमुमाकांत अर्घेणानेन वै प्रभो..
गृहाण त्वं मया दत्तं प्रसन्नो भव शंकर.. 17.124 ..
1.3.m: 'You are worthy of water for honouring, O beloved of Umā! With this water for honouring, O Lord, / accept what has been given by me, and be pleased, O Śaṃkara!

1.3.s:
mayā dattaṃ ca te pādyaṃ puṣpagaṃdhasamanvitam..
gṛhāṇa devadeveśa prasanno varado bhava.. 17.125 ..
1.3.d:
मया दत्तं च ते पाद्यं पुष्पगंधसमन्वितम्..
गृहाण देवदेवेश प्रसन्नो वरदो भव.. 17.125 ..
1.3.m: And foot-washing water accompanied by flowers and fragrances has been given to you by me. / Accept it, O Lord of the gods of gods, and being pleased, be the granter of boons!

1.3.s:
viṣṭaraṃ viṣṭareṇaiva mayā dattaṃ ca vai prabho..
śāṃtyarathaṃ tava deveśa varado bhava me sadā.. 17.126 ..
1.3.d:
विष्टरं विष्टरेणैव मया दत्तं च वै प्रभो..
शांत्यरथं तव देवेश वरदो भव मे सदा.. 17.126 ..
1.3.m: And a seat of sacred grass has been offered by me with a grass mat, O Lord. / For your satisfaction, O Lord of gods, be ever the granter of boons to me!

1.3.s:
ācamanīyaṃ mayā dattaṃ tava viśveśvara prabho..
gṛhāṇa parameśāna tuṣṭo bhava mamādya vai.. 17.127 ..
1.3.d:
आचमनीयं मया दत्तं तव विश्वेश्वर प्रभो..
गृहाण परमेशान तुष्टो भव ममाद्य वै.. 17.127 ..
1.3.m: Sipping water has been given to you by me, O Lord, ruler of the universe. / Accept it, O Supreme Sovereign, and be pleased with me today!

1.3.s:
brahmagranthisamāyuktaṃ brahmakarmapravartakam..
yajñopavītaṃ sauvarṇaṃ mayā dattaṃ tava prabho.. 17.128 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मग्रन्थिसमायुक्तं ब्रह्मकर्मप्रवर्तकम्..
यज्ञोपवीतं सौवर्णं मया दत्तं तव प्रभो.. 17.128 ..
1.3.m: Endowed with the knot of Brahmā, prompting Vedic rites, / a golden sacred thread has been given to you by me, O Lord.

1.3.s:
sugaṃdhaṃ caṃdanaṃ deva mayā dattaṃ ca vai prabho..
bhaktyā para mayā śaṃbho sugaṃdhaṃ kuru māṃ bhava.. 17.129 ..
1.3.d:
सुगंधं चंदनं देव मया दत्तं च वै प्रभो..
भक्त्या पर मया शंभो सुगंधं कुरु मां भव.. 17.129 ..
1.3.m: And fragrant sandalwood, O God, has been given by me, O Lord. / With supreme devotion by me, O Śambhu, make me fragrant, O Bhava!

1.3.s:
dīpaṃ hi paramaṃ śaṃbho ghṛtaprajvalitaṃ mayā..
dattaṃ gṛhāṇa deveśa mama jñānaprado bhava.. 17.130 ..
1.3.d:
दीपं हि परमं शंभो घृतप्रज्वलितं मया..
दत्तं गृहाण देवेश मम ज्ञानप्रदो भव.. 17.130 ..
1.3.m: A supreme lamp, O Śambhu, kindled with ghee, / has been given by me; accept it, O Lord of gods, and be the bestower of knowledge upon me!

1.3.s:
dīpaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ paramaṃ sarvauṣadhivijṛṃbhitam..
gṛhāṇa parameśāna mama śāṃtyarthameva ca.. 17.131 ..
1.3.d:
दीपं विशिष्टं परमं सर्वौषधिविजृंभितम्..
गृहाण परमेशान मम शांत्यर्थमेव च.. 17.131 ..
1.3.m: A supreme, special lamp, blooming with all medicinal herbs, / accept, O Supreme Sovereign, solely for my peace!

1.3.s:
dīpāvaliṃ mayā dattāṃ kṛhāṇa parameśvara..
ārārtikapradānena mama tejaḥ prado bhava.. 17.132 ..
1.3.d:
दीपावलिं मया दत्तां कृहाण परमेश्वर..
आरार्तिकप्रदानेन मम तेजः प्रदो भव.. 17.132 ..
1.3.m: Accept the row of lamps given by me, O Supreme Lord! / By the offering of the waving of lights, be the bestower of splendour upon me!'

1.3.s:
phaladīpādinaivedyatāṃbūlādikrameṇa ca..
pūjanīyo vidhānajñaistasyāṃ rātrau prayatnataḥ.. 17.133 ..
1.3.d:
फलदीपादिनैवेद्यतांबूलादिक्रमेण च..
पूजनीयो विधानज्ञैस्तस्यां रात्रौ प्रयत्नतः.. 17.133 ..
1.3.m: In the order of fruits, lamps, food-offerings, betel, and so on, / he should be worshipped diligently that night by those who know the ritual procedure.

1.3.s:
paścājjāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ gṛhe vā devatālaye..
vitānamaṃḍapaṃ kṛtvā nānāścaryasamanvitam..
gītavāditranṛtyena arcanīyaḥ sadāśivaḥ.. 17.134 ..
1.3.d:
पश्चाज्जागरणं कार्यं गृहे वा देवतालये..
वितानमंडपं कृत्वा नानाश्चर्यसमन्वितम्..
गीतवादित्रनृत्येन अर्चनीयः सदाशिवः.. 17.134 ..
1.3.m: Then a vigil should be kept in the house or in a temple of the deity, / having erected a canopy pavilion adorned with various wonders; / Sadāśiva is to be worshipped with song, musical instruments, and dancing.

1.3.s:
anenaiva vidhānena pradoṣodyāpane vidhiḥ..
kārye vidhimatā śakra sarvakāryārthasiddhaye.. 17.135 ..
1.3.d:
अनेनैव विधानेन प्रदोषोद्यापने विधिः..
कार्ये विधिमता शक्र सर्वकार्यार्थसिद्धये.. 17.135 ..
1.3.m: According to this very procedure, the rule for the closing ceremony of dusk [observance] / must be performed, O Śakra, by one observing the rites, for the accomplishment of all aims.'

1.3.s:
guruṇā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ taccakāra śatakratuḥ..
tenaiva ca sahāyena iṃdro yuddhaparāyaṇaḥ.. 17.136 ..
1.3.d:
गुरुणा कथितं सर्वं तच्चकार शतक्रतुः..
तेनैव च सहायेन इंद्रो युद्धपरायणः.. 17.136 ..
1.3.m: Śatakratu performed everything that had been spoken by his teacher. / With that very assistance, Indra, intent upon battle,

1.3.s:
vṛtraṃ prati suraiḥ sārddhaṃ yuyudhe ca śatakratuḥ..
tumulaṃ yuddhamabhavaddevānāṃ dānāvaiḥ saha.. 17.137 ..
1.3.d:
वृत्रं प्रति सुरैः सार्द्धं युयुधे च शतक्रतुः..
तुमुलं युद्धमभवद्देवानां दानावैः सह.. 17.137 ..
1.3.m: fought against Vṛtra together with the gods. / A tumultuous battle took place between the gods and the Dānavas.

1.3.s:
tasminsutumule gāḍhe devadaityakṣayāvahe..
dvaṃdvayuddhaṃ sutumulamativelaṃ bhayāvaham.. 17.138 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मिन्सुतुमुले गाढे देवदैत्यक्षयावहे..
द्वंद्वयुद्धं सुतुमुलमतिवेलं भयावहम्.. 17.138 ..
1.3.m: In that intense, exceedingly tumultuous [battle] causing the destruction of gods and Daityas, / a fierce single combat occurred, boundlessly dreadful.

1.3.s:
vyomo yamena yuyudhe hyagninā tīkṣṇakopanaḥ..
varuṇena mahādaṃṣṭro vāyunā ca mahābalaḥ.. 17.139 ..
1.3.d:
व्योमो यमेन युयुधे ह्यग्निना तीक्ष्णकोपनः..
वरुणेन महादंष्ट्रो वायुना च महाबलः.. 17.139 ..
1.3.m: Vyoma fought with Yama, and the fiercely wrathful one with Agni; / Mahādaṃṣṭra fought with Varuṇa, and the mighty one with Vāyu.

1.3.s: dvandvayuddha ratāḥ sarve anyonyabalakāṃkṣiṇaḥ.. 17.140 ..
1.3.d: द्वन्द्वयुद्ध रताः सर्वे अन्योन्यबलकांक्षिणः.. 17.140 ..
1.3.m: All were engaged in single combat, seeking to test one another's strength.

1.3.s:
tathaiva te devavarā mahābhujāḥ saṃgrāmaśūrā jayinastadā'bhavan..
parājayaṃ daityavārāśca sarve prāptāstadānīṃ paramaṃ samaṃtāt.. 17.141 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव ते देववरा महाभुजाः संग्रामशूरा जयिनस्तदाऽभवन्..
पराजयं दैत्यवाराश्च सर्वे प्राप्तास्तदानीं परमं समंतात्.. 17.141 ..
1.3.m: Likewise those excellent gods, mighty-armed heroes of battle, were victorious then; / and all the excellent Daityas then met with utter defeat on all sides.

1.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā surairdaityavarānparājitānpalāyamānānatha kāndiśīkān..
tadaiva vṛtraḥ parameṇa manyunā mahābalo vākya midaṃ babhāṣe.. 17.142 ..
1.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा सुरैर्दैत्यवरान्पराजितान्पलायमानानथ कान्दिशीकान्..
तदैव वृत्रः परमेण मन्युना महाबलो वाक्य मिदं बभाषे.. 17.142 ..
1.3.m: Seeing the excellent Daityas defeated by the gods, fleeing and panicked in all directions, / then the mighty Vṛtra spoke this word in supreme wrath:

1.3.s:
..vṛtra uvāca..
he daityāḥ paramārtāśca kasmādyūyaṃ bhayāturāḥ..
palāyanaparāḥ sarve visṛjya raṇamadbhutam.. 17.143 ..
1.3.d:
..वृत्र उवाच..
हे दैत्याः परमार्ताश्च कस्माद्यूयं भयातुराः..
पलायनपराः सर्वे विसृज्य रणमद्भुतम्.. 17.143 ..
1.3.m: Vṛtra said: / 'O Daityas, deeply distressed, why are you stricken with fear / and all intent on fleeing, abandoning the wondrous battle?

1.3.s:
svaṃsvaṃ parākramaṃ vīrā yuddhāya kṛtaniścayāḥ..
darśayadhvaṃ suragaṇāssūdayadhvaṃ mahābalāḥ.. 17.144 ..
1.3.d:
स्वंस्वं पराक्रमं वीरा युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयाः..
दर्शयध्वं सुरगणास्सूदयध्वं महाबलाः.. 17.144 ..
1.3.m: Resolve yourselves on fighting, O heroes, and each show your own valour! / Slaughter the hosts of gods, O mighty ones,

1.3.s:
gadābhiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ śaktitomaramudgaraiḥ..
asibhirbhi dipālaiśca pāśatomaramuṣṭibhiḥ.. 17.145 ..
1.3.d:
गदाभिः पट्टिशैः खड्गैः शक्तितोमरमुद्गरैः..
असिभिर्भि दिपालैश्च पाशतोमरमुष्टिभिः.. 17.145 ..
1.3.m: with clubs, flat-bladed spears, swords, javelins, iron bars, and hammers, / with blades, slings, nooses, spears, and fists!'

1.3.s:
tadā devāśca yuyudhurdadhīcāsthisamudbhavaiḥ..
śastrairastraiśca paramairasurānsamadārayan.. 17.146 ..
1.3.d:
तदा देवाश्च युयुधुर्दधीचास्थिसमुद्भवैः..
शस्त्रैरस्त्रैश्च परमैरसुरान्समदारयन्.. 17.146 ..
1.3.m: Then the gods fought with weapons born from the bones of Dadhīca, / and with supreme missiles they tore the Asuras to pieces.

1.3.s:
punardaityā hatā devaiḥ prāptāstepi parājayam..
punaśca tena vṛtreṇa nodyamānāḥ surānprati.. 17.147 ..
1.3.d:
पुनर्दैत्या हता देवैः प्राप्तास्तेपि पराजयम्..
पुनश्च तेन वृत्रेण नोद्यमानाः सुरान्प्रति.. 17.147 ..
1.3.m: Again the Daityas were struck down by the gods, and they too suffered defeat; / yet once more they were urged against the gods by that Vṛtra.

1.3.s:
yadā hi te daityavarāḥ sureśairnihanyamānāśca vidudruvurdiśaḥ..
keciddṛṣṭvā dānavāste tadānīṃ bhītitrastāḥ klībarūpāḥ krameṇā.. 17.148 ..
1.3.d:
यदा हि ते दैत्यवराः सुरेशैर्निहन्यमानाश्च विदुद्रुवुर्दिशः..
केचिद्दृष्ट्वा दानवास्ते तदानीं भीतित्रस्ताः क्लीबरूपाः क्रमेणा.. 17.148 ..
1.3.m: Indeed, when those foremost Daityas, being struck down by the lords of gods, fled in all directions, / some of those Dānavas, seeing this, were then terrified with fear and gradually became like eunuchs.

1.3.s:
vṛtreṇa kopinā caivaṃ dhikkṛtā daityapuṃgavāḥ..
he pulomanmahābhāga vṛṣaparvannamostu te.. 17.149 ..
1.3.d:
वृत्रेण कोपिना चैवं धिक्कृता दैत्यपुंगवाः..
हे पुलोमन्महाभाग वृषपर्वन्नमोस्तु ते.. 17.149 ..
1.3.m: The foremost Daityas were thus rebuked by the furious Vṛtra: / 'O highly fortunate Puloman, O Vṛṣaparvan, salutation to you!

1.3.s:
he dhūmrākṣa mahākāla mahādaitya vṛkāsura..
sthūlākṣa he mahādaitya sthūladaṃṣṭra namostu te.. 17.150 ..
1.3.d:
हे धूम्राक्ष महाकाल महादैत्य वृकासुर..
स्थूलाक्ष हे महादैत्य स्थूलदंष्ट्र नमोस्तु ते.. 17.150 ..
1.3.m: O Dhūmrākṣa, O Mahākāla, O great Daitya Vṛkāsura! / O Sthūlākṣa, O great Daitya, O Sthūladaṃṣṭra, salutation to you!

1.3.s:
svargadvāraṃ vihāyaiva kṣatriyāṇāṃ manasvinām..
palāyadhve kimarthaṃ vā saṃgrāmāṅgaṇamuttamam.. 17.151 ..
1.3.d:
स्वर्गद्वारं विहायैव क्षत्रियाणां मनस्विनाम्..
पलायध्वे किमर्थं वा संग्रामाङ्गणमुत्तमम्.. 17.151 ..
1.3.m: Abandoning the very gateway to heaven for noble Kṣatriyas, / why do you flee from this supreme battlefield?

1.3.s:
saṃgare maraṇaṃ yeṣāṃ te yāṃti paramaṃ padam..
yatra tatra ca lipseta saṃgrāme maraṇaṃ budhaḥ.. 17.152 ..
1.3.d:
संगरे मरणं येषां ते यांति परमं पदम्..
यत्र तत्र च लिप्सेत संग्रामे मरणं बुधः.. 17.152 ..
1.3.m: Those whose death occurs in battle go to the supreme state; / wherever it may be, a wise man should desire death in battle.

1.3.s: tyajanti saṃgaraṃ ye vai te yāṃti nirayaṃ dhruvam.. 17.153 ..
1.3.d: त्यजन्ति संगरं ये वै ते यांति निरयं ध्रुवम्.. 17.153 ..
1.3.m: Those who abandon battle surely go to hell.

1.3.s:
ye brāhmaṇārthe bhṛtyārthe svārthe vai śastrapāṇayaḥ..
saṃgrāmaṃ ye prakurvaṃti mahāpātakino narāḥ.. 17.154 ..
1.3.d:
ये ब्राह्मणार्थे भृत्यार्थे स्वार्थे वै शस्त्रपाणयः..
संग्रामं ये प्रकुर्वंति महापातकिनो नराः.. 17.154 ..
1.3.m: Men with weapons in hand who wage battle for the sake of brahmins, / for the sake of servants, or for their own sake, even if they are great sinners,

1.3.s:
śastraghātahatā ye vai mṛtā vā saṃgare tathā..
te yāṃti paramaṃ sthānaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 17.155 ..
1.3.d:
शस्त्रघातहता ये वै मृता वा संगरे तथा..
ते यांति परमं स्थानं नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 17.155 ..
1.3.m: if struck down by weapon-blows or dying in battle, / go to the supreme abode; no doubt should be entertained here.

1.3.s:
śastrairvicchinnadehā ye gavārthe svāmikāraṇāt..
raṇe mṛtāḥ kṣatā ye vai te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim.. 17.156 ..
1.3.d:
शस्त्रैर्विच्छिन्नदेहा ये गवार्थे स्वामिकारणात्..
रणे मृताः क्षता ये वै ते यांति परमां गतिम्.. 17.156 ..
1.3.m: Those whose bodies are severed by weapons for the sake of cows or their master's cause, / dying or wounded in battle, go to the supreme goal.

1.3.s:
tasmādraṇe'pi ye śūrāḥ pāpino nihatāḥ puraḥ..
prāpnuvaṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ durlabhaṃ jñānināmapi.. 17.157 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्रणेऽपि ये शूराः पापिनो निहताः पुरः..
प्राप्नुवंति परं स्थानं दुर्लभं ज्ञानिनामपि.. 17.157 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, even sinners who are heroes, slain facing the front in battle, / attain the supreme abode, difficult to obtain even for the wise.

1.3.s:
athavā tīrthagamanaṃ vedādhyayanameva ca..
devatārcanayajñādiśreyāṃsi vividhāni ca.. 17.158 ..
1.3.d:
अथवा तीर्थगमनं वेदाध्ययनमेव च..
देवतार्चनयज्ञादिश्रेयांसि विविधानि च.. 17.158 ..
1.3.m: Or rather, pilgrimage to sacred fords, study of the Vedas, / worship of deities, sacrifices, and various other meritorious deeds—

1.3.s:
aikapadyena tānyeva kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm..
saṃgrāme patitānāṃ ca sarvaśāstreṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ.. 17.159 ..
1.3.d:
ऐकपद्येन तान्येव कलां नार्हंति षोडशीम्..
संग्रामे पतितानां च सर्वशास्त्रेष्वयं विधिः.. 17.159 ..
1.3.m: all these together are not worth a sixteenth part [of the merit] / of those fallen in battle; such is the rule in all scriptures.

1.3.s:
tasmādyuddhāvadānaṃ ca kartavyamaviśaṃkitaiḥ..
bhavadbhirnānyathā kāryaṃ devavākyapramāṇataḥ.. 17.160 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्युद्धावदानं च कर्तव्यमविशंकितैः..
भवद्भिर्नान्यथा कार्यं देववाक्यप्रमाणतः.. 17.160 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, valor in battle must be displayed without hesitation / by you; you must not act otherwise, according to the authority of divine speech.

1.3.s:
yūyaṃ sarve śauravṛttyā sametāḥ kulena śīlena mahānubhāvāḥ..
padāni tānyeva palāyamānā gacchaṃtyaśūrā raṇamaṃḍalācca.. 17.161 ..
1.3.d:
यूयं सर्वे शौरवृत्त्या समेताः कुलेन शीलेन महानुभावाः..
पदानि तान्येव पलायमाना गच्छंत्यशूरा रणमंडलाच्च.. 17.161 ..
1.3.m: All of you are endowed with heroic conduct, noble lineage, and character, possessing great dignity; / fleeing from the battlefield, taking those very [retreating] steps, they become unheroic.

1.3.s: ta eva sarve khalu pāpalokāngacchaṃti nūnaṃ vacanātsmṛteśca.. 17.162 ..
1.3.d: त एव सर्वे खलु पापलोकान्गच्छंति नूनं वचनात्स्मृतेश्च.. 17.162 ..
1.3.m: Indeed, all of them surely go to worlds of sin, according to the words of the traditional scriptures.

1.3.s:
ye pāpiṣṭhāstvadharmmasthā brahmaghnā gurutalpagāḥ..
narakaṃ yāṃti te pāpaṃ tathaiva raṇavicyutāḥ.. 17.163 ..
1.3.d:
ये पापिष्ठास्त्वधर्म्मस्था ब्रह्मघ्ना गुरुतल्पगाः..
नरकं यांति ते पापं तथैव रणविच्युताः.. 17.163 ..
1.3.m: The most sinful who stand in unrighteousness, killers of brahmins, and violators of the teacher's bed / go to painful hell, and just so do those who flee from battle.

1.3.s:
tasmādbhavadbhiryoddhavyaṃ svāmikāryabharakṣamaiḥ..
evamuktāstadā tena vṛtreṇāpi mahātmanā.. 17.164 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्भवद्भिर्योद्धव्यं स्वामिकार्यभरक्षमैः..
एवमुक्तास्तदा तेन वृत्रेणापि महात्मना.. 17.164 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, you must fight, capable of bearing the burden of your master's business.' / When thus addressed by that high-souled Vṛtra,

1.3.s:
cakruste vacaṃnaṃ tasya asurāśca surānprati..
cakruḥ sutumulaṃ yuddhaṃ sarvalokabhayaṃkaram.. 17.165 ..
1.3.d:
चक्रुस्ते वचंनं तस्य असुराश्च सुरान्प्रति..
चक्रुः सुतुमुलं युद्धं सर्वलोकभयंकरम्.. 17.165 ..
1.3.m: the Asuras followed his word against the gods; / they fought a very tumultuous battle that caused fear to all the worlds.

1.3.s:
tasminpravṛtte tumule vigāḍhe vṛtro mahādaityapatiḥ sa ekaḥ..
uvāca roṣeṇa mahādbhutena śatakratuṃ devavaraiḥ sametam.. 17.166 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मिन्प्रवृत्ते तुमुले विगाढे वृत्रो महादैत्यपतिः स एकः..
उवाच रोषेण महाद्भुतेन शतक्रतुं देववरैः समेतम्.. 17.166 ..
1.3.m: When that tumultuous, intense [battle] had begun, Vṛtra alone, the lord of the great Daityas, / spoke with extraordinary wrath to Indra, who was accompanied by the foremost gods.

1.3.s:
..vṛtra uvāca..
śrṛṇu vākyaṃ mayā coktaṃ dharmmārthasahitaṃ hitam..
tvaṃ devānāṃ patirbhūtvā na jānāsi hitāhitam.. 17.167 ..
1.3.d:
..वृत्र उवाच..
श्रृणु वाक्यं मया चोक्तं धर्म्मार्थसहितं हितम्..
त्वं देवानां पतिर्भूत्वा न जानासि हिताहितम्.. 17.167 ..
1.3.m: Vṛtra said: / 'Listen to the beneficial words spoken by me, endowed with righteousness and purpose: / being the lord of the gods, you do not know what is beneficial and what is harmful.

1.3.s:
kiṃbalārthaparo bhūtvā viśvarūpo hatastvayā..
prāptamadyaiva bho iṃdra tasyedaṃ karmmaṇaḥ phalam.. 17.168 ..
1.3.d:
किंबलार्थपरो भूत्वा विश्वरूपो हतस्त्वया..
प्राप्तमद्यैव भो इंद्र तस्येदं कर्म्मणः फलम्.. 17.168 ..
1.3.m: Intent on what source of strength was Viśvarūpa slain by you? / Today indeed, O Indra, the fruit of that action has arrived!

1.3.s:
ye dīrghadarśino maṃdā mūḍhā dharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ..
akalpāḥ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ yatkurvaṃti ca niṣphalam..
tatsarvaṃ viddhi deveṃdra manasā saṃpradhāryatām.. 17.169 ..
1.3.d:
ये दीर्घदर्शिनो मंदा मूढा धर्मबहिष्कृताः..
अकल्पाः कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थं यत्कुर्वंति च निष्फलम्..
तत्सर्वं विद्धि देवेंद्र मनसा संप्रधार्यताम्.. 17.169 ..
1.3.m: Those fools and dullards who see far ahead, cast out from righteousness, / who are incapable of accomplishing their purpose and whose actions are fruitless— / know all of that, O lord of gods; let it be carefully considered in your mind.

1.3.s:
tasmāddharmmaparo bhūtvā yudhyasva gatakalmaṣaḥ..
bhrātṛhā tvaṃ mamaiveṃdra tasmāttvā ghātayāmyaham.. 17.170 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्धर्म्मपरो भूत्वा युध्यस्व गतकल्मषः..
भ्रातृहा त्वं ममैवेंद्र तस्मात्त्वा घातयाम्यहम्.. 17.170 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, intent on righteousness and free from defilement, fight! / You are the slayer of my brother, O Indra, and therefore I shall slay you.

1.3.s:
mā prayāhi sthiro bhūtvā devaiśca parivāritaḥ..
eva muktastu vṛtreṇa śakro'tīva ruṣānvitaḥ..
airāvataṃ samāruhya yayau vṛtrajighāṃsayā.. 17.171 ..
1.3.d:
मा प्रयाहि स्थिरो भूत्वा देवैश्च परिवारितः..
एव मुक्तस्तु वृत्रेण शक्रोऽतीव रुषान्वितः..
ऐरावतं समारुह्य ययौ वृत्रजिघांसया.. 17.171 ..
1.3.m: Do not run away; stand firm, surrounded by the gods!' / Being thus addressed by Vṛtra, Śakra, filled with intense anger,

1.3.s:
iṃdramāyāṃtamālokya vṛtro balavatāṃ varaḥ..
uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ sarveṣāṃ śrṛṇvatāmapi.. 17.172 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्रमायांतमालोक्य वृत्रो बलवतां वरः..
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं सर्वेषां श्रृण्वतामपि.. 17.172 ..
1.3.m: mounted Airāvata and advanced with the desire to slay Vṛtra. / Seeing Indra approaching, Vṛtra, the best of the mighty,

1.3.s: ādau māṃ praharasveti tasmāttvāṃ ghātayāmyaham.. 17.173 ..
1.3.d: आदौ मां प्रहरस्वेति तस्मात्त्वां घातयाम्यहम्.. 17.173 ..
1.3.m: laughed and spoke these words while everyone listened: / 'Strike me first, and then I shall slay you!'

1.3.s:
ityevamukto deveṃdro jaghāna gadayā bhṛśam..
vṛtraṃ balavatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jānudeśe mahābalam.. 17.174 ..
1.3.d:
इत्येवमुक्तो देवेंद्रो जघान गदया भृशम्..
वृत्रं बलवतां श्रेष्ठं जानुदेशे महाबलम्.. 17.174 ..
1.3.m: Thus addressed, the lord of the gods forcefully struck with his mace / the mighty Vṛtra, foremost among the strong, upon the knee.

1.3.s:
tāmāpataṃtiṃ jagrāha kareṇaikena līlayā..
tayaivainaṃ jaghānāśu gadayā tridiveśvaram.. 17.175 ..
1.3.d:
तामापतंतिं जग्राह करेणैकेन लीलया..
तयैवैनं जघानाशु गदया त्रिदिवेश्वरम्.. 17.175 ..
1.3.m: As it came flying, he caught it effortlessly with one hand; / with that very mace he swiftly struck the lord of heaven.

1.3.s:
sā gadā pātayāmāsa savajraṃ ca puraṃdaram..
patitaṃ śakramālokya vṛtra ūce surānprati.. 17.176 ..
1.3.d:
सा गदा पातयामास सवज्रं च पुरंदरम्..
पतितं शक्रमालोक्य वृत्र ऊचे सुरान्प्रति.. 17.176 ..
1.3.m: That mace struck down Purandara along with his thunderbolt. / Seeing Śakra fallen, Vṛtra said to the gods:

1.3.s: nayadhvaṃ svāminaṃ devāḥ svapurīmamarāvatīm.. 17.177 ..
1.3.d: नयध्वं स्वामिनं देवाः स्वपुरीममरावतीम्.. 17.177 ..
1.3.m: 'Take your master, O gods, to your own city, Amarāvatī.'

1.3.s:
etacchrutvā vacaḥ satyaṃ vṛtrasya ca mahātnaḥ..
tathā cakruḥ surāḥ sarve raṇācceṃdraṃ samutsukāḥ.. 17.178 ..
1.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचः सत्यं वृत्रस्य च महात्नः..
तथा चक्रुः सुराः सर्वे रणाच्चेंद्रं समुत्सुकाः.. 17.178 ..
1.3.m: Hearing this true word of the high-souled Vṛtra, / all the gods, anxious, did so from the battlefield for Indra's sake.

1.3.s:
apovāhya gajasthaṃ hi parivārya bhayāturāḥ..
surāḥ sarve raṇaṃ hitvā jagmuste tridivaṃ prati.. 17.179 ..
1.3.d:
अपोवाह्य गजस्थं हि परिवार्य भयातुराः..
सुराः सर्वे रणं हित्वा जग्मुस्ते त्रिदिवं प्रति.. 17.179 ..
1.3.m: Having carried him off while he was on the elephant, surrounding him in fear, / all the gods abandoned the battle and went toward heaven.

1.3.s:
tato gateṣu deveṣu nanarta ca mahāsuraḥ..
vṛtro jahāsa ca paraṃ tenā pūryata diktaṭam.. 17.180 ..
1.3.d:
ततो गतेषु देवेषु ननर्त च महासुरः..
वृत्रो जहास च परं तेना पूर्यत दिक्तटम्.. 17.180 ..
1.3.m: Then, when the gods had gone, the great Asura danced; / Vṛtra laughed aloud, and by that the directions were filled.

1.3.s:
cacāla ca mahī sarvā saśailavanakānanā..
cukṣubhe ca tadā sarvaṃ jaṃgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ tathā.. 17.181 ..
1.3.d:
चचाल च मही सर्वा सशैलवनकानना..
चुक्षुभे च तदा सर्वं जंगमं स्थावरं तथा.. 17.181 ..
1.3.m: The entire earth, along with its mountains, forests, and woods, trembled; / and then everything moving and unmoving was shaken.

1.3.s:
śrutvā prayātaṃ deveṃdraṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ..
upayāto'tha deveṃdra svakamaṇḍaluvāriṇā..
aspṛśallabdhasaṃjño'bhūttatkṣaṇācca puraṃdaraḥ.. 17.182 ..
1.3.d:
श्रुत्वा प्रयातं देवेंद्रं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः..
उपयातोऽथ देवेंद्र स्वकमण्डलुवारिणा..
अस्पृशल्लब्धसंज्ञोऽभूत्तत्क्षणाच्च पुरंदरः.. 17.182 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that the lord of the gods had retreated, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / approached the lord of the gods and touched him with water from his water-pot; / at that very moment Purandara regained consciousness.

1.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā pitāmahaṃ cāgre vrīḍāyukto'bhavattadā..
maheṃdraṃ trapayā yuktaṃ brahmovāca pitāmahaḥ.. 17.183 ..
1.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा पितामहं चाग्रे व्रीडायुक्तोऽभवत्तदा..
महेंद्रं त्रपया युक्तं ब्रह्मोवाच पितामहः.. 17.183 ..
1.3.m: Seeing the grandfather before him, he was filled with shame then. / To Mahendra, who was overwhelmed with embarrassment, Brahmā the grandfather said:

1.3.s:
..brahmovāca..
vṛtro hi tapasā yukto brahmacaryavrate sthitaḥ..
tvaṣṭuśca tapasā yukto vṛtraścāyaṃ mahāyaśāḥ..
ajeyastapasogreṇa tasmāttvaṃ tapasā jaya.. 17.184 ..
1.3.d:
..ब्रह्मोवाच..
वृत्रो हि तपसा युक्तो ब्रह्मचर्यव्रते स्थितः..
त्वष्टुश्च तपसा युक्तो वृत्रश्चायं महायशाः..
अजेयस्तपसोग्रेण तस्मात्त्वं तपसा जय.. 17.184 ..
1.3.m: Brahmā said: / 'Vṛtra is endowed with austerity and established in the vow of celibacy; / and this illustrious Vṛtra is endowed with the austerity of Tvaṣṭṛ.

1.3.s:
vṛtrāsuro daityapatiśca śakra te samādhinā parameṇaiva jayyaḥ..
niśamya vākyaṃ parameṣṭhino hariḥ sasmāra devaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaṃ tadā.. 17.185 ..
1.3.d:
वृत्रासुरो दैत्यपतिश्च शक्र ते समाधिना परमेणैव जय्यः..
निशम्य वाक्यं परमेष्ठिनो हरिः सस्मार देवं वृषभध्वजं तदा.. 17.185 ..
1.3.m: He is unconquerable by severe austerity; therefore, conquer him through austerity! / Vṛtrāsura, the lord of the Daityas, O Śakra, is to be conquered by you only through supreme meditation.' / Hearing the word of the Supreme Lord, Indra then remembered the god whose banner bears the bull.

1.3.s: stutyā tadātaṃ stavamāno mahātmā puraṃdaro guruṇā nodito hi.. 17.186 ..
1.3.d: स्तुत्या तदातं स्तवमानो महात्मा पुरंदरो गुरुणा नोदितो हि.. 17.186 ..
1.3.m: Then, praising him with a hymn of praise, the high-souled Purandara, urged by his preceptor, [said]:

1.3.s:
..iṃdra uvāca..
namo bhargāya devāya devānāmatidurgama..
varado bhava deveśa devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye.. 17.187 ..
1.3.d:
..इंद्र उवाच..
नमो भर्गाय देवाय देवानामतिदुर्गम..
वरदो भव देवेश देवानां कार्यसिद्धये.. 17.187 ..
1.3.m: Indra said: / 'Salutation to the god Bharga, O you who are very difficult for the gods to attain! / Grant a boon, O lord of gods, for the fulfillment of the gods' purpose!'

1.3.s:
evaṃ stitiparo bhūtvā śacīpatirudāradhīḥ..
svakāryadakṣo maṃdātmā prapaṃcābhirataḥ khalu.. 17.188 ..
1.3.d:
एवं स्तितिपरो भूत्वा शचीपतिरुदारधीः..
स्वकार्यदक्षो मंदात्मा प्रपंचाभिरतः खलु.. 17.188 ..
1.3.m: Being thus intent on praise, the husband of Śacī, though of broad intellect, / was clever in his own interest, dull-souled, and indeed delighted in worldly illusion.

1.3.s:
prapaṃcābhiratā mūḍhāḥ śivabhaktiparā hyapi..
na prāpnuvaṃti te sthānaṃ paramīśasyarāgiṇaḥ.. 17.189 ..
1.3.d:
प्रपंचाभिरता मूढाः शिवभक्तिपरा ह्यपि..
न प्राप्नुवंति ते स्थानं परमीशस्यरागिणः.. 17.189 ..
1.3.m: Those fools who delight in worldly illusion, even if intent on devotion to Śiva, / do not attain that supreme state of the Lord, being attached to worldly things.

1.3.s:
nirmalā nirahaṃkārā ye janāḥ paryupāsate..
mṛḍaṃ jñānapradaṃ ceśaṃ pareśaṃ śaṃbhumeva ca.. 17.190 ..
1.3.d:
निर्मला निरहंकारा ये जनाः पर्युपासते..
मृडं ज्ञानप्रदं चेशं परेशं शंभुमेव च.. 17.190 ..
1.3.m: Those spotless people free from ego who worship / Mṛḍa, the granter of knowledge and Lord, the supreme Lord, Śambhu himself—

1.3.s:
teṣāṃ pareṣāṃ varada ihāmutra ca śaṃkaraḥ..
maheṃdreṇa stutaḥ śarvo rāgiṇā parameṇa hi.. 17.191 ..
1.3.d:
तेषां परेषां वरद इहामुत्र च शंकरः..
महेंद्रेण स्तुतः शर्वो रागिणा परमेण हि.. 17.191 ..
1.3.m: to them, the supreme ones, Śaṃkara is the granter of boons both here and in the hereafter. / Śarva was praised by Mahendra, who was indeed utterly impassioned.

1.3.s:
rāgiṇāṃ hi sadā śaṃbhurdurlabho nātra saṃśayaḥ..
tasmādvirāgiṇāṃ nityaṃ sanmukho hi sadāśivaḥ.. 17.192 ..
1.3.d:
रागिणां हि सदा शंभुर्दुर्लभो नात्र संशयः..
तस्माद्विरागिणां नित्यं सन्मुखो हि सदाशिवः.. 17.192 ..
1.3.m: For Śambhu is always hard to attain for the impassioned; there is no doubt about this. / Therefore, Sadāśiva is ever turned towards the dispassionate.

1.3.s:
rājā surāṇāṃ hi mahānurāgī svakarmasaṃsiddhimahāpravīṇaḥ..
tasmātsadā kleśaparaḥ śacīpatiḥ svakāmabhāvātmaparo hi nityam.. 17.193 ..
1.3.d:
राजा सुराणां हि महानुरागी स्वकर्मसंसिद्धिमहाप्रवीणः..
तस्मात्सदा क्लेशपरः शचीपतिः स्वकामभावात्मपरो हि नित्यम्.. 17.193 ..
1.3.m: The king of the gods was indeed full of great passion, exceedingly skilled in accomplishing his own affairs; / therefore Śacī's lord was ever subjected to affliction, perpetually devoted to his own selfish desire.

1.3.s:
stavamānaṃ tadā ceṃdramabravītkāryagauravāt..
vijñāyākhiladṛgdraṣṭā maheśo liṃgarūpavān.. 17.194 ..
1.3.d:
स्तवमानं तदा चेंद्रमब्रवीत्कार्यगौरवात्..
विज्ञायाखिलदृग्द्रष्टा महेशो लिंगरूपवान्.. 17.194 ..
1.3.m: The all-seeing beholder, Maheśa who has the form of a liṅga, / then, understanding [his intention], spoke to Indra who was praising him, on account of the importance of the task:

1.3.s:
iṃdra gaccha suraiḥ sārddhaṃ vṛtraṃ vai dānavaṃ prati..
tapasaiva ca sādhyo'yaṃ raṇe jetuṃ śatakrato.. 17.195 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्र गच्छ सुरैः सार्द्धं वृत्रं वै दानवं प्रति..
तपसैव च साध्योऽयं रणे जेतुं शतक्रतो.. 17.195 ..
1.3.m: "Go, Indra, along with the gods against the demon Vṛtra. / He can only be overcome through tapas, to be conquered in battle, O Śatakratu."

1.3.s:
..iṃdra uvāca..
kenopāyena sādhyo'yaṃ vṛtro daityavaro mahān..
tcachīghraṃ kathyatāṃ śaṃbho yena me vijayo bhavet.. 17.196 ..
1.3.d:
..इंद्र उवाच..
केनोपायेन साध्योऽयं वृत्रो दैत्यवरो महान्..
त्चछीघ्रं कथ्यतां शंभो येन मे विजयो भवेत्.. 17.196 ..
1.3.m: Indra said: / "By what means can this great and foremost of Daityas, Vṛtra, be overcome? / Tell me quickly, O Śambhu, how I may obtain victory."

1.3.s:
..rudra uvāca..
raṇe na śakyate haṃtumapi devavarairapi..
tasmāttvayā hi kartavyaṃ kutsitaṃ karma cādya vai.. 17.197 ..
1.3.d:
..रुद्र उवाच..
रणे न शक्यते हंतुमपि देववरैरपि..
तस्मात्त्वया हि कर्तव्यं कुत्सितं कर्म चाद्य वै.. 17.197 ..
1.3.m: Rudra said: / "He cannot be killed in battle even by the foremost of the gods; / therefore today you must indeed perform a despised deed.

1.3.s:
asya śāpaḥ purā dattaḥ pārvatyā mama sannidhau..
asau citraratho nāmnā vikhyāto bhuvanatraye.. 17.198 ..
1.3.d:
अस्य शापः पुरा दत्तः पार्वत्या मम सन्निधौ..
असौ चित्ररथो नाम्ना विख्यातो भुवनत्रये.. 17.198 ..
1.3.m: Formerly a curse was laid upon him by Pārvatī in my presence; / he was renowned by the name Citraratha in the three worlds.

1.3.s:
paryaṭansu vimānena mayā dattena bhāsvatā..
upahāsādimāṃ yoniṃ saṃprāpto datyapuṃgavaḥ.. 17.199 ..
1.3.d:
पर्यटन्सु विमानेन मया दत्तेन भास्वता..
उपहासादिमां योनिं संप्राप्तो दत्यपुंगवः.. 17.199 ..
1.3.m: Wandering about in an aerial chariot given by me, radiant, / through ridicule that foremost of Daityas arrived at this womb.

1.3.s:
tasmādajeyaṃ jānīhi raṇe raṇavidāṃ vara..
evamukto maheṃdro'yaṃ śaṃbhunā yoginā bhṛśam.. 17.200 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मादजेयं जानीहि रणे रणविदां वर..
एवमुक्तो महेंद्रोऽयं शंभुना योगिना भृशम्.. 17.200 ..
1.3.m: Therefore know him to be invincible in battle, O best of battle-knowers." / When Mahendra was thus addressed repeatedly by Śambhu, the yogin,

1.3.s: tatheti matvā śakro'sau niyamaṃ tamupādade.. 17.201 ..
1.3.d: तथेति मत्वा शक्रोऽसौ नियमं तमुपाददे.. 17.201 ..
1.3.m: agreeing with "So be it," Śakra undertook that discipline.

1.3.s:
raṃdhraṃ pratīkṣya vṛtrasya tatsamīpe sahasrakam..
vatsarāṇāṃ mahābhāgā vasanhaṃtuṃ mano dadhe.. 17.202 ..
1.3.d:
रंध्रं प्रतीक्ष्य वृत्रस्य तत्समीपे सहस्रकम्..
वत्सराणां महाभागा वसन्हंतुं मनो दधे.. 17.202 ..
1.3.m: Watching for a weakness in Vṛtra, living near him for a thousand / years, O fortunate ones, he set his mind on killing him.

1.3.s:
aṃtarvedyāṃ bahiḥ sthitvā vajrapāṇiranujñayā..
guroḥ purodhasaścaiva svakāryamakarodbhṛśam.. 17.203 ..
1.3.d:
अंतर्वेद्यां बहिः स्थित्वा वज्रपाणिरनुज्ञया..
गुरोः पुरोधसश्चैव स्वकार्यमकरोद्भृशम्.. 17.203 ..
1.3.m: Remaining outside in the Antarvedi, Vajrapāṇi, by the instruction / of his guru and family priest, assiduously pursued his task.

1.3.s:
ekadā narmmadāyāṃ vai vṛtro dānavapuṃgavaḥ..
daityaiḥ parivṛtaḥ sarvaiḥ samāyāto yadṛcchayā.. 17.204 ..
1.3.d:
एकदा नर्म्मदायां वै वृत्रो दानवपुंगवः..
दैत्यैः परिवृतः सर्वैः समायातो यदृच्छया.. 17.204 ..
1.3.m: Once at the Narmadā, Vṛtra, that bull among Dānavas, / surrounded by all the Daityas, arrived by chance.

1.3.s:
iṃdraḥ parābhavaṃ prāpto nīto devairddivaṃ prati..
ahameva hatāriśca nānyosti sadṛśo mama.. 17.205 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्रः पराभवं प्राप्तो नीतो देवैर्द्दिवं प्रति..
अहमेव हतारिश्च नान्योस्ति सदृशो मम.. 17.205 ..
1.3.m: "Indra met with defeat and was led by the gods to heaven; / I alone have slain my enemy, and there is no other equal to me,"

1.3.s:
manyamānaḥ sadā vṛtraḥ pauruṣeṇa samanvitaḥ..
pradoṣasamaye viprā narmadāyāmupasthitaḥ.. 17.206 ..
1.3.d:
मन्यमानः सदा वृत्रः पौरुषेण समन्वितः..
प्रदोषसमये विप्रा नर्मदायामुपस्थितः.. 17.206 ..
1.3.m: so Vṛtra always thought, endowed with manly vigor. / At the time of pradoṣa, O brahmins, he arrived at the Narmadā.

1.3.s:
dṛṣṭaśceṃdreṇa sumahānasuraiḥ parivāritaḥ..
vṛtro balavatāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ pradoṣasamaye tadā.. 17.207 ..
1.3.d:
दृष्टश्चेंद्रेण सुमहानसुरैः परिवारितः..
वृत्रो बलवतां श्रेष्ठः प्रदोषसमये तदा.. 17.207 ..
1.3.m: Then, at the time of pradoṣa, the exceedingly mighty Vṛtra, / foremost of the strong, surrounded by Asuras, was seen by Indra.

1.3.s:
tasminpradeṣe saṃyuktā maṃdavāre trayodaśī..
nodito guruṇā ceṃdraḥ kare gṛhya bṛhaspatiḥ.. 17.208 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मिन्प्रदेषे संयुक्ता मंदवारे त्रयोदशी..
नोदितो गुरुणा चेंद्रः करे गृह्य बृहस्पतिः.. 17.208 ..
1.3.m: In that region, the thirteenth lunar day coincided with Saturday. / Indra, prompted by his guru Bṛhaspati who took him by the hand,

1.3.s:
pradakṣiṇānamaskārairyathoktavidhinā tadā..
pūjito liṃgarūpī ca oṃkāro narmadātaṭe.. 17.209 ..
1.3.d:
प्रदक्षिणानमस्कारैर्यथोक्तविधिना तदा..
पूजितो लिंगरूपी च ओंकारो नर्मदातटे.. 17.209 ..
1.3.m: then worshipped Oṃkāra on the bank of the Narmadā, who had the form of a liṅga, / by means of circumambulations and prostrations according to the prescribed rite.

1.3.s:
pradoṣavratamāhātmyādvajrapāṇiḥ pratāpavān..
saṃjātastatkṣaṇādeva prasādācchaṃkarasgayaca.. 17.210 ..
1.3.d:
प्रदोषव्रतमाहात्म्याद्वज्रपाणिः प्रतापवान्..
संजातस्तत्क्षणादेव प्रसादाच्छंकरस्गयच.. 17.210 ..
1.3.m: Through the māhātmya of the pradoṣa vow and the grace of Śaṃkara, / the thunderbolt-handed [Indra] instantly became glorious.

1.3.s:
vṛtropi tapasā yuktaḥ pradoṣasamaye mahān..
nidrāsakto'bhavattatra śuṃḍena prati bodhitaḥ.. 17.211 ..
1.3.d:
वृत्रोपि तपसा युक्तः प्रदोषसमये महान्..
निद्रासक्तोऽभवत्तत्र शुंडेन प्रति बोधितः.. 17.211 ..
1.3.m: Even the great Vṛtra, endowed with tapas, / fell prey to sleep there at the time of pradoṣa, though warned by Śuṇḍa.

1.3.s:
svāpātpradoṣavelāyāṃ tapasā cārjitaṃ phalam..
pranaṣṭaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva niḥśrīkatvamupāgataḥ.. 17.212 ..
1.3.d:
स्वापात्प्रदोषवेलायां तपसा चार्जितं फलम्..
प्रनष्टं तत्क्षणादेव निःश्रीकत्वमुपागतः.. 17.212 ..
1.3.m: From sleeping at the time of pradoṣa, the fruit earned by his tapas / was lost that very instant, and he fell into misfortune.

1.3.s: devyāḥ śāpācca saṃjāto vṛtro bhagnamanorathaḥ.. 17.213 ..
1.3.d: देव्याः शापाच्च संजातो वृत्रो भग्नमनोरथः.. 17.213 ..
1.3.m: And on account of the goddess's curse, Vṛtra had his desires shattered.

1.3.s:
saṃdhyāpādo gato yāvaddhṛtra stīrthamupāviśat..
parīto vividhairddaityaityairnānāyudhasamanvitaiḥ.. 17.214 ..
1.3.d:
संध्यापादो गतो यावद्धृत्र स्तीर्थमुपाविशत्..
परीतो विविधैर्द्दैत्यैत्यैर्नानायुधसमन्वितैः.. 17.214 ..
1.3.m: As soon as the twilight period passed, Vṛtra entered the sacred ford, / surrounded by various Daityas equipped with diverse weapons.

1.3.s:
tasya tatkarmaṇaśchidraṃ chidrānveṣī śacīpatiḥ..
jñātvā gataḥ śanairhatumātmaśatruṃ śatakratuḥ.. 17.215 ..
1.3.d:
तस्य तत्कर्मणश्छिद्रं छिद्रान्वेषी शचीपतिः..
ज्ञात्वा गतः शनैर्हतुमात्मशत्रुं शतक्रतुः.. 17.215 ..
1.3.m: Looking for a weakness, Śacī's lord, Śatakratu, / knowing that flaw in his conduct, went slowly to kill his enemy.

1.3.s:
tāvaddaityāḥ susaṃrabdhā bhīmā bhīmaparākramāḥ..
uttasthuryugapatsarve duḥsahāśca śatakratum.. 17.216 ..
1.3.d:
तावद्दैत्याः सुसंरब्धा भीमा भीमपराक्रमाः..
उत्तस्थुर्युगपत्सर्वे दुःसहाश्च शतक्रतुम्.. 17.216 ..
1.3.m: Then the Daityas, enraged, formidable, of terrifying prowess, / and unbearable, all rose up at once against Śatakratu.

1.3.s:
tatastairabhavadyuddhamatiprabaladaṃḍibhiḥ..
sarve devāḥ sahāyārthaṃ tadā''jagmuḥ śatakratoḥ.. 17.217 ..
1.3.d:
ततस्तैरभवद्युद्धमतिप्रबलदंडिभिः..
सर्वे देवाः सहायार्थं तदा'ऽजग्मुः शतक्रतोः.. 17.217 ..
1.3.m: Then a battle took place with those extremely powerful staff-bearers. / All the gods then came to assist Śatakratu.

1.3.s:
tadā daityāśca devāśca yuyudhuste tarasvinaḥ..
rātrau yuddhaṃ samābhavatsurāsuravimardanam.. 17.218 ..
1.3.d:
तदा दैत्याश्च देवाश्च युयुधुस्ते तरस्विनः..
रात्रौ युद्धं समाभवत्सुरासुरविमर्दनम्.. 17.218 ..
1.3.m: Then the Daityas and the gods fought, full of speed; / a night battle occurred, a crushing of gods and Asuras.

1.3.s:
anekaśastrasaṃvītaṃ mahāraudramavartata..
evaṃ pravartamāne tu saṃgrame raudradāruṇe..
tadā vṛtro'tha sannaddho gṛhītvā śūlamulbaṇam.. 17.219 ..
1.3.d:
अनेकशस्त्रसंवीतं महारौद्रमवर्तत..
एवं प्रवर्तमाने तु संग्रमे रौद्रदारुणे..
तदा वृत्रोऽथ सन्नद्धो गृहीत्वा शूलमुल्बणम्.. 17.219 ..
1.3.m: Covered with numerous weapons, it proceeded, most dreadful. / While the battle, terrible and fierce, was thus proceeding, / Vṛtra, now armored and seizing a terrifying trident,

1.3.s:
iṃdra pramukhato bhūtvā jagarjātivibhīṣaṇam..
tasya nādapraṇādena trāsitaṃ bhuvanatrayam.. 17.220 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्र प्रमुखतो भूत्वा जगर्जातिविभीषणम्..
तस्य नादप्रणादेन त्रासितं भुवनत्रयम्.. 17.220 ..
1.3.m: came before Indra and roared most frightfully. / By the resounding roar of his voice, the three worlds were terrified.

1.3.s:
airāvaṇaṃ samāruhya maheṃdraḥ śuśubhe tadā..
dhriyamāṇenacchatreṇa caṃdramaṃḍalaśobhinā.. 17.221 ..
1.3.d:
ऐरावणं समारुह्य महेंद्रः शुशुभे तदा..
ध्रियमाणेनच्छत्रेण चंद्रमंडलशोभिना.. 17.221 ..
1.3.m: Having mounted Airāvata, Mahendra then shone splendidly, / with an umbrella held [above him] that gleamed like the orb of the moon,

1.3.s: cāmarairvījyamāno'tha babhāṣe daityapuṃgavam.. 17.222 ..
1.3.d: चामरैर्वीज्यमानोऽथ बभाषे दैत्यपुंगवम्.. 17.222 ..
