1.3.m: and fanned with chowries, he then spoke to the foremost of Daityas:

1.3.s:
..iṃdra uvāca..
saṃgrāmaṃ kuru me vṛtra balena mahatā vṛtaḥ..
śūrastvamasi śūrāṇāṃ tapasā parameṇa hi.. 17.223 ..
1.3.d:
..इंद्र उवाच..
संग्रामं कुरु मे वृत्र बलेन महता वृतः..
शूरस्त्वमसि शूराणां तपसा परमेण हि.. 17.223 ..
1.3.m: Indra said: / "Fight with me, Vṛtra, surrounded by your great army! / You are a hero among heroes, indeed through supreme tapas."

1.3.s:
evamuktastadā tena vṛtro vākyamuvāca ha..
ādau prahara māmiṃdrapaścāttvāṃ ghātayāmyaham.. 17.224 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन वृत्रो वाक्यमुवाच ह..
आदौ प्रहर मामिंद्रपश्चात्त्वां घातयाम्यहम्.. 17.224 ..
1.3.m: Thus addressed by him, Vṛtra then said these words: / "Strike me first, Indra; afterwards I will strike you down!"

1.3.s:
tatheti matvā tadatīva duḥsahaṃ vajraṃ tadānīṃ śatadhārameva..
sa moktukāmo hi tadā puraṃdaro nivāritastena mahāprabheṇa..
purodhasā buddhimatāṃ vareṇa tatheti matvā sa cakāra ceṃdraḥ.. 17.225 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा तदतीव दुःसहं वज्रं तदानीं शतधारमेव..
स मोक्तुकामो हि तदा पुरंदरो निवारितस्तेन महाप्रभेण..
पुरोधसा बुद्धिमतां वरेण तथेति मत्वा स चकार चेंद्रः.. 17.225 ..
1.3.m: Thinking "So be it," Purandara then desired to release / that exceedingly unbearable hundred-pointed thunderbolt; / but he was restrained by that priest of great splendor, the best of the wise; / agreeing with "So be it," Indra acted [accordingly].

1.3.s:
gadāṃ pragṛhya deveṃdro vṛtraṃ vivyādha tāṃ gadām..
vārayāmāsa vṛtrosā vatithiṃ kṛpaṇo yathā.. 17.226 ..
1.3.d:
गदां प्रगृह्य देवेंद्रो वृत्रं विव्याध तां गदाम्..
वारयामास वृत्रोसा वतिथिं कृपणो यथा.. 17.226 ..
1.3.m: Taking up a mace, Devendra struck Vṛtra with that mace; / Vṛtra warded it off just as a miser turns away a guest.

1.3.s: vyārthāṃ ca svagadāṃ dṛṣṭvā iṃdraściṃtāmavāpa ha.. 17.227 ..
1.3.d: व्यार्थां च स्वगदां दृष्ट्वा इंद्रश्चिंतामवाप ह.. 17.227 ..
1.3.m: Seeing his mace rendered useless, Indra fell into anxiety.

1.3.s:
taṃ ciṃtyamānaṃ sa tadā puraṃdaraṃ vṛtro babhāṣe paribhartsamānaḥ..
purākṛtaṃ śakra mahādbhutaṃ tvayā jugupsitaṃ karmma ca vismṛtaṃ kim..
yenaiva jāto'si sahasranetraḥ śāpānmaharṣeratha gautamasya.. 17.228 ..
1.3.d:
तं चिंत्यमानं स तदा पुरंदरं वृत्रो बभाषे परिभर्त्समानः..
पुराकृतं शक्र महाद्भुतं त्वया जुगुप्सितं कर्म्म च विस्मृतं किम्..
येनैव जातोऽसि सहस्रनेत्रः शापान्महर्षेरथ गौतमस्य.. 17.228 ..
1.3.m: To Purandara who was thus brooding, Vṛtra, reproaching him, then spoke: / "Have you forgotten, O Śakra, the exceedingly strange and despicable deed formerly done by you, / by which you became thousand-eyed from the curse of the great seer Gautama?

1.3.s:
ye śūrāśceṃdriyagrāmaṃ vartaṃte hi niyamya tu..
te jayaṃ prāpnuvaṃtīha netare hi bhavādṛśāḥ.. 17.229 ..
1.3.d:
ये शूराश्चेंद्रियग्रामं वर्तंते हि नियम्य तु..
ते जयं प्राप्नुवंतीह नेतरे हि भवादृशाः.. 17.229 ..
1.3.m: Those heroes who abide having controlled the host of their senses / obtain victory here, not others like you.

1.3.s: raṇājiraṃ mahāghoraṃ pāpināṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 17.230 ..
1.3.d: रणाजिरं महाघोरं पापिनां नात्र संशयः.. 17.230 ..
1.3.m: A battlefield is exceedingly terrible for sinners; there is no doubt of this."

1.3.s:
evaṃ nirbhartsayāmāsa deveṃdraṃ daityapuṃgavaḥ..
triśūlaṃ dhūnayāmāsa deveṃdro hi taḍitsamam.. 17.231 ..
1.3.d:
एवं निर्भर्त्सयामास देवेंद्रं दैत्यपुंगवः..
त्रिशूलं धूनयामास देवेंद्रो हि तडित्समम्.. 17.231 ..
1.3.m: Thus did that bull among Daityas rebuke Devendra. / Devendra shook his trident that was like lightning.

1.3.s:
tena śūlena mahatā vṛtro'dbhutaparākramaḥ..
babhau tīvreṇa tapasā yathā rudro yugāṃtakṛt.. 17.232 ..
1.3.d:
तेन शूलेन महता वृत्रोऽद्भुतपराक्रमः..
बभौ तीव्रेण तपसा यथा रुद्रो युगांतकृत्.. 17.232 ..
1.3.m: With that great trident, Vṛtra of wonderful prowess / shone through intense tapas like Rudra bringing about the end of the age.

1.3.s:
tathābhūtaṃ samālakṣya devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ..
abhyudyayau haṃtukāmo vṛtre dānavapuṃgavam.. 17.233 ..
1.3.d:
तथाभूतं समालक्ष्य देवराजः शतक्रतुः..
अभ्युद्ययौ हंतुकामो वृत्रे दानवपुंगवम्.. 17.233 ..
1.3.m: Perceiving him in such a state, the king of the gods, Śatakratu, / advanced, wishing to slay that foremost of Dānavas, Vṛtra.

1.3.s:
tamāyāṃtamabhiprekṣya haṃtukāmaṃ puraṃdaram..
jahāsa paramaṃ tatra śakrasya ca bhayāvaham..
mukhaṃ prasārya sumahadāgato hi puraṃdaram.. 17.234 ..
1.3.d:
तमायांतमभिप्रेक्ष्य हंतुकामं पुरंदरम्..
जहास परमं तत्र शक्रस्य च भयावहम्..
मुखं प्रसार्य सुमहदागतो हि पुरंदरम्.. 17.234 ..
1.3.m: Seeing Purandara advancing and seeking to slay him, / he laughed loudly, terrifying Śakra, / and opening his vast mouth wide, he approached Purandara.

1.3.s:
grastukāmo mahātejā daityānāmadhipastadā..
āgatya sahasā śakraṃ grāsayitvā sakuṃjaram.. 17.235 ..
1.3.d:
ग्रस्तुकामो महातेजा दैत्यानामधिपस्तदा..
आगत्य सहसा शक्रं ग्रासयित्वा सकुंजरम्.. 17.235 ..
1.3.m: Then, wishing to swallow him, that immensely splendid lord of the Daityas / suddenly came upon Śakra and swallowed him together with his elephant,

1.3.s:
savajraṃ sakirīṭaṃ ca nanarta ca jagarjja ca..
nimiṣāṃtaramātreṇa grasito'sau puraṃdaraḥ.. 17.236 ..
1.3.d:
सवज्रं सकिरीटं च ननर्त च जगर्ज्ज च..
निमिषांतरमात्रेण ग्रसितोऽसौ पुरंदरः.. 17.236 ..
1.3.m: along with his thunderbolt and his crown, and then danced and roared. / In merely the twinkling of an eye, that Purandara was swallowed.

1.3.s:
hāhākāro mahānāsīddevānāṃ tatra paśyatām..
bhūkampo hi tadā hyasīdulkāpātaḥ sahasraśaḥ.. 17.237 ..
1.3.d:
हाहाकारो महानासीद्देवानां तत्र पश्यताम्..
भूकम्पो हि तदा ह्यसीदुल्कापातः सहस्रशः.. 17.237 ..
1.3.m: There was a great cry of grief among the gods looking on; / an earthquake occurred then, and meteor-showers by the thousands.

1.3.s:
timireṇāvṛtaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam..
nartamānastadā vṛtro babhūva paramadyutiḥ.. 17.238 ..
1.3.d:
तिमिरेणावृतं सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजंगमम्..
नर्तमानस्तदा वृत्रो बभूव परमद्युतिः.. 17.238 ..
1.3.m: The whole world, both immobile and mobile, was covered in darkness. / Dancing then, Vṛtra became exceedingly radiant.

1.3.s:
vidhyamānāstadā sarve devā brahmāṇa māgatāḥ..
śaśaṃsuḥ sarvamevaitadvṛtrāsuraviceṣṭitam.. 17.239 ..
1.3.d:
विध्यमानास्तदा सर्वे देवा ब्रह्माण मागताः..
शशंसुः सर्वमेवैतद्वृत्रासुरविचेष्टितम्.. 17.239 ..
1.3.m: Tormented then, all the gods approached Brahmā / and related this entire deed of the demon Vṛtra.

1.3.s:
tacchrutvā bhagavānbrahmā vyathito'tīva vismitaḥ..
kathaṃ jātaṃ maheṃdrasya vyasanaṃ paramādbhutam.. 17.240 ..
1.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा भगवान्ब्रह्मा व्यथितोऽतीव विस्मितः..
कथं जातं महेंद्रस्य व्यसनं परमाद्भुतम्.. 17.240 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that, the lord Brahmā was deeply troubled and exceedingly astonished: / “How could such an extraordinary disaster have befallen Mahendra?”

1.3.s:
devaiḥ saha tadā brahmā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ..
tuṣṭāva giriśaṃ devaṃ parameṇa samādhinā.. 17.241 ..
1.3.d:
देवैः सह तदा ब्रह्मा सर्वलोकपितामहः..
तुष्टाव गिरिशं देवं परमेण समाधिना.. 17.241 ..
1.3.m: Then Brahmā, the grandfather of all the worlds, together with the gods, / praised the god Giriśa with supreme concentration of mind.

1.3.s:
..brahmovāca..
oṃnamo liṃgarūpāya mahādevāya vai namaḥ..
viśvarūpāya devāya virupākṣāya vai namaḥ.. 17.242 ..
1.3.d:
..ब्रह्मोवाच..
ओंनमो लिंगरूपाय महादेवाय वै नमः..
विश्वरूपाय देवाय विरुपाक्षाय वै नमः.. 17.242 ..
1.3.m: Brahmā said: / “Oṃ, reverence to the one whose form is the liṅga, reverence indeed to Mahādeva; / reverence to the god of universal form, reverence indeed to Virūpākṣa!

1.3.s:
trāhitrāhi trilokeśa vṛtragrastaṃ puraṃdaram..
tadā nabhogatāvāṇī sarveṣāmeva śrṛṇvatām.. 17.243 ..
1.3.d:
त्राहित्राहि त्रिलोकेश वृत्रग्रस्तं पुरंदरम्..
तदा नभोगतावाणी सर्वेषामेव श्रृण्वताम्.. 17.243 ..
1.3.m: Save, save, O Lord of the three worlds, Purandara swallowed by Vṛtra!” / Then a voice in the sky, while all were listening,

1.3.s:
uvāca hitakāmāya vidhiṃ liṃgārcane satī..
pradoṣavratayuktena iṃdreṇa vikṛtaṃ kṛtam.. 17.244 ..
1.3.d:
उवाच हितकामाय विधिं लिंगार्चने सती..
प्रदोषव्रतयुक्तेन इंद्रेण विकृतं कृतम्.. 17.244 ..
1.3.m: desiring their welfare, spoke the true rule for the worship of the liṅga: / “Indra, though undertaking the vow of pradoṣa, committed a transgression:

1.3.s:
nirmālyaṃ pīṭhikāṃ caiva cchāyāprāsādameva ca..
pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtavatā pīṭhikālaṃghanaṃ kṛtam.. 17.245 ..
1.3.d:
निर्माल्यं पीठिकां चैव च्छायाप्रासादमेव च..
प्रदक्षिणां कृतवता पीठिकालंघनं कृतम्.. 17.245 ..
1.3.m: the floral offerings, the pedestal, and the shadow of the temple— / while making the circumambulation, he crossed over the pedestal.

1.3.s:
laṃghayaṃti ca ye mūḍhāste vai daṃḍyā na saṃśayaḥ..
caṃḍasya gaṇamukhyasya tasmātkuryātprayatnataḥ..
pradakṣiṇānamaskārau liṃgārccanasamanvitaḥ.. 17.246 ..
1.3.d:
लंघयंति च ये मूढास्ते वै दंड्या न संशयः..
चंडस्य गणमुख्यस्य तस्मात्कुर्यात्प्रयत्नतः..
प्रदक्षिणानमस्कारौ लिंगार्च्चनसमन्वितः.. 17.246 ..
1.3.m: And the fools who cross over it are undoubtedly to be punished. / Therefore, devoted to the worship of the liṅga, one should diligently perform / circumambulation and salutation of Caṇḍa, the leader of the gaṇas.

1.3.s:
śreyaḥprāptayekabuddhyā vai prayatnālliṃgapūjanam..
kāryaṃ dīkṣā parairnityaṃ sarvapāpopaśāṃtaye.. 17.247 ..
1.3.d:
श्रेयःप्राप्तयेकबुद्ध्या वै प्रयत्नाल्लिंगपूजनम्..
कार्यं दीक्षा परैर्नित्यं सर्वपापोपशांतये.. 17.247 ..
1.3.m: With single-minded intent to attain the highest good, the worship of the liṅga / must always be performed diligently by those devoted to initiation, for the pacification of all sins.”

1.3.s:
āśarīraṃ ca tadvākyaṃ śrutvā brahmādayaḥ surāḥ..
papracchuste prāṃjalayo nabhovāṇīṃ śubhāvahām.. 17.248 ..
1.3.d:
आशरीरं च तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मादयः सुराः..
पप्रच्छुस्ते प्रांजलयो नभोवाणीं शुभावहाम्.. 17.248 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that disembodied voice, the gods headed by Brahmā, / with joined palms, questioned that auspicious voice from the sky:

1.3.s:
kathamarcāmahe liṃgaṃ kenaiva vidhinā tataḥ..
prātarmadhyāhnasamaye sāyaṃkāle tathaiva ca.. 17.249 ..
1.3.d:
कथमर्चामहे लिंगं केनैव विधिना ततः..
प्रातर्मध्याह्नसमये सायंकाले तथैव च.. 17.249 ..
1.3.m: “How shall we worship the liṅga, and by what rite / in the morning, at noon, and in the evening?

1.3.s:
kāni puṣpāṇi sāyāhne madhyāhne ca tathaiva hi..
prātaḥ kāle tu tānyena kathayasva yathātatham.. 17.250 ..
1.3.d:
कानि पुष्पाणि सायाह्ने मध्याह्ने च तथैव हि..
प्रातः काले तु तान्येन कथयस्व यथातथम्.. 17.250 ..
1.3.m: Tell us accurately which flowers [are prescribed] in the evening, / which at noon, and which in the morning.”

1.3.s: tadā nabhogatā vāṇī kathayāmāsa vistaram.. 17.251 ..
1.3.d: तदा नभोगता वाणी कथयामास विस्तरम्.. 17.251 ..
1.3.m: Then the voice situated in the sky explained at length:

1.3.s:
karavīraṃ cārkapuṣpaṃ bṛhatīpuṣpamevaca..
dhattūrakusumaṃ caiva śatapatraṃ tathaiva ca.. 17.252 ..
1.3.d:
करवीरं चार्कपुष्पं बृहतीपुष्पमेवच..
धत्तूरकुसुमं चैव शतपत्रं तथैव च.. 17.252 ..
1.3.m: “The karavīra, the arka blossom, the bṛhatī blossom, / the dhattūra flower, and also the lotus,

1.3.s:
āragvadhaṃ ca punnāgaṃ bakulaṃ nāgakeśaram..
bradhnotpalaṃ kadambaṃ ca maṃdārakusumaṃ tathā.. 17.253 ..
1.3.d:
आरग्वधं च पुन्नागं बकुलं नागकेशरम्..
ब्रध्नोत्पलं कदम्बं च मंदारकुसुमं तथा.. 17.253 ..
1.3.m: the āragvadha, the punnāga, the bakula, the nāgakeśara, / the bradhnotpala, the kadamba, and the mandāra flower;

1.3.s:
bahūni varapuṣpāṇi bahūni kamalānyapi..
trikāle ca pavitrāṇi jñeyāni satataṃ budhaiḥ.. 17.254 ..
1.3.d:
बहूनि वरपुष्पाणि बहूनि कमलान्यपि..
त्रिकाले च पवित्राणि ज्ञेयानि सततं बुधैः.. 17.254 ..
1.3.m: many excellent flowers and many lotuses / should always be known by the wise as pure at all three times.

1.3.s:
jātīpuṣpaṃ mallikāyāśca puṣpaṃ puṣpaṃ mogarakaṃ nīlapuṣpaṃ tathaiva..
tathā puṣpaṃ kuṭajaṃ karṇikāraṃ kausumbhākhyaṃ vārijaṃ raktavarṇanam.. 17.255 ..
1.3.d:
जातीपुष्पं मल्लिकायाश्च पुष्पं पुष्पं मोगरकं नीलपुष्पं तथैव..
तथा पुष्पं कुटजं कर्णिकारं कौसुम्भाख्यं वारिजं रक्तवर्णनम्.. 17.255 ..
1.3.m: The jātī flower, the flower of the mallikā, the mogaraka flower, and also the blue lotus, / as well as the kuṭaja flower, the karṇikāra, the safflower, and the red water-lily—

1.3.s:
etānyeva ya puṣpāṇi madhyāhne liṃgapūjane..
viśiṣṭāni mayoktāni sāyāhne kathayāmyaham.. 17.256 ..
1.3.d:
एतान्येव य पुष्पाणि मध्याह्ने लिंगपूजने..
विशिष्टानि मयोक्तानि सायाह्ने कथयाम्यहम्.. 17.256 ..
1.3.m: these flowers I have declared to be specially suited / for the worship of the liṅga at noon; now I declare [those for] the evening.

1.3.s:
caṃ pakāni trikāle ca pavitrāṇi na saṃśayaḥ..
rātrau mogarakāṇyeva pavitrāṇi na saṃśayaḥ.. 17.257 ..
1.3.d:
चं पकानि त्रिकाले च पवित्राणि न संशयः..
रात्रौ मोगरकाण्येव पवित्राणि न संशयः.. 17.257 ..
1.3.m: Campaka flowers are pure at all three times, without doubt; / at night, mogaraka flowers alone are pure, without doubt.

1.3.s:
evamarccanabhedāṃśca jñātvā talliṃgapūjane..
kāryo vidhirvidhijñaiśca satataṃ ca śivālaye.. 17.258 ..
1.3.d:
एवमर्च्चनभेदांश्च ज्ञात्वा तल्लिंगपूजने..
कार्यो विधिर्विधिज्ञैश्च सततं च शिवालये.. 17.258 ..
1.3.m: Having thus learned the different modes of worship, those who know the ritual / should constantly perform the rite in the temple of Śiva in the worship of his liṅga.

1.3.s:
vṛṣabhāṃtarito bhūtvā pīṭhikāṃtarameva ca..
pradakṣiṇāṃ na kurvīta kurvankilbiṣamaśnute.. 17.259 ..
1.3.d:
वृषभांतरितो भूत्वा पीठिकांतरमेव च..
प्रदक्षिणां न कुर्वीत कुर्वन्किल्बिषमश्नुते.. 17.259 ..
1.3.m: One should not make a circumambulation / passing between [Śiva and] the bull or crossing within the pedestal; by doing so, one incurs guilt.

1.3.s:
tathā hyanena śakreṇa kṛtaṃ caiva pradakṣiṇam..
rājasaṃ bhāvamāśritya tasmājjātaṃca niṣphalam.. 17.260 ..
1.3.d:
तथा ह्यनेन शक्रेण कृतं चैव प्रदक्षिणम्..
राजसं भावमाश्रित्य तस्माज्जातंच निष्फलम्.. 17.260 ..
1.3.m: For in that manner the circumambulation was performed by Śakra, / resorting to the quality of passion; therefore it became fruitless.

1.3.s:
grasito'dyaiva vṛtreṇa sagajo hi puraṃdaraḥ..
bhavadbhireva tatkāryaṃ yena indraḥ pramucyate.. 17.261 ..
1.3.d:
ग्रसितोऽद्यैव वृत्रेण सगजो हि पुरंदरः..
भवद्भिरेव तत्कार्यं येन इन्द्रः प्रमुच्यते.. 17.261 ..
1.3.m: This very day, Purandara along with his elephant has been swallowed by Vṛtra; / you yourselves must perform that by which Indra may be set free.

1.3.s:
mahārudravidhānena mukto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt..
puraṃdaro hyayaṃ devā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 17.262 ..
1.3.d:
महारुद्रविधानेन मुक्तो भवति तत्क्षणात्..
पुरंदरो ह्ययं देवा नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 17.262 ..
1.3.m: By the ritual of the Mahārudra, this Purandara / will instantly be freed, O gods; there should be no doubt about this.”

1.3.s:
tenaiva vacasā devā rudramabhyarcya yatnataḥ..
yathoktena vidhānena rudrasūktena yatnataḥ.. 17.263 ..
1.3.d:
तेनैव वचसा देवा रुद्रमभ्यर्च्य यत्नतः..
यथोक्तेन विधानेन रुद्रसूक्तेन यत्नतः.. 17.263 ..
1.3.m: At that very command, the gods diligently worshipped Rudra / according to the prescribed rite, with the Rudrasūkta, with devotion.

1.3.s:
tathā caikādaśīrudryā rudramabhyarcya vai surāḥ..
havanaṃ pratyahaṃ cakrurddaśāṃśena dvijottamāḥ.. 17.264 ..
1.3.d:
तथा चैकादशीरुद्र्या रुद्रमभ्यर्च्य वै सुराः..
हवनं प्रत्यहं चक्रुर्द्दशांशेन द्विजोत्तमाः.. 17.264 ..
1.3.m: And worshipping Rudra with the Ekādaśīrudrī, O best of brahmins, / the gods performed a burnt offering every day to the extent of a tenth part.

1.3.s:
japaṃ ca pūjāṃ havanaṃ ca cakrurvimoktukāmāḥ sahasā puraṃdaram..
śaṃbhoḥ prasādātsahasā vinirgataḥ kukṣiṃ bhittvā devarājastadānīm.. 17.265 ..
1.3.d:
जपं च पूजां हवनं च चक्रुर्विमोक्तुकामाः सहसा पुरंदरम्..
शंभोः प्रसादात्सहसा विनिर्गतः कुक्षिं भित्त्वा देवराजस्तदानीम्.. 17.265 ..
1.3.m: Wishing to liberate Purandara immediately, they performed recitation, worship, and burnt offering; / and by the grace of Śambhu, tearing open the belly, the king of the gods suddenly emerged at that moment.

1.3.s:
taṃ nirgataṃ samīkṣyātha devadeveṃdramojasā..
sagajaṃ ca sa vajraṃ ca sakirīṭaṃ sakuṇḍalam..
śriyā paramayā yuktaṃ puraṃdaraṃ mahaujasam.. 17.266 ..
1.3.d:
तं निर्गतं समीक्ष्याथ देवदेवेंद्रमोजसा..
सगजं च स वज्रं च सकिरीटं सकुण्डलम्..
श्रिया परमया युक्तं पुरंदरं महौजसम्.. 17.266 ..
1.3.m: Then, seeing that god, the king of the gods, emerged by his power, / together with his elephant, his thunderbolt, his crown, and his earrings, / Purandara, endowed with supreme glory and great might,

1.3.s:
devaduṃdubhayo nedustathā śaṃkhā hyanekaśaḥ..
gaṃdharvāpsaraso yakṣā ṛṣayaśca mudānvitāḥ.. 17.267 ..
1.3.d:
देवदुंदुभयो नेदुस्तथा शंखा ह्यनेकशः..
गंधर्वाप्सरसो यक्षा ऋषयश्च मुदान्विताः.. 17.267 ..
1.3.m: the celestial drums resounded, as did conches in great numbers; / the gandharvas, apsarases, yakṣas, and seers were filled with joy.

1.3.s:
ekapadyena sarveṣāṃ mahāharṣo divaukasām..
saṃjātastatkṣaṇādeva yadā muktaḥ puraṃdaraḥ..
tadā śacī samāyātā yatra muktaḥ puraṃdaraḥ.. 17.268 ..
1.3.d:
एकपद्येन सर्वेषां महाहर्षो दिवौकसाम्..
संजातस्तत्क्षणादेव यदा मुक्तः पुरंदरः..
तदा शची समायाता यत्र मुक्तः पुरंदरः.. 17.268 ..
1.3.m: Simultaneously, a great rejoicing arose among all the dwellers of heaven / in that very moment when Purandara was released. / Then Śacī arrived where Purandara was freed.

1.3.s:
tatra śacyā sameto'sāvabhiṣikto maharṣibhiḥ..
puṇyāhavācanaṃ tasya kṛtaṃ sarvaiḥ prayatnataḥ.. 17.269 ..
1.3.d:
तत्र शच्या समेतोऽसावभिषिक्तो महर्षिभिः..
पुण्याहवाचनं तस्य कृतं सर्वैः प्रयत्नतः.. 17.269 ..
1.3.m: United there with Śacī, he was consecrated by the great seers; / the recitation of auspicious words was diligently performed for him by all.

1.3.s:
evaṃ tadābhiṣikto'sau maheṃdra ṛṣibhiḥ punaḥ..
mahī maṃgalabhūyiṣṭhā tadā jātā dvijottamāḥ.. 17.270 ..
1.3.d:
एवं तदाभिषिक्तोऽसौ महेंद्र ऋषिभिः पुनः..
मही मंगलभूयिष्ठा तदा जाता द्विजोत्तमाः.. 17.270 ..
1.3.m: When Mahendra was thus consecrated again by the seers, / the earth became filled with auspiciousness, O best of brahmins.

1.3.s:
diśaḥ prasannatāṃ yātā nirmalaṃ cābhavannabhaḥ..
śāṃtāstadāgnayo hyāsanmanāṃsi ca mahātmanām.. 17.271 ..
1.3.d:
दिशः प्रसन्नतां याता निर्मलं चाभवन्नभः..
शांतास्तदाग्नयो ह्यासन्मनांसि च महात्मनाम्.. 17.271 ..
1.3.m: The quarters became clear, the sky became cloudless, / the fires became tranquil, and so did the minds of the great-souled ones.

1.3.s:
evamādīnyanekāni maṃgalāni tato'bhavan..
mukte śatakratau tasminbabhūva paramādbhutam.. 17.272 ..
1.3.d:
एवमादीन्यनेकानि मंगलानि ततोऽभवन्..
मुक्ते शतक्रतौ तस्मिन्बभूव परमाद्भुतम्.. 17.272 ..
1.3.m: These and many other auspicious omens appeared then; / when Śatakratu was liberated, an exceedingly wonderful thing took place.

1.3.s:
evaṃ pravartamāne tu mahatāṃ ca mahotsave..
tāvadvṛtrasya patitaṃ śarīraṃ ca bhayānakam.. 17.273 ..
1.3.d:
एवं प्रवर्तमाने तु महतां च महोत्सवे..
तावद्वृत्रस्य पतितं शरीरं च भयानकम्.. 17.273 ..
1.3.m: While that great festival of the great ones was thus taking place, / the dreadful body of Vṛtra fell.

1.3.s:
tatraiva brahmahatyā ca pāpiṣṭhā patitā bhuvi..
gaṃgāyamunayormadhye aṃtarvedīti kathyate.. 17.274 ..
1.3.d:
तत्रैव ब्रह्महत्या च पापिष्ठा पतिता भुवि..
गंगायमुनयोर्मध्ये अंतर्वेदीति कथ्यते.. 17.274 ..
1.3.m: Right there on the earth, the most sinful brahmahatyā fell, / between the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā, in what is called the Antarvedī.

1.3.s:
puṇyabhūmiriti khyātā prasiddhā lokapāvanī..
vṛtrahatyāpratiṣṭhā sā yasmideśe sa pāpavān.. 17.275 ..
1.3.d:
पुण्यभूमिरिति ख्याता प्रसिद्धा लोकपावनी..
वृत्रहत्याप्रतिष्ठा सा यस्मिदेशे स पापवान्.. 17.275 ..
1.3.m: Known as a holy land, renowned as purifying the worlds; / that very place where the sin of slaying Vṛtra fell became sinful.

1.3.s:
malasya bahusaṃbhūtyā mālāveti prakīrtitā..
tasyāṃ tu malabhūmyāṃ vai vṛtrasya ca mahacchiraḥ.. 17.276 ..
1.3.d:
मलस्य बहुसंभूत्या मालावेति प्रकीर्तिता..
तस्यां तु मलभूम्यां वै वृत्रस्य च महच्छिरः.. 17.276 ..
1.3.m: Because of the great accumulation of filth, it is proclaimed as Mālava. / In that land of filth, indeed, the great head of Vṛtra,

1.3.s:
ṣaṇmāseṣvapatatsarvaiḥ kṛttaṃ devaiḥ savāsavaiḥ..
evaṃ vṛtravadhaṃ kṛtvā śakro jayamavāpa ha.. 17.277 ..
1.3.d:
षण्मासेष्वपतत्सर्वैः कृत्तं देवैः सवासवैः..
एवं वृत्रवधं कृत्वा शक्रो जयमवाप ह.. 17.277 ..
1.3.m: severed by all the gods together with Indra, fell within six months. / Having thus slain Vṛtra, Śakra attained victory.

1.3.s:
iṃdrāsane copaviṣṭo nirātaṃkaḥ śacīpatiḥ..
etasminnaṃtare daityāḥ pātālavāsinaṃ balim..
śaśaṃsuḥ sarvamāgatya śakrasya ca viceṣṭitam.. 17.278 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्रासने चोपविष्टो निरातंकः शचीपतिः..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे दैत्याः पातालवासिनं बलिम्..
शशंसुः सर्वमागत्य शक्रस्य च विचेष्टितम्.. 17.278 ..
1.3.m: And seated upon the throne of Indra, free from fear was Śacī’s husband. / In the meantime, the Daityas, coming to Bali who resided in Pātāla, / reported all the deeds of Śakra.

1.3.s:
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vairocanī ruṣānvitaḥ..
śukraṃ papraccha sa tadā sathamiṃdro vaśī bhavet.. 17.279 ..
1.3.d:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वैरोचनी रुषान्वितः..
शुक्रं पप्रच्छ स तदा सथमिंद्रो वशी भवेत्.. 17.279 ..
1.3.m: Hearing their words, the son of Virocana, filled with wrath, / then asked Śukra: "How can Indra be brought under control?"

1.3.s:
tenoktaṃ balaye rājañjayasyandanalabdhaye..
mahāyajñaṃ kuruṣvādya tena te vijayo bhavet.. 17.280 ..
1.3.d:
तेनोक्तं बलये राजञ्जयस्यन्दनलब्धये..
महायज्ञं कुरुष्वाद्य तेन ते विजयो भवेत्.. 17.280 ..
1.3.m: He said to Bali: "O king, to obtain a chariot of victory, / perform a great sacrifice today; through that, victory shall be yours."

1.3.s:
tenokto bhṛguṇā caivaṃ baliryajñārthamudyataḥ..
dadhau yānīha dravyāṇi yajñayogyāni tāni vai..
melayitvā tvareṇaiva vairocanirudāradhīḥ.. 17.281 ..
1.3.d:
तेनोक्तो भृगुणा चैवं बलिर्यज्ञार्थमुद्यतः..
दधौ यानीह द्रव्याणि यज्ञयोग्यानि तानि वै..
मेलयित्वा त्वरेणैव वैरोचनिरुदारधीः.. 17.281 ..
1.3.m: Thus addressed by Bhṛgu, Bali applied himself to the sacrifice. / The noble-minded son of Virocana gathered with great haste / all the materials suitable for a sacrifice that he could procure here.

1.3.s:
pravartito mahāyajño bhārgaveṇa mahātmanā..
dīkṣāyukto balirabhūjjuhuve haghyavāhanam.. 17.282 ..
1.3.d:
प्रवर्तितो महायज्ञो भार्गवेण महात्मना..
दीक्षायुक्तो बलिरभूज्जुहुवे हघ्यवाहनम्.. 17.282 ..
1.3.m: The great sacrifice was commenced by the high-souled descendant of Bhṛgu. / Endowed with initiation, Bali made oblations into the bearer of offerings.

1.3.s:
hūyamāne tadāgnau tu karmaṇā vidhihetunā..
tasmādbaleḥ samutpannaḥ syaṃdanaḥ paramādbhutaḥ.. 17.283 ..
1.3.d:
हूयमाने तदाग्नौ तु कर्मणा विधिहेतुना..
तस्माद्बलेः समुत्पन्नः स्यंदनः परमाद्भुतः.. 17.283 ..
1.3.m: As oblations were being made into the fire in accordance with ritual rule, / there arose from that sacrifice of Bali an exceedingly wondrous chariot,

1.3.s:
hayaiścaturbhiḥ saṃyukto dhvajesiṃho mahāprabhaḥ..
śastrāstraiḥ saṃyutaḥ śrīmānhayaiḥ śvetairalaṃkṛtaḥ.. 17.284 ..
1.3.d:
हयैश्चतुर्भिः संयुक्तो ध्वजेसिंहो महाप्रभः..
शस्त्रास्त्रैः संयुतः श्रीमान्हयैः श्वेतैरलंकृतः.. 17.284 ..
1.3.m: yoked with four horses, having a lion of great radiance on its banner, / equipped with weapons and missiles, splendid, and adorned with white horses.

1.3.s:
tataścāvabhṛthasnānaṃ cakre śukrapraṇoditaḥ..
syaṃdanaṃ pūjayitvātha āruroha balistadā.. 17.285 ..
1.3.d:
ततश्चावभृथस्नानं चक्रे शुक्रप्रणोदितः..
स्यंदनं पूजयित्वाथ आरुरोह बलिस्तदा.. 17.285 ..
1.3.m: Then, prompted by Śukra, he took the concluding ritual bath. / Having then worshipped the chariot, Bali mounted it.

1.3.s:
daityaiḥ parivṛtaḥ sadyo yoddhukāmaḥ puraṃdaram..
sadya eva divaṃ prāpto balirvairocano mahān.. 17.286 ..
1.3.d:
दैत्यैः परिवृतः सद्यो योद्धुकामः पुरंदरम्..
सद्य एव दिवं प्राप्तो बलिर्वैरोचनो महान्.. 17.286 ..
1.3.m: Immediately surrounded by Daityas, desiring to fight Indra, / the great Bali, son of Virocana, went straight to heaven.

1.3.s:
āgatya senayā sārddhamāruro hāmarāvatīm..
saṃruddhāṃ tāṃ purīṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā te surasattamāḥ..
virśayitvā suciramūcuḥ sarve bṛhaspatim.. 17.287 ..
1.3.d:
आगत्य सेनया सार्द्धमारुरो हामरावतीम्..
संरुद्धां तां पुरीं दृष्ट्वा तदा ते सुरसत्तमाः..
विर्शयित्वा सुचिरमूचुः सर्वे बृहस्पतिम्.. 17.287 ..
1.3.m: Arriving with his army, he besieged Amarāvatī. / Seeing that city besieged, the best of the gods, / having deliberated for a long time, all spoke to Bṛhaspati:

1.3.s:
kiṃ kurmo'dya mahābhāga āgatā daityapuṃgavāḥ..
yoddhukāmā mahāghorāḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ.. 17.288 ..
1.3.d:
किं कुर्मोऽद्य महाभाग आगता दैत्यपुंगवाः..
योद्धुकामा महाघोराः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः.. 17.288 ..
1.3.m: “What shall we do now, O illustrious one? The foremost Daityas have arrived, / eager to fight, exceedingly fierce, and all skilled in battle.”

1.3.s: teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bṛhaspatirabhāṣata.. 17.289 ..
1.3.d: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा बृहस्पतिरभाषत.. 17.289 ..
1.3.m: Hearing their words, Bṛhaspati spoke:

1.3.s:
ete ghṛtamukhā ghorā bhṛguṇānoditāḥ surāḥ..
ajeyāścaiva te sarve tapasā vikrameṇa ca.. 17.290 ..
1.3.d:
एते घृतमुखा घोरा भृगुणानोदिताः सुराः..
अजेयाश्चैव ते सर्वे तपसा विक्रमेण च.. 17.290 ..
1.3.m: “These fierce [demons] have their mouths smeared with clarified butter, encouraged by Bhṛgu, O gods; / they are all unconquerable through austerity and valour.”

1.3.s:
etanniśamya vacanaṃ ca guṇābhiyuktaṃ sarve surāḥ samabhavaṃstrapayābhiyuktāḥ..
iṃdro'pi buddhivikalaḥ pariciṃtayā ca vrīḍāyutaḥ samabhavatparibhartsyamānaḥ.. 17.291 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe balidaityasya saṃgrāmodyogavarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 17 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
एतन्निशम्य वचनं च गुणाभियुक्तं सर्वे सुराः समभवंस्त्रपयाभियुक्ताः..
इंद्रोऽपि बुद्धिविकलः परिचिंतया च व्रीडायुतः समभवत्परिभर्त्स्यमानः.. 17.291 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखंडे बलिदैत्यस्य संग्रामोद्योगवर्णनंनाम सप्तदशोऽध्यायः.. 17 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
Hearing these words endowed with reason, all the gods became overcome with shame. / Indra too, his mind bewildered and reproached with anxious reflection, became filled with embarrassment.
Thus ends the seventeenth chapter, named 'Description of the Daitya Bali’s Preparation for War', in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first [section], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
karmaṇā paribhūto hi maheṃdro gurumabravīt..
vinā yatnena saṃklesāttartuṃ karmma kimucyatām.. 18.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
कर्मणा परिभूतो हि महेंद्रो गुरुमब्रवीत्..
विना यत्नेन संक्लेसात्तर्तुं कर्म्म किमुच्यताम्.. 18.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Overwhelmed by that fate, Mahendra said to his guru: / “Tell me, without effort, by what act may we cross over from distress?”

1.3.s:
bṛhaspatiruvācedaṃ tyaktvā caivāmarāvatīm..
yāsyāmo'nyatra sarve vai sakuṭuṃbā jigīpavaḥ.. 18.2 ..
1.3.d:
बृहस्पतिरुवाचेदं त्यक्त्वा चैवामरावतीम्..
यास्यामोऽन्यत्र सर्वे वै सकुटुंबा जिगीपवः.. 18.2 ..
1.3.m: Bṛhaspati said this: “Abandoning Amarāvatī, / we shall all go elsewhere with our families, seeking to conquer.”

1.3.s:
tathā cakruḥ surāḥ sarve hitvā caivāmarāvatīm..
barhiṇo rupamāsthāya gataḥ sadyaḥ puraṃdaraḥ.. 18.3 ..
1.3.d:
तथा चक्रुः सुराः सर्वे हित्वा चैवामरावतीम्..
बर्हिणो रुपमास्थाय गतः सद्यः पुरंदरः.. 18.3 ..
1.3.m: All the gods did so, having abandoned Amarāvatī. / Assuming the form of a peacock, Indra departed at once.

1.3.s:
kāko bhūtvā yamaḥ sākṣātkṛkalāso dhanādhipaḥ..
agniḥ kapotako bhūtvā bheko bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ.. 18.4 ..
1.3.d:
काको भूत्वा यमः साक्षात्कृकलासो धनाधिपः..
अग्निः कपोतको भूत्वा भेको भूत्वा महेश्वरः.. 18.4 ..
1.3.m: Yama became a crow; Kubera, the lord of wealth, a chameleon; / Agni became a dove; Maheśvara became a frog;

1.3.s:
nairṛtastatkṣaṇādeva kapoto'bhūttato gataḥ..
pāśī kapiṃjalo bhūtvā vāyuḥ pārāvato'bhavat.. 18.5 ..
1.3.d:
नैरृतस्तत्क्षणादेव कपोतोऽभूत्ततो गतः..
पाशी कपिंजलो भूत्वा वायुः पारावतोऽभवत्.. 18.5 ..
1.3.m: Nirṛti instantly became a pigeon and then departed; / Varuṇa became a francolin partridge; Vāyu became a pigeon.

1.3.s:
evaṃ nānātanubhṛto hitvā te tridivaṃ gatāḥ..
kaśyapasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃprāptāste bhayāturāḥ.. 18.6 ..
1.3.d:
एवं नानातनुभृतो हित्वा ते त्रिदिवं गताः..
कश्यपस्याश्रमं पुण्यं संप्राप्तास्ते भयातुराः.. 18.6 ..
1.3.m: Thus bearing various bodies, having abandoned heaven, they departed. / Afflicted with fear, they reached the holy hermitage of Kaśyapa.

1.3.s: aditiṃ mātaraṃ sarve śaśaṃsurdaityaceṣṭitam.. 18.7 ..
1.3.d: अदितिं मातरं सर्वे शशंसुर्दैत्यचेष्टितम्.. 18.7 ..
1.3.m: They all related the conduct of the Daityas to their mother Aditi.

1.3.s:
apriyaṃ tadupākarṇya hyaditiḥ putralālasā..
uvāca kaśyapaṃ sā tu surāṇāṃ vyasanaṃ mahat..
maharṣe śrayatāṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā tatkartumarhasi.. 18.8 ..
1.3.d:
अप्रियं तदुपाकर्ण्य ह्यदितिः पुत्रलालसा..
उवाच कश्यपं सा तु सुराणां व्यसनं महत्..
महर्षे श्रयतां वाक्यं श्रुत्वा तत्कर्तुमर्हसि.. 18.8 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that unpleasant news, Aditi, devoted to her sons, / spoke to Kaśyapa about the great distress of the gods: / “O great seer, listen to my words, and having heard them, please act upon them.

1.3.s:
daityaiḥ parājitā devā hitvā caivāmarāvatīm..
tvadīyamāśramaṃ prāptāstānrakṣasva prajāpate.. 18.9 ..
1.3.d:
दैत्यैः पराजिता देवा हित्वा चैवामरावतीम्..
त्वदीयमाश्रमं प्राप्तास्तान्रक्षस्व प्रजापते.. 18.9 ..
1.3.m: Defeated by the Daityas, the gods have abandoned Amarāvatī / and have come to your hermitage; protect them, O lord of creatures!”

1.3.s:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā kaśyapo vākyamabravīt..
tapasā mahatā tanvi jānīhi tvaṃ ca bhāmini..
ajeyā hyasurāḥ sādhvi bhṛguṇā hyanumoditāḥ.. 18.10 ..
1.3.d:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कश्यपो वाक्यमब्रवीत्..
तपसा महता तन्वि जानीहि त्वं च भामिनि..
अजेया ह्यसुराः साध्वि भृगुणा ह्यनुमोदिताः.. 18.10 ..
1.3.m: Hearing her words, Kaśyapa spoke: / “Know, O slender, beautiful woman, that by great austerity / the Asuras, encouraged by Bhṛgu, are indeed invincible, O virtuous lady.

1.3.s:
teṣāṃ jayo hi tapasā ugreṇā''dyena bhāmini..
kuru śīghratareṇaiva surāṇāṃ kāryasiddhaye.. 18.11 ..
1.3.d:
तेषां जयो हि तपसा उग्रेणा'ऽद्येन भामिनि..
कुरु शीघ्रतरेणैव सुराणां कार्यसिद्धये.. 18.11 ..
1.3.m: Victory over them [is possible] only through fierce, primordial austerity, O fair lady; / perform it very quickly for the accomplishment of the purpose of the gods.

1.3.s:
vratametanmahābhāge kathayāmyarthasiddhaye..
tatkuruṣva prayatnena yathoktavidhinā śubhe.. 18.12 ..
1.3.d:
व्रतमेतन्महाभागे कथयाम्यर्थसिद्धये..
तत्कुरुष्व प्रयत्नेन यथोक्तविधिना शुभे.. 18.12 ..
1.3.m: I shall explain this observance to you, O fortunate lady, for the attainment of your goal; / perform it with diligence according to the prescribed rules, O auspicious one.

1.3.s:
māsi bhādrapade devi daśamyāṃ niyatā śuciḥ..
ekabhaktaṃ prakurvīta viṣṇoḥ prītyarthameva ca.. 18.13 ..
1.3.d:
मासि भाद्रपदे देवि दशम्यां नियता शुचिः..
एकभक्तं प्रकुर्वीत विष्णोः प्रीत्यर्थमेव च.. 18.13 ..
1.3.m: In the month of Bhādrapada, on the tenth day, restrained and purified, O goddess, / one should eat only a single meal for the pleasure of Viṣṇu.

1.3.s:
prarthanīyo hariḥ sākṣātsarvakāmavareśvaraḥ..
maṃtreṇānena subhage tadbhaktairvaravarṇini.. 18.14 ..
1.3.d:
प्रर्थनीयो हरिः साक्षात्सर्वकामवरेश्वरः..
मंत्रेणानेन सुभगे तद्भक्तैर्वरवर्णिनि.. 18.14 ..
1.3.m: Hari, the lord who grants all desires and boons, is to be prayed to in person / with this mantra, O auspicious one of excellent complexion, by his devotees:

1.3.s:
tava bhaktosmyahaṃ nātha daśamyādidinatrayam..
vrataṃ carāmyahaṃ viṣṇo anujñāṃ dātumarhasi.. 18.15 ..
1.3.d:
तव भक्तोस्म्यहं नाथ दशम्यादिदिनत्रयम्..
व्रतं चराम्यहं विष्णो अनुज्ञां दातुमर्हसि.. 18.15 ..
1.3.m: ‘I am your devotee, O Lord; for three days beginning with the tenth, / I observe this vow, O Viṣṇu; please grant your permission.’

1.3.s:
anenaiva ca maṃtreṇa prārthanīyo jagatpatiḥ..
ekabhaktaṃ prakurvīta tacca bhaktaṃ ca kevalam.. 18.16 ..
1.3.d:
अनेनैव च मंत्रेण प्रार्थनीयो जगत्पतिः..
एकभक्तं प्रकुर्वीत तच्च भक्तं च केवलम्.. 18.16 ..
1.3.m: With this very mantra the Lord of the universe should be petitioned. / One should eat only a single meal, and that meal of plain food only;

1.3.s:
raṃbhāpatre ca bhoktavyaṃ varjitaṃ lavaṇena hi..
ekādaśyāṃ copavāsaṃ prakurvīta prayatnataḥ.. 18.17 ..
1.3.d:
रंभापत्रे च भोक्तव्यं वर्जितं लवणेन हि..
एकादश्यां चोपवासं प्रकुर्वीत प्रयत्नतः.. 18.17 ..
1.3.m: it is to be eaten from a plantain leaf, completely devoid of salt. / On the eleventh day, one should diligently observe a complete fast.

1.3.s:
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātprayatnena sumadhyame..
dvādaśyāṃ nipuṇatvena pāraṇā tu vidhānataḥ..
kartavyā jñātibhiḥ sārddhaṃ bhojayitvā dvijīttamān.. 18.18 ..
1.3.d:
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्यात्प्रयत्नेन सुमध्यमे..
द्वादश्यां निपुणत्वेन पारणा तु विधानतः..
कर्तव्या ज्ञातिभिः सार्द्धं भोजयित्वा द्विजीत्तमान्.. 18.18 ..
1.3.m: At night, one should diligently keep vigil, O fair-waisted woman. / On the twelfth day, the breaking of the fast must be properly performed according to rule / along with relatives, after feeding the foremost brahmins.

1.3.s:
evaṃ dvādaśamāsāṃstu kuryādvratamataṃdritaḥ..
māsi bhādrapade prāpte ekādaśyāṃ prayatnataḥ..
viṣṇumabhyarcya yatnena kalaśopari saṃsthitam.. 18.19 ..
1.3.d:
एवं द्वादशमासांस्तु कुर्याद्व्रतमतंद्रितः..
मासि भाद्रपदे प्राप्ते एकादश्यां प्रयत्नतः..
विष्णुमभ्यर्च्य यत्नेन कलशोपरि संस्थितम्.. 18.19 ..
1.3.m: Thus one should unweariedly perform the observance for twelve months. / When the month of Bhādrapada arrives, on the eleventh day, with effort / having carefully worshipped Viṣṇu stationed upon a water-pot,

1.3.s:
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi yatāśaktyā prakalpayet..
śravaṇena tu saṃyuktāṃ dvādaśīṃ pāpanāśinīm..
vratī upavasedyatnātsarvadoṣapraśāṃtaye.. 18.20 ..
1.3.d:
सौवर्णं राजतं वापि यताशक्त्या प्रकल्पयेत्..
श्रवणेन तु संयुक्तां द्वादशीं पापनाशिनीम्..
व्रती उपवसेद्यत्नात्सर्वदोषप्रशांतये.. 18.20 ..
1.3.m: fashioned of gold or of silver according to one's capacity, / the observer of the vow should diligently fast on the twelfth day conjoined with the Śravaṇa asterism, / which destroys sins, for the pacification of all faults.”

1.3.s:
evaṃ hi kaśyapenoktaṃ śrutvā'ditirathācarat..
vrataṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ yāvanniyamena samanvitatā.. 18.21 ..
1.3.d:
एवं हि कश्यपेनोक्तं श्रुत्वाऽदितिरथाचरत्..
व्रतं सांवत्सरं यावन्नियमेन समन्वितता.. 18.21 ..
1.3.m: Having thus heard what was spoken by Kaśyapa, Aditi then performed / the observance for the duration of a full year, endowed with self-restraint.

1.3.s:
varṣāṃtena vratenaiva parituṣṭo janārdanaḥ..
prādurbabhūva dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇena tadā dvijāḥ.. 18.22 ..
1.3.d:
वर्षांतेन व्रतेनैव परितुष्टो जनार्दनः..
प्रादुर्बभूव द्वादश्यां श्रवणेन तदा द्विजाः.. 18.22 ..
1.3.m: Fully pleased by that vow at the end of the year, Janārdana / manifested Himself, O twice-born ones, on the twelfth day conjoined with Śravaṇa.

1.3.s:
baṭurūpadharaḥ śrīśo dvibhujaḥ kamalekṣamaḥ..
atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśo vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ.. 18.23 ..
1.3.d:
बटुरूपधरः श्रीशो द्विभुजः कमलेक्षमः..
अतसीपुष्पसंकाशो वनमालाविभूषितः.. 18.23 ..
1.3.m: Bearing the form of a young boy, the Lord of Śrī had two arms and lotus eyes; / resembling the flax flower, he was adorned with a garland of forest flowers.

1.3.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭā pūjāmadhye'ditistadā..
kaśyapena samāyuktā sā'stauṣītkamalekṣaṇā.. 18.24 ..
1.3.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा विस्मयाविष्टा पूजामध्येऽदितिस्तदा..
कश्यपेन समायुक्ता साऽस्तौषीत्कमलेक्षणा.. 18.24 ..
1.3.m: Seeing him in the midst of her worship, Aditi was then filled with wonder; / together with Kaśyapa, she whose eyes were lotus-like praised him:

1.3.s:
..aditiruvāca..
namonamaḥ kāraṇakāraṇāya te viśvātmane viśvasṛje cidātmane..
vareṇyarūpāya parāvarātmane hyakuṃṭhabodhāya namonamaste.. 18.25 ..
1.3.d:
..अदितिरुवाच..
नमोनमः कारणकारणाय ते विश्वात्मने विश्वसृजे चिदात्मने..
वरेण्यरूपाय परावरात्मने ह्यकुंठबोधाय नमोनमस्ते.. 18.25 ..
1.3.m: Aditi said: / 'Salutations, salutations to you, the cause of causes, the Soul of the universe, the creator of the universe, whose nature is consciousness! / Salutations, salutations to you of excellent form, the Self beyond and within, whose knowledge is unhindered!'

1.3.s:
iti smṛtastadā'dityā devānāṃ pariracyutaḥ..
prahasya bhagavānāha aditiṃ devamātaram.. 18.26 ..
1.3.d:
इति स्मृतस्तदाऽदित्या देवानां परिरच्युतः..
प्रहस्य भगवानाह अदितिं देवमातरम्.. 18.26 ..
1.3.m: Thus praised then by Aditi, the Lord, the supreme imperishable one of the gods, / smiled and spoke to Aditi, the mother of the gods.

1.3.s:
..śrībhagavānuvāca..
tapasā parameṇaiva prasannohaṃ tavānaghe..
amunā vapuṣā caiva devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye.. 18.27 ..
1.3.d:
..श्रीभगवानुवाच..
तपसा परमेणैव प्रसन्नोहं तवानघे..
अमुना वपुषा चैव देवानां कार्यसिद्धये.. 18.27 ..
1.3.m: The Holy One said: / 'O sinless one, I am pleased with your supreme austerity; / with this body [I have appeared] for the accomplishment of the purpose of the gods.'

1.3.s:
śrutvā bhagavato vākyamaditistamuvācaha..
bhagavanparājitā devā asurairbalavattaraiḥ..
tānrakṣa śaraṇāpannāsurānsarvāñjanārdana.. 18.28 ..
1.3.d:
श्रुत्वा भगवतो वाक्यमदितिस्तमुवाचह..
भगवन्पराजिता देवा असुरैर्बलवत्तरैः..
तान्रक्ष शरणापन्नासुरान्सर्वाञ्जनार्दन.. 18.28 ..
1.3.m: Hearing the words of the Holy One, Aditi spoke to him: / 'O Lord, the gods have been defeated by the more powerful asuras; / protect those gods who have taken refuge [in you], O Janārdana!'

1.3.s:
niśamya vākyaṃ kila tacca tasyā viṣṇurvikuṃṭhādhipatiḥ sa ekaḥ..
jñātvā ca sarvaṃ suraceṣṭitaṃ tadā baleśca sarvaṃ ca cikīrṣitaṃ ca.. 18.29 ..
1.3.d:
निशम्य वाक्यं किल तच्च तस्या विष्णुर्विकुंठाधिपतिः स एकः..
ज्ञात्वा च सर्वं सुरचेष्टितं तदा बलेश्च सर्वं च चिकीर्षितं च.. 18.29 ..
1.3.m: Hearing indeed those words of hers, Viṣṇu, that sole lord of Vaikuṇṭha, / having understood all the actions of the gods at that time, and all that Bali wished to do,

1.3.s:
kiṃ kāryamadyaiva mayā hi kāryaṃ yenaiva devā jayamāpnuvaṃti..
parājayaṃ daityavarāśca sarve viṣṇuḥ parātmaiva viciṃtya sarvam.. 18.30 ..
1.3.d:
किं कार्यमद्यैव मया हि कार्यं येनैव देवा जयमाप्नुवंति..
पराजयं दैत्यवराश्च सर्वे विष्णुः परात्मैव विचिंत्य सर्वम्.. 18.30 ..
1.3.m: [reflected:] 'What deed must be done by me this very day, by which the gods may attain victory, / and all the best of the daityas defeat?' Viṣṇu, the supreme Self, having considered everything,

1.3.s:
gadamuvāca bhagavāngacchasvādya vadhaṃ prati..
vairocaniṃ mahābhāge ghāta yasva tvarānvitā.. 18.31 ..
1.3.d:
गदमुवाच भगवान्गच्छस्वाद्य वधं प्रति..
वैरोचनिं महाभागे घात यस्व त्वरान्विता.. 18.31 ..
1.3.m: the Lord said to the mace: 'Go today to slay him! / O illustrious one, make haste and kill the son of Virocana!'

1.3.s:
gadovāca hṛṣīkeśaṃ prahasantīva bhāminī..
mayā hyaśakyo vadhituṃ brahmaṇyo hi balirmahān.. 18.32 ..
1.3.d:
गदोवाच हृषीकेशं प्रहसन्तीव भामिनी..
मया ह्यशक्यो वधितुं ब्रह्मण्यो हि बलिर्महान्.. 18.32 ..
1.3.m: The mace, like a smiling woman, said to Hṛṣīkeśa: / 'Indeed, the great Bali cannot be slain by me, for he is devoted to brahmins.'

1.3.s:
cakraṃ prati tadā viṣmuruvāca parisāṃtvayan..
tvaṃ gaccha balinaṃ haṃtuṃ śīghrameva sudarśana.. 18.33 ..
1.3.d:
चक्रं प्रति तदा विष्मुरुवाच परिसांत्वयन्..
त्वं गच्छ बलिनं हंतुं शीघ्रमेव सुदर्शन.. 18.33 ..
1.3.m: Then Viṣṇu spoke consolingly to the discus: / 'Go, O Sudarśana, to slay Bali immediately!'

1.3.s:
tadovāca tvareṇaiva cakrapāṇiṃ sudarśanam..
na śakyate mayā haṃtuṃ balinaṃ taṃ mahāprabho.. 18.34 ..
1.3.d:
तदोवाच त्वरेणैव चक्रपाणिं सुदर्शनम्..
न शक्यते मया हंतुं बलिनं तं महाप्रभो.. 18.34 ..
1.3.m: Then Sudarśana swiftly replied to the Discus-handed one: / 'I am not able to kill that Bali, O great Lord!

1.3.s:
brahmaṇyo'si yathā viṣṇo tathāsau daityapuṃgavaḥ..
dhanuṣā ca tathaivoktaḥ śārṅgapāṇiśca vismitaḥ..
ciṃtayāmāsa bahudhā vimṛśya suciraṃ bahu.. 18.35 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मण्योऽसि यथा विष्णो तथासौ दैत्यपुंगवः..
धनुषा च तथैवोक्तः शार्ङ्गपाणिश्च विस्मितः..
चिंतयामास बहुधा विमृश्य सुचिरं बहु.. 18.35 ..
1.3.m: Just as you are devoted to brahmins, O Viṣṇu, so too is that bull among the daityas.' / Addressed likewise by his bow, the one who holds the Śārṅga bow was astonished; / he pondered in many ways, having reflected for a long time.

1.3.s:
..atriruvāca..
tadā te hyasurāḥ sarve kimakurvastaducyatām.. 18.36 ..
1.3.d:
..अत्रिरुवाच..
तदा ते ह्यसुराः सर्वे किमकुर्वस्तदुच्यताम्.. 18.36 ..
1.3.m: Atri said: / 'Then what did all those asuras do? Tell that!'

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
tadā te hyasurāḥ sarve baliprabhṛtayo divi..
rurudhurnagarīṃ ramyāṃ yoddhukāmāḥ puraṃdaram.. 18.37 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
तदा ते ह्यसुराः सर्वे बलिप्रभृतयो दिवि..
रुरुधुर्नगरीं रम्यां योद्धुकामाः पुरंदरम्.. 18.37 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / 'Then all those asuras, led by Bali, in heaven / besieged the lovely city, wishing to fight against Puraṃdara.

1.3.s:
na vidurhyasurāḥ sarve gatāndevāṃstriviṣṭapāt..
nānārūpadharāṃ stasmātkaśyapasyāśrayaṃ prati.. 18.38 ..
1.3.d:
न विदुर्ह्यसुराः सर्वे गतान्देवांस्त्रिविष्टपात्..
नानारूपधरां स्तस्मात्कश्यपस्याश्रयं प्रति.. 18.38 ..
1.3.m: None of the asuras knew that the gods had departed from heaven, / bearing various forms, to the refuge of Kaśyapa.

1.3.s:
prākāramāruhya tadā hi saṃbhramāddaityāḥ sureśaṃ prati haṃtukāmāḥ..
yāvatpraviṣṭā hyamarāvatīṃ tāṃ śūnyāmapaśyanparituṣṭamānasāḥ.. 18.39 ..
1.3.d:
प्राकारमारुह्य तदा हि संभ्रमाद्दैत्याः सुरेशं प्रति हंतुकामाः..
यावत्प्रविष्टा ह्यमरावतीं तां शून्यामपश्यन्परितुष्टमानसाः.. 18.39 ..
1.3.m: Then, having scaled the rampart in haste, the daityas, wishing to slay the lord of the gods, / when they entered Amarāvatī, saw it empty, their minds becoming fully contented.

1.3.s:
iṃdrāsane ca śukreṇa hyabhiṣikto balistadā..
sahābhiṣekavidhinā hyasuraiḥ parivāritaḥ.. 18.40 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्रासने च शुक्रेण ह्यभिषिक्तो बलिस्तदा..
सहाभिषेकविधिना ह्यसुरैः परिवारितः.. 18.40 ..
1.3.m: And Bali was consecrated upon Indra's throne by Śukra / in accordance with the rite of consecration, surrounded by the asuras.

1.3.s:
tathaivādhiṣṭhito rājye balirvairocano mahān..
śuśubhe parayā bhūtyā maheṃdrādhikṛtastadā.. 18.41 ..
1.3.d:
तथैवाधिष्ठितो राज्ये बलिर्वैरोचनो महान्..
शुशुभे परया भूत्या महेंद्राधिकृतस्तदा.. 18.41 ..
1.3.m: Thus established in kingship, the great Bali, son of Virocana, / shone with supreme splendor, having taken over Mahendra's authority.

1.3.s:
nāgaiścāsurasaṃghaiśca sevyamāno maheṃdravat..
suradrumo jitastena kāmadhe nurmaṇistathā.. 18.42 ..
1.3.d:
नागैश्चासुरसंघैश्च सेव्यमानो महेंद्रवत्..
सुरद्रुमो जितस्तेन कामधे नुर्मणिस्तथा.. 18.42 ..
1.3.m: Served by nāgas and hosts of asuras like Mahendra, / he won the wish-fulfilling tree, the wish-granting cow, and the gem.

1.3.s:
dānairddātā ca sarveṣāṃ ye'nye dānitvamāgatāḥ..
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ dānairdātā balirmahān.. 18.43 ..
1.3.d:
दानैर्द्दाता च सर्वेषां येऽन्ये दानित्वमागताः..
सर्वेषामेव भूतानां दानैर्दाता बलिर्महान्.. 18.43 ..
1.3.m: He was the giver among all givers who had attained generosity; / by his gifts, the great Bali was the giver to all living beings.

1.3.s:
yānyānkāmayate kāmāṃ stānsarvānvitaratyasau..
sarvebhyo'pi sa cārthibhyo dānavānāmadhīśvaraḥ.. 18.44 ..
1.3.d:
यान्यान्कामयते कामां स्तान्सर्वान्वितरत्यसौ..
सर्वेभ्योऽपि स चार्थिभ्यो दानवानामधीश्वरः.. 18.44 ..
1.3.m: Whatever desires [anyone] wished for, he granted them all; / to all petitioners alike, he was the sovereign lord of the dānavas.'

1.3.s:
..śaunaka uvāca..
deveṃdro hi mahābhāga na dadāti kadācana..
kathaṃ balirasau dātā kathayasva yathātatham.. 18.45 ..
1.3.d:
..शौनक उवाच..
देवेंद्रो हि महाभाग न ददाति कदाचन..
कथं बलिरसौ दाता कथयस्व यथातथम्.. 18.45 ..
1.3.m: Śaunaka said: / 'Devendra, O illustrious one, never gives. / How is it that this Bali is a giver? Tell [me] truly.'

1.3.s:
.. lomaśa uvāca..
yatnato yena yatkiṃcitkriyate sukṛtaṃ naraiḥ..
śubhaṃ vāpyaśubhaṃ vāpi jñātavyaṃ hi vipaścitā.. 18.46 ..
1.3.d:
.. लोमश उवाच..
यत्नतो येन यत्किंचित्क्रियते सुकृतं नरैः..
शुभं वाप्यशुभं वापि ज्ञातव्यं हि विपश्चिता.. 18.46 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / 'Whatever good deed is performed with effort by men, / whether auspicious or inauspicious, must be understood by the wise.

1.3.s:
śakro hi yājñiko viprā aśvamedhaśatena vai..
prāptarājyo'marāvatyāṃ kevalaṃ bhogalolupaḥ.. 18.47 ..
1.3.d:
शक्रो हि याज्ञिको विप्रा अश्वमेधशतेन वै..
प्राप्तराज्योऽमरावत्यां केवलं भोगलोलुपः.. 18.47 ..
1.3.m: Śakra, O brahmins, was a performer of sacrifices by means of a hundred horse-sacrifices; / having obtained sovereignty in Amarāvatī, he was purely greedy for enjoyments.

1.3.s:
arthitaṃ tatphalaṃ viddhi punaḥ kārpaṇyamāviśat..
punarmaraṇamāviśya kṣīṇapuṇyo bhaviṣyati.. 18.48 ..
1.3.d:
अर्थितं तत्फलं विद्धि पुनः कार्पण्यमाविशत्..
पुनर्मरणमाविश्य क्षीणपुण्यो भविष्यति.. 18.48 ..
1.3.m: Know that when that fruit was sought, stinginess entered [him] again; / entering death once more, he whose merit is exhausted will exist [no more in power].

1.3.s:
ya iṃdra kṛmireva syātkṛmiriṃdro hi jāyate..
tasmāddānātparataraṃ nānyadastīha mocanam.. 18.49 ..
1.3.d:
य इंद्र कृमिरेव स्यात्कृमिरिंद्रो हि जायते..
तस्माद्दानात्परतरं नान्यदस्तीह मोचनम्.. 18.49 ..
1.3.m: He who was Indra may become a worm; indeed, a worm is born as Indra. / Therefore, there is no other release in this world superior to giving.

1.3.s:
dānāddhi prāpyate jñānaṃ jñānānmokṣo na saṃśayaḥ..
mokṣātparatarā bhaktiḥ śūlapāṇau hi vai dvajāḥ.. 18.50 ..
1.3.d:
दानाद्धि प्राप्यते ज्ञानं ज्ञानान्मोक्षो न संशयः..
मोक्षात्परतरा भक्तिः शूलपाणौ हि वै द्वजाः.. 18.50 ..
1.3.m: From giving, knowledge is obtained; from knowledge comes liberation, without doubt. / Higher than liberation is devotion to the Trident-bearing one, O brahmins.

1.3.s:
dadāti sarvaṃ sarveśaḥ prasannātmā sadāśivaḥ..
kiṃcidalpena toyena parituṣyati śaṃkaraḥ.. 18.51 ..
1.3.d:
ददाति सर्वं सर्वेशः प्रसन्नात्मा सदाशिवः..
किंचिदल्पेन तोयेन परितुष्यति शंकरः.. 18.51 ..
1.3.m: The Lord of all, Sadāśiva, pleased in soul, gives everything; / Śaṃkara is thoroughly pleased even with a little water.

1.3.s:
atraivodāharaṃtīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam..
virocanasutenedaṃ kṛtamasti na saṃśayaḥ.. 18.52 ..
1.3.d:
अत्रैवोदाहरंतीममितिहासं पुरातनम्..
विरोचनसुतेनेदं कृतमस्ति न संशयः.. 18.52 ..
1.3.m: In this very connection, they cite this ancient history; / this was performed by the son of Virocana, without doubt.

1.3.s:
kitavo hi mahāpāpo devabrāhmaṇaniṃdakaḥ..
nikṛtyā parayopetaḥ paradārarato mahān.. 18.53 ..
1.3.d:
कितवो हि महापापो देवब्राह्मणनिंदकः..
निकृत्या परयोपेतः परदाररतो महान्.. 18.53 ..
1.3.m: There was a gambler, a great sinner, a reviler of gods and brahmins, / endowed with supreme deceit, greatly devoted to the wives of others.

1.3.s:
ekadā tu mahāpāpātkaitāvācca jitaṃ dhanam..
gaṇikārthe ca puṣpāṇi tāṃbūlaṃ caṃdanaṃ tathā.. 18.54 ..
1.3.d:
एकदा तु महापापात्कैतावाच्च जितं धनम्..
गणिकार्थे च पुष्पाणि तांबूलं चंदनं तथा.. 18.54 ..
1.3.m: Once, however, from his great sin, he won wealth by gambling, / and for the sake of a courtesan, flowers, betel, and sandalwood.

1.3.s:
kaupīnamātraṃ tasyaiva kitavasya pradṛśyate..
karābhyāṃ svastikaṃ kṛtvā gaṃdhamālyādikaṃ ca yat.. 18.55 ..
1.3.d:
कौपीनमात्रं तस्यैव कितवस्य प्रदृश्यते..
कराभ्यां स्वस्तिकं कृत्वा गंधमाल्यादिकं च यत्.. 18.55 ..
1.3.m: Only a loincloth was seen on that gambler; / making a svastika gesture with both hands, the perfume, garlands, and other things that [he had],

1.3.s:
gaṇikārthamupādāya dhāvamāno gṛhaṃ prati..
tadā praskhalito bhūmau nipapāta ca tatkṣaṇāt.. 18.56 ..
1.3.d:
गणिकार्थमुपादाय धावमानो गृहं प्रति..
तदा प्रस्खलितो भूमौ निपपात च तत्क्षणात्.. 18.56 ..
1.3.m: taking them for the courtesan, while running toward her house, / then he slipped on the ground and fell down instantly.

1.3.s:
patanānmūrchayā yuktaḥ kṣaṇamātraṃ tadā'bhavat..
tato mūrchāgatasyāsya pāpino'niṣṭakāriṇaḥ.. 18.57 ..
1.3.d:
पतनान्मूर्छया युक्तः क्षणमात्रं तदाऽभवत्..
ततो मूर्छागतस्यास्य पापिनोऽनिष्टकारिणः.. 18.57 ..
1.3.m: From the fall, he was afflicted with a swoon for just a moment; / then, as he lay unconscious, this sinner and evildoer

1.3.s:
buddhiḥ sadyaḥ samutpannā karmaṇā prāktanena hi..
nirvedaṃ paramāpannaḥ kitavo duḥkhasaṃyutaḥ.. 18.58 ..
1.3.d:
बुद्धिः सद्यः समुत्पन्ना कर्मणा प्राक्तनेन हि..
निर्वेदं परमापन्नः कितवो दुःखसंयुतः.. 18.58 ..
1.3.m: suddenly had understanding arise due to his past action; / having attained supreme despondency, the gambler was filled with sorrow.

1.3.s:
bhūmyāṃ nipatitaṃ yacca gaṃdhapuṣpādikaṃ mahat..
samarpitaṃ śivāyeti kitavenāpyabuddhinā.. 18.59 ..
1.3.d:
भूम्यां निपतितं यच्च गंधपुष्पादिकं महत्..
समर्पितं शिवायेति कितवेनाप्यबुद्धिना.. 18.59 ..
1.3.m: And the great [offering of] perfume, flowers, and the like that had fallen on the ground / was offered with the words, 'Unto Śiva,' even by that mindless gambler.

1.3.s:
citraguptena cākhyātaṃ dattamasti tvayā punaḥ..
patitaṃ caiva dehāṃte śivāya paramātmane.. 18.60 ..
1.3.d:
चित्रगुप्तेन चाख्यातं दत्तमस्ति त्वया पुनः..
पतितं चैव देहांते शिवाय परमात्मने.. 18.60 ..
1.3.m: And it was declared by Citragupta: 'Yet [something] was given by you; / having fallen at the end of life, [it was given] to Śiva, the supreme Self.'

1.3.s:
pacanīyosi me maṃda narakeṣu mahatsu ca..
ityukto dharmarājena kitavo vākyamabravīt.. 18.61 ..
1.3.d:
पचनीयोसि मे मंद नरकेषु महत्सु च..
इत्युक्तो धर्मराजेन कितवो वाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 18.61 ..
1.3.m: 'You are to be cooked by me, fool, in great hells.' / Being addressed thus by the King of Dharma, the gambler spoke these words:

1.3.s:
pāpācāro hi bhagavankaścinnaiva mayā kṛtaḥ..
vimṛśyatāṃ me sukṛtaṃ yāthātathyena bho yama.. 18.62 ..
1.3.d:
पापाचारो हि भगवन्कश्चिन्नैव मया कृतः..
विमृश्यतां मे सुकृतं याथातथ्येन भो यम.. 18.62 ..
1.3.m: 'O Lord, no sinful conduct was committed by me [with evil intent]; / let my good deed be examined truthfully, O Yama!'

1.3.s:
citraguptena cākhyātaṃ dttamasti tvayā punaḥ..
patitaṃ caiva dehāṃte śivāya paramātmane.. 18.63 ..
1.3.d:
चित्रगुप्तेन चाख्यातं द्त्तमस्ति त्वया पुनः..
पतितं चैव देहांते शिवाय परमात्मने.. 18.63 ..
1.3.m: And it was declared by Citragupta: 'Yet [something] was given by you; / having fallen at the end of life, [it was given] to Śiva, the supreme Self.

1.3.s:
tena karmavipākena ghaṭikātrayameva ca ..
śacīpateḥ padaṃ viddhi prāpsyasi tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ.. 18.64 ..
1.3.d:
तेन कर्मविपाकेन घटिकात्रयमेव च ..
शचीपतेः पदं विद्धि प्राप्स्यसि त्वं न संशयः.. 18.64 ..
1.3.m: By the ripening of that action, know that for three ghaṭikās / you will attain the station of Śacī's husband; there is no doubt.'

1.3.s:
āgatastatkṣaṇāddevaḥ survaiḥ samanvitaḥ..
airāvataṃ samārūḍho nīto'sau śakramaṃdiram..
śakraḥ prabodhitastena guruṇā bhāvitātmanā.. 18.65 ..
1.3.d:
आगतस्तत्क्षणाद्देवः सुर्वैः समन्वितः..
ऐरावतं समारूढो नीतोऽसौ शक्रमंदिरम्..
शक्रः प्रबोधितस्तेन गुरुणा भावितात्मना.. 18.65 ..
1.3.m: At that very moment, the god [Bṛhaspati] arrived, accompanied by the deities. / Mounted on Airāvata, he was led to the abode of Śakra. / Śakra was enlightened by that guru whose self was cultivated: 18.65

1.3.s:
ghaṭikātritayaṃ yāvattāvatkālaṃ puraṃdara..
nijāsane'pi saṃsthāpyaḥ kitavo'pi mamājñayā.. 18.66 ..
1.3.d:
घटिकात्रितयं यावत्तावत्कालं पुरंदर..
निजासनेऽपि संस्थाप्यः कितवोऽपि ममाज्ञया.. 18.66 ..
1.3.m: "O Puraṃdara, for the duration of three ghaṭikās, / even this gambler must be installed upon your own seat by my command." 18.66

1.3.s:
gurorvacanamārkarṇya kṛtvā śirasi tatkṣaṇāt..
gato'nvatraiva śakro'sau kitavo hi praveśitaḥ..
bhavanaṃ devarājasya nānāścaryasamanvitam.. 18.67 ..
1.3.d:
गुरोर्वचनमार्कर्ण्य कृत्वा शिरसि तत्क्षणात्..
गतोऽन्वत्रैव शक्रोऽसौ कितवो हि प्रवेशितः..
भवनं देवराजस्य नानाश्चर्यसमन्वितम्.. 18.67 ..
1.3.m: Having heard the guru's word and placed it upon his head at that moment, / that Śakra went elsewhere, and the gambler was indeed ushered into / the palace of the king of the gods, filled with diverse wonders. 18.67

1.3.s:
śakrāsane'bhiṣikto'sau rājyaṃ prāptaḥ śatakratoḥ..
śaṃbhorgaṃdhapradānācca puṣpatāṃbūlasaṃyutam.. 18.68 ..
1.3.d:
शक्रासनेऽभिषिक्तोऽसौ राज्यं प्राप्तः शतक्रतोः..
शंभोर्गंधप्रदानाच्च पुष्पतांबूलसंयुतम्.. 18.68 ..
1.3.m: He was consecrated upon Śakra's throne and attained the sovereignty of Śatakratu, / merely on account of offering perfume accompanied by flowers and betel to Śambhu. 18.68

1.3.s:
kiṃ punaḥ śraddhayā yuktāḥ śivāya paramātmane..
arpayaṃti sadā bhaktyā gaṃdhapūṣpādikaṃ mahat.. 18.69 ..
1.3.d:
किं पुनः श्रद्धया युक्ताः शिवाय परमात्मने..
अर्पयंति सदा भक्त्या गंधपूष्पादिकं महत्.. 18.69 ..
1.3.m: How much more so for those endowed with faith, who always with devotion / offer supreme perfume, flowers, and the like to Śiva, the Supreme Self! 18.69

1.3.s:
śivasāyujyamāyātāḥ śivasenāsamanvitāḥ..
prāpnuvaṃti mahāmodaṃ śakro hyeṣāṃ ca kiṃkaraḥ.. 18.70 ..
1.3.d:
शिवसायुज्यमायाताः शिवसेनासमन्विताः..
प्राप्नुवंति महामोदं शक्रो ह्येषां च किंकरः.. 18.70 ..
1.3.m: Attaining complete absorption in Śiva and united with Śiva's retinue, / they attain supreme joy, and Śakra is indeed their servant. 18.70

1.3.s:
śivapūjāratānāṃ ca yatsukhaṃ śāṃtacetasām..
brahmaśakrādikānāṃ ca tatsukhaṃ durlabhaṃ mahat.. 18.71 ..
1.3.d:
शिवपूजारतानां च यत्सुखं शांतचेतसाम्..
ब्रह्मशक्रादिकानां च तत्सुखं दुर्लभं महत्.. 18.71 ..
1.3.m: And the joy of those who are devoted to the worship of Śiva, whose minds are tranquil— / even for Brahmā, Śakra, and others, that supreme joy is hard to attain. 18.71

1.3.s:
varākāste na jānaṃti mūḍhā viṣayalolupāḥ..
vaṃdanīyo mahādevo hyarcanīyaḥ sadāśivaḥ.. 18.72 ..
1.3.d:
वराकास्ते न जानंति मूढा विषयलोलुपाः..
वंदनीयो महादेवो ह्यर्चनीयः सदाशिवः.. 18.72 ..
1.3.m: Those wretched fools, greedy for sense objects, do not know / that Mahādeva is to be saluted, that Sadāśiva is to be worshipped. 18.72

1.3.s:
pūjanīyo mahādevaḥ prāṇibhistattvavedibhiḥ..
tasmādiṃdratvamagamatkitavo ghaṭikātrayam.. 18.73 ..
1.3.d:
पूजनीयो महादेवः प्राणिभिस्तत्त्ववेदिभिः..
तस्मादिंद्रत्वमगमत्कितवो घटिकात्रयम्.. 18.73 ..
1.3.m: Mahādeva is to be worshipped by living beings who know the truth. / Therefore, the gambler attained the status of Indra for three ghaṭikās. 18.73

1.3.s:
purodhasābhiṣikto'sau puraṃdarapade sthitaḥ..
tadānīṃ nāradenoktaḥ kitavo'sau mahāyaśāḥ.. 18.74 ..
1.3.d:
पुरोधसाभिषिक्तोऽसौ पुरंदरपदे स्थितः..
तदानीं नारदेनोक्तः कितवोऽसौ महायशाः.. 18.74 ..
1.3.m: Consecrated by the family priest, he was seated in the post of Puraṃdara. / Then that illustrious gambler was addressed by Nārada: 18.74

1.3.s:
indrāṇīmānayastveti yathā rājyaṃ suśobhitam..
tataḥ prahasya covāca kitavaḥ śivavallabhaḥ.. 18.75 ..
1.3.d:
इन्द्राणीमानयस्त्वेति यथा राज्यं सुशोभितम्..
ततः प्रहस्य चोवाच कितवः शिववल्लभः.. 18.75 ..
1.3.m: "Bring Indrāṇī here, so that your kingdom may be fully adorned." / Thereupon, laughing, the gambler who was dear to Śiva said: 18.75

1.3.s:
indrāṇyā nāsti me kāryaṃ na vācyaṃ te mahāmate..
evamuktvātha kitavaḥ pradātumupacakrame.. 18.76 ..
1.3.d:
इन्द्राण्या नास्ति मे कार्यं न वाच्यं ते महामते..
एवमुक्त्वाथ कितवः प्रदातुमुपचक्रमे.. 18.76 ..
1.3.m: "I have no business with Indrāṇī; you must not speak [thus], O highly wise one!" / Having spoken thus, the gambler then began to make gifts. 18.76

1.3.s:
airāvatamagastyāya pradadau śivavallabhaḥ..
viśvāmitrāya kitavo dadau hayamudāradhīḥ.. 18.77 ..
1.3.d:
ऐरावतमगस्त्याय प्रददौ शिववल्लभः..
विश्वामित्राय कितवो ददौ हयमुदारधीः.. 18.77 ..
1.3.m: The gambler, dear to Śiva, gave Airāvata to Agastya; / the generous-minded one gave the horse to Viśvāmitra. 18.77

1.3.s:
uccaiḥśravasasaṃjñaṃ ca kāmadhenuṃ mahāyaśāḥ..
dadau vaśiṣṭhāya tadā ciṃtāmaṇiṃ mahāprabham.. 18.78 ..
1.3.d:
उच्चैःश्रवससंज्ञं च कामधेनुं महायशाः..
ददौ वशिष्ठाय तदा चिंतामणिं महाप्रभम्.. 18.78 ..
1.3.m: The renowned one gave [the horse] named Uccaiḥśravas, Kāmadhenu, / and the brilliantly radiant Cintāmaṇi gem to Vasiṣṭha at that time. 18.78

1.3.s:
gālavāya mahātejāstadā kalpataruṃ ca saḥ..
kauṃḍinyāya mahābhāgaḥ kitavopi gṛhaṃ tadā.. 18.79
evamādīnyanekāni ratnāni vividhāni ca..
dadāvṛṣibhyo muditaḥ śivaprītyarthameva ca.. 18.80 ..
1.3.d:
गालवाय महातेजास्तदा कल्पतरुं च सः..
कौंडिन्याय महाभागः कितवोपि गृहं तदा.. 18.79
एवमादीन्यनेकानि रत्नानि विविधानि च..
ददावृषिभ्यो मुदितः शिवप्रीत्यर्थमेव च.. 18.80 ..
1.3.m: The exceedingly lustrous one then gave the wishing tree to Gālava, / and the highly fortunate gambler gave the palace to Kauṇḍinya. 18.79 / In this manner, he gave numerous other varieties of jewels / to the ṛṣis with a joyful heart, solely for the pleasure of Śiva. 18.80

1.3.s:
ghaṭitakātritayaṃ yāvattāvatkālaṃ dadau prabhuḥ..
ghaṭikātritayādūdhva pūrvasvāmī samāgataḥ.. 18.81 ..
1.3.d:
घटितकात्रितयं यावत्तावत्कालं ददौ प्रभुः..
घटिकात्रितयादूध्व पूर्वस्वामी समागतः.. 18.81 ..
1.3.m: The lord made gifts for the full duration of three ghaṭikās. / After the three ghaṭikās, the previous master returned. 18.81

1.3.s:
puraṃdaro'marāvatyāmupaviśya nijāsane..
ṛṣibhiḥ saṃstutaścaiva śacyā saha tadā'bhavat.. 18.82 ..
1.3.d:
पुरंदरोऽमरावत्यामुपविश्य निजासने..
ऋषिभिः संस्तुतश्चैव शच्या सह तदाऽभवत्.. 18.82 ..
1.3.m: Sitting on his own seat in Amarāvatī, / Puraṃdara was praised by the ṛṣis, and then he was with Śacī. 18.82

1.3.s:
śacīmuvāca durmedhāḥ kitavenāsi bhāmini..
bhuktā hyasyaiva kathaya yāthātathyena śobhane.. 18.83 ..
1.3.d:
शचीमुवाच दुर्मेधाः कितवेनासि भामिनि..
भुक्ता ह्यस्यैव कथय याथातथ्येन शोभने.. 18.83 ..
1.3.m: The evil-minded one said to Śacī: "O radiant woman, have you / been enjoyed by that gambler? Tell me truthfully, O beautiful one!" 18.83

1.3.s:
tadā prahasya covāca puraṃdaramakalmaṣā..
ātmaupamyena sarvatra paśyati tvaṃ puraṃdara.. 18.84 ..
1.3.d:
तदा प्रहस्य चोवाच पुरंदरमकल्मषा..
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र पश्यति त्वं पुरंदर.. 18.84 ..
1.3.m: Then the sinless woman laughed and said to Puraṃdara: / "You look upon everyone as like yourself, O Puraṃdara! 18.84

1.3.s:
asau mahātmā kitavasvarūpī śivaprasādātparamārthavijñaḥ..
vai rāgyayukto hi mahānubhāvo yenāpi sarvaṃ paramaṃ prapannam.. 18.85 ..
1.3.d:
असौ महात्मा कितवस्वरूपी शिवप्रसादात्परमार्थविज्ञः..
वै राग्ययुक्तो हि महानुभावो येनापि सर्वं परमं प्रपन्नम्.. 18.85 ..
1.3.m: That great soul in the form of a gambler, through Śiva's grace knowing the highest reality, / endowed with dispassion, of great dignity, by whom even everything supreme was attained, 18.85

1.3.s: rājyādikaṃ mohamayaṃ ca pāśaṃ tyaktā parebhyo vijayī sa jātaḥ.. 18.86 ..
1.3.d: राज्यादिकं मोहमयं च पाशं त्यक्ता परेभ्यो विजयी स जातः.. 18.86 ..
1.3.m: relinquishing sovereignty and the like, which are snares consisting of delusion, to others, has become victorious!" 18.86

1.3.s:
vaco niśamya deveśa iṃdrāṇyāḥ sa puraṃdaraḥ..
vrīḍāyukto'bhavattūṣṇīmiṃdrāsanagatastadā.. 18.87 ..
1.3.d:
वचो निशम्य देवेश इंद्राण्याः स पुरंदरः..
व्रीडायुक्तोऽभवत्तूष्णीमिंद्रासनगतस्तदा.. 18.87 ..
1.3.m: Hearing the words of Indrāṇī, Puraṃdara, the lord of the gods, / became filled with shame and remained silent, seated upon Indra's throne. 18.87

1.3.s:
bṛhaspatimuvācedaṃ vākyaṃ vākyavidāṃ varaḥ..
airāvato na dṛśyeta tathaivoccaiḥśravā hayaḥ.. 18.88 ..
1.3.d:
बृहस्पतिमुवाचेदं वाक्यं वाक्यविदां वरः..
ऐरावतो न दृश्येत तथैवोच्चैःश्रवा हयः.. 18.88 ..
1.3.m: The best among the eloquent spoke these words to Bṛhaspati: / "Airāvata is not to be seen, nor the horse Uccaiḥśravas. 18.88

1.3.s:
pārijātādayaḥ sarve padārthāḥ kena vā hṛtāḥ..
gururuvācedaṃ kitavena kṛtaṃ mahat.. 18.89 ..
1.3.d:
पारिजातादयः सर्वे पदार्थाः केन वा हृताः..
गुरुरुवाचेदं कितवेन कृतं महत्.. 18.89 ..
1.3.m: By whom have all the objects, beginning with Pārijāta, been taken away?" / The guru said: "This great deed was done by the gambler. 18.89

1.3.s:
ṛṣibhyo datta madyaiva yāvatsattā hi tasya vai..
svasattāyāṃ mahatyāṃ ca svasattā ye bhavaṃti ca.. 18.90 ..
1.3.d:
ऋषिभ्यो दत्त मद्यैव यावत्सत्ता हि तस्य वै..
स्वसत्तायां महत्यां च स्वसत्ता ये भवंति च.. 18.90 ..
1.3.m: He gave them to the ṛṣis this very day, as long as he held power. / Those who hold authority within their own great dominion, 18.90

1.3.s:
apramāttāśca ye nityaṃ śivadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ..
te priyāḥ śaṃkarasyaiva hitvā karmaphalāni vai..
kevalaṃ jñānamāśritya te yāṃti paramaṃ padam.. 18.91 ..
1.3.d:
अप्रमात्ताश्च ये नित्यं शिवध्यानपरायणाः..
ते प्रियाः शंकरस्यैव हित्वा कर्मफलानि वै..
केवलं ज्ञानमाश्रित्य ते यांति परमं पदम्.. 18.91 ..
1.3.m: and who are ever unheedful and devoted to meditating upon Śiva— / they alone are dear to Śaṃkara; having renounced the fruits of their actions / and taking refuge in pure knowledge alone, they attain the supreme state." 18.91

1.3.s:
etacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya ceṃdro bṛhaspatervākyamidaṃ vabhāṣe..
prāyo yamo vakṣyati sarvametatsamṛddhaye hyātmanaścaiva śakraḥ.. 18.92 ..
1.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य चेंद्रो बृहस्पतेर्वाक्यमिदं वभाषे..
प्रायो यमो वक्ष्यति सर्वमेतत्समृद्धये ह्यात्मनश्चैव शक्रः.. 18.92 ..
1.3.m: Hearing these words of his, Śakra Indra spoke this sentence to Bṛhaspati: / "Yama will probably explain all this for my own prosperity." 18.92

1.3.s:
tatheti matvā guruṇā sahaiva rājā surāṇāṃ sahasā jagāma..
svakāryakāmo hi tathā puraṃdaro yayau purīṃ saṃyaminīṃ tadānīm.. 18.93 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा गुरुणा सहैव राजा सुराणां सहसा जगाम..
स्वकार्यकामो हि तथा पुरंदरो ययौ पुरीं संयमिनीं तदानीम्.. 18.93 ..
1.3.m: Thinking 'So be it,' the king of the gods went quickly with his guru. / Desiring his own business [to be resolved], Puraṃdara then went to the city of Saṃyaminī. 18.93

1.3.s:
yamena pūjyamāno hi śakro vākyamuvāca ha..
tvayā dattaṃ mama padaṃ kitavāya durātmane.. 18.94 ..
1.3.d:
यमेन पूज्यमानो हि शक्रो वाक्यमुवाच ह..
त्वया दत्तं मम पदं कितवाय दुरात्मने.. 18.94 ..
1.3.m: Being honored by Yama, Śakra indeed said these words: / "My station was given by you to that wicked gambler. 18.94

1.3.s:
anenaitatkṛtaṃ karmma jugupsitaṃ mahattaram..
madīyāni ca ratnāni yāni sarvāṇyanena vai..
ebhya ebhyaḥ pradattāni dharmma jānīhi tattvataḥ.. 18.95 ..
1.3.d:
अनेनैतत्कृतं कर्म्म जुगुप्सितं महत्तरम्..
मदीयानि च रत्नानि यानि सर्वाण्यनेन वै..
एभ्य एभ्यः प्रदत्तानि धर्म्म जानीहि तत्त्वतः.. 18.95 ..
1.3.m: A most reprehensible, terrible deed has been committed by him! / All my jewels have been given away by him / to this one and that one; know this in truth, O Dharma! 18.95

1.3.s:
tvaṃ dharmanāmāsi kathaṃ kitavāya pradattavān..
mama rājyavināśāya kṛtamasti tvayā'dhunā.. 18.96 ..
1.3.d:
त्वं धर्मनामासि कथं कितवाय प्रदत्तवान्..
मम राज्यविनाशाय कृतमस्ति त्वयाऽधुना.. 18.96 ..
1.3.m: Your name is Dharma: how did you give it to a gambler? / Now you have brought about the destruction of my kingdom! 18.96

1.3.s:
ānayasva mahābhāga gajādīni ca satvaram..
anyāni caiva ratnāni dattāni ca yatastataḥ.. 18.97 ..
1.3.d:
आनयस्व महाभाग गजादीनि च सत्वरम्..
अन्यानि चैव रत्नानि दत्तानि च यतस्ततः.. 18.97 ..
1.3.m: Bring back quickly, O highly fortunate one, the elephant and other [possessions], / and the other gems given here and there!" 18.97

1.3.s:
niśamya vākyaṃ śakrasya yamo vacanamabravīt..
kitavaṃ ca ruṣāviṣṭaḥ kiṃ tvayā pāpinā kṛtam.. 18.98 ..
1.3.d:
निशम्य वाक्यं शक्रस्य यमो वचनमब्रवीत्..
कितवं च रुषाविष्टः किं त्वया पापिना कृतम्.. 18.98 ..
1.3.m: Hearing the words of Śakra, Yama, seized with wrath, / spoke these words to the gambler: "What have you done, you sinner? 18.98

1.3.s:
bhogārthaṃ caiva yaddattaṃ śakrarājyaṃ tvayā'dhun..
pradattaṃ ca dvijātibhyo hyanyathā vai kṛtaṃ mahat.. 18.99 ..
1.3.d:
भोगार्थं चैव यद्दत्तं शक्रराज्यं त्वयाऽधुन्..
प्रदत्तं च द्विजातिभ्यो ह्यन्यथा वै कृतं महत्.. 18.99 ..
1.3.m: The sovereignty of Śakra was given to you now for enjoyment, / but you have given it away to the twice-born! A great wrong was done! 18.99

1.3.s:
akāryaṃ vai tvayā mūḍha paradravyāpahāraṇam..
tena pāpena mahatā nirayaṃ pratigacchasi.. 18.100 ..
1.3.d:
अकार्यं वै त्वया मूढ परद्रव्यापहारणम्..
तेन पापेन महता निरयं प्रतिगच्छसि.. 18.100 ..
1.3.m: An improper deed was done by you, fool—the theft of another's property! / By that great sin you will go to hell." 18.100

1.3.s:
yamasya vacanaṃ śrutvā kitavo vākyamabravīt..
ahaṃ nirayagāmī ca nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 18.101 ..
1.3.d:
यमस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा कितवो वाक्यमब्रवीत्..
अहं निरयगामी च नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 18.101 ..
1.3.m: Hearing Yama's words, the gambler spoke: / "I am bound for hell; there should be no doubt about this. 18.101

1.3.s:
yāvatsvatā mama vibho jātā śakrāsane tathā..
tāvaddattaṃ hi yatkiṃciddvijebhyo hi yathātatham.. 18.102 ..
1.3.d:
यावत्स्वता मम विभो जाता शक्रासने तथा..
तावद्दत्तं हि यत्किंचिद्द्विजेभ्यो हि यथातथम्.. 18.102 ..
1.3.m: As long as my ownership lasted on the throne of Śakra, O lord, / so long whatever [there was] was given properly to the twice-born." 18.102

1.3.s:
.. yama uvāca..
dānaṃ praśastaṃ bhūmyāṃ ca dṛśyate karmmaṇaḥ phalam..
svarge dānaṃ na dātavyaṃ kenacitkasyacitkvacit..
tasmāddaṃḍyo'si re mūḍha aśāstrīyaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā.. 18.103 ..
1.3.d:
.. यम उवाच..
दानं प्रशस्तं भूम्यां च दृश्यते कर्म्मणः फलम्..
स्वर्गे दानं न दातव्यं केनचित्कस्यचित्क्वचित्..
तस्माद्दंड्योऽसि रे मूढ अशास्त्रीयं कृतं त्वया.. 18.103 ..
1.3.m: Yama said: / "Gift-giving is praised on earth, where the fruit of action is seen. / In heaven, no gift is to be given by anyone to anyone at any time. / Therefore you are to be punished, you fool! You acted against the scriptures. 18.103

1.3.s:
gururātmavatāṃ śāstā rājā śāstāḥ durātmanām..
sarveṣāṃ pāpaśīlānāṃ śāsta'haṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 18.104 ..
1.3.d:
गुरुरात्मवतां शास्ता राजा शास्ताः दुरात्मनाम्..
सर्वेषां पापशीलानां शास्तऽहं नात्र संशयः.. 18.104 ..
1.3.m: The guru is the punisher of the self-restrained; the king is the punisher of the wicked; / I am the punisher of all who are of sinful conduct—there is no doubt about this." 18.104

1.3.s:
evaṃ nirbhartsayitvā taṃ kitavaṃ dharmarāṭ‌svayam..
uvāca citraguptaṃ ca narake pacyatāmayam..
tadā prahasya covāca citragupto yamaṃ prati.. 18.105 ..
1.3.d:
एवं निर्भर्त्सयित्वा तं कितवं धर्मराट्‌स्वयम्..
उवाच चित्रगुप्तं च नरके पच्यतामयम्..
तदा प्रहस्य चोवाच चित्रगुप्तो यमं प्रति.. 18.105 ..
1.3.m: Having thus rebuked the gambler, the king of dharma himself / said to Citragupta: "Let him be cooked in hell!" / Then, laughing, Citragupta said to Yama: 18.105

1.3.s:
kathaṃ nirayagāmitvaṃ kitavasya bhaviṣyati..
yena datto hyagastyāya gaja airāvato mahān.. 18.106 ..
1.3.d:
कथं निरयगामित्वं कितवस्य भविष्यति..
येन दत्तो ह्यगस्त्याय गज ऐरावतो महान्.. 18.106 ..
1.3.m: "How could the gambler go to hell, / by whom the great elephant Airāvata was indeed given to Agastya,

1.3.s:
tathāśvo hyabdhisaṃbhūto gālavāya mahātmane..
viśvāmitrāya bhadraṃ te ciṃtāmaṇirmahāprabhaḥ.. 18.107 ..
1.3.d:
तथाश्वो ह्यब्धिसंभूतो गालवाय महात्मने..
विश्वामित्राय भद्रं ते चिंतामणिर्महाप्रभः.. 18.107 ..
1.3.m: and likewise the horse born of the ocean to the great-souled Gālava, / and—blessings upon you!—the brightly shining wish-granting jewel to Viśvāmitra?

1.3.s:
evamādīni ratnāni dattāni kitevana hi..
tena karmavipākena pūjanīyo jagattraye.. 18.108 ..
1.3.d:
एवमादीनि रत्नानि दत्तानि कितेवन हि..
तेन कर्मविपाकेन पूजनीयो जगत्त्रये.. 18.108 ..
1.3.m: Such and other jewels were given by the gambler; / by that fruition of actions he is worthy of worship in the three worlds.

1.3.s:
śivamuddiśya yadattaṃ svarge martye ca yairnaraiḥ..
tatsarvaṃ tvakṣayaṃ vidyānniśchidraṃ karma cocyate..
tasmānnarakagāmitvaṃ kitavasya na vidyate.. 18.109 ..
1.3.d:
शिवमुद्दिश्य यदत्तं स्वर्गे मर्त्ये च यैर्नरैः..
तत्सर्वं त्वक्षयं विद्यान्निश्छिद्रं कर्म चोच्यते..
तस्मान्नरकगामित्वं कितवस्य न विद्यते.. 18.109 ..
1.3.m: Whatever is given by men dedicated to Śiva in heaven and on earth, / all that should be known as imperishable; and the deed is called flawless. / Therefore, the gambler does not go to hell.

1.3.s:
yāniyāni ca pāpāni kitavasya mahātmanaḥ..
bhasmībhūtāni sarvāṇi jātāni smaraṇācca vai.. 18.110 ..
1.3.d:
यानियानि च पापानि कितवस्य महात्मनः..
भस्मीभूतानि सर्वाणि जातानि स्मरणाच्च वै.. 18.110 ..
1.3.m: Whatever sins the great-souled gambler had, / all have been reduced to ashes indeed through remembrance [of Śiva].

1.3.s:
śaṃbhoḥ prasādātsarvāṇi sukṛtāni ca tatkṣaṇāt..
tadvacaścitraguptasya niśamya pretarāṭ svayam.. 18.111 ..
1.3.d:
शंभोः प्रसादात्सर्वाणि सुकृतानि च तत्क्षणात्..
तद्वचश्चित्रगुप्तस्य निशम्य प्रेतराट् स्वयम्.. 18.111 ..
1.3.m: By the grace of Śambhu, all [became] virtuous deeds at that very instant." / Hearing that speech of Citragupta, the King of the Dead himself,

1.3.s:
prahasyāvāṅ‌mukho bhūtvā ida māha śatakratum..
tvaṃ hi rājā sureṃdrāṇāṃ sthaviro rājyalaṃpaṭaḥ.. 18.112 ..
1.3.d:
प्रहस्यावाङ्‌मुखो भूत्वा इद माह शतक्रतुम्..
त्वं हि राजा सुरेंद्राणां स्थविरो राज्यलंपटः.. 18.112 ..
1.3.m: smiling and bowing his head, said this to Śatakratu (Indra): / "You are indeed the king of the chiefs of the gods, an elder clinging to your sovereignty.

1.3.s:
aśvamedhaśatenaiva ekaṃ janmārjitaṃ kṛtam..
tvayā nāstyatra saṃdeho hyarjjitaṃ tena vai mahat.. 18.113 ..
1.3.d:
अश्वमेधशतेनैव एकं जन्मार्जितं कृतम्..
त्वया नास्त्यत्र संदेहो ह्यर्ज्जितं तेन वै महत्.. 18.113 ..
1.3.m: Through a hundred horse-sacrifices, a single [such] birth has been earned and made / by you; there is no doubt here, by that a great thing has been acquired.

1.3.s:
prārthayitvā hyagastyādīnmunīnsarvānviśeṣataḥ..
arthena praṇipātena tvayā labhyāni tāni ca..
gajādikāni ratnāni yena tvaṃ ca sukhī tvaran.. 18.114 ..
1.3.d:
प्रार्थयित्वा ह्यगस्त्यादीन्मुनीन्सर्वान्विशेषतः..
अर्थेन प्रणिपातेन त्वया लभ्यानि तानि च..
गजादिकानि रत्नानि येन त्वं च सुखी त्वरन्.. 18.114 ..
1.3.m: Having petitioned all the sages, especially Agastya and others, / with wealth and prostration, you must obtain those jewels, / the elephant and the rest, so that you may quickly become happy."

1.3.s:
tatheti matvā vacanaṃ puraṃdaro gataḥ purīṃ svāmavivekadṛṣṭiḥ..
abhyarthayāmāsa vinamrakaṃdharaścarṣīstato labdhavānpārijātam.. 18.115 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा वचनं पुरंदरो गतः पुरीं स्वामविवेकदृष्टिः..
अभ्यर्थयामास विनम्रकंधरश्चर्षीस्ततो लब्धवान्पारिजातम्.. 18.115 ..
1.3.m: Thinking 'So be it' to this word, Puraṃdara went to his city, his discernment obscured; / with bent neck he besought the seers, and thereupon obtained the Pārijāta tree.

1.3.s:
anenaiva prakāreṇa labdharājyaḥ puraṃdaraḥ..
jātastadāmarāvatyāṃ rājā saha mahātmabhiḥ.. 18.116 ..
1.3.d:
अनेनैव प्रकारेण लब्धराज्यः पुरंदरः..
जातस्तदामरावत्यां राजा सह महात्मभिः.. 18.116 ..
1.3.m: In this very manner Puraṃdara, having regained his sovereignty, / became king in Amarāvatī together with the great-souled ones.

1.3.s:
kitavasya punarjanma dattaṃ vaivasvatena hi..
kiṃcitakarmavipākena virocanasuto'bhavat.. 18.117 ..
1.3.d:
कितवस्य पुनर्जन्म दत्तं वैवस्वतेन हि..
किंचितकर्मविपाकेन विरोचनसुतोऽभवत्.. 18.117 ..
1.3.m: A rebirth was indeed given to the gambler by the son of Vivasvat (Yama); / through a small fruition of action, he became the son of Virocana.

1.3.s:
surucirjananī tasya kitavasyābhavattadā..
virocanasya mahiṣī duhitā vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ..
tasthau jaṭharamāsthāya tasyāḥ so'pi mahātmanaḥ.. 18.118 ..
1.3.d:
सुरुचिर्जननी तस्य कितवस्याभवत्तदा..
विरोचनस्य महिषी दुहिता वृषपर्वणः..
तस्थौ जठरमास्थाय तस्याः सोऽपि महात्मनः.. 18.118 ..
1.3.m: Suruci was then the mother of that gambler, / the queen of Virocana, daughter of Vṛṣaparvan; / he too dwelt entering the womb of that noble woman.

1.3.s:
tadāprabhṛti tasyaiva prahlādasyātmajātsa vai..
suruceśca tathāpyāsīddharmedāne mahāmatiḥ.. 18.119 ..
1.3.d:
तदाप्रभृति तस्यैव प्रह्लादस्यात्मजात्स वै..
सुरुचेश्च तथाप्यासीद्धर्मेदाने महामतिः.. 18.119 ..
1.3.m: From that time forward, [born] from the son of Prahlāda / and from Suruci, he was greatly devoted to righteousness and charity.

1.3.s:
tenaiva jaṭharasthena kṛtā matiranuttamā..
kitavena kṛtā viprā durlabhā yā manīṣiṇām.. 18.120 ..
1.3.d:
तेनैव जठरस्थेन कृता मतिरनुत्तमा..
कितवेन कृता विप्रा दुर्लभा या मनीषिणाम्.. 18.120 ..
1.3.m: While remaining in the womb, an unsurpassed resolve was made / by that gambler, O brahmins, one difficult to attain even for the wise.

1.3.s:
ekadā vai tadā śakro yayau vairocanaṃ prati..
haṃtukāmo hi daityeṃdraṃ vipro bhūtvā'tha yācakaḥ.. 18.121 ..
1.3.d:
एकदा वै तदा शक्रो ययौ वैरोचनं प्रति..
हंतुकामो हि दैत्येंद्रं विप्रो भूत्वाऽथ याचकः.. 18.121 ..
1.3.m: Once upon a time, Śakra went to the son of Virocana; / wishing to kill the lord of the Daityas, he became a mendicant brahmin.

1.3.s:
virocanagṛhaṃ prāpta iṃdro vākyamuvāca ha..
sthaviro brāhmaṇo bhūtvā dehīti mama suvrata..
manasvī tvaṃ ca daityeṃdra dātā ca bhuvanatraye.. 18.122 ..
1.3.d:
विरोचनगृहं प्राप्त इंद्रो वाक्यमुवाच ह..
स्थविरो ब्राह्मणो भूत्वा देहीति मम सुव्रत..
मनस्वी त्वं च दैत्येंद्र दाता च भुवनत्रये.. 18.122 ..
1.3.m: Arriving at Virocana's house, Indra spoke these words: / having become an elderly brahmin, [he said,] "Give to me, O you of noble vows! / You are high-minded, O lord of the Daityas, and a giver in the three worlds.

1.3.s:
tava viprā mahābhāga caritaṃ paramādbhutam..
varṇayanti samā jeṣu sthitvā kīrti ca nirmalām..
yācako'haṃ ca daityeṃdra dāturarmahasi suvrata.. 18.123 ..
1.3.d:
तव विप्रा महाभाग चरितं परमाद्भुतम्..
वर्णयन्ति समा जेषु स्थित्वा कीर्ति च निर्मलाम्..
याचकोऽहं च दैत्येंद्र दातुरर्महसि सुव्रत.. 18.123 ..
1.3.m: O highly fortunate one, brahmins standing in assemblies praise / your most wondrous conduct and spotless fame. / I am a petitioner, O lord of the Daityas; you ought to give, O you of noble vows!"

1.3.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā daityeṃdro vākyamabravīt..
kiṃ dātavyaṃ tava vibho vada śīghraṃ mamādhunā.. 18.124 ..
1.3.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दैत्येंद्रो वाक्यमब्रवीत्..
किं दातव्यं तव विभो वद शीघ्रं ममाधुना.. 18.124 ..
1.3.m: Hearing his words, the lord of the Daityas spoke: / "What must be given to you, O lord? Tell me quickly now."

1.3.s:
iṃdro hi viprarūpeṇa virocanamuvāca ha..
yācayāmi ca daityeṃdra yadahaṃ paribhāvitaḥ.. 18.125 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्रो हि विप्ररूपेण विरोचनमुवाच ह..
याचयामि च दैत्येंद्र यदहं परिभावितः.. 18.125 ..
1.3.m: Indra, in the guise of a brahmin, spoke to Virocana: / "I ask, O lord of the Daityas, for that which I have contemplated;

1.3.s:
ātmaprītyā ca dātavyaṃ mama nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ..
uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ prahlādasyātmajo'suraḥ.. 18.126 ..
1.3.d:
आत्मप्रीत्या च दातव्यं मम नास्त्यत्र संशयः..
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं प्रह्लादस्यात्मजोऽसुरः.. 18.126 ..
1.3.m: and out of love for yourself it must be given to me, there is no doubt of this." / Smiling, the Asura, the son of Prahlāda, uttered these words:

1.3.s:
dadāmyātmaśiro vipra yadi kāmayase'dhunā..
idaṃ rājyamanāyāsamiyaṃ śrīrnānyagāminī..
ahaṃ samarpayiṣyāmi tava nāstyatra saśayaḥ.. 18.127 ..
1.3.d:
ददाम्यात्मशिरो विप्र यदि कामयसेऽधुना..
इदं राज्यमनायासमियं श्रीर्नान्यगामिनी..
अहं समर्पयिष्यामि तव नास्त्यत्र सशयः.. 18.127 ..
1.3.m: "I give my own head, O brahmin, if you desire it now! / This effortless kingdom, this fortune that does not depart elsewhere— / I will hand it over to you; there is no doubt about this."

1.3.s:
ityuktastena daityena vimṛśya ca tadā hariḥ..
uvāca dehi me svīyaṃ śiro mukuṭasevitam.. 18.128 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युक्तस्तेन दैत्येन विमृश्य च तदा हरिः..
उवाच देहि मे स्वीयं शिरो मुकुटसेवितम्.. 18.128 ..
1.3.m: Being addressed thus by that Daitya, Hari (Indra), having reflected, / then said: "Give me your own head adorned with a crown."

1.3.s:
evamukte tu vacane śakreṇa dvijarūpiṇā..
tvaranmaheṃdrāya tadā śivara utkṛttya vai mudā..
svakareṇa dadau tasmai prahlādasyātmajo'suraḥ.. 18.129 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्ते तु वचने शक्रेण द्विजरूपिणा..
त्वरन्महेंद्राय तदा शिवर उत्कृत्त्य वै मुदा..
स्वकरेण ददौ तस्मै प्रह्लादस्यात्मजोऽसुरः.. 18.129 ..
1.3.m: When this speech was made by Śakra in the form of a twice-born, / swiftly severing his head with joy for the sake of Mahendra, / the Asura, son of Prahlāda, gave it to him with his own hand.

1.3.s:
prahlādena purā yastu kṛto dharmmaḥ suduṣkaraḥ..
kevalāṃ bhaktimāśritya viṣṇostatparacetasā.. 18.130 ..
1.3.d:
प्रह्लादेन पुरा यस्तु कृतो धर्म्मः सुदुष्करः..
केवलां भक्तिमाश्रित्य विष्णोस्तत्परचेतसा.. 18.130 ..
1.3.m: The righteousness which was formerly practiced by Prahlāda was very difficult to perform, / resorting solely to devotion to Viṣṇu with a mind dedicated to Him;

1.3.s:
dānātparataraṃ cānyatkvacidvastu na vidyate..
taddānaṃ ca mahāpuṇyamārtebhyo yatpradīyate.. 18.131 ..
1.3.d:
दानात्परतरं चान्यत्क्वचिद्वस्तु न विद्यते..
तद्दानं च महापुण्यमार्तेभ्यो यत्प्रदीयते.. 18.131 ..
1.3.m: and there is no object anywhere that is higher than giving. / And that gift which is given to the distressed is of great merit;

1.3.s:
svaśaktyā yacca kiṃcicca tadānaṃtyāya kalpate..
dānātparataraṃ nānyattriṣu lokeṣu vidyate.. 18.132 ..
1.3.d:
स्वशक्त्या यच्च किंचिच्च तदानंत्याय कल्पते..
दानात्परतरं नान्यत्त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते.. 18.132 ..
1.3.m: whatever little is given according to one's ability leads to infinity. / There is nothing higher than giving in the three worlds.

1.3.s:
sāttvikaṃ rājasaṃ caiva tāmasaṃ ca prakīrtitatam..
tathā kṛtamanenaiva dānaṃ sāttvikalakṣaṇam.. 18.133 ..
1.3.d:
सात्त्विकं राजसं चैव तामसं च प्रकीर्तिततम्..
तथा कृतमनेनैव दानं सात्त्विकलक्षणम्.. 18.133 ..
1.3.m: It is declared to be sattvic, rajasic, and tamasic; / and likewise the gift made by him had the characteristics of the sattvic.

1.3.s:
śira utkṛttya ceṃdrāya pradattaṃ viprarūpiṇe..
kirīṭaḥ patitastatra maṇayo hi mahāprabhāḥ.. 18.134 ..
1.3.d:
शिर उत्कृत्त्य चेंद्राय प्रदत्तं विप्ररूपिणे..
किरीटः पतितस्तत्र मणयो हि महाप्रभाः.. 18.134 ..
1.3.m: His head was cut off and given to Indra in the form of a brahmin; / the crown fell there, and the brightly shining gems,

1.3.s:
aikapadyena patitāste jātā maṃḍalāya vai..
daityānāṃ ca nareṃdrāṇāṃ pannagānāṃ tathaiva ca.. 18.135 ..
1.3.d:
ऐकपद्येन पतितास्ते जाता मंडलाय वै..
दैत्यानां च नरेंद्राणां पन्नगानां तथैव च.. 18.135 ..
1.3.m: having fallen all at once, became circular crest-jewels / for the Daityas, for lords of men, and likewise for the serpents.

1.3.s:
virocanasya taddānaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam..
gāyaṃtyadyāpi kavayo daityeṃdrasya mahātmanaḥ.. 18.136 ..
1.3.d:
विरोचनस्य तद्दानं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्..
गायंत्यद्यापि कवयो दैत्येंद्रस्य महात्मनः.. 18.136 ..
1.3.m: That gift of Virocana was renowned in the three worlds; / poets still sing of that great-souled lord of the Daityas today.

1.3.s:
virocanasya putro'bhūtkitavo'sau mahāprabhaḥ..
mṛte pitari jāto'sau mātā tasya pativratā.. 18.137 ..
1.3.d:
विरोचनस्य पुत्रोऽभूत्कितवोऽसौ महाप्रभः..
मृते पितरि जातोऽसौ माता तस्य पतिव्रता.. 18.137 ..
1.3.m: The gambler of great radiance became the son of Virocana; / he was born after his father had died, and his mother, devoted to her husband,

1.3.s:
kalevaraṃ ca tatyāja patilokaṃ gatā tataḥ..
bhārgaveṇābhiṣikto'sau janakasya nijāsane.. 18.138 ..
1.3.d:
कलेवरं च तत्याज पतिलोकं गता ततः..
भार्गवेणाभिषिक्तोऽसौ जनकस्य निजासने.. 18.138 ..
1.3.m: abandoned her body and then went to her husband's realm. / He was consecrated upon his father's own throne by Bhārgava (Śukra).

1.3.s:
nāmnā baliriti khyāto babhūva ca mahāyaśāḥ..
tena sarve suragaṇāstrāsitāḥ sumahābalāḥ.. 18.139 ..
1.3.d:
नाम्ना बलिरिति ख्यातो बभूव च महायशाः..
तेन सर्वे सुरगणास्त्रासिताः सुमहाबलाः.. 18.139 ..
1.3.m: Known by the name Bali, he became exceedingly famous; / by him all the hosts of gods, though possessed of great might, were terrified.

1.3.s:
gataste kathitāḥ pūrvaṃ kaśyapasyāśramaṃ śubham..
tadā balirabhūdindro devapuryāṃ mahāyaśāḥ.. 18.140 ..
1.3.d:
गतस्ते कथिताः पूर्वं कश्यपस्याश्रमं शुभम्..
तदा बलिरभूदिन्द्रो देवपुर्यां महायशाः.. 18.140 ..
1.3.m: Those who fled to the auspicious hermitage of Kaśyapa have been recounted to you before; / then the highly renowned Bali became Indra in the city of the gods.

1.3.s:
svayaṃ tatāpa tapasā sūryo bhūtvā tadā'suraḥ..
īśo bhūtvā svayaṃ cāste aiśānyāṃ diśi pālayan.. 18.141 ..
1.3.d:
स्वयं तताप तपसा सूर्यो भूत्वा तदाऽसुरः..
ईशो भूत्वा स्वयं चास्ते ऐशान्यां दिशि पालयन्.. 18.141 ..
1.3.m: The Asura himself shone with heat through his austerity, having become the sun; / having become the Lord himself, he sat protecting the northeastern quarter.

1.3.s:
tathā ca nairṛto bhūtvā tathā tvaṃbupatiḥ svayam..
dhanādhyakṣa udīcyāṃ vai svayamāste balistadā..
evamāste baliḥ sākṣātsvayameva trilokabhuk.. 18.142 ..
1.3.d:
तथा च नैरृतो भूत्वा तथा त्वंबुपतिः स्वयम्..
धनाध्यक्ष उदीच्यां वै स्वयमास्ते बलिस्तदा..
एवमास्ते बलिः साक्षात्स्वयमेव त्रिलोकभुक्.. 18.142 ..
1.3.m: And likewise having become the lord of the south-west, and having become himself the lord of waters (Varuṇa), / Bali then sat himself in the north as the overseer of wealth (Kubera); / thus Bali remained in person, enjoying the three worlds all by himself.

1.3.s:
śivārcanaratenaiva kitavena balirdvijāḥ..
pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva mahādānarato'bhavat.. 18.143 ..
1.3.d:
शिवार्चनरतेनैव कितवेन बलिर्द्विजाः..
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव महादानरतोऽभवत्.. 18.143 ..
1.3.m: Through his past habit as the gambler dedicated to the worship of Śiva, O twice-born ones, / Bali became devoted to great gift-giving.

1.3.s:
