ekadā tu sabhāmadhye āsthito bhṛguṇā saha..
daityeṃdraiḥ saṃvṛtaḥ śrīmāñchaṃḍāmarkau vaco'bravīt.. 18.144 ..
1.3.d:
एकदा तु सभामध्ये आस्थितो भृगुणा सह..
दैत्येंद्रैः संवृतः श्रीमाञ्छंडामर्कौ वचोऽब्रवीत्.. 18.144 ..
1.3.m: Once, seated in the assembly together with Bhṛgu, / surrounded by lords of the Daityas, the glorious one addressed Śaṇḍa and Marka:

1.3.s:
āvāsaḥ kriyatāmatra kriyatāmatra asurairmmama sannidhau..
hitvā pātālamadyaiva mā vilaṃbitumarhatha.. 18.145 ..
1.3.d:
आवासः क्रियतामत्र क्रियतामत्र असुरैर्म्मम सन्निधौ..
हित्वा पातालमद्यैव मा विलंबितुमर्हथ.. 18.145 ..
1.3.m: "Let a dwelling be made here, let a dwelling be made here near me by the Asuras! / Leaving Pātāla this very day, you must not delay."

1.3.s:
bhārgavastadupaśrutya prahasyedamuvāca ha..
yajñaiśca vividhaiścaiva svargaloke mahīyate.. 18.146 ..
1.3.d:
भार्गवस्तदुपश्रुत्य प्रहस्येदमुवाच ह..
यज्ञैश्च विविधैश्चैव स्वर्गलोके महीयते.. 18.146 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that, Bhārgava laughed and said: / 'It is through various sacrifices that one is honored in the heavenly realm.

1.3.s:
yājñikaiśca mahārāja nānyathā svargameva hi..
bhoktuṃ hi pāryate rājannānyatā mama bhāṣitam.. 18.147 ..
1.3.d:
याज्ञिकैश्च महाराज नान्यथा स्वर्गमेव हि..
भोक्तुं हि पार्यते राजन्नान्यता मम भाषितम्.. 18.147 ..
1.3.m: And only by performing sacrifices, O great king, / can heaven indeed be enjoyed, O king, and not otherwise; this is what I say.

1.3.s:
gurorvacanamājñāya daityeṃdro vākyamabravīt..
mayā kaॉtaṃ ca yatkarma tena sarve mahāsurāḥ..
svarge vasaṃtu suciraṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 18.148 ..
1.3.d:
गुरोर्वचनमाज्ञाय दैत्येंद्रो वाक्यमब्रवीत्..
मया कॉतं च यत्कर्म तेन सर्वे महासुराः..
स्वर्गे वसंतु सुचिरं नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 18.148 ..
1.3.m: Understanding the words of his guru, the lord of the daityas spoke: / 'By the deeds I have performed, let all the great asuras / dwell in heaven for a very long time; there should be no doubt about this.'

1.3.s:
prahasyo vāca bhagavānbhārgavāṇāṃ mahātapāḥ..
balinaṃ bāliśaṃ matvā śukro buddhimatāṃ varaḥ.. 18.149 ..
1.3.d:
प्रहस्यो वाच भगवान्भार्गवाणां महातपाः..
बलिनं बालिशं मत्वा शुक्रो बुद्धिमतां वरः.. 18.149 ..
1.3.m: Laughing, the venerable one, of great austerity among the Bhārgavas, / Śukra, the best of the wise, considering Bali to be foolish, said:

1.3.s:
yattvayoktaṃ ca vacanaṃ bale mama na rocate..
ihaiva tvaṃ samā gatya vastuṃ cecchasi suvrata.. 18.150 ..
1.3.d:
यत्त्वयोक्तं च वचनं बले मम न रोचते..
इहैव त्वं समा गत्य वस्तुं चेच्छसि सुव्रत.. 18.150 ..
1.3.m: 'What you have said, Bali, does not please me. / If you wish to dwell right here, coming together, O you of noble vows,

1.3.s:
aśvamedhaśatenaiva yaja tvaṃ jātavedasam..
karmmabhūmiṃ gato bhūtvā mā vilaṃbitumarhasi.. 18.151 ..
1.3.d:
अश्वमेधशतेनैव यज त्वं जातवेदसम्..
कर्म्मभूमिं गतो भूत्वा मा विलंबितुमर्हसि.. 18.151 ..
1.3.m: worship Agni with a hundred horse sacrifices. / Having gone to the realm of action, you must not delay.'

1.3.s:
tatheti matvā sa balirmahātmā hitvā tadānīṃ tridivaṃ manasvī..
daityaiḥ sameto guruṇā ca saṃgato yayau bhuvaṃ sonucaraiḥ sametaḥ.. 18.152 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा स बलिर्महात्मा हित्वा तदानीं त्रिदिवं मनस्वी..
दैत्यैः समेतो गुरुणा च संगतो ययौ भुवं सोनुचरैः समेतः.. 18.152 ..
1.3.m: Thinking, 'So be it,' that noble-minded and wise Bali left heaven then; / accompanied by the daityas and joined with his guru, he went to earth along with his followers.

1.3.s:
tannarmadāyā gurukulyasaṃjñakaṃ tīre mahātīrthamudāraśobham..
gatvā tadā daityapatirmahātmā jitvā samagraṃ vasudhāvalaṃ ca.. 18.153 ..
1.3.d:
तन्नर्मदाया गुरुकुल्यसंज्ञकं तीरे महातीर्थमुदारशोभम्..
गत्वा तदा दैत्यपतिर्महात्मा जित्वा समग्रं वसुधावलं च.. 18.153 ..
1.3.m: Having then gone to that great sacred ford named Gurukulya on the bank of the Narmadā, possessing noble splendor, / that noble lord of the daityas, having conquered the whole extent of the earth,

1.3.s:
tato'śvamedhairbahubhirvicakṣaṇo guruprayuktaḥ sa mahāyaśābaliḥ..
īje ca dīkṣāṃ paramāmupeto vairocaniṃ satyavatāṃ variṣṭhaḥ.. 18.154 ..
1.3.d:
ततोऽश्वमेधैर्बहुभिर्विचक्षणो गुरुप्रयुक्तः स महायशाबलिः..
ईजे च दीक्षां परमामुपेतो वैरोचनिं सत्यवतां वरिष्ठः.. 18.154 ..
1.3.m: then performed sacrifices with many horse sacrifices, being skilled, directed by his guru, that highly renowned Bali, / having undertaken the supreme initiation, the son of Virocana, the best of the truthful.

1.3.s:
kṛtvā brāhmaṇamācāryamṛtvijaḥ ṣoḍaśā'bhavan..
suparīkṣitena tenaiva bhārgaveṇa mahātmanā.. 18.155 ..
1.3.d:
कृत्वा ब्राह्मणमाचार्यमृत्विजः षोडशाऽभवन्..
सुपरीक्षितेन तेनैव भार्गवेण महात्मना.. 18.155 ..
1.3.m: Having made a brahmin the ācārya, there were sixteen priests, / thoroughly vetted by that same noble Bhārgava.

1.3.s:
yajñānāmūnamekena śataṃ dīkṣāpareṇa hi..
balinā cāśvamedhānāṃ pūrṇaṃ kartuṃ samādadhe.. 18.156 ..
1.3.d:
यज्ञानामूनमेकेन शतं दीक्षापरेण हि..
बलिना चाश्वमेधानां पूर्णं कर्तुं समादधे.. 18.156 ..
1.3.m: One sacrifice short of a hundred, intent on initiation indeed, / Bali resolved to complete [the hundred] horse sacrifices.

1.3.s:
yāvadyajñaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ tasya rājño bhaviṣyati..
purā proktaṃ mayā cātra hyadityā vratamuttamam.. 18.157 ..
1.3.d:
यावद्यज्ञशतं पूर्णं तस्य राज्ञो भविष्यति..
पुरा प्रोक्तं मया चात्र ह्यदित्या व्रतमुत्तमम्.. 18.157 ..
1.3.m: While the hundred sacrifices of that king were yet to be completed— / as was previously recounted by me here regarding the excellent vow of Aditi—

1.3.s:
vratena tena saṃtuṣṭo bhagavānharirīśvaraḥ..
baṭurūpema mahatā putrabhūto babhūva ha.. 18.158 ..
1.3.d:
व्रतेन तेन संतुष्टो भगवान्हरिरीश्वरः..
बटुरूपेम महता पुत्रभूतो बभूव ह.. 18.158 ..
1.3.m: pleased by that vow, the lord, Hari, the ruler, / took the form of a son in the immense guise of a young boy.

1.3.s:
adityāḥ kaśyapenaiva upanītastadā prabhuḥ..
upanīte'tha saṃprāpto brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ.. 18.159 ..
1.3.d:
अदित्याः कश्यपेनैव उपनीतस्तदा प्रभुः..
उपनीतेऽथ संप्राप्तो ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः.. 18.159 ..
1.3.m: The Lord was then initiated with the sacred thread by Kaśyapa and Aditi; / when he had been invested with the sacred thread, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, arrived.

1.3.s:
dattaṃ yajñopavītaṃ ca brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā..
daṃḍakāṣṭhaṃ pradattaṃ hi somena ca mahātmanā.. 18.160 ..
1.3.d:
दत्तं यज्ञोपवीतं च ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना..
दंडकाष्ठं प्रदत्तं हि सोमेन च महात्मना.. 18.160 ..
1.3.m: The sacred thread was given by Brahmā Parameṣṭhin; / the staff of wood was given by the noble Soma.

1.3.s:
mekhalā ca samānītā ajinaṃ ca mahādbhutam..
tathā ca pāduke caiva mahyā datte mahātmanaḥ.. 18.161 ..
1.3.d:
मेखला च समानीता अजिनं च महाद्भुतम्..
तथा च पादुके चैव मह्या दत्ते महात्मनः.. 18.161 ..
1.3.m: A girdle was brought, and a wondrous skin of an antelope, / and likewise a pair of sandals was given to the noble one by the earth.

1.3.s:
tatra bhikṣā samānītā bhavānyā cārthasiddhaye..
evaṃ bhagavate dattaṃ viṣṇave baṭurūpiṇe.. 18.162 ..
1.3.d:
तत्र भिक्षा समानीता भवान्या चार्थसिद्धये..
एवं भगवते दत्तं विष्णवे बटुरूपिणे.. 18.162 ..
1.3.m: Alms were brought there by Bhavānī for the attainment of success; / thus [all] was given to the Lord, Viṣṇu in the form of a young boy.

1.3.s:
abhivaṃdya śrīśo vāmano hditiṃ tathā..
kaśyapaṃca mahātejā yajñavāṭaṃ jagāma ca..
yājñikasya balerāha cchalanārthaṃ svayaṃ prabhuḥ.. 18.163 ..
1.3.d:
अभिवंद्य श्रीशो वामनो ह्दितिं तथा..
कश्यपंच महातेजा यज्ञवाटं जगाम च..
याज्ञिकस्य बलेराह च्छलनार्थं स्वयं प्रभुः.. 18.163 ..
1.3.m: Having paid homage to Aditi and Kaśyapa, the radiant Lord of Śrī, Vāmana, / went to the sacrificial enclosure; / the Lord himself went to trick the sacrificer Bali.

1.3.s:
tadā maheśaḥ sa jagāma svargaṃ prakaṃpayangāṃ prapadā bhareṇa..
sa vāmano baṭurūpī ca sākṣādviṣṇuḥ parātmā surakāryahetoḥ.. 18.164 ..
1.3.d:
तदा महेशः स जगाम स्वर्गं प्रकंपयन्गां प्रपदा भरेण..
स वामनो बटुरूपी च साक्षाद्विष्णुः परात्मा सुरकार्यहेतोः.. 18.164 ..
1.3.m: Then that great Lord went to heaven, causing the earth to tremble with the weight of the tips of his feet, / that Vāmana in the form of a young boy, who was Viṣṇu directly, the supreme Self, for the sake of the purpose of the gods.

1.3.s:
gīrbhiryathārthābhirabhiṣṭuto janairmunīśvarairdevagaṇairmahātmā..
tvareṇa gacchansa ca yajñavāṭaṃ prāptastadānīṃ jagadekabaṃdhuḥ.. 18.165 ..
1.3.d:
गीर्भिर्यथार्थाभिरभिष्टुतो जनैर्मुनीश्वरैर्देवगणैर्महात्मा..
त्वरेण गच्छन्स च यज्ञवाटं प्राप्तस्तदानीं जगदेकबंधुः.. 18.165 ..
1.3.m: Praised with truthful words by people, lords among sages, and hosts of gods, the noble one, / going with haste, that sole friend of the universe then reached the sacrificial enclosure.

1.3.s:
udgāpayansāma yato hi sākṣāccakāra devo baṭurūpaveṣaḥ..
udgīyamāno bhagavānsa īśvaro vedāṃta vedyo harirīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ.. 18.166 ..
1.3.d:
उद्गापयन्साम यतो हि साक्षाच्चकार देवो बटुरूपवेषः..
उद्गीयमानो भगवान्स ईश्वरो वेदांत वेद्यो हरिरीश्वरः प्रभुः.. 18.166 ..
1.3.m: Causing the Sāmaveda to be chanted, since the god directly assumed the dress of a young boy, / being chanted to, that venerable Lord, Hari, the ruler and sovereign known through the Vedānta,

1.3.s:
dadarśa taṃ mahāyajñamaśvamedhaṃ balestadā..
dvāri sthito mahātejā vāmano baṭurūpadhṛk.. 18.167 ..
1.3.d:
ददर्श तं महायज्ञमश्वमेधं बलेस्तदा..
द्वारि स्थितो महातेजा वामनो बटुरूपधृक्.. 18.167 ..
1.3.m: then beheld that great sacrifice, the horse sacrifice of Bali; / standing at the door was the radiant Vāmana bearing the form of a young boy.

1.3.s:
brahmarūpeṇa mahatā vyāptamāsīddigaṃtaram..
pavamānasya ca baṭorvāmanasya mahātmanaḥ.. 18.168 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मरूपेण महता व्याप्तमासीद्दिगंतरम्..
पवमानस्य च बटोर्वामनस्य महात्मनः.. 18.168 ..
1.3.m: The expanse of the directions was pervaded by the great brahminical splendor / of the purifying young boy, the noble Vāmana.

1.3.s:
tacchrutvā ca baliḥ prāha śaṃḍāmarkkau ca buddhimān..
brāhmaṇāḥ katisaṃkhyāśca āgatāḥ saṃti īkṣyatām.. 18.169 ..
1.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा च बलिः प्राह शंडामर्क्कौ च बुद्धिमान्..
ब्राह्मणाः कतिसंख्याश्च आगताः संति ईक्ष्यताम्.. 18.169 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that, the wise Bali spoke to Śaṇḍa and Marka: / 'Look and see how many brahmins have arrived.'

1.3.s:
tatheti matvā tvaritāvutthitau tau tadā dvijāḥ..
śaṃḍāmarkau samāgamya maṃḍapadvāri saṃsthitau.. 18.170 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा त्वरितावुत्थितौ तौ तदा द्विजाः..
शंडामर्कौ समागम्य मंडपद्वारि संस्थितौ.. 18.170 ..
1.3.m: Thinking, 'So be it,' the two brahmins swiftly arose then; / Śaṇḍa and Marka, having approached, stood at the door of the pavilion.

1.3.s:
dadṛśāte mahātmānaṃ śrīhariṃ baṭurūpiṇam..
tvaritau punarāyātau baleḥ śaṃsayituṃ tadā.. 18.171 ..
1.3.d:
ददृशाते महात्मानं श्रीहरिं बटुरूपिणम्..
त्वरितौ पुनरायातौ बलेः शंसयितुं तदा.. 18.171 ..
1.3.m: They beheld the noble Lord Hari in the form of a young boy; / they swiftly returned then to report to Bali:

1.3.s:
brahmacārī samāyāta eka eva na cāparaḥ..
paṭhanādau mahārāja cāgatastava sannidhau..
kimarthaṃ tanna jānīmo jānīhi tvaṃ mahāmate.. 18.172 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मचारी समायात एक एव न चापरः..
पठनादौ महाराज चागतस्तव सन्निधौ..
किमर्थं तन्न जानीमो जानीहि त्वं महामते.. 18.172 ..
1.3.m: 'A single religious student has arrived, and no other; / reciting [the Vedas] from the beginning, O great king, he has come into your presence. / For what purpose, we do not know; find out, O you of great intellect.'

1.3.s:
evamukte tu vacane tābhyāṃ sa ca mahāmanāḥ..
utthitastatkṣaṇādeva darśanārthe baṭuṃ prati.. 18.173 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्ते तु वचने ताभ्यां स च महामनाः..
उत्थितस्तत्क्षणादेव दर्शनार्थे बटुं प्रति.. 18.173 ..
1.3.m: When those words were spoken by the two, that high-minded one / arose at that very moment to have darśana of the young boy.

1.3.s:
sa dadarśa mahātejā virocanasuto mahān..
daṃḍavatpatito bhūmau nanāma śirasā baṭum.. 18.174 ..
1.3.d:
स ददर्श महातेजा विरोचनसुतो महान्..
दंडवत्पतितो भूमौ ननाम शिरसा बटुम्.. 18.174 ..
1.3.m: He, the mighty, highly radiant son of Virocana, saw [him]; / falling like a stick upon the ground, he bowed with his head to the young boy.

1.3.s:
ānayitvā baṭuṃ sadyaḥ saṃniveśyaḥ nijāsane..
arghyapādyena mahatābhyarcayāmāsa taṃ baṭum.. 18.175 ..
1.3.d:
आनयित्वा बटुं सद्यः संनिवेश्यः निजासने..
अर्घ्यपाद्येन महताभ्यर्चयामास तं बटुम्.. 18.175 ..
1.3.m: Bringing the young boy immediately and seating him upon his own seat, / he worshipped that young boy with abundant water for honoring guests and water for the feet.

1.3.s:
vinamrakaṃdharo bhūtvā uvāca ślakṣṇayā girā..
kutaḥ kasmācca kasyāsi tacchighraṃ kathyatāṃ prabho.. 18.176 ..
1.3.d:
विनम्रकंधरो भूत्वा उवाच श्लक्ष्णया गिरा..
कुतः कस्माच्च कस्यासि तच्छिघ्रं कथ्यतां प्रभो.. 18.176 ..
1.3.m: Having bowed his neck, he spoke in gentle words: / 'From where, why, and whose are you? Tell that quickly, O lord.'

1.3.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya virocanasutasya vai..
manasā hṛṣitaścāsau vāmano vaktumārabhat.. 18.177 ..
1.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य विरोचनसुतस्य वै..
मनसा हृषितश्चासौ वामनो वक्तुमारभत्.. 18.177 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that speech of his, the son of Virocana, / delighted in his mind, that Vāmana began to speak.

1.3.s:
..bhagavānuvāca..
tvaṃ hi rājā trilokeśo nānyo bhavitumarhasi..
svakulaṃ nyūnatāṃ gacchedyo vai kāpuruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ.. 18.178 ..
1.3.d:
..भगवानुवाच..
त्वं हि राजा त्रिलोकेशो नान्यो भवितुमर्हसि..
स्वकुलं न्यूनतां गच्छेद्यो वै कापुरुषः स्मृतः.. 18.178 ..
1.3.m: The Lord said: / 'You indeed are the king, the ruler of the three worlds; no other deserves to be. / One who allows his own lineage to decline is known as a contemptible man.

1.3.s:
samaṃ vā cādhiko vāpi yo gacchetpuruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ..
tvayā kṛtaṃ ca yatkarmma na kṛtaṃ pūrvajaistava.. 18.179 ..
1.3.d:
समं वा चाधिको वापि यो गच्छेत्पुरुषः स्मृतः..
त्वया कृतं च यत्कर्म्म न कृतं पूर्वजैस्तव.. 18.179 ..
1.3.m: He who equals it or surpasses it is known as a [true] man. / And what you have accomplished was not done by your ancestors,

1.3.s:
daityānāṃ ca variṣṭhā ye hiraṇyakasipādayaḥ..
kṛtaṃ mahattapo yena divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam.. 18.180 ..
1.3.d:
दैत्यानां च वरिष्ठा ये हिरण्यकसिपादयः..
कृतं महत्तपो येन दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रकम्.. 18.180 ..
1.3.m: the foremost among the daityas, Hiraṇyakaśipu and others, / by whom great austerity was performed for a thousand divine years.

1.3.s:
śarīraṃ bhakṣitaṃ yasya juṣāṇasya tapo mahat..
pipīlikābhirbahubhirdaṃśaiścaiva samāvṛtam.. 18.181 ..
1.3.d:
शरीरं भक्षितं यस्य जुषाणस्य तपो महत्..
पिपीलिकाभिर्बहुभिर्दंशैश्चैव समावृतम्.. 18.181 ..
1.3.m: Whose body, engaged in great austerity, was consumed / and covered by numerous ants and biting insects.

1.3.s:
abhavattasya tajjñātvā sureṃdro hyagamatpurā..
nagaraṃ tasya ca tadā sainyena mahatā vṛtaḥ.. 18.182 ..
1.3.d:
अभवत्तस्य तज्ज्ञात्वा सुरेंद्रो ह्यगमत्पुरा..
नगरं तस्य च तदा सैन्येन महता वृतः.. 18.182 ..
1.3.m: Knowing that this had happened to him, the lord of the gods of old went / to his city at that time, surrounded by a large army.

1.3.s:
tatsannidhau hatāḥ sarve asurā daityaśatruṇā..
viṃdhyā tu mahiṣī tasya nīyamānā nivāritā.. 18.183 ..
1.3.d:
तत्सन्निधौ हताः सर्वे असुरा दैत्यशत्रुणा..
विंध्या तु महिषी तस्य नीयमाना निवारिता.. 18.183 ..
1.3.m: In that vicinity all the asuras were slain by the enemy of the daityas; / but Vindhyā, his chief queen, while being carried away, was stopped

1.3.s:
nāradena purā rājankiṃcitkāryaṃ cikīrṣuṇā..
śaṃbhoḥ prasādādakhilaṃ manasā yatsamīkṣitam..
daityeṃdreṇa ca tatsarvaṃ tapasaiva vaśīkṛtam.. 18.184 ..
1.3.d:
नारदेन पुरा राजन्किंचित्कार्यं चिकीर्षुणा..
शंभोः प्रसादादखिलं मनसा यत्समीक्षितम्..
दैत्येंद्रेण च तत्सर्वं तपसैव वशीकृतम्.. 18.184 ..
1.3.m: by Nārada of old, O king, wishing to accomplish a certain purpose. / By the grace of Śambhu, whatever was desired in his mind / was completely brought under control by that lord of the daityas through austerity alone.

1.3.s:
tasyāḥ putro mahātejā yena nīto'bhavatsabhām..
tasya putro mahābhāga pitā te pitṛvatsalaḥ..
nāmnā virocano vidvāniṃdro yena mahātmanā.. 18.185 ..
1.3.d:
तस्याः पुत्रो महातेजा येन नीतोऽभवत्सभाम्..
तस्य पुत्रो महाभाग पिता ते पितृवत्सलः..
नाम्ना विरोचनो विद्वानिंद्रो येन महात्मना.. 18.185 ..
1.3.m: Her son of great radiance, by whom he was taken to the assembly— / his son, O highly fortunate one, was your father, affectionate toward his father, / known by name as Virocana, the wise one by whose noble self Indra...'

1.3.s:
dānena toṣito rājansvenaiva śirasā tadā..
tasyātmajosi bho rājankṛtaṃ te paramaṃ yaśaḥ.. 18.186 ..
1.3.d:
दानेन तोषितो राजन्स्वेनैव शिरसा तदा..
तस्यात्मजोसि भो राजन्कृतं ते परमं यशः.. 18.186 ..
1.3.m: At that time, O king, [he was] pleased by [your father’s] gift of his own head. / You are his son, O king; supreme glory has been achieved by you. 18.186

1.3.s:
yaśodīpena mahatā dagdhāḥ śalabhavatsurāḥ..
iṃdropi nirjito yena tvayā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ.. 18.187 ..
1.3.d:
यशोदीपेन महता दग्धाः शलभवत्सुराः..
इंद्रोपि निर्जितो येन त्वया नास्त्यत्र संशयः.. 18.187 ..
1.3.m: By that great lamp of fame, the gods were burnt like moths. / Even Indra was thoroughly defeated by you; of this there is no doubt. 18.187

1.3.s:
śrutamasti mayā sarvaṃ caritaṃ tava suvrata..
alpako'hamihāyāto brahmacaryavrate sthitaḥ.. 18.188 ..
1.3.d:
श्रुतमस्ति मया सर्वं चरितं तव सुव्रत..
अल्पकोऽहमिहायातो ब्रह्मचर्यव्रते स्थितः.. 18.188 ..
1.3.m: All your deeds have been heard of by me, O you of noble vows. / Being a small person, steadfast in the vow of celibacy, I have come here. 18.188

1.3.s:
uṭajārthe ca me dehi bhūmīṃ bhūmibhṛtāṃvara..
baṭostasyaiva tadvākyaṃ śrutvā balirabhāṣata.. 18.189 ..
1.3.d:
उटजार्थे च मे देहि भूमीं भूमिभृतांवर..
बटोस्तस्यैव तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा बलिरभाषत.. 18.189 ..
1.3.m: Bestow land upon me for a hut, O best of kings! / Having heard those words of that young celibate, Bali spoke: 18.189

1.3.s:
he baṭo paṃḍito bhūtvā yaduktaṃ vacanaṃ purā..
śiśutvāttanna jānāsi śrutvā manye yathārthataḥ.. 18.190 ..
1.3.d:
हे बटो पंडितो भूत्वा यदुक्तं वचनं पुरा..
शिशुत्वात्तन्न जानासि श्रुत्वा मन्ये यथार्थतः.. 18.190 ..
1.3.m: “O young celibate, having become learned, as to the word spoken earlier, / because of your youth you do not understand it; hearing it, I consider it properly. 18.190

1.3.s:
vada śīghraṃ mahābhāga kiyanmātrāṃ mahīṃ tava..
dāsyāmi tvaritenaiva manasā tadvimṛśyatām.. 18.191 ..
1.3.d:
वद शीघ्रं महाभाग कियन्मात्रां महीं तव..
दास्यामि त्वरितेनैव मनसा तद्विमृश्यताम्.. 18.191 ..
1.3.m: Speak quickly, O fortunate one, how much land for you / shall I give with a swift mind; let that be reflected upon.” 18.191

1.3.s:
tadāha vāmano vākyaṃ smayanmadhurayā girā..
asaṃtoṣaparā ye ca viprā naṣṭā na saṃśayaḥ.. 18.192 ..
1.3.d:
तदाह वामनो वाक्यं स्मयन्मधुरया गिरा..
असंतोषपरा ये च विप्रा नष्टा न संशयः.. 18.192 ..
1.3.m: Then Vāmana spoke these words smilingly, with a sweet voice: / “Those brahmins who are devoted to discontent are ruined, without doubt. 18.192

1.3.s:
saṃtuṣṭā ye hi viprāste nānye veṣadharā hyamī..
svadharmaniratā rājannirdaṃbhā niravagrahāḥ.. 18.193 ..
1.3.d:
संतुष्टा ये हि विप्रास्ते नान्ये वेषधरा ह्यमी..
स्वधर्मनिरता राजन्निर्दंभा निरवग्रहाः.. 18.193 ..
1.3.m: For those brahmins who are contented are indeed [true brahmins], not those others who merely wear the guise: / engaged in their own duty, O king, free from deceit, unrestrained, 18.193

1.3.s:
nirmatsarā jitakodhāvadānyā hi mahāmate..
viprāste hi mahābhāga tairiyaṃ dhāryate mahī.. 18.194 ..
1.3.d:
निर्मत्सरा जितकोधावदान्या हि महामते..
विप्रास्ते हि महाभाग तैरियं धार्यते मही.. 18.194 ..
1.3.m: free from envy, with anger conquered, and truly generous, O noble-minded one. / Those are indeed brahmins, O fortunate one; by them this earth is sustained. 18.194

1.3.s:
manasvī tvaṃ bahutvācca dātāsi bhuvanatraye..
tathāpi me pradātavyā mahī tripadasaṃmitā.. 18.195 ..
1.3.d:
मनस्वी त्वं बहुत्वाच्च दातासि भुवनत्रये..
तथापि मे प्रदातव्या मही त्रिपदसंमिता.. 18.195 ..
1.3.m: You are generous-minded, and being great you are the giver in the three worlds. / Even so, land measuring three paces should be granted to me. 18.195

1.3.s:
bahutve nāsti me kāryaṃ mahyā vai surasūdana..
praveśamātramuṭajaṃ tathā mama bhaviṣyati.. 18.196 ..
1.3.d:
बहुत्वे नास्ति मे कार्यं मह्या वै सुरसूदन..
प्रवेशमात्रमुटजं तथा मम भविष्यति.. 18.196 ..
1.3.m: I have no need for a great deal of land, O slayer of gods. / My hut will merely be enough for entry. 18.196

1.3.s:
tripadaṃ pūryate'smākaṃ vastuṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ..
dehi me kramato rājanyāvadbhūmibhaviṣyati..
tāvatsaṃkhyā pradātavyā yadi dātāsi bho bale.. 18.197 ..
1.3.d:
त्रिपदं पूर्यतेऽस्माकं वस्तुं नास्त्यत्र संशयः..
देहि मे क्रमतो राजन्यावद्भूमिभविष्यति..
तावत्संख्या प्रदातव्या यदि दातासि भो बले.. 18.197 ..
1.3.m: Three paces are sufficient for us to dwell in; there is no doubt of this. / Give to me according to my paces, O king, as much land as it will be; / that measure should be given, if you are a giver, O Bali!” 18.197

1.3.s:
prahasya tamuvācedaṃ balirvairocanātmajaḥ..
dāsyāmi te mahīṃ kṛtsāṃ saśailavanakānanām.. 18.198 ..
1.3.d:
प्रहस्य तमुवाचेदं बलिर्वैरोचनात्मजः..
दास्यामि ते महीं कृत्सां सशैलवनकाननाम्.. 18.198 ..
1.3.m: Laughing, Bali, son of Virocana, said this to him: / “I shall give you the entire earth along with its mountains, forests, and groves. 18.198

1.3.s:
madīyāṃ vai mahābhāga mayā dattāṃ gṛhāma vai..
yācako'si baṭo paśya dānaṃ daityāprayācase.. 18.199 ..
1.3.d:
मदीयां वै महाभाग मया दत्तां गृहाम वै..
याचकोऽसि बटो पश्य दानं दैत्याप्रयाचसे.. 18.199 ..
1.3.m: Indeed, accept it as mine, O fortunate one, given by me! / You are a petitioner, O young celibate; see, ask for a gift from the Daitya! 18.199

1.3.s:
yācako hyalpako vāstu dātā sarvaṃ vimṛśya vai..
tathā vilokya cātmānaṃ hyarthibhyaśca dadāti vai.. 18.200 ..
1.3.d:
याचको ह्यल्पको वास्तु दाता सर्वं विमृश्य वै..
तथा विलोक्य चात्मानं ह्यर्थिभ्यश्च ददाति वै.. 18.200 ..
1.3.m: Whether the petitioner is small or not, the giver, having considered everything / and having regarded himself, indeed gives to supplicants. 18.200

1.3.s:
ātmaupamyena sarvatra yo dadāti hyudāradhīḥ..
tasmānna yācitavyaṃ hi arthinā maṃdabhāginā.. 18.201 ..
1.3.d:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र यो ददाति ह्युदारधीः..
तस्मान्न याचितव्यं हि अर्थिना मंदभागिना.. 18.201 ..
1.3.m: A noble-minded one gives everywhere by analogy to himself. / Therefore an unfortunate petitioner should not have to ask [only for little]. 18.201

1.3.s:
baṭo dadāmyahaṃ te'dya sasailavanakānanām..
pṛthvīṃ saparvatāṃ sābdhiṃ nānyathā mama bhāṣitam.. 18.202 ..
1.3.d:
बटो ददाम्यहं तेऽद्य ससैलवनकाननाम्..
पृथ्वीं सपर्वतां साब्धिं नान्यथा मम भाषितम्.. 18.202 ..
1.3.m: O young celibate, today I give you the earth along with its mountains, forests, and groves, / with its hills and oceans; my word is never otherwise.” 18.202

1.3.s:
punaḥ provāca sa baṭurvirocanasutaṃ prati..
pūryate mama daityeṃdra kramato hi padaistribhiḥ.. 18.203 ..
1.3.d:
पुनः प्रोवाच स बटुर्विरोचनसुतं प्रति..
पूर्यते मम दैत्येंद्र क्रमतो हि पदैस्त्रिभिः.. 18.203 ..
1.3.m: Again that young celibate spoke to the son of Virocana: / “My [need] is satisfied, O Daitya lord, by just three paces.” 18.203

1.3.s:
baṭostadvacanaṃ śrutvā asurendro balistadā..
uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ manyamāno balirbhṛśam..
gṛhyatāṃ ca mayā dattāṃ padaistribhiralaṃkṛtām.. 18.204 ..
1.3.d:
बटोस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा असुरेन्द्रो बलिस्तदा..
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं मन्यमानो बलिर्भृशम्..
गृह्यतां च मया दत्तां पदैस्त्रिभिरलंकृताम्.. 18.204 ..
1.3.m: Hearing those words of the young celibate, Bali, the lord of the asuras, then / laughing, spoke these words, considering [it] greatly: / “Let it be accepted, given by me, adorned with three paces!” 18.204

1.3.s:
ityukto vāmanaḥ prāha prahasannasuraṃ prati..
saṃkalpya sakalāṃ pṛthvīṃ dātumarhasi suvrata.. 18.205 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युक्तो वामनः प्राह प्रहसन्नसुरं प्रति..
संकल्प्य सकलां पृथ्वीं दातुमर्हसि सुव्रत.. 18.205 ..
1.3.m: Addressed thus, Vāmana said, laughing, to the asura: / “Having made the solemn resolution, you ought to give the entire earth, O you of noble vows.” 18.205

1.3.s:
tatheti matvā balinā supūjitaḥ sa vāmanaḥ kaśyapanaṃdano mahān..
balistadānīṃ sahasā nitāṃtaṃ saṃstūyamānastvṛṣibhirmunīṃdraiḥ.. 18.206 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा बलिना सुपूजितः स वामनः कश्यपनंदनो महान्..
बलिस्तदानीं सहसा नितांतं संस्तूयमानस्त्वृषिभिर्मुनींद्रैः.. 18.206 ..
1.3.m: Consenting, that great Vāmana, the son of Kaśyapa, was well worshipped by Bali. / Bali was then suddenly praised intensely by seers and supreme sages. 18.206

1.3.s:
taṃ pūjayitvā sa baliryāvaddātuṃ samudyataḥ..
guruṇā vārita stāvadvirocanasuto mahān.. 18.207 ..
1.3.d:
तं पूजयित्वा स बलिर्यावद्दातुं समुद्यतः..
गुरुणा वारित स्तावद्विरोचनसुतो महान्.. 18.207 ..
1.3.m: Having worshipped him, as Bali prepared to give, / just then the great son of Virocana was stopped by his guru: 18.207

1.3.s:
na dātavyaṃ tvayā dānaṃ viṣṇave baṭurūpiṇe..
iṃdrārthamāgataḥ sadyo yajñavighnaṃ karoti te..
tasmāttvayā na pūjyo hi viṣṇuradhyātmadīpakaḥ.. 18.208 ..
1.3.d:
न दातव्यं त्वया दानं विष्णवे बटुरूपिणे..
इंद्रार्थमागतः सद्यो यज्ञविघ्नं करोति ते..
तस्मात्त्वया न पूज्यो हि विष्णुरध्यात्मदीपकः.. 18.208 ..
1.3.m: “A gift must not be given by you to Viṣṇu in the form of a young celibate! / He has arrived at once on Indra’s behalf and will cause an obstacle to your sacrifice. / Therefore Viṣṇu, who illuminates supreme reality, should not be honoured by you. 18.208

1.3.s:
purā kṛtamanenaiva mohinīrūpadhāriṇā..
devebhyaścāmṛtaṃ dattaṃ rāhuryena hato mahān.. 18.209 ..
1.3.d:
पुरा कृतमनेनैव मोहिनीरूपधारिणा..
देवेभ्यश्चामृतं दत्तं राहुर्येन हतो महान्.. 18.209 ..
1.3.m: Formerly, by this very one, who took the form of Mohinī, / nectar was given to the gods, and by him the great Rāhu was slain. 18.209

1.3.s: yena vidrāvitā daityāḥ kālanemirhato balī.. 18.210 ..
1.3.d: येन विद्राविता दैत्याः कालनेमिर्हतो बली.. 18.210 ..
1.3.m: By him the Daityas were routed, and powerful Kālanemi was slain. 18.210

1.3.s:
evaṃvidho'yaṃ puruṣo mahātmā sa īśvaro viśvapatiḥ sa eva..
vimṛśya sarvaṃ manasā mahāmate hitāhitaṃ kartumi hārhasi tvam.. 18.211 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe baliyajñe vāmanagamanavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 18 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
एवंविधोऽयं पुरुषो महात्मा स ईश्वरो विश्वपतिः स एव..
विमृश्य सर्वं मनसा महामते हिताहितं कर्तुमि हार्हसि त्वम्.. 18.211 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे बलियज्ञे वामनगमनवर्णनं नामाष्टादशोऽध्यायः.. 18 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
Such is this great soul, the Lord, the master of the universe himself. / Having reflected upon all beneficial and unbeneficial things in your mind, O noble-minded one, you ought to act here.” 18.211
Thus ends the eighteenth chapter, named ‘Description of Vāmana’s Arrival at the Sacrifice of Bali’, in the Bali sacrifice, in the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skandapurāṇa. 18.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
evaṃ saṃbodhito daityo guruṇā bhārgaveṇa hi..
uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ meghagaṃbhīrayā girā.. 19.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
एवं संबोधितो दैत्यो गुरुणा भार्गवेण हि..
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं मेघगंभीरया गिरा.. 19.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Thus addressed by his guru Bhārgava, / the Daitya, laughing, spoke these words in a voice deep as a thundercloud: 19.1

1.3.s:
tvayoktohaṃ hitārthāya yairvākyaiścālito'smyaham..
tava vākyaṃ mama prītyai hitamapyahitaṃ bhavet.. 19.2 ..
1.3.d:
त्वयोक्तोहं हितार्थाय यैर्वाक्यैश्चालितोऽस्म्यहम्..
तव वाक्यं मम प्रीत्यै हितमप्यहितं भवेत्.. 19.2 ..
1.3.m: “I have been spoken to by you for the sake of benefit, and I have been shaken by those words. / Your word is for my affection; yet even what is beneficial might be unbeneficial. 19.2

1.3.s:
dāsyāmi bhikṣitaṃ cāsmai viṣmave baṭurūpiṇe..
pātrībhūto hyayaṃ viṣṇuḥ sarvakarmaphaleśvaraḥ.. 19.3 ..
1.3.d:
दास्यामि भिक्षितं चास्मै विष्मवे बटुरूपिणे..
पात्रीभूतो ह्ययं विष्णुः सर्वकर्मफलेश्वरः.. 19.3 ..
1.3.m: I will give what is begged to this Viṣṇu in the form of a young celibate. / For this Viṣṇu, the lord of the fruits of all actions, has become a worthy recipient. 19.3

1.3.s:
yeṣāṃ hṛdi sthito viṣṇuste vai pātratamā dhruvam..
yasya nāmnā sarvamidaṃ pavitramiva cocyate.. 19.4 ..
1.3.d:
येषां हृदि स्थितो विष्णुस्ते वै पात्रतमा ध्रुवम्..
यस्य नाम्ना सर्वमिदं पवित्रमिव चोच्यते.. 19.4 ..
1.3.m: Those in whose hearts Viṣṇu resides are truly the most worthy recipients. / By his name, all of this is declared as if purified. 19.4

1.3.s:
yena vedāśca yajñāśca maṃtrataṃtrādayo hyamī..
sarve saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāṃti so'yaṃ viśveśvaro hariḥ.. 19.5 ..
1.3.d:
येन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च मंत्रतंत्रादयो ह्यमी..
सर्वे संपूर्णतां यांति सोऽयं विश्वेश्वरो हरिः.. 19.5 ..
1.3.m: He by whom the Vedas, the sacrifices, and mantras, tantras, and so forth, / all attain completeness—he is this Hari, the lord of the universe. 19.5

1.3.s:
āgataḥ kṛpayā medya sarvātmā harirīśvaraḥ..
uddhartuṃ māṃ na saṃdeha etajjānīhi tattvataḥ.. 19.6 ..
1.3.d:
आगतः कृपया मेद्य सर्वात्मा हरिरीश्वरः..
उद्धर्तुं मां न संदेह एतज्जानीहि तत्त्वतः.. 19.6 ..
1.3.m: The Supreme Lord Hari, the Self of all, has arrived today out of compassion / to uplift me, without doubt; know this in truth! 19.6

1.3.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa ca ruṣānvitaḥ..
bhārgavaḥ śaptumārebhe daityeṃdraṃ dharmmavatsalam.. 19.7 ..
1.3.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा चुकोप च रुषान्वितः..
भार्गवः शप्तुमारेभे दैत्येंद्रं धर्म्मवत्सलम्.. 19.7 ..
1.3.m: Hearing those words of his, Bhārgava was angered and filled with wrath, / and he began to curse the lord of the Daityas, who was devoted to righteousness: 19.7

1.3.s:
mama vākyamatikramya dātumicchasyariṃdama..
viguṇo bhava re maṃda tasmāttvaṃ niḥśriko bhava.. 19.8 ..
1.3.d:
मम वाक्यमतिक्रम्य दातुमिच्छस्यरिंदम..
विगुणो भव रे मंद तस्मात्त्वं निःश्रिको भव.. 19.8 ..
1.3.m: “Transgressing my word, you wish to give, O subduer of foes! / O fool, become devoid of virtue, and therefore become stripped of fortune!” 19.8

1.3.s:
evaṃ śaśāpa ca tadā paramārthavijñaṃ śiṣyaṃ mahātmānamagādhabodham..
sa vai jagāmātha mahākavistvarātsvamāśramaṃ dharmmavidāṃ variṣṭhaḥ.. 19.9 ..
1.3.d:
एवं शशाप च तदा परमार्थविज्ञं शिष्यं महात्मानमगाधबोधम्..
स वै जगामाथ महाकविस्त्वरात्स्वमाश्रमं धर्म्मविदां वरिष्ठः.. 19.9 ..
1.3.m: Thus he cursed his disciple, who knew the ultimate truth, a great soul of fathomless understanding. / Then that great sage, the foremost among knowers of righteousness, swiftly departed to his own hermitage. 19.9

1.3.s:
gate tu bhārgave tasminbalirvirocanātmajaḥ..
vāmanaṃ cārcayitvā sa mahīṃ dātuṃ pracakrame.. 19.10 ..
1.3.d:
गते तु भार्गवे तस्मिन्बलिर्विरोचनात्मजः..
वामनं चार्चयित्वा स महीं दातुं प्रचक्रमे.. 19.10 ..
1.3.m: When that Bhārgava had departed, Bali, the son of Virocana, / having worshipped Vāmana, set about to give the earth. 19.10

1.3.s:
viṃdhyāvaliḥ samāgatya balerarddhāṃgaśobhitā..
avanijya baṭoḥ pādau pradadau viṣṇave mahīm.. 19.11 ..
1.3.d:
विंध्यावलिः समागत्य बलेरर्द्धांगशोभिता..
अवनिज्य बटोः पादौ प्रददौ विष्णवे महीम्.. 19.11 ..
1.3.m: Vindhyāvalī, having approached, adorning half of Bali’s body, / washed the feet of the young celibate and granted the earth to Viṣṇu. 19.11

1.3.s:
saṃkalpapūrveṇa tadā vidhinā vidhikovidaḥ..
saṃkalpenaiva mahatā vavṛdhe bhagavānajaḥ.. 19.12 ..
1.3.d:
संकल्पपूर्वेण तदा विधिना विधिकोविदः..
संकल्पेनैव महता ववृधे भगवानजः.. 19.12 ..
1.3.m: Then, according to the rule accompanied by solemn resolution, he who was skilled in rules [gave]; / by that great solemn resolution itself, the unborn Blessed Lord expanded. 19.12

1.3.s:
yadaikena mahī vyāptā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā..
sarve svargā dvitīyena vyāptāstena mahātmanā.. 19.13 ..
1.3.d:
यदैकेन मही व्याप्ता विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना..
सर्वे स्वर्गा द्वितीयेन व्याप्तास्तेन महात्मना.. 19.13 ..
1.3.m: When the earth was pervaded by powerful Viṣṇu with one [step], / all the heavens were pervaded by that great soul with the second. 19.13

1.3.s:
satyalokagato viṣṇoścaraṇaḥ parameṣṭhinā..
kamaṇḍalugatenaiva aṃbhasā cāvanenije.. 19.14 ..
1.3.d:
सत्यलोकगतो विष्णोश्चरणः परमेष्ठिना..
कमण्डलुगतेनैव अंभसा चावनेनिजे.. 19.14 ..
1.3.m: The foot of Viṣṇu, reaching Satyaloka, was washed / by Brahmā with the water from his water pot. 19.14

1.3.s:
tatpādasaṃparkajalācca jātā bhāgīrathī sarvasumaṃgalā ca..
yayā trilokī ca kṛtā pavitrā yayā ca sarve sagarāḥ samuddhṛtāḥ..
yayā kapardaḥ paripūrito vai śaṃbhostadānīṃ ca bhagīrathena.. 19.15 ..
1.3.d:
तत्पादसंपर्कजलाच्च जाता भागीरथी सर्वसुमंगला च..
यया त्रिलोकी च कृता पवित्रा यया च सर्वे सगराः समुद्धृताः..
यया कपर्दः परिपूरितो वै शंभोस्तदानीं च भगीरथेन.. 19.15 ..
1.3.m: And from the water that touched his foot was born the Bhāgīrathī, entirely auspicious, / by which the three worlds were purified, and by which all the sons of Sagara were redeemed, / and by which at that time the matted hair of Śambhu was completely filled on account of Bhagīratha.

1.3.s:
tīrthānāṃ tīrthamādyaṃ ca gaṃgākhyamavatāritam..
tadviṣṇoścaraṇenaiva sametaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam.. 19.16 ..
1.3.d:
तीर्थानां तीर्थमाद्यं च गंगाख्यमवतारितम्..
तद्विष्णोश्चरणेनैव समेतं ब्रह्मणा कृतम्.. 19.16 ..
1.3.m: The foremost of sacred fords, called Gaṅgā, was brought down; / Brahmā caused it to be united with Viṣṇu's very foot.

1.3.s:
trivikramātparo hyātmā nāmnā trivikramo'bhavat..
trivikramakramākrāṃtaṃ trailokyaṃ ca tadā'bhavat.. 19.17 ..
1.3.d:
त्रिविक्रमात्परो ह्यात्मा नाम्ना त्रिविक्रमोऽभवत्..
त्रिविक्रमक्रमाक्रांतं त्रैलोक्यं च तदाऽभवत्.. 19.17 ..
1.3.m: Because of his three strides, the Supreme Self came to be called Trivikrama; / and the three worlds were then encompassed by Trivikrama's strides.

1.3.s:
padadvayena vā pūrṇaṃ jagadetaccarācaram..
vihāya tatsvarūpaṃ ca devadevo janārddanaḥ..
punaśca baṭurūpo'sāvupaviśya nijāsane.. 19.18 ..
1.3.d:
पदद्वयेन वा पूर्णं जगदेतच्चराचरम्..
विहाय तत्स्वरूपं च देवदेवो जनार्द्दनः..
पुनश्च बटुरूपोऽसावुपविश्य निजासने.. 19.18 ..
1.3.m: When this whole world, moving and unmoving, was filled by his two strides, / the god of gods, Janārdana, abandoned that cosmic form, / and once again assuming the form of a young brahmin student, he sat upon his own seat.

1.3.s:
tadā devāḥ sagaṃdharvā munayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ..
āgatāśca baleryajñaṃ draṣṭuṃ yajñapatiṃ prabhum.. 19.19 ..
1.3.d:
तदा देवाः सगंधर्वा मुनयः सिद्धचारणाः..
आगताश्च बलेर्यज्ञं द्रष्टुं यज्ञपतिं प्रभुम्.. 19.19 ..
1.3.m: Then the gods, accompanied by the gandharvas, sages, siddhas, and cāraṇas, / came to Bali's sacrifice to see the Lord, the master of the sacrifice.

1.3.s:
tatra brahmā samāgatya stutiṃ cakre parātmanaḥ..
balestatraiva cānyena ca daityeṃdrāścāgatāstvaram.. 19.20 ..
1.3.d:
तत्र ब्रह्मा समागत्य स्तुतिं चक्रे परात्मनः..
बलेस्तत्रैव चान्येन च दैत्येंद्राश्चागतास्त्वरम्.. 19.20 ..
1.3.m: Arriving there, Brahmā sang the praise of the Supreme Self; / and just then, from elsewhere, other lords of the daityas quickly arrived.

1.3.s:
ebhiḥ sarvaiḥ parivṛto vāmano balisadmani..
upaviśyāsane so'tha uvāca garuḍaṃ prati.. 19.21 ..
1.3.d:
एभिः सर्वैः परिवृतो वामनो बलिसद्मनि..
उपविश्यासने सोऽथ उवाच गरुडं प्रति.. 19.21 ..
1.3.m: Surrounded by all of them in Bali's palace, / Vāmana sat upon a seat and then said to Garuḍa:

1.3.s:
daityo'sau bāliśo bhūtvā dattānena mahī mama..
tripadakramaṇenaiva gṛhītaṃ ca padadvayam.. 19.22 ..
1.3.d:
दैत्योऽसौ बालिशो भूत्वा दत्तानेन मही मम..
त्रिपदक्रमणेनैव गृहीतं च पदद्वयम्.. 19.22 ..
1.3.m: “This daitya acted foolishly: the earth was given by him to me / to be measured by three strides, and two strides have already been taken.

1.3.s:
padamekaṃ pratiśrutya na dadāti hi durmatiḥ..
tasmāttvayā gṛhītavyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ padameva ca.. 19.23 ..
1.3.d:
पदमेकं प्रतिश्रुत्य न ददाति हि दुर्मतिः..
तस्मात्त्वया गृहीतव्यं तृतीयं पदमेव च.. 19.23 ..
1.3.m: Having promised one [more] stride, the wicked-minded one does not give it; / therefore, you must seize that third stride.”

1.3.s:
ityukto garuḍastena vāmanena mahātmanā..
vairocaniṃ vinirbhartsya vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha.. 19.24 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युक्तो गरुडस्तेन वामनेन महात्मना..
वैरोचनिं विनिर्भर्त्स्य वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह.. 19.24 ..
1.3.m: Addressed thus by that high-souled Vāmana, / Garuḍa rebuked the son of Virocana and spoke these words:

1.3.s:
re bale kiṃ tvayā mūḍha kṛtamasti jugupsitam..
avidyamāne hyarthe hi kiṃ dadāsi paramātmane..
audāryeṇa hi kiṃ kāryamalpakena tvayādhunā.. 19.25 ..
1.3.d:
रे बले किं त्वया मूढ कृतमस्ति जुगुप्सितम्..
अविद्यमाने ह्यर्थे हि किं ददासि परमात्मने..
औदार्येण हि किं कार्यमल्पकेन त्वयाधुना.. 19.25 ..
1.3.m: “Hey Bali, you fool, what contemptible thing have you done? / When the object does not exist, why do you make a gift to the Supreme Self? / What purpose is served now by your petty generosity?

1.3.s:
ityukto balirāviṣṭaḥ syamānaḥ khageśvaram..
vakṣyamāṇamidaṃ vākyaṃ garutmantaṃ tadā'bravīt.. 19.26 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युक्तो बलिराविष्टः स्यमानः खगेश्वरम्..
वक्ष्यमाणमिदं वाक्यं गरुत्मन्तं तदाऽब्रवीत्.. 19.26 ..
1.3.m: Being addressed thus, Bali, possessed [by grief] and smiling, / then spoke these words to Garuḍa, the lord of birds:

1.3.s:
samarthosmi mahāpakṣa gṛpaṇo na bhavāmyaham..
yenedaṃ kāritaṃ sarvaṃ tasmai kiṃ pradadāmyaham.. 19.27 ..
1.3.d:
समर्थोस्मि महापक्ष गृपणो न भवाम्यहम्..
येनेदं कारितं सर्वं तस्मै किं प्रददाम्यहम्.. 19.27 ..
1.3.m: “I am capable, O broad-winged one; I am no miser. / What can I give to him by whom all this was created?

1.3.s:
asamartho hyahaṃ tāta kṛto'nena mahātmanā..
tadovāca baliṃ so'pi tārkṣyaputro mahāmanāḥ.. 19.28 ..
1.3.d:
असमर्थो ह्यहं तात कृतोऽनेन महात्मना..
तदोवाच बलिं सोऽपि तार्क्ष्यपुत्रो महामनाः.. 19.28 ..
1.3.m: Indeed, O friend, I have been rendered powerless by this high-souled one.” / Then that high-minded son of Tārkṣya spoke to Bali:

1.3.s:
jānannapi ca daityeṃdra guruṇāpi nivāritaḥ..
viṣṇave'pi mahīṃ prādāstvayā kiṃ vismṛtaṃ mahat.. 19.29 ..
1.3.d:
जानन्नपि च दैत्येंद्र गुरुणापि निवारितः..
विष्णवेऽपि महीं प्रादास्त्वया किं विस्मृतं महत्.. 19.29 ..
1.3.m: “Even though knowing this, O lord of daityas, and even though restrained by your guru, / you gave the earth to Viṣṇu. Did you forget [his] greatness?

1.3.s:
dātavyaṃ tatpadaṃ viṣṇostṛtīyaṃ yatpratiśrutam..
na dadāsi kathaṃ vīra nirayeca patiṣyasi.. 19.30 ..
1.3.d:
दातव्यं तत्पदं विष्णोस्तृतीयं यत्प्रतिश्रुतम्..
न ददासि कथं वीर निरयेच पतिष्यसि.. 19.30 ..
1.3.m: That third stride of Viṣṇu must be given, since it was promised. / Why do you not give it, O warrior? You will fall into hell!

1.3.s:
na dadāsi tṛtīyaṃ ca padaṃ me svāminaḥ katham..
balādgṛhṇāmi re mūḍha ityuktvā taṃ mahāsuram..
babaṃdha vāruṇaiḥ pāśairvirocana sutaṃ tadā.. 19.31 ..
1.3.d:
न ददासि तृतीयं च पदं मे स्वामिनः कथम्..
बलाद्गृह्णामि रे मूढ इत्युक्त्वा तं महासुरम्..
बबंध वारुणैः पाशैर्विरोचन सुतं तदा.. 19.31 ..
1.3.m: Why do you not give the third stride to my master? / I shall take it by force, you fool!” Having spoken thus to that great asura, / he then bound the son of Virocana with the nooses of Varuṇa.

1.3.s:
nitarāṃ niṣṭhuro bhūtvā garuḍo jayatāṃ varaḥ..
baddhaṃ svapatimālokya viṃdhyāvaliḥ samabhyayāt.. 19.32 ..
1.3.d:
नितरां निष्ठुरो भूत्वा गरुडो जयतां वरः..
बद्धं स्वपतिमालोक्य विंध्यावलिः समभ्ययात्.. 19.32 ..
1.3.m: Garuḍa, the foremost of victors, became exceedingly harsh. / Seeing her husband bound, Vindhyāvalī approached.

1.3.s:
bāṇamekaṃ samāropya vāmanasyāgrataḥ sthitā..
vāmanena tadā pṛṣṭā keyaṃ cātrāgrataḥ sthitā.. 19.33 ..
1.3.d:
बाणमेकं समारोप्य वामनस्याग्रतः स्थिता..
वामनेन तदा पृष्टा केयं चात्राग्रतः स्थिता.. 19.33 ..
1.3.m: Setting an arrow [to her bow], she stood before Vāmana. / Vāmana then asked: “Who is this standing here in front?”

1.3.s:
tadovāca mahātejāḥ prahlādo hyasurādhipaḥ..
baleḥ patnīti tvāṃ prāptā iyaṃ viṃdhyāvalī satī.. 19.34 ..
1.3.d:
तदोवाच महातेजाः प्रह्लादो ह्यसुराधिपः..
बलेः पत्नीति त्वां प्राप्ता इयं विंध्यावली सती.. 19.34 ..
1.3.m: Then the glorious Prahlāda, the lord of the asuras, said: / “This virtuous woman, Vindhyāvalī, has approached you; she is the wife of Bali.”

1.3.s:
prahlādasya vacaḥ śrutvā vāmano vākyamabravīt..
brūhi viṃdhyāvale vākyaṃ kiṃ kāryaṃ te karomyaham..
evamuktā bhagavatā viṃdhyāvalirabhāṣata.. 19.35 ..
1.3.d:
प्रह्लादस्य वचः श्रुत्वा वामनो वाक्यमब्रवीत्..
ब्रूहि विंध्यावले वाक्यं किं कार्यं ते करोम्यहम्..
एवमुक्ता भगवता विंध्यावलिरभाषत.. 19.35 ..
1.3.m: Hearing Prahlāda's words, Vāmana spoke these words: / “Speak, Vindhyāvalī, what can I do for you?” / Being addressed thus by the Blessed Lord, Vindhyāvalī said:

1.3.s:
..vindhyāvaliruvāca..
kasmādbaddho mama patirgaruḍena mahātmanā..
tatkathyatāṃ mahābhāga tvaranneva janārddana..
tadovāca mahātejā baṭuveṣadharo hiḥ.. 19.36 ..
1.3.d:
..विन्ध्यावलिरुवाच..
कस्माद्बद्धो मम पतिर्गरुडेन महात्मना..
तत्कथ्यतां महाभाग त्वरन्नेव जनार्द्दन..
तदोवाच महातेजा बटुवेषधरो हिः.. 19.36 ..
1.3.m: Vindhyāvalī said: / “Why has my husband been bound by the high-souled Garuḍa? / Tell me that immediately, O illustrious Janārdana.” / Then the glorious Hari, disguised as a young student, spoke:

1.3.s:
..śrībhagavānuvāca..
anenaiva pradattā me mahī tripadalakṣaṇā..
padadvayena ca mayākrāṃtaṃ trailokyamadya vai.. 19.37 ..
1.3.d:
..श्रीभगवानुवाच..
अनेनैव प्रदत्ता मे मही त्रिपदलक्षणा..
पदद्वयेन च मयाक्रांतं त्रैलोक्यमद्य वै.. 19.37 ..
1.3.m: The Blessed Lord said: / “By him the earth was given to me to the measure of three strides; / and with two strides the three worlds have today been encompassed by me.

1.3.s:
anena mama dātavyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ padameva ca..
tasmādbaddho mayā sādhvi garuḍenaiva te patiḥ.. 19.38 ..
1.3.d:
अनेन मम दातव्यं तृतीयं पदमेव च..
तस्माद्बद्धो मया साध्वि गरुडेनैव ते पतिः.. 19.38 ..
1.3.m: The third stride must indeed be given to me by him; / therefore, O virtuous lady, your husband has been bound by Garuḍa on my [order].”

1.3.s:
śrutvā bhagavato vākyamuvāca paramaṃ vacaḥ..
pratiśrutamanenaiva na dattaṃ hi tava prabho.. 19.39 ..
1.3.d:
श्रुत्वा भगवतो वाक्यमुवाच परमं वचः..
प्रतिश्रुतमनेनैव न दत्तं हि तव प्रभो.. 19.39 ..
1.3.m: Hearing the words of the Blessed Lord, she spoke these supreme words: / “It was indeed promised by him, O Lord, but it has not been given to you.

1.3.s:
krāṃtaṃ tribhuvanaṃ cādya tvayā vikramarūpiṇā..
tadasmākaṃ vijaghnīthāḥ svarge vāpyathavā bhuvi.. 19.40 ..
1.3.d:
क्रांतं त्रिभुवनं चाद्य त्वया विक्रमरूपिणा..
तदस्माकं विजघ्नीथाः स्वर्गे वाप्यथवा भुवि.. 19.40 ..
1.3.m: The three worlds have today been encompassed by you in the form of Trivikrama; / therefore, strike us in heaven or on earth.

1.3.s:
kiṃcinna dattā hi vibho devadeva jagatpate..
prahasya bhagavānāha tadā viṃdhyāvaliṃ prabhuḥ.. 19.41 ..
1.3.d:
किंचिन्न दत्ता हि विभो देवदेव जगत्पते..
प्रहस्य भगवानाह तदा विंध्यावलिं प्रभुः.. 19.41 ..
1.3.m: Nothing at all was given [beyond that], O all-pervading one, god of gods, lord of the universe!” / Smiling, the Blessed Lord then said to Vindhyāvalī:

1.3.s:
padāni trīṇi me cādya dātavyāni kuto'dhunā..
śīghraṃ vada viśālākṣi yatte manasi varttate..
tadovāca ca sā sādhvī hyurukramamavasthitā.. 19.42 ..
1.3.d:
पदानि त्रीणि मे चाद्य दातव्यानि कुतोऽधुना..
शीघ्रं वद विशालाक्षि यत्ते मनसि वर्त्तते..
तदोवाच च सा साध्वी ह्युरुक्रममवस्थिता.. 19.42 ..
1.3.m: “From where now are my three strides to be given? / Speak quickly, O large-eyed one, whatever is in your mind.” / Then that virtuous woman, standing before Urukrama, said:

1.3.s:
tvayā kuto veyamurukrameṇa krāṃtā trilokī bhuvanaikanātha..
tathaiva sarvaṃ jagadekabaṃdho deyaṃ kismābhiratulyarūpiṇe.. 19.43 ..
1.3.d:
त्वया कुतो वेयमुरुक्रमेण क्रांता त्रिलोकी भुवनैकनाथ..
तथैव सर्वं जगदेकबंधो देयं किस्माभिरतुल्यरूपिणे.. 19.43 ..
1.3.m: “How was this threefold world traversed by you as Urukrama, O sole lord of the worlds? / Likewise, everything [belongs to you], O sole friend of the universe; what could be given by us to one of peerless form?

1.3.s:
tasmādvihāya tadviṣṇo tvamevaṃ kuru saṃprati..
prati śrutāni me bhartrā padāni trīṇi cādhunā..
dadāti me patistedya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 19.44 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्विहाय तद्विष्णो त्वमेवं कुरु संप्रति..
प्रति श्रुतानि मे भर्त्रा पदानि त्रीणि चाधुना..
ददाति मे पतिस्तेद्य नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 19.44 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, O Viṣṇu, leaving that aside, do this now: / Three strides were promised just now by my husband; / my husband will give them to you today; there should be no hesitation here.

1.3.s:
nidhehi me padaṃ tvaṃ hi śīrṣṇi devavara prabho..
dvitīyaṃ me śiśostvaṃ hi kuru mūrdhni jagatpate.. 19.45 ..
1.3.d:
निधेहि मे पदं त्वं हि शीर्ष्णि देववर प्रभो..
द्वितीयं मे शिशोस्त्वं हि कुरु मूर्ध्नि जगत्पते.. 19.45 ..
1.3.m: Place one foot upon my head, O Lord, best of gods; / place the second on the head of my child, O lord of the universe;

1.3.s:
tṛtīyaṃ ca jagannātha kuru śīrṣṇi patermama..
evaṃ trīṇi padānīśa tava dāsyāmi keśava.. 19.46 ..
1.3.d:
तृतीयं च जगन्नाथ कुरु शीर्ष्णि पतेर्मम..
एवं त्रीणि पदानीश तव दास्यामि केशव.. 19.46 ..
1.3.m: and place the third on the head of my husband, O lord of the universe. / Thus I shall give you three strides, O Keśava.”

1.3.s:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā parituṣṭo janārdanaḥ..
uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā virocanasutaṃ prati.. 19.47 ..
1.3.d:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा परितुष्टो जनार्दनः..
उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा विरोचनसुतं प्रति.. 19.47 ..
1.3.m: Hearing her words, Janārdana was deeply pleased, / and spoke in gentle words to the son of Virocana:

1.3.s:
..bhagavānuvāca..
sutalaṃgaccha daityendra mā vilaṃbitumarhasi..
sarvaiścāsurasaṃghaiśca ciraṃ jīva sukhī bhava.. 19.48 ..
1.3.d:
..भगवानुवाच..
सुतलंगच्छ दैत्येन्द्र मा विलंबितुमर्हसि..
सर्वैश्चासुरसंघैश्च चिरं जीव सुखी भव.. 19.48 ..
1.3.m: The Blessed Lord said: / “Go to Sutala, O lord of daityas, you must not delay; / live long and be happy along with all the hosts of asuras.

1.3.s:
parituṣṭo'smyahaṃ tāta kiṃ kāryaṃ karavāṇi te..
sarveṣāmapi dātṝṇāṃ variṣṭho'si mahāmate.. 19.49 ..
1.3.d:
परितुष्टोऽस्म्यहं तात किं कार्यं करवाणि ते..
सर्वेषामपि दातॄणां वरिष्ठोऽसि महामते.. 19.49 ..
1.3.m: I am well-pleased, O friend; what service shall I perform for you? / You are the foremost among all givers, O broad-minded one.

1.3.s:
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te sarvānkāmāndadāmi te..
trivikrameṇaivamukto virocanasutastadā.. 19.50 ..
1.3.d:
वरं वरय भद्रं ते सर्वान्कामान्ददामि ते..
त्रिविक्रमेणैवमुक्तो विरोचनसुतस्तदा.. 19.50 ..
1.3.m: Choose a boon, may you be blessed! I shall grant you all your desires.” / When spoken to thus by Trivikrama at that time, the son of Virocana,

1.3.s:
vimukto hi pariṣvakto devadevena cakriṇā..
tadā baliruvācedaṃ vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ.. 19.51 ..
1.3.d:
विमुक्तो हि परिष्वक्तो देवदेवेन चक्रिणा..
तदा बलिरुवाचेदं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः.. 19.51 ..
1.3.m: released [from bonds] and embraced by the god of gods who bears the discus, / Bali, skilled in speech, then spoke these words:

1.3.s:
tvayā kṛtamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram..
tasmānna kāmaye kiṃcittvatpadābjaṃ vinā prabho.. 19.52 ..
1.3.d:
त्वया कृतमिदं सर्वं जगदेतच्चराचरम्..
तस्मान्न कामये किंचित्त्वत्पदाब्जं विना प्रभो.. 19.52 ..
1.3.m: “All this world, moving and unmoving, was made by you; / therefore, I desire nothing except your lotus feet, O Lord.

1.3.s:
bhaktirastu padāṃbhoje tava deva janārdana..
bhūyobhūyaśca deveśa bhaktirbhavatu śāśvatī.. 19.53 ..
1.3.d:
भक्तिरस्तु पदांभोजे तव देव जनार्दन..
भूयोभूयश्च देवेश भक्तिर्भवतु शाश्वती.. 19.53 ..
1.3.m: May there be devotion to your lotus feet, O god, Janārdana; / again and again, O lord of gods, may there be eternal devotion.”

1.3.s:
evamabhyarthitastena bhagavānbhūtabhāvanaḥ..
uvāca paramaprīto virocanasutaṃ tadā.. 19.54 ..
1.3.d:
एवमभ्यर्थितस्तेन भगवान्भूतभावनः..
उवाच परमप्रीतो विरोचनसुतं तदा.. 19.54 ..
1.3.m: Requested thus by him, the Lord, creator of beings, / exceedingly pleased, then spoke to the son of Virocana: 19.54

1.3.s:
..bhagavānuvāca..
bale tvaṃ sutalaṃ yāhi jñātisaṃbaṃdhibhirvṛtaḥ..
evamuktastadā tena asuro vākyabravīt.. 19.55 ..
1.3.d:
..भगवानुवाच..
बले त्वं सुतलं याहि ज्ञातिसंबंधिभिर्वृतः..
एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन असुरो वाक्यब्रवीत्.. 19.55 ..
1.3.m: The Lord said: / 'O Bali, go to Sutala accompanied by your kinsmen and relatives.' / Addressed thus by him at that time, the Asura spoke [these] words: 19.55

1.3.s:
sutale kiṃ nu me kāryaṃ devadeva vadasva me..
tiṣṭhāmi tava sāṃnidhye nānyathā vaktumarhasi.. 19.56 ..
1.3.d:
सुतले किं नु मे कार्यं देवदेव वदस्व मे..
तिष्ठामि तव सांनिध्ये नान्यथा वक्तुमर्हसि.. 19.56 ..
1.3.m: 'What duty have I in Sutala? Tell me, O God of gods. / Let me remain in your presence; you ought not to say otherwise.' 19.56

1.3.s:
tadovāca hṛṣīkeśo baliṃ taṃ kṛpayā'nvitataḥ..
ahaṃ tava samīpastho bhavāmi satataṃ nṛpa.. 19.57 ..
1.3.d:
तदोवाच हृषीकेशो बलिं तं कृपयाऽन्विततः..
अहं तव समीपस्थो भवामि सततं नृप.. 19.57 ..
1.3.m: Then Hṛṣīkeśa, filled with compassion, said to that Bali: / 'I shall constantly be near you, O king. 19.57

1.3.s:
dvāri sthitastava vibho nivāsāmi nityaṃ mā khidyatāmasuravarya bale śrṛṇuṣva..
vākyaṃ tu me vara maho varadastavādya vaikuṃṭhavāsibhipalaṃ ca bhajāmi geham.. 19.58 ..
1.3.d:
द्वारि स्थितस्तव विभो निवासामि नित्यं मा खिद्यतामसुरवर्य बले श्रृणुष्व..
वाक्यं तु मे वर महो वरदस्तवाद्य वैकुंठवासिभिपलं च भजामि गेहम्.. 19.58 ..
1.3.m: Standing at your door, O mighty one, I will dwell constantly; do not grieve, O best of Asuras, O Bali, listen! / Indeed, grant my word, O giver of boons; today, leaving the dwellers of Vaikuṇṭha, I attend your dwelling.' 19.58

1.3.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya viṣmoratulatejasaḥ..
jagāma sutalaṃ daityau hyasuraiḥ parivāritaḥ.. 19.59 ..
1.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य विष्मोरतुलतेजसः..
जगाम सुतलं दैत्यौ ह्यसुरैः परिवारितः.. 19.59 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that word of Viṣṇu of incomparable splendor, / the Daitya went to Sutala, surrounded indeed by Asuras. 19.59

1.3.s:
tadā putraśatenaiva bāṇamukhyena satvaram..
vasamāno mahābāhurdātṝṇāṃ ca parā gatiḥ.. 19.60 ..
1.3.d:
तदा पुत्रशतेनैव बाणमुख्येन सत्वरम्..
वसमानो महाबाहुर्दातॄणां च परा गतिः.. 19.60 ..
1.3.m: Then, dwelling along with his hundred sons, of whom Bāṇa was the foremost, swiftly / the mighty-armed one became the supreme refuge of givers. 19.60

1.3.s:
trailokye yācakā ye ca sarve yāṃti baliṃ prati..
dvāri sthitastasya viṣṇuḥ prayacchati yathepsitam.. 19.61 ..
1.3.d:
त्रैलोक्ये याचका ये च सर्वे यांति बलिं प्रति..
द्वारि स्थितस्तस्य विष्णुः प्रयच्छति यथेप्सितम्.. 19.61 ..
1.3.m: All those who are suppliants in the three worlds go to Bali; / standing at his door, Viṣṇu gives what is desired. 19.61

1.3.s:
bhuktikāmāśca ye kecinmuktikāmāstathā pare..
yeṣāṃ yajñe ca te viprāstattebhyaḥ saṃprayacchati.. 19.62 ..
1.3.d:
भुक्तिकामाश्च ये केचिन्मुक्तिकामास्तथा परे..
येषां यज्ञे च ते विप्रास्तत्तेभ्यः संप्रयच्छति.. 19.62 ..
1.3.m: Those who desire enjoyment, and likewise others who desire liberation, / and those brahmins in his sacrifice—to them he grants that. 19.62

1.3.s:
evaṃvidho balirjātaḥ prasādācchaṃkarasya ca..
purā hi kitavatvena yaddattaṃ paramātmane.. 19.63 ..
1.3.d:
एवंविधो बलिर्जातः प्रसादाच्छंकरस्य च..
पुरा हि कितवत्वेन यद्दत्तं परमात्मने.. 19.63 ..
1.3.m: Such did Bali become, through the grace of Śaṃkara, / because formerly, in the condition of a gambler, he gave to the Supreme Self. 19.63

1.3.s:
aśuciṃ bhūmimāsādya gaṃdhapuṣpādikaṃ mahat..
patitaṃ cārppitaṃ tena śivāya paramātmane.. 19.64 ..
1.3.d:
अशुचिं भूमिमासाद्य गंधपुष्पादिकं महत्..
पतितं चार्प्पितं तेन शिवाय परमात्मने.. 19.64 ..
1.3.m: Reaching impure ground, the abundant fragrant flowers and other items / that had fallen were offered by him to Śiva, the Supreme Self. 19.64

1.3.s:
kiṃ punaḥ parayā bhaktyā cārcayaṃti maheśvaram..
puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ te yāṃti śivasannidhim.. 19.65 ..
1.3.d:
किं पुनः परया भक्त्या चार्चयंति महेश्वरम्..
पुष्पं फलं तोयं ते यांति शिवसन्निधिम्.. 19.65 ..
1.3.m: What then of those who worship Maheśvara with supreme devotion? / Offering flower, fruit, and water, they go to the presence of Śiva. 19.65

1.3.s:
śivātparataro nāsti pūjanīyo hi bho dvijāḥ..
ye hi mūkāstathāṃdhāśca paṃgavo ye jaḍāstathā.. 19.66 ..
1.3.d:
शिवात्परतरो नास्ति पूजनीयो हि भो द्विजाः..
ये हि मूकास्तथांधाश्च पंगवो ये जडास्तथा.. 19.66 ..
1.3.m: There is none higher than Śiva to be worshipped, O twice-born! / Even those who are mute and blind, lame, and dull, 19.66

1.3.s:
jātihīnāśca caṃḍālāḥ śvapacā hyaṃtyajā hyamī..
śivabhaktiparā nityaṃ te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim.. 19.67 ..
1.3.d:
जातिहीनाश्च चंडालाः श्वपचा ह्यंत्यजा ह्यमी..
शिवभक्तिपरा नित्यं ते यांति परमां गतिम्.. 19.67 ..
1.3.m: and those devoid of caste, Caṇḍālas, dog-cookers, and the outcasts— / if constantly devoted to Śiva, they go to the supreme state. 19.67

1.3.s:
tasmātsadāśivaḥ pūjyaḥ sarvairevamanīṣibhiḥ..
pūjanīyo hi saṃpūjyo hyarcanīyaḥ sadāśivaḥ.. 19.68 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्सदाशिवः पूज्यः सर्वैरेवमनीषिभिः..
पूजनीयो हि संपूज्यो ह्यर्चनीयः सदाशिवः.. 19.68 ..
1.3.m: Therefore Sadāśiva is to be worshipped by all wise men; / Sadāśiva is to be revered, honored, and worshipped. 19.68

1.3.s:
maheśaṃ paramārathajñāściṃtayaṃti hṛdi sthitam..
yatra jīvo bhavatyeva śivastatraiva tiṣṭhati.. 19.69 ..
1.3.d:
महेशं परमारथज्ञाश्चिंतयंति हृदि स्थितम्..
यत्र जीवो भवत्येव शिवस्तत्रैव तिष्ठति.. 19.69 ..
1.3.m: Those who know the highest reality meditate upon Maheśa residing in the heart; / wherever the individual soul exists, right there Śiva abides. 19.69

1.3.s:
vinā śivena yatkiṃcidaśivaṃ bhavati kṣaṇāt..
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca guṇakāryakarā hyamī.. 19.70 ..
1.3.d:
विना शिवेन यत्किंचिदशिवं भवति क्षणात्..
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च गुणकार्यकरा ह्यमी.. 19.70 ..
1.3.m: Without Śiva, whatever exists becomes inauspicious in an instant; / Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra are indeed performers of the work of the qualities. 19.70

1.3.s:
rajoguṇānvito brahmā viṣṇuḥ sattvaguṇānvitaḥ..
tamoguṇāśrito rudro guṇātīto maheśvaraḥ.. 19.71 ..
1.3.d:
रजोगुणान्वितो ब्रह्मा विष्णुः सत्त्वगुणान्वितः..
तमोगुणाश्रितो रुद्रो गुणातीतो महेश्वरः.. 19.71 ..
1.3.m: Brahmā is endowed with the quality of rajas; Viṣṇu is endowed with the quality of sattva; / Rudra is resorted to the quality of tamas; Maheśvara transcends the qualities. 19.71

1.3.s:
liṃgarūpo mahādevo hyarcanīyo mumukṣubhiḥ..
śivātparataro nāsti bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ.. 19.72 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṇḍe balaye varapradānavarṇanaṃnāmaikoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 19 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
लिंगरूपो महादेवो ह्यर्चनीयो मुमुक्षुभिः..
शिवात्परतरो नास्ति भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकः.. 19.72 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखण्डे बलये वरप्रदानवर्णनंनामैकोविंशोऽध्यायः.. 19 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
Mahādeva in the form of a liṅga must be worshipped by those seeking liberation; / there is none higher than Śiva, the giver of enjoyment and liberation. 19.72
Thus ends the nineteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Granting of Boons to Bali,' in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first [part], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 19.

1.3.s:
..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca saguṇāḥ kīrtitāstvayā..
liṃgarūpī tathaiveśo nirguṇo'sau kathaṃ vada.. 20.1 ..
1.3.d:
..ऋषय ऊचुः..
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च सगुणाः कीर्तितास्त्वया..
लिंगरूपी तथैवेशो निर्गुणोऽसौ कथं वद.. 20.1 ..
1.3.m: The seers said: / 'Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra have been declared by you to have qualities; / how then is this Īśa, whose form is a liṅga, without qualities? Tell [us]. 20.1

1.3.s:
tribhirguṇairvyāptamidaṃ carācaraṃ jaganmahadvyāpyatha vālpakaṃ vā..
māyāmayaṃ sarvamidaṃ vibhāti liṃgaṃ vinā kena kutovibhāti.. 20.2 ..
1.3.d:
त्रिभिर्गुणैर्व्याप्तमिदं चराचरं जगन्महद्व्याप्यथ वाल्पकं वा..
मायामयं सर्वमिदं विभाति लिंगं विना केन कुतोविभाति.. 20.2 ..
1.3.m: This world of moving and unmoving beings is pervaded by the three qualities, whether vast or small; / all this appears full of illusion. Without a liṅga, by whom and whence does it shine? 20.2

1.3.s: yaddṛśyamānaṃ mahadalpakaṃ ca tannaśvaraṃ kṛtakatvācca sūta.. 20.3 ..
1.3.d: यद्दृश्यमानं महदल्पकं च तन्नश्वरं कृतकत्वाच्च सूत.. 20.3 ..
1.3.m: Whatever is seen, both vast and small, is perishable because it is created, O Sūta. 20.3

1.3.s:
tasmādvimṛśya bhoḥ sūta saṃśayaṃ chettumarhasi..
vyāsaprasādātsakalaṃ jānāsi tvaṃ na cāparaḥ.. 20.4 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्विमृश्य भोः सूत संशयं छेत्तुमर्हसि..
व्यासप्रसादात्सकलं जानासि त्वं न चापरः.. 20.4 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, reflecting on this, O Sūta, you ought to cut off our doubt; / by the grace of Vyāsa, you know everything, and no other.' 20.4

1.3.s:
..suta uvāca..
vyāsena kathitaṃ sarvamasminnarthe śukaṃ prati..
śuka uvāca..
liṃgarūpī kathaṃ śaṃbhurnirguṇaḥ kathate tvayā..
etanme saṃśayaṃ tāta cchettumarhasyaśeṣataḥ.. 20.5 ..
1.3.d:
..सुत उवाच..
व्यासेन कथितं सर्वमस्मिन्नर्थे शुकं प्रति..
शुक उवाच..
लिंगरूपी कथं शंभुर्निर्गुणः कथते त्वया..
एतन्मे संशयं तात च्छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः.. 20.5 ..
1.3.m: Sūta said: / 'Everything concerning this matter was told by Vyāsa to Śuka. / Śuka said: / "How is Śambhu, whose form is a liṅga, said by you to be without qualities? / You ought to dispel this doubt of mine completely, O father." 20.5

1.3.s:
..vyāsa uvāca..
śruṇu vatsa bravīmyetatpurā proktaṃ ca naṃdinā..
agastyaṃ pṛcchamānaṃ ca yena sarvaṃ śrutaṃ śuka.. 20.6 ..
1.3.d:
..व्यास उवाच..
श्रुणु वत्स ब्रवीम्येतत्पुरा प्रोक्तं च नंदिना..
अगस्त्यं पृच्छमानं च येन सर्वं श्रुतं शुक.. 20.6 ..
1.3.m: Vyāsa said: / "Listen, child! I shall speak of this which was formerly proclaimed by Nandin / to Agastya when he inquired, by whom all was heard, O Śuka. 20.6

1.3.s:
nirguṇaṃ paramātmānaṃ viddhi liṃgasvarūpiṇam..
parā śaktistathā jñeyā nirguṇā śāśvatī satī .. 20.7 ..
1.3.d:
निर्गुणं परमात्मानं विद्धि लिंगस्वरूपिणम्..
परा शक्तिस्तथा ज्ञेया निर्गुणा शाश्वती सती .. 20.7 ..
1.3.m: Know the Supreme Self without qualities to have the form of a liṅga; / likewise, the supreme power, the eternal Satī, is to be known as without qualities, 20.7

1.3.s:
yayā kṛtimidaṃ sarvaṃ guṇatrayavibhāvitam..
etaccarācaraṃ viśvaṃ naśvaraṃ paramārthataḥ.. 20.8 ..
1.3.d:
यया कृतिमिदं सर्वं गुणत्रयविभावितम्..
एतच्चराचरं विश्वं नश्वरं परमार्थतः.. 20.8 ..
1.3.m: by whom was made all this universe, manifested by the three qualities; / this world of moving and unmoving things is perishable in the ultimate sense. 20.8

1.3.s:
eka eva paro hyātmā liṃgarūpī niraṃjanaḥ..
prakṛtyā saha te sarve triguṇā vilayaṃ gatāḥ.. 20.9 ..
1.3.d:
एक एव परो ह्यात्मा लिंगरूपी निरंजनः..
प्रकृत्या सह ते सर्वे त्रिगुणा विलयं गताः.. 20.9 ..
1.3.m: The Supreme Self alone is one, having the form of a liṅga, taintless; / together with Prakṛti, all those three qualities have attained dissolution [in it]. 20.9

1.3.s:
yasminneva tato liṃgaṃ layanātkathitaṃ purā..
tasmālliṃge layaṃ prāptā parā śaktiḥ kuto'pare.. 20.10 ..
1.3.d:
यस्मिन्नेव ततो लिंगं लयनात्कथितं पुरा..
तस्माल्लिंगे लयं प्राप्ता परा शक्तिः कुतोऽपरे.. 20.10 ..
1.3.m: It was called 'liṅga' in ancient times because of dissolution into that very one; / therefore, if the supreme power has attained dissolution in the liṅga, how could others not? 20.10

1.3.s:
līnā guṇāśca rudroktyā yairidaṃ baddhameva ca..
carācaraṃ mahābhāga tasmālliṃgaṃ prapūjayet.. 20.11 ..
1.3.d:
लीना गुणाश्च रुद्रोक्त्या यैरिदं बद्धमेव च..
चराचरं महाभाग तस्माल्लिंगं प्रपूजयेत्.. 20.11 ..
1.3.m: And the qualities, by which this world of moving and unmoving beings is bound, / are dissolved by the word of Rudra, O highly fortunate one; therefore one should worship the liṅga. 20.11

1.3.s:
liṃgaṃ ca nirguṇaṃ sākṣājjānīdhvaṃ bho drijotamāḥ..
layālliṃgasya māhātmyaṃ guṇānāṃ parikīrtyate.. 20.12 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगं च निर्गुणं साक्षाज्जानीध्वं भो द्रिजोतमाः..
लयाल्लिंगस्य माहात्म्यं गुणानां परिकीर्त्यते.. 20.12 ..
1.3.m: Know the liṅga directly to be without qualities, O best of brahmins! / The greatness of the liṅga is proclaimed because of dissolution of the qualities. 20.12

1.3.s:
śaṃkaraḥ sukhadātā hi ucyamāno manīṣibhiḥ..
sarvo hi kathyate viprāḥ sarveṣāmāśrayo hi sa.. 20.13 ..
1.3.d:
शंकरः सुखदाता हि उच्यमानो मनीषिभिः..
सर्वो हि कथ्यते विप्राः सर्वेषामाश्रयो हि स.. 20.13 ..
1.3.m: Śaṃkara is spoken of by the wise as the giver of happiness; / Sarva is so called, O brahmins, because he is the shelter of all. 20.13

1.3.s: śaṃbhurhi kathyate viprā yasmācca śubhasaṃbhavaḥ.. 20.14 ..
1.3.d: शंभुर्हि कथ्यते विप्रा यस्माच्च शुभसंभवः.. 20.14 ..
1.3.m: He is called Śambhu, O brahmins, because auspiciousness originates from him. 20.14

1.3.s:
evaṃ sarvāṇi nāmāni sārthakāni mahātmanaḥ..
tenāvṛtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ śaṃbhunā parameṣṭhinā.. 20.15 ..
1.3.d:
एवं सर्वाणि नामानि सार्थकानि महात्मनः..
तेनावृतं जगत्सर्वं शंभुना परमेष्ठिना.. 20.15 ..
1.3.m: In this way, all the names of the Great Soul are meaningful; / by him, Śambhu, the supreme lord, the entire universe is pervaded." 20.15

1.3.s:
..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
yadā dākṣāyaṇī cāgnau patitā yajñakarmaṇi..
dakṣasya ca mahābhāgā tirodhānagatā satī.. 20.16 ..
1.3.d:
..ऋषय ऊचुः..
यदा दाक्षायणी चाग्नौ पतिता यज्ञकर्मणि..
दक्षस्य च महाभागा तिरोधानगता सती.. 20.16 ..
1.3.m: The seers said: / 'When Dākṣāyaṇī fell into the fire at the performance of Dakṣa's sacrifice, / and the highly fortunate Satī disappeared, 20.16

1.3.s:
prādurbhūtā kadā sūta kathyatāṃ tattvayā'dhunā..
parā śaktirmaheśasya militā ca kathaṃ punaḥ.. 20.17 ..
1.3.d:
प्रादुर्भूता कदा सूत कथ्यतां तत्त्वयाऽधुना..
परा शक्तिर्महेशस्य मिलिता च कथं पुनः.. 20.17 ..
1.3.m: when did she manifest again, O Sūta? Tell that now. / And how was the supreme power of Maheśa united with him once more? 20.17

1.3.s:
etatsarvaṃ mahābhāga pūrvavṛttaṃ ca tattvataḥ..
kathanīyaṃ ca asmākaṃ nānyo vaktāsti kaścana.. 20.18 ..
1.3.d:
एतत्सर्वं महाभाग पूर्ववृत्तं च तत्त्वतः..
कथनीयं च अस्माकं नान्यो वक्तास्ति कश्चन.. 20.18 ..
1.3.m: All this past account must be told to us in truth, / O highly fortunate one; there is no other narrator.' 20.18

1.3.s:
..sūta uvāca..
jajñe dākṣāyaṇī brahmanvidagdhāvayavā yadā..
vinā śaktyā maheśo'pi tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ.. 20.19 ..
1.3.d:
..सूत उवाच..
जज्ञे दाक्षायणी ब्रह्मन्विदग्धावयवा यदा..
विना शक्त्या महेशोऽपि तताप परमं तपः.. 20.19 ..
1.3.m: Sūta said: / 'O brahmin, when Dākṣāyaṇī was born, her limbs burned, / even Maheśa, bereft of his Śakti, performed supreme austerity, 20.19

1.3.s:
līlāgṛhītavapuṣā parvate himavadgirau..
bhṛṃgiṇā saha viśvena naṃdinā ca tathaiva ca.. 20.20 ..
1.3.d:
लीलागृहीतवपुषा पर्वते हिमवद्गिरौ..
भृंगिणा सह विश्वेन नंदिना च तथैव च.. 20.20 ..
1.3.m: having assumed a body in play upon Mount Himavat, / together with Bhṛṅgin, Viśva, and likewise Nandin, 20.20

1.3.s:
tathā caṃḍena muṃḍena tathānyairbahubhirvṛtaḥ..
daśabhiḥ koṭiguṇitairgaṇaiśca parivāritaḥ.. 20.21 ..
1.3.d:
तथा चंडेन मुंडेन तथान्यैर्बहुभिर्वृतः..
दशभिः कोटिगुणितैर्गणैश्च परिवारितः.. 20.21 ..
1.3.m: and surrounded by Caṇḍa, Muṇḍa, and many others, / and encircled by his gaṇas multiplied by ten crores, 20.21

1.3.s:
gaṇānāṃ caiva koṭyā ca tathā ṣaṣṭisahasrakaiḥ..
evaṃ tatra gaṇairdeva āvṛto vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ.. 20.22 ..
1.3.d:
गणानां चैव कोट्या च तथा षष्टिसहस्रकैः..
एवं तत्र गणैर्देव आवृतो वृषभध्वजः.. 20.22 ..
1.3.m: and indeed with a crore and sixty thousand of gaṇas. / Thus surrounded there by his gaṇas was the god whose emblem is a bull.' 20.22

1.3.s:
tapo juṣāṇaḥ sahasā mahātmā himālayasyāgragatastathaiva..
gaṇairvṛto vīrabhadrapradhānaiḥ sa kevalo mūlavidyāvihīnaḥ.. 20.23 ..
1.3.d:
तपो जुषाणः सहसा महात्मा हिमालयस्याग्रगतस्तथैव..
गणैर्वृतो वीरभद्रप्रधानैः स केवलो मूलविद्याविहीनः.. 20.23 ..
1.3.m: Enjoying austerity, the great-souled one stood suddenly before Himālaya, / surrounded by his gaṇas led by Vīrabhadra, solitary, devoid of his primordial wisdom.

1.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare daityāḥ prādurbhūtā hyavidyayā..
viṣṇunā hi balirbaddhastathā te vai mahābalāḥ.. 20.24 ..
1.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे दैत्याः प्रादुर्भूता ह्यविद्यया..
विष्णुना हि बलिर्बद्धस्तथा ते वै महाबलाः.. 20.24 ..
1.3.m: Meanwhile, the Daityas manifested through ignorance; / for Bali was bound by Viṣṇu, and those [others] were of great might.

1.3.s:
jātā daityāstato viprā iṃdropadravakārakāḥ..
kālakhaṃjā mahāraudrāḥ kālakāyāstathāpare.. 20.25 ..
1.3.d:
जाता दैत्यास्ततो विप्रा इंद्रोपद्रवकारकाः..
कालखंजा महारौद्राः कालकायास्तथापरे.. 20.25 ..
1.3.m: From that arose Daityas, O brahmins, who caused distress to Indra: / the exceedingly terrible Kālakhañjas, and others who were Kālakāyas,

1.3.s:
nivātakavacāḥ sarve ravarāvakasaṃjñakāḥ..
anye ca bahavo daityāḥ prajāsaṃhārakārakāḥ.. 20.26 ..
1.3.d:
निवातकवचाः सर्वे रवरावकसंज्ञकाः..
अन्ये च बहवो दैत्याः प्रजासंहारकारकाः.. 20.26 ..
1.3.m: all the Nivātakavacas, those named Ravarāvakas, / and many other Daityas who brought destruction upon creatures.

1.3.s:
tārako namuceḥ putrastapasā parameṇa hi..
brahmāṇaṃ toṣayāmāsa brahmā tasya tutoṣa vai.. 20.27 ..
1.3.d:
तारको नमुचेः पुत्रस्तपसा परमेण हि..
ब्रह्माणं तोषयामास ब्रह्मा तस्य तुतोष वै.. 20.27 ..
1.3.m: Tāraka, the son of Namuci, by supreme austerity / pleased Brahmā, and Brahmā indeed was pleased with him.

1.3.s:
varāndadau yatheṣṭāṃśca tārakāya durātmane..
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te sarvānkāmāndadāmi te.. 20.28 ..
1.3.d:
वरान्ददौ यथेष्टांश्च तारकाय दुरात्मने..
वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते सर्वान्कामान्ददामि ते.. 20.28 ..
1.3.m: He granted desired boons to the evil-minded Tāraka: / 'Choose a boon, good fortune to you! I give you all your desires.'

1.3.s:
tacchatvā vacanaṃ tasya brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ..
varayāmāsa ca tadā varaṃ lokabhayāvaham.. 20.29 ..
1.3.d:
तच्छत्वा वचनं तस्य ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः..
वरयामास च तदा वरं लोकभयावहम्.. 20.29 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that speech of Brahmā, the supreme lord, / he then asked for a boon that struck terror into the worlds:

1.3.s:
yadi me tvaṃ prasanna'si ajarāmaratāṃ prabho..
dehi me yadvijānāsi ajeyatvaṃ tathaiva ca.. 20.30 ..
1.3.d:
यदि मे त्वं प्रसन्नऽसि अजरामरतां प्रभो..
देहि मे यद्विजानासि अजेयत्वं तथैव च.. 20.30 ..
1.3.m: 'If you are pleased with me, O lord, grant me freedom from old age and death, / as you understand it, and likewise invincibility.'

1.3.s:
evamuktastadā tena tārakeṇa durātmanā..
uvāca prahasanvākyamamaratvaṃ kutastava.. 20.31 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन तारकेण दुरात्मना..
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यममरत्वं कुतस्तव.. 20.31 ..
1.3.m: Addressed thus by that evil-minded Tāraka, / he laughed and spoke these words: 'Whence could you have immortality?

1.3.s:
jātasya hi dhruvo mṛtyuretajjānīhi tattvataḥ..
prahasya tārakaḥ prāha ajeyatvaṃ ca dehi me.. 20.32 ..
1.3.d:
जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युरेतज्जानीहि तत्त्वतः..
प्रहस्य तारकः प्राह अजेयत्वं च देहि मे.. 20.32 ..
1.3.m: For death is certain for one who is born; know this in truth.' / Laughing, Tāraka said, 'Then grant me invincibility.'

1.3.s:
brahmovāca tadā daityajeyatvaṃ tavānagha..
vinārbhakeṇa dattaṃ vai hyarbhakastvāṃ vijeṣyate.. 20.33 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच तदा दैत्यजेयत्वं तवानघ..
विनार्भकेण दत्तं वै ह्यर्भकस्त्वां विजेष्यते.. 20.33 ..
1.3.m: Brahmā then said: 'O sinless Daitya, invincibility for you / is granted indeed, except by a child; a child will conquer you.'

1.3.s:
tadā sa tārakaḥ prāha brahmāṇaṃ praṇataḥ prabho..
kṛtārtho'haṃ hi deveśa prasādāttava saṃprati.. 20.34 ..
1.3.d:
तदा स तारकः प्राह ब्रह्माणं प्रणतः प्रभो..
कृतार्थोऽहं हि देवेश प्रसादात्तव संप्रति.. 20.34 ..
1.3.m: Then that Tāraka, bowing, said to Brahmā: 'O lord, / ruler of the gods, my purpose is fulfilled now by your grace.'

1.3.s:
evaṃ labdhavaro bhūtvā tārako hi mahābalaḥ..
devānyuddhārthamāhūya yuyudhe taiḥ sahāsuraḥ.. 20.35 ..
1.3.d:
एवं लब्धवरो भूत्वा तारको हि महाबलः..
देवान्युद्धार्थमाहूय युयुधे तैः सहासुरः.. 20.35 ..
1.3.m: Having thus obtained the boon, Tāraka, being of great might, / challenged the gods to battle and fought with them, as an Asura.

1.3.s:
mucukundaṃ samāśritya devāste jayino'bhavan..
punaḥ punarvikurvāṇā devāste tārakeṇa hi.. 20.36 ..
1.3.d:
मुचुकुन्दं समाश्रित्य देवास्ते जयिनोऽभवन्..
पुनः पुनर्विकुर्वाणा देवास्ते तारकेण हि.. 20.36 ..
1.3.m: Taking refuge in Mucukunda, those gods became victorious; / though the gods were distressed again and again by Tāraka,

1.3.s:
mucukundabalenaiva jayamāpuḥsurāstadā..
kiṃ kartavyaṃ hi cāsmākaṃ yudhyamānairniraṃtaram.. 20.37 ..
1.3.d:
मुचुकुन्दबलेनैव जयमापुःसुरास्तदा..
किं कर्तव्यं हि चास्माकं युध्यमानैर्निरंतरम्.. 20.37 ..
1.3.m: the gods then attained victory solely by the power of Mucukunda. / 'What must be done by us, continually fighting?'

1.3.s:
bhavitavyamiti smṛtvā gatāste brahmaṇaḥ padam..
brahmaṇaścāgrato bhūtvā hyabruvaṃste savāsavāḥ.. 20.38 ..
1.3.d:
भवितव्यमिति स्मृत्वा गतास्ते ब्रह्मणः पदम्..
ब्रह्मणश्चाग्रतो भूत्वा ह्यब्रुवंस्ते सवासवाः.. 20.38 ..
1.3.m: Reflecting, 'Thus it must be,' they went to the realm of Brahmā, / and having arrived before Brahmā, they, together with Indra, spoke.

1.3.s:
.. devā ūcūḥ..
balinā saha pātālamāste'sau madhusūdanaḥ..
viṣṇuṃ vinā hi te sarve vṛṣādyāḥ patitāḥ paraiḥ.. 20.39 ..
1.3.d:
.. देवा ऊचूः..
बलिना सह पातालमास्तेऽसौ मधुसूदनः..
विष्णुं विना हि ते सर्वे वृषाद्याः पतिताः परैः.. 20.39 ..
1.3.m: The gods said: / 'That Madhusūdana dwells in Pātāla with Bali. / For without Viṣṇu, all those led by Vṛṣa were struck down by enemies,

1.3.s:
daityeṃdraiśca mahābhāga trātumarhasi naḥ prabho..
tadā nabhogatā vāṇī hyuvāca parisāṃtvya vai.. 20.40 ..
1.3.d:
दैत्येंद्रैश्च महाभाग त्रातुमर्हसि नः प्रभो..
तदा नभोगता वाणी ह्युवाच परिसांत्व्य वै.. 20.40 ..
1.3.m: and by the Daitya chiefs, O fortunate one; you ought to protect us, O lord.' / Then a voice from the sky spoke, consoling them:

1.3.s:
he devāḥ kriyatāmāśu mama vākyaṃ hi tattvataḥ..
śivātmajo yadā devā bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ.. 20.41 ..
1.3.d:
हे देवाः क्रियतामाशु मम वाक्यं हि तत्त्वतः..
शिवात्मजो यदा देवा भविष्यति महाबलः.. 20.41 ..
1.3.m: 'O gods, let my words be carried out swiftly and truly! / O gods, when a son of Śiva of great might is born,

1.3.s:
yuddhe punastārakaṃ ca vadhiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ..
yenopāyena bhagavāñchaṃbhuḥ sarvaguhāśayaḥ.. 20.42 ..
1.3.d:
युद्धे पुनस्तारकं च वधिष्यति न संशयः..
येनोपायेन भगवाञ्छंभुः सर्वगुहाशयः.. 20.42 ..
1.3.m: he will surely slay Tāraka in battle, without doubt. / By whatever means the venerable Śambhu, who dwells in the secret heart of all,

1.3.s:
dārāparigrahī devāstathā nītirvidhīyatām..
kriyatāṃ ca paro yatno bhavadbhirnānyathā vacaḥ.. 20.43 ..
1.3.d:
दारापरिग्रही देवास्तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम्..
क्रियतां च परो यत्नो भवद्भिर्नान्यथा वचः.. 20.43 ..
1.3.m: may take a wife, O gods, let such a policy be arranged; / and let the utmost effort be made by you; the word cannot be otherwise.

1.3.s:
yūyaṃ devā vijānīdhvamityuvācāśarīravāk..
paraṃ vismayamāpannā ūcurdevāḥ parasparam.. 20.44 ..
1.3.d:
यूयं देवा विजानीध्वमित्युवाचाशरीरवाक्..
परं विस्मयमापन्ना ऊचुर्देवाः परस्परम्.. 20.44 ..
1.3.m: Know this, O gods!' Thus spoke the incorporeal voice. / Overcome with great astonishment, the gods spoke to one another.

1.3.s:
śrutvā nabhogatāṃ vāṇīmājagmuste himālayam..
bṛhaspatiṃ puraskṛtya sarve devā vaco'bruvan..20.45 ..
1.3.d:
श्रुत्वा नभोगतां वाणीमाजग्मुस्ते हिमालयम्..
बृहस्पतिं पुरस्कृत्य सर्वे देवा वचोऽब्रुवन्..20.45 ..
1.3.m: Having heard the voice from the sky, they went to Himālaya; / placing Bṛhaspati at their head, all the gods spoke these words

1.3.s:
himālayaṃ mahābhāgāḥ sarve kāryārthagauravāt..
himālaya mahābhāga śrūyatāṃ no'dhunā vacaḥ.. 20.46 ..
1.3.d:
हिमालयं महाभागाः सर्वे कार्यार्थगौरवात्..
हिमालय महाभाग श्रूयतां नोऽधुना वचः.. 20.46 ..
1.3.m: to Himālaya, the fortunate ones, because of the importance of their goal: / 'O fortunate Himālaya, hear now our word!

1.3.s:
tārakastrāsayatyasmānsāhāyyaṃ tadvadhe kuru..
tvaṃ śaraṇyo bhavāsmākaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca tapasvinām..
tasmātsarve vayaṃ yātā maheṃdrasahitā vibho.. 20.47 ..
1.3.d:
तारकस्त्रासयत्यस्मान्साहाय्यं तद्वधे कुरु..
त्वं शरण्यो भवास्माकं सर्वेषां च तपस्विनाम्..
तस्मात्सर्वे वयं याता महेंद्रसहिता विभो.. 20.47 ..
1.3.m: Tāraka terrifies us; lend aid in his slaying! / Be a refuge for us and for all ascetics; / therefore we have all come, together with great Indra, O lord!'

1.3.s:
.. lomaśa uvāca..
evamabhyarthito devairhimavāngirisattamaḥ..
uvāca devānprahasanvākyaṃ vākyavidāṃ varaḥ.. 20.48 ..
1.3.d:
.. लोमश उवाच..
एवमभ्यर्थितो देवैर्हिमवान्गिरिसत्तमः..
उवाच देवान्प्रहसन्वाक्यं वाक्यविदां वरः.. 20.48 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Thus enticed by the gods, Himavat, best of mountains, / the best among those who know how to speak, laughing, said to the gods,

1.3.s:
mahendra muddiśya tadā hyupahāsasamanvitaḥ..
akṣamāśca vayaṃ sarve mahendreṇa kṛtāḥ surāḥ.. 20.49 ..
1.3.d:
महेन्द्र मुद्दिश्य तदा ह्युपहाससमन्वितः..
अक्षमाश्च वयं सर्वे महेन्द्रेण कृताः सुराः.. 20.49 ..
1.3.m: referring then to Mahendra with mockery: / 'We have all been rendered powerless by Mahendra, O gods!

1.3.s:
kiṃ kurmaḥ surakāryaṃ ca tārakasya vadhaṃ prati..
pakṣayuktā vayaṃ sarve yadi syāma surottamāḥ.. 20.50 ..
1.3.d:
किं कुर्मः सुरकार्यं च तारकस्य वधं प्रति..
पक्षयुक्ता वयं सर्वे यदि स्याम सुरोत्तमाः.. 20.50 ..
1.3.m: What can we do for the sake of the gods regarding the slaying of Tāraka? / If we were all endowed with wings, O best of gods,

1.3.s:
tadā vayaṃ ghātayāmastārakaṃ saha bāṃdhavaiḥ..
acalohaṃ vipakṣaśca kiṃ kāryaṃ karavāṇi va.. 20.51 ..
1.3.d:
तदा वयं घातयामस्तारकं सह बांधवैः..
अचलोहं विपक्षश्च किं कार्यं करवाणि व.. 20.51 ..
1.3.m: then we would slay Tāraka together with his kinsmen. / I am immobile and wingless; what service can I perform for you?'

1.3.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarve devāstamabruvan..
sarve yūyaṃ vayaṃ caiva asamarthā vadhaṃ prati..
tārakasya mahābhāga etatkāryaṃ vicaṃtyatām.. 20.52 ..
1.3.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वे देवास्तमब्रुवन्..
सर्वे यूयं वयं चैव असमर्था वधं प्रति..
तारकस्य महाभाग एतत्कार्यं विचंत्यताम्.. 20.52 ..
1.3.m: Hearing those words of his, all the gods said to him: / 'All of you and we ourselves are incapable of the slaying / of Tāraka, O fortunate one; let this matter be considered,

1.3.s:
yena sādhyo bhavecchatrustārako hi mahābalaḥ..
tadovāca mahātejā himavānsa surānprati.. 20.53 ..
1.3.d:
येन साध्यो भवेच्छत्रुस्तारको हि महाबलः..
तदोवाच महातेजा हिमवान्स सुरान्प्रति.. 20.53 ..
1.3.m: by which the enemy, the mighty Tāraka, may be conquered.' / Then Himavat, possessed of great splendor, said to the gods:

1.3.s:
kenopāyena bho devāstārakaṃ haṃtumicchatha..
kathayaṃtutvareṇaiva kāryaṃ vettuṃ mamaiva hi.. 20.54 ..
1.3.d:
केनोपायेन भो देवास्तारकं हंतुमिच्छथ..
कथयंतुत्वरेणैव कार्यं वेत्तुं ममैव हि.. 20.54 ..
1.3.m: 'By what means, O gods, do you wish to kill Tāraka? / Speak swiftly, that I may understand my duty.'

1.3.s:
tadā suraiḥ kathitaṃ sarvametadvāṇyā coktaṃ yatpurā kāryahetoḥ..
śrutaṃ tadā giriṇā vākyameta xxxxxxx himavānparvato hi.. 20.55 ..
1.3.d:
तदा सुरैः कथितं सर्वमेतद्वाण्या चोक्तं यत्पुरा कार्यहेतोः..
श्रुतं तदा गिरिणा वाक्यमेत xxxxxxx हिमवान्पर्वतो हि.. 20.55 ..
1.3.m: Then all this was told by the gods, and what was spoken before by the voice for the sake of the goal; / that speech was heard then by the mountain, […] indeed Himavat the mountain:

1.3.s:
śivasya putreṇa ca dhīmatā yadā vadhyo daityastārako vai mahātmā..
tadā sarvaṃ suragakāryaṃ śubhaṃsyādvāṇyā coktaṃ satyametadbhavecca.. 20.56 ..
1.3.d:
शिवस्य पुत्रेण च धीमता यदा वध्यो दैत्यस्तारको वै महात्मा..
तदा सर्वं सुरगकार्यं शुभंस्याद्वाण्या चोक्तं सत्यमेतद्भवेच्च.. 20.56 ..
1.3.m: 'When the great-souled Daitya Tāraka is slain by the wise son of Śiva, / then all the affairs of the gods will become auspicious, and this spoken by the voice will come true.

1.3.s:
tasmāttadenatkriyatāṃ bhavadbhiryathā maheśaḥ kurute parigraham..
kanyā yathā tasya śivasya yogyā nirīkṣyatāmāśu surairidānīm.. 20.57 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्तदेनत्क्रियतां भवद्भिर्यथा महेशः कुरुते परिग्रहम्..
कन्या यथा तस्य शिवस्य योग्या निरीक्ष्यतामाशु सुरैरिदानीम्.. 20.57 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, let this be done by you so that the great lord takes a wife; / let a maiden worthy of Śiva be sought at once by the gods now.'

1.3.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasyocuḥ surāstadā..
janitavyā tvayā kanyā śivārthaṃ kāryasiddhaye.. 20.58 ..
1.3.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्योचुः सुरास्तदा..
जनितव्या त्वया कन्या शिवार्थं कार्यसिद्धये.. 20.58 ..
1.3.m: Hearing those words of his, the gods laughed and said then: / 'A maiden must be fathered by you for Śiva, for the accomplishment of this task,

1.3.s:
surāṇāṃ ca gire vākyaṃ kuru śīghraṃ mahāmate..
ādhārastvaṃ tu devānāṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ.. 20.59 ..
1.3.d:
सुराणां च गिरे वाक्यं कुरु शीघ्रं महामते..
आधारस्त्वं तु देवानां भविष्यसि न संशयः.. 20.59 ..
1.3.m: and carry out swiftly the word of the gods, O mountain of great intellect! / For you will become the support of the gods, no doubt.'

1.3.s:
ityukto girirājo'tha devaiḥ svagṛhamāmāviśat..
patnīṃ menāṃ ca papraccha sukāryaṃ samāgatam.. 20.60 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युक्तो गिरिराजोऽथ देवैः स्वगृहमामाविशत्..
पत्नीं मेनां च पप्रच्छ सुकार्यं समागतम्.. 20.60 ..
1.3.m: Thus addressed by the gods, the king of mountains entered his house / and asked his wife Menā about the good enterprise that had presented itself:

1.3.s:
janitavyā sukanyaikā surakāryārthasiddhaye..
devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca tathaiva ca tapasvinām.. 20.61 ..
1.3.d:
जनितव्या सुकन्यैका सुरकार्यार्थसिद्धये..
देवानां च ऋषीणां च तथैव च तपस्विनाम्.. 20.61 ..
1.3.m: 'An excellent maiden must be born for the fulfillment of the purpose of the gods, / and for the gods, the seers, and likewise the ascetics.

1.3.s:
priyaṃ na bhavati strīṇāṃ kanyājananaseva ca..
tathāpi janitavyā ca kanyaikā ca varānane.. 20.62 ..
1.3.d:
प्रियं न भवति स्त्रीणां कन्याजननसेव च..
तथापि जनितव्या च कन्यैका च वरानने.. 20.62 ..
1.3.m: Giving birth to a daughter is indeed not dear to women; / nevertheless, an excellent maiden must be born, O lovely-faced one.'

1.3.s:
prahasya menā provāca svapatiṃ ca himālayam..
yaduktaṃ bhavatā vākyaṃ śrūyatāṃ me tvayā'dhunā.. 20.63 ..
1.3.d:
प्रहस्य मेना प्रोवाच स्वपतिं च हिमालयम्..
यदुक्तं भवता वाक्यं श्रूयतां मे त्वयाऽधुना.. 20.63 ..
1.3.m: Laughing, Menā spoke to her husband Himālaya: / 'What was spoken by you—now hear my reply:'

1.3.s:
kanyā sadā duḥkhakarī nṛṇāṃ pate strīṇāṃ tathā śokakarī mahāmate..
tasmādvimṛśya suciraṃ svayameva buddhyā yathā hitaṃ śailapate taducyatām.. 20.64 ..
1.3.d:
कन्या सदा दुःखकरी नृणां पते स्त्रीणां तथा शोककरी महामते..
तस्माद्विमृश्य सुचिरं स्वयमेव बुद्ध्या यथा हितं शैलपते तदुच्यताम्.. 20.64 ..
1.3.m: "A daughter always brings sorrow to men, O lord, and likewise causes grief to women, O highly intelligent one. / Therefore, after reflecting for a long time by your own intellect, speak that which is beneficial, O lord of mountains!"

1.3.s:
himavāṃstadupaśrutyā priyāyā vacanaṃ tadā..
uvāca vākyaṃ medhāvī paropakaraṇānvitam.. 20.65 ..
1.3.d:
हिमवांस्तदुपश्रुत्या प्रियाया वचनं तदा..
उवाच वाक्यं मेधावी परोपकरणान्वितम्.. 20.65 ..
1.3.m: Having heard those words of his beloved, the wise Himavat then / uttered a speech devoted to the welfare of others:

1.3.s:
yenayena prakāreṇa pareṣāmupajīvanam..
bhaviṣyati ca tatkāryaṃ dhīmatā puruṣeṇa hi.. 20.66 ..
1.3.d:
येनयेन प्रकारेण परेषामुपजीवनम्..
भविष्यति च तत्कार्यं धीमता पुरुषेण हि.. 20.66 ..
1.3.m: "By whatever means the subsistence of others / will come to be, that deed must certainly be done by an intelligent man.

1.3.s:
striyāpi caiva tatkāryaṃ paropakaraṇānvitam..
evaṃ pravartitā tena giriṇā mahiṣī tadā..
dadhāra jaṭhare kanyāṃ menā bhāgyavatī tadā.. 20.67 ..
1.3.d:
स्त्रियापि चैव तत्कार्यं परोपकरणान्वितम्..
एवं प्रवर्तिता तेन गिरिणा महिषी तदा..
दधार जठरे कन्यां मेना भाग्यवती तदा.. 20.67 ..
1.3.m: And by a woman too, that deed devoted to the welfare of others should be done." / Thus impelled by the mountain, the queen, / the fortunate Menā, then bore a daughter in her womb.

1.3.s:
mahāvidyā mahāmāyā mahāmedhāsvarūpiṇī..
rudrakālī ca aṃbā ca satī dākṣāyaṇī parā.. 20.68 ..
1.3.d:
महाविद्या महामाया महामेधास्वरूपिणी..
रुद्रकाली च अंबा च सती दाक्षायणी परा.. 20.68 ..
1.3.m: She was the Great Knowledge, the Great Illusion, the embodiment of great intellect, / Rudrakālī, Ambā, Satī, the supreme daughter of Dakṣa.

1.3.s:
tāṃ vibhūtiṃ viśālākṣī jaṭhare paramāṃ satī..
babhāra sā mahābhāgā menā cāruvilocanā.. 20.69 ..
1.3.d:
तां विभूतिं विशालाक्षी जठरे परमां सती..
बभार सा महाभागा मेना चारुविलोचना.. 20.69 ..
1.3.m: That supreme manifestation of divine power, the large-eyed, virtuous lady, / the highly fortunate, fair-eyed Menā carried in her womb.

1.3.s:
stutiṃ cakrustadā devā ṛṣayo yakṣakinnarāḥ..
menāyā bhūribhāgyāyāstathā himavato gireḥ.. 20.70 ..
1.3.d:
स्तुतिं चक्रुस्तदा देवा ऋषयो यक्षकिन्नराः..
मेनाया भूरिभाग्यायास्तथा हिमवतो गिरेः.. 20.70 ..
1.3.m: Then the gods, ṛṣis, yakṣas, and kinnaras offered praise / to the exceedingly fortunate Menā and to the mountain Himavat.

1.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare jātā girijā nāma nāmataḥ..
prādurbhūtā yadā devī sarveṣāṃ ca sukhapradā.. 20.71 ..
1.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे जाता गिरिजा नाम नामतः..
प्रादुर्भूता यदा देवी सर्वेषां च सुखप्रदा.. 20.71 ..
1.3.m: Meanwhile, the goddess named Girijā was born; / when she appeared, she brought happiness to all.

1.3.s:
devaduṃdubhayo nedurnanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ..
