jagurgaṃdharvapatayo nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ.. 20.72 ..
1.3.d:
देवदुंदुभयो नेदुर्ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः..
जगुर्गंधर्वपतयो ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः.. 20.72 ..
1.3.m: The drums of the gods resounded, the celestial apsarases danced, / the lords of the gandharvas sang, and the apsarases danced.

1.3.s:
puṣpavarṣeṇa mahatā vavṛṣurvibudhāstathā..
tadā prasannamabhavatsarvaṃ trailokyameva ca.. 20.73 ..
1.3.d:
पुष्पवर्षेण महता ववृषुर्विबुधास्तथा..
तदा प्रसन्नमभवत्सर्वं त्रैलोक्यमेव च.. 20.73 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, the gods showered a great downpour of flowers; / then the entire three worlds became joyful.

1.3.s:
yadāvatīrṇā girijā mahāsatī tadaiva daityā bhayamāviśaṃste..
prāptā mudaṃ devagaṇā maharṣayaḥ sacāraṇāḥ siddhagaṇāstathaiva.. 20.74 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṇḍe śrībhavānyutpattivarṇanaṃnāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 20 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
यदावतीर्णा गिरिजा महासती तदैव दैत्या भयमाविशंस्ते..
प्राप्ता मुदं देवगणा महर्षयः सचारणाः सिद्धगणास्तथैव.. 20.74 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखण्डे श्रीभवान्युत्पत्तिवर्णनंनाम विंशोऽध्यायः.. 20 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
When the great Satī, Girijā, descended, fear entered the Daityas; / the hosts of gods, the great ṛṣis, the cāraṇas, and the hosts of siddhas attained delight.
Thus ends the twentieth chapter, named "Description of the Origin of the Auspicious Bhavānī," in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
varddhamānā tadā sādhvī rarāja prativāsaram..
aṣṭavarṣā yadā jātā himālayagṛhe satī.. 21.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
वर्द्धमाना तदा साध्वी रराज प्रतिवासरम्..
अष्टवर्षा यदा जाता हिमालयगृहे सती.. 21.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Growing each day, the virtuous girl shone forth; / when Satī became eight years old in the house of Himālaya,

1.3.s:
maheśo himavaddroṇyāṃ tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ..
sarvairgaṇaiḥ parivṛto vīrabhadrādibhistadā.. 21.2 ..
1.3.d:
महेशो हिमवद्द्रोण्यां तताप परमं तपः..
सर्वैर्गणैः परिवृतो वीरभद्रादिभिस्तदा.. 21.2 ..
1.3.m: Maheśa performed supreme tapas in a valley of Himavat, / surrounded at that time by all his gaṇas, beginning with Vīrabhadra.

1.3.s:
etattapo juṣāṇaṃ taṃ maheśaṃ himavānyayau..
tatpādapallavaṃ draṣṭuṃ pārvatyā saha buddhimān.. 21.3 ..
1.3.d:
एतत्तपो जुषाणं तं महेशं हिमवान्ययौ..
तत्पादपल्लवं द्रष्टुं पार्वत्या सह बुद्धिमान्.. 21.3 ..
1.3.m: The wise Himavat went together with Pārvatī / to see the sprout-like feet of that Maheśa engaged in this tapas.

1.3.s:
yāvatsamāgato draṣṭaṃ naṃdināsau nivāritaḥ..
dvāri sthite ca tadā kṣaṇamekaṃ sthiro'bhavat.. 21.4 ..
1.3.d:
यावत्समागतो द्रष्टं नंदिनासौ निवारितः..
द्वारि स्थिते च तदा क्षणमेकं स्थिरोऽभवत्.. 21.4 ..
1.3.m: As he arrived to see him, he was stopped by Nandin; / standing at the door, he remained still for a moment.

1.3.s:
punarvijñāpayāmāsa naṃdinā himavāngiriḥ..
vijñapto naṃdinā śaṃbhuracalo draṣṭumāgataḥ.. 21.5 ..
1.3.d:
पुनर्विज्ञापयामास नंदिना हिमवान्गिरिः..
विज्ञप्तो नंदिना शंभुरचलो द्रष्टुमागतः.. 21.5 ..
1.3.m: Again, the mountain Himavat made a petition through Nandin; / informed by Nandin that the mountain had arrived to see him,

1.3.s:
tadākarṇya vacastasya naṃdinaḥ parameśvaraḥ..
ānayasva giriṃ cātra naṃdinaṃ vākyamabravīt.. 21.6 ..
1.3.d:
तदाकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य नंदिनः परमेश्वरः..
आनयस्व गिरिं चात्र नंदिनं वाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 21.6 ..
1.3.m: the Supreme Lord, hearing those words of Nandin, / addressed the word to Nandin: "Bring the mountain here!"

1.3.s:
tatheti matvā naṃdī taṃ parvataṃ ca himācalam..
ānayāmāsa sa tathā śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram.. 21.7 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा नंदी तं पर्वतं च हिमाचलम्..
आनयामास स तथा शंकरं लोकशंकरम्.. 21.7 ..
1.3.m: Saying "So be it," Nandin thus brought / that mountain Himācala to Śaṃkara, who brings welfare to the world.

1.3.s: dṛṣṭvā tadānīṃ sakaleśvaraṃ prabhuṃ tapo juṣāṇaṃ vinimīlitekṣaṇam.. 21.8 ..
1.3.d: दृष्ट्वा तदानीं सकलेश्वरं प्रभुं तपो जुषाणं विनिमीलितेक्षणम्.. 21.8 ..
1.3.m: Then, seeing the Lord of all, the master, practicing tapas with closed eyes,

1.3.s:
kaparddhinaṃ caṃdrakalāvibhūṣaṇaṃ vedāṃtavedyaṃ paramātmani sthitam..
vavaṃda śīrṣṇā ca tadā himācalaḥ parāṃ mudaṃ prāpadahīnasattvaḥ.. 21.9 ..
1.3.d:
कपर्द्धिनं चंद्रकलाविभूषणं वेदांतवेद्यं परमात्मनि स्थितम्..
ववंद शीर्ष्णा च तदा हिमाचलः परां मुदं प्रापदहीनसत्त्वः.. 21.9 ..
1.3.m: the one with matted hair, adorned with the crescent moon, knowable through Vedānta, abiding in the supreme Self, / Himācala bowed with his head, and with undiminished vigor attained supreme joy.

1.3.s: uvāca vākyaṃ jagadekamaṃgalaṃ himālayo vākyavidāṃ variṣṭhaḥ.. 21.10 ..
1.3.d: उवाच वाक्यं जगदेकमंगलं हिमालयो वाक्यविदां वरिष्ठः.. 21.10 ..
1.3.m: Himālaya, the best among knowers of speech, spoke words bringing sole auspiciousness to the world:

1.3.s:
sabhāgyo'haṃ mahādeva prasādāttava śaṃkara..
pratyahaṃ cāgamiṣyāmi darśanārthaṃ tava prabho.. 21.11 ..
1.3.d:
सभाग्योऽहं महादेव प्रसादात्तव शंकर..
प्रत्यहं चागमिष्यामि दर्शनार्थं तव प्रभो.. 21.11 ..
1.3.m: "I am fortunate, O Mahādeva, through your grace, O Śaṃkara! / And I will come every day for your darśana, O Lord.

1.3.s:
anayā saha deveśa anujñāṃ dāturmahasi..
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasya devadevo maheśvaraḥ.. 21.12 ..
1.3.d:
अनया सह देवेश अनुज्ञां दातुर्महसि..
श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य देवदेवो महेश्वरः.. 21.12 ..
1.3.m: You ought to grant permission [for me to come] along with her, O Lord of gods!" / Hearing his words, the God of gods, Maheśvara, [said]:

1.3.s:
āgaṃtavyaṃ tvayā nityaṃ darśanārthaṃ mamācala..
kumārīṃ ca gṛhe sthāpya nānyathā mama darśanam.. 21.13 ..
1.3.d:
आगंतव्यं त्वया नित्यं दर्शनार्थं ममाचल..
कुमारीं च गृहे स्थाप्य नान्यथा मम दर्शनम्.. 21.13 ..
1.3.m: "You must come constantly for my darśana, O Mountain, / but keep the maiden at home; otherwise, there shall be no darśana of me."

1.3.s:
acalaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ giriśaṃ natakaṃdharaḥ..
kasmānmayānayā sārddhaṃ nāgaṃtavyaṃ taducyatām..
acalaṃ ca vrīta śaṃbhuḥ prahasanvākyamabravīt.. 21.14 ..
1.3.d:
अचलः प्रत्युवाचेदं गिरिशं नतकंधरः..
कस्मान्मयानया सार्द्धं नागंतव्यं तदुच्यताम्..
अचलं च व्रीत शंभुः प्रहसन्वाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 21.14 ..
1.3.m: With bent neck, the mountain replied to the Lord of the mountains: / "Speak! Why should I not come with her?" / Smiling, Śambhu uttered words to the mountain:

1.3.s:
iyaṃ kumārī suśroṇī tanvī cāruprabhāṣiṇī..
nānetavyā matsamīpe vārayāmi punaḥ punaḥ.. 21.15 ..
1.3.d:
इयं कुमारी सुश्रोणी तन्वी चारुप्रभाषिणी..
नानेतव्या मत्समीपे वारयामि पुनः पुनः.. 21.15 ..
1.3.m: "This maiden has fair hips, a slender frame, and speaks pleasantly; / she must not be brought near me—I forbid it again and again."

1.3.s:
etacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya śaṃbhornirāmayaṃ niḥspṛhaniṣṭhuraṃ vā..
tapasvinoktaṃ vacanaṃ niśamya uvāca gaurī ca vihasya śaṃbhum.. 21.16 ..
1.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य शंभोर्निरामयं निःस्पृहनिष्ठुरं वा..
तपस्विनोक्तं वचनं निशम्य उवाच गौरी च विहस्य शंभुम्.. 21.16 ..
1.3.m: Hearing those words of Śambhu—unafflicted, dispassionate, and harsh— / hearing that speech uttered by the ascetic, Gaurī laughed and spoke to Śambhu:

1.3.s:
..gauryuvāca..
tapaḥśaktyānvitaḥ śaṃbho karoṣi vipulaṃ tapaḥ..
tava buddhiriyaṃ jātā tapastaptuṃ mahātmanaḥ.. 21.17 ..
1.3.d:
..गौर्युवाच..
तपःशक्त्यान्वितः शंभो करोषि विपुलं तपः..
तव बुद्धिरियं जाता तपस्तप्तुं महात्मनः.. 21.17 ..
1.3.m: Gaurī said: / "Endowed with the power of tapas, O Śambhu, you perform vast tapas; / this intention arose in you, the great-souled one, to perform tapas.

1.3.s:
kastvaṃ kā prakṛtiḥ sūkṣmā bhagavaṃstadvimṛśyatām..
pārvatyāstadvacaḥ śrutvā maheśo vākyamabravīt.. 21.18 ..
1.3.d:
कस्त्वं का प्रकृतिः सूक्ष्मा भगवंस्तद्विमृश्यताम्..
पार्वत्यास्तद्वचः श्रुत्वा महेशो वाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 21.18 ..
1.3.m: Who are you, and what is subtle Prakṛti, O Lord? Let that be reflected upon!" / Hearing those words of Pārvatī, Maheśa spoke these words:

1.3.s:
tapasā parameṇaiva prakṛtiṃ nāśayāmyaham..
prakṛtyā rahitaḥ subhru ahaṃ tiṣṭhami tattvataḥ..
tasmācca prakṛte siddhair kāryaḥ saṃgrahaḥ kvacit.. 21.19 ..
1.3.d:
तपसा परमेणैव प्रकृतिं नाशयाम्यहम्..
प्रकृत्या रहितः सुभ्रु अहं तिष्ठमि तत्त्वतः..
तस्माच्च प्रकृते सिद्धैर् कार्यः संग्रहः क्वचित्.. 21.19 ..
1.3.m: "By supreme tapas alone do I destroy Prakṛti; / free from Prakṛti, O fair-browed one, I abide in reality; / therefore, what attachment to Prakṛti can ever be made by perfected beings?"

1.3.s:
..pārvatyuvāca..
yaduktaṃ parayā vācā vacananaṃ śaṃkara tvayā..
sā kiṃ prakṛti rnaiva syādatītastāṃ bhavānkatham.. 21.20 ..
1.3.d:
..पार्वत्युवाच..
यदुक्तं परया वाचा वचननं शंकर त्वया..
सा किं प्रकृति र्नैव स्यादतीतस्तां भवान्कथम्.. 21.20 ..
1.3.m: Pārvatī said: / "The statement which you have made in supreme speech, O Śaṃkara— / is that not Prakṛti? How have you transcended it?

1.3.s:
yacchṛṇopi yadaśrāsi yacca paśyasi śaṃkara..
vāgvādena ca kiṃ kāryamasmāke cādhunā prabho.. 21.21 ..
1.3.d:
यच्छृणोपि यदश्रासि यच्च पश्यसि शंकर..
वाग्वादेन च किं कार्यमस्माके चाधुना प्रभो.. 21.21 ..
1.3.m: Whatever you hear, whatever you eat, and whatever you see, O Śaṃkara— / what need is there for verbal dispute between us now, O Lord?

1.3.s:
tatsarvaṃ prakṛteḥ kāryaṃ mithyāvādo nirrthakaḥ..
prakṛteḥ parato bhūtvā kimarthaṃ tapyate tapaḥ.. 21.22 ..
1.3.d:
तत्सर्वं प्रकृतेः कार्यं मिथ्यावादो निर्र्थकः..
प्रकृतेः परतो भूत्वा किमर्थं तप्यते तपः.. 21.22 ..
1.3.m: All that is the effect of Prakṛti; false argument is useless. / Having gone beyond Prakṛti, for what reason is tapas practiced?

1.3.s:
tvayā śaṃbho'dhunā hyasmingirau himavati prabho..
prakṛtyā milito'si tvaṃ na jānāsi hi śaṃkara.. 21.23 ..
1.3.d:
त्वया शंभोऽधुना ह्यस्मिन्गिरौ हिमवति प्रभो..
प्रकृत्या मिलितोऽसि त्वं न जानासि हि शंकर.. 21.23 ..
1.3.m: O Śambhu, now on this mountain Himavat, O Lord, / you are joined with Prakṛti, and yet you do not know it, O Śaṃkara!

1.3.s:
vāgvādena ca kiṃ kāryamasmākaṃ cādhunā prabho..
prakṛteḥ paratastvaṃ ca yadi satyaṃ vacastava..
tarhi tvayā na bhetavyaṃ mama śaṃkara saṃprati.. 21.24 ..
1.3.d:
वाग्वादेन च किं कार्यमस्माकं चाधुना प्रभो..
प्रकृतेः परतस्त्वं च यदि सत्यं वचस्तव..
तर्हि त्वया न भेतव्यं मम शंकर संप्रति.. 21.24 ..
1.3.m: What need is there for verbal dispute between us now, O Lord? / If your statement that you are beyond Prakṛti is true, / then you should not fear me now, O Śaṃkara!"

1.3.s: prahasya bhagavāndevo girijāṃ pratyuvāca ha.. 21.25 ..
1.3.d: प्रहस्य भगवान्देवो गिरिजां प्रत्युवाच ह.. 21.25 ..
1.3.m: Laughing, the blessed Lord spoke in reply to Girijā:

1.3.s:
..mahādeva uvāca..
pratyahaṃ kuru me sevāṃ girije sādhubhāṣiṇi.. 21.27 ..
ityevamuktvā girijāṃ maheśo himālayaṃ vākyamatho babhāṣe..
atraiva so'haṃ tapasā pareṇa carāmi bhūmyāṃ paramārthabhāvaḥ.. 21.27 ..
1.3.d:
..महादेव उवाच..
प्रत्यहं कुरु मे सेवां गिरिजे साधुभाषिणि.. 21.27 ..
इत्येवमुक्त्वा गिरिजां महेशो हिमालयं वाक्यमथो बभाषे..
अत्रैव सोऽहं तपसा परेण चरामि भूम्यां परमार्थभावः.. 21.27 ..
1.3.m:
Mahādeva said: / "Serve me every day, O Girijā, who speak so well!"
Having said thus to Girijā, Maheśa then spoke these words to Himālaya: / "Right here on the earth I engage in supreme tapas, intent upon the supreme reality.

1.3.s:
tapastaptumanujñā me dātavyā parvatādhipa..
anujñayā vinā kiṃcittapaḥ kartuṃ na pāryate.. 21.28 ..
1.3.d:
तपस्तप्तुमनुज्ञा मे दातव्या पर्वताधिप..
अनुज्ञया विना किंचित्तपः कर्तुं न पार्यते.. 21.28 ..
1.3.m: Permission must be granted to me to perform tapas, O lord of mountains; / without permission, no tapas can be performed at all."

1.3.s:
etacchrutvā vacastasya devadevasya śūlinaḥ..
prahasya himavāñchaṃbhumidaṃ vacanamabravīt.. 21.29 ..
1.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य देवदेवस्य शूलिनः..
प्रहस्य हिमवाञ्छंभुमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्.. 21.29 ..
1.3.m: Hearing those words of that God of gods who holds the trident, / Himavat laughed and addressed this speech to Śambhu:

1.3.s:
tvadīyaṃ hi jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam..
kimahaṃ tu mahādeva tuccho bhūtvā dadāmi te.. 21.30 ..
1.3.d:
त्वदीयं हि जगत्सर्वं सदेवासुरमानुषम्..
किमहं तु महादेव तुच्छो भूत्वा ददामि ते.. 21.30 ..
1.3.m:
"Indeed, this entire world, together with gods, asuras, and humans, is yours.
Being insignificant, O Mahādeva, what can I give to you?"

1.3.s:
evamukto himavatā śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ..
prahasya girirājaṃ taṃ yāhīti prāha sādaram.. 21.31 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्तो हिमवता शंकरो लोकशंकरः..
प्रहस्य गिरिराजं तं याहीति प्राह सादरम्.. 21.31 ..
1.3.m:
Addressed thus by Himavat, Śaṃkara, who brings welfare to the world,
smiled and said respectfully to the king of mountains, "Go."

1.3.s:
śaṃkareṇābyanujñātaḥ svagṛhaṃ himavānyayau..
sārddhaṃ girijayā so'pi pratyahaṃ darśane sthitaḥ.. 21.32 ..
1.3.d:
शंकरेणाब्यनुज्ञातः स्वगृहं हिमवान्ययौ..
सार्द्धं गिरिजया सोऽपि प्रत्यहं दर्शने स्थितः.. 21.32 ..
1.3.m:
Given permission by Śaṃkara, Himavat went to his own home;
and along with the mountain-born [Pārvatī], he remained present daily for [Śaṃkara's] darśana.

1.3.s: evaṃ katipayaḥ kālo gataścopāsanāttayoḥ.. 21.33 ..
1.3.d: एवं कतिपयः कालो गतश्चोपासनात्तयोः.. 21.33 ..
1.3.m: In this way, some time passed in their worship.

1.3.s:
sutāpitrośca tatraiva śaṃkaro duratikramaḥ..
pārvatīṃ prati tatraiva ciṃtāmāpedire surāḥ.. 21.34 ..
1.3.d:
सुतापित्रोश्च तत्रैव शंकरो दुरतिक्रमः..
पार्वतीं प्रति तत्रैव चिंतामापेदिरे सुराः.. 21.34 ..
1.3.m:
While the daughter and father were right there, and Śaṃkara remained unapproachable,
the gods fell into anxiety regarding Pārvatī.

1.3.s:
te ciṃtyamānāśca surāstadānīṃ kathaṃ maheśo girijāṃ sameṣyati..
kiṃ kāryamadyaiva vayaṃ ca kurmo bṛhaspate tatkathayasva mā ciram.. 21.35 ..
1.3.d:
ते चिंत्यमानाश्च सुरास्तदानीं कथं महेशो गिरिजां समेष्यति..
किं कार्यमद्यैव वयं च कुर्मो बृहस्पते तत्कथयस्व मा चिरम्.. 21.35 ..
1.3.m:
Anxious at that time, the gods thought: "How will Maheśa unite with the mountain-born girl?
What work shall we do this very day? Speak, Bṛhaspati, do not delay!"

1.3.s:
bṛhaspatiruvācedaṃ maheṃdraṃ prati sadvacaḥ..
evametattvayā kāryaṃ maheṃdra śrūyatāṃ tadā.. 21.36 ..
1.3.d:
बृहस्पतिरुवाचेदं महेंद्रं प्रति सद्वचः..
एवमेतत्त्वया कार्यं महेंद्र श्रूयतां तदा.. 21.36 ..
1.3.m:
Bṛhaspati spoke these good words to Mahendra:
"Listen, then, Mahendra, to what you must do:

1.3.s:
etatkāryaṃ madanenaiva rājannānyaḥ samartho bhavitā triloke..
viplāvitaṃ tāpasānāṃ tapo hi tasmāttvarātprārthanīyo hi māraḥ.. 21.37 ..
1.3.d:
एतत्कार्यं मदनेनैव राजन्नान्यः समर्थो भविता त्रिलोके..
विप्लावितं तापसानां तपो हि तस्मात्त्वरात्प्रार्थनीयो हि मारः.. 21.37 ..
1.3.m:
This task can only be achieved by Madana, O king; none other in the three worlds is capable.
For the austerity of ascetics is washed away [by him]; therefore, Māra must be entreated at once."

1.3.s:
gurorvacanamākarṇya āhvayanmadanaṃ hariḥ..
āhvānādājagāmātha madanaḥ kāryasādhakaḥ.. 21.38 ..
1.3.d:
गुरोर्वचनमाकर्ण्य आह्वयन्मदनं हरिः..
आह्वानादाजगामाथ मदनः कार्यसाधकः.. 21.38 ..
1.3.m:
Hearing the words of the guru, Hari summoned Madana.
Upon the summons, Madana, the achiever of deeds, arrived.

1.3.s:
ratyā sametaḥ saha mādhavena sa puṣpadhanvā purataḥ sabhāyām..
maheṃdramāgamya uvāca vākyaṃ sagarvitaṃ lokamanoharaṃ ca.. 21.39 ..
1.3.d:
रत्या समेतः सह माधवेन स पुष्पधन्वा पुरतः सभायाम्..
महेंद्रमागम्य उवाच वाक्यं सगर्वितं लोकमनोहरं च.. 21.39 ..
1.3.m:
Together with Rati, accompanied by Mādhava (Spring), the flower-bowed god went into the assembly before Mahendra,
and spoke words that were haughty yet enchanting to the world:

1.3.s:
ahamākāritaḥ kasmādbrūhi me'dya śacīpate..
kiṃ kāryaṃ karavāṇyadya kathyatāṃ mā vilaṃbitam.. 21.40 ..
1.3.d:
अहमाकारितः कस्माद्ब्रूहि मेऽद्य शचीपते..
किं कार्यं करवाण्यद्य कथ्यतां मा विलंबितम्.. 21.40 ..
1.3.m:
"Why have I been summoned? Tell me today, O husband of Śacī!
What task shall I perform today? Tell me without delay!

1.3.s:
mama smaraṇamātreṇa vibhraṣṭā hi tapasvinaḥ..
tvameva jānāsi hare mama vīryaparākramau.. 21.41 ..
1.3.d:
मम स्मरणमात्रेण विभ्रष्टा हि तपस्विनः..
त्वमेव जानासि हरे मम वीर्यपराक्रमौ.. 21.41 ..
1.3.m:
Ascetics fall away merely by remembering me;
you yourself know my prowess and courage, O Hari!

1.3.s:
mama vīryaṃ ca jānāti śakteḥ putraḥ parāśaraḥ..
evaṃ cānaye ca bahavo bhṛgvādya ṛṣayo hyamī.. 21.42 ..
1.3.d:
मम वीर्यं च जानाति शक्तेः पुत्रः पराशरः..
एवं चानये च बहवो भृग्वाद्य ऋषयो ह्यमी.. 21.42 ..
1.3.m:
Parāśara, the son of Śakti, knows my power;
and so do these many others, the seers such as Bhṛgu.

1.3.s:
gururapyabhijānāti bhāryotathyasya caiva hi..
tasyāṃ jāto bharadvājo guruṇā saṃkaro hi saḥ.. 21.43 ..
1.3.d:
गुरुरप्यभिजानाति भार्योतथ्यस्य चैव हि..
तस्यां जातो भरद्वाजो गुरुणा संकरो हि सः.. 21.43 ..
1.3.m:
The guru [Bṛhaspati] also knows, through the wife of Utathya;
upon her, Bharadvāja was born from the guru—indeed, an adulterous union.

1.3.s:
bharadvājo mahābhāga ityuvāca gurustadā..
jānāti mama vīryaṃ ca śauryaṃ caiva prajāpatiḥ.. 21.44 ..
1.3.d:
भरद्वाजो महाभाग इत्युवाच गुरुस्तदा..
जानाति मम वीर्यं च शौर्यं चैव प्रजापतिः.. 21.44 ..
1.3.m:
‘Bharadvāja, the highly fortunate,’ so said the guru then.
Prajāpati also knows my power and my heroism.

1.3.s:
krodho hi mama baṃdhuśca mahābalaparakramaḥ..
ubhābhyāṃ drāvitaṃ viśvaṃ jaṃgamājaṃgamaṃ mahat..
brahmādistaṃbaparyaṃtaṃ plāvitaṃ sacarācaram.. 21.45 ..
1.3.d:
क्रोधो हि मम बंधुश्च महाबलपरक्रमः..
उभाभ्यां द्रावितं विश्वं जंगमाजंगमं महत्..
ब्रह्मादिस्तंबपर्यंतं प्लावितं सचराचरम्.. 21.45 ..

1.3.s:
..devā ūcuḥ..
madanadvaṃ samarthosi asmāñjetuṃ sadaiva hi..
maheśaṃ prati gacchāśu surakāryārthasiddhaye..
pārvatyā sahitaṃ śaṃbhuṃ kuruṣvādya mahāmate.. 21.46 ..
1.3.d:
..देवा ऊचुः..
मदनद्वं समर्थोसि अस्माञ्जेतुं सदैव हि..
महेशं प्रति गच्छाशु सुरकार्यार्थसिद्धये..
पार्वत्या सहितं शंभुं कुरुष्वाद्य महामते.. 21.46 ..
1.3.m:
The gods said:
"O Madana, you are ever capable of conquering us.
Go swiftly to Maheśa for the accomplishment of the purpose of the gods;
unite Śambhu today with Pārvatī, O highly intelligent one!"

1.3.s:
evamabhyarthito devairmadano viśvamohanaḥ..
jagāma tvarito bhūtvā apsarobhiḥ samanvitaḥ.. 21.47 ..
1.3.d:
एवमभ्यर्थितो देवैर्मदनो विश्वमोहनः..
जगाम त्वरितो भूत्वा अप्सरोभिः समन्वितः.. 21.47 ..
1.3.m:
Thus entreated by the gods, Madana, who bewilders the universe,
went swiftly, accompanied by apsarases.

1.3.s:
tato jagāmāśu mahādhanurddharo visphārya cāpaṃ kusumānvitaṃ mahat..
tathaiva bāṇāṃśca manoramāṃśca pragṛhya vīro bhuvanaikajetā..
tasminhimādrau paridṛśyamāno'vanau smaro yodhayatāṃ variṣṭhaḥ.. 21.48 ..
1.3.d:
ततो जगामाशु महाधनुर्द्धरो विस्फार्य चापं कुसुमान्वितं महत्..
तथैव बाणांश्च मनोरमांश्च प्रगृह्य वीरो भुवनैकजेता..
तस्मिन्हिमाद्रौ परिदृश्यमानोऽवनौ स्मरो योधयतां वरिष्ठः.. 21.48 ..

1.3.s:
tatrāgatā tadā raṃbhā urvaśī puṃjikasthalī..
sumlocā miśrakeśī ca subhagā ca tilottamā.. 21.49 ..
1.3.d:
तत्रागता तदा रंभा उर्वशी पुंजिकस्थली..
सुम्लोचा मिश्रकेशी च सुभगा च तिलोत्तमा.. 21.49 ..
1.3.m:
There arrived then Rambhā, Urvaśī, and Puñjikasthalī,
Sumlocā, Miśrakeśī, Subhagā, and Tilottamā,

1.3.s:
anyāśca vividhāḥ jātāḥ sāhāyye madanasya ca..
apsaraso gaṇairdṛṣṭā madanena sahaiva tāḥ.. 21.50 ..
1.3.d:
अन्याश्च विविधाः जाताः साहाय्ये मदनस्य च..
अप्सरसो गणैर्दृष्टा मदनेन सहैव ताः.. 21.50 ..
1.3.m:
and other diverse apsarases came to Madana's aid;
those apsarases along with Madana were seen by the gaṇas.

1.3.s:
sarve gaṇāśca sahasā madanena vimohitāḥ..
bhṛṃgiṇā ca tadā raṃbhā caṇḍena saha corvaśī.. 21.51 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वे गणाश्च सहसा मदनेन विमोहिताः..
भृंगिणा च तदा रंभा चण्डेन सह चोर्वशी.. 21.51 ..
1.3.m:
Suddenly, all the gaṇas were enchanted by Madana:
then Rambhā was joined with Bhṛṅgin, and Urvaśī with Caṇḍa,

1.3.s:
menakā vīrabhadreṇa caṇḍena puṃjikasthalī..
tilottamādayastatra saṃvṛtāśca gaṇaistadā.. 21.52 ..
1.3.d:
मेनका वीरभद्रेण चण्डेन पुंजिकस्थली..
तिलोत्तमादयस्तत्र संवृताश्च गणैस्तदा.. 21.52 ..
1.3.m:
Menakā with Vīrabhadra, and Puñjikasthalī with Caṇḍa;
Tilottamā and the others were surrounded by the gaṇas then.

1.3.s:
amattabhūtairbahubhistrapāṃ tyaktvā manīṣibhiḥ..
akāle kokilā bhiśca vyāptāmāsīnmahītalam.. 21.53 ..
1.3.d:
अमत्तभूतैर्बहुभिस्त्रपां त्यक्त्वा मनीषिभिः..
अकाले कोकिला भिश्च व्याप्तामासीन्महीतलम्.. 21.53 ..
1.3.m:
By many beings, un-intoxicated and wise, shame was abandoned;
and out of season, the surface of the earth was overrun by cuckoos.

1.3.s:
aśokāścaṃpakāścūtā yūthyaścaiva kadaṃbakāḥ..
nīṣāḥ priyālāḥ panasā rājavṛkṣāścarāyaṇāḥ.. 21.54 ..
1.3.d:
अशोकाश्चंपकाश्चूता यूथ्यश्चैव कदंबकाः..
नीषाः प्रियालाः पनसा राजवृक्षाश्चरायणाः.. 21.54 ..
1.3.m:
Aśokas, campakas, mangoes, yūthīs, and kadambas,
nīpas, priyālas, jackfruits, rājavṛkṣas, and rāyans,

1.3.s:
drākṣāvallayaḥ pradṛśyaṃte bahulā nāgakeśarāḥ..
tathā kadalyaḥ ketakyo bhramarairupaśobhitāḥ.. 21.55 ..
1.3.d:
द्राक्षावल्लयः प्रदृश्यंते बहुला नागकेशराः..
तथा कदल्यः केतक्यो भ्रमरैरुपशोभिताः.. 21.55 ..
1.3.m:
grapevines appeared, and abundant nāgakeśaras,
as well as plantains and ketakīs adorned with bees.

1.3.s:
mattā madanasaṃgena haṃsībhiḥ kalahaṃsakāḥ..
kareṇubhirgajāhyāsañchikhaṃḍībhiḥ śikhaṃḍinaḥ.. 21.56 ..
1.3.d:
मत्ता मदनसंगेन हंसीभिः कलहंसकाः..
करेणुभिर्गजाह्यासञ्छिखंडीभिः शिखंडिनः.. 21.56 ..
1.3.m:
Intoxicated by the touch of Madana, the kalahaṃsa drakes [sported] with female swans,
male elephants with cow elephants, and peacocks with peahens.

1.3.s:
niṣkāmā hyaturā hyāsañchivasaṃparkajairguṇaiḥ..
akasmācca tathābhūtaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ vimṛśya ca.. 21.57 ..
1.3.d:
निष्कामा ह्यतुरा ह्यासञ्छिवसंपर्कजैर्गुणैः..
अकस्माच्च तथाभूतं कथं जातं विमृश्य च.. 21.57 ..
1.3.m:
Yet the desireless [attendants] became distressed through the qualities born of contact with Śiva;
and reflecting, "How has such a thing suddenly happened?"

1.3.s:
śailādo hi mahātejā naṃdī hyamitavikramaḥ..
rakṣasaṃ vibudhānāṃ vā kṛtyamastītyaciṃtayat.. 21.58 ..
1.3.d:
शैलादो हि महातेजा नंदी ह्यमितविक्रमः..
रक्षसं विबुधानां वा कृत्यमस्तीत्यचिंतयत्.. 21.58 ..
1.3.m:
Śailāda [Nandin], possessed of great splendor and boundless valor,
thought, "This must be the work of a rākṣasa or of the gods."

1.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare tatra madano hi dhanurddharaḥ..
paṃcabāṇānsamāropya svakīye dhanuṣi dvijāḥ..
tarośchāyāṃ samāśritya devadārugatāṃ tadā.. 21.59 ..
1.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र मदनो हि धनुर्द्धरः..
पंचबाणान्समारोप्य स्वकीये धनुषि द्विजाः..
तरोश्छायां समाश्रित्य देवदारुगतां तदा.. 21.59 ..
1.3.m:
In the meantime, O twice-born, the bow-bearing Madana,
having fixed his five arrows upon his own bow,
then took shelter in the shade of a tree upon a deodar,

1.3.s:
nirīkṣya śaṃbhuṃ paramāsane stitaṃ tapo juṣāṇaṃ parameṣṭhināṃ patim..
gaṃgādharaṃ nīlatamālakaṃṭhaṃ kapardinaṃ candrakalāsametam.. 21.60 ..
1.3.d:
निरीक्ष्य शंभुं परमासने स्तितं तपो जुषाणं परमेष्ठिनां पतिम्..
गंगाधरं नीलतमालकंठं कपर्दिनं चन्द्रकलासमेतम्.. 21.60 ..
1.3.m:
gazing upon Śambhu, who was seated upon an exalted seat, practicing austerity, the lord of the creators,
bearer of the Gaṅgā, his throat like a dark tamāla tree, wearing matted hair, adorned with the digit of the moon,

1.3.s:
bhujaṃgabhogāṃkitasarvagātraṃ paṃcānanaṃ siṃhaviśālavikramam..
karpūragaure parayānvitaṃ ca sa veddhukāmo madanastapasvinam.. 21.61 ..
1.3.d:
भुजंगभोगांकितसर्वगात्रं पंचाननं सिंहविशालविक्रमम्..
कर्पूरगौरे परयान्वितं च स वेद्धुकामो मदनस्तपस्विनम्.. 21.61 ..
1.3.m:
all his limbs marked by the coils of serpents, five-faced, with the immense prowess of a lion,
white as camphor, united with the supreme [energy]—that ascetic, Madana wished to pierce.

1.3.s:
durāsadaṃ dīptimatāṃ variṣṭhaṃ maheśamugraṃ saha mādhavena..
yāvacchivaṃ veddhukāmaḥ śareṇa tāvadyātā girijā viśvamātā..
sakhījanaiḥ saṃvṛtā pūjanārthaṃ sadāśivaṃ maṃgalaṃ maṃgalānām.. 21.62 ..
1.3.d:
दुरासदं दीप्तिमतां वरिष्ठं महेशमुग्रं सह माधवेन..
यावच्छिवं वेद्धुकामः शरेण तावद्याता गिरिजा विश्वमाता..
सखीजनैः संवृता पूजनार्थं सदाशिवं मंगलं मंगलानाम्.. 21.62 ..
1.3.m:
Unapproachable, the foremost among the radiant, the fierce Maheśa—along with Mādhava (Spring),
just as he wished to pierce Śiva with an arrow, the mountain-born mother of the universe arrived,
surrounded by companions, to worship Sadāśiva, the auspiciousness of all that is auspicious.

1.3.s:
kanakakusumamālāṃ saṃdadhe nīlakaṃṭhe sitakiraṇamanojñādurllabhā sā tadānīm..
smitavikasitanetrā cāruvaktraṃ śivasya sakalajananitrī vīkṣamāṇā babhūva.. 21.63 ..
1.3.d:
कनककुसुममालां संदधे नीलकंठे सितकिरणमनोज्ञादुर्ल्लभा सा तदानीम्..
स्मितविकसितनेत्रा चारुवक्त्रं शिवस्य सकलजननित्री वीक्षमाणा बभूव.. 21.63 ..
1.3.m:
She placed a garland of golden flowers upon the blue throat; charming as the cool rays [of the moon], difficult to attain at that time,
with eyes blooming in a smile, the mother of all beings gazed upon the beautiful face of Śiva.

1.3.s:
tāvadviddhaḥ śareṇaiva mohanākhyena catvarāt..
vidhyamānastadā śaṃbhuḥ śanairunmīlya locane..
dadarśa girijāṃ devobdhiryathā śaśinaḥ kalām.. 21.64 ..
1.3.d:
तावद्विद्धः शरेणैव मोहनाख्येन चत्वरात्..
विध्यमानस्तदा शंभुः शनैरुन्मील्य लोचने..
ददर्श गिरिजां देवोब्धिर्यथा शशिनः कलाम्.. 21.64 ..

1.3.s:
cāruprasannavadanāṃ biṃboṣṭhīṃ sasmitekṣaṇām..
sudvijāmagnijāṃ tanvīṃ viśālavadanotsavām.. 21.65 ..
1.3.d:
चारुप्रसन्नवदनां बिंबोष्ठीं सस्मितेक्षणाम्..
सुद्विजामग्निजां तन्वीं विशालवदनोत्सवाम्.. 21.65 ..
1.3.m:
having a beautiful, serene face, bimba-red lips, smiling eyes,
with good teeth, fire-born, slender, her magnificent face a festive sight,

1.3.s:
gaurīṃ prasannamudrāṃ ca viśvamohanamohanām..
yayā trilokaracanā kṛtā brahmādibhiḥ saha.. 21.66 ..
1.3.d:
गौरीं प्रसन्नमुद्रां च विश्वमोहनमोहनाम्..
यया त्रिलोकरचना कृता ब्रह्मादिभिः सह.. 21.66 ..
1.3.m:
Gaurī, with a gracious expression, bewildering even the bewilderer of the universe,
by whom, together with Brahmā and the others, the creation of the three worlds was made,

1.3.s:
utpattipālanavināśakarī ca yā vai kṛtvāgrataḥ sattvarajastamāṃsi..
sā cetanena dadṛśe purato hareṇa saṃmohanī sakalamaṃgalamaṃgalaikā.. 21.67 ..
1.3.d:
उत्पत्तिपालनविनाशकरी च या वै कृत्वाग्रतः सत्त्वरजस्तमांसि..
सा चेतनेन ददृशे पुरतो हरेण संमोहनी सकलमंगलमंगलैका.. 21.67 ..
1.3.m:
and who, indeed, brings about creation, preservation, and destruction, having placed sattva, rajas, and tamas before herself—
she, the sole auspiciousness of all auspiciousness, the enchantress, was seen before him by Hara through consciousness.

1.3.s:
tāṃ nirīkṣya bhavo devo girijāṃ lokapāvanīm..
mumoha darśanāttasyā madanenāturīkṛtaḥ..
vismayotphullanayano babhūva sahasā śivaḥ.. 21.68 ..
1.3.d:
तां निरीक्ष्य भवो देवो गिरिजां लोकपावनीम्..
मुमोह दर्शनात्तस्या मदनेनातुरीकृतः..
विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयनो बभूव सहसा शिवः.. 21.68 ..
1.3.m: Beholding her, the mountain-born goddess who purifies the world, / Lord Bhava was infatuated at her sight, agitated by Madana; / Śiva’s eyes suddenly widened in wonder.

1.3.s:
evaṃ vilokamāno'sau devadevo jagatpatiḥ..
manasā dūyamānena idamāha sadāśivaḥ.. 21.69 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विलोकमानोऽसौ देवदेवो जगत्पतिः..
मनसा दूयमानेन इदमाह सदाशिवः.. 21.69 ..
1.3.m: Looking upon her thus, the God of gods, the Lord of the world, / with an afflicted mind, Sadāśiva spoke this:

1.3.s:
anayā mohitaḥ kasmāttapaḥstho'haṃ nirāmayaḥ..
kutaḥ kasmācca kenedaṃ kṛtamasti mamāpriyam.. 21.70 ..
1.3.d:
अनया मोहितः कस्मात्तपःस्थोऽहं निरामयः..
कुतः कस्माच्च केनेदं कृतमस्ति ममाप्रियम्.. 21.70 ..
1.3.m: “Why have I, established in austerity and free from disease, been deluded by her? / From where, and why, and by whom has this unpleasant thing been done to me?”

1.3.s:
tato vyalokayacchaṃbhurddikṣu sarvāsu sādaram..
tāvaddṛṣṭo dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi hyāttaśarāsanaḥ.. 21.71 ..
1.3.d:
ततो व्यलोकयच्छंभुर्द्दिक्षु सर्वासु सादरम्..
तावद्दृष्टो दक्षिणस्यां दिशि ह्यात्तशरासनः.. 21.71 ..
1.3.m: Then Śambhu looked carefully in all directions; / just then, in the southern direction, one was seen who had taken up a bow.

1.3.s:
cakrīkṛtadhanuḥ sajjaṃ cakre beddhuṃ sadāśivam..
yāvatpunaḥ saṃdhayati madano madanāṃtakam..
tāvaddṛṣṭo maheśena saroṣeṇa tadā dvijāḥ.. 21.72 ..
1.3.d:
चक्रीकृतधनुः सज्जं चक्रे बेद्धुं सदाशिवम्..
यावत्पुनः संधयति मदनो मदनांतकम्..
तावद्दृष्टो महेशेन सरोषेण तदा द्विजाः.. 21.72 ..
1.3.m: Having bent his bow into a circle and strung it, he prepared to pierce Sadāśiva; / while Madana was again aiming at the ender of Madana, / he was seen, O twice-born ones, by Maheśa, filled with wrath.

1.3.s:
nirīkṣitastṛtīyena cakṣuṣā parameṇa hi..
madanastatkṣaṇādeva jvālāmālāvṛto'bhavat..
hāhākāro mahānāsīddevānāṃ tatra paśyatām.. 21.73 ..
1.3.d:
निरीक्षितस्तृतीयेन चक्षुषा परमेण हि..
मदनस्तत्क्षणादेव ज्वालामालावृतोऽभवत्..
हाहाकारो महानासीद्देवानां तत्र पश्यताम्.. 21.73 ..
1.3.m: Gazed upon by that supreme third eye indeed, / Madana was instantly surrounded by a garland of flames; / a great cry of despair arose among the gods watching there.

1.3.s:
..devā ūcuḥ..
devadeva mahādeva devānāṃ varado bhava..
girijāyāḥ sahāyārthaṃ preṣito madano'dhunā.. 21.74 ..
1.3.d:
..देवा ऊचुः..
देवदेव महादेव देवानां वरदो भव..
गिरिजायाः सहायार्थं प्रेषितो मदनोऽधुना.. 21.74 ..
1.3.m: The gods said: / “O God of gods, O Mahādeva, be a granter of boons to the gods! / Madana was just now sent to assist the mountain-born goddess.

1.3.s: vṛthā tvayātha dagdho'sau madano hi mahāprabhaḥ.. 21.75 ..
1.3.d: वृथा त्वयाथ दग्धोऽसौ मदनो हि महाप्रभः.. 21.75 ..
1.3.m: In vain has this Madana of great splendor been burned by you!

1.3.s:
tvayā hi kāryaṃ jagadekabaṃdho kāryaṃ surāṇāṃ parameṇa varcasā..
asyāṃ samutpatsyati deva śaṃbho tenaiva sarvaṃ bhavatīha kāryam.. 21.76 ..
1.3.d:
त्वया हि कार्यं जगदेकबंधो कार्यं सुराणां परमेण वर्चसा..
अस्यां समुत्पत्स्यति देव शंभो तेनैव सर्वं भवतीह कार्यम्.. 21.76 ..
1.3.m: By you, O sole kinsman of the world, must be accomplished the task of the gods with supreme glory; / upon her, O Lord Śambhu, [a son] will be born, by whom indeed the whole task here will be accomplished.

1.3.s:
tārakeṇa mahādeva devāḥ saṃpīḍitā bhṛśam..
tadarthaṃ jīvitaṃ cāsya dattvā ca girijāṃ prabho.. 21.77 ..
1.3.d:
तारकेण महादेव देवाः संपीडिता भृशम्..
तदर्थं जीवितं चास्य दत्त्वा च गिरिजां प्रभो.. 21.77 ..
1.3.m: O Mahādeva, the gods are severely tormented by Tāraka; / for that purpose, having restored his life, O Lord, and having accepted the mountain-born goddess,

1.3.s:
varayasva mahābhāga devākārye bhava kṣamaḥ..
gajāsurāttavayā trātā vayaṃ sarve divaukasaḥ.. 21.78 ..
1.3.d:
वरयस्व महाभाग देवाकार्ये भव क्षमः..
गजासुरात्तवया त्राता वयं सर्वे दिवौकसः.. 21.78 ..
1.3.m: choose her, O fortunate one, and be tolerant toward the gods' affair! / From Gajāsura, all of us heaven-dwellers were saved by you;

1.3.s:
kālakūṭācca nūnaṃ hi rakṣitāḥ smo na cānyathā..
bhasmāsurācca sarveśa tvayā trātā na saṃśayaḥ.. 21.79 ..
1.3.d:
कालकूटाच्च नूनं हि रक्षिताः स्मो न चान्यथा..
भस्मासुराच्च सर्वेश त्वया त्राता न संशयः.. 21.79 ..
1.3.m: and surely we were rescued from the Kālakūṭa poison, not otherwise; / and from Bhasmāsura, O Lord of all, we were saved by you without doubt.

1.3.s:
madanoyaṃ samāyātaḥ surāṇāṃ kāryasiddhaye..
tasmāttvayā rakṣaṇīya upakāraḥ paro hi naḥ.. 21.80 ..
1.3.d:
मदनोयं समायातः सुराणां कार्यसिद्धये..
तस्मात्त्वया रक्षणीय उपकारः परो हि नः.. 21.80 ..
1.3.m: This Madana came for the accomplishment of the gods' purpose; / therefore, he should be preserved by you; he is indeed our supreme benefactor.

1.3.s:
vinā tena jagatsarvaṃ nāśameṣyati śaṃkara..
niṣkāmastvaṃ kathaṃ śaṃbho svabuddhyā ca vimṛsyatām.. 21.81 ..
1.3.d:
विना तेन जगत्सर्वं नाशमेष्यति शंकर..
निष्कामस्त्वं कथं शंभो स्वबुद्ध्या च विमृस्यताम्.. 21.81 ..
1.3.m: Without him, the whole world will go to ruin, O Śaṃkara; / reflect with your own intellect, O Śambhu: how can you remain free of desire?”

1.3.s:
tadovāca ruṣāviṣṭo devānprati maheśvaraḥ..
vinā kāmena bho devā bhavitavyaṃ na cānyathā.. 21.82 ..
1.3.d:
तदोवाच रुषाविष्टो देवान्प्रति महेश्वरः..
विना कामेन भो देवा भवितव्यं न चान्यथा.. 21.82 ..
1.3.m: Then Maheśvara, possessed by wrath, spoke to the gods: / “O gods, one must exist without desire, and not otherwise.

1.3.s:
yadāḥkāmaṃ puraskṛtya sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ..
padabhraṣṭāśca duḥkhena vyāptā dainyaṃ samāśritāḥ.. 21.83 ..
1.3.d:
यदाःकामं पुरस्कृत्य सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः..
पदभ्रष्टाश्च दुःखेन व्याप्ता दैन्यं समाश्रिताः.. 21.83 ..
1.3.m: When all the gods, along with Indra, placed desire before them, / they were displaced from their realm, pervaded by misery, and fell into wretchedness.

1.3.s:
kāmo hi narakāyaiva sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ dhruvam..
duḥkharūpī hyanaṃgo'yaṃ jānīdhvaṃ mama bhāṣitam.. 21.84 ..
1.3.d:
कामो हि नरकायैव सर्वेषां प्राणिनां ध्रुवम्..
दुःखरूपी ह्यनंगोऽयं जानीध्वं मम भाषितम्.. 21.84 ..
1.3.m: Desire indeed leads all living beings only to hell, surely; / for this bodiless one is the embodiment of sorrow; know my word!

1.3.s:
tārako'pi durācāro niṣkāmo'dya bhaviṣyati..
vinākāmena ca kathaṃ pāpamācarate naraḥ.. 21.85 ..
1.3.d:
तारकोऽपि दुराचारो निष्कामोऽद्य भविष्यति..
विनाकामेन च कथं पापमाचरते नरः.. 21.85 ..
1.3.m: Even the wicked Tāraka will today become free of desire; / and without desire, how can a mortal commit sin?

1.3.s:
tasmātkāmo mayā dagdhaḥ sarveṣāṃ śāṃtihetave..
yuṣmābhiśca suraiḥ sarvairasuraiśca maharṣibhiḥ.. 21.86 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्कामो मया दग्धः सर्वेषां शांतिहेतवे..
युष्माभिश्च सुरैः सर्वैरसुरैश्च महर्षिभिः.. 21.86 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, desire was burned by me for the sake of the peace of all; / by all of you—gods, asuras, and great seers—

1.3.s:
anyaiḥ prāṇibhirevātra tapase dhīyatāṃ manaḥ..
kāmakrodhavihīnaṃ ca jagatsarvaṃ mayā kṛtam.. 21.87 ..
1.3.d:
अन्यैः प्राणिभिरेवात्र तपसे धीयतां मनः..
कामक्रोधविहीनं च जगत्सर्वं मया कृतम्.. 21.87 ..
1.3.m: and by other living beings here, let the mind be set upon austerity; / the entire world has been made by me devoid of desire and anger.

1.3.s:
tasmādenaṃ pāpinaṃ duḥkhamūlaṃ na jīvayiṣyāmi surāḥ pratīkṣyatām..
nirantaraṃ cātmasukhaprabodhamānaṃdalakṣaṇamāgādhamananyarūpam.. 21.88 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मादेनं पापिनं दुःखमूलं न जीवयिष्यामि सुराः प्रतीक्ष्यताम्..
निरन्तरं चात्मसुखप्रबोधमानंदलक्षणमागाधमनन्यरूपम्.. 21.88 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, O gods, wait; I will not revive this sinful root of sorrow! / [Turn to] continuous awakening to the bliss of the self, characterised by joy, unfathomable, and incomparable!”

1.3.s:
evamuktāstadā tena śaṃbhunā parameṣṭhinā..
ūcurmaharṣayaḥ sarve śakara lokaśaṃkaram.. 21.89 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्तास्तदा तेन शंभुना परमेष्ठिना..
ऊचुर्महर्षयः सर्वे शकर लोकशंकरम्.. 21.89 ..
1.3.m: Spoken to thus at that time by Parameṣṭhin Śambhu, / all the great seers said to Śaṃkara, who causes welfare to the world:

1.3.s:
yaduktaṃ bhavatā śaṃbho paraṃ śreyaskaraṃ hi naḥ..
kiṃ tu vakṣyāma deveśa śrūyatāṃ cāvadhāryatām.. 21.90 ..
1.3.d:
यदुक्तं भवता शंभो परं श्रेयस्करं हि नः..
किं तु वक्ष्याम देवेश श्रूयतां चावधार्यताम्.. 21.90 ..
1.3.m: “What has been spoken by you, O Śambhu, is indeed supremely beneficial to us; / yet we shall speak, O Lord of gods; may it be heard and attended to!

1.3.s:
yathā sṛṣṭamidaṃ viśvaṃ kāmakrodhasamanvitam..
tatsarvaṃ kāmarūpaṃ hi sa kāmo na tu hanyate.. 21.91 ..
1.3.d:
यथा सृष्टमिदं विश्वं कामक्रोधसमन्वितम्..
तत्सर्वं कामरूपं हि स कामो न तु हन्यते.. 21.91 ..
1.3.m: Since this universe was created endowed with desire and anger, / all of it is indeed an embodiment of desire; that desire cannot be slain.

1.3.s:
dharmārthakāmāmokṣāśca catvāro hyekarūpatām..
nītāyena mahādeva sa kāmo'yaṃ na hanyate.. 21.92 ..
1.3.d:
धर्मार्थकामामोक्षाश्च चत्वारो ह्येकरूपताम्..
नीतायेन महादेव स कामोऽयं न हन्यते.. 21.92 ..
1.3.m: The four aims of life—duty, wealth, desire, and liberation— / were brought to a single form by him; O Mahādeva, that desire is not to be slain.

1.3.s:
kathaṃ tvayā hi saṃdagdhaḥ kāmo hi duratikramaḥ..
yena saṃghaṭitaṃ viśvamābrahmasthāvarātmakam.. 21.93 ..
1.3.d:
कथं त्वया हि संदग्धः कामो हि दुरतिक्रमः..
येन संघटितं विश्वमाब्रह्मस्थावरात्मकम्.. 21.93 ..
1.3.m: How, indeed, could desire, which is insurmountable, be burned by you, / by whom the universe, from Brahmā down to immovable objects, was joined together?

1.3.s:
kāmena hīyate viśvaṃ kāmena pālyate..
kāmenotpadyate viśvaṃ tasmātkāmo mahābalaḥ.. 21.94 ..
1.3.d:
कामेन हीयते विश्वं कामेन पाल्यते..
कामेनोत्पद्यते विश्वं तस्मात्कामो महाबलः.. 21.94 ..
1.3.m: By desire the universe is abandoned, by desire it is protected, / by desire the universe is produced; therefore desire is mighty.

1.3.s:
yasmātkrodho bhavatyugro yena tvaṃ ca vaśīkṛtaḥ..
tasmātkāmaṃ mahādeva saṃbodhayitumarhasi.. 21.95 ..
1.3.d:
यस्मात्क्रोधो भवत्युग्रो येन त्वं च वशीकृतः..
तस्मात्कामं महादेव संबोधयितुमर्हसि.. 21.95 ..
1.3.m: Since wrath is fierce, by which you also were overcome, / therefore, O Mahādeva, you ought to awaken desire.

1.3.s:
tvayā saṃpādito deva madano hi mahābalaḥ..
samartho hi samarthatvāttatsāmarthyaṃ kariṣyati.. 21.96 ..
1.3.d:
त्वया संपादितो देव मदनो हि महाबलः..
समर्थो हि समर्थत्वात्तत्सामर्थ्यं करिष्यति.. 21.96 ..
1.3.m: By you, O Lord, Madana of great might was produced; / being capable, by his capability he will perform that function.”

1.3.s:
ṛṣibhiścaivamukto'pi dviguṇaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ..
cakṣuṣā hi tṛtīyena dagdhukāmo harastadā.. 21.97 ..
1.3.d:
ऋषिभिश्चैवमुक्तोऽपि द्विगुणं रूपमास्थितः..
चक्षुषा हि तृतीयेन दग्धुकामो हरस्तदा.. 21.97 ..
1.3.m: Although addressed thus by the seers, assuming a twofold [fierce] form, / Hara was then eager to burn [them] with his third eye.

1.3.s:
munibhiścāraṇaiḥ siddhairgaṇaiścāpi sadāśivaḥ..
stutaśca vaṃdito rudraḥ pinākī vṛṣavāhanaḥ.. 21.98 ..
1.3.d:
मुनिभिश्चारणैः सिद्धैर्गणैश्चापि सदाशिवः..
स्तुतश्च वंदितो रुद्रः पिनाकी वृषवाहनः.. 21.98 ..
1.3.m: By the sages, cāraṇas, siddhas, and attendants, Sadāśiva, / the wielder of the Pināka, Rudra whose mount is the bull, was praised and saluted.

1.3.s:
madanaṃ ca tathā dagdhvā tyaktvā taṃ parvataṃ ruṣā..
himavaṃtābhidhaṃ sadyastirodhānagato'bhavat.. 21.99 ..
1.3.d:
मदनं च तथा दग्ध्वा त्यक्त्वा तं पर्वतं रुषा..
हिमवंताभिधं सद्यस्तिरोधानगतोऽभवत्.. 21.99 ..
1.3.m: Having burned Madana in that way, and having left that mountain / named Himavat in wrath, he immediately vanished.

1.3.s:
tirodhānagataṃ devī vīkṣya dagdhaṃ ca manmatham..
sakokilaṃ sacūtaṃ ca sabhṛṃgaṃ sahacaṃpakam.. 21.100 ..
1.3.d:
तिरोधानगतं देवी वीक्ष्य दग्धं च मन्मथम्..
सकोकिलं सचूतं च सभृंगं सहचंपकम्.. 21.100 ..
1.3.m: Seeing that he had vanished, and that Manmatha was burned / along with the cuckoos, the mangoes, the black bees, and the campaka blossoms,

1.3.s:
tathaiva dagdhaṃ madanaṃ vilokya ratyā vilāpaṃ ca tadā manasvinī..
sabāṣpadīrghaṃ vimanā vimṛsya kathaṃ sa rudro vaśago bhavenmama.. 21.101 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव दग्धं मदनं विलोक्य रत्या विलापं च तदा मनस्विनी..
सबाष्पदीर्घं विमना विमृस्य कथं स रुद्रो वशगो भवेन्मम.. 21.101 ..
1.3.m: and seeing Madana burned in that manner, the wise woman [Girijā], / hearing the long tearful wailing of Ratī, dejected, pondered: ‘How may that Rudra come under my control?’

1.3.s:
evaṃ vimṛśya suciraṃ girijā tadānīṃ saṃmohamāpa ca satī hi tathā babhāṣe..
saṃmuhyamānā rudatīṃ nirīśyaratirmahārūpavatīṃ manasvinīm.. 21.102 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विमृश्य सुचिरं गिरिजा तदानीं संमोहमाप च सती हि तथा बभाषे..
संमुह्यमाना रुदतीं निरीश्यरतिर्महारूपवतीं मनस्विनीम्.. 21.102 ..
1.3.m: Having thus reflected for a long time, the mountain-born woman, the virtuous wife, then swooned; / and seeing the exceedingly beautiful and wise [Girijā] fainting and weeping, Ratī spoke:

1.3.s:
mā viṣādaṃ kuru sakhi madanaṃ jīvayāmyaham..
tvadarthaṃ bho viśālākṣi tapasā''rādhayāmyaham.. 21.103 ..
1.3.d:
मा विषादं कुरु सखि मदनं जीवयाम्यहम्..
त्वदर्थं भो विशालाक्षि तपसा'ऽराधयाम्यहम्.. 21.103 ..
1.3.m: “Do not grieve, my friend! I will revive Madana; / for your sake, O large-eyed one, I will worship with austerity

1.3.s:
haraṃ rudraṃ virupākṣaṃ devadevaṃ jagadgurum..
mā ciṃtāṃ kuru suśromi madanaṃ jīvayāmyaham.. 21.104 ..
1.3.d:
हरं रुद्रं विरुपाक्षं देवदेवं जगद्गुरुम्..
मा चिंतां कुरु सुश्रोमि मदनं जीवयाम्यहम्.. 21.104 ..
1.3.m: Hara, Rudra, Virūpākṣa, the God of gods, the teacher of the world; / do not worry, O fair-hipped one, I will bring Madana back to life!”

1.3.s:
evama śvāsya tāṃ sādhvī girijāṃ ratiraṃjasā..
tapastepe ca sumahatpatiṃ prāptuṃ sumadhyamā.. 21.105 ..
1.3.d:
एवम श्वास्य तां साध्वी गिरिजां रतिरंजसा..
तपस्तेपे च सुमहत्पतिं प्राप्तुं सुमध्यमा.. 21.105 ..
1.3.m: Having thus comforted that virtuous mountain-born girl, Ratī of slender waist / immediately performed great austerity to regain her husband.

1.3.s:
madano yatra dagdhaśca rudreṇa paramātmanā..
tapyamānāṃ tapastatra nārado dadṛśe tadā.. 21.106 ..
1.3.d:
मदनो यत्र दग्धश्च रुद्रेण परमात्मना..
तप्यमानां तपस्तत्र नारदो ददृशे तदा.. 21.106 ..
1.3.m: Where Madana had been burned by the supreme self Rudra, / Nārada then saw her performing austerity there.

1.3.s:
uvāca gatvā sahasā bhāminīṃ ratimaṃtike..
kasyāsi tvaṃ viśālākṣi kena vā tapyate tapaḥ.. 21.107 ..
1.3.d:
उवाच गत्वा सहसा भामिनीं रतिमंतिके..
कस्यासि त्वं विशालाक्षि केन वा तप्यते तपः.. 21.107 ..
1.3.m: Having gone near the passionate lady Ratī, he suddenly said: / “Whose wife are you, O large-eyed one, or for what reason is this austerity being performed,

1.3.s:
taruṇī rūpasaṃpannā saubhāgyena pareṇa hi..
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā roṣeṇa mahatā tadā..
uvāca vākyaṃ madhuraṃ kiṃcinniṣṭhurameva ca.. 21.108 ..
1.3.d:
तरुणी रूपसंपन्ना सौभाग्येन परेण हि..
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रोषेण महता तदा..
उवाच वाक्यं मधुरं किंचिन्निष्ठुरमेव च.. 21.108 ..
1.3.m: young as you are, endowed with beauty, and supreme good fortune?” / Hearing the words of Nārada, she then, with great anger, / spoke words that were sweet and yet somewhat harsh.

1.3.s:
..ratiruvāca..
nārado'si mayā jñātaḥ kumārastvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ..
svasvarūpādarśanaṃ ca kartumarhasi suvrata.. 21.109 ..
1.3.d:
..रतिरुवाच..
नारदोऽसि मया ज्ञातः कुमारस्त्वं न संशयः..
स्वस्वरूपादर्शनं च कर्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत.. 21.109 ..
1.3.m: Rati said: / I recognize you: you are Nārada, an unmarried youth, there is no doubt. / O you of virtuous vows, you ought not to show your face [here]!

1.3.s:
yathāgatena mārgeṇa gaccha tvaṃ mā vilaṃbitam..
baṭo na kiṃcijjānāsi kevalaṃ kalikṛnmahān.. 21.110 ..
1.3.d:
यथागतेन मार्गेण गच्छ त्वं मा विलंबितम्..
बटो न किंचिज्जानासि केवलं कलिकृन्महान्.. 21.110 ..
1.3.m: Go by the very path you came, without delay. / Young celibate, you know nothing; you are merely a great instigator of strife.

1.3.s:
parastrīkāmukāḥ kṣudrā viṭā vyasaninaśca ye..
tathā hyakarmiṇaḥ stabdhāsteṣāṃ madhye tvamagraṇīḥ.. 21.111 ..
1.3.d:
परस्त्रीकामुकाः क्षुद्रा विटा व्यसनिनश्च ये..
तथा ह्यकर्मिणः स्तब्धास्तेषां मध्ये त्वमग्रणीः.. 21.111 ..
1.3.m: Those who lust after other men's wives, base rogues and profligates, / and likewise the idle and insolent—among them you are the foremost.

1.3.s:
evaṃ nirbhartsito ratyā nārado munisattamaḥ..
svayaṃ jagāma tvarītaṃ śaṃbaraṃ daityapuṃgavam.. 21.112 ..
1.3.d:
एवं निर्भर्त्सितो रत्या नारदो मुनिसत्तमः..
स्वयं जगाम त्वरीतं शंबरं दैत्यपुंगवम्.. 21.112 ..
1.3.m: Thus rebuked by Rati, Nārada, the best of sages, / himself went swiftly to Śambara, the foremost of the Daityas.

1.3.s:
śaśaṃsa daityarājāya dagdhaṃ madanameva ca..
rudreṇa krodhayuktena tasya bhāryā manasvinī.. 21.113 ..
1.3.d:
शशंस दैत्यराजाय दग्धं मदनमेव च..
रुद्रेण क्रोधयुक्तेन तस्य भार्या मनस्विनी.. 21.113 ..
1.3.m: He announced to the Daitya king that Madana had been burned / by enraged Rudra, and that his wise wife [was there]:

1.3.s:
tāmānaya mahābhāga bhāryāṃ kuru mahābala..
atīva rūpasaṃpannā yā ānītāstvayānagha..
tāsāṃ madhye rūpavatī ratiḥ sā madanapriyā.. 21.114 ..
1.3.d:
तामानय महाभाग भार्यां कुरु महाबल..
अतीव रूपसंपन्ना या आनीतास्त्वयानघ..
तासां मध्ये रूपवती रतिः सा मदनप्रिया.. 21.114 ..
1.3.m: "Bring her, O fortunate one; make her your wife, O mighty one! / Among those women endowed with supreme beauty whom you have brought, O sinless one, / Rati, the beloved of Madana, is the most beautiful of all."

1.3.s:
evamākarṇya vacanaṃ devarṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ..
jagāma sahasā tatra yatrāste sā suśobhanā.. 21.115 ..
1.3.d:
एवमाकर्ण्य वचनं देवर्षेर्भावितात्मनः..
जगाम सहसा तत्र यत्रास्ते सा सुशोभना.. 21.115 ..
1.3.m: Hearing this word of the divine seer of purified mind, / he went at once to where that lovely woman was staying.

1.3.s:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā su viśālākṣīṃ ratiṃ madanamohinīm..
uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ śaṃbaro devasaṃkaṭaḥ.. 21.116 ..
1.3.d:
तां दृष्ट्वा सु विशालाक्षीं रतिं मदनमोहिनीम्..
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं शंबरो देवसंकटः.. 21.116 ..
1.3.m: Seeing that large-eyed Rati, who infatuated even Madana, / Śambara, the tormentor of the gods, laughed and spoke these words:

1.3.s:
ehi tanvi mayā sārddhaṃ rājyaṃ bhogānyatheṣṭataḥ..
bhuṃkṣva devi prasādānme tapasā kiṃ prayojanam.. 21.117 ..
1.3.d:
एहि तन्वि मया सार्द्धं राज्यं भोगान्यथेष्टतः..
भुंक्ष्व देवि प्रसादान्मे तपसा किं प्रयोजनम्.. 21.117 ..
1.3.m: "Come with me, O slender-limbed woman! Enjoy the kingdom / and pleasures at your will, O goddess, by my grace; what need is there for austerity?"

1.3.s:
evamuktā tadā tena śaṃbareṇa mahātmanā..
uvāca tanvī madhuraṃ mahiṣī madanasya sā.. 21.118 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्ता तदा तेन शंबरेण महात्मना..
उवाच तन्वी मधुरं महिषी मदनस्य सा.. 21.118 ..
1.3.m: Addressed thus by that great Śambara, / she, the slender queen of Madana, spoke sweetly:

1.3.s:
vidhavāhaṃ mahābāho naivaṃ bhāṣitumarhasi..
rājā tvaṃ sarvadaityānāṃ lakṣṇaiḥ parivāritaḥ.. 21.119 ..
1.3.d:
विधवाहं महाबाहो नैवं भाषितुमर्हसि..
राजा त्वं सर्वदैत्यानां लक्ष्णैः परिवारितः.. 21.119 ..
1.3.m: "I am a widow, O mighty-armed one; you should not speak thus. / You are the king of all Daityas, endowed with auspicious marks.

1.3.s:
etattadvacanaṃ śrutvā śaṃbaraḥ kāmamohitaḥ..
kare grahītu kāmo'sau tadā ratyā nivāritaḥ.. 21.120 ..
1.3.d:
एतत्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शंबरः काममोहितः..
करे ग्रहीतु कामोऽसौ तदा रत्या निवारितः.. 21.120 ..
1.3.m: Hearing these words of hers, Śambara, infatuated by desire, / wished to take her by the hand; then he was stopped by Rati.

1.3.s:
vimṛśya manasā sarvamajeyatvaṃ ca tasya vai..
mā spṛśa tvaṃ ca re mūḍha mama saṃsparśajena vai.. 21.121 ..
1.3.d:
विमृश्य मनसा सर्वमजेयत्वं च तस्य वै..
मा स्पृश त्वं च रे मूढ मम संस्पर्शजेन वै.. 21.121 ..
1.3.m: Pondering everything in her mind, including his invincibility: / "Do not touch me, you fool! By contact arising from touching me,

1.3.s:
saṃparkeṇa ca dagdho'si nānyathā mama bhāṣitam..
tadovāca mahātejāḥ śaṃbaraḥ prahasanniva.. 21.122 ..
1.3.d:
संपर्केण च दग्धोऽसि नान्यथा मम भाषितम्..
तदोवाच महातेजाः शंबरः प्रहसन्निव.. 21.122 ..
1.3.m: you will be burnt through touch; my speech will not prove false!" / Then the glorious Śambara said, as if laughing:

1.3.s:
vibhīṣikābhirbahvībhirmāṃ bhīṣayasi mānini..
gaccha śīghraṃ mama gṛhaṃ bahūktyā kiṃ prayojanam.. 21.123 ..
1.3.d:
विभीषिकाभिर्बह्वीभिर्मां भीषयसि मानिनि..
गच्छ शीघ्रं मम गृहं बहूक्त्या किं प्रयोजनम्.. 21.123 ..
1.3.m: "You frighten me with many terrifying threats, O proud woman! / Go swiftly to my house; what is the use of much talk?"

1.3.s:
ityucyamānena tadā nītā sā prasabhaṃ tathā..
svapuraṃ paramaṃ tanvī śaṃbareṇa manasvinī.. 21.124 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युच्यमानेन तदा नीता सा प्रसभं तथा..
स्वपुरं परमं तन्वी शंबरेण मनस्विनी.. 21.124 ..
1.3.m: While she was thus speaking, that slender, high-minded woman / was forcibly carried off by Śambara to his supreme city.

1.3.s: kṛtā mahānase'dhyakṣā nāmnā māyāvatīti ca.. 21.125 ..
1.3.d: कृता महानसेऽध्यक्षा नाम्ना मायावतीति च.. 21.125 ..
1.3.m: She was appointed as superintendent of the kitchen under the name Māyāvatī.

1.3.s:
..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
pārvatyādhikṛtaṃ sarvaṃ madanānayanaṃ prati..
saṃbareṇa hṛtātanvī madanasya priyā satī..
ata ūrdhvaṃ tadā sūta kiṃ jātaṃ tatra varṇyatām.. 21.126 ..
1.3.d:
..ऋषय ऊचुः..
पार्वत्याधिकृतं सर्वं मदनानयनं प्रति..
संबरेण हृतातन्वी मदनस्य प्रिया सती..
अत ऊर्ध्वं तदा सूत किं जातं तत्र वर्ण्यताम्.. 21.126 ..
1.3.m: The seers said: / Pārvatī undertook everything regarding the bringing of Madana, / and the slender, chaste beloved of Madana was abducted by Śambara. / Describe, O Sūta, what happened there after that!

1.3.s:
..sūta uvāca..
gataṃ tadā śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā dagdhvā madanamojasā..
pārvatī tapasā yuktā sthitā tatraiva bhāminī.. 21.127 ..
1.3.d:
..सूत उवाच..
गतं तदा शिवं दृष्ट्वा दग्ध्वा मदनमोजसा..
पार्वती तपसा युक्ता स्थिता तत्रैव भामिनी.. 21.127 ..
1.3.m: Sūta said: / Seeing Śiva departed after burning Madana with his splendor, / the spirited Pārvatī, engaged in austerity, remained right there.

1.3.s:
pitrā tena tadā tanvī mātrā caiva vicāritā..
bāle ehi gṛhe śīghraṃ mā śramaṃ kartumarhasi.. 21.128 ..
1.3.d:
पित्रा तेन तदा तन्वी मात्रा चैव विचारिता..
बाले एहि गृहे शीघ्रं मा श्रमं कर्तुमर्हसि.. 21.128 ..
1.3.m: Then that slender girl was reasoned with by her father and mother: / "Child, come home quickly; you must not subject yourself to fatigue!"

1.3.s: uktā tābhyāṃ tadā sādhvī girijā vākyamabravīt.. 21.129 ..
1.3.d: उक्ता ताभ्यां तदा साध्वी गिरिजा वाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 21.129 ..
1.3.m: Thus addressed by the two of them, the virtuous Girijā spoke these words.

1.3.s:
..pārvatyuvāca..
nāgacchāmi gṛhaṃ mātastāta me śrṛṇu tattvataḥ..
vākyaṃ dharmārthayuktaṃ ca yena tvaṃ toṣameṣyasi.. 21.130 ..
1.3.d:
..पार्वत्युवाच..
नागच्छामि गृहं मातस्तात मे श्रृणु तत्त्वतः..
वाक्यं धर्मार्थयुक्तं च येन त्वं तोषमेष्यसि.. 21.130 ..
1.3.m: Pārvatī said: / "Mother, I will not come home; Father, hear from me truthfully / a word endowed with righteousness and purpose, by which you will find satisfaction:

1.3.s:
śaṃbhuḥ pareṣāṃ paramo dagdho yena mahābalaḥ..
madano mama sānnidhyamānaye'traiva taṃ śivam.. 21.131 ..
1.3.d:
शंभुः परेषां परमो दग्धो येन महाबलः..
मदनो मम सान्निध्यमानयेऽत्रैव तं शिवम्.. 21.131 ..
1.3.m: Śambhu is the highest of the high, by whom the mighty Madana was burnt / in my presence; I will bring that very Śiva right here!

1.3.s:
durlabhohi tadā śaṃbhuḥ prāṇināṃ gṛhamicchatām..
nāgacchāmi gṛhaṃ mātastasmātsarvaṃ vimṛśyatām.. 21.132 ..
1.3.d:
दुर्लभोहि तदा शंभुः प्राणिनां गृहमिच्छताम्..
नागच्छामि गृहं मातस्तस्मात्सर्वं विमृश्यताम्.. 21.132 ..
1.3.m: Indeed, Śambhu is difficult to attain for living beings who desire a household life. / I will not return home, O mother; therefore let everything be considered."

1.3.s:
tadovāca mahātejā himavānsvasutāṃ prati..
durārādhyaḥ śivaḥ sākṣātsarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ..
tvayā prāptumaśakyo hi tasmāttvaṃ svagṛhaṃ vraja.. 21.133 ..
1.3.d:
तदोवाच महातेजा हिमवान्स्वसुतां प्रति..
दुराराध्यः शिवः साक्षात्सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः..
त्वया प्राप्तुमशक्यो हि तस्मात्त्वं स्वगृहं व्रज.. 21.133 ..
1.3.m: Then the glorious Himavat said to his daughter: / "Directly visible Śiva, worshipped by all gods, is difficult to propitiate. / He cannot be attained by you; therefore return to your home."

1.3.s:
sā bāṣpapūritenaiva kaṃṭhena svasutāṃ prati..
uvāca menā tanvaṃgiyāhi śīghraṃ gṛhaṃ prati.. 21.134 ..
1.3.d:
सा बाष्पपूरितेनैव कंठेन स्वसुतां प्रति..
उवाच मेना तन्वंगियाहि शीघ्रं गृहं प्रति.. 21.134 ..
1.3.m: With a throat filled with tears, Menā / said to her slender-limbed daughter: "Go quickly back to the house!"

1.3.s:
tadā prahasya covāca mātaraṃ prati pārvatī..
pratijñāṃ śrṛṇu me mātastapasā parameṇa hi.. 21.135 ..
1.3.d:
तदा प्रहस्य चोवाच मातरं प्रति पार्वती..
प्रतिज्ञां श्रृणु मे मातस्तपसा परमेण हि.. 21.135 ..
1.3.m: Then laughing, Pārvatī said to her mother: / "Hear my vow, O mother! Through supreme austerity,

1.3.s:
atraiva taṃ samānīya varayāmi vicakṣaṇam..
nāśayāmi rudrasya rudratvaṃ vāravarṇini.. 21.136 ..
1.3.d:
अत्रैव तं समानीय वरयामि विचक्षणम्..
नाशयामि रुद्रस्य रुद्रत्वं वारवर्णिनि.. 21.136 ..
1.3.m: having brought that discerning one right here, I shall choose him. / I will destroy Rudra's dread nature, O fair-complexioned one!"

1.3.s:
sukharūpaṃ parityajya girijā ca manasvinī..
śaṃbhorāradhanaṃ cakre parameṇa samādhinā.. 21.137 ..
1.3.d:
सुखरूपं परित्यज्य गिरिजा च मनस्विनी..
शंभोरारधनं चक्रे परमेण समाधिना.. 21.137 ..
1.3.m: Abandoning all form of comfort, the high-minded Girijā / performed the worship of Śambhu with supreme absorption.

1.3.s:
jayā ca vijayā caiva mādhavī ca sulocanā..
suśrutā ca śrutā caiva tathaiva ca śukī parā.. 21.138 ..
1.3.d:
जया च विजया चैव माधवी च सुलोचना..
सुश्रुता च श्रुता चैव तथैव च शुकी परा.. 21.138 ..
1.3.m: Jayā and Vijayā, Mādhavī and Sulocanā, / Suśrutā and Śrutā, and likewise the supreme Śukī,

1.3.s:
pramlocā subhagā śyāmā citrāṃgī cāruṇī svadhā..
etāścānyāśca bahavaḥ sakhyastā girijāṃ prati..
upāsāṃcakrire sā ca devagarbhā ca bhāminī.. 21.139 ..
1.3.d:
प्रम्लोचा सुभगा श्यामा चित्रांगी चारुणी स्वधा..
एताश्चान्याश्च बहवः सख्यस्ता गिरिजां प्रति..
उपासांचक्रिरे सा च देवगर्भा च भामिनी.. 21.139 ..
1.3.m: Pramlocā, Subhagā, Śyāmā, Citrāṅgī, Cāruṇī, and Svadhā— / these and many other female companions attended / upon Girijā, that spirited woman born of divine womb.

1.3.s:
tapasā paramogreṇa caraṃtī cāruhāsinī..
madano yatra dagdhaśca rudreṇa ca mahātmanā..
tatraiva vediṃ kṛtvā ca tasyopari susaṃsthitā.. 21.140 ..
1.3.d:
तपसा परमोग्रेण चरंती चारुहासिनी..
मदनो यत्र दग्धश्च रुद्रेण च महात्मना..
तत्रैव वेदिं कृत्वा च तस्योपरि सुसंस्थिता.. 21.140 ..
1.3.m: Performing supreme, severe austerity, the sweet-smiling maiden, / right where Madana had been burnt by the great-souled Rudra, / erected an altar and seated herself firmly upon it.

1.3.s:
tyaktvā jalāśanaṃ bālā parṇādā hyabhavacca sā..
tataḥ sā'rdrāṇi parṇāni tyaktvā śuṣkāṇi cādade.. 21.141 ..
1.3.d:
त्यक्त्वा जलाशनं बाला पर्णादा ह्यभवच्च सा..
ततः साऽर्द्राणि पर्णानि त्यक्त्वा शुष्काणि चाददे.. 21.141 ..
1.3.m: Abandoning drinking water, the girl ate only leaves; / then, having given up moist leaves, she took dry leaves.

1.3.s:
śuṣkāṇi caiva parṇāni nāśitāni tayā yadā..
aparṇeti ca vikhyātā babhuva tanumadhyamā.. 21.142 ..
1.3.d:
शुष्काणि चैव पर्णानि नाशितानि तया यदा..
अपर्णेति च विख्याता बभुव तनुमध्यमा.. 21.142 ..
1.3.m: When even dry leaves were given up by her, / the slender-waisted maiden became renowned as Aparṇā.

1.3.s:
vāyupānaratā jātā aṃbupānādanaṃtaram..
kālakrameṇa mahatā babhūva girijā satī..
ekāṃguṣṭhena ca tadā dadhāra ca nijaṃ vapuḥ.. 21.143 ..
1.3.d:
वायुपानरता जाता अंबुपानादनंतरम्..
कालक्रमेण महता बभूव गिरिजा सती..
एकांगुष्ठेन च तदा दधार च निजं वपुः.. 21.143 ..
1.3.m: After drinking water, she became devoted to consuming only wind; / in the great course of time, the chaste Girijā / supported her body upon a single big toe.

1.3.s:
evamugreṇa tapasā śaṃkarārādhanaṃ satī..
cakāra parayā tuṣṭyā śaṃbhoḥ prītyarthameva ca.. 21.144 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुग्रेण तपसा शंकराराधनं सती..
चकार परया तुष्ट्या शंभोः प्रीत्यर्थमेव च.. 21.144 ..
1.3.m: Thus with severe austerity the chaste woman performed the worship of Śaṃkara / with supreme contentment, solely for the gratification of Śambhu.

1.3.s:
paraṃ bhāvaṃ samāśritya jaganmaṃgalamaṃgalā..
tuṣṭyarthaṃ ca maheśasya tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ.. 21.145 ..
1.3.d:
परं भावं समाश्रित्य जगन्मंगलमंगला..
तुष्ट्यर्थं च महेशस्य तताप परमं तपः.. 21.145 ..
1.3.m: Resorting to the highest state, she who brings auspiciousness to the world / performed supreme austerity to please Maheśa.

1.3.s:
evaṃ divyasahasrāṇi varṣāṇi ca tatāpa vai..
himā layastadāgatya pārvatīṃ kṛtaniścayām.. 21.146 ..
1.3.d:
एवं दिव्यसहस्राणि वर्षाणि च तताप वै..
हिमा लयस्तदागत्य पार्वतीं कृतनिश्चयाम्.. 21.146 ..
1.3.m: Thus indeed she performed austerity for thousands of divine years. / Then the Himalaya came to Pārvatī, who had made her resolve,

1.3.s:
sabhāryaḥ sa sutāmāpta uvāca ca mahāsatīm..
mā khidyatāṃ mahādevi tapasānena bhāmini.. 21.147 ..
1.3.d:
सभार्यः स सुतामाप्त उवाच च महासतीम्..
मा खिद्यतां महादेवि तपसानेन भामिनि.. 21.147 ..
1.3.m: and with his wife, having reached his daughter, spoke to the great chaste woman: / "Do not torment yourself, O great goddess, with this austerity, O spirited lady!

1.3.s:
kva rudro dṛśyate bāle virakto nātra saṃśayaḥ..
tvaṃ tanvī taruṇī bālā tapasā ca vimohitā.. 21.148 ..
1.3.d:
क्व रुद्रो दृश्यते बाले विरक्तो नात्र संशयः..
त्वं तन्वी तरुणी बाला तपसा च विमोहिता.. 21.148 ..
1.3.m: Where is Rudra to be seen, O girl? He is detached, there is no doubt of this. / You are slender, young, a maiden, and bewildered by austerity.

1.3.s:
bhaviṣyati na saṃdehaḥ satyaṃ prativadāmi te..
tasmāduttiṣṭha yāhyāśu svagṛhaṃ varavarṇini.. 21.149 ..
1.3.d:
भविष्यति न संदेहः सत्यं प्रतिवदामि ते..
तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ याह्याशु स्वगृहं वरवर्णिनि.. 21.149 ..
1.3.m: It will happen [as I say], have no doubt; I speak the truth to you. / Therefore arise; go quickly to your home, O fair-complexioned one!

1.3.s:
kiṃ tena tava rudreṇa ye dagdhaḥ purā'naghe..
madano nirvikāritvāttaṃ kathaṃ prārthayiṣyasi.. 21.150 ..
1.3.d:
किं तेन तव रुद्रेण ये दग्धः पुराऽनघे..
मदनो निर्विकारित्वात्तं कथं प्रार्थयिष्यसि.. 21.150 ..
1.3.m: What is the use to you of that Rudra, by whom of old, O sinless one, / Madana was burnt due to his passionlessness? How will you entreat him?"

1.3.s:
gaganastho yathā caṃdro grahītuṃ na hi śakyate..
tathaiva durgamaḥ śarbhurjānīhi tvaṃ śucismite.. 21.151 ..
1.3.d:
गगनस्थो यथा चंद्रो ग्रहीतुं न हि शक्यते..
तथैव दुर्गमः शर्भुर्जानीहि त्वं शुचिस्मिते.. 21.151 ..
1.3.m: "Just as the moon abiding in the sky cannot be grasped, / even so Śambhu is hard to reach; understand [this], O sweet-smiling girl!"

1.3.s:
tathaiva menayā coktā tathā sahyādriṇā satī..
meruṇā maṃdareṇaiva mainākena tathaiva ca.. 21.152 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव मेनया चोक्ता तथा सह्याद्रिणा सती..
मेरुणा मंदरेणैव मैनाकेन तथैव च.. 21.152 ..
1.3.m: In the same way the chaste woman was addressed by Menā, and likewise by the Sahya mountain, / by Meru, by Mandara, and likewise by Maināka.

1.3.s:
ebhiruktā tadā tanvī pārvatī tapasi sthitā..
uvāca prahasantteva himavaṃtaṃ śucismitā.. 21.153 ..
1.3.d:
एभिरुक्ता तदा तन्वी पार्वती तपसि स्थिता..
उवाच प्रहसन्त्तेव हिमवंतं शुचिस्मिता.. 21.153 ..
1.3.m: Thus addressed by them, the slender Pārvatī, engaged in austerity, / sweet-smiling, as if laughing, said to the Himālaya:

1.3.s:
purā proktaṃ tvayā tāta aṃba kiṃ vismṛtaṃ tvayā..
adhunaiva pratijñāṃ ca śrṛṇudhvaṃ mama bāṃdhavāḥ.. 21.154 ..
1.3.d:
पुरा प्रोक्तं त्वया तात अंब किं विस्मृतं त्वया..
अधुनैव प्रतिज्ञां च श्रृणुध्वं मम बांधवाः.. 21.154 ..
1.3.m: "This was spoken before by you, father; O mother, have you forgotten? / Right now hear my resolve, O my kinsmen!

1.3.s:
virakto'sau mahādevo madano yena vai hataḥ..
taṃ toṣayāmi tapasā śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram.. 21.155 ..
1.3.d:
विरक्तोऽसौ महादेवो मदनो येन वै हतः..
तं तोषयामि तपसा शंकरं लोकशंकरम्.. 21.155 ..
1.3.m: That Mahādeva, by whom Madana was indeed slain, is detached; / him, Śaṃkara, who brings peace to the world, I shall satisfy through austerity.

1.3.s:
sarve yūyaṃ ca gacchaṃtu nātra kāryā vicāraṇā..
dagdho hi madano yena yena dagdhaṃ girervanam.. 21.156 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वे यूयं च गच्छंतु नात्र कार्या विचारणा..
दग्धो हि मदनो येन येन दग्धं गिरेर्वनम्.. 21.156 ..
1.3.m: All of you may go; there is to be no hesitation here. / For he by whom Madana was burned, by whom the mountain's forest was burned—

1.3.s:
tamānayāmi cātraiva tapasā kevalena hi..
tapobalena mahatā susevyo hi sadāśivaḥ.. 21.157 ..
1.3.d:
तमानयामि चात्रैव तपसा केवलेन हि..
तपोबलेन महता सुसेव्यो हि सदाशिवः.. 21.157 ..
1.3.m: him I shall bring right here by austerity alone! / For by great power of austerity Sadāśiva is truly easily served.

1.3.s: taṃ jānīdhvaṃ mahābhāgāḥ satyaṃsatyaṃ vadāmyaham.. 21.158 ..
1.3.d: तं जानीध्वं महाभागाः सत्यंसत्यं वदाम्यहम्.. 21.158 ..
1.3.m: Know this, O fortunate ones; truly, truly do I speak."

1.3.s:
saṃbhāṣamāṇā jananīṃ tadānīṃ himālayaṃ caiva tathā ca menām..
tathaiva meruṃ mitabhāṣiṇī tadā sā maṃdaraṃ parvatarājakanyā..
jagmustadā tena pathā ca parvatā yathāgatenāpi vicakṣamāṇāḥ.. 21.159 ..
1.3.d:
संभाषमाणा जननीं तदानीं हिमालयं चैव तथा च मेनाम्..
तथैव मेरुं मितभाषिणी तदा सा मंदरं पर्वतराजकन्या..
जग्मुस्तदा तेन पथा च पर्वता यथागतेनापि विचक्षमाणाः.. 21.159 ..
1.3.m: While addressing her mother at that time, and the Himālaya, and also Menā, / and likewise Meru, that measured-speaking daughter of the mountain king [spoke] then to Mandara; / then the mountains departed by that path as they had come, looking on.

1.3.s:
gateṣu teṣu sarveṣu sakhībhiḥ parivāritā..
tatraiva ca tapastepe paramārthā satī tadā.. 21.160 ..
1.3.d:
गतेषु तेषु सर्वेषु सखीभिः परिवारिता..
तत्रैव च तपस्तेपे परमार्था सती तदा.. 21.160 ..
1.3.m: When all of them had gone, surrounded by her female companions, / the chaste woman of the highest aim then performed austerity right there.

1.3.s:
tapasā tena mahatā taptamāsīccarācaram..
tadā surāsurāḥ sarve brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ.. 21-161 ..
1.3.d:
तपसा तेन महता तप्तमासीच्चराचरम्..
तदा सुरासुराः सर्वे ब्रह्माणं शरणं गताः.. 21-161 ..
1.3.m: By that great austerity the moving and unmoving [creation] was scorched. / Then all the gods and asuras went to Brahmā for refuge.

1.3.s:
..devā ūcuḥ..
tvayā sṛṣṭamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagaddeva carācaram..
trātumarhasi devānnastvadanyo nopapadyate.. 21.162 ..
1.3.d:
..देवा ऊचुः..
त्वया सृष्टमिदं सर्वं जगद्देव चराचरम्..
त्रातुमर्हसि देवान्नस्त्वदन्यो नोपपद्यते.. 21.162 ..
1.3.m: The gods said: / "By you all this moving and unmoving world has been created, O god! / You ought to protect us gods; none other than you is able

1.3.s:
asmākaṃ rakṣaṇe śakta ityākarṇya vacastadā..
vimṛśya ca tadā brahmā manasā parameṇa hi.. 21.163 ..
1.3.d:
अस्माकं रक्षणे शक्त इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तदा..
विमृश्य च तदा ब्रह्मा मनसा परमेण हि.. 21.163 ..
1.3.m: for our protection." Hearing that speech then, / and reflecting then in his mind with supreme [insight], Brahmā,

1.3.s:
girijātapasodbhūtaṃ dāvāgniṃ paramaṃ mahat..
jñātvā brahmā jagā māśu kṣīrābdhiṃ paramādbhutam.. 21.164 ..
1.3.d:
गिरिजातपसोद्भूतं दावाग्निं परमं महत्..
ज्ञात्वा ब्रह्मा जगा माशु क्षीराब्धिं परमाद्भुतम्.. 21.164 ..
1.3.m: realising that the exceedingly great forest-fire arose from Girijā's austerity, / went quickly to the most wonderful Ocean of Milk.

1.3.s:
tatra suptaṃ suplayaṃke śeṣākhye cātiśobhane..
lakṣmyā pādopayugalaṃ sevyamānaṃ niraṃtaram.. 21.165 ..
1.3.d:
तत्र सुप्तं सुप्लयंके शेषाख्ये चातिशोभने..
लक्ष्म्या पादोपयुगलं सेव्यमानं निरंतरम्.. 21.165 ..
1.3.m: There [he saw] sleeping on a beautiful couch named Śeṣa, exceedingly radiant, / his pair of feet constantly served by Lakṣmī,

1.3.s:
dūrasthenāpi tārkṣyeṇa natakaṃdharadhāriṇā..
sevyamānaṃ śriyā kāṃtyā kṣāṃtyā vṛttyā dayādibhiḥ.. 21.166 ..
1.3.d:
दूरस्थेनापि तार्क्ष्येण नतकंधरधारिणा..
सेव्यमानं श्रिया कांत्या क्षांत्या वृत्त्या दयादिभिः.. 21.166 ..
1.3.m: served by Tārkṣya standing at a distance with bent neck, / and by Śrī, Splendour, Patience, Livelihood, Compassion, and others,

1.3.s:
navaśaktiyutaṃ viṣṇuṃ pārpadaiḥ parivāritam..
kumudotha kumudvāṃśca sanakaśca sanaṃdanaḥ.. 21.167 ..
1.3.d:
नवशक्तियुतं विष्णुं पार्पदैः परिवारितम्..
कुमुदोथ कुमुद्वांश्च सनकश्च सनंदनः.. 21.167 ..
1.3.m: Viṣṇu endowed with the nine powers, surrounded by attendants: / Kumuda, and Kumudvat, Sanaka, Sanaṃdana,

1.3.s:
sanātano mahābhāgaḥ prasupto vijayo'rijit..
jayaṃtaśca jayatseno jayaścaiva mahāprabhaḥ.. 21.168 ..
1.3.d:
सनातनो महाभागः प्रसुप्तो विजयोऽरिजित्..
जयंतश्च जयत्सेनो जयश्चैव महाप्रभः.. 21.168 ..
1.3.m: the fortunate Sanātana, sleeping, Vijaya, Arijit, / Jayaṃta, Jayatsena, and Jaya of great radiance,

1.3.s:
sanatkumāraḥ sutapā nāradaścaiva tuṃburuḥ..
pāṃcajanyo mahāśaṃkho gadā kaumodakī tathā.. 21.169 ..
1.3.d:
सनत्कुमारः सुतपा नारदश्चैव तुंबुरुः..
पांचजन्यो महाशंखो गदा कौमोदकी तथा.. 21.169 ..
1.3.m: Sanatkumāra, Sutapas, Nārada, and Tuṃburu; / the great conch Pāñcajanya, and the club Kaumodakī,

1.3.s:
sudarśanaṃ tathā cāpaṃ śārṅgaṃ ca paramādbhutam..
etāni vai rūpavaṃti dṛṣṭāni parameṣṭhinā.. 21.170 ..
1.3.d:
सुदर्शनं तथा चापं शार्ङ्गं च परमाद्भुतम्..
एतानि वै रूपवंति दृष्टानि परमेष्ठिना.. 21.170 ..
1.3.m: Sudarśana, and the bow Śārṅga, most wonderful. / These indeed with embodied forms were seen by the Supreme Lord.

1.3.s:
viṣṇoḥ samīpe paramāmano bhṛśaṃ sametya sarve suradānavāstadā..
viṣṇuṃ cāhuḥ parameṣṭhināṃ patiṃ tīre tadānīmudadhermahātmanaḥ.. 21.171 ..
1.3.d:
विष्णोः समीपे परमामनो भृशं समेत्य सर्वे सुरदानवास्तदा..
विष्णुं चाहुः परमेष्ठिनां पतिं तीरे तदानीमुदधेर्महात्मनः.. 21.171 ..
1.3.m: Approaching very close to the supreme-souled Viṣṇu, all the gods and dānavas then, / on the shore of the ocean, addressed Viṣṇu, the lord of the supreme lords, the great-souled one:

1.3.s:
trāhitrāhi mahāviṣṇo taptānnaḥ śaraṇāgatān..
tapasogreṇa mahatā pārvatyāḥ parameṇa hi..
śeṣāsane copaviṣṭa uvāca parameśvaraḥ.. 21.172 ..
1.3.d:
त्राहित्राहि महाविष्णो तप्तान्नः शरणागतान्..
तपसोग्रेण महता पार्वत्याः परमेण हि..
शेषासने चोपविष्ट उवाच परमेश्वरः.. 21.172 ..
1.3.m: "Protect us, protect us, O Mahāviṣṇu! We are scorched and have come for refuge, / because of the great, fierce, supreme austerity of Pārvatī!" / Seated on the serpent-couch, the Supreme Lord spoke:

1.3.s:
yuṣmābhiḥ sahitaścāpi vrajāmi parameśvaram..
mahādevaṃ prārthayāmo girijāṃ prati vai surāḥ.. 21.173 ..
1.3.d:
युष्माभिः सहितश्चापि व्रजामि परमेश्वरम्..
महादेवं प्रार्थयामो गिरिजां प्रति वै सुराः.. 21.173 ..
1.3.m: "Together with you, I shall go to the Supreme Lord; / we shall beseech Mahādeva concerning Girijā, O gods!

1.3.s:
pāṇigrahārthamadhunā devadevaḥ pinākadhṛk..
yathā neṣyati tatraiva kariṣyāmo'dhunā vayam.. 21.174 ..
1.3.d:
पाणिग्रहार्थमधुना देवदेवः पिनाकधृक्..
यथा नेष्यति तत्रैव करिष्यामोऽधुना वयम्.. 21.174 ..
1.3.m: So that the god of gods, the bowman Pinākin, will now take her hand, / we shall now act to that very end.

1.3.s:
tasmādvayaṃ gamiṣyāmo yatra rudro mahāprabhuḥ..
tapasogreṇa saṃyukto hyāste paramamaṃgalaḥ.. 21.175 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्वयं गमिष्यामो यत्र रुद्रो महाप्रभुः..
तपसोग्रेण संयुक्तो ह्यास्ते परममंगलः.. 21.175 ..
1.3.m: Therefore we shall go where Rudra, the great lord, / stays engaged in fierce austerity, the supremely auspicious one."

1.3.s:
viṣṇostadvacanaṃ śrutvā ūcuḥ sarve surāsurāḥ..
na yāsyāmo vayaṃ sarve virūpākṣaṃ mahāprabham.. 21.176 ..
1.3.d:
विष्णोस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ऊचुः सर्वे सुरासुराः..
न यास्यामो वयं सर्वे विरूपाक्षं महाप्रभम्.. 21.176 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that speech of Viṣṇu, all the gods and asuras said: / "We all will not go to the three-eyed great lord.

1.3.s:
yadā dagdhaḥ purā tena madano duratikramaḥ..
tathaiva dhakṣyatyasmākaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 21.177 ..
1.3.d:
यदा दग्धः पुरा तेन मदनो दुरतिक्रमः..
तथैव धक्ष्यत्यस्माकं नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 21.177 ..
1.3.m: Just as before Madana, hard to overcome, was burned by him, / so he will burn us; there is to be no doubt about this."

1.3.s:
prahasya bhagavānviṣṇuruvāca parameśvaraḥ..
mā bhayaṃ kriyatāṃ sarvaiḥ śivarūpī sadāśivaḥ.. 21.178 ..
1.3.d:
प्रहस्य भगवान्विष्णुरुवाच परमेश्वरः..
मा भयं क्रियतां सर्वैः शिवरूपी सदाशिवः.. 21.178 ..
1.3.m: Laughing, the blessed Lord Viṣṇu, the Supreme Lord, said: / "Let no fear be harboured by any; Sadāśiva has an auspicious form.

1.3.s:
sa na dhakṣyati sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ bhayanāśanaḥ..
tasmādbhavadbhirgatavyaṃ mayā sārddhaṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ.. 21.179 ..
1.3.d:
स न धक्ष्यति सर्वेषां देवानां भयनाशनः..
तस्माद्भवद्भिर्गतव्यं मया सार्द्धं विचक्षणाः.. 21.179 ..
1.3.m: He will not burn [anyone]; he destroys the fear of all the gods. / Therefore you must go along with me, O discerning ones!

1.3.s:
śaṃbhuṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ hyadhīśaṃ vareṇyarūpaṃ ca paraṃ parāṇām..
tapo juṣāṇaṃ paramārtharūpaṃ parātparaṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi.. 21.180 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṇḍe pārvatīpaścaryāvarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 21 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
शंभुं पुराणं पुरुषं ह्यधीशं वरेण्यरूपं च परं पराणाम्..
तपो जुषाणं परमार्थरूपं परात्परं तं शरणं व्रजामि.. 21.180 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखण्डे पार्वतीपश्चर्यावर्णनंनामैकविंशतितमोऽध्यायः.. 21 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
I go for refuge to Śambhu, the ancient person, the sovereign, of choice form, higher than the high, / enjoying austerity, whose form is the ultimate reality, higher than the highest."
Thus ends the twenty-first chapter, named 'Description of Pārvatī's Austerity', in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first [section], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.3.s:
..sūta uvāca..
evamuktāstadā devā viṣṇunā parameṣṭhinā..
jagmuḥ sarve maheśaṃ ca draṣṭukāmāḥ pinākinam.. 22.1 ..
1.3.d:
..सूत उवाच..
एवमुक्तास्तदा देवा विष्णुना परमेष्ठिना..
जग्मुः सर्वे महेशं च द्रष्टुकामाः पिनाकिनम्.. 22.1 ..
1.3.m: Sūta said: / Thus addressed then by Viṣṇu, the Supreme Lord, the gods / all went, desiring to see the great lord Pinākin.

1.3.s:
pare pāre parameṇa samādhinā..
yogapīṭhe sdhitaṃ śaṃbhuṃ gaṇaiśca parivāritam.. 22.2 ..
1.3.d:
परे पारे परमेण समाधिना..
योगपीठे स्धितं शंभुं गणैश्च परिवारितम्.. 22.2 ..
1.3.m: On the farther shore, established in supreme absorption / upon the yoga-seat, Śambhu, surrounded by his gaṇas,

1.3.s:
yajñopavītavidhinā urasā bibhrataṃ vṛtam..
vāsukiṃ sarparājaṃ ca kaṃbalāśvatarau tathā.. 22.3 ..
1.3.d:
यज्ञोपवीतविधिना उरसा बिभ्रतं वृतम्..
वासुकिं सर्पराजं च कंबलाश्वतरौ तथा.. 22.3 ..
1.3.m: bearing across his chest, in the manner of a sacred thread, / Vāsuki, king of serpents, and Kambala and Aśvatara,

1.3.s:
karṇadvaye dhārayaṃtaṃ tathā karkoṭakena hi..
pulahena ca bāhubhyāṃ dhārayaṃtaṃ ca kaṃkaṇe.. 22.4 ..
1.3.d:
कर्णद्वये धारयंतं तथा कर्कोटकेन हि..
पुलहेन च बाहुभ्यां धारयंतं च कंकणे.. 22.4 ..
1.3.m: wearing them on both ears, as well as Karkoṭaka, / and Pulaha on both arms, wearing them as bracelets,

1.3.s:
sannūpure śaṅkhakapadmakābhyāṃ saṃdhārayaṃtaṃ ca virājamānam..
karpūragauraṃ śitikaṃṭhamadbhutaṃ vṛṣānvitaṃ devavaraṃ dadarśuḥ.. 22.5 ..
1.3.d:
सन्नूपुरे शङ्खकपद्मकाभ्यां संधारयंतं च विराजमानम्..
कर्पूरगौरं शितिकंठमद्भुतं वृषान्वितं देववरं ददर्शुः.. 22.5 ..
1.3.m: wearing anklets made of Śaṅkhaka and Padmaka, shining brightly, / white as camphor, dark-throated, wonderful, accompanied by his bull, the foremost of gods they saw.

1.3.s:
tadā brahmā ca viṣṇuśca ṛṣayo devadānavāḥ..
tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ sūktairvedopaniṣadanvitaiḥ.. 22.6 ..
1.3.d:
तदा ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च ऋषयो देवदानवाः..
तुष्टुवुर्विविधैः सूक्तैर्वेदोपनिषदन्वितैः.. 22.6 ..
1.3.m: Then Brahmā, Viṣṇu, the seers, the gods and dānavas / praised [him] with various hymns accompanied by the Vedas and Upaniṣads.

1.3.s:
..brahmovāca..
namo rudrāya devāya madanāṃtakarāya ca..
bhargāya bhūribhāgyāya trinetrāya triviṣṭape.. 22.7 ..
1.3.d:
..ब्रह्मोवाच..
नमो रुद्राय देवाय मदनांतकराय च..
भर्गाय भूरिभाग्याय त्रिनेत्राय त्रिविष्टपे.. 22.7 ..
1.3.m: Brahmā said: / "Salutation to Rudra, to the god, to the one who brought an end to Madana, / to Bharga of immense fortune, the three-eyed one in heaven!

1.3.s:
śipiviṣṭāya bhīmāya śeṣaśāyinnamonamaḥ..
tryaṃbakāya jagaddhātre viśvarūpāya vai namaḥ.. 22.8 ..
1.3.d:
शिपिविष्टाय भीमाय शेषशायिन्नमोनमः..
त्र्यंबकाय जगद्धात्रे विश्वरूपाय वै नमः.. 22.8 ..
1.3.m: Salutation to Śipiviṣṭa, the terrible, to the one who rests on Śeṣa! / Salutation to Tryambaka, the maintainer of the world, whose form is the universe!

1.3.s:
tvaṃ dhātā sarvalokānāṃ pitā mātā tvamīśvaraḥ..
kṛpayā parayā yuktaḥ pāhyasmāṃstvaṃ maheśvara.. 22.9 ..
1.3.d:
त्वं धाता सर्वलोकानां पिता माता त्वमीश्वरः..
कृपया परया युक्तः पाह्यस्मांस्त्वं महेश्वर.. 22.9 ..
1.3.m: You are the creator of all worlds, the father, the mother, you are the Lord; / endowed with supreme mercy, protect us, O Maheśvara!"

1.3.s:
itthaṃ stuvatsu deveṣu nandī provāca tānprati..
kimarthamāgatā yūyaṃ kiṃ vā manasi vartate.. 22.10 ..
1.3.d:
इत्थं स्तुवत्सु देवेषु नन्दी प्रोवाच तान्प्रति..
किमर्थमागता यूयं किं वा मनसि वर्तते.. 22.10 ..
1.3.m: While the gods were praising him thus, Nandī said to them: / "For what purpose have you come? What is on your minds?"

1.3.s:
te procurdevakāryārthaṃ vijñaptuṃ śaṃbhumāgatā..
vijñapto naṃdinā tena śailādena mahātmanā..
dhyānasthito mahādevaḥ surakāryārthasiddhaye.. 22.11 ..
1.3.d:
ते प्रोचुर्देवकार्यार्थं विज्ञप्तुं शंभुमागता..
विज्ञप्तो नंदिना तेन शैलादेन महात्मना..
ध्यानस्थितो महादेवः सुरकार्यार्थसिद्धये.. 22.11 ..
1.3.m: They said: "We have come to make a petition to Śambhu for the purpose of the gods' affairs." / Addressed by that noble Nandī, son of Śilāda, / Mahādeva, remaining in meditation, [was petitioned] for the accomplishment of the purpose of the gods' affairs: 22.11

1.3.s:
brahmādayaḥ suragaṇāḥ surasiddhasaṃghāstvāṃ draṣṭumeva suravarya viśeṣayaṃti..
kāryyārthino'suravaraiḥ paribhartsyamānā abhyāgatāḥ sapadi śatrubhirarditāśca.. 22.12 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मादयः सुरगणाः सुरसिद्धसंघास्त्वां द्रष्टुमेव सुरवर्य विशेषयंति..
कार्य्यार्थिनोऽसुरवरैः परिभर्त्स्यमाना अभ्यागताः सपदि शत्रुभिरर्दिताश्च.. 22.12 ..
1.3.m: "Brahmā and the hosts of gods, the assemblies of gods and Siddhas, are especially eager to see you, best of the gods. / Seeking [your help in] their purpose, reviled by the foremost Asuras, / harassed by their enemies, they have quickly arrived. 22.12

1.3.s:
tasmāttvayā hi deveśa trātavyāścādhunā surāḥ..
evaṃ tena tadā śaṃbhurvijñapto naṃdinā dvijāḥ.. 22.13 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्त्वया हि देवेश त्रातव्याश्चाधुना सुराः..
एवं तेन तदा शंभुर्विज्ञप्तो नंदिना द्विजाः.. 22.13 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, O Lord of Gods, the gods must indeed be protected by you now." / Thus Śambhu was petitioned then by Nandī, O twice-born ones. 22.13

1.3.s:
śanaiḥśanairuparamacchaṃbhuḥ paramakopanaḥ..
samādheḥ paramātmā'sāvuvāca parameśvaraḥ.. 22.14 ..
1.3.d:
शनैःशनैरुपरमच्छंभुः परमकोपनः..
समाधेः परमात्माऽसावुवाच परमेश्वरः.. 22.14 ..
1.3.m: Slowly, slowly Śambhu, who is exceedingly wrathful, ceased / from his deep absorption; he, the supreme self, the Supreme Lord, spoke: 22.14

1.3.s:
..mahādeva uvāca..
kasmādyūyaṃ mahābhāgā hyāgatā matsamīpagāḥ..
brahmādayo hyamī devā brūta kāraṇamadya vai.. 22.15 ..
1.3.d:
..महादेव उवाच..
कस्माद्यूयं महाभागा ह्यागता मत्समीपगाः..
ब्रह्मादयो ह्यमी देवा ब्रूत कारणमद्य वै.. 22.15 ..
1.3.m: Mahādeva said: / "Why have you, fortunate ones, come to my presence? / Brahmā and these gods, tell me the reason today!" 22.15

1.3.s:
tadā brahmā hyuvācedaṃ surakāryaṃ mahattaram..
tārakeṇa kṛtaṃ śaṃbho devānāṃ paramādbhutam.. 22.16 ..
1.3.d:
तदा ब्रह्मा ह्युवाचेदं सुरकार्यं महत्तरम्..
तारकेण कृतं शंभो देवानां परमाद्भुतम्.. 22.16 ..
1.3.m: Then Brahmā said this: "A very great task concerning the gods [has arisen]. / A most terrible [calamity] has been inflicted on the gods by Tāraka, O Śambhu. 22.16

1.3.s:
kaṣṭātkaṣṭataraṃ deva tadvijñaptumihāgatāḥ..
he śaṃbho tava putreṇa aurasena hato bhavet..
tārako devaśatruśca nānyathā mama bhāṣitam.. 22.17 ..
1.3.d:
कष्टात्कष्टतरं देव तद्विज्ञप्तुमिहागताः..
हे शंभो तव पुत्रेण औरसेन हतो भवेत्..
तारको देवशत्रुश्च नान्यथा मम भाषितम्.. 22.17 ..
1.3.m: It is harder than the hardest, O Lord; we have come here to petition [you] about that. / O Śambhu, Tāraka, the enemy of the gods, can only be slain by your begotten son; / my word is never otherwise. 22.17

1.3.s:
tasmāttvayā girijā deva śaṃbho gṛhītavyā pāṇinā dakṣiṇena..
pāṇigraheṇaiva mahānubhāva dattā girīndreṇa ca tāṃ kuruṣva.. 22.18 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्त्वया गिरिजा देव शंभो गृहीतव्या पाणिना दक्षिणेन..
पाणिग्रहेणैव महानुभाव दत्ता गिरीन्द्रेण च तां कुरुष्व.. 22.18 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, O Lord Śambhu, Girijā must be taken by you with your right hand; / by taking her hand in marriage, O noble one, accept her who has been offered by the king of mountains." 22.18

1.3.s:
brahmaṇo hi vacaḥ śrutvā prahasannabravīcchivaḥ..
yadā mayā kṛtā devī girijā sarvasundarī.. 22.19 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मणो हि वचः श्रुत्वा प्रहसन्नब्रवीच्छिवः..
यदा मया कृता देवी गिरिजा सर्वसुन्दरी.. 22.19 ..
1.3.m: Hearing the word of Brahmā, Śiva laughed and said: / "If I accept the goddess Girijā, who is beautiful in every way, 22.19

1.3.s:
tadā sarve surendrāśca ṛṣayo munayastathā..
sakāmāśca bhaviṣyaṃti akṣamāśca pare pathi.. 22.20 ..
1.3.d:
तदा सर्वे सुरेन्द्राश्च ऋषयो मुनयस्तथा..
सकामाश्च भविष्यंति अक्षमाश्च परे पथि.. 22.20 ..
1.3.m: then all the lords of gods, and likewise the seers and sages, / will become filled with desire and incapable on the higher path. 22.20

1.3.s:
madano hi mayā dagdhaḥ sarveṣāṃ kāryasiddhaye..
mayā hyadhi kṛtā tanvī girijā ca sumadhyamā.. 22.21 ..
1.3.d:
मदनो हि मया दग्धः सर्वेषां कार्यसिद्धये..
मया ह्यधि कृता तन्वी गिरिजा च सुमध्यमा.. 22.21 ..
1.3.m: Indeed, Madana was burnt by me for the accomplishment of everyone's purpose. / If I take that slender-waisted daughter of the mountain to myself, 22.21

1.3.s:
tadānīmeva bho devāḥ pārvatī madanaṃ ca sā..
jīvayiṣyati bho brahmannātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 22.22 ..
1.3.d:
तदानीमेव भो देवाः पार्वती मदनं च सा..
जीवयिष्यति भो ब्रह्मन्नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 22.22 ..
1.3.m: then immediately, O gods, she, Pārvatī, will bring / Madana back to life, O Brahmā; there is no deliberation needed on this! 22.22

1.3.s:
evaṃ vimṛśya bho devāḥ kāryā kāryavicāraṇā..
madanenaiva dagdhena surakāryaṃ mahatkṛtam.. 22.23 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विमृश्य भो देवाः कार्या कार्यविचारणा..
मदनेनैव दग्धेन सुरकार्यं महत्कृतम्.. 22.23 ..
1.3.m: Having reflected thus, O gods, one must discern between duty and non-duty. / Through Madana alone being burnt, a great task has been achieved for the gods. 22.23

1.3.s:
yūyaṃ sarve ca niṣkāmā mayā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ..
yathāhaṃ ca surāḥ sarve tathā yūyaṃ prayatnataḥ.. 22.24 ..
1.3.d:
यूयं सर्वे च निष्कामा मया नास्त्यत्र संशयः..
यथाहं च सुराः सर्वे तथा यूयं प्रयत्नतः.. 22.24 ..
1.3.m: All of you must become free from desire through me; there is no doubt in this. / Just as I am, O all you gods, so must you be with effort. 22.24

1.3.s:
tapaḥ paramasaṃyuktāḥ pārayāmaḥ suduṣkaram..
paramānandasaṃyuktāḥ sukhinaḥ sarva eva hi.. 22.25 ..
1.3.d:
तपः परमसंयुक्ताः पारयामः सुदुष्करम्..
परमानन्दसंयुक्ताः सुखिनः सर्व एव हि.. 22.25 ..
1.3.m: Endowed with supreme austerity, let us accomplish what is very difficult to do; / endowed with supreme bliss, all indeed will be happy. 22.25

1.3.s:
yūyaṃ samādhinā tena madanena ca vismṛtam..
kāmo hi narakāyaiva tasmātkrodho'bhijāyate.. 22.26 ..
1.3.d:
यूयं समाधिना तेन मदनेन च विस्मृतम्..
कामो हि नरकायैव तस्मात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते.. 22.26 ..
1.3.m: Let that Madana be forgotten by you through meditation. / For desire leads only to hell; from it anger is born. 22.26

1.3.s:
krodhādbhavati saṃmohaḥ saṃmohādbhramate manaḥ..
kāmakrodhau parityajya bhavadbhiḥ surasattamaiḥ..
sarvaireva ca maṃtavyaṃ madvākyaṃ nānyathā kvacit.. 22.27 ..
1.3.d:
क्रोधाद्भवति संमोहः संमोहाद्भ्रमते मनः..
कामक्रोधौ परित्यज्य भवद्भिः सुरसत्तमैः..
सर्वैरेव च मंतव्यं मद्वाक्यं नान्यथा क्वचित्.. 22.27 ..
1.3.m: From anger comes delusion; from delusion the mind wanders. / Giving up desire and anger, you best among the gods / must all heed my word, which is never otherwise." 22.27

1.3.s:
evaṃ viśrāvya bhagavānsa hi devo vṛṣadhvajaḥ..
surānprabodhayāmāsa tathā ṛṣigaṇānmunīn.. 22.28 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विश्राव्य भगवान्स हि देवो वृषध्वजः..
सुरान्प्रबोधयामास तथा ऋषिगणान्मुनीन्.. 22.28 ..
1.3.m: Having thus proclaimed [this], the Lord, the bull-bannered god, / instructed the gods and likewise the hosts of seers and sages. 22.28

1.3.s:
tūṣṇīṃbhūto'bhavacchaṃbhurdhyānamāśritya vai punaḥ..
āste purā yathāvacca gaṇaiśca parivāritaḥ.. 22.29 ..
1.3.d:
तूष्णींभूतोऽभवच्छंभुर्ध्यानमाश्रित्य वै पुनः..
आस्ते पुरा यथावच्च गणैश्च परिवारितः.. 22.29 ..
1.3.m: Śambhu fell silent, having resorted again to meditation; / he remained as before, surrounded by his attendants. 22.29

1.3.s:
dhyānāsthitaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā nandau sarvānvisṛjya tān..
sabrahmasendrānvibudhānuvāca prahasanniva.. 22.30 ..
1.3.d:
ध्यानास्थितं च तं दृष्ट्वा नन्दौ सर्वान्विसृज्य तान्..
सब्रह्मसेन्द्रान्विबुधानुवाच प्रहसन्निव.. 22.30 ..
1.3.m: Seeing him established in meditation, Nandī dismissed all of them, / the gods together with Brahmā and Indra, and spoke as if laughing: 22.30

1.3.s:
yatāgatena mārgeṇa gacchadhvaṃ mā vilaṃbitam..
tatheti matvā te sarve svaṃsvaṃ sthānamathā'vrajan.. 22.31 ..
1.3.d:
यतागतेन मार्गेण गच्छध्वं मा विलंबितम्..
तथेति मत्वा ते सर्वे स्वंस्वं स्थानमथाऽव्रजन्.. 22.31 ..
1.3.m: "Go by the path along which you came; do not delay." / Thinking, "So be it," they all went to their respective abodes. 22.31

1.3.s:
gateṣu teṣu sarveṣu samādhistho'bhavadbhavaḥ..
ātmānamātmanā kṛtvā ātmanyena vicaṃtayan.. 22.32 ..
1.3.d:
गतेषु तेषु सर्वेषु समाधिस्थोऽभवद्भवः..
आत्मानमात्मना कृत्वा आत्मन्येन विचंतयन्.. 22.32 ..
1.3.m: When they had all departed, Bhava remained absorbed in meditation, / holding himself within the self, meditating on the supreme self: 22.32

1.3.s:
parātparataraṃ svacchaṃ nirmalaṃ niravagraham..
nirañjanaṃ nirābhāsaṃ yasminmuhyaṃti sūrayaḥ.. 22.33 ..
1.3.d:
परात्परतरं स्वच्छं निर्मलं निरवग्रहम्..
निरञ्जनं निराभासं यस्मिन्मुह्यंति सूरयः.. 22.33 ..
1.3.m: higher than the highest, pure, spotless, unobstructed, / taintless, without appearance, in which the wise are bewildered; 22.33

1.3.s:
bhānurnabhātyagniratho śaśī vā na jyotirevaṃ na ca māruto na hi..
