yaṃ kevalaṃ vastuvicārato'pi sūkṣmātparaṃ sūkṣmatarātparaṃ ca.. 22.34 ..
1.3.d:
भानुर्नभात्यग्निरथो शशी वा न ज्योतिरेवं न च मारुतो न हि..
यं केवलं वस्तुविचारतोऽपि सूक्ष्मात्परं सूक्ष्मतरात्परं च.. 22.34 ..
1.3.m: neither the sun shines, nor fire, nor moon, nor indeed light, nor the wind; / which is grasped only through inquiry into reality, subtler than the subtle and beyond the highest, 22.34

1.3.s:
anirddeśya macintyaṃ ca nirvikāraṃ nirāmayam..
jñaptimātrasvarūpaṃ ca nyāsino yāṃti tatra vai.. 22.35 ..
1.3.d:
अनिर्द्देश्य मचिन्त्यं च निर्विकारं निरामयम्..
ज्ञप्तिमात्रस्वरूपं च न्यासिनो यांति तत्र वै.. 22.35 ..
1.3.m: indescribable, unthinkable, immutable, free from affliction, / having the nature of pure consciousness; there renouncers indeed go; 22.35

1.3.s:
śabdātīnaṃ nirguṇaṃ nirvikāraṃ sattāmātraṃ jñānagamyaṃ tvagamyam..
yattadvastu sarvadā kathyate vai vedātītaiścāgamairmantrabhūtaiḥ.. 22.36 ..
1.3.d:
शब्दातीनं निर्गुणं निर्विकारं सत्तामात्रं ज्ञानगम्यं त्वगम्यम्..
यत्तद्वस्तु सर्वदा कथ्यते वै वेदातीतैश्चागमैर्मन्त्रभूतैः.. 22.36 ..
1.3.m: beyond sound, qualityless, changeless, pure existence, knowable by knowledge yet unknowable, / which is that eternal reality proclaimed by the scriptures consisting of mantras, which transcend the Vedas. 22.36

1.3.s:
tadvastubhūto bhagavānsa īśvaraḥ pinākapāṇirbhagavānvṛdhvajaḥ..
yenaiva sākṣānmakaradhvajo hatastapo juṣāṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ saḥ.. 22.37 ..
1.3.d:
तद्वस्तुभूतो भगवान्स ईश्वरः पिनाकपाणिर्भगवान्वृध्वजः..
येनैव साक्षान्मकरध्वजो हतस्तपो जुषाणः परमेश्वरः सः.. 22.37 ..
1.3.m: The Lord Īśvara is that very reality, holding the Pināka in his hand, the bull-bannered Lord / by whom the god of love was destroyed visibly, that Supreme Lord engaged in austerity. 22.37

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
girijā hi tadā devī tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ..
tapasā tena rudro'pi uttamaṃ bhayamāgataḥ.. 22.38 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
गिरिजा हि तदा देवी तताप परमं तपः..
तपसा तेन रुद्रोऽपि उत्तमं भयमागतः.. 22.38 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / The goddess Girijā then performed supreme austerity. / Through that austerity even Rudra experienced great apprehension. 22.38

1.3.s:
vijitya tapasā devī pārvatī parameṇa hi..
śambhuṃ sarvārthadaṃ sthāṇuṃ kevalaṃ svasvarūpiṇam.. 22.39 ..
1.3.d:
विजित्य तपसा देवी पार्वती परमेण हि..
शम्भुं सर्वार्थदं स्थाणुं केवलं स्वस्वरूपिणम्.. 22.39 ..
1.3.m: When the goddess Pārvatī had won over through supreme austerity / Śambhu, the granter of all desires, the unmoving, the sole self-formed one, 22.39

1.3.s:
yadā jitastayā devyā tapasā vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ..
samādheścalito bhūtvā yatra sā pārvatī sthitā.. 22.40 ..
1.3.d:
यदा जितस्तया देव्या तपसा वृषभध्वजः..
समाधेश्चलितो भूत्वा यत्र सा पार्वती स्थिता.. 22.40 ..
1.3.m: when the bull-bannered one had been won over by that goddess through austerity, / he stirred from his meditation and went to where Pārvatī was. 22.40

1.3.s:
jagāma tvaritenaiva devadevaḥ pinākadhṛk..
tatrāpaśyatsthitāṃ devīṃ sakhībhiḥ parivāritām.. 22.41 ..
1.3.d:
जगाम त्वरितेनैव देवदेवः पिनाकधृक्..
तत्रापश्यत्स्थितां देवीं सखीभिः परिवारिताम्.. 22.41 ..
1.3.m: The god of gods, bearer of the Pināka, went swiftly; / there he saw the goddess seated, surrounded by female companions, 22.41

1.3.s:
vedikopari vinyastāṃ yathaiva śaśinaḥ kalām..
sa devastāṃ nirīkṣyātha baṭurbhūtvātha tatkṣaṇāt.. 22.42 ..
1.3.d:
वेदिकोपरि विन्यस्तां यथैव शशिनः कलाम्..
स देवस्तां निरीक्ष्याथ बटुर्भूत्वाथ तत्क्षणात्.. 22.42 ..
1.3.m: resting upon an altar like a crescent of the moon. / Looking upon her, that god immediately became a young celibate youth. 22.42

1.3.s:
brahmacārisvarūpeṇa maheśo bhagavānbhavaḥ..
sakhīnāṃ madhyamāśritya hyuvāca baṭurūpavān..
kimarthamālimadhyasthā tanvī sarvāṃgasundarī.. 22.43 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मचारिस्वरूपेण महेशो भगवान्भवः..
सखीनां मध्यमाश्रित्य ह्युवाच बटुरूपवान्..
किमर्थमालिमध्यस्था तन्वी सर्वांगसुन्दरी.. 22.43 ..
1.3.m: Assuming the form of a brahmacārin, the Lord Bhava, the Great Lord, / stepping into the midst of her companions, spoke in the form of a celibate youth: / "Why is this slender girl, beautiful in all her limbs, seated amid her friends? 22.43

1.3.s:
keyaṃ kasya kuto yātā kimarthaṃ tapyate tapaḥ..
sarvaṃ me kathyatāṃ sakhyo yāthātathyena saṃprati.. 22.44 ..
1.3.d:
केयं कस्य कुतो याता किमर्थं तप्यते तपः..
सर्वं मे कथ्यतां सख्यो याथातथ्येन संप्रति.. 22.44 ..
1.3.m: Who is she, whose daughter, whence has she come, and for what purpose does she perform austerity? / O friends, tell me everything accurately right now!" 22.44

1.3.s: tadovāca jayā rudraṃ tapasaḥ kāraṇaṃ param.. 22.45 ..
1.3.d: तदोवाच जया रुद्रं तपसः कारणं परम्.. 22.45 ..
1.3.m: Then Jayā spoke to Rudra the supreme cause of her austerity: 22.45

1.3.s:
himādrerduhiteyaṃ vai tapasā rudramīśvaram..
prāptukāmā patitvana seyamatropaviśya ca.. 22.46 ..
1.3.d:
हिमाद्रेर्दुहितेयं वै तपसा रुद्रमीश्वरम्..
प्राप्तुकामा पतित्वन सेयमत्रोपविश्य च.. 22.46 ..
1.3.m: "She is the daughter of Himavat, wishing to attain Rudra, the Lord, / as her husband through austerity; and she, sitting here, 22.46

1.3.s:
tapastatāpa sumahatsarveṣāṃ duratikramam..
baṭo jānīhi me vākyaṃ nānyathā mama bhāṣitam.. 22.47 ..
1.3.d:
तपस्तताप सुमहत्सर्वेषां दुरतिक्रमम्..
बटो जानीहि मे वाक्यं नान्यथा मम भाषितम्.. 22.47 ..
1.3.m: has performed very great austerity, insurmountable for all. / Know my word, O young celibate; what I speak is not otherwise." 22.47

1.3.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyāḥ prahasyedamuvāca ha..
śrṛṇvatīnāṃ sakhīnāṃ vai maheśo baṭurūpavān.. 22.48 ..
1.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्याः प्रहस्येदमुवाच ह..
श्रृण्वतीनां सखीनां वै महेशो बटुरूपवान्.. 22.48 ..
1.3.m: Hearing her words, the Great Lord in the form of a celibate youth / laughed and spoke this, while her companions listened: 22.48

1.3.s:
mūḍheyaṃ pārvatī sakhyo na jānāti hitāhitam..
kimarthaṃ ca tapaḥ kāryaṃ rudraprāptyarthameva ca.. 22.49 ..
1.3.d:
मूढेयं पार्वती सख्यो न जानाति हिताहितम्..
किमर्थं च तपः कार्यं रुद्रप्राप्त्यर्थमेव च.. 22.49 ..
1.3.m: "This Pārvatī is foolish, O friends, she does not know what is beneficial or harmful. / For what purpose must austerity be performed merely to obtain Rudra? 22.49

1.3.s:
so'maṃgalaḥ kapālī ca śmaśānālaya eva ca..
aśivaḥ śivaśabdena bhaṇyate ca vṛthātha vai.. 22.50 ..
1.3.d:
सोऽमंगलः कपाली च श्मशानालय एव च..
अशिवः शिवशब्देन भण्यते च वृथाथ वै.. 22.50 ..
1.3.m: He is inauspicious, a skull-bearer, dwelling only in cremation grounds, / and though he is inauspicious, he is vainly called Śiva, 'the auspicious one'!" 22.50

1.3.s:
anayā hi vṛto rudro yadā sakhyaḥ sameṣyati..
tadeyamaśubhā tanvī bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ.. 22.51 ..
1.3.d:
अनया हि वृतो रुद्रो यदा सख्यः समेष्यति..
तदेयमशुभा तन्वी भविष्यति न संशयः.. 22.51 ..
1.3.m: For when Rudra, chosen by her, arrives, O friends, / then without doubt this slender maiden will become unfortunate.

1.3.s:
yo dakṣaśāpādvikṛto yajñabāhyo'bhavadviṭā..
ye hyaṃgabhūtāḥ śarvasya sarpā hyāsanmahāviṣāḥ.. 22.52 ..
1.3.d:
यो दक्षशापाद्विकृतो यज्ञबाह्योऽभवद्विटा..
ये ह्यंगभूताः शर्वस्य सर्पा ह्यासन्महाविषाः.. 22.52 ..
1.3.m: He who through Dakṣa's curse was deformed and excluded from the sacrifice, O clever ones; / whose very bodily ornaments are snakes of virulent poison;

1.3.s:
śavabhasmānvito rudraḥ kṛttivāsā hyamaṃgalaḥ..
piśācaiḥ pramathairbhūtairāvṛto hi niraṃtaram.. 22.53 ..
1.3.d:
शवभस्मान्वितो रुद्रः कृत्तिवासा ह्यमंगलः..
पिशाचैः प्रमथैर्भूतैरावृतो हि निरंतरम्.. 22.53 ..
1.3.m: Rudra, smeared with ashes from corpses, clad in animal skins, inauspicious, / and constantly surrounded by piśācas, pramathas, and bhūtas—

1.3.s:
tena rudreṇa kiṃ kāryamanayā sukumārayā..
nivāryatāṃ sakhībhiśca martukāmā piśācavat.. 22.54 ..
1.3.d:
तेन रुद्रेण किं कार्यमनया सुकुमारया..
निवार्यतां सखीभिश्च मर्तुकामा पिशाचवत्.. 22.54 ..
1.3.m: what can this delicate maiden have to do with such a Rudra? / Let her, wishing to die like a piśāca, be restrained by her friends!

1.3.s:
iṃdraṃ hitvā manojñaṃ ca yamaṃ caiva mahāprabham..
nairṛtaṃ ca viśālākṣaṃ varuṇaṃ ca apāṃ patim.. 22.55 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्रं हित्वा मनोज्ञं च यमं चैव महाप्रभम्..
नैरृतं च विशालाक्षं वरुणं च अपां पतिम्.. 22.55 ..
1.3.m: Forsaking charming Indra, and Yama of great majesty, / and Nairṛta of wide eyes, and Varuṇa the lord of the waters,

1.3.s:
kuberaṃ pavanaṃ caiva tathaiva ca vibhāvasum..
evamādīni vākyāni uvāca parameśvaraḥ..
sakhīnāṃ śrṛṇvatīnāṃ ca yatra sā tapasi sthitā.. 22.56 ..
1.3.d:
कुबेरं पवनं चैव तथैव च विभावसुम्..
एवमादीनि वाक्यानि उवाच परमेश्वरः..
सखीनां श्रृण्वतीनां च यत्र सा तपसि स्थिता.. 22.56 ..
1.3.m: and Kubera, and Pavana, and likewise Vibhāvasu!" / Words such as these the Supreme Lord spoke, / within the hearing of the friends, where she remained engaged in austerity.

1.3.s:
ityākarṇya vacastasya rudrasya baṭurūpiṇaḥ..
cukopa ca śivā sādhvī maheśaṃ baṭurūpiṇam.. 22.57 ..
1.3.d:
इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तस्य रुद्रस्य बटुरूपिणः..
चुकोप च शिवा साध्वी महेशं बटुरूपिणम्.. 22.57 ..
1.3.m: Hearing such speech of Rudra disguised as a student-ascetic, / the virtuous Śivā grew angry with the Great Lord in that student's form.

1.3.s:
jaye tvaṃ vijaye sādhvi pramloce'pyatha sundari..
sulocane mahābhāge samīcīnaṃ kṛtaṃ hi me.. 22.58 ..
1.3.d:
जये त्वं विजये साध्वि प्रम्लोचेऽप्यथ सुन्दरि..
सुलोचने महाभागे समीचीनं कृतं हि मे.. 22.58 ..
1.3.m: "O Jayā, O virtuous Vijayā, and Pramlocā, O beautiful one, / O highly fortunate Sulocanā, you have acted properly toward me.

1.3.s:
kimetasya baṭoḥ kāryaṃ bhavatīnāmihādhunā..
baṭusvarūpamāsthāya āgato devaniṃdakaḥ.. 22.59 ..
1.3.d:
किमेतस्य बटोः कार्यं भवतीनामिहाधुना..
बटुस्वरूपमास्थाय आगतो देवनिंदकः.. 22.59 ..
1.3.m: What business do you [ladies] have now with this student-ascetic? / Assuming the form of a student-ascetic, a slanderer of gods has arrived!

1.3.s:
ayaṃ visṛjyatāṃ sakhyaḥ kimanena prayojanam..
baṭusvarūpiṇaṃ rudraṃ kupitā sā tato'bravīt.. 22.60 ..
1.3.d:
अयं विसृज्यतां सख्यः किमनेन प्रयोजनम्..
बटुस्वरूपिणं रुद्रं कुपिता सा ततोऽब्रवीत्.. 22.60 ..
1.3.m: Let him be dismissed, O friends! What is the use of him?" / Then, enraged, she addressed Rudra, who had the form of a student-ascetic:

1.3.s:
baṭo gacchāśu tvarito na stheyaṃ ca tvayā'dhunā..
kimanena pralāpena tava nāsti prayojanam.. 22.61 ..
1.3.d:
बटो गच्छाशु त्वरितो न स्थेयं च त्वयाऽधुना..
किमनेन प्रलापेन तव नास्ति प्रयोजनम्.. 22.61 ..
1.3.m: "Go quickly, student-ascetic, make haste! You must stay no longer! / What is the use of this prattle? You have no purpose here!"

1.3.s:
baṭurnirbhartsitastatra tayā caivaṃ tadā punaḥ..
prahasya vai sthiro bhūtvā punarvākyamathābravīt.. 22.62 ..
1.3.d:
बटुर्निर्भर्त्सितस्तत्र तया चैवं तदा पुनः..
प्रहस्य वै स्थिरो भूत्वा पुनर्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्.. 22.62 ..
1.3.m: Then, rebuked there by her in this manner, the student-ascetic / smiled, stood firm, and spoke again,

1.3.s:
śanaiḥ śanairavitathaṃ vijayāṃ prati satvaram..
kasmātkopastayātanvi kṛtaḥ kenaiva hetunā.. 22.63 ..
1.3.d:
शनैः शनैरवितथं विजयां प्रति सत्वरम्..
कस्मात्कोपस्तयातन्वि कृतः केनैव हेतुना.. 22.63 ..
1.3.m: slowly, truthfully, and quickly turning toward Vijayā: / "Why has anger been shown by her, O slender one? For what reason?

1.3.s:
sarveṣāmapi tadvācyaṃ vacanaṃ sūktameva yat..
yathoktena ca vākyena kasmāttanvī prakopitā.. 22.64 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वेषामपि तद्वाच्यं वचनं सूक्तमेव यत्..
यथोक्तेन च वाक्येन कस्मात्तन्वी प्रकोपिता.. 22.64 ..
1.3.m: That which is a well-spoken word ought to be said even by all. / Why has the slender maiden become enraged by speech spoken as it truly is?

1.3.s:
yaḥ śaṃbhurucyate loke bhikṣuko bhikṣukapriyaḥ..
yadi me hyanṛtaṃ proktaṃ tadā kopa ihocitaḥ.. 22.65 ..
1.3.d:
यः शंभुरुच्यते लोके भिक्षुको भिक्षुकप्रियः..
यदि मे ह्यनृतं प्रोक्तं तदा कोप इहोचितः.. 22.65 ..
1.3.m: He who is called Śambhu in the world is a beggar, fond of beggars. / If what I have said is untrue, then anger here is justified.

1.3.s:
iyaṃ tāvatsurūpā ca virūpo'sau sadāśivaḥ..
viśālākṣī tviyaṃ bālā virūpākṣo bhavastathā.. 22.66 ..
1.3.d:
इयं तावत्सुरूपा च विरूपोऽसौ सदाशिवः..
विशालाक्षी त्वियं बाला विरूपाक्षो भवस्तथा.. 22.66 ..
1.3.m: She, on the one hand, is beautiful, whereas that Sadāśiva is misshapen; / this young girl is large-eyed, while Bhava has deformed eyes.

1.3.s:
evaṃbhūtena rudreṇa mohiteyaṃ kathaṃ bhavet..
sabhāgyo hi patiḥ strīṇāṃ sadā bhāvyo ratipriyaḥ.. 22.67 ..
1.3.d:
एवंभूतेन रुद्रेण मोहितेयं कथं भवेत्..
सभाग्यो हि पतिः स्त्रीणां सदा भाव्यो रतिप्रियः.. 22.67 ..
1.3.m: How could she be infatuated with Rudra who is of such a sort? / A fortunate husband, ever affectionate and pleasing in love, is to be cherished by women.

1.3.s:
iyaṃ kathaṃ mohitāsti nirguṇena yugātmikā..
na śruto na ca vijñāto na dṛṣṭaḥ kena vā śivaḥ.. 22.68 ..
1.3.d:
इयं कथं मोहितास्ति निर्गुणेन युगात्मिका..
न श्रुतो न च विज्ञातो न दृष्टः केन वा शिवः.. 22.68 ..
1.3.m: How is this maiden, the soul of the cosmic ages, infatuated with one devoid of qualities? / By whom has Śiva ever been heard of, or understood, or seen?

1.3.s:
sakāmānāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ durlabho hi sadāśivaḥ..
tapasā parameṇaiva garviteyaṃ sumadhyamā.. 22.69 ..
1.3.d:
सकामानां च भूतानां दुर्लभो हि सदाशिवः..
तपसा परमेणैव गर्वितेयं सुमध्यमा.. 22.69 ..
1.3.m: Sadāśiva is difficult to attain for beings possessing desires; / this slender-waisted maiden is conceited through her supreme austerity.

1.3.s:
niḥstaṃbho hi sadā sthāṇuḥ kathaṃ prāpsyati taṃ patim..
mayoktaṃ kiṃ viśālākṣi kasmānme ruṣitā'dhunā.. 22.70 ..
1.3.d:
निःस्तंभो हि सदा स्थाणुः कथं प्राप्स्यति तं पतिम्..
मयोक्तं किं विशालाक्षि कस्मान्मे रुषिताऽधुना.. 22.70 ..
1.3.m: He is indeed a pillar without support, the Motionless One (Sthāṇu); how will she attain him as her husband? / What did I say wrong, O large-eyed one? Why has she now become angry with me?

1.3.s:
yāvadroṣo bhavennṝṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ..
tena roṣeṇa tatsarvaṃ bhasmībhūtaṃ bhaviṣyati.. 22.71 ..
1.3.d:
यावद्रोषो भवेन्नॄणां नारीणां च विशेषतः..
तेन रोषेण तत्सर्वं भस्मीभूतं भविष्यति.. 22.71 ..
1.3.m: Whatever anger men may have, and women especially, / by that anger all their merits turn to ashes.

1.3.s:
sukṛtaṃ corjitaṃ tanvi satyamevoditaṃ sati..
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca daṃbho mātsaryameva ca.. 22.72 ..
1.3.d:
सुकृतं चोर्जितं तन्वि सत्यमेवोदितं सति..
कामः क्रोधश्च लोभश्च दंभो मात्सर्यमेव च.. 22.72 ..
1.3.m: Their abundant merit is destroyed, O slender one; the truth alone has been spoken, O virtuous maiden: / desire, anger, greed, deceit, and envy,

1.3.s:
hiṃserṣyā ca prapaṃcaśca tena sarvaṃ vinaśyati..
tasmāttapasvibhiryuktaṃ kāmakrodhādivarjanam.. 22.73 ..
1.3.d:
हिंसेर्ष्या च प्रपंचश्च तेन सर्वं विनश्यति..
तस्मात्तपस्विभिर्युक्तं कामक्रोधादिवर्जनम्.. 22.73 ..
1.3.m: violence, jealousy, and duplicity—by these everything is ruined. / Therefore, renunciation of desire, anger, and the like is proper for ascetics.

1.3.s:
yadīśvaro hṛdi madhye vibhāvyo manīṣibhiḥ sarvadā jñaptimātraḥ..
tadā sarvairmunivṛttyā vibhāvyastapasvibhirnānyathā ciṃtanīyaḥ.. 22.74 ..
1.3.d:
यदीश्वरो हृदि मध्ये विभाव्यो मनीषिभिः सर्वदा ज्ञप्तिमात्रः..
तदा सर्वैर्मुनिवृत्त्या विभाव्यस्तपस्विभिर्नान्यथा चिंतनीयः.. 22.74 ..
1.3.m: If Īśvara is to be meditated upon in the middle of the heart by the wise always as pure consciousness alone, / then he is to be meditated upon by all practitioners of austerity in the manner of silent sages, and not contemplated otherwise."

1.3.s:
etacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya śaṃbhostadābravīdvijayā taṃ ca sarvam..
gacchātra kiṃcittava nāsti kāryaṃ na vaktavyaṃ vacanaṃ bāliśānyat.. 22.75 ..
1.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य शंभोस्तदाब्रवीद्विजया तं च सर्वम्..
गच्छात्र किंचित्तव नास्ति कार्यं न वक्तव्यं वचनं बालिशान्यत्.. 22.75 ..
1.3.m: Hearing this speech of Śambhu, Vijayā then said to him completely: / "Begone from here, you have no business! No further foolish words are to be spoken!"

1.3.s:
evaṃ vivadamānaṃ taṃ baṭurūpaṃ sadāśivam..
visarjayāmāsa tadā vijayā vākyakovidā.. 22.76 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विवदमानं तं बटुरूपं सदाशिवम्..
विसर्जयामास तदा विजया वाक्यकोविदा.. 22.76 ..
1.3.m: Vijayā, skilled in speech, then dismissed / Sadāśiva in the form of a student-ascetic, who was disputing in this manner.

1.3.s:
tirodhānaṃ gataḥ sadyo maheśo girijāṃ prati..
alakṣyamāṇaḥ sarvāsāṃ sakhīnāṃ parameśvaraḥ.. 22.77 ..
1.3.d:
तिरोधानं गतः सद्यो महेशो गिरिजां प्रति..
अलक्ष्यमाणः सर्वासां सखीनां परमेश्वरः.. 22.77 ..
1.3.m: The Great Lord instantly vanished from Girijā's presence; / invisible to all the friends, the Supreme Lord

1.3.s:
prādurbabhūva sahasā nijarūpadharastadā..
yadā dhyānasthitā devī nijadhyānaparā satī.. 22.78 ..
1.3.d:
प्रादुर्बभूव सहसा निजरूपधरस्तदा..
यदा ध्यानस्थिता देवी निजध्यानपरा सती.. 22.78 ..
1.3.m: suddenly appeared, assuming his own proper form. / When the goddess, the virtuous maiden, absorbed in her own meditation, sat in meditative absorption,

1.3.s:
tadā hṛdistho deveśo bahirdṛṣṭicarobhavat..
netre unmīlya sā sādhvī girijāyatalocanā..
apaśyaddevadeveśaṃ sarvalokamaheśvaram.. 22.79 ..
1.3.d:
तदा हृदिस्थो देवेशो बहिर्दृष्टिचरोभवत्..
नेत्रे उन्मील्य सा साध्वी गिरिजायतलोचना..
अपश्यद्देवदेवेशं सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम्.. 22.79 ..
1.3.m: then the Lord of the gods, who dwelt in her heart, became visible to outward sight. / Opening her eyes, the virtuous daughter of the mountain, broad-eyed,

1.3.s:
dvibhujaṃ caikavaktraṃ kṛttivāsasamadbhutam..
kapardaṃ caṃdrarekhāṃkaṃ nivītaṃ gajacarmaṇā.. 22.80 ..
1.3.d:
द्विभुजं चैकवक्त्रं कृत्तिवाससमद्भुतम्..
कपर्दं चंद्ररेखांकं निवीतं गजचर्मणा.. 22.80 ..
1.3.m: beheld the God of the gods, the Great Lord of all the worlds, / having two arms and one face, clad wonderfully in animal skins,

1.3.s:
karṇasthau hi mahānāgau kaṃbalāśvatarau tadā..
vāsukiḥ sarparājaśca kṛtāhāro mahādyutiḥ.. 22.81 ..
1.3.d:
कर्णस्थौ हि महानागौ कंबलाश्वतरौ तदा..
वासुकिः सर्पराजश्च कृताहारो महाद्युतिः.. 22.81 ..
1.3.m: with matted hair marked by the crescent moon, wrapped in an elephant hide, / with the great serpents Kambala and Aśvatara resting on his ears,

1.3.s:
valayāni mahārhāṇi tadā sarpamayāni ca..
kṛtāni tena rudreṇa tathā śobhākarāṇi ca.. 22.82 ..
1.3.d:
वलयानि महार्हाणि तदा सर्पमयानि च..
कृतानि तेन रुद्रेण तथा शोभाकराणि च.. 22.82 ..
1.3.m: and Vāsuki, king of serpents, worn as a necklace, exceedingly radiant; / and magnificent bracelets made of snakes / were donned by that Rudra, looking splendid.

1.3.s:
evaṃbhūtastadā śaṃbhuḥ pārvatīṃ prati cāgrataḥ..
uvāca tvarayā yukto varaṃ varaya bhāmini.. 22.83 ..
1.3.d:
एवंभूतस्तदा शंभुः पार्वतीं प्रति चाग्रतः..
उवाच त्वरया युक्तो वरं वरय भामिनि.. 22.83 ..
1.3.m: Standing thus before Pārvatī, Śambhu / spoke with haste: "Choose a boon, O beautiful lady!"

1.3.s:
vrīḍayā parayā yuktā sādhvī provāca śaṃkaram..
tvaṃ nātho mama deveśa tvayā kiṃ vismṛtaṃ purā.. 22.84 ..
1.3.d:
व्रीडया परया युक्ता साध्वी प्रोवाच शंकरम्..
त्वं नाथो मम देवेश त्वया किं विस्मृतं पुरा.. 22.84 ..
1.3.m: Filled with deep modesty, the virtuous woman said to Śaṃkara: / "You are my lord, O God of gods! Have you forgotten the past?

1.3.s:
dakṣayajñavināśaṃ ca yadarthaṃ kṛtavānprabho..
sa tvaṃ sāhaṃ samutpannā menāyāṃ kāryasiddhaye.. 22.85 ..
1.3.d:
दक्षयज्ञविनाशं च यदर्थं कृतवान्प्रभो..
स त्वं साहं समुत्पन्ना मेनायां कार्यसिद्धये.. 22.85 ..
1.3.m: O Lord, the reason for which you brought about the destruction of Dakṣa's sacrifice— / that same you and that same I have been born from Menā for the accomplishment of this purpose,

1.3.s:
devānāṃ devadeveśa tārakasya vadhaṃ prati..
bhavato hi mayā deva bhaviṣyati kumārakaḥ.. 22.86 ..
1.3.d:
देवानां देवदेवेश तारकस्य वधं प्रति..
भवतो हि मया देव भविष्यति कुमारकः.. 22.86 ..
1.3.m: O Lord of the gods, for the sake of the gods, for the slaying of Tāraka. / From you through me, O Lord, a boy will be born.

1.3.s:
tasmāttvayā hi kartavyaṃ mama vākyaṃ maheśvara..
gaṃtavyaṃ himavatpārśvaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 22.87 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्त्वया हि कर्तव्यं मम वाक्यं महेश्वर..
गंतव्यं हिमवत्पार्श्वं नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 22.87 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, O Great Lord, my request must be carried out by you: / you must go to Himavat; there should be no deliberation here.

1.3.s:
yācasva māṃ mahādeva ṛṣibhiḥ parivāritaḥ..
kariṣyati na saṃdehastava vākyaṃ ca me pitā.. 22.88 ..
1.3.d:
याचस्व मां महादेव ऋषिभिः परिवारितः..
करिष्यति न संदेहस्तव वाक्यं च मे पिता.. 22.88 ..
1.3.m: Surrounded by the seers, O Mahādeva, ask for my hand! / My father will carry out your request without doubt.

1.3.s:
dakṣakanyā purāhaṃ vai pitrā dattā yadā tava..
yathoktavidhinā tatra vivāho na kṛtastvayā..722.89 ..
1.3.d:
दक्षकन्या पुराहं वै पित्रा दत्ता यदा तव..
यथोक्तविधिना तत्र विवाहो न कृतस्त्वया..722.89 ..
1.3.m: Formerly, when I as Dakṣa's daughter was given by my father to you, / the marriage was not performed by you according to the prescribed rules.

1.3.s:
na grahāḥ pūjitāstena dakṣeṇa ca mahātmanā..
grahāṇāṃ viṣayatvena sacchidro'yaṃ mahānabhūt.. 22.90 ..
1.3.d:
न ग्रहाः पूजितास्तेन दक्षेण च महात्मना..
ग्रहाणां विषयत्वेन सच्छिद्रोऽयं महानभूत्.. 22.90 ..
1.3.m: The planets were not worshipped by that noble Dakṣa; / through the influence of the planets, that great flaw occurred.

1.3.s:
tasmādyathoktavidhinā kartumarhasi suvrata..
vivāhaṃ svaṃ mahābhāga devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye.. 22.91 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्यथोक्तविधिना कर्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत..
विवाहं स्वं महाभाग देवानां कार्यसिद्धये.. 22.91 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, O faithful observer of vows, O highly fortunate one, you should celebrate / your marriage according to the prescribed ritual for the fulfillment of the gods' purpose."

1.3.s:
tadovāca mahābāho girijāṃ prahasanniva..
svabhāvenaiva tatsarvaṃ jaṃgamājaṃgamaṃ mahat..
jātaṃ tvayā mohitaṃ ca triguṇaiḥ pariveṣṭitam.. 22.92 ..
1.3.d:
तदोवाच महाबाहो गिरिजां प्रहसन्निव..
स्वभावेनैव तत्सर्वं जंगमाजंगमं महत्..
जातं त्वया मोहितं च त्रिगुणैः परिवेष्टितम्.. 22.92 ..
1.3.m: Then [the Lord] said to Girijā, as if laughing, O mighty-armed one: / "By its very nature, all of this vast moving and unmoving creation / has arisen, deluded by you and enveloped by the three guṇas.

1.3.s:
ahaṃkārātsamutpannaṃ mahattattvaṃ ca pārvati..
mahattattvāttamo jātaṃ tamasā veṣṭitaṃ nabhaḥ.. 22.93 ..
1.3.d:
अहंकारात्समुत्पन्नं महत्तत्त्वं च पार्वति..
महत्तत्त्वात्तमो जातं तमसा वेष्टितं नभः.. 22.93 ..
1.3.m: From egoity arose the cosmic intellect (mahattattva), O Pārvatī; / from the cosmic intellect darkness (tamas) was born, and by darkness space was enveloped.

1.3.s:
nabhaso vāyurutpanno vāyoragnirajāyata..
agnerāpaḥ samutpannā adbhyo jātā mahī tadā.. 22.94 ..
1.3.d:
नभसो वायुरुत्पन्नो वायोरग्निरजायत..
अग्नेरापः समुत्पन्ना अद्भ्यो जाता मही तदा.. 22.94 ..
1.3.m: From space arose wind; from wind fire was produced; / from fire the waters were generated; from the waters earth was then born.

1.3.s:
mahyādikāni sthāsnūni carāṇi ca varānane..
dṛśyaṃ yatsarvamevaitannaśvaraṃ viddhi mānini.. 22.95 ..
1.3.d:
मह्यादिकानि स्थास्नूनि चराणि च वरानने..
दृश्यं यत्सर्वमेवैतन्नश्वरं विद्धि मानिनि.. 22.95 ..
1.3.m: Earth and the rest, both stationary and moving, O fair-faced one, / know all this visible realm to be perishable, O proud woman.

1.3.s:
eko'nekatvamāpanno nirguṇo hi guṇāvṛtaḥ..
svajyotirbhāti yo nityaṃ parajyotsnānvito'bhavat..
svataṃtraḥ parataṃtraśca tvayā devi mahatkṛtam.. 22.96 ..
1.3.d:
एकोऽनेकत्वमापन्नो निर्गुणो हि गुणावृतः..
स्वज्योतिर्भाति यो नित्यं परज्योत्स्नान्वितोऽभवत्..
स्वतंत्रः परतंत्रश्च त्वया देवि महत्कृतम्.. 22.96 ..
1.3.m: The One has attained multiplicity; the quality-less is enveloped by qualities; / He who ever shines with His own light has become possessed of another's moonlight; / He who is independent has become dependent—a great thing has been done by you, O Goddess!

1.3.s:
māyāmayaṃ kṛtamidaṃ ca jagatsamagraṃ sarvātmanā avadhṛtaṃ parayā ca buddhyā..
sarvātmabhiḥ sukṛtibhiḥ paramārthabhāvaiḥ saṃsaktiriṃdriyagaṇaiḥ pariveṣṭitaṃ ca.. 22.97 ..
1.3.d:
मायामयं कृतमिदं च जगत्समग्रं सर्वात्मना अवधृतं परया च बुद्ध्या..
सर्वात्मभिः सुकृतिभिः परमार्थभावैः संसक्तिरिंद्रियगणैः परिवेष्टितं च.. 22.97 ..
1.3.m: And this entire world has been made of māyā, grasped as the universal self and by supreme intellect; / it is surrounded by all-souled, virtuous ones through realization of the highest truth, and by attachment to the hosts of sense organs.

1.3.s:
ke grahāḥ ke uḍugaṇāḥ ke bādhyaṃte tvayā kṛtāḥ..
vimuktaṃ cādhunā devi śarvārthaṃ varavarṇini.. 22.98 ..
1.3.d:
के ग्रहाः के उडुगणाः के बाध्यंते त्वया कृताः..
विमुक्तं चाधुना देवि शर्वार्थं वरवर्णिनि.. 22.98 ..
1.3.m: What planets, what constellations, what afflictions have been made by you? / And now, O Goddess, O woman of excellent complexion, everything has been released for Śarva’s purpose.

1.3.s:
guṇakāryaprasaṃgena āvāṃ prādurbhavaḥ kṛtaḥ..
tvaṃ hi vai prakṛtiḥ sūkṣmā rajaḥsattvatamomayī.. 22.99 ..
1.3.d:
गुणकार्यप्रसंगेन आवां प्रादुर्भवः कृतः..
त्वं हि वै प्रकृतिः सूक्ष्मा रजःसत्त्वतमोमयी.. 22.99 ..
1.3.m: By connection with the effects of the qualities, our manifestation was brought about; / for you indeed are subtle Primordial Matter (prakṛti), composed of rajas, sattva, and tamas.

1.3.s:
vyāpāradakṣā satatamahaṃ caiva sumadhyame..
himālayaṃ na gacchāmi na yācāmi kathaṃcana.. 22.100 ..
1.3.d:
व्यापारदक्षा सततमहं चैव सुमध्यमे..
हिमालयं न गच्छामि न याचामि कथंचन.. 22.100 ..
1.3.m: You are ever skilled in activity, and so am I, O slender-waisted one. / I do not go to Himālaya, nor do I beg in any way.

1.3.s:
dehīti vacanātsadyaḥ puruṣo yāti lāghavam..
itthaṃ jñātvā ca bho devi kimasmākaṃ vadasva vai.. 22.101 ..
1.3.d:
देहीति वचनात्सद्यः पुरुषो याति लाघवम्..
इत्थं ज्ञात्वा च भो देवि किमस्माकं वदस्व वै.. 22.101 ..
1.3.m: From the word 'Give,' a man immediately falls into humiliation. / Knowing this thus, O Goddess, tell me: what is ours to do?

1.3.s:
kāryaṃ tvadājñayā bhadre tatsarvaṃ vaktumarhasi..
tenoktātra tadā sādhvī uvāca kamalekṣaṇā.. 22.102 ..
1.3.d:
कार्यं त्वदाज्ञया भद्रे तत्सर्वं वक्तुमर्हसि..
तेनोक्तात्र तदा साध्वी उवाच कमलेक्षणा.. 22.102 ..
1.3.m: What must be done by your command, O auspicious one, you should declare all of that." / Addressed in this way by Him, the virtuous lotus-eyed lady then spoke:

1.3.s:
tvamātmā prakṛtiścāhaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā..
tathāpi śaṃbho kartavyaṃ mama codvahanaṃ mahat.. 22.103 ..
1.3.d:
त्वमात्मा प्रकृतिश्चाहं नात्र कार्या विचारणा..
तथापि शंभो कर्तव्यं मम चोद्वहनं महत्.. 22.103 ..
1.3.m: "You are the Soul (ātman) and I am Primordial Matter (prakṛti); on this no deliberation should be made. / Even so, O Śambhu, my great wedding must be performed.

1.3.s:
deho hyavidyayākṣipto videho hi bhavānparaḥ..
tathāpyevaṃ mahādeva śarīrāvaraṇaṃ kuru.. 22.104 ..
1.3.d:
देहो ह्यविद्ययाक्षिप्तो विदेहो हि भवान्परः..
तथाप्येवं महादेव शरीरावरणं कुरु.. 22.104 ..
1.3.m: For the body is projected by ignorance, while You, the Supreme, are bodiless. / Nevertheless, O Mahādeva, make this bodily covering.

1.3.s:
prapaṃcaracanāṃ śaṃbho kuru vākyānmama prabho..
yācasva māṃ mahādeva saubhāgyaṃ caiva dehi me.. 22.105 ..
1.3.d:
प्रपंचरचनां शंभो कुरु वाक्यान्मम प्रभो..
याचस्व मां महादेव सौभाग्यं चैव देहि मे.. 22.105 ..
1.3.m: Fashion the arrangement of the cosmic manifestation at my word, O Lord Śambhu! / Ask for me in marriage, O Mahādeva, and grant me marital felicity!"

1.3.s:
ityevamuktaḥ sa tayā mahātmā maheśvaro lokaviḍaṃbanāya..
tatheti matvā prahasañjagāma svamālayaṃ devavaraiḥ supūjitaḥ.. 22.106 ..
1.3.d:
इत्येवमुक्तः स तया महात्मा महेश्वरो लोकविडंबनाय..
तथेति मत्वा प्रहसञ्जगाम स्वमालयं देववरैः सुपूजितः.. 22.106 ..
1.3.m: Thus addressed by her, that great-souled Maheśvara, for the sake of conforming to worldly ways, / agreed, thinking 'So be it,' and, laughing, went to His own abode, well worshipped by the foremost of the gods.

1.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare tatra himavāngiribhiḥ saha..
menayā bhāryayā sārddhamājagāma tvarānvitaḥ.. 22.107 ..
1.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र हिमवान्गिरिभिः सह..
मेनया भार्यया सार्द्धमाजगाम त्वरान्वितः.. 22.107 ..
1.3.m: In the meantime, Himavat, together with the mountains / and accompanied by his wife Menā, arrived there in haste,

1.3.s:
pārvatīdarśanārthaṃ ca sutaiśca parivāritaḥ..
tena dṛṣṭā mahādevī sakhībhiḥ parivāritā.. 22.108 ..
1.3.d:
पार्वतीदर्शनार्थं च सुतैश्च परिवारितः..
तेन दृष्टा महादेवी सखीभिः परिवारिता.. 22.108 ..
1.3.m: surrounded by his sons, in order to see Pārvatī. / By him was seen the great goddess, surrounded by her female companions.

1.3.s:
pārvatyā ca tadā dṛṣṭo himavāngiribhiḥ saha..
abhyutthānaparā sādhvī praṇamya śirasā tadā..
pitarau ca tadā bhrātṝnbaṃdhūṃścaiva ca sarvaśaḥ.. 22.109 ..
1.3.d:
पार्वत्या च तदा दृष्टो हिमवान्गिरिभिः सह..
अभ्युत्थानपरा साध्वी प्रणम्य शिरसा तदा..
पितरौ च तदा भ्रातॄन्बंधूंश्चैव च सर्वशः.. 22.109 ..
1.3.m: And then Himavat, together with the mountains, was seen by Pārvatī. / Eager to rise up to greet them, the virtuous woman then bowed her head / to both parents, and then to her brothers and all her kin.

1.3.s:
svamaṃkamāropya mahāyaśāstadā sutāṃ pariṣvajya ca bāṣpapūritaḥ..
uvāca vākyaṃ madhuraṃ himālayaḥ kiṃ vai kṛtaṃ sādhvi yathā tathena.. 22.110 ..
1.3.d:
स्वमंकमारोप्य महायशास्तदा सुतां परिष्वज्य च बाष्पपूरितः..
उवाच वाक्यं मधुरं हिमालयः किं वै कृतं साध्वि यथा तथेन.. 22.110 ..
1.3.m: Then Himālaya, of great renown, placed his daughter on his lap, embraced her, and, filled with tears, / spoke these sweet words: "What indeed has been accomplished by you, O virtuous one, in truth?

1.3.s:
tatkathyatāṃ mahābhāge sarvaṃ śuśrūṣatāṃ hi naḥ..
tacchrutvā madhuraṃ vākyamuvāca pitaraṃ prati.. 22.111 ..
1.3.d:
तत्कथ्यतां महाभागे सर्वं शुश्रूषतां हि नः..
तच्छ्रुत्वा मधुरं वाक्यमुवाच पितरं प्रति.. 22.111 ..
1.3.m: Let that all be told, O highly fortunate one, to us who wish to hear." / Hearing that sweet statement, she spoke to her father:

1.3.s:
tapasā parameṇaiva prārthito madanāṃtakaḥ..
śāṃtaṃ ca me mahātkāryaṃ sarveṣāmapi durllabham.. 22.112 ..
1.3.d:
तपसा परमेणैव प्रार्थितो मदनांतकः..
शांतं च मे महात्कार्यं सर्वेषामपि दुर्ल्लभम्.. 22.112 ..
1.3.m: "By supreme austerity the Destroyer of Madana was petitioned, / and my great task, difficult even for all to attain, has been brought to peace.

1.3.s:
tatra tuṣṭo mahādevo varaṇārthaṃ samāgataḥ..
sa mayoktastadā śaṃbhurmamaṣāṇigrahaḥ katham.. 22.113 ..
1.3.d:
तत्र तुष्टो महादेवो वरणार्थं समागतः..
स मयोक्तस्तदा शंभुर्ममषाणिग्रहः कथम्.. 22.113 ..
1.3.m: Satisfied with it, Mahādeva arrived in order to choose [me]. / Śambhu was then told by me: 'How can my taking of the hand

1.3.s:
kriyate ca tadā śaṃbho mama pitrā vinādhunā..
yatāgatena mārgeṇa gato'sau tripurāṃtakaḥ.. 22.114 ..
1.3.d:
क्रियते च तदा शंभो मम पित्रा विनाधुना..
यतागतेन मार्गेण गतोऽसौ त्रिपुरांतकः.. 22.114 ..
1.3.m: be performed now without my father, O Śambhu?' / That Destroyer of Tripura then departed by the path by which He came."

1.3.s:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā avāpa paramāṃ mudam..
baṃdhubhiḥ saha dharmātmā uvāca svasutāṃ punaḥ.. 22.115 ..
1.3.d:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा अवाप परमां मुदम्..
बंधुभिः सह धर्मात्मा उवाच स्वसुतां पुनः.. 22.115 ..
1.3.m: Hearing her words, the righteous-souled one attained supreme joy. / Together with his kinsmen, he spoke again to his daughter:

1.3.s:
svagṛhaṃ cādya gacchāmo vayaṃ sarve ca bhūdharāḥ..
anayā rādhito devaḥ pinākī vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ.. 22.116 ..
1.3.d:
स्वगृहं चाद्य गच्छामो वयं सर्वे च भूधराः..
अनया राधितो देवः पिनाकी वृषभध्वजः.. 22.116 ..
1.3.m: "Today we and all the mountains will go to our own home; / by her the god who holds the Pināka, whose emblem is the bull, has been propitiated."

1.3.s:
ityūcuste surāḥ sarve himālayapurogamāḥ..
pārvatīsahitāḥ sarve tuṣṭuvurvāgbhirādṛtāḥ.. 22.117 ..
1.3.d:
इत्यूचुस्ते सुराः सर्वे हिमालयपुरोगमाः..
पार्वतीसहिताः सर्वे तुष्टुवुर्वाग्भिरादृताः.. 22.117 ..
1.3.m: Thus all the gods, led by Himālaya, spoke; / together with Pārvatī, all reverently praised [the Lord] with speeches.

1.3.s:
tāṃ stūyamānāṃ ca tadā himālayo hyāropya cāṃsaṃ varavarṇinīṃ ca..
sarvetha śailāḥ parivārya cotsukāḥ samānayāmāsuratha svamālayam.. 22.118 ..
1.3.d:
तां स्तूयमानां च तदा हिमालयो ह्यारोप्य चांसं वरवर्णिनीं च..
सर्वेथ शैलाः परिवार्य चोत्सुकाः समानयामासुरथ स्वमालयम्.. 22.118 ..
1.3.m: Himālaya then placed the fair-complexioned woman, while she was thus being praised, on his shoulder, / and all the eager mountains, surrounding her on all sides, then led her to his own abode.

1.3.s:
devaduṃdubhayo neduḥ śaṃkhatūryāṇyanekaśaḥ..
vāditrāṇi bahūnyeva vādyamānāni sarvaśaḥ.. 22.119 ..
1.3.d:
देवदुंदुभयो नेदुः शंखतूर्याण्यनेकशः..
वादित्राणि बहून्येव वाद्यमानानि सर्वशः.. 22.119 ..
1.3.m: Celestial kettledrums resounded, along with many conches and horns; / numerous musical instruments were sounded on every side.

1.3.s: puṣpavarṣeṇa mahatā tenānītā gṛhaṃ prati.. 22.120 ..
1.3.d: पुष्पवर्षेण महता तेनानीता गृहं प्रति.. 22.120 ..
1.3.m: Amidst a great shower of flowers, she was brought home by him.

1.3.s:
sā pūjyamānā bahubhistadānīṃ mahāvibhūtyullasitā tapasvinī..
tathaiva devaiḥ saha cāraṇaiśca maharṣibhiḥ siddhagaṇaiśca sarvaśaḥ.. 22.121 ..
1.3.d:
सा पूज्यमाना बहुभिस्तदानीं महाविभूत्युल्लसिता तपस्विनी..
तथैव देवैः सह चारणैश्च महर्षिभिः सिद्धगणैश्च सर्वशः.. 22.121 ..
1.3.m: That female ascetic, being worshipped by many at that time, resplendent with great majesty, / was likewise [honored] on all sides by the gods, together with the cāraṇas, the great seers, and the hosts of siddhas.

1.3.s:
pūjyamānā tadā devī uvāca kamalāsanam..
devānṛṣīnpitṝnyakṣānanyānsarvānsamāgatān.. 22.122 ..
1.3.d:
पूज्यमाना तदा देवी उवाच कमलासनम्..
देवानृषीन्पितॄन्यक्षानन्यान्सर्वान्समागतान्.. 22.122 ..
1.3.m: Being worshipped then, the goddess spoke to the Lotus-seated [Brahmā], / to the gods, the seers, the ancestors, the yakṣas, and all others who had arrived:

1.3.s:
gacchadhvaṃ sarva evaite yenye hyatra samāgatāḥ..
svaṃsvaṃ sthānaṃ yatājoṣaṃ sevyatāṃ parameśvaraḥ.. 22.123 ..
1.3.d:
गच्छध्वं सर्व एवैते येन्ये ह्यत्र समागताः..
स्वंस्वं स्थानं यताजोषं सेव्यतां परमेश्वरः.. 22.123 ..
1.3.m: "All of you who have assembled here, go / each to your own place at pleasure, and let the Supreme Lord be served."

1.3.s:
evaṃ tadānīṃ svapiturgṛhaṃ gatā saṃśobhamānā parameṇa varcasā..
sā pārvatī devavaraiḥ supūjitā saṃciṃtayaṃtī manasā sadāśivam.. 22.124 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe pārvatyai śaṃkareṇa svarūpadarśanaṃnāmadvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 22 ..
1.3.d:
एवं तदानीं स्वपितुर्गृहं गता संशोभमाना परमेण वर्चसा..
सा पार्वती देववरैः सुपूजिता संचिंतयंती मनसा सदाशिवम्.. 22.124 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे पार्वत्यै शंकरेण स्वरूपदर्शनंनामद्वाविंशोऽध्यायः.. 22 ..
1.3.m:
Having thus gone at that time to her father's house, shining with supreme splendor, / that Pārvatī, well worshipped by the foremost of gods, meditated in her mind upon Sadāśiva.
Thus ends the twenty-second chapter, titled 'The Revelation of Śaṃkara’s True Form to Pārvatī,' in the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
etasminnaṃtare tatra maheśena praṇoditāḥ..
ājagmuḥ sahasā sadya ṛṣayo'pi himālayam.. 23.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र महेशेन प्रणोदिताः..
आजग्मुः सहसा सद्य ऋषयोऽपि हिमालयम्.. 23.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / In the meantime, impelled there by Maheśa, / the seers also immediately arrived at Himālaya in haste.

1.3.s:
tāndṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya himādriḥ pratimānasaḥ..
pūjayāmāsa tānsarvānuvāca natakaṃdharaḥ.. 23.2 ..
1.3.d:
तान्दृष्ट्वा सहसोत्थाय हिमाद्रिः प्रतिमानसः..
पूजयामास तान्सर्वानुवाच नतकंधरः.. 23.2 ..
1.3.m: Seeing them, Himādri rose at once with attentive mind; / he worshipped all of them and spoke with his neck bowed:

1.3.s:
kimarthamāgatā yūyaṃ brūtāgamanakāraṇam..
tadocuḥ sapta ṛṣayo maheśapreritā vayam.. 23.3 ..
1.3.d:
किमर्थमागता यूयं ब्रूतागमनकारणम्..
तदोचुः सप्त ऋषयो महेशप्रेरिता वयम्.. 23.3 ..
1.3.m: "For what purpose have you come? Tell the reason for your arrival." / Then the Seven Seers said: "We have been sent by Maheśa,

1.3.s:
samāgatāstvatsakāśaṃ kanyāyāśca vilokane..
tānasmānviddhi bhoḥ śaila svāṃ kanyāṃ darśayāśu vai.. 23.4 ..
1.3.d:
समागतास्त्वत्सकाशं कन्यायाश्च विलोकने..
तानस्मान्विद्धि भोः शैल स्वां कन्यां दर्शयाशु वै.. 23.4 ..
1.3.m: and have come to your presence to behold your maiden. / Know us to be them, O Mountain! Show your maiden at once!"

1.3.s:
tathetyuktvā ṛṣigaṇānānītā tatra pārvatī..
svotsaṃge parigṛhyāśu girīndraḥ putravatsalaḥ..
himavāngirirājo'tha uvāca prahasanniva.. 23.5 ..
1.3.d:
तथेत्युक्त्वा ऋषिगणानानीता तत्र पार्वती..
स्वोत्संगे परिगृह्याशु गिरीन्द्रः पुत्रवत्सलः..
हिमवान्गिरिराजोऽथ उवाच प्रहसन्निव.. 23.5 ..
1.3.m: Saying "So be it," Pārvatī was brought there to the host of seers. / Quickly taking her upon his lap, the lord of mountains, fond of his children, / Himavat, the king of mountains, then spoke as if laughing:

1.3.s:
iyaṃ sutā madīyā hi vākyaṃ śruṇuta me punaḥ..
tapasvināṃ variṣṭha'sau virakto madanāṃtakaḥ.. 23.6 ..
1.3.d:
इयं सुता मदीया हि वाक्यं श्रुणुत मे पुनः..
तपस्विनां वरिष्ठऽसौ विरक्तो मदनांतकः.. 23.6 ..
1.3.m: "This is indeed my daughter; listen again to my word: / that Destroyer of Madana is the foremost of ascetics, completely detached.

1.3.s:
kathamudvahanārthī ca yenānaṃgaḥ kṛta smaraḥ..
atyāsannecātidūre āḍhye dhanavivarjite..
vṛttihīne ca mūrkhe ca kanyādānaṃ na śasyate.. 23.7 ..
1.3.d:
कथमुद्वहनार्थी च येनानंगः कृत स्मरः..
अत्यासन्नेचातिदूरे आढ्ये धनविवर्जिते..
वृत्तिहीने च मूर्खे च कन्यादानं न शस्यते.. 23.7 ..
1.3.m: How can He who turned Smara bodiless (anaṅga) desire marriage? / The giving of a daughter in marriage is not commended to one too near, to one too far, to the wealthy, to one devoid of wealth, / to one devoid of livelihood, and to a fool."

1.3.s:
mūḍhāya ca viraktāya ātmasaṃbhāvitāya ca..
āturāya pramattāya kanyādānaṃ na kārayet.. 23.8 ..
1.3.d:
मूढाय च विरक्ताय आत्मसंभाविताय च..
आतुराय प्रमत्ताय कन्यादानं न कारयेत्.. 23.8 ..
1.3.m: One should not give a maiden to a fool, to an ascetic detached [from the world], to one conceited with self-pride, / to a sick person, or to a heedless one. 23.8

1.3.s:
tasmānmayā vicāryaiva bhavadbhirṛṣisattamāḥ..
pradātavyā maheśāya etanme vratamuttamam.. 23.9 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मान्मया विचार्यैव भवद्भिरृषिसत्तमाः..
प्रदातव्या महेशाय एतन्मे व्रतमुत्तमम्.. 23.9 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, O best of seers, after careful deliberation by me and you, / she must be given to Maheśa; this is my supreme vow." 23.9

1.3.s:
tacchrutvā girirājasya vacanaṃ te maharṣayaḥ..
ekapadyena ūcuste prahasya ca himālayam.. 23.10 ..
1.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा गिरिराजस्य वचनं ते महर्षयः..
एकपद्येन ऊचुस्ते प्रहस्य च हिमालयम्.. 23.10 ..
1.3.m: Having heard those words of the king of mountains, those great seers, / laughing together in unison, spoke to Himālaya: 23.10

1.3.s:
yayā kṛtaṃ tapastīvraṃ yayā cārādhitaḥ śivaḥ..
tapasā tena saṃtuṣṭaḥ prasannodya sadāśivaḥ.. 23.11 ..
1.3.d:
यया कृतं तपस्तीव्रं यया चाराधितः शिवः..
तपसा तेन संतुष्टः प्रसन्नोद्य सदाशिवः.. 23.11 ..
1.3.m: "She by whom severe austerity was performed, by whom Śiva was worshipped— / pleased by that austerity, Sadāśiva is now gracious. 23.11

1.3.s:
asyāstasya ca bhoḥ śaila na jānāsi ca kiṃcana..
mahimānaṃ paraṃ caiva tasmādenāṃ prayaccha vai.. 23.12 ..
1.3.d:
अस्यास्तस्य च भोः शैल न जानासि च किंचन..
महिमानं परं चैव तस्मादेनां प्रयच्छ वै.. 23.12 ..
1.3.m: O mountain, you do not know anything of her and his / supreme greatness; therefore, bestow her indeed! 23.12

1.3.s:
śivāya girijāmenāṃ kuruṣya vacanaṃ hi naḥ..
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām.. 23.13 ..
1.3.d:
शिवाय गिरिजामेनां कुरुष्य वचनं हि नः..
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषामृषीणां भावितात्मनाम्.. 23.13 ..
1.3.m: Give this daughter of the mountain to Śiva; fulfill our word!" / Hearing that speech of those seers of purified mind, 23.13

1.3.s:
uvāca tvarayā yuktaḥ parvatānparvateśvaraḥ..
he mero he niṣadhakiṃ gandhamādana mandara..
maināka kriyatāmadya śaṃsadhvaṃ ca yathātatham.. 23.14 ..
1.3.d:
उवाच त्वरया युक्तः पर्वतान्पर्वतेश्वरः..
हे मेरो हे निषधकिं गन्धमादन मन्दर..
मैनाक क्रियतामद्य शंसध्वं च यथातथम्.. 23.14 ..
1.3.m: the lord of mountains, filled with haste, spoke to the mountains: / "O Meru, O Niṣadha, O Gandhamādana, Mandara, / [and] Maināka, what should be done today? Speak truly!" 23.14

1.3.s:
menā tadā uvācedaṃ vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradā..
adhunā kiṃ vimaśana kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ tadaiva hi.. 23.15 ..
1.3.d:
मेना तदा उवाचेदं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदा..
अधुना किं विमशन कृतं कार्यं तदैव हि.. 23.15 ..
1.3.m: Then Menā, skilled in speech, spoke these words: / "What need of deliberation now? The matter was settled then itself! 23.15

1.3.s:
utpanneyaṃ mahābhāgā devakāryārthameva ca..
pradātavyā śivāyeti śivasyārthe'vatāritā.. 23.16 ..
1.3.d:
उत्पन्नेयं महाभागा देवकार्यार्थमेव च..
प्रदातव्या शिवायेति शिवस्यार्थेऽवतारिता.. 23.16 ..
1.3.m: This illustrious maiden was born solely for the purpose of the gods' mission. / She is to be given to Śiva; she was brought down for Śiva's sake. 23.16

1.3.s:
anayārādhito rudro rudreṇa paribhāvitā..
iyaṃ mahābhāgā śivāya pratidīyatām.. 23.17 ..
1.3.d:
अनयाराधितो रुद्रो रुद्रेण परिभाविता..
इयं महाभागा शिवाय प्रतिदीयताम्.. 23.17 ..
1.3.m: Rudra was worshipped by her; she is cherished by Rudra. / Let this illustrious lady be given back to Śiva! 23.17

1.3.s:
nimittamātraṃ ca kṛtaṃ tayā vai śivapūjane..
etacchrutvā vacastasyāmenāyāḥ paribhāṣitam.. 23.18 ..
1.3.d:
निमित्तमात्रं च कृतं तया वै शिवपूजने..
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्यामेनायाः परिभाषितम्.. 23.18 ..
1.3.m: Her worship of Śiva was made a mere occasion." / Having heard these words spoken by Menā, 23.18

1.3.s:
parituṣṭo himādriśca vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha..
ṛṣīnprati nirīkṣaṃstāṃ kanyeyaṃ mama saṃprati.. 23.19 ..
1.3.d:
परितुष्टो हिमाद्रिश्च वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह..
ऋषीन्प्रति निरीक्षंस्तां कन्येयं मम संप्रति.. 23.19 ..
1.3.m: Himādri was delighted, and he spoke these words / looking towards the seers: "Behold, this is my maiden now." 23.19

1.3.s:
tataḥ samānīya sulocanāṃ tāṃ śyāmāṃ nitaṃbārṣitamekhalāṃ śubhām..
vaiḍūryamuktāvalayāndadhānāṃ bhāsvatprabhāṃ cāṃdramasīṃ va rekham.. 23.20 ..
1.3.d:
ततः समानीय सुलोचनां तां श्यामां नितंबार्षितमेखलां शुभाम्..
वैडूर्यमुक्तावलयान्दधानां भास्वत्प्रभां चांद्रमसीं व रेखम्.. 23.20 ..
1.3.m: Then, having brought forth that beautiful-eyed, youthful woman, auspicious with a girdle adorning her hips, / wearing bracelets of cat's-eye and pearls, shining with brilliant luster like a crescent of the moon, 23.20

1.3.s:
lāvaṇyāmṛtavāpikāṃ suvadanāṃ gaurīṃ suvāsāṃ śubhāṃ dṛṣṭvā te hyṛṣayo'pi mohamaganbhrāṃtāstadā saṃbhramāt..
nocuḥ kiṃcanā vākyameva sudhiyo hyāsanpramattā iva stabdhāḥ kāntimatīmatīva rucirāṃ trailokyanāthapriyām.. 23.21 ..
1.3.d:
लावण्यामृतवापिकां सुवदनां गौरीं सुवासां शुभां दृष्ट्वा ते ह्यृषयोऽपि मोहमगन्भ्रांतास्तदा संभ्रमात्..
नोचुः किंचना वाक्यमेव सुधियो ह्यासन्प्रमत्ता इव स्तब्धाः कान्तिमतीमतीव रुचिरां त्रैलोक्यनाथप्रियाम्.. 23.21 ..
1.3.m: a pool of the nectar of loveliness, fair-faced Gaurī, auspicious and beautifully dressed—seeing her, even the seers fell into delusion, bewildered in their astonishment; / those wise men could not say a single word, becoming like intoxicated men, transfixed before the exceedingly lovely, radiant beloved of the Lord of the three worlds. 23.21

1.3.s:
evaṃ tadā te hyṛṣayo'pi mohitā rūpeṇa tasyāḥ kimutātha devatāḥ..
tathaiva sarve ca nirīkṣya tanvīṃ satīṃ girindrasya sutāṃ śivapriyām.. 23.22 ..
1.3.d:
एवं तदा ते ह्यृषयोऽपि मोहिता रूपेण तस्याः किमुताथ देवताः..
तथैव सर्वे च निरीक्ष्य तन्वीं सतीं गिरिन्द्रस्य सुतां शिवप्रियाम्.. 23.22 ..
1.3.m: Thus, when even the seers were enchanted by her beauty, how much more so the gods? / Likewise, all of them gazed upon the slender, faithful daughter of the lord of mountains, the beloved of Śiva. 23.22

1.3.s: tataḥ punaścaitya śivaṃ śivapriyāḥ śaśaṃsurasmā ṛṣayastadānīm.. 23.23 ..
1.3.d: ततः पुनश्चैत्य शिवं शिवप्रियाः शशंसुरस्मा ऋषयस्तदानीम्.. 23.23 ..
1.3.m: Then, approaching Śiva again, those seers, beloved of Śiva, declared to him at that time: 23.23

1.3.s:
..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
bhūṣitā hi girīndreṇa svasutā nāsti saṃśayaḥ..
udvoḍhuṃ gaccha deveśa devaiśca parivāritaḥ.. 23.24 ..
1.3.d:
..ऋषय ऊचुः..
भूषिता हि गिरीन्द्रेण स्वसुता नास्ति संशयः..
उद्वोढुं गच्छ देवेश देवैश्च परिवारितः.. 23.24 ..
1.3.m: The seers said: / "Indeed, his daughter has been adorned by the lord of mountains, there is no doubt. / Go to marry her, O Lord of the gods, surrounded by the gods! 23.24

1.3.s:
gaccha śīghraṃ mahādeva pārvatīmātmajanmane..
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ prahasyedamuvāca ha.. 23.25 ..
1.3.d:
गच्छ शीघ्रं महादेव पार्वतीमात्मजन्मने..
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषां प्रहस्येदमुवाच ह.. 23.25 ..
1.3.m: Go quickly, O Mahādeva, to take Pārvatī as your own!" / Hearing those words of theirs, laughing, he said: 23.25

1.3.s:
vivāho hi mahābhāgā na dṛṣṭo na śruto'pi vā..
mayā purā ca ṛṣayaḥ kathyatāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ.. 23.26 ..
1.3.d:
विवाहो हि महाभागा न दृष्टो न श्रुतोऽपि वा..
मया पुरा च ऋषयः कथ्यतां च विशेषतः.. 23.26 ..
1.3.m: "A wedding has never been seen or heard of by me before, / O illustrious seers; tell me of it in detail." 23.26

1.3.s:
tadocurṛṣayaḥ sarve prahasaṃtaḥ sadāśivam..
viṣṇumāhvaya vai deva brahmaṇaṃ ca śatakratum.. 23.27 ..
1.3.d:
तदोचुरृषयः सर्वे प्रहसंतः सदाशिवम्..
विष्णुमाह्वय वै देव ब्रह्मणं च शतक्रतुम्.. 23.27 ..
1.3.m: Then all the seers, laughing, spoke to Sadāśiva: / "Summon Viṣṇu, O god, and Brahmā, and Indra of a hundred sacrifices, 23.27

1.3.s:
tathā ṛṣigaṇāṃścaiva yakṣagandharvapannagān..
siddhavidyādharāṃścaiva kiṃnarāṃścāpsarogaṇān.. 23.28 ..
1.3.d:
तथा ऋषिगणांश्चैव यक्षगन्धर्वपन्नगान्..
सिद्धविद्याधरांश्चैव किंनरांश्चाप्सरोगणान्.. 23.28 ..
1.3.m: as well as the hosts of seers, yakṣas, gandharvas, pannagas, / siddhas, vidyādharas, kiṃnaras, and the hosts of apsarases. 23.28

1.3.s:
etāṃścānyāṃśca subahūnānayasveti satvaram..
tadākarṇya ṛṣiproktaṃ vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ.. 23.29 ..
1.3.d:
एतांश्चान्यांश्च सुबहूनानयस्वेति सत्वरम्..
तदाकर्ण्य ऋषिप्रोक्तं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः.. 23.29 ..
1.3.m: Bring these and very many others quickly!" / Hearing that speech uttered by the seers, the god, skilled in speech, 23.29

1.3.s:
uvāca nāradaṃ devo viṣṇumānaya satvaram..
brahmāṇaṃ ca mahendraṃ ca anyāṃścaiva samānaya.. 23.30 ..
1.3.d:
उवाच नारदं देवो विष्णुमानय सत्वरम्..
ब्रह्माणं च महेन्द्रं च अन्यांश्चैव समानय.. 23.30 ..
1.3.m: said to Nārada: "Bring Viṣṇu quickly, / and bring Brahmā, Mahendra, and the others as well!" 23.30

1.3.s:
śaṃbhorvacanamādāya śirasā lokapāvanaḥ..
jagāma tvarito bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ viṣṇuvallabhaḥ.. 23.31 ..
1.3.d:
शंभोर्वचनमादाय शिरसा लोकपावनः..
जगाम त्वरितो भूत्वा वैकुण्ठं विष्णुवल्लभः.. 23.31 ..
1.3.m: Taking Śambhu's command upon his head, the purifier of the worlds, / who is dear to Viṣṇu, went swiftly to Vaikuṇṭha. 23.31

1.3.s:
dadarśa devaṃ paramāsane sthitaṃ śriyā ca devyā parisevyamānam..
caturbhujaṃ devavaraṃ mahāprabhaṃ nīlotpalaśyāmatanuṃ vareṇyam.. 23.32 ..
1.3.d:
ददर्श देवं परमासने स्थितं श्रिया च देव्या परिसेव्यमानम्..
चतुर्भुजं देववरं महाप्रभं नीलोत्पलश्यामतनुं वरेण्यम्.. 23.32 ..
1.3.m: He saw the god seated on a supreme throne, served by the goddess Śrī, / four-armed, the best of the gods, of great splendor, his body dark as a blue lotus, the most excellent one, 23.32

1.3.s:
mahārharatnāvṛtacārukuṇḍalaṃ mahākirīṭottamaratnabhāsvatam..
suvaijayaṃtyā vanamālayā vṛtaṃ sa nāradastaṃ bhuvanaikasundaram.. 23.33 ..
1.3.d:
महार्हरत्नावृतचारुकुण्डलं महाकिरीटोत्तमरत्नभास्वतम्..
सुवैजयंत्या वनमालया वृतं स नारदस्तं भुवनैकसुन्दरम्.. 23.33 ..
1.3.m: with beautiful earrings covered with costly gems, resplendent with an excellent jewel in his great crown, / encircled by the forest garland, the fair Vaijayantī—Nārada beheld him, the sole beauty of the world. 23.33

1.3.s:
uvāca nārado'bhyetya śaṃbhorvākyamathādarāt..
brahmavīṇāṃ vādyavīṇāṃ vādyamānaḥ sarvajña ṛṣisattamaḥ.. 23.34 ..
1.3.d:
उवाच नारदोऽभ्येत्य शंभोर्वाक्यमथादरात्..
ब्रह्मवीणां वाद्यवीणां वाद्यमानः सर्वज्ञ ऋषिसत्तमः.. 23.34 ..
1.3.m: Approaching, playing the divine vīṇā, the musical lute, / that all-knowing best of seers, Nārada, respectfully delivered the message of Śambhu: 23.34

1.3.s:
ehyehi tvaṃ mahāviṣṇo mahādevaṃ tvarānvitaḥ..
udvāhanārthaṃ śaṃbhośca tvamekaḥ kāryasādhakaḥ.. 23.35 ..
1.3.d:
एह्येहि त्वं महाविष्णो महादेवं त्वरान्वितः..
उद्वाहनार्थं शंभोश्च त्वमेकः कार्यसाधकः.. 23.35 ..
1.3.m: "Come, come in haste, O Mahāviṣṇu, to Mahādeva! / For the marriage of Śambhu, you alone are the accomplisher of the task!" 23.35

1.3.s:
prahasya bhagavānprāha nāradaṃ prati vai tadā..
kathamudvahane buddhirutpannā tasya śūlinaḥ..
vijñātārtho'pi bhagavānnāradaṃ paripṛṣṭavān.. 23.36 ..
1.3.d:
प्रहस्य भगवान्प्राह नारदं प्रति वै तदा..
कथमुद्वहने बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना तस्य शूलिनः..
विज्ञातार्थोऽपि भगवान्नारदं परिपृष्टवान्.. 23.36 ..
1.3.m: Laughing, the Lord then said to Nārada: / "How has the thought of marriage arisen in that trident-wielder?" / Although he already knew the matter, the Lord questioned Nārada. 23.36

1.3.s:
..nārada uvāca..
tapasā mahatā rudraḥ pārvatyā paritoṣitaḥ..
svayamevāgatastatra yatrāste girijā satī.. 23.37 ..
1.3.d:
..नारद उवाच..
तपसा महता रुद्रः पार्वत्या परितोषितः..
स्वयमेवागतस्तत्र यत्रास्ते गिरिजा सती.. 23.37 ..
1.3.m: Nārada said: / "Rudra has been completely satisfied by Pārvatī through her great austerity. / He himself came there where the faithful daughter of the mountain dwells. 23.37

1.3.s:
dāso'hamavadacchaṃbhuḥ pārvatyā paritoṣitaḥ..
pārvatīṃ ca samabhyarthya varayasva ca bhāmini.. 23.38 ..
1.3.d:
दासोऽहमवदच्छंभुः पार्वत्या परितोषितः..
पार्वतीं च समभ्यर्थ्य वरयस्व च भामिनि.. 23.38 ..
1.3.m: Delighted by Pārvatī, Śambhu said, 'I am your servant,' / and entreating Pārvatī, [he said], 'Choose a boon, O beautiful lady!' 23.38

1.3.s:
tvaritenāvadacchaṃbhustvāmāhvayati saṃprati..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devadevo janārdanaḥ..
nāradena samāyuktaḥ pārṣadaiḥ parivāritaḥ.. 23.39 ..
1.3.d:
त्वरितेनावदच्छंभुस्त्वामाह्वयति संप्रति..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवदेवो जनार्दनः..
नारदेन समायुक्तः पार्षदैः परिवारितः.. 23.39 ..
1.3.m: Hastily Śambhu said: 'He calls you right now.'" / Hearing those words of his, Janārdana, the god of gods, / accompanied by Nārada and surrounded by his attendants, 23.39

1.3.s:
suparṇamāruhya tadā mahātmā yogīśvarāṇāṃ prabhuracyuto mahān..
yayau tadā''kāśapathā hariḥ svayaṃ sanārado devavaraiḥ sametaḥ.. 23.40 ..
1.3.d:
सुपर्णमारुह्य तदा महात्मा योगीश्वराणां प्रभुरच्युतो महान्..
ययौ तदा'ऽकाशपथा हरिः स्वयं सनारदो देववरैः समेतः.. 23.40 ..
1.3.m: mounting Suparṇa, that great-souled, great Acyuta, the lord of the lords of yoga— / Hari himself then went along the skyway, together with Nārada and the best of gods. 23.40

1.3.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tvaritaṃ devo yogidhyeyāṃghripaṃkajaḥ..
abhyutthāya mudā yuktaḥ pariṣvajya ca śārṅgiṇam.. 23.41 ..
1.3.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा त्वरितं देवो योगिध्येयांघ्रिपंकजः..
अभ्युत्थाय मुदा युक्तः परिष्वज्य च शार्ङ्गिणम्.. 23.41 ..
1.3.m: Seeing him arrive swiftly, the god whose lotus feet are meditated upon by yogins, / rising up filled with joy, embraced the wielder of the bow Śārṅga. 23.41

1.3.s:
tadā hariharau devāvaikapadyena tiṣṭhataḥ..
ūcutuḥ sma tadānyonyaṃ kṣemaṃ kuśalameva ca.. 23.42 ..
1.3.d:
तदा हरिहरौ देवावैकपद्येन तिष्ठतः..
ऊचुतुः स्म तदान्योन्यं क्षेमं कुशलमेव च.. 23.42 ..
1.3.m: Then the two gods, Hari and Hara, stood together / and spoke to each other of welfare and auspiciousness. 23.42

1.3.s:
..īśvara uvāca..
girijātapasā viṣṇo jito'haṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ..
pāṇigrahārthamevādya gaṃtukāmo himālayam.. 23.43 ..
1.3.d:
..ईश्वर उवाच..
गिरिजातपसा विष्णो जितोऽहं नात्र संशयः..
पाणिग्रहार्थमेवाद्य गंतुकामो हिमालयम्.. 23.43 ..
1.3.m: Īśvara said: / "O Viṣṇu, I have been won by the austerity of the daughter of the mountain, there is no doubt of this. / Today I wish to go to Himālaya solely to take her hand in marriage. 23.43

1.3.s:
yathārthena ca bho viṣṇo kathayāmi tavāgrataḥ..
yadā dakṣeṇa bho viṣṇo pradattā ca purā satī.. 23.44 ..
1.3.d:
यथार्थेन च भो विष्णो कथयामि तवाग्रतः..
यदा दक्षेण भो विष्णो प्रदत्ता च पुरा सती.. 23.44 ..
1.3.m: I tell you the truth, O Viṣṇu, before you: / when Satī was formerly given by Dakṣa, O Viṣṇu, 23.44

1.3.s:
na ca saṃkalpavidhinā mayā pāṇigrahaḥ kṛtaḥ..
adhunaiva mayā kāryaṃ karmavistāraṇaṃ bahu.. 23.45 ..
1.3.d:
न च संकल्पविधिना मया पाणिग्रहः कृतः..
अधुनैव मया कार्यं कर्मविस्तारणं बहु.. 23.45 ..
1.3.m: the grasping of her hand was not performed by me according to the prescribed rules of intention. / Only now must I perform extensive ceremonial acts. 23.45

1.3.s:
yatkāryaṃ tanna jānāmi sarvaṃ pāṇigrahocitam..
śaṃbhostadvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya madhusūdanaḥ.. 23.46 ..
1.3.d:
यत्कार्यं तन्न जानामि सर्वं पाणिग्रहोचितम्..
शंभोस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य मधुसूदनः.. 23.46 ..
1.3.m: I do not know all that is to be done proper for marriage." / Hearing those words of Śambhu, Madhusūdana laughed; 23.46

1.3.s:
yāvadvaktuṃ samārebhe tāvadbrahmā samāgataḥ..
iṃdreṇa saha sarvaiśca lokapālaistvarānvitaḥ.. 23.47 ..
1.3.d:
यावद्वक्तुं समारेभे तावद्ब्रह्मा समागतः..
इंद्रेण सह सर्वैश्च लोकपालैस्त्वरान्वितः.. 23.47 ..
1.3.m: just as he began to speak, Brahmā arrived / in haste, along with Indra and all the guardians of the world. 23.47

1.3.s:
tathaiva devāsurayakṣadānavā nāgāḥ pataṃgāpsaraso maharṣayaḥ..
sametya sarve parivaktumīśamūcustadānīṃ śirasā praṇamya.. 23.48 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव देवासुरयक्षदानवा नागाः पतंगाप्सरसो महर्षयः..
समेत्य सर्वे परिवक्तुमीशमूचुस्तदानीं शिरसा प्रणम्य.. 23.48 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, the gods, asuras, yakṣas, dānavas, nāgas, birds, apsarases, and great seers / having gathered together, bowing their heads, then spoke to the Lord to address him:

1.3.s:
gacchagaccha mahādeva asmābhiḥ sahitaḥ prabho..
tato viṣṇuruvācedaṃ prastāvasadṛśaṃvacaḥ.. 23.49 ..
1.3.d:
गच्छगच्छ महादेव अस्माभिः सहितः प्रभो..
ततो विष्णुरुवाचेदं प्रस्तावसदृशंवचः.. 23.49 ..
1.3.m: "Go, go, O Mahādeva, accompanied by us, O Lord!" / Then Viṣṇu spoke these words appropriate to the occasion:

1.3.s: gṛhyoktavidhinā śaṃbho karma kartumihārhasi.. 23.50 ..
1.3.d: गृह्योक्तविधिना शंभो कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि.. 23.50 ..
1.3.m: "O Śambhu, you ought to perform the ritual here according to the rule prescribed in the Gṛhyasūtras.

1.3.s:
nāṃdīmukhaṃ maṇḍapasthāpanaṃ ca tathā caitatkuru dharmeṇa yuktam..
mahānadīsaṃgamaṃ varjayitvā kurvaṃti kecidvedamanīṣiṇaśca.. 23.51 ..
1.3.d:
नांदीमुखं मण्डपस्थापनं च तथा चैतत्कुरु धर्मेण युक्तम्..
महानदीसंगमं वर्जयित्वा कुर्वंति केचिद्वेदमनीषिणश्च.. 23.51 ..
1.3.m: Perform the Nāndīmukha [rite] and the erection of the pavilion in accordance with dharma; / some wise masters of the Veda perform [this], avoiding the confluence of great rivers.

1.3.s:
maṇḍapasthāpanaṃ caiva kriyatāṃ hyadhunā vibho..
tathokto viṣṇunā śaṃbhuścakārātmahitāya vai.. 23.52 ..
1.3.d:
मण्डपस्थापनं चैव क्रियतां ह्यधुना विभो..
तथोक्तो विष्णुना शंभुश्चकारात्महिताय वै.. 23.52 ..
1.3.m: Let the erection of the pavilion be performed right now, O Lord!" / Thus addressed by Viṣṇu, Śambhu indeed did so for his own welfare.

1.3.s:
brahmādibhiḥ kṛtaṃ tena sarvamabhyudayocitam..
grahāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ cakre kaśyapo brahmaṇā yutaḥ.. 23.53 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मादिभिः कृतं तेन सर्वमभ्युदयोचितम्..
ग्रहाणां पूजनं चक्रे कश्यपो ब्रह्मणा युतः.. 23.53 ..
1.3.m: All that was suitable for prosperity was performed by him along with Brahmā and the others; / Kaśyapa, accompanied by Brahmā, performed the worship of the planets.

1.3.s:
tathātriśca vaśiṣṭhaśca gautamotha gururbhṛguḥ..
kaṇvo bṛhaspatiḥ śaktirjamadagniḥ parāśaraḥ.. 23.54 ..
1.3.d:
तथात्रिश्च वशिष्ठश्च गौतमोथ गुरुर्भृगुः..
कण्वो बृहस्पतिः शक्तिर्जमदग्निः पराशरः.. 23.54 ..
1.3.m: Likewise Atri, Vasiṣṭha, Gautama, then the preceptor Bhṛgu, / Kaṇva, Bṛhaspati, Śakti, Jamadagni, Parāśara,

1.3.s:
mārkaṃḍeyaḥ śilāvākaḥ śūnyapālo'kṣataśramaḥ..
agastyaścyavano gargaḥ śilādo'tha mahāmuniḥ.. 23.55 ..
1.3.d:
मार्कंडेयः शिलावाकः शून्यपालोऽक्षतश्रमः..
अगस्त्यश्च्यवनो गर्गः शिलादोऽथ महामुनिः.. 23.55 ..
1.3.m: Mārkaṇḍeya, Śilāvāka, Śūnyapāla, Akṣataśrama, / Agastya, Cyavana, Garga, and the great sage Śilāda—

1.3.s:
ete cānye ca bahavo hyāgatāḥ śivasannidhau..
brahmaṇā noditāstatra cakruste vidhivatkriyām.. 23.56 ..
1.3.d:
एते चान्ये च बहवो ह्यागताः शिवसन्निधौ..
ब्रह्मणा नोदितास्तत्र चक्रुस्ते विधिवत्क्रियाम्.. 23.56 ..
1.3.m: these and many others indeed arrived in the presence of Śiva; / impelled there by Brahmā, they performed the rite according to rule.

1.3.s:
vedoktavidhinā sarve vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ..
cakrū rakṣāṃ maheśasya kṛtakautukamaṃgalām.. 23.57 ..
1.3.d:
वेदोक्तविधिना सर्वे वेदवेदांगपारगाः..
चक्रू रक्षां महेशस्य कृतकौतुकमंगलाम्.. 23.57 ..
1.3.m: All of them, well-versed in the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, according to the rule prescribed in the Vedas, / performed the auspicious rite of the marriage-thread to protect Maheśa.

1.3.s:
ṛgyajuḥsāmasahitaiḥ sūktairnānāvidhaistathā..
maṃgalāni ca bhūrīṇi ṛṣayastattvavedinaḥ.. 23.58 ..
1.3.d:
ऋग्यजुःसामसहितैः सूक्तैर्नानाविधैस्तथा..
मंगलानि च भूरीणि ऋषयस्तत्त्ववेदिनः.. 23.58 ..
1.3.m: With diverse hymns accompanied by the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas, / the seers who know the truth [performed] many auspicious rites.

1.3.s:
abhyaṃjanādikaṃ sarvaṃ cakrustasya parātmanaḥ..
khyātaḥ kaparddastasyaiva śivasya paramātmanaḥ.. 23.59 ..
1.3.d:
अभ्यंजनादिकं सर्वं चक्रुस्तस्य परात्मनः..
ख्यातः कपर्द्दस्तस्यैव शिवस्य परमात्मनः.. 23.59 ..
1.3.m: They performed anointing and everything else for that Supreme Self; / the famous matted hair of that very Śiva, the Supreme Self,

1.3.s:
anekairmauktikairyuktā muṇḍamālā'bhavattadā..
ye sarpā hyaṃgabhūtāśca te sarve tatkṣaṇādiva..
babhūvurmaḍanānyeva jātarūpamayāni ca.. 23.60 ..
1.3.d:
अनेकैर्मौक्तिकैर्युक्ता मुण्डमालाऽभवत्तदा..
ये सर्पा ह्यंगभूताश्च ते सर्वे तत्क्षणादिव..
बभूवुर्मडनान्येव जातरूपमयानि च.. 23.60 ..
1.3.m: and the garland of human skulls then became adorned with many pearls; / those snakes that were [his] bodily ornaments all, as if in an instant, / became decorations made entirely of gold.

1.3.s:
sarvabhūṣaṇasaṃpanno devadevo maheśvaraḥ..
yayau devaiḥ parivṛtaḥ śailarājapuraṃ prati.. 23.61 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वभूषणसंपन्नो देवदेवो महेश्वरः..
ययौ देवैः परिवृतः शैलराजपुरं प्रति.. 23.61 ..
1.3.m: Endowed with all ornaments, the God of gods, Maheśvara, / surrounded by the gods, set out toward the city of the King of Mountains.

1.3.s:
caṃḍikā varabhaginī tadā jātā bhayāvahā..
pretāsanā gatā caṇḍī sarpābharaṇabhūṣitā.. 23.62 ..
1.3.d:
चंडिका वरभगिनी तदा जाता भयावहा..
प्रेतासना गता चण्डी सर्पाभरणभूषिता.. 23.62 ..
1.3.m: Caṇḍikā then became the terrifying sister of the groom; / seated on a corpse, Caṇḍī set forth, adorned with ornaments of snakes,

1.3.s:
haimaṃ kalaśamādāya pūrṇaṃ mūrdhnā mahāprabhā..
parivārairmahācaṃḍī dīptāsyā hyugralocanā.. 23.63 ..
1.3.d:
हैमं कलशमादाय पूर्णं मूर्ध्ना महाप्रभा..
परिवारैर्महाचंडी दीप्तास्या ह्युग्रलोचना.. 23.63 ..
1.3.m: carrying a full golden water-pot on her head, of great brilliance, / Mahācaṇḍī with her retinue, with a flaming face and fierce eyes.

1.3.s:
tatra bhūtānyanekāni virūpāṇi sahasraśaḥ..
taiḥ sametāgrataścaṃḍī jagāma vikṛtānanā.. 23.64 ..
1.3.d:
तत्र भूतान्यनेकानि विरूपाणि सहस्रशः..
तैः समेताग्रतश्चंडी जगाम विकृतानना.. 23.64 ..
1.3.m: There were many misshapen spirits by the thousands; / accompanied by them, Caṇḍī, with a deformed face, went in front.

1.3.s:
tasyāḥ sarve pṛṣṭhataśca gaṇāḥ paramadāruṇāḥ..
koṭyekādaśasaṃkhyākā raudrā rudra priyāśca ye.. 23.65 ..
1.3.d:
तस्याः सर्वे पृष्ठतश्च गणाः परमदारुणाः..
कोट्येकादशसंख्याका रौद्रा रुद्र प्रियाश्च ये.. 23.65 ..
1.3.m: All behind her were the most dreadful gaṇas, / numbering eleven crores, terrifying and dear to Rudra.

1.3.s:
tadā ḍamarunirghoṣavyāptamāsījjagattrayam..
bherībhāṃkāraśabdena śaṃkhānāṃ ninadena ca.. 23.66 ..
1.3.d:
तदा डमरुनिर्घोषव्याप्तमासीज्जगत्त्रयम्..
भेरीभांकारशब्देन शंखानां निनदेन च.. 23.66 ..
1.3.m: Then the three worlds were filled with the sound of the ḍamaru, / with the booming noise of kettledrums and the blast of conches,

1.3.s:
tathā duṃdubhinirghoṣaiḥ śabdaḥ kolāhalo'bhavat..
gaṇānāṃ pṛṣṭhato bhūtvā sarve devāḥ samutsukāḥ..
anvayuḥ sarvasiddhāśca lokapālaiḥ samanvitāḥ.. 23.67 ..
1.3.d:
तथा दुंदुभिनिर्घोषैः शब्दः कोलाहलोऽभवत्..
गणानां पृष्ठतो भूत्वा सर्वे देवाः समुत्सुकाः..
अन्वयुः सर्वसिद्धाश्च लोकपालैः समन्विताः.. 23.67 ..
1.3.m: and with the roar of drums, there was a tumult. / Following behind the gaṇas, all the eager gods / and all the siddhas, accompanied by the world-guardians, followed.

1.3.s:
madhye vrajanmaheṃdro'tha airāvatamupāsthitaḥ..
śubhreṇo cchriyamāṇena chatreṇa parameṇa hi.. 23.68 ..
1.3.d:
मध्ये व्रजन्महेंद्रोऽथ ऐरावतमुपास्थितः..
शुभ्रेणो च्छ्रियमाणेन छत्रेण परमेण हि.. 23.68 ..
1.3.m: Then the great Indra, mounted upon Airāvata, went in the middle, / with an exquisite white parasol held high,

1.3.s:
cāmarairvījyamāno'sau surairbahubhirāvṛtaḥ..
tadā tu vrajamānāsta ṛṣayo bahavo hyamī.. 23.69 ..
1.3.d:
चामरैर्वीज्यमानोऽसौ सुरैर्बहुभिरावृतः..
तदा तु व्रजमानास्त ऋषयो बहवो ह्यमी.. 23.69 ..
1.3.m: being fanned with chowries, surrounded by many gods; / then indeed these many seers went forth,

1.3.s:
bharadvājādayo viprāḥ śivasyodvahanaṃ prati..
śākinyo yātudhānāśca vetālā brahmarākṣasāḥ.. 23.70 ..
1.3.d:
भरद्वाजादयो विप्राः शिवस्योद्वहनं प्रति..
शाकिन्यो यातुधानाश्च वेताला ब्रह्मराक्षसाः.. 23.70 ..
1.3.m: vipras headed by Bharadvāja, toward Śiva's wedding; / śākinīs, yātudhānas, vetālas, brahmarākṣasas,

1.3.s:
bhūtapretapiśācāśca tathānye pramathādayaḥ..
pṛcchamānāstadā caṃḍīṃ pṛṣṭhato'nvagamaṃstadā.. 23.71 ..
1.3.d:
भूतप्रेतपिशाचाश्च तथान्ये प्रमथादयः..
पृच्छमानास्तदा चंडीं पृष्ठतोऽन्वगमंस्तदा.. 23.71 ..
1.3.m: bhūtas, pretas, piśācas, and other pramathas and the like / then followed behind Caṇḍī, asking [where she was]:

1.3.s:
kva gatā sā'dhunā caṃḍī dhāvamānāstadā bhṛśam..
prāptā gatā vrajaṃtīṃ tāṃ praṇipatya mahāprabhām.. 23.72 ..
1.3.d:
क्व गता साऽधुना चंडी धावमानास्तदा भृशम्..
प्राप्ता गता व्रजंतीं तां प्रणिपत्य महाप्रभाम्.. 23.72 ..
1.3.m: "Where has Caṇḍī gone now?" Running vigorously then, / they reached and approached that great, radiant one as she was going, bowing down.

1.3.s:
atha procustadā sarve caṃḍīṃ bhairavasaṃyutām..
vināsmābhiḥ kuto yāsi vada caṃḍi yathā tathā.. 23.73 ..
1.3.d:
अथ प्रोचुस्तदा सर्वे चंडीं भैरवसंयुताम्..
विनास्माभिः कुतो यासि वद चंडि यथा तथा.. 23.73 ..
1.3.m: Then they all said to Caṇḍī, who was accompanied by Bhairava: / "Where are you going without us? Tell us truly, O Caṇḍī!"

1.3.s:
prahasyovāca sā caṃḍī bhūtānāṃ tatra śrṛṇvatām..
śaṃbhorudvahanārthāya pretārūḍhā vrajāmyaham.. 23.74 ..
1.3.d:
प्रहस्योवाच सा चंडी भूतानां तत्र श्रृण्वताम्..
शंभोरुद्वहनार्थाय प्रेतारूढा व्रजाम्यहम्.. 23.74 ..
1.3.m: Laughing, that Caṇḍī spoke as the spirits there listened: / "Mounted upon a corpse, I am going for Śambhu's wedding,

1.3.s:
haimaṃ kalaśamādāya śirasā bibhratī svayam..
karavālīsvarūpeṇa caṃḍī jātā tataḥ svayam.. 23.75 ..
1.3.d:
हैमं कलशमादाय शिरसा बिभ्रती स्वयम्..
करवालीस्वरूपेण चंडी जाता ततः स्वयम्.. 23.75 ..
1.3.m: carrying a golden water-pot, bearing it herself upon her head." / Then Caṇḍī herself took the form of the sister of the groom;

1.3.s:
bhūtaiḥ parivṛtā sarvaiḥ sarveṣāmagrato'vrajat..
gaṇāstāmanujagmuste gaṇānāṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ surāḥ.. 23.76 ..
1.3.d:
भूतैः परिवृता सर्वैः सर्वेषामग्रतोऽव्रजत्..
गणास्तामनुजग्मुस्ते गणानां पृष्ठतः सुराः.. 23.76 ..
1.3.m: surrounded by all the spirits, she walked before everyone. / The gaṇas followed her, and behind the gaṇas were the gods;

1.3.s:
iṃdrādayo lokapālā ṛṣayaste'grapṛṣṭhataḥ..
ṛṣīṇāṃ pṛṣṭhato bhūtvā pārṣadāśca mahāprabhāḥ.. 23.77 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्रादयो लोकपाला ऋषयस्तेऽग्रपृष्ठतः..
ऋषीणां पृष्ठतो भूत्वा पार्षदाश्च महाप्रभाः.. 23.77 ..
1.3.m: Indra and the other world-guardians and the seers were in front and behind. / Behind the seers were the radiant attendants,

1.3.s:
viṣṇoramitabhāvajñā mukuṃdācca manoramāḥ..
sarve payodasaṃkāśāḥ sragviṇo vanamālinaḥ..
śrīvatsāṃkadharāḥ sarve pītavāsonvitāśca te.. 23.78 ..
1.3.d:
विष्णोरमितभावज्ञा मुकुंदाच्च मनोरमाः..
सर्वे पयोदसंकाशाः स्रग्विणो वनमालिनः..
श्रीवत्सांकधराः सर्वे पीतवासोन्विताश्च ते.. 23.78 ..
1.3.m: who knew the boundless thoughts of Viṣṇu and were delightful like Mukunda, / all resembling rain-clouds, wearing garlands, adorned with forest-garlands, / all bearing the mark of the Śrīvatsa and clad in yellow garments,

1.3.s:
caturbhujāḥ kuṃḍalinaḥ kirīṭakaṭakāṃgadaiḥ..
hāranūpurasūtraiśca kaṭisūtrāṅgulīyakaiḥ..
śobhitāḥ sarva evaite mahāpuruṣalakṣaṇāḥ.. 23.79 ..
1.3.d:
चतुर्भुजाः कुंडलिनः किरीटकटकांगदैः..
हारनूपुरसूत्रैश्च कटिसूत्राङ्गुलीयकैः..
शोभिताः सर्व एवैते महापुरुषलक्षणाः.. 23.79 ..
1.3.m: four-armed, wearing earrings, adorned with crowns, bracelets, and armlets, / with necklaces, anklet-cords, waist-cords, and rings, / all displaying the marks of a Mahāpuruṣa.

1.3.s: teṣāṃ madhye gato viṣṇuḥ śriyopetaḥ surārihā.. 23.80 ..
1.3.d: तेषां मध्ये गतो विष्णुः श्रियोपेतः सुरारिहा.. 23.80 ..
1.3.m: In their midst went Viṣṇu, accompanied by Śrī, the slayer of the foes of the gods.

1.3.s:
babhau trilokīkṛtaviśvamaṃgalo mahānubhāvairhṛdi kṛtya dhiṣṭhitaḥ..
śivena sākaṃ paramārthadastadā hariḥ parātmā jagadekabaṃdhuḥ.. 23.81 ..
1.3.d:
बभौ त्रिलोकीकृतविश्वमंगलो महानुभावैर्हृदि कृत्य धिष्ठितः..
शिवेन साकं परमार्थदस्तदा हरिः परात्मा जगदेकबंधुः.. 23.81 ..
1.3.m: He shone, having brought universal auspiciousness to the three worlds, placed in the heart and held by men of great dignity, / then giving the supreme goal along with Śiva—Hari, the Supreme Self, the sole friend of the universe.

1.3.s:
sa tārkṣyaputropari saṃsthito mahām̐llakṣmyā sameto bhuvanaikabhartā..
sa cāmarairvījyamāno munīṃdraiḥ sarvaiḥ sameto harirīśvaro mahān.. 23.82 ..
1.3.d:
स तार्क्ष्यपुत्रोपरि संस्थितो महाम्̐ल्लक्ष्म्या समेतो भुवनैकभर्ता..
स चामरैर्वीज्यमानो मुनींद्रैः सर्वैः समेतो हरिरीश्वरो महान्.. 23.82 ..
1.3.m: He, the sole Lord of the universe, the great one, accompanied by Lakṣmī, was mounted upon the son of Tārkṣya, / fanned with chowries, accompanied by all the foremost sages—Hari, the great Lord.

1.3.s:
tathā viriṃcirnijavāhanastho vedaiḥ sametaḥ saha ṣaḍbhiraṃgaiḥ..
tathāgamaiḥ setihāsaiḥ purāṇaiḥ sa saṃvṛto hemagarbho babhūva.. 23.83 ..
1.3.d:
तथा विरिंचिर्निजवाहनस्थो वेदैः समेतः सह षड्भिरंगैः..
तथागमैः सेतिहासैः पुराणैः स संवृतो हेमगर्भो बभूव.. 23.83 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, Viriñci, mounted upon his own vehicle, accompanied by the Vedas along with the six limbs, / and accompanied by the Āgamas, Itihāsas, and Purāṇas, was surrounded [by them]—he, the Golden-garbhed one.

1.3.s:
vedhoharibhyāṃ ca tadā suredraiḥ samāvṛtaścarṣibhiḥ saṃparītaḥ..
vṛṣārūḍho vṛṣaketurdurāpoyogīśvarairapi sarvairagamyaḥ.. 23.84 ..
1.3.d:
वेधोहरिभ्यां च तदा सुरेद्रैः समावृतश्चर्षिभिः संपरीतः..
वृषारूढो वृषकेतुर्दुरापोयोगीश्वरैरपि सर्वैरगम्यः.. 23.84 ..
1.3.m: Surrounded then by the Creator and Hari, by the chiefs of the gods, and encircled by the seers, / mounted on a bull, having a bull for his banner, difficult to attain, unapproachable even to all the lords of yogins,

1.3.s:
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ dharmavatsalam..
sameto mātṛbhiścaiva gobhiśca kṛtalakṣaṇam.. 23.85 ..
1.3.d:
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशं वृषभं धर्मवत्सलम्..
समेतो मातृभिश्चैव गोभिश्च कृतलक्षणम्.. 23.85 ..
1.3.m: mounted upon a bull resembling pure crystal, fond of dharma, / marked with auspicious signs, and accompanied by the mothers and cows,

1.3.s:
ebhissameto'suradānavaiḥ saha yayau maheśo vibudairalaṃkṛtaḥ..
himālayaṃ girivaryaṃ tadānīṃ pāṇigrahārthaṃ pramadottamāyāḥ.. 23.86 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe śrīśivasya vivāhavarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 23 ..
1.3.d:
एभिस्समेतोऽसुरदानवैः सह ययौ महेशो विबुदैरलंकृतः..
हिमालयं गिरिवर्यं तदानीं पाणिग्रहार्थं प्रमदोत्तमायाः.. 23.86 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखंडे श्रीशिवस्य विवाहवर्णनंनाम त्रयोविंशोऽध्यायः.. 23 ..
1.3.m:
accompanied by these, together with asuras and dānavas, adorned by the gods, / Maheśa then set out toward Himālaya, the best of mountains, for the hand-taking of the best of women.
Thus ends the twenty-third chapter, named 'The Description of Śrī Śiva's Marriage,' in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
tathaiva sarvaṃ parayā mudānvitaścakre girīṃdraḥ svasutārthameva..
gargaṃ puraskṛtya mahānubhāvo maṃgalyabhūmiṃ parayā vibhūtyā.. 24.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
तथैव सर्वं परया मुदान्वितश्चक्रे गिरींद्रः स्वसुतार्थमेव..
गर्गं पुरस्कृत्य महानुभावो मंगल्यभूमिं परया विभूत्या.. 24.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Just so, filled with supreme joy, the king of mountains made all [preparations] for his daughter's sake; / honoring Garga before him, the illustrious one [adorned] the auspicious ground with supreme splendor. 24.1

1.3.s:
āhūya viśvakarmāṇaṃ kārayāmāsa sādaram..
maṃḍapaṃ ca suvistīrṇaṃ vedikābhirmanoramam.. 24.2 ..
1.3.d:
आहूय विश्वकर्माणं कारयामास सादरम्..
मंडपं च सुविस्तीर्णं वेदिकाभिर्मनोरमम्.. 24.2 ..
1.3.m: Having summoned Viśvakarman, he respectfully caused to be made / an immense pavilion delightful with altars. 24.2

1.3.s:
ayutenaiva vistāraṃ yojanānāṃ dvijottamāḥ..
maṃḍapaṃ ca guṇopetaṃ nānāścaryasamanvitatam.. 24.3 ..
1.3.d:
अयुतेनैव विस्तारं योजनानां द्विजोत्तमाः..
मंडपं च गुणोपेतं नानाश्चर्यसमन्विततम्.. 24.3 ..
1.3.m: Its extent was ten thousand yojanas, O best of brahmins; / the pavilion was endowed with every virtue and filled with various wonders. 24.3

1.3.s:
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ caiva sadṛśaṃ ca manoharam..
jaṃgamaṃ ca jitaṃ tatra sthāvareṇa tathaiva ca.. 24.4 ..
1.3.d:
स्थावरं जंगमं चैव सदृशं च मनोहरम्..
जंगमं च जितं तत्र स्थावरेण तथैव च.. 24.4 ..
1.3.m: The motionless and the moving were alike and charming; / there the moving was surpassed by the motionless, / and just so 24.4

1.3.s:
jaṃgamena ca tatraiva jitaṃ sthāvarameva ca..
payasā ca jitā tatra sthalabhūmirabhūttadā.. 24.5 ..
1.3.d:
जंगमेन च तत्रैव जितं स्थावरमेव च..
पयसा च जिता तत्र स्थलभूमिरभूत्तदा.. 24.5 ..
1.3.m: the motionless was surpassed right there by the moving; / and by the water, the dry ground was then surpassed. 24.5

1.3.s:
jalaṃ kiṃ nu sthalaṃ tatra na vidustattvato janāḥ..
kvacitsiṃhāḥ kvaciddhaṃsāḥ sārasāśca mahāprabhāḥ.. 24.6 ..
1.3.d:
जलं किं नु स्थलं तत्र न विदुस्तत्त्वतो जनाः..
क्वचित्सिंहाः क्वचिद्धंसाः सारसाश्च महाप्रभाः.. 24.6 ..
1.3.m: People could not truly discern whether it was water or dry ground! / Here were lions, there swans, and cranes of great splendor. 24.6

1.3.s:
kvacicchikhaṃḍinastatra kṛtrimāḥ sumanoharāḥ..
tathā nāgāḥ kṛtrimāśca hayāścaiva tathā mṛgāḥ.. 24.7 ..
1.3.d:
क्वचिच्छिखंडिनस्तत्र कृत्रिमाः सुमनोहराः..
तथा नागाः कृत्रिमाश्च हयाश्चैव तथा मृगाः.. 24.7 ..
1.3.m: Here and there were artificial peacocks, charming to the mind; / likewise artificial elephants, horses, and also deer. 24.7

1.3.s:
ke satyāḥ ke asatyāśca saṃskṛtā viśvakarmaṇā..
tathaiva caivaṃ vidhinā dvārapāḥ adbhutāḥ kṛtāḥ.. 24.8 ..
1.3.d:
के सत्याः के असत्याश्च संस्कृता विश्वकर्मणा..
तथैव चैवं विधिना द्वारपाः अद्भुताः कृताः.. 24.8 ..
1.3.m: Which were real and which unreal, fashioned by Viśvakarman? / In this very manner, wonderful gatekeepers were fashioned: 24.8

1.3.s:
puṃso dhanūṃṣi cotkṛṣya sthāvarā jaṃgamopamāḥ..
tathāśvāḥ sādibhiścaiva gajāśca gajasādibhiḥ.. 24.9 ..
1.3.d:
पुंसो धनूंषि चोत्कृष्य स्थावरा जंगमोपमाः..
तथाश्वाः सादिभिश्चैव गजाश्च गजसादिभिः.. 24.9 ..
1.3.m: Men drawing bows, motionless yet resembling moving beings; / likewise horses with riders and elephants with elephant-riders, 24.9

1.3.s:
cāmarairvījyamānāśca kecitpuṣpāṃkurānvitāḥ..
kecicca puruṣāstatra virejuḥ sragviṇastathā.. 24.10 ..
1.3.d:
चामरैर्वीज्यमानाश्च केचित्पुष्पांकुरान्विताः..
केचिच्च पुरुषास्तत्र विरेजुः स्रग्विणस्तथा.. 24.10 ..
1.3.m: being fanned with fly whisks, some adorned with flower sprouts; / and some men there shone wearing garlands. 24.10

1.3.s:
kṛtrimāśca tathā bahvyaḥ patākāḥ kalpitāstathā..
dvāri sthitā mahālakṣmīḥ kṣīrodadhisamudbhavā.. 24.11 ..
1.3.d:
कृत्रिमाश्च तथा बह्व्यः पताकाः कल्पितास्तथा..
द्वारि स्थिता महालक्ष्मीः क्षीरोदधिसमुद्भवा.. 24.11 ..
1.3.m: Likewise many artificial banners were fashioned; / at the gate stood Mahālakṣmī, born from the Ocean of Milk. 24.11

1.3.s:
gajāḥ svalaṃkṛtā hyāsankṛtrimā hyakṛtopamāḥ..
tathāśvāḥ sādibhiścaiva gajāśca gajasādibhiḥ.. 24.12 ..
1.3.d:
गजाः स्वलंकृता ह्यासन्कृत्रिमा ह्यकृतोपमाः..
तथाश्वाः सादिभिश्चैव गजाश्च गजसादिभिः.. 24.12 ..
1.3.m: Well-adorned elephants, though artificial, resembled natural ones; / likewise horses with riders, and elephants with elephant-riders, 24.12

1.3.s:
rathā rathiyutā hyāsankṛtrimā hyakṛtopamāḥ..
sarveṣāṃ mohanārthāya tathā ca saṃsadaḥ kṛtāḥ.. 24.13 ..
1.3.d:
रथा रथियुता ह्यासन्कृत्रिमा ह्यकृतोपमाः..
सर्वेषां मोहनार्थाय तथा च संसदः कृताः.. 24.13 ..
1.3.m: and chariots with charioteers, though artificial, resembled natural ones; / assemblies were also made to bewilder everyone. 24.13

1.3.s:
mahādvāri sthito naṃdī kṛtastena hi maṃḍape..
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśo yathā naṃdī tathaiva saḥ.. 24.14 ..
1.3.d:
महाद्वारि स्थितो नंदी कृतस्तेन हि मंडपे..
शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशो यथा नंदी तथैव सः.. 24.14 ..
1.3.m: Standing at the main gate of the pavilion, Nandin was fashioned by him, / resembling pure crystal, exactly like the real Nandin. 24.14

1.3.s:
tasyopari mahaddivyaṃ puṣpakaṃ ratnabhūṣitam..
rājitaṃ pallavācchatraiścāmaraiśca suśobhitam.. 24.15 ..
1.3.d:
तस्योपरि महद्दिव्यं पुष्पकं रत्नभूषितम्..
राजितं पल्लवाच्छत्रैश्चामरैश्च सुशोभितम्.. 24.15 ..
1.3.m: Above it was the great, celestial Puṣpaka, adorned with jewels, / radiant with sprout-parasols, and embellished with fly whisks. 24.15

1.3.s:
vāmapārśve gajau dvau ca śuddhakāśmīrasannibhau..
caturdatau ṣaṣṭivarṣau mahātmānau mahāprabhau.. 24.16 ..
1.3.d:
वामपार्श्वे गजौ द्वौ च शुद्धकाश्मीरसन्निभौ..
चतुर्दतौ षष्टिवर्षौ महात्मानौ महाप्रभौ.. 24.16 ..
1.3.m: On the left side were two elephants resembling pure saffron, / four-tusked, sixty years old, noble-spirited, and of great splendor. 24.16

1.3.s:
tathaiva dakṣiṇe pārśve dvāvaśvau daṃśitau kṛtau..
ratnālaṃkārasaṃyuktām̐llokapālāṃstathaiva ca.. 24.17 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव दक्षिणे पार्श्वे द्वावश्वौ दंशितौ कृतौ..
रत्नालंकारसंयुक्ताम्̐ल्लोकपालांस्तथैव च.. 24.17 ..
1.3.m: Likewise on the right side two armored horses were made; / and so were the World Protectors adorned with jewel ornaments. 24.17

1.3.s:
ṣoḍaśaprakṛtīstena yāthātathyena dhīmatā..
sarve devā yathārthena kṛtā vai viśvakarmaṇā.. 24.18 ..
1.3.d:
षोडशप्रकृतीस्तेन याथातथ्येन धीमता..
सर्वे देवा यथार्थेन कृता वै विश्वकर्मणा.. 24.18 ..
1.3.m: The sixteen Prakṛtis were fashioned faithfully by that wise one; / all the gods were truly made in their actual likeness by Viśvakarman. 24.18

1.3.s:
tathaiva ṛṣayaḥ sarve bhṛgvādyaśca tapodhanāḥ..
viśve ca pārṣadaiḥ sākamiṃdro hi paramārthataḥ.. 24.19 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव ऋषयः सर्वे भृग्वाद्यश्च तपोधनाः..
विश्वे च पार्षदैः साकमिंद्रो हि परमार्थतः.. 24.19 ..
1.3.m: Likewise all the seers, Bhṛgu and others rich in austerity; / the Viśvedevas along with their attendants, and Indra just as he truly is. 24.19

1.3.s:
kṛtāḥ sarve mahātmāno yāthātathyena dhīmatā..
evaṃbhūtaḥ kṛtastena maṃḍapo divyarūpavān.. 24.20 ..
1.3.d:
कृताः सर्वे महात्मानो याथातथ्येन धीमता..
एवंभूतः कृतस्तेन मंडपो दिव्यरूपवान्.. 24.20 ..
1.3.m: All the noble ones were faithfully fashioned by the wise one; / such was the heavenly pavilion fashioned by him, 24.20

1.3.s:
anekāścaryasaṃbhūto divyo divyavimohanaḥ..
etasminnaṃtare tatra āgato nāradogrataḥ.. 24.21 ..
1.3.d:
अनेकाश्चर्यसंभूतो दिव्यो दिव्यविमोहनः..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र आगतो नारदोग्रतः.. 24.21 ..
1.3.m: arising with many wonders, divine and bewildering even celestial beings. / In the meantime, Nārada arrived in front, 24.21

1.3.s:
brahmaṇā noditastatra himālayagṛhaṃ prati..
nāradotha dadarśāgre ātmānaṃ vinayānvitam.. 24.22 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मणा नोदितस्तत्र हिमालयगृहं प्रति..
नारदोथ ददर्शाग्रे आत्मानं विनयान्वितम्.. 24.22 ..
1.3.m: impelled there by Brahmā toward the house of Himālaya; / then Nārada saw himself standing before him, full of humility. 24.22

1.3.s:
bhrāṃto hi nāradastena kṛtrimeṇa mahāyaśāḥ..
avalokaparastatra caritaṃ viśvakarmaṇaḥ.. 24.23 ..
1.3.d:
भ्रांतो हि नारदस्तेन कृत्रिमेण महायशाः..
अवलोकपरस्तत्र चरितं विश्वकर्मणः.. 24.23 ..
1.3.m: Indeed, highly renowned Nārada was bewildered by that artificial [self], / and gazed eagerly at the handiwork of Viśvakarman. 24.23

1.3.s:
praviṣṭo maṃḍapaṃ tasya himādre ratnacitritam..
suvarṇakalaśairjuṣṭaṃ raṃbhādyairupaśobhitam.. 24.24 ..
1.3.d:
प्रविष्टो मंडपं तस्य हिमाद्रे रत्नचित्रितम्..
सुवर्णकलशैर्जुष्टं रंभाद्यैरुपशोभितम्.. 24.24 ..
1.3.m: He entered the pavilion of the Snow Mountain, variegated with jewels, / furnished with golden water-pitchers, and adorned with plantain trunks and other decorations, 24.24

1.3.s:
sahasrastambhasaṃyuktaṃ tato'driḥ svagaṇairvṛtaḥ..
tamṛṣiṃ pūjayāmāsa kiṃ kāryamiti pṛṣṭavān.. 24.25 ..
1.3.d:
सहस्रस्तम्भसंयुक्तं ततोऽद्रिः स्वगणैर्वृतः..
तमृषिं पूजयामास किं कार्यमिति पृष्टवान्.. 24.25 ..
1.3.m: endowed with a thousand pillars. Then the mountain, surrounded by his attendants, / honored that seer and asked: 'What is to be done?' 24.25

1.3.s:
..nārada uvāca..
āgatāste mahātmāno devā indrapurogamāḥ..
tathā maharṣayaḥ sarve gaṇaiśca parivāritāḥ..
mahādevo vṛṣārūḍho hyāgatodvahanaṃ prati.. 24.26 ..
1.3.d:
..नारद उवाच..
आगतास्ते महात्मानो देवा इन्द्रपुरोगमाः..
तथा महर्षयः सर्वे गणैश्च परिवारिताः..
महादेवो वृषारूढो ह्यागतोद्वहनं प्रति.. 24.26 ..
1.3.m: Nārada said: / 'Those noble gods have arrived, led by Indra, / and all the great seers, surrounded by their retinues; / and Mahādeva, mounted upon his bull, has arrived for the wedding.' 24.26

1.3.s:
tatastadvacanaṃ śrutvā himavāngirisattamaḥ..
uvāca nāradaṃ vākyaṃ praśastamadhuraṃ mahat.. 24.27 ..
1.3.d:
ततस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हिमवान्गिरिसत्तमः..
उवाच नारदं वाक्यं प्रशस्तमधुरं महत्.. 24.27 ..
1.3.m: Then, having heard his speech, Himavat, the best of mountains, / spoke these words to Nārada, auspicious, sweet, and noble: 24.27

1.3.s: pūjayitvā yathānyāyaṃ gaccha tvaṃ śaṃkaraṃ prati.. 24.28 ..
1.3.d: पूजयित्वा यथान्यायं गच्छ त्वं शंकरं प्रति.. 24.28 ..
1.3.m: 'Having honored [them] properly, go to Śaṃkara.' 24.28

1.3.s:
tatastadvacanaṃ śrutvā munirhimavato gireḥ..
tathaiva matvā vacanaṃ śailarājānabravīt..
menākena ca sahyena meruṇā giriṇā saha.. 24.29 ..
1.3.d:
ततस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मुनिर्हिमवतो गिरेः..
तथैव मत्वा वचनं शैलराजानब्रवीत्..
मेनाकेन च सह्येन मेरुणा गिरिणा सह.. 24.29 ..
1.3.m: Then the sage, having heard that speech of the mountain Himavat, / consented to his word and spoke to the mountain kings: / together with Maināka, Sahya, and Mount Meru, 24.29

1.3.s:
ebhiḥ sameto hyadhunāmahāmate yatasva śīghraṃ śivamatra cānaya..
devaiḥ sametaṃ ca maharṣivaryaiḥ surāsuraircitapādapaṃkajam.. 24.30 ..
1.3.d:
एभिः समेतो ह्यधुनामहामते यतस्व शीघ्रं शिवमत्र चानय..
देवैः समेतं च महर्षिवर्यैः सुरासुरैर्चितपादपंकजम्.. 24.30 ..
1.3.m: 'Joined by these, O highly intelligent one, make an effort quickly and bring Śiva here, / who is accompanied by the gods and foremost great seers, whose lotus feet are revered by gods and asuras.' 24.30

1.3.s:
tatheti matvā sa jagāma tūrṇāṃ sahai va taiḥ parvatarājabhiśca..
tvarāgataścaikapadena śaṃbhuṃ prāpnodṛṣīṇāṃ pravaro mahātmā.. 24.31 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा स जगाम तूर्णां सहै व तैः पर्वतराजभिश्च..
त्वरागतश्चैकपदेन शंभुं प्राप्नोदृषीणां प्रवरो महात्मा.. 24.31 ..
1.3.m: Agreeing, 'So be it,' that illustrious one, foremost among the seers, / went swiftly together with those mountain kings and, arriving quickly at once, reached Śambhu. 24.31

1.3.s:
tāvaddṛṣṭo mahādevo devaiśca parivāritaḥ..
tadā brahmā ca viṣṇuśca rudraścaiva suraiḥ saha.. 24.32 ..
1.3.d:
तावद्दृष्टो महादेवो देवैश्च परिवारितः..
तदा ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्चैव सुरैः सह.. 24.32 ..
1.3.m: Just then Mahādeva was seen, surrounded by the gods; / then Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra, along with the gods, 24.32

1.3.s:
papracachurnāradaṃ sarve ye'nye rudracarā bhṛśam..
kathyatāṃ pṛcchamānānāmasmākaṃ kathyate na hi.. 24.33 ..
1.3.d:
पप्रचछुर्नारदं सर्वे येऽन्ये रुद्रचरा भृशम्..
कथ्यतां पृच्छमानानामस्माकं कथ्यते न हि.. 24.33 ..
1.3.m: and all the others who follow Rudra, persistently asked Nārada: / 'Tell us who are asking! Why are you not speaking? 24.33

1.3.s:
ekaikasyātmajāḥ svāḥ svāḥ sahyamainākameravaḥ..
kanyāṃ dāsyaṃti vā śaṃbhoḥ kiṃ tvidānīṃ pravartate.. 24.34 ..
1.3.d:
एकैकस्यात्मजाः स्वाः स्वाः सह्यमैनाकमेरवः..
कन्यां दास्यंति वा शंभोः किं त्विदानीं प्रवर्तते.. 24.34 ..
1.3.m: Will Sahya, Maināka, and Meru give their own daughters to Śambhu, / one to each, or what is happening now?' 24.34

1.3.s:
tato'vocanmahātejā nāradaścarṣisattamaḥ..
