brahmāṇaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā viṣṇuṃ prati sahetukam.. 24.35 ..
1.3.d:
ततोऽवोचन्महातेजा नारदश्चर्षिसत्तमः..
ब्रह्माणं पुरतः कृत्वा विष्णुं प्रति सहेतुकम्.. 24.35 ..
1.3.m: Then the seer of great splendor, Nārada, best among seers, / placing Brahmā in front, spoke with reason to Viṣṇu. 24.35

1.3.s:
ekāṃtamāśritya tadā surendraṃ sa nārado vākyamidaṃ babhāṣe..
tvaṣṭrā kṛtaṃ vai bhavanaṃ mahattaraṃ yenaiva sarve ca vimohitā vayam.. 24.36 ..
1.3.d:
एकांतमाश्रित्य तदा सुरेन्द्रं स नारदो वाक्यमिदं बभाषे..
त्वष्ट्रा कृतं वै भवनं महत्तरं येनैव सर्वे च विमोहिता वयम्.. 24.36 ..
1.3.m: Retiring to a private place with the lord of gods, Nārada then spoke this word: / 'A vast mansion has been fashioned by Tvaṣṭṛ, by which all of us have been completely bewildered. 24.36

1.3.s:
purā kṛtaṃ tasya mahātmanastvayā kiṃ vismṛtaṃ tatsakalaṃ śacīpate..
tasmādasau tvāṃ vijigīṣukāmo gṛhe vasaṃstasyagirermahātmanaḥ.. 24.37 ..
1.3.d:
पुरा कृतं तस्य महात्मनस्त्वया किं विस्मृतं तत्सकलं शचीपते..
तस्मादसौ त्वां विजिगीषुकामो गृहे वसंस्तस्यगिरेर्महात्मनः.. 24.37 ..
1.3.m: Have you forgotten all that you did to that great soul in the past, O husband of Śacī? / Therefore, desiring to overcome you while dwelling in the house of that noble mountain, 24.37

1.3.s:
aho vimohitastena pratirūpeṇa bhāsvatā..
tathā viṣṇuḥ kṛtastena śaṃkhacakragadādibhṛt.. 24.38 ..
1.3.d:
अहो विमोहितस्तेन प्रतिरूपेण भास्वता..
तथा विष्णुः कृतस्तेन शंखचक्रगदादिभृत्.. 24.38 ..
1.3.m: alas, he has bewildered [everyone] with that radiant replica! / Likewise, Viṣṇu was made by him, holding the conch, discus, and mace, 24.38

1.3.s: brahmā caiva tathābhūtastaṃ caiva kṛtavānasau.. 24.39 ..
1.3.d: ब्रह्मा चैव तथाभूतस्तं चैव कृतवानसौ.. 24.39 ..
1.3.m: and Brahmā also was made just like that by him. 24.39

1.3.s:
māyāmayo vṛṣabhastena veṣātkṛto hi nāgośvatarastathaiva..
tathā cānyānyāpyanenāmarendra sarvāṇyevollikhitānyatra viddhi.. 24.40 ..
1.3.d:
मायामयो वृषभस्तेन वेषात्कृतो हि नागोश्वतरस्तथैव..
तथा चान्यान्याप्यनेनामरेन्द्र सर्वाण्येवोल्लिखितान्यत्र विद्धि.. 24.40 ..
1.3.m: An illusory bull was fashioned by him, and in that disguise an elephant and a mule too; / and know, O lord of immortals, that all other things have also been delineated here by him.' 24.40

1.3.s: tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya deveṃdro vākyamabravīt.. 24.41 ..
1.3.d: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य देवेंद्रो वाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 24.41 ..
1.3.m: Having heard that speech of his, the lord of gods spoke: 24.41

1.3.s:
viṣṇuṃ prati tadā śīghraṃ dṛṣṭvā yāmi vasātra bhoḥ..
putraśokena tapto'sau vyājenānyena vā'karot.. 24.42 ..
1.3.d:
विष्णुं प्रति तदा शीघ्रं दृष्ट्वा यामि वसात्र भोः..
पुत्रशोकेन तप्तोऽसौ व्याजेनान्येन वाऽकरोत्.. 24.42 ..
1.3.m: 'Having seen Viṣṇu, I shall go quickly; stay here, sir. / Tormented with grief for his son, has he done this under some pretext or another?' 24.42

1.3.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devadevo janārddanaḥ..
uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ śakramāptabhayaṃ tadā.. 24.43 ..
1.3.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवदेवो जनार्द्दनः..
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं शक्रमाप्तभयं तदा.. 24.43 ..
1.3.m: Hearing his speech, the god of gods, Janārdana, / laughing, then addressed Śakra who had become fearful: 24.43

1.3.s:
nivātakavacaiḥ pūrvaṃ mohito'si śacīpate..
vidyā'mṛtā tatra mayā samānītopasattaye.. 24.44 ..
1.3.d:
निवातकवचैः पूर्वं मोहितोऽसि शचीपते..
विद्याऽमृता तत्र मया समानीतोपसत्तये.. 24.44 ..
1.3.m: “O lord of Śacī, formerly you were bewildered by the Nivātakavacas; / then the immortal wisdom was brought by me for [your] assistance. 24.44

1.3.s:
mahāvidyābalenaiva praviśya maṇḍape'dhunā..
parvato himavāneṣa tathānye parvatottamāḥ.. 24.45 ..
1.3.d:
महाविद्याबलेनैव प्रविश्य मण्डपेऽधुना..
पर्वतो हिमवानेष तथान्ये पर्वतोत्तमाः.. 24.45 ..
1.3.m: Now, having entered into the pavilion by the power of that great wisdom, / this mountain Himavat, as well as the other excellent mountains, 24.45

1.3.s:
vipakṣā hi kṛtāḥ sarve mama vākyācca vāsava..
hetuṃ smṛtvātha vai tvaṣṭā māyayā hyakarodidam.. 24.46 ..
1.3.d:
विपक्षा हि कृताः सर्वे मम वाक्याच्च वासव..
हेतुं स्मृत्वाथ वै त्वष्टा मायया ह्यकरोदिदम्.. 24.46 ..
1.3.m: have indeed all been turned into adversaries at my word, O Vāsava. / Then Tvaṣṭṛ, mindful of the purpose, indeed created this by [his] magical power. 24.46

1.3.s: jayamicchaṃti vai mūḍhā na ca bhetavyamaṇvapi.. 24.47 ..
1.3.d: जयमिच्छंति वै मूढा न च भेतव्यमण्वपि.. 24.47 ..
1.3.m: Those fools indeed desire victory; there is no need to fear even in the slightest.” 24.47

1.3.s:
evaṃ vivadamānāṃstāndevāñchakrapurogamān..
sāṃtvayāmāsa vai viṣṇurnāradaṃ te tato'bruvan.. 24.48 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विवदमानांस्तान्देवाञ्छक्रपुरोगमान्..
सांत्वयामास वै विष्णुर्नारदं ते ततोऽब्रुवन्.. 24.48 ..
1.3.m: Viṣṇu consoled those gods led by Śakra who were thus disputing; / they then spoke to Nārada: 24.48

1.3.s:
dadāti vā na dadāti kanyāṃ girīndraḥ svāṃ vai kathyatāṃ śīghrameva..
kiṃ tena dṛṣṭāṃ kiṃ kṛtaṃ cādya śaṃsa tatsarvaṃ bho nārada te namo'stu.. 24.49 ..
1.3.d:
ददाति वा न ददाति कन्यां गिरीन्द्रः स्वां वै कथ्यतां शीघ्रमेव..
किं तेन दृष्टां किं कृतं चाद्य शंस तत्सर्वं भो नारद ते नमोऽस्तु.. 24.49 ..
1.3.m: “Does the king of mountains give or not give his daughter? Let it be told at once! / What was seen by him, and what has been done today? Proclaim it all, O Nārada, homage to you!” 24.49

1.3.s:
tacchrutvā prahasañchaṃbhuruvāca vacanaṃ tadā..
kanyāṃ dāsyati cenmahyaṃ parvato hi himālayaḥ..
māyayā mama kiṃ kāryaṃ vada viṣṇo yathātatham.. 24.50 ..
1.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा प्रहसञ्छंभुरुवाच वचनं तदा..
कन्यां दास्यति चेन्मह्यं पर्वतो हि हिमालयः..
मायया मम किं कार्यं वद विष्णो यथातथम्.. 24.50 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that, Śambhu laughed and then spoke [these] words: / “If the mountain Himālaya will indeed give the maiden to me, / what do I have to do with magical illusion? Speak truly, O Viṣṇu.” 24.50

1.3.s:
kenāpvupāyena phalaṃ hi sādhyamityucyate paṃḍitairnyāyavidbhiḥ..
tasmātsarvairgamyatāṃ śīghrameva kāryārthobhiścendrapurogamaiśca.. 24.51 ..
1.3.d:
केनाप्वुपायेन फलं हि साध्यमित्युच्यते पंडितैर्न्यायविद्भिः..
तस्मात्सर्वैर्गम्यतां शीघ्रमेव कार्यार्थोभिश्चेन्द्रपुरोगमैश्च.. 24.51 ..
1.3.m: “The fruit must indeed be accomplished by some means—so say the learned who know logic; / therefore, let everyone who seeks the purpose, led by Indra, go immediately.” 24.51

1.3.s:
tadā śivo'pi viśvātmā paṃcabāṇena mohitaḥ..
mahābhūtena bhūteśastvanyeṣāṃ caiva kā kathā.. 24.52 ..
1.3.d:
तदा शिवोऽपि विश्वात्मा पंचबाणेन मोहितः..
महाभूतेन भूतेशस्त्वन्येषां चैव का कथा.. 24.52 ..
1.3.m: Then even Śiva, the soul of the universe, the lord of beings, / was bewildered by the five-arrowed [god], the great being; what then to say of others? 24.52

1.3.s:
evaṃ ca vidyamāne'sau śaṃbhuḥ paramaśobhanaḥ..
kṛto hyanaṃgena vaśe yathānyaḥ prākṛto janaḥ.. 24.53 ..
1.3.d:
एवं च विद्यमानेऽसौ शंभुः परमशोभनः..
कृतो ह्यनंगेन वशे यथान्यः प्राकृतो जनः.. 24.53 ..
1.3.m: And while this was happening, that most magnificent Śambhu / was brought under control by the bodiless [god] just like another ordinary man. 24.53

1.3.s:
madano hi balī loke yena sarvamidaṃ jagat..
jitamasti nijaprauḍhyā sadevarṣisamanvitam.. 24.54 ..
1.3.d:
मदनो हि बली लोके येन सर्वमिदं जगत्..
जितमस्ति निजप्रौढ्या सदेवर्षिसमन्वितम्.. 24.54 ..
1.3.m: For Madana is mighty in the world; by his own power this entire world, / along with the gods and the seers, has been conquered by him. 24.54

1.3.s:
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ devānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ..
rājā hyanaṃgo balavānyasya cājñā balīyasī.. 24.55 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वेषामेव भूतानां देवानां च विशेषतः..
राजा ह्यनंगो बलवान्यस्य चाज्ञा बलीयसी.. 24.55 ..
1.3.m: The bodiless [god] is indeed the mighty king of all beings, / and especially of the gods, whose command is most powerful. 24.55

1.3.s:
pārvatīstrīsvarūpeṇa ajeyo bhuvanatraye..
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā hi striyaṃ sarve ṛṣayo'pi vicakṣaṇāḥ.. 24.56 ..
1.3.d:
पार्वतीस्त्रीस्वरूपेण अजेयो भुवनत्रये..
तां दृष्ट्वा हि स्त्रियं सर्वे ऋषयोऽपि विचक्षणाः.. 24.56 ..
1.3.m: Through the female form of Pārvatī he is invincible in the three worlds. / For having seen that woman, all the seers, though discerning, 24.56

1.3.s:
devā manuṣyā gandharvāḥ piśācoragarākṣasāḥ..
ājñānullaṃghinaḥ sarve madanasya mahātmanaḥ.. 24.57 ..
1.3.d:
देवा मनुष्या गन्धर्वाः पिशाचोरगराक्षसाः..
आज्ञानुल्लंघिनः सर्वे मदनस्य महात्मनः.. 24.57 ..
1.3.m: the gods, humans, gandharvas, piśācas, snakes, and rākṣasas— / all cannot transgress the command of the great-souled Madana. 24.57

1.3.s:
tapobalena mahatā tathā dānabalena ca..
vettuṃ na śakyo madaṃno vinayena vinā dvijāḥ.. 24.58 ..
1.3.d:
तपोबलेन महता तथा दानबलेन च..
वेत्तुं न शक्यो मदंनो विनयेन विना द्विजाः.. 24.58 ..
1.3.m: O twice-born ones, by great power of austerity and also by power of giving, / Madana cannot be known without humility. 24.58

1.3.s:
tasmādanaṃgasya mahānkrodho hi balavattaraḥ..
īśvaraṃ madanenaivaṃ mohitaṃ vīkṣya mādhavaḥ.. 24.59 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मादनंगस्य महान्क्रोधो हि बलवत्तरः..
ईश्वरं मदनेनैवं मोहितं वीक्ष्य माधवः.. 24.59 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, the great wrath of the bodiless [god] is indeed more powerful. / Seeing Īśvara thus bewildered by Madana, Mādhava, 24.59

1.3.s:
uvāca vākyaṃ vākyajño mā ciṃtāṃ kuru vai prabho..
yaduktaṃ nāradenaiva maṃḍapaṃ prati sarvaśaḥ.. 24.60 ..
1.3.d:
उवाच वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञो मा चिंतां कुरु वै प्रभो..
यदुक्तं नारदेनैव मंडपं प्रति सर्वशः.. 24.60 ..
1.3.m: who knew how to speak, uttered [these] words: “Do not worry, O Lord! / Whatever was said by Nārada concerning the pavilion in every detail, 24.60

1.3.s:
tvaṣṭrā kṛtaṃ vicitraṃ ca tatsarvaṃ madanātprabhoḥ..
tadānīṃ śaṃkaro vākyamuvāca madhusūdanam.. 24.61 ..
1.3.d:
त्वष्ट्रा कृतं विचित्रं च तत्सर्वं मदनात्प्रभोः..
तदानीं शंकरो वाक्यमुवाच मधुसूदनम्.. 24.61 ..
1.3.m: and the wondrous thing fashioned by Tvaṣṭṛ—all that is due to Madana, O Lord!” / At that time Śaṃkara spoke [these] words to the slayer of Madhu: 24.61

1.3.s:
avidyayā vṛtaṃ tena kṛtaṃ tvaṣṭrā hi maṇḍapam..
kiṃ tu vakṣyāmahe viṣṇo maṇḍapaḥ kevalena hi.. 24.62 ..
1.3.d:
अविद्यया वृतं तेन कृतं त्वष्ट्रा हि मण्डपम्..
किं तु वक्ष्यामहे विष्णो मण्डपः केवलेन हि.. 24.62 ..
1.3.m: “The pavilion made by Tvaṣṭṛ is indeed covered with ignorance; / but what can we say, O Viṣṇu? The pavilion is merely [material]. 24.62

1.3.s:
vivāho hi mahābhāga avidyāmūla eva ca..
tasmātsarve vayaṃ yāma udvāhārthaṃ ca saṃprati.. 24.63 ..
1.3.d:
विवाहो हि महाभाग अविद्यामूल एव च..
तस्मात्सर्वे वयं याम उद्वाहार्थं च संप्रति.. 24.63 ..
1.3.m: For marriage, O fortunate one, is rooted in ignorance alone. / Therefore, let us all go now for the sake of the wedding.” 24.63

1.3.s:
nāradaṃ ca puraskṛtya sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ..
himādrisahitā jagmurmandiraṃ paramādbhutam..
anekāścaryasaṃyuktaṃ vicitraṃ viśvakarmaṇā.. 24.64 ..
1.3.d:
नारदं च पुरस्कृत्य सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः..
हिमाद्रिसहिता जग्मुर्मन्दिरं परमाद्भुतम्..
अनेकाश्चर्यसंयुक्तं विचित्रं विश्वकर्मणा.. 24.64 ..
1.3.m: Placing Nārada at the head, all the gods along with Indra / and accompanied by the snow-mountain went to the exceedingly marvelous residence, / filled with many wonders, fashioned marvelously by Viśvakarman. 24.64

1.3.s:
kṛtaṃ ca tenādya pavitramuttamaṃ taṃ yajñavāṭaṃ bahubhiḥ puraskṛtam..
vicitracitraṃ manaso haraṃ ca taṃ yajñavāṭaṃ sa cakāra buddhimān.. 24.65 ..
1.3.d:
कृतं च तेनाद्य पवित्रमुत्तमं तं यज्ञवाटं बहुभिः पुरस्कृतम्..
विचित्रचित्रं मनसो हरं च तं यज्ञवाटं स चकार बुद्धिमान्.. 24.65 ..
1.3.m: And that pure and supreme sacrificial enclosure was fashioned today by him, honored by many; / that wise one fashioned that sacrificial enclosure, mind-captivating with varied designs. 24.65

1.3.s:
pravekṣyamāṇāste sarve surendrā ṛṣibhiḥ saha..
dṛṣṭā himādriṇā tatra abhyutthānagato'bhavat.. 24.66 ..
1.3.d:
प्रवेक्ष्यमाणास्ते सर्वे सुरेन्द्रा ऋषिभिः सह..
दृष्टा हिमाद्रिणा तत्र अभ्युत्थानगतोऽभवत्.. 24.66 ..
1.3.m: As they were about to enter, all those lords of gods along with the seers / were seen there by the snow-mountain, and he stood up to greet them. 24.66

1.3.s:
tathaiva teṣāṃ ca manoharāṇi harmyāṇi tena pratikalpitāni..
gandharvayakṣāḥ pramathāśca siddhā devāśca nāgāpsarasāṃ gaṇāśca..
vasaṃti yatraiva sukhena tebhyaḥ sa tatratatropavanaṃ cakāra.. 24.67 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव तेषां च मनोहराणि हर्म्याणि तेन प्रतिकल्पितानि..
गन्धर्वयक्षाः प्रमथाश्च सिद्धा देवाश्च नागाप्सरसां गणाश्च..
वसंति यत्रैव सुखेन तेभ्यः स तत्रतत्रोपवनं चकार.. 24.67 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, delightful mansions were prepared by him for them; / wherever the gandharvas, yakṣas, pramathas, siddhas, gods, / and troops of nāgas and apsarases lived comfortably, he fashioned a garden here and there for them. 24.67

1.3.s:
teṣāmarthe mahārhāṇi dhārājiragṛhāṇi ca..
atyadbhutāni śobhaṃte kṛtānyeva mahātmanā.. 24.68 ..
1.3.d:
तेषामर्थे महार्हाणि धाराजिरगृहाणि च..
अत्यद्भुतानि शोभंते कृतान्येव महात्मना.. 24.68 ..
1.3.m: For their sake, highly valuable houses with fountains and courtyards, / exceedingly marvelous, shone forth, fashioned by the great-souled one. 24.68

1.3.s:
nivāsārthe kalpitāni sāvakāśāni tatra vai..
devānāṃ caiva sarveṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām.. 24.69 ..
1.3.d:
निवासार्थे कल्पितानि सावकाशानि तत्र वै..
देवानां चैव सर्वेषामृषीणां भावितात्मनाम्.. 24.69 ..
1.3.m: Spacious dwellings were arranged there for the habitation / of all the gods and the seers of purified spirit. 24.69

1.3.s:
evaṃ vistārayāmāsa viśvakarmā bahūnyapi..
mandirāṇi yathāyogyaṃ yatra tatraiva tiṣṭhatām.. 24.70 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विस्तारयामास विश्वकर्मा बहून्यपि..
मन्दिराणि यथायोग्यं यत्र तत्रैव तिष्ठताम्.. 24.70 ..
1.3.m: Thus Viśvakarman extended many mansions appropriately / wherever [they] stayed. 24.70

1.3.s:
bhairavāḥ kṣetrapālāśca ye'nye ca kṣetravāsinaḥ..
śmaśānavāsinaścānye ye'nye nyagrodhavāsinaḥ.. 24.71 ..
1.3.d:
भैरवाः क्षेत्रपालाश्च येऽन्ये च क्षेत्रवासिनः..
श्मशानवासिनश्चान्ये येऽन्ये न्यग्रोधवासिनः.. 24.71 ..
1.3.m: For the bhairavas, kṣetrapālas, and those others dwelling in fields, / and others dwelling in cremation grounds, and others dwelling in banyan trees, 24.71

1.3.s:
aśvatthasevinaścānye khecarāśca tathā pare..
yeye yatropaviṣṭāśca tatratatraiva tena vai.. 24.72 ..
1.3.d:
अश्वत्थसेविनश्चान्ये खेचराश्च तथा परे..
येये यत्रोपविष्टाश्च तत्रतत्रैव तेन वै.. 24.72 ..
1.3.m: and others haunting peepal trees, and likewise other sky-wanderers— / wherever each was seated, right there by him 24.72

1.3.s:
kṛtāni ca manojñāni bhavanāni mahāṃtivai..
teṣāmevānukūlāni bhūtānāṃ viśvakarmaṇā.. 24.73 ..
1.3.d:
कृतानि च मनोज्ञानि भवनानि महांतिवै..
तेषामेवानुकूलानि भूतानां विश्वकर्मणा.. 24.73 ..
1.3.m: delightful and vast mansions were fashioned / by Viśvakarman, suitable for those very beings. 24.73

1.3.s:
tatraiva te sarvagaṇaiḥ sametā nivāsitāstena himādriṇā svayam..
seṃdrāḥ surā yakṣapiśācarakṣasāṃ gandharvavidyāpsarasāṃ samūhāḥ.. 24.74 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe pārvatīpariṇayane himādriṇā devānāṃ nivāsasthānakaraṇavarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 24 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
तत्रैव ते सर्वगणैः समेता निवासितास्तेन हिमाद्रिणा स्वयम्..
सेंद्राः सुरा यक्षपिशाचरक्षसां गन्धर्वविद्याप्सरसां समूहाः.. 24.74 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखंडे पार्वतीपरिणयने हिमाद्रिणा देवानां निवासस्थानकरणवर्णनंनाम चतुर्विंशोऽध्यायः.. 24 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
Right there, accompanied by all the hosts, they were accommodated by the snow-mountain himself— / the gods led by Indra, the multitudes of yakṣas, piśācas, rakṣasas, gandharvas, vidyādharas, and apsarases. 24.74
Thus in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the first Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the Kedārakhaṇḍa, in [the narrative of] the marriage of Pārvatī, the twenty-fourth chapter, named “The Description of the Construction of the Dwellings for the Gods by the Snow-Mountain.” 24.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
tatropaviviśuḥ sarve satkṛtāśca himādriṇā..
te devāḥ saparivārāḥ saharṣāśca savāhanāḥ.. 25.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
तत्रोपविविशुः सर्वे सत्कृताश्च हिमाद्रिणा..
ते देवाः सपरिवाराः सहर्षाश्च सवाहनाः.. 25.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / There, all those gods along with their retinues, full of joy and with their mounts, / entered and were honored by the snow-mountain. 25.1

1.3.s:
tatraiva ca mahāmātraṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā..
dīptyā paramayā yuktaṃ nivāsārthaṃ svayambhuvaḥ.. 25.2 ..
1.3.d:
तत्रैव च महामात्रं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा..
दीप्त्या परमया युक्तं निवासार्थं स्वयम्भुवः.. 25.2 ..
1.3.m: And right there, an immense [mansion] endowed with supreme radiance / was built by Viśvakarman for the residence of the self-manifest [Brahmā]. 25.2

1.3.s:
tathaiva viṣṇostvaparaṃ bhavanaṃ svayameva hi..
bhāsvaraṃ suvicitra ca kṛtaṃ tvaṣṭrā manoramam..
vaṇḍīgṛhaṃ manojñaṃ ca tathaiva kṛtavānsvayam.. 25.3 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव विष्णोस्त्वपरं भवनं स्वयमेव हि..
भास्वरं सुविचित्र च कृतं त्वष्ट्रा मनोरमम्..
वण्डीगृहं मनोज्ञं च तथैव कृतवान्स्वयम्.. 25.3 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, another brilliant and very marvelous house, delightful to the mind, / was fashioned personally by Tvaṣṭṛ for Viṣṇu; / and likewise he himself made an attractive storehouse. 25.3

1.3.s:
tathaiva śvetaṃ paramaṃ manojñaṃ mahāprabhaṃ devavaraiḥ supūjitam..
kailāsalakṣmīprabhayā mahatyā suśobhitaṃ tadbhavanaṃ cakāra.. 25.4 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव श्वेतं परमं मनोज्ञं महाप्रभं देववरैः सुपूजितम्..
कैलासलक्ष्मीप्रभया महत्या सुशोभितं तद्भवनं चकार.. 25.4 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, he fashioned that white, supreme, charming mansion of great splendor, / highly revered by the best of the gods and well-adorned with the great luster and beauty of Kailāsa. 25.4

1.3.s: tatraiva śaṃbhuḥ parayā vibhūtyā sa sthāpitastena himādriṇā vai.. 25.5 ..
1.3.d: तत्रैव शंभुः परया विभूत्या स स्थापितस्तेन हिमाद्रिणा वै.. 25.5 ..
1.3.m: Right there, Śambhu was indeed installed with supreme majesty by that snow-mountain. 25.5

1.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare menā samāyātā sakhīgaṇaiḥ..
nīrājanārthaṃ śaṃbhuṃ ca ṛṣibhiḥ parivāritā.. 25.6 ..
1.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे मेना समायाता सखीगणैः..
नीराजनार्थं शंभुं च ऋषिभिः परिवारिता.. 25.6 ..
1.3.m: In the meantime, Menā arrived with hosts of female companions / and surrounded by seers, in order to perform the wave-offering of lights for Śambhu. 25.6

1.3.s:
tadā vāditradirghopairnāditaṃ bhuvanatrayam..
nīrājanaṃ kṛtaṃ tasya menayā ca tapasvinaḥ.. 25.7 ..
1.3.d:
तदा वादित्रदिर्घोपैर्नादितं भुवनत्रयम्..
नीराजनं कृतं तस्य मेनया च तपस्विनः.. 25.7 ..
1.3.m: Then, with long sounds of musical instruments, the three worlds were made to resound; / and the wave-offering of lights was performed by Menā for that ascetic. 25.7

1.3.s:
avalokya parā sādhvī menā'jānāddharaṃ tadā..
girijoktamanusmṛtya menā vismayamāgatā.. 25.8 ..
1.3.d:
अवलोक्य परा साध्वी मेनाऽजानाद्धरं तदा..
गिरिजोक्तमनुस्मृत्य मेना विस्मयमागता.. 25.8 ..
1.3.m: Looking at him, the supremely chaste Menā then recognized Hara; / remembering what Girijā had said, Menā was filled with wonder:

1.3.s:
yadvai puroktaṃ ca tayā pārvatyā mama sannidhau..
tato'dhikaṃ prapaśyāmi sauṃdaryaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ..
maheśasya mayā dṛṣṭamanirvācyaṃ ca saṃprati.. 25.9 ..
1.3.d:
यद्वै पुरोक्तं च तया पार्वत्या मम सन्निधौ..
ततोऽधिकं प्रपश्यामि सौंदर्यं परमेष्ठिनः..
महेशस्य मया दृष्टमनिर्वाच्यं च संप्रति.. 25.9 ..
1.3.m: "Indeed, what was spoken before by Pārvatī in my presence— / I see the beauty of the Supreme Lord to be even greater than that; / the beauty of Maheśa seen by me now is beyond description."

1.3.s:
evaṃ vismayamāpannā viprapatnībhirāvṛtā..
ahatāṃ barayugmena śobhitā varavarṇinī.. 25.10 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विस्मयमापन्ना विप्रपत्नीभिरावृता..
अहतां बरयुग्मेन शोभिता वरवर्णिनी.. 25.10 ..
1.3.m: Having thus fallen into wonder, surrounded by the wives of the brahmins, / adorned with a pair of unwashed garments, the fair-complexioned lady—

1.3.s:
kaṃcukī paramā divyā nānāratnaiśca śobhitā..
aṃgīkṛtā tadā devyā rarāja parayā śriyā.. 25.11 ..
1.3.d:
कंचुकी परमा दिव्या नानारत्नैश्च शोभिता..
अंगीकृता तदा देव्या रराज परया श्रिया.. 25.11 ..
1.3.m: a supremely divine bodice, adorned with various gems, / was then put on by the goddess; she shone with supreme splendor.

1.3.s:
bibhratī ca tadā hāraṃ divyaratnavibhūṣitam..
valayāni mahārhāṇi śuddhacāmīkarāṇi ca.. 25.12 ..
1.3.d:
बिभ्रती च तदा हारं दिव्यरत्नविभूषितम्..
वलयानि महार्हाणि शुद्धचामीकराणि च.. 25.12 ..
1.3.m: And then she wore a necklace adorned with divine gems, / and costly bracelets made of pure gold.

1.3.s:
tatropaviṣṭā subhagā dhyāyaṃtī parameśvaram..
sakhībhiḥ sevyamānā sā viprapatnībhireva ca.. 25.13 ..
1.3.d:
तत्रोपविष्टा सुभगा ध्यायंती परमेश्वरम्..
सखीभिः सेव्यमाना सा विप्रपत्नीभिरेव च.. 25.13 ..
1.3.m: Seated there, the fortunate lady, meditating on the Supreme Lord, / being attended upon by her female companions and by the wives of the brahmins—

1.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare tatra gargo vākyamabhāṣata..
pāṇigrahārthaṃ śaṃbhuṃ ca ānayadhvaṃ svamaṃdiram..
tvaritenaiva velāyāmasyāmeva vicakṣaṇāḥ.. 25.14 ..
1.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र गर्गो वाक्यमभाषत..
पाणिग्रहार्थं शंभुं च आनयध्वं स्वमंदिरम्..
त्वरितेनैव वेलायामस्यामेव विचक्षणाः.. 25.14 ..
1.3.m: at that moment, Garga spoke these words: / "Bring Śambhu to your palace for taking [her] hand, / with all haste at this very hour, O wise ones!"

1.3.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya gargasya ca mahātmanaḥ..
abhyutthānaparāḥ sarve parvatāḥ sakalatrakāḥ.. 25.15 ..
1.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य गर्गस्य च महात्मनः..
अभ्युत्थानपराः सर्वे पर्वताः सकलत्रकाः.. 25.15 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that speech of the high-souled Garga, / all the mountains together with their wives rose up ready [to depart].

1.3.s:
mahāvibhūtyā saṃyuktāḥ sarve maṃgalapāṇayaḥ..
sālaṃkṛtāstadā teṣāṃ patnyolaṃkāramaṃḍitāḥ.. 25.16 ..
1.3.d:
महाविभूत्या संयुक्ताः सर्वे मंगलपाणयः..
सालंकृतास्तदा तेषां पत्न्योलंकारमंडिताः.. 25.16 ..
1.3.m: Possessed of great magnificence, all holding auspicious articles in their hands, / well-ornamented at that time, their wives adorned with ornaments,

1.3.s:
upāyanānyanekāni jagṛhuḥ snigdhalocanāḥ..
tadā vāditraghoṣeṇa brahmaghoṣeṇa bhūyasā.. 25.17 ..
1.3.d:
उपायनान्यनेकानि जगृहुः स्निग्धलोचनाः..
तदा वादित्रघोषेण ब्रह्मघोषेण भूयसा.. 25.17 ..
1.3.m: with affectionate eyes, they took many gifts. / Then, amidst the sound of musical instruments and the loud chanting of the Veda,

1.3.s:
ājagmuḥ sakalātrāste yatra devo maheśvaraḥ..
pramathairāvṛtastatra caṃḍyā caivābhisevitaḥ.. 25.18 ..
1.3.d:
आजग्मुः सकलात्रास्ते यत्र देवो महेश्वरः..
प्रमथैरावृतस्तत्र चंड्या चैवाभिसेवितः.. 25.18 ..
1.3.m: they all arrived there with their wives, where the divine Lord Maheśvara was, / surrounded by the pramathas and attended upon by Caṇḍī,

1.3.s:
tathā maharṣibhistatra tathā devagaṇaiḥ saha..
ebhiḥ parivṛtaḥ śrīmāñchaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ.. 25.19 ..
1.3.d:
तथा महर्षिभिस्तत्र तथा देवगणैः सह..
एभिः परिवृतः श्रीमाञ्छंकरो लोकशंकरः.. 25.19 ..
1.3.m: as well as by the great seers there, along with the hosts of gods. / Surrounded by these, the glorious Śaṃkara, who brings welfare to the world,

1.3.s:
śrutvā vāditranirghoṣaṃ sarve śaṃkarasevakāḥ..
utthitā aikāpadyena devairṛṣibhirāvṛtāḥ.. 25.20 ..
1.3.d:
श्रुत्वा वादित्रनिर्घोषं सर्वे शंकरसेवकाः..
उत्थिता ऐकापद्येन देवैरृषिभिरावृताः.. 25.20 ..
1.3.m: hearing the sound of musical instruments, all Śaṃkara's attendants / stood up as one, surrounded by gods and seers.

1.3.s:
tathodyato yoginācakrayuktā gaṇā gaṇānāṃ gaṇānāṃ patirekavarcasām..
śivaṃpuraskṛtya tadānubhāvāstathaiva sarve gaṇanāyakāśca.. 25.21 ..
1.3.d:
तथोद्यतो योगिनाचक्रयुक्ता गणा गणानां गणानां पतिरेकवर्चसाम्..
शिवंपुरस्कृत्य तदानुभावास्तथैव सर्वे गणनायकाश्च.. 25.21 ..
1.3.m: Likewise prepared, accompanied by the circle of yoginīs, the hosts of attendants, and the single lord of the hosts of unique splendor, / having placed Śiva in the forefront, those of great power and likewise all the leaders of the hosts,

1.3.s:
tadyoginī cakramatipracaṃḍaṃ ṭaṃkārabherīravanisvanena..
caṃḍīṃ puraskṛtya bhayānakāṃ tadā mahāvibhūtyā samalaṃkṛtāṃ tadā.. 25.22 ..
1.3.d:
तद्योगिनी चक्रमतिप्रचंडं टंकारभेरीरवनिस्वनेन..
चंडीं पुरस्कृत्य भयानकां तदा महाविभूत्या समलंकृतां तदा.. 25.22 ..
1.3.m: that exceedingly fierce circle of yoginīs, with the clang and roar of kettle-drums, / placing the fearsome Caṇḍī in front, then adorned with great magnificence,

1.3.s:
kaṃṭhe karkoṭakaṃ nāgaṃ hārabhūtaṃ ca kāra sā..
padakaṃ vṛścikānāṃ ca daṃdaśūkāṃśca bibhratī.. 25.23 ..
1.3.d:
कंठे कर्कोटकं नागं हारभूतं च कार सा..
पदकं वृश्चिकानां च दंदशूकांश्च बिभ्रती.. 25.23 ..
1.3.m: she made the serpent Karkoṭaka into a necklace at her throat, / wearing a pendant of scorpions and venomous serpents.

1.3.s:
karṇāvataṃsānsā dadhre pāṇipādamayāṃstathā..
raṇe hatānāṃ vīrāṇāṃ śirāṃsyurasicāparān.. 25.24 ..
1.3.d:
कर्णावतंसान्सा दध्रे पाणिपादमयांस्तथा..
रणे हतानां वीराणां शिरांस्युरसिचापरान्.. 25.24 ..
1.3.m: She wore ear-ornaments made of hands and feet, / and on her chest the heads of other heroes slain in battle.

1.3.s:
dvīpicarmaparīdhānā yoginīcakrasaṃyutā..
kṣetrapālāvṛtā tadvadbhairavaiḥ parivāritā.. 25.25 ..
1.3.d:
द्वीपिचर्मपरीधाना योगिनीचक्रसंयुता..
क्षेत्रपालावृता तद्वद्भैरवैः परिवारिता.. 25.25 ..
1.3.m: Clad in a leopard skin, joined by the circle of yoginīs, / surrounded by the guardian of the sacred field, and likewise enclosed by the bhairavas,

1.3.s:
tathā pretaiśca bhūtaiśca kapaṭaiḥ parivāritā..
vīrabhadrādayaścaiva gaṇāḥ paramadāruṇāḥ..
ye dakṣayajñanāśārthe śivenājñāpitāstadā.. 25.26 ..
1.3.d:
तथा प्रेतैश्च भूतैश्च कपटैः परिवारिता..
वीरभद्रादयश्चैव गणाः परमदारुणाः..
ये दक्षयज्ञनाशार्थे शिवेनाज्ञापितास्तदा.. 25.26 ..
1.3.m: surrounded likewise by pretas, bhūtas, and kapaṭas, / and the exceedingly dreadful attendants headed by Vīrabhadra, / who had then been ordered by Śiva for the destruction of Dakṣa's sacrifice;

1.3.s:
tathā kālī bhairavī ca māyā caiva bhayāvahā..
tripurā ca jayā caiva tathā kṣemakarī śubhā.. 25.27 ..
1.3.d:
तथा काली भैरवी च माया चैव भयावहा..
त्रिपुरा च जया चैव तथा क्षेमकरी शुभा.. 25.27 ..
1.3.m: and likewise Kālī, Bhairavī, and terrifying Māyā, / Tripurā, Jayā, and the auspicious Kṣemakarī,

1.3.s:
anyāścaiva tathā sarvāḥ puraskṛtya sadāśivam..
gaṃtukāmāścogratarā bhūtaiḥ pretaiḥ samāvṛtāḥ.. 25.28 ..
1.3.d:
अन्याश्चैव तथा सर्वाः पुरस्कृत्य सदाशिवम्..
गंतुकामाश्चोग्रतरा भूतैः प्रेतैः समावृताः.. 25.28 ..
1.3.m: and all the other exceedingly fierce [goddesses], placing Sadāśiva in front, / were eager to go, surrounded by bhūtas and pretas.

1.3.s:
etāḥ sarvā vilokyātha śivabhakto janārddanaḥ..
maharṣīśca puraskṛtya hyamarāṃśca tathaiva ca..
anasūyāṃ puraskṛtya tathaiva ca hyaruṃdhatīm.. 25.29 ..
1.3.d:
एताः सर्वा विलोक्याथ शिवभक्तो जनार्द्दनः..
महर्षीश्च पुरस्कृत्य ह्यमरांश्च तथैव च..
अनसूयां पुरस्कृत्य तथैव च ह्यरुंधतीम्.. 25.29 ..
1.3.m: Beholding all these, Janārdana, devoted to Śiva, / placing the great seers in front, and likewise the immortals, / placing Anasūyā in front, and likewise Arundhatī—

1.3.s:
..viṣṇuruvāca..
caṇḍīṃ kuru samīpasthāṃ lokapālanatāṃ prabho.. 25.30 ..
1.3.d:
..विष्णुरुवाच..
चण्डीं कुरु समीपस्थां लोकपालनतां प्रभो.. 25.30 ..
1.3.m: Viṣṇu said: / "Keep Caṇḍī near yourself, who brings bowing reverence to the world-protectors, O Lord!"

1.3.s:
taduktaṃ viṣṇunā vākyaṃ niśamya jagadīśvaraḥ..
uvāca prahasanneva caṃḍīṃ prati sadāśivaḥ.. 25.31 ..
1.3.d:
तदुक्तं विष्णुना वाक्यं निशम्य जगदीश्वरः..
उवाच प्रहसन्नेव चंडीं प्रति सदाशिवः.. 25.31 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that speech uttered by Viṣṇu, the Lord of the Universe, / Sadāśiva, smiling, spoke to Caṇḍī:

1.3.s:
atraiva sthīyatāṃ caṃḍīṃ yāvadudvahanaṃ bhavet..
mama bhāvānvijānāsi kāryākārye suśobhane.. 25.32 ..
1.3.d:
अत्रैव स्थीयतां चंडीं यावदुद्वहनं भवेत्..
मम भावान्विजानासि कार्याकार्ये सुशोभने.. 25.32 ..
1.3.m: "Stay right here, O Caṇḍī, until the wedding takes place; / you understand my intentions regarding what is to be done and what is not to be done, O very fair one!"

1.3.s:
evamākarṇya vacanaṃ śaṃbhoramitatejasaḥ..
uvāca kupitā caṃḍī viṣṇumuddiśya sādaram.. 25.33 ..
1.3.d:
एवमाकर्ण्य वचनं शंभोरमिततेजसः..
उवाच कुपिता चंडी विष्णुमुद्दिश्य सादरम्.. 25.33 ..
1.3.m: Hearing this speech of Śambhu of immeasurable splendor, / Caṇḍī, enraged, addressed Viṣṇu with respect.

1.3.s:
tathānye pramathāḥ sarve viṣṇumūcuḥ prakopitāḥ..
yatrayatra śivo bhāti tatratatra vayaṃ prabho.. 25.34 ..
1.3.d:
तथान्ये प्रमथाः सर्वे विष्णुमूचुः प्रकोपिताः..
यत्रयत्र शिवो भाति तत्रतत्र वयं प्रभो.. 25.34 ..
1.3.m: And likewise all the other pramathas, greatly angered, said to Viṣṇu: / "Wherever Śiva shines, there we are, O Lord!

1.3.s:
tvayā nivāritāḥ kasmādvayamābhyudaye pare..
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā keśavovākyamabravīt.. 25.35 ..
1.3.d:
त्वया निवारिताः कस्माद्वयमाभ्युदये परे..
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा केशवोवाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 25.35 ..
1.3.m: Why have we been stopped by you on this supreme festive occasion?" / Hearing those words of theirs, Keśava spoke:

1.3.s:
caṇḍīmuddiśya pramathānanyāṃścaiva tathāvidhān..
yūyaṃ caiva mayā proktā mā kopaṃ karttumarhatha.. 25.36 ..
1.3.d:
चण्डीमुद्दिश्य प्रमथानन्यांश्चैव तथाविधान्..
यूयं चैव मया प्रोक्ता मा कोपं कर्त्तुमर्हथ.. 25.36 ..
1.3.m: Addressing Caṇḍī, the pramathas, and the others of that kind: / "You have been addressed by me [for a reason]; you ought not to be angry."

1.3.s:
evamuktāstadā tena caṃḍīmukhyā gaṇāstadā..
ekāṃtamāśritāḥ sarve viṣṇuvākyājjvaladdhṛdaḥ.. 25.37 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्तास्तदा तेन चंडीमुख्या गणास्तदा..
एकांतमाश्रिताः सर्वे विष्णुवाक्याज्ज्वलद्धृदः.. 25.37 ..
1.3.m: Thus addressed by him then, the attendants headed by Caṇḍī, / their hearts burning because of Viṣṇu's words, all resorted to seclusion.

1.3.s:
tāvatsarve samāyātāḥ parvateṃdrasya maṃtriṇaḥ..
sakalatrāḥ saṃbhrameṇa maheśaṃ prati satvaram.. 25.38 ..
1.3.d:
तावत्सर्वे समायाताः पर्वतेंद्रस्य मंत्रिणः..
सकलत्राः संभ्रमेण महेशं प्रति सत्वरम्.. 25.38 ..
1.3.m: Meanwhile, all the ministers of the king of mountains, / together with their wives, quickly came in haste toward Maheśa.

1.3.s:
paṃcavādyapraghoṣeṇa brahmaghoṣeṇa bhūyasā..
yoṣidbhiḥ saṃvṛtāstatra gītaśabdena bhūyasā.. 25.39 ..
1.3.d:
पंचवाद्यप्रघोषेण ब्रह्मघोषेण भूयसा..
योषिद्भिः संवृतास्तत्र गीतशब्देन भूयसा.. 25.39 ..
1.3.m: With the sound of five musical instruments, with the loud chanting of the Veda, / surrounded by women there, with a great sound of singing,

1.3.s:
evaṃ prāptā yatra śaṃbhuḥ sakalaiḥ parivāritaḥ..
āgatya kalaśaiḥ sākaṃ snāpito hi sadāśivaḥ..
strībhirmaṃgalagītena sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ.. 25.40 ..
1.3.d:
एवं प्राप्ता यत्र शंभुः सकलैः परिवारितः..
आगत्य कलशैः साकं स्नापितो हि सदाशिवः..
स्त्रीभिर्मंगलगीतेन सर्वाभरणभूषितः.. 25.40 ..
1.3.m: they thus arrived where Śambhu was, surrounded by all. / Having arrived, Sadāśiva was indeed bathed with jars / by the women with auspicious songs, and adorned with all ornaments.

1.3.s:
ṛṣayo devagaṃdharvāstathānye parvatottamāḥ..
śaṃbhyagragāstadā jagmuḥ striyaścaiva supūjitāḥ..
babhau chatreṇa mahatā dhrimāṇena mūrddhani.. 25.41 ..
1.3.d:
ऋषयो देवगंधर्वास्तथान्ये पर्वतोत्तमाः..
शंभ्यग्रगास्तदा जग्मुः स्त्रियश्चैव सुपूजिताः..
बभौ छत्रेण महता ध्रिमाणेन मूर्द्धनि.. 25.41 ..
1.3.m: The seers, gods, gandharvas, and other excellent mountains / went before Śambhu, and the well-honored women also; / he shone with a great parasol being held over his head.

1.3.s:
cāmarai vīrjyamāno'sau mukuṭena virājitaḥ..
brahmā viṣṇustathā caṃdro lokapālastathaiva ca.. 25.42 ..
1.3.d:
चामरै वीर्ज्यमानोऽसौ मुकुटेन विराजितः..
ब्रह्मा विष्णुस्तथा चंद्रो लोकपालस्तथैव च.. 25.42 ..
1.3.m: Being fanned with chowries, radiant with a diadem— / Brahmā, Viṣṇu, the Moon, and the world-protectors,

1.3.s:
agragā hyapi śobhaṃtaḥ śriyā paramayā yutāḥ..
tathā śaṃkhāśca bheryaśca paṭahānakagomukhāḥ.. 25.43 ..
1.3.d:
अग्रगा ह्यपि शोभंतः श्रिया परमया युताः..
तथा शंखाश्च भेर्यश्च पटहानकगोमुखाः.. 25.43 ..
1.3.m: going in front, also shone, endowed with supreme splendor; / and conches, kettle-drums, paṭahas, ānakas, and gomukhas,

1.3.s:
tathaiva gāyakāḥ sarve paramamaṃgalam..
punaḥ punaravādyaṃta vāditrāṇi mahotsave.. 25.44 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव गायकाः सर्वे परममंगलम्..
पुनः पुनरवाद्यंत वादित्राणि महोत्सवे.. 25.44 ..
1.3.m: and likewise all the singers [sang] the supreme blessing. / Again and again the musical instruments were played at the great festival.

1.3.s:
aruṃdhatī mahābhāgā anasūyā tathaiva ca..
sāvitrī ca tathā lakṣmīrmātṛbhiḥ parivāritāḥ.. 25.45 ..
1.3.d:
अरुंधती महाभागा अनसूया तथैव च..
सावित्री च तथा लक्ष्मीर्मातृभिः परिवारिताः.. 25.45 ..
1.3.m: The highly fortunate Arundhatī, and likewise Anasūyā, / Sāvitrī, and Lakṣmī, surrounded by the divine mothers—

1.3.s:
ebhiḥ sameto jagadekabaṃdhurbabhau tadānīṃ parameṇa varcasā..
sacaṃdrasūryānilavāyunā vṛtaḥ salokapālapravarairmaharṣibhiḥ.. 25.46 ..
1.3.d:
एभिः समेतो जगदेकबंधुर्बभौ तदानीं परमेण वर्चसा..
सचंद्रसूर्यानिलवायुना वृतः सलोकपालप्रवरैर्महर्षिभिः.. 25.46 ..
1.3.m: accompanied by these, the sole kin of the universe shone at that time with supreme splendor, / surrounded by the Moon, the Sun, Anila, Vāyu, the eminent world-protectors, and the great seers.

1.3.s:
sa vījyamānaḥ pavanenaḥ sākṣācchatraṃ ca tasmai śaśinā hyadhiṣṭhitam..
sūryaḥ purastādabhavatprakāśakaḥ śriyānvito viṣṇurabhūcca sannidhau.. 25.47 ..
1.3.d:
स वीज्यमानः पवनेनः साक्षाच्छत्रं च तस्मै शशिना ह्यधिष्ठितम्..
सूर्यः पुरस्तादभवत्प्रकाशकः श्रियान्वितो विष्णुरभूच्च सन्निधौ.. 25.47 ..
1.3.m: He was fanned by the Wind in visible form, and a parasol was held over him by the Moon; / the Sun went before him as the illuminator, and Viṣṇu, endowed with splendor, was near him.

1.3.s:
puṣpairvavarṣurhyavakīryamāṇā devāstadānīṃ munibhiḥ sametāḥ..
yayau gṛhaṃ kāṃcanakuṭṭimaṃ mahanmahāvi bhūtyāpariśobhitaṃ tadā..
viveśa śaṃbhuḥ parayā saparyayā saṃpūjyamāno naradevadānavaiḥ.. 25.48 ..
1.3.d:
पुष्पैर्ववर्षुर्ह्यवकीर्यमाणा देवास्तदानीं मुनिभिः समेताः..
ययौ गृहं कांचनकुट्टिमं महन्महावि भूत्यापरिशोभितं तदा..
विवेश शंभुः परया सपर्यया संपूज्यमानो नरदेवदानवैः.. 25.48 ..
1.3.m: Scattered [about], the gods then showered flowers together with the sages. / He then approached the great mansion with a golden floor, adorned with immense magnificence. / Śambhu entered, being worshipped with supreme honor by humans, gods, and dānavas.

1.3.s:
evaṃ samāgataḥ śaṃbhuḥ praviṣṭo yajñamaṇḍapam..
saṃstūyamāno vibudhaiḥ stutibhiḥ parameśvaraḥ.. 25.49 ..
1.3.d:
एवं समागतः शंभुः प्रविष्टो यज्ञमण्डपम्..
संस्तूयमानो विबुधैः स्तुतिभिः परमेश्वरः.. 25.49 ..
1.3.m: Thus arrived, Śambhu, the supreme lord, entered the sacrificial pavilion, / being extolled with hymns of praise by the gods.

1.3.s:
gajāduttārayāmāsa maheśaṃ parvatottamaḥ..
upaviśya tataḥ pīṭhe kṛtvā nīrājanaṃ mahat.. 25.50 ..
1.3.d:
गजादुत्तारयामास महेशं पर्वतोत्तमः..
उपविश्य ततः पीठे कृत्वा नीराजनं महत्.. 25.50 ..
1.3.m: The foremost of mountains helped Maheśa dismount from the elephant. / Then, seating him upon a throne and performing a great waving of lights (nīrājana),

1.3.s:
menayā sakhibhiḥ sākaṃ tathaiva ca purodhasā..
madhuparkādikaṃ sarvaṃ yatkṛtaṃ caiva tatra vai.. 25.51 ..
1.3.d:
मेनया सखिभिः साकं तथैव च पुरोधसा..
मधुपर्कादिकं सर्वं यत्कृतं चैव तत्र वै.. 25.51 ..
1.3.m: along with Menā, with her companions, and likewise with the family priest, / [he performed] whatever [rites were customary] there, such as offering the honey-mixture (madhuparka).

1.3.s:
brahmaṇā noditaḥ sadyaḥ purodhāḥ kṛtavānprabhuḥ..
maṃgalaṃ śubhakalyāṇaṃ prastāvasadṛśaṃ bahu.. 25.52 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मणा नोदितः सद्यः पुरोधाः कृतवान्प्रभुः..
मंगलं शुभकल्याणं प्रस्तावसदृशं बहु.. 25.52 ..
1.3.m: Prompted at once by Brahmā, the powerful family priest performed / many auspicious ceremonies appropriate for the occasion.

1.3.s:
aṃtarvedyāṃ saṃpraveśya yatra sā pārvatī sthitā..
vedikopari tanvaṃgī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā.. 25.53 ..
1.3.d:
अंतर्वेद्यां संप्रवेश्य यत्र सा पार्वती स्थिता..
वेदिकोपरि तन्वंगी सर्वाभरणभूषिता.. 25.53 ..
1.3.m: Leading [him] into the inner altar-chamber where Pārvatī was standing / upon the altar-platform, the slender-limbed lady adorned with all ornaments,

1.3.s:
tatrānīto haraḥ sākṣādviṣṇunā brahmaṇā saha..
lagnaṃ nirīkṣamāṇāste vācaspatipurogamāḥ.. 25.54 ..
1.3.d:
तत्रानीतो हरः साक्षाद्विष्णुना ब्रह्मणा सह..
लग्नं निरीक्षमाणास्ते वाचस्पतिपुरोगमाः.. 25.54 ..
1.3.m: Hara was brought there in person together with Viṣṇu and Brahmā. / Those headed by Bṛhaspati, watching closely for the astrological moment (lagna),

1.3.s:
gargo muniścopaviṣṭastatraiva ghaṭikālaye..
yāvatpūrṇā ghaṭī jātā tāvatpraṇavabhāṣaṇam.. 25.55 ..
1.3.d:
गर्गो मुनिश्चोपविष्टस्तत्रैव घटिकालये..
यावत्पूर्णा घटी जाता तावत्प्रणवभाषणम्.. 25.55 ..
1.3.m: and the sage Garga sat right there at the water-clock. / As soon as the water-clock was filled, there was the chanting of the syllable Oṃ.

1.3.s:
oṃpuṇyeti praṇigadangargo vadhvaṃjaliṃ dadhe..
pārvatyakṣatapūrṇaṃ ca śivopari vavarṣa vai.. 25.56 ..
1.3.d:
ओंपुण्येति प्रणिगदन्गर्गो वध्वंजलिं दधे..
पार्वत्यक्षतपूर्णं च शिवोपरि ववर्ष वै.. 25.56 ..
1.3.m: Chanting “Oṃ, auspiciousness!”, Garga held the bride's folded hands; / filled with unbroken rice grains (akṣata), Pārvatī showered them upon Śiva.

1.3.s:
tayā saṃpūjito rudro dadhyakṣatakuśādibhiḥ..
mudā paramayā yuktā pārvatī rucirānanā.. 25.57 ..
1.3.d:
तया संपूजितो रुद्रो दध्यक्षतकुशादिभिः..
मुदा परमया युक्ता पार्वती रुचिरानना.. 25.57 ..
1.3.m: Rudra was worshipped by her with curds, unbroken grains, kuśa grass, and other items. / Endowed with supreme joy, Pārvatī of lovely countenance,

1.3.s:
vilokayaṃtī śaṃbhuṃ taṃ yadarthe paramaṃ tapaḥ..
kṛtaṃ purā mahādevyā pareṣāṃ paramaṃ mahat.. 25.58 ..
1.3.d:
विलोकयंती शंभुं तं यदर्थे परमं तपः..
कृतं पुरा महादेव्या परेषां परमं महत्.. 25.58 ..
1.3.m: gazing upon that Śambhu, for whose sake supreme austerity, / great beyond that of all others, had been performed of old by the great goddess,

1.3.s:
tapasā tena saṃprāpto jagajjīvanajīvanaḥ..
nāradena tataḥ prokto mahādevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ.. 25.59 ..
1.3.d:
तपसा तेन संप्राप्तो जगज्जीवनजीवनः..
नारदेन ततः प्रोक्तो महादेवो वृषध्वजः.. 25.59 ..
1.3.m: [rejoiced that] through that austerity, the life of the life of the world was obtained. / Then the great god, whose banner bears the bull, was addressed by Nārada,

1.3.s:
tathā gaṃgādibhiścanyairmunibhiḥ sanakādibhiḥ..
prati pūjāṃ kuru kṣipraṃ pārvatyāśca trilocana..
tadā śivena sā tanvī pūjitārghyākṣatādibhiḥ.. 25.60 ..
1.3.d:
तथा गंगादिभिश्चन्यैर्मुनिभिः सनकादिभिः..
प्रति पूजां कुरु क्षिप्रं पार्वत्याश्च त्रिलोचन..
तदा शिवेन सा तन्वी पूजितार्घ्याक्षतादिभिः.. 25.60 ..
1.3.m: as well as by the others headed by the Gaṅgā, and sages headed by Sanaka: / “Quickly return the worship unto Pārvatī, O three-eyed one!” / Then that slender lady was worshipped by Śiva with water for honor (arghya), unbroken grains, and the rest.

1.3.s:
evaṃ parasparaṃ tau ca pārvatīparameśvarau..
arcyamānau tadānīṃ ca śuśubhāte jaganmayau.. 25.61 ..
1.3.d:
एवं परस्परं तौ च पार्वतीपरमेश्वरौ..
अर्च्यमानौ तदानीं च शुशुभाते जगन्मयौ.. 25.61 ..
1.3.m: Thus, being worshipped mutually at that time, / both Pārvatī and Parameśvara, who embody the universe, shone resplendent,

1.3.s:
trailokyalakṣmyā saṃvītau nirīkṣaṃtau parasparam..
tadā nīrājitau lakṣmyā sāvitryā ca viśeṣataḥ..
aruṃdhatyā tadā tau ca daṃpatī parameśvarau.. 25.62 ..
1.3.d:
त्रैलोक्यलक्ष्म्या संवीतौ निरीक्षंतौ परस्परम्..
तदा नीराजितौ लक्ष्म्या सावित्र्या च विशेषतः..
अरुंधत्या तदा तौ च दंपती परमेश्वरौ.. 25.62 ..
1.3.m: enveloped in the splendor of the three worlds, looking at one another. / Then those two, the husband and wife, the supreme lords, were honored with lights by Lakṣmī, and especially by Sāvitrī, and by Arundhatī.

1.3.s:
anasūyā tathā śaṃbhuṃ pārvatīṃ ca yaśasvinīm..
dṛṣṭvā nīrājayāmāsa prītyutkalitalocanā.. 25.63 ..
1.3.d:
अनसूया तथा शंभुं पार्वतीं च यशस्विनीम्..
दृष्ट्वा नीराजयामास प्रीत्युत्कलितलोचना.. 25.63 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, beholding Śambhu and the illustrious Pārvatī, / Anasūyā performed the waving of lights, her eyes overflowing with affection.

1.3.s:
tathaiva sarvā dvijayoṣitaśca nīrājayāmāsuraho punaḥ punaḥ..
satīṃ ca śaṃbhuṃ ca vilokayaṃtyastathaiva sarvā muditā hasaṃtyaḥ.. 25.64 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव सर्वा द्विजयोषितश्च नीराजयामासुरहो पुनः पुनः..
सतीं च शंभुं च विलोकयंत्यस्तथैव सर्वा मुदिता हसंत्यः.. 25.64 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, all the wives of the twice-born performed the waving of lights, ah, again and again, / looking at Satī and Śambhu, all of them joyful and smiling.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
etasminnaṃtare tatra gargācāryapraṇoditaḥ..
himavānmenayā sārddhaṃ kanyāṃ dātuṃ pracakrame.. 25.65 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र गर्गाचार्यप्रणोदितः..
हिमवान्मेनया सार्द्धं कन्यां दातुं प्रचक्रमे.. 25.65 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Meanwhile, prompted there by the preceptor Garga, / Himavān, together with Menā, proceeded to give away the maiden.

1.3.s:
haimaṃ kalaśamādāya menā cārddhāṃ gāmāśritā..
himādreśca mahābhāgā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā.. 25.66 ..
1.3.d:
हैमं कलशमादाय मेना चार्द्धां गामाश्रिता..
हिमाद्रेश्च महाभागा सर्वाभरणभूषिता.. 25.66 ..
1.3.m: Taking a golden pitcher, Menā took her place at half the body / of Himādri, the illustrious lady adorned with all ornaments.

1.3.s:
tadā himādriṇā prokto viśvanātho varapradaḥ..
brahmaṇā saha saṃgatya viṣṇunā ca tathaiva ca.. 25.67 ..
1.3.d:
तदा हिमाद्रिणा प्रोक्तो विश्वनाथो वरप्रदः..
ब्रह्मणा सह संगत्य विष्णुना च तथैव च.. 25.67 ..
1.3.m: Then Himādri spoke to the lord of the universe, the bestower of boons, / having conferred with Brahmā and Viṣṇu likewise,

1.3.s:
sārddhaṃ purodhasā caiva gargeṇa sumahātmanā..
kanyādānaṃ karomyadya devadevasya śūlinaḥ.. 25.68 ..
1.3.d:
सार्द्धं पुरोधसा चैव गर्गेण सुमहात्मना..
कन्यादानं करोम्यद्य देवदेवस्य शूलिनः.. 25.68 ..
1.3.m: and together with the priest, the great-souled Garga: / “Today I perform the gift of the maiden to the god of gods, the wielder of the trident.

1.3.s:
prayogo bhaṇyatāṃ brahmannasminsamaya āgate..
tatheti matvā te sarve kālajñā dvijasattamāḥ.. 25.69 ..
1.3.d:
प्रयोगो भण्यतां ब्रह्मन्नस्मिन्समय आगते..
तथेति मत्वा ते सर्वे कालज्ञा द्विजसत्तमाः.. 25.69 ..
1.3.m: Let the ritual procedure be recited, O brahmin, now that this moment has arrived.” / Agreeing to this, all those foremost of twice-born, knowers of the proper time, [said]:

1.3.s:
kathyatāṃ tāta gotraṃ svaṃ kulaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ..
kathayasva mahābhāga ityākarṇya vacastathā..
sumukhena vimukhaḥ sadyo hyaśocyaḥ śocyatāṃ gataḥ.. 25.70 ..
1.3.d:
कथ्यतां तात गोत्रं स्वं कुलं चैव विशेषतः..
कथयस्व महाभाग इत्याकर्ण्य वचस्तथा..
सुमुखेन विमुखः सद्यो ह्यशोच्यः शोच्यतां गतः.. 25.70 ..
1.3.m: “Dear one, declare your lineage (gotra) and especially your family; / speak, O illustrious one!” Hearing that statement, / his cheerful face suddenly turned away, and he who was not to be pitied appeared pitiable.

1.3.s:
evaṃvidhaḥ suravarairṛṣibhistadānīṃ gaṃdharvayakṣamunisiddhagaṇaistathaiva..
dṛṣṭo niruttaramukho bhagavānmaheśo hāsyaṃ cakāra subhṛśaṃ tvatha nāradaśca.. 25.71 ..
1.3.d:
एवंविधः सुरवरैरृषिभिस्तदानीं गंधर्वयक्षमुनिसिद्धगणैस्तथैव..
दृष्टो निरुत्तरमुखो भगवान्महेशो हास्यं चकार सुभृशं त्वथ नारदश्च.. 25.71 ..
1.3.m: When the blessed Maheśa was thus seen speechless / by the foremost gods, the seers, and likewise by the hosts of gandharvas, yakṣas, munis, and siddhas, Nārada laughed very loudly.

1.3.s:
vīṇāṃ prakaṭayāmāsa brahmaputro'tha nāradaḥ..
tadānīṃ vārito dhīmānvīṇāṃ mā vādaya prabho.. 25.72 ..
1.3.d:
वीणां प्रकटयामास ब्रह्मपुत्रोऽथ नारदः..
तदानीं वारितो धीमान्वीणां मा वादय प्रभो.. 25.72 ..
1.3.m: Then Nārada, the son of Brahmā, brought forth his vīṇā. / At that moment, the wise one was stopped: “Do not play the vīṇā, O master!”

1.3.s:
ityuktaḥ parvatenaiva nārado vākyamabravīt..
tvayā pṛṣṭo bhavaḥ sākṣātsvagotrakathanaṃ prati.. 25.73 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युक्तः पर्वतेनैव नारदो वाक्यमब्रवीत्..
त्वया पृष्टो भवः साक्षात्स्वगोत्रकथनं प्रति.. 25.73 ..
1.3.m: Addressed thus by the Mountain, Nārada spoke these words: / “Bhava was questioned by you directly regarding the declaration of his gotra.

1.3.s:
asya gotraṃ kulaṃ caiva nāda eva paraṃ gire..
nāde pratiṣṭhitaḥ śaṃbhurnādo hyasminpratiṣṭhitaḥ.. 25.74 ..
1.3.d:
अस्य गोत्रं कुलं चैव नाद एव परं गिरे..
नादे प्रतिष्ठितः शंभुर्नादो ह्यस्मिन्प्रतिष्ठितः.. 25.74 ..
1.3.m: Sound (nāda) alone is his gotra and family, O mountain. / Śambhu is established in sound, and sound is established in him.

1.3.s:
tasmānnādamayaḥ śaṃbhurnādācca pratilabhyate..
tasmādvīṇā mayā cādya vāditā hi paraṃtapa.. 25.75 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मान्नादमयः शंभुर्नादाच्च प्रतिलभ्यते..
तस्माद्वीणा मया चाद्य वादिता हि परंतप.. 25.75 ..
1.3.m: Therefore Śambhu consists of sound, and through sound he is attained; / for that reason, O scorcher of foes, the vīṇā was played by me today.

1.3.s:
asya gotraṃ kulaṃ nāma na jānaṃti hi parvata..
brahmādayo hi vivudhā anyeṣāṃ caiva kā kathā.. 25.76 ..
1.3.d:
अस्य गोत्रं कुलं नाम न जानंति हि पर्वत..
ब्रह्मादयो हि विवुधा अन्येषां चैव का कथा.. 25.76 ..
1.3.m: Neither the gods headed by Brahmā know his gotra, family, or name, O mountain; / what then to say of others?

1.3.s:
tvaṃ hi mūḍhatvamāpanno na jānāsi hi kiṃcana..
vācyāvācyaṃ maheśasya viṣayā hi bahirmukhāḥ.. 25.77 ..
1.3.d:
त्वं हि मूढत्वमापन्नो न जानासि हि किंचन..
वाच्यावाच्यं महेशस्य विषया हि बहिर्मुखाः.. 25.77 ..
1.3.m: You have fallen into ignorance and know nothing at all; / the [qualities] to be spoken or unspoken of Maheśa are beyond worldly perception, for senses face outward.

1.3.s:
yeye āgamikāścādre naṣṭāste nātra saṃśayaḥ..
arūpoyaṃ virūpākṣo hyakulīno'yamucyate.. 25.78 ..
1.3.d:
येये आगमिकाश्चाद्रे नष्टास्ते नात्र संशयः..
अरूपोयं विरूपाक्षो ह्यकुलीनोऽयमुच्यते.. 25.78 ..
1.3.m: Whichever traditionalists [speak otherwise], O mountain, are ruined, there is no doubt of this. / He is formless, yet odd-eyed (virūpākṣa); he is spoken of as having no lineage (akulīna).

1.3.s:
agotro'yaṃ giriśreṣṭha jāmātā te na saṃśayaḥ..
na karttavyo vimarśo'tra bhavatā vibudhena hi.. 25.79 ..
1.3.d:
अगोत्रोऽयं गिरिश्रेष्ठ जामाता ते न संशयः..
न कर्त्तव्यो विमर्शोऽत्र भवता विबुधेन हि.. 25.79 ..
1.3.m: He is without gotra (agotra), O best of mountains, your son-in-law, without doubt. / No hesitation should be made here by you, an intelligent one.

1.3.s:
na jānaṃti haraṃ sarve kiṃ bahūktyā mama prabho..
yasyājñānānmahābhāga mohitā ṛṣayo hyamī.. 25.80 ..
1.3.d:
न जानंति हरं सर्वे किं बहूक्त्या मम प्रभो..
यस्याज्ञानान्महाभाग मोहिता ऋषयो ह्यमी.. 25.80 ..
1.3.m: All do not know Hara—what is the use of my speaking much, O lord? / Through ignorance of him, O illustrious one, these seers have been bewildered.

1.3.s:
brahmāpi taṃ na jānāti mastakaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ..
viṣṇurgato hi pātālaṃ na dṛṣṭo hi tathaiva ca.. 25.81 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मापि तं न जानाति मस्तकं परमेष्ठिनः..
विष्णुर्गतो हि पातालं न दृष्टो हि तथैव च.. 25.81 ..
1.3.m: Even Brahmā does not know the head of the supreme lord; / Viṣṇu went to Pātāla, and likewise did not see [the base].

1.3.s:
tena liṃgena mahatā hyagādhena jagattrayam..
vyāptamastīti tadviddhi kimanena prayojanam.. 25.82 ..
1.3.d:
तेन लिंगेन महता ह्यगाधेन जगत्त्रयम्..
व्याप्तमस्तीति तद्विद्धि किमनेन प्रयोजनम्.. 25.82 ..
1.3.m: Know that the three worlds are pervaded by that great, bottomless liṅga! / What is the use of this [questioning about gotra]?

1.3.s:
anayārādhitaṃ nūnaṃ tava putryā himālaya..
tattvato hi na jānāsi kathaṃ caiva mahāgire.. 25.83 ..
1.3.d:
अनयाराधितं नूनं तव पुत्र्या हिमालय..
तत्त्वतो हि न जानासि कथं चैव महागिरे.. 25.83 ..
1.3.m: He was surely propitiated by this daughter of yours, O Himālaya. / How is it that you truly do not know him, O great mountain?

1.3.s:
ābhyāmutpādyate viśvamābhyāṃ caiva pratiṣṭhitam..
etacchrutvā vacastasya nāradasya mahātmanaḥ.. 25.84 ..
1.3.d:
आभ्यामुत्पाद्यते विश्वमाभ्यां चैव प्रतिष्ठितम्..
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य नारदस्य महात्मनः.. 25.84 ..
1.3.m: By these two the universe is generated, and by these two it is sustained.” / Hearing this speech of that great-souled Nārada,

1.3.s:
himādripramukhāḥ sarve tathā ceṃdrapurogamāḥ..
sādhusādhviti te sarve ūcurvismitamānasāḥ.. 25.85 ..
1.3.d:
हिमाद्रिप्रमुखाः सर्वे तथा चेंद्रपुरोगमाः..
साधुसाध्विति ते सर्वे ऊचुर्विस्मितमानसाः.. 25.85 ..
1.3.m: all [the guests] headed by Himādri, as well as those led by Indra, / with astonished minds, all said, “Well done! Well done!”

1.3.s:
īśvarasya tu gāṃbhīryaṃ jñātvā sarve vicakṣaṇāḥ..
vismayena samāśliṣṭā ūcuḥ sarve parasparam.. 25.86 ..
1.3.d:
ईश्वरस्य तु गांभीर्यं ज्ञात्वा सर्वे विचक्षणाः..
विस्मयेन समाश्लिष्टा ऊचुः सर्वे परस्परम्.. 25.86 ..
1.3.m: Knowing the profound depth of Īśvara, all the wise ones, / embraced by wonder, spoke to one another.

1.3.s:
..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
yasyājñayā jagadidaṃ ca viśālameva jātaṃ parātparamidaṃ nijabodharūpam..
sarvaṃ svataṃtraparameśvarabhāgamyaṃ so'sau trilokanijarūpayuto mahātmā.. 25.87 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe śivaśāstre śivapārvatīvivāhavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 25 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
..ऋषय ऊचुः..
यस्याज्ञया जगदिदं च विशालमेव जातं परात्परमिदं निजबोधरूपम्..
सर्वं स्वतंत्रपरमेश्वरभागम्यं सोऽसौ त्रिलोकनिजरूपयुतो महात्मा.. 25.87 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखंडे शिवशास्त्रे शिवपार्वतीविवाहवर्णनंनाम पंचविंशोऽध्यायः.. 25 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
The seers said: / “By whose command this vast world has arisen, which is beyond the highest, possessing the nature of his own consciousness, / accessible through devotion to the independent supreme lord—he is this great-souled one, endowed with the true form of the three worlds.”
Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Marriage of Śiva and Pārvatī," in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the Śiva-śāstra of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
atha te parvataśreṣṭhā mervādyā jātasaṃbhramāḥ..
ūcuste caikapadyena himavaṃtaṃ mahāgirim.. 26.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
अथ ते पर्वतश्रेष्ठा मेर्वाद्या जातसंभ्रमाः..
ऊचुस्ते चैकपद्येन हिमवंतं महागिरिम्.. 26.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Then those best of mountains, headed by Meru, filled with agitation, / spoke with one voice to the great mountain Himavat:

1.3.s:
..parvatā ūcuḥ..
kanyādānaṃ kriyatāṃ cādya śaila śrīmāñchambhurbhāgyataste'dya labdhaḥ..
hṛnmadhye vai nātra kāryo vimarśastasmādeṣā dīyatāmīśvarāya.. 26.2 ..
1.3.d:
..पर्वता ऊचुः..
कन्यादानं क्रियतां चाद्य शैल श्रीमाञ्छम्भुर्भाग्यतस्तेऽद्य लब्धः..
हृन्मध्ये वै नात्र कार्यो विमर्शस्तस्मादेषा दीयतामीश्वराय.. 26.2 ..
1.3.m: The mountains said: / "O mountain, let the giving away of the bride be performed today! By your good fortune the glorious Śambhu has been obtained today. / No doubt or hesitation should be held in your heart regarding this; therefore, let her be given to Īśvara!"

1.3.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ teṣāṃ suhṛdāṃ vai himālayaḥ..
samyaksaṃkalpamakarodbrahmamā noditastadā..
imāṃ kanyāṃ tubhyamahaṃ dadāmi parameśvara.. 26.3 ..
1.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषां सुहृदां वै हिमालयः..
सम्यक्संकल्पमकरोद्ब्रह्ममा नोदितस्तदा..
इमां कन्यां तुभ्यमहं ददामि परमेश्वर.. 26.3 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that speech of his friends, Himālaya / then made the proper solemn resolve, prompted by Brahmā: / "I give this maiden to you, O Parameśvara,

1.3.s:
bhāryārthaṃ pratigṛhṇīṣvamaṃtreṇānena dattavān..
asmai rudrāya mahate devadavāya śaṃbhava..
kanyā dattā maheśāya girīṃdreṇa mahātmanā.. 26.4 ..
1.3.d:
भार्यार्थं प्रतिगृह्णीष्वमंत्रेणानेन दत्तवान्..
अस्मै रुद्राय महते देवदवाय शंभव..
कन्या दत्ता महेशाय गिरींद्रेण महात्मना.. 26.4 ..
1.3.m: accept her as your wife!" With this formula he gave [her]. / "To this Rudra, the great one, the god of gods, to Śambhu—" / the maiden was given to Maheśa by the great-souled king of mountains.

1.3.s:
vedyāṃ ca bahirānītau daṃpatīva kamalekṣaṇau..
upaveśitau bahirvedyāṃ pārvatīparameśvarau.. 26.5 ..
1.3.d:
वेद्यां च बहिरानीतौ दंपतीव कमलेक्षणौ..
उपवेशितौ बहिर्वेद्यां पार्वतीपरमेश्वरौ.. 26.5 ..
1.3.m: The lotus-eyed couple, Pārvatī and Parameśvara, / were brought out to the sacrificial altar and seated upon the outer altar.

1.3.s:
ācāryeṇātha tatraiva kaśyapena mahātmanā..
āhvānaṃ havanārthāya kṛtamagnestadā dvijāḥ.. 26.6 ..
1.3.d:
आचार्येणाथ तत्रैव कश्यपेन महात्मना..
आह्वानं हवनार्थाय कृतमग्नेस्तदा द्विजाः.. 26.6 ..
1.3.m: Then, right there, by the officiating priest, the great-souled Kaśyapa, / an invocation of the sacrificial fire was performed for the burnt offering, O twice-born.

1.3.s:
brahmā brahmāsanagato babhūva śivasannidhau..
pravartamāne havana ṛṣayaśca vicakṣaṇāḥ.. 26.7 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मासनगतो बभूव शिवसन्निधौ..
प्रवर्तमाने हवन ऋषयश्च विचक्षणाः.. 26.7 ..
1.3.m: Brahmā took his seat on the brahmāsana in the presence of Śiva. / As the burnt offering proceeded, the discerning seers,

1.3.s:
ūcuḥ parasparaṃ tatra nānādarśanavedinaḥ..
vedavādaratāḥ kecidavadansaṃmatena vai.. 26.8 ..
1.3.d:
ऊचुः परस्परं तत्र नानादर्शनवेदिनः..
वेदवादरताः केचिदवदन्संमतेन वै.. 26.8 ..
1.3.m: knowers of various philosophical systems, spoke to one another there. / Some, devoted to Vedic debates, argued by mutual consensus:

1.3.s:
evameva na cāpyevamevameva na cānyathā..
kāryameva na vā kāryaṃ kāryākāryaṃ tathā pare.. 26.9 ..
1.3.d:
एवमेव न चाप्येवमेवमेव न चान्यथा..
कार्यमेव न वा कार्यं कार्याकार्यं तथा परे.. 26.9 ..
1.3.m: "It is certainly thus, and not thus"; "It is definitely thus, not otherwise"; / "It is indeed an obligation, or not an obligation"; and others [debated] what is to be done and what is not to be done.

1.3.s:
ityevaṃ bruvatāṃ śabdaḥ śrūyate śivasannidhau..
svakīyaṃ matamāsthāya hyabruvaṃste parasparam..
tattvajñānavihīnāste kevalaṃ vedabuddhayaḥ.. 26.10 ..
1.3.d:
इत्येवं ब्रुवतां शब्दः श्रूयते शिवसन्निधौ..
स्वकीयं मतमास्थाय ह्यब्रुवंस्ते परस्परम्..
तत्त्वज्ञानविहीनास्ते केवलं वेदबुद्धयः.. 26.10 ..
1.3.m: Such a sound of them arguing was heard in the presence of Śiva. / Adhering to their own doctrines, they spoke among themselves, / lacking knowledge of reality and relying purely on Vedic intellect.

1.3.s:
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā parasparajayaiṣiṇām..
prahasya nārado vākyamuvāca śivasannidhau.. 26.11 ..
1.3.d:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा परस्परजयैषिणाम्..
प्रहस्य नारदो वाक्यमुवाच शिवसन्निधौ.. 26.11 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that talk of theirs, as they each sought victory over the other, / Nārada laughed and spoke these words in the presence of Śiva:

1.3.s:
yūyaṃ sarve vādinaśca vedavādaratāstathā..
maunamāsthāya bhoviprā hṛdi kṛtya sadāśivam.. 26.12 ..
1.3.d:
यूयं सर्वे वादिनश्च वेदवादरतास्तथा..
मौनमास्थाय भोविप्रा हृदि कृत्य सदाशिवम्.. 26.12 ..
1.3.m: "All of you are disputants, engaged in Vedic debates! / O brahmins, embrace silence and place Sadāśiva in your heart—

1.3.s:
ātmānaṃ paramātmānaṃ parāṇāṃ paramaṃ ca tat..
yenedaṃ kāritaṃ viśvaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ pravarttate..
yasminnilīyate viśvaṃ tasmai sarvātmane namaḥ.. 26.13 ..
1.3.d:
आत्मानं परमात्मानं पराणां परमं च तत्..
येनेदं कारितं विश्वं यतः सर्वं प्रवर्त्तते..
यस्मिन्निलीयते विश्वं तस्मै सर्वात्मने नमः.. 26.13 ..
1.3.m: the Self, the Supreme Self, that supreme beyond the beyond, / by whom this universe was made, from whom everything proceeds, / in whom the universe dissolves: homage to that Self of all!

1.3.s:
so'yamāste'dhunā gehe parvateṃdrasya bho dvijāḥ..
mukhādasyaiva saṃjātāḥ sarve yūyaṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ.. 26.14 ..
1.3.d:
सोऽयमास्तेऽधुना गेहे पर्वतेंद्रस्य भो द्विजाः..
मुखादस्यैव संजाताः सर्वे यूयं विचक्षणाः.. 26.14 ..
1.3.m: He himself is now residing here in the house of the king of mountains, O twice-born! / All of you discerning ones were born from his mouth alone!"

1.3.s:
evamuktāstadā tena nāradena dvijottamāḥ..
upadeśakarairvākyairbodhitāste dvijottamāḥ.. 26.15 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्तास्तदा तेन नारदेन द्विजोत्तमाः..
उपदेशकरैर्वाक्यैर्बोधितास्ते द्विजोत्तमाः.. 26.15 ..
1.3.m: When addressed thus by Nārada, those best of the twice-born / were awakened by those words of instruction, those best of the twice-born.

1.3.s:
varttamāne ca yajñe ca brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ..
dadarśa caraṇau devyā nakheṃduṃ ca manoharam.. 26.16 ..
1.3.d:
वर्त्तमाने च यज्ञे च ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः..
ददर्श चरणौ देव्या नखेंदुं च मनोहरम्.. 26.16 ..
1.3.m: While the sacrifice was underway, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / gazed upon the feet of the goddess and their charming crescent-like nails.

1.3.s:
darśanātskhalitaḥ sadyo babhūvāṃbujasaṃbhavaḥ..
madanena samāviṣṭo vīryaṃ ca prācyavadbhuvi.. 26.17 ..
1.3.d:
दर्शनात्स्खलितः सद्यो बभूवांबुजसंभवः..
मदनेन समाविष्टो वीर्यं च प्राच्यवद्भुवि.. 26.17 ..
1.3.m: From that sight, the lotus-born [god] suddenly slipped [from restraint]; / overcome by Kama, his semen fell upon the earth.

1.3.s:
retasā kṣaramāṇena lajjito'bhūtpitāmahaḥ..
caraṇābhyāṃ mamarddātha mahadgopyaṃ duratyayam.. 26.18 ..
1.3.d:
रेतसा क्षरमाणेन लज्जितोऽभूत्पितामहः..
चरणाभ्यां ममर्द्दाथ महद्गोप्यं दुरत्ययम्.. 26.18 ..
1.3.m: With his semen flowing, the grandfather became ashamed; / with his two feet he rubbed away that great, hard-to-overcome secret.

1.3.s:
bahavaścarṣayo jātā vālakhilyāḥ sahasraśaḥ..
upatasthustadā sarvetātatāteti cābruvan.. 26.19 ..
1.3.d:
बहवश्चर्षयो जाता वालखिल्याः सहस्रशः..
उपतस्थुस्तदा सर्वेताततातेति चाब्रुवन्.. 26.19 ..
1.3.m: From it many seers were born, the Vālakhilyas by the thousands. / They all stood before him then, crying out, "O father! O father!"

1.3.s:
nāradena tadoktāste vālakhilyāḥ prakopinā..
gacchaṃtu baṭavo yūyaṃ parvataṃ gaṃdhamādanam.. 26.20 ..
1.3.d:
नारदेन तदोक्तास्ते वालखिल्याः प्रकोपिना..
गच्छंतु बटवो यूयं पर्वतं गंधमादनम्.. 26.20 ..
1.3.m: Then the enraged Nārada spoke to those Vālakhilyas: / "You young novices, go to Mount Gandhamādana!

1.3.s:
na sthātavyaṃ bhavadbhiśca bhavatāṃ na prayojanam..
ityevamuktāste sarve vālakhilyāśca parvatam..
nāradena samādiṣṭā yayuḥ sarve tvarānvitāḥ.. 26.21 ..
1.3.d:
न स्थातव्यं भवद्भिश्च भवतां न प्रयोजनम्..
इत्येवमुक्तास्ते सर्वे वालखिल्याश्च पर्वतम्..
नारदेन समादिष्टा ययुः सर्वे त्वरान्विताः.. 26.21 ..
1.3.m: You must not stay here; there is no purpose for you here." / Addressed in this way, all those Vālakhilyas, / instructed by Nārada, departed in great haste for the mountain.

1.3.s:
nāradena tato brahmā''śvāsito vacanaiḥ śubhaiḥ..
tāvacca havanaṃ pūrṇaṃ jātaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ.. 26.22 ..
1.3.d:
नारदेन ततो ब्रह्मा'ऽश्वासितो वचनैः शुभैः..
तावच्च हवनं पूर्णं जातं तस्य महात्मनः.. 26.22 ..
1.3.m: Then Brahmā was consoled with auspicious words by Nārada. / Meanwhile, the burnt offering of that great soul was completed.

1.3.s:
maheśasya tathā viprāḥ śāṃtipāṭhaparā babhuḥ..
brahmaghoṣeṇa mahatā vyāpta māsīddigaṃtaram.. 26.23 ..
1.3.d:
महेशस्य तथा विप्राः शांतिपाठपरा बभुः..
ब्रह्मघोषेण महता व्याप्त मासीद्दिगंतरम्.. 26.23 ..
1.3.m: Then the brahmins devoted themselves to reciting peace chants for Maheśa; / the horizon was filled with the great resonance of the Veda.

1.3.s:
tato nīrājito devo devapatnībhiruttamaḥ..
tathaiva ṛṣipatnībhirarcitaḥ pūjitastathā.. 26.24 ..
1.3.d:
ततो नीराजितो देवो देवपत्नीभिरुत्तमः..
तथैव ऋषिपत्नीभिरर्चितः पूजितस्तथा.. 26.24 ..
1.3.m: Then the supreme god was waved with lights by the wives of the gods; / likewise he was honored and worshipped by the wives of the seers.

1.3.s:
tathā girīndrasya manoramāḥ śubhā nīrājayāmāsurathaiva yoṣitaḥ..
gītaiḥ sugītajñaviśāradāśca tathaiva cānye stutibhirmaharṣayaḥ.. 26.25 ..
1.3.d:
तथा गिरीन्द्रस्य मनोरमाः शुभा नीराजयामासुरथैव योषितः..
गीतैः सुगीतज्ञविशारदाश्च तथैव चान्ये स्तुतिभिर्महर्षयः.. 26.25 ..
1.3.m: Likewise the charming, auspicious women of the king of mountains waved lights over him / with songs, skilled in the knowledge of fine music, and other great seers [honored him] with hymns of praise.

1.3.s:
ratnāni ca mahārhāṇi dadau tebhyo mahāmanāḥ..
himālayo mahāśailaḥ saṃhṛṣṭaḥ paritoṣayan.. 26.26 ..
1.3.d:
रत्नानि च महार्हाणि ददौ तेभ्यो महामनाः..
हिमालयो महाशैलः संहृष्टः परितोषयन्.. 26.26 ..
1.3.m: And the broad-minded Himālaya, the great mountain, / gave precious jewels to them, rejoicing and satisfying [all].

1.3.s:
babhau tadānīṃ surasiddhasaṃghairvedyāṃ sthito'sau sakalatrako vibhuḥ..
sarvairupetī nijapārṣadairgaṇaiḥ prahṛṣṭacetā jagadekasundarāḥ.. 26.27 ..
1.3.d:
बभौ तदानीं सुरसिद्धसंघैर्वेद्यां स्थितोऽसौ सकलत्रको विभुः..
सर्वैरुपेती निजपार्षदैर्गणैः प्रहृष्टचेता जगदेकसुन्दराः.. 26.27 ..
1.3.m: Then the all-pervading Lord, standing upon the altar with his wife, / accompanied by all his personal attendants and gaṇas, with a delighted heart, the sole beauty of the world, shone amidst the hosts of gods and siddhas.

1.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare tatra brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ..
ṛṣigaṃdharvayakṣāśca yenye tatra samāgatāḥ.. 26.28 ..
1.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरोगमाः..
ऋषिगंधर्वयक्षाश्च येन्ये तत्र समागताः.. 26.28 ..
1.3.m: In the meantime, the gods led by Brahmā and Viṣṇu, / seers, gandharvas, yakṣas, and whoever else had arrived there—

1.3.s:
sarvānsamabhyarcya tadā mahātmā mahāngirīśaḥ parameṇa varcasā..
sadratnavastrābharaṇāni samyagdadau ca tāmbūlasugandhavāryapi.. 26.29 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वान्समभ्यर्च्य तदा महात्मा महान्गिरीशः परमेण वर्चसा..
सद्रत्नवस्त्राभरणानि सम्यग्ददौ च ताम्बूलसुगन्धवार्यपि.. 26.29 ..
1.3.m: having worshipped them all with supreme splendor, the great-souled mountain king / duly gave fine jewels, clothes, and ornaments, as well as betel and fragrant water.

1.3.s:
tadā śivaṃ puraskṛtyābhyava jahruḥ sureśvarāḥ..
tathā sarve militvā tu aikapadyena moditāḥ.. 26.30 ..
1.3.d:
तदा शिवं पुरस्कृत्याभ्यव जह्रुः सुरेश्वराः..
तथा सर्वे मिलित्वा तु ऐकपद्येन मोदिताः.. 26.30 ..
1.3.m: Then, placing Śiva in front, the lords of the gods ate; / likewise, having all gathered together, they rejoiced in unison.

1.3.s:
paṃktībhūtāśca bubhurliṃginā śrṛṃgiṇā saha..
kecidgaṇāḥ pṛthagbhūtā nānāhāsyarasairvibhum.. 26.31 ..
1.3.d:
पंक्तीभूताश्च बुभुर्लिंगिना श्रृंगिणा सह..
केचिद्गणाः पृथग्भूता नानाहास्यरसैर्विभुम्.. 26.31 ..
1.3.m: Seated in rows, they ate along with the ascetic and Śṛṅgin. / Some gaṇas, standing apart, [entertained] the Lord with various humorous moods;

1.3.s:
atoṣayannāradādyā anekālīkasaṃyutāḥ..
tathā caṇḍīgaṇāḥ sarve babhujuḥ kṛtabhājanāḥ.. 26.32 ..
1.3.d:
अतोषयन्नारदाद्या अनेकालीकसंयुताः..
तथा चण्डीगणाः सर्वे बभुजुः कृतभाजनाः.. 26.32 ..
1.3.m: Nārada and others delighted him with many playful falsehoods. / Likewise, all the gaṇas of Caṇḍī ate after receiving their bowls.

1.3.s:
vaitālāḥ kṣetrapālāśca bubhujuḥ kṛtabhājanāḥ..
śākinī ḍākinī caiva yakṣiṇyo mātṛkādayaḥ.. 26.33 ..
1.3.d:
वैतालाः क्षेत्रपालाश्च बुभुजुः कृतभाजनाः..
शाकिनी डाकिनी चैव यक्षिण्यो मातृकादयः.. 26.33 ..
1.3.m: The vetālas and the guardians of the sacred fields ate after receiving their bowls, / as well as the śākinīs, ḍākinīs, yakṣiṇīs, the mātṛkās, and others,

1.3.s:
yoginyo'tha catuḥ ṣaṣṭiryogino hi tathā pare..
daśa koṭyo gaṇānāṃ ca koṭyekā ca mahātmanām.. 26.34 ..
1.3.d:
योगिन्योऽथ चतुः षष्टिर्योगिनो हि तथा परे..
दश कोट्यो गणानां च कोट्येका च महात्मनाम्.. 26.34 ..
1.3.m: and the sixty-four yoginīs, and other yogins indeed: / ten crores of gaṇas and one crore of great-souled ones.

1.3.s:
evaṃ tu ṛṣayaḥ sarve tathānaye vibudhādayaḥ..
yogino hi mayā cānye kathitāḥ pūrvameva hi.. 26.35 ..
1.3.d:
एवं तु ऋषयः सर्वे तथानये विबुधादयः..
योगिनो हि मया चान्ये कथिताः पूर्वमेव हि.. 26.35 ..
1.3.m: Thus all the seers, and others, the gods and the rest, / and other yogins indeed, have been recounted by me previously.

1.3.s:
yoginyaścaiva kathitāstāsāṃ bhakṣyaṃ vadāmi vaḥ..
khaḍgānāṃ kecidānīya kravyaṃ pavitrameva ca.. 26.36 ..
1.3.d:
योगिन्यश्चैव कथितास्तासां भक्ष्यं वदामि वः..
खड्गानां केचिदानीय क्रव्यं पवित्रमेव च.. 26.36 ..
1.3.m: And the yoginīs too have been recounted; I shall tell you of their food: / some, bringing flesh of rhinoceroses deemed pure,

1.3.s:
bhuṃjaṃti cāsthisaṃyuktaṃ tathāṃtrāṇi bubhukṣitāḥ..
ānīya kecicchīrṣāṇi mahiṣāṇāṃ gurūṇi ca.. 26.37 ..
1.3.d:
भुंजंति चास्थिसंयुक्तं तथांत्राणि बुभुक्षिताः..
आनीय केचिच्छीर्षाणि महिषाणां गुरूणि च.. 26.37 ..
1.3.m: hungry, ate it along with the bones and entrails, / while some brought the heavy heads of buffaloes.

1.3.s:
tathā kecinnṛtyamānāstadānīṃ rorūyyamāṇāḥ pramathāścaiva cānye..
kecittūṣṇīmāsthitā rudrarūpāḥ parecānyām̐llokamānāstathaiva.. 26.38 ..
1.3.d:
तथा केचिन्नृत्यमानास्तदानीं रोरूय्यमाणाः प्रमथाश्चैव चान्ये..
केचित्तूष्णीमास्थिता रुद्ररूपाः परेचान्याम्̐ल्लोकमानास्तथैव.. 26.38 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, some pramathas and others were dancing then and howling loudly; / some, having the form of Rudra, sat in silence, while others gazed around at other [beings].

1.3.s:
yoginīcakramadhyastho bhairavo hi nanarta ca..
tathānye bhūtavetālā māmetyevaṃ pralāpinaḥ.. 26.39 ..
1.3.d:
योगिनीचक्रमध्यस्थो भैरवो हि ननर्त च..
तथान्ये भूतवेताला मामेत्येवं प्रलापिनः.. 26.39 ..
1.3.m: Bhairava danced in the midst of the circle of yoginīs, / and other ghosts and vetālas wailed, crying, "To me! [Give] to me!"

1.3.s:
evaṃ teṣāmuddhavaṃ hi nirikṣya madhusūdanaḥ..
uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram.. 26.40 ..
1.3.d:
एवं तेषामुद्धवं हि निरिक्ष्य मधुसूदनः..
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं शंकरं लोकशंकरम्.. 26.40 ..
1.3.m:
Observing their tumult in this manner, Madhusūdana
smiled and spoke these words to Śaṃkara, who brings welfare to the world:

1.3.s:
etāngaṇānvāraya bho atra mattāṃśca saṃprati..
asminkāle ca yatkāryaṃ sarvaistatkāryame va ca.. 26.41 ..
1.3.d:
एतान्गणान्वारय भो अत्र मत्तांश्च संप्रति..
अस्मिन्काले च यत्कार्यं सर्वैस्तत्कार्यमे व च.. 26.41 ..
1.3.m:
“Restrain these attendants here, O lord, who are intoxicated now!
For at this moment, whatever duty is to be performed must indeed be performed by all.

1.3.s:
pāṃḍityena mahādeva tasmādetānnivāraya..
tacchrutvā bhagavānrudro vīrabhadramuvāca ha.. 26.42 ..
1.3.d:
पांडित्येन महादेव तस्मादेतान्निवारय..
तच्छ्रुत्वा भगवान्रुद्रो वीरभद्रमुवाच ह.. 26.42 ..
1.3.m:
Therefore, O Mahādeva, restrain them with your wisdom!”
Hearing that, the blessed Rudra said to Vīrabhadra:

1.3.s:
..rudra uvāca..
vārayasva pramattāṃśca kṣībāṃścaiva viśeṣataḥ..
tenokto vīrabhadraśca śaṃbhunā parameṣṭhinā.. 26.43 ..
1.3.d:
..रुद्र उवाच..
वारयस्व प्रमत्तांश्च क्षीबांश्चैव विशेषतः..
तेनोक्तो वीरभद्रश्च शंभुना परमेष्ठिना.. 26.43 ..
1.3.m:
Rudra said:
“Restrain the frantic ones, and especially the drunk!”
Thus instructed by Śambhu, the supreme lord, Vīrabhadra

1.3.s:
ājñāpitāḥ pramattāśca vīrabhadreṇa dhīmatā..
pramathā vāritāstena tūṣṇīmāśritya te sthitāḥ.. 26.44 ..
1.3.d:
आज्ञापिताः प्रमत्ताश्च वीरभद्रेण धीमता..
प्रमथा वारितास्तेन तूष्णीमाश्रित्य ते स्थिताः.. 26.44 ..
1.3.m:
commanded the frantic ones, wise as he was.
The pramathas were restrained by him; they remained silent.

1.3.s:
niścalā yoginīmadhye bhūtapramathaguhyakāḥ..
śākinyo yātudhānāśca kūṣmāṃḍāḥ kopikarpaṭāḥ.. 26.45 ..
1.3.d:
निश्चला योगिनीमध्ये भूतप्रमथगुह्यकाः..
शाकिन्यो यातुधानाश्च कूष्मांडाः कोपिकर्पटाः.. 26.45 ..
1.3.m:
Motionless among the yoginīs were the bhūtas, pramathas, and guhyakas,
the śākinīs, yātudhānas, kūṣmāṇḍas, and wrathful ascetics in rags,

1.3.s:
tathānye bhūtavetālāḥ kṣetrapālāśca bhairavāḥ..
sarve śāṃtāḥ pramattāśca babhūvuḥ pramathādayaḥ.. 26.46 ..
1.3.d:
तथान्ये भूतवेतालाः क्षेत्रपालाश्च भैरवाः..
सर्वे शांताः प्रमत्ताश्च बभूवुः प्रमथादयः.. 26.46 ..
1.3.m:
as well as other bhūtas, vetālas, kṣetrapālas, and bhairavas.
All became calm—the frantic ones, the pramathas, and the rest.

1.3.s:
evaṃ vistārasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtamudvahanaṃ tadā..
himādriṇā paraṃ viprāḥ sumaṃgalyaṃ suśobhanam.. 26.47 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विस्तारसंयुक्तं कृतमुद्वहनं तदा..
हिमाद्रिणा परं विप्राः सुमंगल्यं सुशोभनम्.. 26.47 ..
1.3.m:
Thus the wedding was then performed in grand detail
by the Himālaya, O brahmins—most auspicious and splendid.

1.3.s:
catvāro divasā jātāḥ paripūrṇena cetasā..
himādriṇā kṛtā pūjā devadevasya śūlinaḥ.. 26.48 ..
1.3.d:
चत्वारो दिवसा जाताः परिपूर्णेन चेतसा..
हिमाद्रिणा कृता पूजा देवदेवस्य शूलिनः.. 26.48 ..
1.3.m:
Four days passed with a fulfilled heart;
the Himālaya performed worship of the Trident-bearer, the god of gods.

1.3.s:
vastrālaṃkārābharaṇai ratnairuccāvacaistataḥ..
pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ viṣṇorvacanaparo'bhavat.. 26.49 ..
1.3.d:
वस्त्रालंकाराभरणै रत्नैरुच्चावचैस्ततः..
पूजयित्वा महादेवं विष्णोर्वचनपरोऽभवत्.. 26.49 ..
1.3.m:
Then, having worshipped Mahādeva with garments, ornaments,
and various jewels, he attended to Viṣṇu's words.

1.3.s:
lakṣmīsametaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca vastrālaṃkaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ..
pūjayāmāsa himavāṃstathā brahmāṇameva ca.. 26.50 ..
1.3.d:
लक्ष्मीसमेतं विष्णुं च वस्त्रालंकरणैः शुभैः..
पूजयामास हिमवांस्तथा ब्रह्माणमेव च.. 26.50 ..
1.3.m:
The Himālaya worshipped Viṣṇu together with Lakṣmī,
as well as Brahmā, with auspicious garments and ornaments.

1.3.s:
iṃdraṃ purodhasā sārddhamiṃdrāṇyā sahitaṃ vibhum..
tathaiva lokapālāṃśca pūjayitvā pṛthakpṛthak.. 26.51 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्रं पुरोधसा सार्द्धमिंद्राण्या सहितं विभुम्..
तथैव लोकपालांश्च पूजयित्वा पृथक्पृथक्.. 26.51 ..
1.3.m:
Having worshipped the all-pervading Indra together with his priest
and Indrāṇī, and likewise each of the world-protectors separately,

1.3.s:
tathaiva pūjitā caṃḍī bhūtapramathaguhyakaiḥ..
vastrālaṃkaraṇaiścaiva ratnairnānāvidhairapi..
ye cānya āgatāstatra te ca sarve prapūjitāḥ.. 26.52 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव पूजिता चंडी भूतप्रमथगुह्यकैः..
वस्त्रालंकरणैश्चैव रत्नैर्नानाविधैरपि..
ये चान्य आगतास्तत्र ते च सर्वे प्रपूजिताः.. 26.52 ..

1.3.s:
evaṃ tadānīṃ pratipūjitāśca devāśca sarve ṛṣayaśca yakṣāḥ..
gaṃdharvavidyādharasiddhacāraṇāstathaiva marttyāpsarasāṃ gaṇāśca.. 26.53 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṇḍe śivapārvativivāhamaṃgalotsavavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 26 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
एवं तदानीं प्रतिपूजिताश्च देवाश्च सर्वे ऋषयश्च यक्षाः..
गंधर्वविद्याधरसिद्धचारणास्तथैव मर्त्त्याप्सरसां गणाश्च.. 26.53 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखण्डे शिवपार्वतिविवाहमंगलोत्सववर्णनं नाम षड्विशोऽध्यायः.. 26 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
Thus all the gods, seers, and yakṣas were honoured then,
as were the gandharvas, vidyādharas, siddhas, cāraṇas, and the hosts of mortal men and apsarases.
Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter, named “Description of the Auspicious Festival of Śiva and Pārvatī's Wedding,” in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
tathaiva viṣṇunā sarve parvatāśca prapūjitāḥ..
sahyācalaśca viṃdhyaśca maināko gaṃdhamādanaḥ.. 27.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
तथैव विष्णुना सर्वे पर्वताश्च प्रपूजिताः..
सह्याचलश्च विंध्यश्च मैनाको गंधमादनः.. 27.1 ..
1.3.m:
Lomaśa said:
In that same manner, all the mountains were honoured by Viṣṇu:
Mount Sahya, the Vindhya, Maināka, Gandhamādana,

1.3.s:
mālyavānmalayaścaiva maheṃdro maṃdarastathā..
meruścaiva prayatnena pūjito viṣṇunā tadā.. 27.2 ..
1.3.d:
माल्यवान्मलयश्चैव महेंद्रो मंदरस्तथा..
मेरुश्चैव प्रयत्नेन पूजितो विष्णुना तदा.. 27.2 ..
1.3.m:
Mālyavān, Malaya, Mahendra, Mandara,
and Meru was then assiduously worshipped by Viṣṇu.

1.3.s:
śvetaḥ kṛtaḥ śvetagirirnilādriśca tathaiva ca..
udayādriśca śrṛṃgaśca astācalavaro mahān.. 27.3 ..
1.3.d:
श्वेतः कृतः श्वेतगिरिर्निलाद्रिश्च तथैव च..
उदयाद्रिश्च श्रृंगश्च अस्ताचलवरो महान्.. 27.3 ..
1.3.m:
Mount Śveta, Mount Nīla, the Sunrise Mountain,
Mount Śṛṅga, and the great, excellent Mount Asta;

1.3.s:
mānasādristathā śailaḥ kailāsaḥ parvatottamaḥ..
lokālokastathā śailaḥ pūjitaḥ parameṣṭhinā.. 27.4 ..
1.3.d:
मानसाद्रिस्तथा शैलः कैलासः पर्वतोत्तमः..
लोकालोकस्तथा शैलः पूजितः परमेष्ठिना.. 27.4 ..
1.3.m:
Mount Mānasa, the mountain Kailāsa—best of mountains—
and Mount Lokāloka were thus worshipped by the supreme lord.

1.3.s:
evaṃ te parvataśreṣṭhāḥ pūjitāḥ sarva eva hi..
tathānye pūjitāstena sarve parvatavāsinaḥ.. 27.5 ..
1.3.d:
एवं ते पर्वतश्रेष्ठाः पूजिताः सर्व एव हि..
तथान्ये पूजितास्तेन सर्वे पर्वतवासिनः.. 27.5 ..
1.3.m:
Thus all those best of mountains were indeed honoured;
and all other mountain-dwellers were honoured by him.

1.3.s:
viṣṇunā brahmaṇā sārddhaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ yathocitam..
anyehani ca saṃprāpte varayātrā kṛtā tathā.. 27.6 ..
1.3.d:
विष्णुना ब्रह्मणा सार्द्धं कृतं सर्वं यथोचितम्..
अन्येहनि च संप्राप्ते वरयात्रा कृता तथा.. 27.6 ..
1.3.m:
Together with Brahmā, Viṣṇu performed everything as was proper.
And when the next day arrived, the bridal procession took place.

1.3.s:
himādriṇā baṃdhubhiśca parvataṃ gaṃdhamādanam..
yayuḥ sarve suragaṇā gaṇāśca bahavastathā.. 27.7 ..
1.3.d:
हिमाद्रिणा बंधुभिश्च पर्वतं गंधमादनम्..
ययुः सर्वे सुरगणा गणाश्च बहवस्तथा.. 27.7 ..
1.3.m:
With the Himālaya and their kinsmen, to Mount Gandhamādana
went all the hosts of gods and numerous retinues,

1.3.s:
pramathāśca tathā sarve tathā caṃḍīgaṇāḥ pare..
ye cānye bahavastatra samāyātā himālayā.. 27.8 ..
1.3.d:
प्रमथाश्च तथा सर्वे तथा चंडीगणाः परे..
ये चान्ये बहवस्तत्र समायाता हिमालया.. 27.8 ..
1.3.m:
all the pramathas as well, and the other attendants of Caṇḍī,
and the many others who had assembled from the Himālaya,

1.3.s:
śivasyodvahanaṃ viprāḥ śivena paribhāvitāḥ..
paraṃ harṣaṃ samāpannā dṛṣṭvā tau daṃpatī tadā.. 27.9 ..
1.3.d:
शिवस्योद्वहनं विप्राः शिवेन परिभाविताः..
परं हर्षं समापन्ना दृष्ट्वा तौ दंपती तदा.. 27.9 ..
1.3.m:
for Śiva's wedding, O brahmins. Devoted to Śiva,
they were filled with supreme joy upon seeing the couple then:

1.3.s:
pārvatīsahitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ śaṃbhunā saha pārvatī..
puṣpagandhau yathā syātāṃ vāgarthāviva tattvataḥ.. 27.10 ..
1.3.d:
पार्वतीसहितः शंभुः शंभुना सह पार्वती..
पुष्पगन्धौ यथा स्यातां वागर्थाविव तत्त्वतः.. 27.10 ..
1.3.m:
Śambhu accompanied by Pārvatī, Pārvatī together with Śambhu,
just as flower and fragrance, or as word and meaning in their true nature;

1.3.s:
tathā prakṛtipuṃsau ca aikapadyena nānyathā..
daṃpatī tau gajārūḍhau śuśubhāte mahāprabhau.. 27.11 ..
1.3.d:
तथा प्रकृतिपुंसौ च ऐकपद्येन नान्यथा..
दंपती तौ गजारूढौ शुशुभाते महाप्रभौ.. 27.11 ..
1.3.m:
and so too Prakṛti and Puruṣa, united in a single state, not otherwise.
Mounted upon an elephant, the couple shone with great splendor.

1.3.s:
vimāsthastadā brahmā viṣṇuśca garuḍopari..
airāvatagataśceṃdraḥ kuberaḥ puṣpakopari.. 27.12 ..
1.3.d:
विमास्थस्तदा ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च गरुडोपरि..
ऐरावतगतश्चेंद्रः कुबेरः पुष्पकोपरि.. 27.12 ..
1.3.m:
Brahmā was then in his aerial chariot, Viṣṇu upon Garuḍa,
Indra mounted on Airāvata, Kubera upon the Puṣpaka;

1.3.s:
pāśī ca makarā rūḍho yamo mahiṣameva ca..
pretārūḍho nairṛtaḥ syādagnirbastagato mahān.. 27.13 ..
1.3.d:
पाशी च मकरा रूढो यमो महिषमेव च..
प्रेतारूढो नैरृतः स्यादग्निर्बस्तगतो महान्.. 27.13 ..
1.3.m:
the Noose-bearer was mounted on a makara, Yama on a buffalo,
Nirṛti on a corpse, and the great Agni was mounted on a goat;

1.3.s:
mṛgārūḍho'tha pavana īśo vṛṣabhameva ca..
ityevaṃ lokapālāśca sagrahāḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ.. 27.14 ..
1.3.d:
मृगारूढोऽथ पवन ईशो वृषभमेव च..
इत्येवं लोकपालाश्च सग्रहाः परमेष्ठिनः.. 27.14 ..
1.3.m:
Pavana was mounted on a deer, and Īśa on a bull.
Thus the world-protectors, accompanied by the planets and the supreme deities,

1.3.s:
svaiḥ svairbalaiḥ parikrāṃtāstathānye pramathādayaḥ..
himādriśca mahāśaila ṛṣabho gaṃdhamādanaḥ.. 27.15 ..
1.3.d:
स्वैः स्वैर्बलैः परिक्रांतास्तथान्ये प्रमथादयः..
हिमाद्रिश्च महाशैल ऋषभो गंधमादनः.. 27.15 ..
1.3.m:
were surrounded by their own armies, as were the others—the pramathas and the rest.
The Himālaya, that great mountain, Ṛṣabha, Gandhamādana,

1.3.s:
sahyācalo nīlagirirmaṃdaro malayācalaḥ..
kailāso hi mahātejā mainākaśca mahāprabhaḥ.. 27.16 ..
1.3.d:
सह्याचलो नीलगिरिर्मंदरो मलयाचलः..
कैलासो हि महातेजा मैनाकश्च महाप्रभः.. 27.16 ..
1.3.m:
Mount Sahya, Mount Nīla, Mandara, Mount Malaya,
Kailāsa of great radiance, and Maināka of great splendor,

1.3.s:
ete cānye ca girayaḥ kṣīmaṃto hi mahāprabhāḥ..
sakalatrāśca te sarve sasutāśca manoramāḥ.. 27.17 ..
1.3.d:
एते चान्ये च गिरयः क्षीमंतो हि महाप्रभाः..
सकलत्राश्च ते सर्वे ससुताश्च मनोरमाः.. 27.17 ..
1.3.m:
these and other mountains, radiant and of great splendor,
all accompanied by their wives and handsome sons,

1.3.s:
balino rūpiṇaḥ sarve mervādyāstatra parvatāḥ..
varayātrāprasaṃgena śivārcanaparābhavan.. 27.18 ..
1.3.d:
बलिनो रूपिणः सर्वे मेर्वाद्यास्तत्र पर्वताः..
वरयात्राप्रसंगेन शिवार्चनपराभवन्.. 27.18 ..
1.3.m:
mighty and personified, all the mountains beginning with Meru,
were devoted to worshipping Śiva in the course of the bridal procession.

1.3.s:
naṃdinā hyupaviṣṭāste mervādyāstatra parvatāḥ..
varayātrā kṛtā te yathoktā ca himādriṇā..
sarvaistairbaṃdhubhiḥ sārddhaṃ punarāgamanaṃ kṛtam.. 27.19 ..
1.3.d:
नंदिना ह्युपविष्टास्ते मेर्वाद्यास्तत्र पर्वताः..
वरयात्रा कृता ते यथोक्ता च हिमाद्रिणा..
सर्वैस्तैर्बंधुभिः सार्द्धं पुनरागमनं कृतम्.. 27.19 ..

1.3.s:
svakālayastho himavānsa reje hi mahā yaśā..
śivasaṃparkajenaiva mahasā paramema ca..
vikhyāto hi mahāśailastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ.. 27.20 ..
1.3.d:
स्वकालयस्थो हिमवान्स रेजे हि महा यशा..
शिवसंपर्कजेनैव महसा परमेम च..
विख्यातो हि महाशैलस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः.. 27.20 ..

1.3.s:
kanyādānena mahatā tuṣṭo yasya ca śaṃkaraḥ..
te dhanyāste mahātmānaḥ kṛtakṛtatyāstathaiva ca.. 27.21 ..
1.3.d:
कन्यादानेन महता तुष्टो यस्य च शंकरः..
ते धन्यास्ते महात्मानः कृतकृतत्यास्तथैव च.. 27.21 ..
1.3.m:
He with whose great gift of his daughter Śaṃkara was pleased—
blessed are those high-souled ones, and they have accomplished all their aims.

1.3.s:
dvyakṣaraṃ nāma yeṣāṃ ca jihvāgre saṃsthitaṃ sadā..
śiveti dvyakṣaraṃ nāma yairhṛdīritamadya vai..
te vai manuṣyarūpeṇa rudrā eva na saṃśayaḥ.. 27.22 ..
1.3.d:
द्व्यक्षरं नाम येषां च जिह्वाग्रे संस्थितं सदा..
शिवेति द्व्यक्षरं नाम यैर्हृदीरितमद्य वै..
ते वै मनुष्यरूपेण रुद्रा एव न संशयः.. 27.22 ..
1.3.m:
Those on the tip of whose tongue rests always the two-syllable name,
by whom the two-syllable name “Śiva” has been uttered in their heart this day—
they are indeed Rudras in human form, there is no doubt.

1.3.s:
kiṃciddānena saṃtuṣṭaḥ patreṇāpi tathaiva ca..
toyenāpi hi saṃtuṣṭo mahādevo nirantaram.. 27.23 ..
1.3.d:
किंचिद्दानेन संतुष्टः पत्रेणापि तथैव च..
तोयेनापि हि संतुष्टो महादेवो निरन्तरम्.. 27.23 ..
1.3.m:
He is pleased with even a small gift, even with a leaf,
and Mahādeva is constantly pleased even with water.

1.3.s:
patreṇa puṣpeṇa tathā jalena prīto bhavatyeṣa sadāśivo hi..
tasmācca sarvaiḥ pratipūjanīyaḥ śivo maddābhāgyakaro nṛṇāmiha.. 27.24 ..
1.3.d:
पत्रेण पुष्पेण तथा जलेन प्रीतो भवत्येष सदाशिवो हि..
तस्माच्च सर्वैः प्रतिपूजनीयः शिवो मद्दाभाग्यकरो नृणामिह.. 27.24 ..
1.3.m:
With a leaf, with a flower, and with water, this Sadāśiva is pleased;
therefore, Śiva, who bestows great good fortune on mortals here, must be worshipped by all.

1.3.s:
eko mahāñjyotirajaḥ pareśaḥ parāparāṇāṃ paramo mahātmā..
niraṃtaro nirvikāro nirīśo nirābādho nirvikalpo nirīhaḥ.. 27.25 ..
1.3.d:
एको महाञ्ज्योतिरजः परेशः परापराणां परमो महात्मा..
निरंतरो निर्विकारो निरीशो निराबाधो निर्विकल्पो निरीहः.. 27.25 ..
1.3.m:
One, the great light, unborn, the supreme lord, the supreme self above the higher and the lower,
continuous, changeless, without a master, unassailable, free from conceptual distinction, devoid of desire.

1.3.s:
niraṃjano nityarūpo nirodho nityānando nityamuktāḥ sadeva..
evaṃbhūto devadevo'rccitaśca tairdevādyarviśvavedyo bhavaśca..
stuto dhyātaḥ pūjitaściṃtitaśca sarvajño'sau sarvadā sarvadaśca.. 27.26 ..
1.3.d:
निरंजनो नित्यरूपो निरोधो नित्यानन्दो नित्यमुक्ताः सदेव..
एवंभूतो देवदेवोऽर्च्चितश्च तैर्देवाद्यर्विश्ववेद्यो भवश्च..
स्तुतो ध्यातः पूजितश्चिंतितश्च सर्वज्ञोऽसौ सर्वदा सर्वदश्च.. 27.26 ..
1.3.m: Taintless, eternal in form, restraint, eternal bliss, ever-liberated, ever-existing— / being such, the God of gods, Bhava, knowable by the universe, was worshipped by those gods and others; / praised, meditated upon, honoured, and contemplated, he is omniscient, eternal, and the giver of all.

1.3.s:
yathā variṣṭho himavānprasiddhaḥ sarvairguṇaiḥ sarvaguṇo mahātmā..
viśveśavaṃdyo hi tadā himālayo jāto girīṇāṃ pravarastadānīm.. 27.27 ..
1.3.d:
यथा वरिष्ठो हिमवान्प्रसिद्धः सर्वैर्गुणैः सर्वगुणो महात्मा..
विश्वेशवंद्यो हि तदा हिमालयो जातो गिरीणां प्रवरस्तदानीम्.. 27.27 ..
1.3.m: Just as the famous Himavat was supreme through all qualities, endowed with all virtues, a great soul, / praised by the Lord of the Universe, so the Himālaya then became the foremost among mountains.

1.3.s:
menayā saha dharmātmā yathāsthānagatastataḥ..
sarvānvisarjayāmāsa parvatānparvateśvaraḥ.. 27.28 ..
1.3.d:
मेनया सह धर्मात्मा यथास्थानगतस्ततः..
सर्वान्विसर्जयामास पर्वतान्पर्वतेश्वरः.. 27.28 ..
1.3.m: Then, accompanied by Menā, the righteous [king] went to his own abode; / the lord of mountains dismissed all the mountains.

1.3.s:
gateṣu teṣu himavānputraiḥ pautraiḥ prapautrakaiḥ..
rājā girīṇāṃ pravaro mahādevaprasādataḥ.. 27.29 ..
1.3.d:
गतेषु तेषु हिमवान्पुत्रैः पौत्रैः प्रपौत्रकैः..
राजा गिरीणां प्रवरो महादेवप्रसादतः.. 27.29 ..
