1.3.m: When they had departed, Himavat, with his sons, grandsons, and great-grandsons, / [became] the foremost king of mountains by the grace of Mahādeva.

1.3.s:
atho girijayā sārddhaṃ maheśo gandhamādane..
ekāṃte ca matiṃ cakre ramaṇārthaṃ svarūpavān.. 27.30 ..
1.3.d:
अथो गिरिजया सार्द्धं महेशो गन्धमादने..
एकांते च मतिं चक्रे रमणार्थं स्वरूपवान्.. 27.30 ..
1.3.m: Then, along with the Mountain-born Daughter on Gandhamādana, / Maheśa, endowed with a beautiful form, turned his mind in solitude toward lovemaking.

1.3.s:
suratenaiva mahatā tapasā hi samāgame..
dvayoḥ suratamārabdhaṃ taddvayośca tadā'bhavat.. 27.31 ..
1.3.d:
सुरतेनैव महता तपसा हि समागमे..
द्वयोः सुरतमारब्धं तद्द्वयोश्च तदाऽभवत्.. 27.31 ..
1.3.m: Through great copulation indeed, with austerity in that union, / the lovemaking of the two was begun, and then took place between them.

1.3.s:
aniṣṭaṃ mahadāścaryaṃ pralayopamameva ca..
tasminmahārate prāpte nāviṃdaṃta sukhaṃ param.. 27.32 ..
1.3.d:
अनिष्टं महदाश्चर्यं प्रलयोपममेव च..
तस्मिन्महारते प्राप्ते नाविंदंत सुखं परम्.. 27.32 ..
1.3.m: It was disastrous, a great wonder, just like the universal dissolution; / while that great lovemaking was underway, they found no ultimate peace.

1.3.s:
sarve brahmādayo devāḥ kāryākāryavyavasthitau..
retasā ca jagatsarvaṃ naṣṭaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamam.. 27.33 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वे ब्रह्मादयो देवाः कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ..
रेतसा च जगत्सर्वं नष्टं स्थावरजंगमम्.. 27.33 ..
1.3.m: All the gods, Brahmā and the rest, [pondered] what should and should not be done; / and by the semen the entire world, both moving and unmoving, was endangered.

1.3.s:
sasmāra cāgniṃ brahmā ca viṣṇuścādhyātmadāyakaḥ..
manasā saṃsmṛtaḥ sadyo jagāmāgnistvarānvitaḥ.. 27.34 ..
1.3.d:
सस्मार चाग्निं ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्चाध्यात्मदायकः..
मनसा संस्मृतः सद्यो जगामाग्निस्त्वरान्वितः.. 27.34 ..
1.3.m: Brahmā and Viṣṇu, the bestower of spiritual wisdom, remembered Agni; / remembered in their minds, Agni immediately went with haste.

1.3.s:
tābhyāṃ saṃpreṣito'paśyadruciraṃ śivamāṃdiram..
dvāri sthitaṃ naṃdinaṃ ca dadarśāgre mahāprabham.. 27.35 ..
1.3.d:
ताभ्यां संप्रेषितोऽपश्यद्रुचिरं शिवमांदिरम्..
द्वारि स्थितं नंदिनं च ददर्शाग्रे महाप्रभम्.. 27.35 ..
1.3.m: Sent by the two, he saw the charming dwelling of Śiva; / he saw Nandin standing at the door, full of great splendour in front.

1.3.s:
agnirhrasvastadā bhūtvā kāśmīrasadṛśacchaviḥ..
praviṣṭoṃtaḥ puraṃ śaṃbhornānāścaryasamanvitam.. 27.36 ..
1.3.d:
अग्निर्ह्रस्वस्तदा भूत्वा काश्मीरसदृशच्छविः..
प्रविष्टोंतः पुरं शंभोर्नानाश्चर्यसमन्वितम्.. 27.36 ..
1.3.m: Agni then became dwarfish, with a lustre like saffron, / and entered Śambhu's inner apartment, which was filled with various wonders,

1.3.s:
anekaratnasaṃvītaṃ prāsādaiśca svalaṃ kṛtam..
tadaṃgaṇamanuprāpya upaviśyāha havyavāṭ.. 27.37 ..
1.3.d:
अनेकरत्नसंवीतं प्रासादैश्च स्वलं कृतम्..
तदंगणमनुप्राप्य उपविश्याह हव्यवाट्.. 27.37 ..
1.3.m: surrounded by many jewels and well adorned with mansions. / Having reached its courtyard and sat down, the fire spoke:

1.3.s:
pāṇipātrasya me hyamba bhikṣāṃ dehyavarodhataḥ..
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya pāṇipātrasya bālikā.. 27.38 ..
1.3.d:
पाणिपात्रस्य मे ह्यम्ब भिक्षां देह्यवरोधतः..
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य पाणिपात्रस्य बालिका.. 27.38 ..
1.3.m: “O mother, give alms from the inner apartments to me, whose hand is his bowl!” / Hearing that speech of his whose hand was his bowl, the young woman,

1.3.s:
yāvaddātuṃ ca sārebhe bhikṣāṃ tasmai tataḥ svayam..
utthāya suratāttasmācchivo hi kupito bhṛśam.. 27.39 ..
1.3.d:
यावद्दातुं च सारेभे भिक्षां तस्मै ततः स्वयम्..
उत्थाय सुरतात्तस्माच्छिवो हि कुपितो भृशम्.. 27.39 ..
1.3.m: as she began to give him alms, then Śiva himself, / rising from that lovemaking, became exceedingly enraged.

1.3.s:
rudrastriśūlamudyamya bhairavo hya'bhavattadā..
nivārito girijayā vadhāttasmācchivaḥ svayam..
bhikṣāṃ tasmai dadau vācā agnaye jātavedase.. 27.40 ..
1.3.d:
रुद्रस्त्रिशूलमुद्यम्य भैरवो ह्यऽभवत्तदा..
निवारितो गिरिजया वधात्तस्माच्छिवः स्वयम्..
भिक्षां तस्मै ददौ वाचा अग्नये जातवेदसे.. 27.40 ..
1.3.m: Lifting his trident, Rudra then became terrifying; / restrained from slaying him by the Mountain-born Daughter, Śiva himself / gave alms in word to Agni, the knower of beings.

1.3.s:
pāṇau bhikṣāṃ gṛhītvātha pratyakṣaṃ tena cāgninā..
bhikṣitā kupitā taṃ vai śaśāpa girijā tataḥ.. 27.41 ..
1.3.d:
पाणौ भिक्षां गृहीत्वाथ प्रत्यक्षं तेन चाग्निना..
भिक्षिता कुपिता तं वै शशाप गिरिजा ततः.. 27.41 ..
1.3.m: Then, the alms having been received directly into his hand by that fire, / the Mountain-born Daughter, angered at his begging, then cursed him:

1.3.s:
re bhikṣo bhavitā śāpātsarvabhakṣo mamāśu vai..
anena retasā sadyaḥ pīḍāṃ prāpsyasi sarvataḥ.. 27.42 ..
1.3.d:
रे भिक्षो भविता शापात्सर्वभक्षो ममाशु वै..
अनेन रेतसा सद्यः पीडां प्राप्स्यसि सर्वतः.. 27.42 ..
1.3.m: “O mendicant, by my curse you will quickly become an eater of everything; / by this semen you will immediately suffer torment on all sides!”

1.3.s:
ityukto bhakṣayitvāgnī reta īśasya havyavāṭ..
yatra devāḥ sthitāḥ sarve brahmādyāścaiva sarvaśaḥ.. 27.43 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युक्तो भक्षयित्वाग्नी रेत ईशस्य हव्यवाट्..
यत्र देवाः स्थिताः सर्वे ब्रह्माद्याश्चैव सर्वशः.. 27.43 ..
1.3.m: Thus addressed, the fire, the carrier of oblations, consumed the semen of the Lord; / [he went to] where all the gods, Brahmā and the others, were assembled everywhere.

1.3.s:
āgatyākathayatsarvaṃ tadretobhakṣaṇādikam..
sarve sagarbhā hyabhavannindrādyā devatāgaṇāḥ.. 27.44 ..
1.3.d:
आगत्याकथयत्सर्वं तद्रेतोभक्षणादिकम्..
सर्वे सगर्भा ह्यभवन्निन्द्राद्या देवतागणाः.. 27.44 ..
1.3.m: Arriving, he related everything—the consumption of that semen and the rest; / and all the hosts of gods, Indra and the rest, became pregnant.

1.3.s:
agneryathā haviścaiva sarveṣāmupatiṣṭhati..
agnermukhodbhavenaiva retasā te sureśvarāḥ.. 27.45 ..
1.3.d:
अग्नेर्यथा हविश्चैव सर्वेषामुपतिष्ठति..
अग्नेर्मुखोद्भवेनैव रेतसा ते सुरेश्वराः.. 27.45 ..
1.3.m: Just as the oblation of Agni reaches all of them, / through the semen arising from Agni's mouth, those lords of the gods,

1.3.s:
sagarbhāhyabhavansarve ciṃtayā caprapīḍitāḥ..
viṣṇuṃ śaraṇamājagmurddevadeveśvaraṃ prabhum.. 27.46 ..
1.3.d:
सगर्भाह्यभवन्सर्वे चिंतया चप्रपीडिताः..
विष्णुं शरणमाजग्मुर्द्देवदेवेश्वरं प्रभुम्.. 27.46 ..
1.3.m: all became pregnant and were tormented with anxiety; / they sought refuge with Viṣṇu, the Lord, the ruler of the God of gods.

1.3.s:
..devā ūcuḥ..
tvaṃ trātā sarvadevānāṃ lokānāṃ prabhureva ca..
tasmādrakṣā vidhātavyā śaraṇāgatavatsala.. 27.47 ..
1.3.d:
..देवा ऊचुः..
त्वं त्राता सर्वदेवानां लोकानां प्रभुरेव च..
तस्माद्रक्षा विधातव्या शरणागतवत्सल.. 27.47 ..
1.3.m: The gods said: / “You are the protector of all the gods and the lord of the worlds; / therefore protection must be granted, O you who are affectionate to those seeking refuge!

1.3.s:
vayaṃ sarve martukāmā retasānena pīḍitāḥ..
asurebhyaḥ paritrastā vayaṃ sarve divaukasaḥ.. 27.48 ..
1.3.d:
वयं सर्वे मर्तुकामा रेतसानेन पीडिताः..
असुरेभ्यः परित्रस्ता वयं सर्वे दिवौकसः.. 27.48 ..
1.3.m: We all desire to die, tormented by this semen; / we, all the gods of heaven, are terrified of the asuras.

1.3.s:
śaraṇaṃ śaṃkaraṃ yātāḥ paritrātuṃ kṛtodvahāḥ..
yadā putro hi rudrasya bhaviṣyati tadā vayam..
sukhinaḥ syāma sarve nirbhayāśca triviṣṭape.. 27.49 ..
1.3.d:
शरणं शंकरं याताः परित्रातुं कृतोद्वहाः..
यदा पुत्रो हि रुद्रस्य भविष्यति तदा वयम्..
सुखिनः स्याम सर्वे निर्भयाश्च त्रिविष्टपे.. 27.49 ..
1.3.m: We went to Śaṃkara for refuge, eager to be saved; / [thinking] that when a son is born to Rudra, then we / will all be happy and fearless in heaven.

1.3.s:
evaṃ viṣṭabhyamānānāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhayamāgatam..
anena retasā viṣṇo jīvituṃ śakyate katham.. 27.50 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विष्टभ्यमानानां सर्वेषां भयमागतम्..
अनेन रेतसा विष्णो जीवितुं शक्यते कथम्.. 27.50 ..
1.3.m: To us thus obstructed, fear has come; / O Viṣṇu, how can one live with this semen?

1.3.s:
trivargo hi yathā puṃsāṃ kṛto hi supariṣkṛtaḥ..
viparīto bhavatyeva vinā devena nānyathā.. 27.51 ..
1.3.d:
त्रिवर्गो हि यथा पुंसां कृतो हि सुपरिष्कृतः..
विपरीतो भवत्येव विना देवेन नान्यथा.. 27.51 ..
1.3.m: Even if the threefold aim of life of men is thoroughly accomplished, / it indeed turns contrary without God, not otherwise.

1.3.s:
tasmāttadvai balaṃ matvā sarveṣāmapi dehinām..
kāryākāryavyavasthāyāṃ sarve manyāmahe vayam.. 27.52 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्तद्वै बलं मत्वा सर्वेषामपि देहिनाम्..
कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थायां सर्वे मन्यामहे वयम्.. 27.52 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, considering that to be the strength of all embodied beings, / we all reflect upon the determination of what should and should not be done.”

1.3.s:
tathā niśamya devānāṃ pareśaḥ paridevanam..
uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ devānāṃ devatārihā.. 27.53 ..
1.3.d:
तथा निशम्य देवानां परेशः परिदेवनम्..
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं देवानां देवतारिहा.. 27.53 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that lamentation of the gods, the supreme Lord, / the slayer of the enemies of the gods, spoke these words to the gods with a smile:

1.3.s: stūyatāṃ vai mahādevo maheśaḥ kāryagauravāt.. 27.54 ..
1.3.d: स्तूयतां वै महादेवो महेशः कार्यगौरवात्.. 27.54 ..
1.3.m: “Let Mahādeva, Maheśa, be praised because of the gravity of the task!”

1.3.s:
tatheti gatvā te sarve devā viṣṇupurogamāḥ..
tathā brahmādayaḥ sarva īḍire ṛṣayo haram.. 27.55 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति गत्वा ते सर्वे देवा विष्णुपुरोगमाः..
तथा ब्रह्मादयः सर्व ईडिरे ऋषयो हरम्.. 27.55 ..
1.3.m: Saying “So be it,” all those gods headed by Viṣṇu, / as well as Brahmā and the others, all the seers, praised Hara:

1.3.s:
oṃnamo bhargāya devāya nīlakaṃṭhāya mīḍhuṣe..
trinetrāya trivedāya lokatritayadhāriṇe.. 27.56 ..
1.3.d:
ओंनमो भर्गाय देवाय नीलकंठाय मीढुषे..
त्रिनेत्राय त्रिवेदाय लोकत्रितयधारिणे.. 27.56 ..
1.3.m: “Om, homage to the radiant god, to the blue-throated, the bountiful, / to the three-eyed, the three Vedas, the supporter of the three worlds;

1.3.s:
trisvarāya trimātrāya trivedāya trimūrttaye..
trivargāya tridhāmāya tripadāya triśūline.. 27.57 ..
1.3.d:
त्रिस्वराय त्रिमात्राय त्रिवेदाय त्रिमूर्त्तये..
त्रिवर्गाय त्रिधामाय त्रिपदाय त्रिशूलिने.. 27.57 ..
1.3.m: to the three tones, the three measures, the three Vedas, the three forms, / to the threefold aim, the threefold abode, the three paces, the bearer of the trident!

1.3.s: trāhitrāhi mahādeva retaso jagataḥ pate.. 27.58 ..
1.3.d: त्राहित्राहि महादेव रेतसो जगतः पते.. 27.58 ..
1.3.m: Save us, save us, O Mahādeva, Lord of the world, from the semen!”

1.3.s:
brahmaṇā tu stuto yāvattāvaddevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ..
prādurbabhūva tatraiva surāṇāṃ kāryasiddhaye.. 27.59 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मणा तु स्तुतो यावत्तावद्देवो वृषध्वजः..
प्रादुर्बभूव तत्रैव सुराणां कार्यसिद्धये.. 27.59 ..
1.3.m: As soon as he was praised by Brahmā, the god whose banner is the bull / appeared right there for the accomplishment of the purpose of the gods.

1.3.s:
dṛṣṭastadānīṃ jagadekabaṃdhurmahātmabhirdevavaraiḥ supūjitaḥ..
saṃstūyamāno vividhairvacobhiḥ pratyagrūpaiḥ śrutisaṃmataiśca.. 27.60 ..
1.3.d:
दृष्टस्तदानीं जगदेकबंधुर्महात्मभिर्देववरैः सुपूजितः..
संस्तूयमानो विविधैर्वचोभिः प्रत्यग्रूपैः श्रुतिसंमतैश्च.. 27.60 ..
1.3.m: Then the sole friend of the universe was seen, well worshipped by the great-souled foremost gods, / being extolled with various fresh words consistent with the Vedas.

1.3.s:
stuvatāṃ caiva devānāmuvāca parameśvaraḥ..
trāsaṃ kurvaṃtu mā sarve retasānena pīḍitāḥ.. 27.61 ..
1.3.d:
स्तुवतां चैव देवानामुवाच परमेश्वरः..
त्रासं कुर्वंतु मा सर्वे रेतसानेन पीडिताः.. 27.61 ..
1.3.m: And to the praising gods the Supreme Lord said: / “Let none of you, tormented by this semen, be afraid.

1.3.s:
vamanaṃ vai bhavadbhiśca kāryamadyaiva bhoḥsurāḥ..
tatheti matvā te sarva iṃdrādyā devatāgaṇāḥ..
vemuḥ sarve tadā viprāstadretaḥ śaṃkarasya ca.. 27.62 ..
1.3.d:
वमनं वै भवद्भिश्च कार्यमद्यैव भोःसुराः..
तथेति मत्वा ते सर्व इंद्राद्या देवतागणाः..
वेमुः सर्वे तदा विप्रास्तद्रेतः शंकरस्य च.. 27.62 ..
1.3.m: Vomiting must be done by you this very day, O gods!” / Thinking “So be it,” all those hosts of gods, Indra and the rest, / then vomited that semen of Śaṃkara, O brahmins.

1.3.s:
aikapadyena tadreto mahāparvatasannibham..
taptacāmīkaraprakhyaṃ babhūva paramādbhutam.. 27.63 ..
1.3.d:
ऐकपद्येन तद्रेतो महापर्वतसन्निभम्..
तप्तचामीकरप्रख्यं बभूव परमाद्भुतम्.. 27.63 ..
1.3.m: All at once that semen, resembling a great mountain, / looking like molten gold, became a supreme wonder.

1.3.s:
sarve ca sukhino jātā iṃdrādyā devatāgaṇāḥ..
vinā hyagniṃ ca te sarve parituṣṭāstadā'bhavan.. 27.64 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वे च सुखिनो जाता इंद्राद्या देवतागणाः..
विना ह्यग्निं च ते सर्वे परितुष्टास्तदाऽभवन्.. 27.64 ..
1.3.m: And all the hosts of gods, Indra and the rest, became happy; / except for Agni, they all were then fully satisfied.

1.3.s:
tenāgnināpi coktastu śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ..
kiṃ mayādya mahā deva kartavyaṃ devatāvara.. 27.65 ..
1.3.d:
तेनाग्निनापि चोक्तस्तु शंकरो लोकशंकरः..
किं मयाद्य महा देव कर्तव्यं देवतावर.. 27.65 ..
1.3.m: And by that fire too, Śaṃkara, the causer of welfare to the world, was addressed: / “What must be done by me today, O Mahādeva, O best of deities?

1.3.s:
tadbrūhi me prabho'dya tvaṃ yenāhaṃ sarvadā sukhī..
bhaviṣyāmi ca yenāhaṃ devānāṃ havyavāhakaḥ.. 27.66 ..
1.3.d:
तद्ब्रूहि मे प्रभोऽद्य त्वं येनाहं सर्वदा सुखी..
भविष्यामि च येनाहं देवानां हव्यवाहकः.. 27.66 ..
1.3.m: Tell me that today, O Lord, whereby I may always be happy, / and whereby I may become the bearer of oblations for the gods.”

1.3.s:
tadovāca śivaḥ sākṣāddevānāmiha śrṛṇvatām..
reto visṛjyatāṃ yonau tadāgniḥ prahasannavi.. 27.67 ..
1.3.d:
तदोवाच शिवः साक्षाद्देवानामिह श्रृण्वताम्..
रेतो विसृज्यतां योनौ तदाग्निः प्रहसन्नवि.. 27.67 ..
1.3.m: Then Śiva spoke directly, while the gods were listening here: / “Let the semen be discharged into a womb.” Then Agni, laughing, [said] also:

1.3.s:
uvāca śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ bhavattejo durāsadam..
idamulbaṇavattejo dhāryate prākṛtaiḥ katham.. 27.68 ..
1.3.d:
उवाच शंकरं देवं भवत्तेजो दुरासदम्..
इदमुल्बणवत्तेजो धार्यते प्राकृतैः कथम्.. 27.68 ..
1.3.m: he said to the god Śaṃkara: “Your fiery splendour is hard to approach. / How can this exceedingly terrible fiery splendour be borne by ordinary beings?”

1.3.s:
tataḥ provāca bhagavānagniṃ prati maheśvaraḥ..
māsimāsi prataptānāṃ dehe tejo visṛjyatām.. 27.69 ..
1.3.d:
ततः प्रोवाच भगवानग्निं प्रति महेश्वरः..
मासिमासि प्रतप्तानां देहे तेजो विसृज्यताम्.. 27.69 ..
1.3.m: Then the blessed Maheśvara said to Agni: / “Discharge that fiery splendour into the bodies of those [women] who are heated [by morning bathing] month after month.”

1.3.s:
tatheti matvā vacanaṃ mahāprabhaḥ sa jātavedāḥ parameṇa varcasā..
samujjvalaṃstatra mahāprabhāvo brāhme muhūrtte hi sacopaviṣṭaḥ.. 27.70 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा वचनं महाप्रभः स जातवेदाः परमेण वर्चसा..
समुज्ज्वलंस्तत्र महाप्रभावो ब्राह्मे मुहूर्त्ते हि सचोपविष्टः.. 27.70 ..
1.3.m: Thinking “So be it,” regarding that command, the greatly luminous Jātavedas, blazing with supreme splendour, / possessed of great power, sat down there during the brāhma-muhūrta.

1.3.s:
tadā prātaḥ samutthāya prātaḥ snānaparāḥ striyaḥ..
yayuḥ sadā ṛṣīṇāṃ ca satyastā jātavedasam.. 27.71 ..
1.3.d:
तदा प्रातः समुत्थाय प्रातः स्नानपराः स्त्रियः..
ययुः सदा ऋषीणां च सत्यस्ता जातवेदसम्.. 27.71 ..
1.3.m: Then, having arisen in the morning, the wives of the seers, devoted to morning ablutions, / virtuous as they were, constantly went to Jātavedas.

1.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā prajvalitaṃ tatra sarvāstāḥ śītakarṣitāḥ..
taptukāmāstadā sarvvā hyarudhatyā nivāritāḥ.. 27.72 ..
1.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा प्रज्वलितं तत्र सर्वास्ताः शीतकर्षिताः..
तप्तुकामास्तदा सर्व्वा ह्यरुधत्या निवारिताः.. 27.72 ..
1.3.m: Seeing him blazing there, all of them, tormented by the cold, / desired to warm themselves, but were all restrained by Arundhatī.

1.3.s:
tayā nivāritāścāpi tāstepuḥ kṛttikāḥ svayam..
yāvattepuśca tāḥ sarvvā retasaḥ paramāṇavaḥ..
viviśū romakūpeṣu tāsāṃ tatraiva satvaram.. 27.73 ..
1.3.d:
तया निवारिताश्चापि तास्तेपुः कृत्तिकाः स्वयम्..
यावत्तेपुश्च ताः सर्व्वा रेतसः परमाणवः..
विविशू रोमकूपेषु तासां तत्रैव सत्वरम्.. 27.73 ..
1.3.m: Even though restrained by her, those Kṛttikās warmed themselves on their own. / As they were all warming themselves, the subtle particles of semen / swiftly entered their hair-pores right there.

1.3.s: nīretognistadā jāto viśrāṃtaḥ svayameva hi.. 27.74 ..
1.3.d: नीरेतोग्निस्तदा जातो विश्रांतः स्वयमेव हि.. 27.74 ..
1.3.m: Then Agni was rendered devoid of semen and became calm on his own.

1.3.s:
tatastā ṛṣibhāryā hi yayuḥ svabhavanaṃ prati..
ṛṣibhistu tadā śaptāḥ kṛttikāḥ khecarābhavan.. 27.75 ..
1.3.d:
ततस्ता ऋषिभार्या हि ययुः स्वभवनं प्रति..
ऋषिभिस्तु तदा शप्ताः कृत्तिकाः खेचराभवन्.. 27.75 ..
1.3.m: Then the wives of the seers went to their own dwellings. / But, cursed then by the seers, the Kṛttikās became sky-wanderers [as stars].

1.3.s:
tadānīmeva tāḥ sarvā vyabhicāreṇa duḥkhitāḥ..
tatsasarjustadā retaḥ pṛṣṭhe himavato gireḥ.. 27.76 ..
1.3.d:
तदानीमेव ताः सर्वा व्यभिचारेण दुःखिताः..
तत्ससर्जुस्तदा रेतः पृष्ठे हिमवतो गिरेः.. 27.76 ..
1.3.m: At that very time, all of them, distressed by the transgression, / discharged that semen on the ridge of the Himālaya mountain.

1.3.s:
ekapadyena tadretastaptacāmīkaraprabham..
gaṃgāyāṃ ca tadā kṣipraṃ kīcakaiḥ pariveṣṭitam.. 27.77 ..
1.3.d:
एकपद्येन तद्रेतस्तप्तचामीकरप्रभम्..
गंगायां च तदा क्षिप्रं कीचकैः परिवेष्टितम्.. 27.77 ..
1.3.m: Immediately that semen, with the splendour of molten gold, / was quickly surrounded by reed bamboos in the Gaṅgā.

1.3.s:
ṣaṇmukhaṃ bālakaṃ jñātvā sarve devā mudānvitāḥ..
gargeṇoktāstadaṃte vai sukhena hriyatāmiti.. 27.78 ..
1.3.d:
षण्मुखं बालकं ज्ञात्वा सर्वे देवा मुदान्विताः..
गर्गेणोक्तास्तदंते वै सुखेन ह्रियतामिति.. 27.78 ..
1.3.m: Knowing that the child had six faces, all the gods were filled with joy; / then, addressed by Garga, [they thought]: “Let him be carried away easily.”

1.3.s:
śaṃbhoḥ putraḥ prasādena sarvo bhavati śāśvataḥ..
gaṃgāyāḥ puline jātaḥ kārttikeyo mahābalaḥ.. 27.79 ..
1.3.d:
शंभोः पुत्रः प्रसादेन सर्वो भवति शाश्वतः..
गंगायाः पुलिने जातः कार्त्तिकेयो महाबलः.. 27.79 ..
1.3.m: By the grace of Śambhu, this son is all-pervading and eternal; / the mighty Kārttikeya was born on the bank of the Gaṅgā.

1.3.s:
upaviṣṭotha gāṃgeyo hyahorātroṣitastadā..
śākho viśākho'tibalaḥ ṣaṇmukho'sau mahābalaḥ.. 27.80 ..
1.3.d:
उपविष्टोथ गांगेयो ह्यहोरात्रोषितस्तदा..
शाखो विशाखोऽतिबलः षण्मुखोऽसौ महाबलः.. 27.80 ..
1.3.m: Then the son of Gaṅgā sat down, having fasted for a day and a night; / he is Śākha, Viśākha, exceedingly powerful, six-faced, and possessed of great might.

1.3.s:
jāto yadātha gaṃgāyāṃ ṣaṇmukhaḥ śaṃkarātmajaḥ..
tadānīmeva girijā saṃjātā prasnutastanī.. 27.81 ..
1.3.d:
जातो यदाथ गंगायां षण्मुखः शंकरात्मजः..
तदानीमेव गिरिजा संजाता प्रस्नुतस्तनी.. 27.81 ..
1.3.m: When that six-faced son of Śaṃkara was born in the Gaṅgā, / at that very moment milk flowed from the breasts of the Mountain’s daughter.

1.3.s:
śivaṃ nirīkṣya sā prāha he śaṃbho prasnavo mahān..
saṃjāto me mahādeva kimarthastannirīkṣyatām..
sarvajño'pi mahādevo hyabravīttāmathājñavat.. 27.82 ..
1.3.d:
शिवं निरीक्ष्य सा प्राह हे शंभो प्रस्नवो महान्..
संजातो मे महादेव किमर्थस्तन्निरीक्ष्यताम्..
सर्वज्ञोऽपि महादेवो ह्यब्रवीत्तामथाज्ञवत्.. 27.82 ..
1.3.m: Looking at Śiva, she said: “O Śambhu, a great flow of milk / has occurred for me, O Mahādeva! Look into why this is so!” / Even though omniscient, Mahādeva spoke to her as if ignorant:

1.3.s:
nāradastatra cāgatya proktavāñjanma tasya tat..
śivāya ca śivāyai ca putro jāto hi suṃdaraḥ.. 27.83 ..
1.3.d:
नारदस्तत्र चागत्य प्रोक्तवाञ्जन्म तस्य तत्..
शिवाय च शिवायै च पुत्रो जातो हि सुंदरः.. 27.83 ..
1.3.m: Nārada, having arrived there, reported that birth of his / to Śiva and Śivā: “A handsome son has indeed been born!”

1.3.s:
tadākarṇya vaco viprā harṣanirbharamānasāḥ..
babhūvuḥ pramathāḥ sarve gaṃdharvā gītatatparāḥ.. 27.84 ..
1.3.d:
तदाकर्ण्य वचो विप्रा हर्षनिर्भरमानसाः..
बभूवुः प्रमथाः सर्वे गंधर्वा गीततत्पराः.. 27.84 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that word, O brahmins, their minds filled with joy; / all the Pramathas [rejoiced], and the Gandharvas were devoted to singing.

1.3.s:
anekābhiḥ patākābhiścailapallavatoraṇaiḥ..
tathā vimānairbahubhirbabhau prajvalito mahān..
parvataḥ putrajananācchaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ.. 27.85 ..
1.3.d:
अनेकाभिः पताकाभिश्चैलपल्लवतोरणैः..
तथा विमानैर्बहुभिर्बभौ प्रज्वलितो महान्..
पर्वतः पुत्रजननाच्छंकरस्य महात्मनः.. 27.85 ..
1.3.m: With many banners, cloth-and-shoot festoons, / and many aerial chariots, the great mountain shone brightly, blazing, / because of the birth of the son of the great-souled Śaṃkara.

1.3.s: tadā sarve suragaṇā ṛṣayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ rakṣogaṃdharvayakṣāśca apsarogaṇasevitāḥ.. 27.86 ..
1.3.d: तदा सर्वे सुरगणा ऋषयः सिद्धचारणाः रक्षोगंधर्वयक्षाश्च अप्सरोगणसेविताः.. 27.86 ..
1.3.m: Then all the hosts of gods, seers, Siddhas and Cāraṇas, / Rākṣasas, Gandharvas, and Yakṣas, attended by hosts of apsarases,

1.3.s:
ekapadyena te sarve sahitāḥ śaṃkareṇa tu..
draṣṭuṃ gāṃgeyamadhikaṃ jagmuḥ pulinasaṃsthitam.. 27.87 ..
1.3.d:
एकपद्येन ते सर्वे सहिताः शंकरेण तु..
द्रष्टुं गांगेयमधिकं जग्मुः पुलिनसंस्थितम्.. 27.87 ..
1.3.m: all together in a single body, along with Śaṃkara, / went in great numbers to see the son of Gaṅgā staying on the sandbank.

1.3.s:
tato vṛṣabhamāruhya yayau girijayā saha..
anyaiḥ sameto bhagavānsurairiṃdrādibhistathā.. 27.88 ..
1.3.d:
ततो वृषभमारुह्य ययौ गिरिजया सह..
अन्यैः समेतो भगवान्सुरैरिंद्रादिभिस्तथा.. 27.88 ..
1.3.m: Then the Lord, having mounted the bull, set out with the Mountain’s daughter, / accompanied by the other gods, Indra and the rest.

1.3.s: tadā śaṃkhāśca bheryaśca nedustūryīṇyanekaśaḥ.. 27.89 ..
1.3.d: तदा शंखाश्च भेर्यश्च नेदुस्तूर्यीण्यनेकशः.. 27.89 ..
1.3.m: Then conches and kettle-drums and numerous trumpets resounded.

1.3.s:
tadānīmeva sarveśaṃ vīrabhadrādayo gaṇāḥ..
anvayuḥ kelisaṃrabdhā nānāvāditravādakāḥ..
vādayantaśca vādyāni tatāni vitatāni ca.. 27.90 ..
1.3.d:
तदानीमेव सर्वेशं वीरभद्रादयो गणाः..
अन्वयुः केलिसंरब्धा नानावादित्रवादकाः..
वादयन्तश्च वाद्यानि ततानि विततानि च.. 27.90 ..
1.3.m: At that very time, the Gaṇas led by Vīrabhadra followed the Lord of all, / eager for sport, playing various musical instruments, / sounding instruments with stretched membranes and stringed instruments.

1.3.s:
kecinnṛtyaparāstatra gāyakāśca tathā pare..
stāvakāḥ stūyamānāśca cakruste guṇakīrtanam.. 27.91 ..
1.3.d:
केचिन्नृत्यपरास्तत्र गायकाश्च तथा परे..
स्तावकाः स्तूयमानाश्च चक्रुस्ते गुणकीर्तनम्.. 27.91 ..
1.3.m: Some were intent on dancing there, and others were singers; / and panegyrists who were offering praises proclaimed his glorious virtues.

1.3.s:
evaṃvidhāste surasiddhayakṣā gaṃdharvavidyādharapannagā hyamī..
śivena sārddhaṃ parihṛṣṭacittā draṣṭuṃ yayustaṃ varadaṃ ca śāṃkarim.. 27.92 ..
1.3.d:
एवंविधास्ते सुरसिद्धयक्षा गंधर्वविद्याधरपन्नगा ह्यमी..
शिवेन सार्द्धं परिहृष्टचित्ता द्रष्टुं ययुस्तं वरदं च शांकरिम्.. 27.92 ..
1.3.m: Thus these gods, Siddhas, Yakṣas, Gandharvas, Vidyādharas, and Pannagas, / with exceedingly delighted minds, went with Śiva to see that boon-bestowing son of Śaṃkara.

1.3.s:
yāvatsamīkṣayāmāsurgāṃgeyaṃ śaṃkaropamam..
dadṛśuste mahattejo vyāptamāsījjagattrayam.. 27.93 ..
1.3.d:
यावत्समीक्षयामासुर्गांगेयं शंकरोपमम्..
ददृशुस्ते महत्तेजो व्याप्तमासीज्जगत्त्रयम्.. 27.93 ..
1.3.m: As they beheld the son of Gaṅgā, who was like Śaṃkara, / they saw a great fiery splendour that had pervaded the three worlds.

1.3.s:
tattojasāvṛtaṃ bālaṃ taptacāmīkaraprabham..
sumukhaṃ suśriyā yuktaṃ sunasaṃ susmitekṣaṇam.. 27.94 ..
1.3.d:
तत्तोजसावृतं बालं तप्तचामीकरप्रभम्..
सुमुखं सुश्रिया युक्तं सुनसं सुस्मितेक्षणम्.. 27.94 ..
1.3.m: They saw the child enveloped by that splendour, glowing like molten gold, / having a lovely face, endowed with auspicious beauty, with a shapely nose and smiling eyes,

1.3.s:
cāruprasanna vadanaṃ tathā sarvāgasuṃdaram..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ gāṃgeyaṃ prathitātmakam.. 27.95 ..
1.3.d:
चारुप्रसन्न वदनं तथा सर्वागसुंदरम्..
तं दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्यं गांगेयं प्रथितात्मकम्.. 27.95 ..
1.3.m: with a charming, serene face and handsome in all his limbs. / Beholding that great wonder, the renowned son of Gaṅgā,

1.3.s:
vavaṃdire tadā bālaṃ kumāraṃ sūryavarcasam..
pramathāśca gaṇāḥ sarve vīrabhadrādayastathā.. 27.96 ..
1.3.d:
ववंदिरे तदा बालं कुमारं सूर्यवर्चसम्..
प्रमथाश्च गणाः सर्वे वीरभद्रादयस्तथा.. 27.96 ..
1.3.m: the Pramathas, all the Gaṇas, and likewise Vīrabhadra and the others, / then bowed down to the child, Kumāra, who possessed the splendour of the sun.

1.3.s:
parivāryopatasthuste vāmadakṣiṇabhāgataḥ..
tathā brahmā ca viṣṇuśca iṃdraścāpi surairvṛtaḥ.. 27.97 ..
1.3.d:
परिवार्योपतस्थुस्ते वामदक्षिणभागतः..
तथा ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च इंद्रश्चापि सुरैर्वृतः.. 27.97 ..
1.3.m: They stood around him on the left and right sides; / likewise Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Indra, surrounded by the gods,

1.3.s:
ṛṣayo yakṣagaṃdharvāḥ parivārya kumārakam..
daṃḍavatpititā bhūmau kecicca natakaṃdharāḥ.. 27.98 ..
1.3.d:
ऋषयो यक्षगंधर्वाः परिवार्य कुमारकम्..
दंडवत्पितिता भूमौ केचिच्च नतकंधराः.. 27.98 ..
1.3.m: the seers, Yakṣas, and Gandharvas, surrounding Kumāra; / some fell to the ground like a stick, and some bowed their necks.

1.3.s:
praṇemuḥ śirasā cānye matvā svāminamavyayam..
avādyaṃta vicitrāṇi vāditrāṇi mahotsave..
evamabhyudaye tasminnṛṣayaḥ śāṃtimāpaṭham.. 27.99 ..
1.3.d:
प्रणेमुः शिरसा चान्ये मत्वा स्वामिनमव्ययम्..
अवाद्यंत विचित्राणि वादित्राणि महोत्सवे..
एवमभ्युदये तस्मिन्नृषयः शांतिमापठम्.. 27.99 ..
1.3.m: Others bowed with their heads, regarding him as the imperishable master. / Diverse musical instruments were played during the great celebration; / in this way, during that festival of prosperity, the seers recited peace-chants.

1.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare yātaḥ śaṃkaro girijāpatiḥ..
avatīrya vṛṣācchīghraṃ pārvatyā sahasuvratāḥ.. 27.100 ..
1.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे यातः शंकरो गिरिजापतिः..
अवतीर्य वृषाच्छीघ्रं पार्वत्या सहसुव्रताः.. 27.100 ..
1.3.m: In the meantime Śaṃkara, the husband of the Mountain’s daughter, arrived; / having quickly dismounted from the bull together with Pārvatī, O you of noble vows,

1.3.s:
putraṃ niraikṣata tadā jagadekabaṃdhuḥ prītyā yutaḥ paramayā saha vai bhavānyā..
snehānvito bhujagabhogayuto hi sākṣātsarveśvaraḥ parivṛtaḥ pramathaiḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ.. 27.101 ..
1.3.d:
पुत्रं निरैक्षत तदा जगदेकबंधुः प्रीत्या युतः परमया सह वै भवान्या..
स्नेहान्वितो भुजगभोगयुतो हि साक्षात्सर्वेश्वरः परिवृतः प्रमथैः प्रहृष्टः.. 27.101 ..
1.3.m: the sole friend of the universe, accompanied by Bhavānī, filled with supreme love, / filled with affection, adorned with the body of a serpent, the Lord of all in visible form, surrounded by the Pramathas, joyfully looked upon his son.

1.3.s:
upaguhya guhaṃ tatra pārvatī jātasaṃbhramā..
prasnutaṃ pāyayāmāsa stanaṃ snehapariplutā.. 27.102 ..
1.3.d:
उपगुह्य गुहं तत्र पार्वती जातसंभ्रमा..
प्रस्नुतं पाययामास स्तनं स्नेहपरिप्लुता.. 27.102 ..
1.3.m: Embracing Guha there, Pārvatī, agitated with excitement, / overflowing with affection, suckled him with her flowing breast.

1.3.s:
tadā nīrājito devaiḥ sakalatrairmudānvitaiḥ..
jayaśabdena mahatā vyāptamāsīnnabhastalam.. 27.103 ..
1.3.d:
तदा नीराजितो देवैः सकलत्रैर्मुदान्वितैः..
जयशब्देन महता व्याप्तमासीन्नभस्तलम्.. 27.103 ..
1.3.m: Then, waved over with lamps by the joyful gods together with their wives, / the vault of the sky was filled with a great cry of “Victory!”

1.3.s:
ṛṣayo brahmagoṣeṇa gītenaiva ca gāyakāḥ..
vādyaiśca vādakāścaiva upatasthuḥ kumārakam.. 27.104 ..
1.3.d:
ऋषयो ब्रह्मगोषेण गीतेनैव च गायकाः..
वाद्यैश्च वादकाश्चैव उपतस्थुः कुमारकम्.. 27.104 ..
1.3.m: The seers with Vedic recitation, the singers with song, / and the instrumentalists with musical instruments approached Kumāra.

1.3.s:
svamaṃkamārepya tadā girīśaḥ kumārakaṃ taṃ prabhayā mahāprabham..
babhau bhavānīpatireva sākṣācchriyā yutaḥ putravatāṃ variṣṭhaḥ.. 27.105 ..
1.3.d:
स्वमंकमारेप्य तदा गिरीशः कुमारकं तं प्रभया महाप्रभम्..
बभौ भवानीपतिरेव साक्षाच्छ्रिया युतः पुत्रवतां वरिष्ठः.. 27.105 ..
1.3.m: Placing that Kumāra, who was of great brilliance, on his lap by his power, / the husband of Bhavānī, endowed with splendour, shone like the foremost among fathers in visible form.

1.3.s:
daṃpatī tau tadā tatra aikapadyena naṃdatuḥ..
abhiṣicyamāna ṛṣibhirāvṛtaḥ surasattamaiḥ.. 27.106 ..
1.3.d:
दंपती तौ तदा तत्र ऐकपद्येन नंदतुः..
अभिषिच्यमान ऋषिभिरावृतः सुरसत्तमैः.. 27.106 ..
1.3.m: At that time, both husband and wife rejoiced together, / while he was being sprinkled [with waters] by the seers, surrounded by the foremost of the gods.

1.3.s:
kumāraḥ krīḍayāmāsa utsaṃge śaṃkarasya ca..
kaṃṭhe sthitaṃ vāsukiṃ ca pāṇibhyāṃ samapīḍayat.. 27.107 ..
1.3.d:
कुमारः क्रीडयामास उत्संगे शंकरस्य च..
कंठे स्थितं वासुकिं च पाणिभ्यां समपीडयत्.. 27.107 ..
1.3.m: Kumāra played upon the lap of Śaṃkara; / and with both hands he squeezed Vāsuki, who was around his neck.

1.3.s:
mukhaṃ prapīḍayitvā'sau pāṇīnagaṇayattadā..
ekaṃ trīṇidaśāṣṭau ca viparītakrameṇa ca.. 27.108 ..
1.3.d:
मुखं प्रपीडयित्वाऽसौ पाणीनगणयत्तदा..
एकं त्रीणिदशाष्टौ च विपरीतक्रमेण च.. 27.108 ..
1.3.m: Having squeezed his face, he then counted his hands: / “One, three, ten, eight,” in reverse order.

1.3.s: prahasya bhagavāñchaṃbhuruvāca girijāṃ tadā.. 27.109 ..
1.3.d: प्रहस्य भगवाञ्छंभुरुवाच गिरिजां तदा.. 27.109 ..
1.3.m: Laughing, the blessed Śambhu then spoke to the Mountain’s daughter.

1.3.s:
maṃdasmitena ca tadā bhagavānmaheśaḥ prāpto mudaṃca paramāṃ girijāsametaḥ..
premṇā sagadgadagirā jagadekabaṃdhurnovāca kiṃcana tadā bhuvanaikabhartā.. 27.110 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kārttikeyasvāmikumārotpattivarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 27 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
मंदस्मितेन च तदा भगवान्महेशः प्राप्तो मुदंच परमां गिरिजासमेतः..
प्रेम्णा सगद्गदगिरा जगदेकबंधुर्नोवाच किंचन तदा भुवनैकभर्ता.. 27.110 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे कार्त्तिकेयस्वामिकुमारोत्पत्तिवर्णनंनाम सप्तविंशोऽध्यायः.. 27 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
And then, with a gentle smile, the lord Maheśa, united with Girijā, attained supreme joy; / with affection and a voice faltering [with emotion], the sole friend of the universe, the sole master of the worlds, said nothing at that time.
Thus ends the twenty-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Origin of Lord Kumāra Kārttikeya', in the first [section], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
kumāraṃ svāṃkamāropya uvāca jagadīśvaraḥ..
devānprati tadā rudraḥ seṃdrānbhargaḥ pratāpavān.. 28.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
कुमारं स्वांकमारोप्य उवाच जगदीश्वरः..
देवान्प्रति तदा रुद्रः सेंद्रान्भर्गः प्रतापवान्.. 28.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Placing Kumāra upon his lap, the lord of the universe, / Rudra, the glorious Bharga, then spoke to the gods along with Indra:

1.3.s:
kiṃ kāryaṃ kathyatāṃ devāḥ kumāreṇādhunā mama..
tadocuḥ sahitāḥ sarve devaṃ paśupatiṃ prati.. 28.2 ..
1.3.d:
किं कार्यं कथ्यतां देवाः कुमारेणाधुना मम..
तदोचुः सहिताः सर्वे देवं पशुपतिं प्रति.. 28.2 ..
1.3.m: "O gods, tell what Kumāra is now to do for me." / Thereupon all of them together said to the god Paśupati:

1.3.s:
tārakādbhayamutpannaṃ sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ vibho..
trātā tvaṃ jagatāṃ svāmī tasmāttrāṇaṃ vidhīyatām.. 28.3 ..
1.3.d:
तारकाद्भयमुत्पन्नं सर्वेषां जगतां विभो..
त्राता त्वं जगतां स्वामी तस्मात्त्राणं विधीयताम्.. 28.3 ..
1.3.m: "O all-pervading lord, fear has arisen from Tāraka for all the worlds. / You are the protector, the lord of the worlds; therefore, grant protection!

1.3.s:
kumāreṇa hato'dyaiva tārako bhavitā prabho..
tasmādadyaiva yāsyāmastārakaṃ haṃtumudyatāḥ.. 28.4 ..
1.3.d:
कुमारेण हतोऽद्यैव तारको भविता प्रभो..
तस्मादद्यैव यास्यामस्तारकं हंतुमुद्यताः.. 28.4 ..
1.3.m: O lord, Tāraka must be slain this very day by Kumāra; / therefore we shall go this very day, resolved to slay Tāraka."

1.3.s:
tatheti matvā sahasā nirjagmuste tadā surāḥ..
kārttikeyaṃ puraskṛtya śaṃkarātamajameva hi.. 28.5 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा सहसा निर्जग्मुस्ते तदा सुराः..
कार्त्तिकेयं पुरस्कृत्य शंकरातमजमेव हि.. 28.5 ..
1.3.m: Thinking, "So be it," the gods then quickly departed, / having placed Kārttikeya, the very son of Śaṃkara, at their head.

1.3.s:
sarve militvā sahasā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ..
devānāmudyamaṃ śrutvā tārako'pi mahābalaḥ.. 28.6 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वे मिलित्वा सहसा ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरोगमाः..
देवानामुद्यमं श्रुत्वा तारकोऽपि महाबलः.. 28.6 ..
1.3.m: All united together in haste, led by Brahmā and Viṣṇu. / Hearing of the gods' preparation, the mighty Tāraka too,

1.3.s:
sainyena mahatā caiva yayau yoddhuṃ surānprati..
devairdṛṣṭaṃ samāyātaṃ tārakasya mahadbalam.. 28.7 ..
1.3.d:
सैन्येन महता चैव ययौ योद्धुं सुरान्प्रति..
देवैर्दृष्टं समायातं तारकस्य महद्बलम्.. 28.7 ..
1.3.m: with a vast army indeed, marched against the gods to fight. / The gods saw the vast force of Tāraka advancing.

1.3.s:
tadā nabhogatā vāṇī hyuvāca parisāṃtvya tān..
śāṃkariṃ ca puraskṛtya sarve yūya pratiṣṭhitāḥ.. 28.8 ..
1.3.d:
तदा नभोगता वाणी ह्युवाच परिसांत्व्य तान्..
शांकरिं च पुरस्कृत्य सर्वे यूय प्रतिष्ठिताः.. 28.8 ..
1.3.m: Then a voice from the sky spoke, consoling them: / "All of you have set forth, placing Śiva's son at your head;

1.3.s: daityānvijitya saṃgrāme jayino hi bhaviṣyatha.. 28.9 ..
1.3.d: दैत्यान्विजित्य संग्रामे जयिनो हि भविष्यथ.. 28.9 ..
1.3.m: having conquered the daityas in battle, you will indeed be victorious."

1.3.s:
vācaṃ tu khecarīṃ śrutvā devāḥ sarve samutsukāḥ..
kumāraṃ ca puraskṛtya sarve te gatasādhvasāḥ.. 28.10 ..
1.3.d:
वाचं तु खेचरीं श्रुत्वा देवाः सर्वे समुत्सुकाः..
कुमारं च पुरस्कृत्य सर्वे ते गतसाध्वसाः.. 28.10 ..
1.3.m: Hearing the celestial voice, all the gods were eager, / and placing Kumāra at their head, they were all freed from fear.

1.3.s:
yuddhakāmāḥ surā yāvattāvatsarve samāgatāḥ..
varaṇārthaṃ kumārasya sutā mṛtyorduratyayā.. 28.11 ..
1.3.d:
युद्धकामाः सुरा यावत्तावत्सर्वे समागताः..
वरणार्थं कुमारस्य सुता मृत्योर्दुरत्यया.. 28.11 ..
1.3.m: While the gods were desirous of battle, then all came together; / to choose Kumāra [as husband], the irresistible daughter of Death [approached].

1.3.s:
brahmaṇā noditā pūrvaṃ tapaḥ paramamāśritā..
tapasā tena mahatā kumāraṃ prati vai tadā..
āgatā duhitā mṛtyoḥ senā nāmaikasuṃdarī.. 28.12 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मणा नोदिता पूर्वं तपः परममाश्रिता..
तपसा तेन महता कुमारं प्रति वै तदा..
आगता दुहिता मृत्योः सेना नामैकसुंदरी.. 28.12 ..
1.3.m: Having been prompted earlier by Brahmā, she had undertaken supreme austerity. / By that great austerity, toward Kumāra then / the daughter of Death came, an incomparable beauty named Senā.

1.3.s:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā te'bruvansarve devaṃ paśupatiṃ prati..
enaṃ kumāramuddiśya āgatā hyatisuṃdarī.. 28.13 ..
1.3.d:
तां दृष्ट्वा तेऽब्रुवन्सर्वे देवं पशुपतिं प्रति..
एनं कुमारमुद्दिश्य आगता ह्यतिसुंदरी.. 28.13 ..
1.3.m: Seeing her, they all said to the god Paśupati: / "An exceedingly beautiful maiden has come for the sake of this Kumāra."

1.3.s:
brahmaṇo vacanāccaiva kumāreṇa tadā vṛtā..
atha senāpatirjātaḥ kumāraḥ śāṃkaristadā.. 28.14 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मणो वचनाच्चैव कुमारेण तदा वृता..
अथ सेनापतिर्जातः कुमारः शांकरिस्तदा.. 28.14 ..
1.3.m: And by the command of Brahmā, she was then chosen by Kumāra. / Then Kumāra, the son of Śaṃkara, became the commander of the army (Senāpati).

1.3.s:
tadā śaṃkhāśca bheryaśca paṭahānakagomukhāḥ..
tathā duṃdubhayo nedurmṛdaṃgāśca mahāsvanāḥ.. 28.15 ..
1.3.d:
तदा शंखाश्च भेर्यश्च पटहानकगोमुखाः..
तथा दुंदुभयो नेदुर्मृदंगाश्च महास्वनाः.. 28.15 ..
1.3.m: Then conches, drums, paṭahas, ānakas, and gomukhas, / as well as kettledrums and loud mṛdaṅgas resounded.

1.3.s:
tena nādena mahatā pūritaṃ ca nabhastalam..
tadā gaurī ca gaṃgā ca kṛttikā mātarastathā..
parasparamathocustāḥ suto mama mameti ca.. 28.16 ..
1.3.d:
तेन नादेन महता पूरितं च नभस्तलम्..
तदा गौरी च गंगा च कृत्तिका मातरस्तथा..
परस्परमथोचुस्ताः सुतो मम ममेति च.. 28.16 ..
1.3.m: The vault of heaven was filled with that great sound. / Then Gaurī, Gaṅgā, the Kṛttikās, and the Mothers / spoke to one another: "He is my son! He is mine!"

1.3.s:
evaṃ vivādamāpannāḥ sarvāstā mātṛkādayaḥ..
nivāritā nāradena mauḍhyaṃ mā kuruteti ca.. 28.17 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विवादमापन्नाः सर्वास्ता मातृकादयः..
निवारिता नारदेन मौढ्यं मा कुरुतेति च.. 28.17 ..
1.3.m: When all of them, the Mothers and the rest, had thus fallen into dispute, / they were restrained by Nārada, saying, "Do not act foolishly!

1.3.s:
pārvatyāṃ śaṃkarājjāto devakāryārthasiddhaye..
tūṣṇīṃbhūtāstadā sarvāḥ kṛttikā mātṛbhiḥ saha.. 28.18 ..
1.3.d:
पार्वत्यां शंकराज्जातो देवकार्यार्थसिद्धये..
तूष्णींभूतास्तदा सर्वाः कृत्तिका मातृभिः सह.. 28.18 ..
1.3.m: He was born of Śaṃkara in Pārvatī for the accomplishment of the purpose of the gods." / Then the Kṛttikās along with the Mothers all fell silent.

1.3.s:
guhenoktāstadā sarvā ṛṣipatnyaśca kṛttikāḥ..
nakṣatrāṇi samāśritya bhavadbhiḥ sthīyatāṃ ciram.. 28.19 ..
1.3.d:
गुहेनोक्तास्तदा सर्वा ऋषिपत्न्यश्च कृत्तिकाः..
नक्षत्राणि समाश्रित्य भवद्भिः स्थीयतां चिरम्.. 28.19 ..
1.3.m: The wives of the sages, the Kṛttikās, were then all told by Guha: / "Residing in the lunar mansions, may you remain [there] for a long time."

1.3.s:
tathā mātṛgaṇastena svāminā sthāpito divi..
mṛtyoḥ kanyāṃ ca saṃgṛhya kārttikeyastvarānvitaḥ.. 28.20 ..
1.3.d:
तथा मातृगणस्तेन स्वामिना स्थापितो दिवि..
मृत्योः कन्यां च संगृह्य कार्त्तिकेयस्त्वरान्वितः.. 28.20 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, the group of Mothers was established in heaven by the Lord. / And taking the daughter of Death, Kārttikeya, full of haste,

1.3.s:
iṃdraṃ provāca bhagavānkumāraḥ śaṃkarātmajaḥ..
divaṃ yāhi suraiḥ sārddhaṃ rājyaṃ kuru nirantaram.. 28.21 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्रं प्रोवाच भगवान्कुमारः शंकरात्मजः..
दिवं याहि सुरैः सार्द्धं राज्यं कुरु निरन्तरम्.. 28.21 ..
1.3.m: the blessed Kumāra, the son of Śaṃkara, spoke to Indra: / "Go to heaven along with the gods and rule continually."

1.3.s:
iṃdreṇoktaḥ kumāro hi tārakeṇa prapīḍitāḥ..
svargādvidrāvitāḥ sarve vayaṃ yātā diśo daśa.. 28.22 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्रेणोक्तः कुमारो हि तारकेण प्रपीडिताः..
स्वर्गाद्विद्राविताः सर्वे वयं याता दिशो दश.. 28.22 ..
1.3.m: Kumāra was indeed addressed by Indra: "Afflicted by Tāraka, / all of us, driven out from heaven, have fled in the ten directions.

1.3.s:
kiṃ pṛcchasi mahābhāga asmānpadaparicyutān..
evamuktastadā tena vajriṇāśaṃkarātmajaḥ..
prahasyeṃdraṃ prati tadā mā bhaiṣītyabhayaṃ dadau.. 28.23 ..
1.3.d:
किं पृच्छसि महाभाग अस्मान्पदपरिच्युतान्..
एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन वज्रिणाशंकरात्मजः..
प्रहस्येंद्रं प्रति तदा मा भैषीत्यभयं ददौ.. 28.23 ..
1.3.m: Why do you ask about us, O highly fortunate one, who are fallen from our station?" / Having been addressed thus by the thunderbolt-wielder, the son of Śaṃkara, / smiling at Indra, gave [him] fearlessness, saying, "Do not fear!"

1.3.s:
yāvatkathayatastasya śāṃkareśca mahātnaḥ..
kailāsaṃ tu gate rudre pārvatyā pramathaiḥ saha.. 28.24 ..
1.3.d:
यावत्कथयतस्तस्य शांकरेश्च महात्नः..
कैलासं तु गते रुद्रे पार्वत्या प्रमथैः सह.. 28.24 ..
1.3.m: While the high-souled son of Śaṃkara was speaking, / Rudra having gone to Kailāsa with Pārvatī and the pramathas,

1.3.s:
ājagāma mahādaityo daityasenābhirāvṛtaḥ..
raṇaduṃdubhayo nedustatā pralayabhīṣaṇāḥ.. 28.25 ..
1.3.d:
आजगाम महादैत्यो दैत्यसेनाभिरावृतः..
रणदुंदुभयो नेदुस्तता प्रलयभीषणाः.. 28.25 ..
1.3.m: the great daitya arrived, surrounded by daitya armies. / The battle drums, dread as the dissolution of the world, sounded there,

1.3.s:
raṇakarkaśatūryāṇi ḍiṃḍimānyadbhutāni ca..
gomukhāḥ kharaśrṛṃgāṇi kāhalānyeva bhūriśaḥ.. 28.26 ..
1.3.d:
रणकर्कशतूर्याणि डिंडिमान्यद्भुतानि च..
गोमुखाः खरश्रृंगाणि काहलान्येव भूरिशः.. 28.26 ..
1.3.m: as well as battle-harsh trumpets, wondrous ḍiṇḍimas, / gomukhas, shrill horns, and numerous kāhalas.

1.3.s:
vādyabhedā āvādyaṃta tasmindaityasamāgame..
garjamānāstadā vīrastārakeṇa sahaiva tu.. 28.27 ..
1.3.d:
वाद्यभेदा आवाद्यंत तस्मिन्दैत्यसमागमे..
गर्जमानास्तदा वीरस्तारकेण सहैव तु.. 28.27 ..
1.3.m: Various musical instruments were sounded in that gathering of daityas, / while the warriors roared alongside Tāraka.

1.3.s: uvāca nārado vākyaṃ tārakaṃ devakaṇṭakam.. 28.28 ..
1.3.d: उवाच नारदो वाक्यं तारकं देवकण्टकम्.. 28.28 ..
1.3.m: Nārada spoke words to Tāraka, the thorn of the gods:

1.3.s:
..nārada uvāca..
purā devaiḥ kṛto yatno vadhārthaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ..
tavaiva cāsuraśreṣṭha mayoktaṃ nānyathā bhavet.. 28.29 ..
1.3.d:
..नारद उवाच..
पुरा देवैः कृतो यत्नो वधार्थं नात्र संशयः..
तवैव चासुरश्रेष्ठ मयोक्तं नान्यथा भवेत्.. 28.29 ..
1.3.m: Nārada said: / "Formerly, an effort was made by the gods for your slaying; there is no doubt in this. / It was for yours alone, O best of asuras; what I have said cannot be otherwise.

1.3.s:
kumāro'yaṃ ca śarvasya tavārthaṃ copapāditaḥ..
evaṃ jñātvā mahābāho kuru yatnaṃ samāhitaḥ.. 28.30 ..
1.3.d:
कुमारोऽयं च शर्वस्य तवार्थं चोपपादितः..
एवं ज्ञात्वा महाबाहो कुरु यत्नं समाहितः.. 28.30 ..
1.3.m: And this Kumāra of Śarva has been brought forth on your account. / Knowing this, O mighty-armed one, make your effort with concentrated mind."

1.3.s:
nāradoktaṃ niśamyātha tārakaḥ prahasanniva..
uvāca vākyaṃ medhāvī gaccha tvaṃ ca puraṃdaram.. 28.31 ..
1.3.d:
नारदोक्तं निशम्याथ तारकः प्रहसन्निव..
उवाच वाक्यं मेधावी गच्छ त्वं च पुरंदरम्.. 28.31 ..
1.3.m: Hearing what was said by Nārada, Tāraka, as if laughing, / the intelligent one, spoke words: "Go to Puraṃdara.

1.3.s:
mama vākyaṃ maharṣe tvaṃ vada śīghraṃ yathātatham..
kumāraṃ ca puraskṛtya mayā yoddhuṃ tvamicchasi.. 28.32 ..
1.3.d:
मम वाक्यं महर्षे त्वं वद शीघ्रं यथातथम्..
कुमारं च पुरस्कृत्य मया योद्धुं त्वमिच्छसि.. 28.32 ..
1.3.m: O great seer, speak my words to him quickly and truly: / 'Do you wish to fight with me, having placed Kumāra at your head?

1.3.s:
mūḍhabhāvaṃ samāśritya kartumicchasi nānyathā..
manuṣyamekamāśritya mucukundākhyameva ca.. 28.33 ..
1.3.d:
मूढभावं समाश्रित्य कर्तुमिच्छसि नान्यथा..
मनुष्यमेकमाश्रित्य मुचुकुन्दाख्यमेव च.. 28.33 ..
1.3.m: Having resorted to foolishness, you wish to act, and not otherwise! / Relying on a single human named Mucukunda,

1.3.s:
tatprabhāve'marāvatyāṃ sthito'si tvaṃ na cānyathā..
kaumāraṃ balamāśritya tiṣṭhase tvaṃ mamāgrataḥ.. 28.34 ..
1.3.d:
तत्प्रभावेऽमरावत्यां स्थितोऽसि त्वं न चान्यथा..
कौमारं बलमाश्रित्य तिष्ठसे त्वं ममाग्रतः.. 28.34 ..
1.3.m: by his power you remained in Amarāvatī, and not otherwise. / Relying on the strength of a child (Kumāra), do you stand before me?

1.3.s:
tvāṃ haniṣyāmyahaṃ mandalokapālaiḥ sahaiva hi..
evaṃ kathaya devendraṃ devarṣe nānyathā vada.. 28.35 ..
1.3.d:
त्वां हनिष्याम्यहं मन्दलोकपालैः सहैव हि..
एवं कथय देवेन्द्रं देवर्षे नान्यथा वद.. 28.35 ..
1.3.m: I shall surely slay you, dull-witted one, along with the guardians of the world!' / Speak thus to the lord of the gods, O divine seer; do not say otherwise."

1.3.s:
tatheti matvā bhagavānsa nārado yayau surāñchakrapurogamāṃśca..
ācaṣṭa sarvaṃ hyasurendrabhāṣitaṃ sahopahāsaṃ matimāṃstathaiva.. 28.36 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा भगवान्स नारदो ययौ सुराञ्छक्रपुरोगमांश्च..
आचष्ट सर्वं ह्यसुरेन्द्रभाषितं सहोपहासं मतिमांस्तथैव.. 28.36 ..
1.3.m: Thinking, "So be it," the blessed Nārada went to the gods with Śakra at their head; / the wise one reported everything spoken by the lord of asuras, along with the mockery.

1.3.s:
..nārada uvāca..
bhavadbhiḥ śrūyatāṃ devā vacanaṃ mama nānyathā..
tārakeṇa yaduktaṃ ca sānuge nāvadhāryatām.. 28.37 ..
1.3.d:
..नारद उवाच..
भवद्भिः श्रूयतां देवा वचनं मम नान्यथा..
तारकेण यदुक्तं च सानुगे नावधार्यताम्.. 28.37 ..
1.3.m: Nārada said: / "O gods, listen to my words, which are not otherwise; / may what was spoken by Tāraka along with his followers be attended to:

1.3.s:
..tāraka uvāca..
tvāṃ haniṣyāmi re mūḍha nānyathā mama bhāṣitam.. 28.38 ..
1.3.d:
..तारक उवाच..
त्वां हनिष्यामि रे मूढ नान्यथा मम भाषितम्.. 28.38 ..
1.3.m: Tāraka said: / 'I will slay you, O fool! My words are not otherwise.

1.3.s:
mucukundaṃ samāsādya lokapālaiśca pūjitaḥ..
na tvayā bhīruṇā yotsye devo bhūtvā narāśritaḥ.. 28.39 ..
1.3.d:
मुचुकुन्दं समासाद्य लोकपालैश्च पूजितः..
न त्वया भीरुणा योत्स्ये देवो भूत्वा नराश्रितः.. 28.39 ..
1.3.m: Having approached Mucukunda, and worshipped by the guardians of the world, / I will not fight with you, a coward, who, though a god, have taken refuge in a man.'"

1.3.s:
tasya vākyaṃ niśamyocuḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ..
kumāraṃ ca puraskṛtya nāradaṃ carṣisattamam.. 28.40 ..
1.3.d:
तस्य वाक्यं निशम्योचुः सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः..
कुमारं च पुरस्कृत्य नारदं चर्षिसत्तमम्.. 28.40 ..
1.3.m: Hearing his words, all the gods with Indra, / placing Kumāra at their head, spoke to Nārada, the best of seers.

1.3.s:
jānāsi tvaṃ hi devarṣe kumārasya balābalam..
ajño bhūtvā kathaṃ vākyamuktaṃ tasya mamāgrataḥ.. 28.41 ..
1.3.d:
जानासि त्वं हि देवर्षे कुमारस्य बलाबलम्..
अज्ञो भूत्वा कथं वाक्यमुक्तं तस्य ममाग्रतः.. 28.41 ..
1.3.m:
"You indeed know, O celestial seer, the strength and weakness of Kumāra.
Why have you, acting like an ignorant fool, spoken such words in my presence?"

1.3.s:
prahasya nārado vākyamuvāca tasya sannidhau..
ahamapyupahāsaṃ ca vākyaṃ tārakamuktavān.. 28.42 ..
1.3.d:
प्रहस्य नारदो वाक्यमुवाच तस्य सन्निधौ..
अहमप्युपहासं च वाक्यं तारकमुक्तवान्.. 28.42 ..
1.3.m:
Laughing, Nārada spoke these words in his presence:
"I too addressed Tāraka with words of ridicule.

1.3.s:
jānīdhvamamarāḥ sarve kumāraṃ jayinaṃ surāḥ..
bhaviṣyatyatra me vākyaṃ nātra kāryāvicāraṇā.. 28.43 ..
1.3.d:
जानीध्वममराः सर्वे कुमारं जयिनं सुराः..
भविष्यत्यत्र मे वाक्यं नात्र कार्याविचारणा.. 28.43 ..
1.3.m:
Know, all you immortal gods, that Kumāra will be victorious.
My word will surely come to pass here; there should be no doubt in this matter."

1.3.s:
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā sarve devā mudānvitāḥ..
aikapadyena cottasthuryoddhukāmāśca tārakam.. 28.44 ..
1.3.d:
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वे देवा मुदान्विताः..
ऐकपद्येन चोत्तस्थुर्योद्धुकामाश्च तारकम्.. 28.44 ..
1.3.m:
Hearing Nārada's words, all the gods were filled with joy,
and they rose up in unison, eager to fight Tāraka.

1.3.s:
kumāraṃ gajamāropya devendro hyagrago'bhavat..
surasainyena mahatā lokapālaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ.. 28.45 ..
1.3.d:
कुमारं गजमारोप्य देवेन्द्रो ह्यग्रगोऽभवत्..
सुरसैन्येन महता लोकपालैः समावृतः.. 28.45 ..
1.3.m:
Mounting Kumāra upon an elephant, the lord of gods went before him,
surrounded by the great host of gods and the world-protectors.

1.3.s:
tadā dundubhayo nedurbherītūryāṇyanekaśaḥ..
vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgāni tathā gandharvani svanāḥ.. 28.46 ..
1.3.d:
तदा दुन्दुभयो नेदुर्भेरीतूर्याण्यनेकशः..
वीणावेणुमृदंगानि तथा गन्धर्वनि स्वनाः.. 28.46 ..
1.3.m:
Then kettledrums, large drums, and numerous trumpets sounded,
along with lutes, flutes, mṛdaṅga drums, and songs of the gandharvas.

1.3.s:
gajaṃ dattvā maheṃdrāya kumāro yānamāruhat..
anekaratnasaṃvītaṃ nānāścaryasamanvitam..
vicitracitraṃ sumahattathāścaryasamanvitam.. 28.47 ..
1.3.d:
गजं दत्त्वा महेंद्राय कुमारो यानमारुहत्..
अनेकरत्नसंवीतं नानाश्चर्यसमन्वितम्..
विचित्रचित्रं सुमहत्तथाश्चर्यसमन्वितम्.. 28.47 ..
1.3.m:
Having given the elephant to the great Indra, Kumāra mounted a vehicle
bedecked with many jewels, accompanied by various marvels,
variegated and wonderful, exceedingly vast, and endowed with wonders.

1.3.s:
vimānamāruhya tadā mahāyaśāḥ sa śāṃkariḥ sarvagaṇairupetaḥ..
śriyā sametaḥ parayā babhau mahānsa vījyamānaścamarairmahāprabhaiḥ.. 28.48 ..
1.3.d:
विमानमारुह्य तदा महायशाः स शांकरिः सर्वगणैरुपेतः..
श्रिया समेतः परया बभौ महान्स वीज्यमानश्चमरैर्महाप्रभैः.. 28.48 ..
1.3.m:
Mounting the aerial chariot, the renowned son of Śaṅkara, accompanied by all his hosts,
endowed with supreme splendor, shone greatly as he was fanned by brilliantly shining chowries.

1.3.s:
prāce tasaṃ chatra mahāmaṇiprabhaṃ ratnairupetaṃ bahubhirvirājitam..
dhṛtaṃ tadā tena kumāramūrddhani candraiḥ kiraṇaiḥ suśobhitam.. 28.49 ..
1.3.d:
प्राचे तसं छत्र महामणिप्रभं रत्नैरुपेतं बहुभिर्विराजितम्..
धृतं तदा तेन कुमारमूर्द्धनि चन्द्रैः किरणैः सुशोभितम्.. 28.49 ..
1.3.m:
An umbrella belonging to Varuṇa, shining with great jewels, adorned with many gems,
was then held over Kumāra's head, beautifully illuminated like the rays of the moon.

1.3.s:
saṃmīlitāstadā sava devā indrapurogamāḥ..
balaiḥ svaiḥ svaiḥ parikrāṃtā yoddhukāmā mahābalāḥ.. 28.50 ..
1.3.d:
संमीलितास्तदा सव देवा इन्द्रपुरोगमाः..
बलैः स्वैः स्वैः परिक्रांता योद्धुकामा महाबलाः.. 28.50 ..
1.3.m:
Then all the gods, led by Indra, assembled,
advancing with their respective forces, mighty and eager to fight.

1.3.s:
yame'pi svagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ marudbhiśca sadāgatiḥ..
pāthobhirvaruṇastatra kubero guhyakaiḥ saha..
īśo'pi pramathaiḥ sārddhaṃ nairṛto vyādhibhiḥ saha.. 28.51 ..
1.3.d:
यमेऽपि स्वगणैः सार्द्धं मरुद्भिश्च सदागतिः..
पाथोभिर्वरुणस्तत्र कुबेरो गुह्यकैः सह..
ईशोऽपि प्रमथैः सार्द्धं नैरृतो व्याधिभिः सह.. 28.51 ..
1.3.m:
Yama was present with his hosts, the Wind-god with the Maruts,
Varuṇa with the waters, Kubera with the guhyakas,
Īśa with the pramathas, and Nirṛti with diseases.

1.3.s:
evaṃ te'ṣṭau lokapā yoddhukāmāḥ sarve militvā tārakaṃ haṃtumeva..
puraskṛtvā śāṃkariṃ viśvavaṃdyaṃ senāpatiṃ cātmavidāṃ variṣṭham.. 28.52 ..
1.3.d:
एवं तेऽष्टौ लोकपा योद्धुकामाः सर्वे मिलित्वा तारकं हंतुमेव..
पुरस्कृत्वा शांकरिं विश्ववंद्यं सेनापतिं चात्मविदां वरिष्ठम्.. 28.52 ..
1.3.m:
Thus those eight world-protectors, eager to fight, all united to slay Tāraka,
placing in front the son of Śaṅkara, worshipped by the universe, the general of the army and the foremost of those who know the Self.

1.3.s:
evaṃ te yoddhukāmā hi avateruśca bhūtalam..
aṃtarvedyāṃ sthitāḥ sarve gaṃgā yamunamadhyagāḥ.. 28.53 ..
1.3.d:
एवं ते योद्धुकामा हि अवतेरुश्च भूतलम्..
अंतर्वेद्यां स्थिताः सर्वे गंगा यमुनमध्यगाः.. 28.53 ..
1.3.m:
Thus, eager to fight, they descended to the surface of the earth
and stationed themselves in the Antarvedi, between the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā.

1.3.s:
pātālācca samāyātāstārakasyopajīvinaḥ..
ceruraṃgabalopetā hantukāmāḥ surānraṇe.. 28.54 ..
1.3.d:
पातालाच्च समायातास्तारकस्योपजीविनः..
चेरुरंगबलोपेता हन्तुकामाः सुरान्रणे.. 28.54 ..
1.3.m:
From Pātāla also came the dependents of Tāraka;
endowed with the fourfold army, they advanced, eager to slay the gods in battle.

1.3.s:
tārako hi samāyāto vimānena virājitaḥ..
chatreṇa ca mahātejā dhriyamāṇena mūrddhani.. 28.55 ..
1.3.d:
तारको हि समायातो विमानेन विराजितः..
छत्रेण च महातेजा ध्रियमाणेन मूर्द्धनि.. 28.55 ..
1.3.m:
Tāraka arrived, shining in an aerial chariot,
exceedingly majestic, with an umbrella held over his head.

1.3.s: cāmarairvijyamāno hi śuśubhe daityarāṭ svayam.. 28.56 ..
1.3.d: चामरैर्विज्यमानो हि शुशुभे दैत्यराट् स्वयम्.. 28.56 ..
1.3.m: Being fanned with chowries, the king of daityas shone resplendent in person.

1.3.s:
evaṃ devāśca daityāśca aṃtarvedyāṃ sthitāstadā..
sainyena mahatā tatra vyūhānkṛtvā pṛthakpṛthak.. 28.57 ..
1.3.d:
एवं देवाश्च दैत्याश्च अंतर्वेद्यां स्थितास्तदा..
सैन्येन महता तत्र व्यूहान्कृत्वा पृथक्पृथक्.. 28.57 ..
1.3.m:
Thus both the gods and the daityas stationed themselves in the Antarvedi,
forming their battle arrays separately there with their vast armies.

1.3.s:
gajānkṛtvā hyekataśca hayāṃśca vividhāṃstathā..
syaṃdanānivicitrāṇi nānāratnayutāni ca.. 28.58 ..
1.3.d:
गजान्कृत्वा ह्येकतश्च हयांश्च विविधांस्तथा..
स्यंदनानिविचित्राणि नानारत्नयुतानि च.. 28.58 ..
1.3.m:
Placing the elephants on one side, and likewise various kinds of horses,
as well as marvelous chariots adorned with diverse gems,

1.3.s:
padātā bahavastatra śaktiśūlaparaśvadhaiḥ..
khaḍgatomaranārācaiḥ pāśamudgaraśobhitāḥ.. 28.59 ..
1.3.d:
पदाता बहवस्तत्र शक्तिशूलपरश्वधैः..
खड्गतोमरनाराचैः पाशमुद्गरशोभिताः.. 28.59 ..
1.3.m:
there were many foot soldiers adorned with javelins, spears, and battle-axes,
swords, iron clubs, iron arrows, nooses, and mallets.

1.3.s:
te sene suradaityānāṃ śuśubhāte parasparam..
haṃtukāmāstadā te vai stūyamānāśca bandhubhiḥ.. 28.60 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe śivaśāstre devaiḥ saha tārakāsurasya saṃgrāme devadaityasenāhavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 28 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
ते सेने सुरदैत्यानां शुशुभाते परस्परम्..
हंतुकामास्तदा ते वै स्तूयमानाश्च बन्धुभिः.. 28.60 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखंडे शिवशास्त्रे देवैः सह तारकासुरस्य संग्रामे देवदैत्यसेनाहवर्णनंनामाष्टाविंशोऽध्यायः.. 28 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
Those two armies of the gods and the daityas shone against one another,
eager to kill, as they were praised by their kinsmen.
Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Battle between the Armies of the Gods and Daityas in the Battle of Tārakāsura with the Gods', in the Śiva-śāstra of the Kedārakhaṇḍa, in the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
ubhe sene tadā teṣāṃ surāṇāṃ cāmaradviṣām..
anekāścaryasaṃvīte caturaṃgabalānvite..
virejatustadānyo'nyaṃ garjato vāṃbudāgame.. 29.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
उभे सेने तदा तेषां सुराणां चामरद्विषाम्..
अनेकाश्चर्यसंवीते चतुरंगबलान्विते..
विरेजतुस्तदान्योऽन्यं गर्जतो वांबुदागमे.. 29.1 ..
1.3.m:
Lomaśa said:
Then both armies, of those gods and of the enemies of the immortals,
filled with many wonders and endowed with fourfold divisions,
shone against each other, roaring like clouds at the arrival of the rains.

1.3.s:
etasminnantare tatra valgamānāḥ parasparam..
devāsurāstadā sarve yuyudhuśca mahābalāḥ.. 29.2 ..
1.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र वल्गमानाः परस्परम्..
देवासुरास्तदा सर्वे युयुधुश्च महाबलाः.. 29.2 ..
1.3.m:
Meanwhile, leaping and challenging one another there,
all those mighty gods and asuras fought.

1.3.s:
yuddhaṃ sutumulaṃ hyāsīddevadaityasamākulam..
ruṇḍamuṇḍāṃkitaṃ sarvaṃ kṣaṇena samapadyata.. 29.3 ..
1.3.d:
युद्धं सुतुमुलं ह्यासीद्देवदैत्यसमाकुलम्..
रुण्डमुण्डांकितं सर्वं क्षणेन समपद्यत.. 29.3 ..
1.3.m:
A tumultuous battle took place, crowded with gods and daityas;
in an instant, everything became marked with headless trunks and severed heads.

1.3.s:
bhūmau nipatitāstatra śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ..
keṣāṃcidbāhaviśchinnāḥ khaḍgapātaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ.. 29.4 ..
1.3.d:
भूमौ निपतितास्तत्र शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः..
केषांचिद्बाहविश्छिन्नाः खड्गपातैः सुदारुणैः.. 29.4 ..
1.3.m:
They fell upon the ground there by hundreds and by thousands;
the arms of some were severed by dreadful sword-blows.

1.3.s: mucukuṃdo hi balavāṃstrailokye'mitavikramaḥ.. 29.5 ..
1.3.d: मुचुकुंदो हि बलवांस्त्रैलोक्येऽमितविक्रमः.. 29.5 ..
1.3.m: Mucukunda was indeed strong, of immeasurable prowess in the three worlds.

1.3.s:
tārako hi tadā tena mucukuṃdena dhīmatā..
khaḍgena cāhatāstatra sarvaprāṇena vakṣasi..
prasahya tatprahāraṃ ca prahasanvākyamabravīt.. 29.6 ..
1.3.d:
तारको हि तदा तेन मुचुकुंदेन धीमता..
खड्गेन चाहतास्तत्र सर्वप्राणेन वक्षसि..
प्रसह्य तत्प्रहारं च प्रहसन्वाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 29.6 ..
1.3.m:
Tāraka was then struck on the chest with a sword with all his strength
by that wise Mucukunda; enduring that blow, he laughed and said:

1.3.s:
kiṃ re mūḍha tvayā cādya kṛtamasti balādidam..
na tvayā yoddhumicchāmi mānuṣeṇaiva lajjayā.. 29.7 ..
1.3.d:
किं रे मूढ त्वया चाद्य कृतमस्ति बलादिदम्..
न त्वया योद्धुमिच्छामि मानुषेणैव लज्जया.. 29.7 ..
1.3.m:
"What is this, you fool, that you have done today by force?
Out of shame, I do not wish to fight with a mere human.

1.3.s:
tārakasya vacaḥ śrutvā mucukuṃdo'bhyabhāṣata..
mayā hato'si daityeṃdra nānyo bhavitumarhasi.. 29.8 ..
1.3.d:
तारकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा मुचुकुंदोऽभ्यभाषत..
मया हतोऽसि दैत्येंद्र नान्यो भवितुमर्हसि.. 29.8 ..
1.3.m:
Hearing Tāraka's words, Mucukunda replied:
"You are slain by me, O lord of daityas; you cannot become anything else!

1.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā me khaḍgasaṃpātaṃ na tvaṃ tiṣṭhasi cāgrataḥ..
tvāṃ hanmi paśya me śauryaṃ daityarāja sthiro bhava.. 29.9 ..
1.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा मे खड्गसंपातं न त्वं तिष्ठसि चाग्रतः..
त्वां हन्मि पश्य मे शौर्यं दैत्यराज स्थिरो भव.. 29.9 ..
1.3.m:
Having seen the blow of my sword, you will not stand before me.
I will slay you! Behold my valor, O king of daityas; stand firm!"

1.3.s:
evamuktvā tadā vīro mucukuṃdo mahābalaḥ..
yāvajjaghāna khaḍgena tāvacchaktyā samāhataḥ..
māṃdhātustanayastatra papāta raṇamaṃḍale.. 29.10 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तदा वीरो मुचुकुंदो महाबलः..
यावज्जघान खड्गेन तावच्छक्त्या समाहतः..
मांधातुस्तनयस्तत्र पपात रणमंडले.. 29.10 ..

1.3.s: patitastatkṣaṇādeva cotthitaḥ paravīrahā.. 29.11 ..
1.3.d: पतितस्तत्क्षणादेव चोत्थितः परवीरहा.. 29.11 ..
1.3.m: Having fallen, that slayer of enemy heroes rose up in that very instant.

1.3.s:
sa sajjamānotimahābalo vai haṃtuṃ tadā daityapatiṃ ca tārakam..
brahmāstramudyamya dhanurgṛhītvā māṃdhātṛputro bhuvanaikajetā.. 29.12 ..
1.3.d:
स सज्जमानोतिमहाबलो वै हंतुं तदा दैत्यपतिं च तारकम्..
ब्रह्मास्त्रमुद्यम्य धनुर्गृहीत्वा मांधातृपुत्रो भुवनैकजेता.. 29.12 ..
1.3.m:
Preparing himself, exceedingly powerful, to slay Tāraka, the lord of daityas,
the son of Māndhātṛ, sole conqueror of the world, raised the Brahmā weapon and seized his bow.

1.3.s:
sa tārakaṃ yoddhakāmastarasvī ruṣānvitotphullavilocano mahān..
sa nārado brahmasuto babhāṣe tadā nṛvīraṃ mucukuṃdamevam.. 29.13 ..
1.3.d:
स तारकं योद्धकामस्तरस्वी रुषान्वितोत्फुल्लविलोचनो महान्..
स नारदो ब्रह्मसुतो बभाषे तदा नृवीरं मुचुकुंदमेवम्.. 29.13 ..
1.3.m:
As he, swift and mighty, his eyes dilated with rage, was eager to fight Tāraka,
Nārada, the son of Brahmā, spoke thus to that hero among men, Mucukunda:

1.3.s: na tārako hanyate mānuṣeṇa tasmādetanmā vimocīrmahāstram.. 29.14 ..
1.3.d: न तारको हन्यते मानुषेण तस्मादेतन्मा विमोचीर्महास्त्रम्.. 29.14 ..
1.3.m: "Tāraka cannot be slain by a human; therefore, do not release this great weapon."

1.3.s:
niśamya vacanaṃ tasya devarṣernāradasya ca..
mucukuṃda uvācedaṃ bhavitā ko'sya mārakaḥ.. 29.15 ..
1.3.d:
निशम्य वचनं तस्य देवर्षेर्नारदस्य च..
मुचुकुंद उवाचेदं भविता कोऽस्य मारकः.. 29.15 ..
1.3.m:
Hearing those words of the celestial seer Nārada,
Mucukunda said: "Who will be his slayer?"

1.3.s:
tadovāca mahātejā nārado divyadarśanaḥ..
enaṃ haṃtā kumāraśca kumāro'yaṃ śivātmajaḥ.. 29.16 ..
1.3.d:
तदोवाच महातेजा नारदो दिव्यदर्शनः..
एनं हंता कुमारश्च कुमारोऽयं शिवात्मजः.. 29.16 ..
1.3.m:
Then Nārada, endowed with great splendor and divine sight, said:
"Kumāra will slay him—Kumāra, the son of Śiva.

1.3.s:
tasmādbhavadbhiḥ sthātavyamaikapadyena yudhyatām..
tiṣṭha tvaṃ cāyato bhūtvā mucukuṃda mahāmate.. 29.17 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्भवद्भिः स्थातव्यमैकपद्येन युध्यताम्..
तिष्ठ त्वं चायतो भूत्वा मुचुकुंद महामते.. 29.17 ..
1.3.m:
Therefore, you should stand united while fighting.
Be restrained and stand by, O wise Mucukunda."

1.3.s:
niśamya vākyaṃ ca manoharaṃ śubhaṃ hyudīritaṃ tena mahāprabheṇa..
sarve surāḥ śāṃtiparā babhūvustenaiva sākaṃ nṛvareṇayatnāt.. 29.18 ..
1.3.d:
निशम्य वाक्यं च मनोहरं शुभं ह्युदीरितं तेन महाप्रभेण..
सर्वे सुराः शांतिपरा बभूवुस्तेनैव साकं नृवरेणयत्नात्.. 29.18 ..
1.3.m:
Hearing the charming and auspicious words uttered by that illustrious sage,
all the gods, together with that best of men, became calm with effort.

1.3.s:
tato duṃdubhayo neduḥ śaṃkhāśca kṛtaniścayāḥ..
tāḍitā vividhairvādyaiḥ surāsurasamanvitaiḥ.. 29.19 ..
1.3.d:
ततो दुंदुभयो नेदुः शंखाश्च कृतनिश्चयाः..
ताडिता विविधैर्वाद्यैः सुरासुरसमन्वितैः.. 29.19 ..
1.3.m:
Then, resolute, they sounded kettledrums and conches,
accompanied by various musical instruments played by gods and asuras.

1.3.s:
jagarjurasurāstatra devānprati kṛtodyamāḥ..
śivakopodbhavo vīro vīrabhadro ruṣānvitaḥ.. 29.20 ..
1.3.d:
जगर्जुरसुरास्तत्र देवान्प्रति कृतोद्यमाः..
शिवकोपोद्भवो वीरो वीरभद्रो रुषान्वितः.. 29.20 ..
1.3.m:
The asuras roared there, making ready against the gods.
And the hero Vīrabhadra, born of Śiva's wrath, was filled with fury.

1.3.s:
gaṇairbahubhirāsādya tārakaṃ ca mahābalam..
mucukuṃdaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā tathaiva ca surānapi.. 29.21 ..
1.3.d:
गणैर्बहुभिरासाद्य तारकं च महाबलम्..
मुचुकुंदं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा तथैव च सुरानपि.. 29.21 ..
1.3.m: Approaching the mighty Tāraka with numerous gaṇas, / placing Mucukunda and likewise the gods in the rear,

1.3.s:
tadā te pramathāḥ sarve puraskṛtya kumārakam..
yuyudhuḥ saṃyuge tatra vīrabhadrādayo gaṇāḥ.. 29.22 ..
1.3.d:
तदा ते प्रमथाः सर्वे पुरस्कृत्य कुमारकम्..
युयुधुः संयुगे तत्र वीरभद्रादयो गणाः.. 29.22 ..
1.3.m: then all those pramathas, putting Kumāra at their head, / the gaṇas, Vīrabhadra and the others, fought there in the clash.

1.3.s:
triśūlairṛṣṭibhiḥ pāśaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paraśupāṭṭiśaiḥ..
nijaghnuḥ samarenyonyaṃ surāsuravimarddane.. 29.23 ..
1.3.d:
त्रिशूलैरृष्टिभिः पाशैः खड्गैः परशुपाट्टिशैः..
निजघ्नुः समरेन्योन्यं सुरासुरविमर्द्दने.. 29.23 ..
1.3.m: With tridents, spears, nooses, swords, axes, and paṭṭiśas, / they struck one another in the battle, in the crushing encounter of gods and asuras.

1.3.s:
tārako vīrabhadreṇa triśūlena hato bhṛśam..
papāta sahasā tatra kṣaṇa mūrchāpariplutaḥ.. 29.24 ..
1.3.d:
तारको वीरभद्रेण त्रिशूलेन हतो भृशम्..
पपात सहसा तत्र क्षण मूर्छापरिप्लुतः.. 29.24 ..
1.3.m: Tāraka, struck hard by Vīrabhadra with a trident, / suddenly fell there, overcome for a moment by swoon.

1.3.s:
utthāya ca muhūrttācca tārako daityapuṃgavaḥ..
labdhasaṃjño balāviṣṭo vīrabhadraṃ jaghāna ca.. 29.25 ..
1.3.d:
उत्थाय च मुहूर्त्ताच्च तारको दैत्यपुंगवः..
लब्धसंज्ञो बलाविष्टो वीरभद्रं जघान च.. 29.25 ..
1.3.m: Rising after an hour, Tāraka, the bull among daityas, / having regained consciousness and filled with strength, struck Vīrabhadra.

1.3.s:
sa śaktiṃ ca mahātejā vīrabhadro hi tārakam..
triśūlena ca ghoreṇa śivasyānucaro balī.. 29.26 ..
1.3.d:
स शक्तिं च महातेजा वीरभद्रो हि तारकम्..
त्रिशूलेन च घोरेण शिवस्यानुचरो बली.. 29.26 ..
1.3.m: And that Vīrabhadra of great splendour, the powerful attendant of Śiva, / [hurled] a spear and with his dread trident [struck] Tāraka.

1.3.s:
evaṃ saṃyudhyamānau tau jaghnatuścetaretaram..
dvaṃdvayuddhaṃ sutumulaṃ tayorjātaṃ mahātmanoḥ.. 29.27 ..
1.3.d:
एवं संयुध्यमानौ तौ जघ्नतुश्चेतरेतरम्..
द्वंद्वयुद्धं सुतुमुलं तयोर्जातं महात्मनोः.. 29.27 ..
1.3.m: Thus fighting, the two struck each other; / an exceedingly tumultuous duel took place between the two mighty ones.

1.3.s:
surāstatraiva samare prekṣakāhyabhavaṃstadā..
tayorbherīmṛdaṃgāśca paṭahānakagomukhāḥ.. 29.28 ..
1.3.d:
सुरास्तत्रैव समरे प्रेक्षकाह्यभवंस्तदा..
तयोर्भेरीमृदंगाश्च पटहानकगोमुखाः.. 29.28 ..
1.3.m: The gods then became mere onlookers right there in the battle; / the kettle-drums, mṛdaṅgas, paṭahas, ānakas, and gomukhas of the two,

1.3.s:
tathā ḍamarūnādena vyāptamāsījjagattrayam..
tena ghoṣeṇa mahatā yudyamānau mahābalau.. 29.29 ..
1.3.d:
तथा डमरूनादेन व्याप्तमासीज्जगत्त्रयम्..
तेन घोषेण महता युद्यमानौ महाबलौ.. 29.29 ..
1.3.m: as well as the sound of ḍamarus, filled the three worlds; / fighting amid that great noise, the two of great power

1.3.s:
śuśubhāte'tisaṃrabdhau prahārairjarīkṛtau..
anyonyamabhisaṃrabdhau tau budhāṃgārakāviva.. 29.30 ..
1.3.d:
शुशुभातेऽतिसंरब्धौ प्रहारैर्जरीकृतौ..
अन्योन्यमभिसंरब्धौ तौ बुधांगारकाविव.. 29.30 ..
1.3.m: shone, exceedingly enraged, torn by blows, / furiously pitted against each other like Mercury and Mars.

1.3.s:
nāradena tadā khyāto vīrabhadrasya tadvadhaḥ..
na rocate ca tadvākyaṃ vīrabhadrasya vai tadā.. 29.31 ..
1.3.d:
नारदेन तदा ख्यातो वीरभद्रस्य तद्वधः..
न रोचते च तद्वाक्यं वीरभद्रस्य वै तदा.. 29.31 ..
1.3.m: Then the killing of him was proclaimed to Vīrabhadra by Nārada; / and that word did not please Vīrabhadra at all then,

1.3.s:
nāradena yaduktaṃ hi tārakasya vadhaṃ prati..
yathā rudrastathā so'pi vīrabhadro mahābalaḥ.. 29.32 ..
1.3.d:
नारदेन यदुक्तं हि तारकस्य वधं प्रति..
यथा रुद्रस्तथा सोऽपि वीरभद्रो महाबलः.. 29.32 ..
1.3.m: what was indeed spoken by Nārada regarding the slaying of Tāraka; / just as Rudra is, so too was that Vīrabhadra of great might.

1.3.s:
evaṃ prayudhyamānau tau jaghnatuścetaretaram..
anyonyaṃ svarddhamānau tau garjaṃtau siṃhayoriva.. 29.33 ..
1.3.d:
एवं प्रयुध्यमानौ तौ जघ्नतुश्चेतरेतरम्..
अन्योन्यं स्वर्द्धमानौ तौ गर्जंतौ सिंहयोरिव.. 29.33 ..
1.3.m: Thus fighting on, the two struck each other, / emulating one another, roaring like two lions.

1.3.s:
evaṃ tadā tau bhuvi yudhyamānau mahātmanā jñānavatāṃ vareṇa..
sa vīrabhadro hi tadā nivārito vākyairanekairatha nāradena.. 29.34 ..
1.3.d:
एवं तदा तौ भुवि युध्यमानौ महात्मना ज्ञानवतां वरेण..
स वीरभद्रो हि तदा निवारितो वाक्यैरनेकैरथ नारदेन.. 29.34 ..
1.3.m: Thus as the two fought upon the earth, by that great soul, the best among the wise, / by Nārada, Vīrabhadra was indeed restrained then with many words.

1.3.s:
tathā niśamya tadvākyaṃ nāradasya mukhodgatam..
vīrabhadro ruṣāviṣṭo nāradaṃ pratyuvāca ha.. 29.35 ..
1.3.d:
तथा निशम्य तद्वाक्यं नारदस्य मुखोद्गतम्..
वीरभद्रो रुषाविष्टो नारदं प्रत्युवाच ह.. 29.35 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that speech which issued from the mouth of Nārada, / Vīrabhadra, seized with wrath, replied to Nārada:

1.3.s:
tārakaṃ ca vadhiṣyāmi paśya me'dya parākramam..
ānayaṃti ca ye vīrāḥ svāminaṃ raṇasaṃsadi..
te pāpino hyadharmiṣṭhā vimṛśaṃtiraṇaṃ gatāḥ.. 29.36 ..
1.3.d:
तारकं च वधिष्यामि पश्य मेऽद्य पराक्रमम्..
आनयंति च ये वीराः स्वामिनं रणसंसदि..
ते पापिनो ह्यधर्मिष्ठा विमृशंतिरणं गताः.. 29.36 ..
1.3.m: “I will kill Tāraka; behold my valour today! / The heroes who bring their master to the assembly of battle, / those are sinners and exceedingly unrighteous, wavering when they have entered the fray.

1.3.s:
bhīravaste tu vijñeyā na vācyāste kadācana..
tvaṃ na jānāsi devarṣe yodhānāṃ ca pratikriyām.. 29.37 ..
1.3.d:
भीरवस्ते तु विज्ञेया न वाच्यास्ते कदाचन..
त्वं न जानासि देवर्षे योधानां च प्रतिक्रियाम्.. 29.37 ..
1.3.m: They are to be known as cowards, never to be praised. / You do not know, O divine seer, the proper conduct of warriors!

1.3.s:
mṛtyuṃ ca pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā raṇabhūmau gatavyathāḥ..
śastrāśastrairbhinnagātrāḥ praśastā nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 29.38 ..
1.3.d:
मृत्युं च पृष्ठतः कृत्वा रणभूमौ गतव्यथाः..
शस्त्राशस्त्रैर्भिन्नगात्राः प्रशस्ता नात्र संशयः.. 29.38 ..
1.3.m: Putting death behind them, free from anxiety on the battlefield, / their limbs torn by all kinds of weapons—they are praiseworthy, of this there is no doubt.”

1.3.s:
ityuktvā cāvadaddevānvīrabhadro mahābalaḥ..
śruṇvaṃtu mama vākyāni devā indrapurogamāḥ.. 29.39 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा चावदद्देवान्वीरभद्रो महाबलः..
श्रुण्वंतु मम वाक्यानि देवा इन्द्रपुरोगमाः.. 29.39 ..
1.3.m: Having spoken thus, the mighty Vīrabhadra spoke to the gods: / “Let the gods, with Indra at their head, hear my words!

1.3.s: atārakāṃ mahīṃ cādya kariṣye nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 29.40 ..
1.3.d: अतारकां महीं चाद्य करिष्ये नात्र संशयः.. 29.40 ..
1.3.m: Today I shall make the earth rid of Tāraka, there is no doubt of this.”

1.3.s:
atha triśūlamādāya tārakeṇa yuyodha saḥ..
vṛṣārūḍhairanekaiśca triśūlavaradhāribhiḥ.. 29.41 ..
1.3.d:
अथ त्रिशूलमादाय तारकेण युयोध सः..
वृषारूढैरनेकैश्च त्रिशूलवरधारिभिः.. 29.41 ..
1.3.m: Then, seizing his trident, he fought with Tāraka, / along with many mounted on bulls, bearing excellent tridents;

1.3.s:
kaparddino vṛṣāṃkāśca gaṇāstetiprahāriṇaḥ..
vīrabhadraṃ puraskṛtya vīrabhadraparākramāḥ.. 29.42 ..
1.3.d:
कपर्द्दिनो वृषांकाश्च गणास्तेतिप्रहारिणः..
वीरभद्रं पुरस्कृत्य वीरभद्रपराक्रमाः.. 29.42 ..
1.3.m: the gaṇas, wearing matted locks and marked with bulls, striking fiercely, / placing Vīrabhadra at their head, possessing the valour of Vīrabhadra,

1.3.s:
triśūladhāriṇaḥ sarve sarve sarpāgabhūṣaṇāḥ..
sacaṃdraśekharāḥ sarve jaṭājūṭavibhūṣitāḥ.. 29.43 ..
1.3.d:
त्रिशूलधारिणः सर्वे सर्वे सर्पागभूषणाः..
सचंद्रशेखराः सर्वे जटाजूटविभूषिताः.. 29.43 ..
1.3.m: all bearing tridents, all adorned with serpents and mountains, / all bearing the crescent moon upon their crests, adorned with matted locks,

1.3.s:
nilakaṇṭhā daśabhujāḥ pañcakattrāstrilocanāḥ..
chatracāmarasaṃvītāḥ sarve te'tyugrabāhavaḥ.. 29.44 ..
1.3.d:
निलकण्ठा दशभुजाः पञ्चकत्त्रास्त्रिलोचनाः..
छत्रचामरसंवीताः सर्वे तेऽत्युग्रबाहवः.. 29.44 ..
1.3.m: blue-throated, ten-armed, five-faced, three-eyed, / surrounded by umbrellas and chowries, all having exceedingly fierce arms,

1.3.s:
vīrabhadraṃ puraskṛtya sarve haraparākramāḥ..
yuyudhuste tadā daityāstākāsurajīvinaḥ.. 29.45 ..
1.3.d:
वीरभद्रं पुरस्कृत्य सर्वे हरपराक्रमाः..
युयुधुस्ते तदा दैत्यास्ताकासुरजीविनः.. 29.45 ..
1.3.m: placing Vīrabhadra at their head, all possessing the valour of Hara, / fought; then the daityas, whose livelihood was the asura Tāraka, [countered them].

1.3.s:
punaḥ punastaiśca tadā babhūvurgaṇairjitāste hyasurāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ..
babhūva teṣāṃ ca tadātisaṃgaro mahābhayo daityavaraistadānīm.. 29.46 ..
1.3.d:
पुनः पुनस्तैश्च तदा बभूवुर्गणैर्जितास्ते ह्यसुराः पराङ्मुखाः..
बभूव तेषां च तदातिसंगरो महाभयो दैत्यवरैस्तदानीम्.. 29.46 ..
1.3.m: Again and again, defeated by those gaṇas, the asuras turned their backs; / then a dreadful battle took place between them and the foremost daityas.

1.3.s:
amṛṣyamāṇāḥ paramāstrakovidaistato gaṇāste jayino babhūvuḥ..
gaṇairjitāste hyasurāḥ parābhavaṃ taṃ tārakaṃ te vyathitāḥ śaśaṃsuḥ.. 29.47 ..
1.3.d:
अमृष्यमाणाः परमास्त्रकोविदैस्ततो गणास्ते जयिनो बभूवुः..
गणैर्जितास्ते ह्यसुराः पराभवं तं तारकं ते व्यथिताः शशंसुः.. 29.47 ..
1.3.m: Unable to brook [resistance], the gaṇas, skilled in supreme weapons, then became victorious; / defeated by the gaṇas, those afflicted asuras reported their defeat to that Tāraka.

1.3.s:
vināmya cāpaṃ hi tathā ca tārakaḥ sa yoddhukāmaḥ praviveśa senām..
yathā jhaṣo vai praviveśa sāgaraṃ tathā hyasau daityavaro mahātmā.. 29.48 ..
1.3.d:
विनाम्य चापं हि तथा च तारकः स योद्धुकामः प्रविवेश सेनाम्..
यथा झषो वै प्रविवेश सागरं तथा ह्यसौ दैत्यवरो महात्मा.. 29.48 ..
1.3.m: Bending his bow, desiring to fight, Tāraka entered the army; / just as a large fish enters the ocean, so indeed did that high-souled, foremost daitya.

1.3.s:
gaṇaiḥ sameto yuyudhe tadānīṃ sa vīrabhadro hi mahābalaśca..
sarvānsurāṃśceṃdramukhānmahābalastathā gaṇānyakṣapiśācaguhyakān..
sa daityavaryo'tiruṣaṃ praviṣṭaḥ saṃmardayāmāsa mahābalo hi.. 29.49 ..
1.3.d:
गणैः समेतो युयुधे तदानीं स वीरभद्रो हि महाबलश्च..
सर्वान्सुरांश्चेंद्रमुखान्महाबलस्तथा गणान्यक्षपिशाचगुह्यकान्..
स दैत्यवर्योऽतिरुषं प्रविष्टः संमर्दयामास महाबलो हि.. 29.49 ..
1.3.m: Accompanied by the gaṇas, that mighty Vīrabhadra then fought; / and that foremost daitya of great power, entering a towering rage, crushed / all the gods with Indra at their head, as well as the gaṇas, the yakṣas, piśācas, and guhyakas.

1.3.s:
tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ devadānavasaṃkulam..
devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ sannipātakaraṃ mahat.. 29.50 ..
1.3.d:
ततः समभवद्युद्धं देवदानवसंकुलम्..
देवदानवयक्षाणां सन्निपातकरं महत्.. 29.50 ..
1.3.m: Then there ensued a battle crowded with gods and dānavas, / a great clash bringing together gods, dānavas, and yakṣas.

1.3.s:
tathā vṛṣā garjamānā aśvāñjaghnuśca sādibhiḥ..
rathibhiśca rathāñjaghnuḥ kuṃjarānsādibhiḥ saha.. 29.51 ..
1.3.d:
तथा वृषा गर्जमाना अश्वाञ्जघ्नुश्च सादिभिः..
रथिभिश्च रथाञ्जघ्नुः कुंजरान्सादिभिः सह.. 29.51 ..
1.3.m: Then roaring bulls killed horses together with their riders, / and with chariot-warriors they destroyed chariots, and elephants together with their mahouts.

1.3.s: vṛṣārūḍhauḥ sarathaiste ca sarve niṣpāṭitā hyasurāḥ pothitāśca.. 29.52 ..
1.3.d: वृषारूढौः सरथैस्ते च सर्वे निष्पाटिता ह्यसुराः पोथिताश्च.. 29.52 ..
1.3.m: By those mounted on bulls along with chariots, all those asuras were torn apart and crushed.

1.3.s:
kṣayaṃ praṇītā bahavastadānīṃ petuḥ pṛthivyāṃ nihatāśca kecit..
kecitpraviṣṭā hi rasātalaṃ ca palāyamānā bahavastathaiva.. 29.53 ..
1.3.d:
क्षयं प्रणीता बहवस्तदानीं पेतुः पृथिव्यां निहताश्च केचित्..
केचित्प्रविष्टा हि रसातलं च पलायमाना बहवस्तथैव.. 29.53 ..
1.3.m: Brought to ruin, many then fell to the earth, struck down; / some entered Rasātala, and many likewise were fleeing;

1.3.s:
kecicca śaraṇaṃ prāptā rudrānucarakiṃkarān..
evaṃ naṣṭaṃ tadā sainyaṃ vilokyāsurapālakaḥ..
tārako hi ruṣāviṣṭo haṃtuṃ devagaṇānyayau.. 29.54 ..
1.3.d:
केचिच्च शरणं प्राप्ता रुद्रानुचरकिंकरान्..
एवं नष्टं तदा सैन्यं विलोक्यासुरपालकः..
तारको हि रुषाविष्टो हंतुं देवगणान्ययौ.. 29.54 ..
1.3.m: and some sought refuge with the attendants and servants of Rudra. / Seeing his army destroyed thus, the protector of the asuras, / Tāraka, seized with wrath, went to slay the hosts of the gods.

1.3.s:
bhujānāmayutaṃ kṛtvā daityarājo hi tārakaḥ..
āruhya siṃhaṃ sahasā ghātayāmāsa tānraṇe.. 29.55 ..
1.3.d:
भुजानामयुतं कृत्वा दैत्यराजो हि तारकः..
आरुह्य सिंहं सहसा घातयामास तान्रणे.. 29.55 ..
1.3.m: Multiplying his arms to ten thousand, Tāraka, king of the daityas, / mounted a lion and quickly caused slaughter among them in the battle.

1.3.s:
daṃśitena ca siṃhena vṛṣāḥ kecidvidāritāḥ..
tathaiva tārakeṇaiva ghātitā bahavo gaṇāḥ.. 29.56 ..
1.3.d:
दंशितेन च सिंहेन वृषाः केचिद्विदारिताः..
तथैव तारकेणैव घातिता बहवो गणाः.. 29.56 ..
1.3.m: Some bulls were torn apart by his armored lion; / likewise many gaṇas were slaughtered by Tāraka alone.

1.3.s:
evaṃ kṛtaṃ tadā tena tārakeṇa mahātmanā..
sarveṣāmeva devānāmaśakyastārako mahān.. 29.57 ..
1.3.d:
एवं कृतं तदा तेन तारकेण महात्मना..
सर्वेषामेव देवानामशक्यस्तारको महान्.. 29.57 ..
1.3.m: Such was done then by that high-souled Tāraka; / great Tāraka could not be overcome by all the gods.

1.3.s:
jātastadā mahābāhustrailokyakṣayakārakaḥ..
tārakasyānugā daityā ajeyā balavattarāḥ.. 29.58 ..
1.3.d:
जातस्तदा महाबाहुस्त्रैलोक्यक्षयकारकः..
तारकस्यानुगा दैत्या अजेया बलवत्तराः.. 29.58 ..
1.3.m: The mighty-armed one became then the causer of ruin to the three worlds; / the daityas following Tāraka were invincible and exceedingly strong,

1.3.s:
mahārūḍhā daṃśitāśca karālāste prahāriṇaḥ..
tai rāhṛtā gaṇāḥ sarve siṃhaiśca vṛṣabhā hatāḥ.. 29.59 ..
1.3.d:
महारूढा दंशिताश्च करालास्ते प्रहारिणः..
तै राहृता गणाः सर्वे सिंहैश्च वृषभा हताः.. 29.59 ..
1.3.m: well-mounted, armored, formidable, striking blows; / all the gaṇas were seized by them, and the bulls were killed by lions.

1.3.s:
evaṃ nihanyamānā vai gaṇāste raṇamaṇḍale..
prahasya viṣṇuḥ provāca kumāraṃ śivavallabham.. 29.60 ..
1.3.d:
एवं निहन्यमाना वै गणास्ते रणमण्डले..
प्रहस्य विष्णुः प्रोवाच कुमारं शिववल्लभम्.. 29.60 ..
1.3.m: As those gaṇas were being slain thus in the battle arena, / Viṣṇu, laughing, spoke to Kumāra, the beloved of Śiva.

1.3.s:
..viṣṇuruvāca..
nānyo haṃtāsya pāpasya tvadvinā kṛttikāsuta..
tasmāttvayā hi karttavyaṃ vacanaṃ ca mahābhuja.. 29.61 ..
1.3.d:
..विष्णुरुवाच..
नान्यो हंतास्य पापस्य त्वद्विना कृत्तिकासुत..
तस्मात्त्वया हि कर्त्तव्यं वचनं च महाभुज.. 29.61 ..
1.3.m: Viṣṇu said: / “There is no other slayer of this wicked one except you, O son of the Kṛttikās; / therefore you must heed my word, O mighty-armed one!

1.3.s:
tārakasya vadhārthāya utpanno'si śivātmaja..
tasmāttvayaiva karttavya nidhanaṃ tārakasya ca.. 29.62 ..
1.3.d:
तारकस्य वधार्थाय उत्पन्नोऽसि शिवात्मज..
तस्मात्त्वयैव कर्त्तव्य निधनं तारकस्य च.. 29.62 ..
1.3.m: You were born for the sake of slaying Tāraka, O son of Śiva; / therefore the destruction of Tāraka must be accomplished by you alone.”

1.3.s:
tacchrutvā bhagavānkruddhaḥ pārvatīnandano mahān..
uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ viṣṇuṃ prati yathocitam.. 29.63 ..
1.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा भगवान्क्रुद्धः पार्वतीनन्दनो महान्..
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं विष्णुं प्रति यथोचितम्.. 29.63 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that, the great and blessed son of Pārvatī was angered, / and laughing heartily, he addressed Viṣṇu as was fitting:

1.3.s:
mayā nirīkṣyate samyakcitrayuddhaṃ mahātmanām..
anibhijño'smyahaṃ viṣṇo kāryākāryavicāraṇe.. 29.64 ..
1.3.d:
मया निरीक्ष्यते सम्यक्चित्रयुद्धं महात्मनाम्..
अनिभिज्ञोऽस्म्यहं विष्णो कार्याकार्यविचारणे.. 29.64 ..
1.3.m: “I was watching closely the wondrous battle of the great-souled ones. / I am ignorant, O Viṣṇu, in discerning what should and should not be done.

1.3.s:
ke'smadīyāḥ pare caiva na jānāmi kathaṃcana..
kimarthaṃ yudhyamānā vai parasparavadhe sthitāḥ.. 29.65 ..
1.3.d:
केऽस्मदीयाः परे चैव न जानामि कथंचन..
किमर्थं युध्यमाना वै परस्परवधे स्थिताः.. 29.65 ..
1.3.m: I do not know at all who are ours and who are the others; / why are these fighting, intent on killing one another?”

1.3.s: kumārasya vacaḥ śrutvā nārado vākyamabravīt.. 29.66 ..
1.3.d: कुमारस्य वचः श्रुत्वा नारदो वाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 29.66 ..
1.3.m: Hearing Kumāra's words, Nārada spoke these words:

1.3.s:
..nārada uvāca..
kumāro'si mahābāho śaṃkarasyāṃśasaṃbhavaḥ..
tvaṃ trātā jagatāṃ svāmī devānāṃ ca parā gatiḥ.. 29.67 ..
1.3.d:
..नारद उवाच..
कुमारोऽसि महाबाहो शंकरस्यांशसंभवः..
त्वं त्राता जगतां स्वामी देवानां च परा गतिः.. 29.67 ..
1.3.m: Nārada said: / “You are Kumāra, O mighty-armed one, born of a portion of Śaṃkara; / you are the protector, the lord of the worlds, and the highest refuge of the gods.

1.3.s:
tārakeṇa purā vīra tapastaptaṃ sudāruṇam..
yenaiva vijitā devā yena svargastathā jitaḥ.. 29.68 ..
1.3.d:
तारकेण पुरा वीर तपस्तप्तं सुदारुणम्..
येनैव विजिता देवा येन स्वर्गस्तथा जितः.. 29.68 ..
1.3.m: Formerly, O hero, Tāraka performed terrible austerity, / by which alone the gods were conquered, by which heaven was likewise conquered.

1.3.s:
tapasā tena cogreṇa ajeyatvamavāptavān..
anenāpi jitaśceṃdro lokapālāstathaiva ca.. 29.69 ..
1.3.d:
तपसा तेन चोग्रेण अजेयत्वमवाप्तवान्..
अनेनापि जितश्चेंद्रो लोकपालास्तथैव च.. 29.69 ..
1.3.m: And through that fierce austerity he obtained invincibility; / by him also Indra was conquered, and likewise the guardians of the worlds.

1.3.s:
trailokyaṃ ca jitaṃ sarvaṃ hyanenaiva radurātmanā..
tasmāttvayā nihaṃtavyastārakaḥ pāpapūruṣaḥ.. 29.70 ..
1.3.d:
त्रैलोक्यं च जितं सर्वं ह्यनेनैव रदुरात्मना..
तस्मात्त्वया निहंतव्यस्तारकः पापपूरुषः.. 29.70 ..
1.3.m: And all the three worlds were conquered by this very wicked soul; / therefore you must kill Tāraka, that sinful person.

1.3.s:
sarveṣāṃ śaṃ vidhātavyaṃ tvayā nāthena cādya vai..
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā kumāraḥ prahasanmahān..
vimānā davatīryātha padātiḥ paramo'bhavat.. 29.71 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वेषां शं विधातव्यं त्वया नाथेन चाद्य वै..
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा कुमारः प्रहसन्महान्..
विमाना दवतीर्याथ पदातिः परमोऽभवत्.. 29.71 ..
1.3.m: Auspiciousness must be brought to all by you today, the lord!” / Hearing Nārada’s words, the great Kumāra, laughing heartily, / descended from the aerial chariot and became a supreme foot-soldier.

1.3.s:
padmyāṃ tadāsau paridhāvamānaḥ śivātmajoyaṃ ca kumārarūpī..
kare samādāya mahāprabhāvāṃ śaktiṃ maholkāmiva dīptiyuktām.. 29.72 ..
1.3.d:
पद्म्यां तदासौ परिधावमानः शिवात्मजोयं च कुमाररूपी..
करे समादाय महाप्रभावां शक्तिं महोल्कामिव दीप्तियुक्ताम्.. 29.72 ..
1.3.m: Then, running on foot, this son of Śiva in the form of Kumāra, / took in hand his spear of great prowess, like a great blazing meteor.

1.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tamāyāṃtamatīva caṃḍamavyaktarūpaṃ balināṃ variṣṭham..
daityo babhāṣe surasattamānamasau kumāro dviṣatāṃ nihaṃtā.. 29.73 ..
1.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तमायांतमतीव चंडमव्यक्तरूपं बलिनां वरिष्ठम्..
दैत्यो बभाषे सुरसत्तमानमसौ कुमारो द्विषतां निहंता.. 29.73 ..
1.3.m: Seeing him approaching, exceedingly fierce, of unmanifest form, foremost among the strong, / the Daitya said to the best of gods: “This Kumāra is a slayer of foes!

1.3.s:
anena sārddhaṃ hyahameva vīro yotsyāmi sarvānahameva vīrān..
gaṇāṃśca sarvānapi ghātayāmi maheśvarām̐llokapālāṃśca sadyaḥ.. 29.74 ..
1.3.d:
अनेन सार्द्धं ह्यहमेव वीरो योत्स्यामि सर्वानहमेव वीरान्..
गणांश्च सर्वानपि घातयामि महेश्वराम्̐ल्लोकपालांश्च सद्यः.. 29.74 ..
1.3.m: I alone, the hero, will fight with him, and I alone [will fight] all the heroes; / and I shall forthwith slay all the gaṇas, the great lords, and the guardians of the worlds!”

1.3.s:
ityevamuktvā satataṃ mahābalaḥ kumāramuddiśya yayau ca yoddham..
jagrāha śaktiṃ paramādbhutāṃ ca sa tārako vākyamidaṃ babhāṣe.. 29.75 ..
1.3.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सततं महाबलः कुमारमुद्दिश्य ययौ च योद्धम्..
जग्राह शक्तिं परमाद्भुतां च स तारको वाक्यमिदं बभाषे.. 29.75 ..
1.3.m: Having spoken thus, the exceedingly mighty one constantly advanced toward Kumāra to fight; / he grasped a most wondrous spear, and that Tāraka spoke these words:

1.3.s:
..tāraka uvāca..
kumāro megrataścādya bhavadbhiśca kathaṃ kṛtaḥ..
yūyaṃ gatatrapā devā yeṣāṃ rājā puraṃdaraḥ.. 29.76 ..
1.3.d:
..तारक उवाच..
कुमारो मेग्रतश्चाद्य भवद्भिश्च कथं कृतः..
यूयं गतत्रपा देवा येषां राजा पुरंदरः.. 29.76 ..
1.3.m: Tāraka said: / “Why has Kumāra been placed before me today by you? / You are shameless gods whose king is Puraṃdara!

1.3.s:
purā yena kṛtaṃ karma viditaṃ sarvameva tat..
prasuptāścārdditā garbhe jaṭharasthā nipātitāḥ.. 29.77 ..
1.3.d:
पुरा येन कृतं कर्म विदितं सर्वमेव तत्..
प्रसुप्ताश्चार्द्दिता गर्भे जठरस्था निपातिताः.. 29.77 ..
1.3.m: What deed was done by him formerly—all that is known: / while sleeping, they were tortured in the womb, and those within the belly were struck down.

1.3.s:
kaśyapasyātmajenaiva bahurūpo hato'suraḥ..
namuciśca hato vīro vṛtraścaiva tathā hataḥ.. 29.78 ..
1.3.d:
कश्यपस्यात्मजेनैव बहुरूपो हतोऽसुरः..
