नमुचिश्च हतो वीरो वृत्रश्चैव तथा हतः.. 29.78 ..
1.3.m: By that son of Kaśyapa alone the multiform Asura was slain; / and the heroic Namuci was slain, and likewise Vṛtra was slain.

1.3.s:
kumāraṃ haṃtumosau deveṃdro balaghātakaḥ..
kumāro'yaṃ mayā devā ghātitodya na saṃśayaḥ.. 29.79 ..
1.3.d:
कुमारं हंतुमोसौ देवेंद्रो बलघातकः..
कुमारोऽयं मया देवा घातितोद्य न संशयः.. 29.79 ..
1.3.m: That Deveṃdra, the slayer of Bala, [has now sent] Kumāra to be slain! / This Kumāra has been slain by me today, O gods, of this there is no doubt!

1.3.s:
purā hatāstvayā viprā dakṣayajñe hyanekaśaḥ..
tatkarmaṇaḥ phalaṃ cādya vīrabhadra mahāmate..
darśayiṣyāmi te vīra raṇe raṇaviśārada.. 29.80 ..
1.3.d:
पुरा हतास्त्वया विप्रा दक्षयज्ञे ह्यनेकशः..
तत्कर्मणः फलं चाद्य वीरभद्र महामते..
दर्शयिष्यामि ते वीर रणे रणविशारद.. 29.80 ..
1.3.m: Formerly, brahmins were slain in large numbers by you at Dakṣa's sacrifice; / today, O great-minded Vīrabhadra, hero skilled in battle, / I shall show you the fruit of that deed in battle!”

1.3.s:
ityevamuktvā sa tadā mahātmā daityādhipo vīravaraḥ sa ekaḥ..
jagrāha śaktiṃ paramādbhutāṃ ca sa tārako yuddhavidāṃ variṣṭhaḥ.. 29.81 ..
1.3.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा स तदा महात्मा दैत्याधिपो वीरवरः स एकः..
जग्राह शक्तिं परमाद्भुतां च स तारको युद्धविदां वरिष्ठः.. 29.81 ..
1.3.m: Having spoken thus, that great-souled sovereign of the Daityas, the one foremost among heroes, / that Tāraka, best of those skilled in warfare, grasped a most wondrous spear.

1.3.s:
iti paramaruṣabhibhūto dititanayaḥ parīvṛto'sureṃdraiḥ..
yudhi matimakarottadā nihaṃtuṃ samaravijayī sa tārako balīyān.. 29.82 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṇḍe śivaśāstre suratārakāsurasaṃgrāmavarṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 29 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
इति परमरुषभिभूतो दितितनयः परीवृतोऽसुरेंद्रैः..
युधि मतिमकरोत्तदा निहंतुं समरविजयी स तारको बलीयान्.. 29.82 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखण्डे शिवशास्त्रे सुरतारकासुरसंग्रामवर्णनंनामैकोनत्रिंशोऽध्यायः.. 29 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
Overpowered by supreme wrath, that son of Diti, surrounded by lords of the Asuras, / that powerful Tāraka, victorious in battle, then set his mind on slaying in battle.
Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter, entitled “Description of the Battle between the Gods and Tārakāsura”, in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the Śivaśāstra, in the first Māheśvarakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
valgamānaṃ tamāyāṃtaṃ tārakā suramojasā..
ājaghāna ca vajreṇa iṃdro matimatāṃ varaḥ.. 30.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
वल्गमानं तमायांतं तारका सुरमोजसा..
आजघान च वज्रेण इंद्रो मतिमतां वरः.. 30.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / As Tārakāsura came bounding along in his might, / Indra, best among the wise, struck him with his thunderbolt.

1.3.s:
tena vajraprahāreṇa tārako vihvalīkṛtaḥ
patito'pi samutthāya śaktyā taṃ prāharaddvipam.. 30.2 ..
1.3.d:
तेन वज्रप्रहारेण तारको विह्वलीकृतः
पतितोऽपि समुत्थाय शक्त्या तं प्राहरद्द्विपम्.. 30.2 ..
1.3.m: Overwhelmed by that blow of the thunderbolt, Tāraka, / though fallen, rose up and struck his elephant with a spear.

1.3.s:
puraṃdaraṃ gajasthaṃ hi apātayā bhūtale..
hāhākāro mahānāsītpatite ca puraṃdare.. 30.3 ..
1.3.d:
पुरंदरं गजस्थं हि अपातया भूतले..
हाहाकारो महानासीत्पतिते च पुरंदरे.. 30.3 ..
1.3.m: He caused Puraṃdara, mounted on his elephant, to fall to the earth; / and when Puraṃdara fell, there was a great cry of woe.

1.3.s:
tārakeṇāpi tatraiva yatkṛtaṃ tacchṛṇu prabho..
patitaṃ ca padākramya hastādvajraṃ pragṛhya ca.. 30.4 ..
1.3.d:
तारकेणापि तत्रैव यत्कृतं तच्छृणु प्रभो..
पतितं च पदाक्रम्य हस्ताद्वज्रं प्रगृह्य च.. 30.4 ..
1.3.m: Hear also what was done right there by Tāraka, O lord! / Stepping with his foot upon the fallen one and seizing the thunderbolt from his hand,

1.3.s:
hataṃ deveṃdramālokya tārako ripusūdanaḥ..
vajraghātena mahatā'tāḍayattu puraṃdaram.. 30.5 ..
1.3.d:
हतं देवेंद्रमालोक्य तारको रिपुसूदनः..
वज्रघातेन महताऽताडयत्तु पुरंदरम्.. 30.5 ..
1.3.m: seeing Deveṃdra struck down, Tāraka, the slayer of foes, / struck Puraṃdara with a mighty blow of the thunderbolt.

1.3.s:
triśūlamudyamya mahābalastadā sa vīrabhadro ruṣitaḥ puraṃdaram..
saṃrakṣamāṇo hi jaghāna tārakaṃ śūlena daityaṃ ca mahāprabheṇa.. 30.6 ..
1.3.d:
त्रिशूलमुद्यम्य महाबलस्तदा स वीरभद्रो रुषितः पुरंदरम्..
संरक्षमाणो हि जघान तारकं शूलेन दैत्यं च महाप्रभेण.. 30.6 ..
1.3.m: Raising his trident, the exceedingly mighty Vīrabhadra then, enraged, / protecting Puraṃdara, struck the Daitya Tāraka with the trident of great splendour.

1.3.s:
śūlaprahārābhihato nipapāta mahītale..
patito'pi mahātejāstārakaḥ punarutthitaḥ.. 30.7 ..
1.3.d:
शूलप्रहाराभिहतो निपपात महीतले..
पतितोऽपि महातेजास्तारकः पुनरुत्थितः.. 30.7 ..
1.3.m: Struck by the blow of the trident, he fell onto the surface of the earth; / yet though fallen, Tāraka of great splendour rose up again.

1.3.s:
jaghāna parayā śaktyā vīrabhadraṃ tadorasi..
vīrabhadropi patitaḥ śaktighātena tasya vai.. 30.8 ..
1.3.d:
जघान परया शक्त्या वीरभद्रं तदोरसि..
वीरभद्रोपि पतितः शक्तिघातेन तस्य वै.. 30.8 ..
1.3.m: With an excellent spear he struck Vīrabhadra in the chest; / and Vīrabhadra also fell from the blow of his spear.

1.3.s:
sagaṇāścaiva devāśca gaṃdharvoragarākṣasāḥ..
hāhākāreṇa mahatā cukruśuśca punaḥpunaḥ.. 30.9 ..
1.3.d:
सगणाश्चैव देवाश्च गंधर्वोरगराक्षसाः..
हाहाकारेण महता चुक्रुशुश्च पुनःपुनः.. 30.9 ..
1.3.m: Then the gods with their gaṇas, and the Gandharvas, serpents, and Rākṣasas, / wailed repeatedly with a great cry of woe.

1.3.s:
tadotthitaḥ sahasā mahābalaḥ sa vīrabhadro dviṣatāṃ nihaṃtā..
triśūlamudyamya taḍitprakāśaṃ jājvalyamānaṃ prabhayā niraṃtaram..
svarociṣā bhāsitadigvitānaṃ sūyadubiṃbāgnyuḍumaṇḍalābham.. 30.10 ..
1.3.d:
तदोत्थितः सहसा महाबलः स वीरभद्रो द्विषतां निहंता..
त्रिशूलमुद्यम्य तडित्प्रकाशं जाज्वल्यमानं प्रभया निरंतरम्..
स्वरोचिषा भासितदिग्वितानं सूयदुबिंबाग्न्युडुमण्डलाभम्.. 30.10 ..
1.3.m: Then the exceedingly mighty Vīrabhadra, slayer of foes, suddenly rose up, / raising his trident that resembled a flash of lightning, continuously blazing with splendour, / illuminating the expanse of the directions with its radiance, resembling the sun’s disc, fire, and the multitude of stars.

1.3.s:
triśūlena tadā yāvaddhaṃtukāmo mahābalaḥ..
nivāritaḥ kumāreṇa māvadhīstvaṃ mahāmate.. 30.11 ..
1.3.d:
त्रिशूलेन तदा यावद्धंतुकामो महाबलः..
निवारितः कुमारेण मावधीस्त्वं महामते.. 30.11 ..
1.3.m: Then, as the exceedingly mighty one wished to kill him with his trident, / he was restrained by Kumāra: “Do not kill him, O great-minded one!”

1.3.s: jagarja ca mahātejāḥ kārttikeyo mahābalaḥ.. 30.12 ..
1.3.d: जगर्ज च महातेजाः कार्त्तिकेयो महाबलः.. 30.12 ..
1.3.m: And Kārttikeya of great splendour and immense strength roared.

1.3.s:
tadā jayetyabhihito bhūtairākāśasaṃsthitaiḥ..
śaktyā paramayā vīrastārakaṃ haṃtumudyataḥ.. 30.13 ..
1.3.d:
तदा जयेत्यभिहितो भूतैराकाशसंस्थितैः..
शक्त्या परमया वीरस्तारकं हंतुमुद्यतः.. 30.13 ..
1.3.m: Then, addressed with cries of “Victory!” by the beings stationed in the sky, / the heroic one prepared to slay Tāraka with his supreme spear.

1.3.s:
tārakasya kumārasya saṃgrāmastatra duḥsahaḥ..
jātastato mahāghoraḥ sarvabhūtabhayaṃkaraḥ.. 30.14 ..
1.3.d:
तारकस्य कुमारस्य संग्रामस्तत्र दुःसहः..
जातस्ततो महाघोरः सर्वभूतभयंकरः.. 30.14 ..
1.3.m: Then an unbearable combat took place between Tāraka and Kumāra, / exceedingly dreadful and striking terror into all beings.

1.3.s:
śaktihastau ca tau vīrau yuyudhāte parasparam..
śaktibhyāṃ bhinnahastau tau mahāsāhasasaṃyutau.. 30.15 ..
1.3.d:
शक्तिहस्तौ च तौ वीरौ युयुधाते परस्परम्..
शक्तिभ्यां भिन्नहस्तौ तौ महासाहससंयुतौ.. 30.15 ..
1.3.m: With spears in hand, the two heroes fought each other; / with their spears their hands were wounded, yet they were endowed with great daring.

1.3.s:
parasparaṃ vaṃcayaṃtau siṃhāviva mahābalau..
vaitālikīṃ samāśritya tathā vai khecarīṃ gatim.. 30.16 ..
1.3.d:
परस्परं वंचयंतौ सिंहाविव महाबलौ..
वैतालिकीं समाश्रित्य तथा वै खेचरीं गतिम्.. 30.16 ..
1.3.m: Eluding each other like two exceedingly strong lions, / resorting to the Vaitālikī posture and likewise the movement in the air,

1.3.s:
pārvataṃ matamāśritya śaktyā śaktiṃ nijaghnatuḥ..
ebhirmatairmahāvīrau cakraturyuddhamuttamam.. 30.17 ..
1.3.d:
पार्वतं मतमाश्रित्य शक्त्या शक्तिं निजघ्नतुः..
एभिर्मतैर्महावीरौ चक्रतुर्युद्धमुत्तमम्.. 30.17 ..
1.3.m: and resorting to the mountainous style of combat, they struck spear against spear; / adopting these tactics, the two great heroes waged an excellent fight.

1.3.s:
anyonyasādhakau bhūtvā mahābalaparākramau..
jaghnatuḥ śaktidhārābhī raṇe raṇaviśāradau.. 30.18 ..
1.3.d:
अन्योन्यसाधकौ भूत्वा महाबलपराक्रमौ..
जघ्नतुः शक्तिधाराभी रणे रणविशारदौ.. 30.18 ..
1.3.m: Matching one another, possessed of great strength and valour, / skilled in warfare, they struck with the blades of their spears in the battle.

1.3.s:
mūrdhni kaṇṭhe tathā bāhvorjānvoścaiva kaṭītaṭe..
vakṣasyurasi pṛṣṭhe ca cicchidatuḥ parasparam.. 30.19 ..
1.3.d:
मूर्ध्नि कण्ठे तथा बाह्वोर्जान्वोश्चैव कटीतटे..
वक्षस्युरसि पृष्ठे च चिच्छिदतुः परस्परम्.. 30.19 ..
1.3.m: On the head, on the throat, on the arms, on the knees, and on the hips, / on the chest, on the breast, and on the back, they cut one another.

1.3.s:
tadā tau yudhyamānau ca hantukāmau mahābalau..
prekṣakā hyabhavansarve devagandharvaguhyakāḥ.. 30.20 ..
1.3.d:
तदा तौ युध्यमानौ च हन्तुकामौ महाबलौ..
प्रेक्षका ह्यभवन्सर्वे देवगन्धर्वगुह्यकाः.. 30.20 ..
1.3.m: Then, as those two of mighty strength were fighting and seeking to kill [each other], / all the gods, gandharvas, and guhyakas became spectators.

1.3.s:
ūcuḥ parasparaṃ sarve ko'sminyuddhe vijeṣyate..
tadā nabhogatā vāṇī uvāca parisāṃtvya vai.. 30.21 ..
1.3.d:
ऊचुः परस्परं सर्वे कोऽस्मिन्युद्धे विजेष्यते..
तदा नभोगता वाणी उवाच परिसांत्व्य वै.. 30.21 ..
1.3.m: They all said to one another, “Who will be victorious in this battle?” / Then a voice situated in the sky spoke, reassuring them indeed:

1.3.s:
tārakaṃ hi surāścādya kumāro'yaṃ haniṣyati..
mā śocyatāṃ surāḥ sarvaiḥ sukhena sthīyatāṃ divi.. 30.22 ..
1.3.d:
तारकं हि सुराश्चाद्य कुमारोऽयं हनिष्यति..
मा शोच्यतां सुराः सर्वैः सुखेन स्थीयतां दिवि.. 30.22 ..
1.3.m: “O gods, today this Kumāra will surely slay Tāraka. / Let no gods grieve; let everyone abide happily in heaven.”

1.3.s:
śrutvā tadā tāṃ gagane samīritāṃ tadaiva vācaṃ pramathaiḥ parītaḥ..
kumārakastaṃ prati haṃtukāmo daityādhipaṃ tārakamugrarūpam.. 30.23 ..
1.3.d:
श्रुत्वा तदा तां गगने समीरितां तदैव वाचं प्रमथैः परीतः..
कुमारकस्तं प्रति हंतुकामो दैत्याधिपं तारकमुग्ररूपम्.. 30.23 ..
1.3.m: Then, having heard that voice uttered in the sky at that very moment, surrounded by the pramathas, / the young boy, desiring to slay him, turned toward that ruler of daityas, Tāraka of terrifying form.

1.3.s:
śaktyā tayā mahābāhurājaghāna stanāṃtare..
tārakaṃ hyasuraśreṣṭhaṃ kumāro balavattaraḥ.. 30.24 ..
1.3.d:
शक्त्या तया महाबाहुराजघान स्तनांतरे..
तारकं ह्यसुरश्रेष्ठं कुमारो बलवत्तरः.. 30.24 ..
1.3.m: The mighty-armed Kumāra, the more powerful one, struck with that spear / Tāraka, the foremost of the asuras, in the chest.

1.3.s:
taṃ prahāramanā dṛtya tārako daityapuṃgavaḥ..
kumāraṃ cā'pi saṃkruddhaḥ svaśaktyā cājaghāna vai.. 30.25 ..
1.3.d:
तं प्रहारमना दृत्य तारको दैत्यपुंगवः..
कुमारं चाऽपि संक्रुद्धः स्वशक्त्या चाजघान वै.. 30.25 ..
1.3.m: Disregarding that blow, Tāraka, the bull among daityas, / became enraged and struck Kumāra indeed with his own spear.

1.3.s:
tena śaktiprahāreṇa śāṃkarirmūrcchito'bhavat..
muhūrtāccetanāṃ prāptaḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ.. 30.26 ..
1.3.d:
तेन शक्तिप्रहारेण शांकरिर्मूर्च्छितोऽभवत्..
मुहूर्ताच्चेतनां प्राप्तः स्तूयमानो महर्षिभिः.. 30.26 ..
1.3.m: By that blow of the spear, the son of Śaṃkara swooned; / after a moment, being praised by the great ṛṣis, he regained consciousness.

1.3.s:
yathā siṃho madonmatto haṃtukāmastathaiva ca..
kumārastārakaṃ daityamājaghāna pratāpavān.. 30.27 ..
1.3.d:
यथा सिंहो मदोन्मत्तो हंतुकामस्तथैव च..
कुमारस्तारकं दैत्यमाजघान प्रतापवान्.. 30.27 ..
1.3.m: Just like a lion intoxicated with rut wishing to kill, even so / the glorious Kumāra struck the daitya Tāraka.

1.3.s:
evaṃ paraspareṇaiva kumāraścaiva tārakaḥ..
yuyudhāte'tisaṃrabdhau śaktiyuddhaparāyaṇau.. 30.28 ..
1.3.d:
एवं परस्परेणैव कुमारश्चैव तारकः..
युयुधातेऽतिसंरब्धौ शक्तियुद्धपरायणौ.. 30.28 ..
1.3.m: In this way, Kumāra and Tāraka / fought each other with great fury, devoted to the spear duel.

1.3.s:
abhyāsaparamāvāstāmanyonyavijigīṣayā..
tathā tau yudhyamānau ca citrarūpau tapasvinau.. 30.29 ..
1.3.d:
अभ्यासपरमावास्तामन्योन्यविजिगीषया..
तथा तौ युध्यमानौ च चित्ररूपौ तपस्विनौ.. 30.29 ..
1.3.m: Devoted to their practice, they stood wishing to conquer each other; / thus the two of wondrous form, full of austerity, fought on.

1.3.s:
dhārābhiśca aṇībhīśca suprayuktau ca jaghnatuḥ..
avalokaparāḥ sarve devagandharvakinnarāḥ.. 30.30 ..
1.3.d:
धाराभिश्च अणीभीश्च सुप्रयुक्तौ च जघ्नतुः..
अवलोकपराः सर्वे देवगन्धर्वकिन्नराः.. 30.30 ..
1.3.m: With blades and points well employed, they struck [each other]; / all the gods, gandharvas, and kinnaras were intent on watching.

1.3.s:
vismayaṃ paramaṃ prāptā nocuḥ kiṃcana tasya vai..
na vavau ca tadāvāyurniṣprabho'bhūddivākaraḥ.. 30.31 ..
1.3.d:
विस्मयं परमं प्राप्ता नोचुः किंचन तस्य वै..
न ववौ च तदावायुर्निष्प्रभोऽभूद्दिवाकरः.. 30.31 ..
1.3.m: Filled with the utmost amazement, they said nothing at all to him; / and the wind did not blow then, and the sun lost its splendor.

1.3.s:
himālayo'tha meruśca śvetakūṭaśca darduraḥ..
malayo'tha mahāśailo maināko viṃdhyaparvataḥ.. 30.32 ..
1.3.d:
हिमालयोऽथ मेरुश्च श्वेतकूटश्च दर्दुरः..
मलयोऽथ महाशैलो मैनाको विंध्यपर्वतः.. 30.32 ..
1.3.m: Then Himālaya, Meru, Śvetakūṭa, Dardura, / Malaya the great mountain, Maināka, Mount Vindhya,

1.3.s:
lokālokau mahāśailau mānasottaraparvataḥ..
kailāso mandaro mālyo gandhamādana eva ca.. 30.33 ..
1.3.d:
लोकालोकौ महाशैलौ मानसोत्तरपर्वतः..
कैलासो मन्दरो माल्यो गन्धमादन एव च.. 30.33 ..
1.3.m: the two great mountains Lokāloka, Mount Mānasottara, / Kailāsa, Mandara, Mālya, and Gandhamādana,

1.3.s: udayādrirmaheṃdraśca tathaivāstagirirmahān.. 30.34 ..
1.3.d: उदयाद्रिर्महेंद्रश्च तथैवास्तगिरिर्महान्.. 30.34 ..
1.3.m: the mountain of sunrise, Mahendra, and likewise the great mountain of sunset—

1.3.s:
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ parvatāśca mahāprabhāḥ..
snehārdditāstadājagmuḥ kumāraṃ ca parīpsavaḥ.. 30.35 ..
1.3.d:
एते चान्ये च बहवः पर्वताश्च महाप्रभाः..
स्नेहार्द्दितास्तदाजग्मुः कुमारं च परीप्सवः.. 30.35 ..
1.3.m: these and many other mountains of great splendor, / overwhelmed with affection, came then, desiring to protect Kumāra.

1.3.s:
tataḥ sa dṛṣṭvā tānsarvānbhayabhītāṃśca śāṃkariḥ..
parvatāngirijāputro babhāṣe pratibodhayan.. 30.36 ..
1.3.d:
ततः स दृष्ट्वा तान्सर्वान्भयभीतांश्च शांकरिः..
पर्वतान्गिरिजापुत्रो बभाषे प्रतिबोधयन्.. 30.36 ..
1.3.m: Then, seeing all those mountains terrified with fear, / the son of Śaṃkara, the son of the Mountain's daughter, spoke, reassuring them:

1.3.s:
..kumāra uvāca..
mā khidyata mahābhāgā mā ciṃtā kriyatāṃ nagāḥ..
ghātayāmyadya pāpiṣṭhaṃ sarveṣāmiha paśyatām.. 30.37 ..
1.3.d:
..कुमार उवाच..
मा खिद्यत महाभागा मा चिंता क्रियतां नगाः..
घातयाम्यद्य पापिष्ठं सर्वेषामिह पश्यताम्.. 30.37 ..
1.3.m: Kumāra said: / “Do not despair, O blessed ones! Do not worry, O mountains! / Today I shall slay this most sinful one while everyone looks on here.”

1.3.s:
evaṃ samāśvāsya tadā manasvī tānparvatāndevagaṇaiḥ sametān..
praṇamya śaṃbhuṃ manasā haripriyaḥ svāṃ mātaraṃ caiva nataḥ kumāraḥ.. 30.38 ..
1.3.d:
एवं समाश्वास्य तदा मनस्वी तान्पर्वतान्देवगणैः समेतान्..
प्रणम्य शंभुं मनसा हरिप्रियः स्वां मातरं चैव नतः कुमारः.. 30.38 ..
1.3.m: Having thus comforted those mountains along with the hosts of gods, / Kumāra, the wise one dear to Hari, bowed in his mind to Śambhu and bowed down to his own mother.

1.3.s:
kārttikeyastataḥ śaktyā nicakarta ripoḥ śiraḥ..
tacchiro nipapātorvyāṃ tārakasya ca tatkṣaṇāt..
evaṃ sa jayamāpede kārttikeyo mahāprabhuḥ.. 30.39 ..
1.3.d:
कार्त्तिकेयस्ततः शक्त्या निचकर्त रिपोः शिरः..
तच्छिरो निपपातोर्व्यां तारकस्य च तत्क्षणात्..
एवं स जयमापेदे कार्त्तिकेयो महाप्रभुः.. 30.39 ..
1.3.m: Then Kārttikeya severed the enemy's head with his spear; / at that instant, that head of Tāraka fell upon the earth; / thus did Kārttikeya, the great lord, attain victory.

1.3.s:
dadṛśustaṃ suragaṇā ṛṣayo guhyakāḥ khagāḥ..
kiṃnarāścāraṇāḥ sarpāstathā caivāpsaro gaṇāḥ.. 30.40 ..
1.3.d:
ददृशुस्तं सुरगणा ऋषयो गुह्यकाः खगाः..
किंनराश्चारणाः सर्पास्तथा चैवाप्सरो गणाः.. 30.40 ..
1.3.m: The hosts of gods, the ṛṣis, guhyakas, birds, / kinnaras, cāraṇas, serpents, and likewise troops of apsarases saw him.

1.3.s:
harṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭāstuṣṭuvustaṃ kumārakam..
vidyādharyaśca nanṛturgāyakāśca jagustadā.. 30.41 ..
1.3.d:
हर्षेण महताविष्टास्तुष्टुवुस्तं कुमारकम्..
विद्याधर्यश्च ननृतुर्गायकाश्च जगुस्तदा.. 30.41 ..
1.3.m: Overcome with great joy, they praised that Kumāra; / vidyādharīs danced, and singers sang at that time.

1.3.s:
evaṃ vijayamāpannaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve mudā yutāḥ..
tato harṣātsamāgamya svāṃkamāropya cātmajam.. 30.42 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विजयमापन्नं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे मुदा युताः..
ततो हर्षात्समागम्य स्वांकमारोप्य चात्मजम्.. 30.42 ..
1.3.m: Seeing him thus victorious, everyone was filled with joy; / then, having approached out of joy and placed her son upon her lap,

1.3.s:
pariṣvajya tu gāḍhena girijāpi tutoṣa vai..
svotsaṃge ca samāropya kumāraṃ sūryavarcasam.. 30.43 ..
1.3.d:
परिष्वज्य तु गाढेन गिरिजापि तुतोष वै..
स्वोत्संगे च समारोप्य कुमारं सूर्यवर्चसम्.. 30.43 ..
1.3.m: and embracing him tightly, the Mountain's daughter rejoiced indeed; / placing upon her lap Kumāra, who possessed the radiance of the sun,

1.3.s:
lālayāmāsa tanvaṃgī pārvatī rucirekṣaṇā..
ṛṣībhiḥ satkṛtaḥ śaṃbhuḥ pārvatyā sahitastadā.. 30.44 ..
1.3.d:
लालयामास तन्वंगी पार्वती रुचिरेक्षणा..
ऋषीभिः सत्कृतः शंभुः पार्वत्या सहितस्तदा.. 30.44 ..
1.3.m: Pārvatī of slender limbs and charming eyes fondled him; / Śambhu, honored by the ṛṣis together with Pārvatī at that time,

1.3.s:
āryāsanagatā sādhvī śuśubhe mitabhāṣiṇī..
saṃstūyamānā munibhiḥ siddhacāraṇapannagaiḥ.. 30.45 ..
1.3.d:
आर्यासनगता साध्वी शुशुभे मितभाषिणी..
संस्तूयमाना मुनिभिः सिद्धचारणपन्नगैः.. 30.45 ..
1.3.m: and the virtuous woman seated upon the noble seat, speaking measured words, shone, / being praised by the munis, siddhas, cāraṇas, and pannagas.

1.3.s:
nīrājitā tadā devaiḥ pārvatī śaṃbhunā saha..
kumāreṇa sahaivātha śomamānā tadā satī.. 30.46 ..
1.3.d:
नीराजिता तदा देवैः पार्वती शंभुना सह..
कुमारेण सहैवाथ शोममाना तदा सती.. 30.46 ..
1.3.m: Then Pārvatī, with Śambhu, was venerated with the waving of lights by the gods; / and with Kumāra, the virtuous lady shone then.

1.3.s:
himālayastadāgatya putraiśca parivāritaḥ..
mervādyaiḥ parvataiścaiva stūyamānaḥ paro'bhavat.. 30.47 ..
1.3.d:
हिमालयस्तदागत्य पुत्रैश्च परिवारितः..
मेर्वाद्यैः पर्वतैश्चैव स्तूयमानः परोऽभवत्.. 30.47 ..
1.3.m: Then Himālaya, having arrived surrounded by his sons / and being praised by Meru and other mountains, became supreme.

1.3.s:
tadā devagaṇāḥ sarva indrādya ṛṣibhiḥ saha..
puṣpavarṣeṇa mahāta vavarṣuramitadyutim..
kumāramagrataḥ kṛtvā nīrājanaparā babhuḥ.. 30.48 ..
1.3.d:
तदा देवगणाः सर्व इन्द्राद्य ऋषिभिः सह..
पुष्पवर्षेण महात ववर्षुरमितद्युतिम्..
कुमारमग्रतः कृत्वा नीराजनपरा बभुः.. 30.48 ..
1.3.m: Then all the hosts of gods, Indra and the others together with the ṛṣis, / rained a great shower of flowers upon him of boundless splendor; / placing Kumāra at their head, they were intent on waving lights before him.

1.3.s:
gītavāditraghoṣeṇa brahmaghoṣeṇa bhūyasā..
saṃstūyamāno vividhaiḥ sūktairvedavidāṃ varaiḥ.. 30.49 ..
1.3.d:
गीतवादित्रघोषेण ब्रह्मघोषेण भूयसा..
संस्तूयमानो विविधैः सूक्तैर्वेदविदां वरैः.. 30.49 ..
1.3.m: With the sound of songs and musical instruments, and the loud roar of Vedic chanting, / he was praised with various hymns by the foremost of the knowers of the Vedas.

1.3.s:
kumāravijayaṃnāma caritraṃ paramādbhutam..
sarvapāpaharaṃ divyaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām.. 30.50 ..
1.3.d:
कुमारविजयंनाम चरित्रं परमाद्भुतम्..
सर्वपापहरं दिव्यं सर्वकामप्रदं नृणाम्.. 30.50 ..
1.3.m: This supremely wondrous narrative called ‘The Victory of Kumāra’ / removes all sins, is divine, and grants all desires to mortals.

1.3.s:
ye kīrttayaṃti śucayo'mitabhāgyayuktāścānaṃtyarūpamajarāmaramādadhānāḥ..
kaumāravikramamahātmyamudārametadānaṃdadāyakamanorthakaraṃ nṛṇāṃ hi.. 30.51 ..
1.3.d:
ये कीर्त्तयंति शुचयोऽमितभाग्ययुक्ताश्चानंत्यरूपमजरामरमादधानाः..
कौमारविक्रममहात्म्यमुदारमेतदानंददायकमनोर्थकरं नृणां हि.. 30.51 ..
1.3.m: Those pure people who, endowed with boundless fortune, proclaim this noble / greatness of Kumāra's valor, which assumes an infinite, ageless, and immortal form, indeed brings delight and fulfills the desires of men.

1.3.s:
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi kumārasya mahātmanaḥ..
caritaṃ tārakākhyaṃ ca sarvapāpaiḥ samucyate.. 30.52 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe śivaśāstre tārakāsuravadhapūrvakaṃ svāmikārttikeyavijayotsavavarṇanaṃ nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 30 ..
1.3.d:
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि कुमारस्य महात्मनः..
चरितं तारकाख्यं च सर्वपापैः समुच्यते.. 30.52 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखंडे शिवशास्त्रे तारकासुरवधपूर्वकं स्वामिकार्त्तिकेयविजयोत्सववर्णनं नाम त्रिंशोऽध्यायः.. 30 ..
1.3.m:
Whoever reads or hears this deed of the great-souled Kumāra, / known by the name of Tāraka, is released from all sins.
Thus ends the thirtieth chapter, named ‘Description of the Festival of Victory of Lord Kārttikeya Preceded by the Slaying of the Asura Tāraka,’ in the Śiva-śāstra in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.3.s:
..śonaka uvāca..
hatvā taṃ tārakaṃ saṃkhye kumāreṇa mahātmanā..
kiṃ kṛtaṃ sumahadvipra tatsarvaṃ vaktumarhasi.. 31.1 ..
1.3.d:
..शोनक उवाच..
हत्वा तं तारकं संख्ये कुमारेण महात्मना..
किं कृतं सुमहद्विप्र तत्सर्वं वक्तुमर्हसि.. 31.1 ..
1.3.m: Śaunaka said: / After Tāraka was slain in battle by the great-souled Kumāra, / what great thing was done, O brahmin? You ought to tell all that.

1.3.s:
kumāro hyaparaḥ śaṃbhuryena sarvamidaṃ tatam..
tapasā toṣitaḥ śaṃbhurdadāti paramaṃ padam.. 31.2 ..
1.3.d:
कुमारो ह्यपरः शंभुर्येन सर्वमिदं ततम्..
तपसा तोषितः शंभुर्ददाति परमं पदम्.. 31.2 ..
1.3.m: Kumāra is indeed another Śambhu, by whom all this is pervaded; / Śambhu, pleased by austerity, grants the supreme state.

1.3.s:
kumāro darśanātsadyaḥ saphalo hi nṛṇāṃ sadā..
ye pāpino hyadharmmiṣṭhāḥ śvapacā api lomaśa..
darśanāddhūtapāpāste bhavaṃtyeva na saṃśayaḥ.. 31.3 ..
1.3.d:
कुमारो दर्शनात्सद्यः सफलो हि नृणां सदा..
ये पापिनो ह्यधर्म्मिष्ठाः श्वपचा अपि लोमश..
दर्शनाद्धूतपापास्ते भवंत्येव न संशयः.. 31.3 ..
1.3.m: For Kumāra brings immediate fruit to mortals always upon darśana; / those who are sinful, most unrighteous, even dog-eaters, O Lomaśa, / their sins are washed away upon his darśana—there is no doubt.

1.3.s:
śaunakasya vacaḥ śrutvā uvāca caritaṃ tadā..
vyāsa śiṣyo mahāprajñaḥ kumārasya mahātmanaḥ.. 31.4 ..
1.3.d:
शौनकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा उवाच चरितं तदा..
व्यास शिष्यो महाप्रज्ञः कुमारस्य महात्मनः.. 31.4 ..
1.3.m: Having heard the words of Śaunaka, Vyāsa's disciple, endowed with great intellect, / then spoke about the life of the great-souled Kumāra.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
htāva taṃ tārakaṃ saṃkhye devānāmajayaṃ tataḥ..
avadhyaṃ ca dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kumāro jayamāptavān.. 31.5 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
ह्ताव तं तारकं संख्ये देवानामजयं ततः..
अवध्यं च द्विजश्रेष्ठाः कुमारो जयमाप्तवान्.. 31.5 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Having slain that Tāraka in battle, whom the gods could not conquer / and who was invulnerable, O best of the twice-born, Kumāra attained victory.

1.3.s:
mahimā hi kumārasya sarvaśāstreṣu kathyate..
vedaiśca svāgamaiścāpi purāṇaiśca tathaiva ca.. 31.6 ..
1.3.d:
महिमा हि कुमारस्य सर्वशास्त्रेषु कथ्यते..
वेदैश्च स्वागमैश्चापि पुराणैश्च तथैव च.. 31.6 ..
1.3.m: For the majesty of Kumāra is proclaimed in all the scriptures, / by the Vedas, by his own āgamas, and likewise by the Purāṇas,

1.3.s:
tathopaniṣadaiścaiva mīmāṃsādvitayena tu..
evaṃbhūtaḥ kumāroyamaśakyo varṇituṃ dvijāḥ.. 31.7 ..
1.3.d:
तथोपनिषदैश्चैव मीमांसाद्वितयेन तु..
एवंभूतः कुमारोयमशक्यो वर्णितुं द्विजाः.. 31.7 ..
1.3.m: and likewise by the Upaniṣads, and by the two Mīmāṃsās; / such is this Kumāra, impossible to describe, O twice-born!

1.3.s:
yo hi darśanamātreṇa punāti sakalaṃ jagat..
trātāraṃ bhuvanasyāsya niśamya pitṛrāṭsvayam.. 31.8 ..
1.3.d:
यो हि दर्शनमात्रेण पुनाति सकलं जगत्..
त्रातारं भुवनस्यास्य निशम्य पितृराट्स्वयम्.. 31.8 ..
1.3.m: Hearing of the protector of this world, / who purifies the entire world by mere darśana, the king of the ancestors himself,

1.3.s:
brahmāṇaṃ ca puraskṛtya viṣṇuṃ caiva savāsavam..
sa yayau tvaritenaiva śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram..
tṛṣṭāva prayato bhūtvā dakṣiṇāśāpatiḥ svayam.. 31.9 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्माणं च पुरस्कृत्य विष्णुं चैव सवासवम्..
स ययौ त्वरितेनैव शंकरं लोकशंकरम्..
तृष्टाव प्रयतो भूत्वा दक्षिणाशापतिः स्वयम्.. 31.9 ..
1.3.m: placing Brahmā in front, as well as Viṣṇu along with Indra, / went swiftly to Śaṃkara, the causer of welfare to the world; / becoming restrained, the lord of the southern quarter himself praised him:

1.3.s:
namo bhargāya devāya devānāṃ pataye namaḥ..
mṛtyuṃjayāya rudrāya īśānāya kaparddine.. 31.10 ..
1.3.d:
नमो भर्गाय देवाय देवानां पतये नमः..
मृत्युंजयाय रुद्राय ईशानाय कपर्द्दिने.. 31.10 ..
1.3.m: "Salutations to the luminous god, salutations to the lord of the gods, / to the conqueror of death, to Rudra, to Īśāna, to the one with matted hair,

1.3.s:
nīlakaṃṭhāya śarvāya vyomāvayavarūpiṇe..
kālāya kālanāthāya kālarūpāya vai namaḥ.. 31.11 ..
1.3.d:
नीलकंठाय शर्वाय व्योमावयवरूपिणे..
कालाय कालनाथाय कालरूपाय वै नमः.. 31.11 ..
1.3.m: to the blue-throated one, to Śarva, whose body has the form of the sky, / salutations indeed to Time, to the lord of Time, to the one whose form is Time."

1.3.s:
yamena stūyamāno hi uvāca prabhurīśvaraḥ..
kimarthamāgato'si tvaṃ tatsarvaṃ kathayasva naḥ.. 31.12 ..
1.3.d:
यमेन स्तूयमानो हि उवाच प्रभुरीश्वरः..
किमर्थमागतोऽसि त्वं तत्सर्वं कथयस्व नः.. 31.12 ..
1.3.m: Thus praised by Yama, the lord Īśvara spoke: / "For what purpose have you come? Tell us all of that."

1.3.s:
..yama uvāca..
śrūyatāṃ devadeveśa vākya vākyaviśārada..
tapasā parameṇaiva tuṣṭiṃ prāptosi śaṃkara.. 31.13 ..
1.3.d:
..यम उवाच..
श्रूयतां देवदेवेश वाक्य वाक्यविशारद..
तपसा परमेणैव तुष्टिं प्राप्तोसि शंकर.. 31.13 ..
1.3.m: Yama said: / "Listen, O lord of the gods of gods, O eloquent speaker of words! / O Śaṃkara, you are pleased solely by supreme austerity.

1.3.s:
karmaṇā parameṇaiva brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ..
tuṣṭimeti na saṃdeho varāṇāṃ hi sadā prabhuḥ.. 31.14 ..
1.3.d:
कर्मणा परमेणैव ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः..
तुष्टिमेति न संदेहो वराणां हि सदा प्रभुः.. 31.14 ..
1.3.m: Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, is pleased solely by supreme action; / there is no doubt that he is ever the lord of boons.

1.3.s:
tathā viṣṇurhi bhagavānvedavedyaḥ sanātanaḥ..
yajñairanekaiḥ saṃtuṣṭa upavāsavrataistathā.. 31.15 ..
1.3.d:
तथा विष्णुर्हि भगवान्वेदवेद्यः सनातनः..
यज्ञैरनेकैः संतुष्ट उपवासव्रतैस्तथा.. 31.15 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, the blessed eternal Viṣṇu, known through the Vedas, / is pleased by various sacrifices and by fasts and vows.

1.3.s:
dadāti kevalaṃ bhāvaṃ yena kaivalyamāpnuyuḥ..
narāḥ sarve mama mataṃ nānyatā hi vaco mama.. 31.16 ..
1.3.d:
ददाति केवलं भावं येन कैवल्यमाप्नुयुः..
नराः सर्वे मम मतं नान्यता हि वचो मम.. 31.16 ..
1.3.m: He grants pure devotion by which men may attain absolute liberation, / all of them; this is my view, and my word is never otherwise.

1.3.s:
dadāti tuṣṭo vai bhogaṃ tathā svargādisaṃpadaḥ..
sūryo namasyayā'rogyaṃ dadātīha na cānyathā.. 31.17 ..
1.3.d:
ददाति तुष्टो वै भोगं तथा स्वर्गादिसंपदः..
सूर्यो नमस्ययाऽरोग्यं ददातीह न चान्यथा.. 31.17 ..
1.3.m: Being pleased, [one god] indeed grants enjoyment and the treasures of heaven and beyond; / Sūrya grants health here upon prostration, and not otherwise.

1.3.s:
gaṇeśo hi mahādeva arghyapādyādicaṃdanaiḥ..
maṃtrāvṛttyā tathā śaṃbho nirvighnaṃ ca kariṣyati.. 31.18 ..
1.3.d:
गणेशो हि महादेव अर्घ्यपाद्यादिचंदनैः..
मंत्रावृत्त्या तथा शंभो निर्विघ्नं च करिष्यति.. 31.18 ..
1.3.m: O Mahādeva, Gaṇeśa will indeed remove obstacles, O Śambhu, / through offerings of water, foot-wash, and sandalwood, and through the repetition of mantras.

1.3.s:
tathānye lokapāḥ sarve yathāśaktyā phalapradāḥ..
yajñādhyayanadānādyaiḥ parituṣṭāśca śaṃkara.. 31.19 ..
1.3.d:
तथान्ये लोकपाः सर्वे यथाशक्त्या फलप्रदाः..
यज्ञाध्ययनदानाद्यैः परितुष्टाश्च शंकर.. 31.19 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, all other guardians of the world grant fruits according to ability, / being satisfied by sacrifice, study, giving, and the like, O Śaṃkara.

1.3.s:
mahadāścarya saṃbhūtaṃ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmiha..
kṛtaṃ ca tava putreṇa svargadvāramapāvṛtām.. 31.20 ..
1.3.d:
महदाश्चर्य संभूतं सर्वेषां प्राणिनामिह..
कृतं च तव पुत्रेण स्वर्गद्वारमपावृताम्.. 31.20 ..
1.3.m: A great wonder has arisen here for all living beings; / the gate of heaven has been thrown open by your son.

1.3.s:
darśanācca kumārasya sarve svargaikaso narāḥ..
pāpino'pi mahādeva jātā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ.. 31.21 ..
1.3.d:
दर्शनाच्च कुमारस्य सर्वे स्वर्गैकसो नराः..
पापिनोऽपि महादेव जाता नास्त्यत्र संशयः.. 31.21 ..
1.3.m: And from the darśana of Kumāra, all men have become dwellers in heaven alone; / even sinners [have become so], O Mahādeva; there is no doubt about this.

1.3.s:
mayā kiṃ kriyatāṃ deva kāryākāryavyavasthitau..
ye satyaśīlāḥ śāṃtāśca vadānyā niravagrahāḥ.. 31.22 ..
1.3.d:
मया किं क्रियतां देव कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ..
ये सत्यशीलाः शांताश्च वदान्या निरवग्रहाः.. 31.22 ..
1.3.m: What am I to do, O Lord, regarding the ordering of what should and should not be done? / Those who are truthful and peaceful, generous and unrestrained,

1.3.s:
jiteṃdriyā alubdhāśca kāmarāgavivarjitāḥ..
yājñikā dharmaniṣṭhāśca vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ.. 31.23 ..
1.3.d:
जितेंद्रिया अलुब्धाश्च कामरागविवर्जिताः..
याज्ञिका धर्मनिष्ठाश्च वेदवेदांगपारगाः.. 31.23 ..
1.3.m: those of subdued senses, free from greed, devoid of lust and passion, / sacrificers devoted to dharma, proficient in the Vedas and Vedāṅgas—

1.3.s:
yāṃ gatiṃ yāṃti vai śaṃbho sarve sukṛtinopi hi..
tāṃ gatiṃ darśanātsarve śvapacā adhamā api.. 31.24 ..
1.3.d:
यां गतिं यांति वै शंभो सर्वे सुकृतिनोपि हि..
तां गतिं दर्शनात्सर्वे श्वपचा अधमा अपि.. 31.24 ..
1.3.m: that destination which all those of good deeds attain, O Śambhu, / that very destination even base outcastes reach from darśana

1.3.s:
kumārasya ca deveśa mahadāścaryakarmaṇaḥ..
kārttikyāṃ kṛttikāyogasahitāyāṃ śivasya ca.. 31.25 ..
1.3.d:
कुमारस्य च देवेश महदाश्चर्यकर्मणः..
कार्त्तिक्यां कृत्तिकायोगसहितायां शिवस्य च.. 31.25 ..
1.3.m: of Kumāra, O lord of the gods, whose deeds are of great wonder. / On the full-moon day of Kārttika joined with the constellation Kṛttikā, having seen the son of Śiva,

1.3.s:
śivasya tanayaṃ dṛṣṭvā te yāṃti svakulaiḥ saha..
koṭibhirbahubhiścaiva matsthānaṃ parimucya vai.. 31.26 ..
1.3.d:
शिवस्य तनयं दृष्ट्वा ते यांति स्वकुलैः सह..
कोटिभिर्बहुभिश्चैव मत्स्थानं परिमुच्य वै.. 31.26 ..
1.3.m: having seen the son of Śiva, they go along with their families / by many tens of millions, completely abandoning my abode.

1.3.s:
kumāradarśanātsarve śvapacā api yāṃti vai..
sadgatiṃ tvaritenaiva kiṃ kriyeta mayādhunā.. 31.27 ..
1.3.d:
कुमारदर्शनात्सर्वे श्वपचा अपि यांति वै..
सद्गतिं त्वरितेनैव किं क्रियेत मयाधुना.. 31.27 ..
1.3.m: From the darśana of Kumāra, even all outcastes go / swiftly to the good realm; what should be done by me now?"

1.3.s: yamasya vacanaṃ śrutvā śaṃkaro vākyamabravīt.. 31.28 ..
1.3.d: यमस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा शंकरो वाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 31.28 ..
1.3.m: Having heard Yama's words, Śaṃkara spoke these words:

1.3.s:
..śaṃkara uvāca..
yeṣāṃ tvaṃtagataṃ pāpaṃ janānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām..
viśuddhabhāvo bho dharmma teṣāṃ manasi varttate.. 31.29 ..
1.3.d:
..शंकर उवाच..
येषां त्वंतगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम्..
विशुद्धभावो भो धर्म्म तेषां मनसि वर्त्तते.. 31.29 ..
1.3.m: Śaṃkara said: / "Those people of meritorious deeds whose sin has reached its end— / O Dharma, a purified disposition exists in their minds.

1.3.s:
sattīrthagamanāyaiva darśanārthaṃ satāmiha..
vāṃchā ca mahatī teṣāṃ jāyate pūrvakāritā.. 31.30 ..
1.3.d:
सत्तीर्थगमनायैव दर्शनार्थं सतामिह..
वांछा च महती तेषां जायते पूर्वकारिता.. 31.30 ..
1.3.m: A great desire, caused by previous deeds, is born in them / precisely to go to true sacred fords and to have darśana of the virtuous here.

1.3.s:
bahūnāṃ janmanāmaṃte mayi bhāvo'nuvarttate..
prāṇināṃ sarvabhāvena janmābhyāsenabho yama.. 31.31 ..
1.3.d:
बहूनां जन्मनामंते मयि भावोऽनुवर्त्तते..
प्राणिनां सर्वभावेन जन्माभ्यासेनभो यम.. 31.31 ..
1.3.m: At the end of many births, through the habit of births, devotion to me / with all one's being persists in living beings, O Yama.

1.3.s:
tasmātsukṛtinaḥ sarve yeṣāṃ bhāvo'nuvartte..
janmajanmānuvṛttānāṃ vismayaṃ naiva kārayet.. 31.32 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्सुकृतिनः सर्वे येषां भावोऽनुवर्त्ते..
जन्मजन्मानुवृत्तानां विस्मयं नैव कारयेत्.. 31.32 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, all those are doers of good deeds in whom devotion persists; / one should not feel wonder at those who have continued through birth after birth.

1.3.s:
strībālaśūdrāḥ śvapacādhamāśca prāgjanmasaṃskāravaśāddhi dharmma..
yoniṃ pāpiṣu varttamānāstathāpi śuddhā manujā bhavaṃti.. 31.33 ..
1.3.d:
स्त्रीबालशूद्राः श्वपचाधमाश्च प्राग्जन्मसंस्कारवशाद्धि धर्म्म..
योनिं पापिषु वर्त्तमानास्तथापि शुद्धा मनुजा भवंति.. 31.33 ..
1.3.m: Women, children, śūdras, and base outcastes, due to the impressions of previous births, O Dharma— / even while living in sinful wombs, such men become pure.

1.3.s:
tathā sitena manasā ca bhavaṃti sarve sarveṣu caiva viṣayeṣu bhavaṃti tajjñāḥ..
daivena pūrvacaritena bhavaṃti sarve surāśceṃdrādayo lokapālāḥ prāktanena.. 31.34 ..
1.3.d:
तथा सितेन मनसा च भवंति सर्वे सर्वेषु चैव विषयेषु भवंति तज्ज्ञाः..
दैवेन पूर्वचरितेन भवंति सर्वे सुराश्चेंद्रादयो लोकपालाः प्राक्तनेन.. 31.34 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, they all come to have bright minds and become knowers of that in all matters; / by past destiny and former conduct, all the gods, Indra and others, and the guardians of the world exist due to previous deeds.

1.3.s: jātā hyamī bhūtagaṇāśca sarve hyamī ṛṣayo hyamī devatāśca.. 31.35 ..
1.3.d: जाता ह्यमी भूतगणाश्च सर्वे ह्यमी ऋषयो ह्यमी देवताश्च.. 31.35 ..
1.3.m: All these hosts of spirits, all these seers, and all these deities were born thus.

1.3.s:
vismayo naiva karttavyastvayā vāpi kumārake..
kumāradarśane caiva dharmarāja nibodha me.. 31.36 ..
1.3.d:
विस्मयो नैव कर्त्तव्यस्त्वया वापि कुमारके..
कुमारदर्शने चैव धर्मराज निबोध मे.. 31.36 ..
1.3.m: You should not feel wonder regarding Kumāra, / nor concerning the darśana of Kumāra; understand from me, O Dharmarāja!

1.3.s:
vacanaṃ karmasaṃyuktaṃ sarveṣāṃ phaladāyakam..
sarvatīrthāni yajñāśca dānāni vividhāni ca..
kāryāṇi manaḥśuddhyarthaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 31.37 ..
1.3.d:
वचनं कर्मसंयुक्तं सर्वेषां फलदायकम्..
सर्वतीर्थानि यज्ञाश्च दानानि विविधानि च..
कार्याणि मनःशुद्ध्यर्थं नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 31.37 ..
1.3.m: Speech combined with action yields fruit to all; / all sacred fords, sacrifices, and various gifts / should be performed for the purification of the mind; there should be no deliberation on this.

1.3.s:
manasā bhāvito hyātmā ātmanātmānameva ca..
ātmā ahaṃ ca sarveṣaāṃ prāṇināṃ hi vyavasthitaḥ.. 31.38 ..
1.3.d:
मनसा भावितो ह्यात्मा आत्मनात्मानमेव च..
आत्मा अहं च सर्वेषआं प्राणिनां हि व्यवस्थितः.. 31.38 ..
1.3.m: The Self is indeed meditated upon by the mind, through oneself and as oneself; / and I, the Self, reside in all living beings.

1.3.s:
ahaṃ sadā bhāvayukta ātmasaṃstho niraṃtaraḥ..
jaṃgamājaṃgamānāṃ ca satyaṃ prati vadāmi te.. 31.39 ..
1.3.d:
अहं सदा भावयुक्त आत्मसंस्थो निरंतरः..
जंगमाजंगमानां च सत्यं प्रति वदामि ते.. 31.39 ..
1.3.m: I am ever endowed with contemplation, established in the Self, continuous / in both moving and unmoving beings; I tell you the truth.

1.3.s:
dvaṃdvātīto nirvikalpo hi sākṣātsvastho nityo nityayukto nirīhaḥ..
kūṭastho vai kalpabhedapravādairbahiṣkṛto bodhabodhyo hyanantaḥ.. 31.40 ..
1.3.d:
द्वंद्वातीतो निर्विकल्पो हि साक्षात्स्वस्थो नित्यो नित्ययुक्तो निरीहः..
कूटस्थो वै कल्पभेदप्रवादैर्बहिष्कृतो बोधबोध्यो ह्यनन्तः.. 31.40 ..
1.3.m: Beyond dualities, without mental construction, directly present in oneself, eternal, ever-united, free from striving, / immovable indeed, set outside the arguments of diverse kalpas, to be known by awakening, infinite—

1.3.s:
vismṛtya cainaṃ svātmānaṃ kevalaṃ bodhalakṣaṇam..
saṃsāriṇo hi dṛśyaṃte samastā jīvarāśayaḥ.. 31.41 ..
1.3.d:
विस्मृत्य चैनं स्वात्मानं केवलं बोधलक्षणम्..
संसारिणो हि दृश्यंते समस्ता जीवराशयः.. 31.41 ..
1.3.m: and forgetting this own Self, whose sole mark is awareness, / all the multitudes of living beings are seen as transmigrating beings.

1.3.s:
ahaṃ brahmā ca viṣṇuśca trayo'mī guṇakāriṇaḥ..
sṛṣṭipālanasaṃhārakārakā nānyathā bhavet.. 31.42 ..
1.3.d:
अहं ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च त्रयोऽमी गुणकारिणः..
सृष्टिपालनसंहारकारका नान्यथा भवेत्.. 31.42 ..
1.3.m: I, Brahmā, and Viṣṇu: these three produce the qualities, / carrying out creation, preservation, and destruction; it cannot be otherwise.

1.3.s:
ahaṃkāravṛtenaiva karmaṇā kāritāvayam..
yūyaṃ ca sarve vibudhā manuṣyāśca khagādayaḥ.. 31.43 ..
1.3.d:
अहंकारवृतेनैव कर्मणा कारितावयम्..
यूयं च सर्वे विबुधा मनुष्याश्च खगादयः.. 31.43 ..
1.3.m: We are caused to act by karma wrapped in egoity, / as are you, all the gods, human beings, birds, and the rest,

1.3.s:
paśvādayaḥ pṛthagbhūtāstathānye bahavo hyamī..
pṛthakpṛthaksamīcīnā guṇavataśca saṃsṛtau.. 31.44 ..
1.3.d:
पश्वादयः पृथग्भूतास्तथान्ये बहवो ह्यमी..
पृथक्पृथक्समीचीना गुणवतश्च संसृतौ.. 31.44 ..
1.3.m: beasts and others, differentiated, and these many others— / diverse, fitting, and endowed with qualities in worldly existence.

1.3.s:
patitā mṛgatṛṣṇāyāṃ māyayā ca vaśīkṛtāḥ..
vayaṃ sarve ca vibudhāḥ prājñāḥ paṃḍitamāninaḥ.. 31.45 ..
1.3.d:
पतिता मृगतृष्णायां मायया च वशीकृताः..
वयं सर्वे च विबुधाः प्राज्ञाः पंडितमानिनः.. 31.45 ..
1.3.m: Fallen into a mirage and brought under control by māyā, / we, all the gods, the wise, and those who consider themselves scholars,

1.3.s: parasparaṃ dūṣayaṃto mithyāvādaratāḥ khalāḥ.. 31.46 ..
1.3.d: परस्परं दूषयंतो मिथ्यावादरताः खलाः.. 31.46 ..
1.3.m: censure one another, delighting in falsehood, wicked,

1.3.s:
traiguṇā bhavasaṃpannā atattavajñāśca rāgiṇaḥ..
kāmakrodhabhayadveṣamadamātsaryasaṃyutāḥ.. 31.47 ..
1.3.d:
त्रैगुणा भवसंपन्ना अतत्तवज्ञाश्च रागिणः..
कामक्रोधभयद्वेषमदमात्सर्यसंयुताः.. 31.47 ..
1.3.m: consisting of the three qualities, full of worldly existence, ignorant of the truth, impassioned, / endowed with desire, anger, fear, malice, pride, and envy,

1.3.s:
parasparaṃ dūṣayaṃto hyatattvajñā bahirmukhāḥ..
tasmādevaṃ viditvātha asatyaṃ guṇabhedataḥ.. 31.48 ..
1.3.d:
परस्परं दूषयंतो ह्यतत्त्वज्ञा बहिर्मुखाः..
तस्मादेवं विदित्वाथ असत्यं गुणभेदतः.. 31.48 ..
1.3.m: censuring one another, ignorant of the truth, outward-facing. / Therefore, knowing thus what is unreal through the distinction of qualities,

1.3.s: guṇātīte ca vastvarthe paramārthaikadarśanam.. 31.49 ..
1.3.d: गुणातीते च वस्त्वर्थे परमार्थैकदर्शनम्.. 31.49 ..
1.3.m: and seeing solely the supreme truth in the reality that is beyond qualities—

1.3.s:
yasminbhedo hyabhedaṃ ca yasminrāgo virāgatām..
krodho hyakrodhatāṃ yāti tadvāma paramaṃ śrṛṇu.. 31.50 ..
1.3.d:
यस्मिन्भेदो ह्यभेदं च यस्मिन्रागो विरागताम्..
क्रोधो ह्यक्रोधतां याति तद्वाम परमं श्रृणु.. 31.50 ..
1.3.m: in which difference becomes non-difference, in which passion becomes dispassion, / and anger attains angerlessness—hear of that supreme left [path]!

1.3.s:
na tadbhāsayate śabdaḥ kṛtakatvādyathā ghaṭaḥ..
śabdo hi jāyate dharmmaḥ pravṛttiparamo yataḥ.. 31.51 ..
1.3.d:
न तद्भासयते शब्दः कृतकत्वाद्यथा घटः..
शब्दो हि जायते धर्म्मः प्रवृत्तिपरमो यतः.. 31.51 ..
1.3.m: Sound does not illumine that, because [sound] is created, like a pot; / for sound is produced as a property whose ultimate nature is worldly activity.

1.3.s:
pravṛttiśca nivṛttiśca tathā dvaṃdvāni sarvaśaḥ..
vilayaṃ yāṃti yatraiva tatsthānaṃ śāśvataṃ matam.. 31.52 ..
1.3.d:
प्रवृत्तिश्च निवृत्तिश्च तथा द्वंद्वानि सर्वशः..
विलयं यांति यत्रैव तत्स्थानं शाश्वतं मतम्.. 31.52 ..
1.3.m: Where activity and withdrawal, as well as pairs of opposites in every way, / dissolve away, that is considered the eternal state. (31.52)

1.3.s:
niraṃtaraṃ nirguṇaṃ jñaptimātraṃ niraṃjanaṃ nirvikāśaṃ nirīham..
sattāmātraṃ jñānagamyaṃ svasiddhaṃ svayaṃprabhaṃ suprabhaṃ bodhagamyam.. 31.53 ..
1.3.d:
निरंतरं निर्गुणं ज्ञप्तिमात्रं निरंजनं निर्विकाशं निरीहम्..
सत्तामात्रं ज्ञानगम्यं स्वसिद्धं स्वयंप्रभं सुप्रभं बोधगम्यम्.. 31.53 ..
1.3.m: Uninterrupted, devoid of qualities, pure awareness, stainless, unexpanded, desireless, / pure existence, reachable through knowledge, self-established, self-luminous, bright, approachable by wisdom. (31.53)

1.3.s:
etajjñānaṃ jñānavido vadaṃti sarvātmabhāvena nirīkṣayaṃti..
sarvātītaṃ jñānagamyaṃ viditvā yena svasthāḥ samabuddhyā caraṃti.. 31.54 ..
1.3.d:
एतज्ज्ञानं ज्ञानविदो वदंति सर्वात्मभावेन निरीक्षयंति..
सर्वातीतं ज्ञानगम्यं विदित्वा येन स्वस्थाः समबुद्ध्या चरंति.. 31.54 ..
1.3.m: Those who know knowledge declare this knowledge; they perceive [all] with universal selfhood, / having known that which is beyond all, reachable through knowledge, by which they remain centered, acting with an even mind. (31.54)

1.3.s:
atītya saṃsāramanādimūlaṃ māyāmayaṃ māyayā durvicāryam..
māyāṃ tyaktvā nirmamā vītarāgā gacchaṃti te pretarāṇinarvikalpam.. 31.55 ..
1.3.d:
अतीत्य संसारमनादिमूलं मायामयं मायया दुर्विचार्यम्..
मायां त्यक्त्वा निर्ममा वीतरागा गच्छंति ते प्रेतराणिनर्विकल्पम्.. 31.55 ..
1.3.m: Having transcended beginningless saṃsāra, made of illusion, difficult to discern through illusion, / having abandoned illusion, free from possessiveness, free from passion, O King of the departed, they attain the indeterminate state. (31.55)

1.3.s:
saṃsṛtiḥ kalpanāmūlaṃ kalpanā hyamṛtopamā..
yaiḥ kalpanā parityaktā te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim.. 31.56 ..
1.3.d:
संसृतिः कल्पनामूलं कल्पना ह्यमृतोपमा..
यैः कल्पना परित्यक्ता ते यांति परमां गतिम्.. 31.56 ..
1.3.m: Transmigratory existence has mental conceptualisation as its root; mental conceptualisation is indeed nectar-like [in its attraction]. / Those by whom mental conceptualisation has been abandoned attain the supreme goal. (31.56)

1.3.s:
śuktyāṃ rajatabuddhiśca rajjubuddhiryarthoraṇe..
marīcau jalabuddhiśca mithyā mithyaiva nānyathā.. 31.57 ..
1.3.d:
शुक्त्यां रजतबुद्धिश्च रज्जुबुद्धिर्यर्थोरणे..
मरीचौ जलबुद्धिश्च मिथ्या मिथ्यैव नान्यथा.. 31.57 ..
1.3.m: The notion of silver in mother-of-pearl, and the notion of a snake in a rope, / and the notion of water in a mirage: all are false, truly false, and not otherwise. (31.57)

1.3.s:
siddhiḥ svacchaṃdavarttitvaṃ pārataṃtryaṃ hi vai mṛṣā..
baddho hi parataṃtrākhyo muktaḥ svātaṃtryabhāvanaḥ.. 31.58 ..
1.3.d:
सिद्धिः स्वच्छंदवर्त्तित्वं पारतंत्र्यं हि वै मृषा..
बद्धो हि परतंत्राख्यो मुक्तः स्वातंत्र्यभावनः.. 31.58 ..
1.3.m: Perfection is acting of one's own will; dependence on another is indeed false. / The bound one is called dependent on another; the liberated one is mindful of self-determination. (31.58)

1.3.s:
eko hyātmā viditvātha nirmamo niravagrahaḥ..
kutasteṣāṃ baṃdhanaṃ ca yathākhe puṣpameva ca.. 31.59 ..
1.3.d:
एको ह्यात्मा विदित्वाथ निर्ममो निरवग्रहः..
कुतस्तेषां बंधनं च यथाखे पुष्पमेव च.. 31.59 ..
1.3.m: Having known the Self as one, free from possessiveness and unimpeded, / where is bondage for them? It is just like a flower in the sky. (31.59)

1.3.s:
śaśaviṣāṇamevaitajtrānaṃ saṃsāra eva ca..
kiṃ kāryaṃ bahunoktena vacasā niṣphalena hi.. 31.60 ..
1.3.d:
शशविषाणमेवैतज्त्रानं संसार एव च..
किं कार्यं बहुनोक्तेन वचसा निष्फलेन हि.. 31.60 ..
1.3.m: This world and saṃsāra itself are indeed like the horns of a hare. / What is the use of saying much with useless words? (31.60)

1.3.s:
mamatāṃ ca nirākṛtya prāptukāmāḥ paraṃ padam..
jñāninaste hi vidvāṃso vītarāgā jiteṃdriyāḥ.. 31.61 ..
1.3.d:
ममतां च निराकृत्य प्राप्तुकामाः परं पदम्..
ज्ञानिनस्ते हि विद्वांसो वीतरागा जितेंद्रियाः.. 31.61 ..
1.3.m: Having cast aside possessiveness, desiring to reach the supreme state, / they are the knowers, the wise, free from passion, with senses conquered. (31.61)

1.3.s:
yaistyakto mamatābhāvo lobhakopau nirākṛtau..
te yāṃti paramaṃ sthānaṃ kāmakrodhavivarjitāḥ.. 31.62 ..
1.3.d:
यैस्त्यक्तो ममताभावो लोभकोपौ निराकृतौ..
ते यांति परमं स्थानं कामक्रोधविवर्जिताः.. 31.62 ..
1.3.m: Those by whom the sense of possessiveness is cast off, and greed and anger rejected, / free from desire and anger, go to the supreme state. (31.62)

1.3.s:
yāvatkāmaśca lobhaśca rāgadveṣau vyavasthitau..
nāpnuvaṃti ca tāṃ siddhiṃ śabdamātraikabodhakāḥ.. 31.63 ..
1.3.d:
यावत्कामश्च लोभश्च रागद्वेषौ व्यवस्थितौ..
नाप्नुवंति च तां सिद्धिं शब्दमात्रैकबोधकाः.. 31.63 ..
1.3.m: As long as desire and greed, passion and aversion remain, / those who merely understand mere words do not attain that perfection. (31.63)

1.3.s:
..yama uvāca..
śabdācchabdaḥ pravartteta niḥśabdaṃ jñānameva ca..
anityatvaṃ hi śabdasya kathaṃ proktaṃ tvayā prabho.. 31.64 ..
1.3.d:
..यम उवाच..
शब्दाच्छब्दः प्रवर्त्तेत निःशब्दं ज्ञानमेव च..
अनित्यत्वं हि शब्दस्य कथं प्रोक्तं त्वया प्रभो.. 31.64 ..
1.3.m: Yama said: / Sound arises from sound, whereas knowledge is soundless. / Why, O Lord, was the impermanence of sound spoken of by You? (31.64)

1.3.s:
akṣaraṃ brahmaparamaṃ śabdo vai hyarātmakaḥ..
tasmācchabdastvayā prokto nirīkṣaka iti śrutam.. 31.65 ..
1.3.d:
अक्षरं ब्रह्मपरमं शब्दो वै ह्यरात्मकः..
तस्माच्छब्दस्त्वया प्रोक्तो निरीक्षक इति श्रुतम्.. 31.65 ..
1.3.m: The supreme Brahman is the imperishable syllable, while sound consists of syllables. / Therefore, it is heard that sound was spoken of by You as an observer. (31.65)

1.3.s:
pratipādyaṃ hi yatkiṃcicchabdenaiva vinā katham..
tatsarvaṃ kathyatāṃ śaṃbho kāryākāryavyavasthitau.. 31.66 ..
1.3.d:
प्रतिपाद्यं हि यत्किंचिच्छब्देनैव विना कथम्..
तत्सर्वं कथ्यतां शंभो कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ.. 31.66 ..
1.3.m: Whatever is to be demonstrated, how can it be done without sound? / Tell all that, O Śambhu, regarding what should and should not be done. (31.66)

1.3.s:
..śaṃkara uvāca..
śrṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā paramārdhayutaṃ vacaḥ..
yasya śravaṇamātreṇa jñātavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate.. 31.67 ..
1.3.d:
..शंकर उवाच..
श्रृणुष्वावहितो भूत्वा परमार्धयुतं वचः..
यस्य श्रवणमात्रेण ज्ञातव्यं नावशिष्यते.. 31.67 ..
1.3.m: Śaṃkara said: / Listen with attention to this speech endowed with the supreme truth, / by merely hearing which nothing remains to be known. (31.67)

1.3.s:
jñānapravādinaḥ sarva ṛṣayo vītakalmaṣāḥ..
jñānābhyāsena varttaṃte jñānaṃ jñānavido viduḥ.. 31.68 ..
1.3.d:
ज्ञानप्रवादिनः सर्व ऋषयो वीतकल्मषाः..
ज्ञानाभ्यासेन वर्त्तंते ज्ञानं ज्ञानविदो विदुः.. 31.68 ..
1.3.m: All the seers who discuss knowledge, free from blemish, / abide through the practice of knowledge; those who know knowledge know knowledge. (31.68)

1.3.s:
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ jñātvā ca parigīyate..
kathaṃ kena ca jñātavyaṃ kiṃ tadvaktuṃ vivakṣitam.. 31.69 ..
1.3.d:
ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं ज्ञात्वा च परिगीयते..
कथं केन च ज्ञातव्यं किं तद्वक्तुं विवक्षितम्.. 31.69 ..
1.3.m: Knowledge, the object of knowledge, and that which is reachable through knowledge, having been known, are praised. / How, and by whom is it to be known? What is intended to be said about it? (31.69)

1.3.s:
etatsarvaṃ samāsena kathayāmi nibodha me..
eko hyanekadhā caiva dṛśyate bhedabhāvanaḥ.. 31.70 ..
1.3.d:
एतत्सर्वं समासेन कथयामि निबोध मे..
एको ह्यनेकधा चैव दृश्यते भेदभावनः.. 31.70 ..
1.3.m: I shall tell you all this in brief; understand it from Me: / The One is indeed seen in many forms by one who perceives distinction. (31.70)

1.3.s:
yathā bhramarikādṛṣṭā bhramyate ca mahī yama..
tathātmā bhedabuddhyā ca pratibhāti hyanekadhā.. 31.71 ..
1.3.d:
यथा भ्रमरिकादृष्टा भ्रम्यते च मही यम..
तथात्मा भेदबुद्ध्या च प्रतिभाति ह्यनेकधा.. 31.71 ..
1.3.m: Just as the earth seems to spin to one suffering from dizziness, O Yama, / so the Self appears manifold through the intellect that perceives duality. (31.71)

1.3.s:
tasmādvimṛśya tenaiva jñātavyaḥ śravaṇena ca..
maṃtavyaḥ suprayogeṇa mananena viśeṣataḥ.. 31.72 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्विमृश्य तेनैव ज्ञातव्यः श्रवणेन च..
मंतव्यः सुप्रयोगेण मननेन विशेषतः.. 31.72 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, having reflected with that, It is to be known through hearing, / and must be reflected upon with proper application, especially through contemplation. (31.72)

1.3.s:
nirddhārya cātmanātmānaṃ sukhaṃ baṃdhātpramucyate..
māyājālamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccārācaram.. 31.73 ..
1.3.d:
निर्द्धार्य चात्मनात्मानं सुखं बंधात्प्रमुच्यते..
मायाजालमिदं सर्वं जगदेतच्चाराचरम्.. 31.73 ..
1.3.m: Having ascertained the Self by the Self, one is easily freed from bondage. / All this moving and unmoving world is a web of illusion. (31.73)

1.3.s:
māyāmayo'yaṃ saṃsāro mamatālakṣaṇo mahān..
mamatāṃ ca bahiḥ kṛtvā sukhaṃ baṃdhātpramucyate.. 31.74 ..
1.3.d:
मायामयोऽयं संसारो ममतालक्षणो महान्..
ममतां च बहिः कृत्वा सुखं बंधात्प्रमुच्यते.. 31.74 ..
1.3.m: This great saṃsāra is made of illusion, characterised by possessiveness. / Casting possessiveness outside, one is easily freed from bondage. (31.74)

1.3.s:
ko'haṃ kastvaṃ kutaścānye mahāmāyāvalaṃbinaḥ..
ajāgalastanasyeva prapaṃco'yaṃ nirarthakaḥ.. 31.75 ..
1.3.d:
कोऽहं कस्त्वं कुतश्चान्ये महामायावलंबिनः..
अजागलस्तनस्येव प्रपंचोऽयं निरर्थकः.. 31.75 ..
1.3.m: Who am I? Who are you? From where are the others relying on the great illusion? / Like the dewlap of a goat, this phenomenal expansion is useless. (31.75)

1.3.s:
niṣphalo'yaṃ nirābhāso niḥsāro dhūmaḍaṃbaraḥ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena ātmānaṃ smara vai yama.. 31.76 ..
1.3.d:
निष्फलोऽयं निराभासो निःसारो धूमडंबरः..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन आत्मानं स्मर वै यम.. 31.76 ..
1.3.m: It is fruitless, unreal, substanceless, an ostentation of smoke. / Therefore, with all effort, remember the Self, O Yama. (31.76)

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
evaṃ pracoditastena śaṃbhunā pretarāṭ‌svayam..
buddho bhūtvā yamaḥ sākṣādātmabhūto'bhavattadā.. 31.77 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
एवं प्रचोदितस्तेन शंभुना प्रेतराट्‌स्वयम्..
बुद्धो भूत्वा यमः साक्षादात्मभूतोऽभवत्तदा.. 31.77 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / Having been thus urged by Śambhu Himself, the King of the departed, / Yama, having become awakened, then became directly identical with the Self. (31.77)

1.3.s:
karmmaṇāṃ hi ca sarveṣāṃ śāstā karmānusārataḥ..
babhūva ḍaṃbaro nṝṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca samāhitaḥ.. 31.78 ..
1.3.d:
कर्म्मणां हि च सर्वेषां शास्ता कर्मानुसारतः..
बभूव डंबरो नॄणां भूतानां च समाहितः.. 31.78 ..
1.3.m: The punisher of all actions in accordance with karma / became composed, [free from] the display of men and living beings. (31.78)

1.3.s:
..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
hatvā tu tārakaṃ yuddhe kumāreṇa mahātmanā..
ata ūrdhvaṃ kathyatāṃ bhoḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ mahadadbhutam.. 31.79 ..
1.3.d:
..ऋषय ऊचुः..
हत्वा तु तारकं युद्धे कुमारेण महात्मना..
अत ऊर्ध्वं कथ्यतां भोः किं कृतं महदद्भुतम्.. 31.79 ..
1.3.m: The seers said: / When Tāraka was slain in battle by the great-souled Kumāra, / tell us, sir, what great wonder was done thereafter? (31.79)

1.3.s:
..sūta uvāca..
hate tu tārake daitye himavanpramukhādrayaḥ..
kārttikeyaṃ samāgatya gīrbhī ramyābhiraiḍayan.. 31.80 ..
1.3.d:
..सूत उवाच..
हते तु तारके दैत्ये हिमवन्प्रमुखाद्रयः..
कार्त्तिकेयं समागत्य गीर्भी रम्याभिरैडयन्.. 31.80 ..
1.3.m: Sūta said: / When the demon Tāraka was slain, the mountains led by Himavat, / having approached Kārttikeya, praised him with delightful words. (31.80)

1.3.s:
..giraya ūcuḥ..
namaḥ kalyāṇarūpāya namaste viśvamaṃgala..
viśvabaṃdho namaste'stu namaste viśvabhāvana.. 31.81 ..
1.3.d:
..गिरय ऊचुः..
नमः कल्याणरूपाय नमस्ते विश्वमंगल..
विश्वबंधो नमस्तेऽस्तु नमस्ते विश्वभावन.. 31.81 ..
1.3.m: The mountains said: / Homage to you whose form is auspiciousness, homage to you, universal auspiciousness! / Homage to you, friend of the universe! Homage to you, source of the universe! (31.81)

1.3.s:
varīṣṭhāḥ śvapacā yena kṛtā vai darśanāttvayā..
tvāṃ namāmo jagadbaṃdhuṃ tvāṃ vayaṃ śaraṇāgatāḥ.. 31.82 ..
1.3.d:
वरीष्ठाः श्वपचा येन कृता वै दर्शनात्त्वया..
त्वां नमामो जगद्बंधुं त्वां वयं शरणागताः.. 31.82 ..
1.3.m: By you, through your sight, even outcasts have been made the best. / We bow to you, the friend of the world; we have taken refuge in you. (31.82)

1.3.s:
namaste pārvatīputra śaṃkarātmaja te namaḥ..
namaste kṛttikāsūno agnibhūta namostu te.. 31.83 ..
1.3.d:
नमस्ते पार्वतीपुत्र शंकरात्मज ते नमः..
नमस्ते कृत्तिकासूनो अग्निभूत नमोस्तु ते.. 31.83 ..
1.3.m: Homage to you, son of Pārvatī! Son of Śaṃkara, homage to you! / Homage to you, son of the Kṛttikās! Born from fire, homage to you! (31.83)

1.3.s:
namostu te devavaraiḥ supūjya namo'stu te jñānavidāṃ variṣṭha..
namo'stu te devavara prasīda śaraṇya sarvārtivināśadakṣa.. 31.84 ..
1.3.d:
नमोस्तु ते देववरैः सुपूज्य नमोऽस्तु ते ज्ञानविदां वरिष्ठ..
नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद शरण्य सर्वार्तिविनाशदक्ष.. 31.84 ..
1.3.m: Homage to you, well-worshipped by the best of gods! Homage to you, foremost among the knowers of knowledge! / Homage to you, best of gods, be pleased, O refuge, expert in destroying all distress! (31.84)

1.3.s:
evaṃ stuto giribhiḥ kārttikeyo hyumāsutaḥ..
tāngirīnsuprasannātmā varaṃ dātuṃ samutsukaḥ.. 31.85 ..
1.3.d:
एवं स्तुतो गिरिभिः कार्त्तिकेयो ह्युमासुतः..
तान्गिरीन्सुप्रसन्नात्मा वरं दातुं समुत्सुकः.. 31.85 ..
1.3.m: Thus praised by the mountains, Kārttikeya, the son of Umā, / with a very gracious mind, was eager to grant a boon to those mountains. (31.85)

1.3.s:
..kārttikeya uvāca..
bhobho girivarā yūyaṃ śrṛṇudhvaṃ madvaco'dhunā..
karmibhirjñānibhiścaiva sevyamānā bhaviṣyatha.. 31.86 ..
1.3.d:
..कार्त्तिकेय उवाच..
भोभो गिरिवरा यूयं श्रृणुध्वं मद्वचोऽधुना..
कर्मिभिर्ज्ञानिभिश्चैव सेव्यमाना भविष्यथ.. 31.86 ..
1.3.m: Kārttikeya said: / O best of mountains, listen now to my words: / You will be served by men of action and by men of knowledge. (31.86)

1.3.s:
bhavatsveva hi varttate dṛṣado yatnasevitāḥ..
punaṃtu viścaṃ vacanānmama tā nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 31.87 ..
1.3.d:
भवत्स्वेव हि वर्त्तते दृषदो यत्नसेविताः..
पुनंतु विश्चं वचनान्मम ता नात्र संशयः.. 31.87 ..
1.3.m: The stones existing upon you, when worshipped with effort, / will purify the universe by my word; there is no doubt in this. (31.87)

1.3.s:
parvatīyāni tīrthāni bhaviṣyaṃti na cānyathā..
śivālayāni divyāni divyānyāyatanāni ca.. 31.88 ..
1.3.d:
पर्वतीयानि तीर्थानि भविष्यंति न चान्यथा..
शिवालयानि दिव्यानि दिव्यान्यायतनानि च.. 31.88 ..
1.3.m: There will be sacred fords on mountains—it will not be otherwise— / and divine abodes of Śiva, and divine shrines. (31.88)

1.3.s:
ayanāni vicitrāṇi śobhanāni mahāṃti ca..
bhaviṣyaṃti na saṃdehaḥ parvatā vacanānmama.. 31.89 ..
1.3.d:
अयनानि विचित्राणि शोभनानि महांति च..
भविष्यंति न संदेहः पर्वता वचनान्मम.. 31.89 ..
1.3.m: Diverse, beautiful, and great dwelling places / will arise, O mountains, by my word; of this there is no doubt. (31.89)

1.3.s:
yo'yaṃ mātāmaho me'dya himavānparvatottamaḥ..
tapasvināṃ mahābhāgaḥ phalado hi bhaviṣyati.. 31.90 ..
1.3.d:
योऽयं मातामहो मेऽद्य हिमवान्पर्वतोत्तमः..
तपस्विनां महाभागः फलदो हि भविष्यति.. 31.90 ..
1.3.m: This maternal grandfather of mine, Himavat, the best of mountains, / highly fortunate, will indeed bestow fruit upon ascetics. (31.90)

1.3.s:
meruśca girirājo'yamāśrayo hi bhaviṣyati..
lokāloko girivara udayādrirmahāyaśaḥ.. 31.91 ..
1.3.d:
मेरुश्च गिरिराजोऽयमाश्रयो हि भविष्यति..
लोकालोको गिरिवर उदयाद्रिर्महायशः.. 31.91 ..
1.3.m: And Meru, this king of mountains, will be a sanctuary; / and Lokāloka, the best of mountains, and the glorious Udayādri. (31.91)

1.3.s:
liṃgarūpo hi bhagavānbhaviṣyati na cānyathā..
śrīśailo hi maheṃdraśca tathā sahyācalogiriḥ.. 31.92 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगरूपो हि भगवान्भविष्यति न चान्यथा..
श्रीशैलो हि महेंद्रश्च तथा सह्याचलोगिरिः.. 31.92 ..
1.3.m: The Lord will indeed assume the form of a liṅga, and not otherwise, / on Śrīśaila, Mahendra, and also the Sahyācala mountain. (31.92)

1.3.s:
mālyavānmalayo vindhyastathāsau gaṃdhamādanaḥ..
śvetakūṭastrikūṭo hi tathā darduraparvataḥ.. 31.93 ..
1.3.d:
माल्यवान्मलयो विन्ध्यस्तथासौ गंधमादनः..
श्वेतकूटस्त्रिकूटो हि तथा दर्दुरपर्वतः.. 31.93 ..
1.3.m:
Mālyavān, Malaya, Vindhya, and likewise Gandhamādana,
Śvetakūṭa, Trikūṭa, and likewise the Dardura mountain, 31.93

1.3.s:
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ parvatā liṃgarūpiṇaḥ..
mama vākyādbhaviṣyaṃti pāpakṣayakarā hyamī.. 31.94 ..
1.3.d:
एते चान्ये च बहवः पर्वता लिंगरूपिणः..
मम वाक्याद्भविष्यंति पापक्षयकरा ह्यमी.. 31.94 ..
1.3.m:
these and many other mountains shall assume the form of a liṅga
by my word, destroying sins. 31.94

1.3.s:
evaṃ varaṃ dadau tebhyaḥ parvatebhyaśca śāṃkariḥ..
tato naṃdīhyuvācātha sarvāgamapuraskṛtam.. 31.95 ..
1.3.d:
एवं वरं ददौ तेभ्यः पर्वतेभ्यश्च शांकरिः..
ततो नंदीह्युवाचाथ सर्वागमपुरस्कृतम्.. 31.95 ..
1.3.m:
Thus the son of Śaṃkara granted a boon to those mountains.
Then Nandī spoke, honouring all the scriptures: 31.95

1.3.s:
..naṃdyuvāca..
tvayā kṛtā hi girayo liṃgarūpiṇa eva te..
śivālayāḥ kathaṃ nātha pūjyāḥ syuḥsarvadaivataiḥ.. 31.96 ..
1.3.d:
..नंद्युवाच..
त्वया कृता हि गिरयो लिंगरूपिण एव ते..
शिवालयाः कथं नाथ पूज्याः स्युःसर्वदैवतैः.. 31.96 ..

1.3.s:
..kumāra uvāca..
liṃgaṃ śivālayaṃ jñeyaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ..
sarvairnṛbhirdaivataiśca brahmādibhiratāṃdritaiḥ.. 31.97 ..
1.3.d:
..कुमार उवाच..
लिंगं शिवालयं ज्ञेयं देवदेवस्य शूलिनः..
सर्वैर्नृभिर्दैवतैश्च ब्रह्मादिभिरतांद्रितैः.. 31.97 ..
1.3.m:
Kumāra said:
A liṅga should be known as the abode of Śiva, the God of gods who holds the trident,
[to be worshipped] untiringly by all mortals, deities, Brahmā, and the rest. 31.97

1.3.s:
nīlaṃ muktā pravālaṃ ca vaiḍūryaṃ caṃdrameva ca..
gomedaṃ padmarāgaṃ ca mārataṃ kāṃcanaṃ tathā.. 31.98 ..
1.3.d:
नीलं मुक्ता प्रवालं च वैडूर्यं चंद्रमेव च..
गोमेदं पद्मरागं च मारतं कांचनं तथा.. 31.98 ..
1.3.m:
Sapphire, pearl, coral, cat's eye, and moonstone,
hessonite, ruby, emerald, and also gold, 31.98

1.3.s:
rājataṃ tāmramāraṃ ca tathā nāgamayaṃ param..
ratnadhātumayānyeva liṃgāni kathitāni te.. 31.99 ..
1.3.d:
राजतं ताम्रमारं च तथा नागमयं परम्..
रत्नधातुमयान्येव लिंगानि कथितानि ते.. 31.99 ..
1.3.m:
silver, copper, brass, and supreme lead:
thus the liṅgas made of gems and metals have been spoken of to you. 31.99

1.3.s:
pavitrāṇyeva pūjyāni sarvakāmapradāni ca..
eteṣāmapi sarveṣāṃ kāśmīraṃ hi viśiṣyate.. 31.100 ..
1.3.d:
पवित्राण्येव पूज्यानि सर्वकामप्रदानि च..
एतेषामपि सर्वेषां काश्मीरं हि विशिष्यते.. 31.100 ..
1.3.m:
They are pure, worthy of worship, and bestow all desires;
yet superior to all of these is the one made of saffron. 31.100

1.3.s: aihikāmuṣmikaṃ sarvaṃ pūjākartuḥ prayacchati.. 31.101 ..
1.3.d: ऐहिकामुष्मिकं सर्वं पूजाकर्तुः प्रयच्छति.. 31.101 ..
1.3.m: It bestows everything pertaining to this world and the next upon its worshipper. 31.101

1.3.s:
..naṃdyuvāca..
liṃgānāmapi pūjyaṃ syādbāṇaliṃgaṃ tvayā katham..
kathitaṃ cottamatvena tatsarvaṃ vadasuvrata.. 31.102 ..
1.3.d:
..नंद्युवाच..
लिंगानामपि पूज्यं स्याद्बाणलिंगं त्वया कथम्..
कथितं चोत्तमत्वेन तत्सर्वं वदसुव्रत.. 31.102 ..
1.3.m:
Nandī said:
Why has the Bāṇaliṅga been declared by you
as the most excellent to be worshipped among liṅgas? Speak all that, O you of noble vows! 31.102

1.3.s:
..kumāra uvāca..
revāyāṃ toyamadhye ca dṛśyaṃte dṛṣado hi yāḥ..
śivaprasādāttāstu syurliṃgarūpā na cānyathā.. 31.103 ..
1.3.d:
..कुमार उवाच..
रेवायां तोयमध्ये च दृश्यंते दृषदो हि याः..
शिवप्रसादात्तास्तु स्युर्लिंगरूपा न चान्यथा.. 31.103 ..
1.3.m:
Kumāra said:
The stones that are seen in the waters of the Revā,
they indeed, through the grace of Śiva, are forms of the liṅga, and not otherwise. 31.103

1.3.s:
ślakṣṇamūlāśca kartavyāḥ piṃḍikopari saṃsthitāḥ..
pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena śivadīkṣāyutena hi.. 31.104 ..
1.3.d:
श्लक्ष्णमूलाश्च कर्तव्याः पिंडिकोपरि संस्थिताः..
पूजनीयाः प्रयत्नेन शिवदीक्षायुतेन हि.. 31.104 ..
1.3.m:
They should be made smooth at the base and placed upon a pedestal;
they should be worshipped with effort by one endowed with Śaiva initiation. 31.104

1.3.s:
piṃḍīyuktaṃ ca śāstreṇa vidhinā ca yajecchivam..
varado hi jagannāthaḥ pūjakasya na cānyathā.. 31.105 ..
1.3.d:
पिंडीयुक्तं च शास्त्रेण विधिना च यजेच्छिवम्..
वरदो हि जगन्नाथः पूजकस्य न चान्यथा.. 31.105 ..
1.3.m:
And one should worship Śiva united with the pedestal according to scriptural rule;
the Lord of the universe is indeed the giver of boons to the worshipper, not otherwise. 31.105

1.3.s:
paṃcākṣarī yasya mukhe sthitā sadā cetonivṛttiḥ śivaciṃtane ca..
bhūteṣuḥ sāmyaṃ parivādamūkatā ṣaṃḍhatvameva parayoṣitāsu.. 31.106 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṇḍe śivaśāstre kārttikeyaproktaśivaliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 31 ..
1.3.d:
पंचाक्षरी यस्य मुखे स्थिता सदा चेतोनिवृत्तिः शिवचिंतने च..
भूतेषुः साम्यं परिवादमूकता षंढत्वमेव परयोषितासु.. 31.106 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखण्डे शिवशास्त्रे कार्त्तिकेयप्रोक्तशिवलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकत्रिंशोऽध्यायः.. 31 ..
1.3.m:
In whose mouth the five-syllable mantra is ever present, whose mind is withdrawn into meditation on Śiva,
who is impartial toward living beings, mute to slander, and truly impotent toward the wives of others— 31.106
Thus ends the thirty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of the Śivaliṅga Spoken by Kārttikeya', in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the Śivaśāstra, in the first Māheśvarakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 31.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
evaṃ te śivadharmāśca kathitāstena vai dvijāḥ..
saviśeṣāḥ pāśupatāḥ prasādāccaiva vistarāt.. 32.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
एवं ते शिवधर्माश्च कथितास्तेन वै द्विजाः..
सविशेषाः पाशुपताः प्रसादाच्चैव विस्तरात्.. 32.1 ..
1.3.m:
Lomaśa said:
Thus those duties of Śiva were spoken by him to you, O twice-born ones,
especially the Pāśupata ones, in full detail and through his grace. 32.1

1.3.s:
anekāgamasaṃvītā yathātattvamudāhṛtāḥ..
kāpālikānāṃ bhedāśca proktā vyāsasamāsataḥ.. 32.2 ..
1.3.d:
अनेकागमसंवीता यथातत्त्वमुदाहृताः..
कापालिकानां भेदाश्च प्रोक्ता व्याससमासतः.. 32.2 ..
1.3.m:
Endowed with many Āgamas, they were declared according to reality;
and the divisions of the Kāpālikas were spoken in brief by Vyāsa. 32.2

1.3.s: dharmā nānāvidhāḥ proktā naṃdinaṃ prati vai tadā.. 32.3 ..
1.3.d: धर्मा नानाविधाः प्रोक्ता नंदिनं प्रति वै तदा.. 32.3 ..
1.3.m: Diverse duties were then spoken to Nandī. 32.3

1.3.s:
..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
śrutaṃ kumāracaritamaviśeṣaṃ sumaṃgalam..
asmābhiśca mahābhāgakiṃcitpṛcchāmahe vayam.. 32.4 ..
1.3.d:
..ऋषय ऊचुः..
श्रुतं कुमारचरितमविशेषं सुमंगलम्..
अस्माभिश्च महाभागकिंचित्पृच्छामहे वयम्.. 32.4 ..
1.3.m:
The seers said:
The most auspicious, extraordinary deeds of Kumāra have been heard
by us; O fortunate one, we ask something [further]: 32.4

1.3.s:
śvetasya rājasiṃhasya caritaṃ paramādbhutam..
yena saṃtoṣito rudraḥ śivo bhaktyā'prameyayā.. 32.5 ..
1.3.d:
श्वेतस्य राजसिंहस्य चरितं परमाद्भुतम्..
येन संतोषितो रुद्रः शिवो भक्त्याऽप्रमेयया.. 32.5 ..
1.3.m:
The exceedingly wondrous story of Śveta, the lion among kings,
by whom Śiva Rudra was pleased with immeasurable devotion. 32.5

1.3.s:
te bhaktāste mahātmāno jñāninaste ca karmiṇaḥ..
ye'rcayaṃti mahāśaṃbhuṃ devaṃ bhaktyā samāvṛtāḥ.. 32.6 ..
1.3.d:
ते भक्तास्ते महात्मानो ज्ञानिनस्ते च कर्मिणः..
येऽर्चयंति महाशंभुं देवं भक्त्या समावृताः.. 32.6 ..
1.3.m:
They are devoted, they are great-souled, they possess knowledge, and they are performers of rites
who worship the great Śambhu, the God, filled with devotion. 32.6

1.3.s:
tasmātpṛcchāmahe sarve caritaṃ śaṃkarasya ca..
vyāsaprasādātsarvaṃ yajjānāsi tvaṃ na cāparaḥ.. 32.7 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्पृच्छामहे सर्वे चरितं शंकरस्य च..
व्यासप्रसादात्सर्वं यज्जानासि त्वं न चापरः.. 32.7 ..
1.3.m:
Therefore we all ask about the life of Śaṃkara,
all of which you know through Vyāsa's grace, and no one else. 32.7

1.3.s: niśamya vacanaṃ teṣāṃ munīnāṃ lomaśo'bravīt.. 32.8 ..
1.3.d: निशम्य वचनं तेषां मुनीनां लोमशोऽब्रवीत्.. 32.8 ..
1.3.m: Hearing their words, the sage Lomaśa spoke: 32.8

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
ākarṇyatāṃ mahābhāgāścaritaṃ paramādbhutam..
tasya rājño hi bhajato rājabhogāṃśca sarvaśaḥ..
matirddhirme samutpannā śvetasya ca mahātmanaḥ.. 32.9 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
आकर्ण्यतां महाभागाश्चरितं परमाद्भुतम्..
तस्य राज्ञो हि भजतो राजभोगांश्च सर्वशः..
मतिर्द्धिर्मे समुत्पन्ना श्वेतस्य च महात्मनः.. 32.9 ..
1.3.m:
Lomaśa said:
Listen, O fortunate ones, to the exceedingly wondrous life
of that king who, while enjoying all royal pleasures,
[yet] wisdom arose in me [concerning] the great-souled Śveta. 32.9

1.3.s:
pṛthivīṃ pālayāmāsa prajā dharmeṇa pālayan..
brahmaṇyaḥ satyavākchūraḥ śivabhakto niraṃtaram.. 32.10 ..
1.3.d:
पृथिवीं पालयामास प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्..
ब्रह्मण्यः सत्यवाक्छूरः शिवभक्तो निरंतरम्.. 32.10 ..
1.3.m:
He ruled the earth, protecting his subjects righteously,
devoted to brahmins, truthful in speech, heroic, and constantly devoted to Śiva. 32.10

1.3.s:
rājyaṃ śaśāsātha sa śaktito nṛpo bhaktyā tadā caiva samarcayatsadā..
śaṃbhuṃ pareśaṃ paramaṃ parātparaṃ śāṃtaṃ purāṇaṃ paramātmarūpam.. 32.11 ..
1.3.d:
राज्यं शशासाथ स शक्तितो नृपो भक्त्या तदा चैव समर्चयत्सदा..
शंभुं परेशं परमं परात्परं शांतं पुराणं परमात्मरूपम्.. 32.11 ..
1.3.m:
That king then governed his kingdom according to his capacity, and ever worshipped with devotion
Śambhu, the Supreme Lord, the highest, higher than the highest, peaceful, ancient, having the nature of the Supreme Self. 32.11

1.3.s:
āyustasya parikṣīṇamarcataḥ parameśvaram..
athaitacca mahābhāga caritaṃ śrūyatāṃ mama.. 32.12 ..
1.3.d:
आयुस्तस्य परिक्षीणमर्चतः परमेश्वरम्..
अथैतच्च महाभाग चरितं श्रूयतां मम.. 32.12 ..
1.3.m:
His lifespan was consumed as he worshipped the Supreme Lord.
Now hear this life of mine [to relate], O fortunate one! 32.12

1.3.s:
vāṇī śivakathāyuktā paramāścaryasaṃyutā..
na vā''dhayo hi tasyaiva vyādhayo hi mahīpateḥ.. 32.13 ..
1.3.d:
वाणी शिवकथायुक्ता परमाश्चर्यसंयुता..
न वा'ऽधयो हि तस्यैव व्याधयो हि महीपतेः.. 32.13 ..
1.3.m:
His speech was united with discourse on Śiva, full of supreme wonder.
Neither anxieties nor illnesses afflicted that lord of the earth. 32.13

1.3.s:
tasya rājño na bādhaṃte tathā copadravāstvamī..
nirītiko jano hyāsīnnirupadrava eva ca.. 32.14 ..
1.3.d:
तस्य राज्ञो न बाधंते तथा चोपद्रवास्त्वमी..
निरीतिको जनो ह्यासीन्निरुपद्रव एव च.. 32.14 ..
1.3.m:
Nor did these afflictions and calamities harass that king;
his people were free from agricultural plagues and free from troubles. 32.14

1.3.s:
akṛṣṭapacyauṣadhayastasya rājño'bhavanbhuvi..
tapasvino brāhmaṇāśca varṇāśramayutā janāḥ.. 32.15 ..
1.3.d:
अकृष्टपच्यौषधयस्तस्य राज्ञोऽभवन्भुवि..
तपस्विनो ब्राह्मणाश्च वर्णाश्रमयुता जनाः.. 32.15 ..
1.3.m:
In that king's land, plants grew without cultivation;
there were ascetics, brahmins, and people following the system of castes and stages of life. 32.15

1.3.s:
na putramaraṇe duḥkhaṃ nāpamānaṃ na mārakāḥ..
na dāridryaṃ ca te sarve prāpnuvanti kadācana.. 32.16 ..
1.3.d:
न पुत्रमरणे दुःखं नापमानं न मारकाः..
न दारिद्र्यं च ते सर्वे प्राप्नुवन्ति कदाचन.. 32.16 ..
1.3.m:
They never experienced sorrow over the death of a son, nor dishonour, nor pestilences,
nor did they ever encounter poverty. 32.16

1.3.s:
evaṃ bahutaraḥ kālastasya rājño mahātmanaḥ..
gato hi saphalo viprāḥ śivapūjāratasya vai.. 32.17 ..
1.3.d:
एवं बहुतरः कालस्तस्य राज्ञो महात्मनः..
गतो हि सफलो विप्राः शिवपूजारतस्य वै.. 32.17 ..
1.3.m:
Thus a great deal of time passed fruitfully, O brahmins,
for that great-souled king devoted to the worship of Śiva. 32.17

1.3.s:
ekadā pūjamānaṃ taṃ śaṃkaraṃ paramārthadam..
yamo hi preṣayāmāsa yamadūtānnṛpaṃ prati.. 32.18 ..
1.3.d:
एकदा पूजमानं तं शंकरं परमार्थदम्..
यमो हि प्रेषयामास यमदूतान्नृपं प्रति.. 32.18 ..
1.3.m:
Once, as he was worshipping Śaṃkara, the giver of the supreme goal,
Yama sent the messengers of Yama to the king, 32.18

1.3.s:
vacanāccitraguptasya śveta ānīyatāmiti..
tatheti matvā te dūtā āgatāḥ śivamaṃdiram.. 32.19 ..
1.3.d:
वचनाच्चित्रगुप्तस्य श्वेत आनीयतामिति..
तथेति मत्वा ते दूता आगताः शिवमंदिरम्.. 32.19 ..
1.3.m:
by the word of Citragupta saying: 'Let Śveta be brought!'
Saying 'So be it', those messengers arrived at the temple of Śiva. 32.19

1.3.s:
rājānaṃ netukāmāste pāśahastā mahābhayāḥ..
yāvatsamāgatā yāmyā rājānaṃ dadṛśustvarāt.. 32.20 ..
1.3.d:
राजानं नेतुकामास्ते पाशहस्ता महाभयाः..
यावत्समागता याम्या राजानं ददृशुस्त्वरात्.. 32.20 ..
1.3.m:
Desiring to take the king, with nooses in hand, very terrifying,
as soon as the servants of Yama arrived, they swiftly saw the king. 32.20

1.3.s:
na cakrire tadā dūtā ājñāṃ dharmasya caiva hi..
jñātvā sarvaṃ yamaścaiva āgataḥ svayameva hi.. 32.21 ..
1.3.d:
न चक्रिरे तदा दूता आज्ञां धर्मस्य चैव हि..
ज्ञात्वा सर्वं यमश्चैव आगतः स्वयमेव हि.. 32.21 ..
1.3.m:
Then the messengers could not execute the command of Dharma;
and knowing everything, Yama came there in person. 32.21

1.3.s:
uddhṛtya daṃḍaṃ sahasā netukāmastadā nṛpam..
dadarśa ca mahābāhuḥ śivadhyānaparāyaṇam.. 32.22 ..
1.3.d:
उद्धृत्य दंडं सहसा नेतुकामस्तदा नृपम्..
ददर्श च महाबाहुः शिवध्यानपरायणम्.. 32.22 ..
1.3.m:
Raising his staff, suddenly wishing to take the king,
the mighty-armed one saw him intent on meditation upon Śiva, 32.22

1.3.s:
śivabhaktiyutaṃ śāṃtaṃ kevalaṃ jñānasaṃyutam..
yamo'pi dṛṣṭvā rājānaṃ paraṃ kṣobhamupāgamat.. 32.23 ..
1.3.d:
शिवभक्तियुतं शांतं केवलं ज्ञानसंयुतम्..
यमोऽपि दृष्ट्वा राजानं परं क्षोभमुपागमत्.. 32.23 ..
1.3.m:
endowed with devotion to Śiva, peaceful, and filled solely with knowledge.
Even Yama, seeing the king, fell into supreme agitation. 32.23

1.3.s:
citrastho hyabhavatsdyaḥ pretarājo'tivihvalaḥ..
kālarūpaśca yo nityaṃ prajānāṃ kṣayakārakaḥ.. 32.24 ..
1.3.d:
चित्रस्थो ह्यभवत्स्द्यः प्रेतराजोऽतिविह्वलः..
कालरूपश्च यो नित्यं प्रजानां क्षयकारकः.. 32.24 ..
1.3.m:
The king of the dead became instantly motionless as in a painting, deeply distraught;
and he who is the form of Time, the eternal destroyer of creatures, 32.24

1.3.s:
āgatastatkṣaṇādeva nṛpaṃ prati ruṣānvitaḥ..
khaḍgena sitadhāreṇa carmaṇā paramema hi.. 32.25 ..
1.3.d:
आगतस्तत्क्षणादेव नृपं प्रति रुषान्वितः..
खड्गेन सितधारेण चर्मणा परमेम हि.. 32.25 ..
1.3.m:
came at that very moment toward the king, filled with rage,
with a sharp-edged sword and an excellent shield. 32.25

1.3.s:
tāvattaṃ dadṛśe so'pi sthitaṃ dvāri bhayāvṛtam..
uvāca kālo hi tadā yamaṃ vaivasvataṃ prati.. 32.26 ..
1.3.d:
तावत्तं ददृशे सोऽपि स्थितं द्वारि भयावृतम्..
उवाच कालो हि तदा यमं वैवस्वतं प्रति.. 32.26 ..
1.3.m:
He too then saw Yama standing at the door overcome with fear.
Then Time spoke to Yama, the son of Vivasvat: 32.26

1.3.s:
kasmāttvayā dharamarāja no nīto'yaṃ nṛpo mahān..
yama dūtasahāyaśca bhītavatpratibhāsi me.. 32.27 ..
1.3.d:
कस्मात्त्वया धरमराज नो नीतोऽयं नृपो महान्..
यम दूतसहायश्च भीतवत्प्रतिभासि मे.. 32.27 ..
1.3.m:
'Why, O king of righteousness, has this great king not been taken by you?
O Yama, though accompanied by messengers, you appear to me like one terrified. 32.27

1.3.s:
kālātyayo na karttavyo vacanānmama suvrata..
kālenoktastadā dharma uvāca prastutaṃ vacaḥ.. 32.28 ..
1.3.d:
कालात्ययो न कर्त्तव्यो वचनान्मम सुव्रत..
कालेनोक्तस्तदा धर्म उवाच प्रस्तुतं वचः.. 32.28 ..
1.3.m:
No loss of time should be committed upon my command, O you of noble vows!'
Addressed then by Time, Dharma spoke the relevant word: 32.28

1.3.s:
tavājñāṃ ca kariṣyāmi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā..
asau huratyayo'smākaṃ śivabhakto niraṃtaram.. 32.29 ..
1.3.d:
तवाज्ञां च करिष्यामि नात्र कार्या विचारणा..
असौ हुरत्ययोऽस्माकं शिवभक्तो निरंतरम्.. 32.29 ..
1.3.m: "I will carry out your command; no deliberation is needed here. / This devotee of Śiva is perpetually unassailable by us.

1.3.s:
citrasthā iva tiṣṭhāma bhayāddevasya śūlinaḥ..
yamasya vacanaṃ śrutvā kālaḥ krodhasamanvitaḥ..
rājānaṃ haṃtumārebhe tvaritaḥ khaḍgamādade.. 32.30 ..
1.3.d:
चित्रस्था इव तिष्ठाम भयाद्देवस्य शूलिनः..
यमस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा कालः क्रोधसमन्वितः..
राजानं हंतुमारेभे त्वरितः खड्गमाददे.. 32.30 ..
1.3.m: We stand as if in a picture, out of fear of the trident-bearing god." / Hearing Yama's word, Kāla, filled with fury, / set out to kill the king and swiftly seized his sword.

1.3.s:
triguṇāṣṭākrasaṃkāśaṃ praviveśa śivālayam..
yāvatkopena mahatā tāvaddṛṣṭaḥ pinākinā..
svabhaktaṃ haṃtukāmosau śvetarājānamuttamam.. 32.31 ..
1.3.d:
त्रिगुणाष्टाक्रसंकाशं प्रविवेश शिवालयम्..
यावत्कोपेन महता तावद्दृष्टः पिनाकिना..
स्वभक्तं हंतुकामोसौ श्वेतराजानमुत्तमम्.. 32.31 ..
1.3.m: He entered Śiva's temple, which shone with threefold eightfold corners. / As he did so with great rage, the wielder of the Pināka saw him, / eager to slay his devotee, the excellent King Śveta,

1.3.s:
dhyānasthitaṃ cātmani taṃ viśuddhajñānapradīpena viśuddhacittam..
ātmānamātmātmatayā niraṃtaraṃ svayaṃprakāśaṃ paramaṃ purastāt.. 32.32 ..
1.3.d:
ध्यानस्थितं चात्मनि तं विशुद्धज्ञानप्रदीपेन विशुद्धचित्तम्..
आत्मानमात्मात्मतया निरंतरं स्वयंप्रकाशं परमं पुरस्तात्.. 32.32 ..
1.3.m: who stood in meditation within the self, his mind purified by the lamp of immaculate knowledge, / continually contemplating the supreme Self in front of him, self-luminous through identity with the Self.

1.3.s:
evaṃvidhaṃ taṃ prasamīkṣya kālaṃ saṃciṃtyamānaṃ manasā'calena..
śaivaṃ padaṃ yatparamārtharūpaṃ kaivalyasāyujyakaraṃ svarūpataḥ.. 32.33 ..
1.3.d:
एवंविधं तं प्रसमीक्ष्य कालं संचिंत्यमानं मनसाऽचलेन..
शैवं पदं यत्परमार्थरूपं कैवल्यसायुज्यकरं स्वरूपतः.. 32.33 ..
1.3.m: Seeing him thus, and seeing Kāla, while meditating with an unswerving mind / on the Śaiva state, which is the ultimate truth and by its very nature bestows absorption in liberation,

1.3.s:
sadāśivena dṛṣṭo'sau kālaḥ kālāṃtakena ca..
ucchṛṃkhalaḥ khalo darpādviśamāno nijāṃtike.. 32.34 ..
1.3.d:
सदाशिवेन दृष्टोऽसौ कालः कालांतकेन च..
उच्छृंखलः खलो दर्पाद्विशमानो निजांतिके.. 32.34 ..
1.3.m: this Kāla was seen by Sadāśiva, the destroyer of Kāla— / unbridled and wicked, entering his presence with arrogance.

1.3.s:
naṃdikeśvaramadhyastho yāvaddṛṣṭo nijāṃtike..
śivena jagadīśena bhaktavatsalabaṃdhunā.. 32.35 ..
1.3.d:
नंदिकेश्वरमध्यस्थो यावद्दृष्टो निजांतिके..
शिवेन जगदीशेन भक्तवत्सलबंधुना.. 32.35 ..
1.3.m: As soon as he was seen near him, standing in the middle of Nandīkeśvara, / by Śiva, the Lord of the World, the friend who loves his devotees,

1.3.s:
nirīkṣitastṛtīyena cakṣuṣā parameṣṭhinā..
svabhaktaṃ rakṣamāṇena bhasmasādabhavatkṣaṇāt.. 32.36 ..
1.3.d:
निरीक्षितस्तृतीयेन चक्षुषा परमेष्ठिना..
स्वभक्तं रक्षमाणेन भस्मसादभवत्क्षणात्.. 32.36 ..
1.3.m: he was looked upon with the third eye by the Supreme Lord / who was protecting his own devotee, and in an instant he was reduced to ashes.

1.3.s:
dadāha taṃ kālamanekavarṇaṃ vyāttānanaṃ bhīmabahūgrarūpam..
jvālāvalībhiḥ paridahyamānamatipracaṃḍaṃ bhuvanaikabhakṣaṇam.. 32.37 ..
1.3.d:
ददाह तं कालमनेकवर्णं व्यात्ताननं भीमबहूग्ररूपम्..
ज्वालावलीभिः परिदह्यमानमतिप्रचंडं भुवनैकभक्षणम्.. 32.37 ..
1.3.m: He burned that Kāla of many colors, with gaping mouth, of terrible, manifoldly fierce form, / being consumed by rows of flames, exceedingly violent, the sole devourer of the world.

1.3.s:
dadarśire devagaṇāḥ sametāḥ sayakṣagaṃdharvapiśācaguhyakāḥ..
siddhāpsaraḥsarvakhagāśca pannagāḥ patatriṇo lokapālāstathaiva.. 32.38 ..
1.3.d:
ददर्शिरे देवगणाः समेताः सयक्षगंधर्वपिशाचगुह्यकाः..
सिद्धाप्सरःसर्वखगाश्च पन्नगाः पतत्रिणो लोकपालास्तथैव.. 32.38 ..
1.3.m: The assembled hosts of gods saw it, along with yakṣas, gandharvas, piśācas, and guhyakas, / siddhas, apsarases, all birds, serpents, winged creatures, and likewise the world-protectors.

1.3.s:
jvālāmālāvṛtaṃ kālamīśvarasyāgrataḥ sthitam..
labdhasaṃjñastadā rājā kālaṃ svaṃ haṃtumāgatam.. 32.39 ..
1.3.d:
ज्वालामालावृतं कालमीश्वरस्याग्रतः स्थितम्..
लब्धसंज्ञस्तदा राजा कालं स्वं हंतुमागतम्.. 32.39 ..
1.3.m: Then, seeing Kāla enveloped in a garland of flames standing before Īśvara, / the king regained his consciousness and [saw] Kāla, who had come to kill him,

1.3.s:
punaḥ punarddadarśātha dahyamānaṃ kṛśānunā..
prārthayāmāsa sa vyagro rudraṃ kālāgnisannibham.. 32.40 ..
1.3.d:
पुनः पुनर्द्ददर्शाथ दह्यमानं कृशानुना..
प्रार्थयामास स व्यग्रो रुद्रं कालाग्निसन्निभम्.. 32.40 ..
1.3.m: burning again and again in the fire. / Agitated, he prayed to Rudra, who resembled the fire of cosmic dissolution:

1.3.s:
..rājovāca..
namo rudrāya śāṃtāya svajyotsnāyātmavedhase..
niraṃtarāya sūkṣmāya jyotiṣāṃ pataye namaḥ.. 32.41 ..
1.3.d:
..राजोवाच..
नमो रुद्राय शांताय स्वज्योत्स्नायात्मवेधसे..
निरंतराय सूक्ष्माय ज्योतिषां पतये नमः.. 32.41 ..
1.3.m: The king said: / "Obeisance to Rudra the peaceful, who is self-radiance, the maker of the self, / to the continuous, subtle Lord of the luminaries, obeisance!

1.3.s:
trātā tvaṃ hi jagannātha pitā mātā suhṛtsakhā..
tvameva baṃdhuḥ svajano lokānāṃ prabhurīśvaraḥ.. 32.42 ..
1.3.d:
त्राता त्वं हि जगन्नाथ पिता माता सुहृत्सखा..
त्वमेव बंधुः स्वजनो लोकानां प्रभुरीश्वरः.. 32.42 ..
1.3.m: You indeed are the protector, Lord of the Universe, father, mother, well-wisher, companion; / you alone are kinsman, relative, master, and ruler of the worlds.

1.3.s:
kiṃ kṛtaṃ hi tvayā śaṃbho ko'sau dagdho mamāgrataḥ..
na jānāmi ca kiṃ jātaṃ kṛtaṃ kena mahattaram.. 32.43 ..
1.3.d:
किं कृतं हि त्वया शंभो कोऽसौ दग्धो ममाग्रतः..
न जानामि च किं जातं कृतं केन महत्तरम्.. 32.43 ..
1.3.m: What indeed has been done by you, O Śambhu? Who is this that has been burned before me? / I do not understand what has occurred, or by whom this great deed was performed."

1.3.s:
evaṃ prārthayatastasya śrutvā ca paridevanam..
uvāca śaṃkaro vākyaṃ bodhayanniva taṃ nṛpam.. 32.44 ..
1.3.d:
एवं प्रार्थयतस्तस्य श्रुत्वा च परिदेवनम्..
उवाच शंकरो वाक्यं बोधयन्निव तं नृपम्.. 32.44 ..
1.3.m: Hearing this lament of him who was thus praying, / Śaṃkara spoke a word, as if enlightening the king:

1.3.s:
..rudra uvāca..
mayā dagdho hyayaṃ kālastavārthe ca tavāgrataḥ..
dahyamāno hi dṛṣṭaste jvālā mālākulo mahān.. 32.45 ..
1.3.d:
..रुद्र उवाच..
मया दग्धो ह्ययं कालस्तवार्थे च तवाग्रतः..
दह्यमानो हि दृष्टस्ते ज्वाला मालाकुलो महान्.. 32.45 ..
1.3.m: Rudra said: / "Indeed, this Kāla was burned by me for your sake, and before your eyes; / he has been seen by you burning, vast and overwhelmed by a garland of flames.

1.3.s:
evamuktastadā tena śaṃbhunā rājasattamaḥ..
uvāca praśrito bhūtvā vacanaṃ śivamagrataḥ.. 32.46 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन शंभुना राजसत्तमः..
उवाच प्रश्रितो भूत्वा वचनं शिवमग्रतः.. 32.46 ..
1.3.m: Being thus addressed then by that Śambhu, the best of kings, / becoming humble, spoke these words to Śiva before him:

1.3.s:
kimanena kṛtaṃ śaṃbho akṛtyaṃ vada tattvataḥ..
ya imāṃ prāptito'vasthāṃ prāṇātyayakarīṃ bhava.. 32.47 ..
1.3.d:
किमनेन कृतं शंभो अकृत्यं वद तत्त्वतः..
य इमां प्राप्तितोऽवस्थां प्राणात्ययकरीं भव.. 32.47 ..
1.3.m: "What wrong was done by him, O Śambhu? Tell me in truth, / that he has been brought to this condition that destroys life, O Bhava!"

1.3.s:
evaṃ vijñāpitastena hyuvāca parameśvaraḥ..
bhakṣako'yaṃ mahārāja sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmiha.. 32.48 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विज्ञापितस्तेन ह्युवाच परमेश्वरः..
भक्षकोऽयं महाराज सर्वेषां प्राणिनामिह.. 32.48 ..
1.3.m: Being thus questioned by him, the Supreme Lord said: / "O great king, he is the devourer of all living beings here.

1.3.s:
bhakṣaṇārthaṃ tava vibho so'yaṃ krūro'dhunā''gataḥ..
mamāṃtikaṃ mahārāja tasmāddagdho mayā vibho.. 32.49 ..
1.3.d:
भक्षणार्थं तव विभो सोऽयं क्रूरोऽधुना'ऽगतः..
ममांतिकं महाराज तस्माद्दग्धो मया विभो.. 32.49 ..
1.3.m: For the sake of devouring you, O mighty one, that cruel one now came / into my presence, O great king; therefore, O mighty one, he was burned by me,

1.3.s: bahūnāṃ kṣemamanvicchaṃstavārthe'nhaṃ viśeṣataḥ.. 32.50 ..
1.3.d: बहूनां क्षेममन्विच्छंस्तवार्थेऽन्हं विशेषतः.. 32.50 ..
1.3.m: seeking the welfare of many, and especially for your sake.

1.3.s:
ye pāpino hyadharmiṣṭhā lokasaṃhārakārakāḥ..
pāṣaṃḍavādasaṃyuktā vadhyāste mama caiva hi..
vākyaṃ niśamya rudrasya śveto vacanamabravīt.. 32.51 ..
1.3.d:
ये पापिनो ह्यधर्मिष्ठा लोकसंहारकारकाः..
पाषंडवादसंयुक्ता वध्यास्ते मम चैव हि..
वाक्यं निशम्य रुद्रस्य श्वेतो वचनमब्रवीत्.. 32.51 ..
