1.3.m: Those sinners who are deeply unrighteous, perpetrators of the destruction of the world, / devoted to heretical doctrines—they are certainly fit to be slain by me." / Having heard the word of Rudra, Śveta spoke these words:

1.3.s:
kālenaiva hi loko'yaṃ puṇyamācarate sadā..
dharmaniṣṭhāśca kecittu bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ.. 32.52 ..
1.3.d:
कालेनैव हि लोकोऽयं पुण्यमाचरते सदा..
धर्मनिष्ठाश्च केचित्तु भक्त्या परमया युताः.. 32.52 ..
1.3.m: "It is indeed by Time that this world always performs merit; / some are devoted to righteousness, endowed with supreme devotion;

1.3.s:
upāsanāratāḥ kecijjñānino hi tathā pare..
kecidadhyātmasaṃyuktāścānye muktāśca kecana.. 32.53 ..
1.3.d:
उपासनारताः केचिज्ज्ञानिनो हि तथा परे..
केचिदध्यात्मसंयुक्ताश्चान्ये मुक्ताश्च केचन.. 32.53 ..
1.3.m: some are dedicated to worship, while others are possessors of knowledge; / some are united with the spiritual Self, and some others are liberated.

1.3.s:
kālo hi hartā ca carācarāṇāṃ tathā hyasau pālako'pyadvitīyaḥ..
sa sraṣṭā vai prāṇināṃ prāṇabhūtastasmādenaṃ jīvayasvāśu bhūyaḥ.. 32.54 ..
1.3.d:
कालो हि हर्ता च चराचराणां तथा ह्यसौ पालकोऽप्यद्वितीयः..
स स्रष्टा वै प्राणिनां प्राणभूतस्तस्मादेनं जीवयस्वाशु भूयः.. 32.54 ..
1.3.m: Time indeed is the destroyer of the moving and unmoving, and likewise he is the peerless protector; / he is indeed the creator of living beings, their very breath of life; therefore, revive him quickly once more!

1.3.s:
yadi sṛṣṭiparo'si tvaṃ kālaṃ jīvaya satvaram..
yadi saṃhārabhūto'si sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmiha.. 32.55 ..
1.3.d:
यदि सृष्टिपरोऽसि त्वं कालं जीवय सत्वरम्..
यदि संहारभूतोऽसि सर्वेषां प्राणिनामिह.. 32.55 ..
1.3.m: If you are devoted to creation, revive Kāla quickly; / if you are the dissolution of all living beings here,

1.3.s:
tarhyevaṃ kuru śaṃbho tvaṃ kālasya ca mahātmanaḥ..
vinā kālena yatkiṃcidbhaviṣyati na śaṃkara.. 32.56 ..
1.3.d:
तर्ह्येवं कुरु शंभो त्वं कालस्य च महात्मनः..
विना कालेन यत्किंचिद्भविष्यति न शंकर.. 32.56 ..
1.3.m: then do so, O Śambhu, to the great-souled Kāla! / Without Time, nothing whatsoever will come to pass, O Śaṃkara."

1.3.s:
iti vijñāpitastena rājñā śaṃbhuḥ pratāpinā..
cakāra vacanaṃ tasya bhaktasya ca cikīrṣitam.. 32.57 ..
1.3.d:
इति विज्ञापितस्तेन राज्ञा शंभुः प्रतापिना..
चकार वचनं तस्य भक्तस्य च चिकीर्षितम्.. 32.57 ..
1.3.m: Thus petitioned by that glorious king, Śambhu / fulfilled the wish and desired goal of that devotee of his.

1.3.s:
śaṃbhuḥ prahasyātha tadā maheśaḥ saṃjīvayāmāsa pinākapāṇiḥ..
cakāra rūpaṃ ca yathā purāsīdāliṃgatosau yamadūtamadhye.. 32.58 ..
1.3.d:
शंभुः प्रहस्याथ तदा महेशः संजीवयामास पिनाकपाणिः..
चकार रूपं च यथा पुरासीदालिंगतोसौ यमदूतमध्ये.. 32.58 ..
1.3.m: Laughing, the Great Lord Śambhu, with the Pināka in hand, brought him back to life; / he restored his form as it was before, and he was embraced in the midst of the messengers of Yama.

1.3.s:
upasthito'sau tvatha lajjamānastuṣṭāva devaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaṃ tam..
natvā puraḥsthāgnimayaṃ hi kālaḥ savismayo vākyamidaṃ babhāṣe.. 32.59 ..
1.3.d:
उपस्थितोऽसौ त्वथ लज्जमानस्तुष्टाव देवं वृषभध्वजं तम्..
नत्वा पुरःस्थाग्निमयं हि कालः सविस्मयो वाक्यमिदं बभाषे.. 32.59 ..
1.3.m: Standing there, embarrassed, he praised that god whose banner bears the bull; / bowing before the fiery one who stood in front of him, Kāla spoke these words in astonishment:

1.3.s:
..kāla uvāca..
kālāṃtaka tripureśa tripurāṃtakara prabho..
madano hi tvayā deva kṛto'naṃgo jagatpate.. 32.60 ..
1.3.d:
..काल उवाच..
कालांतक त्रिपुरेश त्रिपुरांतकर प्रभो..
मदनो हि त्वया देव कृतोऽनंगो जगत्पते.. 32.60 ..
1.3.m: Kāla said: / "O destroyer of Kāla, Lord of Tripura, destroyer of Tripura, O Lord! / Madana, O God, was made bodiless by you, O Lord of the Universe!

1.3.s:
dakṣayajñavināśaśca kṛto hi paramādbhutaḥ..
kālakūṭaṃ duḥprasahaṃ sarveṣāṃ kṣayakṛnmahat.. 32.61 ..
1.3.d:
दक्षयज्ञविनाशश्च कृतो हि परमाद्भुतः..
कालकूटं दुःप्रसहं सर्वेषां क्षयकृन्महत्.. 32.61 ..
1.3.m: The destruction of the sacrifice of Dakṣa was accomplished, supreme and wondrous; / the Kālakūṭa poison, unbearable and the great cause of destruction of all,

1.3.s:
grasitaṃ tattvayā śaṃbho anyeṣāmapi durddharam..
liṃgarūpeṇa mahatā vyāptamāsījjagattrayam.. 32.62 ..
1.3.d:
ग्रसितं तत्त्वया शंभो अन्येषामपि दुर्द्धरम्..
लिंगरूपेण महता व्याप्तमासीज्जगत्त्रयम्.. 32.62 ..
1.3.m: was swallowed by you, O Śambhu, uncontainable even by others! / The three worlds were pervaded by your vast liṅga form.

1.3.s:
layanālliṃgamityuktaṃ sarvairapi surā suraiḥ..
yasyāṃtaṃ na vidurddevā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ.. 32.63 ..
1.3.d:
लयनाल्लिंगमित्युक्तं सर्वैरपि सुरा सुरैः..
यस्यांतं न विदुर्द्देवा ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरोगमाः.. 32.63 ..
1.3.m: It is called liṅga from the dissolution [of all things] by all gods and asuras; / whose end the gods, preceded by Brahmā and Viṣṇu, do not know,

1.3.s:
liṃgasya devadevasya mahimānaṃ parasya ca..
namaste parameśāya namaste viśvamaṃgala..
namaste śitikaṇṭhāya namastasmai kapardine.. 32.64 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगस्य देवदेवस्य महिमानं परस्य च..
नमस्ते परमेशाय नमस्ते विश्वमंगल..
नमस्ते शितिकण्ठाय नमस्तस्मै कपर्दिने.. 32.64 ..
1.3.m: the majesty of the liṅga of the supreme God of gods! / Obeisance to you, Supreme Lord; obeisance to you, auspiciousness of the universe! / Obeisance to you, dark-necked one; obeisance to him with braided hair!

1.3.s:
namonamaḥ kāraṇakāraṇāya te namonamo maṃgalamaṃgalātmane..
jñānātmane jñānavidāṃ manīṣiṇāṃ tvamādidevo'si pumānpurāṇaḥ.. 32.65 ..
1.3.d:
नमोनमः कारणकारणाय ते नमोनमो मंगलमंगलात्मने..
ज्ञानात्मने ज्ञानविदां मनीषिणां त्वमादिदेवोऽसि पुमान्पुराणः.. 32.65 ..
1.3.m: Obeisance, obeisance to you, the cause of causes; obeisance, obeisance to the embodiment of the most auspicious; / to the embodiment of knowledge of wise men who know knowledge! You are the primal deity, the ancient spirit.

1.3.s:
tvameva sarvaṃ jagadevabaṃdho vedāṃtavedyo'si mahānubhāvaḥ..
mahānubhāvaiḥ parikīrttanīyastvameva viśveśvara viśvamānyaḥ.. 32.66 ..
1.3.d:
त्वमेव सर्वं जगदेवबंधो वेदांतवेद्योऽसि महानुभावः..
महानुभावैः परिकीर्त्तनीयस्त्वमेव विश्वेश्वर विश्वमान्यः.. 32.66 ..
1.3.m: You alone are the whole universe, O friend of the universe! You are to be known through the Vedānta, full of majesty; / to be praised by the great-souled, you alone, Lord of the Universe, are revered by the universe!

1.3.s: tvaṃ pāsi luṃpasi jagattritayaṃ maheśa sraṣṭāsi bhūtapatireva na kaścidanyaḥ.. 32.67 ..
1.3.d: त्वं पासि लुंपसि जगत्त्रितयं महेश स्रष्टासि भूतपतिरेव न कश्चिदन्यः.. 32.67 ..
1.3.m: You protect, you dissolve the triad of worlds, O Great Lord! You are the creator, the Lord of beings alone, and none other!"

1.3.s:
iti stutastadā tena kālena jagadīśvaraḥ..
uvāca kālo rājānaṃ śvetaṃ saṃbodhayanniva.. 32.68 ..
1.3.d:
इति स्तुतस्तदा तेन कालेन जगदीश्वरः..
उवाच कालो राजानं श्वेतं संबोधयन्निव.. 32.68 ..
1.3.m: Thus praised then by that Kāla, the Lord of the Universe, / Kāla addressed King Śveta as if reminding him:

1.3.s:
..kāla uvāca..
manuṣyaloke sakale nānyastvatto hi vidyate..
yena tvayā jito devo hyajeyo bhuvanatraye.. 32.69 ..
1.3.d:
..काल उवाच..
मनुष्यलोके सकले नान्यस्त्वत्तो हि विद्यते..
येन त्वया जितो देवो ह्यजेयो भुवनत्रये.. 32.69 ..
1.3.m:
Kāla said:
In the entire mortal world there is no one other than you,
by whom, by you, the god unconquerable in the three worlds has indeed been won over.

1.3.s:
mayā hatamidaṃ viśvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram..
jetāhaṃ sarvadevānāṃ sarveṣāṃ duratikramaḥ.. 32.70 ..
1.3.d:
मया हतमिदं विश्वं जगदेतच्चराचरम्..
जेताहं सर्वदेवानां सर्वेषां दुरतिक्रमः.. 32.70 ..
1.3.m:
By me this universe, this moving and unmoving world, is destroyed.
I am the conqueror of all gods, insurmountable to all.

1.3.s:
sa hi te cānugo jāto mahārāja prayaccha me..
abhayaṃ devadevācca śūlinaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ.. 32.71 ..
1.3.d:
स हि ते चानुगो जातो महाराज प्रयच्छ मे..
अभयं देवदेवाच्च शूलिनः परमेष्ठिनः.. 32.71 ..
1.3.m:
That very [Lord] has become your follower; O great king, grant me
fearlessness from the God of gods, the trident-bearer, the supreme deity.

1.3.s:
evamuktastadā tena śvetaḥ kālena caiva hi..
uvāca prahasanvācā meghanādagabhīrayā.. 32.72 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन श्वेतः कालेन चैव हि..
उवाच प्रहसन्वाचा मेघनादगभीरया.. 32.72 ..
1.3.m:
Thus addressed then indeed by that Kāla,
Śveta, laughing, spoke with a voice deep as thunder:

1.3.s:
..rājovāca..
śivasya paramaṃ rūpaṃ tvameko nāsti saṃśayaḥ..
kālastvamasi bhūtānāṃ sthitisaṃhārarūpavān.. 32.73 ..
1.3.d:
..राजोवाच..
शिवस्य परमं रूपं त्वमेको नास्ति संशयः..
कालस्त्वमसि भूतानां स्थितिसंहाररूपवान्.. 32.73 ..
1.3.m:
The king said:
You alone are the supreme form of Śiva; there is no doubt.
You are the Death of beings, having the form of sustenance and destruction.

1.3.s:
tasmātpūjyatamo'si tvaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca niyāmakaḥ..
tvadbhayātkṛtinaḥ sarve śaraṇaṃ parameśvaram..
vrajaṃti vividhairbhārvairātmalakṣaṇatatparāḥ.. 32.74 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्पूज्यतमोऽसि त्वं सर्वेषां च नियामकः..
त्वद्भयात्कृतिनः सर्वे शरणं परमेश्वरम्..
व्रजंति विविधैर्भार्वैरात्मलक्षणतत्पराः.. 32.74 ..
1.3.m:
Therefore you are most worthy of worship and the regulator of all.
Out of fear of you, all righteous ones go for refuge to the Supreme Lord
with diverse feelings, intent on the characteristics of the Self.

1.3.s:
..suta uvāca..
tenaivaṃ rakṣitataḥ kālo rājñā paramadharmiṇā..
śivaprasādamātreṇa labdhasaṃjño babhūvaha.. 32.75 ..
1.3.d:
..सुत उवाच..
तेनैवं रक्षिततः कालो राज्ञा परमधर्मिणा..
शिवप्रसादमात्रेण लब्धसंज्ञो बभूवह.. 32.75 ..
1.3.m:
Sūta said:
Kāla, having thus been protected by the supremely virtuous king,
regained his consciousness through the mere grace of Śiva.

1.3.s:
tadā yamena stavito mṛtyunā yamadūtakaiḥ..
śivaṃ praṇamya saṃstutya śvetaṃ rājānameva ca..
yayau svamālayaṃ viprā mene svaṃ janitaṃ punaḥ.. 32.76 ..
1.3.d:
तदा यमेन स्तवितो मृत्युना यमदूतकैः..
शिवं प्रणम्य संस्तुत्य श्वेतं राजानमेव च..
ययौ स्वमालयं विप्रा मेने स्वं जनितं पुनः.. 32.76 ..
1.3.m:
Then Yama, praised by Death and Yama's messengers,
having bowed to and extolled Śiva and King Śveta,
went to his own abode, O brahmins, and considered himself born anew.

1.3.s:
māyayā saha patnyā ca śivasya caritaṃ mahat..
anusaṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayau.. 32.77 ..
1.3.d:
मायया सह पत्न्या च शिवस्य चरितं महत्..
अनुसंस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य विस्मयं परमं ययौ.. 32.77 ..
1.3.m:
Together with his wife Māyā, repeatedly remembering
the great deed of Śiva, he was filled with supreme wonder.

1.3.s:
kathayāmāsa sarveṣāṃ dūtānāṃ svayameva hi..
ākarṇyatāṃ mama vaco he dūtāstvaritena hi.. 32.78 ..
1.3.d:
कथयामास सर्वेषां दूतानां स्वयमेव हि..
आकर्ण्यतां मम वचो हे दूतास्त्वरितेन हि.. 32.78 ..
1.3.m:
He himself indeed spoke to all his messengers:
'Let my words be heard quickly, O messengers!

1.3.s: karttavyaṃ ca prayatnena nānyathā mama bhāṣitam.. 32.79 ..
1.3.d: कर्त्तव्यं च प्रयत्नेन नान्यथा मम भाषितम्.. 32.79 ..
1.3.m: And what is spoken by me must be carried out with diligence, not otherwise.

1.3.s:
..kāla uvāca..
ye tripuṇḍraṃdhārayaṃti tathā ye vai jaṭādharāḥ..
ye rudrākṣadharāścaiva tathā ye śivanāminaḥ.. 32.80 ..
1.3.d:
..काल उवाच..
ये त्रिपुण्ड्रंधारयंति तथा ये वै जटाधराः..
ये रुद्राक्षधराश्चैव तथा ये शिवनामिनः.. 32.80 ..
1.3.m:
Kāla said:
Those who wear the tripuṇḍra, likewise those who wear matted hair,
those who wear rudrākṣa beads, and likewise those who bear the name of Śiva,

1.3.s:
upajīvanahetośca bhiyā ye hyapi mānavāḥ..
pāpino'pi durācārāḥ śivaveṣadharā hyamī.. 32.81 ..
1.3.d:
उपजीवनहेतोश्च भिया ये ह्यपि मानवाः..
पापिनोऽपि दुराचाराः शिववेषधरा ह्यमी.. 32.81 ..
1.3.m:
and those men who, even for the sake of livelihood or out of fear,
though sinners and of wicked conduct, wear the guise of Śiva—

1.3.s:
nānetavyā bhavadbhiśca mama lokaṃ kadācana..
varjyāste hi prayatnena pāpino'pi sadaiva hi.. 32.82 ..
1.3.d:
नानेतव्या भवद्भिश्च मम लोकं कदाचन..
वर्ज्यास्ते हि प्रयत्नेन पापिनोऽपि सदैव हि.. 32.82 ..
1.3.m:
these must never be brought by you to my realm.
They must always be diligently avoided, even if they are sinners.

1.3.s:
anyeṣāṃ kā kathā dūtā ye'rcayaṃti sadāśivam..
bhaktyā paramayā śaṃbhuṃ rudrāste nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 32.83 ..
1.3.d:
अन्येषां का कथा दूता येऽर्चयंति सदाशिवम्..
भक्त्या परमया शंभुं रुद्रास्ते नात्र संशयः.. 32.83 ..
1.3.m:
What need to speak of others, O messengers, who worship Sadāśiva,
Śambhu, with supreme devotion? They are Rudras, there is no doubt here.

1.3.s:
rudrākṣamekaṃ śirasā bibharti yastathā tripuṃḍraṃ ca lalāṭamadhyake..
paṃcākṣarīṃ ye prajapaṃti sādhavaḥ pūjya bhavadbhiśca na cānyathā kvacit.. 32.84 ..
1.3.d:
रुद्राक्षमेकं शिरसा बिभर्ति यस्तथा त्रिपुंड्रं च ललाटमध्यके..
पंचाक्षरीं ये प्रजपंति साधवः पूज्य भवद्भिश्च न चान्यथा क्वचित्.. 32.84 ..
1.3.m:
One who wears a single rudrākṣa on his head and likewise the tripuṇḍra in the middle of his forehead,
and the virtuous who recite the five-syllable mantra—they must be honored by you, and never otherwise.

1.3.s:
yasminrāṣṭro'tha vā deśe grāme cāpi vicakṣaṇaḥ..
śivabhakto na dṛśyeta smaśānāttu viśiṣyate..
tadrāṣṭraṃ deśamityāhuḥ satyaṃ prativadāmi vaḥ.. 32.85 ..
1.3.d:
यस्मिन्राष्ट्रोऽथ वा देशे ग्रामे चापि विचक्षणः..
शिवभक्तो न दृश्येत स्मशानात्तु विशिष्यते..
तद्राष्ट्रं देशमित्याहुः सत्यं प्रतिवदामि वः.. 32.85 ..
1.3.m:
In whichever realm, or country, or village, an intelligent
devotee of Śiva is not seen, that realm or country—
I tell you the truth—they say is worse than a cremation ground.

1.3.s:
yasminna saṃti nityaṃ hi śivabhaktisamanvitāḥ..
tadgramasthā janāḥ sarve śāsanīyā na saṃśayaḥ.. 32.86 ..
1.3.d:
यस्मिन्न संति नित्यं हि शिवभक्तिसमन्विताः..
तद्ग्रमस्था जनाः सर्वे शासनीया न संशयः.. 32.86 ..
1.3.m:
Where there are never people endowed with devotion to Śiva,
all the people residing in that village are to be punished, there is no doubt.

1.3.s:
evamājñāpayāmāsa yamo'pi nijakiṃkarān..
tatheti matvā te sarve tūṣṇī māsansuvismitāḥ.. 32.87 ..
1.3.d:
एवमाज्ञापयामास यमोऽपि निजकिंकरान्..
तथेति मत्वा ते सर्वे तूष्णी मासन्सुविस्मिताः.. 32.87 ..
1.3.m:
Thus Yama commanded his own servants.
Saying "So be it," they all remained silent, greatly astonished.

1.3.s:
evaṃvidho'yaṃ bhuvanaikabhartā sadāśivo lokaguruḥ sa ekaḥ..
dātā prahartā nijabhāvayuktaḥ sanātano'yaṃ jagadekabaṃdhuḥ.. 32.88 ..
1.3.d:
एवंविधोऽयं भुवनैकभर्ता सदाशिवो लोकगुरुः स एकः..
दाता प्रहर्ता निजभावयुक्तः सनातनोऽयं जगदेकबंधुः.. 32.88 ..
1.3.m:
Such is this sole lord of the universe, Sadāśiva, that one teacher of the world,
the giver, the destroyer, endowed with his innate nature, this eternal, sole friend of the universe.

1.3.s:
dagdhvā kālaṃ mahādevo nirbhayaṃ ca dadau vibhuḥ..
śvetasya rājarājasya mahīpālavarasya ca.. 32.89 ..
1.3.d:
दग्ध्वा कालं महादेवो निर्भयं च ददौ विभुः..
श्वेतस्य राजराजस्य महीपालवरस्य च.. 32.89 ..
1.3.m:
Having burned Kāla, the all-pervading Mahādeva
granted fearlessness to Śveta, the king of kings, the best of rulers.

1.3.s:
tadā nirbhayamāpannaḥ śvetarājo mahāmanāḥ..
bhaktyā ca parayā mukto babhūva kṛtaniścayaḥ.. 32.90 ..
1.3.d:
तदा निर्भयमापन्नः श्वेतराजो महामनाः..
भक्त्या च परया मुक्तो बभूव कृतनिश्चयः.. 32.90 ..
1.3.m:
Then, having attained fearlessness, the high-minded King Śveta,
resolute in purpose, became liberated through supreme devotion.

1.3.s:
tadā devaiḥ pūjyamāna ṛṣibhiḥ pannagaistathā..
śvato rājanyavaryo'sau śivasāyujyamāptavān.. 32.91 ..
1.3.d:
तदा देवैः पूज्यमान ऋषिभिः पन्नगैस्तथा..
श्वतो राजन्यवर्योऽसौ शिवसायुज्यमाप्तवान्.. 32.91 ..
1.3.m:
Then, being praised by the gods, by the seers, and likewise by the serpents,
that excellent king Śveta attained communion with Śiva.

1.3.s:
evaṃ bhaktiparāṇāṃ ca maheśe ca jagadgurau..
siddhiḥ karatale teṣāṃ satyaṃ prativadāmi vaḥ.. 32.92 ..
1.3.d:
एवं भक्तिपराणां च महेशे च जगद्गुरौ..
सिद्धिः करतले तेषां सत्यं प्रतिवदामि वः.. 32.92 ..
1.3.m:
Thus, for those devoted to Maheśa, the teacher of the world,
perfection lies in the palm of their hand; I tell you the truth.

1.3.s:
śvapaco'pi variṣṭhaḥ syātprasādācchaṃ karasya ca..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjanīyo hi śaṃkaraḥ.. 32.93 ..
1.3.d:
श्वपचोऽपि वरिष्ठः स्यात्प्रसादाच्छं करस्य च..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन पूजनीयो हि शंकरः.. 32.93 ..
1.3.m:
Even a dog-cooker becomes the most eminent through the grace of Śaṃkara;
therefore Śaṃkara is certainly to be worshipped with all effort.

1.3.s: bahūnāṃ janamanāmaṃte śivabhaktiḥ prajāyate.. 32.94 ..
1.3.d: बहूनां जनमनामंते शिवभक्तिः प्रजायते.. 32.94 ..
1.3.m: At the end of many births devotion to Śiva arises.

1.3.s:
jñānināṃ kṛtabuddhīnāṃ janmajanmaniśaṃkaraḥ..
kiṃ mayā bahunoktena pūjanīyaḥ sadāśivaḥ.. 32.95 ..
1.3.d:
ज्ञानिनां कृतबुद्धीनां जन्मजन्मनिशंकरः..
किं मया बहुनोक्तेन पूजनीयः सदाशिवः.. 32.95 ..
1.3.m:
For the wise whose intellect is disciplined, Śaṃkara is [revered] birth after birth.
What need is there of saying much by me? Sadāśiva is to be worshipped.

1.3.s:
atraivodāharaṃtīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam..
kirātena kṛtaṃ vrataṃ ca paramādbhutam..
yenaiva tāritaṃ viśvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram.. 32.96 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṇḍe śvetarājacarite śivabhaktiprabhāveṇa kāladahanavṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 32 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
अत्रैवोदाहरंतीममितिहासं पुरातनम्..
किरातेन कृतं व्रतं च परमाद्भुतम्..
येनैव तारितं विश्वं जगदेतच्चराचरम्.. 32.96 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखण्डे श्वेतराजचरिते शिवभक्तिप्रभावेण कालदहनवृत्तान्तवर्णनंनाम द्वात्रिंशोऽध्यायः.. 32 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
In this very regard they cite this ancient legend:
the most wonderful vow performed by a Kirāta,
by which alone this universe, this moving and unmoving world, was saved.
Thus ends the thirty-second chapter, titled "Description of the Account of the Burning of Kāla by the Power of Devotion to Śiva in the Deeds of King Śveta", in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first [part], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

1.3.s:
..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
kinnāmā ca kirāto'bhūtkiṃ tena vratamāhitam..
tattvaṃ kathaya vipreṃdra paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ.. 33.1 ..
1.3.d:
..ऋषय ऊचुः..
किन्नामा च किरातोऽभूत्किं तेन व्रतमाहितम्..
तत्त्वं कथय विप्रेंद्र परं कौतूहलं हि नः.. 33.1 ..
1.3.m:
The seers said:
What was the name of the Kirāta, and what vow was undertaken by him?
Tell us the truth, O best of brahmins, for our curiosity is immense.

1.3.s:
tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmo yāthātathyena kathyatām..
na hyanyo vidyate loke tvadvinā vadatāṃ varaḥ..
tasmātkatha bho vipra sarvaṃ śuśrūṣatāṃ hi naḥ.. 33.2 ..
1.3.d:
तत्सर्वं श्रोतुमिच्छामो याथातथ्येन कथ्यताम्..
न ह्यन्यो विद्यते लोके त्वद्विना वदतां वरः..
तस्मात्कथ भो विप्र सर्वं शुश्रूषतां हि नः.. 33.2 ..

1.3.s:
evamuktastadā tena śaunakena mahātmanā..
kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ puṣkasena kṛtaṃ yat.. 33.3 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन शौनकेन महात्मना..
कथयामास तत्सर्वं पुष्कसेन कृतं यत्.. 33.3 ..
1.3.m:
Thus addressed then by the great-souled Śaunaka,
he related all that was done by the hunter.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
āsītpurā mahāraudraścaḍonāma durātmavān..
krūrasaṃgo niṣkṛtiko bhūtānāṃ bhayavāhakaḥ.. 33.4 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
आसीत्पुरा महारौद्रश्चडोनाम दुरात्मवान्..
क्रूरसंगो निष्कृतिको भूतानां भयवाहकः.. 33.4 ..
1.3.m:
Lomaśa said:
Long ago there was a very terrible, wicked-souled [man] named Caṇḍa,
of cruel associations, treacherous, bringing fear to living beings.

1.3.s:
jālena matsyānduṣṭātmā ghātayatyaniśaṃ khalu..
bhallairmṛgāñchāpadāṃśca kṛṣṇasārāṃśca śallakān.. 33.5 ..
1.3.d:
जालेन मत्स्यान्दुष्टात्मा घातयत्यनिशं खलु..
भल्लैर्मृगाञ्छापदांश्च कृष्णसारांश्च शल्लकान्.. 33.5 ..
1.3.m:
With a net the evil-minded one constantly killed fish indeed,
and with spears deer, beasts of prey, blackbucks, and porcupines.

1.3.s:
khaḍgāṃścaiva ca duṣṭātmā dṛṣṭvā kāṃścicca pāpavān..
pakṣiṇo'ghātayatkruddho brāhmaṇāṃśca viśeṣataḥ.. 33.6 ..
1.3.d:
खड्गांश्चैव च दुष्टात्मा दृष्ट्वा कांश्चिच्च पापवान्..
पक्षिणोऽघातयत्क्रुद्धो ब्राह्मणांश्च विशेषतः.. 33.6 ..
1.3.m:
And the evil-minded sinner, having seen rhinos and some others,
wrathfully killed birds and especially brahmins.

1.3.s:
lubdhako hi mahāpāpo duṣṭo duṣṭajanapriyaḥ..
bhāryā tathāvidhaā tasya puṣkasasya mahābhayā.. 33.7 ..
1.3.d:
लुब्धको हि महापापो दुष्टो दुष्टजनप्रियः..
भार्या तथाविधआ तस्य पुष्कसस्य महाभया.. 33.7 ..
1.3.m:
He was indeed a hunter of great sin, wicked, fond of wicked people;
of such a nature also was the terrifying wife of that outcaste.

1.3.s:
evaṃ viharatastasya bahukālotyavartata..
gate bahutithekāle pāpaughaniratasya ca.. 33.8 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विहरतस्तस्य बहुकालोत्यवर्तत..
गते बहुतिथेकाले पापौघनिरतस्य च.. 33.8 ..
1.3.m:
While he lived in this manner, a long time passed;
when a long time had passed as he indulged in a multitude of sins,

1.3.s:
niṣaṃge jalamādāya kṣutpipāsārddito bhṛśam..
ekadā niśi pāpīyācchrīvṛkṣopari saṃsthitaḥ..
kolaṃ haṃtuṃ dhanuṣpāṇirjāgraccānimiṣeṇa hi.. 33.9 ..
1.3.d:
निषंगे जलमादाय क्षुत्पिपासार्द्दितो भृशम्..
एकदा निशि पापीयाच्छ्रीवृक्षोपरि संस्थितः..
कोलं हंतुं धनुष्पाणिर्जाग्रच्चानिमिषेण हि.. 33.9 ..
1.3.m:
having taken water in a quiver, severely afflicted by hunger and thirst,
once at night the sinner stood upon a bilva tree
with bow in hand, staying awake with unblinking eyes to kill a wild boar.

1.3.s:
māghamāse'sitāyāṃ vai caturdaśyāmathāgrataḥ..
mṛgamārgavilokārthī bilvapatrāṇyapātayat.. 33.10 ..
1.3.d:
माघमासेऽसितायां वै चतुर्दश्यामथाग्रतः..
मृगमार्गविलोकार्थी बिल्वपत्राण्यपातयत्.. 33.10 ..
1.3.m:
Then, on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight in the month of Māgha,
desiring to look along the path of the deer, he dropped bilva leaves in front of him.

1.3.s:
śrīvṛkṣaparṇāni bahūni tatra sa cchedayāmāsa ruṣānvitopi..
śrīvṛkṣamūle parivartamāne liṃgaṃ tasyoparidṛṣṭabhāvaḥ.. 33.11 ..
1.3.d:
श्रीवृक्षपर्णानि बहूनि तत्र स च्छेदयामास रुषान्वितोपि..
श्रीवृक्षमूले परिवर्तमाने लिंगं तस्योपरिदृष्टभावः.. 33.11 ..
1.3.m:
Though filled with rage, he tore down many leaves of the bilva tree there;
while [they] turned around at the foot of the bilva tree, a liṅga was seen upon it.

1.3.s:
vavarṣa gaṃḍūṣajalaṃ durātmā yadṛcchayā tāni śive pataṃti..
śrīvṛkṣaparṇāni ca daivayogājjātaṃ ca sarvaṃ śivapūjanaṃ tat.. 33.12 ..
1.3.d:
ववर्ष गंडूषजलं दुरात्मा यदृच्छया तानि शिवे पतंति..
श्रीवृक्षपर्णानि च दैवयोगाज्जातं च सर्वं शिवपूजनं तत्.. 33.12 ..
1.3.m: The wicked-minded man accidentally sprayed a mouthful of water, and it fell upon Śiva; / and by stroke of fate, those bilva leaves fell too, so that all became worship of Śiva.

1.3.s:
gaṃḍūṣavāriṇā tena snapanaṃ ca kṛtaṃ mahat..
bilvapatrairasaṃkhyātairarcanaṃ mahatkṛtam.. 33.13 ..
1.3.d:
गंडूषवारिणा तेन स्नपनं च कृतं महत्..
बिल्वपत्रैरसंख्यातैरर्चनं महत्कृतम्.. 33.13 ..
1.3.m: A great ceremonial bath was performed with that mouthful of water, / and a great worship was accomplished with countless bilva leaves.

1.3.s:
ajñānenāpi bho viprāḥ puṣkasena durātmanā..
māghamāse'site pakṣe caturdaśyāṃ vidhūdaye.. 33.14 ..
1.3.d:
अज्ञानेनापि भो विप्राः पुष्कसेन दुरात्मना..
माघमासेऽसिते पक्षे चतुर्दश्यां विधूदये.. 33.14 ..
1.3.m: Even though done unwittingly, O brahmins, by that wicked-minded Puṣkasa, / on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of the month of Māgha, at the rising of the moon,

1.3.s:
puṣkaso'tha durācāro vaॉkṣādavatatāra saḥ..
āgatya jalasaṃkāśaṃ matsyānhaṃtuṃ pracakrame.. 33.15 ..
1.3.d:
पुष्कसोऽथ दुराचारो वॉक्षादवततार सः..
आगत्य जलसंकाशं मत्स्यान्हंतुं प्रचक्रमे.. 33.15 ..
1.3.m: the ill-behaved Puṣkasa then climbed down from the tree. / Having approached the water, he began to kill fish.

1.3.s:
lubdha kasyāpi bhāryābhūnnāmnā caiva ghanodarī..
duṣṭā sā pāpaniratā paradravyāpahāriṇī.. 33.16 ..
1.3.d:
लुब्ध कस्यापि भार्याभून्नाम्ना चैव घनोदरी..
दुष्टा सा पापनिरता परद्रव्यापहारिणी.. 33.16 ..
1.3.m: The hunter had a wife named Ghanodarī, / who was wicked, intent on sin, and a stealer of others' goods.

1.3.s:
gṛhānnirgatya sāyāhne puradvārabahiḥ sthitā..
vanamārgaṃ prapaśyaṃtī patyurāgamanecchayā.. 33.17 ..
1.3.d:
गृहान्निर्गत्य सायाह्ने पुरद्वारबहिः स्थिता..
वनमार्गं प्रपश्यंती पत्युरागमनेच्छया.. 33.17 ..
1.3.m: Going out from the house at eventide, she stood outside the city gate, / gazing down the forest path in the desire for her husband's return.

1.3.s:
cirādbhartarī nāyāte cintayāmāsa lubdhakī..
adya sāyāhnavelāyāmāgatāḥ sarvalubdhakāḥ.. 33.18 ..
1.3.d:
चिराद्भर्तरी नायाते चिन्तयामास लुब्धकी..
अद्य सायाह्नवेलायामागताः सर्वलुब्धकाः.. 33.18 ..
1.3.m: When her husband did not arrive for a long time, the hunter's wife grew anxious: / 'Today, at evening time, all the hunters have returned;

1.3.s:
tamaḥ stomena saṃchannāścatasro vidiśo diśaḥ..
rātrau yāmadvayaṃ yātaṃ kiṃ mataṃgaḥ samāgataḥ.. 33.19 ..
1.3.d:
तमः स्तोमेन संछन्नाश्चतस्रो विदिशो दिशः..
रात्रौ यामद्वयं यातं किं मतंगः समागतः.. 33.19 ..
1.3.m: the four quarters and intermediate directions are veiled by a mass of darkness; / two watches have passed in the night—has Matanga arrived?

1.3.s:
kiṃ vā kesaralobhena siṃhenaiva vidāritaḥ..
kiṃ bhujaṃgaphaṇāratnahārī sarpaviṣārditaḥ.. 33.20 ..
1.3.d:
किं वा केसरलोभेन सिंहेनैव विदारितः..
किं भुजंगफणारत्नहारी सर्पविषार्दितः.. 33.20 ..
1.3.m: Or was he torn apart by a lion in his greed for its mane? / Or was he, seeking to take the jewel from a serpent's hood, afflicted by a snake's poison?

1.3.s:
kiṃ vā varāhadaṃṣṭrāgraghātaiḥ paṃcatvamāgataḥ..
madhulobhena vṛkṣāgrātsa vai prapatito bhuvi.. 33.21 ..
1.3.d:
किं वा वराहदंष्ट्राग्रघातैः पंचत्वमागतः..
मधुलोभेन वृक्षाग्रात्स वै प्रपतितो भुवि.. 33.21 ..
1.3.m: Or did he meet his death from the blows of a boar's tusks? / Or has he fallen down to earth from the treetop in his greed for honey?

1.3.s:
kvānveṣayāmi pṛcchāmi kva gacchāmi ca kaṃ prati..
evaṃ vilapya bahudhā nivṛttā svaṃ gṛhaṃ prati.. 33.22 ..
1.3.d:
क्वान्वेषयामि पृच्छामि क्व गच्छामि च कं प्रति..
एवं विलप्य बहुधा निवृत्ता स्वं गृहं प्रति.. 33.22 ..
1.3.m: Where shall I search, whom shall I ask, and where shall I go, to whom?' / Having thus lamented in many ways, she returned to her own house.

1.3.s:
naivānnaṃ no jalaṃ kiṃcinna bhuktaṃ taddine tayā..
ciṃtayaṃtī patiṃ cāpi lubdhakī tvayanniśām.. 33.23 ..
1.3.d:
नैवान्नं नो जलं किंचिन्न भुक्तं तद्दिने तया..
चिंतयंती पतिं चापि लुब्धकी त्वयन्निशाम्.. 33.23 ..
1.3.m: On that day she took no food and no water whatsoever, / and that hunter's wife spent the night worrying about her husband.

1.3.s:
atha prabhāte vimale puṣkasī vanamāyayau..
aśanārthaṃ ca tasyānnamādāya tvaritā satī.. 33.24 ..
1.3.d:
अथ प्रभाते विमले पुष्कसी वनमाययौ..
अशनार्थं च तस्यान्नमादाय त्वरिता सती.. 33.24 ..
1.3.m: Then, at the bright dawn, the Puṣkasa woman went into the forest, / taking food along for him to eat, proceeding swiftly.

1.3.s:
bhramamāṇāvane tasmindadarśa mahatīṃ nadīm..
tasyāstīre samāsīnaṃ svapatiṃ prekṣya harṣitā.. 33.25 ..
1.3.d:
भ्रममाणावने तस्मिन्ददर्श महतीं नदीम्..
तस्यास्तीरे समासीनं स्वपतिं प्रेक्ष्य हर्षिता.. 33.25 ..
1.3.m: Wandering in that forest, she saw a great river; / seeing her husband seated on its bank, she was delighted.

1.3.s:
tadannaṃ kūlanaḥ sthāpya nadīṃ tartuṃ pracakrame..
nirīkṣya cātha matsyānsa jālaprotānsamānayat.. 33.26 ..
1.3.d:
तदन्नं कूलनः स्थाप्य नदीं तर्तुं प्रचक्रमे..
निरीक्ष्य चाथ मत्स्यान्स जालप्रोतान्समानयत्.. 33.26 ..
1.3.m: Placing that food on the bank, she began to cross the river; / and having watched, he brought out the fish caught in the net.

1.3.s:
tāvattayoktaścaṇḍo'sāvehi śīghraṃ ca bhakṣaya..
annaṃ tvadarthamānītamupoṣya divasaṃ mayā.. 33.27 ..
1.3.d:
तावत्तयोक्तश्चण्डोऽसावेहि शीघ्रं च भक्षय..
अन्नं त्वदर्थमानीतमुपोष्य दिवसं मया.. 33.27 ..
1.3.m: Then she said to that Caṇḍa: 'Come quickly and eat! / Food has been brought for you by me, having fasted throughout the day.

1.3.s:
kṛtaṃ kimadya re maṃda gate'hani ca kiṃ kṛtam..
nā'śitaṃ ca tvayā mūḍha laṃghitenādya pāpinā.. 33.28 ..
1.3.d:
कृतं किमद्य रे मंद गतेऽहनि च किं कृतम्..
नाऽशितं च त्वया मूढ लंघितेनाद्य पापिना.. 33.28 ..
1.3.m: What did you do today, you fool? What did you do during the day that has passed? / And you have not eaten today, you foolish sinner, having fasted.'

1.3.s:
nadyāṃ snātau tathā tau ca dampatī ca śuci vratau..
yāvadgataśca bhoktuṃ sa tāvacchvā svayamāgataḥ.. 33.29 ..
1.3.d:
नद्यां स्नातौ तथा तौ च दम्पती च शुचि व्रतौ..
यावद्गतश्च भोक्तुं स तावच्छ्वा स्वयमागतः.. 33.29 ..
1.3.m: The couple then bathed in the river and observed pure vows; / just as he went to eat, a dog came of its own accord.

1.3.s:
tena sarvaṃ bhakṣitaṃ ca tadannaṃ svayameva hi..
caṃḍī prakupitā caiva śvānaṃ haṃtumupasthitā.. 33.30 ..
1.3.d:
तेन सर्वं भक्षितं च तदन्नं स्वयमेव हि..
चंडी प्रकुपिता चैव श्वानं हंतुमुपस्थिता.. 33.30 ..
1.3.m: All that food was eaten by it entirely by itself. / The fierce woman became enraged and stepped up to kill the dog.

1.3.s:
āvayorbhakṣitaṃ cānnamanenaiva ca pāpinā..
kiṃ ca bhakṣayase mūḍha bhavitādya vubhukṣitaḥ.. 33.31 ..
1.3.d:
आवयोर्भक्षितं चान्नमनेनैव च पापिना..
किं च भक्षयसे मूढ भविताद्य वुभुक्षितः.. 33.31 ..
1.3.m: 'Our food has been eaten by this very sinner! / And what will you eat, you fool? You will be starving today!'

1.3.s:
evaṃ tayoktaścaṇḍo'sau babhāṣe tāṃ śivapriyaḥ..
yacchunā bhakṣitaṃ cānnaṃ tenāhaṃ paritoṣitaḥ.. 33.32 ..
1.3.d:
एवं तयोक्तश्चण्डोऽसौ बभाषे तां शिवप्रियः..
यच्छुना भक्षितं चान्नं तेनाहं परितोषितः.. 33.32 ..
1.3.m: Spoken to in this way by her, that Caṇḍa, who had become dear to Śiva, said to her: / 'Because the food was eaten by the dog, by that I am well pleased.

1.3.s:
kimanena śarīreṇa naśvareṇa gatāyuṣā..
śarīraṃ durlabhaṃ loke pūjyate kṣaṇabhaṃguram.. 33.33 ..
1.3.d:
किमनेन शरीरेण नश्वरेण गतायुषा..
शरीरं दुर्लभं लोके पूज्यते क्षणभंगुरम्.. 33.33 ..
1.3.m: What is the use of this perishable body whose lifespan is fleeting? / A body is hard to obtain in this world, yet it is revered although fleeting in an instant.

1.3.s:
ye puṣṇaṃti nijaṃ dehaṃ sarvabhāvena cāhatāḥ..
mūḍhāste pāpino jñeyā lokadvayabahiṣkṛtāḥ.. 33.34 ..
1.3.d:
ये पुष्णंति निजं देहं सर्वभावेन चाहताः..
मूढास्ते पापिनो ज्ञेया लोकद्वयबहिष्कृताः.. 33.34 ..
1.3.m: Those who nurture their own body with all their being, smitten [by delusion]— / those fools should be known as sinners, banished from both worlds.

1.3.s:
tasmānmānaṃ parityajya krodhaṃ ca duravagraham..
svasthā bhava vimarśena tattvabuddhyā sthirā bhava.. 33.35 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मान्मानं परित्यज्य क्रोधं च दुरवग्रहम्..
स्वस्था भव विमर्शेन तत्त्वबुद्ध्या स्थिरा भव.. 33.35 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, abandon pride and obstinate anger; / be composed through reflection, and be steadfast with discernment of the truth.'

1.3.s:
bodhitā tena caṃḍī sā puṣkasena tadā bhṛśam..
jāgarādi ca saṃprāptaḥ puṣkaso'pi caturdaśīm.. 33.36 ..
1.3.d:
बोधिता तेन चंडी सा पुष्कसेन तदा भृशम्..
जागरादि च संप्राप्तः पुष्कसोऽपि चतुर्दशीम्.. 33.36 ..
1.3.m: Enlightened then greatly by that Puṣkasa, the fierce woman [calmed down]. / The Puṣkasa also observed the vigil and other [rites] on the fourteenth day;

1.3.s:
śivarātriprasaṃgācca jāyate yaddhyasaṃśayam..
tajjñānaṃ paramaṃ prāptaḥ śivarātriprasaṃgataḥ.. 33.37 ..
1.3.d:
शिवरात्रिप्रसंगाच्च जायते यद्ध्यसंशयम्..
तज्ज्ञानं परमं प्राप्तः शिवरात्रिप्रसंगतः.. 33.37 ..
1.3.m: and that supreme knowledge which unquestionably arises by connection with Śivarātri— / he attained that supreme knowledge by virtue of the occasion of Śivarātri.

1.3.s:
yāmadvayaṃ ca saṃjātamamāvāsyāṃ tu tatra vai..
āgatāśca gaṇāstatra bahavaḥ śivanoditāḥ.. 33.38 ..
1.3.d:
यामद्वयं च संजातममावास्यां तु तत्र वै..
आगताश्च गणास्तत्र बहवः शिवनोदिताः.. 33.38 ..
1.3.m: When two watches had elapsed on that new moon day, / many gaṇas, dispatched by Śiva, arrived there.

1.3.s:
vimānāni bahūnyatra āgatāni tadaṃtikam..
dṛṣṭāni tena tānyeva vimānāni gaṇāstathā.. 33.39 ..
1.3.d:
विमानानि बहून्यत्र आगतानि तदंतिकम्..
दृष्टानि तेन तान्येव विमानानि गणास्तथा.. 33.39 ..
1.3.m: Many aerial chariots arrived there into his presence; / he saw those very aerial chariots and the gaṇas.

1.3.s:
uvāca parayā bhaktyā puṣkaso'pi ca tānprati..
kasmātsamāgatā yūyaṃ sarve rudrākṣadhāriṇaḥ.. 33.40 ..
1.3.d:
उवाच परया भक्त्या पुष्कसोऽपि च तान्प्रति..
कस्मात्समागता यूयं सर्वे रुद्राक्षधारिणः.. 33.40 ..
1.3.m: Puṣkasa also spoke to them with supreme devotion: / 'Why have all of you, who wear rudrākṣa beads, come here—

1.3.s:
vimānasthāśca kecicca vṛṣārūḍhāśca kecana..
sarve sphaṭikasaṃkāśāḥ sarve caṃdrārddhaśekharāḥ.. 33.41 ..
1.3.d:
विमानस्थाश्च केचिच्च वृषारूढाश्च केचन..
सर्वे स्फटिकसंकाशाः सर्वे चंद्रार्द्धशेखराः.. 33.41 ..
1.3.m: some seated in aerial chariots, and some mounted on bulls, / all resembling crystal, and all bearing the crescent moon on their crests,

1.3.s:
kaparddinaścarmaparītavāsaso bhujaṃgabhogaiḥ kṛtahārabhūṣaṇāḥ..
śriyānvitā rudrasamānavīryā yathātathaṃ bho vadatātmanocitam.. 33.42 ..
1.3.d:
कपर्द्दिनश्चर्मपरीतवाससो भुजंगभोगैः कृतहारभूषणाः..
श्रियान्विता रुद्रसमानवीर्या यथातथं भो वदतात्मनोचितम्.. 33.42 ..
1.3.m: having matted hair, clad in animal skins, adorned with necklaces made of serpent coils, / endowed with glory, having prowess equal to Rudra? Speak truthfully as is fitting for yourselves.'

1.3.s:
puṣkasena tadā pṛṣṭā ūcuḥ sarve ca pārpadāḥ..
rudrasya devadevasya saṃnamrāḥ kamalekṣaṇāḥ.. 33.43 ..
1.3.d:
पुष्कसेन तदा पृष्टा ऊचुः सर्वे च पार्पदाः..
रुद्रस्य देवदेवस्य संनम्राः कमलेक्षणाः.. 33.43 ..
1.3.m: Questioned then by the Puṣkasa, all the attendants / of Rudra, the god of gods, bowing low and lotus-eyed, spoke.

1.3.s:
..gaṇā ūcuḥ..
preṣitāḥ smo vayaṃ caṃḍa śivena parameṣṭhinā..
āgaccha tvarito bhutvā sastrīko yā namāruha.. 33.44 ..
1.3.d:
..गणा ऊचुः..
प्रेषिताः स्मो वयं चंड शिवेन परमेष्ठिना..
आगच्छ त्वरितो भुत्वा सस्त्रीको या नमारुह.. 33.44 ..
1.3.m: The gaṇas said: / 'We have been sent, O Caṇḍa, by Śiva, the Supreme Lord; / come quickly, and together with your wife ascend the vehicle!

1.3.s:
liṃgārccanaṃ kṛtaṃ yacca tvayā rātrau śivasya ca..
tena karmavipākena prāpto'si śivasannidhim.. 33.45 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगार्च्चनं कृतं यच्च त्वया रात्रौ शिवस्य च..
तेन कर्मविपाकेन प्राप्तोऽसि शिवसन्निधिम्.. 33.45 ..
1.3.m: Because worship of the liṅga of Śiva was performed by you at night, / by that fruition of actions you have attained the presence of Śiva.'

1.3.s:
tathokto vīrabhadreṇa uvāca prahasanniva..
puṣkaso'pi svayā buddhyā prastāvasadṛśaṃ vacaḥ.. 33.46 ..
1.3.d:
तथोक्तो वीरभद्रेण उवाच प्रहसन्निव..
पुष्कसोऽपि स्वया बुद्ध्या प्रस्तावसदृशं वचः.. 33.46 ..
1.3.m: Addressed thus by Vīrabhadra, the Puṣkasa too, smiling as it were, / spoke words suited to the occasion according to his own intellect:

1.3.s:
..puṣkasa uvāca..
kiṃ mayā kṛtamadyaiva pāpinā hiṃsakena ca..
mṛgayārasikenaiva puṣkasena durātmanā.. 33.47 ..
1.3.d:
..पुष्कस उवाच..
किं मया कृतमद्यैव पापिना हिंसकेन च..
मृगयारसिकेनैव पुष्कसेन दुरात्मना.. 33.47 ..
1.3.m: The Puṣkasa said: / 'What was done today by me, a sinner and a killer, / a wicked-minded Puṣkasa, fond only of hunting?

1.3.s:
pāpācāro hyahaṃ nityaṃ kathaṃ svargaṃ vrajāmyaham..
kathaṃ liṃgārcanamidaṃ kṛtamasti taducyatām.. 33.48 ..
1.3.d:
पापाचारो ह्यहं नित्यं कथं स्वर्गं व्रजाम्यहम्..
कथं लिंगार्चनमिदं कृतमस्ति तदुच्यताम्.. 33.48 ..
1.3.m: I am of sinful conduct at all times; how can I go to heaven? / How has this worship of the liṅga been done? Let that be told!

1.3.s:
paraṃ kautukamāpannaḥ pṛcchāmi tvāṃ yathātatham..
kathayasva mahābhāga sarvaṃ caiva yathāvidhi.. 33.49 ..
1.3.d:
परं कौतुकमापन्नः पृच्छामि त्वां यथातथम्..
कथयस्व महाभाग सर्वं चैव यथाविधि.. 33.49 ..
1.3.m: Overcome by great wonder, I ask you truthfully; / tell me everything properly, O noble one!'

1.3.s:
ityevaṃ pṛcchatastasya puṣkasasya yathāvidhi..
kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ śivadharma mudānvitaḥ.. 33.50 ..
1.3.d:
इत्येवं पृच्छतस्तस्य पुष्कसस्य यथाविधि..
कथयामास तत्सर्वं शिवधर्म मुदान्वितः.. 33.50 ..
1.3.m: As that Puṣkasa was thus inquiring properly, / [Vīrabhadra], filled with joy, related to him all that duty pertaining to Śiva.

1.3.s:
..vīrabhadra uvāca..
devadevo mahādevo devānāṃ patirīśvaraḥ..
parituṣṭo'dya he caṃḍa sa maheśa umāpatiḥ.. 33.51 ..
1.3.d:
..वीरभद्र उवाच..
देवदेवो महादेवो देवानां पतिरीश्वरः..
परितुष्टोऽद्य हे चंड स महेश उमापतिः.. 33.51 ..
1.3.m: Vīrabhadra said: / 'The god of gods, Mahādeva, Īśvara, the master of the gods, / that Maheśa, the lord of Umā, is pleased today, O Caṇḍa!

1.3.s:
prāsaṃgikatayā māghe kṛtaṃ liṃgārcanaṃ tvayā..
śivatuṣṭikaraṃ cādya pūto'si tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ..
śivarātryāṃ prasaṃgena kṛtamarcanameva ca.. 33.52 ..
1.3.d:
प्रासंगिकतया माघे कृतं लिंगार्चनं त्वया..
शिवतुष्टिकरं चाद्य पूतोऽसि त्वं न संशयः..
शिवरात्र्यां प्रसंगेन कृतमर्चनमेव च.. 33.52 ..
1.3.m: Incidental worship of the liṅga was performed by you in Māgha, / which causes delight to Śiva, and today you are purified, without doubt; / worship was performed indeed coincidentally on Śivarātri.

1.3.s:
kolaṃ nirīkṣamāṇena bilvapatrāṇi caiva hi..
ccheditāni tvayā caṃḍa patitāni tadaiva hi..
liṃgasya mastake tāni tena tvaṃ sukṛtī prabho.. 33.53 ..
1.3.d:
कोलं निरीक्षमाणेन बिल्वपत्राणि चैव हि..
च्छेदितानि त्वया चंड पतितानि तदैव हि..
लिंगस्य मस्तके तानि तेन त्वं सुकृती प्रभो.. 33.53 ..
1.3.m: As you were watching for a boar, bilva leaves indeed / were plucked by you, O Caṇḍa, and fell just then / upon the head of the liṅga; by that you are a performer of good deeds, O master!'

1.3.s:
tataśca jāgaro jāto mahānvṛkṣopari dhruvam..
tenaiva jāgareṇaiva tutoṣa jagadīśvaraḥ.. 33.54 ..
1.3.d:
ततश्च जागरो जातो महान्वृक्षोपरि ध्रुवम्..
तेनैव जागरेणैव तुतोष जगदीश्वरः.. 33.54 ..
1.3.m: And then indeed a great vigil took place atop the tree; / by that very vigil the Lord of the World was pleased.

1.3.s:
chalenaiva mahābhāga kolasaṃdarśanena hi..
śivarātridine cātra svapnaste na ca yoṣitaḥ.. 33.55 ..
1.3.d:
छलेनैव महाभाग कोलसंदर्शनेन हि..
शिवरात्रिदिने चात्र स्वप्नस्ते न च योषितः.. 33.55 ..
1.3.m: Only under a pretext, O highly fortunate one, because of watching the boar, / on this day of Śivarātri there was no sleep for you, nor a woman.

1.3.s:
tenopavāsena ca jāgareṇa tuṣṭo hyasau devavaro mahātmā..
tava prasādāya mahānubhāvo dadāti sarvānvarado mahāṃśca.. 33.56 ..
1.3.d:
तेनोपवासेन च जागरेण तुष्टो ह्यसौ देववरो महात्मा..
तव प्रसादाय महानुभावो ददाति सर्वान्वरदो महांश्च.. 33.56 ..
1.3.m: Pleased indeed by that fast and by the vigil, that exalted deity, the great soul, / the magnificent granter of boons, gives all [boons] for your grace, being great.

1.3.s:
evamuktastadā tena vīrabhadreṇa dhīmatā..
puṣkaso'pi vimānāgryamāruhoha ca paśyatām.. 33.57 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन वीरभद्रेण धीमता..
पुष्कसोऽपि विमानाग्र्यमारुहोह च पश्यताम्.. 33.57 ..
1.3.m: Addressed thus then by the wise Vīrabhadra, / the outcaste mounted an excellent aerial chariot as they watched.

1.3.s:
gaṇānāṃ devatānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmapi..
tadā duṃdubhayo nedurbheryastūryāṇyanekaśaḥ.. 33.58 ..
1.3.d:
गणानां देवतानां च सर्वेषां प्राणिनामपि..
तदा दुंदुभयो नेदुर्भेर्यस्तूर्याण्यनेकशः.. 33.58 ..
1.3.m: Then, before the gaṇas, the deities, and all living beings, / kettledrums, large drums, and numerous musical instruments sounded.

1.3.s:
vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgāni tasya cāgre gatāni ca..
jagurgaṃdharvapatayo nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ.. 33.59 ..
1.3.d:
वीणावेणुमृदंगानि तस्य चाग्रे गतानि च..
जगुर्गंधर्वपतयो ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः.. 33.59 ..
1.3.m: Lutes, flutes, and mṛdaṅga drums went before him; / masters of the gandharvas sang, and hosts of apsarases danced.

1.3.s:
vidyādharagaṇāḥ sarve tuṣṭuvuḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ..
cāmaraivarvījyamāno hi cchatraiśca vividhairapi..
mahotsavena mahatā ānīto gaṃdhamādanam.. 33.60 ..
1.3.d:
विद्याधरगणाः सर्वे तुष्टुवुः सिद्धचारणाः..
चामरैवर्वीज्यमानो हि च्छत्रैश्च विविधैरपि..
महोत्सवेन महता आनीतो गंधमादनम्.. 33.60 ..
1.3.m: All the hosts of vidyādharas, siddhas, and cāraṇas praised him; / being fanned with chowries and shaded with various parasols, / he was brought to Gandhamādana with great celebration.

1.3.s:
śivasānnidhyamāgaccaṃḍosau tena karmaṇā..
śivarātryupavāsena paraṃ sthānaṃ samāgamat.. 33.61 ..
1.3.d:
शिवसान्निध्यमागच्चंडोसौ तेन कर्मणा..
शिवरात्र्युपवासेन परं स्थानं समागमत्.. 33.61 ..
1.3.m: That Caṇḍa attained the presence of Śiva by that deed; / through the fast of Śivarātri, he went to the supreme abode.

1.3.s:
puṣkaso'pi tathā prāptaḥ prasaṃgena sadāśivam..
kiṃ punaḥ śraddhayā yuktāḥ śivāya paramātmane.. 33.62 ..
1.3.d:
पुष्कसोऽपि तथा प्राप्तः प्रसंगेन सदाशिवम्..
किं पुनः श्रद्धया युक्ताः शिवाय परमात्मने.. 33.62 ..
1.3.m: Even an outcaste thus attained Sadāśiva merely through circumstance; / how much more those endowed with faith [who offer] to Śiva, the supreme Self,

1.3.s:
puṣpādikaṃ phalaṃ gaṃdhaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ bhakṣyamṛddhimat..
ye prayacchaṃti loke'sminrudrāste nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 33.63 ..
1.3.d:
पुष्पादिकं फलं गंधं तांबूलं भक्ष्यमृद्धिमत्..
ये प्रयच्छंति लोकेऽस्मिन्रुद्रास्ते नात्र संशयः.. 33.63 ..
1.3.m: flowers and the like, fruit, incense, betel, and abundant edible food? / Those who offer [these] in this world become Rudras; of this there is no doubt.

1.3.s:
caṃḍena vai puṣkasena saphalaṃ tasya cābhavat..
prasaṃgenāpi tenaiva kṛtaṃ taccālpabuddhinā.. 33.64 ..
1.3.d:
चंडेन वै पुष्कसेन सफलं तस्य चाभवत्..
प्रसंगेनापि तेनैव कृतं तच्चाल्पबुद्धिना.. 33.64 ..
1.3.m: Indeed, for Caṇḍa, the outcaste, it became fruitful, / though performed even by him, dull-witted, merely through circumstance.

1.3.s:
..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
kiṃ phalaṃ tasya coddeśaḥ kena caiva punā kṛtam..
kasmādvratamidaṃ jātaṃ kṛtaṃ kena purā vibho.. 33.65 ..
1.3.d:
..ऋषय ऊचुः..
किं फलं तस्य चोद्देशः केन चैव पुना कृतम्..
कस्माद्व्रतमिदं जातं कृतं केन पुरा विभो.. 33.65 ..
1.3.m: The seers said: / What is its fruit, and what its prescription? By whom was it performed again? / Whence did this observance arise, and by whom was it performed formerly, O lord?

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
yadā sṛṣṭaṃ jagatsarvaṃ brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā..
kālacakraṃ tadā jātaṃ purā rāśimanvitām.. 33.66 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
यदा सृष्टं जगत्सर्वं ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना..
कालचक्रं तदा जातं पुरा राशिमन्विताम्.. 33.66 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / When the entire world was created by Brahmā, the supreme lord, / the wheel of time then arose, endowed anciently with the zodiacal signs.

1.3.s:
dvādaśa rāśayastatra nakṣatrāṇi tathaiva ca..
saptaviṃśatisaṃkhyāni mukhyāni xxxxxx siddhaye.. 33.67 ..
1.3.d:
द्वादश राशयस्तत्र नक्षत्राणि तथैव च..
सप्तविंशतिसंख्यानि मुख्यानि xxxxxx सिद्धये.. 33.67 ..
1.3.m: There are twelve signs of the zodiac, and likewise the lunar mansions, / twenty-seven in number, foremost […] for success.

1.3.s:
ebhiḥ sarvaṃ pracaṃḍaṃ ca rāśibhiruḍubhistathā..
kālacakrānvitaḥ kālaḥ krīḍayansṛjate jagat.. 33.68 ..
1.3.d:
एभिः सर्वं प्रचंडं च राशिभिरुडुभिस्तथा..
कालचक्रान्वितः कालः क्रीडयन्सृजते जगत्.. 33.68 ..
1.3.m: With all these fierce zodiacal signs and constellations, / Time, united with the wheel of time, creates the world in sport.

1.3.s:
ābrahmastaṃbaparyaṃtaṃ sṛjatya vati haṃti ca..
nibaddhamasti tenaiva kālenaikena bho dvijāḥ.. 33.69 ..
1.3.d:
आब्रह्मस्तंबपर्यंतं सृजत्य वति हंति च..
निबद्धमस्ति तेनैव कालेनैकेन भो द्विजाः.. 33.69 ..
1.3.m: From Brahmā down to a clump of grass, it creates, protects, and destroys; / everything is bound by that one Time alone, O twice-born ones.

1.3.s:
kālo hi balavām̐lloke eka eva na cāparaḥ..
tasmātkālātmakaṃ sarvamidaṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ.. 33.70 ..
1.3.d:
कालो हि बलवाम्̐ल्लोके एक एव न चापरः..
तस्मात्कालात्मकं सर्वमिदं नास्त्यत्र संशयः.. 33.70 ..
1.3.m: For Time alone is powerful in the world, one and no other; / therefore all this consists of Time; of this there is no doubt.

1.3.s:
ādau kālaḥ kālanācca lokanāyakanāyakaḥ..
tato lokā hi saṃjātāḥ sṛṣṭiśca tadanaṃtaram.. 33.71 ..
1.3.d:
आदौ कालः कालनाच्च लोकनायकनायकः..
ततो लोका हि संजाताः सृष्टिश्च तदनंतरम्.. 33.71 ..
1.3.m: In the beginning was Time, and by reckoning it is the ruler of the world's rulers; / from it the worlds were born, and creation immediately thereafter.

1.3.s:
sṛṣṭerlavo hi saṃjāto lavācca kṣaṇameva ca..
kṣaṇācca nimiṣaṃ jātaṃ prāṇināṃ hi niraṃtaram.. 33.72 ..
1.3.d:
सृष्टेर्लवो हि संजातो लवाच्च क्षणमेव च..
क्षणाच्च निमिषं जातं प्राणिनां हि निरंतरम्.. 33.72 ..
1.3.m: From creation a lava was born, and from a lava a kṣaṇa; / and from a kṣaṇa a nimiṣa was born, continuously for living beings.

1.3.s:
nimiṣāṇāṃ ca ṣaṣṭyā vai phala ityabhidhīyate..
paṃcadaśyā ahorātraiḥ pakṣaityabhidhīyate.. 33.73 ..
1.3.d:
निमिषाणां च षष्ट्या वै फल इत्यभिधीयते..
पंचदश्या अहोरात्रैः पक्षैत्यभिधीयते.. 33.73 ..
1.3.m: By sixty nimiṣas, indeed, a phala is designated; / by fifteen days and nights a pakṣa is designated.

1.3.s:
pakṣābhyāṃ māsa eva syānmāsā dvādaśa vatsaraḥ..
taṃ kālaṃ jñātukāmena kāryaṃ jñānaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ.. 33.74 ..
1.3.d:
पक्षाभ्यां मास एव स्यान्मासा द्वादश वत्सरः..
तं कालं ज्ञातुकामेन कार्यं ज्ञानं विचक्षणैः.. 33.74 ..
1.3.m: By two pakṣas a month is made; twelve months make a year. / By one wishing to know that Time, knowledge should be acquired by the wise.

1.3.s:
pratipaddinamārabhya paurṇamāsyaṃtameva ca..
pakṣaṃ pūrṇo hi yasmācca pūrṇimetyabhidhīyate.. 33.75 ..
1.3.d:
प्रतिपद्दिनमारभ्य पौर्णमास्यंतमेव च..
पक्षं पूर्णो हि यस्माच्च पूर्णिमेत्यभिधीयते.. 33.75 ..
1.3.m: Beginning with the day of pratipad and ending with the full-moon day; / because the fortnight is full, it is designated as pūrṇimā.

1.3.s:
pūrṇacaṃdramasī yā tu sā pūrṇā devatāpriyā..
naṣṭastu caṃdro yasyāṃ vā amā sā kathitā budhaiḥ.. 33.76 ..
1.3.d:
पूर्णचंद्रमसी या तु सा पूर्णा देवताप्रिया..
नष्टस्तु चंद्रो यस्यां वा अमा सा कथिता बुधैः.. 33.76 ..
1.3.m: The [night] which has a full moon is the pūrṇā, dear to the gods; / but that on which the moon is lost is declared by the wise to be amā.

1.3.s:
agniṣvāttādipitṝṇāṃ priyātīva babhūva ha..
triṃśaddināni hyetāni puṇyakālayutāni ca..
teṣāṃ madhye viśeṣo yastaṃ śrṛṇudhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ.. 33.77 ..
1.3.d:
अग्निष्वात्तादिपितॄणां प्रियातीव बभूव ह..
त्रिंशद्दिनानि ह्येतानि पुण्यकालयुतानि च..
तेषां मध्ये विशेषो यस्तं श्रृणुध्वं द्विजोत्तमाः.. 33.77 ..
1.3.m: It became exceedingly dear to the ancestors, the Agniṣvāttas and others. / These thirty days are endowed with meritorious times; / hear that which is distinctive among them, O best of the twice-born:

1.3.s:
yogānāṃ vā vyatīpāta ūḍūnāṃ śravaṇastathā..
amāvāsyā tithīnāṃ ca pūrṇimā vai tathaiva ca.. 33.78 ..
1.3.d:
योगानां वा व्यतीपात ऊडूनां श्रवणस्तथा..
अमावास्या तिथीनां च पूर्णिमा वै तथैव च.. 33.78 ..
1.3.m: Among yogas, vyatīpāta; among constellations, Śravaṇa; / among lunar days, the new-moon day and likewise the full-moon day;

1.3.s:
saṃkrāṃtayastathājñeyāḥ pavitrā dānakarmaṇi..
tathāṣṭamī priyā śaṃbhorgaṇeśasya caturthikā.. 33.79 ..
1.3.d:
संक्रांतयस्तथाज्ञेयाः पवित्रा दानकर्मणि..
तथाष्टमी प्रिया शंभोर्गणेशस्य चतुर्थिका.. 33.79 ..
1.3.m: likewise the saṃkrāntis should be known as sacred for acts of giving. / Likewise the eighth is dear to Śambhu, the fourth to Gaṇeśa,

1.3.s:
pañcamī nāgarājasya kumārasya ca ṣaṣṭhikā..
bhānośca saptamī jñeyā navamī caṇḍikāpriyā.. 33.80 ..
1.3.d:
पञ्चमी नागराजस्य कुमारस्य च षष्ठिका..
भानोश्च सप्तमी ज्ञेया नवमी चण्डिकाप्रिया.. 33.80 ..
1.3.m: the fifth to the king of nāgas, and the sixth to Kumāra; / the seventh should be known as belonging to the sun, and the ninth is dear to Caṇḍikā;

1.3.s:
brahmaṇo daśamī jñeyā rudrasyaikādaśī tathā..
viṣṇupriyā dvādaśī ca aṃtakasya trayodaśī.. 33.81 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मणो दशमी ज्ञेया रुद्रस्यैकादशी तथा..
विष्णुप्रिया द्वादशी च अंतकस्य त्रयोदशी.. 33.81 ..
1.3.m: the tenth should be known as Brahmā's, and the eleventh as Rudra's; / the twelfth is dear to Viṣṇu, and the thirteenth to the Ender;

1.3.s:
caturddaśī tathā śaṃbhoḥ priyā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ..
niśīthasaṃyutā yā tu kṛṣṇapakṣe caturddaśī..
upoṣyā sā tithiḥ śreṣṭhā śivasāyujyakāriṇī.. 33.82 ..
1.3.d:
चतुर्द्दशी तथा शंभोः प्रिया नास्त्यत्र संशयः..
निशीथसंयुता या तु कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्द्दशी..
उपोष्या सा तिथिः श्रेष्ठा शिवसायुज्यकारिणी.. 33.82 ..
1.3.m: and the fourteenth is dear to Śambhu; of this there is no doubt. / That fourteenth in the dark fortnight which is joined with midnight / should be fasted upon as the best lunar day, bestowing union with Śiva.

1.3.s:
śivarātritithiḥ khyātā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī..
atraivodāharaṃtīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam.. 33.83 ..
1.3.d:
शिवरात्रितिथिः ख्याता सर्वपापप्रणाशिनी..
अत्रैवोदाहरंतीममितिहासं पुरातनम्.. 33.83 ..
1.3.m: Known as the Śivarātri lunar day, it destroys all sin. / In this connection, they relate this ancient narrative:

1.3.s:
brāhmaṇī vidhavā kācitpurā hyāsīcca caṃcalā..
śvapacābhiratā sā ca kāmukī kāmahetutaḥ.. 33.84 ..
1.3.d:
ब्राह्मणी विधवा काचित्पुरा ह्यासीच्च चंचला..
श्वपचाभिरता सा च कामुकी कामहेतुतः.. 33.84 ..
1.3.m: Formerly there was a certain fickle brahmin widow; / she took delight in an outcaste, lustful out of passion.

1.3.s:
tasyāṃ tasya suto jātaḥ śvapacasya durātmanaḥ..
duḥ saho duṣṭanāmātmā sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ.. 33.85 ..
1.3.d:
तस्यां तस्य सुतो जातः श्वपचस्य दुरात्मनः..
दुः सहो दुष्टनामात्मा सर्वधर्मबहिष्कृतः.. 33.85 ..
1.3.m: To her, a son was born of that wicked outcaste: / Duḥsaha by name, evil-natured, excluded from all duties,

1.3.s:
mahāpāpaprayogācca pāpamārabhate sadā..
kitavaśca surāpāyī steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ.. 33.86 ..
1.3.d:
महापापप्रयोगाच्च पापमारभते सदा..
कितवश्च सुरापायी स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः.. 33.86 ..
1.3.m: and from engagement in great sins he was always committing sin— / a gambler, a drinker of liquor, a thief, and a violator of his guru's bed,

1.3.s:
mṛgayuśca durātmāsau karmacaṇḍāla eva saḥ..
adharmiṣṭho hyasadvṛttaḥ kadācicca śivālayam..
śivarātryāṃ ca saṃprāpto hyuṣitaḥ śivasannidhau.. 33.87 ..
1.3.d:
मृगयुश्च दुरात्मासौ कर्मचण्डाल एव सः..
अधर्मिष्ठो ह्यसद्वृत्तः कदाचिच्च शिवालयम्..
शिवरात्र्यां च संप्राप्तो ह्युषितः शिवसन्निधौ.. 33.87 ..
1.3.m: a hunter, evil-minded, a caṇḍāla by deed. / Most unrighteous and of wicked conduct, he once reached a temple of Śiva / on Śivarātri, and stayed in Śiva's presence.

1.3.s:
śravaṇaṃ śaivaśāstrasya yadṛcchājātamaṃtike..
śivasya liṃgarūpasya svayaṃbhuvo yadā tadā.. 33.88 ..
1.3.d:
श्रवणं शैवशास्त्रस्य यदृच्छाजातमंतिके..
शिवस्य लिंगरूपस्य स्वयंभुवो यदा तदा.. 33.88 ..
1.3.m: Listening to the Śaiva scripture occurred by chance nearby, / beside Śiva in the form of a self-manifest liṅga at that time.

1.3.s:
sa ekatroṣito duṣṭaḥ śivarātryāṃ tu jāgarāt..
tena karmavipākena puṇyāṃ yonimavāptavān.. 33.89 ..
1.3.d:
स एकत्रोषितो दुष्टः शिवरात्र्यां तु जागरात्..
तेन कर्मविपाकेन पुण्यां योनिमवाप्तवान्.. 33.89 ..
1.3.m: That wicked man stayed in that one place, keeping vigil during Śivarātri; / by the ripening of that deed, he attained a virtuous womb.

1.3.s:
bhuktvā puṇyatāmām̐llokānuṣitvā śāśvatīḥ samāḥ..
citrāṃgadasya putrobhūdbhūpāleśvaralakṣaṇaḥ.. 33.90 ..
1.3.d:
भुक्त्वा पुण्यतामाम्̐ल्लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः..
चित्रांगदस्य पुत्रोभूद्भूपालेश्वरलक्षणः.. 33.90 ..
1.3.m: Having enjoyed the most meritorious worlds and dwelled there for perpetual years, / he became the son of Citrāṅgada, bearing the marks of a king of monarchs.

1.3.s:
nāmnā vicitravīryo'sau subhagaḥ saṃdurī priyaḥ..
rājyaṃ mahattaraṃ prāpya niḥstaṃbho hi mahānabhūt.. 33.91 ..
1.3.d:
नाम्ना विचित्रवीर्योऽसौ सुभगः संदुरी प्रियः..
राज्यं महत्तरं प्राप्य निःस्तंभो हि महानभूत्.. 33.91 ..
1.3.m: Named Vicitravīrya, handsome and beloved of beautiful women, / having attained a greater kingdom, he became great and unhesitating.

1.3.s:
śive bhaktiṃ prakurvāṇaḥ śivakarmaparo'bhavat..
śaivaśāstraṃ puraskṛtya śivapūjanatatparaḥ..
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ yatnātkaroti śivasannidhau.. 33.92 ..
1.3.d:
शिवे भक्तिं प्रकुर्वाणः शिवकर्मपरोऽभवत्..
शैवशास्त्रं पुरस्कृत्य शिवपूजनतत्परः..
रात्रौ जागरणं यत्नात्करोति शिवसन्निधौ.. 33.92 ..
1.3.m: Rendering devotion to Śiva, he was devoted to the service of Śiva; / following the Śaiva scripture, intent on worshipping Śiva, / he diligently kept vigil at night in Śiva's presence.

1.3.s:
śivasya gāthā gāyaṃstu ānaṃdāśrukaṇānmuhuḥ..
pramuṃcaṃścaiva netrābhyāṃ romāṃcapulakāvṛtaḥ.. 33.93 ..
1.3.d:
शिवस्य गाथा गायंस्तु आनंदाश्रुकणान्मुहुः..
प्रमुंचंश्चैव नेत्राभ्यां रोमांचपुलकावृतः.. 33.93 ..
1.3.m: Singing verses of praise to Śiva, repeatedly shedding / drops of tears of joy from his eyes, he was covered with bristling horripilation.

1.3.s:
āyuṣyaṃ ca gataṃ tasya śivadhyānaparasya ca..
śivo hi sulabho loke paśūnāṃ jñānanināmapi.. 33.94 ..
1.3.d:
आयुष्यं च गतं तस्य शिवध्यानपरस्य च..
शिवो हि सुलभो लोके पशूनां ज्ञाननिनामपि.. 33.94 ..
1.3.m: And his lifespan passed, devoted to meditation on Śiva. / For Śiva is easily attained in this world by both the ignorant and the wise.

1.3.s:
saṃsevituṃ sukhaprāptyai hyeka eva sadāśivaḥ..
śivarātryupavāsena prāpto jñānamanuttamam.. 33.95 ..
1.3.d:
संसेवितुं सुखप्राप्त्यै ह्येक एव सदाशिवः..
शिवरात्र्युपवासेन प्राप्तो ज्ञानमनुत्तमम्.. 33.95 ..
1.3.m: Sadāśiva is the only one to be served for the attainment of happiness; / through the fast on Śivarātri, he attained unsurpassed knowledge.

1.3.s:
jñānātsarvamanuprāptaṃ bhūtasāmyaṃ niraṃtaram..
sarvabhūtātmakaṃ jñātvā kevalaṃ ca sadā śivam..
vinā śivena yatkiṃcinnāsti vastvatra na kvacit.. 33.96 ..
1.3.d:
ज्ञानात्सर्वमनुप्राप्तं भूतसाम्यं निरंतरम्..
सर्वभूतात्मकं ज्ञात्वा केवलं च सदा शिवम्..
विना शिवेन यत्किंचिन्नास्ति वस्त्वत्र न क्वचित्.. 33.96 ..
1.3.m: From knowledge, everything was attained, [namely] constant sameness toward [all] beings, / having known that solely Śiva is ever the soul of all beings. / Without Śiva, there is no real thing whatsoever, anywhere here. (96)

1.3.s:
evaṃ pūrṇaṃ niṣprapaṃcaṃ jñānaṃ prāpnoti durlabham..
prāptajñānastadā rājā jāto hi śivavallabhaḥ.. 33.97 ..
1.3.d:
एवं पूर्णं निष्प्रपंचं ज्ञानं प्राप्नोति दुर्लभम्..
प्राप्तज्ञानस्तदा राजा जातो हि शिववल्लभः.. 33.97 ..
1.3.m: Thus he attains full, unconditioned, hard-to-attain knowledge; / having attained knowledge, the king then indeed became dear to Śiva. (97)

1.3.s:
muktiṃ sāyujyatāṃ prāptaḥ śivarātrerupoṣaṇāt..
tena labdhaṃ śivājjanma purā yatkathitaṃ mayā.. 33.98 ..
1.3.d:
मुक्तिं सायुज्यतां प्राप्तः शिवरात्रेरुपोषणात्..
तेन लब्धं शिवाज्जन्म पुरा यत्कथितं मया.. 33.98 ..
1.3.m: He attained liberation and union [with God] by fasting on Śivarātri; / by him was birth attained from Śiva, as was told by me formerly: (98)

1.3.s:
dākṣāyaṇīvīyo gācca jaṭājūṭena vistarāt..
ya utpanno mastakācca śivasya paramātmanaḥ..
vīrabhadreti vikhyāto dakṣayajñavināśanaḥ.. 33.99 ..
1.3.d:
दाक्षायणीवीयो गाच्च जटाजूटेन विस्तरात्..
य उत्पन्नो मस्तकाच्च शिवस्य परमात्मनः..
वीरभद्रेति विख्यातो दक्षयज्ञविनाशनः.. 33.99 ..
1.3.m: he who, from the separation from Dākṣāyaṇī, arose in full extent from the matted locks / and from the head of Śiva, the Supreme Self, / celebrated as Vīrabhadra, the destroyer of Dakṣa's sacrifice. (99)

1.3.s:
śivarātrivratenaiva tāritā bahavaḥ purā..
prāptāḥ siddhiṃ purā viprā bharatādyāśca dehinaḥ.. 33.100 ..
1.3.d:
शिवरात्रिव्रतेनैव तारिता बहवः पुरा..
प्राप्ताः सिद्धिं पुरा विप्रा भरताद्याश्च देहिनः.. 33.100 ..
1.3.m: Through the observance of Śivarātri alone were many redeemed in the past; / perfections were attained formerly, O brahmins, by Bharata and other embodied beings. (100)

1.3.s:
māṃdhātā dhundhumāriśca hariścandrādayo nṛpāḥ..
prāptāḥ siddhimaneneva vratena parameṇa hi.. 33.101 ..
1.3.d:
मांधाता धुन्धुमारिश्च हरिश्चन्द्रादयो नृपाः..
प्राप्ताः सिद्धिमनेनेव व्रतेन परमेण हि.. 33.101 ..
1.3.m: Māndhātṛ, Dhundhumāra, Hariścandra, and other kings / attained perfection by this supreme observance indeed. (101)

1.3.s:
tato girīśo girijāsametaḥ krīḍānvito'sau girirājamastake..
dyūtaṃ tathaivākṣayutaṃ pareśo yukto bhavānyā sa bhṛśaṃ cakāra.. 33.102 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhastryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe śivarātrivratamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 33 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
ततो गिरीशो गिरिजासमेतः क्रीडान्वितोऽसौ गिरिराजमस्तके..
द्यूतं तथैवाक्षयुतं परेशो युक्तो भवान्या स भृशं चकार.. 33.102 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्त्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखंडे शिवरात्रिव्रतमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रयस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः.. 33 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
Then the Lord of the Mountain, accompanied by Girijā and engaged in play on the peak of the King of Mountains, / that supreme Lord, joined with Bhavānī, eagerly played a game of dice with dice. (102)
Thus ends the thirty-third chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Greatness of the Śivarātri Observance', in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first [section], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand [verses], the glorious Skandapurāṇa. 33.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
rājyaṃ cakāra kailāsa davadavā jagatpatiḥ..
gaṇaiḥ sameto bahubhirvīrabhadrānvito mahān.. 34.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
राज्यं चकार कैलास दवदवा जगत्पतिः..
गणैः समेतो बहुभिर्वीरभद्रान्वितो महान्.. 34.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / The Lord of the World held sway on Mount Kailāsa, / accompanied by many attendants, the great [Lord] accompanied by Vīrabhadra, (1)

1.3.s:
ṛṣibhiḥ sahito rudro devairindrādibhiḥ saha..
brahmā yasya stutiparo viṣṇuḥ preṣyavadāsthitaḥ.. 34.2 ..
1.3.d:
ऋषिभिः सहितो रुद्रो देवैरिन्द्रादिभिः सह..
ब्रह्मा यस्य स्तुतिपरो विष्णुः प्रेष्यवदास्थितः.. 34.2 ..
1.3.m: Rudra, accompanied by the seers, along with the gods headed by Indra, / whom Brahmā was intent on praising, and [before whom] Viṣṇu stood like a servant; (2)

1.3.s:
iṃdro devagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ sevādharmaparo'bhavat..
yasya cchatradharaścaṃdro vāyuścāmaradhṛktathā.. 34.3 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्रो देवगणैः सार्द्धं सेवाधर्मपरोऽभवत्..
यस्य च्छत्रधरश्चंद्रो वायुश्चामरधृक्तथा.. 34.3 ..
1.3.m: Indra along with the host of gods was intent on the duty of service; / whose parasol-bearer was the Moon, and the Wind was the bearer of the flywhisk; (3)

1.3.s:
sūpānnakartā satataṃ jātavadā nirantaram..
gaṃdharvā gāyakā yasya stāvakāśca pinākinaḥ.. 34.4 ..
1.3.d:
सूपान्नकर्ता सततं जातवदा निरन्तरम्..
गंधर्वा गायका यस्य स्तावकाश्च पिनाकिनः.. 34.4 ..
1.3.m: the preparer of soup and food continuously, perpetually; / whose singers and praisers were the gandharvas, [worshipping] the wielder of Pināka; (4)

1.3.s:
vidyādharāśca bahavastathā cāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ..
nanṛtuścāgragā yasya so'sau kailāsaparvate.. 34.5 ..
1.3.d:
विद्याधराश्च बहवस्तथा चाप्सरसां गणाः..
ननृतुश्चाग्रगा यस्य सोऽसौ कैलासपर्वते.. 34.5 ..
1.3.m: and many vidyādharas as well as hosts of apsarases / danced before him; he on Mount Kailāsa, (5)

1.3.s:
putrairgaṇeśaskaṃdādyaistathā girijayā saha..
rājyaṃ pratāpibhiścakre'śaṃkaścaṃkramaṇena ca.. 34.6 ..
1.3.d:
पुत्रैर्गणेशस्कंदाद्यैस्तथा गिरिजया सह..
राज्यं प्रतापिभिश्चक्रेऽशंकश्चंक्रमणेन च.. 34.6 ..
1.3.m: with his sons headed by Gaṇeśa and Skanda, and with Girijā, / held sway, illustrious and moving about without fear; (6)

1.3.s:
yenāṃdhako mahā daityaḥ sa devānāmarirmahān..
duṣṭo viddhastriśūlena gagane sthāpitaściram.. 34.7 ..
1.3.d:
येनांधको महा दैत्यः स देवानामरिर्महान्..
दुष्टो विद्धस्त्रिशूलेन गगने स्थापितश्चिरम्.. 34.7 ..
1.3.m: by whom Andhaka, the great Daitya, that great enemy of the gods, / the wicked one, was pierced with the trident and held for a long time in the sky; (7)

1.3.s:
hatvā gajāsuraṃ yena utkṛttya carma vai kṛtam..
ciraṃ prāvaraṇaṃ divyaṃ tathā tripuradīpanam..
viṣṇunā pālyabhūtena reje sarvāṃgasundaraḥ.. 34.8 ..
1.3.d:
हत्वा गजासुरं येन उत्कृत्त्य चर्म वै कृतम्..
चिरं प्रावरणं दिव्यं तथा त्रिपुरदीपनम्..
विष्णुना पाल्यभूतेन रेजे सर्वांगसुन्दरः.. 34.8 ..
1.3.m: by whom, having slain Gajāsura and stripped his hide, / a divine covering was made for a long time; and who was the burner of Tripura; / he shone, beautiful in all his limbs, with Viṣṇu having become his protector. (8)

1.3.s:
taṃ draṣṭukāmo bhagavānnārado divya rśanaḥ..
yayau ca parvataśreṣṭhaṃ kailāsaṃ candrapāṃḍuram.. 34.9 ..
1.3.d:
तं द्रष्टुकामो भगवान्नारदो दिव्य र्शनः..
ययौ च पर्वतश्रेष्ठं कैलासं चन्द्रपांडुरम्.. 34.9 ..
1.3.m: Desiring to see him, the venerable Nārada of divine vision / went to that best of mountains, Kailāsa, white like the moon, (9)

1.3.s:
sudhayā parayā cāpi sevitaṃ paramādbhutam..
karpūragauraṃ ca tadā dṛṣṭvā taṃ sumahābalam..
nārado vismayāviṣṭaḥ praviṣṭo gandhamādanam.. 34.10 ..
1.3.d:
सुधया परया चापि सेवितं परमाद्भुतम्..
कर्पूरगौरं च तदा दृष्ट्वा तं सुमहाबलम्..
नारदो विस्मयाविष्टः प्रविष्टो गन्धमादनम्.. 34.10 ..
1.3.m: resorted to by supreme nectar, exceedingly wondrous, / and white as camphor; having seen that exceedingly mighty one then, / Nārada, filled with wonder, entered Gandhamādana, (10)

1.3.s:
anekāścaryasaṃyuktaṃ tapanaiśca suśobhitam..
gāyadvidyādharībhiśca pūritaṃ ca mahāprabham.. 34.11 ..
1.3.d:
अनेकाश्चर्यसंयुक्तं तपनैश्च सुशोभितम्..
गायद्विद्याधरीभिश्च पूरितं च महाप्रभम्.. 34.11 ..
1.3.m: which was endowed with many marvels, well adorned with shining lights, / filled with singing vidyādharīs, and exceedingly radiant. (11)

1.3.s:
kalpadrumāśca bahavo latābhiḥ pariveṣṭitāḥ..
ghanacchāyāsū tāsveva viśiṣṭā kāmadhenavaḥ.. 34.12 ..
1.3.d:
कल्पद्रुमाश्च बहवो लताभिः परिवेष्टिताः..
घनच्छायासू तास्वेव विशिष्टा कामधेनवः.. 34.12 ..
1.3.m: And there were many wish-fulfilling trees intertwined with creepers; / in their dense shade were distinguished wish-granting cows. (12)

1.3.s:
pārijātavanāmodalaṃpaṭā bahavo'layaḥ..
kalahaṃsāśca bahavaḥ krīḍamānāḥ sarastu ca.. 34.13 ..
1.3.d:
पारिजातवनामोदलंपटा बहवोऽलयः..
कलहंसाश्च बहवः क्रीडमानाः सरस्तु च.. 34.13 ..
1.3.m: Many bees were greedy for the fragrance of the pārijāta groves; / and many swans were playing in the lakes. (13)

1.3.s:
śikhaṃḍino mahaccakrustatra kekāravaṃ mudā..
paṃcamālāpinaḥ sarve vihaṃgāḥ saṃmadānvitāḥ.. 34.14 ..
1.3.d:
शिखंडिनो महच्चक्रुस्तत्र केकारवं मुदा..
पंचमालापिनः सर्वे विहंगाः संमदान्विताः.. 34.14 ..
1.3.m: Peacocks made their loud peacock cries there with delight; / all the birds warbled the fifth note, full of intoxication. (14)

1.3.s:
kariṇaḥ kariṇībhiśca modamānāḥ suvarcasaḥ..
siṃhāstathā garjamānāḥ śārdūlaiḥ saha saṃgatāḥ.. 34.15 ..
1.3.d:
करिणः करिणीभिश्च मोदमानाः सुवर्चसः..
सिंहास्तथा गर्जमानाः शार्दूलैः सह संगताः.. 34.15 ..
1.3.m: Elephants of fine brilliance were rejoicing with female elephants; / lions, roaring likewise, came together with tigers. (15)

1.3.s:
vṛṣabhā naṃdimukhyāśca rebhamānā nirantaram..
devadrumāśca bahavastathā caṃdanavāṭikāḥ.. 34.16 ..
1.3.d:
वृषभा नंदिमुख्याश्च रेभमाना निरन्तरम्..
देवद्रुमाश्च बहवस्तथा चंदनवाटिकाः.. 34.16 ..
1.3.m: Bulls headed by Nandi were lowing continuously; / and there were many divine trees and groves of sandalwood, (16)

1.3.s:
nāgapuṃnāgabakulāścaṃpakā nāgakesarāḥ..
tathā ca vanajaṃbvaśca tathā kanakaketakāḥ.. 34.17 ..
1.3.d:
नागपुंनागबकुलाश्चंपका नागकेसराः..
तथा च वनजंब्वश्च तथा कनककेतकाः.. 34.17 ..
1.3.m: nāga, puṃnāga, bakula, campaka, and nāgakesara trees, / and also wild rose-apples, and golden ketakas, (17)

1.3.s:
kahlārāḥ karavīriśca kumudāni hyanekaśaḥ..
maṃdārāśca badaryaśca kramukāḥ pāṭalāstathā.. 34.18 ..
1.3.d:
कह्लाराः करवीरिश्च कुमुदानि ह्यनेकशः..
मंदाराश्च बदर्यश्च क्रमुकाः पाटलास्तथा.. 34.18 ..
1.3.m: white water-lilies, oleanders, and water-lilies in abundance, / coral trees, jujube trees, areca palms, and trumpet-flowers, (18)

1.3.s:
tathānye bahavo vṛkṣāḥ śambhostoṣakarāhyamī..
aikapadyena dṛṣṭāste nānādrumalatānvitāḥ..
ārāmā bahavastatra dviguṇāśca babhūvire.. 34.19 ..
1.3.d:
तथान्ये बहवो वृक्षाः शम्भोस्तोषकराह्यमी..
ऐकपद्येन दृष्टास्ते नानाद्रुमलतान्विताः..
आरामा बहवस्तत्र द्विगुणाश्च बभूविरे.. 34.19 ..
1.3.m: and many other trees, all pleasing to Śambhu; / seen at once, endowed with various trees and creepers, / the many pleasure-gardens there seemed doubled. (19)

1.3.s:
gaganānnissṛtaḥ sadyo gaṃgaughaḥ paramādbhutaḥ..
patito mastake tasya parvatasya suśobhite.. 34.20 ..
1.3.d:
गगनान्निस्सृतः सद्यो गंगौघः परमाद्भुतः..
पतितो मस्तके तस्य पर्वतस्य सुशोभिते.. 34.20 ..
1.3.m: The flood of the Gaṅgā, exceedingly wondrous, having just issued from the sky, / fell upon the beautifully adorned summit of that mountain. (20)

1.3.s:
kūpo hi payasāṃ ye na pavitraṃ vartate jagat..
sopi dvidhā tadā dṛṣṭo nāradena mahātmanā.. 34.21 ..
1.3.d:
कूपो हि पयसां ये न पवित्रं वर्तते जगत्..
सोपि द्विधा तदा दृष्टो नारदेन महात्मना.. 34.21 ..
1.3.m: A reservoir indeed of water, by which the world is purified; / it too was seen at that time as divided into two by the great-souled Nārada. (21)

1.3.s:
sarvaṃ tadā dvidhābhūtaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tena mahātmanā..
nāradena tadā viprāḥ parameṇa nirīkṣitaḥ.. 34.22 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वं तदा द्विधाभूतं दृष्टं तेन महात्मना..
नारदेन तदा विप्राः परमेण निरीक्षितः.. 34.22 ..
1.3.m: Everything was then seen as twofold by that great-souled one; / it was observed then, O brahmins, by the supreme Nārada. (22)

1.3.s:
evaṃ vilokamāno'sau nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ..
tvaritena tathā yātaḥ śivālokanatatparaḥ.. 34.23 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विलोकमानोऽसौ नारदो भगवानृषिः..
त्वरितेन तथा यातः शिवालोकनतत्परः.. 34.23 ..
1.3.m: Looking around in this manner, that venerable seer Nārada / went quickly, intent on looking upon Śiva. (23)

1.3.s:
yāvaddvāri sthitopaśyanmahadāścaryameva ca..
dvārapālau tadā dṛṣṭau kṛtakau viśvakmaṇā.. 34.24 ..
1.3.d:
यावद्द्वारि स्थितोपश्यन्महदाश्चर्यमेव च..
द्वारपालौ तदा दृष्टौ कृतकौ विश्वक्मणा.. 34.24 ..
1.3.m: While standing at the door, he beheld a great wonder indeed: / he saw two doorkeepers fabricated by Viśvakarman. (24)

1.3.s:
nārado mohito hyāsītpapraccha ca sa tau tadā..
ahaṃ praveṣṭumicchāmi śivadarśanalālasaḥ.. 34.25 ..
1.3.d:
नारदो मोहितो ह्यासीत्पप्रच्छ च स तौ तदा..
अहं प्रवेष्टुमिच्छामि शिवदर्शनलालसः.. 34.25 ..
1.3.m: Nārada was bewildered and asked the two of them then: / 'I wish to enter, eager for the darśana of Śiva. (25)

1.3.s:
tasmādanujñā dātavyā darśanārthaṃ śivasya ca..
aśrṛṇvantau tadā dṛṣṭvā nārado vismito'bhavat.. 34.26 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मादनुज्ञा दातव्या दर्शनार्थं शिवस्य च..
अश्रृण्वन्तौ तदा दृष्ट्वा नारदो विस्मितोऽभवत्.. 34.26 ..
1.3.m: Therefore permission should be given for the darśana of Śiva.' / Seeing the two not listening, Nārada was astonished. (26)

1.3.s:
jñānadṛṣṭyā vilokyātha dūṣṇīṃbhūto'bhavattadā..
kṛtrimau hi ca tau jñātvā praviṣṭo hi mahāmanāḥ.. 34.27 ..
1.3.d:
ज्ञानदृष्ट्या विलोक्याथ दूष्णींभूतोऽभवत्तदा..
कृत्रिमौ हि च तौ ज्ञात्वा प्रविष्टो हि महामनाः.. 34.27 ..
1.3.m: Having looked with the eye of knowledge, he then became silent; / and knowing the two to be artificial, the great-minded one entered. (27)

1.3.s:
tathānye tatsarūpāśca dṛṣṭāstena mahātmanā..
ṛṣiḥ praṇamitastaiśca nārado bhagavānmuxx.. 34.28 ..
1.3.d:
तथान्ये तत्सरूपाश्च दृष्टास्तेन महात्मना..
ऋषिः प्रणमितस्तैश्च नारदो भगवान्मुxx.. 34.28 ..
1.3.m: And others of the same form were seen by that great-souled one; / and the seer, the venerable Nārada, was saluted by them. (28)

1.3.s:
evamādīnyanekāni āścaryāṇi dadarśa saḥ..
dadarśātha ca suvyaktaṃ tryaṃbakaṃ girijānvitam.. 34.29 ..
1.3.d:
एवमादीन्यनेकानि आश्चर्याणि ददर्श सः..
ददर्शाथ च सुव्यक्तं त्र्यंबकं गिरिजान्वितम्.. 34.29 ..
1.3.m: He beheld many marvels such as these; / and then he clearly beheld Tryambaka accompanied by Girijā: (29)

1.3.s:
ardhāsanagatā sādhvī śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ..
tanayā girirājya yayā vyāptaṃ jagattrayam.. 34.30 ..
1.3.d:
अर्धासनगता साध्वी शंकरस्य महात्मनः..
तनया गिरिराज्य यया व्याप्तं जगत्त्रयम्.. 34.30 ..
1.3.m: the virtuous woman seated on half the throne of the great-souled Śaṃkara, / the daughter of the King of Mountains, by whom the three worlds are pervaded; (30)

1.3.s:
gaurī sitekṣaṇā bālā tanvaṃgī cārulocanā..
yayā rūpī kṛtaḥ śambhurupādeyaḥ kṛto mahān.. 34.31 ..
1.3.d:
गौरी सितेक्षणा बाला तन्वंगी चारुलोचना..
यया रूपी कृतः शम्भुरुपादेयः कृतो महान्.. 34.31 ..
1.3.m: Gaurī, fair-eyed, youthful, slender-limbed, and lovely-eyed, / by whom Śambhu was given form and the great one was made accessible, (31)

1.3.s:
nirvikāni vikāraiśca bahubhirvikalīkṛtaḥ..
arddhāgalagnā sā devī dṛṣṭā tena śivasya ca.. 34.32 ..
1.3.d:
निर्विकानि विकारैश्च बहुभिर्विकलीकृतः..
अर्द्धागलग्ना सा देवी दृष्टा तेन शिवस्य च.. 34.32 ..
1.3.m: and [by whom] the changeless one was agitated by many alterations; / that goddess was seen by him joined to half the body of Śiva. (32)

1.3.s:
nāradena tathā śambhurdṛṣṭastribhuvaneśvaraḥ..
śuddhacāmī karaprakhyaḥ sevyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ.. 34.33 ..
1.3.d:
नारदेन तथा शम्भुर्दृष्टस्त्रिभुवनेश्वरः..
शुद्धचामी करप्रख्यः सेव्यमानः सुरासुरैः.. 34.33 ..
1.3.m: Thus Śambhu, the Lord of the Three Worlds, was seen by Nārada, / resembling pure gold, served by gods and asuras. (33)

1.3.s:
śaṃkhena bhogivaryeṇa sevitaṃ cāṃghripaṃkajam..
dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa ca tathā takṣakeṇa viśeṣataḥ..
tathā padmena mahā śeṣeṇāpi viśeṣataḥ.. 34.34 ..
1.3.d:
शंखेन भोगिवर्येण सेवितं चांघ्रिपंकजम्..
धृतराष्ट्रेण च तथा तक्षकेण विशेषतः..
तथा पद्मेन महा शेषेणापि विशेषतः.. 34.34 ..
1.3.m: His lotus-feet were served by Śaṅkha, the best of serpents, / and likewise by Dhṛtarāṣṭra, and especially by Takṣaka, / as well as by Padma and especially by the great Śeṣa.

1.3.s:
anyaiśca nāgavaryaiśca sevito hi niraṃtaraṃm..
vāsukiḥ kaṃṭhalagno hi hārabhūto mahāprabhaḥ.. 34.35 ..
1.3.d:
अन्यैश्च नागवर्यैश्च सेवितो हि निरंतरंम्..
वासुकिः कंठलग्नो हि हारभूतो महाप्रभः.. 34.35 ..
1.3.m: And he was continually served by other foremost serpents. / Vāsuki, clung to his neck, had become a garland of great splendor.

1.3.s:
kaṃbalāśvatarau nityaṃ karṇabhūṣaṇabhūṣitau..
jaṭāmūlagatāścānye mahāphaṇivarā hyamī.. 34.36 ..
1.3.d:
कंबलाश्वतरौ नित्यं कर्णभूषणभूषितौ..
जटामूलगताश्चान्ये महाफणिवरा ह्यमी.. 34.36 ..
1.3.m: Kambala and Aśvatara ever adorned him as ear-ornaments; / and other excellent, great-hooded serpents had gone to the base of his matted hair.

1.3.s:
anekajātisaṃvītā nānāvarṇāśca padminaḥ..
takṣakaḥ kulikaḥ śaṃkho dhṛtarāṣṭro mahāprabhaḥ.. 34.37 ..
1.3.d:
अनेकजातिसंवीता नानावर्णाश्च पद्मिनः..
तक्षकः कुलिकः शंखो धृतराष्ट्रो महाप्रभः.. 34.37 ..
1.3.m: Encompassed by numerous species and possessing diverse colors, there were serpents / such as Takṣaka, Kulika, Śaṅkha, and Dhṛtarāṣṭra of great splendor,

1.3.s:
padmo daṃbhaḥ sudaṃbhaśca karālo bhīṣaṇastathā..
ete cānye ca bahavo nāgāścāśīviṣā hyamī.. 34.38 ..
1.3.d:
पद्मो दंभः सुदंभश्च करालो भीषणस्तथा..
एते चान्ये च बहवो नागाश्चाशीविषा ह्यमी.. 34.38 ..
1.3.m: Padma, Dambha, and Sudambha, Karāla, and Bhīṣaṇa. / These and many other venomous serpents

1.3.s:
aṃgabhūtā harasyā sanpūjyasyāsya jagattraye..
phaṇaikayā śobhamānāḥ keciddhi pannagottamāḥ.. 34.39 ..
1.3.d:
अंगभूता हरस्या सन्पूज्यस्यास्य जगत्त्रये..
फणैकया शोभमानाः केचिद्धि पन्नगोत्तमाः.. 34.39 ..
1.3.m: became the bodily limbs of Hara, who is to be worshipped in the three worlds. / Certain foremost serpents shone with a single hood,

1.3.s:
phaṇānāṃ dvitayaṃ keṣāṃ tritayaṃ ca mahāprabham..
catuṣka paṃcakaṣaṭkaṃ saptakaṃ cāṣṭakaṃ tathā.. 34.40 ..
1.3.d:
फणानां द्वितयं केषां त्रितयं च महाप्रभम्..
चतुष्क पंचकषट्कं सप्तकं चाष्टकं तथा.. 34.40 ..
1.3.m: some had a pair of hoods, and some possessed three of great splendor, / four, five, six, seven, and eight,

1.3.s:
navakaṃ daśakaṃ caiva tathaikādaśakaṃ tvatha..
dvādaśakaṃ cāṣṭādaśakamekonaviṃśakaṃ tathā.. 34.41 ..
1.3.d:
नवकं दशकं चैव तथैकादशकं त्वथ..
द्वादशकं चाष्टादशकमेकोनविंशकं तथा.. 34.41 ..
1.3.m: nine, ten, eleven, / twelve, eighteen, and nineteen,

1.3.s:
catvāriṃśatphaṇāḥ ke'pi paṃcāśatkaṃ ca ṣaṣṭikam..
saptatiścāpyaśītiśca navatiśca tathaiva ca.. 34.42 ..
1.3.d:
चत्वारिंशत्फणाः केऽपि पंचाशत्कं च षष्टिकम्..
सप्ततिश्चाप्यशीतिश्च नवतिश्च तथैव च.. 34.42 ..
1.3.m: some had forty hoods, fifty, and sixty, / and seventy, eighty, and ninety,

1.3.s:
tathā śatasahasrāṇi hyayutaprayutāni ca..
arbudāni ca ratnāni tathā śaṅkhamitāni ca.. 34.43 ..
1.3.d:
तथा शतसहस्राणि ह्ययुतप्रयुतानि च..
अर्बुदानि च रत्नानि तथा शङ्खमितानि च.. 34.43 ..
1.3.m: and hundreds, thousands, tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands, / tens of millions, hundreds of millions, and billions.

1.3.s:
anaṃtāśca phaṇā yeṣāṃ te sarpāḥ śivabhūṣaṇāḥ..
dṛṣṭāstadānīṃ te sarve nāradena mahātmanā.. 34.44 ..
1.3.d:
अनंताश्च फणा येषां ते सर्पाः शिवभूषणाः..
दृष्टास्तदानीं ते सर्वे नारदेन महात्मना.. 34.44 ..
1.3.m: Those serpents, the ornaments of Śiva, whose hoods were infinite— / all of them were then seen by the great-souled Nārada.

1.3.s:
vidyāvaṃto'pi te sarve bhogino'pi suśobhitāḥ..
hārabhūṣaṇabhūtāste maṇimaṃto'mitaprabhāḥ.. 34.45 ..
1.3.d:
विद्यावंतोऽपि ते सर्वे भोगिनोऽपि सुशोभिताः..
हारभूषणभूतास्ते मणिमंतोऽमितप्रभाः.. 34.45 ..
1.3.m: All of them, though possessors of wisdom, were also splendid serpent bodies; / having become garlands and ornaments, they bore jewels and possessed boundless splendor.

1.3.s:
arddhacaṃdrāṃkito yasya kaparddastvatisuṃdaraḥ..
cakṣuṣā ca tṛtīyena bhālasthena virājitaḥ.. 34.46 ..
1.3.d:
अर्द्धचंद्रांकितो यस्य कपर्द्दस्त्वतिसुंदरः..
चक्षुषा च तृतीयेन भालस्थेन विराजितः.. 34.46 ..
1.3.m: His matted hair, marked by the crescent moon, was exceedingly beautiful, / and he was adorned with a third eye positioned on his forehead.

1.3.s:
paṃcavaktro mahādevo bāhubhirddaśabhirvṛtaḥ..
tathā marakataśyāmakaṃdharo'tīvasuṃdaram.. 34.47 ..
1.3.d:
पंचवक्त्रो महादेवो बाहुभिर्द्दशभिर्वृतः..
तथा मरकतश्यामकंधरोऽतीवसुंदरम्.. 34.47 ..
1.3.m: Mahādeva had five faces and was endowed with ten arms; / likewise, his throat, dark as emerald, was exceedingly beautiful.

1.3.s:
uro yasya viśālaṃ ca tathorujaghanaṃ param..
caraṇadvayaṃ ca rudrasya śobhitaṃ paramaṃ mahat.. 34.48 ..
1.3.d:
उरो यस्य विशालं च तथोरुजघनं परम्..
चरणद्वयं च रुद्रस्य शोभितं परमं महत्.. 34.48 ..
1.3.m: His chest was broad, and his thighs and hips were supreme; / the two feet of Rudra were splendid, supreme, and magnificent.

1.3.s:
taddṛṣṭaṃ caraṇāraviṃdamatulaṃ tejomayaṃ suṃdaraṃ saṃdhyārāgasumaṃgalaṃ ca paramaṃ tāpāpanuttiṃkaram..
tejorāśikaraṃ parātparamidaṃ lāvaṇyalīlaspadaṃ sarveṣāṃ sukhavṛddhikāraṇaparaṃ śaṃbhoḥ padaṃ pāvanam.. 34.49 ..
1.3.d:
तद्दृष्टं चरणारविंदमतुलं तेजोमयं सुंदरं संध्यारागसुमंगलं च परमं तापापनुत्तिंकरम्..
तेजोराशिकरं परात्परमिदं लावण्यलीलस्पदं सर्वेषां सुखवृद्धिकारणपरं शंभोः पदं पावनम्.. 34.49 ..
1.3.m: He beheld that matchless lotus-foot, luminous, beautiful, / most auspicious like the twilight glow, supreme, dispelling distress, / generating a mass of light, higher than the highest, the abode of graceful charm, / the highest cause of increasing joy for all, the purifying foot of Śambhu.

1.3.s:
tathaiva dṛṣṭvā paramaṃ parāṇāṃ parā satī rūpavatī ca suṃdarī..
saubhāgyalāvaṇyamahāvibhūtyā virājamānā hyatisuṃdarī śubhā.. 34.50 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव दृष्ट्वा परमं पराणां परा सती रूपवती च सुंदरी..
सौभाग्यलावण्यमहाविभूत्या विराजमाना ह्यतिसुंदरी शुभा.. 34.50 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, having seen the highest of the high, the supreme Satī, full of beauty and lovely, / shining forth with the great majesty of good fortune and charm, exceedingly lovely and auspicious,

1.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tau dapatī śuddhau rājamānau jagattraye..
abhinnau bhedamāpannau nirguṇau guṇinau ca tau.. 34.51 ..
1.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तौ दपती शुद्धौ राजमानौ जगत्त्रये..
अभिन्नौ भेदमापन्नौ निर्गुणौ गुणिनौ च तौ.. 34.51 ..
1.3.m: having seen that pure couple shining in the three worlds, / non-different yet appearing differentiated, devoid of qualities yet endowed with qualities,

1.3.s:
sākārau ca nirākārau nirātaṃkau sukhapradau..
vavaṃde ca mudā tau sa nārado bhagavatpriyaḥ..
utthāyotthāya ca tadā tuṣṭāva jagadīśvarau.. 34.52 ..
1.3.d:
साकारौ च निराकारौ निरातंकौ सुखप्रदौ..
ववंदे च मुदा तौ स नारदो भगवत्प्रियः..
उत्थायोत्थाय च तदा तुष्टाव जगदीश्वरौ.. 34.52 ..
1.3.m: possessing form and formless, free of distress and bestowing happiness, / he, Nārada, dear to the Lord, bowed to them both with joy; / and rising up again and again, he then praised the two Lords of the Universe.

1.3.s:
..nārada uvāca..
natosmyahaṃ devavarau yuvābhyāṃ parātparābhyāṃ kalayā tathāpi..
dṛṣṭau mayā daṃpatī rājamānau yau vījabhūtau sacarācarasya .. 34.53 ..
1.3.d:
..नारद उवाच..
नतोस्म्यहं देववरौ युवाभ्यां परात्पराभ्यां कलया तथापि..
दृष्टौ मया दंपती राजमानौ यौ वीजभूतौ सचराचरस्य .. 34.53 ..
1.3.m: Nārada said: / I bow to you both, the two foremost deities, higher than the highest, yet manifest by a portion. / The shining couple, who are the source-seed of the moving and unmoving, have been seen by me,

1.3.s:
pitarau sarvalalokasya jñātau cādyaiva tattvataḥ..
mayā nāstyatra saṃdeho bhavatoḥ kṛpayā tathā.. 34.54 ..
1.3.d:
पितरौ सर्वललोकस्य ज्ञातौ चाद्यैव तत्त्वतः..
मया नास्त्यत्र संदेहो भवतोः कृपया तथा.. 34.54 ..
1.3.m: the parents of the entire world, known in truth this very day / by me; there is no doubt in this, through your grace.

1.3.s:
evaṃ stutau tadā tena nāradena mahātmanā..
tutoṣa bhagavāñchaṃbhuḥ pārvatyā sahitastadā.. 34.55 ..
1.3.d:
एवं स्तुतौ तदा तेन नारदेन महात्मना..
तुतोष भगवाञ्छंभुः पार्वत्या सहितस्तदा.. 34.55 ..
1.3.m: When they were thus praised at that time by the great-souled Nārada, / the blessed Lord Śambhu, accompanied by Pārvatī, was pleased.

1.3.s:
..mahādeva uvāca..
sukhena sthīyate brahmankiṃ kāryaṃ karavāṇi te..
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ śaṃbhornārado vākyamabravīt.. 34.56 ..
1.3.d:
..महादेव उवाच..
सुखेन स्थीयते ब्रह्मन्किं कार्यं करवाणि ते..
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं शंभोर्नारदो वाक्यमब्रवीत्.. 34.56 ..
1.3.m: Mahādeva said: / Are you at ease, O brahmin? What task may I perform for you? / Having heard that statement of Śambhu, Nārada spoke [these] words:

1.3.s:
darśanaṃ jātamadyaiva tena tuṣṭo'smyahaṃ vibho..
darśanātsarvamevādya śaṃbho mama na saṃśayaḥ.. 34.57 ..
1.3.d:
दर्शनं जातमद्यैव तेन तुष्टोऽस्म्यहं विभो..
दर्शनात्सर्वमेवाद्य शंभो मम न संशयः.. 34.57 ..
1.3.m: Darśana has occurred this very day; by that I am pleased, O All-pervading One! / Through your darśana, everything is mine today, O Śambhu, there is no doubt.

1.3.s:
krīḍanārthamihāyātaḥ kailāsaṃ parvatottamam..
hṛdistho hi sadā nṝṇāmāsthito bhagavanprabho.. 34.58 ..
1.3.d:
क्रीडनार्थमिहायातः कैलासं पर्वतोत्तमम्..
हृदिस्थो हि सदा नॄणामास्थितो भगवन्प्रभो.. 34.58 ..
1.3.m: I have come here to Kailāsa, the foremost of mountains, for sport. / You ever dwell in the hearts of men, O blessed Lord,

1.3.s: tathāpi darśanaṃ bhāvyaṃ satataṃ prāṇināmiha.. 34.59 ..
1.3.d: तथापि दर्शनं भाव्यं सततं प्राणिनामिह.. 34.59 ..
1.3.m: yet your darśana must constantly be sought by living beings here.

1.3.s:
..girijovāca..
kā krīḍā hi tvayā bhāvyā vada śīghraṃ mamāgrataḥ..
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā uvāca prahasanniva.. 34.60 ..
1.3.d:
..गिरिजोवाच..
का क्रीडा हि त्वया भाव्या वद शीघ्रं ममाग्रतः..
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा उवाच प्रहसन्निव.. 34.60 ..
1.3.m: Girijā said: / What sport should be [played] by you? Speak quickly before me! / Hearing that speech of hers, he said, as if laughing:

1.3.s:
dyūtakrīḍā mahādeva dṛśyate vividhātra ca..
bhaveddvābhyāṃ ca dyūte hi ramaṇāc mahatsukham.. 34.61 ..
1.3.d:
द्यूतक्रीडा महादेव दृश्यते विविधात्र च..
भवेद्द्वाभ्यां च द्यूते हि रमणाच् महत्सुखम्.. 34.61 ..
1.3.m: A game of dice, O Mahādeva, of various kinds is seen here; / great pleasure would arise from playing a game of dice between the two [of you].

1.3.s:
ityevamuktvo parataṃ satī bhṛśamuvāca vākyaṃ kupitā ṛṣiṃ prati..
kathaṃ vijānāsi paraṃ prasiddhaṃ dyūtaṃ ca duṣṭodarakaṃ manasvinām.. 34.62 ..
1.3.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वो परतं सती भृशमुवाच वाक्यं कुपिता ऋषिं प्रति..
कथं विजानासि परं प्रसिद्धं द्यूतं च दुष्टोदरकं मनस्विनाम्.. 34.62 ..
1.3.m: When he had spoken thus and ceased, Satī, intensely angered, spoke words to the seer: / 'How do you know that supreme, well-known gambling, which ruins the belly of the wise?

1.3.s:
tvaṃ brahmaputro'si munirmanīṣiṇāṃ śāstā hi vākyaṃ vividhaiḥ prasiddhaiḥ..
cariṣyamāṇo bhuvanatraye na hi tvadanyo hyaparo manasvī.. 34.63 ..
1.3.d:
त्वं ब्रह्मपुत्रोऽसि मुनिर्मनीषिणां शास्ता हि वाक्यं विविधैः प्रसिद्धैः..
चरिष्यमाणो भुवनत्रये न हि त्वदन्यो ह्यपरो मनस्वी.. 34.63 ..
1.3.m: You are a son of Brahmā, a sage, a teacher of the wise through various renowned discourses; / wandering in the three worlds, there is indeed no other wise person than you!'

1.3.s:
evamuktastadā devyā nārado devadarśanaḥ..
uvāca vākyaṃ prahasangirijāṃ śivasannidhau.. 34.64 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्तस्तदा देव्या नारदो देवदर्शनः..
उवाच वाक्यं प्रहसन्गिरिजां शिवसन्निधौ.. 34.64 ..
1.3.m: Addressed thus at that time by the goddess, Nārada, who has the vision of a deity, / spoke words, laughing, to Girijā in the presence of Śiva.

1.3.s:
..nārada uvāca..
dyūtaṃ na jānāmi na cāśrayāmi hyahaṃ tapasvī śivakiṃkaraśca kathaṃ ca māṃ pṛcchasi rājakanyake yogīśvarāṇāṃ paramaṃ pavitre.. 34.65 ..
1.3.d:
..नारद उवाच..
द्यूतं न जानामि न चाश्रयामि ह्यहं तपस्वी शिवकिंकरश्च कथं च मां पृच्छसि राजकन्यके योगीश्वराणां परमं पवित्रे.. 34.65 ..
1.3.m: Nārada said: / 'I do not know gambling, nor do I resort to it; I am an ascetic and a servant of Śiva. / Why do you ask me, O princess, you who are supremely pure among the lords of yogins?'

1.3.s:
niśamya vākyaṃ girijā satī tadā hyuvāca vākyaṃ ca vihasya taṃ prati..
jānāsi sarvaṃ ca baṭo'dya paśya me dyūtaṃ maheśena karomi te'grataḥ.. 34.66 ..
1.3.d:
निशम्य वाक्यं गिरिजा सती तदा ह्युवाच वाक्यं च विहस्य तं प्रति..
