जानासि सर्वं च बटोऽद्य पश्य मे द्यूतं महेशेन करोमि तेऽग्रतः.. 34.66 ..
1.3.m: Hearing his speech, Girijā Satī then laughed and said to him: / 'You know everything, O young student! Today, behold me: I shall play dice with Maheśa before you.'

1.3.s:
ityevamuktvā girirājakanyakā jagrāha cākṣānbhuvanaikasuṃdarī..
krīḍāṃ cakārātha maharṣisākṣyake tatrāsthitā sā hi bhavena saṃyutā.. 34.67 ..
1.3.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा गिरिराजकन्यका जग्राह चाक्षान्भुवनैकसुंदरी..
क्रीडां चकाराथ महर्षिसाक्ष्यके तत्रास्थिता सा हि भवेन संयुता.. 34.67 ..
1.3.m: Having spoken thus, the daughter of the king of mountains, the sole beauty of the world, took the dice; / she then engaged in the game with the great seer as witness, seated there accompanied by Bhava.

1.3.s:
tau daṃpatī krīḍayā sajjamānau dṛṣṭau tadā ṛṣiṇā nāradena..
savismayotphullamanā manasvī vilokamāno'titarāṃ tutoṣa.. 34.68 ..
1.3.d:
तौ दंपती क्रीडया सज्जमानौ दृष्टौ तदा ऋषिणा नारदेन..
सविस्मयोत्फुल्लमना मनस्वी विलोकमानोऽतितरां तुतोष.. 34.68 ..
1.3.m: Those two spouses intent upon the game were then beheld by the seer Nārada; / with a mind expanding in wonder, the wise [sage] rejoiced greatly as he looked on.

1.3.s:
sakhījanena saṃvītā tadā dyūtaparā satī..
śivena saha saṃgatya cchalāddyūtamakārayat.. 34.69 ..
1.3.d:
सखीजनेन संवीता तदा द्यूतपरा सती..
शिवेन सह संगत्य च्छलाद्द्यूतमकारयत्.. 34.69 ..
1.3.m: Surrounded by her female companions, Satī, devoted to the dice game, / joined with Śiva and made him play the game by trickery.

1.3.s:
sa paṇaṃ ca tadā cakre chalena mahatā vṛtaḥ..
jitā bhavānī ca tadā śivena prahasanniva.. 34.70 ..
1.3.d:
स पणं च तदा चक्रे छलेन महता वृतः..
जिता भवानी च तदा शिवेन प्रहसन्निव.. 34.70 ..
1.3.m: He then placed a wager, surrounded by great deceit; / and Bhavānī was then defeated by Śiva, as he smiled.

1.3.s:
nārado'syāḥ śivenātha upahāsakaro'bhavat..
niśamya hāritaṃ dyūtamupahāsaṃ niśamya ca.. 34.71 ..
1.3.d:
नारदोऽस्याः शिवेनाथ उपहासकरोऽभवत्..
निशम्य हारितं द्यूतमुपहासं निशम्य च.. 34.71 ..
1.3.m: Along with Śiva, Nārada then mocked her. / Having heard that she had lost the game of dice, and having heard the mockery,

1.3.s:
nāradasya duruktaiśca kupitā pārvatī bhṛśam..
uvāca tvaritā caiva dattvā caivārddhacaṃdrakam.. 34.72 ..
1.3.d:
नारदस्य दुरुक्तैश्च कुपिता पार्वती भृशम्..
उवाच त्वरिता चैव दत्त्वा चैवार्द्धचंद्रकम्.. 34.72 ..
1.3.m: and greatly angered by Nārada's harsh words, / Pārvatī swiftly spoke, having also given [him] a push with the hand.

1.3.s:
tathā śiromaṇī caiva tarale ca manohare..
mukhaṃ sukhobhanaṃ caiva tathā kupitasuṃdaram..
dṛṣṭaṃ hareṇa ca punaḥ punardyūtamakārayat.. 34.73 ..
1.3.d:
तथा शिरोमणी चैव तरले च मनोहरे..
मुखं सुखोभनं चैव तथा कुपितसुंदरम्..
दृष्टं हरेण च पुनः पुनर्द्यूतमकारयत्.. 34.73 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, the crest-jewel, trembling and charming, / her face exceedingly radiant, and lovely even in anger, / was beheld by Hara, and repeatedly he caused the game of dice to proceed.

1.3.s:
tathā girijayā proktaḥ śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ..
hāritaṃ ca mayā dattaḥ paṇa eva ca nānyathā.. 34.74 ..
1.3.d:
तथा गिरिजया प्रोक्तः शंकरो लोकशंकरः..
हारितं च मया दत्तः पण एव च नान्यथा.. 34.74 ..
1.3.m: Then Śaṃkara, who brings welfare to the world, was addressed by Girijā: / “I lost, and the wager has indeed been paid by me, not otherwise.

1.3.s:
kriyate ca tvayā śaṃbho kaḥ paṇo hi taducyatām..
tataḥ prahasya covāca pārvatīṃ ca trilocanaḥ.. 34.75 ..
1.3.d:
क्रियते च त्वया शंभो कः पणो हि तदुच्यताम्..
ततः प्रहस्य चोवाच पार्वतीं च त्रिलोचनः.. 34.75 ..
1.3.m: What wager is made by you, O Śambhu? Let that indeed be spoken.” / Thereupon the three-eyed Lord laughed and said to Pārvatī:

1.3.s:
mayā paṇo'yaṃ kriyate bhavāni tvadarthametacca vibhūṣaṇaṃ mahat..
sā caṃdralekhā hi mahānhi hārastathaiva karṇotpalabhūṣaṇadvayam.. 34.76 ..
1.3.d:
मया पणोऽयं क्रियते भवानि त्वदर्थमेतच्च विभूषणं महत्..
सा चंद्रलेखा हि महान्हि हारस्तथैव कर्णोत्पलभूषणद्वयम्.. 34.76 ..
1.3.m: “This wager is laid by me, O Bhavānī, for your sake—this great ornament: / that crescent moon, indeed, and the great necklace, as well as the pair of ear-lotus ornaments.

1.3.s:
idameva tvayā tanvi māṃ jitvā gṛhyatāṃ sukham..
tataḥ pravartitaṃ dyūtaṃ śaṃkareṇa sahaiva ca.. 34.77 ..
1.3.d:
इदमेव त्वया तन्वि मां जित्वा गृह्यतां सुखम्..
ततः प्रवर्तितं द्यूतं शंकरेण सहैव च.. 34.77 ..
1.3.m: Having defeated me, O slender lady, let this very thing be happily taken by you.” / Then the game of dice was set in motion along with Śaṃkara.

1.3.s:
evaṃ vikrīḍamānau tāvakṣavidyāviśāradau..
tadā jito bhavānyātha śaṃkaro bahubhūṣaṇaḥ.. 34.78 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विक्रीडमानौ तावक्षविद्याविशारदौ..
तदा जितो भवान्याथ शंकरो बहुभूषणः.. 34.78 ..
1.3.m: While the two of them, skilled in the science of dice, were thus playing, / Śaṃkara, adorned with many ornaments, was then defeated by Bhavānī.

1.3.s:
prahasya gaurī provāca śaṃkaraṃ tvatisuṃdarī..
hāritaṃ ca paṇaṃ dehi mama cādyaiva śaṃkara.. 34.79 ..
1.3.d:
प्रहस्य गौरी प्रोवाच शंकरं त्वतिसुंदरी..
हारितं च पणं देहि मम चाद्यैव शंकर.. 34.79 ..
1.3.m: Laughing, Gaurī, exceedingly lovely, said to Śaṃkara: / “Give me this very day the lost wager, O Śaṃkara.”

1.3.s:
tadā maheśaḥ prahasansatyaṃ vākyamuvāca ha..
na jito'haṃ tvayā tanvi tattvato hi vimaśyatām.. 34.80 ..
1.3.d:
तदा महेशः प्रहसन्सत्यं वाक्यमुवाच ह..
न जितोऽहं त्वया तन्वि तत्त्वतो हि विमश्यताम्.. 34.80 ..
1.3.m: Then Maheśa, laughing, spoke these truthful words: / “I was not defeated by you, O slender lady; consider it according to reality.

1.3.s:
ajeyo'haṃ prāṇināṃ sarvathaiva tasmānna vācyaṃ tu voca hi sādhvi..
dyūtaṃ kuruṣvādya yatheṣṭameva jeṣyāmi cāhaṃca punaḥ prapaśyā.. 34.81 ..
1.3.d:
अजेयोऽहं प्राणिनां सर्वथैव तस्मान्न वाच्यं तु वोच हि साध्वि..
द्यूतं कुरुष्वाद्य यथेष्टमेव जेष्यामि चाहंच पुनः प्रपश्या.. 34.81 ..
1.3.m: I am entirely unconquerable by living beings; therefore, do not speak such words, O virtuous lady. / Play the dice this day as you wish, and I will win again; just see!”

1.3.s:
tadāmbikāha svapatiṃ maheśaṃ mayā jito'syadya na vismayo'tra..
evamuktvā tadā śaṃbhuṃ kare gṛhya varānanā..
jito'si tvaṃ na saṃdehastvaṃ na jānāsi śaṃkara.. 34.82 ..
1.3.d:
तदाम्बिकाह स्वपतिं महेशं मया जितोऽस्यद्य न विस्मयोऽत्र..
एवमुक्त्वा तदा शंभुं करे गृह्य वरानना..
जितोऽसि त्वं न संदेहस्त्वं न जानासि शंकर.. 34.82 ..
1.3.m: Then Ambikā said to her husband Maheśa: “You are defeated by me today, there is no doubt in this.” / Having spoken thus, taking Śambhu by the hand, the fair-faced lady said: / “You are defeated, there is no doubt; you do not know it, O Śaṃkara.”

1.3.s:
evaṃ prahasya ruciraṃ girijā tu śaṃbhuṃ sā prekṣyā narmavacasā sa tayābhibhūtaḥ..
dehīti ma sakalamaṃgalamaṃgaleśa yaddhāritaṃ smararipo vacasānumoditam.. 34.83 ..
1.3.d:
एवं प्रहस्य रुचिरं गिरिजा तु शंभुं सा प्रेक्ष्या नर्मवचसा स तयाभिभूतः..
देहीति म सकलमंगलमंगलेश यद्धारितं स्मररिपो वचसानुमोदितम्.. 34.83 ..
1.3.m: Having thus laughed charmingly, Girijā looked upon Śambhu, and he was overwhelmed by her with playful words: / “Give me, O Lord of all blessings, what was lost, O enemy of Smara, as assented to by your word.”

1.3.s:
..śiva uvāca..
ajeyo'haṃ viśālākṣi tava nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ..
ahaṃkāreṇa yatproktaṃ tattvatastadvimṛśyatām.. 34.84 ..
1.3.d:
..शिव उवाच..
अजेयोऽहं विशालाक्षि तव नास्त्यत्र संशयः..
अहंकारेण यत्प्रोक्तं तत्त्वतस्तद्विमृश्यताम्.. 34.84 ..
1.3.m: Śiva said: / “I am unconquerable, O large-eyed lady, [even] by you; there is no doubt here. / That which was said out of pride, consider it in accordance with truth.”

1.3.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā provāca ca vihasya sā..
ajeyo hi mahādevaḥ sarveṣāmapi vai prabho.. 34.85 ..
1.3.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रोवाच च विहस्य सा..
अजेयो हि महादेवः सर्वेषामपि वै प्रभो.. 34.85 ..
1.3.m: Hearing those words of his, she laughed and said: / “Mahādeva is indeed unconquerable to all, O Lord.

1.3.s:
mayaikayā jito'si tvaṃ dyūtena vimalena hi..
na jānāsi ca kiṃcicca kāryākāryaṃ vivakṣitam.... 34.86 ..
1.3.d:
मयैकया जितोऽसि त्वं द्यूतेन विमलेन हि..
न जानासि च किंचिच्च कार्याकार्यं विवक्षितम्.... 34.86 ..
1.3.m: Yet by me alone have you been defeated in a fair game of dice! / You do not understand in the least what is meant concerning what is to be done and what is not to be done.”

1.3.s:
evaṃ vivadamānau tau daṃpatī parameśvarau..
nāradaḥ prahasanvākyamuvāca ṛṣisattamaḥ.. 34.87 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विवदमानौ तौ दंपती परमेश्वरौ..
नारदः प्रहसन्वाक्यमुवाच ऋषिसत्तमः.. 34.87 ..
1.3.m: While the two supreme lords, husband and wife, were thus disputing, / Nārada, the best of seers, laughing, spoke these words:

1.3.s:
..nārada uvāca..
ākarṇayā''karṇaviśālanetre vākyaṃ tadekaṃ jagadekamaṃgalam..
asau mahābhāgyavatāṃ vareṇyastvayā jitaḥ kiṃ ca mṛṣā bravīṣi.. 34.88 ..
1.3.d:
..नारद उवाच..
आकर्णया'ऽकर्णविशालनेत्रे वाक्यं तदेकं जगदेकमंगलम्..
असौ महाभाग्यवतां वरेण्यस्त्वया जितः किं च मृषा ब्रवीषि.. 34.88 ..
1.3.m: Nārada said: / “Listen, O lady whose eyes are broad as far as your ears, to that single word which is the sole blessing of the world: / This [Lord] is the foremost of the most fortunate; has he been defeated by you, that you speak falsely?

1.3.s:
ajito hi mahādevo devānāṃ paramo guruḥ..
arūpo'yaṃ surūpoyaṃ rūpātīto'yamucyate.. 34.89 ..
1.3.d:
अजितो हि महादेवो देवानां परमो गुरुः..
अरूपोऽयं सुरूपोयं रूपातीतोऽयमुच्यते.. 34.89 ..
1.3.m: Mahādeva is indeed unconquered, the supreme teacher of the gods. / He is formless, he has a fair form, and he is spoken of as beyond all forms.

1.3.s:
eka eva paraṃ jyotisteṣāmapi ca yanmahaḥ..
trailokyanātho viśvātmā śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ.. 34.90 ..
1.3.d:
एक एव परं ज्योतिस्तेषामपि च यन्महः..
त्रैलोक्यनाथो विश्वात्मा शंकरो लोकशंकरः.. 34.90 ..
1.3.m: He alone is the supreme light, that luster which belongs even to them, / the Lord of the three worlds, the soul of the universe, Śaṃkara, who brings welfare to the world.

1.3.s:
kathaṃ tvayā jito devi hyajeyo bhuvanatraye..
śivamenaṃ na jānāsi strībhāvācca varānane.. 34.91 ..
1.3.d:
कथं त्वया जितो देवि ह्यजेयो भुवनत्रये..
शिवमेनं न जानासि स्त्रीभावाच्च वरानने.. 34.91 ..
1.3.m: How could he, unconquerable in the three worlds, be defeated by you, O goddess? / Out of your womanly nature, O fair-faced lady, you do not recognise this Śiva.”

1.3.s:
nāradenaivamuktā sā kupitā pārvatī bhṛśam..
babhāṣe matsaragrastā sākṣepaṃ vacanaṃ satī.. 34.92 ..
1.3.d:
नारदेनैवमुक्ता सा कुपिता पार्वती भृशम्..
बभाषे मत्सरग्रस्ता साक्षेपं वचनं सती.. 34.92 ..
1.3.m: Addressed thus by Nārada, Pārvatī became exceedingly angry. / Seized with indignation, the virtuous lady uttered reproachful words:

1.3.s:
..pārvatyuvāca..
cāpalyācca na vaktvyaṃ brahmaputra namostu te ..
tava bhītāsmi bhadraṃ te devarṣe maunamāvaha.. 34.93 ..
1.3.d:
..पार्वत्युवाच..
चापल्याच्च न वक्त्व्यं ब्रह्मपुत्र नमोस्तु ते ..
तव भीतास्मि भद्रं ते देवर्षे मौनमावह.. 34.93 ..
1.3.m: Pārvatī said: / “You should not speak out of thoughtlessness, O son of Brahmā, homage to you! / I am afraid of you; blessing to you, O divine seer, keep silent!

1.3.s:
kathaṃ śivo hi devarṣa ukto'to hi tvayā bahu..
matprasādā schavo jāta īśvaro yo hi paṭhyate.. 34.94 ..
1.3.d:
कथं शिवो हि देवर्ष उक्तोऽतो हि त्वया बहु..
मत्प्रसादा स्छवो जात ईश्वरो यो हि पठ्यते.. 34.94 ..
1.3.m: How is it that Śiva has been extolled so much by you, O divine seer? / Through my favor he who is recited as Īśvara became more than a corpse.

1.3.s: mayā labdhapratiṣṭho'yaṃ jāto nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ.. 34.95 ..
1.3.d: मया लब्धप्रतिष्ठोऽयं जातो नास्त्यत्र संशयः.. 34.95 ..
1.3.m: Having obtained his standing through me, he came into being; there is no doubt here.”

1.3.s:
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ śrutvā nārado maunamāśrayat..
pasthitaṃ ca taddṛṣṭvā bhṛṃgī vākyamathābravīt.. 34.96 ..
1.3.d:
एवं बहुविधं श्रुत्वा नारदो मौनमाश्रयत्..
पस्थितं च तद्दृष्ट्वा भृंगी वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्.. 34.96 ..
1.3.m: Hearing these manifold [words], Nārada resorted to silence. / Seeing what had transpired, Bhṛṅgin then spoke these words:

1.3.s:
..bhṛṃgyuvāca..
tvayā bahu na vaktavyaṃ punareva ca bhāmini..
ajeyo nirvikāro hi svāmī mama sumadhyame.. 34.97 ..
1.3.d:
..भृंग्युवाच..
त्वया बहु न वक्तव्यं पुनरेव च भामिनि..
अजेयो निर्विकारो हि स्वामी मम सुमध्यमे.. 34.97 ..
1.3.m: Bhṛṅgin said: / “You must not speak so much once again, O passionate lady! / My master, O slender-waisted lady, is indeed unconquerable and changeless.

1.3.s:
strībhāvayuktāsi varānane tvaṃ devaṃ na jānāsi paraṃ parāṇām..
kāmaṃ puraskṛtya purā bhavāni samāgatāsyeva maheśamugrama.. 34.98 ..
1.3.d:
स्त्रीभावयुक्तासि वरानने त्वं देवं न जानासि परं पराणाम्..
कामं पुरस्कृत्य पुरा भवानि समागतास्येव महेशमुग्रम.. 34.98 ..
1.3.m: You are possessed of a womanly nature, O fair-faced lady; you do not know the God who is higher than the highest. / Placing desire at the forefront of old, O Bhavānī, you came to the fierce Maheśa.

1.3.s:
yathā kṛtaṃ tena pinākinā purā etatsmṛtaṃ kiṃ subhage vadasva naḥ..
kṛto hyanaṃgo hi tadā hyanena dagdhaṃ vanaṃ tasya gireḥ pituste.. 34.99 ..
1.3.d:
यथा कृतं तेन पिनाकिना पुरा एतत्स्मृतं किं सुभगे वदस्व नः..
कृतो ह्यनंगो हि तदा ह्यनेन दग्धं वनं तस्य गिरेः पितुस्ते.. 34.99 ..
1.3.m: How it was done of old by that wielder of the Pināka—is that remembered, O fortunate lady? Tell us! / Kama was made bodiless by him then, and the forest of your father's mountain was burned.

1.3.s: xxxvāttvayārādhita eva eṣa śivaḥ parāṇāṃ paramaḥ parātmā.. 34.100 ..
1.3.d: xxxवात्त्वयाराधित एव एष शिवः पराणां परमः परात्मा.. 34.100 ..
1.3.m: […] this Śiva, the highest of the high, the supreme Self, was worshipped by you.

1.3.s:
bhṛṃgiṇetyevamuktā sā hyuvāca kipitā bhṛśam..
śrṛṇvato hi maheśasya vākyaṃ pṛṣṭā ca bhṛṃgiṇam.. 34.101 ..
1.3.d:
भृंगिणेत्येवमुक्ता सा ह्युवाच किपिता भृशम्..
श्रृण्वतो हि महेशस्य वाक्यं पृष्टा च भृंगिणम्.. 34.101 ..
1.3.m: Addressed thus by Bhṛṅgin, she became exceedingly angry, / and while Maheśa was listening, she questioned Bhṛṅgin and said:

1.3.s:
..pārvatyuvāca..
haṃ bhṛṃginpakṣapātitvādyaduktaṃ vacanaṃ mama..
śivapriyo'si re manda bhedabuddhirato hyasi.. 34.102 ..
1.3.d:
..पार्वत्युवाच..
हं भृंगिन्पक्षपातित्वाद्यदुक्तं वचनं मम..
शिवप्रियोऽसि रे मन्द भेदबुद्धिरतो ह्यसि.. 34.102 ..
1.3.m: Pārvatī said: / “O Bhṛṅgin, because of the words you spoke out of partiality— / you are dear to Śiva, yet, O fool, you are intent on seeing division!

1.3.s:
ahaṃ śivātmikā mūḍha śivo nityaṃ mayi sthitaḥ..
kathaṃ śivābhyāṃ bhinnatvaṃ tvayoktaṃ vāgbalena hi.. 34.103 ..
1.3.d:
अहं शिवात्मिका मूढ शिवो नित्यं मयि स्थितः..
कथं शिवाभ्यां भिन्नत्वं त्वयोक्तं वाग्बलेन हि.. 34.103 ..
1.3.m: I am of the nature of Śiva, O fool; Śiva is eternally situated in me. / How is a separateness from both Śivas spoken by you merely through the power of speech?

1.3.s:
śrutaṃ ca vākyaṃ śubhadaṃ pārvatyā bhṛṃgiṇā tadā..
uvāca pārvatīṃ bhṛṃgī ruṣitaḥ śivasannidhau.. 34.104 ..
1.3.d:
श्रुतं च वाक्यं शुभदं पार्वत्या भृंगिणा तदा..
उवाच पार्वतीं भृंगी रुषितः शिवसन्निधौ.. 34.104 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that auspicious statement of Pārvatī then, / Bhṛṅgin, infuriated in the presence of Śiva, said to Pārvatī:

1.3.s:
puturyajñe ca dakṣasya śivaniṃdā tvayā śrutā..
apriyakṣavaṇātsadyastvayā tyaktaṃ kalevaram.. 34.105 ..
1.3.d:
पुतुर्यज्ञे च दक्षस्य शिवनिंदा त्वया श्रुता..
अप्रियक्षवणात्सद्यस्त्वया त्यक्तं कलेवरम्.. 34.105 ..
1.3.m: “At the sacrifice of your father Dakṣa, the reviling of Śiva was heard by you; / hearing the disagreeable words, your body was instantly abandoned by you.

1.3.s:
tatkṣaṇādeva nanvaṃgi hyadhunā kiṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā..
saṃbhramātkiṃ na jānāsi śivaniṃdakameva ca.. 34.106
kathaṃ vā parvataśreṣṭhājjātā se varavarṇini..
kathaṃ vā tapasogreṇa saṃtaptāsi sumadhyame.. 34.107 ..
1.3.d:
तत्क्षणादेव नन्वंगि ह्यधुना किं कृतं त्वया..
संभ्रमात्किं न जानासि शिवनिंदकमेव च.. 34.106
कथं वा पर्वतश्रेष्ठाज्जाता से वरवर्णिनि..
कथं वा तपसोग्रेण संतप्तासि सुमध्यमे.. 34.107 ..
1.3.m: Indeed at that very moment, O slender-limbed lady! What has been done by you now? / Do you not know yourself, in your agitation, to be a reviler of Śiva? / How was it that you were born from the best of mountains, O lady of excellent complexion? / How was it that you were heated by fierce austerity, O slender-waisted lady?

1.3.s:
sapremā ca śive bhaktistava nāstīha saṃprātam..
śivapriyāsi tanvaṃgi tasnādevaṃ bravīmi te.. 34.108 ..
1.3.d:
सप्रेमा च शिवे भक्तिस्तव नास्तीह संप्रातम्..
शिवप्रियासि तन्वंगि तस्नादेवं ब्रवीमि ते.. 34.108 ..
1.3.m: You have no loving devotion to Śiva at present. / You are dear to Śiva, O slender-limbed lady, therefore do I speak thus to you.

1.3.s:
śivātparataraṃ nānyattriṣu lokeṣu vidyate..
śive bhaktistvayā kāryā sapremā varavarṇini.. 34.109 ..
1.3.d:
शिवात्परतरं नान्यत्त्रिषु लोकेषु विद्यते..
शिवे भक्तिस्त्वया कार्या सप्रेमा वरवर्णिनि.. 34.109 ..
1.3.m: Nothing higher than Śiva exists in the three worlds; / loving devotion to Śiva must be performed by you, O lady of excellent complexion.

1.3.s:
bhaktāsi tvaṃ mahādevi mahābhāgyavatāṃ vare..
saṃsevyatāṃ prayatnena tapasopārjitastvayā.. 34.110 ..
1.3.d:
भक्तासि त्वं महादेवि महाभाग्यवतां वरे..
संसेव्यतां प्रयत्नेन तपसोपार्जितस्त्वया.. 34.110 ..
1.3.m: You are a devotee, O Mahādevī, best among the most fortunate; / let him who was acquired by you through austerity be attended upon with effort.

1.3.s:
śivo vareṇyaḥ sarveśo nānyathā kartumarhasi..
bhṛṃgiṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā girijā tamuvācaha.. 34.111 ..
1.3.d:
शिवो वरेण्यः सर्वेशो नान्यथा कर्तुमर्हसि..
भृंगिणो वचनं श्रुत्वा गिरिजा तमुवाचह.. 34.111 ..
1.3.m: Śiva is the most excellent, the Lord of all; you ought not to act otherwise.” / Hearing the words of Bhṛṅgin, Girijā said to him:

1.3.s:
..girijovāca..
re bhṛṃginmaunamālaṃbya sthiro bhavātha vā vraja..
vācyāvācyaṃ na jānāsi kiṃ bravīṣi piśācavat.. 34.112 ..
1.3.d:
..गिरिजोवाच..
रे भृंगिन्मौनमालंब्य स्थिरो भवाथ वा व्रज..
वाच्यावाच्यं न जानासि किं ब्रवीषि पिशाचवत्.. 34.112 ..
1.3.m: Girijā said: / “O Bhṛṅgin, maintain silence and remain steady, or else depart! / You do not know what should and should not be said; why do you babble like a Piśāca?”

1.3.s:
tapasā kena cānītaḥ kayā cāpi śivo hyayam..
kāhaṃ ko'sau tvayā jñāto bhedabuddhyā bravīṣi me.. 34.113 ..
1.3.d:
तपसा केन चानीतः कया चापि शिवो ह्ययम्..
काहं कोऽसौ त्वया ज्ञातो भेदबुद्ध्या ब्रवीषि मे.. 34.113 ..
1.3.m: By whose austerity was this Śiva brought, and by which woman? / Who am I, and who is he known by you [to be], that you speak to me with a mind of duality?

1.3.s:
ko'si tvaṃ kena yukto'si kasmācca bahu bhāṣase..
śāpaṃ tava pradāsyāmi śivaḥ kiṃ kurute'dhunā.. 34.114 ..
1.3.d:
कोऽसि त्वं केन युक्तोऽसि कस्माच्च बहु भाषसे..
शापं तव प्रदास्यामि शिवः किं कुरुतेऽधुना.. 34.114 ..
1.3.m: Who are you? With what are you endowed? And why do you babble so much? / I shall give you a curse; what can Śiva do now?

1.3.s:
bhṛṃgiṇoktā tiraskṛtya tadā śāpaṃ dadau satī..
nimāmo bhava re manda re bhṛṃgiñchiṃkarapriya.. 34.115 ..
1.3.d:
भृंगिणोक्ता तिरस्कृत्य तदा शापं ददौ सती..
निमामो भव रे मन्द रे भृंगिञ्छिंकरप्रिय.. 34.115 ..
1.3.m: Having addressed Bhṛṅgin with reproach, Satī then gave a curse: / 'Become devoid of flesh, O fool, O Bhṛṅgin, darling of Śaṃkara!'

1.3.s:
evamuktvā tadā devī pārvatī śaṃkarapriyā..
atha kopena saṃyuktā pārvatī śaṃkaraṃ tadā.. 34.116 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तदा देवी पार्वती शंकरप्रिया..
अथ कोपेन संयुक्ता पार्वती शंकरं तदा.. 34.116 ..
1.3.m: Having spoken thus, the goddess Pārvatī, beloved of Śaṃkara, / then filled with anger toward Śaṃkara,

1.3.s:
kara gṛhya ca tanvaṃgī bhujaṃgaṃ vāsukiṃ tathā..
udatārayatkaṃṭhātsā tathānyāni bahūni ca.. 34.117 ..
1.3.d:
कर गृह्य च तन्वंगी भुजंगं वासुकिं तथा..
उदतारयत्कंठात्सा तथान्यानि बहूनि च.. 34.117 ..
1.3.m: the slender-limbed woman seized [his] hand and pulled down the serpent Vāsuki from his neck, / as well as many other [ornaments].

1.3.s:
śaṃbhorjagrāha kupitā bhūṣaṇāni tvarānvitā..
hṛta caṃdrakalā tasya gajājinamanuttamam.. 34.118 ..
1.3.d:
शंभोर्जग्राह कुपिता भूषणानि त्वरान्विता..
हृत चंद्रकला तस्य गजाजिनमनुत्तमम्.. 34.118 ..
1.3.m: Enraged, she hastily stripped Śambhu of his ornaments: / his crescent moon was snatched away, and his peerless elephant hide;

1.3.s:
kaṃbalāśvatarau nāgau maheśakṛtabhūṣaṇau..
hṛtau tayā mahādevyā chaloktyāṃ ca prahasya vai.. 34.119 ..
1.3.d:
कंबलाश्वतरौ नागौ महेशकृतभूषणौ..
हृतौ तया महादेव्या छलोक्त्यां च प्रहस्य वै.. 34.119 ..
1.3.m: the two serpents Kambala and Aśvatara, who adorned Maheśa, / were seized by the great goddess, laughing with mocking words;

1.3.s:
kaupīnācchā danaṃ tasyā cchaloktyā ca prahasya vai..
tadā gaṇāśca sakhyaśca trapayā pīḍitā bhavan.. 34.120 ..
1.3.d:
कौपीनाच्छा दनं तस्या च्छलोक्त्या च प्रहस्य वै..
तदा गणाश्च सख्यश्च त्रपया पीडिता भवन्.. 34.120 ..
1.3.m: and with mocking words, laughing, she [snatched] the covering of his loincloth. / Then the gaṇas and her companions became afflicted with embarrassment.

1.3.s:
parāṅgamukhāśca saṃjātā bhṛṅgī caiva mahātapāḥ..
tathā caṇḍo hi muṇḍaśca mahālomā mahodaraḥ.. 34.121 ..
1.3.d:
पराङ्गमुखाश्च संजाता भृङ्गी चैव महातपाः..
तथा चण्डो हि मुण्डश्च महालोमा महोदरः.. 34.121 ..
1.3.m: Their faces turned away, both Bhṛṅgī of great austerity, / and Caṇḍa, Muṇḍa, Mahāloman, and Mahodara;

1.3.s:
ete cānye ca bahavo gaṇāste duḥkhino'bhavan..
tāṃśca dṛṣṭvā tathābhūtanmaheśo lajjito'bhavat.. 34.122 ..
1.3.d:
एते चान्ये च बहवो गणास्ते दुःखिनोऽभवन्..
तांश्च दृष्ट्वा तथाभूतन्महेशो लज्जितोऽभवत्.. 34.122 ..
1.3.m: these and many other gaṇas of his became dejected. / And seeing them in such a state, Maheśa was ashamed.

1.3.s: uvāca vākyaṃ ruṣitaḥ pārvatīṃ prati śaṃkaraḥ.. 34.123 ..
1.3.d: उवाच वाक्यं रुषितः पार्वतीं प्रति शंकरः.. 34.123 ..
1.3.m: Enraged, Śaṃkara addressed these words to Pārvatī:

1.3.s:
..rudra uvāca..
upahāsaṃ prakurvaṃti sarve hi ṛṣayo bhṛśam..
tathā brahmā ca viṣṇuśca tathā cendrādayo hyamī.. 34.124 ..
1.3.d:
..रुद्र उवाच..
उपहासं प्रकुर्वंति सर्वे हि ऋषयो भृशम्..
तथा ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च तथा चेन्द्रादयो ह्यमी.. 34.124 ..
1.3.m: Rudra said: / 'All the seers are mocking severely, / and likewise Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and these gods led by Indra;

1.3.s:
upahāsaparāḥ sarve kiṃ tvayādya kṛtaṃ śubhe..
kule jātāsi tanvaṃgi kathamevaṃ kariṣyasi.. 34.125 ..
1.3.d:
उपहासपराः सर्वे किं त्वयाद्य कृतं शुभे..
कुले जातासि तन्वंगि कथमेवं करिष्यसि.. 34.125 ..
1.3.m: they are all intent on mockery! What have you done today, auspicious lady? / You were born in a noble family, slender-limbed woman; how can you act thus?

1.3.s:
tvayā jito hyahaṃ subhru yadi jānāsi tattvataḥ..
tarhyevaṃ kuru me dehi kaupīnācchādanaṃ param..
dehi kaupī nāmātraṃ me nānyathā kartumarhasi.. 34.126 ..
1.3.d:
त्वया जितो ह्यहं सुभ्रु यदि जानासि तत्त्वतः..
तर्ह्येवं कुरु मे देहि कौपीनाच्छादनं परम्..
देहि कौपी नामात्रं मे नान्यथा कर्तुमर्हसि.. 34.126 ..
1.3.m: I was indeed defeated by you, fair-browed lady, if you truly know it; / therefore do this: give me back the excellent covering of my loincloth. / Give me merely the loincloth; you ought not to act otherwise!'

1.3.s:
evamuktā satī tena śaṃbhunā yoginā tadā..
prahasya vākyaṃ provāca pārvatī rucirānanā.. 34.127 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्ता सती तेन शंभुना योगिना तदा..
प्रहस्य वाक्यं प्रोवाच पार्वती रुचिरानना.. 34.127 ..
1.3.m: Addressed thus then by that Śambhu, the yogin, / Satī Pārvatī of charming countenance laughed and said:

1.3.s:
kiṃ kaupīnena te kāryaṃ muninā bhāvitātmanā..
digambareṇaiva tadā kṛtaṃ dāruvanaṃ tathā.. 34.128 ..
1.3.d:
किं कौपीनेन ते कार्यं मुनिना भावितात्मना..
दिगम्बरेणैव तदा कृतं दारुवनं तथा.. 34.128 ..
1.3.m: 'What need have you of a loincloth, a sage whose soul is purified? / For space-clad did you enter the Pine Forest back then;

1.3.s:
bhikṣāṭanamiṣeṇaiva ṛṣipatnyo virohitāḥ..
gaccha taste tadā śaṃbho pūjanaṃ tairmahatkṛtam.. 34.129 ..
1.3.d:
भिक्षाटनमिषेणैव ऋषिपत्न्यो विरोहिताः..
गच्छ तस्ते तदा शंभो पूजनं तैर्महत्कृतम्.. 34.129 ..
1.3.m: under the pretext of wandering for alms, the wives of the seers were enchanted. / When you departed then, O Śambhu, a great worship was performed by them;

1.3.s:
kaupīnaṃ patitaṃ tatra munibhirnānyathoditam..
tasmāttvayā prahātavyaṃ dyūtohāritameva tat.. 34.130 ..
1.3.d:
कौपीनं पतितं तत्र मुनिभिर्नान्यथोदितम्..
तस्मात्त्वया प्रहातव्यं द्यूतोहारितमेव तत्.. 34.130 ..
1.3.m: the loincloth fell there, as told by the sages without falsehood. / Therefore you must surrender it; it was truly lost in the gambling match!'

1.3.s:
tacchrutvā kupito rudraḥ pārvatīṃ parameśvaraḥ..
nirīkṣamāṇo'tiruṣā tṛtīyenaiva cakṣuṣā.. 34.131 ..
1.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा कुपितो रुद्रः पार्वतीं परमेश्वरः..
निरीक्षमाणोऽतिरुषा तृतीयेनैव चक्षुषा.. 34.131 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that, Rudra, the supreme lord, became enraged, / staring at Pārvatī in extreme wrath with his third eye alone.

1.3.s:
kupitaṃ śaṃkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā sarva devagaṇāstadā..
bhayena mahatāviṣṭāstathā gaṇakumārakāḥ.. 34.132 ..
1.3.d:
कुपितं शंकरं दृष्ट्वा सर्व देवगणास्तदा..
भयेन महताविष्टास्तथा गणकुमारकाः.. 34.132 ..
1.3.m: Seeing Śaṃkara enraged, all the troops of gods then / and the young gaṇas were seized by great terror.

1.3.s:
ūcuḥ sarve śanaistatra śaṃkitena parasparam..
adyāyaṃ kupito rudro girijāṃ prati saṃprati.. 34.133 ..
1.3.d:
ऊचुः सर्वे शनैस्तत्र शंकितेन परस्परम्..
अद्यायं कुपितो रुद्रो गिरिजां प्रति संप्रति.. 34.133 ..
1.3.m: Anxiously they all whispered there to one another: / 'Today Rudra is enraged against Girijā now;

1.3.s:
yathā hi madano dagdhastatheyaṃ nānyathā vacaḥ..
evaṃ mīmāṃsamānāste gaṇā devarṣayastadā.. 34.134 ..
1.3.d:
यथा हि मदनो दग्धस्तथेयं नान्यथा वचः..
एवं मीमांसमानास्ते गणा देवर्षयस्तदा.. 34.134 ..
1.3.m: just as the god of love was burned, so will she be—the words are not otherwise.' / While those gaṇas and divine seers were thus deliberating,

1.3.s:
vilokitāstayā devyā sarve saubhāgyamudrayā..
uvāca prahasanneva satī satpuruṣaṃ tadā.. 34.135 ..
1.3.d:
विलोकितास्तया देव्या सर्वे सौभाग्यमुद्रया..
उवाच प्रहसन्नेव सती सत्पुरुषं तदा.. 34.135 ..
1.3.m: they were all looked upon by the goddess with the gesture of good fortune. / Then, laughing, Satī said to the noble person:

1.3.s:
kimālokaparo bhūtvā cakṣuṣā parameṇa hi..
nāhaṃ kālo na kāmo'haṃ nāhaṃ dabhasya vai makhaḥ.. 34.136 ..
1.3.d:
किमालोकपरो भूत्वा चक्षुषा परमेण हि..
नाहं कालो न कामोऽहं नाहं दभस्य वै मखः.. 34.136 ..
1.3.m: 'Why are you intent on glaring with your supreme eye? / I am not Time, I am not desire, nor am I the sacrifice of Dakṣa;

1.3.s:
tripuro naiva vai śaṃbho nāṃdhako vṛṣabhadhvaja..
vīkṣitenaiva kiṃ tena tava cādya bhaviṣyati..
vṛthaiva tvaṃ virūpākṣo jāto'si mama cāgrataḥ.. 34.137 ..
1.3.d:
त्रिपुरो नैव वै शंभो नांधको वृषभध्वज..
वीक्षितेनैव किं तेन तव चाद्य भविष्यति..
वृथैव त्वं विरूपाक्षो जातोऽसि मम चाग्रतः.. 34.137 ..
1.3.m: I am not Tripura, O Śambhu, nor Andhaka, O you whose banner bears the bull! / What will you achieve today by merely glaring? / In vain have you become three-eyed before me!'

1.3.s:
evamādīnyanekāni hayuvāca parameśvarī..
niśamya devo vākyāni gamanāya mano dadhe.. 34.138 ..
1.3.d:
एवमादीन्यनेकानि हयुवाच परमेश्वरी..
निशम्य देवो वाक्यानि गमनाय मनो दधे.. 34.138 ..
1.3.m: The supreme goddess spoke these and many other such words. / Hearing the words, the god set his mind on departing:

1.3.s:
vanameva varaṃ cādya vijanaṃ paramārthataḥ..
ekākī yatacittātmā tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ.. 34.139 ..
1.3.d:
वनमेव वरं चाद्य विजनं परमार्थतः..
एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः.. 34.139 ..
1.3.m: 'Solitary forest alone is better today, desolate in ultimate truth, / [for one who is] alone, self-controlled in mind and soul, having abandoned all possessions.

1.3.s:
sa sukhī paramārthajñaḥ sa vidvānsa ca paṃḍitaḥ..
yena muktau kāmarāgau sa muktaḥ sa sukhī bhavet.. 34.140 ..
1.3.d:
स सुखी परमार्थज्ञः स विद्वान्स च पंडितः..
येन मुक्तौ कामरागौ स मुक्तः स सुखी भवेत्.. 34.140 ..
1.3.m: He is happy, he knows the ultimate truth, he is learned, and he is wise, / by whom desire and passion have been abandoned; he is liberated, he is happy.'

1.3.s:
evaṃ vimṛśya ca tadā girijāṃ vihāya śrīśaṃkaraḥ paramakāruṇikastadānīm..
yātaḥ priyāvirahito vanamadbhutaṃ ca siddhāṭavīṃ paramahaṃsayutāṃ tathaiva.. 34.141 ..
1.3.d:
एवं विमृश्य च तदा गिरिजां विहाय श्रीशंकरः परमकारुणिकस्तदानीम्..
यातः प्रियाविरहितो वनमद्भुतं च सिद्धाटवीं परमहंसयुतां तथैव.. 34.141 ..
1.3.m: Having reflected thus, leaving Girijā behind, the glorious Śaṃkara, supremely compassionate at that time, / separated from his beloved, went to the wondrous forest, the forest of the perfected filled with supreme ascetics.

1.3.s:
nirgataṃ śaṃkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve kailāsavāsinaḥ..
niryayuśca gaṇāḥ sarve vīrabhadrādayo'nu tam.. 34.142 ..
1.3.d:
निर्गतं शंकरं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे कैलासवासिनः..
निर्ययुश्च गणाः सर्वे वीरभद्रादयोऽनु तम्.. 34.142 ..
1.3.m: Seeing Śaṃkara depart, all the inhabitants of Kailāsa / and all the gaṇas led by Vīrabhadra followed after him.

1.3.s:
chatraṃ bhṛṃgī samādāya jagāma tasya pṛṣṭhataḥ..
cāmare vījyamāne ca gaṃgāyamunasannibhe.. 34.143 ..
1.3.d:
छत्रं भृंगी समादाय जगाम तस्य पृष्ठतः..
चामरे वीज्यमाने च गंगायमुनसन्निभे.. 34.143 ..
1.3.m: Taking the parasol, Bhṛṅgī walked behind him, / while two fly-whisks, resembling the Gaṅgā and Yamunā, were fanned.

1.3.s:
tābhyāṃ yuktastadā naṃdī pṛṣṭhato'nvagamatsudhīḥ..
vṛṣabhoṃ hyagrato bhūtvā puṣpakeṇa virājitaḥ.. 34.144 ..
1.3.d:
ताभ्यां युक्तस्तदा नंदी पृष्ठतोऽन्वगमत्सुधीः..
वृषभों ह्यग्रतो भूत्वा पुष्पकेण विराजितः.. 34.144 ..
1.3.m: Endowed with them, the wise Nandī then followed behind; / the bull, resplendent with flowers, went in front.

1.3.s:
śobhamāno mahādeva ebhiḥ sarvaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ..
aṃtaḥpuragatā devī pārvatī sā hi durmanāḥ.. 34.145 ..
1.3.d:
शोभमानो महादेव एभिः सर्वैः सुशोभनैः..
अंतःपुरगता देवी पार्वती सा हि दुर्मनाः.. 34.145 ..
1.3.m: While Mahādeva shone with all these splendid [attendants], / the goddess Pārvatī, having gone into the inner chambers, became dejected.

1.3.s:
sakhībhirbahubhistatra tathānyābhiḥ susaṃvṛtā..
girijā ciṃtayāmāsa manasā parameśvaram.. 34.146 ..
1.3.d:
सखीभिर्बहुभिस्तत्र तथान्याभिः सुसंवृता..
गिरिजा चिंतयामास मनसा परमेश्वरम्.. 34.146 ..
1.3.m: Surrounded there by her many companions and other women, / Girijā meditated in her mind upon the supreme lord.

1.3.s:
tato dūraṃ gataḥ śaṃbhurvisṛjya ca gaṇāṃstadā..
gaṇeśaṃ ca kumāraṃ ca vīrabhadraṃ tathā'parān.. 34.147 ..
1.3.d:
ततो दूरं गतः शंभुर्विसृज्य च गणांस्तदा..
गणेशं च कुमारं च वीरभद्रं तथाऽपरान्.. 34.147 ..
1.3.m: Having gone far from there, Śambhu then dismissed the gaṇas: / Gaṇeśa, Kumāra, Vīrabhadra, and the others,

1.3.s:
bhṛṃgiṇaṃ naṃdinaṃ caṃḍaṃ somanaṃdinameva ca..
etānanyāṃśca sarvāṃśca kailāsapuravāsinaḥ.. 34.148 ..
1.3.d:
भृंगिणं नंदिनं चंडं सोमनंदिनमेव च..
एतानन्यांश्च सर्वांश्च कैलासपुरवासिनः.. 34.148 ..
1.3.m: Bhṛṅgin, Nandin, Caṇḍa, and Somanandin, / having dismissed these and all the others who dwelt in the city of Kailāsa,

1.3.s:
visṛjya ca mahādeva eka eva mahātapāḥ..
gato dūraṃ vanasyāṃte tathā siddhavaṭaṃ śivaḥ.. 34.149 ..
1.3.d:
विसृज्य च महादेव एक एव महातपाः..
गतो दूरं वनस्यांते तथा सिद्धवटं शिवः.. 34.149 ..
1.3.m: Mahādeva, the great ascetic Śiva, completely alone, / went far away to the edge of the forest, to the Banyan of the Perfected.

1.3.s:
kāśmīraratnopalasiddharatnavaidūryacitraṃ sudhayā pariṣkṛtam..
divyāsanaṃ tasya ca kalpitaṃ bhuvā tatrāsthito yogapatirmaheśaḥ.. 34.150 ..
1.3.d:
काश्मीररत्नोपलसिद्धरत्नवैदूर्यचित्रं सुधया परिष्कृतम्..
दिव्यासनं तस्य च कल्पितं भुवा तत्रास्थितो योगपतिर्महेशः.. 34.150 ..
1.3.m: A celestial seat was fashioned for him by the earth, adorned with saffron, gems, stones, stones of the perfected, and lapis lazuli, and beautified with nectar; / upon it sat Maheśa, the lord of yoga.

1.3.s:
padmāsane copaviṣṭo maheśo yogavittamaḥ..
kevalaṃ cātmanātmānaṃ dadhyau mīlitalocanaḥ.. 34.151 ..
1.3.d:
पद्मासने चोपविष्टो महेशो योगवित्तमः..
केवलं चात्मनात्मानं दध्यौ मीलितलोचनः.. 34.151 ..
1.3.m: Seated in the lotus posture, Maheśa, the supreme knower of yoga, / with closed eyes meditated on the Self solely by the Self.

1.3.s:
śuśubhe sa mahādevaḥ samādhau caṃdraśekharaḥ..
yogapaṭṭaḥ kṛtastena śeṣasya ca mahātmanaḥ..
vāsukiḥ sarparājaśca kaṭibaddhaḥ kṛto mahān.. 34.152 ..
1.3.d:
शुशुभे स महादेवः समाधौ चंद्रशेखरः..
योगपट्टः कृतस्तेन शेषस्य च महात्मनः..
वासुकिः सर्पराजश्च कटिबद्धः कृतो महान्.. 34.152 ..
1.3.m: Mahādeva, the moon-crested god, shone in deep meditation; / a yogic band was made by him out of the great-souled Śeṣa, / and Vāsuki, king of serpents, was bound tightly around his waist.

1.3.s:
ātmānamātmātmatayā ca saṃstuto vedāṃtavedyo na hi viśvaceṣṭitaḥ..
eko hyaneko hi duraṃtapārastathā hyarkyo nijabodharūpaḥ..
sthitastadānīṃ paramaṃ parāṇāṃ nirīkṣamāṇo bhuvanaikabhartā.. 34.153 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe śivaśāstre śivapārvatīdyūtaprasaṃgena pārvatīhāritasarvasvasya śivasya kailāsaṃ vihāya tapovanagamanavarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 34 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
आत्मानमात्मात्मतया च संस्तुतो वेदांतवेद्यो न हि विश्वचेष्टितः..
एको ह्यनेको हि दुरंतपारस्तथा ह्यर्क्यो निजबोधरूपः..
स्थितस्तदानीं परमं पराणां निरीक्षमाणो भुवनैकभर्ता.. 34.153 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखंडे शिवशास्त्रे शिवपार्वतीद्यूतप्रसंगेन पार्वतीहारितसर्वस्वस्य शिवस्य कैलासं विहाय तपोवनगमनवर्णनंनाम चतुस्त्रिंशोऽध्यायः.. 34 .. छ ..
1.3.m:
Praised by the Self through the nature of the Self, known through the Upaniṣads, untouched by worldly actions, / one yet manifold, of boundless shore, beyond thought, whose form is pure consciousness, / the sole protector of the universe remained at that time, beholding the highest of the high.
Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter, entitled "The Description of Śiva's Departure to the Penance Grove after Leaving Kailāsa, Having Lost All His Belongings to Pārvatī in the Dice Game," in the Śiva-Śāstra of the Kedārakhaṇḍa, in the first Māheśvarakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses.

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
vanaṃ gate mahādeve girijā virahāturā..
sukhaṃ na lebhe tanvaṃgī harmyeṣvāyataneṣu vā.. 35.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
वनं गते महादेवे गिरिजा विरहातुरा..
सुखं न लेभे तन्वंगी हर्म्येष्वायतनेषु वा.. 35.1 ..
1.3.m: Lomaśa said: / When Mahādeva went to the forest, the daughter of the mountain, distressed by separation, / the slender-limbed lady found no joy in palaces or shrines.

1.3.s:
ciṃtayaṃtī śivaṃtanvī sarvabhāvena śobhanā..
ciṃtamānāṃ śivāṃ jñātvā hyuvāca vijayā sakhī.. 35.2 ..
1.3.d:
चिंतयंती शिवंतन्वी सर्वभावेन शोभना..
चिंतमानां शिवां ज्ञात्वा ह्युवाच विजया सखी.. 35.2 ..
1.3.m: The slender, fair woman meditated on Śiva with all her heart. / Knowing that Śivā was thus contemplating, her friend Vijayā said:

1.3.s:
..vijayovāca..
tapasā mahatā caiva śivaṃ prāptāsi śobhane..
mṛṣaśā dyūtaṃ kṛtaṃ tena śaṃkareṇa tapasvinā.. 35.3 ..
1.3.d:
..विजयोवाच..
तपसा महता चैव शिवं प्राप्तासि शोभने..
मृषशा द्यूतं कृतं तेन शंकरेण तपस्विना.. 35.3 ..
1.3.m: Vijayā said: / Through great tapas, O fair lady, you obtained Śiva. / In vain was that dice game played by the ascetic Śaṃkara.

1.3.s:
dyūte hi vahavo doṣā na śrutāḥ kiṃ tvayā'naghe..
kṣamā paya śivaṃ tanvi tvareṇaiva vicakṣaṇe.. 35.4 ..
1.3.d:
द्यूते हि वहवो दोषा न श्रुताः किं त्वयाऽनघे..
क्षमा पय शिवं तन्वि त्वरेणैव विचक्षणे.. 35.4 ..
1.3.m: Have you not heard of the many faults in gambling, O faultless one? / Pacify Śiva at once, O slender-limbed, wise woman!

1.3.s: asmābhiḥ sahitā devi gacchagaccha varānane.. 35.5 ..
1.3.d: अस्माभिः सहिता देवि गच्छगच्छ वरानने.. 35.5 ..
1.3.m: Go, go together with us, O goddess of lovely face!

1.3.s:
yāvacchaṃbhurdūrato nābhigacchettāvadgatvā śaṃkaraṃ kṣāmayasva..
no cetanvi kṣāmayethāḥ śivaṃ tvaṃ duḥkhaṃ paścātte bhaviṣyatyavaśyam.. 35.6 ..
1.3.d:
यावच्छंभुर्दूरतो नाभिगच्छेत्तावद्गत्वा शंकरं क्षामयस्व..
नो चेतन्वि क्षामयेथाः शिवं त्वं दुःखं पश्चात्ते भविष्यत्यवश्यम्.. 35.6 ..
1.3.m: Before Śambhu goes far away, go and seek Śaṃkara's forgiveness. / Otherwise, O slender lady, if you do not pacify Śiva, sorrow will surely come upon you later.

1.3.s:
niśamya vākya vijayāprayuktaṃ prahasyāmānā samadhīracetāḥ..
uvāca vākyaṃ vijayāṃ sakhīṃ ca āścaryabhūtaṃ paramārthayuktam.. 35.7 ..
1.3.d:
निशम्य वाक्य विजयाप्रयुक्तं प्रहस्यामाना समधीरचेताः..
उवाच वाक्यं विजयां सखीं च आश्चर्यभूतं परमार्थयुक्तम्.. 35.7 ..
1.3.m: Hearing the words spoken by Vijayā, smiling, with a deeply composed mind, / she spoke to her friend Vijayā wondrous words full of ultimate truth:

1.3.s:
mayā jito'sau nirapatrapaśca purā vṛto vai parayā vibhūtyā..
kiṃcicca kṛtyaṃ mama nāsti sadyo mayā vināsau ca virūpa āsthitaḥ.. 35.8 ..
1.3.d:
मया जितोऽसौ निरपत्रपश्च पुरा वृतो वै परया विभूत्या..
किंचिच्च कृत्यं मम नास्ति सद्यो मया विनासौ च विरूप आस्थितः.. 35.8 ..
1.3.m: "He was defeated by me, shameless, though chosen of old with supreme majesty. / I have no urgent need [of him]; without me, he has become formless and deformed.

1.3.s:
rūpīkṛto mayā devo maheśo nānyathā vada..
mayā tena viyogaśca saṃyogo naiva jāyate.. 35.9 ..
1.3.d:
रूपीकृतो मया देवो महेशो नान्यथा वद..
मया तेन वियोगश्च संयोगो नैव जायते.. 35.9 ..
1.3.m: The god Maheśa was given form by me; do not speak otherwise. / Between me and him there is neither separation nor union.

1.3.s: sākāro hi nirākāro maheśo hi mayā kṛtaḥ.. 35.10 ..
1.3.d: साकारो हि निराकारो महेशो हि मया कृतः.. 35.10 ..
1.3.m: Maheśa, though formless, was indeed made with form by me.

1.3.s:
kṛtaṃ mayā viśvamidaṃ samagraṃ carācaraṃ devavaraiḥ sametam..
krīḍārthamasyodbhavavṛttihetubhiścikrīḍitaṃ me vijaye prapaśya.. 35.11 ..
1.3.d:
कृतं मया विश्वमिदं समग्रं चराचरं देववरैः समेतम्..
क्रीडार्थमस्योद्भववृत्तिहेतुभिश्चिक्रीडितं मे विजये प्रपश्य.. 35.11 ..
1.3.m: This entire universe, moving and unmoving, together with the foremost gods, was created by me. / Behold, O Vijayā, my sport, undertaken for the sake of play, through the causes of its creation and existence."

1.3.s:
evamuktvā tadā devī girijā sarvamaṃgalā..
śabarīrūpamāsthāya gaṃtukāmā maheśvaram.. 35.12 ..
1.3.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तदा देवी गिरिजा सर्वमंगला..
शबरीरूपमास्थाय गंतुकामा महेश्वरम्.. 35.12 ..
1.3.m: Having spoken thus, the goddess Girijā, the all-auspicious, / assumed the form of a Śabarī tribal woman, wishing to approach Maheśvara.

1.3.s:
śyāmā tanvī śikharadaśanā biṃbabiṃbādharoṣṭhī sugrīvāḍhyā kucabharanatā girijā snigdhakeśī..
madhye kṣāmā pṛthukaṭitaṭā hemaraṃbhorugaurī pallīyuktā varavalayinī barhibarhāvataṃsā.. 35.13 ..
1.3.d:
श्यामा तन्वी शिखरदशना बिंबबिंबाधरोष्ठी सुग्रीवाढ्या कुचभरनता गिरिजा स्निग्धकेशी..
मध्ये क्षामा पृथुकटितटा हेमरंभोरुगौरी पल्लीयुक्ता वरवलयिनी बर्हिबर्हावतंसा.. 35.13 ..
1.3.m: Girijā was youthful and slender, with pointed teeth, lips like the bimba fruit, a noble neck, bent with the weight of her breasts, and glossy hair; / slender at the waist, broad-hipped, fair with thighs like golden plantains, belonging to the wilderness hamlet, wearing excellent bangles, and adorned with peacock feathers as ear-ornaments.

1.3.s:
pāṇau mṛṇālasadṛśaṃ dadhatī ca cāpaṃ pṛṣṭhe lasatkṛtakaketakibāṇakośam..
sā taṃ nirīśamalokayati sma tatra saṃsevitā suvadanā bahubhiḥ sakhībhiḥ.. 35.14 ..
1.3.d:
पाणौ मृणालसदृशं दधती च चापं पृष्ठे लसत्कृतककेतकिबाणकोशम्..
सा तं निरीशमलोकयति स्म तत्र संसेविता सुवदना बहुभिः सखीभिः.. 35.14 ..
1.3.m: Holding in her hand a bow resembling a lotus stalk, with a gleaming quiver of arrows made of ketakī on her back, / attended by many female friends, the lovely-faced one saw him there, the lord without an equal.

1.3.s:
bhṛṃgīnādena mahatā nādayaṃtī jagattrayam..
girijā manmathaṃ sadyo jīvayaṃtī punaḥpunaḥ.. 35.15 ..
1.3.d:
भृंगीनादेन महता नादयंती जगत्त्रयम्..
गिरिजा मन्मथं सद्यो जीवयंती पुनःपुनः.. 35.15 ..
1.3.m: Making the three worlds resound with the great humming of bees, / Girijā brought Manmatha back to life, again and again.

1.3.s:
sakāmanā rājahaṃsā babhūvustatkṣaṇādapi..
dvirephā barhiṇaścaiva sarve te hṛcchayānvitāḥ.. 35 16 ..
1.3.d:
सकामना राजहंसा बभूवुस्तत्क्षणादपि..
द्विरेफा बर्हिणश्चैव सर्वे ते हृच्छयान्विताः.. 35 16 ..
1.3.m: At that very instant, the royal swans became filled with desire; / bees and peacocks—all of them were overcome with love.

1.3.s:
ekākī saṃsthito yatra yamādhistho maheśvaraḥ..
dṛṣṭastatastayā devyā bhṛṃgīnādena mohitaḥ.. 35.17 ..
1.3.d:
एकाकी संस्थितो यत्र यमाधिस्थो महेश्वरः..
दृष्टस्ततस्तया देव्या भृंगीनादेन मोहितः.. 35.17 ..
1.3.m: Where Maheśvara remained alone, established in deep absorption, / he was seen there by the goddess, enchanted by the humming sound of the bees.

1.3.s:
prabaddho hi mahādevo nirīkṣya śabarīṃ tadā..
samādherutthitaḥ sadyo maheśo madanānvitaḥ.. 35.18 ..
1.3.d:
प्रबद्धो हि महादेवो निरीक्ष्य शबरीं तदा..
समाधेरुत्थितः सद्यो महेशो मदनान्वितः.. 35.18 ..
1.3.m: Then Mahādeva, captivated upon seeing the Śabarī woman, / at once arose from his absorption, Maheśa filled with love.

1.3.s:
yāvatkare gṛhyamāṇo girijāṃ sa samīpagaḥ..
tāvattasya puraḥ sadyastirodhānaṃ gatā satī.. 35.19 ..
1.3.d:
यावत्करे गृह्यमाणो गिरिजां स समीपगः..
तावत्तस्य पुरः सद्यस्तिरोधानं गता सती.. 35.19 ..
1.3.m: Just as he approached to seize Girijā by the hand, / so quickly did Satī disappear before him.

1.3.s:
taddṛṣṭvā tatkṣaṇādeva devo bhrāṃtivināśanaḥ..
bhramamāṇastadā śaṃbhurnāpaśyadasitekṣaṇām.. 35.20 ..
1.3.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा तत्क्षणादेव देवो भ्रांतिविनाशनः..
भ्रममाणस्तदा शंभुर्नापश्यदसितेक्षणाम्.. 35.20 ..
1.3.m: Seeing that, the god who destroys delusions, / wandering about at that moment, Śambhu did not see the dark-eyed woman.

1.3.s:
viraheṇa samāyukto hṛcchayena samanvitaḥ..
madanāristadā śaṃbhurjñānarūpo niraṃtaram.. 35.21 ..
1.3.d:
विरहेण समायुक्तो हृच्छयेन समन्वितः..
मदनारिस्तदा शंभुर्ज्ञानरूपो निरंतरम्.. 35.21 ..
1.3.m: Stricken with separation, overcome by desire, / Śambhu, the enemy of Madana, who is ever of the nature of pure consciousness,

1.3.s:
nirmoho mohamāpanno dadarśa girijāṃ punaḥ..
uvāca vākyaṃ śabarīṃ prastāva sadṛśaṃ mahat.. 35.22 ..
1.3.d:
निर्मोहो मोहमापन्नो ददर्श गिरिजां पुनः..
उवाच वाक्यं शबरीं प्रस्ताव सदृशं महत्.. 35.22 ..
1.3.m: though free from delusion, fell into delusion, and saw Girijā again. / He spoke great words suited to the occasion to the Śabarī woman:

1.3.s:
..śiva uvāca..
vākyaṃ me śrṛṇu tanvaṃgi śrutvā tatkartumarhasi..
kāsi kasyāsi tanvaṃgi kimarthamaṭanaṃ vane..
tatkathyatāṃ mahābhāge yāthātathyaṃ sumadhyame.. 35.23 ..
1.3.d:
..शिव उवाच..
वाक्यं मे श्रृणु तन्वंगि श्रुत्वा तत्कर्तुमर्हसि..
कासि कस्यासि तन्वंगि किमर्थमटनं वने..
तत्कथ्यतां महाभागे याथातथ्यं सुमध्यमे.. 35.23 ..
1.3.m: Śiva said: / "Listen to my words, O slender-limbed lady, and having heard them, you should act upon them. / Who are you, whose are you, O slender woman, and for what purpose are you wandering in the forest? / Tell me truly, O highly fortunate one of lovely waist!"

1.3.s:
..śivovāca..
patimanveṣayiṣyāmi sarvajñaṃ sakalārthadam..
svataṃtraṃ nirvikāraṃ ca jagatāmīśvaraṃ varam.. 35.24 ..
1.3.d:
..शिवोवाच..
पतिमन्वेषयिष्यामि सर्वज्ञं सकलार्थदम्..
स्वतंत्रं निर्विकारं च जगतामीश्वरं वरम्.. 35.24 ..
1.3.m: Śivā said: / "I seek a husband who is omniscient, bestowing all desires, / independent, immutable, the supreme Lord of the worlds."

1.3.s:
ityuktaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ girijāṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ..
ahaṃ tavocito bhadre patirnānyo hi bhāmini.. 35.25 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युक्तः प्रत्युवाचेदं गिरिजां वृषभध्वजः..
अहं तवोचितो भद्रे पतिर्नान्यो हि भामिनि.. 35.25 ..
1.3.m: Addressed thus, the bull-bannered lord replied to Girijā: / "I am your fitting husband, O auspicious lady; none other is, O beautiful woman!

1.3.s:
vimṛśyatāṃ varārohe tattvato hi varānane..
vaco niśamya rudrasya smitapūrvamabhāṣata.. 35.26 ..
1.3.d:
विमृश्यतां वरारोहे तत्त्वतो हि वरानने..
वचो निशम्य रुद्रस्य स्मितपूर्वमभाषत.. 35.26 ..
1.3.m: Consider this in truth, O lady of fair hips and lovely face!" / Hearing the words of Rudra, she spoke with a smile:

1.3.s:
mayārthito mahābhāga patistvaṃ nānyathā vada..
kiṃ tu vakṣyāmi bhadraṃ te nirguṇo'si paraṃtapaḥ.. 35.27 ..
1.3.d:
मयार्थितो महाभाग पतिस्त्वं नान्यथा वद..
किं तु वक्ष्यामि भद्रं ते निर्गुणोऽसि परंतपः.. 35.27 ..
1.3.m: "You are desired by me as husband, O highly fortunate one; do not speak otherwise. / But I tell you—blessing be upon you—you are devoid of qualities, an ascetic scorcher of foes.

1.3.s:
yayā purā vṛto'si tvaṃ tapasā ca pareṇa hi..
parityaktā tvayāraṇye kṣaṇamātreṇa bhāminī.. 35.28 ..
1.3.d:
यया पुरा वृतोऽसि त्वं तपसा च परेण हि..
परित्यक्ता त्वयारण्ये क्षणमात्रेण भामिनी.. 35.28 ..
1.3.m: She by whom you were chosen of old through supreme tapas, / that passionate woman was abandoned by you in the forest in a mere moment.

1.3.s:
durārādhyo'si satataṃ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmapi..
tasmānna vācyaṃ hi punaryaduktaṃ te mamāgrataḥ.. 35.29 ..
1.3.d:
दुराराध्योऽसि सततं सर्वेषां प्राणिनामपि..
तस्मान्न वाच्यं हि पुनर्यदुक्तं ते ममाग्रतः.. 35.29 ..
1.3.m: You are difficult to propitiate constantly for all living beings. / Therefore, what you said before me must not be repeated."

1.3.s:
śabaryā vacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca vṛṣadhvajaḥ..
maivaṃ vada viśālākṣi na tyaktā sā tapasvinī..
yadi tyaktā mayā tanvi kiṃ vaktumiha pāryate.. 35.30 ..
1.3.d:
शबर्या वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच वृषध्वजः..
मैवं वद विशालाक्षि न त्यक्ता सा तपस्विनी..
यदि त्यक्ता मया तन्वि किं वक्तुमिह पार्यते.. 35.30 ..
1.3.m: Hearing the words of the Śabarī woman, the bull-bannered god replied: / "Do not speak thus, O large-eyed woman; that ascetic woman has not been abandoned. / If she was abandoned by me, O slender lady, what more can be said here?

1.3.s:
evaṃ jñātvā viśālākṣi kṛpaṇaṃ kṛpaṇapriyam..
tasmāttvayā hi kartavyaṃ vacanaṃ me sumadhyame.. 35.31 ..
1.3.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा विशालाक्षि कृपणं कृपणप्रियम्..
तस्मात्त्वया हि कर्तव्यं वचनं मे सुमध्यमे.. 35.31 ..
1.3.m: Knowing me thus, O large-eyed woman, as pitiable and fond of the distressed, / therefore, O lady of lovely waist, you should obey my word."

1.3.s:
evamabhyarthitā tena bahudhā śūlapāṇinā..
prahasya girijā prāha upahāsaparaṃ vaca.. 35.32 ..
1.3.d:
एवमभ्यर्थिता तेन बहुधा शूलपाणिना..
प्रहस्य गिरिजा प्राह उपहासपरं वच.. 35.32 ..
1.3.m: Being thus entreated in many ways by the trident-bearing god, / Girijā laughed and spoke words full of mockery:

1.3.s:
tapodhano'si yogīśa virakto'si niraṃjanaḥ..
ātmārāmo hi nirdvaṃdvo madano yena ghātitaḥ.. 35.33 ..
1.3.d:
तपोधनोऽसि योगीश विरक्तोऽसि निरंजनः..
आत्मारामो हि निर्द्वंद्वो मदनो येन घातितः.. 35.33 ..
1.3.m: "You are rich in tapas, the lord of yogins, detached, stainless, / delighting in the Self, beyond duality, the one by whom Madana was slain.

1.3.s:
sa tvaṃ sākṣādvirūpākṣo mayā dṛṣṭosi cādya vai..
aśakyo hi mayā prāptuṃ sarveṣāṃ duratikramaḥ..
tasmāttvayā na vaktavyaṃ yaduktaṃ ca purā mama.. 35.34 ..
1.3.d:
स त्वं साक्षाद्विरूपाक्षो मया दृष्टोसि चाद्य वै..
अशक्यो हि मया प्राप्तुं सर्वेषां दुरतिक्रमः..
तस्मात्त्वया न वक्तव्यं यदुक्तं च पुरा मम.. 35.34 ..
1.3.m: As such, you, the three-eyed god in visible form, have been seen by me today. / You are impossible for me to attain, insurmountable for all. / Therefore, you must not repeat what you said to me earlier."

1.3.s:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā provāca madanāṃtakaḥ..
mama bhāryā bhava tvaṃ hi nānyathā kartumarhasi.. 35.35 ..
1.3.d:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रोवाच मदनांतकः..
मम भार्या भव त्वं हि नान्यथा कर्तुमर्हसि.. 35.35 ..
1.3.m: Hearing her words, the destroyer of Madana said: / "Become my wife! You ought not do otherwise!"

1.3.s:
ityuktvā tāṃ kare'gṛhṇācchabarīṃ madanāturaḥ..
uvāca taṃ smayaṃtī sā muṃcamuṃceti sādaram.. 35.36 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तां करेऽगृह्णाच्छबरीं मदनातुरः..
उवाच तं स्मयंती सा मुंचमुंचेति सादरम्.. 35.36 ..
1.3.m: Having said this, afflicted by love, he seized the Śabarī woman by the hand. / Smiling, she respectfully said to him: "Release me, release me!

1.3.s:
nocitaṃ bhagavānkartuṃ tāpasena balādidam..
yācayasva piturme tvaṃ nānyathābhibhaviṣyasi.. 35.37 ..
1.3.d:
नोचितं भगवान्कर्तुं तापसेन बलादिदम्..
याचयस्व पितुर्मे त्वं नान्यथाभिभविष्यसि.. 35.37 ..
1.3.m: It is not fitting for the Lord, an ascetic, to do this by force. / Ask my father; you will not win me in any other way."

1.3.s:
..mahādeva uvāca..
pitaraṃ kathayāśu tvaṃ sthitaḥ kutra śubhānane..
drakṣyāmi taṃ viśālākṣi praṇipātapuraḥsaram.. 35.38 ..
1.3.d:
..महादेव उवाच..
पितरं कथयाशु त्वं स्थितः कुत्र शुभानने..
द्रक्ष्यामि तं विशालाक्षि प्रणिपातपुरःसरम्.. 35.38 ..
1.3.m: Mahādeva said: / "Quickly tell me about your father, where he stays, O lady of auspicious face! / I will see him, O large-eyed woman, bowing down with reverence."

1.3.s:
etaduktaṃ tadā tena niśamyāsitanetrayā..
ānīto hi tayā tanvyā pitaraṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ.. 35.39 ..
1.3.d:
एतदुक्तं तदा तेन निशम्यासितनेत्रया..
आनीतो हि तया तन्व्या पितरं वृषभध्वजः.. 35.39 ..
1.3.m: Having heard what was said then by him, the dark-eyed, slender woman led him whose banner bears a bull to her father,

1.3.s:
sthitaṃ kailāsaśikhare himavaṃtaṃ nagottamam..
ahibhirbahubhiścaiva saṃvṛtaṃ ca mahāprabham.. 35.40 ..
1.3.d:
स्थितं कैलासशिखरे हिमवंतं नगोत्तमम्..
अहिभिर्बहुभिश्चैव संवृतं च महाप्रभम्.. 35.40 ..
1.3.m: to Himavat, the foremost of mountains, standing on the peak of Kailāsa, surrounded by many serpents and endowed with great splendour.

1.3.s:
dvāri sthitaṃ tayā devyā darśitaṃ śaṃkarasya ca..
asau mama pitā deva yācasva vigatatrapaḥ..
dadāti māṃ na saṃdehastapasvinmā vilaṃbitam.. 35.41 ..
1.3.d:
द्वारि स्थितं तया देव्या दर्शितं शंकरस्य च..
असौ मम पिता देव याचस्व विगतत्रपः..
ददाति मां न संदेहस्तपस्विन्मा विलंबितम्.. 35.41 ..
1.3.m: Shown to Śaṃkara by the goddess as he stood at the doorway: / 'This is my father, O god; ask him, free of bashfulness! / He will give me [to you], there is no doubt, O ascetic, without delay.'

1.3.s:
tatheti matvā sahasā praṇamya himālayaṃ vākyamidaṃ babhāṣe..
prayaccha tāṃ cādya girīśavarya hyārtāya kanyāṃ subhagāṃ mahāmate.. 35.42 ..
1.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा सहसा प्रणम्य हिमालयं वाक्यमिदं बभाषे..
प्रयच्छ तां चाद्य गिरीशवर्य ह्यार्ताय कन्यां सुभगां महामते.. 35.42 ..
1.3.m: Agreeing, 'So be it,' and bowing quickly before Himālaya, he spoke this word: / 'Bestow her today, O best of mountain lords, the auspicious maiden, upon me who am distressed, O wise one!'

1.3.s:
kṛpaṇaṃ vākyamākarṇya samutthāya himālayaḥ..
maheśaṃ ca samādāya hyuvāca girirāṭ svayam.. 35.43 ..
1.3.d:
कृपणं वाक्यमाकर्ण्य समुत्थाय हिमालयः..
महेशं च समादाय ह्युवाच गिरिराट् स्वयम्.. 35.43 ..
1.3.m: Hearing this humble word, Himālaya stood up, / and embracing Maheśa, the mountain king himself spoke:

1.3.s:
kiṃ jalpasi hi bho deva tāvayuktaṃ ca sāṃpratam..
tvaṃ dātā triṣu lokeṣu tvaṃ svāmī jagatāṃ vibho.. 35.44 ..
1.3.d:
किं जल्पसि हि भो देव तावयुक्तं च सांप्रतम्..
त्वं दाता त्रिषु लोकेषु त्वं स्वामी जगतां विभो.. 35.44 ..
1.3.m: 'Why do you chatter thus, O god? It is unfitting for you now! / You are the giver in the three worlds, you are the master of the universes, O omnipresent Lord!

1.3.s:
tvayā tatamidaṃ viśvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram..
evaṃ stutiparo'bhūcca himālayāgirirmahān..
āgato nāradastatra ṛṣibhiḥ parivāritaḥ.. 35.45 ..
1.3.d:
त्वया ततमिदं विश्वं जगदेतच्चराचरम्..
एवं स्तुतिपरोऽभूच्च हिमालयागिरिर्महान्..
आगतो नारदस्तत्र ऋषिभिः परिवारितः.. 35.45 ..
1.3.m: By you this entire universe, moving and unmoving, is pervaded.' / While the great mountain Himālaya was thus devoted to praising him, / Nārada arrived there, surrounded by seers.

1.3.s:
uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ śūlapāṇe namaḥ prabho..
he śaṃbho śrṛṇu me vākyaṃ tattvasāramayaṃ param.. 35.46 ..
1.3.d:
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं शूलपाणे नमः प्रभो..
हे शंभो श्रृणु मे वाक्यं तत्त्वसारमयं परम्.. 35.46 ..
1.3.m: Smiling, he said words: 'O wielder of the trident, homage to you, O Lord! / O Śambhu, hear my word, which is the supreme essence of truth.

1.3.s:
yoṣidbhiḥ saṃgati puṃsāṃ viḍaṃbāyopakalpate..
tvaṃ svāmī jagatāṃ nāthaḥ parāṇāṃ paramaḥ paraḥ..
vimṛśya sarvaṃ deveśa yathāvadvaktumarhasi.. 35.47 ..
1.3.d:
योषिद्भिः संगति पुंसां विडंबायोपकल्पते..
त्वं स्वामी जगतां नाथः पराणां परमः परः..
विमृश्य सर्वं देवेश यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि.. 35.47 ..
1.3.m: Association with women leads men to humiliation. / You are the master, the lord of the worlds, the highest beyond the high. / Having considered everything, O Lord of gods, you should speak properly.'

1.3.s:
evaṃ prabodhitastena nāradena mahātmanā..
prabodhamagamacchaṃbhurjahāsa parameśvaraḥ.. 35.48 ..
1.3.d:
एवं प्रबोधितस्तेन नारदेन महात्मना..
प्रबोधमगमच्छंभुर्जहास परमेश्वरः.. 35.48 ..
1.3.m: Thus awakened by that great-souled Nārada, / Śambhu came to his senses, and the Supreme Lord laughed.

1.3.s:
..śiva uvāca..
satyamuktaṃ tvayā cātra nānyathā nāradakvacit..
yoṣitsaṃgatimātreṇa nṛṇāṃ patanameva ca.. 35.49 ..
1.3.d:
..शिव उवाच..
सत्यमुक्तं त्वया चात्र नान्यथा नारदक्वचित्..
योषित्संगतिमात्रेण नृणां पतनमेव च.. 35.49 ..
1.3.m: Śiva said: / 'You have spoken the truth here, Nārada; it is never otherwise. / By the mere company of women, men fall indeed;

1.3.s:
bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho nānyathā vacanaṃ tava..
anayā mohito'dyāhamānīto gaṃdhamādanam.. 35.50 ..
1.3.d:
भविष्यति न संदेहो नान्यथा वचनं तव..
अनया मोहितोऽद्याहमानीतो गंधमादनम्.. 35.50 ..
1.3.m: there is no doubt, your word is never false. / Deluded by her today, I was brought to Gandhamādana,

1.3.s: piśācavatkṛtamidaṃ caritaṃ paramādbhutam.. 35.51 ..
1.3.d: पिशाचवत्कृतमिदं चरितं परमाद्भुतम्.. 35.51 ..
1.3.m: and like a piśāca I performed this most wondrous act.

1.3.s:
tasmānna tiṣṭhāmi gireḥ samīpe vrajāmi cādyaiva vanāṃtaraṃ punaḥ..
ityevamuktvā sa jagāma mārgaṃ duratyayaṃ yogenāmapyagamyam.. 35.52 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मान्न तिष्ठामि गिरेः समीपे व्रजामि चाद्यैव वनांतरं पुनः..
इत्येवमुक्त्वा स जगाम मार्गं दुरत्ययं योगेनामप्यगम्यम्.. 35.52 ..
1.3.m: Therefore I shall not remain near the mountain; I depart this very day again to another forest.' / Having spoken thus, he took the path that is insurmountable, impassable even for yogins.

1.3.s:
nirālaṃbaṃ sa vijñāya nārado vākyamabravīt..
girijāṃ ca girīṃdraṃ ca pārṣadānprati satvaram.. 35.53 ..
1.3.d:
निरालंबं स विज्ञाय नारदो वाक्यमब्रवीत्..
गिरिजां च गिरींद्रं च पार्षदान्प्रति सत्वरम्.. 35.53 ..
1.3.m: Perceiving him to be unattached, Nārada spoke words / swiftly to the mountain's daughter, to the king of mountains, and to the attendants:

1.3.s:
vaṃdanīyaśca stutyaśca kṣāmyatāṃ paramārthataḥ..
maheśo'yaṃ jagannāthastripurārirmahāyaśāḥ.. 35.54 ..
1.3.d:
वंदनीयश्च स्तुत्यश्च क्षाम्यतां परमार्थतः..
महेशोऽयं जगन्नाथस्त्रिपुरारिर्महायशाः.. 35.54 ..
1.3.m: 'He is worthy of praise and reverence; in absolute truth, let him be forgiven. / This Maheśa is the Lord of the universe, the slayer of Tripura, of great renown.'

1.3.s:
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ nāradasya mukhodgatam..
girijāṃ purataḥ kṛtvā girayo hi mahāprabhāḥ.. 35.55 ..
1.3.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं नारदस्य मुखोद्गतम्..
गिरिजां पुरतः कृत्वा गिरयो हि महाप्रभाः.. 35.55 ..
1.3.m: Hearing this word issuing from Nārada's mouth, / the mountains of great splendour, placing the mountain's daughter before them,

1.3.s:
daṇḍavatpatitāḥ sarve śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram..
tuṣṭuvuḥ praṇatāḥ sarve pramathā guhyakādayaḥ.. 35.56 ..
1.3.d:
दण्डवत्पतिताः सर्वे शंकरं लोकशंकरम्..
तुष्टुवुः प्रणताः सर्वे प्रमथा गुह्यकादयः.. 35.56 ..
1.3.m: all fell down like sticks before Śaṃkara, who brings welfare to the world. / Bowing low, all the pramathas, guhyakas, and others praised him.

1.3.s:
stūyamāno hi bhagavānāgato gaṃdhamādanam..
aṃgirasā hi sarveśo hyabhiṣikto mahātmabhiḥ.. 35.57 ..
1.3.d:
स्तूयमानो हि भगवानागतो गंधमादनम्..
अंगिरसा हि सर्वेशो ह्यभिषिक्तो महात्मभिः.. 35.57 ..
1.3.m: Being praised, the Lord came to Gandhamādana. / The Lord of all was indeed consecrated by the great-souled Aṅgiras [and others].

1.3.s:
tadā dundubhayo nedurvāditrāṇi bahūni ca..
indrādayaḥ surāḥ sarve puṣpavarṣaṃ vavarṣire.. 35.58 ..
1.3.d:
तदा दुन्दुभयो नेदुर्वादित्राणि बहूनि च..
इन्द्रादयः सुराः सर्वे पुष्पवर्षं ववर्षिरे.. 35.58 ..
1.3.m: Then kettle-drums sounded, and many musical instruments; / Indra and all the gods rained down a shower of flowers.

1.3.s:
brahmādibhiḥ suragaṇairbahubhiḥ parīto yogīśvaro girijayā saha viśvavaṃdyaḥ..
abhyarthitaḥ paramamaṃgala maṃgalaiśca divyāsanopari rarāja mahāvibhūtyā.. 35.59 ..
1.3.d:
ब्रह्मादिभिः सुरगणैर्बहुभिः परीतो योगीश्वरो गिरिजया सह विश्ववंद्यः..
अभ्यर्थितः परममंगल मंगलैश्च दिव्यासनोपरि रराज महाविभूत्या.. 35.59 ..
1.3.m: Surrounded by many hosts of gods headed by Brahmā, the Lord of yoga, adored by the universe, together with the mountain's daughter, / entreated with the most auspicious blessings, shone forth with great splendour upon a divine seat.

1.3.s:
evaṃvidhānyanekāni caritāni mahātmanaḥ..
maheśasya ca bho viprāḥ pāpahārīṇi śrṛṇvatām.. 35.60 ..
1.3.d:
एवंविधान्यनेकानि चरितानि महात्मनः..
महेशस्य च भो विप्राः पापहारीणि श्रृण्वताम्.. 35.60 ..
1.3.m: Such are the many deeds of the great-souled Maheśa, / O brahmins, which remove sin for those who hear them.

1.3.s:
yāniyānīha rudrasya caritāni mahāṃtyapi..
śrutāni paramāṇyeva bhūyaḥ kiṃ kathayāmi vaḥ.. 35.61 ..
1.3.d:
यानियानीह रुद्रस्य चरितानि महांत्यपि..
श्रुतानि परमाण्येव भूयः किं कथयामि वः.. 35.61 ..
1.3.m: Whatever great and supreme deeds of Rudra / have been heard here, what more shall I tell you?'

1.3.s:
..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
eva muktaṃ tvayā sūta caritaṃ śaṃkarasya ca..
anena caritenaiva saṃtṛptāḥ smo na saṃśayaḥ.. 35.62 ..
1.3.d:
..ऋषय ऊचुः..
एव मुक्तं त्वया सूत चरितं शंकरस्य च..
अनेन चरितेनैव संतृप्ताः स्मो न संशयः.. 35.62 ..
1.3.m: The seers said: / 'Thus the story of Śaṃkara has been narrated by you, O Sūta; / by this very deed we are satisfied, there is no doubt.'

1.3.s:
..sūta uvāca..
vyāsaprasādācchrutamasti sarvaṃ mayā tataṃ śaṃkararūpamadbhutam..
suvistṛtaṃ cādbhutavedagarbhaṃ jñānātmakaṃ paramaṃ cedamuktam.. 35.63 ..
1.3.d:
..सूत उवाच..
व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतमस्ति सर्वं मया ततं शंकररूपमद्भुतम्..
सुविस्तृतं चाद्भुतवेदगर्भं ज्ञानात्मकं परमं चेदमुक्तम्.. 35.63 ..
1.3.m: Sūta said: / 'By the grace of Vyāsa everything has been heard by me, the wondrous form of Śaṃkara pervading all; / and this supreme [teaching], fully expanded, containing the wondrous essence of the Vedas and consisting of knowledge, has been proclaimed.

1.3.s:
śraddhayā parayopetāḥ śrāvayaṃti śivapriyam..
śrṛṇvaṃti caiva ye bhaktyā śaṃbhermāhātmyamadbhutam..
śivaśāstramidaṃ prītyā te yāṃti maramāṃ gatim.. 35.64 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṇḍe śivaśāstre pārvatyā śabarīrūpeṇa śivasya gandhamādanaparvataṃ pratyānayanapūrvakaṃ bṛhaspatikṛtaśivarājyābhiṣekavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 35 .. cha ..
.. iti śrīskāndamahāpurāṇe prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe prathamaḥ kedārakhaṇḍaḥ samāptaḥ.. 1 ..
1.3.d:
श्रद्धया परयोपेताः श्रावयंति शिवप्रियम्..
श्रृण्वंति चैव ये भक्त्या शंभेर्माहात्म्यमद्भुतम्..
शिवशास्त्रमिदं प्रीत्या ते यांति मरमां गतिम्.. 35.64 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखण्डे शिवशास्त्रे पार्वत्या शबरीरूपेण शिवस्य गन्धमादनपर्वतं प्रत्यानयनपूर्वकं बृहस्पतिकृतशिवराज्याभिषेकवर्णनं नाम पञ्चत्रिंशोऽध्यायः.. 35 .. छ ..
.. इति श्रीस्कान्दमहापुराणे प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे प्रथमः केदारखण्डः समाप्तः.. 1 ..
1.3.m:
Endowed with supreme faith, those who recite what is dear to Śiva / and who listen with devotion to the wondrous māhātmya of Śambhu, / to this scripture of Śiva with joy, go to the supreme goal.'
Thus ends the thirty-fifth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Coronation of Śiva Performed by Bṛhaspati, Preceded by Śiva Being Brought to Mount Gandhamādana by Pārvatī in the Form of a Śabarī', in the Śivaśāstra of the Kedārakhaṇḍa, in the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skandapurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
Thus ends the first Kedārakhaṇḍa, in the first section, the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandamahāpurāṇa. 1.

1.3.s: atha māheśvarakhaṇḍe prathamaṃ kedārakhaṇḍam .. ( 1-1) ..
1.3.d: अथ माहेश्वरखण्डे प्रथमं केदारखण्डम् .. ( 1-1) ..
1.3.m: Now begins the first Kedārakhaṇḍa in the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa. (1-1)

1.3.s: 1 maṅgalācaraṇama, atha skāndamahāpurāṇopakramaḥ, tatra naimiṣāraṇye śaunakādimaharṣidarśanārthaṃ vyāsaśiṣyasya lomaśasūtamaharṣerāgamanam, śaunakādimaharṣibhirlomaśaṃ prati śrīśivamāhātmyaśravaṇecchayā praśnakaraṇam, atha lomaśamaharṣiṇā purāṇopakramapūrvakaṃ śivaparamamahimopakramavarṇanam, tatrādau-dakṣayajñavidhvaṃsavṛttāntavarṇanam, tatra dakṣeṇa śivaniṃdākaraṇapūrvakaṃ śivāya śivagaṇebhyaśca śāpapradānam, śivaśivakiṃkaraśāpamasahamānena nandinā dakṣādibrāhmaṇebhyaḥ śāpapradānam , atha śaṅkareṇa nandinaḥ sāntvanam, dakṣasya śaṅkaranindanenā'śāntivarṇanam.. 1 .
1.3.d: 1 मङ्गलाचरणम, अथ स्कान्दमहापुराणोपक्रमः, तत्र नैमिषारण्ये शौनकादिमहर्षिदर्शनार्थं व्यासशिष्यस्य लोमशसूतमहर्षेरागमनम्, शौनकादिमहर्षिभिर्लोमशं प्रति श्रीशिवमाहात्म्यश्रवणेच्छया प्रश्नकरणम्, अथ लोमशमहर्षिणा पुराणोपक्रमपूर्वकं शिवपरममहिमोपक्रमवर्णनम्, तत्रादौ-दक्षयज्ञविध्वंसवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्, तत्र दक्षेण शिवनिंदाकरणपूर्वकं शिवाय शिवगणेभ्यश्च शापप्रदानम्, शिवशिवकिंकरशापमसहमानेन नन्दिना दक्षादिब्राह्मणेभ्यः शापप्रदानम् , अथ शङ्करेण नन्दिनः सान्त्वनम्, दक्षस्य शङ्करनिन्दनेनाऽशान्तिवर्णनम्.. 1 .
1.3.m: 1. Invocation of auspiciousness; now the commencement of the Skandamahāpurāṇa; therein, the arrival of the great seer Lomasa Sūta, the disciple of Vyāsa, at Naimiṣāraṇya to behold the great seers headed by Śaunaka; the posing of questions by the great seers headed by Śaunaka to Lomaśa out of a desire to hear the glorious Śivamāhātmya; now the description of the commencement of the supreme greatness of Śiva by the great seer Lomaśa following the introduction to the Purāṇa; therein, first, the narration of the destruction of Dakṣa's sacrifice; therein, Dakṣa pronouncing a curse upon Śiva and the attendants of Śiva following his censure of Śiva; Nandin, unable to bear the curse upon Śiva and Śiva's servants, pronouncing a curse upon Dakṣa and the other brahmins; now the pacification of Nandin by Śaṅkara; the description of Dakṣa's unrest caused by his reviling of Śaṅkara. 1.

1.3.s: 2 dakṣeṇa kanakhalakṣetre yajñakarmaprārambhakaraṇam, tatra yajñe vasiṣṭhādimaharṣīṇāṃ viṣṇubrahmendraprabhṛtīnāṃ devatānāṃ cāgamanama ,tatra śaṃkaramanāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā dadhīcimaharṣiṇā dakṣaṃ prati śaṃkarānayanārthamupadeśakaraṇam, dakṣeṇa śaṅkarānādarapradarśanam, dadhīcinā śaṃkarānādara- ṇā'nyāyena yajñavināśamāśrāvya yajñavāṭānnirgamanam, dakṣeṇa devayajanārambhakaraṇam, atha gandhamādanaparvate vimānasthayā dākṣāyaṇyā satyā svapiturdakṣasya yajñasamāraṃbhe svapatnībhiḥ saha gacchataścandrasya mukhena yajñavṛttāṃtaṃ samākarṇya śivasamīpaṃ sametya svapitṛmaṃdiraṃ prīta svasyā jigamiṣāsamutkaṇṭhāpradarśanam, śivena kriyamāṇe'pyupadeśe satyā'tyāgraheṇa svasyā gamanārthaṃ śivasakāśādājñāprārthanam, pitrā'vamānitāyāḥ satyāḥ punaranāgamanaṃ śivena nirdhārya nandyādibhiḥ saha tasyāḥ preṣaṇam, dakṣayajñaṃ prati satodevyāgamanavarṇanam ... ....
1.3.d: 2 दक्षेण कनखलक्षेत्रे यज्ञकर्मप्रारम्भकरणम्, तत्र यज्ञे वसिष्ठादिमहर्षीणां विष्णुब्रह्मेन्द्रप्रभृतीनां देवतानां चागमनम ,तत्र शंकरमनागतं दृष्ट्वा दधीचिमहर्षिणा दक्षं प्रति शंकरानयनार्थमुपदेशकरणम्, दक्षेण शङ्करानादरप्रदर्शनम्, दधीचिना शंकरानादर- णाऽन्यायेन यज्ञविनाशमाश्राव्य यज्ञवाटान्निर्गमनम्, दक्षेण देवयजनारम्भकरणम्, अथ गन्धमादनपर्वते विमानस्थया दाक्षायण्या सत्या स्वपितुर्दक्षस्य यज्ञसमारंभे स्वपत्नीभिः सह गच्छतश्चन्द्रस्य मुखेन यज्ञवृत्तांतं समाकर्ण्य शिवसमीपं समेत्य स्वपितृमंदिरं प्रीत स्वस्या जिगमिषासमुत्कण्ठाप्रदर्शनम्, शिवेन क्रियमाणेऽप्युपदेशे सत्याऽत्याग्रहेण स्वस्या गमनार्थं शिवसकाशादाज्ञाप्रार्थनम्, पित्राऽवमानितायाः सत्याः पुनरनागमनं शिवेन निर्धार्य नन्द्यादिभिः सह तस्याः प्रेषणम्, दक्षयज्ञं प्रति सतोदेव्यागमनवर्णनम् ... ....
1.3.m: 2. Dakṣa's commencement of the sacrificial rite in the sacred field of Kanakhala; the arrival there at the sacrifice of great seers headed by Vasiṣṭha and deities headed by Viṣṇu, Brahmā, and Indra; the great seer Dadhīci, seeing that Śaṃkara had not arrived, advising Dakṣa to bring Śaṃkara; Dakṣa showing disrespect toward Śaṃkara; Dadhīci, proclaiming the destruction of the sacrifice due to the injustice of disrespecting Śaṃkara, departing from the sacrificial enclosure; Dakṣa commencing the sacrifice to the gods; then Satī, the daughter of Dakṣa, seated in an aerial chariot on Mount Gandhamādana, hearing news of the sacrifice from the mouth of Candra who was going with his wives to her father Dakṣa's grand sacrifice, approaching Śiva and expressing her intense desire to go affectionately to her father's home; despite Śiva's advice, Satī, out of extreme insistence, requesting permission from Śiva to go; Śiva, ascertaining that Satī would not return after being insulted by her father, sending her along with Nandin and others; description of goddess Satī's arrival at Dakṣa's sacrifice.

1.3.s: 3 satīdevyā pitṛsamīpaṃ gatvā bhṛgvādisaṃnidhau śaṅkarānāhvānakāraṇe pṛṣṭe dakṣeṇa śivanindākaraṇama śivanindāmātmāpamānaṃ cā'sahamānayā satyā hutāśane praveśakaraṇamū, tāmanusamāgatānāṃ dvyayutagaṇānāṃ śastraprahāraiḥ svāṃgavicchedena nāśaḥ, lokapālādīnāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca bhayena stabdhībhāvaḥ,śaṃkareṇa nāradamukhāttaṃ vṛttāntaṃ śrutvā'tikopena parvataśikharopari nijajaṭāsphoṭanam, tato vīrabhadrakālībhūtakoṭiprādurbhāvaḥ, rudraniḥśvāsataḥ śatasaṃkhyākajvaratrayodaśasaṃkhyākasaṃnipātotpatti:, tataḥ śaṃkarājñayā vīrabhadrādīnāṃ dakṣayajñavāṭaṃ pratyāgamanam, tāmāyāṃtīṃ rudrasenāṃ dṛṣṭvā yajñavāṭasthitānāṃ bhayātpalāyane śakrādīnāṃ yuddhārthaṃ saṃnahanam, dakṣeṇa sarvadevaprārthanākaraṇam, viṣṇunā dakṣanirbhartsanākaraṇam, karmaphaladātṛtvena śivamahimavarṇanaṃ ca. ... --- 3.
1.3.d: 3 सतीदेव्या पितृसमीपं गत्वा भृग्वादिसंनिधौ शङ्करानाह्वानकारणे पृष्टे दक्षेण शिवनिन्दाकरणम शिवनिन्दामात्मापमानं चाऽसहमानया सत्या हुताशने प्रवेशकरणमू, तामनुसमागतानां द्व्ययुतगणानां शस्त्रप्रहारैः स्वांगविच्छेदेन नाशः, लोकपालादीनामृषीणां च भयेन स्तब्धीभावः,शंकरेण नारदमुखात्तं वृत्तान्तं श्रुत्वाऽतिकोपेन पर्वतशिखरोपरि निजजटास्फोटनम्, ततो वीरभद्रकालीभूतकोटिप्रादुर्भावः, रुद्रनिःश्वासतः शतसंख्याकज्वरत्रयोदशसंख्याकसंनिपातोत्पत्ति:, ततः शंकराज्ञया वीरभद्रादीनां दक्षयज्ञवाटं प्रत्यागमनम्, तामायांतीं रुद्रसेनां दृष्ट्वा यज्ञवाटस्थितानां भयात्पलायने शक्रादीनां युद्धार्थं संनहनम्, दक्षेण सर्वदेवप्रार्थनाकरणम्, विष्णुना दक्षनिर्भर्त्सनाकरणम्, कर्मफलदातृत्वेन शिवमहिमवर्णनं च. ... --- 3.
1.3.m: 3. Goddess Satī, having approached her father, asking in the presence of Bhṛgu and others the reason for not inviting Śaṃkara; Dakṣa reviling Śiva; Satī, unable to endure the reviling of Śiva and her own insult, entering into the sacrificial fire; the destruction of the twenty thousand attendants who followed her, cutting off their own limbs with blows of weapons; the guardians of the world and the seers becoming stunned with fear; Śaṃkara, hearing that account from the mouth of Nārada, striking his matted hair upon a mountain peak in extreme wrath; then the appearance of Vīrabhadra, Kālī, and tens of millions of spirits; from the sigh of Rudra, the emergence of a hundred fevers and thirteen types of delirium; then, by the command of Śaṃkara, the arrival of Vīrabhadra and others at the enclosure of Dakṣa's sacrifice; those standing in the sacrificial enclosure fleeing out of fear upon seeing that army of Rudra approaching, and Śakra and others arming themselves for battle; Dakṣa praying to all the gods; Viṣṇu rebuking Dakṣa and describing the greatness of Śiva as the giver of the fruits of actions.

1.3.s: 4 vīrabhadrādibhiḥ sahendrādidevānāṃ yuddham, jayacintānvitendrapṛṣṭabṛhaspatikṛtendrādinirbhartsanā, vīrabhadrasya lokapālaparājayapūrvakaṃ yajñavāṭamadhya āgamanam, tato viṣṇvādidevaiḥ saha vīrabhadrādīnāṃ dvaṃdvayuddhārambhaḥ, śivagaṇānāṃ parājayamadṛṣṭvā viṣṇoḥ svadhāmagamanam. ... ---- ---- - - - ---
1.3.d: 4 वीरभद्रादिभिः सहेन्द्रादिदेवानां युद्धम्, जयचिन्तान्वितेन्द्रपृष्टबृहस्पतिकृतेन्द्रादिनिर्भर्त्सना, वीरभद्रस्य लोकपालपराजयपूर्वकं यज्ञवाटमध्य आगमनम्, ततो विष्ण्वादिदेवैः सह वीरभद्रादीनां द्वंद्वयुद्धारम्भः, शिवगणानां पराजयमदृष्ट्वा विष्णोः स्वधामगमनम्. ... ---- ---- - - - ---
1.3.m: 4. The battle of the gods headed by Indra with Vīrabhadra and others; the rebuke of Indra and the others by Bṛhaspati when questioned by Indra who was anxious about victory; Vīrabhadra entering into the midst of the sacrificial enclosure after defeating the guardians of the world; then the commencement of dual combat between Vīrabhadra and others with the gods headed by Viṣṇu; Viṣṇu, seeing no defeat for Śiva's attendants, departing for his own abode.

1.3.s: 5 viṣṇoḥ svadhāmagamanānantaraṃ vīrabhadrādigaṇaiḥ sarvadevānvijitya bhṛgvādimaharṣiviḍaṃbanapūrvakaṃ dakṣaśiraśchittvā yajñāgnikuṇḍe homakaraṇam, sarveṣāṃ devarṣipitṛyakṣrarākṣasādònāṃ bhītyā palāyanam, putraśokapīḍitasya brahmaṇaḥ śaṃkaraṃ prasādayituṃ kailāsaṃ prati gamanam , bahmakṛtā śivastutiḥ, stutiprasannena śaṃkareṇa sarvairdevaiḥ saha dakṣayajñamaṇḍapaṃ pratyāgatya dakṣakabandhopari kūrcayuktacchāgapaśuśiraḥsaṃyojanapūrvakaṃ dakṣasya saṃjīvanam, dakṣakṛtā śivastutiḥ, stutiprasannena śivena dakṣayopadeśakaraṇam, śivabrahmādīnāṃ svasvalokagamanama, lomaśena sūtena śivopāsanāśivavratavidhimāhātmyavarṇanam, śivabhaktimāhātmyaprasaṃgena indradyumnasutasya indrasenasyetihāsavarṇanam, tatrā'tipāpiṣṭhasya tasya yamadūtairyamalokaṃ nītasyāpi-'āhara praharasva' ityādiśabdamiṣeṇa pāpakarmasvapi 'hara' nāmoccāraṇaprabhāvādyamena satkārakaraṇama, tataḥ śivadūtai'rvimānamāropya tasya śivalokaṃ prati nayanama, haranāmoccāraṇamahimnendrasenasya caṇḍanāmakagaṇatvaprāptivarṇanama, śivanāma-bhasma-rudrākṣa-tripuṃḍramāhātmyam, śivapūjanamāhātmyam, tatprasaṃgena nandivaiśyakirātayoritihāsavarṇanam, tatra nandivaiśyena ratnairārādhite śive kirātena mukhadhṛtajalagaṇḍūṣasamarpaṇādirūpabhaktikaraṇam, tadbhaktisaṃtuṣṭena śivena kirātasya kirātaprārthanayā naṃdivaiśyasya ca mahākālanāmakaśivadvārapālatvapradānama, śivabhaktimāhātmyam... ... -.. -.. 6 5
1.3.d: 5 विष्णोः स्वधामगमनानन्तरं वीरभद्रादिगणैः सर्वदेवान्विजित्य भृग्वादिमहर्षिविडंबनपूर्वकं दक्षशिरश्छित्त्वा यज्ञाग्निकुण्डे होमकरणम्, सर्वेषां देवर्षिपितृयक्ष्रराक्षसाद्òनां भीत्या पलायनम्, पुत्रशोकपीडितस्य ब्रह्मणः शंकरं प्रसादयितुं कैलासं प्रति गमनम् , बह्मकृता शिवस्तुतिः, स्तुतिप्रसन्नेन शंकरेण सर्वैर्देवैः सह दक्षयज्ञमण्डपं प्रत्यागत्य दक्षकबन्धोपरि कूर्चयुक्तच्छागपशुशिरःसंयोजनपूर्वकं दक्षस्य संजीवनम्, दक्षकृता शिवस्तुतिः, स्तुतिप्रसन्नेन शिवेन दक्षयोपदेशकरणम्, शिवब्रह्मादीनां स्वस्वलोकगमनम, लोमशेन सूतेन शिवोपासनाशिवव्रतविधिमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, शिवभक्तिमाहात्म्यप्रसंगेन इन्द्रद्युम्नसुतस्य इन्द्रसेनस्येतिहासवर्णनम्, तत्राऽतिपापिष्ठस्य तस्य यमदूतैर्यमलोकं नीतस्यापि-ऽआहर प्रहरस्व' इत्यादिशब्दमिषेण पापकर्मस्वपि ऽहर' नामोच्चारणप्रभावाद्यमेन सत्कारकरणम, ततः शिवदूतैऽर्विमानमारोप्य तस्य शिवलोकं प्रति नयनम, हरनामोच्चारणमहिम्नेन्द्रसेनस्य चण्डनामकगणत्वप्राप्तिवर्णनम, शिवनाम-भस्म-रुद्राक्ष-त्रिपुंड्रमाहात्म्यम्, शिवपूजनमाहात्म्यम्, तत्प्रसंगेन नन्दिवैश्यकिरातयोरितिहासवर्णनम्, तत्र नन्दिवैश्येन रत्नैराराधिते शिवे किरातेन मुखधृतजलगण्डूषसमर्पणादिरूपभक्तिकरणम्, तद्भक्तिसंतुष्टेन शिवेन किरातस्य किरातप्रार्थनया नंदिवैश्यस्य च महाकालनामकशिवद्वारपालत्वप्रदानम, शिवभक्तिमाहात्म्यम्... ... -.. -.. 6 5
1.3.m: 5. After Viṣṇu's departure to his own abode, Vīrabhadra and his attendants conquering all the gods, mocking the great seers headed by Bhṛgu, severing Dakṣa's head, and offering it as an oblation into the sacrificial fire pit; all the divine seers, ancestors, yakṣas, rākṣasas, and others fleeing out of fear; Brahmā, afflicted with grief for his son, going to Kailāsa to propitiate Śaṃkara; the praise of Śiva sung by Brahmā; Śaṃkara, pleased by the hymn of praise, returning with all the gods to the pavilion of Dakṣa's sacrifice, restoring Dakṣa to life by joining the bearded head of a sacrificial goat onto Dakṣa's torso; the praise of Śiva sung by Dakṣa; Śiva, pleased by the hymn of praise, giving instruction to Dakṣa; Śiva, Brahmā, and the others returning to their respective worlds; the Sūta Lomaśa describing the greatness of Śiva's worship and the rules for Śiva vows; in the context of the greatness of devotion to Śiva, narration of the history of Indrasena, son of Indradyumna; there, even though that extremely sinful man was taken to the realm of Yama by Yama's messengers, Yama honoring him due to the power of his utterance of the name 'Hara' even amidst sinful acts under the pretext of words such as 'bring' [āhara] and 'strike' [prahara]; then Śiva's messengers placing him on an aerial chariot and conveying him to the world of Śiva; description of Indrasena attaining the status of an attendant named Caṇḍa by the greatness of uttering the name of Hara; the greatness of the name of Śiva, sacred ash, rudrākṣa beads, and the tripuṇḍra mark; the greatness of worshipping Śiva; in that context, narration of the history of the merchant Nandi and the Kirāta; there, while Śiva was worshipped with gems by the merchant Nandi, the Kirāta offering devotion consisting of spitting out mouthfuls of water held in his mouth; Śiva, satisfied with that devotion, granting the status of Śiva's door-keeper named Mahākāla to the Kirāta and, by the Kirāta's request, to the merchant Nandi; the greatness of devotion to Śiva. 5

1.3.s: 6 śaunakādibhiḥ śaṃkarasya mūrtiṃ vihāya liṃgapūjāpravṛttiviṣayake praśne kṛte sati lomaśena sūtena-liṃgapūjāpravṛttivṛttāntanirūpaṇam. tatra dāruvane śaṃkarasya nagnatayā bhikṣārthamaṭamānasya digaṃbaraṃ sundaraṃ svarūpaṃ nirīkṣya mohitānāṃ samastamunipatnīnāṃ śaṃkarapṛṣṭhato'nugamanama, tāsāṃ tamanugamanena svāśramāñchūnyānnirīkṣya kupitānāṃ teṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ śāpena śivasya liṃgapatanam, patitena tena liṃgena carācarasamastabrahmāṃḍaṃ vyāpyaikarūpeṇāvasthānam, taddṛṣṭvā cakitaiḥ surādibhirviṣṇubrahmaṇoḥ prārthanā, devaprārthanayā liṃgaparyaṃtaśodhanāya pātāle viṣṇorgamanama, svarge ca brahmaṇo gamanam, brahmaṇo merupṛṣṭhe surabhīdarśanam, ketakīdarśanaṃ ca, brahmaprārthanayā surabhīketakībhyāṃ 'brahmaṇā liṃgamastakaṃ dṛṣṭam iti mṛṣā sākṣyapradānapratijñānānantaraṃ brahmaṇaḥ pratyāvṛtya punaḥ pūrvasthānaṃ pratyāgamanam, devāgre ca surabhīketakībhyāṃ mṛṣāsākṣyapradānapūrvakaṃ 'mayā liṅgamastakaṃ dṛṣṭam, iti mithyāprauḍhivādakathanam, bhṛgvādibhiśca tadanumodanam, viṣṇunā ca pātālātpratyāvṛtya sarvadevāgre 'mayā liṅgānto na dṛṣṭaḥ' iti satyabhāṣaṇakathanam, surabhīketakyormṛṣoktimākarṇya kupitena bhagavatā-ākāśavāṇyā-apavitramukhatveta surabhyāḥ, śivapūjānarhatvena ketakyāḥ, apūjyatvena brahmaṇaḥ, kleśādibhāgitvena tadanumodakānāṃ bhṛgvādibrāhmaṇānāṃ ca śāpapradānam, evamākāśavāṇyā śaptānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ liṅgaṃ prati śaraṇagamanam.. ............. 10 1
1.3.d: 6 शौनकादिभिः शंकरस्य मूर्तिं विहाय लिंगपूजाप्रवृत्तिविषयके प्रश्ने कृते सति लोमशेन सूतेन-लिंगपूजाप्रवृत्तिवृत्तान्तनिरूपणम्. तत्र दारुवने शंकरस्य नग्नतया भिक्षार्थमटमानस्य दिगंबरं सुन्दरं स्वरूपं निरीक्ष्य मोहितानां समस्तमुनिपत्नीनां शंकरपृष्ठतोऽनुगमनम, तासां तमनुगमनेन स्वाश्रमाञ्छून्यान्निरीक्ष्य कुपितानां तेषामृषीणां शापेन शिवस्य लिंगपतनम्, पतितेन तेन लिंगेन चराचरसमस्तब्रह्मांडं व्याप्यैकरूपेणावस्थानम्, तद्दृष्ट्वा चकितैः सुरादिभिर्विष्णुब्रह्मणोः प्रार्थना, देवप्रार्थनया लिंगपर्यंतशोधनाय पाताले विष्णोर्गमनम, स्वर्गे च ब्रह्मणो गमनम्, ब्रह्मणो मेरुपृष्ठे सुरभीदर्शनम्, केतकीदर्शनं च, ब्रह्मप्रार्थनया सुरभीकेतकीभ्यां ऽब्रह्मणा लिंगमस्तकं दृष्टम् इति मृषा साक्ष्यप्रदानप्रतिज्ञानानन्तरं ब्रह्मणः प्रत्यावृत्य पुनः पूर्वस्थानं प्रत्यागमनम्, देवाग्रे च सुरभीकेतकीभ्यां मृषासाक्ष्यप्रदानपूर्वकं ऽमया लिङ्गमस्तकं दृष्टम्, इति मिथ्याप्रौढिवादकथनम्, भृग्वादिभिश्च तदनुमोदनम्, विष्णुना च पातालात्प्रत्यावृत्य सर्वदेवाग्रे ऽमया लिङ्गान्तो न दृष्टः' इति सत्यभाषणकथनम्, सुरभीकेतक्योर्मृषोक्तिमाकर्ण्य कुपितेन भगवता-आकाशवाण्या-अपवित्रमुखत्वेत सुरभ्याः, शिवपूजानर्हत्वेन केतक्याः, अपूज्यत्वेन ब्रह्मणः, क्लेशादिभागित्वेन तदनुमोदकानां भृग्वादिब्राह्मणानां च शापप्रदानम्, एवमाकाशवाण्या शप्तानां ब्रह्मादीनां लिङ्गं प्रति शरणगमनम्.. ............. 10 1
1.3.m: 6. When Śaunaka and the others asked about the origin of worshipping the liṅga rather than Śaṃkara's anthropomorphic form, Lomaśa Sūta set forth the account of the origin of liṅga worship: There, while Śaṃkara was wandering naked in the Dāruvana forest to beg for alms, all the wives of the sages were infatuated upon seeing his sky-clad, handsome form and followed after Śaṃkara. Seeing their hermitages deserted because of the women following him, the enraged ṛṣis cursed Śiva, causing his liṅga to fall off. The fallen liṅga expanded uniformly, pervading the entire universe of moving and unmoving beings. Seeing this, the gods and others were astonished and prayed to Viṣṇu and Brahmā. At the prayer of the gods, Viṣṇu went to Pātāla and Brahmā went to heaven to find the liṅga's ends. Brahmā saw Surabhi and Ketakī on the ridge of Mount Meru. At Brahmā's request, Surabhi and Ketakī promised to give false testimony that "the top of the liṅga was seen by Brahmā," after which Brahmā returned to his former place. Before the gods, through the false testimony of Surabhi and Ketakī, he boastfully made the false claim, "I have seen the top of the liṅga," and Bhṛgu and others confirmed it. Viṣṇu, having returned from Pātāla, spoke truthfully before all the gods: "I did not see the end of the liṅga." Hearing the false words of Surabhi and Ketakī, the Lord was angered and, through a disembodied voice, cursed Surabhi with having an impure mouth, Ketakī with being unfit for Śiva's worship, Brahmā with being unworthy of worship, and Bhṛgu and the other brahmins who had concurred with it with experiencing suffering and adversity. Thus, cursed by the disembodied voice, Brahmā and the others took refuge in the liṅga. 10 1

1.3.s: 7 brahmadevarṣikṛta śivastutiḥ, brahmādikṛtastutisantuṣṭena śivena vrahmādīnprati viṣṇuprārthanārthamājñākaraṇam, brahmādibhirviṣṇustavanam, tata ākāśavāṇyā viṣṇoḥ piṇḍībhāvena śivaliṅgadhāraṇam, tataḥ śivapriyeṇa vīrabhadreṇa brahmādibhiḥ saha śivaliṅgapūjanam, tataḥ śaṃkarasyānekairdevādibhiranekeṣu sthaleṣu nānānāmakaliṅgasthāpanam, tatratatra liṃgārcanārthaṃ vīrabhadrāṃśasthāpanaṃ vīrabhadrādārabhya liṃgapūjakaguruparaṃparotpattiḥ, nandino liṃgamahimapraśaṃsakaprathamācāryatvam, skandasya ca liṃgapūjakācāryatvam, tataśca liṃgapūjakaguruparaṃparāpravṛttiḥ, śivabhaktimāhātmyam, tatra pataṃgyāḥ kīṭapakṣiṇyāḥ śivamandiramārjanapuṇyavaśena kāśirājasutātvaprāptivṛttāntavarṇanam, uddālakamaharṣe kāśirājasutayā sundaryākhyayā saha saṃvādaḥ, ....... ... 11 2
1.3.d: 7 ब्रह्मदेवर्षिकृत शिवस्तुतिः, ब्रह्मादिकृतस्तुतिसन्तुष्टेन शिवेन व्रह्मादीन्प्रति विष्णुप्रार्थनार्थमाज्ञाकरणम्, ब्रह्मादिभिर्विष्णुस्तवनम्, तत आकाशवाण्या विष्णोः पिण्डीभावेन शिवलिङ्गधारणम्, ततः शिवप्रियेण वीरभद्रेण ब्रह्मादिभिः सह शिवलिङ्गपूजनम्, ततः शंकरस्यानेकैर्देवादिभिरनेकेषु स्थलेषु नानानामकलिङ्गस्थापनम्, तत्रतत्र लिंगार्चनार्थं वीरभद्रांशस्थापनं वीरभद्रादारभ्य लिंगपूजकगुरुपरंपरोत्पत्तिः, नन्दिनो लिंगमहिमप्रशंसकप्रथमाचार्यत्वम्, स्कन्दस्य च लिंगपूजकाचार्यत्वम्, ततश्च लिंगपूजकगुरुपरंपराप्रवृत्तिः, शिवभक्तिमाहात्म्यम्, तत्र पतंग्याः कीटपक्षिण्याः शिवमन्दिरमार्जनपुण्यवशेन काशिराजसुतात्वप्राप्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्, उद्दालकमहर्षे काशिराजसुतया सुन्दर्याख्यया सह संवादः, ....... ... 11 2
1.3.m: 7. Brahmā and the divine seers praised Śiva; pleased with the praise offered by Brahmā and the others, Śiva ordered Brahmā and the rest to pray to Viṣṇu; Brahmā and the others praised Viṣṇu; then, by a disembodied voice, Viṣṇu assumed the form of a pedestal (piṇḍī) to support the Śivaliṅga; then Vīrabhadra, beloved of Śiva, together with Brahmā and the others, worshipped the Śivaliṅga; thereafter, numerous gods and others installed liṅgas of various names in many places for Śaṃkara; portions of Vīrabhadra were established in each place to perform liṅga worship; the succession of gurus who worship the liṅga began from Vīrabhadra; Nandin became the first teacher to praise the greatness of the liṅga, and Skanda became a teacher who worshipped the liṅga; from this arose the lineage of teachers worshipping the liṅga; the greatness of devotion to Śiva; therein, the account of how a winged insect obtained the state of being the daughter of the king of Kāśi by virtue of the merit of sweeping a Śiva temple; the dialogue between the great sage Uddālaka and the daughter of the king of Kāśi named Sundarī; 11 2

1.3.s:
