8 śivabhaktimāhātmyaprasaṃgena-taskarasya śivaśiro'dhiruhya ghaṇṭāṃ harataḥ śivalokaprāptivṛttāntaḥ, sarvajagataḥ śivaśaktimayatvavarṇanam, tatra narāṇāṃ liṃgayuktatvam , strīṇāṃ ca piṇḍībhūtatvam, śivaviṣṇvorabhedavarṇanam, brahmādikṛtamaṇimayādiliṃgapūjāvarṇanam, prahlādabalibāṇāsurādidaityānāṃ śivaliṃgapūjāparatvavarṇanama, śivārcanaprabhāvādhigataduḥsahapratāparāvaṇanirjitaiḥ surairnandivākyācchivaliṃgārādhane samudyogaḥ. tatra prasaṃgena devapṛṣṭena nandinā svasya vānarānanatvakāraṇavarṇanam, tatra rāvaṇaśāpato nandino vānarānanatvaprāptiḥ, nandinā ca 'vānaraiḥ sametasya kasyāpi hastena te mṛtyurbhaviṣyati' iti rāvaṇāya śāpadānam. tato nandiprabhṛtibhiḥ sarvadevairvaikuṃṭhaṃ gatvā liṃgasya pīṭhikābhavanāya viṣṇoḥ prārthanā, bhagavatā viṣṇunā rāvaṇahananāyāvatāra-
grahaṇe devānāmāśvāsanam, viṣṇorājñayā sarvadevānāṃ vānareṣvaṃśāvatāravarṇanam rāmāvatāraḥ, rāmeṇa rāvaṇahananam, rāvaṇasya śivasāyujyaprāptiḥ, śivaliṃgārcanamahimavarṇanam..... ........ ....... 13 1
1.3.d:
8 शिवभक्तिमाहात्म्यप्रसंगेन-तस्करस्य शिवशिरोऽधिरुह्य घण्टां हरतः शिवलोकप्राप्तिवृत्तान्तः, सर्वजगतः शिवशक्तिमयत्ववर्णनम्, तत्र नराणां लिंगयुक्तत्वम् , स्त्रीणां च पिण्डीभूतत्वम्, शिवविष्ण्वोरभेदवर्णनम्, ब्रह्मादिकृतमणिमयादिलिंगपूजावर्णनम्, प्रह्लादबलिबाणासुरादिदैत्यानां शिवलिंगपूजापरत्ववर्णनम, शिवार्चनप्रभावाधिगतदुःसहप्रतापरावणनिर्जितैः सुरैर्नन्दिवाक्याच्छिवलिंगाराधने समुद्योगः. तत्र प्रसंगेन देवपृष्टेन नन्दिना स्वस्य वानराननत्वकारणवर्णनम्, तत्र रावणशापतो नन्दिनो वानराननत्वप्राप्तिः, नन्दिना च ऽवानरैः समेतस्य कस्यापि हस्तेन ते मृत्युर्भविष्यति' इति रावणाय शापदानम्. ततो नन्दिप्रभृतिभिः सर्वदेवैर्वैकुंठं गत्वा लिंगस्य पीठिकाभवनाय विष्णोः प्रार्थना, भगवता विष्णुना रावणहननायावतार-
ग्रहणे देवानामाश्वासनम्, विष्णोराज्ञया सर्वदेवानां वानरेष्वंशावतारवर्णनम् रामावतारः, रामेण रावणहननम्, रावणस्य शिवसायुज्यप्राप्तिः, शिवलिंगार्चनमहिमवर्णनम्..... ........ ....... 13 1
1.3.m: 8. In connection with the greatness of devotion to Śiva, the account of a thief attaining the world of Śiva while climbing onto the head of Śiva to steal a bell; the description of the entire world consisting of Śiva and Śakti, wherein men are endowed with the liṅga and women have become the pedestal (piṇḍī); the description of the non-difference between Śiva and Viṣṇu; the description of the worship of liṅgas made of gems and other materials by Brahmā and others; the description of the devotion to worshipping the Śivaliṅga by Prahlāda, Bali, Bāṇāsura, and other daityas; the effort undertaken by the gods, defeated by Rāvaṇa whose irresistible prowess was acquired through the power of Śiva worship, to worship the Śivaliṅga according to Nandin's words; in that connection, Nandin, questioned by the gods, explains the reason for his having a monkey face; there, Nandin acquired a monkey face due to Rāvaṇa's curse, and Nandin cursed Rāvaṇa saying, "Your death will come at the hands of someone accompanied by monkeys"; then all the gods, led by Nandin, went to Vaikuṇṭha and prayed to Viṣṇu to become the pedestal of the liṅga; the Lord Viṣṇu comforted the gods by agreeing to take an incarnation to slay Rāvaṇa; by Viṣṇu's command, the description of all the gods taking partial incarnations among the monkeys; the Rāma incarnation; the slaying of Rāvaṇa by Rāma; Rāvaṇa's attainment of union with Śiva; the description of the greatness of worshipping the Śivaliṅga. 13 1

1.3.s: 9 bṛhaspaterapamānena śakrasya rājyabhaṃgaḥ, baliparājitena śakreṇa brahmādibhiḥ saha viṣṇulokaṃ gatvā viṣṇoḥ prārthanākaraṇam, viṣṇorupadeśena śakrādīnāṃ baleḥ śaraṇagamanam, śaraṇāgatasya śakrasya nāradavākyena balino saṃmānakaraṇam, ratnalipsārthaṃ balinā pṛṣṭena śakreṇa samudramanthanodyogapraśaṃsanam, tataḥ samudramanthanāya mandarācalaṃ prati deva dānavānāṃ gamanam, mahatā prayāsena viṣṇusāhāyyena mandarācalamānīya vāsukiṃ manthanarajjuṃ vidhāya devadānavaiḥ samudramanthanārambhaṇam, mathyamānātsamudrāddhālāhala- samudbhavaḥ, nāradena saṃkaṭe'smiñchivaḥ smartavya ityukte'pi tadvacanamanākarṇya deveṣu svārthalipsayā samudramanthana eva pravṛtteṣu pravṛddhena hālāhalena vaikuṇṭhaparyantāṣṭāvaraṇasarvabrahmāṇḍadahanavarṇanam. 15
1.3.d: 9 बृहस्पतेरपमानेन शक्रस्य राज्यभंगः, बलिपराजितेन शक्रेण ब्रह्मादिभिः सह विष्णुलोकं गत्वा विष्णोः प्रार्थनाकरणम्, विष्णोरुपदेशेन शक्रादीनां बलेः शरणगमनम्, शरणागतस्य शक्रस्य नारदवाक्येन बलिनो संमानकरणम्, रत्नलिप्सार्थं बलिना पृष्टेन शक्रेण समुद्रमन्थनोद्योगप्रशंसनम्, ततः समुद्रमन्थनाय मन्दराचलं प्रति देव दानवानां गमनम्, महता प्रयासेन विष्णुसाहाय्येन मन्दराचलमानीय वासुकिं मन्थनरज्जुं विधाय देवदानवैः समुद्रमन्थनारम्भणम्, मथ्यमानात्समुद्राद्धालाहल- समुद्भवः, नारदेन संकटेऽस्मिञ्छिवः स्मर्तव्य इत्युक्तेऽपि तद्वचनमनाकर्ण्य देवेषु स्वार्थलिप्सया समुद्रमन्थन एव प्रवृत्तेषु प्रवृद्धेन हालाहलेन वैकुण्ठपर्यन्ताष्टावरणसर्वब्रह्माण्डदहनवर्णनम्. 15
1.3.m: 9. Śakra's loss of his kingdom due to the insult to Bṛhaspati; Śakra, defeated by Bali, went with Brahmā and the others to the realm of Viṣṇu and prayed to Viṣṇu; on Viṣṇu's instruction, Śakra and the others took refuge with Bali; the honoring of Śakra, who had taken refuge, by Bali at the word of Nārada; Śakra, questioned by Bali for the sake of obtaining jewels, praised the effort to churn the ocean; then the gods and dānavas went to Mount Mandara to churn the ocean; having brought Mount Mandara with great effort with the help of Viṣṇu and made Vāsuki the churning rope, the gods and dānavas began churning the ocean; the emergence of the hālāhala poison from the ocean being churned; although Nārada said that Śiva must be remembered in this danger, the gods did not heed his words, being driven by self-interest and continuing with the churning of the ocean itself; the description of the raging hālāhala burning the entire universe including the eight envelopes up to Vaikuṇṭha. 15

1.3.s: 10 viṣāgnivyāptaharibrahmādivijñaptaheraṃbaprārthanayā santuṣṭātsadāśivājjagatkāraṇayonirūpa parāśaktiprādurbhāvaḥ, tatra prasaṃgataḥ śaunakādipṛṣṭena lomaśākhyasūtena heraṃbotpattivṛttāntavarṇanam, tatra parāśakteḥ sakāśāddherambotpattivṛttāntaḥ, jñānavatā tena gaṇeśena śaktiyukta śrīśivastutikaraṇam, heraṃbastutiprasannena liṃgarūpeṇa kālakūṭagrasanam, tataḥ samastadevairdaityaiśca liṃgastutikaraṇam, tatstutiprasannasya śivasyāvirbhavanam, śivena hālāhalabhakṣaṇottaraṃ sarvakāryārambhe gaṇeśapūjanaṃ karttavyamityupadeśakaraṇam -.. 17
1.3.d: 10 विषाग्निव्याप्तहरिब्रह्मादिविज्ञप्तहेरंबप्रार्थनया सन्तुष्टात्सदाशिवाज्जगत्कारणयोनिरूप पराशक्तिप्रादुर्भावः, तत्र प्रसंगतः शौनकादिपृष्टेन लोमशाख्यसूतेन हेरंबोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्, तत्र पराशक्तेः सकाशाद्धेरम्बोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तः, ज्ञानवता तेन गणेशेन शक्तियुक्त श्रीशिवस्तुतिकरणम्, हेरंबस्तुतिप्रसन्नेन लिंगरूपेण कालकूटग्रसनम्, ततः समस्तदेवैर्दैत्यैश्च लिंगस्तुतिकरणम्, तत्स्तुतिप्रसन्नस्य शिवस्याविर्भवनम्, शिवेन हालाहलभक्षणोत्तरं सर्वकार्यारम्भे गणेशपूजनं कर्त्तव्यमित्युपदेशकरणम् -.. 17
1.3.m: 10. At the prayer of Heramba, who was petitioned by Hari, Brahmā, and the others enveloped by the fire of poison, the Supreme Śakti, who has the form of the womb that is the cause of the universe, manifested from the pleased Sadāśiva; in this connection, the sūta named Lomaśa, questioned by Śaunaka and others, describes the account of Heramba's origin; therein, the account of Heramba's birth from the Supreme Śakti; the wise Gaṇeśa praises the glorious Śiva accompanied by Śakti; pleased by Heramba's praise, [Śiva] in the form of a liṅga swallows the kālakūṭa poison; then all the gods and daityas praise the liṅga; Śiva, pleased by their praise, manifests; after consuming the hālāhala poison, Śiva instructs that the worship of Gaṇeśa must be performed at the beginning of all undertakings. 17

1.3.s: 11 śivaproktagaṇeśapūjāvidhivarṇanam, śivāntardhānānantaraṃ sarvadevaiḥ samudramanthanam, tataścandrotpattiḥ, candrasya samudrādutpatte kāraṇavarṇane gargaproktamuhūrttavṛttāntaḥ, mathyamānātsamudrātkāmadhenvādiratnotpattiḥ, tyarkṣṇaprādurbhāvaḥ, lakṣmīkṛtaviṣṇuvaraṇa vṛttāntavarṇanam. ... 19 2
1.3.d: 11 शिवप्रोक्तगणेशपूजाविधिवर्णनम्, शिवान्तर्धानानन्तरं सर्वदेवैः समुद्रमन्थनम्, ततश्चन्द्रोत्पत्तिः, चन्द्रस्य समुद्रादुत्पत्ते कारणवर्णने गर्गप्रोक्तमुहूर्त्तवृत्तान्तः, मथ्यमानात्समुद्रात्कामधेन्वादिरत्नोत्पत्तिः, त्यर्क्ष्णप्रादुर्भावः, लक्ष्मीकृतविष्णुवरण वृत्तान्तवर्णनम्. ... 19 2
1.3.m: 11. Description of the procedure for worshiping Gaṇeśa as taught by Śiva; the churning of the ocean by all the gods after the disappearance of Śiva; then the emergence of the Moon; the account of the auspicious moment (muhūrta) spoken by Garga in describing the cause of the Moon's birth from the ocean; the emergence of the wish-fulfilling cow (Kāmadhenu) and other jewels from the ocean as it was being churned; the manifestation of the three nakṣatras; description of the account of Lakṣmī choosing Viṣṇu. ... 19 2

1.3.s: 12 amṛtārthaṃ punaḥ samudramaṃthane sāmṛtakalaśadhanvantariprādurbhāvaḥ,dhanvaṃtarihastādvṛṣaparvaṇā daityenāmṛtakalaśaharaṇapūrvakaṃ sakaladaityaiḥ saha pātālagamanam, suraprārthanayā viṣṇunā mohinīrūpeṇa daityānvaṃcayitvā devānpratyamṛtapāyanam, devapaṅktyupaviṣṭasya candrasūryābhyāṃ sūcitasya rāhoḥ śiraśchedakaraṇam, amṛtapāne vañcitānāṃ daityānāṃ prakopavarṇanam.... 21 1
1.3.d: 12 अमृतार्थं पुनः समुद्रमंथने सामृतकलशधन्वन्तरिप्रादुर्भावः,धन्वंतरिहस्ताद्वृषपर्वणा दैत्येनामृतकलशहरणपूर्वकं सकलदैत्यैः सह पातालगमनम्, सुरप्रार्थनया विष्णुना मोहिनीरूपेण दैत्यान्वंचयित्वा देवान्प्रत्यमृतपायनम्, देवपङ्क्त्युपविष्टस्य चन्द्रसूर्याभ्यां सूचितस्य राहोः शिरश्छेदकरणम्, अमृतपाने वञ्चितानां दैत्यानां प्रकोपवर्णनम्.... 21 1
1.3.m: 12. In the renewed churning of the ocean for nectar, the appearance of Dhanvantari holding the jar of nectar; the demon Vṛṣaparvan seizing the jar of nectar from Dhanvantari's hand and going down to Pātāla along with all the demons; Viṣṇu, at the request of the gods, assuming the form of Mohinī, deceiving the demons, and causing the gods to drink the nectar; the severing of the head of Rāhu, who sat in the row of gods and was pointed out by the Sun and the Moon; description of the fury of the demons who were cheated of the drink of nectar. ... 21 1

1.3.s: 13 devadaityatumuladvandvayuddhavarṇanam, tasminyuddhe śaṅkareṇa svaśirasi rāhumuṇḍamālāveṣṭanam, tatprasaṃgena śivabhaktibhasmatripuṃḍrarudrākṣadhāraṇādiśivadharmamahimavaṇarnam, devadaityasaṃgrāme kālaneminā devānāṃ parājaye kṛte devairviṣṇustavanama, kālaneminā saha yuddhārtha viṣṇuprādurbhāvaḥ ... -.. ...... -..... -. 22 2
1.3.d: 13 देवदैत्यतुमुलद्वन्द्वयुद्धवर्णनम्, तस्मिन्युद्धे शङ्करेण स्वशिरसि राहुमुण्डमालावेष्टनम्, तत्प्रसंगेन शिवभक्तिभस्मत्रिपुंड्ररुद्राक्षधारणादिशिवधर्ममहिमवणर्नम्, देवदैत्यसंग्रामे कालनेमिना देवानां पराजये कृते देवैर्विष्णुस्तवनम, कालनेमिना सह युद्धार्थ विष्णुप्रादुर्भावः ... -.. ...... -..... -. 22 2
1.3.m: 13. Description of the tumultuous single combats between the gods and the demons; in that battle, Śaṃkara wrapping the severed head of Rāhu as a garland around his own head; in that connection, description of the greatness of the Śaiva duties, such as devotion to Śiva, the wearing of sacred ash, the triple mark (tripuṇḍra), and rudrākṣa beads; the gods' defeat by Kālanemi in the war between the gods and demons, and the gods' praise of Viṣṇu; the manifestation of Viṣṇu to fight against Kālanemi. ... 22 2

1.3.s: 14 kālanemiṃ hatvā viṣṇorantardhānam, tataḥ śakreṇānyāyena bhītapatitadaityahanana ārabdhe nāradena tannivāraṇam, tataḥ surasenāsametasyendrasyāmarāvatīṃ prati gamanapūrvakaṃ vijayābhiṣekavarṇanam, avaśiṣṭānāṃ parājitānāṃ daityānāṃ śukrācāryaṃ prati gamanam, śukreṇa daityānāṃ vijayasiddhyarthe tapaḥkaraṇam........ - -. 25 1
1.3.d: 14 कालनेमिं हत्वा विष्णोरन्तर्धानम्, ततः शक्रेणान्यायेन भीतपतितदैत्यहनन आरब्धे नारदेन तन्निवारणम्, ततः सुरसेनासमेतस्येन्द्रस्यामरावतीं प्रति गमनपूर्वकं विजयाभिषेकवर्णनम्, अवशिष्टानां पराजितानां दैत्यानां शुक्राचार्यं प्रति गमनम्, शुक्रेण दैत्यानां विजयसिद्ध्यर्थे तपःकरणम्........ - -. 25 1
1.3.m: 14. The disappearance of Viṣṇu after slaying Kālanemi; then, when Śakra unjustly begins to slay the terrified and fallen demons, Nārada restraining him; then Indra, accompanied by the army of the gods, going to Amarāvatī, and the description of his consecration of victory; the departure of the remaining defeated demons to Śukrācārya; Śukra performing austerity for the sake of securing victory for the demons. ... 25 1

1.3.s: 15 apamānitasya bṛhaspaterasāṃnidhye viśvakarmasutasya viśvarūpasya śakrapaurohityam, viśvarūpeṇa kṛtā daityānāṃ havirdānarūpāṃ devavañcanāmavekṣya śakreṇa vajreṇa viśvarūpaśiraśchedakaraṇam ,tadvadhodbhūtabrahmahatyayopadrutasya śakrasyāpsu nimajjanam ,tataḥ sarvalokapālairguroḥ samīpamabhyetya śakrakṛtabrahmahatyādivṛttāntanivedanam, tato nāradoktyendrasthāne nahuṣasya sthāpanaviṣaye mantraṇam, indrasthāne nahuṣasthāpanaṃ śrutvā śacyāḥ śokenāntaḥpuraṃ prati gamanam, nahuṣasyendrapadādhirohaṇāya sarvadevānumodanam, nahuṣasyendrapadābhiṣekaḥ, nahuṣeṇendrāṇīviṣaye kāmecchayā bṛhaspaterindrāṇīsaṃnidhau preṣaṇam, indrāṇyā'vāhya vāhanenāgamanārthaṃ nahuṣāya saṃdeśapraṣeṇam, nahuṣeṇa śibikāvāhanārthamagastyādibrāhmaṇayojanam, tataḥ kupitenāgastyena nahuṣasyājagaro bhaveti śāpapradānam, tato'jagaratvaprāptyā nahuṣasya svargātpatanottaraṃ yayāterindratve sthāpanam, tasya ca svapuṇya kīrtanena puṇyakṣayādadhaḥ patanam, tataḥ sarveṣāṃ surāṇāṃ cintāprāptiḥ... - ... - - 26 1
1.3.d: 15 अपमानितस्य बृहस्पतेरसांनिध्ये विश्वकर्मसुतस्य विश्वरूपस्य शक्रपौरोहित्यम्, विश्वरूपेण कृता दैत्यानां हविर्दानरूपां देववञ्चनामवेक्ष्य शक्रेण वज्रेण विश्वरूपशिरश्छेदकरणम् ,तद्वधोद्भूतब्रह्महत्ययोपद्रुतस्य शक्रस्याप्सु निमज्जनम् ,ततः सर्वलोकपालैर्गुरोः समीपमभ्येत्य शक्रकृतब्रह्महत्यादिवृत्तान्तनिवेदनम्, ततो नारदोक्त्येन्द्रस्थाने नहुषस्य स्थापनविषये मन्त्रणम्, इन्द्रस्थाने नहुषस्थापनं श्रुत्वा शच्याः शोकेनान्तःपुरं प्रति गमनम्, नहुषस्येन्द्रपदाधिरोहणाय सर्वदेवानुमोदनम्, नहुषस्येन्द्रपदाभिषेकः, नहुषेणेन्द्राणीविषये कामेच्छया बृहस्पतेरिन्द्राणीसंनिधौ प्रेषणम्, इन्द्राण्याऽवाह्य वाहनेनागमनार्थं नहुषाय संदेशप्रषेणम्, नहुषेण शिबिकावाहनार्थमगस्त्यादिब्राह्मणयोजनम्, ततः कुपितेनागस्त्येन नहुषस्याजगरो भवेति शापप्रदानम्, ततोऽजगरत्वप्राप्त्या नहुषस्य स्वर्गात्पतनोत्तरं ययातेरिन्द्रत्वे स्थापनम्, तस्य च स्वपुण्य कीर्तनेन पुण्यक्षयादधः पतनम्, ततः सर्वेषां सुराणां चिन्ताप्राप्तिः... - ... - - 26 1
1.3.m: 15. In the absence of the insulted Bṛhaspati, Viśvakarma's son Viśvarūpa becoming Śakra's domestic priest; Śakra seeing the deception of the gods committed by Viśvarūpa through offering oblations to the demons, and severing Viśvarūpa's head with his thunderbolt; Śakra, afflicted by the sin of killing a brahmin (brahmahatyā) arising from that slaying, plunging into the waters; then all the world-protectors approaching the Guru and reporting the matter of the killing of a brahmin and other events committed by Śakra; then, by Nārada's advice, consultation regarding the installation of Nahuṣa in Indra's place; hearing of Nahuṣa's installation in Indra's place, Śacī going to the inner apartments in grief; the approval of all the gods for Nahuṣa's ascent to Indra's station; the consecration of Nahuṣa to the office of Indra; Nahuṣa, driven by lust for Indrāṇī, sending Bṛhaspati into Indrāṇī's presence; Indrāṇī sending a message to Nahuṣa to come mounted upon an unprecedented conveyance; Nahuṣa yoking Agastya and other brahmins to carry his palanquin; then the enraged Agastya giving the curse, "Become a python"; then Nahuṣa falling from heaven upon becoming a python, and the subsequent installation of Yayāti in Indra's state; and his fall downwards due to the exhaustion of merit caused by boasting of his own merits; then anxiety overtaking all the gods. ... 26 1

1.3.s: 16 indrānayanārthaṃ śacyā bṛhaspatyādīnpratyājñākaraṇaṃ bṛhaspateḥ svāvahelanācchāpapradānaṃ ca, śacīśāpabhītyā bhītasya bṛhaspateḥ śakrānayanārthaṃ sarastīrapratigamanam, indrasyāhvāne kriyamāṇe sarastīrasthayā brahmahatyayā devānprati nijāvāsaprārthanāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ satyāṃ tasyāścaturvibhāgānpṛthivīvṛkṣajalanārīṣu varapradānapūrvakaṃ nikṣipya niṣpāpamindramamarāvatyāmānīyendrapade'bhiṣecanama, tato viśvarūpavadhakupitena tvaṣṭrā tapasā brahmāṇaṃ santoṣya tato devabhayāvahaputraprārthanama, tato brahmavarāttasya vṛtranāmakaputraprāptiḥ, tena vṛtrāsureṇa saṃjā taharṣāṇāṃ daityānāṃ pātālādbhūtalaṃ pratyāgamanam, taddṛṣṭvā devānāṃ bhayaprāptiḥ parasparaṃ mantrakaraṇaṃ ca, brahmaṇa ājñayā devairdadhīcāśramaṃ prati gatvā śastrārthaṃ dadhīciṃ prati tadasthiprārthanam, devairasthikṛte'bhyarthitena dadhīcinā yogena svadehavisarjanam... 28
1.3.d: 16 इन्द्रानयनार्थं शच्या बृहस्पत्यादीन्प्रत्याज्ञाकरणं बृहस्पतेः स्वावहेलनाच्छापप्रदानं च, शचीशापभीत्या भीतस्य बृहस्पतेः शक्रानयनार्थं सरस्तीरप्रतिगमनम्, इन्द्रस्याह्वाने क्रियमाणे सरस्तीरस्थया ब्रह्महत्यया देवान्प्रति निजावासप्रार्थनायां कृतायां सत्यां तस्याश्चतुर्विभागान्पृथिवीवृक्षजलनारीषु वरप्रदानपूर्वकं निक्षिप्य निष्पापमिन्द्रममरावत्यामानीयेन्द्रपदेऽभिषेचनम, ततो विश्वरूपवधकुपितेन त्वष्ट्रा तपसा ब्रह्माणं सन्तोष्य ततो देवभयावहपुत्रप्रार्थनम, ततो ब्रह्मवरात्तस्य वृत्रनामकपुत्रप्राप्तिः, तेन वृत्रासुरेण संजा तहर्षाणां दैत्यानां पातालाद्भूतलं प्रत्यागमनम्, तद्दृष्ट्वा देवानां भयप्राप्तिः परस्परं मन्त्रकरणं च, ब्रह्मण आज्ञया देवैर्दधीचाश्रमं प्रति गत्वा शस्त्रार्थं दधीचिं प्रति तदस्थिप्रार्थनम्, देवैरस्थिकृतेऽभ्यर्थितेन दधीचिना योगेन स्वदेहविसर्जनम्... 28
1.3.m: 16. Śacī issuing an order to Bṛhaspati and others to bring back Indra, and Bṛhaspati pronouncing a curse because of his own disregard; Bṛhaspati, frightened by fear of Śacī's curse, going to the bank of the lake to bring Śakra; when the invocation to Indra was being made, the sin of killing a brahmin residing on the bank of the lake petitioning the gods for her own abode, and their casting her into four divisions—earth, trees, water, and women—while conferring boons upon them, bringing Indra, cleansed of sin, to Amarāvatī and consecrating him in Indra's station; then Tvaṣṭṛ, enraged at the slaying of Viśvarūpa, pleasing Brahmā through austerity and requesting from him a son who would bring terror to the gods; then, by Brahmā's boon, his obtaining a son named Vṛtra; the demons, filled with joy because of that demon Vṛtra, coming back from Pātāla to the surface of the earth; the gods, seeing this, becoming terrified and taking counsel with one another; by the command of Brahmā, the gods going to Dadhīci's hermitage and requesting his bones from Dadhīci for a weapon; Dadhīci, besought by the gods for his bones, relinquishing his own body through yoga. ... 28

1.3.s: 17 surabhyā kāmadhenvā svajihvayā dadhīcyasthnālehanena nirmāṃsakaraṇam ,devaistadasthibhirva- jrādyāyudhanirmāpaṇam, suvarcākhyayā dadhīcipatnyā devānāmaprajastvaśāpapradānam, suvarcayā svaputraṃ pippalādamaśvatthasaṃnidhau saṃsthitaya ājñāpya patyā saha samādhinānugamanama, devāsurasaṃgrāmārambhaḥ, vṛtrāsurasaṃgrāmārambhaḥ vṛtrāsurahananāya bṛhaspatyājñayendreṇa śani- pradoṣavratakaraṇena śivārādhanam, śanipradoṣavratavidhānam, vṛtrāsurasya pūrvajanmani citrarathasya gaṃdharvasya devīśāpenāsuratvaprāptivṛttāntavarṇanama, śanipradoṣavratodyāpanavi- dhānama , śanipradoṣavrataprabhāvenendrasya parākramaprāptyanaṃtaraṃ daityaiḥ saha saṃgrāmakaraṇam, raṇātpalāyitānāṃ daityānāṃ vṛtrāsureṇa yuddhadharmavarṇanam, devadānavānāṃ tumulayuddhavarṇanam, vṛtrakṛtaprahāreṇendrasya mūrchayā patanam, tato labdhasaṃjñasyendrasya brahmājñayā vṛtrahananāya śivārādhanarūpatapaḥkaraṇama, śivoktyā vṛtramajayyaṃ matvā śakreṇa sahasravatsaraparyaṃtaṃ vṛtreṇa saha maitrīṃ kṛtvā vṛtrasamīpe taddhananāya nivāsakaraṇam, vṛtrasya garvaḥ, vajrapāṇinā narmadātaṭa oṃkāreśvarasya pradoṣavratena sampūjanam, vṛtrasya tu pradoṣasamaye śivapūjāṃ vismṛtya nidrākaraṇena tapohānyā niḥśrīkatvaprāptyā manorathabhaṃgaḥ, tato vṛtrendrayuddhe vṛtreṇendragrasanama, brahmaprārthanayā saṃtuṣṭena bhagavatā''kāśavāṇyā brahmāṇaṃ prati pradoṣavrate śakrasya pīṭhikālaṃghanakaraṇadoṣakaraṇāddaityakṛtagrāsarūpāpatprāptikathanam ,tatprasaṃgena traikālikaliṃgapūjāvidhivarṇanam, tataḥ śaṃkarājñayā devairyathāśāstraṃ liṃgapūjākaraṇam, tatprabhāveneṃdrasya vṛtrakukṣiṃ bhittvā bahirnirgamanam, vṛtrāsuraśarīrasya ca patana- varṇanam , gaṃgāyamunayormadhye'ntarvedyāṃ śarīrapatanama, mālave ca śiraḥpatanam, savardevaiḥ ṣaṇmāsaparyataṃ vṛtraśiraḥkṛntanam, indrasya jayaprāptiḥ, tato daityaniveditavṛtravadhavṛttāntena balinā śukrājñayā yajñe kriyamāṇe tasmādrathaprāptiḥ, taṃ rathamāruhya daityasenāsamanvitasya baleḥ suravijayārthaṃ svargalokaṃ prati gamanam, tadāgamanaṃ śrutvā śakrasya lajjā- prāptiḥ. .. 30 1
1.3.d: 17 सुरभ्या कामधेन्वा स्वजिह्वया दधीच्यस्थ्नालेहनेन निर्मांसकरणम् ,देवैस्तदस्थिभिर्व- ज्राद्यायुधनिर्मापणम्, सुवर्चाख्यया दधीचिपत्न्या देवानामप्रजस्त्वशापप्रदानम्, सुवर्चया स्वपुत्रं पिप्पलादमश्वत्थसंनिधौ संस्थितय आज्ञाप्य पत्या सह समाधिनानुगमनम, देवासुरसंग्रामारम्भः, वृत्रासुरसंग्रामारम्भः वृत्रासुरहननाय बृहस्पत्याज्ञयेन्द्रेण शनि- प्रदोषव्रतकरणेन शिवाराधनम्, शनिप्रदोषव्रतविधानम्, वृत्रासुरस्य पूर्वजन्मनि चित्ररथस्य गंधर्वस्य देवीशापेनासुरत्वप्राप्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम, शनिप्रदोषव्रतोद्यापनवि- धानम , शनिप्रदोषव्रतप्रभावेनेन्द्रस्य पराक्रमप्राप्त्यनंतरं दैत्यैः सह संग्रामकरणम्, रणात्पलायितानां दैत्यानां वृत्रासुरेण युद्धधर्मवर्णनम्, देवदानवानां तुमुलयुद्धवर्णनम्, वृत्रकृतप्रहारेणेन्द्रस्य मूर्छया पतनम्, ततो लब्धसंज्ञस्येन्द्रस्य ब्रह्माज्ञया वृत्रहननाय शिवाराधनरूपतपःकरणम, शिवोक्त्या वृत्रमजय्यं मत्वा शक्रेण सहस्रवत्सरपर्यंतं वृत्रेण सह मैत्रीं कृत्वा वृत्रसमीपे तद्धननाय निवासकरणम्, वृत्रस्य गर्वः, वज्रपाणिना नर्मदातट ओंकारेश्वरस्य प्रदोषव्रतेन सम्पूजनम्, वृत्रस्य तु प्रदोषसमये शिवपूजां विस्मृत्य निद्राकरणेन तपोहान्या निःश्रीकत्वप्राप्त्या मनोरथभंगः, ततो वृत्रेन्द्रयुद्धे वृत्रेणेन्द्रग्रसनम, ब्रह्मप्रार्थनया संतुष्टेन भगवता'ऽकाशवाण्या ब्रह्माणं प्रति प्रदोषव्रते शक्रस्य पीठिकालंघनकरणदोषकरणाद्दैत्यकृतग्रासरूपापत्प्राप्तिकथनम् ,तत्प्रसंगेन त्रैकालिकलिंगपूजाविधिवर्णनम्, ततः शंकराज्ञया देवैर्यथाशास्त्रं लिंगपूजाकरणम्, तत्प्रभावेनेंद्रस्य वृत्रकुक्षिं भित्त्वा बहिर्निर्गमनम्, वृत्रासुरशरीरस्य च पतन- वर्णनम् , गंगायमुनयोर्मध्येऽन्तर्वेद्यां शरीरपतनम, मालवे च शिरःपतनम्, सवर्देवैः षण्मासपर्यतं वृत्रशिरःकृन्तनम्, इन्द्रस्य जयप्राप्तिः, ततो दैत्यनिवेदितवृत्रवधवृत्तान्तेन बलिना शुक्राज्ञया यज्ञे क्रियमाणे तस्माद्रथप्राप्तिः, तं रथमारुह्य दैत्यसेनासमन्वितस्य बलेः सुरविजयार्थं स्वर्गलोकं प्रति गमनम्, तदागमनं श्रुत्वा शक्रस्य लज्जा- प्राप्तिः. .. 30 1
1.3.m: 17. The stripping of flesh from Dadhīci's bones by the celestial cow Surabhi through licking with her tongue; the fashioning of the vajra and other weapons by the gods from his bones; the pronouncing of a curse of childlessness upon the gods by Dadhīci's wife named Suvarcā; her instructing her son Pippalāda as she stood near the sacred fig tree, and then following her husband through yogic absorption; the beginning of the battle between the gods and the asuras; the beginning of the battle with the demon Vṛtra; Indra's worship of Śiva by performing the Śanipradoṣa vow at Bṛhaspati's command to slay the demon Vṛtra; the prescribed rules for the Śanipradoṣa vow; the description of the account of the demon Vṛtra's previous birth as the gandharva Citraratha receiving the state of an asura due to the Goddess's curse; the procedure for the concluding rite of the Śanipradoṣa vow; Indra's battle with the daityas after gaining valor through the power of the Śanipradoṣa vow; the demon Vṛtra's exposition of the duty of warriors to the daityas fleeing from the battlefield; the description of the tumultuous battle between the gods and the dānavas; Indra's falling into a swoon from a blow struck by Vṛtra; then Indra, having regained consciousness, performing austerity consisting of the worship of Śiva to slay Vṛtra according to Brahmā's command; Śakra, knowing Vṛtra to be invincible based on Śiva's words, forming an alliance with Vṛtra for a thousand years and residing near Vṛtra in order to kill him; Vṛtra's pride; the wielder of the thunderbolt's thorough worship of Oṃkāreśvara on the bank of the Narmadā through the Pradoṣa vow; but Vṛtra, having forgotten the worship of Śiva at the time of twilight and falling asleep, suffering loss of his austerity, loss of fortune, and the ruin of his purpose; then, in the battle between Vṛtra and Indra, Vṛtra's swallowing of Indra; the Lord, pleased by Brahmā's prayer, speaking via a voice from the sky to Brahmā to declare that Śakra incurred the misfortune of being swallowed by the daitya due to the flaw of transgressing the pedestal during the Pradoṣa vow; in that context, the description of the procedure for the three-fold daily worship of the liṅga; then, by the command of Śaṃkara, the gods performing the worship of the liṅga in accordance with the scriptures; by its power, Indra piercing Vṛtra's belly and coming out; the description of the falling of the demon Vṛtra's body; the body's falling in the Antarvedi between the Gaṅgā and the Yamunā; the head's falling in Mālava; the cutting of Vṛtra's head by all the gods for six months; Indra's attainment of victory; then Bali, informed of the account of Vṛtra's slaying by the daityas, obtaining a chariot from a sacrifice performed at the command of Śukra; Bali, mounted upon that chariot and accompanied by the army of daityas, setting out toward heaven for the conquest of the gods; Śakra's feeling of shame upon hearing of his arrival. [30] 1.

1.3.s: 18 baleḥ svarga āgamanaṃ dṛṣṭvā bṛhaspatipreraṇayendrādisarvadevānāṃ mayūrādipakṣirūpāṇi vidhāya svargānnirgatya kaśyapāśramaṃ pratyetya nijamātaramaditiṃ prati nijaduḥkhanivedanam , devarakṣārthamadityā prārthitena kaśyapenādityai śravaṇadvādaśīvratena vipṇūpāsanavarṇanam, adityā tadvratācaraṇena viṣṇuprādurbhāvaḥ, adityā devarakṣārthaṃ stutena bhagavatā balidamanārthaṃ nijagadācakrābhyāmājñāpitābhyāṃ tasya damane svasyāsāmarthyeṃ kathite ciṃtākaraṇama devendrāsane śukrakṛtābhiṣekeṇa balinā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samagrendrasampattipradānavarṇanam, tatprasaṃgena-indrāsanasthitasya yasya kasyāpīndrasya dānābhāvātpuṇyasamāptya nantaramindrakṛmitvaprāptivarṇanam, baleḥ pūrvajanmavṛttāntavarṇane kasyacitkitavasya gaṇikārthamupanītaṃ puṣpatāṃbūlādikaṃ praskhalena bhūmau patitaṃ vīkṣya śivārpaṇamastu iti buddhyā niścayena sarvapāpanivṛttiḥ, tato maraṇottaraṃ yamoktyā sārdhatrighaṭikāparyaṃtaṃ tasya śatakratupadaprāptau tena tasminnavasare'gastyādimaharṣibhya airāvatādidānavarṇanam, sārdhaghaṭikātritayottaraṃ pūrvapuraṃdarasya svasthāne sthitvā śacīnirbhartsanādanantaraṃ śacīkṛtatannirbhartsanapūrvakakitavendrapraśaṃsanam pūrvendrasya lajjāprāptiḥ, kitavapradattai- rāvatādikanijadhanaṃ samavekṣya yamaṃ prati gatvendreṇa kitavanirbhartsanam, tadā yamādi- ṣṭena citraguptena śivoddeśena kṛtasya dānasya mahimnā kitavasya narakānarhatvavarṇanam, tacchrutvā lajjitasya śakrasya svargagamanam, tasya kitavasya prahlādātmajavirocana- patnyāḥ surucyākhyāyā garbhe praveśaḥ, indreṇa viprarūpeṇa virocanaṃ balitātaṃ pratyabhyetya śiroyācanam, virocanasya kapaṭakṛtavipraveṣāya śakrāya svaśira utkṛtya pradānavarṇa- nam, virocanākhyasya piturmaraṇottaraṃ surucyāḥ sakāśādbalerjanma, surucyāḥ prasūtyanantaraṃ patilokaṃ prati gamanam, bhārgaveṇa baleḥ piturvirocanasya rājyāsane'bhiṣecanam , athendrādīnāṃ baliparājitānāṃ nirgamanottaraṃ baleḥ svarge'dhiṣṭhānārthaṃ sarveṣāmā- jñāpanam, tataḥ śu'kravacanena svarge sthātumanarhatāṃ vicārya baleḥ sarvadaityaiḥ saha śukreṇa ca saha vasudhātale narmadātīre gurukulyatīrthaṃ pratyāgatyāśvamedhādibahuyajñakaraṇavarṇanam- tasminneva baleryajñasamaye'ditikṛtavratasaṃtuṣṭasya bhagavato baṭurūpeṇāvataraṇam, tatasta- syopanayanādividheranantaraṃ baleryajñavāṭaṃ prati gamanam, balikṛtavāmanabadusatkāravarṇa- nam, vāmanavaṭubhagavatā baliṃ prati tadāgraheṇa tripādabhūmiyācanam, balinā tasmai bhūmidānapratijñāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ tadguruṇā śukreṇa tasya baṭorviṣṇutvavarṇanapūrvakaṃ bhūmidāna- niṣedhakaraṇam. ................ 36
1.3.d: 18 बलेः स्वर्ग आगमनं दृष्ट्वा बृहस्पतिप्रेरणयेन्द्रादिसर्वदेवानां मयूरादिपक्षिरूपाणि विधाय स्वर्गान्निर्गत्य कश्यपाश्रमं प्रत्येत्य निजमातरमदितिं प्रति निजदुःखनिवेदनम् , देवरक्षार्थमदित्या प्रार्थितेन कश्यपेनादित्यै श्रवणद्वादशीव्रतेन विप्णूपासनवर्णनम्, अदित्या तद्व्रताचरणेन विष्णुप्रादुर्भावः, अदित्या देवरक्षार्थं स्तुतेन भगवता बलिदमनार्थं निजगदाचक्राभ्यामाज्ञापिताभ्यां तस्य दमने स्वस्यासामर्थ्यें कथिते चिंताकरणम देवेन्द्रासने शुक्रकृताभिषेकेण बलिना ब्राह्मणेभ्यः समग्रेन्द्रसम्पत्तिप्रदानवर्णनम्, तत्प्रसंगेन-इन्द्रासनस्थितस्य यस्य कस्यापीन्द्रस्य दानाभावात्पुण्यसमाप्त्य नन्तरमिन्द्रकृमित्वप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, बलेः पूर्वजन्मवृत्तान्तवर्णने कस्यचित्कितवस्य गणिकार्थमुपनीतं पुष्पतांबूलादिकं प्रस्खलेन भूमौ पतितं वीक्ष्य शिवार्पणमस्तु इति बुद्ध्या निश्चयेन सर्वपापनिवृत्तिः, ततो मरणोत्तरं यमोक्त्या सार्धत्रिघटिकापर्यंतं तस्य शतक्रतुपदप्राप्तौ तेन तस्मिन्नवसरेऽगस्त्यादिमहर्षिभ्य ऐरावतादिदानवर्णनम्, सार्धघटिकात्रितयोत्तरं पूर्वपुरंदरस्य स्वस्थाने स्थित्वा शचीनिर्भर्त्सनादनन्तरं शचीकृततन्निर्भर्त्सनपूर्वककितवेन्द्रप्रशंसनम् पूर्वेन्द्रस्य लज्जाप्राप्तिः, कितवप्रदत्तै- रावतादिकनिजधनं समवेक्ष्य यमं प्रति गत्वेन्द्रेण कितवनिर्भर्त्सनम्, तदा यमादि- ष्टेन चित्रगुप्तेन शिवोद्देशेन कृतस्य दानस्य महिम्ना कितवस्य नरकानर्हत्ववर्णनम्, तच्छ्रुत्वा लज्जितस्य शक्रस्य स्वर्गगमनम्, तस्य कितवस्य प्रह्लादात्मजविरोचन- पत्न्याः सुरुच्याख्याया गर्भे प्रवेशः, इन्द्रेण विप्ररूपेण विरोचनं बलितातं प्रत्यभ्येत्य शिरोयाचनम्, विरोचनस्य कपटकृतविप्रवेषाय शक्राय स्वशिर उत्कृत्य प्रदानवर्ण- नम्, विरोचनाख्यस्य पितुर्मरणोत्तरं सुरुच्याः सकाशाद्बलेर्जन्म, सुरुच्याः प्रसूत्यनन्तरं पतिलोकं प्रति गमनम्, भार्गवेण बलेः पितुर्विरोचनस्य राज्यासनेऽभिषेचनम् , अथेन्द्रादीनां बलिपराजितानां निर्गमनोत्तरं बलेः स्वर्गेऽधिष्ठानार्थं सर्वेषामा- ज्ञापनम्, ततः शुऽक्रवचनेन स्वर्गे स्थातुमनर्हतां विचार्य बलेः सर्वदैत्यैः सह शुक्रेण च सह वसुधातले नर्मदातीरे गुरुकुल्यतीर्थं प्रत्यागत्याश्वमेधादिबहुयज्ञकरणवर्णनम्- तस्मिन्नेव बलेर्यज्ञसमयेऽदितिकृतव्रतसंतुष्टस्य भगवतो बटुरूपेणावतरणम्, ततस्त- स्योपनयनादिविधेरनन्तरं बलेर्यज्ञवाटं प्रति गमनम्, बलिकृतवामनबदुसत्कारवर्ण- नम्, वामनवटुभगवता बलिं प्रति तदाग्रहेण त्रिपादभूमियाचनम्, बलिना तस्मै भूमिदानप्रतिज्ञायां कृतायां तद्गुरुणा शुक्रेण तस्य बटोर्विष्णुत्ववर्णनपूर्वकं भूमिदान- निषेधकरणम्. ................ 36
1.3.m: 18. Seeing Bali's arrival in heaven, all the gods headed by Indra, prompted by Bṛhaspati, assuming the forms of peacocks and other birds, departing from heaven, going to Kaśyapa's hermitage, and relating their sorrow to their mother Aditi; Kaśyapa, entreatt by Aditi to protect the gods, describing the worship of Viṣṇu through the Śravaṇadvādaśī vow to Aditi; Viṣṇu's manifestation due to Aditi's performance of that vow; the Lord, praised by Aditi for the protection of the gods, commanding His mace and discus to subdue Bali, but feeling concern when they declared their inability to subdue him; the description of Bali, consecrated by Śukra on the throne of the king of the gods, giving away the entire wealth of Indra to brahmins; in that context, the description of any Indra on the throne of Indra, due to the lack of giving, becoming an insect in Indra's realm after the exhaustion of his merit; in the description of Bali's past life, a certain gambler seeing the flowers, betel, and other offerings brought for a courtesan fall onto the ground from a slip, and, thinking with resolve, 'May it be offered to Śiva,' becoming freed from all sins; then, after his death, by Yama's word, his gaining the station of the performer of a hundred sacrifices for three and a half ghaṭikās, and during that time his giving away of Airāvata and other gifts to Agastya and other great seers; after three and a half ghaṭikās, the former Purandara, staying in his own place, rebuking Śacī, followed by Śacī's rebuking him and praising the gambler-Indra; the former Indra's feeling of shame; Indra, seeing his own wealth such as Airāvata given away by the gambler, going to Yama and rebuking the gambler; then Citragupta, instructed by Yama, declaring that the gambler did not deserve hell owing to the greatness of the gift made with Śiva as its object; hearing this, Śakra, embarrassed, going to heaven; that gambler's entering into the womb of Suruci, the wife of Prahlāda's son Virocana; Indra, in the guise of a brahmin, approaching Bali's father Virocana and begging for his head; the description of Virocana cutting off his own head and giving it to Śakra, who was disguised as a deceitful brahmin; after the death of the father named Virocana, the birth of Bali from Suruci; Suruci, after giving birth, going to her husband's realm; Bali being consecrated by the descendant of Bhṛgu on the royal throne of his father Virocana; then, after the departure of Indra and the others defeated by Bali, Bali's command to all regarding their stay in heaven; then, considering the unsuitability of residing in heaven according to the word of Śukra, Bali, together with all the daityas and Śukra, coming to the Gurukulyatīrtha on the bank of the Narmadā on the surface of the earth and performing many sacrifices such as the horse-sacrifice; at that very time of Bali's sacrifice, the Lord, pleased by the vow performed by Aditi, incarnating as a celibate youth; then, after the rites of his sacred-thread investiture and the like, his going to Bali's sacrificial enclosure; the description of Bali's hospitable reception of the dwarf-youth; the Lord in the form of the dwarf-youth begging Bali for three paces of land upon his insistence; when Bali made a promise to give the land, his guru Śukra, declaring that youth to be Viṣṇu, forbidding the gift of land. [36]

1.3.s: 19 baṭave bhūmidānāya balerāgrahaṃ dṛṣṭvā śukreṇa balaye śāpapradānam balinā saṃkalpapūrvakaṃ bhūmidāne datte māyāvaṭorbhagavato vṛddhivarṇanam, padadvayena carācarabrahmāṇḍavyāpanama, tṛtīyapādaparimitabhūpradānārthaṃ vāmanena baliṃ prati garuḍapreṣaṇam, tato balipatnyā viṃdhyāvalyāḥ prahlādena saha vāmanabhagavatsamīpaṃ pratyāgamanama, tatastayā svasyā nijaputrasya nijapatyuśceti triṣu śiraḥsu vāmanarūpeṇa padatrayanidhānaprārthanam, tena vijñāpanena saṃtuṣṭena bhagavatā baleḥ sutalaṃ prati gamanārthamājñāpanam, baliprārthanayā viṣṇoḥ pātāle balisaṃnidhāvavasthānam, evaṃ pūrvajanmani kitavasya balitvaprāptirūpa- śivabhaktimahimaprabhāvavarṇanama........... 40 0
1.3.d: 19 बटवे भूमिदानाय बलेराग्रहं दृष्ट्वा शुक्रेण बलये शापप्रदानम् बलिना संकल्पपूर्वकं भूमिदाने दत्ते मायावटोर्भगवतो वृद्धिवर्णनम्, पदद्वयेन चराचरब्रह्माण्डव्यापनम, तृतीयपादपरिमितभूप्रदानार्थं वामनेन बलिं प्रति गरुडप्रेषणम्, ततो बलिपत्न्या विंध्यावल्याः प्रह्लादेन सह वामनभगवत्समीपं प्रत्यागमनम, ततस्तया स्वस्या निजपुत्रस्य निजपत्युश्चेति त्रिषु शिरःसु वामनरूपेण पदत्रयनिधानप्रार्थनम्, तेन विज्ञापनेन संतुष्टेन भगवता बलेः सुतलं प्रति गमनार्थमाज्ञापनम्, बलिप्रार्थनया विष्णोः पाताले बलिसंनिधाववस्थानम्, एवं पूर्वजन्मनि कितवस्य बलित्वप्राप्तिरूप- शिवभक्तिमहिमप्रभाववर्णनम........... 40 0
1.3.m: 19 Seeing Bali's resolve to grant land to the celibate student, Śukra gives a curse to Bali; Bali makes the formal vow and gives the gift of land, whereupon the divine illusory celibate student is described expanding [in size]; his pervading the universe of moving and unmoving things with two steps; Vāmana sending Garuḍa to Bali to obtain the gift of land measured by the third step; then Bali's wife Vindhyāvalī coming before Lord Vāmana along with Prahlāda; then her requesting the placing of the three steps in the form of Vāmana upon the three heads—of herself, of her own son, and of her own husband; the Lord, pleased by that petition, commanding Bali to go to Sutala; at Bali's request, Viṣṇu's remaining in Pātāla in the presence of Bali; thus the description of the power of the greatness of devotion to Śiva through which a gambler in a previous birth attained the state of Bali... 40

1.3.s: 2 0 śaṃbhorliṃgarūpatvaprāptivarṇane suratārakāsurasaṃgrāmavṛttāntavarṇanam, tatra parājayaṃ prāpya brahmasamīpe gatāndevānprati nabhovāṇyā tārakāsuravadhāya śivātmajasyaivāvaśyakatva- varṇanapūrvakaṃ patnyā viyuktasya śivasya dāraparigrahārthaṃ yatnakaraṇāyājñāpanama, devairna- bhovāṇīśravaṇānantaraṃ himālayaṃ prati gatvā kanyotpādanārtha prārthanākaraṇam, himavatā nijabhāryāyai menāyai kanyotpādanārthaṃ devaprārthanākīrtanam, menayā kanyājananeḥ mātā- pitrorduḥkhakīrtanama, tataḥ paropakārārthapravṛtterāvaśyakatvaṃ manyamānena himavatā bodhi-tayā menayā himavataḥ sakāśājjaṭhareḥ jagadambaivibhūtidhāraṇam, jagadambāvirbhāva- varṇanam......... ... .... 42 1
1.3.d: 2 0 शंभोर्लिंगरूपत्वप्राप्तिवर्णने सुरतारकासुरसंग्रामवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्, तत्र पराजयं प्राप्य ब्रह्मसमीपे गतान्देवान्प्रति नभोवाण्या तारकासुरवधाय शिवात्मजस्यैवावश्यकत्व- वर्णनपूर्वकं पत्न्या वियुक्तस्य शिवस्य दारपरिग्रहार्थं यत्नकरणायाज्ञापनम, देवैर्न- भोवाणीश्रवणानन्तरं हिमालयं प्रति गत्वा कन्योत्पादनार्थ प्रार्थनाकरणम्, हिमवता निजभार्यायै मेनायै कन्योत्पादनार्थं देवप्रार्थनाकीर्तनम्, मेनया कन्याजननेः माता- पित्रोर्दुःखकीर्तनम, ततः परोपकारार्थप्रवृत्तेरावश्यकत्वं मन्यमानेन हिमवता बोधि-तया मेनया हिमवतः सकाशाज्जठरेः जगदम्बैविभूतिधारणम्, जगदम्बाविर्भाव- वर्णनम्......... ... .... 42 1
1.3.m: 20 In the description of Śambhu attaining the form of a liṅga: an account of the battle between the gods and the demon Tāraka; the gods, defeated therein and approaching Brahmā, are addressed by a voice from the sky describing that the slaughter of the demon Tāraka requires only a son born of Śiva, and ordering them to make an effort toward Śiva taking a wife since he is separated from his spouse; after hearing the voice from the sky, the gods go to Himālaya and make a request for the production of a daughter; Himavat's telling of the gods' request to his wife Menā for the production of a daughter; Menā's recounting of the distress of parents upon the birth of a daughter; then, persuaded by Himavat who considers the necessity of acting for the welfare of others, Menā conceives in her womb the divine power of the Mother of the Universe from Himavat; the description of the manifestation of the Mother of the Universe... 42

1.3.s: 21 pārvatyā saha himavato maheśāntikaṃ prati darśanārthamāgamanam, śivena gauryāḥsvasevānumodanam, gaurīkṛtā śivaparicaryā, atrāntare devendraprahitamadanena śaṃkare bāṇavedha- karaṇam, madanabāṇaviddhasya śaṃkarasya pārvatīṃ dṛṣṭvā madanāturatvadaśāvarṇanam, tataḥ śaṃkareṇa vivekena manaso mohakāraṇaṃ vicāryātmānaṃ veddhukāmyayā sajjadhanuṣaṃ madanaṃ vilokya krodhavaśena tārtīyikalocanāgninā madanasya bhasmasātkaraṇam, samastadevai- rmadanasaṃjīvanārthaṃ śivaprārthanākaraṇam, tataḥ śivasyāntardhānam, dagdhaṃ madanaṃ vilokya madanapatnyā ratyā vilāpakaraṇam, girijāyā ratikṛtaṃ madanasaṃjīvanapratijñāpūrvaka māśvāsanam, tato ratyā madanadahanasthāna eva tapaścaryārambhaḥ tatrāntare nāradasya rati samīpamāgatya saṃbhāṣaṇe ratikṛtā nāradanirbhartsanā, nāradena śaṃbarāsuraṃ prati gatvā ratiharaṇārthamājñākaraṇam, śaṃbarāsureṇa balātkāreṇa ratyāḥ svagṛhaṃ pratyānayanapūrvakaṃ mahānasādhyakṣatāyāṃ niyojanam , atha pārvatyā śivaprāptyuddeśena tapaścaryākaraṇam, tattapastaptabrahmādisuravarāṇāṃ viṣṇunā saha śivapāṇigrahaṇārthaṃ mantrakaraṇam. 43 1
1.3.d: 21 पार्वत्या सह हिमवतो महेशान्तिकं प्रति दर्शनार्थमागमनम्, शिवेन गौर्याःस्वसेवानुमोदनम्, गौरीकृता शिवपरिचर्या, अत्रान्तरे देवेन्द्रप्रहितमदनेन शंकरे बाणवेध- करणम्, मदनबाणविद्धस्य शंकरस्य पार्वतीं दृष्ट्वा मदनातुरत्वदशावर्णनम्, ततः शंकरेण विवेकेन मनसो मोहकारणं विचार्यात्मानं वेद्धुकाम्यया सज्जधनुषं मदनं विलोक्य क्रोधवशेन तार्तीयिकलोचनाग्निना मदनस्य भस्मसात्करणम्, समस्तदेवै- र्मदनसंजीवनार्थं शिवप्रार्थनाकरणम्, ततः शिवस्यान्तर्धानम्, दग्धं मदनं विलोक्य मदनपत्न्या रत्या विलापकरणम्, गिरिजाया रतिकृतं मदनसंजीवनप्रतिज्ञापूर्वक माश्वासनम्, ततो रत्या मदनदहनस्थान एव तपश्चर्यारम्भः तत्रान्तरे नारदस्य रति समीपमागत्य संभाषणे रतिकृता नारदनिर्भर्त्सना, नारदेन शंबरासुरं प्रति गत्वा रतिहरणार्थमाज्ञाकरणम्, शंबरासुरेण बलात्कारेण रत्याः स्वगृहं प्रत्यानयनपूर्वकं महानसाध्यक्षतायां नियोजनम् , अथ पार्वत्या शिवप्राप्त्युद्देशेन तपश्चर्याकरणम्, तत्तपस्तप्तब्रह्मादिसुरवराणां विष्णुना सह शिवपाणिग्रहणार्थं मन्त्रकरणम्. 43 1
1.3.m: 21 Himavat coming together with Pārvatī before Maheśa for darśana; Śiva approving Gaurī's attendance upon him; Gaurī's performance of service to Śiva; meanwhile, Madana, dispatched by the lord of the gods, pierces Śaṃkara with an arrow; Śaṃkara, pierced by Madana's arrow, looks upon Pārvatī, and the state of his infatuation with love is described; then Śaṃkara, discerning through discrimination the cause of the agitation of his mind, sees Madana with bow strung, intending to pierce him, and, overpowered by wrath, reduces Madana to ashes with the fire of his third eye; all the gods praying to Śiva for the revival of Madana; then Śiva's disappearance; Rati, wife of Madana, bewailing upon seeing Madana burned; Girijā consoling Rati with a pledge to revive Madana; then Rati beginning the practice of austerity at the very place where Madana was burned; meanwhile, Nārada coming near Rati and conversing, whereupon Rati rebukes Nārada; Nārada going to the demon Śambara and directing him to abduct Rati; the demon Śambara forcibly bringing Rati to his own house and appointing her as superintendent of the kitchen; then Pārvatī's practice of austerity with the aim of obtaining Śiva; the best of gods, Brahmā and others, distressed by that austerity, holding counsel with Viṣṇu for Śiva's taking of her hand... 43

1.3.s: 22 brahmādidevānāṃ samudrasya pare pāre yogapoṭhe samādhisthaṃ śaṃkaraṃ pratyāgamanam, brahmādikṛtā mahādevastutiḥ surastutiprasannena śaṃkareṇa pārvatīkariṣyamāṇamadanasañjīvanā- vadhivarṇanam, devānprati kāmatyāgopadeśaḥ, tataḥ śivasya samādhisthito nandikṛta- sarvadevavisarjanam, śivasya. svarūpānandasamādhisthitiḥ, tato girijāprabalatapaḥ prabhāvācchivasya samādheścalanam, girijātapaḥsthānaṃ prati bahurūpeṇa śivasyāgamanam, girijācittaparīkṣārthaṃ baṭurūpiṇā śivanindākaraṇam, tadasahamānayā girajayā sakhī dvārā baṭorvisarjane kṛte śivasyāntardhānapūrvakaṃ svasvarūpeṇa prakaṭanam, śivapārvatīsaṃ- bhāṣaṇam, pārvatyā svodvāhārthaṃ śivaprārthanā, tataḥ pārvatyai varapradānapūrvakaṃ śivasya svalokaṃ prati gamanam, tato himālayena pārvatyāstapaḥsiddhatyanantaraṃ brahmādidevaiḥ saha mahatā samāraṃbheṇa svagṛhaṃ pratyānayanama.. .. ... 47 1
1.3.d: 22 ब्रह्मादिदेवानां समुद्रस्य परे पारे योगपोठे समाधिस्थं शंकरं प्रत्यागमनम्, ब्रह्मादिकृता महादेवस्तुतिः सुरस्तुतिप्रसन्नेन शंकरेण पार्वतीकरिष्यमाणमदनसञ्जीवना- वधिवर्णनम्, देवान्प्रति कामत्यागोपदेशः, ततः शिवस्य समाधिस्थितो नन्दिकृत- सर्वदेवविसर्जनम्, शिवस्य. स्वरूपानन्दसमाधिस्थितिः, ततो गिरिजाप्रबलतपः प्रभावाच्छिवस्य समाधेश्चलनम्, गिरिजातपःस्थानं प्रति बहुरूपेण शिवस्यागमनम्, गिरिजाचित्तपरीक्षार्थं बटुरूपिणा शिवनिन्दाकरणम्, तदसहमानया गिरजया सखी द्वारा बटोर्विसर्जने कृते शिवस्यान्तर्धानपूर्वकं स्वस्वरूपेण प्रकटनम्, शिवपार्वतीसं- भाषणम्, पार्वत्या स्वोद्वाहार्थं शिवप्रार्थना, ततः पार्वत्यै वरप्रदानपूर्वकं शिवस्य स्वलोकं प्रति गमनम्, ततो हिमालयेन पार्वत्यास्तपःसिद्धत्यनन्तरं ब्रह्मादिदेवैः सह महता समारंभेण स्वगृहं प्रत्यानयनम.. .. ... 47 1
1.3.m: 22 Brahmā and the other gods approaching Śaṃkara, who is established in meditation upon a yoga seat on the far shore of the ocean; the praise of Mahādeva by Brahmā and the others; Śaṃkara, pleased by the praise of the gods, describing the time limit for Pārvatī's revival of Madana; his instruction to the gods regarding the renunciation of desire; then, while Śiva is established in meditation, Nandi dismisses all the gods; Śiva's remaining in the meditative state of the bliss of his own essential nature; then, through the power of Girijā's mighty austerity, Śiva's meditation is shaken; Śiva coming in many forms to the place of Girijā's austerity; assuming the form of a celibate student to test Girijā's heart, his reviling of Śiva; Girijā, unable to endure that, having the celibate student dismissed through her friend, whereupon Śiva disappears and reveals his true form; the conversation of Śiva and Pārvatī; Pārvatī's petition to Śiva for her marriage; then Śiva granting a boon to Pārvatī and departing to his own realm; then Himālaya, after the success of Pārvatī's austerity, bringing her back to his house with great festivity along with Brahmā and the other gods... 47

1.3.s: 23 śivena himālayaṃ prati svasmai pārvatīpradānārthaṃ mādhyasthyakaraṇāya saptarṣipreṣaṇam, saptarṣihimālayasaṃvādaḥ, saptarṣikṛtavivāhaniścayānantaraṃ śivaṃ pratyāgatya vivāhaniścayanivedanam, mahādevena viṣṇvādidevanimantraṇārthaṃ nāradapreṣaṇam, viṣṇvādīnāṃ śivasamīpaṃ pratyāgamanapūrvakaṃ śivasya mahatā samāraṃbheṇa grahapūjanādividhipūrvakaṃ vivāhārthaṃ sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha śailarājapuraṃ prati gamanam- -.. .. ... - 50
1.3.d: 23 शिवेन हिमालयं प्रति स्वस्मै पार्वतीप्रदानार्थं माध्यस्थ्यकरणाय सप्तर्षिप्रेषणम्, सप्तर्षिहिमालयसंवादः, सप्तर्षिकृतविवाहनिश्चयानन्तरं शिवं प्रत्यागत्य विवाहनिश्चयनिवेदनम्, महादेवेन विष्ण्वादिदेवनिमन्त्रणार्थं नारदप्रेषणम्, विष्ण्वादीनां शिवसमीपं प्रत्यागमनपूर्वकं शिवस्य महता समारंभेण ग्रहपूजनादिविधिपूर्वकं विवाहार्थं सर्वैः सुरगणैः सह शैलराजपुरं प्रति गमनम्- -.. .. ... - 50
1.3.m: 23 Śiva sending the seven seers to Himālaya to act as mediators for giving Pārvatī to him; the conversation between the seven seers and Himālaya; after the marriage is determined by the seven seers, their return to Śiva and reporting of the determination of the marriage; Mahādeva sending Nārada to invite Viṣṇu and the other gods; Viṣṇu and the others coming into Śiva's presence, whereupon Śiva, with great celebration and following the rites such as worship of the planets, departs for the city of the king of mountains together with all the hosts of gods for the wedding... 50

1.3.s: 24 himālayena svasutāyā vivāhārthaṃ gargācāryapurohitaṃ puraskṛtya viśvakarmadvārā'pūrvamaṇḍapanirmāpaṇādivarṇanam, nāradādviśvakarmakṛtavivāhamaṇḍape cāturyeṇa sarvadevapratikṛticitravinyāsaṃ śrutvā sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ śaṃkāprāptiḥ, tataśca himavatā śivasya svanagaraṃ pratyānayanam, sarveṣāṃ ca śivādisurāṇāṃ vividhabhavyasthāneṣu nivāsaḥ 51
1.3.d: 24 हिमालयेन स्वसुताया विवाहार्थं गर्गाचार्यपुरोहितं पुरस्कृत्य विश्वकर्मद्वाराऽपूर्वमण्डपनिर्मापणादिवर्णनम्, नारदाद्विश्वकर्मकृतविवाहमण्डपे चातुर्येण सर्वदेवप्रतिकृतिचित्रविन्यासं श्रुत्वा सर्वेषां देवानां शंकाप्राप्तिः, ततश्च हिमवता शिवस्य स्वनगरं प्रत्यानयनम्, सर्वेषां च शिवादिसुराणां विविधभव्यस्थानेषु निवासः 51
1.3.m: 24 Himālaya, appointing the family priest Gargācārya at the head for his daughter's wedding, has an unprecedented pavilion constructed by Viśvakarman and so forth; from Nārada, hearing that all the gods' portraits were skillfully depicted in the wedding pavilion constructed by Viśvakarman, all the gods become apprehensive; and then Himavat bringing Śiva to his own city; and all the gods, Śiva and the rest, lodging in diverse magnificent abodes. 51

1.3.s: 25 sarveṣāṃ surāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthakpraśastasthāneṣu nivāsānantaraṃ menāyāḥ śivaṃ nīrājya tatsaundaryaṃ dṛṣṭvā santoṣaḥ, tataḥ pārvatyā vaivāhikavastraparidhānapūrvakaṃ haste varavaraṇārtha hāraṃ vṛtvā parameśvaraṃ dhyātvā tatpratīkṣārthamavasthānam, pāṇigrahaṇārtha vivāhamaṇḍapaṃ prati gargoktamuhūrte mahatā samārambheṇa śivasyānayanam, śivapārvatyorvivāhamaṃgalam, lakṣmī sāvitryarundhatyādi puṇyasuvāsinībhiḥ śivapārvatīnīrājanam, tato menayā sahitena himālayena kanyādānasaṃkalpakaraṇe śivasya nāmagotroccāraviṣayajijñāsāprasaṃge nāradena śivaparameśvaryavarṇanam .... .. .... .. ... ... 53
1.3.d: 25 सर्वेषां सुराणां पृथक्पृथक्प्रशस्तस्थानेषु निवासानन्तरं मेनायाः शिवं नीराज्य तत्सौन्दर्यं दृष्ट्वा सन्तोषः, ततः पार्वत्या वैवाहिकवस्त्रपरिधानपूर्वकं हस्ते वरवरणार्थ हारं वृत्वा परमेश्वरं ध्यात्वा तत्प्रतीक्षार्थमवस्थानम्, पाणिग्रहणार्थ विवाहमण्डपं प्रति गर्गोक्तमुहूर्ते महता समारम्भेण शिवस्यानयनम्, शिवपार्वत्योर्विवाहमंगलम्, लक्ष्मी सावित्र्यरुन्धत्यादि पुण्यसुवासिनीभिः शिवपार्वतीनीराजनम्, ततो मेनया सहितेन हिमालयेन कन्यादानसंकल्पकरणे शिवस्य नामगोत्रोच्चारविषयजिज्ञासाप्रसंगे नारदेन शिवपरमेश्वर्यवर्णनम् .... .. .... .. ... ... 53
1.3.m: 25. After all the gods had resided in their separate excellent places, Menā waved the lights before Śiva, saw his beauty, and was delighted; then Pārvatī put on the bridal garments, took the garland in her hand to choose the groom, meditated upon Parameśvara, and waited for him; at the auspicious moment declared by Garga, Śiva was brought in great splendor to the wedding pavilion for taking her hand; the auspicious marriage of Śiva and Pārvatī [took place]; auspicious married women such as Lakṣmī, Sāvitrī, and Arundhatī waved the lights before Śiva and Pārvatī; then, when Himālaya together with Menā undertook the ritual resolution for the giving away of the maiden, during the inquiry concerning the recital of Śiva's name and lineage (gotra), Nārada described Śiva's supreme sovereignty.

1.3.s: 26 himālayena kanyādānakaraṇam, śivapārvatīkṛtagṛhyāgnihomaprasaṅge pārvatīcaraṇanakhendudarśanaskhavalitabrahmaretasaḥ ṣaṣṭisahasravālakhilyotpattivṛttāntaḥ, tato himavatkṛtavarapakṣīyasamastasurasatkārapūrvakavivāhamaṅgalotsavavarṇanam -. ... ... 55
1.3.d: 26 हिमालयेन कन्यादानकरणम्, शिवपार्वतीकृतगृह्याग्निहोमप्रसङ्गे पार्वतीचरणनखेन्दुदर्शनस्खवलितब्रह्मरेतसः षष्टिसहस्रवालखिल्योत्पत्तिवृत्तान्तः, ततो हिमवत्कृतवरपक्षीयसमस्तसुरसत्कारपूर्वकविवाहमङ्गलोत्सववर्णनम् -. ... ... 55
1.3.m: 26. Himālaya's performance of the giving away of the maiden; on the occasion of the domestic fire oblations performed by Śiva and Pārvatī, the account of the birth of the sixty thousand Vālakhilyas from Brahmā's semen which fell upon seeing the moon-like nails of Pārvatī's feet; then the description of the auspicious marriage festival accompanied by Himavat's honoring of all the gods on the groom's side.

1.3.s: 27 tataśca varapakṣīyeṇa viṣṇunā vadhūpakṣīyāṇāṃ sahyācalavindhyācalādivividhaparvatān yathāyogyasatkārakaraṇam, tataśca varayātrāsamārambhaḥ, varayātrāyāṃ sarvaparvataiḥ śivārca-nam, atha sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ svasvasthānaṃ prati gamanam, tataśca śivapārvatyorgandhamādanaparvate ramaṇam, tataścaikānte śivapārvatyoḥ suratasamārambhārambhaḥ, atyadbhutatatsuratasaṃjātavitrāsairbrahmādibhiḥ surairekānte tatsamīpaṃ pratyagneḥ preṣaṇam, bhikṣukavyājena suratasamaye samāgatenāgninā pārvatīśāpena śivasya reto bhakṣayitvā devānāṃ samīpaṃ pratyāgamanam, agnimukhodbhavaretasā sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ sagarbhatvavarṇanam tataḥ sarvadevānāṃ viṣṇuṃ prati śaraṇagamanam ,viṣṇupreraṇayā sarvadevaiḥ śivaprārthanam, tataḥ santuṣṭasya śivasyājñayā sarvadevairmukhato retaśchardanam, sarvadevaccharditaretasaḥ suvarṇamayapuñjatvavarṇanam, tataḥ śivenāgnaye yonau retaḥsecanājñākaraṇama, athāgneḥ samujjvalitasya samīpeṃ'gatāpārthaṃ samāgatānāṃ ṣaṭkṛttikākhyānāṃ ṣaḍṛṣipatnīnāṃ śarīreṣu nijajvālādvārā retaḥ paramāṇupraveśanena nīretastvaprāptipūrvake viśrāntiḥ, tābhiḥ kṛttikābhirvyabhicāraśaṃkayā tapyamānābhirhimavato gireḥ pṛṣṭhe gaṃgāyāṃ tasya retaso yugapadeva visarjanam, tadretasaḥ sakāśāttatkṣaṇa eva ṣaṇmukhabālakotpattiḥ, tasya bālakasya janmasamaya evākasmādgirijāyāḥ stanaprasravaḥ, tadānīmeva nāradena śivaṃ pratyāgatya kumārajanmavṛttāntakathanam, tasya kumārasya darśanārthaṃ sarvasuraiḥ saha śivapārvatyoḥ kumārasamīpaṃ pratyāgamanam, kumārābhyudayotsavasamārambhaḥ, śivapārvatyorharṣaprāptiḥ. 56 2
1.3.d: 27 ततश्च वरपक्षीयेण विष्णुना वधूपक्षीयाणां सह्याचलविन्ध्याचलादिविविधपर्वतान् यथायोग्यसत्कारकरणम्, ततश्च वरयात्रासमारम्भः, वरयात्रायां सर्वपर्वतैः शिवार्च-नम्, अथ सर्वेषां देवानां स्वस्वस्थानं प्रति गमनम्, ततश्च शिवपार्वत्योर्गन्धमादनपर्वते रमणम्, ततश्चैकान्ते शिवपार्वत्योः सुरतसमारम्भारम्भः, अत्यद्भुततत्सुरतसंजातवित्रासैर्ब्रह्मादिभिः सुरैरेकान्ते तत्समीपं प्रत्यग्नेः प्रेषणम्, भिक्षुकव्याजेन सुरतसमये समागतेनाग्निना पार्वतीशापेन शिवस्य रेतो भक्षयित्वा देवानां समीपं प्रत्यागमनम्, अग्निमुखोद्भवरेतसा सर्वेषां देवानां सगर्भत्ववर्णनम् ततः सर्वदेवानां विष्णुं प्रति शरणगमनम् ,विष्णुप्रेरणया सर्वदेवैः शिवप्रार्थनम्, ततः सन्तुष्टस्य शिवस्याज्ञया सर्वदेवैर्मुखतो रेतश्छर्दनम्, सर्वदेवच्छर्दितरेतसः सुवर्णमयपुञ्जत्ववर्णनम्, ततः शिवेनाग्नये योनौ रेतःसेचनाज्ञाकरणम, अथाग्नेः समुज्ज्वलितस्य समीपेंऽगतापार्थं समागतानां षट्कृत्तिकाख्यानां षडृषिपत्नीनां शरीरेषु निजज्वालाद्वारा रेतः परमाणुप्रवेशनेन नीरेतस्त्वप्राप्तिपूर्वके विश्रान्तिः, ताभिः कृत्तिकाभिर्व्यभिचारशंकया तप्यमानाभिर्हिमवतो गिरेः पृष्ठे गंगायां तस्य रेतसो युगपदेव विसर्जनम्, तद्रेतसः सकाशात्तत्क्षण एव षण्मुखबालकोत्पत्तिः, तस्य बालकस्य जन्मसमय एवाकस्माद्गिरिजायाः स्तनप्रस्रवः, तदानीमेव नारदेन शिवं प्रत्यागत्य कुमारजन्मवृत्तान्तकथनम्, तस्य कुमारस्य दर्शनार्थं सर्वसुरैः सह शिवपार्वत्योः कुमारसमीपं प्रत्यागमनम्, कुमाराभ्युदयोत्सवसमारम्भः, शिवपार्वत्योर्हर्षप्राप्तिः. 56 2
1.3.m: 27. And then Viṣṇu, on the side of the bridegroom, duly honored the various mountains on the bride's side, such as Mount Sahya and Mount Vindhya; then the departure of the wedding procession; during the wedding procession, the worship of Śiva by all the mountains; then the return of all the gods to their respective places; then Śiva and Pārvatī's love-play on Mount Gandhamādana; then the commencement of intimate intercourse by Śiva and Pārvatī; the gods, headed by Brahmā, terrified by that extraordinary intercourse, sent Agni secretly into their presence; Agni, having arrived at the time of lovemaking in the guise of a beggar, through the curse of Pārvatī swallowed Śiva's semen and returned to the presence of the gods; the description of all the gods becoming pregnant by the semen originating from Agni's mouth; then all the gods sought refuge in Viṣṇu; prompted by Viṣṇu, all the gods prayed to Śiva; then, by the command of the pleased Śiva, all the gods vomited the semen from their mouths; the description of the semen vomited by all the gods becoming a heap of gold; then Śiva gave the command to Agni to discharge the semen into a womb; then, into the bodies of the six wives of the seers known as the six Kṛttikās, who had come near the blazing Agni to warm their limbs, he introduced the subtle particles of semen through his flames, and so, freed of the semen, found relief; those Kṛttikās, tormented by fear of [accusation of] unchastity, cast that semen simultaneously into the Gaṅgā on the slope of Mount Himavat; from that semen, at that very moment, a six-faced child was born; at the very time of that child's birth, milk suddenly flowed from Girijā's breasts; just then Nārada came to Śiva and related the account of Kumāra's birth; Śiva and Pārvatī, along with all the gods, came to Kumāra to see that boy; the commencement of the festival of Kumāra's rising fortunes; the attainment of joy by Śiva and Pārvatī.

1.3.s:
28 tatastārakāsuravijayārthaṃ kumāraṃ puraskṛtya śivājñayā sarvadevānāṃ nirgamanam, tasminsamaye nabhovāṇyā devānāṃ vijayābhiśaṃsanama, etasminnevāntare samāgatāyā mṛtyukanyāyāḥ senākhyāyāḥ kumāreṇa brahmavākyādvaraṇam, tataḥ kumārasya senāpatitvaprāptivarṇanam, tasminneva samaye samāgatānāṃ gaṃgāgaurīkṛttikānāṃ skandamātṛtvamabhilaṣantīnāṃ skandena mātṛgaṇatvena sthāpanam tataḥ kumārasya sarvadevaiḥ saha tārakāsuraṃ pratyabhiyānam,
tataśca devadaityasenāsaṃnāhaḥ.. ... 58 2
1.3.d:
28 ततस्तारकासुरविजयार्थं कुमारं पुरस्कृत्य शिवाज्ञया सर्वदेवानां निर्गमनम्, तस्मिन्समये नभोवाण्या देवानां विजयाभिशंसनम, एतस्मिन्नेवान्तरे समागताया मृत्युकन्यायाः सेनाख्यायाः कुमारेण ब्रह्मवाक्याद्वरणम्, ततः कुमारस्य सेनापतित्वप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, तस्मिन्नेव समये समागतानां गंगागौरीकृत्तिकानां स्कन्दमातृत्वमभिलषन्तीनां स्कन्देन मातृगणत्वेन स्थापनम् ततः कुमारस्य सर्वदेवैः सह तारकासुरं प्रत्यभियानम्,
ततश्च देवदैत्यसेनासंनाहः.. ... 58 2
1.3.m: 28. Then, for the sake of victory over the demon Tāraka, all the gods set out on Śiva's command, placing Kumāra at their head; at that moment, a voice from the sky proclaimed the victory of the gods; in the meantime, the maiden of Death named Senā arrived, whom Kumāra married according to the word of Brahmā; then the description of Kumāra obtaining the office of commander of the army (senāpati); at that very moment, Gaṅgā, Gaurī, and the Kṛttikās arrived, desiring the motherhood of Skanda, and Skanda established them as the group of mothers; then Kumāra's march against the demon Tāraka together with all the gods; and then the marshalling of the armies of the gods and the Daityas.

1.3.s: 29 devāsurāṇāṃ saṃgrāme sarvadevaparājaye viṣṇukṛtayā praśaṃsayā kumārasya tārakāsureṇa saha saṃgrāmārthaṃ purato'vasthitau tārakāsureṇa nijaprauḍhipraśaṃsākaraṇam 60 1
1.3.d: 29 देवासुराणां संग्रामे सर्वदेवपराजये विष्णुकृतया प्रशंसया कुमारस्य तारकासुरेण सह संग्रामार्थं पुरतोऽवस्थितौ तारकासुरेण निजप्रौढिप्रशंसाकरणम् 60 1
1.3.m: 29. In the battle between the gods and the asuras, when all the gods were defeated, Kumāra, praised by Viṣṇu, stood before the demon Tāraka to fight; Tāraka praised his own might.

1.3.s: 30 svaprauḍhiṃ valgamānasya tasyendrādibhiḥ saha tumulasaṃgrāme devānāṃ parājayaṃ dṛṣṭvā kārtike yasvāminastārakāsureṇa saha dvandvayuddhavarṇanam, kumārasya yuddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā khinnānāṃ yuddhāvalokanārthaṃ samāgatānāṃ himālayādīnāṃ kumāreṇa sāntvanam, tataḥ kumāreṇa tārakaśiraśchedakaraṇam, tatastārakavadhena kumārasya jayaprāptipūrvakaṃ sarvadevakṛtakumāravijayotsa- vavarṇanam.. ... 61
1.3.d: 30 स्वप्रौढिं वल्गमानस्य तस्येन्द्रादिभिः सह तुमुलसंग्रामे देवानां पराजयं दृष्ट्वा कार्तिके यस्वामिनस्तारकासुरेण सह द्वन्द्वयुद्धवर्णनम्, कुमारस्य युद्धं दृष्ट्वा खिन्नानां युद्धावलोकनार्थं समागतानां हिमालयादीनां कुमारेण सान्त्वनम्, ततः कुमारेण तारकशिरश्छेदकरणम्, ततस्तारकवधेन कुमारस्य जयप्राप्तिपूर्वकं सर्वदेवकृतकुमारविजयोत्स- ववर्णनम्.. ... 61
1.3.m: 30. Seeing that he was boasting of his own might and that the gods were defeated in the tumultuous battle with Indra and the others, the description of the duel between Lord Kārttikeya and the demon Tāraka; Kumāra consoled Himālaya and the others who had arrived to watch the battle and were distressed at seeing Kumāra fighting; then Kumāra severed Tāraka's head; then the description of Kumāra's attainment of victory through the slaying of Tāraka, followed by the festival of Kumāra's victory celebrated by all the gods.

1.3.s: 31 kumārasvāmimāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra kumāradarśanamātreṇa pāpināmapi pavitratāṃ dṛṣṭvā yamalokasya vaiyarthyaṃ manyamānena yamena brahmaviṣṇvādidevānpuraskṛtya śivaṃ pratyāgatya śivaṃ stutvā kumāradarśanamāhātmyatokhilapāpijanānāṃ svargaprāptau nijādhikāravaiyarthyanivedanam, tataḥ śaṃkareṇa saṃsāranivṛttyai viśuddhabhāvanāprāptyarthaṃ śuddhadharmasvarūpopadeśakaraṇam, śaṃkarakṛtopadeśena yamasya viśuddhātmatāprāptivarṇanam, atha kumārasya sarvagiribhiḥ stutikaraṇama, kumāreṇa giribhyaḥ śivaliṃgarūpatvavarapradānam, nandinā śivaliṃgapūjanaviṣaye praśne kṛte sati kumāreṇa nānāvidharatnaliṃganārmadeśvara- liṃgapūjāmāhātmyakathanam ...... - - 62
1.3.d: 31 कुमारस्वामिमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र कुमारदर्शनमात्रेण पापिनामपि पवित्रतां दृष्ट्वा यमलोकस्य वैयर्थ्यं मन्यमानेन यमेन ब्रह्मविष्ण्वादिदेवान्पुरस्कृत्य शिवं प्रत्यागत्य शिवं स्तुत्वा कुमारदर्शनमाहात्म्यतोखिलपापिजनानां स्वर्गप्राप्तौ निजाधिकारवैयर्थ्यनिवेदनम्, ततः शंकरेण संसारनिवृत्त्यै विशुद्धभावनाप्राप्त्यर्थं शुद्धधर्मस्वरूपोपदेशकरणम्, शंकरकृतोपदेशेन यमस्य विशुद्धात्मताप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, अथ कुमारस्य सर्वगिरिभिः स्तुतिकरणम, कुमारेण गिरिभ्यः शिवलिंगरूपत्ववरप्रदानम्, नन्दिना शिवलिंगपूजनविषये प्रश्ने कृते सति कुमारेण नानाविधरत्नलिंगनार्मदेश्वर- लिंगपूजामाहात्म्यकथनम् ...... - - 62
1.3.m: 31. The description of the māhātmya of Lord Kumāra; seeing the purification of even sinners merely by the sight of Kumāra, Yama considered the realm of Yama to be useless, and placing the gods headed by Brahmā and Viṣṇu before him, approached Śiva, praised Śiva, and reported the uselessness of his own authority since all sinners were attaining heaven due to the māhātmya of the sight of Kumāra; then Śaṅkara imparted instruction on the true nature of pure dharma for the cessation of worldly existence and the attainment of pure contemplation; the description of Yama attaining purity of self through the teaching given by Śaṅkara; then the praising of Kumāra by all the mountains; Kumāra's granting of the boon of being forms of the Śivaliṅga to the mountains; upon Nandin asking a question concerning the worship of the Śivaliṅga, Kumāra's narration of the māhātmya of worshiping various gem-made liṅgas and the Narmadeśvara liṅga.

1.3.s: 32 śivārādhanamāhātmyaprasaṃgena śvetākhyabhūpateścaritravarṇanam, tatrājanmataḥ śivabhaktiparāyaṇasya śvetabhūpasyāntakāle dhyānāvasthitasya saṃharaṇe'śaknuvatāṃ yamādīnāṃ paśyatāṃ satāṃ kālena khaḍgena haṃtuṃ kṛtamudyogaṃ dṛṣṭvā paramātmanā śivena svabhaktarakṣaṇārthaṃ tṛtīya- locanāgninā kālasya bhasmīkaraṇam, atha samādhervyutthitena śvetabhūpena purato dahyamānaṃ kālaṃ dṛṣṭvā vyagrībhūya rudrastutikaraṇam, rudreṇa tasmai haṃtukāmaḥ kālo mayā dagdha-iti kāladahnakāraṇakathanam, tataḥ śvetabhūpaprārthanayā maheśvareṇa kālasaṃjīvanam, kālakṛtā bhagavatstutiḥ, tataḥ kālena paropakāraparāyaṇasya śvetabhūpasya praśaṃsā. karaṇama, atha kālena yamādibhiḥ saha śivaṃ praṇamya śvetabhūpaṃ ca saṃstutya svālayaṃ pratyāgatya tripuṇḍra jaṭā bhasma rudrākṣa dhāraṇādirūpa śivadharmamāhātmyavarṇanapūrvakaṃ nijadūtānāṃ śivadūtā yamaloke nāneyā-ityājñākaraṇam, śvetabhūpasya śivasāyujyavarṇanam, śivadharmaviṣaye kirātavṛttāntaprastāvaḥ- ... .. .. 64
1.3.d: 32 शिवाराधनमाहात्म्यप्रसंगेन श्वेताख्यभूपतेश्चरित्रवर्णनम्, तत्राजन्मतः शिवभक्तिपरायणस्य श्वेतभूपस्यान्तकाले ध्यानावस्थितस्य संहरणेऽशक्नुवतां यमादीनां पश्यतां सतां कालेन खड्गेन हंतुं कृतमुद्योगं दृष्ट्वा परमात्मना शिवेन स्वभक्तरक्षणार्थं तृतीय- लोचनाग्निना कालस्य भस्मीकरणम्, अथ समाधेर्व्युत्थितेन श्वेतभूपेन पुरतो दह्यमानं कालं दृष्ट्वा व्यग्रीभूय रुद्रस्तुतिकरणम्, रुद्रेण तस्मै हंतुकामः कालो मया दग्ध-इति कालदह्नकारणकथनम्, ततः श्वेतभूपप्रार्थनया महेश्वरेण कालसंजीवनम्, कालकृता भगवत्स्तुतिः, ततः कालेन परोपकारपरायणस्य श्वेतभूपस्य प्रशंसा. करणम, अथ कालेन यमादिभिः सह शिवं प्रणम्य श्वेतभूपं च संस्तुत्य स्वालयं प्रत्यागत्य त्रिपुण्ड्र जटा भस्म रुद्राक्ष धारणादिरूप शिवधर्ममाहात्म्यवर्णनपूर्वकं निजदूतानां शिवदूता यमलोके नानेया-इत्याज्ञाकरणम्, श्वेतभूपस्य शिवसायुज्यवर्णनम्, शिवधर्मविषये किरातवृत्तान्तप्रस्तावः- ... .. .. 64
1.3.m: [Chapter] 32: In the context of the greatness of the worship of Śiva, the description of the deeds of King Śveta; there, seeing Yama and the others unable to destroy King Śveta, who was devoted to Śiva from birth and fixed in meditation at the time of death, and seeing Kāla strive to kill him with a sword while they watched, the supreme Self Śiva reduces Kāla to ashes with the fire of his third eye to protect his devotee; then King Śveta, rising from samādhi, seeing Kāla burning before him, becomes agitated and praises Rudra; Rudra tells the reason for burning Kāla, saying, 'Kāla, wishing to slay you, was burnt by me'; then, at King Śveta's request, Maheśvara revives Kāla; the praise of the Lord spoken by Kāla; then Kāla praises King Śveta who is intent on doing good to others; then Kāla, bowing to Śiva along with Yama and the others and praising King Śveta, returns to his own abode, and after describing the greatness of Śiva's duty consisting in wearing the tripuṇḍra mark, matted hair, ash, and rudrākṣa beads, orders his messengers that Śiva's messengers must not be brought to Yama's world; the description of King Śveta attaining union with Śiva; the introduction of the story of the hunter concerning Śiva's duty. 64

1.3.s: 33 caṇḍanāmakasya kasyacitkirātasya kadācinmāghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ mahāśivarātryāṃ mṛgayārthaṃ vicarato yāvaddinaṃ mṛgādivadhyajīvā'prāptau rātrau bilvavṛkṣopari sthitvā'jñānato'nāyāsena bilvapatracchedanena vṛkṣā'dhaḥsthitasya śivasya pūjanam, gaṃḍūṣajalena śivasnapanaṃ ca bhakṣyālābhādanāyāsenopoṣaṇaṃ ca- tasya bhojanābhāvāttadbhāryāyā api tatpratīkṣaṇanopoṣaṇaṃ ca, athāparedyurnadītīre tadbhāryayā'nne samānīya sthāpite'kasmācchunā''gatya bhakṣite sati kirātasyānnadānaṃ saṃjātamiti matvā mahānsaṃtoṣaḥ, tenājñānasaṃjātaśivarātrivratamahimnā kirātasya śivalokaprāpaṇāya śivagaṇairvimānānayanam-śivagaṇaiḥ saha kirātasya śivalokaṃ prati gamanam ḥ śivarātrivratotpattivarṇanam- śivarātrivratamāhātmyaprasaṃgena vidhavābrāhmaṇīputrasya śvapacādutpannasya śivarātrivrataprabhāvājjanmāntare śivādvīrabhadrākhyayā janmaprāptivṛttāntavarṇanam-śivarātrivratena bharatādimahīpatīnāṃ siddhatvaprāptivarṇanam. 66
1.3.d: 33 चण्डनामकस्य कस्यचित्किरातस्य कदाचिन्माघकृष्णचतुर्दश्यां महाशिवरात्र्यां मृगयार्थं विचरतो यावद्दिनं मृगादिवध्यजीवाऽप्राप्तौ रात्रौ बिल्ववृक्षोपरि स्थित्वाऽज्ञानतोऽनायासेन बिल्वपत्रच्छेदनेन वृक्षाऽधःस्थितस्य शिवस्य पूजनम्, गंडूषजलेन शिवस्नपनं च भक्ष्यालाभादनायासेनोपोषणं च- तस्य भोजनाभावात्तद्भार्याया अपि तत्प्रतीक्षणनोपोषणं च, अथापरेद्युर्नदीतीरे तद्भार्ययाऽन्ने समानीय स्थापितेऽकस्माच्छुना'ऽगत्य भक्षिते सति किरातस्यान्नदानं संजातमिति मत्वा महान्संतोषः, तेनाज्ञानसंजातशिवरात्रिव्रतमहिम्ना किरातस्य शिवलोकप्रापणाय शिवगणैर्विमानानयनम्-शिवगणैः सह किरातस्य शिवलोकं प्रति गमनम् ः शिवरात्रिव्रतोत्पत्तिवर्णनम्- शिवरात्रिव्रतमाहात्म्यप्रसंगेन विधवाब्राह्मणीपुत्रस्य श्वपचादुत्पन्नस्य शिवरात्रिव्रतप्रभावाज्जन्मान्तरे शिवाद्वीरभद्राख्यया जन्मप्राप्तिवृत्तान्तवर्णनम्-शिवरात्रिव्रतेन भरतादिमहीपतीनां सिद्धत्वप्राप्तिवर्णनम्. 66
1.3.m: [Chapter] 33: A certain hunter named Caṇḍa, roaming once for hunting on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Māgha, on Mahāśivarātri, finding no deer or other animals to kill throughout the day, stays upon a bilva tree at night, and unknowingly and effortlessly worships Śiva situated below the tree by plucking bilva leaves; and his bathing Śiva with a mouthful of water, and his effortlessly fasting due to not obtaining food; his wife's fasting as well while waiting for him due to his lack of a meal; then the next day, after his wife brings food to the riverbank and places it there, a dog suddenly comes and eats it, whereupon the hunter is greatly pleased, thinking that a gift of food was accomplished; through the greatness of the Śivarātri vow thus performed unknowingly, Śiva's attendants bring an aerial chariot to take the hunter to Śiva's world; the hunter's departure to Śiva's world with Śiva's attendants; the description of the origin of the Śivarātri vow; in the context of the greatness of the Śivarātri vow, the description of the story of a widowed brahmin woman's son born from an outcaste who, through the power of the Śivarātri vow, attains birth from Śiva under the name Vīrabhadra in another life; the description of kings such as Bharata attaining perfection through the Śivarātri vow. 66

1.3.s: 34 atha kadācitkailāsaparvate nijamandire sukhāsīnayoḥ śivapārvatyordyūte pravṛtte pārvatyā sarvasvapaṇe jite sati pārvatīhāritasarvasvasya śivasya kailāsaṃ vihāya tapovanagamanavarṇanama.. 69
1.3.d: 34 अथ कदाचित्कैलासपर्वते निजमन्दिरे सुखासीनयोः शिवपार्वत्योर्द्यूते प्रवृत्ते पार्वत्या सर्वस्वपणे जिते सति पार्वतीहारितसर्वस्वस्य शिवस्य कैलासं विहाय तपोवनगमनवर्णनम.. 69
1.3.m: [Chapter] 34: Then, when Śiva and Pārvatī are once seated comfortably in their own palace on Mount Kailāsa, a dice-game begins; when Pārvatī wins having wagered everything, the description of Śiva, having lost his all to Pārvatī, abandoning Kailāsa and going to the penance grove. 69

1.3.s: 35 atha śivanirgamanottaraṃ virahāturāyāḥ pārvatyāḥ śabarīrūpaṃ dhṛtvaikānte samādhisthasya śivasya samīpaṃ prati gamanam tayā dṛṣṭamātrasya śivasya samādhito vyutthānama, śivena dṛṣṭamātrāyāḥ pārvatyā antardhāne śivasya virahāvasthāpannatvam, atha śivena śabarīṃ prati svavaraṇaprārthanā, tataḥ śabaryā kāmavaśaṃgataṃ śivaṃ prati svaprāptaye svapituḥ samīpe prārthanārthaṃ gaṃdhamādanaparvate pituḥ samīpaṃ pratyānayanama, śivena himālayaṃ prati kanyāprārthanam, atrāṃtare tatra nāradenāgatya śivaṃ prati prabodhakaraṇam, atha śivasya pārvatīkṛtāṃ nijavañcanāṃ nirīkṣya roṣeṇa vanāṃtaraṃ punaḥ prasthātukāmasya himālayādigiribhirgirijāṃ puraskṛtya prārthanāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ roṣaśāṃteranaṃtaraṃ gaṃdhamādanaparvate divyasiṃhāsanoparyaṃgiromaharṣidvārābhiṣekavarṇanam, evaṃ kedāranāthamāhātmyaprasaṃgena samastaśivadharmapraśaṃsāvarṇanam. -..... - -. ... 72 1
1.3.d: 35 अथ शिवनिर्गमनोत्तरं विरहातुरायाः पार्वत्याः शबरीरूपं धृत्वैकान्ते समाधिस्थस्य शिवस्य समीपं प्रति गमनम् तया दृष्टमात्रस्य शिवस्य समाधितो व्युत्थानम, शिवेन दृष्टमात्रायाः पार्वत्या अन्तर्धाने शिवस्य विरहावस्थापन्नत्वम्, अथ शिवेन शबरीं प्रति स्ववरणप्रार्थना, ततः शबर्या कामवशंगतं शिवं प्रति स्वप्राप्तये स्वपितुः समीपे प्रार्थनार्थं गंधमादनपर्वते पितुः समीपं प्रत्यानयनम, शिवेन हिमालयं प्रति कन्याप्रार्थनम्, अत्रांतरे तत्र नारदेनागत्य शिवं प्रति प्रबोधकरणम्, अथ शिवस्य पार्वतीकृतां निजवञ्चनां निरीक्ष्य रोषेण वनांतरं पुनः प्रस्थातुकामस्य हिमालयादिगिरिभिर्गिरिजां पुरस्कृत्य प्रार्थनायां कृतायां रोषशांतेरनंतरं गंधमादनपर्वते दिव्यसिंहासनोपर्यंगिरोमहर्षिद्वाराभिषेकवर्णनम्, एवं केदारनाथमाहात्म्यप्रसंगेन समस्तशिवधर्मप्रशंसावर्णनम्. -..... - -. ... 72 1
1.3.m: [Chapter] 35: Then, after Śiva's departure, Pārvatī, distressed by separation, assumes the form of a Śabarī woman and goes near Śiva who is in solitary meditation; Śiva's rising from meditation as soon as he sees her; when Pārvatī vanishes the moment Śiva looks at her, Śiva falls into a state of separation; then Śiva asks the Śabarī to choose him; then the Śabarī, to obtain Śiva who has fallen under the power of desire, brings him to her father on Mount Gandhamādana to make a request to her father; Śiva asks Himālaya for the maiden; in the meantime, Nārada arrives there and enlightens Śiva; then Śiva, realizing he was deceived by Pārvatī, wishes to depart in anger for another forest, but after Himālaya and the other mountains place the mountain-born goddess [Pārvatī] before him and make a supplication, his anger subsides; after which follows the description of the consecration performed by the great seer Aṅgiras on a divine lion-throne on Mount Gandhamādana; thus, in the context of the greatness of Kedāranātha, the description praising the entire duty to Śiva. 72 1

ओंनमो भगवते वासुदेवाय..
ओंनारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्..
देवीं सरस्वती चैव ततो जयमुदीरयेत्.. 1.1 ..
..व्यास उवाच..
यस्याज्ञया जगत्स्रष्टाविरिंचिः पालको हरिः..
