1.3.m:
Now begins the first [section], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.
Homage to the glorious Gaṇeśa.
Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One, Vāsudeva.
Having bowed down to Nārāyaṇa and Nara, the best of men,
and to the goddess Sarasvatī, one should then recite the [word] 'Victory!' 1.1
Vyāsa said:
By whose command Viriñci is the creator of the universe, Hari is the protector,
and he called Kālarudra is the destroyer—homage to that bearer of the Pināka bow! 1.1

1.3.s:
tīrthānāmuttamaṃ tīrthaṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ kṣetramuttamam..
tatraiva naimiṣāraṇye saunakādyāstapodhanāḥ..
dīrghasatraṃ prakurvaṃtaḥ satriṇaḥ karmacetasaḥ.. 1.2 ..
1.3.d:
तीर्थानामुत्तमं तीर्थं क्षेत्राणां क्षेत्रमुत्तमम्..
तत्रैव नैमिषारण्ये सौनकाद्यास्तपोधनाः..
दीर्घसत्रं प्रकुर्वंतः सत्रिणः कर्मचेतसः.. 1.2 ..
1.3.m:
The best sacred ford among sacred fords, the best sacred field among sacred fields—
right there in Naimiṣāraṇya, Śaunaka and the other rich in austerity,
performing a long sacrificial session, were sacrificers whose minds were fixed on the rite. 1.2

1.3.s:
teṣāṃ sadarśanautsukyādāgato hi mahātapāḥ..
vyāsaśiṣyo mahāprājño lomaśonāma nāmataḥ.. 1.3 ..
1.3.d:
तेषां सदर्शनौत्सुक्यादागतो हि महातपाः..
व्यासशिष्यो महाप्राज्ञो लोमशोनाम नामतः.. 1.3 ..
1.3.m:
Out of eager desire to see them, there indeed arrived one of great austerity,
a disciple of Vyāsa, very wise, Romaśa by name. 1.3

1.3.s:
tatrāgataṃ te dadṛśurmunayo dīrghasatriṇaḥ..
uttasthuryugapatsarve sārghyahastāḥ samutsukāḥ.. 1.4 ..
1.3.d:
तत्रागतं ते ददृशुर्मुनयो दीर्घसत्रिणः..
उत्तस्थुर्युगपत्सर्वे सार्घ्यहस्ताः समुत्सुकाः.. 1.4 ..
1.3.m:
Those sages performing the long sacrificial session saw him arrived there;
they all stood up at once, eager, with guest-water in their hands. 1.4

1.3.s:
dattvārghyapādyaṃ satkṛtya munayo vītakalmaṣāḥ..
taṃ papracchurmahābhāgāḥ śivadharmaṃ savistaram.. 1.5 ..
1.3.d:
दत्त्वार्घ्यपाद्यं सत्कृत्य मुनयो वीतकल्मषाः..
तं पप्रच्छुर्महाभागाः शिवधर्मं सविस्तरम्.. 1.5 ..
1.3.m:
Having offered guest-water and water for the feet, and having honored him, the illustrious sages, free from stain,
questioned him at length about Śiva's duty. 1.5

1.3.s:
..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
kathayasva mahāprājña devadevasya śūlinaḥ..
mahimānaṃ mahābhāga dhyānārcanasamanvitam.. 1.6 ..
1.3.d:
..ऋषय ऊचुः..
कथयस्व महाप्राज्ञ देवदेवस्य शूलिनः..
महिमानं महाभाग ध्यानार्चनसमन्वितम्.. 1.6 ..
1.3.m:
The seers said:
Tell us, O very wise one, O fortunate one, the greatness
of the trident-bearing god of gods, together with meditation and worship. 1.6

1.3.s:
saṃmārjane kiṃ phalaṃ syāttathā raṃgāvalīṣu ca..
pradāne darpaṇasyātha tathā vai cāmarasya ca.. 1.7 ..
1.3.d:
संमार्जने किं फलं स्यात्तथा रंगावलीषु च..
प्रदाने दर्पणस्याथ तथा वै चामरस्य च.. 1.7 ..
1.3.m:
What fruit would there be in sweeping, and likewise in colored powder designs?
In the offering of a mirror, and likewise indeed of a chowrie? 1.7

1.3.s:
pradāne ca vitānasya tathā dhārāgṛhasya ca..
dīpadāne kiṃ phalaṃ syātpūjāyāṃ kiṃ phalaṃ bhavet.. 1.8 ..
1.3.d:
प्रदाने च वितानस्य तथा धारागृहस्य च..
दीपदाने किं फलं स्यात्पूजायां किं फलं भवेत्.. 1.8 ..
1.3.m:
And in the offering of a canopy, and likewise of a fountain-pavilion?
What fruit would there be in the gift of a lamp? What fruit would there be in worship? 1.8

1.3.s:
kānikāni ca puṇyāni kathyatāṃ śivapūjane..
itihāsapurāṇāni vedādhyayanameva ca.. 1.9 ..
1.3.d:
कानिकानि च पुण्यानि कथ्यतां शिवपूजने..
इतिहासपुराणानि वेदाध्ययनमेव च.. 1.9 ..
1.3.m:
And what merits are there in the worship of Śiva, let it be told!
Histories and Purāṇas, and the study of the Veda— 1.9

1.3.s:
śivasyāgre prakurvaṃti kārayantyatha vā narāḥ..
kiṃ phalaṃ ca nṛṇāṃ teṣāṃ kathyatāṃ vistareṇa hi.. 1.10 ..
1.3.d:
शिवस्याग्रे प्रकुर्वंति कारयन्त्यथ वा नराः..
किं फलं च नृणां तेषां कथ्यतां विस्तरेण हि.. 1.10 ..
1.3.m:
these men recite or cause to be recited before Śiva;
what fruit belongs to those men? Let it indeed be told in full! 1.10

1.3.s: śivākhyānaparoloke tvatto nānyo'sti vai mune.. 1.11 ..
1.3.d: शिवाख्यानपरोलोके त्वत्तो नान्योऽस्ति वै मुने.. 1.11 ..
1.3.m: In the world, there is indeed no other than you devoted to tales of Śiva, O sage. 1.11

1.3.s:
iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām..
uvāca vyāsaśiṣyo'sau śivamāhātmyamuttamam.. 1.12 ..
1.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तेषां मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्..
उवाच व्यासशिष्योऽसौ शिवमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम्.. 1.12 ..
1.3.m:
Having heard this speech of those contemplative sages,
that disciple of Vyāsa spoke the supreme greatness of Śiva. 1.12

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
aṣṭādaśapurāṇeṣu gīyate vai paraḥ śivaḥ..
tasmācchivasya māhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ ko'pi na pāryate.. 1.13 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
अष्टादशपुराणेषु गीयते वै परः शिवः..
तस्माच्छिवस्य माहात्म्यं वक्तुं कोऽपि न पार्यते.. 1.13 ..

1.3.s:
śiveti dvyakṣaraṃ nāma vyāhariiṣyaṃti ye janāḥ..
teṣāṃ svargaśca mokṣaśca bhaviṣyati na cānyathā.. 1.14 ..
1.3.d:
शिवेति द्व्यक्षरं नाम व्याहरिइष्यंति ये जनाः..
तेषां स्वर्गश्च मोक्षश्च भविष्यति न चान्यथा.. 1.14 ..
1.3.m:
Those people who will pronounce the two-syllable name "Śi-va",
heaven and liberation will be theirs, and not otherwise.

1.3.s:
udāro hi mahādevo devānāṃ patiriśvaraḥ..
yena sarvaṃ pradattaṃ hi tasmātsarva iti smṛtaḥ.. 1.15 ..
1.3.d:
उदारो हि महादेवो देवानां पतिरिश्वरः..
येन सर्वं प्रदत्तं हि तस्मात्सर्व इति स्मृतः.. 1.15 ..
1.3.m:
For Mahādeva, the lord of gods, Īśvara, is generous;
because everything has indeed been given by him, therefore he is remembered as Śarva.

1.3.s: te dhanyāste mahātmāno ye bhajaṃti sadā śivam.. 1.16 ..
1.3.d: ते धन्यास्ते महात्मानो ये भजंति सदा शिवम्.. 1.16 ..
1.3.m: Fortunate are they, great-souled are they, who constantly worship Śiva.

1.3.s:
vinā sadāśivaṃ yohi saṃsāraṃ tartumicchati..
sa mūḍho hi mahāpāpaḥ śivadveṣī na saṃśayaḥ.. 1.17 ..
1.3.d:
विना सदाशिवं योहि संसारं तर्तुमिच्छति..
स मूढो हि महापापः शिवद्वेषी न संशयः.. 1.17 ..
1.3.m:
He who wishes to cross the cycle of worldly existence without Sadāśiva,
he is a fool, a great sinner, a hater of Śiva, without a doubt.

1.3.s:
bhakṣitaṃ hi garaṃ yena dakṣayajño vināśitaḥ..
kālasya dahanaṃ yena kṛtaṃ rājñaḥ pramocanam.. 1.18 ..
1.3.d:
भक्षितं हि गरं येन दक्षयज्ञो विनाशितः..
कालस्य दहनं येन कृतं राज्ञः प्रमोचनम्.. 1.18 ..
1.3.m:
By whom the poison was eaten, by whom Dakṣa's sacrifice was destroyed,
by whom the burning of Kāla was wrought, and the release of the king [was effected].

1.3.s:
..ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
yathā garaṃ bhakṣitaṃ ca yathā yajño vināśitaḥ..
dakṣasya ca tathā brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ.. 1.19 ..
1.3.d:
..ऋषय ऊचुः..
यथा गरं भक्षितं च यथा यज्ञो विनाशितः..
दक्षस्य च तथा ब्रूहि परं कौतूहलं हि नः.. 1.19 ..
1.3.m:
The seers said:
Tell us how the poison was eaten and how the sacrifice was destroyed,
and that of Dakṣa, for our curiosity is great.

1.3.s:
..sūta uvāca..
dākṣāyaṇī purā dattā śaṃkarāya mahātmane..
vacanādbrahmaṇo viprā dakṣeṇa parameṣṭhinaḥ.. 1.20 ..
1.3.d:
..सूत उवाच..
दाक्षायणी पुरा दत्ता शंकराय महात्मने..
वचनाद्ब्रह्मणो विप्रा दक्षेण परमेष्ठिनः.. 1.20 ..
1.3.m:
Sūta said:
Formerly, O brahmins, Dākṣāyaṇī was given to the great-souled Śaṃkara
by Dakṣa, at the command of Brahmā the supreme lord.

1.3.s:
ekadā hi sa dakṣo vai naimiṣāraṇyamāgataḥ..
yadṛcchāvaśamāpanna ṛṣibhiḥ paripūjitaḥ.. 1.21 ..
1.3.d:
एकदा हि स दक्षो वै नैमिषारण्यमागतः..
यदृच्छावशमापन्न ऋषिभिः परिपूजितः.. 1.21 ..
1.3.m:
Once, indeed, that Dakṣa came to Naimiṣāraṇya,
having arrived by chance, and was worshipped by the seers,

1.3.s:
stutibhiḥ praṇipātaiśca tathā sarvaiḥ surāsuraiḥ..
tatra sthito mahādevo nābhyutthānābhivādane..
cakārāsya tataḥ kruddho dakṣo vacanabravīt.. 1.22 ..
1.3.d:
स्तुतिभिः प्रणिपातैश्च तथा सर्वैः सुरासुरैः..
तत्र स्थितो महादेवो नाभ्युत्थानाभिवादने..
चकारास्य ततः क्रुद्धो दक्षो वचनब्रवीत्.. 1.22 ..

1.3.s:
sarvatra sarve hi surāsurā bhṛśaṃ namaṃti māṃ vipravarāḥ samutsukāḥ..
kathaṃ hyasau durjanavanmahātmā bhūtādibhiḥ pretapiśācayuktaḥ..
śmaśānavāsī nirapatrapo hyayaṃ kathaṃ praṇāmaṃ na karoti me'dhunā.. 1.23 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वत्र सर्वे हि सुरासुरा भृशं नमंति मां विप्रवराः समुत्सुकाः..
कथं ह्यसौ दुर्जनवन्महात्मा भूतादिभिः प्रेतपिशाचयुक्तः..
श्मशानवासी निरपत्रपो ह्ययं कथं प्रणामं न करोति मेऽधुना.. 1.23 ..
1.3.m:
"Everywhere all the gods and asuras, and best of brahmins, eagerly bow to me very much.
How does this great-souled one, like a wicked person accompanied by bhūtas, pretas, and piśācas,
a dweller in the cremation ground, devoid of shame—why does he not make an obeisance to me now?

1.3.s:
pākhaṃḍino durjanāḥ pāpaśīlā vipraṃ dṛṣṭvā coddhatā unmadāśca..
vadhyāstyājyāḥ sadbhirevaṃvidhā hi tasmādenaṃ śāpituṃ codyato'smi.. 1.24 ..
1.3.d:
पाखंडिनो दुर्जनाः पापशीला विप्रं दृष्ट्वा चोद्धता उन्मदाश्च..
वध्यास्त्याज्याः सद्भिरेवंविधा हि तस्मादेनं शापितुं चोद्यतोऽस्मि.. 1.24 ..
1.3.m:
Heretics, wicked people, sinful by nature, arrogant and maddened upon seeing a brahmin,
are fit to be slain, fit to be abandoned by the good, of such a kind; therefore I am ready to curse him."

1.3.s: ityevamuktvā sa mahātapāstadā ruṣānvito rudramidaṃ babhāṣe.. 1.25 ..
1.3.d: इत्येवमुक्त्वा स महातपास्तदा रुषान्वितो रुद्रमिदं बभाषे.. 1.25 ..
1.3.m: Having spoken thus, he of great austerity, filled with anger, then addressed Rudra in this way:

1.3.s:
śrṛṇvaṃtvamī vipratamā idānīṃ vaco hi me kartumihārhathaitat..
rudro hyayaṃ yajñabāhyo vṛto me varṇātīto varṇaparo yataśca.. 1.26 ..
1.3.d:
श्रृण्वंत्वमी विप्रतमा इदानीं वचो हि मे कर्तुमिहार्हथैतत्..
रुद्रो ह्ययं यज्ञबाह्यो वृतो मे वर्णातीतो वर्णपरो यतश्च.. 1.26 ..
1.3.m:
"Let these most excellent brahmins hear my word now, and you ought to carry this out here:
this Rudra is excluded by me from the sacrifice, since he is beyond caste and opposed to caste."

1.3.s:
naṃdī niśamya tadvākyaṃ śailādo hi ruṣānvitaḥ..
abravīttvarito dakṣaṃ śāpadaṃ taṃ mahāprabham.. 1.27 ..
1.3.d:
नंदी निशम्य तद्वाक्यं शैलादो हि रुषान्वितः..
अब्रवीत्त्वरितो दक्षं शापदं तं महाप्रभम्.. 1.27 ..
1.3.m:
Hearing that statement, Nandī, the son of Śilāda, filled with anger,
said quickly to Dakṣa, that great lord who gave the curse:

1.3.s:
..nandyuvāca..
yajñabāhyo hi me svāmī maheśo'yaṃ kṛtaḥ katham..
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa yajñāśca saphalā hyamī.. 1.28 ..
1.3.d:
..नन्द्युवाच..
यज्ञबाह्यो हि मे स्वामी महेशोऽयं कृतः कथम्..
यस्य स्मरणमात्रेण यज्ञाश्च सफला ह्यमी.. 1.28 ..
1.3.m:
Nandī said:
How is this my master, Maheśa, made excluded from the sacrifice,
by the mere remembrance of whom these sacrifices become fruitful?

1.3.s:
yajño dānaṃ tapaścaiva tīrthāni vividhāni ca..
yasya nāmnā pavitrāṇi soyaṃ śapto'dhunā katham.. 1.29 ..
1.3.d:
यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव तीर्थानि विविधानि च..
यस्य नाम्ना पवित्राणि सोयं शप्तोऽधुना कथम्.. 1.29 ..
1.3.m:
Sacrifice, gift, austerity, and various sacred fords
are made holy by whose name—how is that one cursed now?

1.3.s:
vṛthā te brahmacāpalyācchapto'yaṃ dakṣa durmate..
yenedaṃ pālitaṃ viśvaṃ sarveṇa ca mahātmanā..
śapto'yaṃ sa kathaṃ pāpa rudro'yaṃ brāhmaṇādhama.. 1.30 ..
1.3.d:
वृथा ते ब्रह्मचापल्याच्छप्तोऽयं दक्ष दुर्मते..
येनेदं पालितं विश्वं सर्वेण च महात्मना..
शप्तोऽयं स कथं पाप रुद्रोऽयं ब्राह्मणाधम.. 1.30 ..
1.3.m:
In vain has he been cursed by you out of brahminical rashness, O foolish Dakṣa!
By whom this entire universe is protected, by Śarva, the great-souled one,
how has that one been cursed, O sinner, O Rudra, O lowest of brahmins?

1.3.s:
evaṃ nirbhārtsitastena naṃdinā hi prajāpatiḥ..
naṃdinaṃ ca śaśāpātha dakṣo roṣasamanvitaḥ.. 1.31 ..
1.3.d:
एवं निर्भार्त्सितस्तेन नंदिना हि प्रजापतिः..
नंदिनं च शशापाथ दक्षो रोषसमन्वितः.. 1.31 ..
1.3.m:
Rebuked thus by that Nandī, the lord of creatures,
Dakṣa, filled with anger, then cursed Nandī:

1.3.s:
yūyaṃ sarve rudravarā vedabāhyāśca vai bhṛśam..
śaptāhi vedamārgaiśca tathā tyaktā maharṣibhiḥ.. 1.32 ..
1.3.d:
यूयं सर्वे रुद्रवरा वेदबाह्याश्च वै भृशम्..
शप्ताहि वेदमार्गैश्च तथा त्यक्ता महर्षिभिः.. 1.32 ..
1.3.m:
"All of you, eminent followers of Rudra, are completely outside the Veda;
cursed by the Vedic paths and abandoned by the great seers,

1.3.s:
pāṣaṃḍavādasaṃyuktāḥ śiṣṭa''cārabahiṣkṛtāḥ..
kapālinaḥ pānaratāstathā kālamukhā hyamī.. 1.33 ..
1.3.d:
पाषंडवादसंयुक्ताः शिष्ट'ऽचारबहिष्कृताः..
कपालिनः पानरतास्तथा कालमुखा ह्यमी.. 1.33 ..
1.3.m:
joined with heretical doctrines, excluded from standard conduct,
bearers of skulls, given to drinking, and Kālāmukhas are these!"

1.3.s:
iti śaptāstadā tena dakṣeṇa śivakiṃkarāḥ..
tadā prakupito naṃdī dakṣaṃ śaptuṃ pracakrame.. 1.34 ..
1.3.d:
इति शप्तास्तदा तेन दक्षेण शिवकिंकराः..
तदा प्रकुपितो नंदी दक्षं शप्तुं प्रचक्रमे.. 1.34 ..
1.3.m:
When the servants of Śiva had been cursed thus by Dakṣa,
then Nandī, intensely enraged, set about cursing Dakṣa:

1.3.s:
śaptā vayaṃ tvayā vipra sādhavaḥ śivakiṃkarāḥ..
vṛthaiva brahmacāpalyādahaṃ śāpaṃ dadāmi te.. 1.35 ..
1.3.d:
शप्ता वयं त्वया विप्र साधवः शिवकिंकराः..
वृथैव ब्रह्मचापल्यादहं शापं ददामि ते.. 1.35 ..
1.3.m:
"We, the virtuous servants of Śiva, have been cursed by you, O brahmin,
vainly out of brahminical rashness; I give a curse to you:

1.3.s:
vedavādaratā yūyaṃ nānyadastītivādinaḥ..
kāmātmānaḥ svargaparā lobhamohasamanvitāḥ.. 1.36 ..
1.3.d:
वेदवादरता यूयं नान्यदस्तीतिवादिनः..
कामात्मानः स्वर्गपरा लोभमोहसमन्विताः.. 1.36 ..
1.3.m:
Delighting in Vedic arguments, declaring 'there is nothing else,'
you are lustful, intent on heaven, accompanied by greed and delusion.

1.3.s:
vaidikaṃ ca puraskṛtya brāhmaṇāḥ śūdrayājakāḥ..
daridriṇo bhaviṣyaṃti pratigraharatāḥ sadā.. 1.37 ..
1.3.d:
वैदिकं च पुरस्कृत्य ब्राह्मणाः शूद्रयाजकाः..
दरिद्रिणो भविष्यंति प्रतिग्रहरताः सदा.. 1.37 ..
1.3.m:
Putting forward the Vedic [ritual], brahmins officiating for Śūdras
will become poor, constantly intent on accepting gifts.

1.3.s:
dakṣa kecidbhaviṣyanti brāhmaṇā brahmarākṣasāḥ..
..lomaśa uvāca..
viprāste śapitāstena naṃdinā kopinā bhṛśam.. 1.38 ..
1.3.d:
दक्ष केचिद्भविष्यन्ति ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मराक्षसाः..
..लोमश उवाच..
विप्रास्ते शपितास्तेन नंदिना कोपिना भृशम्.. 1.38 ..
1.3.m:
O Dakṣa, some brahmins will become brahmarākṣasas."
Lomaśa said:
Those brahmins were cursed very harshly by that angry Nandī.

1.3.s:
athākarṇyeśvaro vākyaṃ naṃdinaḥ prahasanniva..
uvāca vākyaṃ madhuraṃ bodhayayuktaṃ sadāśivaḥ.. 1.39 ..
1.3.d:
अथाकर्ण्येश्वरो वाक्यं नंदिनः प्रहसन्निव..
उवाच वाक्यं मधुरं बोधययुक्तं सदाशिवः.. 1.39 ..
1.3.m:
Then hearing the words of Nandī, Īśvara, as if smiling,
Sadāśiva spoke sweet words joined with instruction:

1.3.s:
..mahādeva uvāca..
kopaṃ nārhasi vai kartuṃ brāhmaṇānprati vai sadā..
brāhmaṇāguravo hyete vedavādaratāḥ sadā.. 1.40 ..
1.3.d:
..महादेव उवाच..
कोपं नार्हसि वै कर्तुं ब्राह्मणान्प्रति वै सदा..
ब्राह्मणागुरवो ह्येते वेदवादरताः सदा.. 1.40 ..

1.3.s:
vedo maṃtramayaḥ sākṣāttathā sūktamayo bhṛśam..
sūkte pratiṣṭhito hyātmā sarveṣāmapi dehinām.. 1.41 ..
1.3.d:
वेदो मंत्रमयः साक्षात्तथा सूक्तमयो भृशम्..
सूक्ते प्रतिष्ठितो ह्यात्मा सर्वेषामपि देहिनाम्.. 1.41 ..
1.3.m:
The Veda is directly composed of mantras, and immensely composed of hymns;
in the hymn is established the Self of all embodied beings.

1.3.s:
tasmānnātmavido nindyā ātmaivāhaṃ na cetaraḥ..
ko'yaṃ kastvaṃ kva cāhaṃ vai kasmācchaptā hi vai dvijāḥ.. 1.42 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मान्नात्मविदो निन्द्या आत्मैवाहं न चेतरः..
कोऽयं कस्त्वं क्व चाहं वै कस्माच्छप्ता हि वै द्विजाः.. 1.42 ..
1.3.m:
Therefore knowers of the Self are not to be reviled; I am the Self alone and nothing else.
Who is this? Who are you? And where am I? Why indeed were the twice-born cursed?

1.3.s:
prapaṃcaracanāṃ hitvā buddho bhava mahāmate..
tattvajñānena nirvartya svasthaḥ krodhādivarjitaḥ.. 1.43 ..
1.3.d:
प्रपंचरचनां हित्वा बुद्धो भव महामते..
तत्त्वज्ञानेन निर्वर्त्य स्वस्थः क्रोधादिवर्जितः.. 1.43 ..
1.3.m:
Abandoning the fabricated world, be enlightened, O great-minded one!
Ceasing through knowledge of truth, remain composed, free from anger and the like.

1.3.s:
evaṃ prabodhitastena śaṃbhunā parameṣṭhinā..
vivekaparamo bhūtvā śailādo hi mahātapāḥ..
śivena saha saṃgamya paramānaṃdasaṃplutaḥ.. 1.44 ..
1.3.d:
एवं प्रबोधितस्तेन शंभुना परमेष्ठिना..
विवेकपरमो भूत्वा शैलादो हि महातपाः..
शिवेन सह संगम्य परमानंदसंप्लुतः.. 1.44 ..
1.3.m:
Thus instructed by Śambhu, the supreme lord,
the son of Śilāda of great austerity became endowed with supreme discernment,
and joining with Śiva, was flooded with supreme bliss.

1.3.s:
dakṣopi hi ruṣā''viṣṭaṛṣibhiḥ parivāritaḥ..
yayau sthānaṃ svakaṃ tatra praviveśa ruṣā'nvitaḥ.. 1.45 ..
1.3.d:
दक्षोपि हि रुषा'ऽविष्टऋषिभिः परिवारितः..
ययौ स्थानं स्वकं तत्र प्रविवेश रुषाऽन्वितः.. 1.45 ..
1.3.m:
Dakṣa too, overcome by anger, surrounded by the seers,
went to his own place; there he entered, filled with wrath.

1.3.s:
śraddhāṃ vihāya paramāṃ śivapūjakānāṃ niṃdāparaḥ sa hi babhūva narādhamaśca..
sarvairmaharṣibhirupetya sa tatra śarvaṃ devaṃ nininda na babhūva kadāpi śāntaḥ.. 1.46 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṇḍe purāṇaprastāvadakṣavṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 1 .. cha ..
1.3.d:
श्रद्धां विहाय परमां शिवपूजकानां निंदापरः स हि बभूव नराधमश्च..
सर्वैर्महर्षिभिरुपेत्य स तत्र शर्वं देवं निनिन्द न बभूव कदापि शान्तः.. 1.46 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां प्रथमे माहेश्वरखण्डे केदारखण्डे पुराणप्रस्तावदक्षवृत्तान्तवर्णनंनाम प्रथमोऽध्यायः .. 1 .. छ ..

1.3.s:
..lomaśa uvāca..
dākṣāyaṇī gatā tatra yatra yajño mahānabhūt..
tatpituḥ sadanaṃ gatvā nā nāścaryasamanvitam.. 3.1 ..
1.3.d:
..लोमश उवाच..
दाक्षायणी गता तत्र यत्र यज्ञो महानभूत्..
तत्पितुः सदनं गत्वा ना नाश्चर्यसमन्वितम्.. 3.1 ..

1.3.s:
dvāri sthitā tadā devā avatīrya nijāsanāt..
naṃdino hi mahābhāgā devalokaṃ nirīkṣya ca.. 3.2 ..
1.3.d:
द्वारि स्थिता तदा देवा अवतीर्य निजासनात्..
नंदिनो हि महाभागा देवलोकं निरीक्ष्य च.. 3.2 ..
1.3.m:
descending from their own mounts, the gods stood at the door;
and seeing the realm of the gods, the fortunate followers of Nandī,

1.3.s:
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā suhṛtsaṃbaṃdhi vāṃdhavān..
abhivādyaiva pirataṃ mātaraṃ ca mudānvitā.. 3.3 ..
1.3.d:
मातरं पितरं दृष्ट्वा सुहृत्संबंधि वांधवान्..
अभिवाद्यैव पिरतं मातरं च मुदान्विता.. 3.3 ..
1.3.m:
having seen her mother, father, friends, relations, and kinsmen,
having saluted her father and mother, filled with joy,

1.3.s:
babhāṣe vacanaṃ devī prastāpasadṛśaṃ tadā..
anāhūtastvayā kasmācchaṃbhuḥ paramaśobhanaḥ.. 3.4 ..
1.3.d:
बभाषे वचनं देवी प्रस्तापसदृशं तदा..
अनाहूतस्त्वया कस्माच्छंभुः परमशोभनः.. 3.4 ..
1.3.m:
the goddess then spoke words appropriate to the occasion:
"Why was the exceedingly auspicious Śambhu not invited by you,

1.3.s:
yena pūtamidaṃ sarvaṃ samagraṃ sacarācaram..
yajño yajñavidāṃ śreṣṭho yajñāṃgo yajñadakṣiṇaḥ.. 3.5 ..
1.3.d:
येन पूतमिदं सर्वं समग्रं सचराचरम्..
यज्ञो यज्ञविदां श्रेष्ठो यज्ञांगो यज्ञदक्षिणः.. 3.5 ..
1.3.m:
by whom this whole universe, everything moving and unmoving, is purified,
who is the sacrifice, the best among knowers of sacrifice, the limb of the sacrifice, and the sacrificial fee?"

1.3.s:
dravyaṃ maṃtrādikaṃ sarvaṃ havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca yanmayam..
vinā tena kṛtaṃ sarvamapavitraṃ bhaviṣyati.. 3.6 ..
1.3.d:
द्रव्यं मंत्रादिकं सर्वं हव्यं कव्यं च यन्मयम्..
विना तेन कृतं सर्वमपवित्रं भविष्यति.. 3.6 ..
1.3.m: The sacrificial substance, the mantras and all else, the offerings to gods and the offerings to ancestors—which consist of him— / without him, all that is performed will be impure.

1.3.s:
śaṃbhunā hi vinā tāta kathaṃ yajñaḥ pravartate..
ete kathaṃ samāyātā brahmaṇā sahitāḥ pitaḥ.. 3.7 ..
1.3.d:
शंभुना हि विना तात कथं यज्ञः प्रवर्तते..
एते कथं समायाता ब्रह्मणा सहिताः पितः.. 3.7 ..
1.3.m: Indeed, without Śambhu, O father, how can a sacrifice proceed? / How have these come here, accompanied by Brahmā, O father?

1.3.s:
he bhṛgo tvaṃ na jānāsi he kaśyapa mahāmate..
atre viśiṣṭha ekastvaṃ śakra kiṃ kṛtamadyate.. 3.8 ..
1.3.d:
हे भृगो त्वं न जानासि हे कश्यप महामते..
अत्रे विशिष्ठ एकस्त्वं शक्र किं कृतमद्यते.. 3.8 ..
1.3.m: O Bhṛgu, do you not know? O wise Kaśyapa! / O Atri! You, the one distinguished [sage]! O Śakra, what has been done today by you?

1.3.s:
he viṣṇo tvaṃ mahādevaṃ jānāsi parameśvaram..
brahmankiṃ tvaṃ na jānāsi mahādevasya vikramam.. 3.9 ..
1.3.d:
हे विष्णो त्वं महादेवं जानासि परमेश्वरम्..
ब्रह्मन्किं त्वं न जानासि महादेवस्य विक्रमम्.. 3.9 ..
1.3.m: O Viṣṇu, you know Mahādeva, the Supreme Lord. / O Brahmā, do you not know the prowess of Mahādeva?

1.3.s:
purā paṃcamukho bhūtvā garvitosi sadāśivam..
kṛtaścaturmukhastena vismṛto'si tadadbhutam.. 3.10 ..
1.3.d:
पुरा पंचमुखो भूत्वा गर्वितोसि सदाशिवम्..
कृतश्चतुर्मुखस्तेन विस्मृतोऽसि तदद्भुतम्.. 3.10 ..
1.3.m: Formerly, having become five-faced, you grew arrogant towards Sadāśiva; / you were made four-faced by him—have you forgotten that wondrous deed?

1.3.s:
bhikṣāṭanaṃ kṛtaṃ yena purā dāruvane vibhuḥ..
śaptoyaṃ bhikṣuko rudro bhavadbhiḥ sakhibhistadā.. 3.11 ..
1.3.d:
भिक्षाटनं कृतं येन पुरा दारुवने विभुः..
शप्तोयं भिक्षुको रुद्रो भवद्भिः सखिभिस्तदा.. 3.11 ..
1.3.m: When the all-pervading lord formerly wandered for alms in the Dāruvana, / this beggar Rudra was cursed by you and your companions then.

1.3.s:
śaptenāpi ca rudreṇa bhavadbhirvismṛtaṃ katham..
yasyāvayavamātreṇa pūritaṃ sacarācaram.. 3.12 ..
1.3.d:
शप्तेनापि च रुद्रेण भवद्भिर्विस्मृतं कथम्..
यस्यावयवमात्रेण पूरितं सचराचरम्.. 3.12 ..
1.3.m: Even though Rudra was cursed, how have you forgotten / [him] by a mere part of whom all the moving and unmoving world was filled?

1.3.s:
liṃgabhūtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ jātaṃ tatkṣaṇameva hi..
layānālliṃgamityāhuḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ.. 3.13 ..
1.3.d:
लिंगभूतं जगत्सर्वं जातं तत्क्षणमेव हि..
लयानाल्लिंगमित्याहुः सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः.. 3.13 ..
1.3.m: The entire universe indeed became a liṅga at that very moment. / Because of dissolution (laya), all the gods with Indra call it a liṅga.

1.3.s:
sarve devāśca saṃbhūtā yato devasya śūlinaḥ..
so'sau vedāṃtago devastvayā jñātuṃ na pāryate.. 3.14 ..
1.3.d:
सर्वे देवाश्च संभूता यतो देवस्य शूलिनः..
सोऽसौ वेदांतगो देवस्त्वया ज्ञातुं न पार्यते.. 3.14 ..
1.3.m: And from which trident-bearing god all gods arose, / that god, known through the Upaniṣads, cannot be comprehended by you.

1.3.s:
tasyā vacanamākarṇya dakṣaḥ kruddho'bravīdvacaḥ..
kiṃ tvayā bahunoktena kāryaṃ nāstīha sāṃpratam.. 3.15 ..
1.3.d:
तस्या वचनमाकर्ण्य दक्षः क्रुद्धोऽब्रवीद्वचः..
किं त्वया बहुनोक्तेन कार्यं नास्तीह सांप्रतम्.. 3.15 ..
1.3.m: Hearing her words, Dakṣa became angry and spoke these words: / “What is the use of your saying so much? There is no business for you here now.

1.3.s:
gaccha vā tiṣṭhavā bhadre kasmāttvaṃ hi samāgatā..
amaṃgalo hi bhartā te aśivosau sumadhyame.. 3.16 ..
1.3.d:
गच्छ वा तिष्ठवा भद्रे कस्मात्त्वं हि समागता..
अमंगलो हि भर्ता ते अशिवोसौ सुमध्यमे.. 3.16 ..
1.3.m: Go, or stay, auspicious one! Why indeed have you come? / Inauspicious indeed is your husband, that un-auspicious one, O slender-waisted lady!

1.3.s:
akulīno vedabāhyo bhūtapretapiśācarāṭ..
tasmānnākārito bhadre yajñārthaṃ cārubhāṣiṇi.. 3.17 ..
1.3.d:
अकुलीनो वेदबाह्यो भूतप्रेतपिशाचराट्..
तस्मान्नाकारितो भद्रे यज्ञार्थं चारुभाषिणि.. 3.17 ..
1.3.m: He is of low birth, outside the Veda, the king of ghosts, spirits, and goblins. / Therefore he was not invited for the sacrifice, O fair-spoken lady!

1.3.s:
mayā dattāsi suśroṇi pāpinā maṃdabuddhinā..
rudrāyāviditārthāya uddhatāya durātmane.. 3.18 ..
1.3.d:
मया दत्तासि सुश्रोणि पापिना मंदबुद्धिना..
रुद्रायाविदितार्थाय उद्धताय दुरात्मने.. 3.18 ..
1.3.m: You were given, O shapely lady, by me, a sinner of dull intellect, / to Rudra, who is ignorant of righteous ends, arrogant, and evil-minded.

1.3.s:
tasmātkāyaṃ parityajya svasthā bhava śucismite..
dakṣeṇoktā tadā putrī sā satī lokapūjitā.. 3.19 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्कायं परित्यज्य स्वस्था भव शुचिस्मिते..
दक्षेणोक्ता तदा पुत्री सा सती लोकपूजिता.. 3.19 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, leave your body and remain composed, O lady of pure smile!” / Thus addressed then by Dakṣa, his daughter Satī, revered by the world,

1.3.s:
niṃdāyuktaṃ svapitaraṃ vilokya ruṣitā bhṛśam..
ciṃtayaṃtī tadā devī kathaṃ yāsyāmi maṃdire.. 3.20 ..
1.3.d:
निंदायुक्तं स्वपितरं विलोक्य रुषिता भृशम्..
चिंतयंती तदा देवी कथं यास्यामि मंदिरे.. 3.20 ..
1.3.m: seeing her own father engaged in censure, became exceedingly angry. / Then reflecting, the goddess thought: “How shall I go to my home?

1.3.s:
śaṃkaraṃ draṣṭukāmāṃha kiṃ vakṣye tena pṛcchitā..
yo niṃdati mahādevaṃ niṃdyamānaṃ śrṛṇoti yaḥ..
tāvubhau narake yāto yāvaccandradivākarau.. 3.21 ..
1.3.d:
शंकरं द्रष्टुकामांह किं वक्ष्ये तेन पृच्छिता..
यो निंदति महादेवं निंद्यमानं श्रृणोति यः..
तावुभौ नरके यातो यावच्चन्द्रदिवाकरौ.. 3.21 ..
1.3.m: Desiring to see Śaṃkara, what shall I say when questioned by him? / He who censures Mahādeva and he who listens to him being censured— / both of them go to hell for as long as the moon and sun endure.

1.3.s: tasmāttayakṣyāmyahaṃ dehaṃ pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam.. 3.22 ..
1.3.d: तस्मात्तयक्ष्याम्यहं देहं प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम्.. 3.22 ..
1.3.m: Therefore I will cast off this body and enter the fire.”

1.3.s:
evaṃ mīmāṃsamānā sā śivarudretibhāṣiṇī..
apamānābhibhūtā sā praviveśa hutāśanam.. 3.23 ..
1.3.d:
एवं मीमांसमाना सा शिवरुद्रेतिभाषिणी..
अपमानाभिभूता सा प्रविवेश हुताशनम्.. 3.23 ..
1.3.m: Thus deliberating, speaking the names “Śiva” and “Rudra,” / overwhelmed by humiliation, she entered the fire.

1.3.s:
hāhākāreṇa mahatā vyāptamāsīddigaṃtaram..
sarve te maṃcamārūḍhāḥ śastrairvyāptā niraṃtarāḥ.. 3.24 ..
1.3.d:
हाहाकारेण महता व्याप्तमासीद्दिगंतरम्..
सर्वे ते मंचमारूढाः शस्त्रैर्व्याप्ता निरंतराः.. 3.24 ..
1.3.m: A great wailing filled the ends of the quarters. / All those who had mounted the platforms, covered without interruption with weapons,

1.3.s:
śastraiḥ svairjadhnurātmānaṃ svāni dehāni cicchiduḥ..
kecitkaratale gṛhya śirāṃsi svāni cotsukāḥ.. 3.25 ..
1.3.d:
शस्त्रैः स्वैर्जध्नुरात्मानं स्वानि देहानि चिच्छिदुः..
केचित्करतले गृह्य शिरांसि स्वानि चोत्सुकाः.. 3.25 ..
1.3.m: struck themselves with their own weapons and cut their own bodies. / Some, taking their own heads in the palms of their hands, eager,

1.3.s:
nīrājayaṃtastvaritā bhasmībhūtāśca jajñire..
evamūcustadā sarve jagarjjuratibhīṣaṇam.. 3.26 ..
1.3.d:
नीराजयंतस्त्वरिता भस्मीभूताश्च जज्ञिरे..
एवमूचुस्तदा सर्वे जगर्ज्जुरतिभीषणम्.. 3.26 ..
1.3.m: making an offering of their heads quickly, were reduced to ashes. / Thus they all spoke then, and roared most frightfully.

1.3.s:
śastraprāhāraiḥ svāṃgāni cicchiduścātibhīṣaṇāḥ..
te tathā vilayaṃ prāptā dākṣāyaṇyā samaṃ tadā.. 3.27 ..
1.3.d:
शस्त्रप्राहारैः स्वांगानि चिच्छिदुश्चातिभीषणाः..
ते तथा विलयं प्राप्ता दाक्षायण्या समं तदा.. 3.27 ..
1.3.m: With blows of weapons, the most terrifying ones cut their own limbs; / in that manner they attained destruction together with Dakṣa’s daughter then.

1.3.s:
gaṇāstatrāyūte dve ca tadadbhutamivābhavat..
te sarva ṛṣayo devā iṃdrādyāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ.. 3.28 ..
1.3.d:
गणास्तत्रायूते द्वे च तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्..
ते सर्व ऋषयो देवा इंद्राद्याः समरुद्गणाः.. 3.28 ..
1.3.m: Twenty thousand attendants were there; that was like a wonder. / All those seers, gods headed by Indra, along with the troop of Maruts,

1.3.s:
viśve'śvanau lokapālāstūṣṇīṃbūtāstadābhavan..
viṣṇuṃ vareṇyaṃ kecicca prārthayaṃtaḥ samaṃtataḥ.. 3.29 ..
1.3.d:
विश्वेऽश्वनौ लोकपालास्तूष्णींबूतास्तदाभवन्..
विष्णुं वरेण्यं केचिच्च प्रार्थयंतः समंततः.. 3.29 ..
1.3.m: the Viśvedevas, the Aśvins, and the guardians of the quarters then became silent, / and some prayed from all sides to Viṣṇu, the most excellent one.

1.3.s:
evaṃ bhūtastadā yajño jātastasya durātmanaḥ..
dakṣasya brahmabaṃdhośca ṛṣayo bhayamāgatāḥ.. 3.30 ..
1.3.d:
एवं भूतस्तदा यज्ञो जातस्तस्य दुरात्मनः..
दक्षस्य ब्रह्मबंधोश्च ऋषयो भयमागताः.. 3.30 ..
1.3.m: Such did the sacrifice of that evil-minded Dakṣa, / a mere so-called brahmin, then become; the seers were struck with fear.

1.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare viprā nāradena mahātmanā..
kathitaṃ sarvamevaitaddakṣasya ca viceṣṭitam.. 3.31 ..
1.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे विप्रा नारदेन महात्मना..
कथितं सर्वमेवैतद्दक्षस्य च विचेष्टितम्.. 3.31 ..
1.3.m: In the meantime, O brahmins, all this conduct of Dakṣa / was told by the noble Nārada [to Śiva].

1.3.s:
tadākarṇyeśvaro vākyaṃ nāradasya mukhodgatam..
cukopa paramaṃ kruddha āsanādutpatanniva.. 3.32 ..
1.3.d:
तदाकर्ण्येश्वरो वाक्यं नारदस्य मुखोद्गतम्..
चुकोप परमं क्रुद्ध आसनादुत्पतन्निव.. 3.32 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that speech which came from the mouth of Nārada, the Lord / flew into a great fury, as if leaping up from his seat.

1.3.s:
uddhṛtya ca jaṭāṃ rudro lokasaṃhārakārakaḥ..
āsphoṭayāmāsa ruṣā parvatasya śiropari.. 3.33 ..
1.3.d:
उद्धृत्य च जटां रुद्रो लोकसंहारकारकः..
आस्फोटयामास रुषा पर्वतस्य शिरोपरि.. 3.33 ..
1.3.m: Uprooting a matted lock of hair, Rudra, the cause of the world's destruction, / struck it in fury upon the summit of the mountain.

1.3.s:
tāḍanācca samudbhūto vīrabhadro mahāyaśāḥ..
tathā kālī samutpannā bhūtakoṭibhirāvṛtā.. 3.34 ..
1.3.d:
ताडनाच्च समुद्भूतो वीरभद्रो महायशाः..
तथा काली समुत्पन्ना भूतकोटिभिरावृता.. 3.34 ..
1.3.m: From that striking arose the highly renowned Vīrabhadra; / likewise Kālī arose, surrounded by millions of spirits.

1.3.s:
kopānniḥśvasitenaiva rudrasya ca mahātmanaḥ..
jātaṃ jvarāṇāṃ ca śataṃ sannipātāstrayodaśa.. 3.35 ..
1.3.d:
कोपान्निःश्वसितेनैव रुद्रस्य च महात्मनः..
जातं ज्वराणां च शतं सन्निपातास्त्रयोदश.. 3.35 ..
1.3.m: From the angry exhalation alone of the noble Rudra / arose a hundred fevers and the thirteen malignant fever-types.

1.3.s:
vijñapto vīrabhadreṇa rudro raudraparākramaḥ..
kiṃ kāryaṃ bhavataḥ kāryaṃ śīghrameva vada prabho.. 3.36 ..
1.3.d:
विज्ञप्तो वीरभद्रेण रुद्रो रौद्रपराक्रमः..
किं कार्यं भवतः कार्यं शीघ्रमेव वद प्रभो.. 3.36 ..
1.3.m: Rudra of fierce prowess was addressed by Vīrabhadra: / “What duty is to be done by your servant? Speak quickly, O Lord!”

1.3.s:
ityukto bhagavānrudraḥ preṣayāmāsa satvaram..
gaccha vīra mahā bāho dakṣayajñaṃ vināśaya.. 3.37 ..
1.3.d:
इत्युक्तो भगवान्रुद्रः प्रेषयामास सत्वरम्..
गच्छ वीर महा बाहो दक्षयज्ञं विनाशय.. 3.37 ..
1.3.m: Thus addressed, the divine Rudra sent him forth at once: / “Go, mighty-armed hero! Destroy Dakṣa’s sacrifice!”

1.3.s:
śāsanaṃ śirasā dhṛtvā devadevasya śūlinaḥ..
kālikā''lihito vīraḥ sarvabhūtaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ..
vīrabhadro mahātejā yayau dakṣamakhaṃ prati.. 3.38 ..
1.3.d:
शासनं शिरसा धृत्वा देवदेवस्य शूलिनः..
कालिका'ऽलिहितो वीरः सर्वभूतैः समावृतः..
वीरभद्रो महातेजा ययौ दक्षमखं प्रति.. 3.38 ..
1.3.m: Placing the command of the god of gods, the trident-bearer, upon his head, / licked by Kālikā, surrounded by all spirits, / Vīrabhadra of great splendour set out towards Dakṣa’s sacrifice.

1.3.s:
tadānīmeva sahasā durnimittāni cābhavan..
rūkṣo vavau tadā vāyuḥ śarkarābhiḥ samāvṛtaḥ.. 3.39 ..
1.3.d:
तदानीमेव सहसा दुर्निमित्तानि चाभवन्..
रूक्षो ववौ तदा वायुः शर्कराभिः समावृतः.. 3.39 ..
1.3.m: At that very moment, evil omens suddenly occurred: / a harsh wind blew then, filled with gravel;

1.3.s:
asṛgvarṣati devaśca timireṇā''vṛtā divaśaḥ..
ulkāpātāśca bahavaḥ petururvyāṃ sahasraśaḥ.. 3.40 ..
1.3.d:
असृग्वर्षति देवश्च तिमिरेणा'ऽवृता दिवशः..
उल्कापाताश्च बहवः पेतुरुर्व्यां सहस्रशः.. 3.40 ..
1.3.m: blood rained from the sky, and the directions were shrouded in darkness; / and many meteors fell by the thousands upon the earth.

1.3.s:
evaṃvidhānyariṣṭāni dadṛśurvibudhādayaḥ..
dakṣo'pi bhayamāpanno viṣṇuṃ śaraṇamāyayau.. 3.41 ..
1.3.d:
एवंविधान्यरिष्टानि ददृशुर्विबुधादयः..
दक्षोऽपि भयमापन्नो विष्णुं शरणमाययौ.. 3.41 ..
1.3.m: The gods and others saw portents of this kind. / Dakṣa too, overcome with fear, took refuge with Viṣṇu:

1.3.s:
rakṣarakṣa mahāviṣṇo tvaṃ hi naḥ paramo guruḥ..
yajño'si tvaṃ suraśreṣṭha bhayānmāṃ parimocaya.. 3.42 ..
1.3.d:
रक्षरक्ष महाविष्णो त्वं हि नः परमो गुरुः..
यज्ञोऽसि त्वं सुरश्रेष्ठ भयान्मां परिमोचय.. 3.42 ..
1.3.m: “Protect, protect, O Mahāviṣṇu! For you are our supreme guru; / you are the sacrifice, O best of gods! Deliver me from fear!”

1.3.s:
dakṣeṇa prārthya māno hi jagāda madhusūdanaḥ..
mayā rakṣā vidātavyā bhavato nātra saṃśayaḥ.. 3.43 ..
1.3.d:
दक्षेण प्रार्थ्य मानो हि जगाद मधुसूदनः..
मया रक्षा विदातव्या भवतो नात्र संशयः.. 3.43 ..
1.3.m: Being thus entreated by Dakṣa, Madhusūdana spoke: / “Protection must indeed be given to you by me, there is no doubt about this.

1.3.s:
apūjyā yatra pūjyaṃte pūjanīyo na pūjyate..
trīṇī tatra pravartaṃte durbhikṣaṃ tvayā dharmamajānatāḥ..
īśvarāvajñayā sarvaṃ viphalaṃ ca bhaviṣyati.. 3.44 ..
1.3.d:
अपूज्या यत्र पूज्यंते पूजनीयो न पूज्यते..
त्रीणी तत्र प्रवर्तंते दुर्भिक्षं त्वया धर्ममजानताः..
ईश्वरावज्ञया सर्वं विफलं च भविष्यति.. 3.44 ..
1.3.m: Where the unworthy of worship are worshipped, and the one worthy of worship is not worshipped, / three things prevail there: famine […], by you who are ignorant of righteousness; / and through disrespect to the Lord, everything will come to naught.

1.3.s:
apūjyā yatra pūjyaṃ te pūjanīyo na pūjyate..
trīṇī tatra pravartaṃte durbhikṣaṃ maraṇaṃ bhayam.. 3.45 ..
1.3.d:
अपूज्या यत्र पूज्यं ते पूजनीयो न पूज्यते..
त्रीणी तत्र प्रवर्तंते दुर्भिक्षं मरणं भयम्.. 3.45 ..
1.3.m: Where the unworthy of worship are worshipped, and the one worthy of worship is not worshipped, / three things prevail there: famine, death, and fear.

1.3.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena mānanīyo vṛṣadhvajaḥ..
amānitānmaheśāttvāṃ mahadbhayamupasthitam.. 3.46 ..
1.3.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन माननीयो वृषध्वजः..
अमानितान्महेशात्त्वां महद्भयमुपस्थितम्.. 3.46 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, by every effort the bull-bannered lord should be honored. / Because Maheśa was not honored, a great danger has confronted you.

1.3.s:
adhunaiva vayaṃ sarve prabhavo na bhavāmahe..
bhavato durnnayeneva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā.. 3.47 ..
1.3.d:
अधुनैव वयं सर्वे प्रभवो न भवामहे..
भवतो दुर्न्नयेनेव नात्र कार्या विचारणा.. 3.47 ..
1.3.m: Right now, none of us have the power [to stop it]; / on account of your misconduct alone, no deliberation is to be made here.”

1.3.s:
viṣṇostadvacanaṃ śrutvā dakṣaściṃtāparo'bhavat..
vivirṇavadano bhūtvā tūṣṇīmāsīdbhuvi sthitaḥ.. 3.48 ..
1.3.d:
विष्णोस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दक्षश्चिंतापरोऽभवत्..
विविर्णवदनो भूत्वा तूष्णीमासीद्भुवि स्थितः.. 3.48 ..
1.3.m: Hearing that speech of Viṣṇu, Dakṣa became filled with anxiety. / His face drained of color, he remained silent, standing on the ground.

1.3.s:
vīrabhadro mahābāhū rudreṇaiva pracoditaḥ..
kālī kātyāyanīśānā cāmuṃḍā muṃḍamarddinī.. 3.49 ..
1.3.d:
वीरभद्रो महाबाहू रुद्रेणैव प्रचोदितः..
काली कात्यायनीशाना चामुंडा मुंडमर्द्दिनी.. 3.49 ..
1.3.m: The mighty-armed Vīrabhadra, impelled indeed by Rudra, / and Kālī, Kātyāyanī, Īśānā, Cāmuṇḍā, the crusher of Muṇḍa,

1.3.s:
bhadrakālī tathā bhadrā tvaritā vaiṣṇavī tathā..
navadurgādisahito bhūtānāṃ ca gaṇo mahān.. 3.50 ..
1.3.d:
भद्रकाली तथा भद्रा त्वरिता वैष्णवी तथा..
नवदुर्गादिसहितो भूतानां च गणो महान्.. 3.50 ..
1.3.m: And Bhadrakālī, Bhadrā, Tvaritā, and Vaiṣṇavī, / accompanied by the nine Durgās and the rest, and a great host of spirits,

1.3.s:
śākinī ḍākinī caiva bhūtapramathaguhyakāḥ..
tathaiva yoginīcakraṃ catuḥ ṣaṣṭyā samanvitam.. 3.51 ..
1.3.d:
शाकिनी डाकिनी चैव भूतप्रमथगुह्यकाः..
तथैव योगिनीचक्रं चतुः षष्ट्या समन्वितम्.. 3.51 ..
1.3.m: śākinīs, ḍākinīs, bhūtas, pramathas, and guhyakas, / and likewise the circle of sixty-four yoginīs,

1.3.s:
nijanmuḥ sahasā tatra yajñavāṭaṃ mahāprabham..
vīrabhadrasametā sarve haraparākramāḥ..
daśabāhavastrinetrā jaṭilā rudrabhūṣaṇāḥ.. 3.52 ..
1.3.d:
निजन्मुः सहसा तत्र यज्ञवाटं महाप्रभम्..
वीरभद्रसमेता सर्वे हरपराक्रमाः..
दशबाहवस्त्रिनेत्रा जटिला रुद्रभूषणाः.. 3.52 ..
1.3.m: suddenly set out for that sacrifice enclosure of great splendor, / together with Vīrabhadra, all possessing the prowess of Hara, / having ten arms, three eyes, matted hair, and Rudra's ornaments.

1.3.s:
pārṣadāḥ śaṃkarasyaite sarve rudrasvarūpiṇaḥ..
paṃcavaktrā nīlakaṃṭhāḥ sarve te śastrapāṇayaḥ.. 3.53 ..
1.3.d:
पार्षदाः शंकरस्यैते सर्वे रुद्रस्वरूपिणः..
पंचवक्त्रा नीलकंठाः सर्वे ते शस्त्रपाणयः.. 3.53 ..
1.3.m: These attendants of Śaṃkara all possessed the very form of Rudra; / they had five faces, blue throats, and all held weapons in their hands.

1.3.s:
chatracāmarasaṃvītāḥ sarve haraparākramāḥ..
daśabāhavastrinetrā jaṭilā rudrabhūṣaṇāḥ.. 3.54 ..
1.3.d:
छत्रचामरसंवीताः सर्वे हरपराक्रमाः..
दशबाहवस्त्रिनेत्रा जटिला रुद्रभूषणाः.. 3.54 ..
1.3.m: Surrounded by umbrellas and chowries, all having the prowess of Hara, / with ten arms, three eyes, matted hair, and Rudra's ornaments,

1.3.s:
ardhacaṃdradharāḥ sarve sarve caiva mahaujasaḥ..
sarve te vṛṣabhārūḍhāḥ sarve te veṣabhūṣaṇāḥ.. 3.55 ..
1.3.d:
अर्धचंद्रधराः सर्वे सर्वे चैव महौजसः..
सर्वे ते वृषभारूढाः सर्वे ते वेषभूषणाः.. 3.55 ..
1.3.m: all bearing the crescent moon, and all endowed with mighty energy, / all mounted upon bulls, and all adorned with his dress and ornaments.

1.3.s:
sahasrabāhurbhujagādhipairvṛtastrilocano bhīmabalo bhayāvahaḥ..
ebhiḥ sametaśca tadā mahātmā sa vīrabhadro'bhijagāma yajñam.. 3.56 ..
1.3.d:
सहस्रबाहुर्भुजगाधिपैर्वृतस्त्रिलोचनो भीमबलो भयावहः..
एभिः समेतश्च तदा महात्मा स वीरभद्रोऽभिजगाम यज्ञम्.. 3.56 ..
1.3.m: Endowed with a thousand arms, surrounded by serpent kings, three-eyed, of terrible strength, causing dread— / accompanied by these, the great-souled Vīrabhadra then marched to the sacrifice.

1.3.s:
yugyānāṃ ca sahasreṇa dvipramāṇena syaṃdanam..
siṃhānāṃ prayutenaiva vāhyamānaṃ ca tasya tat.. 3.57 ..
1.3.d:
युग्यानां च सहस्रेण द्विप्रमाणेन स्यंदनम्..
सिंहानां प्रयुतेनैव वाह्यमानं च तस्य तत्.. 3.57 ..
1.3.m: His chariot was drawn by a thousand teams of draught animals, / of double measure, drawn indeed by a million lions.

1.3.s:
tathaiva daṃśitāḥ siṃhā bahavaḥ pārśvarakṣakāḥ..
śārdūlā makarā matsyā gajāścaiva sahasraśaḥ..
chatrāṇi vividhānyeva cāmarāṇi tathaiva ca.. 3.58 ..
1.3.d:
तथैव दंशिताः सिंहा बहवः पार्श्वरक्षकाः..
शार्दूला मकरा मत्स्या गजाश्चैव सहस्रशः..
छत्राणि विविधान्येव चामराणि तथैव च.. 3.58 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, many armored lions served as flank-guards, / as did thousands of tigers, sea monsters, fish, and elephants, / and various kinds of parasols and chowries as well,

1.3.s:
mūrddhanidhriyamāṇāni sarvatogrāṇi sarvaśaḥ..
tato bherīmahānādāḥ śaṃkhāśca vividhasvanāḥ..
paṭahā gomukhāścaiva śrṛṃgāṇi vividhāni ca.. 3.59 ..
1.3.d:
मूर्द्धनिध्रियमाणानि सर्वतोग्राणि सर्वशः..
ततो भेरीमहानादाः शंखाश्च विविधस्वनाः..
पटहा गोमुखाश्चैव श्रृंगाणि विविधानि च.. 3.59 ..
1.3.m: carried fiercely on heads everywhere on every side. / Then came the great sounds of kettledrums, conchs of various tones, / paṭaha drums, gomukhas, and various horns.

1.3.s:
tato'vādyaṃta tānyeva ghanāni suṣirāṇi ca..
kalagānaparāḥ sarve sarve mṛdaṃgavādinaḥ.. 3.60 ..
1.3.d:
ततोऽवाद्यंत तान्येव घनानि सुषिराणि च..
कलगानपराः सर्वे सर्वे मृदंगवादिनः.. 3.60 ..
1.3.m: Then these solid and wind instruments were played; / all were intent on sweet melodies, and all were players of the mṛdaṅga drum.

1.3.s:
anekalāsyasaṃyuktā vīrabhadrāgratobhavan..
raṇavāditranirghoṣairjagarjuramitaujasaḥ.. 3.61 ..
1.3.d:
अनेकलास्यसंयुक्ता वीरभद्राग्रतोभवन्..
रणवादित्रनिर्घोषैर्जगर्जुरमितौजसः.. 3.61 ..
1.3.m: Engaged in manifold dances, they were in front of Vīrabhadra. / With the roaring sound of battle musical instruments, those of boundless energy roared.

1.3.s:
tena nādena mahatā nāditaṃ bhuvanatrayam..
evaṃ sarve samāyātā gaṇā rudrapraṇoditāḥ.. 3.62 ..
1.3.d:
तेन नादेन महता नादितं भुवनत्रयम्..
एवं सर्वे समायाता गणा रुद्रप्रणोदिताः.. 3.62 ..
1.3.m: By that great roar, the three worlds were made to resound. / Thus all the hosts arrived, urged on by Rudra,

1.3.s:
yajñavāṭaṃ ca dakṣasya vināśārthaṃ prahāriṇaḥ..
rajasā cā''vṛtaṃ vyoma tamasā ca vṛtā diśaḥ.. 3.63 ..
1.3.d:
यज्ञवाटं च दक्षस्य विनाशार्थं प्रहारिणः..
रजसा चा'ऽवृतं व्योम तमसा च वृता दिशः.. 3.63 ..
1.3.m: striking out to destroy the sacrificial enclosure of Dakṣa. / The sky was covered with dust, and the directions were enveloped in darkness.

1.3.s:
saptadvīpavatī pṛthvī cacāla sādrikānanā..
te dṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryyaṃ lokakṣayakaraṃ tadā.. 3.64 ..
1.3.d:
सप्तद्वीपवती पृथ्वी चचाल साद्रिकानना..
ते दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्य्यं लोकक्षयकरं तदा.. 3.64 ..
1.3.m: The earth with its seven continents trembled together with its mountains and forests. / Beholding then that great wonder bringing about the destruction of the worlds,

1.3.s:
uttasthuryugapatsarve devadaityaniśācarāḥ..
te vai dadṛśurāyāṃtīṃ rudrasenā bhayāvahām.. 3.65 ..
1.3.d:
उत्तस्थुर्युगपत्सर्वे देवदैत्यनिशाचराः..
ते वै ददृशुरायांतीं रुद्रसेना भयावहाम्.. 3.65 ..
1.3.m: the gods, Daityas, and night-roaming demons all rose up at once. / Indeed, they saw that dreadful army of Rudra approaching.

1.3.s:
pṛthvīṃ kecitsamāyātā gagane kecidāgatāḥ..
diśaśca pradiśaścaiva samāvṛtya tathāpare.. 3.66 ..
1.3.d:
पृथ्वीं केचित्समायाता गगने केचिदागताः..
दिशश्च प्रदिशश्चैव समावृत्य तथापरे.. 3.66 ..
1.3.m: Some came over the earth, some came in the sky, / while others arrived covering the cardinal and intermediate directions.

1.3.s:
anaṃtā hyakṣayāḥ sarve śūrā rudrasamā yudhi..
evaṃbhūtaṃ ca tatsainyaṃ rudraiśca parivāritam..
dṛṣṭvo curvismitāḥ sarve yāmo'dya śastrapāṇayaḥ.. 3.67 ..
1.3.d:
अनंता ह्यक्षयाः सर्वे शूरा रुद्रसमा युधि..
एवंभूतं च तत्सैन्यं रुद्रैश्च परिवारितम्..
दृष्ट्वो चुर्विस्मिताः सर्वे यामोऽद्य शस्त्रपाणयः.. 3.67 ..
1.3.m: All were endless, imperishable, heroic, equal to Rudra in battle. / Seeing that army constituted thus and surrounded by Rudras, / all said in amazement, "Let us go now, weapons in hand!"

1.3.s:
iṃdro hi gajamārūḍho mṛgārūḍhaḥ sadāgatiḥ..
yamo mahiṣamārūḍho yamadaṃḍasamanvitaḥ.. 3.68 ..
1.3.d:
इंद्रो हि गजमारूढो मृगारूढः सदागतिः..
यमो महिषमारूढो यमदंडसमन्वितः.. 3.68 ..
1.3.m: Indra mounted his elephant, the Wind mounted a deer, / Yama mounted a buffalo, equipped with the staff of Yama,

1.3.s:
kuberaḥ puṣpakārūḍhaḥ pāśī makarameva ca..
agnirbastamārūḍho nirṛtiḥ pretameva ca.. 3.69 ..
1.3.d:
कुबेरः पुष्पकारूढः पाशी मकरमेव च..
अग्निर्बस्तमारूढो निरृतिः प्रेतमेव च.. 3.69 ..
1.3.m: Kubera mounted the Puṣpaka, the Noose-bearer [Varuṇa mounted] a makara, / Agni mounted a goat, and Nirṛti mounted a corpse.

1.3.s:
tathānye surasaṃghāśca yakṣacāraṇaguhyakāḥ..
āruhya vāhanānyeva svānisvāni pratipinaḥ.. 3.70 ..
1.3.d:
तथान्ये सुरसंघाश्च यक्षचारणगुह्यकाः..
आरुह्य वाहनान्येव स्वानिस्वानि प्रतिपिनः.. 3.70 ..
1.3.m: Likewise, the other hosts of gods, yakṣas, cāraṇas, and guhyakas, / mounting their respective vehicles, were ready to resist.

1.3.s:
sveṣāmudyogamālokya dakṣaścāśrumukhastataḥ..
daṃḍavatpatito bhūmau sarvānevābhyabhāṣata.. 3.71 ..
1.3.d:
स्वेषामुद्योगमालोक्य दक्षश्चाश्रुमुखस्ततः..
दंडवत्पतितो भूमौ सर्वानेवाभ्यभाषत.. 3.71 ..
1.3.m: Beholding the preparations of his own people, Dakṣa, with a tearful face, / then fell flat on the ground like a staff and addressed them all:

1.3.s:
yuṣmadbalenaiva mayā yajñaḥ prāraṃbhito mahān..
satkarmasiddhaye yūyaṃ pramāṇaṃ sumahāprabhāḥ.. 3.72 ..
1.3.d:
युष्मद्बलेनैव मया यज्ञः प्रारंभितो महान्..
सत्कर्मसिद्धये यूयं प्रमाणं सुमहाप्रभाः.. 3.72 ..
1.3.m: "Only by your strength was this great sacrifice commenced by me. / You are the authority for the accomplishment of this noble rite, O ones of immense splendor!

1.3.s:
viṣṇo tvaṃ karmaṇaḥ sākṣādyajñānāṃ paripālakaḥ..
dharmasya vedagarbhasya brahmaṇyastvaṃ ca mādhava.. 3.73 ..
1.3.d:
विष्णो त्वं कर्मणः साक्षाद्यज्ञानां परिपालकः..
धर्मस्य वेदगर्भस्य ब्रह्मण्यस्त्वं च माधव.. 3.73 ..
1.3.m: O Viṣṇu, you are the protector of the rite in person and of sacrifices, / and you are devoted to the sacred law, the womb of the Vedas, and the brahmins, O Mādhava.

1.3.s:
tasmādrakṣā vidhātavyā yajñasyā'sya mahāprabho..
dakṣasya vacanaṃ śrutvā uvāca madhusūdanaḥ.. 3.74 ..
1.3.d:
तस्माद्रक्षा विधातव्या यज्ञस्याऽस्य महाप्रभो..
दक्षस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा उवाच मधुसूदनः.. 3.74 ..
1.3.m: Therefore, protection must be provided for this sacrifice, O great lord!" / Hearing the words of Dakṣa, the Slayer of Madhu said:

1.3.s:
mayā rakṣā vidhātavyā dharmasya paripālane..
tatsatyaṃ tu tvayoktaṃ hi kiṃ tu tasya vyatikramaḥ.. 3.75 ..
1.3.d:
मया रक्षा विधातव्या धर्मस्य परिपालने..
तत्सत्यं तु त्वयोक्तं हि किं तु तस्य व्यतिक्रमः.. 3.75 ..
1.3.m: "Protection must be provided by me in the safeguarding of sacred duty. / What you have said is indeed true, but a transgression of it

1.3.s:
yātastvadyaiva yajñasya yattvayoktaṃ sadāśivam..
naimiṣe'nimiṣakṣetre tadā kiṃ na smṛtaṃ tvayā.. 3.76 ..
1.3.d:
यातस्त्वद्यैव यज्ञस्य यत्त्वयोक्तं सदाशिवम्..
नैमिषेऽनिमिषक्षेत्रे तदा किं न स्मृतं त्वया.. 3.76 ..
1.3.m: has been committed today concerning your sacrifice, because of what you said of Sadāśiva. / At Naimiṣa, in that sacred field of the gods, why did you not remember then?

1.3.s:
yo'yaṃ rudro mahātejā yajñarūpaḥ sadāśivaḥ..
yajñabāhyaḥ kṛto mūḍha tacca durmmatritaṃ tava.. 3.77 ..
1.3.d:
योऽयं रुद्रो महातेजा यज्ञरूपः सदाशिवः..
यज्ञबाह्यः कृतो मूढ तच्च दुर्म्मत्रितं तव.. 3.77 ..
1.3.m: This Rudra of great splendor, Sadāśiva whose form is the sacrifice itself, / has been excluded from the sacrifice, O fool, and that was ill-counseled of you.

1.3.s:
rudrakopācca ko hyatra samartho rakṣaṇe tava..
na paśyāmi ca taṃ vipra tvāṃ vai rakṣati durmmatim.. 3.78 ..
1.3.d:
रुद्रकोपाच्च को ह्यत्र समर्थो रक्षणे तव..
न पश्यामि च तं विप्र त्वां वै रक्षति दुर्म्मतिम्.. 3.78 ..
1.3.m: And who here is able to protect you from the anger of Rudra? / I do not see anyone, O brahmin, who will protect you, foolish of mind.

1.3.s:
kiṃ karmma kimakarmmeti tanna paśyasi durmmate..
samarthaṃ kevalaṃ karmana bhaviṣyati sarvadā.. 3.79 ..
1.3.d:
किं कर्म्म किमकर्म्मेति तन्न पश्यसि दुर्म्मते..
समर्थं केवलं कर्मन भविष्यति सर्वदा.. 3.79 ..
1.3.m: What is action and what is non-action—that you do not see, O evil-minded one! / Action alone will never be efficacious at all times.

1.3.s:
seśvaraṃ karma viddhyotatsamarthatvena jāyate..
na hyanyaḥ karmmaṇo dātā īśvareṇa vinā bhavet.. 3.80 ..
1.3.d:
सेश्वरं कर्म विद्ध्योतत्समर्थत्वेन जायते..
न ह्यन्यः कर्म्मणो दाता ईश्वरेण विना भवेत्.. 3.80 ..
1.3.m: Know this: action joined with the Lord becomes effective. / For there can be no other bestower [of the fruit] of action without the Lord.

1.3.s:
īśvarasya ca ye bhaktāḥ śāṃtāstadgatamānasāḥ..
karmmaṇo hi phalaṃ teṣāṃ prayacchati sadāśivaḥ.. 3.81 ..
1.3.d:
ईश्वरस्य च ये भक्ताः शांतास्तद्गतमानसाः..
कर्म्मणो हि फलं तेषां प्रयच्छति सदाशिवः.. 3.81 ..
1.3.m: And to those who are devoted to the Lord, tranquil, with their minds fixed on him, / Sadāśiva gives the fruit of their action.

1.3.s:
kevalaṃ karma cāśritya nirīśvaraparā janāḥ..
nirayaṃ te ca gacchaṃti koṭiyajñaśatairapi.. 3.82 ..
1.3.d:
केवलं कर्म चाश्रित्य निरीश्वरपरा जनाः..
निरयं ते च गच्छंति कोटियज्ञशतैरपि.. 3.82 ..
1.3.m: Relying on action alone, people dedicated to a godless view / go to hell, even through hundreds of millions of sacrifices.

1.3.s:
punaḥ karmamayaiḥ pāśairbaddhā janmanijanmani..
nirayeṣu prapacyaṃte kevalaṃ karmmarūpiṇaḥ.. 3.83 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ prathame māheśvarakhaṇḍe kedārakhaṃḍe vīrabhadraprādurbhāvavarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ.. 3 ..

1.3.m:
Bound again by bonds consisting of action birth after birth, / those whose form is mere ritual action are roasted in the hells."
Thus ends the third chapter, named 'Description of the Appearance of Vīrabhadra', in the Kedārakhaṇḍa of the first [part], the Māheśvarakhaṇḍa, in the Skandamahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.
